title.title: HIVE fights boredom
title.body:
![HIVE fights boredom.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoreforma/23tvVWLRt8QAoFSqSaf9LG8Q8dJZSBTSCyPNjQ2Jca8bfkLusM6eQETRwUK5vVX35Uoj5.jpg)
While Web2 platforms struggle with how little they have to offer—since it’s all just more of the same—Web3—specifically HIVE—brings us something new practically every day. Either because these features have been around for a while but we’re only noticing them now, or because new applications are popping up like mushrooms in the fall.  ﾠ If I had to describe HIVE in a single word, I wouldn’t hesitate: diversity. You won’t die of boredom here. Want to write something substantial? There are various front-ends and communities available. From knitting to agriculture, through sports and art, there are communities for every field and interest. Want to write something lighter? There are various microblogging platforms available to share a thought, a joke, a meme, a song, a photo—whatever you want. Don’t want to write, just want to browse? There are hundreds and hundreds of posts published daily. Take the opportunity to curate, vote for what you like. Build your portfolio.  Want to play games? There’s no shortage of them. Want to trade? Head to Hive-Engine or Tribaldex. Buy, sell, trade, have fun. Sometimes I like to be on HIVE without posting, without curating, without interacting—nothing. Just looking around and exploring tools and apps that already exist or are being built.  Over the past few days, I’ve been drawn to several enthusiastic users who are raving about #hSnaps. I already knew they existed, but I’ve only recently given them the attention they deserve.  Any adjective used to describe @sagarkothari88’s apps will always fall short of the value he provides us. Of the various tools available, I’ve only managed to focus on two so far: #hSnaps and #hStats.
![main separator.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoreforma/23t7YN54ksTQz6cDk6AHxBSd4ghBk8wbX6hgyer5UZmWDgr8XD4C5vkyusk3phanKDNys.png) ### h[Snaps](https://hsnaps.sagarkothari88.one) ![sagarkothari88_4.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoreforma/EoCavCbVEd4jMzrs3YCsiQgjqbMZFwvexG7q967U518qwCmQVuPrEcmwKogmKycyqPw.png)
I’d like to highlight the functional, minimalist interface, which allows you to view four microblogging feeds simultaneously: Snaps, Waves, Threads, and Moments. This well-organized view is very useful for curating content. You can keep track of all the microblogging feeds without leaving the same screen. The colors and design are identical to PeakD, which makes the experience feel familiar.
![sagarkothari88_2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoreforma/23swfuNqtiNnjGkpubCJeXKemo2EvkA7X79rUctYnHXGGyVVG8sX6ZCmHo2XF2w6GEU6n.png)
Another thing I really liked is that posts are immediately directed to the microblogging platform of your choice, without having to constantly switch between them. It’s the ideal spot for my strategy, which also emphasizes diversity. I like all of them, so my goal is to distribute unique content across each one. ﾠ On Snaps (Peakd), I share music, science and technology, photos, and some catchphrases. On Waves (Ecency), only photos with a predominance of the color blue. On Threads (INLEO), I posted when I became fascinated—and profited—last summer with the trio of INLEO tokens: #SURGE #LEO #LSTR. On #hSnaps, I only recently made my first post, but I want to continue this unique way of sharing photos, here displayed individually in frames. I haven’t posted on Moments (Liketu) yet, but maybe something will come up soon. ![main separator.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoreforma/23t7YN54ksTQz6cDk6AHxBSd4ghBk8wbX6hgyer5UZmWDgr8XD4C5vkyusk3phanKDNys.png) ### h[Stats](https://hive-stats.sagarkothari88.one/) There are many analytics tools available on HIVE, some more complex and sophisticated than others. But #hStats presents the essentials in a simple, accessible, and user-friendly way. ![sagarkothari88_3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoreforma/23tGTdiBQXwRNG36nB1DEDbeLetowBRmQ9dA1Ao8q3CsRMW8tHridNFhGbghHwr6vve15.png)
We can check all our blockchain activity; what interested me most was “Curation Rewards.” All our curation activities cover the last seven days—that is, the content currently in the payment phase—organized in chronological order. It’s like a photo’s EXIF data. Here’s what matters to me: date, voting time after publication, vote value, reward value, and, crucially, the voting efficiency for each post. ![sagarkothari88_b.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoreforma/23tv8ninS4Mm3Qsneb8WrLhiG49whedXm9MYyFCPbhr1qWPXyP9Fi6unjzswZWpvNM4Nu.png)
The cherry on top of this suite of tools, this laboratory of useful applications—still to be fully explored—is undoubtedly the financial reporting. ﾠ A fine example of [transparency and rigor](https://sagarkothari88.one/#/expenses). The blockchain is an open ledger; all transactions are recorded and can be viewed, but aggregating all the information and making it available in this way is exemplary conduct that should be followed by everyone supported by DHF. Thank you @sagarkothari88. ![main separator.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoreforma/23t7YN54ksTQz6cDk6AHxBSd4ghBk8wbX6hgyer5UZmWDgr8XD4C5vkyusk3phanKDNys.png) ![cryptoreforma Banner animated 1440x510, 10fps.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoreforma/23tbRgmvUr2wnjV51FoK5G5vd3jCNyqru4LAdQRxZhWEHbTTXWn8xF7i7Kq7kddaBJCfc.gif)

title.title: Back home at last.  My Actifit Report Card: April 10 2026
title.body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/0651b9d1-cdfb-4c57-827d-a89b35794dc5.jpg) Back to my regular life. Back to my regular home. Back to my regular routine. Back to my regular job. Well, most of it is good. Anyways, I returned yesterday on the airplane. With all the flying and driving I only managed about 4800 steps so not enough to post. But I did get some good pictures of the mountains nearby So, I went from Edmonton which has large flat areas for cattle and crops and from the air it looks like this. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/09687156-a4cf-4688-bcc9-2960b1df3ffa.jpg) Then as we got closer to home it is easy to tell when getting close because you can see all the mountain ranges which look so much smaller from the air. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/16540a9e-8160-42d0-8ed9-bd79b0566cdc.jpg) However I did get a good picture of Mount Baker which made me happy. Looks different when looking up at it from the ground but still pretty cool to see even from the air. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/473e1938-609f-4718-8b64-5205b30a59c2.jpg) As for getting my steps today? Most of my steps were in the morning walking the dog and the rest were at work walking around the pharmacy. I can guarantee walking the dog was more pleasant. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/44042003-9731-4af5-aa7d-9939829bc6e7.jpg) Granted the sun was very bright in my eyes as I was walking around. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/69274a95-2c38-45dc-b3b0-f8a76cc2a8a6.jpg) There was a lot of dew on the grass so my feet got a little wet walking through the park. However, compared to walking through the snow? I'll take the dew every single time. Then walking through the actual park? ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/6613e6f9-e7da-4459-8e44-ff4aa6155165.jpg) Not too cold, not too hot, no rain and generally the perfect weather to walk the dog in. Work after that. ... Well, it was work. Then I came home and my wife had made dinner. Horray! Got to chat with my sons. Then in the evening sit down and enjoy a show with my wife. The only down side of my evening was the dog who kept barking at people and cars as they went by. Kind of annoying but honestly? I can handle that little slice of home much more than being on vacation or even away with my mom. Overall, a great day back at home and looking forward to working on my diet yet again in the days to come. ...and maybe even get back to the gym :)
_This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@terganftp/actifit-terganftp-20260411t010611238z)_

title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPxPg4asJaD3YFtCEnm3M5BJ9vek92C13QNQGYaLkn2Eh/1775849223810.jpg)


|**Esp**|**Eng** | 
| ------------ | ------------ |
|‎Hola amigos me es grato saludarles hoy viernes y traer para ustedes esté *LINDO Y COQUETO LLAVERO DE MARIPOSA** último trabajo para cerrar  la semana y prepararme para disfrutar esté fin de semana en compañía de mi familia, descansar y preparar comidas ricas, irnos de paseo,  recrearnos y distraernos un poco,  y tambien porque no,  ver una buena serie o película. Esté llavero  es de mariposa bordada con delicas y con lentejuelas, muy coqueto para usar como llavero o también como dije para adornar un bolso o morral.  Esté ya tiene dueño porque mi hija se apropio de él para adornar su morral escolar, aparte de que combina perfecto con su morral. A continuación les comparto  el proceso que espero les guste  y la lista de materiales.|Hello, friends! It’s a pleasure to greet you this Friday and share with you this *CUTE AND CHARMING BUTTERFLY KEYCHAIN**—my latest project to wrap up the week and get ready to enjoy the weekend with my family: relaxing, cooking delicious meals, going for walks, having fun, and taking our minds off things a bit—and why not, watching a good TV show or movie. This keychain features a butterfly embroidered with Delica beads and sequins—it’s very cute to use as a keychain or, as I mentioned, to decorate a purse or backpack. It already has an owner because my daughter claimed it to decorate her school backpack; plus, it matches her backpack perfectly. Below, I’ll share the process—which I hope you’ll like—and the list of materials.|


|**Materiales:**|**Materials:**|
| ------------ | ------------ |
|Delicas de la marca Miyuki colores: rosa viejo, plata,verde; hilo de nylon calibre delgado, tela Pop, aguja mostacillera, lentejuelas rosadas y verdes, perlas pequeñas,1 cristal mediano,.llavero, tijeras, pistola de silicón, patrón de mariposa.|Miyuki Delicas in the following colors: antique pink, silver, green; thin nylon thread, Pop fabric, beading needle, pink and green sequins, small pearls, 1 medium-sized crystal, keychain, scissors, hot glue gun, butterfly pattern.|


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma725PiGzbp7DHq8LLZxjGkSZbc7GmdD5b4rdGSM4uN3E/1775850129345.jpg)



|**Instrucciones:**|**Instructions:**|
| ------------ | ------------ |

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ7mdJPFcf1S8hMHsuF3YKDxmxF6UP6dkbSQufBxdVaty/1723506304106.png)

| Paso 1| Step 1|
| ------------ | ------------ | 
|El primer paso es que una vez que tengamos el patrón de la mariposa ya transferido en el papel lo colocamos sobre la tela de Pop y lo sujetamos con un alfiler. Enebramos el hilo de nylon en la aguja.|The first step is to place the butterfly pattern, once it has been transferred to the paper, on the Pop fabric and pin it in place. Thread the nylon thread through the needle.|

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQbw8DEEQrMcXXvDBEJsgnsBrGSUXFReCJc2WBr8qvyDq/1775850504963.jpg)




|Paso 2| Step 2|
| ------------ | ------------ |
|Como la tela es Pop es delgada para asegurar el hilo no transpase la tela le coloco una mostacilla en el extremo del hilo y aseguramos quedé bien sujeta. Luego introducimos la aguja en la parte de atrás donde deseamos comenzar a trabajar.|Since the Pop fabric is thin, to make sure the thread doesn’t poke through, I put a bead on the end of the thread and make sure it’s securely fastened. Then I insert the needle into the back where I want to start working.|

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdBy2hZPQXwL2Wd5cKHJ1jsoiDuEzEqQqpxPqXeUrpmgS/1775850733114.jpg)


|Paso 3| Step 3|
| ------------ | ------------ |
|Comencé a colocar toda  la orilla de delicas verdes, lo hice con la técnica de costura de mano  pespunte, comencé con cuatro delicas y fuí colocando todas las delicas alrededor.|I started attaching the entire edge with green Delica beads, using the hand-stitching technique known as backstitching. I began with four Delica beads and continued attaching them all around.|


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS9S4TwFsysK9vNEFGArSWpn9YTWJzMmAXj4zoa1VV2pF/1775851072772.jpg)


|Paso 4| Step 4|
| ------------ | ------------ |
|Una vez colocada todas las delicas de esa ala de la mariposa, para darle más soporte y estabilidad de la ala introduje nuevamente por todas las delicias la aguja y así con doble hilo quedan más derechas las delicas.|Once all the Delica beads were in place on that wing of the butterfly, I threaded the needle through all the beads again to give the wing more support and stability; using double thread helps keep the Delica beads straighter.|

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYZTWWc5PDg5FiYnwbfwC4Jq3CwShia1qFrztmoKVBQbK/1775851260050.jpg)



| Paso 5| Step 5|
| ------------ | ------------ |
|En la imágen observamos el trabajo de la segunda y tercera al aplicando la misma técnica de bordado con el punto pespunte.|In the image, we can see the work of the second and third students using the same backstitch embroidery technique.| 


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbZrFe36cLBpj2VL6MEXvmPJhSkfR9FTG7LiNv8rNHnkE/1775851455370.jpg)



|Paso 6| Step 6|
| ------------ | ------------ |
|También podemos observar el trabajo de bordado de toda la línea que define toda la mariposa y las divisiones de sus alas.|We can also see the embroidery work along the entire outline that defines the butterfly and the divisions of its wings.|


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQcUNnv3QbYrV4rBxQoLRHUwYCeo7K3LrtX1CymXiGK96/1775851984395.jpg)



| Paso 7| Step 7|
| ------------ | ------------ |
|Para el cuerpo de la mariposa  dispuse tres perlas y las llevé de extremo a extremo donde el espacio que va definido el cuerpo de la mariposa.|For the butterfly's body, I arranged three pearls and placed them end to end along the outline of the butterfly's body.|

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeTAwcnUgP8muorusuXPbzMdECxbuMsggucSz7TJB41Kd/1775852158125.jpg)


| Paso 8| Step 8|
|------------ | ------------ |
|Para la cabeza posicione la aguja en el lugar indicado y dispuse una lentejuela verde, un cristal verde y una mostacilla introduje la aguja de regreso por el cristal y por la lentejuela para sujetar las piezas con la mostacilla.|For the head, I positioned the needle where indicated and placed a green sequin, a green bead, and a small bead; then I threaded the needle back through the bead and the sequin to secure the pieces with the small bead.|

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZECfVRKc9nCb1sFzwVvfzXJ96oTjdGSb4U3ug1tcKag1/1775852586928.jpg)


| Paso 9| Step 9|
|------------ | ------------ |
|Quite todo el papel Bond y despeje el área de las alas para comenzar a bordarlas.|Remove all the Bond paper and clear the wing area so you can start sewing the wings.|


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWkxPjr33yNp6xsZgbHvvYPhGEgNyNp2Eqf7UmUPJVoNt/1775852703657.jpg)



| Paso 10| Step 10|
|------------ | ------------ |
|Fui colocando las lentejuelas rosadas de esta ala sujetandolas con delicas color rosa vieja y cubrí todo el espacio del ala.|I attached the pink sequins to this wing, securing them with antique pink delica beads, and covered the entire surface of the wing.|

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQvQ9G7mfZazK4Vx8UZY3TSQthivM8QyX8DpLmJ5qZXKs/1775852934599.jpg)


| Paso 11| Step 11|
|------------ | ------------ |
|Borde todo el área de la segunda ala con delicas color rosa viejo.|.Embroider around the entire edge of the second wing using old rose-colored Delica beads.|


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZxboRuEedFzSuKbQSS6xSG5CAV3tQ5mtZuTa4ZK9nvgo/1775853061113.jpg)


| Paso 12| Step 12|
|------------ | ------------ |
|Para el última ala decidí colocarle lentejuelas verdes para eso tome grupos de 5 o más lentejuelas y las fui uniendo y colocando que cubrieran todo el área del ala.|For the last wing, I decided to add green sequins, so I took groups of five or more sequins, attached them together, and placed them so they covered the entire surface of the wing.|

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRoQ5MKmx6zXHbHdokG6P1AkKgSZweBzkvu2ygrvy7BCc/1775853432088.jpg)




| Paso 13| Step 13|
|------------ | ------------ |
|En las imágenes observamos el proceso del trabajo de bordado del otro lado de las alas.|In the images, we can see the embroidery process on the underside of the wings.|


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaTm74pjMu3Yb4VBnuucv5htz3qzENEjaeiHvJzHVhpFT/1775853727761.jpg)


| Paso 14| Step 14|
|------------ | ------------ |
|Uní el llavero a la mariposa cosiendolo con hilo.|I attached the keychain to the butterfly by sewing it on with thread.|

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZddovVek91KbtnSg5p7bjueeouNqGHTPnvY9yVrjoUFn/1775853998845.jpg)


| Paso 15| Step 15|
|------------ | ------------ |
|Coloqué silicón liquido en la parte posterior y coloqué otra pieza de tela Pop,. dejé secar y recorté por toda la línea de la mariposa.|I applied liquid silicone to the back and attached another piece of Pop fabric. I let it dry and cut along the entire outline of the butterfly.|

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSxCBnLvpwomWkutUfEE2CHULzij7ZRuPQB9fQ9LsnaXC/1775854496547.jpg)



| Paso 16| Step 16|
|------------ | ------------ |
|Con hilo color melón cosí por toda la orilla delicas en técnica de costura sobrehilado pero con delicas.|Using melon-colored thread, I sewed Delicas along the entire edge using the overcasting technique, but with Delicas.|

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPe2pD4fBG3BhtxYYXEguQtezN6FC2x7APD2BhuCMAdzM/1775855262373.jpg)

title.title: Our Fri-Yay!
title.body:
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ifarmgirl/23xehVMGWQYnxRM6Xoj9ruvvWFf5aZ7pjo9MQQ9eiPqDJARaG5t6Kh6KwNTNEyi9bPYPE.jpg
We drove to the other town yesterday for a couple of errands. First, we dropped by my sister's workplace to get our parcels. From there, we proceeded to the RHU for my vaccination, then went home to BC to pick up some stuff and install the mini gates in the yard. We had to because the neighbors' dogs and chickens are intruding on it and making a mess. Dad wasn't around as he attended an aunt's entombment. After watering the plants, we headed to the valley for groceries and yep, lunch. It was early afternoon (1 pm), and we were quite famished. Meanwhile, Yongi was in a *lazy* mode. He was pretty quiet when we settled into our table by the balcony at the Cafe. He seemed tired or something. He slumped on the chair, his eyes fixated on the street below.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ifarmgirl/23wMaSrtck5AZxEmARZ8kr3d7gRymiiGfS5XNUv8eHqxLucWvXdq7BkASfcnHsRLuKwau.jpg
Alas, he got quite excited when our meals came. He was up quickly and started sniffing the sandwich. There are veggies in it, that's why.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ifarmgirl/242Y5ppyiNkp73xvYJocCvW6Ps61dWdmCF5gDX3eJWbx6nL3SQzMcZyXjW2DexFJt5LB5.jpg
||| |-|-| |https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ifarmgirl/Eou9ciZ4HXep2E5XP4xh7sLoD5erhpJC4uTZRVhEAkbYb9GdVJhZtGtZbz62oA8Ynuu.jpg|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ifarmgirl/Eonm2RPrAr2U3joAUb9hYPamRAnxExi6iyjAHMTXqJVfc6y8cwcDfPqUHVrCCtmqjuh.jpg|
We shared everything, well, except the bowl of Ramyun, which the hubby had for himself. It looked appetizing but very spicy, which is a no-no for me. He gave one of the chickens to our LilGuy, removing the skin and bones, that is.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ifarmgirl/23y8xQpMKKTEADtit47Ew362jhERx1yaMcvn5SNCVekCgwgdr5cr8epd1heP8fNDXXkpv.jpg
So we ate slowly, savoring each bite, as if it were the last meal in the world, lol! Joke aside, it was one of those times when we didn't feel the need to rush. Well, we had some meaningful conversations, too. Result?
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ifarmgirl/AK9QA7B6X2bprGNmunbpjvGvsXY86zcuJbmM53tnDW88nA9cJf7k3koi1ekoxUD.jpg
We emptied the plates. We were really hungry, eh!😅 Anyway, one last photo of our little boy before we left our seats.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ifarmgirl/245cYhmVrxc2ZYFwBjZBzzTjQRoR87D4vyfgoUPbPBoh2kpA4Y6UwtqAhvUBr427qKPcF.jpg
From there, we took the road to my father-in-law's place for a visit, dropping by the veggie center for some greens, romaine, lettuce, beans, snacks, etc, which we shared with the old man. We stayed three hours there over chit-chats and such, before we left and came back home to DD. A day well-spent, I say!
--- --- **

>Smile... laugh often... love more... be grateful always!** --- ---

title.title: Vanja Dragojević - Hofenhajm
title.body:
Partizan midfielder Vanja Dragojević has attracted interest from German side Hoffenheim, according to Direktno.

As reported, representatives of the Bundesliga club were present during Partizan’s match against Čukarički, closely monitoring Dragojević’s performance in a defensive midfield role.

According to available information, if an agreement between the clubs is reached, Dragojević may not immediately join the Bundesliga squad. Instead, he could spend his first season on loan. One option is to remain at Partizan, while clubs from the Netherlands and Belgium are also being considered as potential destinations.

Dragojević made his first-team debut for Partizan just over a year ago and quickly established himself as a regular starter.

During the summer, he signed a professional contract that includes a €15 million release clause. However, due to the club’s financial situation, Partizan is not considered to be in a strong negotiating position, making such a fee difficult to achieve.

This season, Dragojević has worn the captain’s armband in most matches, largely due to the limited playing time of official captain Bibars Natcho.

Interest in the young midfielder comes at a time when several Partizan players have attracted attention from European clubs. Recently, Andrej Kostić was transferred to Milan, while Nikola Simić and Bogdan Kostić have also drawn interest.

In addition to Hoffenheim, Spanish side Villarreal has previously shown interest in Dragojević. Although there is no confirmed official offer at this stage, negotiations could intensify in the near future.

title.title: My New Experience The Story Leveling Up the Magmaforged Card
title.body:
Today I had a cool experience in  Splinterlands game. I have been playing game for while now. I have been trying  make my card collection stronger. Today was a day for me because I was able level up one of my favorite cards the Magmaforged card. This whole experience was really fun. I learned a lot from it. So today I want tell you all about this card and what it was like level it up.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWtzWcW98qjgt2xXFWEFdRX1mwik5XGKUNJASRt7NjtfN/1775868753208.jpg)

🔥 Introduction to the Magmaforged Card

The Magmaforged card is a Fire Element card. I think this card looks really cool. It has a lot of power. It is really effective. When you look at design card you can tell that it is made fire and lava. The body of the card is made lava there are flames burning all around it.

The main things about this card are:

* Mana Cost is 3, which means you can use it without spending much.

* Attack Type is Ranged, which means you can attack from away.

* Health is Medium. It gets better when you level it up.

* Speed is really good so it can attack quickly.

This card is really good in battles where you need to attack and weaken your opponent.

⚔️ Magmaforgeds Abilities

When you level up the Magmaforged card it gets abilities that make it even stronger.

* At first the card does not have any abilities but it is still a good ranged unit.

* When it gets to level 3 and 4 it gets an ability that makes it more effective. It can really hurt your enemy.

* When it gets to level 5 and above its attack power and survivability get a lot better so it can stay in battle for a time.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWMJ5BbH4TNsvTg83vbWeDZJVTLFfVq9dm6dEHHixoP2M/1775868753335.jpg)

📈 My Leveling Up Experience

Today I combined 5 Magmaforged cards. Leveled it up to level 4. When I clicked the combine button a warning message came up. It said that I could not undo this action. This was a moment for me. I wanted to make sure I was making the decision. I knew that my cards would be locked for 3 days and I would not be able to separate them.. I still did it. I was able level it up level 4.

Changes After Leveling Up

After I leveled up the Magmaforged card I noticed some changes:

* Its attack power got a lot better.

* Its health got a little better.

* It got an ability.

* It did a lot better in battle.

Now the Magmaforged card is not a card it is an important part of my team.

💡 Why Is It Important to Level Up Magmaforged?

You might wonder if it is really necessary to level up all your cards.. From my experience leveling up cards like the Magmaforged card is really important.

* It can deal a lot of damage without using much mana.

* It works well with other Fire cards.

* It can help you defeat your opponent when it gets to a high level.

🧠 My Strategy

I usually use the card like this:

* I put a tank in the front line.

* I put the card in the back line.

* I use it to weaken my enemys team.

I have won a lot of matches using this strategy.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUpsAsgvqCMqro6bhX1axuhRZWHyMueP4spMcxqRmtL2m/1775868753425.jpg)

😍 My Feelings

To be honest today was a happy day for me. Leveling up a card might seem like a thing but it is really important for people who play Splinterlands. When I look at my level 4 Magmaforged card I feel really proud of myself. It is not a card it is the result of my hard work.

🚀 Future Plans

I am planning to:

* Level up the card even more.

* Make my Fire deck stronger.

* Get a rank.

The Magmaforged card is a great card, especially for people who like to play with the Fire Element. Today I leveled it up. I realized how important it is make the right decisions at right time. This experience has given me a lot encouragement. I hope do even better future.

If you play Splinterlands you should definitely try out the card. If you have than one copy do not hesitate to level it up. Its power is really amazing!

title.body:
![PSX_20260411_074747.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWQ4u34Nm2fDm9igRAdKoxbnsPTqYesXcMeBFQeRJXrGa/PSX_20260411_074747.jpg)
![hive dividers-04.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdvc788wxsBSQHY3z21o3wSTU7hqRnyYc2JFEn2pEYSev/hive%20dividers-04.png)
That morning, the streets were still quiet, even though activity had begun to pick up. At the edge of the intersection, an old motorcycle stopped for a moment. It wasn't just any motorcycle, but one that had been modified to carry fresh fish. On the left and right sides, large, slightly yellowed plastic containers hung, a sign of being used for years to weather the heat and rain.

The distinctive aroma of the sea seemed to be carried along, even though the beach wasn't far away. Beneath its simplicity, the motorcycle held a story of struggle. Every day, its rider had to wake up earlier than most, set out to catch fish, and then travel from one place to another to sell their catch.

It wasn't always easy. Sometimes the fish sold out quickly, but oftentimes they had to return home with leftovers. Scorching heat, sudden rain, and even rough roads were all part of the journey. But the wheels kept turning, just like the unwavering spirit.

Amidst the hustle and bustle of more modern vehicles, the motorcycle kept moving, carrying not only fish but also the hope of keeping the kitchen steaming at home. Every drop of sweat that fell on the road testified to a labor unseen by many.

Seeing it made me realize that sustenance can come from anywhere, as long as you're willing to put in the effort. It doesn't have to be luxurious, it doesn't have to be perfect. The important thing is to keep moving, like that motorbike faithfully delivering fresh fish to the hands of customers.

Simple, yet meaningful.
![hive dividers-04.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdvc788wxsBSQHY3z21o3wSTU7hqRnyYc2JFEn2pEYSev/hive%20dividers-04.png)

title.title: Endless ignorance
title.body:
</center> 
<center>-**Amos Bronson Alcott**-</center>

----------------------------------
-------------------------------------------------------

How did the Earth come to be populated by so many species?

No, don't try to explain it... Nobody knows. There may be many hypotheses, theories, beliefs... But I don't know, nobody knows.

And so many ethnicities within our own species—don't try to tell me it's the climate, migrations, mutations... I don't know, you don't know...

Life on Earth is a mystery, the existence of Earth is a mystery... Don't tell me it's the Big Bang theory, don't tell me it's the Bible... No, and no... I don't know, you don't know.

The earth was not only populated by people and millions of species of flora and fauna, which I know nothing about, but little by little the human race created different agreements for coexistence, such as language and beliefs... So many languages, so many dialects, and I only know my own, Spanish. I have very basic notions of English... I am ignorant; without the help of technology, I wouldn't be able to communicate in any other language with a human being who speaks to me, for example, in Chinese or Bulgarian.

For every detail I know about a particular topic, there are many more details I don't know. For example, I might know some articles of my country's labor law, but the rest are like I'm reading them for the first time.

I couldn't calculate the 10th root of a decimal number without a calculator, nor the process for solving a nuclear physics problem, and probably not even something simpler related to those topics.

I don't know human anatomy in true detail, nor all the processes the body carries out to stay alive... I know almost nothing, and for every topic that comes to mind, there are millions of things I don't know...

I don't know how to perform technical or fundamental analysis of a cryptocurrency... I don't know how to use even half the functions of the cryptocurrency exchange I use; I only go to the basics, to what I need, and that's it. I don't know anything else. I really know almost nothing about it.

I'm so ignorant that I'm unaware of all the topics I'm ignorant about. What I do know is that everything I don't know is infinite... 🥴

![IMG-20260410-WA0051.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/verdesmeralda/Eoc7aFF4NEhPeBhjGL6NzYgFNUj6bnWXWtmi3CsZ71VZg2Ein6uYp47YqBsiKWVLWQP.jpg)

If I try to ignore how ignorant I am, I'll be closing the door to new ideas and opportunities for growth. Do you agree?

title.body:
>

<center>
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/irenenavarroart/23uFS1Gji5W8fJdMm6ZhHs1X3tL54gpd6LzVw7nu1HRm33bQajLbao6qB73dRCjyFiLhp.jpg
[Source](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/mujer-en-blanco-camiseta-sin-mangas-acostado-cama-5871524/)
</center>

Creo que mantener la palabra es algo muy importante, tanto para tener buenas relaciones con los demás como para uno mismo, pero para mi lo mas importante de cumplir lo que se dice viene de la propia satisfacción personal y no de cumplir las expectativas de otros, con los años he aprendido que debo que cuidar mucho lo que digo frente a otros o los compromisos que se adquiero de manera pública, porque hay que hacer que las palabras tengan peso, pero ese peso siempre viene de la mi misma conciencia, por lo tanto e aprendido y sigo aprendiendo a cuidar de los que digo y quien lo digo, por supuesto debe haber una que otra ocasión en las que pude haberme equivocado pero el esfuerzo siempre ha estado allí en mi manera de ser responsable frente a mis palabras.

> I believe that keeping one's word is very important, both for having good relationships with others and for oneself, but for me the most important thing about fulfilling what one says comes from personal satisfaction and not from meeting the expectations of others. Over the years I have learned that I must be very careful about what I say in front of others or the commitments I make publicly, because words must carry weight, but that weight always comes from my own conscience. Therefore, I have learned and continue to learn to be careful about what I say and who I say it to. Of course, there may have been some occasions where I have been wrong, but the effort has always been there in my way of being responsible for my words.

<center>
https://i.imgur.com/CWx3RWZ.png
</center>

Algunas veces también me he sentido un poco presionada por mis propias palabras, cuando me establezco metas o retos a mis mismas y los hago de conocimiento de otros, pero al mismo tiempo no temo defraudar a nadie sino a misma, en tanto que el esfuerzo que hago también es motivado por mi determinación, no me gusta que las expectativas de otras dirijan mi destino y tampoco me gusta que alguien mas me diga que no puedo hacer algo, incluso prefiero ser yo misma la que no tenga expectativas en cierta circunstancia pero no dejarme llevar no por el que dirán ni por la vergüenza de que mi fracaso sea público.

> Sometimes I've also felt a little pressured by my own words, when I set goals or challenges for myself and make them known to others, but at the same time I'm not afraid of disappointing anyone but myself, since the effort I make is also motivated by my determination. I don't like the expectations of others to direct my destiny, and I also don't like someone else telling me that I can't do something. I even prefer to be the one who has no expectations in a certain circumstance, but not to let myself be carried away by what others will say or by the shame of my failure being public.

<center>
https://i.imgur.com/CWx3RWZ.png
</center>

No obstante, en mi blog muchas veces he compartido metas u objetivos que no siempre he cumplido, sobre todo cuando se hacen dinámicas  de año nuevo por mencionar un ejemplo, esto definitivamente me hace sentir un poco mal pero tampoco me siento presionada, pero por otro lado cuando cuando comparto mis creaciones a crochet y manifiesto el deseo de hacer un reto personal de figuras de algún tipo que involucra mucho esfuerzo y tiempo, me agrada ver como en los comentarios las personas me apoyan y me dicen que esperan con ansias ver la siguiente figura de ese reto hecho realidad, esa es una motivación nueva que solo puedo experimentar gracias a Hive, pero que no me he atrevido a experimentar en ninguna otra red social, pues aquí modo la comunidad es mas respetuosa sobre todo en el nicho de las artes y artesanías.

> However, on my blog I've often shared goals or objectives that I haven't always achieved, especially when there are New Year's challenges, for example. This definitely makes me feel a little bad, but I don't feel pressured either. On the other hand, when I share my crochet creations and express my desire to take on a personal challenge of creating figures of some kind that involves a lot of effort and time, I like to see how people support me in the comments and tell me they're eagerly awaiting the next figure in that challenge. That's a new kind of motivation that I can only experience thanks to Hive, but that I haven't dared to try on any other social network, because here the community is more respectful, especially in the arts and crafts niche.

title.body:
## I'm back! Shadowhunters.

That's right, after a well-deserved week's vacation, I'm back hunting spectral shadows. No more long naps; there's work to be done in the streets. In my absence, the shadows have multiplied, now a much larger army, preparing for the battle of the century, so we must do the same.

It is our duty to face with courage and determination those dangers that lurk in the shadows, in order to protect the innocent who depend on our strength. Every individual within our group must stand firm in their convictions, fight with unwavering discipline, and act with strategic intelligence to thwart the dark plans that seek to engulf us.

We are not alone in this arduous battle; united, we form an intense flame that vigorously combats the darkness that seeks to devour us without mercy.

We must remember that every shadow we manage to capture represents a victory and a spark of renewed hope for our entire army. We are not allowed to let fear paralyze us, nor to let despair lead us to indifference in the face of suffering.

True light resides deep within our inner being, and with that radiance we will continue to move forward. We are the proud Shadowhunters!

In this eternal battle against the dark forces, we are the shining torch that illuminates a world shrouded in desolation and abandonment.

No matter the circumstances, we are always prepared to emerge victorious. For there is no doubt that we are the best and most skilled Shadowhunters in existence.

It is only a matter of time before we fully transform into the professional Shadowhunter Legion. In this dedicated and courageous community, we bring light and guidance to all those who are lost and trapped in the deepest darkness.

Together, we will reach Round 500, and by then, we will have become the experts we aspire to be: The Best Shadowhunters.

title.title: PROFESSIONAL, AMATEUR AND BEGINNER SKATEBOARDING
title.body:
The idea was simple: to put a professional skater, an amateur, and a beginner side-by-side.

And that's where skateboarding shines.

Seeing such different skill levels skating together shows exactly what makes this lifestyle so unique: it doesn't matter if you're landing technical tricks or just trying to balance. Everyone is part of it.

Damascena, with all his experience, was there naturally executing his lines, while the rest were evolving, making mistakes, trying again… and having fun. That's the point.

One of the most memorable moments was when he landed a **varial heel with a broken board**. This sums up a lot about skateboarding: improvisation, adaptation, and overcoming challenges. No matter the conditions, the ride continues.

More than technique, we have connection. Skateboarding is this exchange. It's learning together.

And of course… it wasn't going to stop there.

<iframe id=\

allowfullscreen></iframe>


Since we were already together, that classic idea came up:

“what if we tried something even crazier?”

Damascena issued the challenge:

**Go up with a nose manual, make the turn, and land with a nollie flip.**

Simple in theory. In practice... another story.

And there was an important detail: he was wearing a new pair of Tá na Base pants. Those situations where you already know something might go wrong 😅

He tried. He went for it. And almost...

In the end, the nollie flip didn't happen, the fall did... and the board broke.

![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbtjn85aWmoy5aJfhsQensp1HQT7p5fn63FrSsC4u8wHQ/6bBanogy8hU.jpeg)

Maybe the first time someone \

😂

But what remains from all this is the constant evolution and the will to try. Not being afraid to fail and, above all, enjoying the process.

Damascena represents this very well. No matter the level, you can always go further, try something new.

And perhaps that is the greatest essence of skateboarding.


<iframe id=\

allowfullscreen></iframe>



----

# SKATE PROFISSIONAL, AMADOR E INICIANTE

A ideia era simples: colocar lado a lado um skatista profissional, um amador e uma iniciante.

E é aí que o skate brilha.

Ver níveis tão diferentes andando juntos mostra exatamente o que faz esse lifestyle ser tão único: não importa se você está acertando manobras técnicas ou só tentando se equilibrar. Todo mundo faz parte.

Damascena com toda sua experiência, estava lá mandando suas linhas com naturalidade, enquanto o restante ia evoluindo, errando, tentando de novo… e se divertindo. Esse é o ponto.

Um dos momentos mais marcantes foi quando ele acertou um **varial heel com o shape quebrado**. Isso resume muito do skate: improviso, adaptação e superação. Não importa a condição o rolê continua.

Mais do que técnica temos a conexão. Skate é essa troca. É aprender junto.

E claro… não ia parar por aí.

Aproveitando que já estávamos juntos, surgiu aquela ideia clássica:
“e se a gente tentasse algo mais insano?”

Damascena lançou o desafio:
**subir de nose manual, fazer a curva e descer de nollie flip.**

Simples na teoria. Na prática... outra história.

E ainda tinha um detalhe importante: ele estava usando uma calça nova da Tá na Base. Aquelas situações onde você já sabe que alguma coisa pode dar errado 😅

Ele tentou. Foi pra cima. E quase...

No final, não veio o nollie flip, veio a queda... e o shape quebrado.


Talvez a primeira vez que alguém “troca um shape por uma calça nova” 😂

MAs o que fica disso tudo e a evolução constante e a vontade de tentar.  não ter medo de errar e, principalmente, curtir o processo

Damascena representa muito bem isso. Não importa o nível sempre dá pra ir além, testar algo novo

E talvez essa seja a maior essência do skate.

title.body: It has been a while since I ate a plate of Roasted Chicken Rice here in Miri city. So, while here in Miri, I went to a chicken rice shop to have a plate of chicken rice. \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ Usually, I prefer the roasted chicken rice. Good Morning to all my wonderful friends. How has your week been? It is the weekend again. Time flies.

/> Rong Kee HK Roasted Chicken Rice ================================ This chicken rice shop is quite special because it is air conditioned. Most chicken rice shops here in Miri are not located in a restaurant that is air conditioned. This one is.

/> It is still early,, and not many customers are here eating lunch yet. So, I was here quite early. That is not my table. Some other family ate here and left already after that. A plate of tofu with some fried garlic on top, with some peanut soup. The tofu has to be steamed and hot.
/> This is no ordinary peanut soup. It is mixed with chicken meat inside. It is best consumed when it is hot.
/> Roasted pork and noodles My wife ordered this.

/> I ordered a plate of roasted chicken rice. This is usually what I order at a restaurant that specializes in chicken rice. The soup is plain but hot. It has some taste but not a lot. I also have a cup of hot coffee.
/> The best chicken rice has rice that is steamed with chicken essence ( chicken oil ). The meat has to be tender and with very little fat. I don't really eat the fatty bits.
/> Thank you very much for reading my post. Have a great Saturday @luueetang YouTube :Www.youtube.com/luueejanice Tiktok: www.tiktok.com/@luueejanice

title.title: Broken Promises For Profit - ZAPFIC50 FRIDAY (4/10/26) | Prompt: cheat (engañar)
title.body: >\n\nFor this week's ZAPFIC50 Friday challenge, I was presented with the prompt \

. Wow, this is a loaded one. The spouse or other party in a relationship is usually what comes to mind with this word. I chose a story more aligned with an event that individuals may have experienced during their lifetime. Not everyone that approaches you operate in good faith. They may have ulterior motives contrary to your own. Knowing that's at stake in any situation goes a long way to avoiding misunderstandings in the future. 

This challenge by @felt-buzz is to tell as near a complete story as you can in exactly fifty (50) words. I hope you enjoy.

**My story is below:**

<center>![rinreMr4T-dividerline-Resized.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/justclickindiva/23tv8hvCs9XJ6jvySDHoq8PqyG4YaAkLbtNT5rMVejff3KMvBDdAtpvqbHwZFE1k5MRdW.png)</center>

Confusion and fear heightened among family members gathered to celebrate their ancestors' property ownership milestone.

Great-grandson, Roosevelt, slammed the phone down.

Family raced to the homestead, arriving minutes before bulldozers uprooted historical soil.

*\

> Para el reto del viernes de ZAPFIC50 de esta semana, me propusieron el tema «engañar». Vaya, este sí que da que pensar. Lo primero que suele venir a la mente con esta palabra es la pareja o la otra persona en una relación. He elegido una historia más acorde con una situación que cualquiera puede haber vivido a lo largo de su vida. No todas las personas que se te acercan actúan de buena fe. Pueden tener motivos ocultos contrarios a los tuyos. Ser consciente de que eso está en juego en cualquier situación ayuda mucho a evitar malentendidos en el futuro. Este reto de @felt-buzz consiste en contar una historia lo más completa posible en exactamente cincuenta (50) palabras. Espero que lo disfrutes. **A continuación mi historia.**
![rinreMr4T-dividerline-Resized.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/justclickindiva/23tv8hvCs9XJ6jvySDHoq8PqyG4YaAkLbtNT5rMVejff3KMvBDdAtpvqbHwZFE1k5MRdW.png)
**Promesas incumplidas por el afán de lucro** La confusión y el miedo se intensificaron entre los familiares reunidos para celebrar el hito que suponía la propiedad de la finca de sus antepasados. Roosevelt, el bisnieto, colgó el teléfono de un golpe. La familia se apresuró a acudir a la finca, llegando unos minutos antes de que las excavadoras arrasaran aquel terreno histórico. *«No se atreverían a estafarnos nuestra herencia»,* exclamó Mildred enfurecida. «Parece que los promotores nos han engañad

body.title: Cover Art
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcN1bCqSrFiNdzw8bPB7i1h5MAnVjBSmP3LoZzF1fH1N3/img_7714.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY52JAsU2UNkvUxLmp9znBjbyesV6ngkx68DMTGdBkiUm/img_7713.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdoQsjMuaFeWaPVrn1ipRPhebqejucEbEGrejbCppvxU7/img_7712.png)

I don’t just design music covers… I design how your sound feels before it’s heard 🎧

For these covers, I worked with one core idea:
same identity, different emotions.

Instead of changing everything, I kept the structure consistent and let color + energy tell the story.

🟢 Army Green — calm, controlled, reflective
🔴 Red Riot — intense, loud, full of energy
🟣 Indigo — deep, moody, introspective

That repeating face effect?
It represents sound waves, thoughts, and different layers of the artist… like the music is literally expanding outwards.

And here’s the key:
When people see it, they don’t just see art…
They feel something.

That feeling is what makes them stop scrolling.
That pause is what turns into a click.
That click is what turns into a stream.

Consistency makes it recognizable.
Emotion makes it powerful.

So yeah…
I’m not just making covers.

I’m building a visual identity that makes people want to press play 

#CoverArt #GraphicDesign #MusicBranding #AfrobeatsDesign #CreativeProcess

body.title: Feeling Cute and Confident at My Office 💚✨ / Bonita y Segura en Mi Consultorio 💚✨
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSLjtUyk7sobTU8ZjurgteJ9zdTax7PXUy6F1gY8UCn6o/IMG_4026.jpg 

Today I’m feeling happy in my consultorio, wearing my white coat… but also with a more relaxed touch because I came in shorts. And honestly, I kind of love this look. It feels like the perfect mix between professional and comfortable, like I can still be myself while doing what I love.

Sometimes we think we have to fit into a very strict image at work, but I believe you can look good, feel confident, and still be completely professional. When you feel comfortable in what you’re wearing, it shows in your attitude, your energy, and even in how you connect with others.

Today I feel light, confident, and happy with my vibe. Maybe it’s the mix of my outfit, or just the fact that I’m doing what I love in a place that means so much to me. But yes… I think this look suits me well, or at least that’s how I feel. 💚✨

>Hoy estoy feliz en mi consultorio, con mi bata blanca… pero también con un toque más relajado porque me vine en short. Y la verdad, este look me gustó. Siento que es una combinación entre lo profesional y lo cómodo, como poder ser yo misma mientras hago lo que me encanta.

>A veces pensamos que en el trabajo debemos vernos de cierta forma muy estricta, pero yo creo que también puedes verte bien, sentirte segura y seguir siendo profesional. Cuando te sientes cómoda con lo que llevas puesto, eso se nota en tu actitud, en tu energía y en cómo conectas con los demás.

>Hoy me siento ligera, segura y contenta con mi estilo. Tal vez es la combinación del outfit o simplemente que estoy en un lugar que amo haciendo lo que me apasiona. Pero sí… creo que este look me queda bien, o al menos así lo siento. 💚✨

body.title: Delicious oatmeal cookies, with only 3 ingredients  (ENG - ESP)
body.body:
***Greetings, dear foodie friends 😊***

+ ***Saludos apreciados amigos foodie 😊***

---
---
![photo_5100709723899628590_x.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/23yTiz6iTcNL7BB6tePU9ZZ9AzviLP1QuNFJenKrTTV9F6wrLfSPrKtEbwUc3C8DN8Y48.jpg)

---
---
Join me today as we prepare these delicious oatmeal cookies, perfect to enjoy with your favorite beverage. With just three ingredients, I guarantee you'll have some delightful cookies that will satisfy your sweet tooth in a more natural and healthy way.

These cookies have a semi-crispy texture and a delicate honey flavor. I assure you that in just thirty minutes you'll have delicious baked cookies ready to enjoy! 👌

+ Acompáñenme hoy a preparar estas ricas Galletas de avena, ideales para acompañar tu bebida preferida, con tan solo tres ingredientes te aseguro que obtendrás unas galletas deliciosas, que saciará ese antojo de dulce pero de forma más natural y saludable.

+ Estas galletas tienen una textura semi crujiente, con un delicado sabor a miel, te aseguro que en treinta minutos tendrás unas deliciosas galletas horneadas listas para disfrutar 👌

**Credits for this recipe: YouTube channel, Auxi's Healthy Desserts 💕**

+ **Créditos de esta receta: canal de YouTube, PostresSaludables de Auxi 💕**

***Without further ado, I invite you to make this recipe together 😊***

+ ***Sin más preámbulos te invito a que juntos hagamos esta receta 😊***

# Ingredients:
-140 grams of rolled oats.
-40 grams of unsalted butter at room temperature or extra virgin coconut oil.
-3 tablespoons of honey.
-1/4 teaspoon of salt, optional.
-5.5 cm diameter cookie cutter.

+ # Ingredientes:
+ -140 gramos de copos de avena.
+ -40 gramos de mantequilla sin sal a temperatura ambiente o aceite de coco extra virgen.
+ -3 cucharadas de miel.
+ -1/4 cucharadita de sal, opcional.
+ -molde para galleta de 5.5 de diámetro.

![photo_5100709723899628591_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EpxrKts1Tyqz3QbGgcBJyFDQvdNZ2CirNskqftZeudvRo1ULsmTutjbwuc9N4oJgKCC.jpg)

---
---
# Let's get started:

The first thing we'll do is preheat the oven to 180 degrees Celsius (350 degrees Fahrenheit).

+ # Vamos con la preparación:

+ Lo primero que haremos es encender el horno a 180 grados.

In a bowl, we're going to put the oats along with the honey, butter, and salt.

+ En un recipiente vamos a echar la avena junto con la miel, la mantequilla y la sal.

![photo_5100709723899628592_x.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/23yTjjYBZmSHDmPhfADa14W9HF66CHhZVt6rFjJ3UacxWyYGw6vzpjphCLp7yVmKB7fmS.jpg)

---
![photo_5100709723899628594_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EoEq7KPW9jndPcfCWZkFJLQ4xK1MvyFJEhaetcEaS7bnwW53Y6YFnv964DH4rq9RYNQ.jpg)

---
![photo_5100709723899628595_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/23xAcLi2eeKvfUJvgS7o4YFAL9AHoaJZ39RkngFMm3swoiScmAh5Z5S7tZp8qtuKvUuCa.jpg)

---
![photo_5100709723899628596_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EoCi5KtAexqUSz9L2i3Pb7uxa19M3PdpKnrwt5ZE9RU5JjELAXqutnE9JaELdF6KWpY.jpg)

We mix very well, making sure that the ingredients are well integrated.

+ Mezclamos muy bien, asegurándonos que los ingredientes queden bien integrados.

![photo_5100709723899628597_x.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/23vsXCgFT4mFNZdhPVw2nevJEtTkkfjZBGh58ggkcevAJvXnA8788vzdbJN9614iubTW7.jpg)

---
![photo_5100709723899628598_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EoEqzmoVTyWk3VgynPfUqJvc2Mvqcp3t82PaHJa4n8KmoseMPgMXckw4dmHc5K1RW8x.jpg)

Then we let the mixture rest for about 5 minutes so that the oats absorb the ingredients.

+ Luego dejamos reposar la mezcla por unos 5 minutos para que la avena absorba los ingredientes.

![photo_5100709723899628599_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/Eos1kEEvQjcGBskE5MkzYpDWdW9m1qJaVNqEDusWzuYBceiJ63q31czFcSrPRTesyE4.jpg)

Now, using a measuring spoon, we're going to shape our cookies. I used a 15 ml spoon.

+ Ahora con una cuchara medidora vamos a dar forma a nuestras galletas, yo he usado una cuchara de 15 ml.

![photo_5100709723899628600_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EoiWG6t5JVx3doQfXvPVh3a9GGkoy7wDLRjFv9VnjabHMC5DqrU9df5yDzNMnPEaEwr.jpg)

We can make the cookies in the following way: on a baking tray and using parchment paper, we place the cookie cutter and pour two tablespoons of mixture, pressing with our fingers. Then we remove the cutter and we will have some beautiful round cookies. In total, 8 cookies came out, although the quantity will depend on the size you want to make them.

+ Las galletas las podemos hacer de la siguiente manera, en una fuente para horno y usando papel encerado colocamos el molde para galletas y le echamos dos cucharadas de mezcla presionando con los dedos, luego sacamos el molde y nos quedarán unas hermosas galletas redondas, en total salieron 8 galletas, aunque la cantidad va a depender del tamaño que tu desees hacerlas.

![photo_5100709723899628601_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EoeFr7iZtPudx9HncNdo3yvqkfSXN8ZgZt3ciKq1LMZHTV84zupWqgujdvR3vch1A7c.jpg)

---
![photo_5100709723899628602_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/23wgYStGbv4h8QiQ5p9yDZ7b4o1536XGf3fCsbABzp9mkBpoVG5TZGcWxJnFQSCTE57WA.jpg)

---
![photo_5100709723899628603_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EoCj7cCjZNv8Ga2jwG8tY7rwvzXpNKuCM7Rx2rXQ8V99NnyDyPCkiTgLV4yDhKoL15r.jpg)

---
![photo_5100709723899628604_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EoErV2TXbTBATUUiq3j3YkV4x76A7X7Rz8h25jZCZWE3kNJ6x3gBGnSSAvFkCy7eLYU.jpg)

We bake them in the oven for about 10 to 12 minutes or until our cookies are golden brown.

+ Llevamos al horno por unos 10 a 12 minutos o hasta que nuestras galletas estén doradas.

![photo_5100709723899628605_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/23uQtsavMGemE8tUSaQ4mfaN5RxZ7fDDriPTA5Cbxr9EzhQmndwdLARVz5DKquMs1DFmZ.jpg)

---
![photo_5100709723899628606_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EogNipNpgCpinkTsRfKebPBBPd3JRQViXCSzo5rJW2sFerrjYqbsg79J1hayWKZDfLq.jpg)

***Let them cool and then enjoy them with your favorite drink! 👌 This time I went for a coffee! What would you pair these delicious cookies with?***

+ ***¡Dejamos enfriar y las podemos disfrutar con nuestra bebida favorita! 👌 esta vez me decidí por un cafecito! ¿con que acompañarías estas deliciosas galletas?***

![photo_5100709723899628607_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/23xejg3axsTpow3XRS5pSw8GjHnFWxRAPmkPGekaDnFhAULaP4C2hbpqBxU9SEKqkmf6p.jpg)

---
![photo_5100709723899628608_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EouA7fPB9AErctB37PUdgsLkK7ep5HJWzT8rLLfZrwKBpDNQ3bFraGPyJN5rTnLw4EQ.jpg)

---
---

Some days don’t need big plans or perfect lighting… just a quiet moment, a comfy outfit, and a little pause to breathe.

Today felt like that. Sitting down, catching up with myself, thinking about everything that’s been happening lately. Life moves fast, but these small pauses remind me to stay grounded and appreciate where I am right now.

Hope your day has at least one peaceful moment too 🤍

de los 65 Juegos: ¿Está la NBA devaluando su propia historia? 🛑📉
body.body:
<center>
![Lesion de Doncic hace dìas, Foto: NBA](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spartano/23x14ndZ7Te1HLWcHyCF5DZpqPp6tFBgLvTtvcrp33QstU6LRNRE8bSWK5AXZdYUfVrvW.jpg)
</center>

<div class=\
>\n\nMientras nos dirigimos al último fin de semana de la temporada regular 2025-26, una nube negra se cierne sobre la entrega de premios de la NBA. Lo que fue diseñado como una cura para el \

se ha convertido en una guillotina rígida que está cercenando los legados de jugadores que han dominado la cancha, pero cayeron víctimas de la simple biología humana.

La regla es simple: **65 partidos, 20 minutos cada uno.** Si juegas 64, eres invisible para la historia. Y ahora mismo, la historia se está borrando.

---

### 💸 La trampa de los 50 millones: Más que un trofeo

Esto no se trata solo de una estatua bañada en oro para la repisa. La regla de los 65 partidos está ligada directamente a las selecciones **All-NBA**, que a su vez dictan la elegibilidad para los **contratos Supermax**. Aquí es donde el deporte se mezcla con los negocios pesados.

En la NBA, no todos los contratos \

(conocida oficialmente como *Designated Veteran Player Extension*). Así funciona la trampa:\n\n1.  **El Bono por ser de Élite:** Normalmente, una estrella aspira a un contrato del 30% del límite salarial. Pero si demuestra ser \

, puede saltar al **35%**.
    * *¿Cómo se demuestra?* Siendo All-NBA (1º, 2º o 3º equipo), ganando el MVP o el Defensor del Año (DPOY).

2.  **El muro de los 65 juegos:** Antes, podías jugar 50 partidos con números increíbles y calificar para el Supermax si la prensa te votaba. **Ahora no.** Si juegas 64 partidos, la NBA prohíbe legalmente que recibas votos. Sin votos, no hay All-NBA. Sin All-NBA, pierdes ese 5% extra.

3.  **¿Por qué 50 millones?** Ese 5% en un contrato de 5 años es una cifra astronómica.
    * **Contrato Máximo (30%):** Aprox. 250 millones por 5 años.
    * **Contrato Supermax (35%):** Sube a casi **300 millones**.
    * **La Diferencia:** Alrededor de **50 millones de dólares**. Por eso, si a Luka o a Embiid les falta un solo juego, esa lesión les cuesta 50 millones.

---

### 🏥 Cuando los médicos se vuelven \

Imagina que eres el médico de los Lakers y **Luka Dončić** tiene una pequeña distensión:
* **Como médico:** Dirías \

:** Sabes que si descansa, se queda en 64 juegos y **pierde 50 millones**.

Esto crea una presión peligrosa para autorizar a jugadores lesionados, poniendo en riesgo su salud física solo para proteger su salud financiera y los activos de la franquicia. Ya no es solo el trofeo; es el cheque que viene con él.

---

### 🚨 El reporte de bajas: Una lista de \

de nivel Hall of Fame
La lista de jugadores purgados por esta regla parece una alineación del Juego de Estrellas:

* **Luka Dončić (La tragedia del MVP):** Liderando la liga en anotación y cargando a los Lakers, Luka está varado en **64 partidos** por una distensión de último minuto. Si no juega el final \
, el favorito al MVP queda fuera legalmente.\n\n* **Victor Wembanyama (El robo del DPOY):** El \
redefinió la defensa, pero un problema de tobillo lo tiene a **un solo juego** del umbral. Sin Wemby, el DPOY será un \
.\n\n* **Anthony Edwards:** Enfermedad y problemas de rodilla bloquean a \

en **64 partidos**. Una de las temporadas más electrizantes de los Timberwolves quedará sin recompensa oficial.\n\n* **Cade Cunningham:** Temporada legendaria frenada por un pulmón colapsado a los 61 juegos. Una emergencia médica real es tratada igual que \

.

* **El elenco de apoyo:** Jugadores como **Austin Reaves**, **Jimmy Butler** y **Giannis Antetokounmpo** han coqueteado con el límite, arriesgando una lista All-NBA descafeinada.

---

### 🤔 La paradoja de la credibilidad

Si el objetivo es coronar al *mejor*, pero el *mejor* no es elegible, ¿qué valor tiene el trofeo? Nos dirigimos a una realidad donde la disponibilidad es la *única* habilidad que cuenta. **Adam Silver** defiende el límite, pero la NBA lo tilda de \
.\n\n**Conclusión:** La regla de los 65 partidos necesita una enmienda de \
. Un jugador con un pulmón colapsado no debería estar en la misma categoría que alguien que falta a un partido para irse de fiesta.\n\n**¿Es legítimo un MVP ganado \
? ¿Es hora de bajar el límite a 60? 📝👇** FIN. ---

body.title: What should students' daily routine be like?
body.body:
Assalamu Alaikum. Greetings students and parents. How are you? I hope that by the grace of Allah, you are all doing well. Alhamdulillah, by the grace of Allah, the Creator, I am also doing well. Today I want to talk to you about what the daily routine of students should be like. Basically, there are many students in our society. However, we should determine what the daily routine should be for an ideal student. Because if the students do not complete their daily activities according to the routine, then that student can never be an ideal student. To be an ideal student, he must have a daily routine and there should be some ideal content in it. Now you can ask me, what should the daily routine of a student be like and what is important in it? https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQKx54bbtfx4bvM3ekpL54qqS5yvQGrabbCQ2sfgba8mx/pexels-yankrukov-8613305.jpg [Source](https://www.pexels.com/photo/active-kids-doing-bending-exercise-8613305/) Basically, a student must be hardworking and he must be an ideal. And to be an ideal and a follower, a person must be hardworking. For this, a student must wake up early in the morning. A student needs to wake up at least five in the morning. After waking up, he will not use his smartphone. That is, if he is a Muslim, he will go to the mosque or can be a follower of any religion. That is, after waking up, he will return from the washroom and purify himself and express his love for religion. If the first work of the day is done for religion, the Creator will be pleased and it is possible to expect a lot of good things for the student's life. The second thing after finishing the religious work is that a student must exercise for some time in the morning. Because to get a healthy and beautiful body, it is important for us to exercise. After waking up, a student will exercise and then he will lead his life. After finishing the exercise, a light snack and then a student's job is to sit at the table with a book. There are many students in our society who dislike reading books. They complete their studies through online activities. But this is completely wrong. An educationist must wake up early in the morning and should study at the desk for at least three hours in the morning. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQrG5i3zuEZ7qvCFQ7f9Lmfd2bwUaT2x7uUnu4JQx7rU3/pexels-yankrukov-8617556.jpg [Source](https://www.pexels.com/photo/girl-in-white-sleeveless-shirt-glass-tumbler-8617556/) Then the education will be completed and the students will reach school. After reaching school, the students' work will definitely be to read each textbook well. The classes that the teacher has taken should be attended carefully and if they do not understand, they should ask the teacher again. The second important thing is food and drink. To improve mental health, we have to eat food regularly. And those foods must be balanced food. If a student has to maintain good mental and physical health, then he must increase his attention to food and drink. He must eat balanced food regularly. Because without eating food, the body will not have enough energy and attention will not come to studies. Therefore, a student should definitely study and eat balanced food carefully. By eating balanced food, a student can increase his morale in his body and he can become strong and improve his position. Lunch must be a strong breakfast. Apart from education, he must eat balanced food and vitamin-like food regularly. Because if we do not consume a balanced and vitamin-rich diet, our body will not gain strength and our morale will not increase. We should pay close attention to this issue. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVhnPDdNZ5Eq4ggggW5T8M4NeTLSyQ7z57rAnoPYS5hqx/pexels-kong-reach-111149247-12371885.jpg [Source](https://www.pexels.com/photo/beautiful-woman-in-eyeglasses-reading-a-book-12371885/) Finally, I want to inform you again about the education of students. A student must return home before evening. However, if a student wants to, he can play with his friends in the school grounds in the afternoon. I think it is mandatory for students to play with friends in the afternoon. If students play, their inner happiness increases. So a student must go to the school grounds in the afternoon or play with his friends in empty campuses. After finishing the sports, a student must return home before evening. After returning home in the evening, he must have a light breakfast and sit at the study table. After the evening, a student should continue his study activities at the study table for at least five hours. Otherwise, a student can never improve his own life. The last thing I want to discuss is sleep. Sleep removes all the fatigue, sadness and misery in the human body. So a student must sleep in moderation. At least 8 hours of sleep is necessary for a human being. So students must sleep regularly to develop their brains and keep everything in order. I think a standard routine has been set here for students. If a student follows this above routine then he can do something good in his later life and he can prove himself as a standard student. If there is any mistake in the routine then definitely don't forget to comment. Thank you very much for being with the education community.

Following the report, Bate's was subsequently arrested by detectives from Warrington CID. During questioning he denied all of the allegations against him.

Despite his denials, he was convicted of all the offences following a trial at Liverpool Crown Court which concluded on Thursday 21 May.

Following the sentencing, Detective Constable Maurizio Lucchesi who led the investigation said: “Firstly, I want to praise the victim for the courage that they have shown throughout this investigation.

“Bate is clearly a sexual predator, whose only interest is to fulfil his own sexual gratification. He showed no regard for the victim and even when faced with all the evidence against him, he refused to plead guilty to any of the charges against him.

“Instead, he forced his victim to relive their experiences in court, which could not have been easy for them.

“Thankfully, as a result of the bravery of the victim, and the evidence we gathered, the jury have seen through his lies, and he is now being held accountable for his actions.

“I hope that the sentence handed to Bates will provide the victim with some closure and allow them to move forward with their lives, knowing that he will never be able do the same to any other children.”

In addition to the custodial sentence Bate’s was ordered to sign the sexual offenders’ register and comply with a sexual harm prevention order for life.

Detective Constable Lucchesi added: “Nobody should have to experience what the victim has been though and if anything can come from this case, I hope that it encourages other victims of sexual offences to come forward and report them to us.

“Cheshire Constabulary takes any allegation of sexual offences extremely seriously, and any allegation will be thoroughly investigated, with the wishes and needs of the victim as our main priority.

“Victims should never feel ashamed to talk about what they have been subjected to. They will receive the help and support they need from our specialist officers, as well as from other support agencies we work alongside, and all victims of sexual offences have the right to anonymity.”

To report any sexual offence, call Cheshire Constabulary on 101  https://www.cheshire-live.co.uk/news/chester-cheshire-news/cheshire-man-jailed-21-years-29577749

body.title: The Night Glow of Leaves
body.body:
Last night, I took a quick walk in the garden and brought a light with me just to see if I could capture something interesting. I did not expect much at first, but once the light passed through the leaves, the whole scene changed. The plants looked more alive at night, almost as if the darkness was helping reveal a side of them that is not as noticeable during the day. That was what fascinated me the most. ![1000127640.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/Eo6D7MMCwVaGV1k64RjpBJoneiK9eP5c3Vs15rZAjMZiDhL5py9D48VmPpkPtMbkDGt.jpg) With the light shining through, the leaves seemed to glow from within. Their patterns became clearer, the veins stood out beautifully, and the shapes felt softer yet more dramatic at the same time. In black and white, the contrast became even stronger. The light was no longer just something falling on the leaves. It started to feel like it had become part of them. My little theory is that leaves have this amazing characteristic that allows them to scatter light in such a beautiful way. Because of that, they do not simply reflect brightness. They seem to hold it, soften it, and spread it across their surface. That is why the patterns appear so naturally and why the leaves can look almost luminous in a photo like this. It also made me think about life in a simple way. Sometimes, we only notice certain beauty when light passes through difficult or quiet moments. There are parts of us that do not show up in the brightness of an ordinary day, but become visible when life shines through us in a different way. Strength, softness, depth, and character can appear more clearly when touched by the right kind of light. That is what I felt while taking these photos. The leaves were not only reflecting light. They were revealing what was already inside them. Have a good day ahead. *** ![1000127640.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/Eo6D7MMCwVaGV1k64RjpBJoneiK9eP5c3Vs15rZAjMZiDhL5py9D48VmPpkPtMbkDGt.jpg) ![1000127639.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/Eo6CGS5m4M5NHTUnqHsSyYS33q1LFDfWvdyNpxVK7MvfYJazwW7CeRGQALTLEzUGqPH.jpg) ![1000127638.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/EoEo9yWwpP4iHrkZAvgojAztLaj52GrkCta8gEsSieW4rjhkdesEVMYcRSdhAMNZ5k8.jpg) ![1000127637.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/Eo1wU2sUXeTsTJSsuyKQjiGupgxN9KjimTiWf3bxqPVigQoWMdfkZJZLJUPvPT8EMWS.jpg) ***

”To see in color is a delight for the eye, but to see in black and white is delight for the soul.”

*~ Andri Cauldwell*

帅哥去跑外卖以后，就租了一辆电动车，又破又丑又笨重，他自己也不想骑，然后就拉我的电瓶车去改装，多加了一个接口，可以直接去租电瓶的地方换电瓶进去用，没电了又拎出来去指定的地点进行更换就行。

前几天清明他回去扫墓了，然后车一直是我在骑，周末去那个小姐姐家带娃骑了两天来回40公里这样，电量略显不足，我就想自己去换电瓶。

按照帅哥给我的地址，我就骑着车过去了，去到之后把那个二维码拍给他，叫他在软件操作给我开门换电瓶。结果我把电瓶还回去之后，新的电瓶的柜门没有打开。我以为是我操作失误。我去AI了一下说是没问题，可能系统卡顿了，叫我联系客服。然后我就问帅哥叫他去联系。结果他说客服下班了。气的我就到抖音搜索，智电换租，结果一搜就搜到了人家卖电瓶的直播间，我不管三七二十一我就直接在直播间问，怎么开不了柜门，他们告诉我联系客服。我说没人接电话，他们就说现在还在上班的，多打几遍电话。

这时我就感觉可能帅哥没找对位置，我一边重复直播间的解答跟他说怎么操作联系，一边我就下载了那个软件，点进去之后确实有个电话，我打过去就有人接了。问了我绑定的电话和绑定人，最后给我开门了。

帅哥那边先前打的那种中介的电话，可能是这边分点的电话，都没人接。我直接去app的官方客服那里打电话，直接就打通了。问题也解决了。

所以我总结出来，有时候远程工作人员比进程更靠谱更容易解决问题。比如在分中心发现的问题，在分中心没人给你解决，投诉到总部去一下子就搞定了。🤣

---

body.title: Finding Balance in the Middle of Chaos 🎧✨ | Encontrando equilibrio en medio del caos 🎧✨
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmT75q9NUeAPvtym5CciSk1KHNosNBLj1tTAKXpEpoZg89/IMG_9787.jpg 

Some days feel like everything is happening at once… and today was definitely one of those days.

Between lesson plans, little ones needing attention, and trying to keep everything organized, it can get overwhelming. But I’ve learned that even in the middle of all that noise, there’s always a way to find a little balance. 🌿

Hay días en los que todo pasa al mismo tiempo… y hoy definitivamente fue uno de esos días.

Entre planeaciones, pequeños que necesitan atención y tratar de mantener todo en orden, puede volverse abrumador. Pero he aprendido que incluso en medio de todo ese ruido, siempre hay una forma de encontrar un poco de equilibrio. 🌿

Sometimes it’s just taking a deep breath, pausing for a second, and reminding myself why I love what I do.

A veces es solo respirar profundo, hacer una pausa y recordarme por qué amo lo que hago.

Because at the end of the day, all the chaos turns into memories, and all the effort turns into something meaningful. 💛

Porque al final del día, todo el caos se convierte en recuerdos, y todo el esfuerzo en algo que vale la pena. 💛

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@fryda/finding-balance-in-the-middle-of-chaos-encontrando-equilibrio-en-medio-del-caos--cma)

body.title: The Architect of My Dreams.
body.body:
> I close my eyes and the first sound that comes to mind is not the traffic of present-day Caracas—which now lies miles away—but the rhythmic clang of a trowel against the concrete block. It is a sharp, metallic and hopeful sound. If I had to define my childhood, I would do so through the feel of fresh concrete and the smell of the mist on Monte Carmelo, back in my native Táchira, where the days passed as slowly as the clouds over the Andes. That is what these prompts are like, such as the one presented by the [Silver Bloggers](https://peakd.com/c/hive-106316/created) community in their regular prompt [The Silverbloggers Chronicles - Prompt #41](https://peakd.com/hive-106316/@hive-106316/the-silverbloggers-chronicles-prompt-41-the-home-where-you-grew-up-in). Let me tell you about it.
# ***
The Architect of My Dreams
*** My father didn’t just build walls; he built security and a future. In that Táchira of the 1960s, I saw him transform the land into a home. Always under the same principle: ribbed blocks and a flat roof. For him, the flat roof was more than just a concrete ceiling; it was the promise that there would always be a firm place over our heads, a raised surface where we could hang out the washing in the sun or where we children could climb up to try and touch the sky with our hands.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmevcmRXH9hAsLLQuK7KbbyZv4Bpu7YccsHTfDr96zAigo/image.png)
I remember the move to the capital. Caracas in the 1970s was a vibrant adventure, a city growing upwards and outwards. We settled in Vista Hermosa, in Catia. The name did not lie: from there, the valley stretched out like an illuminated nativity scene as evening fell. Once again, I saw my old man shouldering the weight of the days and the building materials. His hands, weathered by work and love, raised the walls of our family home. That house in Vista Hermosa became our headquarters. The textured brickwork, perfectly smooth beneath the light-coloured paint, felt cool to the touch when we arrived, sweaty from playing in the street. Back then, Venezuela smelled of freshly brewed coffee and new tarmac. The house in Catia was the refuge where the Andean chill we carried in our souls was warmed by the neighbourhood’s warmth and the solidarity of the few neighbours we had back then. I remember once, a rooster chased me and I fell into the pit Dad was digging for the septic tanks; another time I fell into a water well, and thank goodness Dad was nearby because he pulled me out straight away.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVsXaRfu6MoAR4zi43cBY65nPfGSYuRRXoRrQA7UFqCXu/image.png)
My brother Henry still lives within those very walls today. Sometimes, when I speak to him via video call, I can feel the echo of our childhood laughter bouncing off the parapet. It is a structure that has withstood the test of time, the tremors of the earth and those of life itself. That house is our family’s diary, written not in ink, but with the exact mixture of sand, water and determination that my father prepared every morning. To walk through the memories of that home today is to understand that we did not grow up in an anonymous block of flats, but in a handmade work of art. We grew up in a house that has a pulse, that breathes through its windows and that holds, in the frieze of its walls, the DNA of a man who taught us that, for a home to be eternal, it must be made of fine materials and unconditional devotion.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZsoJTkC3uUSMc6wrsY3yiGEZY8BwGyMPmZoLvzuJ3E2g/image.png)
Today, with the benefit of hindsight, I look back and realise that my father didn’t just leave us a terraced house; he left us the moral foundation upon which we still stand today. Henry looks after the walls, but we all carry within us the original design of that home that saw us grow up. *** ***
