Let me explain. I've been commissioned to write five short screenplays about their lives. I told you, it's my project. And I'm having fun with my project. Are there any frustrations? Quantities. Joy. Also. ***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWj5GBtxdKngYGJNVB6snjZjNniufmZsBECmU1G9dkKDk/1775830533422.jpg)
***

>

Entrepreneurship isn't about opening a store; it's about summoning spirits to work for you.

Just like you read it.

My work table looks like an algorithm error or the delirium of a feverish artificial intelligence.

I have a Russian mathematician obsessed with wallpaper, a bearded chemist who tamed the elements in his dreams, and a Colombian who made virgins and priests levitate.

 I also have a visionary who built an empire on the silhouette of a rodent, and a charro who transformed the drum of his heart into the throat of a legend.

What do these names have in common with cash flow, sleepless nights, or the \

of Web3?

The answer is simple: vertigo.

And if you think this is just \

you haven't grasped the nature of fire.

I started with Sophia because you don't write about Europe's first female professor with the lightness of a voice message.

Sophia is technical audacity. She had to disguise herself as a man to study; she was a hacker of reality when code was a stigma.

Then I jumped to Mendeleev. This man ordered the universe in rows and columns. Dmitri is the architect of chaos.

 Entrepreneurship is exactly that: looking at the chaos of market elements and having blind faith that there's a pattern, a logic, a periodicity that only you can see.

My frustration: understanding that my personal \

will never be as perfect as the Cauchy-Kovalevski theorem. But you try, because the market, like science, doesn't forgive the lukewarm.

From Russia, I landed in Macondo (figuratively speaking). Writing about García Márquez is like walking through a field of perfect adjectives.

It's the curse of excellence.

The entrepreneur lives with this ghost: the fear of being a cheap imitation of their role models.

And when exhaustion weighed heavily, Walt Disney arrived. No theme parks here: the human being who was fired for \

What a thing! Walt is the true patron saint of bankruptcy. In his stubbornness, he dreamed of a mouse that could move mountains, and his hand didn't tremble when he drew it. Don't tremble! Let's fight for our dreams! And we must do it even when everyone, even the banks, turns their backs on us. Walt Disney left that message for us. ***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTiCw3ixsBn2e3ota8NNLz4Tkin24Q4WRKscMuhKhSgBf/1775830859541.png)
***

>

I'm boarding that train heading south, listening to Vicente Fernández.

What's a screenwriter like me doing in front of the \

? Learning that entrepreneurship is performance. It's holding the note until your lungs burn. It's knowing that if the audience keeps applauding, you can't stop producing. It's the ethic of hard work disguised as a gala. My entrepreneurial endeavor amuses and tears me apart. It's like chipping away at the stones in the quarry of history so that others can consume those lives while navigating traffic, for example. It's about transforming data into drama and drama into a digital asset. These five individuals, at some point in their lives, were all, in some April of their lives, a project with a 99% chance of failure. What unites them isn't success; what unites them is their refusal to give up. My screenplays are my minimum viable product. My capital is the voice of the dead. Right? ***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmU8aca6oZvFrHKuBogjjf5H514fesEUtWCjcWS2PUDysg/1774413737291.jpg)
***

> And you, sitting there deciphering your own periodic table or sketching your own empire from the kitchen table: which ghost will you summon to help you win the game? In this game, you're either the author of your own story, or a supporting character in someone else's. I've been commissioned to write five short screenplays in April. I'm in the preliminary stages. I'll let you know how it goes. #
***[Thanks for reading. It's always a pleasure to have you]()***
>\n\n💎 My book of short stories, \
(2024), was published by Editorial Matanzas in Cuba.\n\n

body.title: 10 April 2026, Freewriters Community Daily Writing Prompt Day 3069: analyst of what?
body.body:
/>

As protective as he was of his grandchildren by nature, Capt. R.E. Ludlow realized that all eight Ludlow little ones and their friends needed to explore the world and learn things that way, so, he sometimes caught himself before interfering in a learning moment – like a whole truck of not-well-secured snacks losing a box on a pothole that did not exist before Hurricane Mneme.

“Papa! Free snacks!” nine-year-old George Ludlow shouted – the two were out on their weekly walk.

“We must first offer to return them,” Capt. Ludlow said as the truck stopped a little way up the road.

“Nah, man, keep those – we can't even sell that box now,” the driver said as he looked at it. “I'll have to take that on the chin for being in a hurry – but y'all enjoy.”

Capt. Ludlow and George smiled and thanked the driver, and between them took the half-cracked box back to the Ludlow house. As they were going up the stairs to the porch, the box gave way and the captain saw those snacks.

“My immediate reaction was, 'Ain't no way I would have bought this flavored air to give to my family,'” he said to the laughing Mrs. Ludlow, “but you see that 16 hands and the 10 hands of their friends have decided all that!”

The little Ludlows, and their friends the little Trents and younger Stepforths (because Tom was 16, but his nine-year-old brother Vertran shared with him like they were peers), barely let all those snacks hit the ground before they were spread out, snatched up, and enjoyed … sorta.

This was where all of them being in houses that cooked and bought good food kicked in.

“We thank God for blessing us with snacks through people in a hurry,” eleven-year-old Eleanor said, “but while God is good, people really aren't measuring up.”

“This is why he didn't mind losing that box,” George said.

“Which is all a polite standard English way of saying this ain't it,” eight-year-old Gracie Trent said.

“Where is the seasoning?” nine-year-old Milton Trent said. “I mean, I'm looking at this chip and I just see potato!”

“Where is the love?” five-year-old Lil' Robert Ludlow said as he sat down in a heap.

“Because, no!” ten-year-old Glendella Ludlow said as she flopped down by him.

“I remember that brand name – that's a whole bag of nope,” six-year-old Grayson said as he put his bag down, unopened, and his big brother ten-year-old Andrew just shook his head.

“George, you weren't with us yet,” Andrew said, “but when Papa is trying to return stuff, he is trying to protect us.”

“Maybe they didn't use enough oil and the flavor is at the bottom of the bag,” seven-year-old Amanda Ludlow said, and then closed her little bag and started shaking it up before getting out another chip and concluding, “Nope. At the bottom of the bag is just bag.”

“This is a crime against food fashion!” eight-year-old Edwina said. “Good snacks are supposed to have you mad because you are getting flavor prints on your clothes – but nothing is happening here!”

“These fools are about to be in the _Lofton County Free Voice,_ this is so bad,” Tom said, “because these are the ones available on the poorer sides of every town down here and enough is enough.”

“Yeah, I'mma hafta do a review video about no,” Vertran said.

“I gotta get some hot sauce – in fact, y'all bring your chips and stuff and we're gonna fix this,” eleven-year-old Velma Trent said. “Vanna, I need some of your best popcorn seasoning because folks are throwing unseasoned snacks off the back of trucks to bore us!”

18-year-old Vanna Trent came and looked and then picked up one of the bags to look at the brand name.

“Oh yeah, these things,” Vanna said. 'Y'all might as well be eating puffed cardboard – and y'all give me that granola before you start eating more cardboard. We gotta doctor up all this stuff. I'm going to turn the granola into dessert for y'all, but you'll have your chips back in five minutes.

So Vanna went into her collection of spices and sauces and cheese powder and put all the chips and crisps and puffs in a big pan and got busy – and came back with a masterpiece.

“See, you should be the analyst of food fixing,” George told her when he tasted what she came back with.

“Analyst of what?” she said.

“Food fixing,” George said, right before Lil' Robert plowed into her in a running hug.

“Thank you – I taste the love now and I love you too!” he said.

“I'm going to mess up my clothes now and be happy about it!” Edwina said.

“See?” George said. “Food fixing fixes everything – Edwina is happy and that takes some doing!”

“Nah,” Vanna said. “I'm not about to be fixing this mess – it's time for me to get my popcorn out there and put these fools out of business at least locally. It is a sin and a shame that folks make people buy these leftover starches and stuff – there weren't even any whole potatoes sliced to make a chip in there. We're not gon' do this – hey, Pop-Pop, I'mma have that popcorn business plan to you this week.”

All the little ones cheered, and Mrs. Gladys Jubilee Trent, Vanna's paternal grandmother, smiled.

“Right on, granddaughter,” she said. “We don't fix injustice – we end it, in food fashion style when necessary.”

“'Bout time,” said Mrs. Velma Stepforth, Vanna's maternal grandmother. “Got a whole billionaire granddad ready to help out – 'bout time to change the snack scene because I would have backed my car over that brand. They have been out here having people pay to bore their tastebuds with their substandard products long enough!”

“Ain't it the truth, Velma,” Mrs. Jubilee Trent said, “Ain't it the truth.”

body.title: Aliens Is One of the Greatest Sequels Ever Made. Bigger, Louder, and Just as Powerful as the Original.
body.body:
Released in 1986, Aliens had the difficult task of following Ridley Scott’s Alien, which is one of the greatest science fiction horror films ever made. Instead of trying to copy that film, Aliens goes in a different direction. It keeps the tension and fear, but adds action, scale, and intensity. The result is an excellent film that stands right alongside the original.

![IMG_0160.webp](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNv7id8NjJKSwgSVhiDL3yLUdzSDsQtopQPa2CxPJoEyA/IMG_0160.webp)

The film was directed by James Cameron, who brought his own style to the franchise. Cameron leans more into action and military elements, turning the story into a full scale battle for survival. At the same time, he keeps the suspense and atmosphere that made the first film so effective.

Sigourney Weaver returns as Ellen Ripley, and this is the film that truly cements her as one of the greatest action heroes in movie history. Weaver gives a strong performance that combines toughness, intelligence, and real emotional depth. Ripley is no longer just trying to survive. She is ready to fight back.

The supporting cast is outstanding. Michael Biehn plays Corporal Hicks, a calm and capable soldier who becomes one of Ripley’s closest allies. Bill Paxton delivers a memorable performance as Hudson, bringing both humor and panic to the group. Lance Henriksen is excellent as Bishop, the android whose true nature becomes a key part of the story.

The plot follows Ripley as she returns to the alien infested planet LV 426, this time with a group of Colonial Marines. At first, the soldiers are confident and even cocky. They believe they are fully prepared to handle anything they encounter.

Of course, that confidence quickly disappears. The aliens are not just dangerous. There are many of them, and they are far more organized than anyone expected. The mission turns into a desperate fight for survival as the group is picked apart.

One of the biggest strengths of Aliens is how it builds tension. Even though there is more action, the film still takes its time setting up the situation. When things finally go wrong, it feels earned and intense.

![IMG_0162.webp](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTqdxeQJyQCrj8gi7MHcKrpcnzxLW115KTeRVMrT3SmXk/IMG_0162.webp)

James Cameron also does a great job giving each character a distinct personality. You get to know the Marines before the chaos begins, which makes their fate more impactful.

The action scenes are fantastic. The firefights, the escape sequences, and the final battle all deliver exactly what you want. Everything feels fast, dangerous, and exciting.

At the same time, the film has a strong emotional core. Ripley’s relationship with Newt, the young survivor they find on the planet, adds depth to the story. It gives Ripley a reason to fight beyond just survival.

The Alien Queen is another major addition to the franchise. The design and presence of the Queen raise the stakes and give the film an unforgettable final confrontation.

Visually, Aliens still holds up incredibly well. The practical effects, sets, and creature design all contribute to a believable and terrifying world.

James Cameron deserves a lot of credit for expanding the universe while still respecting what came before. He took the concept and pushed it in a new direction without losing what made it special.

Aliens remains an excellent film because it delivers everything you could want from a sequel. Strong performances, intense action, real emotion, and unforgettable moments all come together. It is not just a great sequel. It is one of the greatest action science fiction films ever made and a true classic.

body.title: I would like to learn about the use of artificial intelligence in education
body.body:
> Greetings to everyone on Hive and @weekendexperiences. Today, I’m once again taking part in this week’s initiative proposed by @galenkp, in which he presents us with a range of topics so we can choose one to share our views on and also learn about the experiences of other users on Hive.
![GridArt_20260410_182716538.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23yJLcZUbmhzNpxq77ukDE8gX62yaaAVEt7h63fQiNdMs1JkuG7YvD6DKLQKVheibfCNf.jpg) It is worth noting that I have been working for nineteen years as a teacher at a centre called the Bolivarian Centre for Information Technology and Telematics (CBIT); this is a computer lab equipped with the necessary hardware to introduce Information and Communication Technologies (ICT) to students, teachers and members of the wider community. When I first started, we were given training sessions covering both teaching methods and technology, to keep us up to date and enable us to apply that knowledge with my students in the classroom. ![IMG_20260410_080739.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23yd5w9ubm3t2RRpg9uNFzyywY7y8YrP4gi1j9oKeV52xMCtqNHQjF4kL6nBknzqGPwGM.jpg) It is also important to keep up to date with the latest technological innovations, which is why I believe it is necessary to learn more about artificial intelligence (AI) tools and how to introduce them to our students. This is because there is widespread global concern about the misuse of AI, which some may apply in their education and even in their daily lives. ![IMG_20260410_080748.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23xVKAB5HFq3nQiVoco5ew5M9AjEPU5XwykmX1T7j7ZSYB21esGGCTZbwYAZMRR6esHNc.jpg) In light of this concern, it is important to continue learning every day and to acquire the necessary strategies for the teaching and learning process so that we can apply them with our students. We must also raise students’ awareness of the appropriate use of this technology as a tool to be integrated into their learning. Finally, I will be preparing myself in all aspects of Artificial Intelligence so that I can apply it in my work within the education sector. ![IMG_20260410_094239.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23y8ssebUUvnCx33VXusnee7LprWqLpDiS6xFPKHx4Dny6Suv56ZTvKrBcV9S6mnmdvc5.jpg) I hope you liked it, see you in a next post. body.title: A Lazy Day.
body.body:
Is it just me or some other persons feel lazy on a busy day? Well today was a busy day for me but guess what? I woke up tired lol. Who wakes up tired? Me, on a supposedly busy day.


![IMG_1748.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tessyy/23uQzbAAsDm9oBTr7mb8VNisDt95N2tLbfDYaGJWtNzqtRb8J9Edpzg2NtBvxdVozwZmj.jpeg)


#### About My Day

After my morning prayers, I took a 10 minutes walk. On a good day i walk for at least 35 minutes. Trying to keep up with my fitness journey. After my walk, I grudgingly did my laundry, and that took almost an hour I guess. After laundry, I had Golden morn cereals for breakfast.

![IMG_1738.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tessyy/23w2j3pe52DSFaqjizLhUxGRbDLQAGkTNHfYrcTqfofPS6cM2Tz9iatXLrwSUuSgTJ7R2.jpeg)
Golden morn cereal 

Afterwards, I had my bath and prepared for work. If you can remember, I am currently serving my country and the service I render is teaching; so yeah, that was the work I went to do today. I teach Civic Education and today’s topic was Political Apathy. It was an interactive class because an average Nigerian youth partakes in political apathy and the reason is usually the same; “our votes will not count”. In as much as my students are not in the voting age bracket yet, they already concluded that their vote won’t  count and it saddens me because when I was their age i remember my siblings saying the same thing and I in turn said same thing. Years later, our votes still does not count. At the end of the day I left them with what I believe every Nigerian youth has at this point; *Hope*. I also let them know that if we always conclude our votes won’t count without making conscious efforts to make it count at least, we won’t make any change either. I believe this would do something to their mindset, at least a change in their thinking. 

After school, I took a nap and afterwards, scrolled through my socials while listening to music. While on that, I remembered I had a task to do. My sister is getting married and I needed to contact some event vendors on her behalf. Thank God I remembered. I would have been in soup lol. Right after contacting the vendors as requested by my sister, I quickly made dinner and ate, had some rest while planning for tomorrow’s work. After a well deserved rest, I proceeded to write this. 

At the end of the day, I feel much better, not tired like I was in the morning and I’m happy making my second post in the Hive community. Thank you for reading through, and please tell me how your day went in the comments if you can! 

![IMG_1744.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tessyy/241tox4j6iiMaGQkEBxtcwf2z2EbtzDD4G2dgu6DTZ39wBYL1rGi1cjyhTymk1EFTVzF2.jpeg)

body.title: Sami Pajari leads Croatia Rally 2026 after day one
body.body:
Hi, friends! 

Please join our #Rally community which can be found here:
https://hive.blog/trending/hive-109272

What a day it was at Croatia Rally today. Three big names had to stop very early in the rally because of the crashes/off road excursions. Oliver Solberg (Toyota) crashed out after some 5km into the first special stage. His team mate and WRC Championship leader Elfyn Evans crashed out in the first loop and then M-Sport Ford's Jon Armstrong destroyed suspension in an off and that was it for them for today. Unfortunately, that's also rallying. All of them will continue tomorrow under Super Rally rules. 

Finnish youngster Sami Pajari (Toyota) currently leads event in front of Thierry Neuville (Hyundai) and Pajari's team mate and Safari Rally Kenya winner Takamoto Katsuta. 

It is still very early in the rally and anything can happen. Let the best win - as always... 

https://youtu.be/X_J-akHRKEM?is=PLhggpWP-bnMtqNQ

Credit for photos and videos to WRC and Youtube. 

Vote for @pfunk and @guiltyparties as Hive witnesses.

Give some support to @tenkminnows :)

Grab a beer and enjoy!

Cheers!

Older community writeups spell out the mechanics and perks pretty clearly, including badges, delegations, and occasional prize incentives in posts like [this one](https://www.publish0x.com/cryptominute/leo-pud-big-changes-at-inleo-leoads-22-percent-apr-enpt-br-xkedwop) and [this community recap](https://blog.suseona.com/@leogrowth/lpud-kicked-serious-ass).  \n\nThe basic idea is simple: stake LEO, grow your influence, and signal you’re actually committed instead of just renting vibes. Recent InLeo search results around “LPUD” were thin, so I’d treat it as a standing community tradition rather than some brand-new April event, but the tag is still what people use when they do it.

body.title: Glaciares y minería: la historia de una contradicción
body.body:
**Cristina Fernández de Kirchner vetó en 2008 la primera ley de protección de glaciares aprobada por unanimidad en el Congreso, cediendo a presiones de la industria minera, y luego aceptó con resistencia pasiva una versión similar en 2010 que su propio gobierno se encargó de no implementar.** Esta trayectoria constituye uno de los casos más documentados de contradicción entre discurso ambientalista y acción de gobierno en la política argentina contemporánea. La relación de CFK con la legislación glaciar y minera atravesó cuatro etapas claramente diferenciadas —desde el activismo pro-glaciares como senadora en 1996, pasando por el veto como presidenta y la alianza con Barrick Gold, hasta el giro discursivo contra el extractivismo como vicepresidenta— y revela cómo la conveniencia política moldeó posiciones que se presentaron como principios.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4JC8IidW-Lw

* * *

De defensora de los hielos a autora del \

(1996-2008)
------------------------------------------------------------------

La ironía fundacional de esta historia es que CFK comenzó su carrera política nacional defendiendo glaciares. En 1996, como senadora por Santa Cruz, convirtió la defensa de los **hielos continentales patagónicos** en su principal bandera legislativa, oponiéndose al acuerdo Menem-Aylwin que cedía territorio glaciar a Chile. Esa posición nacionalista sobre los hielos contrastaría radicalmente con sus decisiones una década después.

El 22 de noviembre de 2007, la Cámara de Diputados otorgó media sanción al proyecto de Ley de Presupuestos Mínimos para la Protección de los Glaciares y del Ambiente Periglacial, impulsado por la diputada **Marta Maffei** y por el diputado kirchnerista **Miguel Bonasso**, presidente de la Comisión de Recursos Naturales. El proyecto fue aprobado con **136 votos afirmativos**. El 22 de octubre de 2008, el Senado lo sancionó por **unanimidad con 47 votos afirmativos**, registrándose como Ley 26.418. La norma prohibía actividades de exploración y explotación minera e hidrocarburífera en glaciares y ambiente periglacial, y ordenaba un inventario nacional de cuerpos de hielo.

Apenas diecinueve días después, el **10 de noviembre de 2008**, CFK vetó totalmente la ley mediante el **Decreto 1837/2008**, firmado también por el jefe de Gabinete Sergio Massa. Fue el primer veto total de su presidencia. Los argumentos oficiales del decreto revelaban la presión del sector minero con una transparencia insólita:

*   _\

_
    

El decreto convocó a un foro en la Secretaría de Ambiente para el 1° de diciembre de 2008, pero el daño político ya estaba hecho. El veto fue bautizado por organizaciones ambientales y medios como **\
**. La ex secretaria de Ambiente **Romina Picolotti** reveló a Bonasso que _\
_. Fuentes gubernamentales confirmaron a La Nación que internamente _\
_ sobre la posición de Picolotti. Bonasso abandonó el bloque oficialista y publicó el libro _El Mal: El Modelo K y la Barrick Gold_. El geólogo Jorge Rabassa del CONICET declaró que el veto _\

_.

* * *

La Ley 26.639 se aprueba contra la voluntad del Ejecutivo (2009-2010)
---------------------------------------------------------------------

El período entre el veto y la sanción de la nueva ley expuso la profundidad de los vínculos entre el gobierno de CFK y la industria minera. El **15 de abril de 2009**, CFK recibió en Casa de Gobierno a **Peter Munk**, presidente de Barrick Gold Corporation, con la presencia del gobernador **José Luis Gioja**, el ministro **Julio De Vido** y el secretario de Minería **Jorge Mayoral**. Ante el Council of Americas en septiembre de 2009, CFK agradeció públicamente a directivos de Barrick Gold por Pascua-Lama, describiéndolo como _\
_. El propio Munk declaró en la reunión anual de accionistas de 2008 que CFK y Michelle Bachelet le habían rogado: _\
_ (Toronto Star; Barrick luego se disculpó por la \

_ Esta promesa fue el resultado de la enorme presión social de más de 300 asambleas ciudadanas y organizaciones ambientales.\n\nLa sanción definitiva llegó en la madrugada del **1° de octubre de 2010**, con una votación de **35 a favor y 33 en contra** en el Senado. De los 35 votos positivos, **28 fueron de senadores no oficialistas**. De los 33 negativos, **23 pertenecían al Frente para la Victoria**. Solo 7 senadores kirchneristas rompieron la disciplina partidaria para votar a favor, entre ellos Filmus y el jefe de bloque Pichetto, quien dio \
. **CFK nunca firmó la promulgación de la ley**: se promulgó de hecho el 28 de octubre de 2010 por vencimiento del plazo legal. La Nación calificó esta actitud como la _\

_.

* * *

Una implementación saboteada desde adentro (2011-2015)
------------------------------------------------------

La aprobación de la ley no significó su aplicación. El gobierno de CFK la reglamentó mediante el Decreto 207/2011, pero **no reglamentó el artículo 15**, que establecía un plazo de 180 días para inventariar glaciares en zonas prioritarias donde hubiera actividades prohibidas en curso —precisamente las zonas donde operaba Barrick Gold—. El inventario completo, que la ley fijaba en 5 años (plazo: octubre 2015), no se completó hasta **mayo de 2018**, bajo el gobierno de Macri.

Los tres secretarios de Ambiente del período CFK —**Juan José Mussi, Omar Judis y Sergio Lorusso**— fueron procesados por el juez federal **Sebastián Casanello** por abuso de autoridad. También fue procesado el director del IANIGLA, **Ricardo Villalba**. Casanello determinó que habían creado un documento (\

_ que impidió inventariar cuerpos de hielo en la zona Veladero-Lama. Más de **1.000 geoformas fueron excluidas del inventario de San Juan** al aplicar una metodología que solo incluía glaciares de más de 1 hectárea. El juez concluyó que _\
_.\n\nMientras tanto, CFK celebraba públicamente la minería. El 9 de diciembre de 2010, en la firma del Acuerdo Nacional de Promoción del Diálogo Social en la Industria Minera, declaró: _\
_ En marzo de 2012, inaugurando la explotación subterránea de **Cerro Vanguardia** en Santa Cruz, afirmó: _\

_

* * *

La alianza Gioja-Kirchner y el poder de Barrick Gold
----------------------------------------------------

El gobernador de San Juan **José Luis Gioja** (2003-2015) fue el nexo central entre el kirchnerismo y la industria minera. Aliado incondicional de CFK, Gioja fue señalado por Bonasso como _\

_. Su hermano **César Gioja** presidía la Comisión de Minería del Senado y fue denunciado por tener negocios directos como proveedor de Barrick Gold, una incompatibilidad de cargos nunca resuelta judicialmente.

El secretario de Minería **Jorge Mayoral**, que ocupó el cargo durante todo el período kirchnerista, tenía participación accionaria del **15%** en la firma Milestone, que compartía dirección postal y directores con Barrick Gold. Mayoral fue posteriormente procesado por incumplimiento de deberes de funcionario público.

Bajo este entramado, el gobierno de CFK mantuvo intacto el **marco legal minero de los años 90**: la Ley de Inversiones Mineras 24.196 (1993) garantizaba estabilidad fiscal por 30 años, deducción del 100% de gastos en Ganancias, regalías provinciales limitadas al 3% del valor \

(reducible mediante deducciones), y exención del Impuesto sobre Activos. La inversión minera acumulada entre 2003 y 2015 alcanzó los **US$ 18.600 millones**. El gobierno de CFK enfrentó protestas masivas contra la megaminería sin pronunciarse nunca a favor de las comunidades. En **Famatina** (La Rioja), en enero de 2012, hasta 10.000 personas marcharon contra el proyecto de la canadiense Osisko Mining. El gobernador kirchnerista **Luis Beder Herrera** había firmado un convenio con la minera pese a haber llegado al cargo con discurso antiminero. El diputado Jorge Yoma reveló que CFK le dijo personalmente que _\

_. El intendente kirchnerista de Famatina que se opuso a la mina denunció que le cortaron fondos.

En **Andalgalá** (Catamarca), la resistencia contra el proyecto Agua Rica —tres veces más grande que Minera Alumbrera— generó represión y judicialización de asambleístas. En **Esquel** (Chubut), el plebiscito de 2003 donde el 81% votó contra la megaminería no recibió posicionamiento del gobierno nacional. Siete provincias prohibieron la minería a cielo abierto durante el período. La **Unión de Asambleas Ciudadanas** reunió más de 300 asambleas territoriales en todo el país. El gobierno nacional no promovió ningún mecanismo de consulta popular, delegando la cuestión en las provincias mientras promovía activamente la inversión minera desde la Nación.

La Corte Suprema intervino como contrapeso. En **julio de 2012**, revocó las medidas cautelares que el juez sanjuanino **Miguel Gálvez** había otorgado a Barrick Gold suspendiendo artículos centrales de la ley. La Corte sostuvo que _\

El kirchnerismo vota contra la reforma de Milei en 2026
-------------------------------------------------------

El 9 de abril de 2026, la Cámara de Diputados aprobó por **137 votos a favor, 111 en contra y 3 abstenciones** la reforma de la Ley de Glaciares impulsada por el gobierno de Milei. Los cambios eliminan la protección automática del ambiente periglacial, permiten a las provincias definir qué glaciares proteger, habilitan actividades productivas previo estudio de impacto ambiental provincial y retiran al inventario su carácter vinculante.

Conclusión: pragmatismo extractivo con retórica cambiante
---------------------------------------------------------

La trayectoria de CFK respecto a glaciares y minería revela un patrón consistente de **pragmatismo económico-político que adoptó distintos ropajes discursivos según la coyuntura**. Como presidenta, vetó la protección glaciar, se reunió con el CEO de Barrick Gold, mantuvo el marco legal de los años 90, celebró la minería como motor de desarrollo y permitió que sus funcionarios sabotearan la implementación de la ley que finalmente se aprobó contra la voluntad de su bloque. Los tres secretarios de Ambiente de su gobierno fueron procesados por obstruir el inventario de glaciares. Como opositora y vicepresidenta, adoptó un discurso contra el extractivismo sin valor agregado y su bloque votó contra la flexibilización de la ley que ella misma vetó originalmente.

Tres datos condensan la contradicción. Primero: en 2008, CFK vetó una ley aprobada por unanimidad; en 2010, una versión similar se aprobó por apenas dos votos, con 23 de los 33 votos negativos provenientes de su propio bloque. Segundo: CFK nunca firmó la promulgación de la Ley 26.639 —se promulgó de hecho por vencimiento del plazo—, una resistencia pasiva sin precedentes para una ley ambiental de esta magnitud. Tercero: el gobierno que vetó la ley en nombre del \

es el mismo cuyos funcionarios fueron procesados por impedir que se inventariaran los glaciares que la ley debía proteger, en la misma zona donde luego se produjo el peor desastre ambiental minero de la historia argentina.

La evolución posterior —del silencio como senadora al discurso soberanista sobre el litio como vicepresidenta— no constituye una revisión autocrítica sino una adaptación a nuevas coordenadas políticas. CFK nunca reconoció públicamente el error del veto de 2008, nunca explicó la promulgación tácita de 2010, nunca se pronunció sobre el derrame de Veladero, y el gobierno que integró como vicepresidenta nombró funcionarios sanjuaninos pro-mineros sin modificar el marco regulatorio heredado. La defensa de los glaciares, en definitiva, fue para el kirchnerismo una bandera disponible cuando no gobernaba y un obstáculo incómodo cuando lo hacía.

# Salida en semana santa a la catedral de Maturín ❤️

> Hola amigos de Hive en esta oportunidad les doy la bienvenida a esta hermosa comunidad que trata sobre la familia y los amigos, también para aquellos que disfrutamos de la hermandad, es por eso que en esta oportunidad les quiero presentar algunas fotografías que tomamos el día viernes santo en la catedral de la ciudad de Maturín. Para este encuentro fueron mis suegros, mi hijo, mi pareja y yo, los cuales tuvimos un grato momento en la iglesia, también pudimos observar a lo lejos la escena del lavado de los pies, igualmente la devoción de cada persona en esa iglesia. Teníamos pensado realizar la visita de los 7 templos, pero lamentablemente no se pudo ya que hubo un pequeño incidente en casa antes de salir, es por eso que decidimos quedarnos en ella y poder retomar la iglesia al día siguiente, para este momento lo hicimos de tarde y después de allí nos fuimos a comer un rico helado en una heladería muy cercana a la catedral, después nos quedamos un rato a las afueras de la iglesia y finalmente nos fuimos hasta la casa. Precisamente para esta fecha siempre llega mi familia, los cuales siempre me han me han conectado directamente con Dios y me acompañan siempre a las visitas de los 7 templos, aunque esto lo conocí gracias a la familia de mi pareja que ya falleció, quienes siempre en compañía de sus familiares en estos días santos viajan y van al recorrido de las 7 iglesias, aunque para mucho suele ser tedioso, para mí es un acto de fe y devoción hacia mi religión. Espero que les haya gustado, pronto les traeré un poco más de lo que fue mi Semana Santa. Un abrazo los quiero.

>

​Hello, Hive friends! Today, I’d like to welcome you to this beautiful community centered around family and friends, as well as for all of us who cherish the bonds of brotherhood. That is why I want to share some photographs we took this past Good Friday at the Cathedral in the city of Maturín. My parents-in-law, my son, my partner, and I all attended this gathering. We had a lovely time at the church, where we were able to observe the washing of the feet ceremony from a distance and witness the deep devotion of everyone present.


We had planned to do the \

visitation, but unfortunately, we couldn't make it due to a small incident at home before leaving. Because of that, we decided to stay in and head to the church the following day instead. On this occasion, we went in the afternoon, and afterward, we went to have some delicious ice cream at a shop very close to the cathedral. We spent a little more time hanging out just outside the church before finally heading back home.


​My family always visits around this time of year; they have always kept me directly connected to God and always join me for the \

visitation. I actually discovered this tradition thanks to my late partner's family, who always traveled during these Holy Days to complete the seven-church pilgrimage with their relatives. While many people might find it tedious, for me, it is a profound act of faith and devotion to my religion. ​I hope you enjoyed this! I will soon share more highlights from my Holy Week. Sending you a big hug—love you all! ---

body.title: Foraging For Another Batch Of The Scaly Lentinus Mushrooms!
body.body:
TGIF! It's another Friday to talk about everything fungi. So let's dive into it. 😅 

Some weeks ago, I shared a video where I was foraging for mushrooms - the Scaly Lentinus, at my sister's yard. I believe most of you watched it. But if you didn't, you can still watch it [here](https://ecency.com/hive-151327/@luchyl/d1322915?referral=luchyl). Thanks for watching. 😍 

So today, I'd be sharing photos of a different batch of the Scaly Lentinus mushrooms I foraged from the same source. As I mentioned earlier, the Scaly Lentinus grows naturally on dead wood or decaying deciduous trees, including avocado. 

There's a big avocado tree at the front of my sister's yard, which had to be removed during renovations to make space for landscaping. The tree had grown quite tall and was a threat to the property and human lives, so it was cut down and packed away. Interestingly, the stump has become a breeding ground for the Scaly Lentinus and other types of mushrooms. 


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNamKWusuuXHmKCL1UzGEcy2AAvqcTzemh3cZDcm1ySbN/1775864742080.jpg)


On one of my visits, I found some of these mushrooms that had grown quite big, and I ended up foraging for them. They were growing in clusters, and each cluster was quite large. 



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPkH15DPgPpBAzPhmF26rsTwB9ZjEWvqqq9GK1UcFbA1z/1775864920419.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTfVxBFYTR7B4gpMPtQqdvHbY5gAZax2X5FSX2UdZ1N8h/1775864920588.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfAj6ZdLczFWZdAWEhoiLRVa1q4NH8xaEAgukWghupKVL/1775864920753.jpg)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYBhu54KuhybxZKhD2RqX5ArX8a1NGjsccgAYZWZcwkT4/1775863199952.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ3EkPShyYw6ws1d4VeEWHT3ddR2hrMRkMKY5U1wqx3Hx/1775863200210.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVRcGfvdZe8xLsQ7ZAA3ZJwsoJJRFF3K3KAf82TzQTp9b/1775863200313.jpg)



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSzX1QAHpamxERFqDPaKNDps2bXBBZL184rt1sssA2D9A/1775863200702.jpg)


***

Give these an extra day, and they'll almost double in size. 




![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQUgWCCNejX5vZkeoV5Jz2coxe7SMGYTbkk6UvZvT9bLk/1775863418013.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSxbuJuWqducHupCc6nZ6e9dr91mf7TqxgLokABTAebwP/1775863418122.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUrE3zJu2SZ8ApKg8FRtue75hxg6gCt33wusCvirGS8vt/1775863418253.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTpQDXie5KRCZZnXHtQKvN7kSfgYHznpV6DtKyFaLnFHx/1775863418386.jpg)

Unlike the other types of mushrooms, like the Ero Onye Ntekam that grow seasonally, the Scaly Lentinus grows all year round, provided there are dead woods around. 

Oh, lest I forget, they're one of my favorites too. Have you foraged for mushrooms before? Which mushrooms grow more in your region, and where do you find them?

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@luchyl/foraging-for-another-batch-of-the-scaly-lentinus-mushrooms--bjo)

body.title: Building a Safe Place: Why We Are Raising $15,000 for a Dormitory.
body.body: In my previous post, I shared a painful story about some of the children in our school—how they were wrongly accused, unheard, and mistreated despite their innocence. That story is not an isolated case. It reflects a deeper reality. Many of the children we serve come from extremely vulnerable backgrounds. Some are orphans. Some go for days without proper meals. Many lack a safe and stable environment where they are protected and cared for. When they leave school, they return to uncertainty. Sometimes to hunger. Sometimes to neglect. Sometimes to situations where they are not safe. This is why we are working to build a dormitory. Not just a building—but a place of refuge. A place where children will have: • A safe place to sleep • Regular meals • Protection from harmful environments • Stability to focus on their education • A sense of belonging and care We are seeking to raise $15,000 to make this possible. To some, it may seem like a small structure. But to these children, it means: Safety. Dignity. Hope. It means they will not have to face the world alone. We are taking this step in faith, knowing that change often begins with people who are willing to care.Our example can in this manner be carried through years to come. If you feel moved by this mission, you can be part of building this safe space. And even if you are not in a position to give, sharing this story can help it reach someone who can.Your effort can be meaningful here even when you see that this may not work,just share it and leave it with someone you know.Your fellow church member,a friend or your church pastor.With many hands involved we can expedite this dream in unprecedented way.

/>

  
Together, we can create a place where children are not just educated—but protected and valued.

body.body: ![Hive-Banner-Green-Rounded.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23tGM7REKBsvoBhPiEV5Fvb8tb333qQ8N9x2YfxaF9vWohE9Qf39RUEAn3LfysdgfbYpZ.png) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260409_153324845.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23u65PtLh7cf4Pby2UPLdvTPrkVyf1AL3CygDsoLmBuKLi24CRYaEoALJmiGk7ZxCSuuZ.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) >I live naked and barefooted, very close to Earth and Nature, in an 18-acre, off-grid, clothing-optional, food-forest intentional community ([GaiaYoga Gardens](https://gaiayoga.org)), way out in the jungles of Lower Puna, far East Big Island, Hawai'i, and I have for more than 7 years now. Although there are many challenges, I love my life, and I'm immensely grateful to live where and how I do, on my own terms! I would not want to live any other way! 😁🙏💚⚡💥🔥✴️✳️❇️👣🌱✨🤙 ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) ``` Hive Debt: 23.71% HIVE Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.061 USD HBD/HIVE-Backed Dollar Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.996 USD ALIVE SWAP.HIVE Price: 0.03712497 SWAP.HIVE HEARTBEAT ALIVE Price: 0.38618979 ALIVE BLURT Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.00117361 USD QORT Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.148440 USD VOI Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.0001739 USD BTC/Bitcoin Fiat-Dollar Price: 73,266.95 USD BCH/Bitcoin Cash Fiat-Dollar Price: 445.64 USD LTC/Litecoin Fiat-Dollar Price: 55.25 USD Gold Fiat-Dollar Price: 4,747.00 USD Silver Fiat-Dollar Price: 76.11 USD Ranking for Our @aliveandmmb Witness Node: #131 (among all witnesses, including inactive)/#103 (among active witnesses only)/448.8 HP in votes/46 votes in total ``` ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) Warm greetings all! 😁🙏💚✨🤙 After a bit more reading, research, assistance and suggestions to try from Grok, and lots of experimenting and testing yesterday evening, I was finally able to figure out and resolve all notable issues in my Arch-to-Artix-conversion process, so I now have a fully-functional Artix Linux installation. I still have two more Arch Linux installations to convert/migrate to Artix, and given that I want to keep the process and important points about it clearly in memory for my next two rounds, I'm planning to dive into converting the other two as soon as possible, hopefully within the next two weeks or so. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260409_153140936_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23xAZpjCd2CqLjC9eSDAW4kZXmtqyN2WyNzRz178n1Jbz8mxoMtui8ojfoieLu1CajpmZ.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260409_153350012.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23w2gXpoRhgwp9YTrn3R5EaAMw6YA1mifwABZURfV5aQXmuTF1CadX7QoLfniRP8Hwsbj.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) Thankfully after uninstalling, deleting all data, and reinstalling Vivaldi, I was able to recover most of my most-used browser tabs from a sync backup, so I was up and running on Hive and Blurt again as soon as I readded all the keys to Hive Keychain and WhaleVault. Many things in Vivaldi can be synced back, which is very helpful indeed. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260409_153441300.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23tbtvPQHHW5yC5UjVTBwjK3J1ctnhAmsbfpGyhjEWbVktMBCXZiEy2BfWLyqSS1F1yXQ.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260409_153532039.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23vhuWPjdX5ezJquYtmtDFVjx8aHqkwPzJMfi8o9bGCk6NMLMXDKZuYrtpKjGMDiVmuH4.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) I have one or two more minor issues to fix, that I'm going to do my best to investigate and resolve at some point either today or tomorrow. Once those two small problems are fixed, I'll clone this new Artix Linux installation, swap in another Arch Linux installation into my laptop, and then jump into the next round of conversion. Once the second one is successfully converted, I'll start almost immediately with the third and last Arch installation to migrate to Artix. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260409_153740682.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23xAVcFMRh9YUJaFqyGzhuaU1d7xPAuc6T82SJAsjZ6BQCAEE4dPCw6qd8guMBWD6ot4V.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260409_153936743.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23wMWc36gqmUZTj4tWp63Fsa8V4gPxGmqiKMQkJNoK1Nz4ocBFUPwTsBLyXWVqwbM9864.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) I will say that the boot time on my laptop is now much faster using the dinit init system than it was using systemd. It only takes a handful of seconds now to go from boot or reboot back to the desktop, which is extraordinary indeed. So now I have the double speed boost of my Arch/Artix installations being on NVMe SSDs, and now with the notably faster dinit intit system. That's pretty nifty, I've got to say! ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260409_154028495.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23tSaytkrErbRieDqmdA7Ni7owZfa8DSGKZXM7jDTdT9KyjH4znym6X134VMVjgmBdbXc.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260409_154105139.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23vi8KezkpyjVQRvFoBMJLwKVsk5TZjzrtdJ8GgjYgjoeY9xK3x3QcyweHcYXu9pqVG6z.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) There are all sorts of amazing and diverse Linux distributions, but Arch, and those distributions based on it like Artix, are the most interesting to me, because the Arch Linux framework is so incredible, as it provides those who work with it a highly customizable, configurable, flexible, fast, and efficient operating system, and a huge variety of software, that can be installed and updated as binary packages from the official and assorted unofficial repositories, as well as compiled (*software can often be compiled in specific ways, to meet specific needs*), installed, and updated from source. Arch, Artix, and other Arch-based Linux distributions are also 100%-community-driven, so their development is much more decentralized compared to Windows, MacOS, or Linux distributions that are created and managed by corporations. It's fascinating to know that every single super computer in the world runs some version or other of Linux. Not Windows, and not MacOS. Windows and MacOS don't even come close to what's possible in Linux. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260409_154307346.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23wWyPzgYFZahEd5LGtC1AsKzBVzbKoMonK9mvv8zSY3gnW3bkN1bgxUQrGRogyCjXxXj.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260409_154442222.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23wgWVdWPM5Y8bwFyr2DmNVm6kcv1WELrK76Xp4SX4n8NHXJKMKrPhYPUUMvvhKmLTGJo.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) Yesterday, Thursday, I left the Flow House, after finishing up my Hive-Blurt-'We Are Alive Tribe' tasks, quite late, mostly due to copious rain, by a little after 3:30PM, giving my attention to some photography for my posts first, and then to a few small jungle-community tasks. The weather was cloudy and quite rainy again, so I turned on the generator, and I headed to Wabisabi fairly early in the evening to heat myself up some food that I had in the fridge, and with that and my jar of leftover superfood fire coffee in hands, I made my way back to the Flow House to do another very-successful round of Arch-to-Artix conversion troubleshooting, and to begin on my evening Hive tasks. I got through all of my notifications by around 10PM, and after some asset management, I went to bed, a bit on the late side once again, by a bit after 12:30AM. I woke up just before 7AM, having slept reasonably well, going to prepare my superfood fire coffee in Wabisabi, then returning to the Flow House to write this post. It's now just before 2PM, so it's a really good time to wrap this up, so that I may attend to my few other important Hive-Blurt-'We Are Alive Tribe' tasks, before leaving the Flow House a little later in the afternoon, to focus first on some photography for my posts, and then on some jungle-community/land work and tasks. I deeply appreciate y'all so very much! Until tomorrow's manifestation of theses posts! 😁 🙏 💚 ✨ 🤙 ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260409_154535283.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23uFPm7hNFAijvKjbHs6ScK3xUUN8oAEdq4sk5eBDc7oRboCbHCGqZeZem1E7c9TBWFZR.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260409_154605350.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23wC7rUdk5bzSUwedKBxrDMPcvN9t9rACAJXs8XWYGVcFi5ndMkzEnn1cpU3tyUkSAFjb.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) ### 2026 Life Goals ``` 1.) Do regular integral practices again, alone or with others. 2.) Prepare regular batches of my medicinal teas collected from the land again. 3.) Make my plant nursery, and the gardens, beautiful again. 4.) Begin learning relevant coding/programming languages to more fully contribute to the sovereignty-driven technologies where I am active, like Arch Linux, Hive, Qortal, DeSo, and Bastyon. ``` ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) *All photos were taken with my **Motorola G Play 2024 Android Phone**.* ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1RxBbudG9rt2dp1cGCcDqm1HJsmhBZUTJ8yUepXHTDRdUuVF5MhuePSiKAaiqqoQ.png) Thank you all so much who have helped me get to where I am today, and allowing me to share more of the beauty and magic from my life and my world with you, and for your continuous appreciation and support! I am truly deeply grateful! 😁🙏💚✨🤙 ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1RxBbudG9rt2dp1cGCcDqm1HJsmhBZUTJ8yUepXHTDRdUuVF5MhuePSiKAaiqqoQ.png) If you'd like to find me on other alternative platforms where I have accounts (I spend most of my time here on ***Hive***), click on this signature image below to go to my *LinkTree* page. body.title: 대전 오월드 늑대 늑구
body.body:
오늘 기사를 보면서 마음이 좀 무거워졌다. 대전 오월드에서 탈출한 늑대 ‘늑구’가 사흘째 발견되지 않았다는 소식을 접했는데, 단순한 사건이라기보다 한 생명의 위태로운 상황처럼 느껴졌다.

처음엔 “어디 숨어 있겠지”라는 생각이 들었지만, 기사를 읽을수록 걱정이 커졌다. 늑구가 야생에서 태어난 개체가 아니라 사육 환경에서 자라 사냥 능력이 부족하다는 점이 특히 마음에 걸렸다. 자연에서는 당연한 ‘먹이 찾기’조차 쉽지 않다는 게 안타깝게 느껴졌다. 비와 안개 때문에 수색도 어려웠다고 하니, 늑구는 얼마나 더 불안하고 지쳤을까 상상하게 됐다.

드론으로 추적하다가 배터리 문제로 놓쳤다는 부분에서는 조금 아쉬움도 들었다. 그 짧은 순간이 이렇게 길어질 수도 있다는 게 현실적으로 느껴졌다. 그래도 여러 기관과 전문가들이 함께 찾고 있고, 먹이도 곳곳에 놓아두었다는 점에서 작은 희망을 가져본다.

오늘 하루는 뉴스 하나로도 생명에 대해 다시 생각하게 된 날이었다. 인간이 만든 환경에서 살아가던 동물이 갑자기 자연에 놓였을 때 얼마나 취약해질 수 있는지 느꼈다. 늑구가 무사히 발견되어 다시 안전한 곳으로 돌아가기를 진심으로 바란다.

body.title: I reached Gold Rank III in Splinterlands  Frontier【 🇪🇸 - 🇺🇸 】
body.body:
> 

Saludos, estimados hivers que dan vida a #Splinterlands. Hoy les traigo un momento especial en mi perfil que duró sólo unas cuantas batallas porque tras perder, retomé mi nivel de Silver I. Hoy les comparto el momento en el que fui feliz y llegué a Rango de Oro III.

> Greetings, fellow Hivers who bring #Splinterlands to life. Today I bring you a special moment on my profile that only lasted a few battles because after losing, I regained my Silver I rank. Today, I share with you the moment I was happy and reached Gold III Rank.

<center>![sep.2026.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/23tbPXTf1bvy4jaGNjptgQFy5gWYhWKJKS8g2jUuibSPhe56BuNS1C7amKtxLNKAEqeKn.png)</center>

<center>![1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/23tRxWboEngNxdf864zdUZP3muvP8Lrv78DJatVZBKHYapC9KEQSvubuTE3bSuR1aFnMT.png)</center>



<div class=\

>

Como pueden ver, mi perfil actualmente dice que sigo en Silver I. Pero como les dije, llegué por un breve momento a Oro III y en ese instante fui feliz. Ya que empecé hace poco más de un mes y ya logré llegar a este nivel, me siento orgullosa de mi avance.

El premio no lo entendía muy bien, pero ya luego decifré cómo abrirlos todos y lo que me dieron realmente. Por eso me ven que dudo un poco en si ir al lobby o hacer ¿qué cosa?


> As you can see, my profile currently says I'm still at Silver I. But as I mentioned, I briefly reached Gold III, and I was happy for a moment. Since I started just over a month ago and have already reached this level, I'm proud of my progress.
>
> I didn't quite understand the reward at first, but I later figured out how to open them all and what they actually gave me. That's why you see me hesitating a bit, wondering whether to go to the lobby or do... what?

<center>![4.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/23t7BZ8hvVT41gM9MjsQSED2PaRvDVLVEfVGhMGErxFiwJfiad77XB3bBg3CSaCtoQc8R.png)</center>




<div class\

>

Y bueno, por lo que veo creo que me dieron primero un premio y luego el otro que era el especial por haber alcanzado el Rango Oro III. Igual todo sale en el video y si me apoyan por Youtube, se los agradecería mucho también con un pequeño like.

> Well, from what I can see, I think I received one award first, and then the other, which was the special one for reaching Gold Rank III. It's all in the video, and if you support me on YouTube, I'd really appreciate it with a like.


<center>![5.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/48FiSez85pze5dL7LpMmcxd2QTshQLX71BWzNU5pGDsZf2VJ9qNiSR3Gg8VJMHW2DM.png)</center>

Aquí está mi premio real, mis 15 premios por haber hecho bien la tarea en ganar muchas batallas por varios días seguidos y alcanzar finalmente ese rango de oro que tanto anhelaba desde que empecé. Yo era una de esos tantos usuarios que veían a los demás en este rango y decía wow, algún día quisiera jugar así de bien y seguir subiendo de nivel.

> Here's my real prize, my 15 awards for doing my homework, winning many battles for several days in a row, and finally reaching that gold rank I'd longed for since I started. I was one of those many users who saw others at this rank and thought, \

>


Ya aquí pueden ver el video como tal, este momento especial cargado de alegría, lo edité con mucho cariño para ustedes ya que mi anterior video creo que lo hice mal y se veían ciertos detalles que no debían verse. 

Es un video bastante corto, así que si te tomas un minuto para verlo, te lo agradecería enormemente ya que me ayudas a crecer por mi otra red social.

> Here you can see the video itself, this special moment filled with joy. I edited it with a lot of love for you because I think I messed up my previous video, and some details shouldn't have been seen.
>
>It's a fairly short video, so if you take a minute to watch it, I would greatly appreciate it, as it helps me grow on my other social media platform.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GAZ0oh7hhDg

<div class\

>

Me salieron un total de siete cartas y unas cuantas pociones que me sirven de mucha ayuda. Las cartas fueron muy buenas, aunque son de frontera, me sirven las que están repetidas para subirlas de nivel y darles más poder. Hacer esto me da más ventaja en cada batalla.


> I got a total of seven cards and a few very helpful potions. The cards were great, and even though they're from the frontier, I can level up the duplicates to make them more powerful. Doing this gives me a significant advantage in every battle.


<center>![7.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/23swntqVyXF2V2gsKVAAr5GkkKfGfACQwX82qQQZA7jFgmGvbEeAmeR8mNEgPryJtBFFm.png)</center>

<div class\

>

Ver tantos cofres juntos me puso realmente nerviosa, era como ver una piñata romperse en pedacitos sin saber qué me tocaría de premio. Esto es lo que más me gusta de Splinterlands, que dan muy buenos premios y muy buenas recompensas cuando se invierte tiempo en ello. Las recompensas valen la pena.


> Seeing so many chests together really made me nervous; it was like watching a piñata shatter into pieces without knowing what I'd get. This is what I love most about Splinterlands: they give really good prizes and great rewards when you invest time in them. The rewards are worth it.

<center>![8.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/23tbPi8Dntma4dhtNna1695zQnL2PSHYQjZ1cGscVHNxuFvDEEkA9jaPSVMkM3bh7xcHu.png)</center>

***
***

<div class\

> Bueno, dejaré mi post hasta aquí, espero que lo hayan disfrutado tanto como yo cuando se lo redacté. Si llegaste al final de mi post, te doy las gracias infinitas por leerlo. ¡Hasta una próxima publicación! 🌸 > Well, I'll leave my post here. I hope you enjoyed it as much as I enjoyed writing it. If you made it to the end, thank you so much for reading! Until next time! 🌸
![sps.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/23w2cj7QkcEnRavFxEmvXYSutH3qifiTToekTNwn3tVLWQZBYiUyKpY1aHu6uEee4sPe9.gif)

body.body:

<center>
![O69FWcVrlAqAS7ZD_1000215041.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/filoriologo/images/O69FWcVrlAqAS7ZD_1000215041/O69FWcVrlAqAS7ZD_1000215041.webp)

</center>
</liketuimages>

He estado reflexionando sobre el poder simbólico y he estado reflexionando un montón de cosas al respecto. En resumen, aunque no puedo controlar lo que las personas piensan de mi, si puedo influir en como me perciben y en eso quiero enfocarme, aunque no se trata únicamente de cambios estéticos o superficiales hay cosas que ameritan decisiones.

Incluso estoy pensando en matar a filoriologo, pero descuida, hablo solo del pseudónimo...aunque eso aún no lo decido es algo que estoy cuestionando.

Tengo ahora simplemente una premisa, enfocarme en entender que el poder simbólico se construye desde lo invisible.

¿Has pensado en el poder simbólico?
¿Qué consejo me das?


*Fotografía @filoriologo Redmi Note 14**Edición: Adobe Photoshop Lightroom*


***

---

##  ENGLISH VERSION

# The Call of Symbolic Power

I’ve been thinking about symbolic power, and I’ve been pondering a lot of things related to it. In short, while I can’t control what people think of me, I can influence how they perceive me, and that’s what I want to focus on—though it’s not just about aesthetic or superficial changes; there are things that warrant making decisions.

I’m also thinking about killing off Filoriologo, but don’t worry—I’m only talking about the pseudonym… though I haven’t decided yet; it’s something I’m still considering.

Right now, I have just one premise: to focus on understanding that symbolic power is built from the invisible.

Have you thought about symbolic power?
What advice do you have for me?

body.title: Playa puerto Viejo [Esp/Eng]
body.body:
>  ![321832.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23uQnDQ2zq7wFjzY6znppWo6WhTru2QsQYrAKAzbbe6xUSJyPKfGTu3npwgNK7e3wQKYk.png) Hola, ¿qué tal, gente, cómo están? ¿Cómo les ha ido? Espero que muy bien, de verdad que sí. Yo por aquí muy contenta porque sí, son los viernes, para mí contenta porque voy a descansar, jajajajja. Saben que no recordaba que les había compartido mi excursión al Copei, pero no les compartí el after, jajaja, sí, el after como el nuevo álbum de Rawayana, que está buenísimo, por cierto. Bueno, yo ese día salí de mi casa con que iba para el Copei, pero ya mi amigo me había dicho que podíamos hacer algo después para pasar el rato.
Hi there, how’s it going, everyone? How are you all? How have things been? I hope you’re all doing really well, I really do. I’m feeling pretty chuffed over here because, well, it’s Friday, and I’m happy because I’m going to have a rest, ha ha ha ha. You know, I didn’t realise I’d told you about my trip to Copei, but I didn’t tell you about the after-party, ha ha ha, yes, the after-party like Rawayana’s new album, which is brilliant, by the way. Well, that day I left home thinking I was off to Copei, but my friend had already told me we could do something afterwards to hang out.
![20260405_151433.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23zRxjPvMneGncM2p3BDTDv3yNcCTTPnkB7wcUCEvQ59cBZ6tYmi9jRhkMqvnm4tMgk6G.jpg) ![20260405_150835.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/Ep5jhGjJ8u4jEA2gqTLvzoh4U9fP4v2vwvf2TdY9p1Jsc6pF1jtmv5M7Wq5Hwqu2Xqt.jpg) ![20260405_150836.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/EqUbTkMbgCmwZouAT2wNw85Rqnm99UCJfYSfzhz81j3BPE8f1iqGSqjCN6vgkfRaNew.jpg) Dicho rato fue que después de eso la familia de él le envió un mensaje que estaban en la playa, que fueran un rato. Yo no tenía mucho ánimo porque, ajá, era domingo de Semana Santa y había mucha gente en la playa y yo no quería, pues, pero con la calor que tenía y el cuerpo cansado, dije: \

. Pero la cuestión es que nosotros, en vez de bajar por la Asunción, como subimos, bajamos por Juan Griego y me gustó mucho el paseo por toda esa parte, ya que no es una zona que comúnmente conozco. La cuestión es que llegamos detrás de Hesperia y entramos por su misma entrada, cosa que yo nunca había hecho, porque era mi primera vez por esa playa. Como no se puede entrar por el camino del hotel, por el lado hay un camino de tierra por donde pasamos los mortales que no estamos hospedados en el hotel.
It was just then that his family sent him a message saying they were at the beach and asking him to come along for a bit. I wasn’t really in the mood because, well, it was Easter Sunday and there were loads of people on the beach and I didn’t really fancy it, but with the heat and feeling so tired, I said, ‘I’ll go.’ But the thing is, instead of going down via La Asunción, as we’d come up, we went down via Juan Griego and I really enjoyed the walk through that whole area, as it’s not a part I’m usually familiar with. The thing is, we ended up behind Hesperia and went in through their entrance, which I’d never done before, as it was my first time at that beach. As you can’t go in via the hotel path, there’s a dirt track to the side that we mere mortals who aren’t staying at the hotel use.
![20260405_160401.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/244oUsXWQzGuAVSMLapUDDafT8NdQH3SpRXqns2a2qMTQGfQvxALqPT78iyf5qsw5smpD.jpg) ![20260405_163252.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23y8xK2xb9PvTmko8dZ6DKYsFAGjoAWDLXdy65hMik1rx57bjnc8XkUFRsM7cT8ycEFo9.jpg) ![20260405_162949.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/241tX3awLPa9uzoCAus8Ymzh9b9ZxxyLrchZcvpKtaLkXJFWpF2QD6uM7YzRhwgRLB9MJ.jpg) ![20260405_163129.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/243M7SKR1qbidC6j7jgmWhUVAL9AbRE32PcPCL3NGrsUeDWG5JeqvfC5f4YaPSQvsnazZ.jpg) ![20260405_152715.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/243BiVW5vF4Bef4sZRi5oAKFfVtAZ3ut7mZPzJ7h1bzUSDfdgvwo7e7fVfx4cHN6X4Mbg.jpg) La cuestión es que al llegar me dio risa que está dividido entre la parte del hotel y la parte normal y hay atracciones como moto de agua e igualmente la banana, que por cierto es algo que me gusta muchísimo. El agua, pues, hipermegafría, literalmente me estaba muriendo, y lo otro que me dio mucha risa es que tú, por donde caminabas, encontrabas estrellitas de mar y aproveché para tomarles fotitos, así como también a esto que encontré que parece como un coral o varios caracoles juntos; la verdad, se veía raro, y entre una y otra cosa se ven pocos vendedores, pero sí hay un local de Hesperia, pero tú puedes comprar en él. Me dio curiosidad indagar su nombre y se llama Puerto Viejo. ¡Saludos!
The thing is, when I got there, I found it quite funny that it’s split into the hotel area and the general area, and there are attractions like jet skis and the banana boat – which, by the way, is something I really love. The water, well, was freezing cold – I was literally freezing to death – and the other thing that made me laugh was that wherever you walked, you’d find little starfish, so I took the opportunity to snap a few photos of them, as well as this thing I found that looks like a piece of coral or a bunch of snails all stuck together; to be honest, it looked a bit odd, and apart from that, there aren’t many vendors around, but there is a Hesperia shop, and you can buy things there. I was curious to find out its name, and it’s called Puerto Viejo. Cheers!

body.title: Pretty Lethal's recommendation 🩰: ballet can be a lethal weapon. [Eng/Esp]
body.body:
> **Hello, film lovers!** I hope you’re all well. Today I’m here to recommend a film that’s a bit bizarre but quite funny, which I watched recently; it’s one of those films where you can just sit back, have a laugh and enjoy yourself for a while, with plenty of action and laughs thanks to the sheer madness of the situation. The film is called: Pretty lethal.
![17758641072096442635456382434811.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valsalazar/23wWkLqxqxgwdHw9Foe6XNbHj1TuKFe3LUFWGQ1ctfPdLiTBrYvDppqt1rF6bGzCAmreE.jpg)
[Doblaje Wiki]( https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/doblaje/images/2/24/Lindas_y_letales_2026.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20260329235719&path-prefix=es )
The story is about a group of five young dancers with quite different personalities, who, along with their coach, travel to Hungary to take part in a prestigious dance competition. Unfortunately, the coach breaks down halfway there, so they end up taking refuge in the strange, dark and menacing inn run by Devora Kaisimer. It is worth noting that the inn is a haunt for gangsters and underworld criminals, where tourists never leave. So, from the moment the dancers enter and witness the brutal murder of their coach, the plot turns into a fight for survival, where the dancers will use their years of training, pain and technique to take down Devora and the criminals staying there. ![17758636753517583972922888422391.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valsalazar/23tGyM5HLiszF59toR32dLBrP7T6cGjnE8UTNiWB3kyjVcKQ9QpsWYBkr366qCqtj3tgK.jpg)
[IMDb]( https://m.imdb.com/es/title/tt26678938/mediaviewer/rm1069997826/?ref_=ext_shr_lnk )
![17758637450206665602914876573161.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valsalazar/23tbK6aNXb1CSeSE9mkXsSHokJR7iCcztXn7Qgd7c2ugm9cdhqcZJUe7NhQBsfBGBtDUW.jpg)
[IMDb]( https://m.imdb.com/es/title/tt26678938/mediaviewer/rm1727649538/?ref_=ext_shr_lnk )
Something I really enjoyed, apart from seeing Uma Thurman in the role of the ruthless Devora Kaisimer, were the much-anticipated ballet choreographies adapted for combat, where the standout was undoubtedly the actress and professional dancer Maddie Ziegler (she performed the most complicated ballet steps). The film made me laugh a lot, because it’s a light-hearted thriller, fast-paced and very funny. It has a style of dark elegance, but with blood and violence. The film repeatedly emphasises the discipline and demands of ballet, talking about obsession, envy and the pressure to be perfect—and, if not, to be broken. ![17758638399308539897381181890305.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valsalazar/23sweNDkVEbyxWGJpFMuYtrZoRLgKqS5fSLtxRW5n79VKBAyMApXrDTWwP4ejnAnN4z3R.jpg)
[IMDb]( https://m.imdb.com/es/title/tt26678938/mediaviewer/rm1881986562/?ref_=ext_shr_lnk)
![17758639397257106689814473179367.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valsalazar/EoAU3NNMaHPmuL14MMCzX6oe2J6oe5KJFYC4v5GdUQDYYXyUQAGxMrfwEmDb1TPe6zo.jpg)
[IMDb]( https://m.imdb.com/es/title/tt26678938/mediaviewer/rm46587650/?ref_=ext_shr_lnk )
The scenes are explosive, the characters eccentric, with razor blades in their ballet shoes and dancers who just wanted to go to a competition; it turns into sequences of non-stop action, funny scenes with black humour and an entertaining film to watch. Overall, I quite liked it; it was entertaining and fun to watch, especially because of the dancers. Because of Bones’s leadership and strength, Princess’s arrogance, the protective Zoe, the wild Chloe and the very religious Grace.
![1000167922.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valsalazar/23wr7T13K3akYgwrutQkHPN5SNsieBsDHDD9FoQ3F9KfbF6nzU7aoj8HhfhHT5egriMVb.jpg)
**¡Hola, amantes de las películas!** Espero que se encuentren bien. Hoy les vengo a recomendar una película un poco bizarra pero bastante graciosa que vi hace poco; es de esas películas para sentarse, reírse y entretenerse un rato, con acción y risas por lo alocado de la situación. Esta película se llama: Lindas y letales.
![17758641072096442635456382434811.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valsalazar/23wWkLqxqxgwdHw9Foe6XNbHj1TuKFe3LUFWGQ1ctfPdLiTBrYvDppqt1rF6bGzCAmreE.jpg)
[Doblaje Wiki]( https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/doblaje/images/2/24/Lindas_y_letales_2026.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20260329235719&path-prefix=es )
La historia trata de un grupo de 5 jóvenes bailarinas con personalidades bastante diferentes, quienes junto a su entrenadora viajan a Hungría para asistir a un prestigioso concurso de danza. Por desgracia, el autobús se avería a medio camino, por lo que terminan refugiándose en la extraña, oscura y amenazante posada de Devora Kaisimer. Cabe destacar que la posada es una posada frecuentada por mafiosos y criminales del bajo mundo, donde los turistas no vuelven a salir. Por lo que, a partir de que las bailarinas entran y presencian el cruel asesinato de su entrenadora, la trama se transforma en una lucha por la supervivencia, donde las bailarinas usarán sus años de entrenamiento, dolor y técnica para acabar con Devora y los criminales que se hospedan ahí. ![17758636753517583972922888422391.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valsalazar/23tGyM5HLiszF59toR32dLBrP7T6cGjnE8UTNiWB3kyjVcKQ9QpsWYBkr366qCqtj3tgK.jpg)
[IMDb]( https://m.imdb.com/es/title/tt26678938/mediaviewer/rm1069997826/?ref_=ext_shr_lnk )
![17758637450206665602914876573161.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valsalazar/23tbK6aNXb1CSeSE9mkXsSHokJR7iCcztXn7Qgd7c2ugm9cdhqcZJUe7NhQBsfBGBtDUW.jpg)
[IMDb]( https://m.imdb.com/es/title/tt26678938/mediaviewer/rm1727649538/?ref_=ext_shr_lnk )
Algo que me gustó mucho, aparte de ver a Uma Thurman en el papel de la despiadada Devora Kaisimer, fueron las esperadas coreografías de ballet adaptadas al combate, donde la evidentemente más destacada fue la actriz y bailarina profesional Maddie Ziegler (ella hizo los pasos de ballet más complicados). La película me hizo reír mucho, porque es un thriller ligero, rápido en acción y muy gracioso. Con un estilo de elegancia oscura, pero con sangre y violencia. La película hace énfasis en repetidas ocasiones en la disciplina y exigencias del ballet, hablando de obsesión, envidia y presión por ser perfectas y, si no, estar rotas. ![17758638399308539897381181890305.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valsalazar/23sweNDkVEbyxWGJpFMuYtrZoRLgKqS5fSLtxRW5n79VKBAyMApXrDTWwP4ejnAnN4z3R.jpg)
[IMDb]( https://m.imdb.com/es/title/tt26678938/mediaviewer/rm1881986562/?ref_=ext_shr_lnk)
![17758639397257106689814473179367.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valsalazar/EoAU3NNMaHPmuL14MMCzX6oe2J6oe5KJFYC4v5GdUQDYYXyUQAGxMrfwEmDb1TPe6zo.jpg)
[IMDb]( https://m.imdb.com/es/title/tt26678938/mediaviewer/rm46587650/?ref_=ext_shr_lnk )
Las escenas son explosivas, los personajes excéntricos, con cuchillas en las zapatillas de ballet y bailarinas que solo querían ir a un concurso; se transforma en secuencias de acción constante, escenas graciosas con humor negro y una película entretenida para ver. En general, me gustó bastante; fue entretenida y divertida de ver, sobre todo por las bailarinas. Por el liderazgo y fuerza de Bones, la arrogancia de Princess, la protectora Zoe, la desatada Chloe y la muy religiosa Grace.
🔅 Cover in/Portada en [Doblaje Wiki](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/doblaje/images/2/24/Lindas_y_letales_2026.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20260329235719&path-prefix=es ), 🇺🇸Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator (free version)

body.title: 76ers drop third straight game vs Rockets | Team in Indianapolis to face Pacers tonight
body.body:
![nba-philadelphia-76ers-logo.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/adhammer/AK3eyGpWbyoaTTjJeeKnj44681PrD7tPGkoXMiDJYKDywwjPDVKgyqJH3UhvszU.png)
[Src](https://loodibee.com/nba/nba-philadelphia-76ers-logo/)

The Sixers had an awkward game vs the Rockets yesterday. They were getting pretty much destroyed for a majority of the contest but made things really interesting with a fourth quarter surge. They were down as much as 28 but made it a 5 point game with 1:36 remaining in the game. 

I'm pretty proud of the boys but unfortunately it wasn't good enough. Paul George had a rough game after a stretch of good ones. It would have been nice to see him play better vs Kevin Durant but it is what it is. Tyrese Maxey, V.J. Edgecombe, and Quentin Grimes combined for 64 points which is solid, and Andre Drummond grabbed an impressive 15 rebounds.

The Sixers' chances at grabbing a top six spot are rapidly dwindling. They were looking good for a minute but have lost three straight at a very bad time. Dang.

They still have a chance though, and luckily they play the Pacers and Bucks in these final games. They should finish with a 45-37 record. If they do, all they can do is hope the cookie crumbles in their favor. They still will be in the play-in!

Man, I can't believe the season is nearly over. Halloween, Thanksgiving, Christmas, the New Year, Valentine's Day, St. Patrick's Day, and spring is now here. Time flies man. 

Playoff spots, storylines, to the side, I'm just grateful to watch the second to last Sixers game. Phillies are playing too. Rare times!

Hola amigos de #hive y en especial a la comunidad de @music1sound como siempre espero que se encuentren bien al igual que sus familiares y amigos. En el día de hoy paso por acá para traerles un cover de la canción \

content.description:
<div class=text-justify>






Hola amigos de #hive y en especial a la comunidad de @music1sound como siempre espero que se encuentren bien al igual que sus familiares y amigos. En el día de hoy paso por acá para traerles un cover de la canción \

de la cantante española Malú, un tema musical hermoso y que la verdad me gusta mucho. 



![1000230779.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariolisrnaranjo/Ep5q7cXUVmFv81zDDWGrMyP9EkYytB7mhFserymghTnbGGbF8JUR2CW883gwk6isQCy.jpg)


\

es una canción que en su totalidad una canción de desamor y sobre el desenlace de una relación toxica que llega a su fin, en la cual la intérprete habla de una relacion no correspondida en la cual siente vacío y soledad a pesar de estar acompañada. Esta es una canción de valentía y empoderamiento, donde la interprete decide romper los lazos que la unen a ese amof tóxico.



![1000230780.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariolisrnaranjo/EpA5tLm6771V1LhdMjeGDbWuDfNDmpEMgPA37wYQmsQ6hAHnX6UxodrapJeWvo5UQzS.jpg)


Malú en esta canción termina con un momento amargo de su vida, liberandose de las cadenas de un amor que solo le hacía daño. Es definitivamente un tema musical de empoderamiento femenino que resuena con todo aquel que este pasando por la misma situación. Amigos yo por mi parte me despido de ustedes y espero que puedan disfrutar de este cover. Un saludo especial a todos y bendiciones miles. 



![1000230778.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariolisrnaranjo/23xexZkNCKYCEZVGsEaviiAfSFNjzV98eeayoCHh8dPH8TqWDtbjKn64ZzKpmzwgeyiXr.jpg)




<div class=\

> Las imágenes utilizadas en el post son de mi propiedad, tomadas con mi móvil Tecno Spark Go del 2024. Este video fue editado en la app disponible para móviles [InShort](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.camerasideas.instashot). Textos llevados al Inglés por [Deepl Traslate](https://www.deepl.com/mobile-apps/?utm_source=android&utm_medium=app&utm_campaign=share-with-friends). ‎
‎ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

Hello, friends of #hive, and especially to the @music1sound community. As always, I hope you and your family and friends are doing well. Today I’m stopping by to share a cover of the song “Deshazte de mí” by the Spanish singer Malú—a beautiful track that I really love. \

is a song entirely about heartbreak and the end of a toxic relationship that has run its course, in which the singer speaks of an unrequited relationship where she feels empty and lonely despite being in someone’s company. This is a song of courage and empowerment, where the singer decides to break the ties that bind her to that toxic relationship.




In this song, Malú puts an end to a bitter chapter of her life, freeing herself from the chains of a love that only hurt her. It is definitely a song about female empowerment that resonates with anyone going through the same situation. Friends, I’ll say goodbye for now and hope you enjoy this cover. A special greeting to everyone and a thousand blessings.
