body.title: 晚上吃點粥 / A Simple Porridge Dinner
body.body:
![e9K9VUXhtVNyJSI7_P_20260314_174125.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/diochen/images/e9K9VUXhtVNyJSI7_P_20260314_174125/e9K9VUXhtVNyJSI7_P_20260314_174125.webp) ![TTBYnAJgztR9r2hQ_P_20260314_174019.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/diochen/images/TTBYnAJgztR9r2hQ_P_20260314_174019/TTBYnAJgztR9r2hQ_P_20260314_174019.webp) ![SuV0rIpR45Ruo3Y9_P_20260314_174034.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/diochen/images/SuV0rIpR45Ruo3Y9_P_20260314_174034/SuV0rIpR45Ruo3Y9_P_20260314_174034.webp) ![JgYUTORTUtknTxLI_P_20260314_174322.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/diochen/images/JgYUTORTUtknTxLI_P_20260314_174322/JgYUTORTUtknTxLI_P_20260314_174322.webp) ![uGmL9f9czmb84wqP_P_20260314_173857.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/diochen/images/uGmL9f9czmb84wqP_P_20260314_173857/uGmL9f9czmb84wqP_P_20260314_173857.webp)
晚上吃點粥 / A Simple Porridge Dinner 小時候，大人們常講，「早餐吃得好，午餐吃得飽，晚餐吃得少」，因為人們一早起床，需要補足體力，而中午時需要維持體力，所以要吃多一些，到了晚上則應該減少熱量，避免脂肪堆積，所以要吃得少一些，聽起來有一定的道理，但是我很懷疑大家是否依照那句話的建議來進食。 在我家，晚餐通常是一天中最豐盛的一餐，因為在晚上時，家人們都忙完了一天的工作，才較有時間可以放鬆地享用美食，不過，某天晚上，剛好家人都有事情外出，而我那天的中午吃得太飽了，晚餐不想吃太多食物，但是又想吃些東西墊墊肚子，這時候，便利商店的粥品，就是我最好的選擇。 提到粥的話，我的第一印象就是皮蛋瘦肉粥，不只是它的價錢便宜之外，它的味道層次也非常豐富，皮蛋特有的濃郁氣味與微微彈性的蛋白，瘦肉吸收了粥的熱氣與鹹香，讓原本清淡的粥多了一種特殊風味，不過，因為我太常吃皮蛋瘦肉粥了，我更期待這款滑蛋牛肉粥，希望它能帶給我不一樣的體驗。 加熱過後的滑蛋牛肉粥，蛋液在熱粥中，不需要過度攪拌，就能形成如絲般柔滑的蛋花，牛肉的香氣在熱粥中慢慢散開，而鮮嫩的肉片，讓我每一口都能感受到肉片柔嫩的口感，與白粥的細膩形成對比，真是吃巧不吃飽的完美組合，吃完後也帶給我剛剛好的飽足感。
---
When I was little, adults often said, “Eat well for breakfast, eat full for lunch, and eat less for dinner”. The idea was that people need energy first thing in the morning, need to maintain that energy at noon, and then should reduce calories at night to avoid gaining fat. It sounds reasonable in theory, but honestly, I sometimes wonder how many people actually follow that advice in real life. In my family, dinner is usually the most substantial meal of the day, because by evening everyone has finished work and finally has time to relax and enjoy food together. But one night was different; first of all, my family members all had plans and went out, and since I had eaten a very heavy lunch that day, I didn’t really want a big dinner. Still, I wanted something light to fill my stomach a little, and at that moment, convenience store porridge felt like the perfect choice. When it comes to porridge, my first thought is always preserved egg and pork porridge. Besides being affordable, it has a surprisingly rich flavor. The preserved egg has that distinctive strong taste and slightly bouncy texture, while the pork absorbs the warmth and seasoning of the porridge, giving the otherwise mild rice porridge a deeper flavor. But because I’ve had preserved egg porridge so many times already, this time I wanted to try something different. That’s why I picked beef porridge with silky egg, hoping it would give me a new experience. After heating it up, the egg blended beautifully into the hot porridge. Without much stirring, it naturally formed soft, silky egg strands. The aroma of beef slowly spread through the porridge, and the tender beef slices added a satisfying bite. Each spoonful gave me both the softness of the porridge and the tenderness of the meat, creating a nice contrast in texture. It really felt like one of those meals that is more about enjoying delicate flavor than eating until you’re stuffed. And after finishing it, I felt exactly the right amount of fullness—light, comfortable, and just enough. --- For the best experience view this post on [Liketu](https://liketu.com/@diochen/a-simple-porridge-dinner)

body.title: The Fleischmann Singularity – Atom Ecology
body.body:
# The Fleischmann Singularity – Atom Ecology

**Source:** https://atom-ecology.russgeorge.net/2014/12/02/fleischmann-singularity/


									
									Pons and Fleischmann created a singularity in 1988
It was one of those moments in science that transforms our understanding of the atom
Some few years ago (2006) I was sitting in Martin Fleischmann’s parlour in the South of England. He had invited me to come chat with him about my work which at the time was going on under the banner of my company D2Fusion. After getting lost trying to find his tiny village of Tisbury and ending up in nearby Stonehenge I finally made it. I spent a long afternoon with Martin talking over the history of cold fusion and his search for gentle energy. One particular story I was keen to hear was of the melting event in the lab in Utah that was shrouded in mystery. Over time I have come to think that mysterious event was the creation of a what must be named a ‘Fleischmann singularity’.
As Martin told me the story he and Stan had been conducting many electrochemical loading experiments with heavy water and palladium. One long running experiment was with a largish cube of palladium, as I recall about a 1 cm cube. It had been sitting for a very long time, months, in the typical electrolysis bath of  heavy water into which a bit of lithium had been introduced to help the electrolyte. It was one of those experiments that explorers often have on the ‘back of the bench’ to watch over a long time frame.
Pons and Fleischmann showing their lab to a group of school kids in 1989
As it happened over a weekend where Stan and Martin were not going to be around the lab Stan’s son was tasked with peeking in on the lab to make sure all was in order. When he did so he saw that the cube experiment lay shattered and broken on the lab bench and in the bench was a hole as if something had burned through it from the experiment. Stan’s son telephoned to report the news and Stan and Martin sprang into action to see what might have happened.
When they examined the lab bench and remains of the experiment they noted that indeed something had not only burned its way through the bench but had also burned down and out of sight into the concrete floor of the basement lab. The basement lab was in the large chemistry building with a massive concrete foundation at the University of Utah where Professor Pons was the chair of the department.
In 1979 the movie China Syndrome told of a nuclear melting event where the core melts down into the earth
Much was done to try to get to the bottom of what happened and no explanation could be arrived at save that the palladium had become and sustained being impossibly hot and produced a mini ‘China Syndrome’ event. Mysteriously the palladium was gone.
What happened next?
The conditions of the experiment were seemingly quite benign. A tiny amount of DC current amounting a 1 watt or so was being used to electrolyze the heavy water. Oxygen was being produced and bubbled up at the platinum anode and deuterium, heavy hydrogen, bubbled at the palladium cathode cube. Palladium being a sponge for hydrogen was also soaking up the deuterium and that palladium cathode may have been holding as many atoms of deuterium as there were palladium atoms. Surely those deuteriums were not uniformly distributed in the metal but rather concentrated in special locations. This was Fleischmann’s perfect recipe for cold fusion.
Martin noted that the measure of the density (fugacity) of the heavy hydrogen isotope deuterium electrochemically loaded into palladium surely exceeded that of metallic hydrogen. Indeed he mused to me the calculations based on his measurements put the density of that heavy hydrogen as being well beyond metallic and similar to the density of hydrogen inside the center of a star! Here’s a paper on just how this is sure to happen and shows hydrogen at the density of white dwarfs and supernova that comes from the HOT fusion world.
Prof. Stanley Pons in his cold fusion lab at University of Utah 1989
Stan Pons, then chairman of the chemistry department at Utah was a former graduate student of Fleischmann’s. As Martin told me he recently had moved from his active career as a professor of chemistry to professor emeritus at the University of South Hampton in England and could now, without risking his retirement, take on some of the more out of the box lines of research that he’d been secretly investigating for decades. Stan was more than willing to be his partner in this pioneering and courageous work.
Martin told me he had first glimpsed cold fusion in his reading about hydrogen in metals in 1949 and long thereafter had been on the trail that he noted tracked even further back into the 1930’s. But these ideas were so out of the box of traditional scientific dogma it was just too hot to handle while upholding the duties of a prominent teaching professor.
Beyond Cold Fusion
I asked Martin whether he had tried to repeat the palladium cube melt down experiment. His reply was a dramatic and emphatic NO, he said he thought it far too dangerous to do so. He figured they got away with it once without dire consequences — a second time they might not be so lucky. Just what it was that destroyed that experiment he noted “was perhaps even beyond than cold fusion.” The energy required to do the damage they observed was simply beyond anything they could imagine. It was surely nuclear if not beyond so. Fleischmann and Pons dutifully informed nuclear authorities and were flummoxed when they were simply dismissed as reporting the impossible. ‘Fools’ is what Martin called them.
Martin and Stan did continue on their much smaller scale experiments with tiny palladium cathodes that were typically about 1 cm long and the diameter of a toothpick. These were producing reliable anomalous heat that was far beyond any conceivable chemical energy source. Eventually they were able to produce boiling cells that would sustain boiling temperatures for weeks on end and even continue long after the electrolyzing current was shut off!
This is what they reported in their March 1989 press conference, watch a short video below,  that started the world on a long path toward cold fusion energy.

![Image 1](https://atom-ecology.russgeorge.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/12/PonsFleischmann_Lab_1.jpg)

The singularity mystery remains
How does a few grams of molten palladium metal burn through a lab bench and deep into the concrete basement floor of a large building.
Surely this is a question that begs for an answer. As the molted palladium was first contained in a beaker of water sitting on a lab bench something had to take place to make it rapidly get very hot. Palladium melts at 1600 degree C. At that temperature molten palladium is brilliantly white hot, as blindingly bright as the brightest search light.
Presumably the suddenly white hot cube of palladium flashed the heavy water in the beaker to stream and shattered the beaker. It then proceeded to burn through the chemistry lab bench-top which are typically made of heat resistant materials. Then it dropped to the concrete floor. All of the time one might presume it was cooling off as it boiled and burned its way through the bench to the floor.
Once on the concrete floor it was in contact with a very large cold mass of concrete that surely was capable of dissipating the heat from the molten metal rapidly. Anyone with experience in welding and working with molten metals knows that should have been the end of the heat as tiny amounts of molten metals even white hot metals, in this case something with a volume of less than a single cube of sugar, spilled onto concrete can never burned deeply into the concrete.
So somehow the heat had not merely appeared moments before while the experiment was running in the beaker it was continuing to be produced and under this circumstance the sustained 1600 degree C puddle of molten palladium would vaporize the concrete as long as energy was available.
No ordinary explanation of some character of palladium and chemistry can accommodate the observations. Not even I would say is even the most likely ‘out of the box cold fusion explanation’ of a mixture or palladium and heavy hydrogen. Something else must have been happening. The reacting mixture of palladium and deuterium may well have transcended ordinary matter and become a large quark mass, not for long, but long enough to burn itself out of existence.
Might such a large mass, even just milligrams being large, of quark matter have come to exist. Would it be as hot as a star and rapidly worm its way out of our space time into quantum space and dimensions.
Other explanations are invited?
CERN super collider might fuse hydrogen nuclei into mini black holes
Formation of a mini black hole in the CERN super collider via the fusion of two protons into dense quark matter
At the most elaborate and modern cathedral of classical physics, the CERN super collider, thousands of scientists focus their attention on what happens when two protons (hydrogen nuclei) are brought very close together through energetic collisions. As CERN protons collide they transform for a flickering moment from being two independent protons into a tiny bag of quark matter. That sub-atomic bit of strange matter is surrounded by layers of detectors tens of meters thick resulting data/science that provides clues for unravelling mysteries of both the atom and the universe.
If you want a quick video lesson on CERN check out the LHC RAP that should have won a Grammy.
Without the overhead of the super collider (~$20 billion to date) Fleischmann’s teacup of cold solid state fusion clearly attains this same state of fusion of hydrogen nuclei under conditions that Fleischmann had shown in a lifetime of studies of hydrogen loading into metals that the density and therefore the closeness of hydrogen nuclei was as extraordinary as inside a metal lattice as inside the super collider.
Cold fusion being a process where matter that reaches a quark state proceeds slowly without the release of the high energy radiation of its high energy counterparts in hot fusion. It’s as if cold fusion enjoys the life within the bounds of the Irish blessing, “may you be half an hour in heaven before the devil knows you’re dead.”  That brief moment of time is sufficient for that cold formed solid state quark matter to worm its way out of our domain leaving just a trail of heat behind.
Black holes have a rapacious appetite for matter
We know that black holes form in space when certain stars, much larger than our Sun, collapse on themselves at the end of their lives. They concentrate a very large amount of matter in a very small space. They become so dense in this quark matter state that the gravity they exert is such that not even light can travel out of their blackness.
Speculations about black holes at the LHC refer to particles produced in the collisions of pairs of protons. These are subatomic – or quantum – black holes. Scientists are not at all sure that quantum black holes exist but evidence for them is one of the things the world is spending countless billions at CERN to try to find.
The physical part of the LHC experiments – colliding particles – happens in nature all the time. We know, for example, that the Earth is constantly bombarded by cosmic rays: when high energy cosmic rays hit the atmosphere, particles are colliding with one another in much the same way, many with vastly higher energies as in the collisions planned at the LHC. Subatomic black holes could be forming and worming their way into other dimensions in our atmosphere constantly.
What if collisions at the LHC produced a black hole? Where would it go. Would it just be pulled by gravity down into the Earth until it disappeared. That is the assumption and the source of endless speculation by the thousands of scientists working at CERN and elsewhere.
CERN-LHC Celebrates success in glimpsing the fleeting God Particle but has yet to reveal finding the wormhole to heaven.
The creation of a quantum black hole at the LHC would be very surprising, but very exciting indeed. It would allow physicists to learn about nature’s most elusive force – gravity. Remember: particle collisions happen all the time in nature, and we’re all still here. If you would like to read up more on the safety of the LHC, there is more information here.
.
.
What would be the significance of the creation of a black hole at the LHC or elsewhere?
The creation of a black hole at the LHC would confirm theories that our universe is not 4 dimensional (3 space plus 1 time dimensions), but indeed hosts other dimensions. It would be quite a spectacular philosophical outcome! In the same way that the theory of relativity or of quantum mechanics revolutionized our way of thinking, discovering the existence of extra dimensions would be a major new milestone in our understanding of the Universe.
While some boffins at CERN suggest there is no obvious application for knowing this. Other CERN folks acknowledge that many people will start speculating about using these extra dimensions for space and time travel, or as a source of clean energy, and who knows what else. It is rather tempting to compare it to the discovery of magnetism by the Phoenicians who could not foresee that electricity and magnetism would completely reshape modern life…
Many think that the late great Martin Fleischmann ( and his colleague Stanley Pons) already delivered the practical application for the merging of hydrogen nuclei into quark matter with the resulting release of incredible useful gentle energy.
As the melting palladium experiment illustrated Martin may have not made it into the history books as a “STAR” but he is most certainly the father of one.
* I am reminded that another account of the melting event has been written Charles Beaudette’s book “Excess Heat – Why Cold Fusion Research Prevailed.”
My own plans include repeating the Fleischmann singularity experiment early this year. Or perhaps it might better be called the Fleishmann/Dyson Sphere experiment.

Hi Wednesdaywalk and Threespeak Community. 

This is the first time in six years that a severe flood has hit our city, and it has been so severe that many people have been affected, especially those who were on the road at the time, but no one was injured. There were quite a lot of hailstones coming down and quite a lot of them were hitting the vehicles here too. So what I'm saying here is that things like this keep happening, so we all should take care of each other and support each other. 

Hola, comunidad de Wednesdaywalk y Threespeak.

Esta es la primera vez en seis años que nuestra ciudad sufre una inundación tan grave, y ha sido tan severa que muchas personas se han visto afectadas, especialmente quienes se encontraban en la calle en ese momento, pero nadie resultó herido. Cayó bastante granizo, y muchos de los impactos llegaron hasta los vehículos. Por eso, quiero decir que este tipo de sucesos ocurren con frecuencia, así que debemos cuidarnos y apoyarnos mutuamente.

Now, for the last two days, the weather in our city has been good. It's not that hot, but it's not raining. We were at home for the last two days, but when we heard the news here, we felt worried because if we look here now, there was a war going on until a few days ago. It has only been a couple of days since the war ended. Our government should reduce the price of petrol again and bring it down to the same level. 

Durante los últimos dos días, el clima en nuestra ciudad ha sido bueno. No hace mucho calor, pero no llueve. Estuvimos en casa estos dos días, pero al escuchar las noticias, nos preocupamos porque, si miramos aquí, hasta hace pocos días había una guerra. La guerra terminó hace apenas un par de días. Nuestro gobierno debería bajar el precio de la gasolina y volver a ponerlo al mismo nivel.

At present, the price has become so high that a poor person cannot afford petrol because the price had increased significantly. Now, the chances of the war ending here have increased. Here, the prices of petrol have also come down. But our government has not reduced petrol yet. So, we all demand that the price of petrol be reduced soon. If peace comes, there will be a lot of benefit in the whole world. 

Actualmente, el precio se ha disparado tanto que una persona pobre no puede permitirse la gasolina, ya que ha aumentado considerablemente. Ahora, las probabilidades de que la guerra termine aquí han aumentado. Aquí, los precios de la gasolina también han bajado. Pero nuestro gobierno aún no los ha reducido. Por eso, exigimos que se baje el precio de la gasolina pronto. Si llega la paz, habrá muchos beneficios para todo el mundo.

And the situation in the whole world is getting worse at the moment. So here I have to say that if there is a ceasefire, it will be good news for us. If inflation decreases, then if inflation does not decrease and the war also stops, then people should definitely protest. We were all very worried because of inflation before, and now it happens that inflation does not end, the war ends, and the prices of things are not reduced, 

Y la situación mundial está empeorando en este momento. Así que debo decir que si hay un alto el fuego, será una buena noticia para nosotros.  Si la inflación disminuye, y si la inflación no disminuye y la guerra también termina, entonces la gente definitivamente debería protestar. Todos estábamos muy preocupados por la inflación antes, y ahora sucede que la inflación no termina, la guerra termina y los precios de las cosas no se reducen,

Hi Wednesdaywalk and Threespeak Community. 

This is the first time in six years that a severe flood has hit our city, and it has been so severe that many people have been affected, especially those who were on the road at the time, but no one was injured. There were quite a lot of hailstones coming down and quite a lot of them were hitting the vehicles here too. So what I'm saying here is that things like this keep happening, so we all should take care of each other and support each other. 

Hola, comunidad de Wednesdaywalk y Threespeak.

Esta es la primera vez en seis años que nuestra ciudad sufre una inundación tan grave, y ha sido tan severa que muchas personas se han visto afectadas, especialmente quienes se encontraban en la calle en ese momento, pero nadie resultó herido. Cayó bastante granizo, y muchos de los impactos llegaron hasta los vehículos. Por eso, quiero decir que este tipo de sucesos ocurren con frecuencia, así que debemos cuidarnos y apoyarnos mutuamente.

![PhotoCollage_1775767791539.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmekZsALQvoH9tnVUYfpuygZNNpLmiGYvn8FynzfaEyBWM/PhotoCollage_1775767791539.jpg)

Now, for the last two days, the weather in our city has been good. It's not that hot, but it's not raining. We were at home for the last two days, but when we heard the news here, we felt worried because if we look here now, there was a war going on until a few days ago. It has only been a couple of days since the war ended. Our government should reduce the price of petrol again and bring it down to the same level. 

Durante los últimos dos días, el clima en nuestra ciudad ha sido bueno. No hace mucho calor, pero no llueve. Estuvimos en casa estos dos días, pero al escuchar las noticias, nos preocupamos porque, si miramos aquí, hasta hace pocos días había una guerra. La guerra terminó hace apenas un par de días. Nuestro gobierno debería bajar el precio de la gasolina y volver a ponerlo al mismo nivel.

At present, the price has become so high that a poor person cannot afford petrol because the price had increased significantly. Now, the chances of the war ending here have increased. Here, the prices of petrol have also come down. But our government has not reduced petrol yet. So, we all demand that the price of petrol be reduced soon. If peace comes, there will be a lot of benefit in the whole world. 

Actualmente, el precio se ha disparado tanto que una persona pobre no puede permitirse la gasolina, ya que ha aumentado considerablemente. Ahora, las probabilidades de que la guerra termine aquí han aumentado. Aquí, los precios de la gasolina también han bajado. Pero nuestro gobierno aún no los ha reducido. Por eso, exigimos que se baje el precio de la gasolina pronto. Si llega la paz, habrá muchos beneficios para todo el mundo.

And the situation in the whole world is getting worse at the moment. So here I have to say that if there is a ceasefire, it will be good news for us. If inflation decreases, then if inflation does not decrease and the war also stops, then people should definitely protest. We were all very worried because of inflation before, and now it happens that inflation does not end, the war ends, and the prices of things are not reduced, 

Y la situación mundial está empeorando en este momento. Así que debo decir que si hay un alto el fuego, será una buena noticia para nosotros.  Si la inflación disminuye, y si la inflación no disminuye y la guerra también termina, entonces la gente definitivamente debería protestar. Todos estábamos muy preocupados por la inflación antes, y ahora sucede que la inflación no termina, la guerra termina y los precios de las cosas no se reducen,

Here, the price of petrol, which is now 382 rupees, earlier it was 262 rupees. 

Entonces esto estará mal. El clima aquí estuvo bueno después de mucho tiempo, no llovió, así que habíamos planeado visitar este lugar. Tengo que publicar aquí las fotos de mi boda, y tengo muchas fotos de Murree, donde fui a caminar, así que también se las mostraré poco a poco. Aquí, el precio de la gasolina, que ahora es de 382 rupias, antes era de 262 rupias.

Here, they have increased it so much that people are still very worried and because of which a storm of inflation has arisen here, so we went to visit this place. We have visited this place before, but when we want to relax our minds, we visit such places. No country has benefited from war so far, so it would be better if there was no war. 

Aquí, lo han subido tanto que la gente sigue muy preocupada, y por eso se ha desatado una ola de inflación, así que fuimos a visitar este lugar. Ya habíamos estado aquí antes, pero cuando queremos relajarnos, visitamos lugares como este. Ningún país se ha beneficiado de la guerra hasta ahora, así que sería mejor que no hubiera guerras.

body.title: April 2nd Harvest: Balance, Land Market Review, and Forging My First Craftable Cards! [Eng/Esp]
body.body:
> Greetings again to the Splinterlands and Hive community! Welcome to my second report for April in Lands. Two weeks ago, we had another opportunity to craft new cards for everyone with plots in Praetoria, and it's clearly one of the best things you've done! The more features and craftable items we have to trade, the closer we'll get to merging Lands with the main game. The biggest impact of these events is seen in resource prices; for example, stone and iron have seen a significant increase in value. Let's hope these aren't the only craftable cards this year, so we can give our resources even more value and utility. > Saludos de nuevo comunidad de [Splinterlands](https://ecency.com/created/hive-13323) y Hivers! Les doy la bienvenida a mi segundo reporte en lo que llevamos del mes de abril en Lands. Hace 2 semanas atrás tuvimos una nueva oportunidad para creaftear nuevas cartas a todos aquellos que tienen parcelas en Praetoria, y es a todas luces uno de los mayores acierto que han tenido! Mientras más funciones y objetos crafteables que se pueden tradear, estaremos más cerca de fusionar Lands con el juego principal, el mayor impacto de estos eventos lo podemos ver en el precio de los recursos, por ejemplo la piedra y el hierro han tenido un incremento notable en su valor. Esperemos que estas no sean las únicas cartas creafteables de este año, para que así podamos darle mayor valor y utilidad a nuestros recursos.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23swe13mxHTbGtszE3bJxazMqPRDFmziLh3xvgWqEK9vrf62ru2aWrZx7Tha33cNDmQa1.png)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23tkjb2WkDjvStGX6oQK6dKcZhJjsDDCymUZatKiZTxbtRFV4QW7RSUZ8ZRCSdasqHdmi.png)
# Resource Harvest/Cosecha de Recursos

> We'll start by harvesting our grain plot. You have no idea how much I regret buying at least a couple of extra grain plots last year when they were $14 each. Currently, the plots that produce this valuable resource in the Great Lowlands have appreciated considerably. No matter which region of the Great Lowlands you're in, they're all starting at $30! But we'll explore plot prices later. For now, the important thing is to know that this common plot generates enough grain for my two stone quarries. > Comenzamos por cosechar nuestra parcela de granos, no saben como me arrepiento de haber comprado al menos un par de parcelas extra de grano el año pasado cuando estaban en 14$. Actualmente las parcelas que producen este valioso recurso en Great Lowlands se han apreciado considerablemente, no importa en cual región de Great Lowlands se encuentre, todas ya están a partir de los 30$! Pero más adelante exploraremos los precios de las parcelas, por ahora lo importante es saber que esta parcela común me genera el grano suficiente para mis 2 canteras de piedra.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNcT6M1DVGAsK4tXcb5irgo7FxhGoo4JKUnyLYntfBr29/cosecha_com_n_6_4_26.gif)
---

> Once the harvest is complete, we have enough grain to collect all the production from my two quarries: Bredaine, which is a rare plot, and Oxborough, which is my most productive plot because it's epic and has golden cards with totems and epic titles locked in it. I bought the first one at the end of last year and the second one in 2024, when the prices of these assets were really low. Currently, their price has doubled, however, good deals can still be found, and that's why I'm so focused on the stone resource. > Una vez realizada la cosecha, tenemos el grano suficiente para recoger toda la producción de mis 2 canteras: Bredaine que es una parcela rara y Oxborough que es mi parcela más productiva por ser épica y tener bloqueadas cartas doradas con totem y título épico. La primera la compre a finales del año pasado y la segunda en 2024, cuando los precios de estos activos estaban realmente bajos. Actualmente han duplicado su precio, sin embargo aún pueden conseguirse buenas ofertas y es la razón por la que estoy tan enfocado en el recurso de piedra.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS3rMpJFDMexHjYcQsEKwpWiBHuPzo2wYVupraGgpe7Wi/cosecha_rara_6_4_26.gif) --- ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUJF2rCTk1sQFXdsX2rpwGgyag6v2EdcnhZNyS8YUCeC9/cosecha_epica_6_4_26.gif)

> In short, this is what I have locked in Decs and the amount of stone I've accumulated. There's also some grain, but not much, because ultimately I use almost everything produced to gather stone from the quarries. We have 428,000 stone so far, and I'd really like to increase production, but I'd like to maintain a balance: for every two stone quarries, I'd like to have one grain farm to feed the workers, without losing the pace of stone production. Obviously, this is a process that consumes time, resources, and dedication. With that in mind, I did a quick look at the land market to see how prices are in this region of the Great Lowlands. > En resumen esto es lo que tengo en Decs bloqueados y la cantidad de piedra que llevo acumulados, también aparece algo de grano no es mucho porque en última instancia uso caso todo lo producido para recoger la producción de piedra en las canteras. Llevamos hasta ahora 428K de piedra y la verdad es que me gustaría aumentar la producción de recurso, pero me gustaría llevar un equilibrio de por cada 2 canteras de piedra, tener una granja de granos para alimentar a esos trabajadores, sin perder el ritmo de la producción de piedra. Obviamente es un proceso que consume tiempo, recursos y dedicación, en ese contexto realicé un breve repaso al mercado de tierras para ver como están los precios en esta región de Great Lowlands.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23tGTG4psa1HjFA1P2JrcGGm2P9FmrghUqpyT7gPx8ctuST3xV6N7XcvFumgQuP4kPPbR.png)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23tGc5SeWQkLdGakKAoo7f1BxyPsgF26BKQJJcM2CrMVX4ZwgBtY8GpUg7vJ7NUCiA29k.png)
# Land Plot Prices in the Great Lowlands/Precios de parcelas en Great Lowlands

> With the exception of grain plots, those lands that produce wood, stone, and iron are at unbeatable prices! Many of them even have unstable buildings and totems on them, so I think these assets are being sold for far below their true value. If it weren't for the fact that I'm currently investing my few cents in Conclave Arcana strategic cards, believe me, I'd be buying many of these common plots for $10 and the rare ones starting at $19. Although fully developing them would take a considerable amount of time, I wouldn't worry about buying them first and developing them much later; there are simply too many cards on the market, so you won't have any trouble getting good workers. > A excepción de las parcelas de grano, aquellos terrenos que producen madera, piedra y hierro se encuentras a precios inmejorables! Muchos de ellos incluso tienen edificaciones y totems inestables en ellos, por lo que creo que estos activos se están vendiendo a un precio muy por debajo de su valor real. Si no fuera porque actualmente estoy invirtiendo mis pocos centavos en cartas estratégicas de Conclave Arcana, créanme estaría comprando muchas de estas parcelas comunes en 10$ y las raras a partir de 19$. Aunque desarrollarlas a tope llevaría una gran cantidad de tiempo no me preocuparía de comprarlas primero y desarrollarlas mucho tiempo después, simplemente hay demasiadas cartas en el mercado asi que no encontrarás problemas en conseguir buenos trabajadores.
![Land Price.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23tHZbY6YBGBSyxeYxh3y4KAMyisoAUyY6iBNHhNtts4QQpzCq7wwNJYfjjvzjQwqae6x.jpg)

> Then we have the most expensive lands, the grain farms. Their value starts at $29 for a common plot, and rare ones range between $40 and $60. If you're not playing casually, acquiring one of these plots requires a significant investment, so I recommend carefully considering your goals if you're going to enter this phase of the game. > Luego tenemos los las tierras más costosas, las granjas de grano, su valor parte de los 29$ en una parcela común y rara se ubica entre los 40 y 60$. Aquí si no estamos jugando amigos, hacerse con una de estas parcelas requiere de una inversión importante, por lo que recomiendo evaluar con detenimiento que planeas proponerte si vas a entrar en esta fase del juego.
![Land Price 2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23tw8AdxP84EWqXK2H6BpsJW8kWssz7GfuJ3A1cfhhA8drL3qwgQr4azeJGgp8ChXihTf.jpg)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/EoCavJcRUBhhoCYgZU6QL5GyCpoev59Xn8BdDJdFxcZbn6GP6a6jUiREze99d8YaFN2.png)
# Forging my first craftable cards!/Forjando mis primeras cartas crafteables!

> When the day finally arrived to craft, I checked my permissions to create these cards and found I had 7, based on the number of production points I generated. Each card required 187.5 ash obtained by burning cards, so I decided to burn Chaos Legion Rewards cards from my collection—I have hundreds—to create these first copies. All we needed were the Land resources required for each card. > Cuando finalmente llegó el día de craftear, revisé mis permisos para crear estas cartas y tenía 7 por la cantidad de puntos de producción que generaba. Para cada carta eran necesarios 187,5 de ceniza obtenidos al quemar cartas, decidí quemar cartas Chaos Legion Rewards de mi colección, que tengo cientos para crear estas primeras copias. Solo nos faltaban los recursos de Lands que requerían cada carta.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23tRta7nWQTYr55E6DZh3ZbRwxiemE447JudESaLnDeCX1PPPrUsuVK4Cekg9V27HtqGN.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23t752FYkcwNmpf4F39ZpvFNBKGPVxNcx5XYsWjb47xWDoSJsciqB1ekgHtX7LNFKP1BF.png) --|--

> The fire card Thessok Hunter required 2000 stone, while the earth card Ghostly Blacksmith required 450 iron. Of course, I wasn't going to spend my land resources to forge these cards. I decided to sell some of my many second-layer tokens to buy DCs and use them to acquire those resources on the market. > Las cartas de fuego Thessok Hunter requieren de 2000 unidades de piedra, mientras que la carta de tierra Ghostly Blacksmith requiere 450 de Hierro. Por supuesto no iba a gastar mis recursos de lands para forjar estas cartas. decidí vender una parte de mis muchos tokens de segunda capa para comprar Dces y con ellos adquirir esos recursos en el mercado.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23xV65y8sYA3LvwFprRZmDvRD2pWVgKhqJiDJZdYuK1ZbjKgtoe4pWLQKyVpegkqXdTm3.png)

> These cards currently sell for between $0.15 and $0.17, much cheaper than crafting them, so you might be interested in buying them on the secondary market. I made them for the sheer joy of creating handcrafted NFTs; it's something I've enjoyed since games like Diablo 2: LoD, and if they can be traded, even better! At first, I only wanted to create the fire card, but then I understood the potential of the Pain Forge ability when activated by abilities like Burning, which convinced me to create the earth card. Its advantage isn't just that; unlike Thessok Hunter, this card has a low mana cost and deals 2 magic damage. So far, I haven't found an opportunity to use these cards in modern ranked play. I'll upgrade them to level 5 to use them with the Foundation Archons, which I already have maxed out, and then I'll do a more complete review of these two interesting cards. > Actualmente estas cartas se venden entre 0.15$-0.17$ mucho más económicas que crearlas así que quizás te interese comprarlas en el mercado secundario. Yo las hice por el encanto de crear nft artesanales es algo que disfruto desde juegos como Diablo2 LoD y si puede tradearse mucho mejor! En un primer momento quería solo crear la carta de fuego, pero luego entendí el potencial de la habilidad Pain Forge al activarse con habilidades como Burning, lo que me convenció de crear la carta de tierra, su ventaja no es solo esa, sino que a diferencia de Thessok Hunter, esta carta tiene un bajo costo de mana y de 2 daño mágico. Hasta ahora no he encontrado una oportunidad de utilizar estas cartas en el ranking moderno, las llevaré a nivel 5 para usarlos con los arcontes foundations que ya los tengo al máximo y así hacer una reseña más completa de estas 2 interesantes cartas.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/Ep5jknco9Lu7o93HdjC76nnKc53QX4o6neu8BFXMyj91vkjqq2HoroAe2qEVVwAz5jR.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/Ep5eugtbPWX68xSG8MJkeeEaML9JN5KJeEe6aioRdM5o8SQor4SKjiTR9hwmTpHnaSn.png) --|--

> Well, friends, this was my report for the second week of April. We continue accumulating resources, fishing for card prices, and crafting cards. The future looks optimistic for Splinterlands despite the thorny valley Hive is currently in. Let's hope it recovers its price soon, and until then, I think our best option is to acquire cheap assets, and Lands is the key. See you in the next report. Best regards! > Bien amigos, este fue mi reporte de la segunda semana de abril, seguimos acumulando recursos, pescando precios de cartas y crafteando cartas. El futuro parece optimista en Splinterlands a pesar del valle espinado en el que se encuentra Hive. Esperemos que recupere pronto su precio y mientras lo hacemos, creo que la mejor opción que tenemos es adquirir activos baratos y en Lands esta la clave. Nos vemos en el próximo reporte. Saludos!
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVHJCoB9j3YjCuZ91Q6buMWc8Gj8ZSBYvHQkQ9zz5JyDc/animacion_lands.gif)
![Gold league divisor wild.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23tbM6GZHqUjFZHRmt9wWEuQcRm4j4ggQ4QLRc1cq2bdtBAQ25fZt93je3ZFeQV9sU1jB.png)
If you are new to splinterlands and want to get into and get to know this game you can do it at the link below: > Si eres nuevo en splinterlands y quieres adentrarte y conocer este juego puedes hacerlo en el siguiente enlace:

body.title: Soy cubano, estoy empezando en Hive y esto es lo que he aprendido 🇨🇺
body.body:
Saludos a toda la comunidad.

Me presento otra vez: soy Santiago, cubano, y hace pocos días hice mi primera publicación aquí en Hive. Llegué porque me recomendaron la plataforma para poder generar ingresos extras, pero les soy sincero: los primeros días me sentí perdido.

No entendía nada de términos como HP, HBD, Resource Credits, votos, porcentajes… ¡hasta me dio error cuando quise seguir a alguien! Pero aquí ando, aprendiendo poco a poco y con muchas ganas de seguir.

---

📌 Lo que he entendido hasta ahora (explicado fácil)

Por si hay otro cubano o alguien nuevo que esté empezando como yo, les comparto lo que voy aprendiendo:

· Hive no es solo una criptomoneda como Bitcoin, sino que también es una red social descentralizada. Lo que publicas queda en la blockchain y nadie te lo puede borrar.
· Los votos (upvotes) son como los \
pero con valor. Cuando alguien vota tu publicación, ganas recompensas.\n· Las recompensas se dividen en dos:\n  · HP (Hive Power): es como la \

que te da poder de voto. Mientras más HP tengas, más fuerte votas.\n  · HBD (Hive Backed Dollars): es como el dinero líquido, más estable, que puedes usar o cambiar.\n· Los Resource Credits (RC) son como la \

de tu cuenta. Sin ellos no puedes votar, comentar ni seguir. Los RC se regeneran cuando tienes HP.

---

🎉 Mi primer voto

Algo que me motivó mucho fue que en mi primera publicación alguien me dio un voto de 60%. En ese momento no sabía qué significaba, pero después entendí que era una persona con experiencia apoyando a los nuevos.

Ese gesto me hizo ver que aquí hay comunidad, que no estoy solo y que vale la pena seguir aprendiendo.

---

🇨🇺 Desde Cuba

Sé que en Cuba a veces la conexión no es la mejor, y los apagones no ayudan, pero voy a intentar ser constante. Si hay más cubanos por aquí, me encantaría conectar con ustedes y aprender juntos.

---

🚀 Lo que sigue

Seguiré publicando, comentando en otros posts y aprendiendo sobre este mundo. Si alguien tiene consejos para los que vamos empezando, son bienvenidos.

Gracias por leer y que tengan un lindo día o noche, mi gente.

Santiago 🇨🇺
