body.title: 🔐 Cyber Security Daily News | 11.04.2026
body.body:
> 

![Black Blue Futuristic Cyber Security Presentation.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23uQG5ekNQzJrNY2y8nxsBpF1wkZVkQmkz7a7QqeB68SsYbMePeM7bojutkpoPMiw5yjo.jpg)

# 🔐 Cyber Security Daily News | 11.04.2026

Codzienny przegląd ciekawszych wiadomości ze świata cyberbezpieczeństwa, do poczytania przy porannej kawie, podzielony na kluczowe kategorie.

![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23tkpMakka2YSNHo8Yp3YL2D66xs6858mLHvQe3W9yhqFSmR3Upas5gVNembRrPcpUj7R.jpg)

-----

## 1. NEWS

---

### ***CERT Polska ostrzega przed atakiem supply chain na CPU-Z i HW-Monitor — pobieranie narzędzi z cpuid.com było niebezpieczne***

CERT Polska wydał pilny komunikat: między 9 a 10 kwietnia strona cpuid.com — twórcy popularnych narzędzi diagnostycznych CPU-Z i HW-Monitor — przekierowywała pobierania do serwera atakujących, który serwował zmodyfikowane wersje oprogramowania zawierające złośliwy plik CRYPTBASE.dll. Każda osoba, która w ciągu ostatnich 24 godzin instalowała lub aktualizowała CPU-Z lub HW-Monitor, powinna natychmiast sprawdzić system pod kątem wskaźników IoC opublikowanych przez CERT. Malware komunikuje się z serwerem C2 pod adresem `welcome.supp0v3.com`. Telepolis i The Register potwierdzają incydent. To klasyczny atak supply chain — użytkownik robi „właściwą\

. Atakujący zatruwa wyniki wyszukiwania w Office 365 — gdy pracownik działu HR lub płac szuka w wewnętrznym portalu firmowym formularza dotyczącego wypłat, zamiast właściwego dokumentu trafia na spreparowaną stronę phishingową zbierającą poświadczenia korporacyjne. Po przejęciu konta przestępcy zmieniają dane bankowe pracowników, przekierowując wypłaty na własne konta. Kampania celuje przede wszystkim w firmy kanadyjskie. To niepokojący przykład nadużycia zaufanej infrastruktury firmowej — pracownik w niczym nie podejrzewa, że coś jest nie tak.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/244oouPPChZcz8D3PTULDZLqFe52SziReNrpWBsZzH4dJvVUDBhwYc51UJTQRNGbuTb3d.png)

*Źródło: [BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/microsoft/microsoft-canadian-employees-targeted-in-payroll-pirate-attacks/) [EN] | [Microsoft Security Blog](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2026/04/09/investigating-storm-2755-payroll-pirate-attacks-targeting-canadian-employees/) [EN] | [HelpNetSecurity](https://www.helpnetsecurity.com/2026/04/10/poisoned-office-365-search-results-lead-to-stolen-paychecks/) [EN]*

---

### ***Instalki.pl: fałszywa faktura Orange dystrybuuje infostealera FormBook***

Instalki.pl opisują aktywną kampanię phishingową, w której cyberprzestępcy rozsyłają e-maile z załącznikiem podszywającym się pod fakturę Orange. Plik jest w rzeczywistości dropperem infostealera FormBook — malware wykradającego dane z formularzy przeglądarek, hasła, zawartość schowka i robienie zrzutów ekranu. FormBook jest jednym z najstarszych i najszerzej rozprowadzanych infostelaerów na rynku MaaS (Malware-as-a-Service) — jest aktywny od 2016 roku i wciąż skuteczny, bo regularnie aktualizowany przez twórców. Nigdy nie otwieraj załączników faktur z e-maila bez weryfikacji — prawdziwy rachunek Orange jest dostępny w panelu klienta na stronie www.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/241tbC9Y3eiopSeBK4gAcpsCTvKgVGvmrispJd63KHrU56tZqdYaRveLseq8rZMTGxnKw.png)

*Źródło: [Instalki.pl](https://www.instalki.pl/news/bezpieczenstwo/email-z-faktura-orange-formbook/) [PL]*

---

## 3. CIEKAWOSTKI

---

### ***Rozszerzenia przeglądarki stają się nowym wektorem ataków AI — analiza zagrożeń The Hacker News***

The Hacker News opisuje raport wskazujący, że rozszerzenia przeglądarki przeżywają renesans jako wektor ataku w erze AI. Nowość polega na tym, że złośliwe rozszerzenia coraz częściej udają narzędzia AI (asystenty, tłumacze, narzędzia do pisania) — a użytkownicy chętnie przyznają im szeroki dostęp do treści wszystkich odwiedzanych stron. W praktyce takie rozszerzenie widzi każdą stronę bankową, każdą rozmowę w Gmailu i każdy formularz wypełniany przez użytkownika. Infosecurity Magazine potwierdza 76-procentowy wzrost incydentów związanych z rozszerzeniami przeglądarki w 2025 roku. Zasada: instaluj wyłącznie rozszerzenia od zweryfikowanych wydawców z historią i recenzjami — koniecznie sprawdzaj zakres żądanych uprawnień.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23wC5ha4uvAmhTXXGNjQ9UXZEryFmxPT6CLLxzrcXaf2NBubVW9zC5NFfPGNaxmYDEuFJ.png)

*Źródło: [The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/04/browser-extensions-are-new-ai.html) [EN] | [Infosecurity Magazine](https://www.infosecurity-magazine.com/news/governance-gaps-agents-76-increase/) [EN]*

---

### ***Analiza miliarda rekordów CISA KEV: ludzie nie są w stanie nadążyć z łataniem podatności — potrzebna automatyzacja***

BleepingComputer opisuje raport analizujący miliard rekordów z katalogu CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities pod kątem czasu reakcji organizacji. Wyniki są alarmujące: nawet najwyżej priorytetyzowane podatności KEV są łatane przez przeciętną organizację z opóźnieniem 30–90 dni od publikacji. Kluczowy wniosek: „ludzka skala\

z prośbą o wypełnienie formularza w celu odzyskania środków. Cała wizualna szata wiadomości i strony docelowej jest dopracowana i wiarygodna — krok po kroku prowadzi ofiarę przez formularz zbierający dane karty płatniczej. Ekspert ESET Kamil Sadkowski podkreśla, że to nie przypadkowa, masowa kampania niskiej jakości, lecz przemyślana operacja. PGE nigdy nie prosi o dane karty płatniczej w celu zwrotu nadpłaty — ewentualny zwrot trafia automatycznie na konto powiązane z umową.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/EpT67EX1Zyr4ScrwUeVaz4wDiL8CJsr7GmVZckcYVh2PEoJQx7zaiiBBsAxmZF1gwN4.png)

*Źródło: [CRN.pl](https://crn.pl/aktualnosci/pge-na-celowniku-cyberprzestepcow/) [PL] | [Techno-Senior](https://techno-senior.com/2026/04/10/uwaga-dostales-informacje-o-nadplacie-w-pge-to-oszustwo/) [PL] | [LegalnieWSieci.pl](https://www.legalniewsieci.pl/aktualnosci/nadplata-za-energie-elektryczna-uwazaj-na-oszustwo) [PL]*

---

### ***Sekurak: kolejna kampania rekrutacyjna instalująca malware przez fałszywy Zoom i polecenia w terminalu***

Sekurak opisuje przypadek Bogdana Chadkina, który zebrał szczegółową dokumentację ataku rekrutacyjnego: fałszywy CTO europejskiego startupu fintech nawiązał kontakt na LinkedIn i przez kilka sesji „umów na rozmowę\

przez wklejenie komend `curl | zsh` w terminalu, okazało się, że komendy pobierają malware z fałszywej domeny imitującej Zoom. Kluczowe sygnały ostrzegawcze: przeniesienie rozmowy na Telegram, naleganie na konkretne narzędzia wideo, prośba o wklejenie poleceń w terminalu. Żaden legalny rekruter nigdy nie prosi o uruchamianie poleceń w terminalu podczas rozmowy kwalifikacyjnej.

*Źródło: [Sekurak](https://sekurak.pl/kolejny-scam-rekrutacyjny-pisze-do-ciebie-rekruter-ale-zamiast-pracy-proponuje-instalacje-malware-na-komputerze/) [PL]*

---

### ***Fałszywa strona Claude instaluje malware dający dostęp zdalny do komputera ofiary***

Malwarebytes opisuje kampanię, w której atakujący stworzyli fałszywą stronę podszywającą się pod Claude (narzędzie AI Anthropic) i promowaną przez reklamy w wyszukiwarce. Ofiara pobiera i instaluje „aplikację Claude\

In that case, you burn the excess energy by punishing a poor tennis ball... ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/bcd5fca3-5d4d-4989-b415-6bb08f87f8f3.jpg) I had to drive some friends to the airport so we didn't have enough time for longer walks until later. body.body: 1/4 🧵 Mark Jones is out at ESPN **right before the NBA playoffs**, and that’s the real headline. Not just a broadcaster leaving — a **36-year ESPN voice** is gone at the most visible moment of the basketball calendar. That’s not a quiet offseason shuffle. It’s a sharp break with timing that raises eyebrows.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 2/4 🧵 Jones’ final call will be **Sunday’s Celtics-Magic game**, ending a run that started in **1990**. Over that stretch, he became one of ESPN’s signature voices across NBA and college football, and he also worked men’s and women’s college basketball, WNBA, and NHL coverage. He wasn’t some fringe utility guy — at one point he was ESPN’s **No. 2 NBA play-by-play voice** behind Mike Breen, even stepping in for **two NBA Finals games in 2022** when Breen had COVID.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 3/4 🧵 The subtext is pretty clear: this looks less like retirement and more like a professional split after Jones had slid down ESPN’s pecking order. The report says **he chose to leave**, ESPN said he **could have stayed**, and he’s **not expected to retire**. That combination usually means the door was technically open, but the role probably wasn’t the one a veteran of his stature wanted. In plain English: if you’ve spent decades as a major voice and you’re getting leapfrogged, staying can start to feel like hanging around your own replacement.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body:
4/4 🧵 The article also sketches why Jones mattered: former NYU player, early career in Canada, host of **“NBA Today”** before moving into play-by-play, and years working with analysts like Doris Burke, Jay Bilas, Jon Barry, and Louis Riddick. So the takeaway is simple: this is the end of a long ESPN era, **not** the end of Mark Jones’ career. The interesting part now is where he lands next — because voices with that kind of résumé don’t usually disappear, they just change microphones. 📎 Source

body.title: Sense of belonging / Sentido de pertenencia (eng-esp)
body.body: Hello, my friends.\n\nIn my personal opinion, a sense of belonging is the urge to pick up a piece of paper from the ground even if you didn't throw it there. It's feeling bothered by a broken doorknob and doing something to fix it instead of waiting for someone \

to come and solve it for you.

A sense of belonging is knowing that what happens to your neighborhood, your workplace, or your family matters to you because it's yours and it affects you. It's knowing that it's worth taking care of, regardless of what you belong to or what belongs to you.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS6Q6XrhAKD43GD8pJEK3F9MNh5Uv17SVR9BTu91HnVRf/1775858201734.jpg)

I'm not talking about the kind of patriotism that involves anthems and flags. I'm talking about something more concrete. I'm talking about whether the trash on the corner disgusts you or you're indifferent to it. If you're indifferent, then you don't belong there; you're just passing through, waiting to leave.

And look, I understand people who want to leave; I don't judge them. But while you're here, while you lay your head on the pillow in this country (and by this country, I mean your country, the country of anyone we live in), you have to belong.

It's a matter of your own mental health.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaPXFv1rNm6skPeioSavrKVWpPZoPQVnsnYhDrfZhLsvs/1775858506258.jpg)

In my work, for example, I don't own a business; I'm a concert guitarist. So I have a sense of belonging because of art, because of music.

But I'm also a mother, so I also have that sense of belonging to my home and my family.

That means if I see the refrigerator is leaking, I report it, I insist, and I find a way to get it fixed, even if I'm not the only person living in the house or I don't know anything about refrigeration.

Why? Because if the refrigerator breaks down completely, the damage affects me too. It affects the environment, the heat, the extra work it generates. Feeling that this space is mine (home, work, neighborhood, etc.), even if legally it isn't, makes daily life more bearable.

If I go to work in a place I consider foreign and hostile, my blood pressure is going to skyrocket every day.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXGNk4oWHz8c8jicg5Fyk6xLGtpZRLJpopDQBqQnLL6qN/1775858506327.jpg)

This can also be applied to the country, to the city. I have a sense of belonging to Las Tunas, and that's why it hurts me to see certain doorways falling down.

It hurts me because I walk there, I live there. When I see something wrong, I don't feel the abstract pain of a tourist who says, \

It's the pain of someone who knows that if that wall falls, it could fall on me or my child.

That's why, when I can, I sweep my section of the sidewalk, I take care of my piece of land: I do what I can. I do it for myself, not for the neighbor, not for the local official. I do it because I belong to this piece of land and I don't want to live among rubble.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV47AZjihunLLjGirE1o16qGvo9qHc9xCQsVWs3kVpPVM/1775858506391.jpg)

Without that sense of belonging, everything becomes a no-man's land. And in a no-man's land, people steal, litter, and destroy without remorse.
Everything becomes a jungle where everyone grabs what they can and leaves. That's exhausting. On the other hand, when you take ownership of your space, your guild, your profession, you face whatever comes your way: you defend what's yours because you know your well-being is tied to that place.

***
**Versión en español**
***


Hola, amigos míos.

En mi opinión personal, el sentido de pertenencia es el cuidado de mantener ese impulso de recoger un papel del suelo aunque no lo hayas tirado tú. Es sentir que te molesta ver roto el pomo de la puerta del edificio y hacer algo para arreglarlo en lugar de esperar a que venga alguien de \

a resolverlo por ti. 
El sentido de pertenencia es saber que lo que le pase a tu cuadra, a tu centro de trabajo o a tu familia te importa porque es tuyo y te afecta. Es saber que vale la pena cuidarlo, independientemente de lo que sea a lo que pertenezcas o te pertenezca.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS6Q6XrhAKD43GD8pJEK3F9MNh5Uv17SVR9BTu91HnVRf/1775858201734.jpg)

Yo no hablo de patriotismo de himno y bandera. Hablo de algo más concreto. Hablo de si la basura que hay en la esquina te da asco o te da igual. Si te da igual, es que no perteneces a esa esquina, solo estás de paso esperando irte. 
Y mira, yo entiendo a la gente que se quiere ir, no la juzgo. Pero mientras estás aquí, mientras pones la cabeza en la almohada en este país (y por este país, entiéndase tu país, el de cualquiera donde vivamos), tienes que pertenecer. 
Es una cuestión de salud mental propia.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaPXFv1rNm6skPeioSavrKVWpPZoPQVnsnYhDrfZhLsvs/1775858506258.jpg)

En mi trabajo, por ejemplo, yo no soy dueña de un negocio, soy guitarrista concertista. Así que tengo sentido de pertenencia por el arte, por la música.
Pero también soy madre, así que también tengo ese sentido de pertenencia hacia mi casa, mi familia.
Eso significa que si veo que la nevera está goteando, aviso, insisto y busco la manera de que se repare, aunque no sea la única persona que viva en la casa ni sepa nada de refrigeración. 
¿Por qué? Porque si la nevera se daña por completo, el perjuicio me afecta a mí también. Me afecta en el ambiente, en el calor, en el trabajo extra que genera. Sentir que ese espacio es mío (casa, trabajo, barrio, etc), aunque legalmente no lo sea, hace que el día a día sea más llevadero. 
Si yo voy a trabajar a un lugar que considero ajeno y hostil, mi presión arterial se va a disparar todos los días.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXGNk4oWHz8c8jicg5Fyk6xLGtpZRLJpopDQBqQnLL6qN/1775858506327.jpg)

Esto también puede aplicarse al país, a la ciudad. Yo tengo sentido de pertenencia por Las Tunas, y por eso me duele ver ciertos portales cayéndose. 
Me duele porque camino por ahí, vivo por ahí. Cuando veo algo mal, no siento el dolor abstracto de un turista que dice \

. Es el dolor de quien sabe que si esa pared se cae, me puede caer a mí o a mi hijo. 
Por eso, cuando puedo, barro mi pedazo de acera, cuido mi pedazo de tierra: hago lo que puedo hacer. Lo hago por mí, no por el vecino, no por el delegado. Lo hago porque pertenezco a este pedazo de tierra y no quiero vivir entre escombros.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV47AZjihunLLjGirE1o16qGvo9qHc9xCQsVWs3kVpPVM/1775858506391.jpg)

Sin ese sentido de pertenencia, todo se convierte en tierra de nadie. Y en tierra de nadie, la gente roba, ensucia y destruye sin remordimiento.

body.body: 1/4 🧵 Browning Nagle’s story is the brutal NFL classic: one electric debut, huge expectations, and then the league chews up the script. He died this week at 57 after battling colon cancer, and the piece frames him as more than a failed Jets prospect — a Louisville star whose football life had real peaks before the NFL turned messy.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 2/4 🧵 Before the Jets rollercoaster, Nagle was a legit college standout at Louisville. He threw for 4,653 yards and 32 TDs in two seasons as starter under Howard Schnellenberger. His signature moment was the 1991 Fiesta Bowl win over Alabama: 451 passing yards, 3 TDs, and Offensive Player of the Game. That wasn’t hype out of nowhere — the guy had a real résumé.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 3/4 🧵 The NFL twist is especially cruel: the Jets took him with the No. 34 pick in 1991, one slot after Brett Favre. That detail hangs over the whole story like a dark joke from the football gods. Nagle’s first Jets start in Sept. 1992 looked like the breakout — 366 yards and 2 TDs vs. Atlanta — but that was basically the high-water mark. He finished with the Jets at 2,361 passing yards, 8 TDs, 20 INTs, and a 49.4% completion rate across 18 games. In plain English: flashes, then a lot of pain.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body:
4/4 🧵 The rest of his career became journeyman stuff: brief stops with the Colts and Falcons, then a later revival in the Arena Football League with the Orlando Predators, where he threw 74 TD passes. After football, he went back to Louisville, worked in medical sales, and built a life with his family. Louisville’s statement and Jeff Brohm’s tribute make the real point here: teammates and programs don’t remember guys only by stat lines. 📎 Source

📎 [Source](https://nypost.com/2026/04/10/sports/former-jets-qb-browning-nagle-dead-at-57-after-cancer-battle/)

body.title: Mi terapia natural 💗🌻(Es/En)
body.body:
>

Feliz tardes mis queridos amigos de Hive, como de costumbre les envío un cálido saludo y un genuino deseo de que cada uno de ustedes y sus familiares se encuentren bien. En esta ocasión quiero compartir con ustedes mi experiencia con las puestas de sol. En realidad son mi parte favorita del día. A continuación les explico las razones. Espero que sea de su agrado leer mi publicación. >Good afternoon, dear friends of Hive. As always, I send you my warmest regards and sincerely hope that you and your families are doing well. Today, I’d like to share with you my experience with sunsets. In fact, they’re my favorite time of day. I’ll explain why below. I hope you enjoy reading my post. ![1000921303.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/abisag/242NitCw3axgbGM6e2RKSn1f97hYBpmqvGmxzrvc2efNJsY2h54mn9vRy2evqdhcATodP.jpg) Sin importar quiénes seamos, dónde vivamos o cuánto dinero y riquezas poseamos, a todos nos alcanzan los problemas. Hay momentos en los que al parecer los problemas se ponen de acuerdo y se presentan en la vida simultáneamente,por lo menos a mí me ha ocurrido esa situación. No termina un problema cuando ya comienza otro y estoy desgasta muchísimo. Sin embargo, en nuestras manos está el hecho de contrarrestar los efectos negativos que suelen venir con las dificultades. Es necesario parar con el propósito de renovar fuerzas y seguir adelante con alegría y entusiasmo. Particularmente, una de las cosas que realizó con frecuencia y que me ayuda muchísimo a lidiar con sentimientos de angustia y ansiedad es mirar detenidamente las puestas de sol. Les cuento que mirar este hermosos escenario sin prisa, me ayuda a respirar mejor, siento un alivio en mi corazón y puedo barrer mi mente de pensamientos negativos. Definitivamente es una terapia fundamental y necesaria para mí. >No matter who we are, where we live, or how much money and wealth we have, problems affect us all. There are times when it seems like problems conspire to show up in our lives all at once—at least that’s how it’s been for me. One problem hasn’t even ended before another begins, and it’s incredibly draining. However, it’s up to us to counteract the negative effects that often come with difficulties. We need to pause to recharge our strength and move forward with joy and enthusiasm. >In particular, one of the things I do often that helps me a lot in dealing with feelings of distress and anxiety is to watch sunsets closely. I’ll tell you that watching this beautiful scene without rushing helps me breathe better; I feel relief in my heart and can clear my mind of negative thoughts. It is definitely a fundamental and necessary form of therapy for me. ![1000921298.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/abisag/EptdPqci31WgvNsvzvJtQ5CobNyv1iY2NbW44HeAjDXh1D8M98zXeHCL518esQC45Pb.jpg) Algunos amigos me han contado que les parece más bonito el amanecer porque el atardecer los deprime porque evoca nostalgia. Esta es la percepción de una chica que en un momento determinado me comentó que el atardecer le produce esto y en otra ocasión otra persona aseveró la misma idea. A algunos les beneficia más contempla el amanecer y a otros les gusta la belleza y sublime puesta de sol. Ese es mi caso 😍 sin importar cuáles sean nuestras preferencias lo más importante es que nos conozcamos y encontremos esa parte bonita del día que nos fortalezca. >Some friends have told me that they find sunrises more beautiful because sunsets make them feel down—they evoke a sense of nostalgia. This is the perspective of a girl who once told me that sunsets make her feel this way, and on another occasion, someone else expressed the same idea. Some people benefit more from watching the sunrise, while others appreciate the beauty and grandeur of the sunset. That’s my case 😍. No matter what our preferences are, the most important thing is that we get to know ourselves and find that beautiful part of the day that strengthens us. ![1000921307.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/abisag/Ensa4eexrtA4G8CJ8VTFuAfG6ihPivgJWvF8y6fMiUfdjtFFz72uG3C9emNVsD2RH1b.jpg) Es cierto que mirar ya sea el amanecer, el atardecer o cualquier otro escenario natural no nos quita los problemas, estos siguen pero lo que cambia es mi actitud hacia ellos al sentirme renovada puedo tener una mejor perspectiva de cómo sobrellevarlos e impedir que me desanimen hasta el punto de caer en la tristeza o la frustración. Lo más bonito de mi terapia natural es que es gratis y percal no la generosidad de mi Creador que con tanto amor diseña a diario un atardecer diferente que me da sosiego y que me infunde esperanza de que todo va a mejorar. Realmente es un regalo espectacular el que cada uno de nosotros tenemos ya que el contacto con la naturaleza es sanador. Durante la vida experimentamos dificultades pero también muchísimos momentos hermosos que a veces damos por sentado por estar enfocado en sobrevivir. La idea es gestionar lo que nos afecte sin dejar de tener ilusiones y mucho menos sin perder la esperanza. Por lo tanto, estoy determinada a llenarme de fuerza con cada escenario lindo que vea en la naturaleza. >It’s true that watching the sunrise, the sunset, or any other natural scene doesn’t take away our problems—they’re still there—but what changes is my attitude toward them. When I feel renewed, I can gain a better perspective on how to cope with them and prevent them from discouraging me to the point of falling into sadness or frustration. >The best part of my natural therapy is that it’s free—and I’m grateful for the generosity of my Creator, who so lovingly designs a different sunset every day that brings me peace and fills me with hope that everything will get better. It truly is a spectacular gift that each of us has, since connecting with nature is healing. >Throughout life, we experience difficulties but also many beautiful moments that we sometimes take for granted because we’re focused on surviving. The idea is to manage what affects us without losing our dreams, and certainly without losing hope. Therefore, I’m determined to draw strength from every beautiful scene I see in nature. ![1000921295.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/abisag/Eq7LVyT5tEwYvkJDAKC832Xezga9AytPM6fN1cszjE3SVZQEX9ZvWoxsLU4K8CgA5Pm.jpg)

body.title: Der Mensch hat nur 24 Stunden
body.body:
Hallo Freunde,

wisst ihr was ich mir immer wieder denke. Der Mensch hat nur 24 Stunden Zeit um etwas zu erledigen und zwar jeder Mensch und egal wie viel man macht, irgendwas bleibt in diesen 24 Stunden immer auf der Strecke. Ich denke mir manchmal, ich weiß nicht wie das alles da draußen funktioniert. Ich habe selbst oft Tage an denen ich mich frage, wie zur Hölle hat das jetzt alles in 24 Stunden gepasst, eigentlich hätte ich noch 1-2 Tage mehr dafür gebraucht, aber dafür bleibt dabei einiges auf der Strecke. Manchmal denke ich mir an so stellen dann, was ich wohl alles verpasse? Ein normales Leben wahrscheinlich. Aber gut, wenn ich ein paar Jahre zurück denke, dann war es da noch schlimmer. Ich hatte Tage an denen ich es nicht geschafft habe irgendwie zurecht zu kommen. Die Arbeit als Selbstständiger war das was man gerne dazu sagt, man arbeitet selbst und ständig. Und so ist es jetzt wieder. Die Welt geht um mich herum gefühlt jeden Tag unter und man arbeitet dagegen an. Aber am Ende vom Tag bewegt man nur kleine Schritte. So dumm es klingt. 

Mal schauen was da noch alles kommt. Ich habe das jetzt über ein Jahrzehnt hinter mir, also ein Leben ohne freie Momente. Und genau das wird noch einige Jahre so weiter gehen. Die Welt ist irgendwie spannend, man kann einiges verändern, aber dafür braucht man dann auf einmal eine ganzschöne Menge an Nerven und verpasst vieles anderes dabei. Ich meine ich weiß nicht wie viele private Termine ich in den letzten Jahren habe sausen lassen, weil die Arbeit dazwischen kam und ich dann dort eingebunden war. Ich glaube inzwischen, es dürften hunderte sein. Jedes Jahr ein paar dutzend. Aber mal schauen wo es hin geht. Ein großes Vermögen wird sich dabei nicht bilden. Ich muss auch sagen, dahinter bin ich nicht her. Aber vielleicht lässt sich die Welt etwas verändern. Ich meine ich schreibe auch hier wieder aktiver, seit die Kurse in den Keller gehen. Nicht weil ich dabei Geld verdiene, sondern weil es irgendwie wieder Spaß macht. Wenn hier wirklich Geld dabei rumkommt, verliere ich oft einfach die Lust. Warum, keine Ahnung, nach den letzten Jahren hat es sich dann so entwickelt, dass diese niedrig Phasen, die Zeit ist, wo ich diesem Hobby nachkommen kann. 

Und das ist es, ein Hobby, wenn man hier zu viel verdient, dann wird es spannend, dann schaut auch das Finanzamt hin und so kann ich immer sagen, ich bin weit weg davon hier eine aufwendige Buchführung zu treiben. Dafür verdiene ich hier viel zu wenig. Aber mal schauen ob sich das ganze auch nochmal ändert. 

In dem Sinne, gehabt euch wohl und wie handhabt ihr das ganze? Ist das hier ein Hobby für euch oder etwas anderes? Ich meine wir sind an dem Punkt, wo man nicht wirklich groß Geld hier verdienen kann. Zumindest nicht kurzfristig. Wie die Welt langfristig aussieht, können wir alle nicht wissen. Aber in dem Sinne, schönen Samstag noch euch allen. Zumindest den 10 die das laut Peakd noch lesen.

body.title: Sorpresas que ha traído el otoño en Buenos Aires / Surprises that autumn has brought to Buenos Aires
body.body:
En Argentina, hace poco empezó el otoño, y con este cambio radical la flora y fauna también varían considerablemente, apareciendo algunos especímenes que durante el calor del verano quedan rezagados en esporas o debajo de la tierra.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmVHdzBx3QnBgcGEsroFDVf72iuucqhhPoczMkL5vBU5gG/regalos.png</center>

Y ha sido cuestión de coincidencias las dos oportunidades que me permitieron inmortalizar estas especies que en otras circunstancias no veo durante el verano que recién termina.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmQW41KZv7uJfg26UZJaTuZTLDLVoLexuGw2N8URiTnTKj/20260408_160508.jpg</center>

Primeramente, con las tormentas que despidieron el verano, una vez el clima recuperó la calma y las lluvias cesaron, empezaron a aparecer grandes especies de hongos en algunos árboles cerca de casa. De hecho, los hongos que salieron en este mismo [árbol](https://ecency.com/hive-166168/@mamaemigrante/el-reinado-de-los-hongos) lo documenté hace un par de años, y por ello puedo comparar ambas especies, que siendo la misma, esta vez resultan mucho más grandes que la vez anterior.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmbUc9vb1cYSXo3SWdgpfTJzXvWkSq43XJu12MZXBLEUjA/regalos_1_.png</center>

Por su color, deben haber tenido por lo menos día y medio desde que aparecieron, pues originalmente son muy blancos, luego marrones y terminan quemándose, producto del impacto del sol y la falta de humedad en el ambiente.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmT8JLo68k5XH2n4SjqcWdpN8xs1ptmCD9ZXoCYAWSPb27/20260408_160457.jpg</center>

A diferencia de mi primer encuentro con este árbol particular, este año las setas no solo están al pie del árbol, sino también en su tronco, semejando un camino de hongos que asciende, y si nos ponemos poéticos, quizás los que se sitúan arriba, están huyendo de la cruel realidad que les espera, aunque esta sea en vano.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmPS9DGrvWdBoJdU9UN4ukbtQCb485kAKtdmBnAVLeMpTV/20260408_160434.jpg</center>

El otro espécimen fue un particular gusanito, que por poco termina siendo mi víctima (o yo la de él) pues estaba caminando muy plácido en una banca del parque, a donde imagino se había caído luego de una fuerte bocanada de brisa fría.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmZY8ALX5dUZzos1cCEZDwgq8uSt9wMB8Z4VadQT76p5zG/20260404_154519.jpg</center>

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmPCDhT3vKeYbUUbybCFwMJznLhFfLXTFcobWTbHuzw8TC/20260404_154551.jpg</center>

Este pequeño animalito, tiene un llamativo color verdoso, que además, tiene la semejanza de ser pequeñas hojas de un árbol, lo cual es fantástico para camuflarse, y que mientras camina se separan, dejando ver la estructura real de su cuerpo, que se encuentra cubierto con esa especie de plumillas que realmente son su arma de defensa.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmc4zoicQqRitwgmsiga3W6rdiySiCDiLAKMYHkoF1adFi/20260404_154544.jpg</center>

Así que luego de fotografiarlo por un rato, opté por buscar asiento en otro espacio lejos de los árboles, por el mismo temor de no ser visitada de imprevisto por un gusano como este, que dicen, pica al contacto como medida preventiva, generando según mi mamá, fiebres altas y quizás, alguna reacción alérgica.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmdacYsWKdxpWA1n5xQv4bfiyzCf7sZ5VsCiZx4ATTeGHk/20260404_154537.jpg</center>

Y aunque parecieran ser nimiedades de la vida cotidiana, para mi son señales de que ya el otoño llegó y tomó las riendas del clima por acá en el sur, pues también las hojas secas van vistiendo de amarillo y ocre las veredas y patios de las casas de la ciudad.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmdqWeH4FqRmuk5BXQYL6ELhmE6YzQvrHiKV5LUX9uDYK6/20260404_154525.jpg</center>

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmcMNxZLX3nyQd4z3z36B8GmMQ8e8PN44qLnocC8hsWu8u/separador_ingles.png</center>

Autumn has recently begun in Argentina, and with this drastic change, the flora and fauna also vary considerably, with some species emerging that remain dormant as spores or underground during the summer heat.

It was purely by chance that I had two opportunities to capture these species, which I don’t usually see during the summer that has just ended.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmQW41KZv7uJfg26UZJaTuZTLDLVoLexuGw2N8URiTnTKj/20260408_160508.jpg</center>

First, with the storms that marked the end of summer, once the weather calmed down and the rains stopped, large species of mushrooms began to appear on some trees near my home. In fact, I documented the mushrooms that grew on this very [tree](https://ecency.com/hive-166168/@mamaemigrante/el-reinado-de-los-hongos) a couple of years ago, so I can compare the two specimens—which, though the same species, are much larger this time than they were before.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmbUc9vb1cYSXo3SWdgpfTJzXvWkSq43XJu12MZXBLEUjA/regalos_1_.png</center>

Judging by their color, they must have been there for at least a day and a half since they appeared, as they are originally very white, then turn brown, and eventually scorch, due to the sun’s rays and the lack of humidity in the air.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmT8JLo68k5XH2n4SjqcWdpN8xs1ptmCD9ZXoCYAWSPb27/20260408_160457.jpg</center>

Unlike my first encounter with this particular tree, this year the mushrooms are not only at the base of the tree but also on its trunk, resembling an ascending path of fungi, and if we get poetic, perhaps those at the top are fleeing the cruel reality that awaits them, even if it is in vain.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmPS9DGrvWdBoJdU9UN4ukbtQCb485kAKtdmBnAVLeMpTV/20260408_160434.jpg</center>

The other specimen was a peculiar little worm that nearly became my victim (or I his), as it was walking quite placidly on a park bench, where I imagine it had fallen after a strong gust of cold wind.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmZY8ALX5dUZzos1cCEZDwgq8uSt9wMB8Z4VadQT76p5zG/20260404_154519.jpg</center>

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmPCDhT3vKeYbUUbybCFwMJznLhFfLXTFcobWTbHuzw8TC/20260404_154551.jpg</center>

This little creature has a striking greenish color, and it also resembles small tree leaves, which is fantastic for camouflage. As it walks, the “leaves” part, revealing the actual structure of its body, which is covered with tiny bristles that actually serve as its defense mechanism.


<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmc4zoicQqRitwgmsiga3W6rdiySiCDiLAKMYHkoF1adFi/20260404_154544.jpg</center>

So after photographing it for a while, I decided to find a seat in another spot away from the trees, out of fear of being unexpectedly visited by a worm like this one, which, they say, stings on contact as a defensive measure, causing, according to my mom, high fevers and perhaps some allergic reaction.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmdacYsWKdxpWA1n5xQv4bfiyzCf7sZ5VsCiZx4ATTeGHk/20260404_154537.jpg</center>

And although these might seem like trivialities of everyday life, to me they are signs that autumn has arrived and taken control of the weather here in the south, as the dry leaves are also dressing the sidewalks and courtyards of the city’s houses in shades of yellow and ochre.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmdqWeH4FqRmuk5BXQYL6ELhmE6YzQvrHiKV5LUX9uDYK6/20260404_154525.jpg</center>

body.title: Mensaje diario de 5  minutos: No puedo pasar eso por alto / 5 Minute Freewrite: can’t overlook that
body.body:
>



# Nunca más


#


Las personas se relacionan durante toda su vida en distintos escenarios y situaciones siendo comunicativas porque forma parte de su esencia, ya que son seres humanos que sienten, piensan tienen sentimientos y diferentes reacciones. En realidad son muy complicados también en cuanto a ciertas actitudes cuando alguno posee una personalidad bastante fuerte y particular; es que cuando se comunican se exaltan con mucha facilidad lo que suele desatar a veces complicaciones con palabras agresivas, groseras y cuando se faltan el respeto entre sí se pierde todo en ese instante marcando una separación entre ellos porque ya no hay entendimiento aunque siempre hay una de las partes que intenta lograr un mejor entendimiento, pero fracasa.

Hay relaciones que realmente son admirables porque prevalece el respeto, los valores y el buen trato entre ellos cuando se hablan y conviven lo que habla de su buena educación; sin embargo, no todo es así, pues, claro que hay momentos en que no estás con el mejor ánimo y puedes estar triste, feliz o muy molesto por algo o con alguien y ante eso reaccionan. Sin pretender justificar o no esos momentos que pueden ser tensos o poco agradable; está también la razón para hacer o decir tantas cosas y bueno si hay momentos en donde hay aceptación de culpas y de pedir disculpas lo que habla de una persona que deja el orgullo de lado y es valiente porque quiere seguir adelante en las buenas relaciones.

Así como hay personas que logran resolver sus diferencias, hay otras que parecen que las domina la soberbia, no aceptan cuando se equivocan, son irrespetuosos cuando consideran que tienen la razón y no toleran que los contradiga nadie. Son personas indeseables que algunos toleran por necesidad, pero otros firmemente les dicen **No puedo pasar eso por alto** y nunca más me trataras groseramente.
​

​<center>![WhatsApp Image 2022-05-12 at 3.28.50 PM.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeucn6MeLy6DkeFM7A2nU8vB9xADUBt8Yr6bzbsja2DRK/WhatsApp%20Image%202022-05-12%20at%203.28.50%20PM.jpeg)</center>

​

# Never again

#
People interact throughout their lives in various settings and situations, communicating because it is part of their very nature; after all, they are human beings who feel, think, have emotions, and react in different ways. In reality, things can also get very complicated when it comes to certain attitudes, especially when someone has a rather strong and unique personality; the thing is, when they communicate, they get worked up very easily, which often leads to complications involving aggressive or rude words, and when they disrespect each other, everything is lost in that instant, creating a rift between them because there is no longer any understanding—even though one of the parties always tries to achieve a better understanding, but fails.

There are relationships that are truly admirable because respect, values, and kindness prevail when they talk and spend time together, which speaks to their good upbringing; however, it’s not always like that, because, of course, there are times when you’re not in the best mood, and you might be sad, happy, or very upset about something or with someone, and they react to that. Without trying to justify or dismiss those moments that can be tense or unpleasant, there’s also a reason for doing or saying so many things. And well, if there are moments when people accept blame and apologize, that speaks to someone who sets pride aside and is brave because they want to move forward in a healthy relationship.

​Just as there are people who manage to resolve their differences, there are others who seem to be consumed by arrogance: they refuse to admit when they’re wrong, act disrespectfully when they think they’re right, and won’t tolerate anyone contradicting them. They’re undesirable people whom some tolerate out of necessity, but others firmly tell them, **“I can’t let that slide,”** and make it clear that they’ll never be treated rudely again.



#

## Liquidity Pools

### **Liquidity pool positions on SPS-BNB**

The SPS-BNB pool on PancakeSwap is a liquidity pool where users can provide two different cryptocurrencies, namely SPS (Splintershards) and Binance Coin (BNB). This liquidity allows other users to swap cryptocurrencies and pay liquidity fees. In return, those who provide liquidity receive shares in the pool and earn fees based on their share of the liquidity provided. This pool facilitates trading between SPS and BNB on the PancakeSwap platform and supports the liquidity and smooth exchange of these two cryptocurrencies.

body.title: Ups and Downs
body.body:
For the last 2/3 years, I have seen countless people behaving in countless ways. Over a particular matter, I was kinda sad, but when I analyzed the situation, I got to realize that people are bearing worse than mine. To be honest, life is always a mixture of pleasant and unpleasant struggles with time; we shouldn't be broken into pieces nor fly high in the sky. 

In every place, we have one competitor, not real-world competition but someone who is like us, maybe in terms of age, responsibility, earnings, or position. So in such positions/stuff, there are always some compensations that need to be addressed; many don't get them and end up messing up badly. 

So a year ago, the guy I'm talking about often got compared with me due to some matter by a bunch of people who have nothing important to do apart from these kinda stuffs. Lifestyle! Yeah, it was about the lifestyle. I was lagging behind, still doing.  But yet, I'm happy with myself, Allah will fix things, and I'm slowly doing that as well. 


![joseph-greve-RSGb2x2hd-k-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/minhajulmredol/23u5vxBsvXyWNSsehkRFsC9emjHr8399feW47LLpCPb3EUBawfAho6F2NGQxZiC569Mcb.jpg)

[📸 Joseph Greve](https://unsplash.com/photos/three-dried-leaves-RSGb2x2hd-k)

People used to point out the lack with him, show me this, this, and that. Moreover, that guy was happy in showing off as well, financially solvent and would spend a lot as well, used to ruling social media, and business was expanding.  I don't know what happened, the business suddenly got stuck, losses after losses, and now things got pretty fucked up. That guy is in pretty bad shape. 

From my personal observation, it's not good to showcase our personal achievements or successes, as evil eyes are true. Even if we do, we must stay within our limits, have good intentions, and keep things as invisible as possible. That guy is going through hard times, financially. I pray and hope that he gets to recover from these situations. But the fact is, he got silent, inactive on social media, no showoff, nothing, as everything fell apart. So what's the use of flying so high that the impact while landing on the ground is so bad?

Just because of these kinda situations, I'm very much afraid of social media and its craze, even though I don't like the showoff mentality. I always try to keep things hidden, at least to its bare minimum. I'm very afraid of evil eyes; they are so real that I too suffered greatly due to this.  So you may say, I learnt the lesson already, that too the hard way.  

***So yeah, it was just like a reminder, go slow, don't fly, stay down to earth as none knows what's gonna happen next.***

I thought the waterway would be a shortcut and much faster than walking. So I started rowing a boat through the narrow canals, but I soon noticed that the water was quite slow. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVrobVDtPiAW895iaE9ocwFUgmQvUFH4mPFrN7noF9onA/screenshot_8_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPyz3VSYNKikaivsu7NySefVfhVa7XBCJwnXfYQWLBwyC/screenshot_9_.png) Since the boat was not as fast as I hoped, I decided to try the other way. On my way, I spotted a locked crate guarded by a soldier. I assassinated the soldier quickly so I could steal some supplies from the crate. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYtQkdFGEpAj9JGYPD5AAuyYovGZtyHyiJLbpmK9P6tiN/screenshot_10_.png) I tried to leave the other soldier alone as I walked past his post. However, he noticed me moving through the shadows and came over to meet his fate, which was my sword. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUpjjRHaF9G7zgzLYorYjfzoyDDVowEBtwJia3F6orQU7/screenshot_11_.png) I assassinated one more soldier on my way who was standing guard on a big wall. I was passing right beside him, so finished him before he could look into my eyes. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVc6DZS77GsfJ5HCM97WkNthakPr1GYUgJQ6yCnvnsDVL/screenshot_12_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPJRFEaVFnGXhWbPxwzaYv8ac3zErzdKnnSvDijVGhCrq/screenshot_13_.png) After reaching close to the Bureau, I called Enkidu to fly high and check the area. I wanted to spot the exact location of the bureau from the sky, and I found it quickly with the help of Enkidu. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRF97ztn9otigUxBaD4S64u283w9JSySTmyjjeFo3zEYN/screenshot_14_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcnXLWQWkEoQxzptNFxhAGkQyMaNS31BzKEF6wJFSGRkb/screenshot_15_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ4v2rH6fe2Us3pYEQCfgyeY1Bijn2Sp6wpGGb6BZLEy5/screenshot_16_.png) I ran for the bureau and once inside, I found both Roshan and Rebekah waiting for me. Rebekah talked about the harsh reality of Karkh and how the people there were struggling. It was a very dark and difficult situation for everyone living in that part of town. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY2beHchcCmUE42in2AYzdeS1NUKQYNiE6TRTbD5LmfWY/screenshot_17_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdybXdySk7HBHL4pZvJdgzXnUcJ1KtPDmzzrTb9FXcgU9/screenshot_18_.png) I met Roshan outside after I finished upgrading and equipping some new gear from Ahmad. I also changed my outfit before following Roshan toward the local market to see the injustice of the soldiers, who were treating the mercenaries very poorly in the middle of the street. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdAn9UqBaUHS2sNG7Cm7HQsLTm2BsgVpFFkWAFTW2k4YZ/screenshot_19_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmejmjFXuuJ8LEoGg8jpYxaufVapMzgUeLFGYY4VhybJGs/screenshot_20_.png) On our way to the market, Roshan said a lot of things to let me know more about the situation. After reaching the gate, Roshan welcomed me to the district. It seemed like Basim had a very good connection to this town. Until next time, happy gaming. *Note: The icon for the thumbnail is collected from steamgriddb.com* --- ▶️ [3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=paarvez/db497ffb)

body.title: weak men, big guns
body.body: a youtube title caught my attention the other day. it was this guy hanging around subways in the us asking people uncomfortable questions, maybe you know the channel, and the latest question was: > should we nuke iran?

></center>


and of course, the first logical thought is…who’s ‘we’? because i highly doubt joe smith, getting off the subway to go to the freaking dentist is in the business of nuking anyone, regardless of his answer.
it is, however, the sort of talk that’s been common these past few hectic weeks. should ‘we’ this, and if ‘they’ that. very non-descriptive, vague terms, and i’m generally cautious about those. gotta be careful with herd mentality. just look at the world we’re living in, eh.
it’s highly unlikely that you personally are nuking anyone. and so, it stands to reason you’d take any kind of military action (as satisfying as it may seem) with a grain of salt. because while it replies to a personal need for validation, it does not, in fact, pertain to a personal action. in other words, other people’s guns ain’t making you more manly or powerful. and things get tricky when you start taking personal pride and pleasure in someone else’s actions. especially violent ones.

but we love to think we’re big. we love to bandy around the word ‘we’ when it comes to military exploits and other such manly things, forgetting all the while that the people that lead us and often are in charge of said military exploits have a very different definition of ‘we’. in fact, time and again, the pandemic notwithstanding, politicians have shown their colors and proven quite clearly that ‘we’ and ‘our common good’ don’t mean what we think they mean.

usually, when you meet somebody new, you give it a long time of knowing that person before you let the lines blur, and before ‘we’ truly becomes a common we that both parties can speak on behalf of, and work towards. friendship works like that. romance, also. and yet, you get one donald duck on the tv enough times, you start forgetting who’s who and mistaking your ‘i’s for ‘we’s.

and here, i thought conservatives were more skeptical about changing their pronouns.

now, in all fairness, i didn’t watch the video. perhaps the people interviewed said ‘no’ to this proposed gen pop expedition. we should not nuke iran. strange, though, because the people who would say no would (ironically) also think in terms of ‘we’. look at what we are doing in the middle east. we should feel shame for the people we’ve chosen to govern us (regardless of your vote).

‘we’-ness goes both ways, doesn’t it?

i am watching the world come to pieces with great skepticism, but also a renewed sense of we-ness. it’s more of a general we. it’s a ‘we the many’ as opposed to you, the few. it contains both the apologists and the weak men (i say men because women have had a long and complex relationship with the patriarchy, so perhaps there’s more nuance there) that take such vicarious pleasure in other men’s big, phallic rockets.

it is always ‘we’. it is always ‘they’. the trouble is, as long as some of us insist on identifying with them, we’ll never manage to do anything about it. it was the same during the pandemic, when so many took pleasure in being good little boys that daddy pats on the back, and it’s much the same now. should we…
… except notice they don’t really ask your opinion, unless it suits them. and if it’s your children that must die in the name of righteousness, then so be it. theirs will be safely away, somewhere cushy and untouchable. i reckon whose kids are first to die is a good indicator of how much we’re a ‘we’.

meanwhile, i have been watching the continuation to “the handmaid’s tale”, “the testaments”. which, i must say, is an unnerving watch. it was, nine years ago, when the original series premiered.  it was, in 1985, when margaret atwood first published the book, presumably. yet you’d think we’d move further from the storyline, not closer. to look at america now, the insane proselytism, the merging of state once more with “god” (or at least a vicious mask, because it’s certainly not the christian god that reigns terror and death upon the earth in this way). the reduction of women that has seen such a rise in the past decade.

the world of commanders and divine oppression seems only heartbeats away, but perhaps there’s some comfort in that. because to every oppressor, there must be an opposition. to every psycho, a group of subversive right-thinkers. the fight, as it tends to, wearing on.

still, we’re talking about a book written more than forty years ago. isn’t it time we got better villains. i’m just asking.

https://youtu.be/zRmJwqVbtQI?list=RDzRmJwqVbtQI

The killing and dying, it was all done in vain,
Oh Willie McBride, it all happened again, and again, and again, and again.\

body.title: The wait is over the astronauts are returning to Earth
body.body: ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeHu6ZSApoUtwypDWrxAfLnC1MiQAJBzGJVWVMjWSFfuE/copilot_20260410_164324.png) ![art002e000192.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/animek/23tbP7RiuvLDbNWjaYUJDDtcqY5UyoHLtbQcsLZd296wUB3EWY1Ku1AayHfACSB3h1TJb.webp) Hey hey everyone! Greetings from wherever you are — Animek here, together with all of us who love science. We’re staying on Earth, but we get to see the results of years of study and progress in knowledge finally paying off. What we’re seeing is our beautiful planet photographed from space, from the Orion spacecraft of the ARTEMIS 2 project, which this Friday, April 10 2026, will return to Earth after spending 10 days in space. The mission seems to be going really well; the astronauts had a few problems but managed to fix them. ![Screenshot_16.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/animek/23xosrjndaZxQLWnh9Vj4cG7buBfzrSwvvS1na3sTomSKkNncM4eJd6wym7jMHiTRYHFW.png) Now we can enjoy views of our planet in new ways. Back in the 60s they took photos, but now, with today’s technology, we can capture images with much clearer detail — like in the first picture, where you can see cosmic dust, sunlight reflecting off our planet, and even an aurora borealis. ![Screenshot_17.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/animek/23swZZBnJB9cKJ4xeTbK4UE7ZCqAH23weXE1esUTperXNtWj4rtYJRPJux5VBgmVKgo7k.png) Both the Moon and Earth have been photographed from different angles and at different moments. It must be an incredible experience to have the privilege of going into space and seeing with your own eyes how magnificent the place we live in truly is. ![Screenshot_18.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/animek/23w2oBsCN7GZhXqP84BhL9sXxsAHKc3XLr169zbfJafEwDGmdQBsUbwnVqSJDKXUeV4T6.png) ![Screenshot_19.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/animek/23t7936oVukfgnUEqmUnZbByLv4PAnRV6jAQPs3magiju5R3qAzobFTWyikKFwiGr7uZw.png) During these 10 days of live mission broadcasts, they’ve explained a lot for those who don’t know how things work — from planning ideas, checking food, setting coordinates, to how each system on the ship should behave. Today they focused on how the ship and astronauts must prepare to land on Earth. They talked about several scenarios, from the best ones to the worst‑case ones where something could go wrong and the astronauts’ lives could be at risk. But there are many scientists who’ve studied every possibility, so let’s hope nothing bad happens and they come home safely. We’re just hours away from seeing them arrive. I’ve watched several simulations, so I already have an idea of how this last part of the adventure will go. All the staff are ready to welcome them and review all the material they photographed from the Dark Side of the Moon — a face of our satellite that had only been seen by robots before. Now humans have seen it directly, pushing knowledge forward for future missions planned ahead. * * * **Follow me so you don't miss the next adventure!**

body.title: Pepe Entered the Hive.
body.body:
Somewhere between a green candle and a bad decision, Pepe was met.

Not the quiet, meme-in-the-corner Pepe. Not the “feels good man” relic of internet archaeology.  I’m talking about Pepe as he exists now.  Fully tokenized, slightly unhinged, and somehow holding court across chains like a frog who read one too many whitepapers and decided, “yeah, I could run a financial system.”

It started on a Tuesday.  Or at least I think it was Tuesday.  Time moves differently when you’re deep in charts and caffeine as a frog being.  Watching Pepe candles dance like they’ve got something to prove.  Had three tabs open, one for prices, one for memes, and one for what I told myself was “research” but was actually just a forum thread arguing whether frogs understand liquidity pools.
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmRTovteeMBAvZhbSGVSZtht4LT6LeZjJMRcMJTZ9Zjs2R/Screenshot%202026-04-10%202.38.04%20PM.png 

That’s when Hive buzzed.

Now, Hive isn’t the kind of place where things just “buzz” without reason.  It hums.  It posts.  It rewards.  It occasionally spirals into philosophical debates about decentralization and whether [cobbee should be tokenized](https://hive-engine.com/trade/COFFEE).  But that day, something felt… different.

A post appeared.

No author.  No history.  Just a title:

**“Pepe Has Entered the Hive.”**

Naturally, I clicked.

Inside was a single line:

> “Liquidity is temporary.  Memes are forever.”

And beneath it? A wallet address already receiving deposits.

At first, I laughed.  Because of course.  Of course someone would try to bridge the chaotic energy of Pepe into the oddly civilized ecosystem of Hive.  It felt like inviting a trickster god to a town hall meeting.

https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVWvSSgzCvfLpHZGfDZinYgnw39xmgqoS2wAfBRbZ9TJ7/Screenshot%202026-04-10%202.39.36%20PM.png 

But then things escalated.

Within hours, users started reporting strange occurrences:

* Tokens appearing in wallets with no transaction history
* NFTs of Pepe… but evolving
* Comments replying *before* the original post was even written

One user claimed their staking rewards started fluctuating based on how many frog memes they posted per day.  Another insisted their account was “visited” by something that left behind a trail of green checkmarks and a single message:

> “You are now part of the pond.”

https://img.leopedia.io/DQmWdAv37wvmvqohpGM5xTg4fb7NKDhEdHEx9WqgGpf9JKE/Screenshot%202026-04-10%202.40.31%20PM.png 

I decided to investigate.

Deep in Hive’s ecosystem, past the usual posts and communities, I found something new.  A tag that hadn’t existed before:

**#PepePond**

Clicking it felt like stepping into a parallel timeline.

Posts weren’t just posts... they were… coordinated.  As if a decentralized intelligence had learned humor and decided to deploy it strategically.  Memes referenced events that hadn’t happened yet.  One post joked about a “flash crash caused by a frog blinking,” and twelve hours later, the market dipped.  Just enough to make you uncomfortable.

Coincidence?  Probably.

Was I going to ignore it?  Absolutely not!

Then came the *hopping* point.

A user.. let’s call him Dave.  Because it’s always Dave.  Dave decided to create a token:

**PEPEHIVE**

No roadmap.  No utility.  Just vibes.

Except… it worked.

Liquidity flowed in.  People started trading.  Another added staking. Within days, $PEPE (on Hive) had more engagement than projects with million-dollar budgets and carefully crafted mission statements.

And at the center of it all?

Pepe.

Or at least, the idea of Pepe.  The myth.  The collective hallucination of a community that understood something most financial systems don’t:

**Value is a story we agree to believe.**

https://img.leopedia.io/DQmbyHNpVSt5xJ55Epwb6tEF2JPzYrsCP4vmaEdZvtp1Rbz/Screenshot%202026-04-10%202.42.09%20PM.png 

Around this time, there was a dream somewhere.

Sitting in what looked like a boardroom, except the chairs were lily pads and the projector was a glowing smart contract.  At the head of the table sat Pepe himself, wearing a suit, naturally.

He clicked to the next slide.

“Q3 Roadmap,” he said.

* Expand into interdimensional liquidity
* Partner with fictional ekonormies
* Achieve enlightenment

I raised my hand.

Asking: “Is any of this real?”

Pepe paused, then smiled.

“Define real.”
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUTUC6SV1M7DzxvbSutKA2T2Tv4GUvED6ASCMAmHLmmh3/Screenshot%202026-04-10%202.43.08%20PM.png 

When I woke up, my wallet had morphed.

Not dramatically.  Just… subtly.  A new token.  A new NFT.  A notification that read:

> “You have been airdropped participation.”

Participation in what?  No idea.

But I checked the markets anyway.

And there it was.

PEPEHIVE -> up XXX%.
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmRAbuSsQW6vKyrybmoaxeKk5gFzoTMWwvXwfA3hiw18mi/Screenshot%202026-04-10%202.44.23%20PM.png 

Now, here’s where the real world creeps back in.

Because while it’s easy to laugh at the absurdity of a frog-themed token infiltrating a blockchain ecosystem, the underlying mechanics are very real:

* Community-driven value
* Decentralized coordination
* Narrative as financial infrastructure

We’ve seen versions of this before.  From early internet forums to modern crypto ecosystems, the pattern repeats:

1. A joke
2. A community
3. A market

And somewhere along the way, the line between satire and system (dis)appears.

https://img.leopedia.io/DQmY4rTedqG7gxCaXDuV3PSrDGX4D1F1Y3B9PaD2E6wAj6Q/Screenshot%202026-04-10%202.45.22%20PM.png 

Back on Hive, the #pepe tag continues to grow.

Some treat it as a (Pepe) game.  Others as an experiment.  A few as a legitimate financial opportunity.  And maybe it’s all three.

For you?

For me?

Still check that original post sometimes.  It’s still there.  Still receiving deposits.  Still saying the same thing:

# > “Liquidity is temporary. Memes are forever.”

And honestly?

Might be the most accurate financial advice I’ve heard all year.

https://img.leopedia.io/DQmYCZG6fcdVXXRttPvGA9HZVniQBYG74PeWSdveVhsKAfa/Screenshot%202026-04-10%202.46.21%20PM.png 

*images sourced with help of ChatGPT*

If you find yourself scrolling through Hive late at night, and you see a frog staring back at you from a post that seems just a little too self-aware…

Don’t panic.

https://i.pinimg.com/originals/cf/e0/59/cfe05933da047ff95bac4a8c1cb98a6c.jpg 
[image](pinimg.com)

Just remember:

You’re not just observing the market anymore.

You’re part of the pond.

 https://www.skyechooks.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/Are-small-frog-ponds-a-great-addition-to-your-garden.png

body.body:
>


> # We Talk Friday
>(WTF)


This is a semi-regular series that I will run on Fridays to hold discussions on a current topic from the week gone. The aim is to keep them light and conversational, though some might be heavier - regardless of the content topic itself though, just have some fun engaging and discussing with whoever happens to put in the effort in the comments section below. 

---



![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tarazkp/23xL96dDxp6STUpqdJ5gKqV7z7cBf2abUvxJwPPR3m1ihtPqjyrv9XpKn6x9CKcwaSTmR.png)



---

# We Talk Friday Ep. 50: Take a Seat

It has been quite a busy week for me for some reason. Not bad, but just busy and it has required thought in areas I haven't thought about for a while, and it has sapped my energy. When I have to think about things I don't often think about, I get tired. But on we go!

# 1. WTF is 50?

Correct. This is the 50th episode of WTF and since it hasn't been entirely weekly, it probably means that it is somewhere older than a year now, which is kind of cool Hopefully you have enjoyed it and we can meet to start the weekend for another year ahead. A year in today's world is a long time though, so who knows if any of us will exist in another 365 days. 

# 2. Cease and Desist

Fuck, saying that out loud screws with my lisp. Normally I have \

control of it unless I get tired - which I am. However, what a shambles geopolitics is currently. But what I found interesting was Starmer (the UK PM) said; >“I’m fed up with the fact that families across the country see their bills go up and down on energy, businesses’ bills go up and down on energy because of the actions of Vladimir Putin or Donald Trump across the world” That's right, core US allies are putting Trump into the same category as Putin and what is more, talking about the impact they are having on the global economy. What is most interesting with that though is that the haphazard and violent Trump activity has had far more effect on the global economy in a year than the Russian war in Ukraine has had in the last four years. The impact of mad men is not equal, even if their madness is. # 3. Time is Relative I was reading about some new car battery charging tech that cuts the time for a recharge down to about 10 minutes, which people are still complaining is too slow in comparison to filling up an ICE engine. But my question is, when people are spending hours a day scrolling mindlessly through ridiculous feeds of TikTok and Instagram, even if it take 30 minutes, what is the big deal? I remember having to wait four *and a half* days for a 200 MB download of Photoshop from a warez site, and that was at full speed the whole time. > People are spoiled brats these days. So impatient. body.title: Volvimos a Max Burgers para probar nuevas cosas [ESP/ENG]
body.body:
> ## Español Hola a todos! mi esposo y yo amamos las hamburguesas y en Max Burgers venden unas muy deliciosas, así que mientras estuvimos en Suecia, Pawel y yo aprovechamos la oportunidad de visitar de nuevo este restaurante ya que en Polonia no tenemos una sucursal cerca de casa, y la última vez que comimos allí fue hace bastante tiempo ya cuando fuímos a Varsovia, por lo que ya se imaginarán lo mucho que lo disfrutamos esta vez después de tanto tiempo. Pawel fue el encargado de hacer el pedido mientras Olivia y yo esperabamos en una mesa ya que como ven en las fotos había bastante gente en el restaurante y les cuento que además de las hamburguesas Cheeseburger esta vez también decidimos probar las alitas de pollo y además ordenamos unos nuggets para Olivia que les cuento a ella le encantaron y eso que esta era una de sus primeras veces comiendo nuggets. No esperamos mucho tiempo cuando ya Pawel estaba en la mesa con el pedido, y la verdad es que las hamburguesas estaban igual de deliciosas como las recordabamos, además las alitas de pollo nos encantaron también a ambos y como les dije antes Olivia disfrutó bastante los nuggets. Por todo pagamos 221 coronas suecas o 24 dólares aproximadamente que para ser Suecia la verdad es un buen precio ya que como les dije para nosotros como turistas nos pareció un país caro pero la verdad es que disfrutamos el tiempo allí y por supuesto también disfrutamos la comida en Max Burgers, por lo que fue bueno que pudimos encontrar este restaurante en Suecia y ahora les recomiendo también además de las hamburguesas, probar los nuggets y las alitas de pollo pues estoy segura que les van a encantar tanto como a nosotros. ## English Hi everyone! My husband and I love burgers, and Max Burgers serves up some really delicious ones, so while we were in Sweden, Pawel and I took the opportunity to visit this restaurant again since we don’t have a branch near our home in Poland, and the last time we ate there was quite a while ago when we went to Warsaw, so you can imagine how much we enjoyed it this time after so long. Pawel was in charge of placing the order while Olivia and I waited at a table—as you can see in the photos, the restaurant was pretty crowded. I’ll tell you that in addition to the cheeseburgers, this time we also decided to try the chicken wings, and we ordered some nuggets for Olivia. I’ll tell you, she loved them, even though this was one of her first times eating nuggets. We didn’t have to wait long before Pawel was already at the table with our order, and honestly, the burgers were just as delicious as we remembered them. We both loved the chicken wings too, and as I mentioned earlier, Olivia really enjoyed the nuggets. We paid 221 Swedish kronor, or about $24, for everything, which is actually a good price for Sweden. As I mentioned, we found it to be an expensive country as tourists, but we really enjoyed our time there, and of course we also enjoyed the food at Max Burgers, so it was great that we were able to find this restaurant in Sweden. Now I also recommend that, in addition to the burgers, you try the nuggets and the chicken wings, because I’m sure you’ll love them just as much as we did.

body.title: “If the World Went to War: My Truth, My Choices”
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmXRTvUZykv66GK9Q7AHVJpZMw3G56pPSgp4Z3dhmu4GKN/IMG_4181.jpeg 
[source](https://pixabay.com/photos/war-soldiers-parachutes-469503/)

Seeing this prompt made me realize that I had never thought of this and most people won’t think of this until it’s actually happens. Really I do not pray for a world war because the little gist I heard about the Biafra war is very unsettling.Not withstanding the subject isnt far fetched. It’s actually something that can happen and we may not think of it until we have to. 

The truth be told that in the face of war, I repeat again that I pray it doesn’t happen. The thoughts of it alone is unsettling, we would have to make difficult choices.Unsettling for someone like me that wants peace and nothing but peace. I don’t even have the energy to fight with someone or quarrel not to talk of the entire world. 

Well, in the face of such, being a hero is not what me or someone else might thing about immediately.I did be drawn to thinking of the safety of my family and myself. I would think of survival first. My first move would be have to ensure that my family is safe and secure. 

I would have to think ahead by considering which locations I think is safer and we may have to make quicker decisions whether we would relocate or stay put wherever we are. In the times We are in, I believe that civilians would be safer if they avoided chaos, crowds and places of uncertainty than running towards it. 

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmXvQ4SuWkNLE64gMTMFQ5BGLCkWTL4ttx646WardVPsdU/IMG_4182.jpeg 
[source](https://pixabay.com/illustrations/peace-drawing-paper-plane-beginning-7041249/)

That’s to say that even though the thought of joining the army or wanting to be a hero is a noble one, we know that that is an action that requires deep and several trainings to be a part of.I believe that to some persons, that is a calling and One would have to understand the risks that are involved before wanting to be a part. 

Not everyone will any to be a part of that especially if they have people depending on them. 
Clearly I wouldn’t opt for such. So my first approach would be to ensure that my loved ones are safe and to do that, there are some approach I could consider. 

The first would be to know and search out exit routes and also look out for safe zones and incase someone gets separated, a communication means to reach-out should be in places.
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVFGfxt2gjCjKRLqxwWhdP7PeEF36E6ABKaNj1CLs4f5s/IMG_4183.jpeg 
[source](https://pixabay.com/photos/the-military-infantry-the-army-1819855/)

The next thing would be to ensure that there’s availability of food, water and medications for the members of the family while we are on the go. I heard that during the Biafra war, that most people died from starvation than from the war itself.

I would also ensure we have access to verified and reliable news to know how to navigate our escape routes rather than relying on rumors because false news circulated faster in time of crises than the real news. 

We also be keeping a low profile and avoid drawing attention to ourselves as this is also key to survival. Amidst all of these, there would be need for mental toughness. Mental strength and calming down is as important as any physical preparation because fear and panic would only lead to making poor decisions.

War is a serious thing and it’s not the way we see them in movies. It’s about endurance, protecting oneself and having to make difficult choices. May we never see war.

body.title: If only the money were available.
body.body: > ## Hello, everyone! I welcome you to my blog. Trust me, there are a lot of people out there with vision and so many plans, both for themselves, family, and everyone close to them, but then the lack of the finances and funds needed to make this vision a reality has stopped them from actually doing anything. Everyone has a vision or dream that they hope to achieve some day, and one of the things that makes dreams a reality is the finances (money) needed to make it happen; if money were not the problem, I think a lot of people's dreams would have been made a reality already. The lack of money is the only thing that makes a lot of people's dreams stay dreams instead of actualizing those dreams. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNhCdYFMjXjvYeLxRU6jCofSvuYHVv4XnzcWNZPAbf6uE/1775857460301.jpg) [Source](https://unsplash.com/photos/a-woman-holding-a-bunch-of-money-in-her-hands-t7DywUCRXh8) I have heard so many elderly people and even young people talk about how they wanted to go to college after graduating high school, but the lack of finances to do so only made their dreams of going to college stay dreams, as they were never actualized. One of the things that determines if we get to do all that we dream of is the access to the finance (money) needed to actually make it happen. I think everyone has had their own fair share of not having the money needed to make something happen, whether big or small; at least at some point in our lives we have been in that situation where the lack of the money needed stopped us from reaching our goals. Assuming I get to the point where money is not a problem, there are lots and lots of things that I really want to do, but the lack of the money needed to get them done has always been a challenge, so if somehow money stops being the problem, one of the first things I will do is start up an agricultural business, buy a plot of land, and on it build a poultry farm where I can train both chickens and turkeys. Also, on the same land, I can start up a fish farm; if money were not the problem, this is something I really want to get into. It is going to cost a lot, but it is worth it. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQonw6e8mB1P2q5rjEinPhUtZs5gYYFYm9qPCVZJcdpBd/1775857460206.jpg) [Source](https://unsplash.com/photos/chicken-poultry-Mpm69Pad_-8) In my country I have come to realize that you have to create job opportunities for yourself if you want to excel, as the government is doing little or nothing to provide that for you, and as a graduate of agricultural and bioresources engineering, starting up a business in my line is one of the ways I can actually provide myself with a job since at the moment none is coming forth. This is my entry to the India United contest; you can also join [here](https://peakd.com/hive-197685/@indiaunited/indiaunited-new-contest-and-last-7a7caf29dc7dd)

Do not despise your [days](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-day) of little beginning. I was just writing this [article](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-article) and well I just remembered when we started this [business](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-business) some [years](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-year) ago. A small four by four ceiling shop and that was where it [ALL](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-all-currency) began. People will just pass by and begin to imagine if they should actually trust these young lads with their clothes. It was those days of just praying to have a shop jam-packed with cloth since that was the mentality to drive trust.   

People start trusting you with a few hundred naira and it moves to the unit thousand, the tens of thousands, the hundreds of thousands and then follow the million, millions and so on. I had to take [time](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-time) to analyze this because you are left to build your worth. No one will bundle thousands to you without either trusting you or knowing your records of trust.   

We’ve moved on and expanded and our laundry section has been the most trusted and we can't doubt since it was where it all started. Sewing, branding and other things have come in and the [customer](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-customer) base is changing lanes. Aside from just customer influx, we are talking of them viewing us to be more responsible and that's what business is mostly about. Should I trust this person? It gets much easier to answer when the ‘person’ turns to a ‘brand’.   

It gets very easy to close a deal from here since you can see the brand and its growth yourself. Aside from just business premises, people begin to know and refer to you as a business [man](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-man). It has been driven by a mindset of determination to be productive even when [profit](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-profit) was going against odds.  

I have a couple of articles I will be touching on one after the other. I thought I was going to be able to send out this article much more than this, but I got choked up with activities to cater for. I first of all have to admit that I have seen many positive changes around me just three [months](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-month) into this year.   
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmeTtjzDi5nKicm8CEcyD4PYC584gpHTVtqNxRQazqpqAN/1000162676.jpg 
[source](https://www.freepik.com/free-photo/still-life-with-human-brains-watering-can_48110814.htm#fromView=search&page=4&position=29&uuid=6064bd2b-4d74-4234-ae05-a0f92366cd5d&query=Productivity+mindset+AI+generated) 
It all started with a desire to improve and I can say, when desire comes, then comes [opportunity](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-opportunity) to manifest it. I wanted to grow, learn, get exposure, improve myself and there the [Journey](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-journey-singles) kick started. I first got an opportunity to attend a high skill mentorship session; something that I don't regret spending that [money](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-money) on.   

I learned a [lot](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-lot-commodities) in the process, it is something I am still gradually digesting and at the appointed time, I will delve into its execution. Talking of improvement, I have seen improvement in [delivery](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-delivery). Having to manage a multipurpose business comes at the [cost](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-cost) of filling in the blank spaces. What happens when demand is high and the working force is little. I had to find a way to fit in.   

In the process, I had to improve upon my sewing asides from being dependent on workers. Let's just say, converting every extra time available to a productive one. And well, adding to that, trying to save some extra bucks for the [company](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-company-business). It has also made my [contract](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-contract-real-estate) worker pick [interest](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-interest) in showing up knowing he will concentrate on one thing while I focus on the other.   

In conclusion, anyway, I am not saying that it is compulsory to join the working force but until we are capable of employing more, the production floor needs my assistance. It was one of such timingly deliveries today. I am happy we could beat the customer’s imagination to deliver although it came at the cost of me reaching the planned meeting today very late. The take [home](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-home) here is, give yourself consistently to develop yourself and you will be surprised how far you can go in a few months.
