body.title: My Actifit Report Card: April 10 2026 - Doing deliveries and visiting the city museum ✨
body.body:
#
ENGLISH CONTENT

Hello everyone in this community! In my previous post, I mentioned that I would probably be out today, and I confirmed my outing when a customer from my [business](https://www.instagram.com/sue_citos/) showed up, so I had to make a delivery. That really cheered me up, since I brought some of my creations to offer to the people of this region 😌 I thought it was going to rain because the day dawned a bit cloudy, but it stayed cloudy for most of the morning. Once I met up with the customer, I delivered her order. I felt great afterward, because she wants to buy other products I make, so I'll have things to do when I get back to my workshop in the capital.
![1000396179.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23w2m8SsfAwmwjst9cGt5tSC8wqrSdUMBgxXbcBRLNRfbNmX6Lg8GkpZ2wgGbzjtJc7Xh.jpg)
**✨ Product ready for delivery ✨**

Once I'd done that, I could have gone back to where I was staying, but instead, I decided to do some shopping for supplies I needed to prepare for attending a couple of bazaars. I got some beautiful light green cardstock, as well as some clear bags to protect my supplies. Since I was nearby, I also went to a small bazaar being held at an art school. There were some interesting things, but I ended up buying a small notebook from a girl who approached me while I was browsing the booths; she came up and said, \

I couldn't say no to that offer, haha, not to mention it was a small price (around $0.40). Honestly, I didn't know what I was buying at first, until I received it... I loved it! It's a small, handmade notebook made with colorful paper, and they even added a keyring loop. I plan to use it for drawings and sketches, which I might then share on the [Drawday community](https://peakd.com/c/hive-140877/created). I was so happy to buy it because I love supporting small businesses.
![1000396034.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23vsJFbLdyvYkUi42hsq4A39fagUKDUYxperLeexXEGuQaUzjyBUCVuXJm4Di3K43YwVV.jpg)
**✨ Lovely purchase I made at the little bazaar ✨**

My visit to the bazaar was quick, since there were only a few stalls and the temptation to buy was so strong, haha, not to mention I was hungry. So I went to eat at a place I'd been wanting to go to for a while. It's a place that sells filled empanadas, which I used to go to with my mom when we came shopping downtown. I admit that part of my desire to go was nostalgia, and of course, the delicious taste of the empanadas. I ordered a chicken one and peach juice. I enjoyed that lunch so much 😭
![1000396035.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/EpVC5jjUJ5qWazRTA6VyMb7VCJFWV47Ffwj1dqrTFBFxkBfvnEqRMgmdf7uSkJzyxR7.jpg)
**✨ My delicious lunch ✨**

Before heading back, a friend told me there was an exhibition at the Barquisimeto Museum, so I didn't hesitate to go. I took plenty of pictures of the exhibits, so I hope to upload them very soon 😉 Despite the intense heat and all the walking, I don't feel tired; in fact, I feel fulfilled and full of enthusiasm... Does this mean I'm on the \

? They say that when you're doing what you should be doing in life, you feel a great sense of well-being in your heart, and that's exactly how I felt today 💖 I want to feel like this always! 🤗
![1000396155.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/EpLgSoFnTBvHEgUKhKewWRnBX859yETQL3s64Bn4qbW4fmXJBuWUkrsJv9wSZHyaKSC.jpg)
**✨ Hopefully the museum will have more visitors in the coming days ✨**

### ✨ Thank you so much for visiting my post. I hope you found it interesting ✨
![sticker-hive-good-luck_eng.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/AJmmUV1yayiznHFJfUGf3NNWfH9ifhsnVHdRXhexXndn8Ky6G7nHMgfMBVmfQdV.gif)

#
💚 Until next time! 💚

![SEPARADOR.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23ydCF6RtBK44fyUqZnnPGvJWAgep2EUuKVgg1fmuih7CXvQzHPWpAqG5Q2SEJmUAZxCx.jpeg)
#
CONTENIDO EN ESPAÑOL

¡Hola a todos los integrantes de esta comunidad! En mi post anterior había mencionado que probablemente saldría el día de hoy, confirmando la salida cuando apareció un cliente de mi [emprendimiento](https://www.instagram.com/sue_citos/), por lo que debía hacer delivery. Eso es algo que me animó bastante, ya que traje parte de mis creaciones para ofrecerlas a los habitantes de esta región 😌 Pensaba que iba a llover, porque el día amaneció algo nublado, sin embargo, permaneció nublado durante gran parte de la mañana. Una vez que me encontré con la clienta, le hice entrega de su pedido. Quedé con un buen sabor de boca tras de ello, pues la chica desea adquirir otro tipo de productos que sé elaborar, así que tendré cosas que hacer cuando regrese a mi taller en la capital.
![1000396179.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23w2m8SsfAwmwjst9cGt5tSC8wqrSdUMBgxXbcBRLNRfbNmX6Lg8GkpZ2wgGbzjtJc7Xh.jpg)
**✨ Producto listo para ser entregado ✨**

Una vez hecho esto, podía volver al sitio en dónde me estoy hospedando, pero en lugar de ello, decidí ir a hacer unas compras que necesitaba para las preparaciones de mi asistencia a un par de bazares. Conseguí una cartulina de un hermoso color verde claro, así como unas bolsas transparentes para proteger mis productos. Aprovechando que estaba cerca, también me acerqué a un pequeño bazar que se estaba realizando en una escuela de arte. Habían cosas interesantes, pero acabé comprándole una pequeña libreta a una niña que me abordó mientras veía los stands; llegó y me dijo *\

*... No pude decirle que no a esa oferta de venta jaja sin mencionar que era un precio pequeño (alrededor de 0.40$). La verdad, no sabía que estaba comprando al principio, hasta que lo recibí... ¡Lo amé! Se trata de una pequeña libreta artesanal realizada con hojas de varios colores y hasta le colocaron un aro de llaveros. Pienso utilizar esta libreta para hacer pequeños dibujos y sketches, que luego podría subir en la [comunidad Drawaday](https://peakd.com/c/hive-140877/created). Me sentí dichosa de hacer esa compra, porque me gusta ayudar a los emprendedores.
![1000396034.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23vsJFbLdyvYkUi42hsq4A39fagUKDUYxperLeexXEGuQaUzjyBUCVuXJm4Di3K43YwVV.jpg)
**✨ Encantadora compra que hice en el pequeño bazar ✨**

La visita al bazar fue rápida, ya que habían pocos stands y la tentación de comprar, era muy grande jaja sin mencionar que tenía hambre, por lo que fui a comer a un sitio al que quería ir desde hace un tiempo. Se trata de un local de ventas de empanadas rellenas, al cual solía ir con mi madre cuando veníamos de compras al centro. Admito que parte de mi deseo de ir, fue por nostalgia y por supuesto, por el delicioso sabor de las empanadas. Pedí una de pollo y jugo de durazno. Disfruté muchísimo de ese almuerzo 😭
![1000396035.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/EpVC5jjUJ5qWazRTA6VyMb7VCJFWV47Ffwj1dqrTFBFxkBfvnEqRMgmdf7uSkJzyxR7.jpg)
**✨ Mi delicioso almuerzo ✨**

Antes de regresar, una amiga me comentó que en *Museo de Barquisimeto* había una exposición, por lo que no dudé en acercarme. Tomé suficientes fotografías de las obras expuestas, por lo que espero subirlas muy pronto 😉 A pesar del intenso calor y de todo lo que caminé, no me siento cansada, de hecho, me siento plena y llena de entusiasmo... ¿Significa esto que estoy en el \

? Dicen que cuando estás haciendo lo que deberías en tu vida, sientes un gran bienestar en tu corazón y así, me sentí el día de hoy 💖 ¡Quiero sentirme así siempre! 🤗
![1000396155.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/EpLgSoFnTBvHEgUKhKewWRnBX859yETQL3s64Bn4qbW4fmXJBuWUkrsJv9wSZHyaKSC.jpg)
**✨ Ojalá el museo tenga más visitas los próximos días ✨**

### ✨ Muchas gracias por haber visitado mi publicación. Espero que les haya parecido interesante ✨
![sticker-hive-buena suerte.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/AJmmnEQYeWpz9ahkrnTjX2iQeByWVPm34VwZiDp2JMRshUrYjySk8SdvUVoTPwp.gif)

#
💚 ¡Hasta una próxima oportunidad! 💚

![Banner.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/243qMECvxnUKyfFWvVxjRU8NeQxazLeXcSG2qyeexLvTPHNYJQJUmijkuPNe8qYacVGnd.jpg)

> ###
Ciao Mitici!
Esiste un’opportunità legale, riconosciuta da due governi, che ti permette di ottenere la residenza permanente in Panama in meno di una settimana. In Italia quasi nessuno ne parla. Si chiama Trattato di Amicizia tra Panama e Italia. Esiste dal 1965, ma nella forma attuale funziona dal 2012. È un accordo bilaterale che crea una corsia preferenziale esclusiva per i cittadini italiani. Qualcuno lo definisce un bug nel sistema migratorio globale: in un mondo dove spostarsi è sempre più difficile e costoso, questa porta è ancora aperta. Ma i bug vengono fixati. Le leggi cambiano, le finestre si chiudono. Chi ha agito per tempo ha già la residenza permanente. Chi aspetta rischia di trovare la porta chiusa. Se vuoi sapere come funziona, trovi il link in bio su Beacons per Piano B Panama. Consulenza gratuita con il coupon HRC. ###

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbrLLijgB15qXzX9tRuXxs7RYbPRZHkcWqspgt2mgZPR2/1775856836005.jpg)


I was scrolling through Instagram when I came across a lady’s video. She was carrying two children—one on her back and the other in her arms.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcVRruE5VSTDT3YU9zpxL2RL8ypp8wxMZA6NUfLj3eZ8P/1775857048625.jpg)


Then she started talking about giving birth to all your children at once so you can “rest” afterwards.



The baby on her back was 2 years old.(According to her). The one in her arms was 7 months old. And she is presently 5 months pregnant with the third.


*It got me thinking*


Honestly, everyone is entitled to their opinion when it comes to childbearing and spacing. But sometimes, some of these opinions just feel… extreme.
I often hear people saying just give birth to all your children in your early twenties, so you can focus on raising them and resting.



Others  like myself believes in spacing kids properly, because our life and health is involved. And we know that pregnancy and the discomfort that comes with it isn't an easy one. So we like to space.



Not unnecessarily  for a long, except for health reasons—but intentional spacing that considers not just the body, but also real-life responsibilities.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbzuAsVzEMVFQx3XcZNo9hAboTc2TBrLNJKcFm328GfMz/1775856804982.jpg)


Because beyond health, there is something people don’t talk about enough**finance**. 
Kids need care, attention, time and money. And these things don't appear magically just because the society expects us to keep having kids.


>The pressure.

*Few weeks ago, some women came to my workspace. While we were talking, they asked me why I wasn’t pregnant yet.*

*One of them even jokingly asked if I was living with my brother.*

*It wasn’t funny but I laughed.*


*Because sometimes, that’s all you can do.*




**We keep adding pressure on our fellow women and also start assuming something is wrong if they don't take  our own idea.**


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTTEjUx9ES2Z4gJCQrSKtgxqL6ggj3RW5JSVYXQmQTWAL/1775856992430.jpg)




I remember reading that women should have at least about two years gap between births to properly recover.


**What’s your take on child spacing?
Do you think it’s better to have children back-to-back or give some space in between?**

The platform LinkedIn has restricted my ability to make comments for some days now. I just noticed it. But funny enough, today I tried to comment and the comment went well. 

So I'm taking it easy on how I comment on LinkedIn these days because I don't want my account to be blocked. I have been managing the account and working to build up the account, organize content and do a lot of optimization there every now and then. Almost every day I put a content there or have some content schedule on it. 

And now I cannot risk it being banned or shadow banned or restricted. So I just have to pause so many things I'm doing then look for other things to do. Another thing that I did was I added one more catalog, project catalog on my Upwork accounts, which was actually doing well. 



 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmd8DeSWv4hG5FXWgBzYp7oc2nGnrJSN2147EK8avcBE63/Screenshot_10-4-2026_135141_www.upwork.com.jpeg 

So I told a friend of mine that, oh, look at my account, come and have a look. I'm trying to upload catalog almost every now and then, but there is no view on my account. So the friend told me that those are not what brings view on the account that even though I'm optimizing every now and then, that is still a part or one of the factors that bring views on the Upwork account because it goes far more than adding catalog, project catalog, optimizing project catalogs and the like. 

It goes beyond that. It goes into writing proposal, boosting profile and all these things cost money, which I don't have presently. So I've decided to look into another direction, which I am thinking about thoroughly throughout this week. 

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmco7YrMqocbtntWVxCrX12DwoxzsBWsJecH8nHhpKYbuh/Screenshot_10-4-2026_135436_www.upwork.com.jpeg 


I will look into other options that I have and what next I have to do. And I'm still expectant to that all the optimization I did throughout this week is going to yield results at least give me one or two views to show that I didn't work in vain and I did not do all this optimisation every day in vain. So that it's not just look like a wasted effort, because if it's later turns to a wasted effort, it is a learning process though. 

Yes, I agreed, but it's going to make me feel bad. Like it's a whole week is wasted because that was, I use a large portion of this week to do optimization, adding catalog and making sure that the accounts stand up again. Then I try to increase more of my keyword in my account.

And I hope that is going to be positive because I'm so expectant on that go high level. So if my go high level on Upwork is still doing that, I will look into another platform in this coming week. I don't really want to jump around. 

That's one thing I'm guiding against. I just want to be on Upwork and LinkedIn at the same time. So those are the two things that I want to work on. 

But let's see how this next week comes up. I'm sure it's going to be positive and I'm going to be at the end of the day.

title.title: Food Is the Best Asset
title.body: ![OrStarve.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZ4TaJLsjAnBZx114ydr8Zw9CY3jivgR8vDi9oUGqjFKz/OrStarve.png) In the near future You will grow your own food in your own greenhouse … because you can't afford food from the grocery store. This is a very possible future. We will soon see much higher gasoline/diesel prices, which will make food shipments even more costly. And, this is all contrived, because America is supposed to be oil independent, or close to it. And huge forces are moving against farming and farmers. Like, literally trying to kill off the cattle population. This same force is building bug growing factories, and printed, lab grown meat. You won't be able to buy good, not-poisoned food, because it won't be for sale.

> ## Assets are no longer assets; Food is no longer food When economies collapse, or currencies collapse, or … collapses, things that were assets just a few weeks ago, are no longer assets. Like, when Cuba collapsed, gold got you some food. But, mostly you way overpaid. But, when you NEED food, you will pay with whatever you have. Govern-cement bonds are good, right up until they are not. We will see people around the world dumping The US Treasury bonds. The prices will be a steal… but they will be payable in FRNs, and that will be a losing proposition. Gold and silver are not money, when there is no exchange rate and a stablish currency to convert into. It will be a great boon if stores had an assayer at the front of the store, and converted gold and silver into some kind of store credit. I hope they do that quick. I really hope that bitcoin catches on, and we can seamlessly buy food from the grocery store with it, and that the store can pay their suppliers with it… Sadly, the food in grocery stores is also degrading. McD's burger has almost no nutrition in it. You are eating, but starving. And the better food, in the grocery store, its nutrition is still falling

> ## Being one second too late The whole phrase is: > It is better to be ten years too early, than one second too late. When govern-cements have revalued currency. If your money was in the bank, it was gone. If you had you money anywhere else, foreign currency, foreign stocks, gold, commodities… than you didn't lose your purchasing power. This has happened in Mexico, in Cuba, in Venezuela… and it is happening again. The problem is when. Because, one second too late, and you join the line of people hoping the bank opens and gives them back their money. (what's left of it) The day before a hurricane hits, everyone is in the grocery store buying everything, and anything they can buy. When the hurricane passes, the stores are still empty. They day after, even if there was very little damage, there is no food to buy. Just having a month's worth of food allows you to stay at home, safe and not hungry, while the masses go crazy trying to find something to eat. If a food or fuel crisis is in your future, having stores of needed things is very important. **AND!!!** you will be saving a LOT of money. Like buying APPL stock when it was only $3. Buying food to keep you fed during a crisis will be one of the best investments you ever made. (1 second after)

></center>
## One of the biggest markets to come

When the masses start waking up to how bad their food is, people will be searching out wholesome, healthy food from local growers.

Building a business to provide this food will be one of the most lucrative plans in the coming decade.

Again, it is about timing.  You cannot just slap some seeds in the ground and hope good food grows.  It usually takes a few years to get the soil working well, and the irrigation you will need.

Investment bankers is so last decade, the new wealthy class will be farmers.

My feelings say that if you don't get in before a certain date, you will have problems getting into this market.  But, i am unsure why.

Probably getting things like plastic pipes, sprinklers and control valves will become difficult.  Way back ordered, or China stops selling to America.

It could also be govern-cement \

shutting down farms, which means, starting a new farm is impossible, and you will have to protect what you have. Or, it could be that getting GMO-free seeds becomes impossible, as the old stuff is banned from being sold. Anyway, get yourself a greenhouse, and grow your own food. It will pay BIG dividends

> Gold has been money for 5000 years. Only sorta… Food has been money for as long as humans have had to eat. During good times, when food is plentiful, people become complacent. Thinking there will always be enough. And then the bad times come, and everyone wishes for food. Gold, dollars, stocks… are all worthless until enough food is being grown and an economy is reformed. So, make food a substantial part of your investment portfolio. It will pay the largest dividends. And the best part about it, is that you CAN eat it.

>\n
All images in this post are my own original creations.

title.title: When to stop talking?
title.body: > The amount of [hate speech and hate crime are correlated.](https://www.researchgate.net/publication/384937899_From_online_hate_speech_to_offline_hate_crime_the_role_of_inflammatory_language_in_forecasting_violence_against_migrant_and_LGBT_communities). If we let everything slide in words, actions will become more drastic, too. It won’t be at the same level. Trump calling for rotting out an entire country will not have exactly that effect in activists, they won’t kill a whole civilization. Because they can’t, luckily, they don’t have enough power. But it will help them conceptualize that violence is fine and accepted when serving one’s own purpose, disguised as a morally good action. ![IMG_20260401_120042408_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beelzael/EppJBtDXgD2YVAnUHNHnSgEvx7aJpPR7qM4xGW5CZMP1jpUf31gd5CXrjD8jRe6h4Ty.jpg) Normalizing this kind of communication without pushbacks will eventually do harm to someone. There is a definition of hate, of course, a vague one. And as so many times, the interpretation of the definition of “hate” is done by society, by their moral code and their values. “Hate” in Germany is different then in the US then in Iran. *And so is the definition of free speech.* In Germany, not everything is tolerated. The argument of hate speech leading to hate crime has lead to a code of conduct and speech that is a lot stricter and (ironically) less diverse than in the US, for example. There’s much too that, as it’s generally defined by the values and traditions that a society wants to uphold (or so it claims). Not exactly, but in a watered down version – not every opinion can be incorporated, but through free elections of representatives there is the hope for that. Which is a whole different topic. *Rules are important.* They’re guidelines. And although I’d love for humans not to need that much guidance, I do believe it’s necessary these days. Communities being fragmented and less human contact also leads to the disappearance of guidelines. Rule can help with that, giving a code to fall back on. *Until it's too much.* On the other hand, over-regulation and too many taboos inhibit free speech, and lead to the phenomenon of everyone being insulted all the time, without anyone doing anything anymore. To exaggerate. If I can’t talk to someone without them feeling attacked continuously, communication dies, too. *But that’s my comfort zone.* I probably won’t have friends like they wouldn’t fall within my spectrum of people I get along with. Nor would I fall in theirs. At least in theory, a society is based on the middle ground of values of all its members. So, they play a role in society, too, and there’s as much reason to shun them (or not) as there is on the other side of the spectrum. And they are getting their fair share, as very visible in social media and such. And that’s good. *We all need pushbacks.* The important part is not the taboo, but the pushback. Not letting it slide. The more harmful part of hate speech is not the hate itself. It’s that without pushbacks, people who read it will think that it makes sense and adopt the opinion. Lurking is a problem here. Everyone looking at those tweets and posts and all that, without saying or writing “yeah that’s not true”. Of course, you won’t convince the person who wrote the post, but you might just spark doubt in the minds of other readers who will then think twice before taking over the statement without reflecting on it. *Beware of the silent mass.* The most vocal people aren’t the problem. It’s those who listen. It’s those who let them be vocal, who don’t talk back. In the end, free speech also includes calling people out for what they say and do. It covers all opinions. Even the one to kill radically free speech and create guidelines of conduct. ___ What are your thoughts about this topic? Please feel free to engage in any original way, including dropping links to your posts on similar topics. I'm happy to read (and curate) any quality content that is not created by LLM/AI, as well as read your own experience and point of view, I love to learn! > Pictures taken with a Motorola Edge 60 Pro, I reserve the copyright - but feel free to ask if you want to use one of the pictures!

Susan works as a sales representative in QLink - a biscuit manufacturing company. Over the years the company has been making huge sales which has led it to open over five branches within a space of three years. Susan was elevated to head one of the new branches opened by the company.

This is the third year running and the branch headed by Susan has been recording huge losses. During the year's annual general meeting, it was resolved that Susan's branch be audited by another auditor different from the one that has been auditing the company, especially the one headed by Susan. 

When the new auditor came, he requested for several documents including cash receipts, invoice and all that. At the conclusion of his audit, Susan was indicted and was asked to refund huge sums of money to the company's coffers.

When Susan's attention was drawn to it she became extremely furious asking what exactly the auditor did and how he arrived at his findings. 

The next day, the company issued its white paper indicting Susan based on the latest company's audit. When a copy was served on Susan she could not believe her eyes. \
How did this man arrive at his findings?\

body.body:
![oneee.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSnjorBn4Pq5nn2PPBd5aYadoUUsLCc6b1gWpt5LphLE4/oneee.jpg) [Source](https://www.filmaffinity.com/es/filmimages.php?movie_id=277580) There are stories—like movies—that leave you wanting to see more details and more plot, and you end up enjoying every single second of them. One such story that has earned widespread admiration and rave reviews is *One Piece: Towards the Grand Line, a story with a format that became something special. This second season isn’t just a continuation; it’s exactly what was needed to completely change the course of the series with new challenges, adventure, and sustained excitement—and everything starts to feel much more real. This second part, with so few episodes, seeks to break away from the norm, since unlike the first season—which was all about preparation, encounters, fights, and promises—it goes further here, as if it were a test, where everything changes starting from the sea, since it’s now much more dangerous. Every decision and every stop marks the beginning of a new story, and every enemy becomes a threat and a source of smiles—and concern. >Hay historias de película que uno ve y quede con ganas de seguir viendo más detalles, más trama y pasan a disfrutarse segundo tras segundo y una de esas que ha logrado conseguir la admiración y muy buenas críticas es One Piece: Rumbo a la Grand Line, una historia con un formato que se volvió especial y esta segunda temporada no es solo una continuación, es lo que le hacía falta para cambiar todo el rumbo de la producción con nuevos desafíos, aventura, mantener esa emoción y todo comienza a ser mucho más real. # >Esta segunda parte con tan pocos episodios, busca salir de lo normal, ya que a diferencia de la primera temporada que fue preparación, encuentros, peleas y promesas. Aquí va más allá como si fuera una prueba, donde todo cambia comenzando desde el mar, puesto que ahora es mucho más peligroso, cada decisión y cada parada es el comienzo de nueva historia, como también cada enemigo se convierte en una amenaza y sonrisas, que serán de preocupación. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbUugZL1pzioqTkjWrpuceYMKECr2unL4mXrroQbmBfxy/image.png) [Source](https://www.filmaffinity.com/es/filmimages.php?movie_id=277580) Each episode unfolds perfectly, capturing those small moments—like glances and silences—that make everything so much more special. Another standout aspect is the action, which has improved with every battle, largely because it’s more realistic. What really stands out is how the characters begin to change: Zoro steps up, Nami no longer just guides but trusts, Usopp no longer just fears but faces every new adventure head-on, and Luffy begins to shoulder the responsibility of not failing. Every scene in this new phase feels much more expansive, with greater freedom and new places to explore, so that every adventure has something to offer, giving the story much more depth. Additionally, the villains aren’t always over-the-top; some are simply dangerous, which gives the entire production that unique touch, making it a complete game while maintaining the essence of the original. >Cada episodio se va moviendo de la mejor manera, para así poder lograr capturar esos pequeños momentos como miradas, silencios que hacen que todo sea mucho más especial. Otras de las cosas que también se destaca es la acción, que ha ido mejorando en cada combate, por el mismo hecho de ser más realista y lo que realmente se nota es cómo los personajes empiezan a cambiar, aquí entra Zoro, Nami ya no solo guía, confía. Usopp ya no solo teme resiste a cada aventura nueva y Luffy empieza a cargar con la responsabilidad de no fallar. # >Cada escena de esta nueva etapa se siente mucho más amplio, más libertad y lugares nuevos por explorar y así cada aventura tenga algo que mostrar, dándole mucho más peso a la historia. Además, los villanos no siempre son exagerados, algunos son simplemente peligrosos, la cual le dan ese toque único a toda la producción para que así sea todo un juego y mantenga la esencia de la original. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmV4MEGUhaKZg71R23sFaSo1n3dyNDwSrf9BAPL1vMMqdt/image.png) [Source](https://www.filmaffinity.com/es/filmimages.php?movie_id=277580) They managed to pull off a lot in this second part, starting with much larger settings, stranger creatures, and more intense battles—and it was essential to see these elements in *One Piece*, because if anything defines this second phase, it’s that there’s no turning back. I really liked the outcome of One Piece: Journey to the Grand Line, which was exactly what was needed to give that journey the ending it deserved—a journey where you realize you’re far from home, where you can no longer turn back, and where every decision counts and carries weight. So if you’re looking for something to watch, don’t miss this one, and even though the path gets tougher, it also gets more exciting. >Lograron superar muchas cosas en este segunda parte comenzando desde los escenarios que son mucho más grandes, criaturas más extrañas, combates más intensos y era necesario verlos en One Piece, porque si algo define en esta segunda etapa, es que ya no hay vuelta atrás. # >Me gusto mucho el resultado de One Piece: Rumbo a la Grand Line, la cual era lo que hacía falta para así poder darle como ese final a todo ese viaje, viaje donde te das cuenta de que estás lejos de casa, donde ya no puedes retroceder y donde cada decisión cuenta y pesa. Por eso si buscas algo para ver, no dejes pasar esta y aunque el camino se vuelva más difícil, también se vuelve más emocionante. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmP3iYND5fMBKYJ6KDV51EWyECoUSGZJUw6Yhjc768vhSe/image.png) [Source](https://www.filmaffinity.com/es/filmimages.php?movie_id=277580)

body.title: Exploring the tunnels of Cu Chi in Vietnam
body.body:
Hey dear community, I hope you all have a great start to the new weekend so far! Also if I don't always post actively, I would like to share something from time to time and am happy when others like my work.

![IMG_6810.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elevator09/EpCARYFikcQBJX8USAqJMrV9GwGRZVj4uhzjCbRJX1sKMzJSd5mGtDCMYt9MFeUWdRC.jpeg)

In Vietnam I saw so many interesting places and my trip was in every way a cultural enrichment for me which I do not regret in any way. During my stop in Saigon or Ho Chi Minh City it was clear to me that I would like to visit the well-known tunnels from the time of the Vietnam War which are probably one of the highlights of the country which are about 60 kilometres away from the city. To get there I decided to travel like locals and took the bus in the city and had to change twice in total until I arrived and that I can find my way around more easy, locals also helped me a lot. There were two main points to see the tunnels of Cu Chi and one of the places is very touristy which is why I decided to go to the other part and here I could join a guided tour which presented part of the underground network. It cost a small admission but for what was offered extremely fair, but visitors also have to be careful at the beginning of the site because there are also some attractions which cost extra and it's not worth paying extra in my eyes. 

![IMG_6819.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elevator09/Ep1WtZEiRSnTC7wu3kSdgLMRYs5LffHvLq54RYZEaBpWinNmYJS3NUFASSEyZtipS1T.jpeg)

![IMG_6824.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elevator09/23tbM6Evg5sN3mgo6HWw5FfKo7ZsuwBoqkZ1ydqjFJH7D9CoMzdYcKPzfvhRJDxjD8yMb.jpeg)


![IMG_6768.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elevator09/23xedSWnef7pFZMXk8NMTvDxW2JSY2WrDBdXj35vECadPbi3g1PUhGGfWAdzX6Fe1D1F5.jpeg)


During the tour I learned everything about the history as well as the use of the facility and the interesting thing is that the tunnels are hundreds of metres long and have been built by human hands. The tunnels that can be visited here are always just small sections that have it in them and people with claustrophobia can probably forget it completely because it is already extremely tight, but those who venture down will know why a visit is worthwhile. Here you can see living spaces, kitchens, warehouses and other places that are reminiscent of underground cities and prove how strong the Vietnamese were when it comes to camouflage themselves in times of crisis and to defend them strategically in such a way that no one sees them. The first tunnels were built during the 20th century and were expanded over the years and when Vietnam's troops saw how secure these facilities were, more and more resources were invested in the construction. 

![IMG_6809.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elevator09/EoJyaKdHtkpJR99jp5q4LrTWNzhRinrSsdJ5TGtkmKgDtVbZB23eazQBWZBipUEewTn.jpeg)

![IMG_6828.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elevator09/Eq5FSBzetkdSgVi4QxBfR8kR6hSmNRUVY2NhnCCGCzgngFZYQ1Kgsc6bg5XDPf284Qn.jpeg)


![IMG_6769.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elevator09/EpA2399UsbutpWXf8ttULM5qwevpSNWWQyinKfm2DrvSYuazHNcWLodf8BQ3KjVFdGH.jpeg)


These buildings had the advantage that it was safe even from strong attacks such as by planes and also weapons could be stored here unnoticed and this technique is also called guerilla tactics. Even if it looks interesting during the visit, it must have been a horrible for the people to live here and there was probably also the spread of diseases and even when it came to the oxygen it often became dangerous but the systems when it came to the air supply became more and more intelligent and even fire was made in the tunnel so that the smoke got safely to the outside. It is probably one of the most important sights of the country and if you should be near Ho Chi Minh City, you should not miss looking here and you can learn pretty much everything important about the construction or use in the past.

![IMG_6792.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elevator09/EokcBZEh8sjtivshW9uMRzyYyHkAa8tk7TY72bt4zXUDwfjxxW23tijHJWuR1NoyhzQ.jpeg)

![IMG_6779.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elevator09/EpEKGVSYyrz2USvqoVwZE8Kp1LdSsJaP7R78fbUreUG9nYVeQcrfYi4CYJCWAbwYZGK.jpeg)

Many thanks for stopping by and I hope you could learn something new and like my post and appreciate my effort! I captured these pictures with my iPhone 16.

body.title: Thoughts on War, Survival and Responsibility
body.body:
> *I sincerely hope we never experience a world war again. I have never lived through one, but those who have all say the same thing: there is nothing good about it.*
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRJPqrxvpAswbhPgjz49wLwjRG4wXiZFVepQgH8U5cxVE/image.png)
[source](https://pixabay.com/illustrations/retro-soldiers-soldiers-7989575/) *A world war doesn’t just affect soldiers; it affects millions of innocent people. And in the middle of that chaos, some people will take advantage to commit crimes and make things even worse.* *The ongoing war between the USA and Iran is already being felt here in my country, and this isn’t even a world war. Just two countries, yet fuel prices have already skyrocketed.* *Now imagine if more countries get involved, pulling in major global powers… it would be absolute chaos*. *If a world war ever breaks out, my priority is simple: be with my family*. *Not money. Not status. Not anything else*. *Family.* *I would rather be in a community where people still have values, where everyone is looking out for each other. Because in times like that, it is not just war you are dealing with, it is the chaos that comes with it. People taking advantage, crimes rising, survival mode kicking in*. *As for joining the army? That is a no for me. I won’t risk my life for a system that won’t do the same for me. And I won’t encourage anyone close to me to do it either.* *Call me selfish if you want.* *But I won’t risk my life for a country that didn’t remember me when there was no war*. *When things were normal, some people were busy enjoying the nation’s wealth, flying in and out, living large, spending public money like it meant nothing.* *Now imagine things go bad… and suddenly it is time for sacrifice?* *The same people who benefited the most should be the first to step forward and lead from the front*. *Not the ones who were already struggling just to survive*. *As long as war hasn’t reached my doorstep, I am staying with my family.* *But the moment it does… everything changes*. *At that point, it is no longer about any country. It is about survival. Protecting my life and the people I love.*
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdEqfPPNP32sFHZvp2Nr5817Ppps7d47kg45WX6ktYyrr/image.png)
[source](https://pixabay.com/illustrations/retro-soldiers-soldiers-7989579/) *People always say “go somewhere safe”, but is anywhere truly safe during war?* *Sometimes, the place you know best is your best chance. Moving blindly can be more dangerous than staying put.* *And let us be real, if things get that bad, borders will tighten, flights will stop, and countries will look inward first.* *Just thinking about war sends a cold shiver down my spine*. *There is absolutely nothing good about it. People lose their loved ones, food becomes scarce, and fear takes over… because you never know when it might come to your doorstep.* *Sometimes I even wonder, who has a better chance of survival?* *The man with no family, responsible for only himself… or the family man who carries the weight of others?* *A single man can move freely, join any group, and leave at the slightest sign of danger.* *But a family man?* *He doesn’t have that luxury. He stays. He fights. He protects*. *Even if it costs him everything.* *In the end, all you really have is your people. Protect them, Stay smart, Stay ready.*

https://images.hive.blog/DQmUZZuDr3arGngLn5SfCF6yHQm9yLP3Zkhzm5DodpnhqhH/imageedit_1_5025017951.jpg

I don't know what came over my friends, so we went to have an adventure, so it was just a strange place, one of the strange places we have never been before, close to Libre Forest, so we were just walking around, doing what we had to do our best, and everything, but while we continued the journey and we went in, it was as if we felt lost, we didn't know our way in and we didn't know our way out.

At this moment we didn't know where to continue the adventure or we should go back, even trying to find our way back was very odd, we checked our map and we couldn't get the connection, the compass we had was not directing us where, and we looked more confused.

While we were panicking, I wanted to find our way out instead of continuing the adventure, our friend, Williams, said we should go down that, she wanted to make an analysis. I said analysis of what, what are we analysing, we should find our way out instead of analysing, this is a very strange situation, so we started panicking, panicking, panicking, so after making an analysis, it was as if we knew the way out or the way long, but he refused to tell us and he wanted us to be scared, so he just directed us smoothly, and we went out, and we vowed never to make such an adventure again.

)...Continued...

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZHtxYf3JhtK9bqyejMpSegrXT7VuRthmozc6DwvgRSYR/image.png)

*[Last time...]*

Across the deck, the red glow of the Captain’s pipe stood out in the approaching darkness. Despite the cheerful response of all crew, the Captain knew a growing sense of gloom was lingering in the hearts of all. ‘Would they get through the night in peace?’ He wondered as he took a long draw on his pipe and let out a large plume of blue smoke in the shape of an arrow that wafted in the breeze and slowly broke apart into nothingness under the glow of the early evening ship’s lanterns.

*(See: https://hive.blog/pirates/@joshuaslane/silver-adventures-captain-joshua-slane-08ap26-serious-problems )*

〰️⛵〰️ ⛵〰️ ⛵ 〰️⛵〰️

![1a.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQma19c9YJ5UWTkw8iKpU213UskxGqPVg5ZfshFi8Dw3AYa/1a.png)

*[Seneca Village…early morning…]*

Big Bear lay shaking on a bed of animal skins in Chief Minetoh’s longhouse. His shoulder was wrapped in wet beech leaves and moss and his face grimaced in pain…

“He not live another two days…” *[Translated]* The Chief whispered to Running Fox at the far side of the room.
“What can we do?!” Running Fox asked.
“The Shaman has done everything he can. May the Great Spirit take him gently.

Tears welled up in Running Fox’s eyes as he gazed at his life-long friend laying stricken on the floor…

“The thunder stick is a terrible weapon!” He exclaimed with a bitter tone.
“They will not be back! We set fire to their great ship and the river has washed them away!” The Chief consoled with pride.

*[On the Silverton…two bells into the morning watch…]*
![bowsprit.2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSDYwUYN98Pz2hkpW6wNSHSt7bYvtTAFmCjhKALgvCU3G/bowsprit.2.jpg)
Just before dawn, the Captain ordered the gun crew to be replaced with fresh men...
![cannons.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbEDBjVKm62X3GW35VtYk5xznFvRipAswYhPovhSxsri4/cannons.jpg)
“A long night...” Commander Kerrislravenhill said she watched as the exhausted crew stumbled away to find their bunks.

![kerrislravenhill.12.a.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZ3CZhGgqmJ6f7k9rWPrvzqwJuWUNajqAQ8fkSFk8tCHm/kerrislravenhill.12.a.jpg)

“I want you to command the second gin crew Errisl…”
“Aye Sairrr. What is your intention if I may ask Sairrr?” Kerrislravenhill asked as she pondered his next move.
“We hoist anchor at foo sunrise an heads up-river.” He said as he gazed off to the forests lining the eastern bank of the river.

“But the fire….Sairrr?”
“Och- there’ll be fire! An’ thaur wull be fire in returns!” The Captain answered with grit in his voice as he turned and walked away.

![C-Slane-3.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmecy9Yg1pUkA7ooPdNNPcuZu5tojZ55AeD3mmd8x7LGQj/C-Slane-3.jpg)

“Time for a cup of tea…” Kerrisl whispered to herself with a great exhalation as she quickly made her way down the stairs towards the galley before manning the next gun watch.

![tea.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVKTfWAXyZ8ePe6awtRhVYHLcmZPkpz3SwGKbfQJzzLPU/tea.jpg)

⏑ ⏑ ⏑ ⏑

## Announcement

I'm excited to announce that after a series of two land swap deals, I have relocated the majority of my land production to Pandon Reach, Region #41. The Reach is the last region of the Broken Lands, sharing a southern border with the Land of Prosperity and featuring waterfront property on the Southwest Coast of Praetoria.

It was a difficult decision to uproot my land infrastructure from four regions where I had established operations producing Aura and mining SPS. But after careful deliberation, it made the most sense to consolidate into a smaller number of premium plots in a younger region with room for future expansion.

## In The Beginning 

My land empire started with 5 unclaimed deeds in a group claim tract within the @shield-of-glory. If I remember correctly, @zagorlord sold some parcels of his presale purchase to guild members and hive friends. I acquired 5 deeds from someone who had already bought into the tract. In fact, I ended up running the spreadsheets and distributing the plots from the two \

tracts to the 20ish participants in the group claim. Sadly, I didn't win the lottery with my 5 plots in Region 95, Tract 8, but the person who did open the keep, ironically, did get lucky with only 5 plots in the claim... the last 5 plots, 96 to 100. I think the keep was plot 97. I was fortunate to open a rare iron plot along with a common magic and three common naturals. During Land 1.0, I made grain and produced research from my single magical plot. I capitalized on the 15% rShare bonus in Ranked play for joining the RUNEGUARD, and enlisted 5 RUNI to help me work my land. I think RUNI are a tremendous bargain for the handy 100% bonus they offer on land production! ## Land Strategy Over the years, as land developed with more resources, I decided to focus on SPS mining and aura production. I liked the idea of earning SPS from the fixed pool allocation and producing the soulbound resource, aura. The rest of my farming would be to support my ongoing Aura/SPS activities. I picked up a cheap, rare occupied plot in my home region, but I had no stone production and was short on wood and grain. I started finding bargains on epics in a few hot regions like 27, 97, and 136. Before I knew it, I had eclipsed the 50 plot threshold and became a land baron. Every harvest was becoming tedious, having to purchase resources and balance budgets. None of my four regions was self-sufficient, so each individual region took precious time to buy the necessary resources before I could harvest all. This was an especially bad situation for me in Region 97, where I had an operation of six occupied plots. With barely any other resource support in the same region, it would cost me over half-a-million grain for each harvest every 5 days. I was tired of the big DEC bill I faced with each harvest because of my unbalanced resource production, so solving this mismatch was my main goal for the move. If I moved somewhere from scratch, I could better balance my resource production and expand more freely. ## The Solution After some brief conversations in passing during an unsuccessful play at a highly coveted Gold Foil card, I responded to an article by @ecoinstant about trading plots. The proposal was to swap plots in regions across Praetoria to acquire land in Pandon Reach and boost tax revenue for their castle. I said I'd bring my RUNIs to boost production in The Reach, and they let me trade up into a spread of epic plots to leverage my highest PP workers. When the dust settled, I moved out of my full positions in 27 (7 plots), 95 (17 plots), and 136 (2 plots), plus another handful of mostly occupied plots from 97. I gave up a pair of epics, a rare occupied, three magic commons, ten grain, and a mix of other resources. I threw in 20 common totems, 32 CL Max GFCs for 2K PP and 8 CL Max GFRs for 4K PP + $100 in DEC to get the deal over the line. The nice thing about downsizing was being able to find a home for all those displaced Pelacors and totems. ![Screenshot 2026-04-08 143311.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ducecrypto/23wC3KkLEZ49xqTi25X3nLg3TJn5UioV584oLakan7igezQ6dSEFVwtgNLNV5d32H9XHm.png) The upside of 41 is huge, as I will finally be able to balance my books and engineer my operations to be mostly self-sufficient after some final tweaking. With the land and survival cooldowns, it's been a bit tricky to get everything sorted in the proper places, but I should have everything in order by next week. And there is plenty of room if I need to level up my production, which was not the case in 27, 95, and 97 -- all three are active and densely populated regions! ## The Spread The jewel of my new spread of land is the keep in Tract 4/54. There's no grain in 4, but in my new home tract, I'll be firing up two epic plots each for wood, stone, iron, and aura, plus three more occupied rares. My grain production will come from Tract 10, where I have an epic and three more rares to feed my workers. When the initial two swaps are finished, I will have 19 plots in Pandon Reach, with my focus continuing to be on mining SPS from the six occupied plots and producing aura from the two epic magic plots. All my resource production will go to support these eight lands. I'm hoping I will finally be close to breaking even with the grip of epics working to churn out grain, wood, stone, and iron. By the end of April, I should have a new way forward to sort out any resource shortfalls as I finish my transition to Pandon Reach. Here's to my new chapter of land, Duce 2.0 in Pandon Reach #41! ![Screenshot 2026-04-08 143426.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ducecrypto/23wqijZtHREW1oVK2NX8TFma99VLEqpLywnd7kdNGWVsAZpQZHCmJAot3DfiE4eGJKaHY.png) ![SPL divider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ducecrypto/23t7YkFmVUsPmKt3qas5ZnaBbsBckvaqnYAQMBgZhEEfpRBkLYLh3ZP4zT8U4FJ8mcdL4.png)

body.title: [EN/PT-BR] Infallible plans... that are fallible.
body.body:
>
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shiftrox/23uQhk9RCk6hH1XgAeYgHyzPyKtJCabpA8CW5JYmaKyMqbGe5eA3uTvkBieEYiyt1hQj6.png)[Unsplash](https://unsplash.com/pt-br/fotografias/pessoa-escrevendo-em-white-paper-io0ZLYbu31s)
![divisor.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shiftrox/23x1ckYW5T1yBx8C6Rd18NYtNsYsNdTGDvWitn6Bsn1q5DyNyNy6dyVhLcGh4zUN1vwui.jpeg) We make foolproof plans, but we always have a feeling they're fallible. It seems that, no matter how hard we try, everything conspires against us—life, fate, people, everything—why does nothing work out? Haha, it's almost funny how we plan everything down to the smallest detail, but nothing gets done. Well, don't be sad about it, things aren't really easy. A lot is planned, but little is truly executed. That's life. I'm going through some crazy times, a lot of them financially, but I've stopped just complaining and I'm fighting, trying to do things differently, create new things, monetize something, take advantage of the AI ​​boom. With all this, I saw an opportunity to make money, although I haven't yet realized it. I thought it would be easier, I really thought that, but even with good tools, we're the ones in control, so it really depends on us thinking even harder and, of course, having the resilience to understand that when everything goes wrong, it's not necessarily the end. If something didn't work out, if the plan failed, but we're still alive, why not come up with the next one and the next and so on? Eventually, it will work out. And even if it doesn't, I'll be happy knowing that I went through this life and this moment trying, giving my best to change my life and achieve the things I desire. To give my family a better life, to make many friends, to contribute something—these are all things I want, and I know that sooner or later everything will fall into place. Plans fail, but our perseverance is what cannot fail. If the world collapses around us, it's tense, it's complicated, but it also depends solely on us to get up, dust ourselves off, and keep moving forward. ![sun_divisor.webp](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXEDLx7R7Jy8fHF1tA7sPyb4A9QBvmj3y4FjFhephcPCS/sun_divisor.webp)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shiftrox/23uQhk9RCk6hH1XgAeYgHyzPyKtJCabpA8CW5JYmaKyMqbGe5eA3uTvkBieEYiyt1hQj6.png)[Unsplash](https://unsplash.com/pt-br/fotografias/pessoa-escrevendo-em-white-paper-io0ZLYbu31s)
![divisor.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shiftrox/23x1ckYW5T1yBx8C6Rd18NYtNsYsNdTGDvWitn6Bsn1q5DyNyNy6dyVhLcGh4zUN1vwui.jpeg) Planos infalíveis que fazemos, mas temos uma sensação de que são sempre falíveis. Parece que, por mais que a gente tente, tudo orquestra contra, a vida, o destino, as pessoas, tudo, por que nada dá certo? Haha chega a ser engraçado como planejamos tudo nos mínimos detalhes, mas nada sai do lugar. Bem, não fique triste com isso, as coisas não são realmente fáceis, muita coisa é planejada, mas poucas são verdadeiramente executadas. A vida têm disso. Estou passando por momentos malucos, muitos relacionados ao financeiro, mas parei de ficar apenas reclamando e estou lutando, tentando fazer diferente, criar coisas novas, monetizar algo, aproveitar o boom das IAs. Com tudo isso, vi uma oportunidade de fazer dinheiro, apesar de que ainda não concretizei isso. Achei que seria mais fácil, realmente pensei isso, mas mesmo com boas ferramentas, nós é que estamos no controle, então depende mesmo de nós pensar mais ainda e, claro, ter a resiliência de entender quando tudo dá errado, que não é bem o fim. Se algo não deu certo, se o plano falhou, mas ainda estamos vivos, por que não bolar o próximo e o próximo e assim por diante? Uma hora vai dar certo. E mesmo que não dê, eu vou ficar feliz de saber que passei por essa vida e por este momento tentando, dando o meu melhor para mudar de vida e conquistar as coisas que desejo. Dar uma condição de vida melhor para minha família, fazer muitos amigos, contribuir com algo, tudo isso são coisas que desejo e sei que cedo ou tarde tudo vai se encaixar. Os planos falham, mas a nossa perseverança é o que não pode falhar. Se o mundo desaba sobre nós, é tenso, é complicado, mas depende somente de nós também, levantar, sacudir a poeira e continuar em frente. ![divisor.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shiftrox/23x1ckYW5T1yBx8C6Rd18NYtNsYsNdTGDvWitn6Bsn1q5DyNyNy6dyVhLcGh4zUN1vwui.jpeg)

body.title: AUDI On The Offensive
body.body: /> [source](https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcS9FmFbMcIrzqiYRpmjkF0VIGzXMlv1TmCf_A&s) I was reading an announcement this week with AUDI stating they are going to fight back against the fierce competition they have been under of late. This is not just an AUDI problem and has been more of a trend with the premium vehicle sales in South Africa. Over the last decade from about 2014 onwards the premium sector has seen it's sales shrink by as much as 70%. This is a catastrophe for those legacy brands which would include Mercedes, BMW along with Audi. Audi in particular does not have the models it requires in order to take the attack to it's competitors. The problem the premium brands have been facing is the cost of living has increased rapidly due to inflation and combining this alongside cheaper Chinese imports with upgraded features consumers are spoilt for choice. The premium sector is by no means that large, but lies between the 32 000 - 35 000 annual sales region. The leading legacy brand in this sector is BMW followed by Audi and then Mercedes. The popular AUDI A4 model was discontinued in SA last year and the current model range is looking more like ageing stock and finally they have a plan to fight back. 13 new models over the next 18 months will be launched into SA as no AUDI's are assembled locally anymore. I think it is common knowledge the biggest selling factor for the Chinese vehicles versus the rest has not only been price, but the extended service warranty plans now being offered for 7 years or 200 000 km. In the past you saw 3 or 5 year plans with a maximum of 100 000 km. That figure has been raised to 150 000 km recently which is still not enough. The Chinese manufacturers have been heavily financed by their government with subsidies being given so they are still making a profit if they sold the vehicle for cost. This has allowed the Chinese to attack their competitors by severely undercutting the price which is how they have grown. The resale value will become a problem and the consumers will find out the hard way which is still going to happen. This is still going to hit the Chinese auto makers hard and this is no done deal with their increased market share. The Chinese government has already discussed dropping their subsidies and when that happens the Chines auto honeymoon period is over. There are too many Chinese brands on the market and in this particular sector will cannibalize each other leaving 2 or possibly 3 left.

/></center>

[source](https://www.audi.co.za/en/audi-service/audi-maintenance-and-service-plans/audi-freeway-plan-extension/)


Audi has a secret weapon which the Chinese cannot compete against and that is a 15 year Freeway policy. The 15 year service warranty plan covers everything and there is no balloon payment once the plan ends. Basically you are leasing your vehicle from Audi and through this method your monthly payments are far less making the vehicle more affordable.

Audi has been known for their quality and there is no question an Audi would survive 300 000 km if service and maintained by the dealerships. The vehicle would retain more of it's value knowing there is x amount of years left on the service warranty plan. Audi also mentioned they will be reducing their pricing model so at least they are being flexible because they know they can  increase their market share with the correct strategy.

When buying our vehicle last month I noticed many Chinese vehicles that had low mileage and had their prices dropped significantly due to not holding their value. The depreciation of a Chinese vehicle with very low kilometers (less than !0 000 km) was around 30% because it was now second hand. Not only do they have no available spares on many models the insurance premium is that much higher for the Chinese vehicles. I did look at two Chinese models with an open mind, but walked away knowing it was a bad purchase even though the price was seriously good. If I had bought one I know the value would drop off the edge being a 3rd hand car when I sold and you would be stuck with a Chinese vehicle.

Audi at the end of the day may cost you more overall but the safety net is what the company are offering and expect Mercedes and BMW to offer similar packages going forward. Personally I have always liked Audi vehicles and it is great to see them finally wake up and fight back.

body.title: [ES/EN] Splinterlands – Update: Bulwark and Shadow Focus are Non-Dispellable
body.body:
<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmfSBhu3cXMu7Nmnv7XJxrAoGhCU9TLLjuKLqpJN1cZQcU/Portada%20-%20Shadow%20Focus%20y%20Bulwark%20no%20es%20Disipable.png</center>

<center>In the complex system of **Splinterlands**, the **Dispel** ability has long been the **great equalizer.** It was the safety valve that prevented certain buffs from spiraling out of control, allowing a low-cost unit to neutralize a powered-up giant. However, the update on **March 24, 2026**, specifically targeting the **Escalation** mini-set, has drastically changed the rules. By making **Bulwark** and the damage bonus from **Shadow Focus** non-dispellable, the developers have sent a clear message: these abilities are no longer temporary states, but definitive and inevitable evolutions on the battlefield.</center>

><center>En el complejo sistema de **Splinterlands**, la habilidad **Dispel** ha sido durante mucho tiempo el **gran ecualizador**. Era la válvula de seguridad que evitaba que ciertos bufos se salieran de control, permitiendo que una unidad económica pudiera neutralizar a un gigante potenciado. Sin embargo, la actualización del **24 de marzo de 2026**, dirigida específicamente al mini-conjunto **Escalation**, ha cambiado las reglas del juego de forma drástica. Al hacer que **Bulwark** y el bono de daño de **Shadow Focus** ya no se puedan disipar, los desarrolladores han enviado un mensaje claro: estas habilidades ya no son estados temporales, sino evoluciones definitivas e inevitables de la unidad en el campo de batalla.</center>

# <center>[UPDATE 2026-03-24](https://docs.splinterlands.com/platform/release-notes/2026#id-2026-03-24)</center>

### <center>Revising the past: What happened to my previous analyses? | Revisando el pasado: ¿Qué pasó con mis análisis previos?</center>

<center>In my previous posts about **Bulwark** and **Shadow Focus**, a significant part of the tactical analysis and doubts centered on risk management. Previously, I emphasized that although these abilities were extremely powerful, their main weakness was their fragility against a well-executed **Dispel** by the opponent.</center>

><center>En mis publicaciones anteriores sobre **Bulwark** y **Shadow Focus**, una parte significativa de los análisis tácticos y dudas se centraba en la gestión de riesgos. Anteriormente, enfaticé que aunque estas habilidades eran extremadamente poderosas, su principal debilidad era su fragilidad ante un **Dispel** bien ejecutado por el oponente.</center>

## <center>[Bulwark](https://support.splinterlands.com/hc/en-us/articles/45343460205588)</center>
<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVjMAfJQcaGyyxwX2nUUmWRCkB272beaHK5XN12pzHY2s/ability_on-bg_bulwark_150.png</center>

- **Bulwark**: When in the first position, -2 power, +8 health, and +8 armor.

>- **Bulwark**: Cuando está en la primera posición: -2 de poder, +8 de salud y +8 de armadura.

<center>For **Bulwark**, the ability to resist more damage in the battle in exchange for losing some power gave it a strong advantage. However, the constant fear of losing that stat boost mid-battle forced players to have a backup tank or avoid relying on **Bulwark** cards.</center>

><center>Para **Bulwark**, la capacidad de resistir más daño en la batalla a cambio de perder algo de poder le daba una ventaja muy fuerte. Pero el miedo constante a perder esa mejora de estadísticas a mitad de una batalla obligaba al jugador a tener un tanque secundario o no depender de las tarjetas con **Bulwark**.</center>

## <center>[Shadow Focus](https://support.splinterlands.com/hc/en-us/articles/45343333949460)</center>
<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUKURwbvXsLcYz9VvGAaswGkq164FSNuQPJaTkNytVLT3/ability_on-bg_shadow-focus_150.png</center>

- **Shadow Focus**: When in the last position, gains **Camouflage**, cannot attack, and all allied units gain +1 Power and **Determined**.

>- **Shadow Focus**: Cuando está en la última posición: gana **Camouflage**, no puede atacar, y todas las unidades aliadas ganan +1 de Poder y **Determined**.

<center>For **Shadow Focus**, losing the power boost against a **Dispel** while keeping a non-attacking unit was a punishment too severe to rely on. In both cases, turns and strategies with pre-battle preparation were easily invalidated by a unit with **Dispel**.</center>

><center>Para **Shadow Focus**, perder el aumento de poder de las unidades contra un **Dispel** manteniendo una unidad sin atacar era un castigo muy fuerte para depender de él. En ambos casos, turnos y estrategias con preparación antes de la batalla se veían invalidados con facilidad por una unidad con **Dispel**.</center>

---

### <center>The necessary correction | La corrección necesaria</center>

<center>Today, those sections of my previous analyses have become officially obsolete. We no longer need to play with the **fear of a reset.** This change transforms the units in this set from **fragile powerhouses** into **solid options.** The risk has been reduced to zero, while the reward potential remains intact.</center>

><center>Hoy, esas secciones de mis análisis anteriores han quedado oficialmente obsoletas. Ya no necesitamos jugar con el **miedo al reinicio**. Este cambio transforma a las unidades de este conjunto de ser **potencias frágiles** a convertirse en **opciones sólidas**. El riesgo se ha reducido a cero, mientras que el potencial de recompensa se mantiene intacto.</center>

---

## <center>Strategic Value and Market Appeal | Valor estratégico y atractivo de mercado</center>

<center>Why does this adjustment make these abilities much more attractive to players? The answer is **Reliability**.</center>

><center>¿Por qué este ajuste hace que estas habilidades sean mucho más atractivas para los jugadores? La respuesta es la **Fiabilidad**.</center>

<center>In a TCG as competitive as **Splinterlands**, players value consistency above any other metric. A card that could be strong depending on luck or the rival not bringing a specific counter is good; but a card that always maintains its power is top-tier. By removing the interaction with **Dispel**, **Escalation** cards have ceased to be **experimental** options to become **essential** pieces of the current meta.</center>

><center>En un TCG tan competitivo como **Splinterlands**, los jugadores valoran la consistencia por encima de cualquier otra métrica. Una carta que podría ser fuerte dependiendo de la suerte o de que el rival no traiga un counter específico es buena; pero una carta que siempre mantiene su poder es de nivel superior. Al eliminar la interacción con **Dispel**, las cartas de **Escalation** han dejado de ser opciones **experimentales** para convertirse en piezas **esenciales** del meta actual.</center>

<center>For league climbing: In **Diamond** and **Champion**, where every mana point is optimized, having the guarantee of an unbreakable shield or a silent team buffer that can later join the battle provides a very solid competitive advantage.</center>

><center>Para el ascenso de ligas: En **Diamante** y **Champion**, donde se optimiza cada punto de maná, tener la garantía de un escudo inquebrantable o un potenciador para el equipo silencioso que después puede unirse a la batalla, otorgan una ventaja competitiva muy sólida.</center>

## <center>Conclusion: A new era for Escalation | Conclusión: Una nueva era para Escalation</center>

<center>The update on **March 24, 2026**, has acted as an **indirect buff** for the **Escalation** set. By eliminating the vulnerability to **Dispel**, the developers have solidified the identity of these abilities as permanent evolutions and not just simple status effects, giving more attention to these non-dispellable abilities and opening the door for similar mechanics in the future.</center>

><center>La actualización del **24 de marzo de 2026** ha funcionado como un **bufo indirecto** para el conjunto **Escalation**. Al eliminar la vulnerabilidad al **Dispel**, los desarrolladores han solidificado la identidad de estas habilidades como evoluciones permanentes y no como simples estados alterados, dándole más atención a estas habilidades que no se pueden disipar y abriendo la puerta a habilidades que tampoco se vean afectadas por **Dispel** en el futuro.</center>

body.title: Code Black Mirror: What I Learned from the “Mythos Case”
body.body:
<center>
Code Black Mirror: What I Learned from the “Mythos Case”
</center>

Lately, i’ve started to view tech news with a kind of skepticism… maybe even a more educated pride. You know the story: a new model comes out, everyone gets excited, and then the hype evaporates. But the recent discussions surrounding a supposed model called “Mythos” — whether it’s a rumor, an internal prototype, or just media hype — have made me realize something important: While we’re playing around with chatbots that summarize our emails, the real battle is going on behind the scenes in the realm of critical infrastructure and software security.
https://youtu.be/yBOOhzLltJA?si=VLtsPWXC-hrzzit2
When i first heard the name “Mythos,” i thought it was just a digital urban legend. And maybe it is. But the discussions around it touch on a sensitive issue: old vulnerabilities hidden in systems that have been considered “hardened” for years. It doesn’t take a magic model to understand that many financial institutions are still running code written decades ago, and auditing these systems is difficult, slow, and expensive.

So, if you look at the broader context, the recent meetings between authorities and big banks are not about panic, but about adaptation. About the fact that digital attacks have become faster, cheaper, and more accessible, while critical infrastructure remains, in many places, obsolete. That’s the reality, whether the “Mythos” exists or not.

A concept that really deserves attention is that of *large-scale internal reasoning*. Modern models are no longer limited to filling in text; they can analyze structures, simulate scenarios, detect patterns that a human would miss. It’s not about offensive autonomy, but about the ability to identify logical problems or vulnerabilities in ways that weren’t possible a few years ago.

Here’s the crux of the matter: not an “out-of-the-box” model, but the fact that the digital world has become so complex that increasingly sophisticated tools are needed to protect it. And the gap between the technology we see — the friendly chatbot on the screen — and the technology running underground is greater than ever.
https://youtu.be/GXFzfmfwjbM?si=85PbNG5JFsnEE8zU
My conclusion is simple: we are not living in a moment of technological apocalypse, but one of maturation. We need to understand the architecture of the world we live in, not because an imaginary model could “escape,” but because the real systems we rely on are fragile, and the future will belong to those who understand how these mechanisms work.

I don’t think “Mythos” is the end — I think it’s just a symbol of our collective anxieties. A reminder that technology is not just a gadget, but an ecosystem that forces us to be more attentive, more informed, and more responsible.

And perhaps this is the real lesson of the “Mythos case”: not that there is a hidden pattern, but that we are vulnerable to our own projections. The media loves to turn any rumor into a digital monster story, because anxiety sells better than reality. But if you cut through the noise, something much more important than a mysterious name remains: the fact that the world of software we rely on is old, fragmented, and hard to maintain.

We don’t need out-of-the-box AI to feel exposed. We only need to look around: financial systems running code written in the 1980s, critical infrastructures that depend on hastily applied patches, companies that still treat security as a cost, not a responsibility. In this context, the emergence of models capable of logical analysis, simulating scenarios, and identifying vulnerabilities is not a threat, but a necessity.

In fact, the real divide is not between humans and AI, but between the old world—built on layers of legacy code—and the new world, where automated analysis is becoming the only realistic way to keep up with complexity. Modern models are not “hunters,” but tools that force us to look in the mirror and see how fragile the digital foundations we consider unshakable are.

So if there’s one message i take away from all this, it’s this: we shouldn’t fear AI, but our complacency. The idea that technology is a stable backdrop, when in fact it’s a living organism that requires ongoing maintenance, auditing, and understanding.

And in the years to come, the difference between those who navigate the digital world and those who suffer from it will be simple -some will understand how these models think, others will continue to believe that everything is magic. And magic, as we well know, has never protected anyone.

body.title: Vintage Photos - Lot 6 (201-204)
body.body: Several years ago I bought a flatbed scanner with a slide adapter to scan some old film slides that my grandparents had. After I finished scanning those, I picked up several batches of slides from Goodwill and on eBay out of curiosity. I am not sure why these commonly wind up at such places but I know that at least some of them have ultimately come from estate sales. Maybe family members just don't know what to do with them. I've seen them advertised as being for arts and crafts but I was more interested in the actual contents. Each slide is literally a snapshot in history. These pictures span from as early as the late 1940s to as late as the early 1990s. There are thousands of these slides. I will be scanning some from time to time and posting them here as an interesting way to look back at the past.\n\nWhen I say \
I mean a group of slides I bought in a single purchase. Usually they are from the same ultimate origin. Typically, a batch will have 100s or even 1000s of slides.\n\nWhen I say \

I mean a subset of a batch that I scan together. There are normally four slides in one set because that's how many slides my scanner can scan at once. Likewise, a post will typically have one set of four slides. It's just easier to keep track of that way. This set contains photos spanning from as far back as at least 1959 to as recent as at least 1980. Other than these slides coming from eBay, I have no idea of their ultimate origin other than the clues provided in the photos themselves. These were all scanned with an Epson Perfection V600 Photo scanner. All of the photos in this set were processed in August 1979 and it looks like they were all taken the same day. These show some people out on a lake waterskiing probably somewhere in Michigan. Other photos have shown up from time to time in this batch from this lake, though most of the others have been from near the shore.

>

See the previous post in this series

<div class=text-justify>



![IMG_4791.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/23xA1xeMAD9GjuqiqD12tNpP6jg2otC6BbxBeUSETSuKiqwRrKJT334WhQTX5YHYwKn95.jpeg)

I don’t mind fast-paced storytelling, covert missions, or even layered betrayals that make me pause and rewind a film. But what I do mind is when I can’t even follow what’s going on, not because the film is complex, but that something as basic as language gets in the way. And sadly, that was my experience with this film. 

**Synopsis**

This film follows Badh (Marine Vacth), a former elite French intelligence agent trained by the DGSE, basically one of those “do the dirty work for the state” operatives. She was once deployed to eliminate high-value targets, including an arms dealer in Syria, but things went left when she was betrayed by her own agency.

![IMG_4793.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/23zRpFidQ5mBsrtvgiMgdMZ7JQTtuwm3fsUPpnjrwtTaZ4jzq7rgr1BmUqauHQe3fXzTy.jpeg)

Trying to escape that life, she disappears and rebuilds a quiet existence in Morocco, living under the radar with her husband Ilias, who works as a police officer. But peace doesn’t last long. When Ilias is shot and left for dead by a cartel linked to Mansour Khoury, a powerful crime boss, Badh is forced to return to the violent identity she tried to bury.

What follows is a revenge-driven mission where betrayal, espionage, and buried secrets collide,  especially when she discovers that the enemies she’s fighting may be connected to people from her past, including her former intelligence handler Joanna Walter.

**My Review (what actually works)**

![IMG_4790.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/23tRvjU7yUKbDWqLg2uHyR6hDZ4snuUB8hxCbVYuMnN2LiStj3HJPHFgr6HbXin4K8qSZ.jpeg)

From a purely action standpoint, I won’t lie, this film has its moments. The fight scenes are clean and very intentional. There’s no unnecessary noise according to my observations or  over-the-top dramatics. All you get is just straight-up calculated violence.

You can tell the film was going for that female Bourne / Taken energy, where you have a quiet but deadly protagonist who doesn’t waste time talking when they can act. Well, Marine Vacth carries that role well by not overreacting but moving instead like someone who has done this before, and will do it again if necessary.

![IMG_4792.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/23xeYvoMPNJB9gQL19HTZpVMmdX3autEitYYfsTXzKdPHvYz1LjpSTQVXGEK5CzJPD7Ds.jpeg)

There’s also something interesting about the theme of state betrayal. The idea that the same system that trained you can discard you hits differently. 

**Now Let Me Talk About What Ruined It For Me**

The subtitles did. I’m still annoyed thinking about it. Because this film is originally in French, and the version I watched had terrible subtitles. Important conversations felt incomplete plus there were scenes where characters were clearly revealing something crucial, and I was just sitting there like, “Am I missing something or is this just badly translated?” That was frustrating as this is a film built on betrayal, hidden motives and shifting alliances.

![IMG_4801.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/EokbG4eHdjKhyq9HiULgX5Z9aesjzowZe7KwCxxrmqVSymhLPEfGnASd2sNYByCeqcH.jpeg)

So if the dialogue isn’t clear, the entire story starts to feel messy, not literally, but because you can’t properly follow it. Instead of being immersed, I was constantly distracted, trying to interpret subtitles instead of watching the film. And that breaks the experience completely. Anyway, I still had to pay close action to really understand. 

Another thing is that the film had the potential to be more than just action. A woman betrayed by her country, a life rebuilt from nothing, Love disrupted by violence and revenge fueled by both pain and duty, sure is a lot to work with. But, the film doesn’t fully explore these. It just brushes past them and leans more into action sequences. So while I understood Badh’s motivation, I didn’t feel it as deeply as I wanted to. And again, maybe the subtitle issue played a role in that disconnect.

![IMG_4799.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/242NjQ6r9ZdKx7uM588Vdetvp8PwBQDjMW3i8CLe1gSnEccCyog44BtmqZEb1iXqLAeex.jpeg)

All in all, *Agent Zero* is not a terrible film. It’s actually quite decent in terms of action and pacing. It knows what it wants to be and it sticks to that. But for me, the experience was heavily affected by poor subtitles, and that’s something I can’t ignore. Because no matter how good a film is, if I can’t fully understand it, I can’t fully enjoy it.
There’s a solid movie in there, I just didn’t get the best version of it.

Rating: 6.5/10

That said, I will be dusting my Duolingo account. This time I’m learning French. 


</diva>
