body.title: LIVING LIFE IN THE DARK
body.body:
Hello everyone, welcome to My Blog 

Today, living life without technology would be very different and difficult. I think everything would be slow, and people would have to rely more on themselves and those around them.

There are some simple activities which are entertainment sports. This would take much time and effort. Living in a world without technology, communication would not be constant. There would be no forms of social media or means of communication like Facebook, writing letters, or visiting each other just to exchange news. This may be difficult for those who live far away. Conversations would be more meaningful because they would require more time and attention from people.

Walking on a daily basis would also change a lot because many things that are done with machines would have to be done manually - cooking, cleaning, farming and this would take much longer and require more physical strength. It might be very tiring, but it would also create a very strong sense of satisfaction. People would feel more connected to each other and to whatever they produce and consume because they did it directly.

Education might be different too. Instead of always searching for answers online, people would resort to reading books. There would be no eBooks but everything would be based on personal experience. Learning would be much slower, but it would be much deeper because students would develop patience and critical thinking.

Entertainment would take a more natural and social form. Instead of just watching the screen for a long time, people would spend more time outdoors being entertained by themselves. They would play games, tell stories, engage in cultural activities, creativity, music, and many others. Communities would likely bond well because people would interact face-to-face more often.

Life without technology would not be easy. Healthcare would not be up to standard, diseases would be harder to treat, traveling long distances would be very difficult and time-consuming, and access to information and data would be limited. This would slow down the progress of things. In the end, life without technology would be very simple, but it would demand a lot from people. It would bring people closer to nature and remove many comforts provided by technology. The real lesson should not be to demonize technology itself or view technology as bad, but to create a balance with both our physical life and technology where we can enjoy the benefits without losing human connection.


Thank you for stopping by my blog

body.title: The lost meaning of love
body.body:
![05324101-9CD1-48BE-988D-9BB409EA3051.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dwayne16/23zRy2AK3RotEkUfMWNRQq2okx6NCkYTWMxhqWcjt2VfYGiutiFWNbxNgTZCcK4fAGKFP.jpeg)

***
Romance is meant for those who are worthy of it. It doesn’t just “come”. It doesn’t just appear because in your mind you’ve assumed it’s the “right time”. And it has nothing to do with hopeful wishing. 

Love is a companionship. A shared emotional bond that has more meaning to it than any other type of relationship. Romance between those who truly love each other flourishes. 
 
Nowadays our conception of love is skewed. Misshapen. And mistook for a  completely different thing other than what it truly means or is. So much to the point where somebody can engage themselves in very intimate physical activities like sex and have no strings attached to it. Nowadays sex or any other relative sexual indulgences and interactions are increasingly desensitised. Anyone can fornicate. And anyone can have leisure in a “body count” and not have much to lose when it comes to pleasing themselves.

There is a general consensus which states that sex is often not enjoyed when it’s with someone you don’t love. Of course, this instance is self-explanatory. When there is no emotional bond between two individuals or as they say no strings attached, the emotional fulfilment that leads to bonding , satisfaction and actual love are deactivated. The issue is, sex is a bonding act. there’s no such thing as casual sex. Every intimate sexual relation is an initiation of mutual bond. Biologically, your brain will try and fill in the gaps as if you find someone you “love”. It will form a connection with that person. But if that connection fails to be reciprocated or weakened by indifference, it creates a mismatch.  Which is why many people say that once they had sex with someone they didn’t love, they felt empty inside, turned off or sometimes even disgusted with the person or themselves.

 Sex in that manner is like eating junk food. Junk food can taste amazing. And nourish you. But sometimes we find ourselves feel sluggish or a lingering sense of distaste just off the fact that the food is unhealthy. Sometimes we may want more and get addicted. And once someone gets addicted to junks, a life full of obesity and life threatening health issues cloud you.

We must restore the value of love for what it truly is. A bond. A companionship. An experience. Not an obligation.

body.title: Ficción: Resaca/ Hangover
body.body: > La primera sensación fue la de haber comido vidrio molido y haber recibido una fuerte golpiza: su boca estaba seca y tenía dolor de cabeza. Abrió los ojos de repente y así de repente tuvo que cerrarlos: una luz amarilla penetró sus pupilas. Luego los abrió lentamente de nuevo, entrecerrando los ojos para ver dónde estaba: era el suelo de su baño. Un fuerte olor a orina, heces y sangre llegó a su nariz y le hizo arrugar el rostro. Se levantó lo mejor que pudo y apoyó la espalda contra la pared: un mareo lo hizo cerrar los ojos de nuevo y quedarse inmóvil. Sintió ganas de vomitar...

>o0o

Recostado así y con los ojos todavía cerrados, recordó que el día anterior había salido del trabajo y había ido a buscar su carro al mecánico. Después de eso, se dirigió al bar cercano. Como era viernes, había mucha gente, así que no recuerda haber estado con nadie en particular. Llamó a Melina, su esposa, que estaba de viaje. Eso lo recuerda claramente. Pelearon, eso cree. Por qué pelearon, no lo sabe, aunque podría haber sido por cualquier cosa. Durante algún tiempo, Melina y él habían estado peleando todo el tiempo. También tiene recuerdos vagos de una joven camarera con lentes que lo miraba mucho, así como de un tipo con bigote y barba. Después de eso, no hay nada, todo está borrado, cubierto por una capa de polvo.

>o0o

Le dolía el cuerpo como si un tren lo hubiera atropellado, especialmente en la parte baja. Suspiró profundamente y decidió levantarse. Abrió los ojos de nuevo e intentó incorporarse. En ese momento vio que estaba desnudo y que una de sus manos tenía rastros de sangre. Entonces abrió los ojos, horrorizado, con miedo, y miró su mano como si no la reconociera, como si no fuera suya. También había sangre en uno de sus muslos. Se levantó rápidamente y se miró en el espejo del baño para ver si había alguna señal de algo en su cara. En ese instante, la puerta del baño se abrió y un chico con anteojos, barba y bigote entró, se pegó a su espalda y dijo con cariño: \_Por fin te has despertado, volvamos a la cama. Entonces sintió un fuerte reflejo de arcadas y se inclinó sobre el lavamanos incapaz de controlarse: un líquido amarillento y verdoso salió de su boca. * * * * * * **Versión en inglés**

>Hangover The first sensation was that of having eaten ground glass and having received a strong blow: his mouth was dry and he had a headache. He opened his eyes suddenly and just as suddenly had to close them: a yellow light pierced his pupils. Then he opened them slowly again, squinting to see where he was: it was the floor of his bathroom. A strong smell of urine, fecal matter, and blood reached his nose and made him wrinkle his face. He got up as best as he could and pressed his back against the wall: a dizziness made him close his eyes again and remain motionless. He felt like vomiting...

>o0o

Lying like this and with his eyes still closed, he remembered that the previous day he had left work and gone to look for his car at the mechanic. After that, he went to the bar nearby. Since it was Friday, there were a lot of people, so he doesn’t remember being with anyone in particular. He called Melina, his wife, who was traveling. He remembers that clearly. They fought, he thinks. Why they fought, he does not know, although it could be about anything. For some time, Melina and he had been fighting all the time. He also has vague memories of a young waitress with glasses who looked at him a lot, as well as a guy with a mustache and beard. After that, there is nothing, everything is erased, covered by a layer of dust.

>o0o

His body hurt as if a train had run over him, especially in the lower part. He sighed deeply and decided to get up. He opened his eyes again and tried to sit up. At that moment he saw he was naked and one of his hands had traces of blood. Then he opened his eyes in horror, with fear, and looked at his hand as if he did not recognize it, as if it were not his. There was also blood on one of his thighs. He stood up quickly and looked at himself in the bathroom mirror to see if there was any sign of anything on his face. At that instant, the bathroom door opened and a boy with glasses, beard, and mustache entered, attached himself to his back, and lovingly said: \
Then he felt a strong gag reflex and bent over the sink unable to hold it: a yellowish-green liquid came out of his mouth.
>La imagen principal fue hecha en Canva y el texto fue traducido con Deepl
>Gracias por vuestra lectura y comentario, amigo. Hasta una próxima oportunidad\n\n

body.title: ¡Water Temple! : The Legend Of Zelda : The Minish Cap #10 [ENG|ESP]
body.body: >\n\nGreetings, Hive Gaming community! I hope you are having a fantastic day. Today we reach the tenth chapter of our walkthrough of \

In the previous post, we had just entered the Temple of Droplets, and in this session, we focused entirely on overcoming its icy and treacherous puzzles to reach the heart of the sanctuary. To be honest, this dungeon is one of the most creative so far, as it forces us to manipulate the light and the state of the water to progress. # One of the most important moments was discovering the **Lantern**. This item is essential not only for lighting up the darkest corners of the temple but also for melting the huge blocks of ice that block our way. By using the fire, we were able to open paths that previously seemed impassable. Additionally, the dungeon mechanics required us to push blocks across slippery surfaces and activate light beams to thaw out chests containing small keys and other vital items for our progress. # After intense exploration and solving complex puzzles, we finally reached the deepest part of the temple. There, we faced the Big Octo, a massive octopus that had been frozen. By using our lantern and our agility, we managed to defeat him, and as a reward, we finally obtained the **Water Element**! This is a huge milestone in our adventure, as it is the third of the four elements we need to restore the Picori Blade. Watching the element shine after such a difficult climb was truly rewarding. # With the Water Element in our power, our next mission is to return to the Sanctuary to infuse its power into our sword. This chapter has been a masterclass in dungeon design and resource management. I am very satisfied with the progress made and excited for what comes next. Thank you very much for reading and for following this series with such enthusiasm! # Until next time, take care!
>\n\n¡Saludos, comunidad de Hive Gaming! Espero que estén teniendo un día fantástico. Hoy llegamos al décimo capítulo de nuestro recorrido por \

. En la publicación anterior, apenas habíamos entrado al Templo de una Gota, y en esta sesión nos enfocamos totalmente en superar sus gélidos y traicioneros acertijos para llegar al corazón del santuario. Para ser sincero, esta mazmorra es una de las más creativas hasta ahora, ya que nos obliga a manipular la luz y el estado del agua para poder avanzar. # Uno de los momentos más importantes fue descubrir el **Candil** (Linterna). Este objeto es esencial no solo para iluminar los rincones más oscuros del templo, sino también para derretir los enormes bloques de hielo que bloquean nuestro camino. Al usar el fuego, pudimos abrir senderos que antes parecían impasables. Además, las mecánicas de la mazmorra nos exigieron empujar bloques por superficies resbaladizas y activar rayos de luz para descongelar cofres que contenían llaves pequeñas y otros objetos vitales para nuestro progreso. # Tras una exploración intensa y resolver complejos puzles, finalmente llegamos a la parte más profunda del templo. Allí, nos enfrentamos al Gran Octo, un pulpo masivo que había quedado congelado. Usando nuestra linterna y nuestra agilidad, logramos derrotarlo, y como recompensa, ¡finalmente obtuvimos el **Elemento Agua**! Este es un hito enorme en nuestra aventura, ya que es el tercero de los cuatro elementos que necesitamos para restaurar la Espada Picori. Ver el elemento brillar después de una escalada tan difícil fue realmente gratificante. # Con el Elemento Agua en nuestro poder, nuestra próxima misión es regresar al Santuario para infundir su poder en nuestra espada. Este capítulo ha sido una clase magistral de diseño de mazmorras y gestión de recursos. Estoy muy satisfecho con el progreso realizado y emocionado por lo que viene a continuación. ¡Muchas gracias por leerme y por seguir esta serie con tanto entusiasmo! # ¡Hasta la próxima, cuídense mucho! ------ ---- |

body.title: Trothguard Session 14 Recap
body.body:
<center> 
![Trothguard - Cover - PlayerResources.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oblivioncubed/23uR5Pt6dq9jZzGXmCmC5yq3Cts8ReLJ27e8EZiNukYy8wY4jptYHzEqH5A8sFH4sRxyB.png)
</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oblivioncubed/23tS312jjmpA15ZM7Q4NfvBe5inG9BbKn3K8nww2UjhntxLVyTiaWxphxeu833iJLoLip.png)</center>

Whoo, this one was a big one!

# Overview
Yuantine confronts his past. 
Quywn learns something new.
Fistandia sees a path forward.

In this session, we had a lore drop by the wizard Fistandia, who had been saved in the prior session after being basically kidnapped, drugged, and used as a human battery for 75 ish years.

Her speech to the party was thus:

> Fistandia:
> I wanted to... thank you. For... for giving me time. Time to heal, time to be... free. It has been an... adjustment.
> 
> Now, I'm sure you all have questions about, well, everything, that you're burning to ask... and I probably have answers... but before we get into that I think I need to tell you a story. A story about the past, and how it has influenced the present. How it might influence our shared future.
> 
> Once, long, long ago, I sat at the pinnacle of personal achievement in the mystic arts. I was the head of a school of magic in the lost city of magic - Mach'Lithe. My achievements and my hunger for advancement brought me to the eye of the The Angel Empress, Revasha Faror
who invited me to sit upon the Council of High Magic.
> 
> It was in my seventh year in that position that the Empress approached us with a secret task: create a ritual that could, potentially, safeguard the Empress herself or a successor against any possible attack. At the time, I thought it was honestly an exercise simply to get us all working together again - the year prior had been rife with infighting and clashing opinions among the Council - but now, looking back, I think she'd become aware of a potential threat well before any murmurings began.
> 
> Anyhow, it consumed us all, and we collectively - secretly - set to the task at hand. It took 8 months for theory and planning to resolve into trial and action, but we, together... (She looks at Freyot apologetically) we did it. It would require refinement, of course... and the setup was complex, intensive, costly, and took longer than we'd like... but the theory worked in practice. We were able to temporarily remove a room from the flow of time and re-deposit it back into the timestream at a specific point.
> 
> We completed four trials, initially on a simple object, then a desk and its contents (including a live lizard), then on a closet, and finally on a decently sized room with a few volunteers. First removing the item for a day, then a week, then two weeks, and finally for a full month. It was working, exactly as we'd hoped... so we eased off the pace, locked the ritual scroll within an arcane spell case, and put it and as many material components as we could into Masarak's Vault to be used once we'd been given approval to try it on an even larger area.
> 
> With everything safely locked away within a protected vault accessible only to the members of the Council, we each returned to our individual focuses, and two years later the scroll was used when Freyot and I were in the City of Brass within the Elemental Plane of Fire, and, well... we can all see how that went.
> 
> My theory is that - (Freyot places a hand on her shoulder) - right, right. Not the time to dive into that. Does anyone have questions at this point?

After that, we rejoined the party in the streets of Lavan, specifically, at the local arena enjoying some gladiator matches! And we met two gelatinous cubes with riders who worked as arena cleaners. The party joked that they should be named \

so they are now!

> Scene 1:
> The team is enjoying an afternoon at the Arena, and witnesses a pair of fights. The first set is a pair of Prakkean adventurers facing off against another pair of human fighters, Silver Light Adventurers. Who wins will depend on luck, but also on how much aid is given to them.

I had some fun (I thought) audience mechanics that allowed players to purchase various items/boons and have them applied to whatever side they wanted to win. They could:

Throw stones at the fighters. 1 bucket of rocks (5 rocks) for 5g. 1d4 damage on a d10 hit.
Throw in a potion.
Healing (60g)
Fire/acid/cold Breath (70g)
Giant Strength / Giant size (500g)
Fly (1000g)
Trigger a trap (50g) (fire, acid, pit, falling column, spikes, paralysis, etc)
Add feral beast (150g) (Owlbear, Bear, Wolf, Lion, Tiger, Jaguar, Bull, Giant Salamander)

The Prakkean adventurers (Culturally gypsy-stereotype-like folks) were the winners of our first match. They won the players over instantly with their vibrant clothing colours and underdog charm.

Our second battle of the evening was were the real meat of our session started - here we had two new competitors enter the ring. One of which was - unbeknownst to him at the time - a rival of one of my player characters.

> Torvald's Battle
> Initially, the orc comes in with a full-face mask, there doesn't appear to be any eye-slits, looking like a solid piece of black steel. His skin is a unique orange-tinted shade, not typical for most orcs, who are usually a shade of grey, green, dark blue. Particularly light grey orcs look nearly white, while dark ones appear almost black - orangish-red is a very atypical skin tone for an Orc.
> 
> The clash between the Minotaur and the Orc is quick, and brutal. The Minotaur charges, and in the last moment the orc side-steps, viciously punching into the minotaur's side. He reels, but recovers quickly as the orc moves in a weirdly off-balance way to close the gap, attempting another combination of punches. The minotaur takes one on the pauldron, but is already in the process of delivering his own, which shoves the orc back several feet. They charge towards each-other, and the minotaur rears up to bring down a massive two-handed tomahawk blow on the orcs head. It connects and a loud crack can be heard, but the minotaur's body is between you and the orc. At nearly the same instance, the orc's attack continues and his right hand slams up, into the chin of the minotaur with such force as to immediately snap the head backwards savagely, breaking his neck and killing him instantly.
> 
> As the announcer screams for a cleric, and you see two clerics scrambling into the arena, you see the blackout-mask fall off the orc's face...
> 
> For Quywn, when you last saw this man it was at least a decade ago, maybe more. Sometime within the last 40 years. When was the last time you saw him? He was a long-time family friend of your father and mother, who had some sort of business dealings with him. You always thought of him as a kindly old uncle-type; he'd bring you little trinkets and baubles, including occasionally little pets - lizards and other desert dwelling creatures.
> 
> For Yuantine, you recognize this man as well... in a very different light. This man is a monster. A tyrant who hunts people for sport. The last time you saw him, many years prior, he was covered in the blood of one of your family members (younger cousin?) and was grinning ear to ear. He had beaten you - he thought - to death. Nobody knew you survived. Once, many orc tribes lived in The Blasted Lands, but they each were visited by this Warlord and either absorbed peacefully, or - much more commonly - beaten into submission and devoured.

Yuantine, taking my bait, chooses to jump into the ring immediately and a second later Peril follows, and then finally Quinn also follows. Peril has no dog in this fight, but he's a ride-or-die friend and if anyone in the party is throwing down, he's gonna be there.

It was a heck of a fight. I had two different stat-blocks behind the screen for if Yuantine was going to 1v1 this guy, or if the party was going to try and gank him. I wanted it to be a fun fight either way, and even with my beefed-up group-fight stat block they managed to get him past half HP... so he busted out his secret weapon:

> Torvald has a black one-or two-handed sword that on a crit adds 4d6 extra damage, and you roll another d20 - on a 20, you cleave off a limb. The sword also has a pommel with a deep green gem in it. if it's turned (and activated) it will fire off up to 3 Disintegrate spells. This can be done up to 3 times per day.

body.title: Miner verlieren 15.000 US-Dollar pro Coin/Miners lose $15,000 per coin
body.body:
Erste Spannungen im Netzwerk werden sichtbar.


![50161.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQd92AfVeR9A3CvfHp5dTUGv1HfUoQ6wUYGd7sRzykDtV/50161.png)


Die ökonomische Lage für Bitcoin Miner hat sich deutlich verschlechtert. Laut Daten von Checkonchain liegen die durchschnittlichen Produktionskosten derzeit bei rund 88.000 US-Dollar pro Bitcoin. Der Kurs notiert hingegen nur bei knapp unter 73.000 US-Dollar. Für viele Miner bedeutet das einen Verlust von mehr als 19 Prozent pro geschürftem Block.

Der Druck baut sich bereits seit dem Kursrückgang im Oktober auf, damals handelte Bitcoin noch bei 126.000 US-Dollar. Zusätzliche Dynamik erhält die Entwicklung durch geopolitische Spannungen. Der Konflikt zwischen den USA, Israel und dem Iran treibt die Energiepreise nach oben, das steigert die Produktionskosten der Miner zusätzlich.

Die Auswirkungen sind bereits im Bitcoin-Netzwerk sichtbar. Die Mining Difficulty ist zuletzt um 7,76 Prozent gefallen. Parallel sinkt die Hashrate auf etwa 945 EH/s.

Ein zentraler Indikator für die Rentabilität bleibt der sogenannte Hashprice. Dieser liegt aktuell bei rund 33,30 US-Dollar pro Petahash pro Sekunde und Tag. Für viele Betreiber bewegt sich das Mining damit nahe der Gewinnschwelle.

**Können Miner ihre Kosten nicht decken, müssen sie Bestände veräußern, um den Betrieb aufrechtzuerhalten. Dadurch entsteht zusätzlicher Verkaufsdruck in einem ohnehin angespannten Marktumfeld.**

Ich zitierte aus folgendem Artikel...

https://www.btc-echo.de/schlagzeilen/bitcoin-mining-unter-druck-227685/


![50163.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNn8YGcQxcHGEzvHpZbCsmVghrsEmdxZmSbS9dujdM421/50163.png)


Mein persönliches Fazit:

Momentan scheint sich die Lage um den Bitcoin-Kurs etwas zu entspannen. Meiner Meinung nach wurden jedoch nur Short-Wetten liquidiert. Das führt dazu, dass nun Bitcoin gekauft werden müssen, um die verlorenen Wetten der Trader zu bezahlen. 

Glaubst du nun an eine Trendwende?

---

English 

The first signs of tension within the network are becoming visible.

![50161.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQd92AfVeR9A3CvfHp5dTUGv1HfUoQ6wUYGd7sRzykDtV/50161.png)

The economic situation for Bitcoin miners has deteriorated significantly. According to data from Checkonchain, average production costs are currently around $88,000 per Bitcoin. The price, however, is trading at just under $73,000. For many miners, this translates to a loss of more than 19 percent per mined block.

The pressure has been building since the price drop in October, when Bitcoin was still trading at $126,000. Geopolitical tensions are adding further momentum to this development.  The conflict between the US, Israel, and Iran is driving up energy prices, further increasing miners' production costs.

The effects are already visible in the Bitcoin network. The mining difficulty recently fell by 7.76 percent. At the same time, the hashrate is dropping to approximately 945 EH/s.

A key indicator of profitability remains the so-called hash price. This currently stands at around US$33.30 per petahash per second per day. For many operators, mining is thus approaching the break-even point.

If miners cannot cover their costs, they must sell off assets to maintain operations.  This creates additional selling pressure in an already tense market environment.**

I quoted from the following article...

https://www.btc-echo.de/schlagzeilen/bitcoin-mining-unter-druck-227685/

![50163.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNn8YGcQxcHGEzvHpZbCsmVghrsEmdxZmSbS9dujdM421/50163.png)

My personal conclusion:

Currently, the situation surrounding the Bitcoin price seems to be easing somewhat. In my opinion, however, only short positions have been liquidated. This means that Bitcoin now has to be bought to cover the traders' lost bets.

Do you now believe in a trend reversal?

body.title: Furry friend…
body.body: Afternoon everyone…. The weather has finally broke here. It’s in the high sixties today and the weekend is supposed to be in the mid seventies. So who doesn’t like little furry friends on their silver coins. Well the Perth Mint loves to make coins with furry and feathered friends. They have so many series with this theme, such as the kookaburra, the lunar series, swan, stock horse, wedged tail eagle and this one the koala. The Australian Silver Koala is one of the most prominent coins from the Perth Mint of Australia. Introduced in 2007, the Silver Koala stands with the Silver Kookaburra and newer Silver Kangaroo as the primary investment-grade silver coins offered by the mint on an annual basis. Coin Highlights: Arrives inside of a protective capsules! 6th release of the Silver Koala coin! Limited mintage of only 388,046 coins! Contains 1 Troy oz of .999 pure silver in BU condition. Bears a face value of $1 (AUD) backed by the federal government of Australia. Obverse includes the effigy of Queen Elizabeth II. Reverse features the image of a Koala lying on a tree branch. Each of the 2012 1 oz Australian Silver Koala Coins in this product listing comes to you with a protective capsule and is available as such individually. This coin is in Brilliant Uncirculated condition and comes from a year of release that featured a total mintage of 388,046 coins. The 2012 coin was down significantly from the previous year in this series. From 2007 to 2015, the Perth Mint issued the Silver Koala coins with an unlimited mintage figure. The mintage in 2012 was roughly one-third that of the previous issue in 2011 which had a total of more than 910,000 coins. The Australian Silver Koala coin is like the Silver Kookaburra in that it uses a new depiction of the koala each year. The Perth Mint features this native marsupial species in a different relief each year, sometimes depicting just one koala and sometimes using a family unit. On the reverse of the 2012 1 oz Australian Silver Koala Coin, you’ll find a single koala lying along the branch of a tree taking a nap. The koala is one of the least active species in the world, napping for as much as 20 hours in a year. Engravings denote the name of the collection, along with the coin’s year of issue, weight, purity, and metal content. The obverse of 2012 Australian Silver Koalas features the right-profile portrait of Queen Elizabeth II. The Queen’s right-profile portrait is the fourth-generation design and was created in 1998 by Ian Rank-Broadley for the Royal Mint of England. Perth Mint is located in Perth, Western Australia. Founded in 1899 as the third and final Royal Mint facility on the content, today Perth Mint is owned by the state of Western Australia. Sorry for the horrible pictures, glare…. **_Now for the coin…._**

body.title: Confeccionando hermosos zapaticos tejidos para mi muñeca Lulú./ Making beautiful knitted shoes for my Lulu doll.(Esp/Eng)
body.body:
# Español
# Saludos amigos amantes de las manualidades.💁🌈
¡Feliz día para todos!
En estos días tensos, amigos, por situaciones familiares, quise  acudir al arte del tejer como mecanismo de relajación.La manualidad que confeccioné, fueron unos zapaticos tejidos destinados a mi muñeca Lulú, esa antigua muñeca que logra calmarme al observarla en momentos de angustias, desde mi etapa infante.Los invito amigos a que me acompañen a conocer cómo logré estos hermosos zapaticos, que en dimensiones mayores pueden ser confeccionados para  los pequeños de casa.¡Comencemos!
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260410_133259714.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23uQvQGbwC5pFHeHGg8N59Dsj6AbA4VYE8ZqeDJY6LKqNW81avH1ECd2KjBXA3RJJMqov.jpg)
</center>
#
# ✨Zapaticos tejidos para muñecas✨
# ✨Materiales✨ 
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260410_133500654.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23wCLWZbkWJyiBBX7m1dabUsuH7JboemgvB9XSksJd4odQjuKFX55DZyqf5CG5jJ6m4HB.jpg)
</center>
#
.Hilo de tejer blanco 
.Hilo de coser 
.Aguja de tejer
.Aguja de coser
.Tijera
.Piedras pequeñas coloridas

# ✨Modo de confección ✨ 
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260410_133713379.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23vi5jjoWwycN25KE7GHam9jMGL5GiFMRAhikxqpznMopQFw9VBpV93UQFuvss8FyqigP.jpg)
</center>
#
Comenzamos el proceder, tejiendo con ayuda de aguja e hilo una cadeneta de 22 eslabones. Decirles, que esta cadeneta inicial es la que marcará el tamaño del zapato, si lo desean de mayor o menor dimensión, sólo deben ajustarla. Seguidamente, comenzamos una primer vuelta, tejiendo una cadeneta de 3 eslabones , la que  continuaremos con  un punto vareta en cada espacio de la cadeneta inicial, hasta completar la primera vuelta.Luego, proseguimos  tejiendo 10 vueltas de forma similar, y terminamos el tejido con un punto deslizado,cortando el hilo.

Hasta aquí amigos, se logra conformar la base cuadrada del zapato, ahora, pasaremos a estructurarlo de la siguiente forma:
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260410_133945338.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23uQtf4EAto4VVsK8JWzK3ZAubiugErScbi2jYZAQyGyucHva5PMx6CZAs8pstivry8oZ.jpg)
</center>
#
Doblamos uno de los vértices del cuadrado tejido aproximadamente 2 centímetros.Esto permitirá realizar la puntera del zapato.
Seguidamente, doblamos el cuadrado centralmente formando un triángulo, que poseerá el vértice doblado internamente.
Mantenemos  esta estructura, cosiendo con ayuda de aguja e hilo , primeramente los dos laditos del triángulo pequeños de la puntera, y luego, todo el lado inferior del triángulo hasta llegar al vértice, dónde doblamos y continuamos cosiendo hasta un centímetro más del otro lado, dónde  quedará conformada  la región del talón del zapatico.Rematamos y cortamos el hilo.
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260410_134355457.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23uQvaQniuuNovqGsH4diSk4XJphG2UoJEPMSkrPTzLLx7UsXFP96v2hAeCGbiU9Y5xH9.jpg)
</center>
#
Ya casi listo tenemos creado el zapatico, ahora, viramos completamente la estructura, le realizamos un doblez a la parte superior hacia delante, y lo decoramos con piedrecitas de colores a nuestro gusto, yo escogí las de color amarillo, para que hicieran juego con el vestido.
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260410_134441325.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23vsNg5piM21dgdBicdZgY4UEro76EN4v7zm17388hs4VXaKAUnuWCXyhQqumQLiMrFWM.jpg)
</center>
#
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260410_134550159.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/EoK6Pyuv59AbxYDt5Ye29wvkC4WMAuAVd8Q6nw87JCMVJsm58Nmu4CzdJFGW5UoTT23.jpg)
</center>
#
Amigos , me encantaron como lucen estos hermosos zapaticos tejidos en Lulú, mi muñeca.Espero, que a ustedes también les hayan gustado, y que se anímen a su futura confección tanto para sus muñecas, para los pequeños de su familia, o simplemente cómo un excelente mecanismo de relajación.
Me despido de ustedes, deseándoles un feliz y relajado fin de semana familiar.¡Abrazos!
Fotografías propias.
*** 
# English
# Greetings friends who love crafts.💁🌈
Happy day to everyone!
In these tense days, friends, due to family situations, I wanted to turn to the art of knitting as a mechanism of relajación.La craft that I made, were some knitted shoes intended for my Lulu doll, that old doll that manages to calm me down by watching her in moments of anguish since my childhood stage.I invite you friends to join me to know how I achieved these beautiful shoes, which in larger dimensions can be made for the little ones at home.Let's get started!
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260410_133259714.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23uQvQGbwC5pFHeHGg8N59Dsj6AbA4VYE8ZqeDJY6LKqNW81avH1ECd2KjBXA3RJJMqov.jpg)
</center>
#
# ✨Knitted shoes for dolls✨
# ✨Materials 
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260410_133500654.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23wCLWZbkWJyiBBX7m1dabUsuH7JboemgvB9XSksJd4odQjuKFX55DZyqf5CG5jJ6m4HB.jpg)
</center>
#
.White knitting yarn 
.Sewing thread 
.Knitting needle
.Sewing needle
.Scissor
.Colorful small stones

# ✨Mode of preparation ✨ 
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260410_133713379.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23vi5jjoWwycN25KE7GHam9jMGL5GiFMRAhikxqpznMopQFw9VBpV93UQFuvss8FyqigP.jpg)
</center>
#
We started the procedure, knitting with the help of needle and thread a 22-link chain. Tell them, that this initial chain is the one that will mark the size of the shoe, if they want it of greater or lesser dimension, they just have to adjust it. Next, we start a first round, knitting a 3-link chain, which we will continue with a varette stitch in each space of the initial chain, until the first round is completed.Then, we continue knitting 10 turns in a similar way, and we finish the knitting with a slipped stitch, cutting the thread.

So far friends, it is possible to shape the square base of the shoe, now, we will move on to structure it as follows:
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260410_133945338.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23uQtf4EAto4VVsK8JWzK3ZAubiugErScbi2jYZAQyGyucHva5PMx6CZAs8pstivry8oZ.jpg)
</center>
#
We bend one of the vertices of the knitted square about 2 centimeters.This will make it possible to make the toe of the shoe.
Next, we fold the square centrally forming a triangle, which will have the vertex folded internally.
We maintain this structure, sewing with the help of needle and thread, firstly the two sides of the small triangle of the toe, and then, the entire lower side of the triangle until we reach the apex, where we fold and continue sewing until one centimeter more of the other side, where the heel region of the shoe will be shaped.We finish and cut the thread.
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260410_134355457.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23uQvaQniuuNovqGsH4diSk4XJphG2UoJEPMSkrPTzLLx7UsXFP96v2hAeCGbiU9Y5xH9.jpg)
</center>
#
Almost ready we have created the shoe, now, we completely turned the structure, we made a fold to the top forward, and we decorated it with colored pebbles to our liking, I chose the yellow ones, to match the dress.
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260410_134441325.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23vsNg5piM21dgdBicdZgY4UEro76EN4v7zm17388hs4VXaKAUnuWCXyhQqumQLiMrFWM.jpg)
</center>
#
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260410_134550159.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/EoK6Pyuv59AbxYDt5Ye29wvkC4WMAuAVd8Q6nw87JCMVJsm58Nmu4CzdJFGW5UoTT23.jpg)
</center>
#
Friends, I loved how these beautiful Lulu knitted shoes look, my doll.I hope you liked them too, and that you are encouraged to make them for your dolls, for the little ones in your family, or just as an excellent relaxation mechanism.
I say goodbye to you, wishing you a happy and relaxed family weekend.Hugs!
Own photographs.

It is so important to promote activity and entrepreneurship among people over 50. In many parts of the world, particularly in Latin America, there is no place for this age group in the labour market and they are considered old, when in reality they are the people with the most experience. That is why I believe it is so important to hold these conferences; raising awareness and opening up opportunities for everyone is vital.

The topics you’ve covered, particularly those on investment, benefits and risks, are fundamental, as is learning from them. I’m delighted that conferences of this kind are taking place across the country. Thank you, JC, for always bringing us such interesting information and events. A big hug!🤗

Por ello considero tan importante se den estas conferencias, concientizar y abrir posibilidades a todo es mundo es muy importante.

I have always imagined how my life would be if I had unlimited money to myself, how those around me would be bubbling  with enjoyment and luxury. 

![1000385216.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tehilah/AKqanEFPLvnJEdqEW8CDAhkWt4L2TNqo6NEEPaykbJQQWjGJtZsPUECqvi1vF5r.jpg)

body.title: My Daily Blog 2026#099
body.body:
>

![MDB.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/48bWa188f1tGrKwgoTnCuSenBsjChPLBGh5EyGdjR7QxgpK2FS462n1BbokFSWu6Pe.jpg)

Rano skończyłem pracę i wreszcie mogłem zacząć długi weekend (aż do środy). Po wczorajszym nieudanym bieganiu zdecydowałem się na luźny dzień bez treningu. Żona to wykorzystała i wyciągnęła mnie do centrum handlowego „po drobiazgi”. Rzeczywiście kupiliśmy tylko to, co planowała i były to dość szybkie zakupy, ale sam spacer po sklepie IKEA mnie wykończył. Nie wiem, co jest w tym miejscu, ale po przekroczeniu bramek wejściowych czuję się zmęczony. Tamtejsza „ścieżka zdrowia” została tak zaprojektowana, by klient nie mógł niczego przeoczyć i był zmuszony łazić jak zombie przez cały sklep.

> **[ENG] I finished work this morning, marking the start of a long weekend (until Wednesday). After yesterday's unsuccessful run, I decided on a rest day without any training. My wife took advantage of this and dragged me to the shopping mall for \

We actually bought only what she had planned, and it was a fairly quick shopping trip, but the walk through IKEA alone wiped me out. I don't know what it is about that store, but as soon as I pass through the entrance barriers, I’m already exhausted. The \

is designed so that customers can't miss a thing and are forced to wander through the entire store like zombies.** ![IMG_3583.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23xVCzXwbWyQatxhWQ1LM2FnY9dKy5bnWBdSFk9iZWEDWwyzBBv4VfkuVVAS9SdajPpxc.jpg) ![IMG_3585.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23x15EfoTVx19PB4r1nJnkVogqDH7b5818E9SXW8wR9omBXXTJSmQR552wXdThXHT8bhe.jpg) ![IMG_3586.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23xyNgrJev4VHP8BN6tD56K3keQ2KCYU23j75b3HFT3BPEyoxWcfG7rx8dhSrBsQ2nXKX.jpg) Po zakupach czekała nas mała nagroda w postaci kawy i czegoś słodkiego na Grand Place. Przy okazji zauważyliśmy, że na placu rozstawiono namioty, w których różne belgijskie browary sprzedają swoje trunki – to coś w rodzaju festiwalu piwa. Niestety, w przeciwieństwie do tego typu imprez w Polsce, gdzie piwowarzy serwują swoje najnowsze propozycje, w Belgii sprzedawcy stawiają na sprawdzone produkty, które można spotkać na co dzień w każdym supermarkecie. Chodzi tu bardziej o okazję do spotkania ze znajomymi przy piwie niż o odkrywanie nowych smaków. > **[ENG] After shopping, we had a small reward—coffee and something sweet at the Grand Place. We noticed that tents were set up on the square, where various Belgian breweries were selling their beers, a kind of beer festival. Unfortunately, unlike similar festivals in Poland, where brewers serve their latest creations, sellers in Belgium stick to proven products that can be found every day in any supermarket. It's more about the chance to meet friends over a beer than about discovering new flavors.** ![IMG_3589.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23vhyvvKfP4QBqNcqDcWLc6rJy8dKmc5uo5Q9nkmyV9pBNgcuLxpQEdZx6uoovsvyPhVn.jpg) ![IMG_3591.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23ywnxnmZdM3mATy8dsXPVG7WBM1nNHeBSTtd4C3h92nu4hM3cXAgrcuCitnm5gzkVEzw.jpg) ![IMG_3592.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23xyT5Gf5KLpehCfohSjTVkRf3Kf1VpMciTtLrAFwUy3J6g8T6NtHrnGG1v4ySNhMmdUk.jpg) ![IMG_3598.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23uQtsabFKJ6GTcobnFV2AD5nxx7Hed5wJYHyz7iAgViXPBPS5pnAtqJuwXitxZJMD7ZC.jpg) ---

body.title: A Final Goodbye.
body.body: > Aloy returned to the base and shared an emotional hug with Zo to remember Varl. After planning the next mission, Zo led Aloy to Varl's grave on the edge of a hill. Zo revealed she was pregnant with Varl's child, and Aloy promised to protect them both. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfJ7d2tfB6aSxHnGb3XnovaH7dwiAod4XMz4cBrwa98ec/screenshot_1_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWzLpPeboWuAbqgTgEU9JFUXAfhn51p3xsiMzYBn8s8GW/screenshot_2_.png) I had to get back to the base to meet up with the rest of the team. The group was trying to talk through various things while they waited for Aloy to arrive. There was a lot of tension in the room as they discussed their next steps without their leader being present yet. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmULXJ4pMsvjLfgBZZxyLmej8cNPtJk9QVhWDm1GPd1xfv/screenshot_3_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRbzJ37pbrFsRotugSaZWiTj9J7WqLiUmdRzFFRvcC8tT/screenshot_4_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTuvNEe7cVafqER4Q4Kgx2EPW4X7SW2tkcDNGhzqqhYrL/screenshot_5_.png) Suddenly, Aloy reached the perimeter, which attracted everyone's attention immediately. The first thing Aloy did was give a big hug to Zo. It was a very emotional moment because Zo was the closest person to Varl during his last days, and they both missed him very much. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZdVKSUCCLYyvkwuyGgWDtiBnJMjDbqpMpvJnTJQRFuV9/screenshot_6_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQme6NfMjCfc62tKqFPyfwU9YKfKwp6jmKc4H3nr1txNwfN/screenshot_7_.png) After the hug, Aloy told the team about her next plan for the mission. As the meeting ended, Zo asked Aloy to meet her outside the base. It seemed like she had something very urgent and personal to discuss away from the rest of the group. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ1G2Q7TCgKRnMcxTZdWeUUB4m8g4eBsawLYLD5k7zgR2/screenshot_8_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUQ3UMvGXGCG9A5ZWGMRgMLV7sbpxVgMbXsu4z3x1BLvV/screenshot_9_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXm2PWpHXX8TBWUvRDdvvse24unqmkbJfjF4oSmmESfq5/screenshot_10_.png) I went out of the base and started looking for Zo. While I walked, I noticed that this part of the mountain was decorated a little bit. I used the photo mode to look around and eventually found Zo at a side of the hill. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP7w2vqQG8bqk4nXcGuwiDasavd8vhqtyK9AZRjQBrZ5v/screenshot_11_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmToQx47T158CrCcukCURuZscXLVFVPk7ZZdxbcaeDGkNc/screenshot_12_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQVfehUXaN6vwAAsDWZaDJiNjRiHRmzAoVFbo5DTNXxix/screenshot_13_.png) I reached Zo and another cinematic part began. Zo said she used to watch the sunrise with Varl from that exact point on the hill. She also mentioned that they had buried Varl right there, making it a very sacred and quiet spot for her. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmecX2KVgLyTi15UtHTy9NvrMjt1R3BGqd1FN1GVzBwbDp/screenshot_14_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYgbdzX2N7W5f4Y4voHK7PdccNQoPgK34sNqoyJpiPEvL/screenshot_15_.png) After a brief conversation, Zo revealed that she was pregnant with Varl's child. This news made Aloy feel happy but also very sad. It was a tragedy that Varl never got to know the good news about starting a family before he passed away. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ9AbhdjGxXqMFcGjKaEdtWyhPHLnbNTp4EeZW7k3zaib/screenshot_16_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQe87eH8Gw7sP42DeZV3yBnTqJM4USXScYywSS2QLsb4A/screenshot_17_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf8q5orpXomBomHyDBVFnkr48xxr8PSoVrn1ZQUnyQZfD/screenshot_18_.png) As Zo left Aloy behind to go back inside, Aloy stayed by the grave. She looked at the site and promised Varl that she would look after Zo and the child. Then Aloy left the peaceful place to go toward her next mission. --- The next post will be coming soon. Screenshots are my take from the game and I took the game logo that I used on the thumbnail picture from online. SEE YOU. --- ▶️ [3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=frankevor/870e0af6)

body.title: LOOK DOWN 👇 I'M RIGHT AT HIS FEET
body.body:
‎Greetings pals.. I still remain your loyal and most respected brother and handsome friend John Petra. Let's reflect more on life as a special gift from Yahweh.

If the enemy can't pull you away from God's presence, he'll try so much to harden your heart ❤️. Don't let hurt rewrite your character, instead kindly allow God to get you refined.

![IMG-20260315-WA0003_2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/johnpetra/23xKzo5ByP7a47JNniJSeaCWjpk94X75RNSDpAri6KivVd7VE26ABobiwREAxir6Wdq2R.jpg)


In my life, the highest place I want to be is at the feet of Jesus Christ.
‎Father, Lord God, I come before You with a humble heart. Strip away anything in me that is not of You. Teach me to live low so that You can be lifted high.
‎
‎Lord, I surrender everything. My thoughts, my plans, my desires, my past, my future, it all belongs to You. Keep me far from pride and ego. When they try to rise up, remind me of the cross. Remind me of who I used to be, and who You have called me to be.
‎
‎Father God, give me strength in the valleys. When life feels heavy, when the road feels long, remind me that You are walking with me. You never leave me, You never forsake me. Build endurance in me. Build perseverance in me. Shape me in the hard seasons.

![IMG-20260313-WA0005.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/johnpetra/Eq9XFzvXxEbagLgN4o8a49f2StbbjtnHZb8NyPGTsTcLZbQ8VSkmSdUq2PP1mW4d9U7.jpg)

‎
‎Thank You, Lord, for everything You have done in my life. Thank You for Your grace, Your mercy, and Your patience with me. Thank You for opening my eyes when I was blind. Thank You for helping me see the beauty in the small things, the everyday moments that used to pass me by.
‎
‎The man I used to be, full of pride and ego, has been crucified at the cross. I am not that man anymore. I am made new through the blood of Jesus Christ, through His death and His resurrection. And today, I choose to walk in that new life.
‎
‎Father, keep my heart soft, my spirit teachable, and my eyes fixed on You. The highest place I want to be is right at Your feet.
‎
‎Today, slow down and take a moment to kneel before the Lord, whether physically or in your heart. Lay down your pride, your worries, your need for control, and give it all to Him. Let gratitude fill your spirit and remind yourself that who you used to be is not who you are anymore through Jesus Christ. Walk in humility, walk in surrender, and watch how God begins to transform your life from the inside out.
‎
You're reading from your handsome friend John Petra... Remain blessed and stay safe in love, unity and progress.

body.title: Działki dla wszystkich
body.body:
Tylko jedna dostawę zrobiłem tego dnia. Ogólnie to trwała tego dnia moja wściekłość na hamulce SRAM level (za przeproszeniem, nazwa własna). Inna sprawa, że sam jestem sobie winny. WD-40 itp może pomogło przy osi i śrubach, ale zaszkodziło tarczy hamulcowej. Skorzystałem z okazji i pojechałem zdobywać leśne kwadraty w lasach Ludolfiny (na granicy z Sopotem). Dawno tam nie byłem. Potem skusiły mnie kolejne niezaliczone kwadraty I tak znalazłem się na... działkach. Była otwarta furtka to zacząłem wszerz i wzdłuż jeździć drogami między działkami. Ale to nie koniec... ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/c269d360-bbdf-4371-b847-2ff9ed6a81b9.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/c4b56a99-4364-4ad0-a288-7a9d9181f6cb.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/865681a5-4331-46ec-88f8-8f4305b5cc0d.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/2145b229-a077-45ad-866f-f58f7e34a648.jpg) Potem znów zajechałem do lasu i od tej strony znalazłem się w ciekawym Urbexie - terenie dawnego szpitala gruźliczego. Ciekawy modernistyczny, przedwojenny budynek. A jeszcze ładniejszy jest tam relikt parku romantycznego ze stawem. Ciekawe było natknąć się na ochroniarza w skodzie do którego podjechałem : - dzień dobry, przepraszam jak stąd wyjechać ? - yyy aaaa ale jak pan tu wjechał No od strony lasu wjechałem. Nie było ogrodzenia, sarenki śmigały a ja puszczałem moim hamulcem, który teraz jest już na śmietniku :). ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/718a89a5-b7f8-4862-848f-a9b9e6c4462b.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8353b97e-a0a7-4bfb-a176-bac85e3daed1.jpg) Zarobiłem podczas tej wycieczki 11 złotych. Mandatu nie dostałem.

body.title: The  killer called  comfort: How to navigate unfamiliar circumstances
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSM4qpR8vwojNXj7s8rXGgViRqke1rJbfi9H5NJjKR9kK/images%203.jpeg 
[source](https://www.freepik.com/premium-vector/man-is-laying-couch_377318325.htm)


I hate to be comfortable, does that mean I like been uncomfortable?,  yes but not literally, so the context I'm  coming from is that of a growth mindset, I don't  like to  stay rooted at a place or a thing for too long more than necessary, I love travels, I love to go on to explore, to dare new things and experience  new heights, this is because I believe life is to be lived foreward progressively,  where everyday is a better version of the previous  day, where things are not the same, where everything  is always improved upon, I hate familiar patterns,  repeated routine over time and again, I love innovations new ideas leveling up because life is constantly  changing,

But here's  a thing life is filled with  so much uncertainties it often feels risky in taking the next unfamiliar move,  that's  why we often wants a situation  where things are okay atleast have an edge or a clue before  we love or initiate something, it's  very difficult  to launch out especially  in an unfamiliar  territory or circumstances hence the urge to stay rooted or fixed at a place, the issue with this kind of life is that  everything  feels  okay and stable at the moment and that feeling can linger for so long you can forget where or what you were aiming for.

my pastor had to illustrate this to us one time, he said God's  word tells us we're  great,  then there is  an expected  end, but between  what the word had said and it's  manifestation  there is a trial  period, to taste us or say molding process  to make us fit, however some people  can linger so long in the molding process till they normalize  or come to accept whatever life  had thrown at them, so they just adapt amd grow into that situation  and stay comfortable,  meanwhile  the greater purpose of who they are suppose to be is far better than now, so what happened is that  they just accepted  the norm letting go of who they are suppose to be...
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUae6iXFwgr8fAnV9AygSacmkFax9uoziagq1gwkLwsyt/images%202.jpeg 
[source](https://www.freepik.com/premium-vector/man-is-laying-couch_377318325.htm)

comfort is a killer, but it happens  in a very subtle way you rarely  notice, it will relegate you to the background and make you comfortable  in that situation,  gradually you can forget who you were meant to be, if the prodigal son didn't  realise on time his real state and returned  to the father he would have normalize his condition  at the time ..

some times we called it moving on when what you expected isn't  coming fort but in reality  could we have put in  a little  effort and  not buying  into the   the comfort of the moments  would have made a difference....


we see this a lot people  settling into a life that wasn't in the picture  just because  certain  factors  never played out and instead of forging ahead, fighting  it, they choose to be comfortable instead and allow other dreams and aspiration  die....

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmPS5wANwMuNexx6qcan8cEhnmokoWLVmWaexadjpuQb9n/20260410_212446.jpg 
[source](https://www.shutterstock.com/image-vector/happy-man-sitting-on-comfortable-couch-2261669379)

I want you to challenge  the norm and by all means  continue to evolve, do everything  to add value to yourself,  there is always a better version of you, there's always  something better , there's  more  if only you let it. 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmcV65vbANkWtgqEMTejQ3sNx8T1WgjpVuAZNb43YR5poe/20250611_132658.jpg

body.title: zucchini bread sandwich[ENG/ESP]
body.body:
>
![post hive (51).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23wgWaxtM8mRzPM8sAnM9S2LscKjHPQKZxZPWtmDY5HQ84ML7tPGXi5x1KEfcBtYBbnNL.png)
## I'm back!😍 I missed making my recipes, friends. You have no idea how tough these past few days have been, but hey, everything in its own time. Here I am again with a new recipe for all of you food lovers. If you love bread but are on a diet and can’t eat gluten, here’s the perfect recipe for a delicious breakfast sandwich—easy to make, nutritious, and best of all, delicious. This is a recipe I found online, of course. I’d saved it days ago, but for one reason or another, I hadn’t been able to make it. Today I decided to give it a try, and now I’m sharing it with you. Let’s see how to make this delicious **Zucchini Bread**. # Ingredients: - 1 zucchini - 1 cup rolled oats - A pinch of salt and pepper - 2 eggs - 2 tablespoons whole wheat flour
![post hive (4).gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23ynb7S3eYDibp3gcDSWboY45VMsavEVFLYZowwruYpJdiwAPjdKyRUwamycKCjaP3s5e.gif)
### Preparation: The first step is to wash and grate the zucchini. We need to squeeze out all the liquid—make sure you do this; it’s essential. Believe me, I know what I’m talking about, haha. This time, I made sure to squeeze it out thoroughly. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23uFPgMAVZXFkYMU7a2VxmJ6YwGtpd3YPNJkKLF3JKhi2QtjGPWhuuVZfnTke8wn8RMB1.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23xp227Xwdh2BuiieiDv3qLkw5j7nmDoUAGqajf1zbm4T1RTgyFoaHDuTirmrCJZMRzeC.png) |-|-| Next, we’ll add the egg, along with the oat flour, salt, and pepper. I decided to add two tablespoons of whole wheat flour as an optional ingredient—you can leave it out—but I also decided to add another egg since the mixture was turning out too dry.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/EpLfWPfqaAFSNzGQXjL4AbiSjrcSQ3n3o8hxScaR8sURdbUrAKRgrPmffC9cQ8KJY3j.png)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/EonjyMfPPLgWsHa3mnhdqRfjJdixqoZwXyTC2yktKMiZiryvqcMtyKwS5P6xrZ8K4bJ.png)
Now that our mixture is ready, we’ll place it on a baking sheet and spread it out like this. 👇 Bake it for about 20 to 25 minutes.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/Eo8TQ2Dw62pxyuVVRtgvDWDPy8DZYTvEK1XNfhexpK4rk2ePUh3jHvtWntTqKWhSuNS.png)
Let it rest for a few more minutes, then cut it into four pieces.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/EokeYy8JxH6zEfpZiqu1NhWuD7VvbX6BZn6pPL4Cxuez3FQ1sQUqYZ5zQRgaaWRe9Ej.png)
And finally, we’ll put it in the toaster to toast the bread so it’s perfect for a sandwich.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/EpCBR7b6ba9wez6AvhmLqduKhPJ4H8PsGXVskmDTrxB7ZqkRmYxnS7t9tnWpXnJxq3x.png)
You can fill it with whatever you like. As you can see, it’s easy to make, and if it tastes good—well, I liked it, hehehe—and best of all, it’s filling. 😅
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/EpJZdzQAm4KaZPeXe5pqDfvBuyRLgY76WRrmtgeCBDF7dsErcA9BtjgB6zHW5JzKThk.png)
Have you tried it? What do you think? If you’re up for it, let me know. 👇
SPANISH VERSION

## ¡He vuelto!😍 Extrañaba hacer mis recetas, amigos, no saben lo duro que han sido estos días, pero bueno, todo a su tiempo, aquí me encuentro de nuevo, con una nueva receta, para todos ustedes, amantes del buen comer, si te gusta comer pan, pero esta a dieta, y no puedes comer gluten, aquí te traigo la receta perfecta, para desayunar con un rico sándwich, fácil de hacer, nutritivo, y lo mejor, rico. Esta es una receta, que por supuesto vi por internet, la tenia días guardada, pero no por cosas, no había podido hacerla, ahora hoy me decidí a probar, y ahora se las traigo, veamos como se prepara este rico **Pan de calabacín**. # Ingredients: - 1 Calabacín - 1 taza de harina de avena - Pizca de sal y pimienta - 2 huevos - 2 cucharadas de harina integral

![post hive (4).gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23ynb7S3eYDibp3gcDSWboY45VMsavEVFLYZowwruYpJdiwAPjdKyRUwamycKCjaP3s5e.gif)
### Preparation: El primer paso es lavar y rallar nuestro calabacín, a este le vamos a sacar todo el liquido, asegúrense de esto, es fundamental, si lo sabré yo jajaja, esta vez me asegure exprimirlo lo suficiente. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23uFPgMAVZXFkYMU7a2VxmJ6YwGtpd3YPNJkKLF3JKhi2QtjGPWhuuVZfnTke8wn8RMB1.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23xp227Xwdh2BuiieiDv3qLkw5j7nmDoUAGqajf1zbm4T1RTgyFoaHDuTirmrCJZMRzeC.png) |-|-| Luego le añadiremos el huevo, junto con la harina de avena, sal y pimienta, yo decidí agregarle opcional, dos cucharadas de harina integral, ustedes pueden omitirlo, sin embargo, también decidí agregar otro huevo, ya que la mezcla me estaba quedando seca.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/EpLfWPfqaAFSNzGQXjL4AbiSjrcSQ3n3o8hxScaR8sURdbUrAKRgrPmffC9cQ8KJY3j.png)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/EonjyMfPPLgWsHa3mnhdqRfjJdixqoZwXyTC2yktKMiZiryvqcMtyKwS5P6xrZ8K4bJ.png)
Ya con nuestra mezcla lista, lo vamos a colocar en una bandeja, y expandirla alli, de esta forma. 👇 Lo llevamos al horno por unos 20 o 25 minutos.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/Eo8TQ2Dw62pxyuVVRtgvDWDPy8DZYTvEK1XNfhexpK4rk2ePUh3jHvtWntTqKWhSuNS.png)
Dejamos reposar por otros minutos, lo vamos a cortar en cuatro partes.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/EokeYy8JxH6zEfpZiqu1NhWuD7VvbX6BZn6pPL4Cxuez3FQ1sQUqYZ5zQRgaaWRe9Ej.png)
Y finalmente lo llevaremos a nuestra tostadora, para sellar nuestro pan, y que quede como un pan de sándwich.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/EpCBR7b6ba9wez6AvhmLqduKhPJ4H8PsGXVskmDTrxB7ZqkRmYxnS7t9tnWpXnJxq3x.png)
Lo pueden rellenar con lo que gusten, como ven, es facil de preparar, y si queda rico, bueno a mi me gusto jejeje, y lo mejor, es que llena.😅
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/EpJZdzQAm4KaZPeXe5pqDfvBuyRLgY76WRrmtgeCBDF7dsErcA9BtjgB6zHW5JzKThk.png)

body.title: Increased integration is how AI companies will become profitable
body.body:
![019d5c78-2d15-792a-9d99-402ca8bb1650.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/badbitch/23tmN6XaUYbMTX7LZcwviiBU649NngR3d6kebTrho7BYJniG5ycHXSzs8g9rpqAUAKLXy.webp)

I just want to say this before getting into the details. AI companies will become profitable with increased integration because how people use AI will evolve significantly with it.

Now, moving forward.

The average person that's come in contact with AI uses it as a search engine with summarization. If not this, they are either generating random images or videos.

Writing code, well, that's not exactly \

territory.

It is a little comical when you come to really think about it. This is supposed to be some truly powerful technology, one which the Department of Defense of the United States wants full control over, so badly, but the average person is probably asking it to write a love text, fix grammar error, look up trending stories, or generate media that's bringing lots of AI hate because social media addicts now have to deal with mass-produced AI media.

The reality is humbling. It is somewhat a reminder that most people are clueless about what they'd do with much advanced tech we only see in the movies.

### The environment factor

If I have to open an AI chat bot, I already have something I want to do there in mind. This is limitation.

The reason it is a limitation is because I will remain in whatever bubble I've always been in and what I use the AI for will consistently remain within things I'm familiar or at least comfortable with. This is my environment.

If I'm an email marketer, I'll mostly use it for that. If I don't work a job that would generally need scaling with tech on my part, then I'll mostly only ever come to these apps to see what's trending, ask a question because it came up in a conversation and it didn't feel like an inconvenience to do so at the time.

You can see how this is a limitation. I truly don't have a \

reason to use these apps. It could go away today and I'll be fine. The translation here is that for people like me, AI companies are burning billions for nothing. So they need help.

### Integration changes things

Contrary to what people think, integration isn't always about making it convenient for people to access and use things. It is sometimes (if not most times) a forced feature that brings more revenue.

Take the X app for instance. At lot less people know Grok than ChatGPT. But Grok is integrated into the X app and that exposes it to much more people.

Now people can tap a simple icon besides a post on X, and use Grok AI to fact-check a post. The algorithm is now supposedly powered by Grok, and with auto translate enabled on posts, it's possible that's also powered by Grok.

These are all little ways people are interacting or using the same AI they'd normally never download. 

Now, all of the above are simple examples of integration. We have to see AI integration move into ways that they are basically one with systems people use every day.

In this way, monetization becomes easier.

The solution is no longer AI, it's the integrated features that enables people do different things, both things they are previously familiar with and new.

body.title: The fallen one - The Tale of James - ENG- SPA
body.body: > Losing everything you've achieved after so much effort is always very sad, because you surely had to make many sacrifices to get there. But there's something much worse, and even sadder: losing it all through your own fault. It could be because of your actions or decisions that sooner or later shatter what you've accomplished. Both of these things happened to James, and having to live with it was very sad, even for the people who once loved him. It happened a while ago, but it feels almost like it was yesterday. Before it all happened, he was a great rock guitarist. Since he joined the band, they both shone brightly. In the beginning, he was one of the band's biggest contributors of song ideas, and several of his suggestions ended up becoming the band's biggest hits. At that point in his life, no one could have imagined the turn everything was about to take. For some time, he continued with the band, steadily rising in fame and in the music industry. But then the problems began. He occasionally started drinking a lot of rum. He'd never been much of a drinker, but he was having problems at home with his partner and was relieving stress by drinking a little. Since it was only occasionally, it didn't initially affect his work or his relationship with the band. Everything seemed fine. But as time went on, James began to unravel. His problems with his partner were actually due to his own choices; it wasn't her fault. She was almost never home because she was on tour, and her presence was missed. In the end, his partner left with their children, and he was left alone.

> Perder todo lo que has logrado luego de mucho esfuerzo siempre es muy triste, porque seguro se tuvieron que hacer muchos sacrificios para llegar lejos. Pero hay algo mucho peor y es incluso aún más triste, perderlo todo por tu propia culpa. Puede ser por tus acciones o por decisiones que tarde o temprano rompen lo que has logrado. A James le sucedieron ambas cosas, y tuvo que vivir con ello fue muy triste, incluso hasta para las personas que una vez lo amaron. Sucedió hace ya un poco de tiempo pero se siente casi como su hubiera pasado ayer. Antes de ocurrir todo el era un gran guitarrista de rock. Desde que se unió a la banda juntos llegaron a brillar. En la banda al principio el era uno de los que más aportaba ideas para canciones, varias de sus sugerencias terminaron convirtiéndose en los mejores éxitos que tuvo la banda. En esa parte de su vida nadie se imaginaba el giro que todo daría. Por algún tiempo más continuó con la banda cada vez subiendo más en la fama y en la música. Pero entonces comenzaron a llegar los problemas. Ocasionalmente empezó a tomar mucho ron. El nunca había sido persona de tomar mucho pero estaba teniendo problemas en casa con su pareja y se quitaba el estrés tomando un poco. Como era solo ocasionalmente no afectó en un inicio su trabajo ni su relación la banda. Todo marchaba bien en apariencias. Pero a medida que fue pasando el tiempo James comenzó a desestabilizarse. Sus problemas con su pareja en realidad eran a causa de sus propias decisiones, no era culpa de ella. Casi nunca estaba en casa porque estaba de gira y su presencia en el hogar hacía falta. Al final su pareja se fue con sus hijos y el se quedó solo.
![joshua-hanson-AMUzdK0tct8-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nelsoncu/23tGTqsnkhaD4XG5uW6fS35yU2fHVxjzjfbWRCPRvbv9QMLTTHrRyvFfqWRkjPprpfKwp.jpg) ...Free image from Pixabay...

> After that change in his life, he began drinking rum more heavily. What had initially been just occasional became a daily habit, almost all day long. Up until that point, this bad habit hadn't affected his career, but now it was starting to cause problems. He began arriving at rehearsals drunk, or nearly so. Because he was quite skilled with the guitar, even after a few drinks, he could still play at those rehearsals. So, although his friends were wary, they didn't say anything, because he was doing his job. But they knew he was on the wrong track and couldn't continue like that or he would ruin his career. That's why they tried to help him improve his relationship. They gave him more time off to sort out his problems at home. But instead of trying to repair the relationship, he kept drinking; he refused to budge or do anything. It was a fatal decision that would end up damaging his entire future. There was a big concert that had been in the works for months. The concert was to celebrate the city's anniversary. And the band had been hired for this big moment. They would be paid a large sum and, moreover, would have the opportunity to reach a wide audience. The other band members went to great lengths to tell him that for this occasion he had to be sober, absolutely no drunk. They knew it was unlikely he'd arrive completely sober, but at least they hoped he wouldn't drink too much. Besides, he had played well on other occasions even after having a few drinks. But disaster was practically inevitable. James arrived almost at the time the concert was scheduled to start, but this time completely drunk. But his friends didn't notice because he didn't look it. So when he went on stage and they started playing, he made a complete fool of himself, falling to the ground and being unable to play properly. So the concert had to be canceled and couldn't continue. The band was left looking ridiculous because they couldn't keep their promise.

> Luego de ese cambio en su vida comenzó a tomar más ron de forma más intensiva. Lo que al principio fue solo casual ya comenzó a ser diariamente y casi todas horas. Hasta ese momento este mal habito que había adquirido no había afectado su carrera pero ahora si comenzó a crear conflictos. En algunos ensayos comenzó a llegar ebrio, o casi ebrio. Como tenía buena habilidad con la guitarra incluso con algunos tragos de más podía aún tocar en esos ensayos. Por eso aunque sus amigos lo veían con recelo no le decían nada, porque cumplía con lo que había que hacer. Pero ellos sabían que el iba por mal camino y no podía seguir así si no echaría a perder su carrera. Por eso intentaron ayudarlo para que mejorara su situación con su pareja. Le dieron más tiempo libre, para que arreglara sus problemas en casa. Pero él en vez de buscar reparar la relación siguió tomando, no quiso ceder ni hacer nada. Fue una decisión fatal que terminaría dañando todo su futuro. Había un gran concierto que se llevaba preparando desde hacía meses. Ese concierto eran para celebrar un aniversario de creación de la ciudad. Y la banda había sido contratada para ese gran momento. Les pagarían una gran suma y además podrían darse a conocer a muchas personas. Los demás miembros de la banda se esforzaron mucho en decirle que para esta ocasión debía estar limpio de ron, nada de llegar ebrio. Ellos sabían que era difícil que llegara completamente limpio pero al menos esperaban que no tomara tanto. Además él en otras ocasiones había tocado bien incluso con tragos encima. Pero el desastre ya estaba casi anunciado. James llegó casi a la hora de empezar el concierto pero esta vez completamente borracho. Pero sus amigos no se dieron cuenta porque él no lo aparentaba. Así que cuando subió al escenario y comenzaron a tocar el hizo un papelazo, se calló al suelo y no podía tocar bien. Así que el concierto debió cancelarse y no se pudo continuar. La banda quedó en ridículo porque no pudo cumplir con lo prometido.
![anthony-delanoix-hzgs56Ze49s-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nelsoncu/23wqnKoyGfsehHYJgTj9k4ZwXzBGNxwfZsjfXDZogVJbt6vmuhZcXuYHbrmVrxL8K18tR.jpg) ...Free image from Pixabay...

> The band had to break up because they didn't have a guitarist. It was a complete disaster. But the consequences would be even greater for James. He was the one who caused it all. That's why the band had to say goodbye with great sorrow. It was very hard for them because they cared about him a lot. But he never took it seriously. So in one day he lost everything: his career, his reputation, his fans. The event was a huge wake-up call for James, because in the midst of everything he created, he was able to recognize that our actions have consequences. He may change, he may not. But if he doesn't, he'll know that his career as a guitarist has come to an end.

> Al banda tuvo que rice porque no tenían guitarrista. Fue un completo desastre. Pero las consecuencias serían mayores para James. El había sido el causante de todo. Por eso la banda tuvo que con mucho dolor despedirlo. Fue muy duro para ellos porque lo apreciaban mucho. Pero el nunca se lo tomó en serio. Así que en un día perdió todo. Su carrera, su reputación, su fans. El evento fue un gran llamado a atención para James, porque en medio de todo lo que creó pudo reconocer que nuestras acciones tienen consecuencias. Puede que cambie, puede que no. Pero si no lo hace sabrá que su carrera como guitarrista ha llegado a su fin.
![alessandro-armignacco-Tw-xCMlq6qM-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nelsoncu/23w2oLAatkuMvoTVEPqh5fkCMXUqbLaSqWCLE1Xi7UX7XWuW55epwXKVzbvaK2cPC4Z8g.jpg) ...Free image from Pixabay...

> This post is completely original and my own. No programs have been used to edit the text or correct the grammar. I wrote it exactly as you read it. The English version was translated using Google Translate. Esta publicación es completamente original, y de mi autoría. NO se han usado programas para modificar el texto o para reparar la gramática. Tal cual lo lees así lo escribí. La versión en ingles fue traducida usando Google traductor.

body.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1775852724538-55412e04b7270696.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=aliento/dfca6ee7) ▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=aliento/dfca6ee7) ---
![1000898451.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliento/23ynQbJgzeSbLqggJae1eMQtzJcSqmhzvvsGiibSeYLLgUyKbHdvJY9wbMCN9jqSFWpaR.png)
---
¡Saludos, comunidad! Cuando hablamos de Seguridad, por lo general algunos sienten miedo, ansiedad o nerviosismo, lo que resulta una reacción contradictoria. Aprender sobre seguridad, no debería ponernos nerviosos, si no más bien un poco más confiados, pues tampoco podemos irnos a otro extremo, y siempre debemos usar los métodos de seguridad necesarios aún cuando creamos saber mucho sobre el tema. Desde Aliento, lanzamos una publicación llamada: [Seguridad en Hive: Lo que no puedes ignorar](https://peakd.com/hive-110011/@aliento/seguridad-en-hive-or-lo-que-no-puedes-ignorar), la cual te invitamos a leer (si no lo has hecho), donde compartimos una serie de pasos y tips para cuidar nuestras cuentas y activos. La seguridad en Web3 no se trata de vivir con miedo, sino de desarrollar buenos hábitos para así poder estar más seguros. Acciones básicas como: 👉🏻 Revisar los enlaces antes de hacer clic en ellos. 👉🏻 No compartir tus llaves, claves, frases semillas o contraseñas. 👉🏻 Usar solo herramientas confiables. Pueden marcar una gran diferencia en la protección de tu cuenta. No necesitas saberlo todo para empezar, pero sí prestar atención a lo que haces cada día dentro del ecosistema. Algo muy importante es que, el hecho de que aunque aprendas sobre seguridad y la pongas en práctica, no significa que ya estamos totalmente protegidos o exentos de caer en alguna estafa, ser víctimas de hackeos o perder nuestras llaves, pero sí nos ayuda a estar protegidos, atentos ante posibles ataques y baja las posibilidades de que nos pase algunas de esas cosas. ***Recuerda: ¡No se trata de temer, se trata de aprender y cuidar!***
