body.title: New Tunes 🎵 🎸 10.4.2026 🎤🎺
body.body:
## Hello music lovers! 🎶  
 
It's a Friday and time for #newtunes! A fresh selection of music featuring well-known, lesser-known, and even unknown artists who are trying to get a few minutes of our time.
Is there even a future global hit among them? You won't know until you listen :)  
 
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXhSuHhYF6JetoAMbNZCovT5D8DLnTUuZoh3RuJWNbRqs/nt.10.4.2026.logo.webp)

Eight songs for curious music lovers! If you like something, you can dig deeper to find more detailed information.
If you don't like, skip it. 
 
**Music4life!**  
 
<center>🎵 🎧 🎵</center>  
 
## Opus Kink - Come Over, Do Me Wrong

Opus Kink is an English band from Brighton, UK. They’ve been playing since 2017 and have released three EPs. A new band for me. They started out as a jazz band but quickly shifted to a gritty mix of punk, jazz, country, and cabaret. The horn section gives their music a unique, chaotic, and jazzy character.
The song 'Come Over, Do Me Wrong' is the lead single for their debut studio album, The Sweet Goodbye. A funky post-punk mix of tension and energy. I’ll be keeping an eye on them; they seem like one of the most original British bands I’ve heard lately.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1JD5wfuO3XQ

<center>🎵 🎧 🎵</center>  
 
## Jack White: G.O.D. And The Broken Ribs (Live) - SNL

Jack White (White Stripes, The Raconteurs, and others) has been performing as a solo artist since 2012. Garage rock, blues, country, experimental sounds, and a DIY ethos still define his work. 
The song 'G.O.D. And The Broken Ribs' is, following six solo albums, a new single released a week ago, and performed live for the first time on SNL TV. It’s classic Jack White, featuring a powerful two-chord guitar riff, organ, and preacher-style vocals, telling an apocalyptic story that blends the beginning and the end of the world.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VOyLzSv3mYE


<center>🎵 🎧 🎵</center>  

## Kurt Vile - Chance to Bleed 

Kurt Vile is an American singer, songwriter, multi-instrumentalist, and producer from Philadelphia. He has been performing since 2003 and is also known as the founder of the band War On Drugs, which he later left to pursue a solo career, releasing nine studio albums. He is highly regarded in the indie scene for his laid-back, hypnotic “dazed and confused” style, featuring heavy guitar riffs and a lo-fi aesthetic.
The song 'Chance to Bleed' is a preview of his new, tenth album, 'Philadelphia’s Been Good to Me,' set for release at the end of May. It features a groovy, easy rhythm, multiple guitars, and nostalgic lyrics about returning to the basics of creation.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FDq6YTeldcY


<center>🎵 🎧 🎵</center>  

## GHINZU - Snow White (Official Video)

Ghinzu is a Belgian band from Brussels. They have been playing since 1999 and have released three studio albums to date. They are known for their eclectic sound, which blends indie, art, noise, and groovy elements. After seventeen years, they’ve released a new single, 'Snowy White,' which serves as a preview for their fourth album, W.O.W.A. (When Other Worlds Await), scheduled for late May. The song is a dynamic triptych that explores various addictions.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BOpIauP_LkE


<center>🎵 🎧 🎵</center>
 
## HEADSEND - Do Do

Headsend is a young Australian rock trio formed in 2024; so far, they have released one EP, Angel Glands, featuring five tracks, in late March of this year. Their sound is rooted in ’90s grunge and nostalgic indie rock. They quickly won over audiences with their captivating, energetic live performances. A new band for me.
The song 'Do Do' is a single from the EP, a raw yet polished, modern grunge sound that gets stuck in your head and won’t let go for a while. Pure rock, if you ask me. Someone described them as 'Qotsa, Interpol, and Nirvana had a beautiful baby' :)

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZNq4uPBFoQw

<center>🎵 🎧 🎵</center>  
 
## Waagal - Rising || Handpan Didgeridoo Synth Asalato Neotone Multitasking One man Band

I’ve always liked one-man bands, especially when I’ve heard them live. Last week I came across this one. Waagal, or Erwann Texier-Harth, is a French multi-instrumentalist and one-man band from Bordeaux. Since 2014, he has been creating unique world-fusion music that blends various ethnic and contemporary elements, including the handpan, didgeridoo, asalato, kalimba, synthesizers, throat singing, and more. He plays multiple instruments simultaneously, creating a rich and hypnotic sound. To date, he has released several EPs and four albums. 
The song 'Rising' is a new standalone single, released at the end of March. I’ll definitely be keeping an eye on him.
 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pf5evMxRf7o


<center>🎵 🎧 🎵</center>

## Jon Spencer - Knock 'Em Out

Jon Spencer is an American musician, singer, and guitarist, and is considered an icon of garage rock. I’ve been following him since his early days in 1985 when he played in the noise rock band Pussy Galore, and from 1991 to 2016 as the explosive blues/rock/punk trio Jon Spencer Blues Explosion; I’ve seen him live three times, most recently about six years ago with the band HITmakers. Across all his projects, he has released more than 20 albums.
The song 'Knock 'Em Out' is a preview of his new solo album, Songs of Personal Loss and Protest, which is set to be released in June. To me, it sounds like the old Blues Explosion - still that unstoppable energy and rage, wrapped up in rock'n'garage'n'punk. I'm looking forward to the album.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0OnqAaDNXwI


<center>🎵 🎧 🎵</center>  
 
##  I'm Waiting for the Man - The Velvet Underground Live 1969 (4K)

And finally, something a bit old-school: one of the rare recordings of The Velvet Underground from 1969. The AnalogAnarchy channel combined audio recorded at the End of Cole Ave club in Dallas on October 19 with 8mm film footage from October 15, 1969, at the Dallas Peace Moratorium, a protest against the Vietnam War.
Since the original performance at the protest didn’t have synchronized audio, they created a sync - the song matches up very well (based on lip-reading and comparing the performances). The result is a 4K remaster (upscaled and processed for modern resolution), which gives the feeling of watching a real live performance from the 1960s in high quality.
As a longtime fan, I think it’s awesome! :)

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XwgkhIkSZFo

<center>🎵 🎧 🎵</center>
 
🎶 That should be all for today, thanks for your attention, and enjoy your weekend with new songs!

body.title: Dailyprompt: analyst of what?
body.body:
I was so happy that I finally got my job after so many years of being a graduate.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcRJAF9WL5thansDLq7NcaBrGJ6ugPYMuYwoEc5zqYvEk/1775849945247.png)
[Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/vectors/business-calculation-finance-audit-6680123/)

The first day of my work as an accountant, I was arranging my decks in the office. The secretary came and said the boss wanted me to come and do an analysis.

I was just thinking, analysis of what?
I was thinking what should be the analysis?
I'm just resuming from work today. I just started working today. What is the analysis for? Analysis for what in particular?

So it was a very tight situation and I was confused.  I'm getting to where my boss is. Just called me that I should just analyze a few data for him and it was just a calculation. The secretary made it as if it was such a big deal of analyzing a big chart or things concerning the company.

I was lost. I was so happy that it was just a simple calculation and everything and I was able to solve the problem and went back to my office.

body.title: What The Policies Of Central Banks Are Doing In 2026 is doing to gold prices
body.body:
**What The Policies Of Central Banks Are Doing In 2026 is doing to gold prices**  
**Gold Demand**  
Global gold demand is still driven by central banks. Their policies immediately affect gold bullion prices and the [gold live market](https://aubullion.com/product-category/1-oz-silver-bars).  
Gold rates were affected by severe monetary tightening and currency interventions in 2026. As central banks raise interest rates, gold loses value since it does not pay interest.  
The goal of central banks to hold on to gold has not changed in February, as they bought a net 27t. This was an improvement over the slow month of January, and it was about the same as the monthly average of 26t seen in 2025. Central banks have bought 31t so far this year, which is a lot less than they did at the same time last year.  
**Key Effects of the Central Bank on Gold in 2026**  
• Emerging market central banks, especially those from China, Russia, and India, are continuing to move their savings away from the US dollar. They see gold as an important non-sovereign safe-haven asset and are diversifying their holdings.  
• Central banks are likely to buy between 800 and 850 tonnes of gold in 2026, even though prices are higher. This will keep long-term demand high.  
• Policy and \

and want to protect themselves from global risks and possible penalties. This keeps demand at the central bank high.  
• Impact of Interest Rates: Central banks are still building up their stocks, and decisions made by the Federal Reserve about rates (like the rate cuts that are expected in 2026) are expected to keep investment demand high and keep price drops from falling too sharply.  
**Effects on Silver and Metals**  
• Silver is indirectly affected by central bank actions. 100oz, 10oz, and [1 oz silver bars](https://aubullion.com/product-category/1-oz-silver-bars) and coins follow gold's price.  
• The price of silver bullion rises with industrial demand but follows gold's trajectory.  
**Global Mints and Refiners**  
Major mints and refiners affect supply networks. Institutions trust [Pamp Suisse](https://aubullion.com/product-category/pamp-suisse) and Valcambi for large-scale gold production. Retail bullion investors use the Perth Mint and the British Royal Mint.  
[Gold prices](https://aubullion.com/live-gold-prices) are driven by central bank policy in 2026. Knowing their effects helps investors purchase gold bars, grams, or follow the gold live market.

body.title: From Survival to Humanity: Can We Reclaim Our Values Before It's Too Late?
body.body: Change is constant, and as the world evolves, so do humans and their behavior. While positive changes exist, negative ones are equally prevalent—from assault to fraud and crimes once uncommon. Daily reports showcase violence against children and \

by vigilantes punishing suspected thieves. These consequences stem from a system and government that have failed their people. Suffering has become a catalyst, transforming individuals into versions of themselves they never intended to become.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeZGZUD6HqsTd7izTrLkEidEhn6v6ZM9Rra2w9e6zT4Gb/1775819925634.png)

**Image generated using Gemini AI**

Moral decline has become normalized. Stealing and corruption are labeled as shrewdness, while the honest and dedicated face ridicule. Society has adapted to a survival mentality where morality gradually transforms into what's now considered acceptable. While collective responsibility exists, individuals bear the greatest burden. Yet the government, families, and society share equal blame through the values and lessons they transmit to younger generations. The older generation longs for a time of safety and honesty, when truth was valued above wealth.

Youth have lost themselves pursuing relevance and adopting foreign cultures. Crime has surged, violence is rampant—fathers harm their children, youth attack one another, mothers abuse their sons—yet many still consider it normal. Despite systemic decay, hope remains if the government provides basic services, teachers instill moral values, parents nurture their children with both guidance and love, and individuals commit to positive change. 

Real improvement requires collective action: government, schools, society, parents, and individuals must each play their part to build a better world. Improving the standard of society does not rest on ones shoulder, we all have a part to play and this happens when honesty, empathy, and love dwells.

body.title: Un rato en la Casa de la Música de Artemisa/A While at the Artemisa House of Music (Esp-Eng)
body.body:
> Hola, mis amigos de Daily Blog y el resto de los usuarios que me honrran con su visita. Que placer saludarlos. Ayer en la mañana, por cuestiones de trabajo, estuve en Artemisa. Luego de terminar mis labores ya era medio día y unas colega de trabajo que viven allí, me invitaron a pasar un rato por un lugar donde la ciudad se viste de fiesta, un sitio que es pura melodía, la Casa de la Música. Olvídate de los lugares comunes, porque este es otra cosa, aquí se respira cubania. >Hello, my friends at Daily Blog and the rest of the users who honor me with your visit. What a pleasure to greet you. > >Yesterday morning, for work reasons, I was in Artemisa. After finishing my tasks, it was already noon, and some coworkers who live there invited me to spend some time at a place where the city dresses up in celebration, a spot that is pure melody: the House of Music. Forget about ordinary places, because this one is something else — here, you breathe Cuban spirit.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRhXCoeZEXqWZV4LbrNZV2zF1RW3jkc5yWYM4MpBAqm4P/1775851539468.jpg)

> Como pueden apreciar este es un hermoso inmueble con una arquitectura colonial que resalta y se diferencia entre el resto de las casas de esta zona. Esta casa abrió sus puertas como lo que es hoy en 2017, pero no en cualquier lado. Está en la Calle 33 (la calle principal de Artemisa) entre 52 y 54, en lo que fue el antiguo Casino Español. El Casino Español de Artemisa, conocido también como Casino Español Cubano, fue una sociedad de instrucción y recreo fundada a principios del siglo XX. Más tarde, pasó a llamarse Casino Hispano Cubano. En sus instalaciones, funcionó una emisora de radio de la ciudad. Un sitio con mucha historia que la EGREM se encargó de restaurar para traer lo mejor de nuestra música. >As you can see, this is a beautiful building with colonial architecture that stands out and differs from the other houses in this area. This house opened its doors as what it is today in 2017, but not just anywhere. It’s located on Calle 33 (Artemisa’s main street) between 52 and 54, in what used to be the old Spanish Casino. The Spanish Casino of Artemisa, also known as the Cuban Spanish Casino, was a society for instruction and recreation founded in the early 20th century. Later, it became known as the Hispano-Cuban Casino. A city radio station once operated from its facilities. A site with a lot of history that EGREM took care to restore in order to bring us the best of our music.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcEmGiHWedaUh98vmdcQBCM1HubptQSNjEigQo96wMSKS/1775851590964.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdrV2jPVvJoZLUEHmGFRnNA1EpiGDATY2NzPgij2bt37J/1775851591135.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVGGEsHwpYtwDUAgS2tuT9opFcEYmE1i8NgzvuqCXytdJ/1775851591182.jpg)

>






Nos sentamos en el Álbum Kafé, un espacio que está ubicado afuera en el portal con toldos y mesas para tomar el fresco, cervezas, picaderas y seguir compartiendo. A pesar de que en ese momento no había ninguna de las actividades que alli se hacen, si había muy buena músicacy varias personas compartían con amigos, familiares. Aquí le hacen un monumento al son, al bolero, a la timba y a los nuevos talentos. El salón principal, bautizado como “Un montón de estrellas” en honor al inolvidable Polo Montañés, es cosa seria. 

>We sat down at the Álbum Kafé, a space located outside in the portal area with awnings and tables to enjoy the fresh air, beers, snacks, and keep chatting. Even though no activities were happening at that moment, there was really good music playing, and several people were hanging out with friends and family. Here, they pay tribute to son, bolero, timba, and new talent. The main hall, named \

in honor of the unforgettable Polo Montañés, is serious business.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS6BMo5h83VHbY25hwuupp9PB7oETQ8UsxviND2msS1t4/1775851660050.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQcE4tLuNjf8feBkxzV5nPS1VUThdBehBKX8H9DMAzeze/1775851660098.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUxFnUDzSrFvy6C89EcU1huMC8Bmx9pAyfi4cUy3pprEq/1775851660156.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbVwtEmcjGAQsH95yUjyLj7qK9ygWeu6XDsD83cvuWhJy/1775851660322.jpg)

> El sitio es grande y está pensado para gozar y divertirse. Este Salón Principal tiene capacidad para unas 300 almas, dos barras para servir y una tarima que es puro corazón. La pista de baile es un imán. En la parte de arriba hay un Salón VIP con un espacio para' los que quieren ver el show desde lo más alto, con una vista de primera. Pero el plan no es solo para la rumba, la Casa es como la madre de la comunidad. Aqui también hay espacio al diálogo, a la mujer, al libro y al talento joven. >The place is large and designed for enjoyment and fun. This Main Hall has a capacity of about 300 souls, two bars for service, and a stage that is pure heart. The dance floor is a magnet. Upstairs, there is a VIP Lounge with space for those who want to watch the show from the top, with a first-class view. But the plan isn’t just about the rumba — the House is like the mother of the community. Here, there is also room for dialogue, for women, for books, and for young talent.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRoNtkHeNKLJjHBkjc6pyQwq1ynxAY2FoGhsZW6k8BHD5/1775851692155.jpg)

> Según supe aquí organizan el Festival Artemisa Mestiza, que es una fusión de tradiciones y cultura que no te puedes imaginar. Eso sí, aquí la casa tiene sus reglas, se paga en moneda nacional, el derecho de admisión se lo guardan y se pide respeto, porque esto es para la gente que viene a disfrutar de verdad. >From what I learned, they organize the Artemisa Mestiza Festival here, which is a fusion of traditions and culture you can’t even imagine. That said, the house has its rules: you pay in national currency, they reserve the right of admission, and respect is demanded, because this is for people who come to truly enjoy themselves.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTurv2j6uZo1xiLfxvCNvyaE2oE8D8W1CvpgWrL1WXswA/1775851805879.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcx6LXocYUjyzi65KLZxndSSBvFQHLmeHHmNeMp8iXiC6/1775851806042.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSyKySMSeAt4UFpirYFUqHAMdyAa86d8Bjm9umZZ5TMzS/1775851806092.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbdV8Cg2C1KB9ffKvvaZvt82qaoXtVYgnURx9VYBHu8JR/1775851806249.jpg)

> Debo decir que pasé un rato muy agradable allí con mis colegas mientras esperaba un transporte de regreso a mi casa. Hubo charla, risa y cerveza fría, por supuesto. Tambien hablamos de nuevos proyectos, sueños y futuras publicacionesde libros en común. La Casa de la Música de Artemisa es un punto de encuentro y es además, orgullo de la comunidad. >I have to say I had a very pleasant time there with my colleagues while waiting for a ride back home. There was chat, laughter, and cold beer, of course. We also talked about new projects, dreams, and future joint book publications. The Artemisa House of Music is a meeting point and also a source of pride for the community.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNR8ErAV4ruxZsouG874aFBXRzeGkeUkYFQvD6dLpR8fa/1775851847677.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSwcN4zG9EiTHWLZ34dCtuzUckvUnUvF47eYGXVEQmPmo/1775852165247.jpg) https://images.ecency.com/DQmUJDibgVv7QpnG7cFRyL8RrNKwrY4Tkx4636U9mec4jSH/img_8206.gif Gracias por visitar mi blog Texto e imágenes de mi propiedad Thanks to visite my blog Text and imagen are my own https://images.ecency.com/DQmdmftReAUFLd1o6yeBP8wg9ths82CW6Fpu7doGEYgCEWV/img_7269.jpg

body.title: Television Review: You Win or You Die (Game of Thrones, S1X07, 2011)
body.body:
![(source:tmdb.org)](https://image.tmdb.org/t/p/original/l0d3WVs99QZPoxrOGuk21mV5NSp.jpg)

**You Win or You Die (S01E07)**

Airdate: 29 May 2011

Written by: David Benioff & D. B. Weiss
Directed by: Daniel Minahan

Running Time: 52 minutes 


In the grand tapestry of *Game of Thrones*, certain episodes stand out as important not merely for their narrative thrust within George R.R. Martin’s fictional universe, but for the manner in which they encapsulate, and indeed influence, the broader television landscape of their time. The early 2010s were frequently heralded as a new Golden Age of Television, a period where serialised storytelling on cable and streaming platforms reached unprecedented levels of ambition, budget, and cultural penetration. Within this context, an episode’s importance can sometimes be measured less by its plot mechanics and more by its contribution to the evolving lexicon and techniques of the medium itself. Season one’s seventh episode, *You Win or You Die*, is precisely such an instalment. While it delivers the series’ first seismic political earthquake, its most enduring legacy may well be a single, salacious scene that inspired commentators to coin a term which would swiftly enter the global critical vocabulary and earn its own Wikipedia entry: “sexposition.”

That term, originally formulated by culture blogger Myles McNutt, finds its quintessential exemplar in this episode’s much-debated brothel sequence. After a prior episode leaning heavily into visceral violence, *You Win or You Die* appears to compensate by delivering to a certain segment of the audience what was ostensibly missing: graphic lesbian sex. The scene, set within one of Petyr Baelish’s establishments, features the prostitute Ros receiving instruction from the experienced Armeca, played by English pornographic actress Sahara Knite—the first performer cast in *Game of Thrones* with such a specialist background. As Ros and Armeca engage with apparent enjoyment, even inviting Baelish to participate, Littlefinger demurs. He instead uses the titillating action as a narrative backdrop to divulge his lifelong, unrequited obsession with an unnamed woman, whom astute viewers had already deduced was Catelyn Stark. Directed with a certain sleek efficiency, the scene was nevertheless widely criticised as gratuitous, a naked (quite literally) ploy by HBO to inundate its prestige drama with the spicy content for which the network was known. Yet, even its detractors often conceded a clever, if cynical, utility. By grafting crucial character exposition onto “edgy,” titillating action, the show ensured viewers absorbed Baelish’s motivating pathology alongside their thrill. This technique, previously seen in shows like *Deadwood*, was here distilled to such a pure form that it demanded a new label. “Sexposition” thus became a recognised, and frequently critiqued, narrative shorthand across television, a testament to this episode’s inadvertent trend-setting power.

Beyond defining a televisual trend, *You Win or You Die* is fundamentally important for providing the series’ first genuine “wham” moment, the point at which the fragile political equilibrium of Westeros shatters irreparably, accelerating the plot towards open war. The chain of events is set in motion with Eddard Stark’s honourable, yet catastrophically naive, confrontation with Queen Cersei. Having uncovered the truth of her children’s parentage, Ned offers her a chance to flee before he informs King Robert. This act of mercy, however, is immediately rendered moot by news that Robert has been mortally gored by a boar. The king’s deathbed scene is a masterclass in tragic irony: he reaffirms his friendship with Ned, names him Lord Protector and Regent for the odious Joffrey, and even finds a final shred of decency by rescinding the order to assassinate Daenerys Targaryen. Ned, steadfast in his honour, intends to use this authority to install the legitimate heir, Stannis Baratheon. His plans, however, spectacularly unravel. He underestimates the ambition of Robert’s younger brother Renly, who advocates for his own claim based on Stannis’s perceived lack of popular appeal, and he fatally misplaces his trust in the duplicitous Petyr Baelish. The episode’s climax is a brutal lesson in realpolitik. As Joffrey ascends the Iron Throne, Ned attempts to wield Robert’s last will, only for Cersei to contemptuously dismiss it as “a piece of paper.” In the ensuing chaos, Littlefinger’s betrayal is delivered with a chilling whisper—“I did warn you not to trust me”—and Ned is seized by the City Watch. The stability of the realm dies with Robert, and the game of thrones begins in earnest.

Simultaneously, across the Narrow Sea, the revoked assassination order against Daenerys takes on a life of its own. Local agents, unaware of the countermand, proceed with their attempt. It fails, but its consequences are profound. Ser Jorah Mormont, having received a royal pardon from Varys’s agents that would allow him to return home, chooses instead to intervene and save Daenerys from poisoned wine. This moment crystallises his shifting loyalty from self-interest to genuine devotion. Moreover, the attack provokes a seismic shift in Khal Drogo. His genuine, if initially possessive, affection for his *khaleesi* transforms into a roaring fury. He renounces his earlier reluctance, vowing to lead his Dothraki horde across the “poisoned water” to conquer the Seven Kingdoms for her, thereby planting the seeds for a future invasion.

The script by David Benioff and D. B. Weiss handles other narrative threads with notable economy. At the Wall, Jon Snow and Samwell Tarly formally swear their vows and join the Night’s Watch. Jon’s assignment as a steward, rather than a ranger, fuels his petulant disappointment—he yearns to search for his missing uncle, Benjen. It falls to Sam to provide the crucial insight: by being made the Lord Commander’s personal steward, Jon is not being sidelined but groomed for future command. This quiet scene effectively establishes the pair’s dynamic and the bureaucratic realities of the Watch, all without diverting focus from the southern turmoil.

The episode’s opening, however, is reserved for introducing perhaps the most formidable player of all: Tywin Lannister. In a stark, memorable scene, we find him in a military camp, skinning a stag—a not-so-subtle symbol of House Baratheon—while lecturing his son Jaime. He chastises Jaime’s attachment to knightly honour and glory, espousing a ruthless, pragmatic philosophy of power. His declaration, “A lion doesn’t concern itself with the opinion of sheep,” instantly establishes him as the apex predator of Westerosi politics, a man who views morality and reputation as currencies for the weak. It is a perfect introduction, setting the tone for the cutthroat manoeuvring that follows.

In the end, *You Win or You Die* is an episode of dual legacies. As a piece of narrative, it is brilliantly effective, executing a devastating political coup that forever changes the series’ trajectory. Its character work, from Ned’s tragic integrity to Tywin’s menacing debut, is superlative. Yet, its place in television history is equally secured by its more controversial contribution: the crystallisation of “sexposition” as a debated storytelling crutch. It is, therefore, a perfect artefact of its time—a product of HBO’s bold, often brash, approach to the Golden Age, where high political intrigue and low titillation could coexist, for better or worse, in a single, unforgettable piece of television.


RATING: 7/10 (+++)

body.title: Inflation
body.body:
### 🎯 WHAT IS THE FED TELLING US

Let’s take it from the beginning, starting with the minutes from the latest Federal Reserve meeting.

And here, we’re seeing a very important shift in tone.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeXxciGNPbw1eVtFjf5RzKEZsvyaLpFdAg26zEXdeNwVL/image.png)


The Fed kept interest rates unchanged. We already knew that. But the real story isn’t the decision itself… it’s what’s being said between the lines.

Because now, Fed officials are clearly stating that inflation may stay higher for longer than they previously expected.

And this isn’t random.

We’re seeing rising oil prices due to tensions in the Middle East, lingering effects from last year’s tariffs, and overall, an environment that keeps prices elevated.

And this is where the real problem begins.

The Fed has two goals: control inflation and support the labor market. The issue is that now, both seem to be moving in the wrong direction.

Inflation is “sticking”… while at the same time, cracks are starting to appear in the job market.

This is the worst-case scenario for a central bank.

So what does that mean in practice? It means the Fed can’t easily cut rates.

And indeed, what they’re now signaling is that rate cuts will come… but later than expected.

Now here’s the most interesting part.

There’s even talk of potential rate hikes if inflation doesn’t come down.

Yes, we’ve gone from discussing when to cut… to questioning whether rates might need to go even higher.

---

### 📊 THE LATEST DATA

Let’s look at the data to see if all of this makes sense.

Starting with Core PCE, the Fed’s preferred inflation measure.

The message is clear. Inflation is still at 3%, well above the 2% target.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP8tTUARQAwGp9wphugX3bBepucHLh6Jb34tEWfPdT4gb/image.png)


And more importantly, it’s not coming down easily. It’s what we call “sticky.”

Now let’s move to GDP.

Economic growth dropped from 4.4% to 0.5%. That’s a massive slowdown in just one quarter.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeHHyQUcPQUKiHjSAkpyE22Q8jqEJj7ha9Ac8d9gof84M/image.png)


Investments are declining, consumption is still there but growing much more slowly, and overall, the economy is starting to show signs of fatigue.

Put it all together?

We have high inflation… and slowing growth.

That’s what we call stagflation.

And it’s one of the most challenging environments for both the economy and the markets.

And as if that wasn’t enough, we’re starting to see early signs in the labor market, with jobless claims ticking higher. Not dramatically, but they are rising.

And that’s usually the first step.

Businesses are getting squeezed by higher costs and are reacting by slowing hiring or freezing expansion plans.

We’re not in a crisis yet, but the direction is clear.

---

### 🧠 WHAT ANALYSTS ARE SAYING

So what are analysts saying about all this?

The first major takeaway is that inflation is unlikely to return to 2% anytime soon. Many now expect it to stay around 3% to 4% for quite some time.

And that’s because this isn’t just about demand. It’s also about supply.

We have rising commodity prices, geopolitical tensions, and even countries stockpiling raw materials, all of which keep prices elevated.

In other words, we’re entering a phase where inflation becomes more structural.

On the other hand, some analysts believe the Fed is now in an even tougher position than a few months ago.

With oil prices high, liquidity increasing, and government spending rising, inflationary pressures are not easing.

That’s why they don’t even rule out the possibility of rate hikes instead of cuts.

---

### 📈 INVESTMENT TAKEAWAY

Putting everything together, the picture is clear.

Inflation isn’t coming down easily. Growth is slowing. Consumers are under pressure. The labor market is starting to weaken.

And the Fed is now in a position where it can’t easily move in either direction.

body.title: The Burger Calzone
body.body:
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/themyscira/242hfEs3gVTpzEBJ4kbjg4dhDWxRP3WTsF7shsJczPLrWMEohy6rT8kS3G4iLptQe1dYq.png)
Hello, fellow foodies! Today I’ve conjured up something from the world of burgers – simple, quick and yet absolutely brilliant. I was absolutely knackered and couldn’t be bothered to cook, but that’s often when the best ideas strike. In the photo you can see two of these galactic delicacies, but believe me: I could barely manage one. They’re massive, but incredibly tasty.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/themyscira/23xVMWfGp3AyCNhVsHHs9NmWrZD2W7KCN8cRUfpobCdsfBe5tvJPagNie7C4uS2w6Hpsa.png)

Yes, I admit it: I cheated and bought some ready-made pizza dough from the fridge. I already had everything else at home – sometimes you just need to keep things simple.
What do you need for these interstellar burger calzone?
•    Pizza dough – homemade or shop-bought
•    Minced meat for the patties
•    And whatever else your personal burger universe has to offer

I used a saucepan lid to cut out two round discs of dough and placed the dough over a deep, round bowl. Then the ‘filling’ mission began.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/themyscira/23tmNNpgvD2TEA4oHQw12UVmegaxFxBZiig7g8ZEEyeghFrQ2sTMFYmi7QywRxeHkznCC.png)

I shaped the patties and pre-cooked them until they were almost done. I then layered the dough, which I’d pulled over the bowl, with onions, barbecue sauce,...


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/themyscira/23wCDwHzuE6i93wyqdTv4skttdXWK8HW6PdodDShrPq1Z3PPBq4MsT9uQDKTVTPASrvt9.png)


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/themyscira/23yd8J4EGeXMTQt21rXqK2v8k5NBQdtE4V8psPRSKFQZ5x7sUEbWdYxDg6gCT7q6J2LFw.png)
a slice of cheese, the patty, burger sauce, more cheese and, finally, lettuce. A little flavour explosion in layers.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/themyscira/23xpAzANKRNqLQWV1afw7C7MQkErg7BirmhenxaSvNiwCxUwMRbL5kw2jYWtqV5iBkCyp.png)


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/themyscira/23xVPAYoTAsJUgwxuYLg75pXjLw7whabAnz4vRUMAHCmvuTrRgfCdqQBz7RQqHtgQ14nB.png)


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/themyscira/23uQvaJGGHosFsBeeJ8Vzh48iDfYkQWSZgoS2HfMHQzKfN4BCmxwDjSsxHcSwuXyxCZrZ.png)

Once you’ve added everything your burger calzone needs, simply seal the edges of the dough at the bottom, turn it over, brush with egg yolk and top with sesame seeds – for that authentic burger look.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/themyscira/23x1BAMvgXXjpTjogoTMxcdAnqLqZRfMro6G83YRsi561ERnm9DFqnADPBfEUwbxweRfm.png)

Then pop it in the air fryer or oven: 200 degrees, 15–20 minutes, and before you know it, a new creation from the fast-food galaxy will be on your plate. Let’s put it this way: the perfect meal to round off a hectic week.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/themyscira/EoyQ1csVPPzNsRRXpD7apgZzege7poRsHKaKBcoLe1Wd2kTjAWhyetAi7umaorq5BMr.png)

On that note: Have a great weekend and enjoy yourselves. 💚


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/themyscira/23yJZDRUntKe1UpeEg1qZQkY6DYn6TueGGCeboL8L2eN8AVfYtR7VUPsfTUbmxHs7qy4B.png)
Thank you for reading my post. 😘

![2023-08-14 03_48_18-Window.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/themyscira/23wCHvE3hS6oDC1qefwsQHHG2J6GjWXfbThjQDqvQPKasJ5NobMR3FJ7bb57nJdmuFVuA.png)

DE

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/themyscira/242hfEs3gVTpzEBJ4kbjg4dhDWxRP3WTsF7shsJczPLrWMEohy6rT8kS3G4iLptQe1dYq.png)

Hallo ihr Lieben des guten Geschmacks, heute habe ich etwas aus dem Burger Universum auf den Tisch gezaubert – simpel, schnell und trotzdem ein absoluter Knaller. Ich war mega erschöpft und hatte null Lust zu kochen, aber genau dann entstehen ja oft die besten Ideen. Auf dem Bild seht ihr zwei dieser galaktischen Köstlichkeiten, aber glaubt mir: Ich habe nur eine mit Mühe geschafft. Die Dinger sind mächtig, aber unfassbar lecker.

Ja, ich gestehe: Ich habe geschummelt und einen fertigen Pizzateig aus der Kühlung gekauft. Alles andere war schon zu Hause – manchmal muss es einfach unkompliziert sein.

Was braucht ihr für diese interstellaren Burger Calzonen?
•	Pizzateig – selbst gemacht oder gekauft
•	Hackfleisch für die Patties
•	Und alles, was euer persönliches Burger Universum hergibt

Ich habe mit einem Topfdeckel zwei runde Teigscheiben ausgestochen und den Teig über eine tiefe, runde Schale gestülpt. Dann begann die Mission „Füllen“.

Die Patties habe ich geformt und vorgegart, bis sie fast durch waren. In den über die Schale gestülpten Teig kamen dann Zwiebeln, Barbecuesoße, eine Scheibe Käse, das Patty, Burgersoße, wieder Käse und zum Schluss Salat. Eine kleine Geschmacksexplosion in Schichten.

Wenn alles drin ist, was eure Burger Calzone braucht, einfach den Teig unten gut verschließen, umdrehen, mit Eigelb bestreichen und mit Sesam toppen – für den echten Burger Look.

Dann ab in den Airfryer oder Backofen: 200 Grad, 15–20 Minuten, und schon landet eine neue Kreation aus der Fast Food Galaxie auf eurem Teller. Sagen wir mal so: Das perfekte Essen, um eine anstrengende Woche zu verabschieden.

In diesem Sinne: Kommt gut ins Wochenende und genießt eure Zeit. 💚 😍 


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/themyscira/23yJZDRUntKe1UpeEg1qZQkY6DYn6TueGGCeboL8L2eN8AVfYtR7VUPsfTUbmxHs7qy4B.png)
Vielen Dank, dass ihr meinen Beitrag gelesen habt. 😘

body.title: Mi experiencia con el trabajo remoto 🖥️ 📝 🏠
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcRqPuJDEsbw4EHVQrwNA5x8TRNi4GPEQYTeaxJt75uo1/1775849875863.jpg)



Hello everyone! In this opportunity, I want to document some important and special moments of my life. I feel that through this platform, I can create a space to preserve memories that I truly believe should never fade from my mind, while also sharing a meaningful message. That is why I want to talk about remote work—or rather, my experience over these past few months.
​I want to explain that I spent several months unemployed, but this was not an obstacle. Instead, it allowed me to open my mind and focus on something I had desired for a long time: working from home, being able to supervise my children, and at the same time, earning more than I did when I worked on-site. In my previous job as a brand ambassador or promoter, I earned a fixed salary of $400 a month. It is a huge blessing for me to be able to say that since God opened the doors for me in this industry, I have been able to exceed that salary and surpass my own expectations.
​The people closest to me, like my family, know about my time working with companies where simply providing customer service and using sales strategies was enough. These companies have been very responsible with payments, and I mention this because I often felt afraid that they wouldn't pay what was agreed upon during the virtual interviews.
​Secondly, I want to mention that working from home is just like any other job; it truly requires a lot of concentration and discipline. Obviously, there are factors that can distract you, especially since you aren't in an office but at home. In my case, I have someone who handles the housework for me—whom I pay—and who also supports me with anything I might need. This is something I used to do before, but back then I had to do it while being away from home, having to commute every single day to go to work





Hola un saludo para todos en esta oportunidad quiero documentar momentos importantes y especiales de mi vida o que al menos considero que por medio de esta red puedo tener ese espacio para guardar cosas que de verdad considero no deberían desaparecer de mi mente y al mismo tiempo dejar un mensaje es por eso que quiero hablar del trabajo remoto o más bien mi experiencia durante todo estos meses. 

Quiero explicar que pase algunos meses desempleada pero que esto no fue obstáculo para abrir mi mente y enfocarme en algo que desde hace mucho tiempo deseaba que era trabajar desde mi casa con la supervisión de mis hijos y al mismo tiempo ganar más de lo que estaba ganando en la calle mi antiguo trabajo como promotora o impulsadora generaba 400 dólares mensuales fijos y para mí es una gran bendición poder decir que desde que Dios me abrió las puertas en este mundo he podido superar ese sueldo y mis expectativas.


 Las personas más cercanas a mí como mi familia saben de estos momentos en los que he podido estar con empresas que tan solo con brindar una atención al cliente y contener estrategias de venta han sido muy responsables en Cancelar y esto lo digo porque muchas veces sentí miedo de que no pudieran pagar o cancelar lo establecido al momento de una entrevista virtual. 


En segundo lugar quiero mencionar que trabajar desde casa es como cualquier trabajo la verdad te exige mucho la concentración y la disciplina porque evidentemente si hay factores que pueden distraerte sobre todo si no estás en una oficina si estás en tu casa,  al menos en mi lugar yo tengo una persona que realiza los quehaceres por mí a la que le cancelo y que también me apoya en alguna cosa que necesite LO CUAL antes hacía pero estando fuera de mi casa porque tenía que todos los días tomar un carro para ir a trabajar. 


  Otro punto que quiero mencionar es que estos trabajos que he tenido han sido básicamente la atención al cliente y cierre de ventas que si bien en las distintas empresas que he estado trabajando desde el mes de noviembre hasta ahora tienen distintos sueldos o distintas características o políticas conozco ahora que hay un campo bastante amplio al que sí o sí me gustaría explorar pero no tan solo eso mi meta es poder trabajar en empresas más grandes y más formales a través de páginas especializadas en el trabajo remoto pero mientras tanto debo agradecer mucho a Dios por estas oportunidades porque puedo generar más de lo que hacía antes y desde mi casa por lo que si en algún momento te has sentido mal por no tener eso que necesitas para generar y sales todos los días a buscar trabajo te invito también a buscar en el Internet inclusive en el Facebook anuncios publicitarios y evaluar todas las ofertas porque puedes estar generando desde tu misma casa ahora sí puedo decir que soy testigo quería que esto quedara como evidencia para mí misma como impulso si en algún momento me desanimo y para otras personas decirles que sí se pueden y hay varios niveles que debes trazarte a alcanzar considero que ahora estoy en el piso número uno pero pienso ir por más me he sentido tan cómoda que hasta estoy con la camisa de mi esposo trabajando en mi teléfono con un cuaderno y la computadora. 

Aunque quizás no me vean con las mejores ropas zapatos o camisas puedo decir que he invertido en mi casa en cosas importantes que día a día puedo ver que aunque suene chistoso puedo mencionar una ventana corrediza que me recuerda día tras día que obtuve a través de un trabajo remoto aunque suene chistoso así como eso otras cosas que he colaborado en mi hogar en mi familia que puedo palpar y me queda como recuerdo y experiencia de que si se puede. Y esto lo menciona porque a veces parece irreal el poder producir desde mi casa y poder obtener cosas que realmente son prioridades y necesito un saludo a todos y bendiciones. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWhJkxBzChSRqMhj6d2729oh3AKnNyukPLutLkMbAVGQg/1775849895880.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVVcDvfgKo5aPHN9cih6qhNvhnwc16fg3ss2GEQuD391B/1775849895806.jpg)

body.body:
Interessante Beobachtung. Irgendwie vertraut diese Mischung aus Gruppendynamik, Konkurrenz und dem plötzlichen Kippen. Sie zeigt, dass organisierte Gewalt kein rein menschliches Problem ist. Trotzdem fühlt sich der Schritt hin zur Erklärung menschlicher Kriege etwas zu kurz an.

Was man dort sieht, sind unter Druck geratene Systeme: zu viele Individuen, zu wenig Ressourcen und auch Veränderungen in der Führung. Und ja, hier spielt der Zerfall von Beziehungen sicherlich eine große Rolle.

Beim Menschen kommt aber eine weitere Ebene dazu. Entscheidungen werden nicht nur \

getroffen, sondern oft bewusst herbeigeführt, geplant oder instrumentalisiert. 

>Ich bezweifle das aber, denn Krieg entsteht öfter durch individuelle Führungspersönlichkeiten und deren Machtanspruch

Sehe ich auch so - Machtinteressen, Ideologien oder strategische Überlegungen lassen sich nicht einfach auf biologische Muster zurückführen.

Vielleicht liegt genau darin der Unterschied: Die Voraussetzungen mögen ähnlich sein, aber der Umgang damit ist ein anderer.

body.title: Mi mejor amigo
body.body:
Hace unos dias estuve con mi mejor amigo haciendo una sesion de fotos , la cual era para la tienda en donde trabaja creando contenido y haciendo de modelo también , nos decidimos por varios outfits muy elegantes ya que algunos eran con pantalones de vestir pero esta fotos fue la que mas llamo mi atención

Al darme cuenta del movimiento barrido que queriamos hacer para esa foto , el tuvo que quedarse todo el tiempo quieto aguantando las risas ya que muchos pensaban que era un muñeco, o no sabian que estaba haciendo asi vestido en la calle .

Me pregunto que se siente estar parado en un escenario donde todos te esten mirando de esa manera , no se sabe si es burla , admiracion , deseos de ser igual que el , ganas de poder hacerlo , porq si muchas veces vemos cosas que queremos hacer y no lo hacemos por pena , por el que diran o simplemente porque creiste que era algo tonto . 

Ya que no es muy usual que en mi provincia en Santiago de Cuba se vistan asi , son pocas las personas curiosas que se aventurar a probar cosas nuevas , buscar tendencias a la moda , y crear nuevos e inovadores outfits, me gusta mucho trabajar con el porque es espontáneo , es creativo , no me gusta vacer fotos de posa y ya sin un significado alguno para la persona . 

Muchas veces yo no tengo ideas para hacer fotos o pienso divagando en mi mente en hacer algunas que termino NO haciendo , por eso decidi incursionar un poco mas

body.title: Romania'25 #2 - Salina Turda - Amazing Salt Mine
body.body:
### Hi Guys!
***

**The next day we had in plans to visit very large salt mine Salina Turda - which was the best and most interesting spots during whole journey (for me)...**

***

![IMG_4118-Enhanced-NR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/photovisions/23tbNy96hwKHzYztM5o5m5WoNmvtaJo4PHGmbKydqMduJ3S33fA3MARa9dsWcGZc5NzVX.jpg)

***

Here's a photo gallery from the incredible salt mine we visited in Romania – Salina Turda.
**The true scale of this place can't be captured in photos – there's no way to show this seemingly enclosed yet massive space.**

If you look closely, you'll see tiny dots in the photos – those are people 🙂.

***

![IMG_4123-Enhanced-NR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/photovisions/23tkovaDqyZsdpfecN98re5pW12xPiPgi1q94wtrS9bVkvtxCT6BMUsSfT3Pyop66FTmw.jpg)

![IMG_4144-Enhanced-NR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/photovisions/23tbR7ZU8Hh6fw3Dy9q9cuWBZkssfsUG5cDHhTPMBnfuJpCsbZ9QVgBRRfXT19Z1zRMYL.jpg)

![IMG_4134-Pano-Enhanced-NR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/photovisions/23tbRG9tVN9AFC6cqs1jP5Y9kretvMMD3473euXPs44SSXdURLrYqMk2Y7Ua9EKfC4p46.jpg)

![IMG_4126-Enhanced-NR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/photovisions/Eo45HhjKXCEuWTzfGPE2vCo183GS3zu5QmCmQVEpgVsJjSr5BtghhphkVDzdP7xgmdR.jpg)

![IMG_4112-Enhanced-NR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/photovisions/23u5bTtZEb8HcfEdauo67cRSdkVqxR1qAbzPgeBMEV14GFw4pRMf64RvE6p9NEvQ28zTu.jpg)

***

*The sheer size of this place is evident in the fact that the main hall houses various attractions, such as basketball courts, ping-pong tables, children's playgrounds, a souvenir shop, and outdoor gyms. There's also a closed exhibition area, an amphitheater with an auditorium, and in the middle stands a rather large Ferris wheel – a kind of vertical carousel 😉... And a few more interesting facts I forgot. In the lower hall, in the middle of the lake, there are interesting installations, as you can see in the photos – these are various wooden structures where you can sit on benches and inhale the healing salt vapors... a natural, huge graduation tower.*

The main hall is **90 meters high**. This salt mine differs from our polish Wieliczka salt mine in that, among other things, the vast underground workings are open to visitors, rather than a network of tunnels – although there are plenty of those too.

***

![IMG_4158-Enhanced-NR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/photovisions/23tkhck1j7S6LaB5KFAduauoGH8drYHb4ay9V8ZPYd2uykCJ6VgiGk3GGC9eAahJhLDgT.jpg)

![IMG_4163-Enhanced-NR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/photovisions/23tkjzfCJ5XRhoDWEKF1BrvZFEskEj2U3shYgBQrXnuvjTX9ybvuDiX5gUFuBdebsYmpR.jpg)

![IMG_4167-Enhanced-NR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/photovisions/23tvYHR2DG6EoWjmPkiMErMvdp3P4MNfBdEXc2BYunG7sbQfKUG385rKcwfUTXqJD6LBV.jpg)

![IMG_4149-Enhanced-NR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/photovisions/23tkfFPg3BHMJadH9FT2NQTQB6DQcSjDpfQR9Pui6A1oU8E6j8NBDXwcb1mww73cvnTqc.jpg)

***

**Interesting facts: The first mention of the mine dates back to 1271, and the average thickness of the salt deposits here was 250 meters. In 2017, the mine was visited by 618,000 tourists, 35% of whom were foreigners – so there's no shortage of people there 😉.**

Between 2008 and 2010, the mine was fully adapted for tourism, museum, and therapeutic purposes – one giant salt graduation tower that you can feel in your lungs and sinuses. This place made a truly powerful impression on us.

***

![IMG_4179-Enhanced-NR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/photovisions/23uFK2R8RSpHHNibESUagxKeLqkX9BCWKMMeSRiSQDeNcH5rDeygdjUHGnExFz5ga9qLg.jpg)

![IMG_4180-Enhanced-NR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/photovisions/23u5Zg9jaQwKf2Ew8fNrNnQkKHae7QVZzcCyktZVxVPpwGCEhx1oy6bA3YwSbDCdxbj2P.jpg)

![IMG_4190-Enhanced-NR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/photovisions/23tvW8X1eYDaXDAg2H5j5WCJbTYFaActMjwzzo5RXg1ye5e5hp3CBm98qYGq1o7iMXFBQ.jpg)

![IMG_4193-Enhanced-NR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/photovisions/23vrpovBbC5e7Ji4j5Z9HHwEsqJjqTvVRWhg2Btt3LZfHyToVjpjtXkawXRmrVAH95zEH.jpg)

![IMG_4200-Enhanced-NR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/photovisions/23u5bKeyZyhMYDTT61fwQsuKTiWMjFFVy3muDZAR7ZvUMs3cuGbkQqraNVP7txLMDTDJV.jpg)

![IMG_4205.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/photovisions/AKs1gnxEZePNk3g7Kp7AaYQdjm1wSLShSuB27ELRcM3kXUxxhzKZ39KbVuP1KDK.jpg)

***

**Hope You liked the gallery - this place is really worth visiting if You ever visit Romania!
But be prepared to meet a lot of people there - and try to book Your tickets in advance!**

Thanks for watching and reading!

body.title: Mercado de Angeiras, Portugal
body.body:
### Good evening, friends! ##### Welcome to my fourth post in this super interesting [community](https://peakd.com/c/hive-196308/created)! For my birthday last year, I went to visit my friends in Lavra. By the end of November, temperatures are already relatively low, even for Portugal’s generally mild climate. But the difference between the weather in Lisbon and what you experience in the Douro region is striking. And we’re talking about a distance of just over 300 kilometers between the two cities. And you, do you like the winter cold? I confess that as I get older, I increasingly enjoy the cozy atmosphere of homes, with families gathered around the table, sharing a heartwarming meal. It’s something that puts a smile on my face and puts me in a great mood... Even though the days are shorter and rainy, we end up being more reserved and staying close to those dearest to us. And since it was a festive occasion, we decided to stock up at a local market. The decision wasn’t based solely on the quality of the products sold there—which are markedly different from those at big-box stores—but also on a significant difference in price. Incredibly, not only is the quality superior, but the price of many individual items is more reasonable compared to what we buy at hypermarkets, which are already packaged and pre-packaged. My compadres went there to buy a specific gift that they really love. Of course, they couldn’t just buy the ham. The warm, still-crispy bread also had to be part of the basket, as did a semi-cured sheep’s milk cheese that was absolutely divine… I’m telling you. As for wines, and despite the wide selection, there was no need to buy any, since we had a few bottles at home, and I myself had brought a good wine to share so we could open it during the meal. Honey and olive oil, as well as nuts, are always a must on a winter dinner table, aren’t they? The traditional cake known as folar, or braided cake, is also one of the most traditional choices, but we already had plenty of sweets! Unfortunately, I can’t make these true delicacies a regular occurrence, because even though they taste wonderful, my serum cholesterol is a bit high, and I have to be very careful about what I eat. But there are special days, and my birthday was certainly a good reason to celebrate and share a wonderful meal with friends, as well as some wonderful moments. Unfortunately, largely due to the hustle and bustle of daily life, I don’t usually go to weekend markets and fairs, but these days, they’re an excellent option, not only in terms of quality but also in terms of affordability. I hope you enjoyed my post about this market, and that these photos have made your mouth water. Anyone who has visited Portugal knows that our cuisine is one of the highlights of what we have to offer. For those who aren’t as familiar with the Mediterranean diet, I encourage you to give it a try someday. You don’t even have to come to Portugal. Many places scattered across cities around the world have restaurants run by Portuguese immigrants or the children of immigrants, and they invariably serve regional and traditional dishes. Look for the restaurants with the best ratings. In Portugal, it’s very common that the most expensive restaurants aren’t always the ones offering the best and tastiest dishes!

body.body:
# Hello dear hivers and vegan 🌱 family 🥰💕.

![98FEE554-1850-4CDA-AFAD-D25F005435D6.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AKZpp8XHMeifhMxopG8xbbZhP6RWk5jGQna3gFeCRv6yqqj3NQr8yniQiBR1C6y.jpeg)

![3A793159-1A9D-40DF-9D83-B89A7942D471.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/24246bpbPhRrncxMHiYywZzxgvZuAamfogjiQr1Pbu2c6rBAbwCHdYhSPXEUd4biRRx3f.jpeg)

![785B7770-F903-4848-947E-B4E927E3043C.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23ynjD2vvUFTCeqWhnvttMArxMnStxqLkAAk1NoiJwLUUj1RarQ8KvqnVhxJYAWap3G8L.jpeg)

Hope we are all doing great and enjoying wellness of rest from the just past Easter 🐣 holiday.  Although it was such a one fast weekend holiday, but one I really enjoyed with family 🥰.

This pull apart mini l loafs 🥯 recipe am sharing with you is one  from the Easter holiday that I baked for my little nieces that came to spend the Easter school break with my family and I.  So I can tell you these mini loafs was made with love ❤️. Haha 😀. With just few ingredients it , breakfast of hit chocolate 🍫 was ready for the kids aa they jump around the house while perceiving the aroma of a fresh oven bake. 

![452BFDA8-8ED5-45FC-ABDF-A63AB21C7C83.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/244eVWKu5Umk3vf3VijNR54ABYTAnoBSwYdz1tjCpPqEb9ypDmmkXRE26z9tqenjacg1v.jpeg)

My loving bread so much has really made me to perfect so quickly in baking all kinds of homemade flavors and shapes of bread 🥖, and I tell you that I enjoy baking them because it has helped me reduce going to the bakery and secondly, it a way to enjoy fresh oven breads 🍞 brought to the table at any time.

Below I share the step by step process of this easy pull apart mini loafs.

# INGREDIENTS: ( Five (5) Servings)

![45F56EA6-77B7-495B-8FAF-E8A854882B0C.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23uQpfhMchewcSHQcdRuvPGpsu6Z1DsmXQ9QkDz7c23bvx8GzFYj3bHJwdvD81tMRqXko.jpeg)

250 g of all purpose flour 
1/2 teaspoon cinnamon 
1/4 teaspoon of salt 
2 tablespoons of margarine 
1/4 cup of sugar 
5 ml cap of vegetable oil
11/2 teaspoon of dry yeast 
1/2 glass of warm water

# STEPS FOR PREPARATION:

Step 1.

![659B8664-7CEB-48CB-8C19-A43C2888800E.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AKpBA1SdVQ58GdsbS5kAEMd7DXQ19PnpqdqBn5VXr51TYHvqWVRH1C5uxvqR1N5.jpeg)

We start by taking our flour into a bowl as above.

![1852D0AD-245C-40B1-A540-6A98F5548057.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AJkT7Mdv2fCUpdRPTZS53mE7f3VRFz3cidRdgu41jprZJ6kxLD3Rmf6uJ6xSnL9.jpeg)

We add our dry ingredients above. The yeast, sugar, salt and cinnamon for flavor 

Step 2.

![A6F55CDD-E3B4-48FF-B0F1-A390141FEDE9.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AJmtgouYjE7wgt7RuGonj5XzkLDnPDQXUPmANEiQV3wWgBjeoghoVr1xF35Joxb.jpeg)

We stir to incorporate, add our margarine and incorporate using our finger tips.

![D404BF1A-08F0-405D-A2E6-C9317D64ED2A.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wgU1YYf57xQ1pmVYHPrNuNVjEWh3a8RV7PEGeiJSjmTUB8Xcf8MqmvN9mKcomMxhhZe.jpeg)

As here above.

Step 3.

![34686478-6F4D-400C-9CFE-322971523593.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AJoKuhbm8Bs3nQBRoBTzacLkTmhdDeqvuLxxswHFZiBBrHxwt1txsUGWP1bXpSW.jpeg)

![F76E9B8B-3582-4C85-80D7-A658D9CBFF8D.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23x159sDqXY1cEiYrQFqrkEL1tEnb58bpvSuXC9j8Y3aqgrZh9ts8TtXJqSwNp58M5ovj.jpeg)

We add our warm water, stir gradually to form our dough 

![991C6B3D-76A0-45FD-9399-2A5361A4B025.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AKuur8p7KA6Az7iUukwZU5kSAd9e1rWriYSFcz6L4icPgsvQLawL72D4w1n5e7t.jpeg)

To obtain our fine dough, we add some vegetable oil and knead properly. 

![5D1596A2-C12B-453A-8063-E2C983B81801.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wgHYcr4hsTsN2fknq2c95N3sy6QZA49t4nu4xMpRTQgjUePpnVyPKR8AVk9rvjthWCr.jpeg)

As here above 

Step 5.

![E40600DA-0E2C-4EBB-A378-6E8094115338.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23qrYdqUGCAgX37YieZZKZN15ZskH8SK1q8uzK12NSV25kpiMrjSnT82CU5xWzNcsoe5k.jpeg)

![219EB60C-26EA-4598-933B-351219703736.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AJoKqfL3G49B4W2MWFYyW5W4KS9v3U3sD3vXabSLP1S1UFJsQS1HN9i1Jrw2jNg.jpeg)

We cut the dough into two before cutting it into little chunks  to mold into a ball .

![BF715A1F-8B33-4699-B621-92141931869B.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23zbMgbw3K132d6Zmc7oZbxnAgAj6BiwbvLGmarXRBnnPUwepY23XanptTeEZFECLvCgw.jpeg)

![972E9403-C2F0-4784-A294-3C496EE5FAD9.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23xAXxjKzWHqqSux4oNYNxsJppKLbtED7AZgMowUCQ3yrbvczEUFDN3ADmBXuV1h3sAYh.jpeg)

And place them into a bowl baking pan as above.

Step 6.

![8E6A7AC9-F3FD-4AFC-BC66-0DB47CCB6B64.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23rBLG37f1XBFdMuxuQ4SDoWJChd4kwQPTKdJkrdFVPkBY3ntakgURCJ6KPMxjjkDqk48.jpeg)

![29D7A87B-0B94-43ED-9790-CF2EBDC4A816.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/244KV8kQFeqsMmQP4FcZ7ZmNKtBhzGwySWPUWVYKXn2rVAzLqNwTMF8DXEvK6FwMF8Zb5.jpeg)

![E71256AC-3D2F-485D-B5DE-AB06C4768586.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/242rygSYnM9aurPprYBmuxEAhewbgRi5vK33NUQZ41F88EdSSoZgTwHch6zas6ZHwxtW4.jpeg)

Once all the dough are mold, we take it into the preheated oven and bake for 15 - 20 minutes at 180 Celsius . 

![0ACA0811-F487-43E8-A687-DBD80A423C5B.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/24246bpbPhRrncxMHiYywZzxgvZuAamfogjiQr1Pbu2c6rBAbwCHdYhSPXEUd4biRRx3f.jpeg)

Breakfast of mini loafs 🥯 and hot chocolate was ready before any one could notice.  Haha 😀.  And the kids we so thrilled with how the mini loafs are being separated from each other, counting on the numbers as I lay each loaf on their plate. 

![A7C2227C-19A8-4021-B4EE-9EB557472981.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23zm3XoaEFBFuWJ31HasceJosCdgoiJQvg9EnHqj3MAE7xsAFsgr1hCRWK6XtLE9eaup3.jpeg)

Such a fun 🤩 to bake this easy pull apart mini loafs this Easter 🐣. A memory I will keep anytime am baking this mini loafs again because my nieces made it an enjoyable Easter 🐣 holiday weekend.

# Hope you will love to make this mini loafs for your kids. Thanks for supporting friends 😍

# Best Regards @sunshine  🧡

Images are mine.

![C5A7831F-7533-4160-A300-11D323E71F32.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wrCDE2h44bLTEYSEBGxB6ZehD3N2pQsNLmW9rQUmRRK84pKoeCsTcUMgKE4vVnsSq4X.gif)


## Espanol Version

# Hola, queridos hivers y familia vegana 🌱 🥰💕.

![98FEE554-1850-4CDA-AFAD-D25F005435D6.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AKZpp8XHMeifhMxopG8xbbZhP6RWk5jGQna3gFeCRv6yqqj3NQr8yniQiBR1C6y.jpeg)

![3A793159-1A9D-40DF-9D83-B89A7942D471.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/24246bpbPhRrncxMHiYywZzxgvZuAamfogjiQr1Pbu2c6rBAbwCHdYhSPXEUd4biRRx3f.jpeg)

![785B7770-F903-4848-947E-B4E927E3043C.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23ynjD2vvUFTCeqWhnvttMArxMnStxqLkAAk1NoiJwLUUj1RarQ8KvqnVhxJYAWap3G8L.jpeg)

Espero que todos estéis muy bien y disfrutando del descanso tras las vacaciones de Semana Santa 🐣 que acaban de terminar. Aunque fue un fin de semana corto, lo disfruté muchísimo con la familia 🥰.


Esta receta de mini panecillos para compartir 🥯 que voy a compartir con vosotros es de las vacaciones de Semana Santa, cuando los horneé para mis sobrinas pequeñas, que vinieron a pasar las vacaciones escolares de Semana Santa con mi familia y conmigo.  Así que puedo decirles que estos mini panecillos están hechos con mucho cariño ❤️. Jaja 😀. Con solo unos pocos ingredientes, el desayuno de chocolate 🍫 estaba listo para los niños, que saltaban por toda la casa mientras percibían el aroma de lo recién horneado. 

![452BFDA8-8ED5-45FC-ABDF-A63AB21C7C83.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/244eVWKu5Umk3vf3VijNR54ABYTAnoBSwYdz1tjCpPqEb9ypDmmkXRE26z9tqenjacg1v.jpeg)

Mi gran pasión por el pan me ha llevado a perfeccionar rápidamente la elaboración de todo tipo de panes caseros, con diferentes sabores y formas 🥖, y os confieso que disfruto mucho haciéndolos porque, por un lado, me ha ayudado a ir menos a la panadería y, por otro, es una forma de disfrutar de panes recién horneados 🍞 en la mesa en cualquier momento.

A continuación, os cuento paso a paso cómo preparar estas sencillas mini hogazas para compartir.

# INGREDIENTES: (Cinco (5) raciones)

![45F56EA6-77B7-495B-8FAF-E8A854882B0C.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23uQpfhMchewcSHQcdRuvPGpsu6Z1DsmXQ9QkDz7c23bvx8GzFYj3bHJwdvD81tMRqXko.jpeg)

250 g de harina para todo uso 
1/2 cucharadita de canela 
1/4 de cucharadita de sal 
2 cucharadas de margarina 
1/4 de taza de azúcar 
5 ml de aceite vegetal
1 1/2 cucharadita de levadura seca 
1/2 vaso de agua tibia

# PASOS PARA LA PREPARACIÓN:

Paso 1.

![659B8664-7CEB-48CB-8C19-A43C2888800E.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AKpBA1SdVQ58GdsbS5kAEMd7DXQ19PnpqdqBn5VXr51TYHvqWVRH1C5uxvqR1N5.jpeg)

Empezamos echando la harina en un bol, como se ha indicado anteriormente.

![1852D0AD-245C-40B1-A540-6A98F5548057.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AJkT7Mdv2fCUpdRPTZS53mE7f3VRFz3cidRdgu41jprZJ6kxLD3Rmf6uJ6xSnL9.jpeg)

Añadimos los ingredientes secos por encima: la levadura, el azúcar, la sal y la canela para dar sabor. 

Paso 2.

![A6F55CDD-E3B4-48FF-B0F1-A390141FEDE9.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AJmtgouYjE7wgt7RuGonj5XzkLDnPDQXUPmANEiQV3wWgBjeoghoVr1xF35Joxb.jpeg)

Removemos para mezclar bien, añadimos la margarina y la incorporamos con las yemas de los dedos.

![D404BF1A-08F0-405D-A2E6-C9317D64ED2A.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wgU1YYf57xQ1pmVYHPrNuNVjEWh3a8RV7PEGeiJSjmTUB8Xcf8MqmvN9mKcomMxhhZe.jpeg)

Como se ha indicado anteriormente.

Paso 3.

![34686478-6F4D-400C-9CFE-322971523593.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AJoKuhbm8Bs3nQBRoBTzacLkTmhdDeqvuLxxswHFZiBBrHxwt1txsUGWP1bXpSW.jpeg)

![F76E9B8B-3582-4C85-80D7-A658D9CBFF8D.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23x159sDqXY1cEiYrQFqrkEL1tEnb58bpvSuXC9j8Y3aqgrZh9ts8TtXJqSwNp58M5ovj.jpeg)

Añadimos el agua tibia y removemos poco a poco hasta formar la masa 

![991C6B3D-76A0-45FD-9399-2A5361A4B025.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AKuur8p7KA6Az7iUukwZU5kSAd9e1rWriYSFcz6L4icPgsvQLawL72D4w1n5e7t.jpeg)

Para obtener nuestra masa fina, añadimos un poco de aceite vegetal y la amasamos bien. 

![5D1596A2-C12B-453A-8063-E2C983B81801.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wgHYcr4hsTsN2fknq2c95N3sy6QZA49t4nu4xMpRTQgjUePpnVyPKR8AVk9rvjthWCr.jpeg)

Como se ha indicado anteriormente.

Paso 4.

![E40600DA-0E2C-4EBB-A378-6E8094115338.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23qrYdqUGCAgX37YieZZKZN15ZskH8SK1q8uzK12NSV25kpiMrjSnT82CU5xWzNcsoe5k.jpeg)

![219EB60C-26EA-4598-933B-351219703736.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AJoKqfL3G49B4W2MWFYyW5W4KS9v3U3sD3vXabSLP1S1UFJsQS1HN9i1Jrw2jNg.jpeg)

Partimos la masa en dos antes de cortarla en trocitos pequeños  para formar bolitas.

![BF715A1F-8B33-4699-B621-92141931869B.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23zbMgbw3K132d6Zmc7oZbxnAgAj6BiwbvLGmarXRBnnPUwepY23XanptTeEZFECLvCgw.jpeg)

![972E9403-C2F0-4784-A294-3C496EE5FAD9.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23xAXxjKzWHqqSux4oNYNxsJppKLbtED7AZgMowUCQ3yrbvczEUFDN3ADmBXuV1h3sAYh.jpeg)

Y colócalos en un molde para hornear, tal y como se ha indicado anteriormente.

Paso 5.

![8E6A7AC9-F3FD-4AFC-BC66-0DB47CCB6B64.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23rBLG37f1XBFdMuxuQ4SDoWJChd4kwQPTKdJkrdFVPkBY3ntakgURCJ6KPMxjjkDqk48.jpeg)

![29D7A87B-0B94-43ED-9790-CF2EBDC4A816.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/244KV8kQFeqsMmQP4FcZ7ZmNKtBhzGwySWPUWVYKXn2rVAzLqNwTMF8DXEvK6FwMF8Zb5.jpeg)

![E71256AC-3D2F-485D-B5DE-AB06C4768586.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/242rygSYnM9aurPprYBmuxEAhewbgRi5vK33NUQZ41F88EdSSoZgTwHch6zas6ZHwxtW4.jpeg)

Una vez moldeada toda la masa, la metemos en el horno precalentado y la horneamos durante 15-20 minutos a 180 °C. 

![0ACA0811-F487-43E8-A687-DBD80A423C5B.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/24246bpbPhRrncxMHiYywZzxgvZuAamfogjiQr1Pbu2c6rBAbwCHdYhSPXEUd4biRRx3f.jpeg)

El desayuno, compuesto por panecillos 🥯 y chocolate caliente, estuvo listo antes de que nadie se diera cuenta.  Jaja 😀.  Y a los niños les encantó ver cómo se separaban los panecillos unos de otros, contando los números mientras yo iba colocando cada panecillo en su plato. 

![A7C2227C-19A8-4021-B4EE-9EB557472981.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23zm3XoaEFBFuWJ31HasceJosCdgoiJQvg9EnHqj3MAE7xsAFsgr1hCRWK6XtLE9eaup3.jpeg)

Ha sido muy divertido 🤩 preparar estos panecillos fáciles de desmenuzar esta Semana Santa 🐣. Un recuerdo que conservaré cada vez que vuelva a hornear estos panecillos, porque mis sobrinas hicieron que pasáramos un fin de semana de Semana Santa 🐣 muy agradable.

# Espero que os encante preparar estos panecillos para vuestros hijos. Gracias por vuestro apoyo, amigos 😍

# Un saludo @sunshine  🧡

The day this photo was taken was one of those times when I really thought, “I should have taken more pictures.” It was during the buñuelo fairs in Venezuela, and I went with some friends to see what we could find. In one part of the fair, there was an archery team offering four shots at the target for 500 bolivars. We all gave it a try, and I’m happy to say I was the one who came closest, but unfortunately, none of us managed to hit the bullseye, so we didn’t win the prize—but we had a lot of fun.

>El día de esta foto es mi verdadero \

fueron las ferias de buñuelo en Venezuela y me fui con unos amigos a ver que conseguiamos, en una parte de la feria estaba el equipo de arqueria y ofrecía intentar 4 tiros al blanco por 500bs, todos lo intentamos y me alegra decir que la que más se acercó fui yo pero aún así lamentablemente ninguno logró darle al blanco así que no nos llevamos el premio, pero nos divertimos mucho.

body.title: My Actifit Report Card: April 10 2026
body.body:
![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g7d9d9f012b667dee5bf2565ca9e3df1c2d11ab4a671659f702093a87f3f7fa7c8cf6f07200ff3d7e767607065b24df18a25b0ad494caf3011d5cf2044c46a409_640.jpg)
Сегодняшняя прогулка была просто замечательной! Я решил исследовать новый маршрут в наших местных горах. Погода была идеальной: солнечно и слегка ветрено. По пути мне встретился интересный человек — любитель орнитологии, который остановился, чтобы понаблюдать за редкой птицей. Мы немного пообщались, и он показал мне свою коллекцию снимков с предыдущих походов. Также я наткнулся на красивый водопад, который совсем не ожидал увидеть. Вода искрилась на солнце, создавая волшебные радуги. Я провел некоторое время, наслаждаясь звуком воды и чистым воздухом, а потом продолжил свой путь, полон энергии и вдохновения. _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@titusfrost/actifit-titusfrost-20231229t015511428z)_

body.title: Chartered Insurance Institute CII Caught Out in Scam
body.body:
*Press Release* Newswire @ ScamBuster.TV  


![CII Scam Thumbnail.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tonybad/23xL5ESnEM4AXLByHkR1Sbrzn3xMoR6ngnbNVtfeKAJwe1eqtFzcc4WHPcKWqiG9H2kfc.jpeg)
CII “Certificate of Conviction” Under Challenge

Petition Update & Press Release

Chartered Insurance Institute faces serious questions following new evidence that directly challenges the basis of an ongoing investigation into a member’s professional standing.

 
Formal challenge submitted
A formal notice has now been issued challenging the evidence currently being relied upon by the Chartered Insurance Institute (CII).

During a recorded telephone conversation with a CII investigator, identified as Nirosha, it was confirmed that the Institute is relying on a “Certificate of Conviction” dated 16 March 2017, signed by an individual named Andrew Bate, as proof of an alleged criminal conviction.

This claim has now been subjected to detailed scrutiny.

 
Forensic review exposes contradictions
A forensic review of the evidence bundle supplied by the Financial Conduct Authority reveals a critical inconsistency:

The FCA’s own internal records do not contain the 2017 certificate
Instead, the FCA relies on a different certificate dated 30 December 2015
This creates an immediate and serious evidential conflict.

 
Court confirmation: no sealed order exists
Further investigation has produced formal written confirmation from Harrow Crown Court:

The Court Manager, Mr Steven Williams, has confirmed that
no sealed order of conviction exists in this matter
This is a crucial point.

A valid criminal conviction requires a properly issued and sealed court order. Without it, the legal foundation of any such claim is fundamentally undermined.

 
Key concerns identified
Based on the evidence now available, the material relied upon by the CII appears to:

Conflict with the FCA’s own internal records
Lack any supporting sealed court order or judicial confirmation
Have been issued retrospectively (2017) after the FCA’s original enforcement action began
In addition:

The investigator was unable to identify the source of the original allegation
The explanation provided was simply that it was “public knowledge”
This indicates that no independent verification process has been carried out and raises concerns about reliance on unverified or hearsay information.

 
Recorded conversation raises further issues
The linked recording highlights several troubling points:

The investigator could not confirm the origin of the allegation
No clear court-issued document was verified during questioning
Requests for clarification were met with limited or incomplete answers
This reinforces concerns about transparency and evidential standards.

 
Formal requests issued to the CII
In light of these findings, the following actions have been formally requested:

Full disclosure of the source
The CII is requested to identify the origin of the information relied upon, in line with the right to examine third-party material.
Immediate suspension of proceedings
All current action should be paused until a valid, sealed court order is produced — which the court has confirmed does not exist.
Official acknowledgment of challenge
The “Certificate of Conviction” should be formally recorded as disputed, defective, and unsubstantiated pending verification.
 
Supporting evidence submitted
The challenge is supported by:

A formal letter from Harrow Crown Court confirming no sealed order exists
A comparative analysis of the two conflicting certificates (2015 vs 2017)
 
Why this matters
This case raises broader concerns about:

The standards of evidence used in professional investigations
The risk of reputational harm based on unverified claims
The importance of due process and transparency
For any regulated professional, the reliance on inconsistent or unsupported documents presents a serious issue.

 
Petition update
These developments significantly strengthen the concerns raised in the ongoing petition.

They point to:

A lack of verifiable evidence
Contradictions between regulatory bodies
A failure to establish a clear and reliable factual foundation
 
Conclusion
The central issue remains unchanged:

No sealed court order has been produced, the evidence is inconsistent, and the source of the allegation remains unidentified.
Until these points are addressed, the validity of the investigation — and the documents it relies upon — remains in question.

Further updates will follow as formal responses are received.
