body.title: Built From What Most People Ignore
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmaK8KnV9RDJUNeGubGyjEBRrTS8yAuaTF28JqYTMVCLd7/image.png 


## Introduction  

On a typical morning, after completing early gig work tasks and checking for available delivery orders, attention shifted toward reviewing emails. What initially appeared to be routine quickly revealed something more structured. Multiple confirmation messages appeared, each verifying that a claim had been successfully submitted for different legal settlements.  

These included settlements related to Grubhub, Kaiser, Verita, American Textile, Nutramax, Beef Litigation, Differin, GameSpot, and Colgate. While each individual claim appeared minor, collectively they represented a pattern. This pattern suggested that legal settlements could function as an overlooked but legitimate income stream.  

This post explores how stacking multiple settlement claims can evolve into a structured financial strategy rather than a matter of chance.  

---

## Understanding Legal Settlement Income  

Legal settlements occur when companies resolve disputes, often involving data breaches, misclassification of workers, or consumer product issues. These settlements frequently involve large sums of money allocated to affected individuals. However, participation is not automatic. Individuals must actively submit claims to receive compensation.  

A significant portion of eligible participants do not file claims. Emails are ignored, deadlines are missed, and funds remain unclaimed. This creates a gap between allocated funds and actual participation.  

This gap represents an opportunity. Rather than viewing settlements as random or occasional payouts, they can be approached systematically. By consistently identifying and submitting claims, individuals can access income streams that require minimal ongoing effort.  

---

## Building a System Instead of Relying on Luck  

At first glance, submitting a single claim may appear insignificant. However, the process becomes more meaningful when repeated across multiple cases.  

For example, claims submitted across various settlements such as Grubhub and Kaiser represent larger or mid range opportunities. Additional claims from Verita, American Textile, Nutramax, Beef Litigation, Differin, GameSpot, and Colgate contribute smaller amounts.  

Individually, these payouts may not appear substantial. Collectively, they form a diversified stream of incoming funds.  

This approach transforms the process from a random occurrence into a structured system. The key factor is consistency. Instead of waiting for opportunities, individuals actively seek and participate in them.  

---

## Financial Breakdown and Expected Outcomes  

To evaluate this strategy objectively, it is important to consider realistic payout ranges.  

Smaller settlements typically range from 5 to 50 dollars per claim. With approximately seven smaller claims, the total from this category may range between 35 and 350 dollars.  

Mid level settlements, such as Kaiser, often fall between 100 and 300 dollars depending on participation levels and allocation structures.  

Larger settlements, such as Grubhub, may range from 300 to 1200 dollars or more depending on individual involvement and total distribution.  

When combined, the total projected outcomes can be summarized as follows:  

- Low range estimate: 150 dollars  
- Mid range estimate: 400 to 1000 dollars  
- High range estimate: 1200 to 2000 dollars or more  

These figures demonstrate that while individual claims may appear minor, the cumulative effect can be financially meaningful.  

---

## Active Income Versus Captured Income  

A key distinction in this strategy is the difference between active income and what can be described as captured income.  

Active income requires continuous effort. For example, gig work such as delivery driving involves time, fuel, and physical effort. Each dollar earned is directly tied to hours worked.  

Captured income, on the other hand, requires minimal effort after the initial action. Submitting a claim typically takes only a few minutes. After submission, the process continues without additional involvement until distribution occurs.  

This distinction highlights the value of integrating both forms of income. Active income provides immediate cash flow, while captured income contributes supplemental funds over time.  

---

## Strategic Use of Settlement Payouts  

One of the most important aspects of this approach is how the payouts are utilized. Many individuals treat settlement funds as disposable income. This often leads to immediate spending rather than long term benefit.  

A more effective strategy involves consolidating multiple payouts and deploying them intentionally. For example, instead of spending each payout separately, funds can be combined and allocated toward investments.  

This may include:  

- Purchasing cryptocurrency assets  
- Increasing positions in long term holdings such as Hive Power  
- Investing in dividend producing assets  

By redirecting settlement income into investments, individuals can convert temporary gains into assets with potential long term growth.  

---

## The Role of Discipline and Patience  

Despite its simplicity, this system requires discipline. The process does not provide immediate rewards. Claims may take several months to process and distribute.  

This delay discourages many participants. Without instant feedback, individuals often lose interest or fail to track their submissions.  

However, this delay also creates an advantage. Systems that require patience tend to have lower participation rates. As a result, those who remain consistent are more likely to benefit.  

Discipline ensures that claims are submitted regularly, tracked properly, and integrated into a broader financial strategy.  

---

## Recognizing Overlooked Opportunities  

The broader lesson extends beyond legal settlements. Financial opportunities often exist in systems that receive limited attention. These opportunities may not be widely discussed or immediately visible.  

Examples include:  

- Legal settlements  
- Incentive programs  
- Data breach compensations  

Each of these systems operates independently of traditional income sources. Participation is optional, which reduces competition and increases potential value for those who engage.  

Recognizing and acting on these opportunities requires awareness. It also requires a willingness to engage in processes that may appear insignificant at first.  

---

## Conclusion  

The accumulation of multiple settlement claims demonstrates that small financial opportunities can become meaningful when approached systematically. What begins as a series of minor actions evolves into a structured income stream.  

This approach emphasizes consistency, awareness, and intentional decision making. By identifying overlooked opportunities, submitting claims regularly, and strategically deploying payouts, individuals can build additional layers of financial stability.  

Ultimately, the value lies not only in the income generated but in the mindset developed. Small actions, when repeated and managed effectively, can compound over time.  

This reinforces a broader principle in financial strategy: sustainable growth often comes from consistent participation in systems that others overlook.

body.title: Can ZEC Ever Actually Reach $15,000?
body.body: ![Cover Image](https://img.leopedia.io/DQmdRD9hsLx5f4xwgXKHhRn5wTv3JCsBRSi5dywzDfe4xXH/ai-image-1775848465108.jpeg)\n\nZcash has the same 21 Million supply as Bitcoin. It offers the promise of \
. Is ZEC just another coin in a long line of tokens claiming to be as good (or even better than) Bitcoin? \n\nRecently, you've seen some of the biggest crypto influencers & thought leaders being \

. From Naval to the Winklevoss twins to Balaji, we've seen some of the best investors and entrepreneurs of our time backing Zcash as a futuristic technology that can radically change the world. 

We are either on the verge of a massive revolution or right smack in the middle of another piece of vaporware aiming to grab money from the market.

In this post, I'll dive into my ZEC thesis and where I think reality and hype diverge. Uncovering the true value of Zcash, why people may want to own the asset and where I think it can go in the future. 

In other words, **Can ZEC Ever Reach $15,000?**

## Recent News Creating the ZEC Price Action

A lot of recent positive news has surfaced which can take at least *some* of the credit for the recent run in ZEC. 

1. SEC closed its investigation — no enforcement action (Jan 2026)
2. Grayscale filed for the first-ever ZEC spot ETF — $196M AUM (Nov 2025)
3. ZODL raised $25M from Paradigm, a16z, Coinbase Ventures (Mar 2026)
4. Cypherpunk Technologies (Nasdaq: CYPH) bought $97M in ZEC
5. Foundry Digital launching institutional ZEC mining pool (Apr 2026)
6. Vitalik Buterin donated to Zcash development — for the second time

News has a role to play but it drives short-term price action. The real long-term alpha in crypto comes from cycles and fundamental value. 

## Market Cap, Supply and Shielded ZEC

Let's start by gaining a complete picture of what ZEC's tokenomics look like: ZEC has the same 21M Supply as BTC. It was founded under very similar principles as BTC itself. In fact, Satoshi had some famous quotes about zk technology and privacy at-large. Many speculate that \

. 

My thesis on Bitcoin is that it is onchain digital gold. This is vastly different than the promise of Zcash which is onchain digital private cash. 

You don't use cash the same way you use gold. You also don't have the same kind of privacy with BTC as you do with ZEC. As someone who holds a lot of BTC, I don't see ZEC as a competitor to BTC. I see it as a complement to the larger Digital economy that is forming around us in 2026 and beyond. More on this later.

![image](https://img.leopedia.io/DQmdWQkmWa6vDqfRAqMToAExShC8aqCs44zyqx7CgQd9DZF/image.png)

ZEC is the 19th largest crypto in the world and worth $6.2B right now.  

## 3 Reasons I think ZEC Will Be Worth $15,000

Let's shave the fluff and get to the real point of why I'm writing this post. 

I believe ZEC not only **can** be worth $15,000+ per token but that it is **inevitable**. The world is converging on a few topics of interest that all contribute to this thesis and we are only just beginning to see adoption of ZEC in these 3 core ways:

1. Agent Payments
2. Private Digital Transactions
3. Quantum Resistance

#### Agent Payments

The Agentic revolution is not *all* hype. There is definitely a lot of hype in the industry but we are seeing true use cases of agents emerge. There is much more happening behind-the-scenes than most realize. 

It is often obfuscated by the noise and hype around agents and AI in general. When you get to the bottom of it and find out how people are *actually* using agents then it will completely change your perspective. 

I use multiple agents for a wide array of tasks. I have automated pipelines, daily tasks, reminders. Even built a fitness coach but most important to this conversation: I have automated **payments**.

I have to make all sorts of payments on a regular basis. Some are to employees. Others are for bills. Others are for agents to actually transact in various ways (pay server bills, pay for API infrastructure, pay their own AI Inference, etc.). 

Agent2Agent and Agent2Business and Agent2Consumer payments are only just beginning to emerge. In 3-10 years, this will be an obvious end state: Agents will be paying for things and they will prefer to do it **onchain**. In many cases, they will also prefer to do it **privately** - as will humans.

### Private Digital Transactions

Private transactions aren't because you're *hiding* (not always, at least). Sometimes, you just don't want to publicly share what you're buying or **how much money you have**.

One of the big gaps that ZEC solves is that nobody can see your **total balance** when you send a payment onchain.

Imagine if you had to publicly post your Bank Balance on X every time you paid for groceries. This would be a great \

situation. I can't remember the last time I saw someone post their bank balance outside of a ferrari-renting influencer trying to get people to buy his course. 

Being able to transact privately is as much about obfuscating exactly what you're buying and how much you're spending on it as it is about **protecting** your total bank balance. I don't know about you, but I'd prefer if people didn't know exactly how much was in my bank account at any given time. Whether that's an AI watchtower, an insurance company, my mortgage company or Joe living down the block. 

Treating BTC like a savings account (digital Gold) and ZEC as a checking account (private digital cash) makes a lot of sense to me and I don't think I'm alone in this. Many of the influencers I mentioned before become Z-pilled and start echoing the same sentiments. 

### Quantum Resistance

Quantumania! We're all gonna die but not before an AI comes and takes all your crypto!

Look, I'm not a quantum doomer. I see a lot of people on X who are. As technology develops, there is always counter-technology that develops in parallel. I don't buy into the idea that quantum is suddenly going to steal all your crypto and break the encryption of everything on the internet.

That being said, what is the cost of a hedge? What's the economic value of having something that might be quantum resistant or **at the very least** obfuscates your \

so that its not readily available for any hacker/quantum computer/quantum-empowered AI to view freely. 

Is that hedge worth even a meager 1% or 10% of your portfolio? Is that hedge worth 1% or 10% of BTC's market cap? Is that hedge worth 1% or 10% of **all digital assets' market cap?** 

It is hard to put a precise value on being either quantum resistant or at least obfuscated from hacks in general. The value will be a lot to some and a little to others, but I can guarantee that there is some value to it for **everyone**. 

## So What's My Actual Thesis? 

About a third of all ZEC is in the Shielded Pools which means its probably not moving any time soon. Smart money in the form of the top investors and thinkers in the world are backing Zcash as the future of onchain private digital cash. 

Meanwhile, Institutions love to find ways to benefit. Bitcoin continues to grow in size (market cap) and while I think there is a lot of room for growth (I am uber bullish on BTC), I know that Institutions are **greedy** and will ALSO look for shiny new objects they can push for more value. 

Institutions are starting to look at ZEC in a big way. 

**Grayscale** — filed for the first ZEC spot ETF. They did this for BTC before it went from $27K to $100K. Their ZEC Trust AUM hit $196M, up 228%.

**Paradigm** + a16z — led ZODL's $25M seed. These are the same funds that backed Ethereum, Uniswap, and Solana pre-breakout.

body.title: Enjoying Spring at A Conservation Area
body.body: Spring is officially here in southern Canada! 🌞 The old adage of *\

* is finally coming to fruition 🙏 We have been very fortunate to be enjoying such lovely weather together as a family. Just yesterday we were able to take a walk through a beautiful conservation area.
--------------------

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQUJbyAG6zUkDTtYrDDpd5aGUtt9hSmeHZEWmYkPsbSrK/1775834585667.jpg)

The rain stopped once we arrived at the trail (thank goodness), and we made our journey down it. It was uncanny; the day before I was receiving signs from God (or so I would like to believe) that we were meant to go to this location. The water kept piercing my mind until I finally agreed to venture there the following morning. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmW66hGPJXWuoAoGBZGZNHWgM3V7wkaYbCD1XMhyxB2UVV/1775834585880.jpg)

Our girls have never been here before. For me, it holds a lot of bittersweet memories... For although it is a beautiful location, I used to frequent it when I was not in a good place myself... It is very hard to look back on such memories and not be moved by nature, but thankfully I am able to make new, happier memories with my family. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTw4WrCb6KVp1kUEtL1k3S6XjzNzS18kkwDVGHF1rXz89/1775834586009.jpg)

Believe it or not, this enchanting stream is the beginnings of what is known as *Albion Falls.* We did not visit the falls themselves, but the river is a treasure all on its own. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeDStf6nZEBxPbLySBzcmFMgLMNcnhNt69rjYmM1UNgyS/1775834625912.jpg)

Lots of beautiful, natural landscapes. Entire walls of rock slate! The rock would create natural stone stairs. I tried capturing a photo here, but of course, the sun was too bright. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbXXYNEZwEUgST55jftaxRBSPZN5eU7SeJ7MeQAwhnGds/1775834626121.jpg)

Our girls, checking out the river. Of course, anytime we reach a body of water, the first thing they have to do is chuck some stones into it 😂 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUuFRd77s1ZQDBcttnVkfaEAdGSsEzkuHMgxJj6q4RMm9/1775834626348.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXCViwjJY1o5Ns6NytoXJ9fPVQ6cHhP8eUYuT5AFL26kU/1775834626406.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeTvUuyzcN9TiWwCgK2syfqgZSkEu1KxdtkiBJF5VRo7a/1775834626467.jpg)

We kept asking them if they were having a good time, and they always answered yes 😁 It was wonderful to feel the warm sun on our skin, the way the water sparkled underneath it...

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdViKLsL1xF4x5jfZ8qTUmRtRdyDJyR5xdX69vjt7zZfL/1775834910843.jpg)

Some of my favorite photos are of light hitting the surface of the water. Sunlight dances like a thousand glistening crystals. Moonlight is also beautiful and dreamy...

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNMFjz2KN5Pfb1Ayi6uJcMB4uEjTcwSj1Kb3SqmA5CDc1/1775834911052.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQxhfqR62s96sARKYtrB9mmFHnuujnbWT3cQtqR8GbYeH/1775834911256.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcrph2WkhrGdPVYCABfVtR1hjYG45VMGvpwaQxe8ceGa8/1775834911508.jpg)

Getting some great family pictures 😁 Our youngest's face in this one cracks me up!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVjJbiXVcaiHkHxTG5W9LkQ1TFPLWXCh2r32swC3fytbS/1775834952328.jpg)

Another lovely shot of the water. I especially enjoy the way it ripples near the tree...

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZo55SsSdAKrDiHoNLiowbJhAByQwtVng5hfYxjGTYTwK/1775834952544.jpg)

I love this shot as well. The tiny little trail that walks alongside the trees has been so trodden that the roots are exposed. The water ebbs away at what little shoreline remains. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZBXqYTtE2x7u1RhU1dyK98HTjxfLTLtdvHRHBKM8eCrk/1775835303646.jpg)

Further along the trail, we came across this \

tunnel. My husband researched it once we got home, and this was reportedly a tunnel that ran under the train tracks since 1895! Unfortunately, it eventually crumbled in the 1980s, and this is all that remains. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWtxFHM66okB6DtxuuUpFpRktWwVYvrZNxrh4J9naqizc/1775834952778.jpg)

I saw this along the way and of course had to snap a picture 😂

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaeXyLZd8aWRW8pDYzj8KF849wxnCLRkfRJkEyzqyXymb/1775834952898.jpg)

We also came across a little memorial spot that someone had set up. The flowers were artificial, but I believe it may be dedicated to someone's dog who enjoyed walking the trail 🐶🪽...

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc7DfKH2xeLNBVDoyJ6Rpcy46RKz9nXitkHPbihwBEvAs/1775835046519.jpg)

I wanted to capture this shot of the overpass, as well as the pipeline further ahead. Again, the pipeline had to do with the train tracks that used to run through here. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNP2ke5G1eLGTce9pBjS5ToL77rJ7zy6aBTvHhZddKkuQ/1775835046665.jpg)

Under the overpass, I saw this graffiti. The smoking demon? is cool on its own, but it is the writing that truly spoke to me:

*\

*
----------------

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUgWvpDJe4izkGhRykmQjSk2fLXoGA5TE5y7pztSLJG4e/1775835046815.jpg)

Walking further along the trail, we came across an opening through the trees that gave us a great view of the city skyline. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmW6u6puBBGzpMwkCkbVqcE28RH2inbG8iRaQbVbqzgx1b/1775835046998.jpg)

Anything for the shot! 😅 My husband took these photos of me climbing back over the barrier, haha!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXb1sH5ZGjme92u751XpAQUSDKBDMFN514boRSVDybKs5/1775835047055.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaLgNXBPQ5GedD5VqA2242Xsh9aYcYpjkeSiQhtCHSwUb/1775835150700.jpg)

I found this cliff to be stunning! This part of the escarpment rock was a vibrant green color -- amazing!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXNpH4Pk8hjYWJifryfUmCRvz9XX6T8mBGHzXyj1mmEfE/1775835150919.jpg)

These are the Uli Stairs! It is an incredible creation. There never used to be any proper stairs to climb down from the mountain to downtown, so a few people took it upon themselves to create their own stairs! Some locals carried rocks over to this spot and created manmade stairs out of them. Best of all, it is open for public use 😃

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNTFoXeMA3BZcwkiWMdPdYQyTGhNisKegCA5kaZcNdSBm/1775835151115.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWetFTWxk4rf8UuP3G3VpyoW2BiACiU4AfFZuvGH6FYUv/1775835151185.jpg)

Blessed enough to have even captured this picture of a Redtailed Hawk! 😍 These birds frequent the area, especially because of our pigeon population -- hawks love hunting pigeons 😅 I didn't want to scare the bird, so I tried my best to zoom in...

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWnpDprE4TEEkNB3RoAFpwQvX3ZNEs2EACMbTe16MGGuH/1775835151299.jpg)

I love this shot 💛 Further downtown sits a single house, all dressed in yellow paint. It's so vibrant that we were still able to spot it over 100 feet away! 😂 Can you see the yellow house in the picture??

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNXbvBq21ZjmNc6AA1uUkE38AMucbxKpf7yeMfHxdAHS7/1775835211988.jpg)

This is probably my favorite photo of the entire trip. There is nothing quite like the love shared between a daughter and her father 💗
---------------

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVcZ239KHaLFPDn28VtWHN6HXYPpnMpA8P7xm964c8G5F/1775835212161.jpg)

A great one that my husband took 😂 My hat is two sizes too small because it is actually our oldest daughter's! 🤣

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfUTjZRxoH2XryLXMmSVHmAHtzzK8RnpCNqwBG8XzRpU5/1775835212222.jpg)

Off to the side of the trail, I spotted these beautiful blue flowers already blooming out of the ground. Our girls picked a few of them; they actually had a subtle sweet smell to them.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfLFXPfgW352mtEdHJvKwLZtigchuptbWznV6UBmuP9Fc/1775835212396.jpg)

A sad photo that I took... I also spotted this along the side of the trail. It was a framed photo that had been broken... As unfortunate as it is, there are a few homeless encampments on this trail; a lot of them turn to drug use. I wondered if perhaps this was a father who had lost his young son because of the choices he had made... Regardless, seeing such a happy photo crumbled off to the side like this was heartbreaking...

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSBiBbCGjC8muEcgVCVcJTfJeKKLJ2EBRnzqnCKPaNQXH/1775835212593.jpg)

At the end of the trail, we were met with the words that we had been telling our girls the whole time: *\

* Oh yes, I am incredibly proud of our young daughters. They are only 4 and 3-years-old; we were outside for 6 hours and walked over 20,000 steps! All the while, they did it without a single complaint (they did get tired a few times, but we had their car stroller that they took turns in).
------------------

------------
------------

**What a great outing! I truly had a wonderful time, and the rest of my family is in agreement. It was great to be out in the sunshine, smelling the fresh air and the damp earth, taking in the sights... I hope you enjoyed the post, and as always, happy (and safe) travels! 🛩**

body.body:
Hello everyone,
How are you all? I hope everyone is fine and doing great in their life.

I am back with another Splinterlands blog, and today I want to share something a bit different.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRn2xg9XE8HdEAXH8nK7RiyC1xXdtQxQbUyRfHNjXJnhr/image.png)


Before that, I would like to talk about my future plan in the game. I am planning to shift completely from Frontier battle mode to Modern battle mode. I feel like I have already earned enough in Frontier mode and reached the highest league possible there. Now I want to focus on mastering the Modern league.

I will still play Frontier occasionally, but my main focus will now be on Modern mode. For that, I am also planning to start buying packs and cards directly.

As usual, I started the day by opening foundation packs. Normally I open five, but today I only had four, so I opened four foundation packs. As you can see in the screenshot below, I was not expecting much from them. Even though last time I got a gold summoner, I still kept my expectations low.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcQtXPLxwF4TKZR1P3PaDNfYXVPCKZPSUDfKAbJZhRvzJ/image.png)

In the screenshot, you can see all the cards I received. Thankfully, this was not a bad opening. I got two summoners, which is enough for me to feel satisfied.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaQS8FMibNnN2ktTqVEz97yBNnemTeG5wXevTPwnTQNdU/image.png)

Today, I also upgraded two of my common cards. In the screenshot below, you can see the first one, New Beluroc Aegis. I combined 60 cards to upgrade it. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcNT3mieyBmUn16cu6MT6cQuwqcW9FtZ8UpPEC9aZkK59/image.png)

Then I also upgraded Kanaaq Miner by combining 60 cards, and now both of them are at their maximum level.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS9GfRvZ4fc1aMstse5zXrtqM8MgaR1Sph8pEteLLtKir/image.png)

After that, I went to the Glint shop and bought Minor Chests. I only bought four chests for 2,000 Glint. I was hoping to get at least one or two common cards.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUSKKbUfjUHApKK99JX7yKsUG8TXV8r4FGJs4zgdhJWdS/image.png)

As you can see below, I was lucky enough to get one rare card from those four chests. I also received 170 merits, 99 merits, and one alchemy potion charge. So overall, it was a good deal this time.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcibQ2ZpXqnnAVMDFL7C6kq89egmNQenrsTrqtw33j2o5/image.png)

I then checked the market value of the new card I got. The card is Anchor Hex Adept from the Earth category, and it is worth around 9 cents. I am happy to have it.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeJqwcrrdAp1iN6EdCawt8ZCkDVTbz6ooe27vVaDtbE6j/image.png)

Now let me share one of the battles I played today.

This battle had the “Going the Distance” modifier, which means only ranged monsters could be used. It also had the “Equal Opportunity” modifier, so every monster had the opportunity ability and attacked the enemy with the lowest health.

Both of us used Earth element monsters. The battle was quite balanced, but my Alan Musketeer was one level higher than my opponent’s, which gave me some confidence.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd8WouRrytHCLA5RtntLDpCEmgXXxyoEmsZLiPH6m4V8w/image.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWujocSU7ioDMtutHdbPiWLvf3PMcfkBdpjXXpNAun5Js/image.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPMRyW83GeoWeceZxPXdNJFemCfSQ2sR7ESEUwk2cuyb4/image.png)

In my Terracore base, I had 8 attacks ready, and I used all of them at once. Since I recently upgraded my stats, I was expecting to earn at least 2000 scraps.

body.title: Who Says Motherhood Is Easy?
body.body:
There’s this notion that motherhood is easy, and honestly, that idea could not be further from the truth, especially when you’re doing it without money to ease the load. I often hear people say that it gets easier as you go along, but those words are usually coming from people who have the financial freedom to make their lives a little simpler. If you’re lucky enough to have money, a lot of things can be outsourced. Things like childcare, cleaning services, and even the small but important things like a washing machine, suddenly, motherhood feels a bit more manageable.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmagfECzNEH9FyfoLZLMkBDHvxxNAS8mZeN3K5V5VvhHBp/1775848164012.jpg)


But for the rest of us who are doing it without that cushion, life is not as easy as it may seem. Every day is a reminder of how much hard work it takes to keep things going. And sometimes, the little things we take for granted are the ones that make all the difference. I’ve been telling myself for months now that I need a washing machine. It's not a luxury; it’s a necessity. The thought of not having to spend hours on end washing clothes by hand feels like a dream. But reality is, I don’t have that kind of money, and so, I’m stuck doing it the hard way.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSQNx5yQjk4x7jem5W2Y8nU2L2asd1jf1XWNo4GicEhG4/1775848192922.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdJZqU2SdnhdzGus9Fh8u4kXrGr8ZG4GWMB4kAuz4Vko7/1775848193367.jpg)


The simple task of washing clothes has become a mountain. It’s not like when I was single and could do a load of laundry here and there. Now, with a family, it feels like there’s always something to wash. I try to do laundry every three days, but honestly, the amount piles up so quickly that it feels like I’m washing everything I wore for two weeks when I was living alone. It’s really exhausting both physically and mentally. I find myself dreading the moment when I’ll have to face the laundry pile again, knowing I’ll be scrubbing and wringing clothes for hours.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf6UMsoF1XJxsYYRUbcpsDq588hFpkxBJ8jjLrr4ZJnWH/1775848239170.jpg)


The worst part of it all is how my hands have suffered. I can’t even look at them without feeling a sense of frustration. They’re rough, cracked, and sore from the constant scrubbing. It’s a reminder that this is what my day-to-day looks like, and it’s not easy. When you don't have money to make your life easier, you end up sacrificing your time, your energy, and sometimes even your health. I look at my hands and wonder how much longer I’ll be able to keep up with this. I try to tell myself that one day things will get better, but when you’re caught in the cycle of doing everything by hand, it can feel like there’s no end in sight.

I know I’m not alone in this. There are countless mothers out there doing everything they can, with very little resources, to keep things running. They might not have the luxury of outsourcing tasks, but they do what they have to do. And even though it’s hard, they find strength in pushing through. Because motherhood isn’t about how easy things are, it’s about how much you’re willing to sacrifice to make sure your family is taken care of. It’s a reminder that behind every mom’s tired eyes and rough hands, there’s an immense amount of love and dedication.

So, next time someone tells you that motherhood is easy, remember that it’s easy when you have the resources to make it so. For the rest of us, it's a constant grind, but one that’s worth it, even if it means getting our hands a little rough along the way.




**Thanks for checking on my blog and have a wonderful day**

body.title: My Amazing Little Adventure Buddy!
body.body:
My 4 year old daughter always sits with me while I edit photos and videos. Looking at all of the places that I adventure to and telling me how badly she wants to come with me! So I started taking her to some easier to access waterfalls and now if I say that I am going to one. Well there is no way I can go without her lol. 

On this rainy and windy day, I planned on hiking to the Devils Punchbowl in Stoney Creek Ontario and without fail. When I told her that, she wanted to come. I was on the fence about her coming because it is a more difficult hike and even more difficult in these weather conditions. Ultimately I decided to bring her and if it got too hard, we could always turn around and I could come back another day. 

To my surprise, she had no issues and before we knew it. We were at the base of the falls! (usually there would be photos of the hike but I was helping her lol)
![IMG_1569.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQWRVMWhpSegs1cTFkGay9Fpjv4dUTr4kC1aQsb2wRkAy/IMG_1569.JPG)

![IMG_1551.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmX6V3o4zR7VXe5cEmScSkrvs9srU54ki4CHtEaDCLU5gp/IMG_1551.JPG)

Watching the wind intermediately blowing the waterflow around.

![IMG_1562.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWekUT9iSWyi4JRm4s52uUygSZKREYz6F5egv5J4wWiei/IMG_1562.JPG)

I stood with my camera and watched her traverse the rocks and water. No fear, no hesitation. Just wonderment and excitement! 

![IMG_1554.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZDqeS9TFarynNZGAyxFooVSG1aR8MBX4C2wT4Fad4ftc/IMG_1554.JPG)



![IMG_1523.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdDo5oUM3emzGvKmLyXYV3V4Ho2aothBiC62nYJ6PQmTw/IMG_1523.JPG)

![IMG_1527.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcbKoZjzR2EDJvYvMyMnsoNcyAtSwPHtTF4anu5wdFWBr/IMG_1527.JPG)


![IMG_1531.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRso1PuzzLXVt4pba4PEiDh3v3FrHVdWNBgV3DZNvzVLU/IMG_1531.JPG)

I am so proud of her! And feel so completely blessed that I can share these adventures with her! As parents we all hope that we can pick which memories become core memories, but of course we cannot. To me if there was ever a great one, this would be it! Going with my dad to face adversity and conquer fears/set backs, with the payoff of soaking in some incredible natural beauty!

She is quickly becoming my little adventure buddy and I could not be happier!

body.title: Turning Pages
body.body:
The UK weather has finally been improving over the past month, and with that, I have achieved Higher step counts, shed more weight, and spent more time outdoors. I stepped into spring after a tough but fresh winter months of early 2026, I set goals and got my life more on track and for the most part it went well. Going into spring and the hotter months, life is still financially tricky, but I aim to stay positive and appreciate all the little things I'm doing that are not only cost-free but improving my health both physically and mentally.
I am, Turning Pages

>
My social battery is doing very well. I am spending far more time Networking, catching up with friends and building an online presence. My 2026 goals have been steadily staying on track, and my health is doing much better. I have lost 10kg in 3 months.
Sometimes I have a bad day, but that is normal; everyone has a bad day. Life won't always go your way, and for me, the big thing is Money. Sure, it is not everything, but money is something you depend on, and things like debt, cost of living and fearing about my future are just chronic things that I will always worry about. It's just how my mind works. To combat this chronic thinking, my goals and small wins come into play; they give my mind a break and something else to focus on. Reading, for example, those 15-20 minutes I spend every so often turning pages closes my mind and instead focuses on taking in a fresh story. Achieving 10k steps a day forces me to go outside and avoid being left alone, so my mind doesn't spiral. Writing allows me to get everything out of my mind and onto something else, and when it looks good for me, I post it just like this post today, tomorrow and whenever.
I leave this post here for today. Thank you for having a read, have a great day.
DISLCAIMER: Photos are my own unless otherwise stated

body.title: Anthropic Claude Mythos Will Break Vulnerability Management
body.body:
/>

\n

\n
Anthropic’s latest AI Model, Claude Mythos, will break the cybersecurity vulnerability management operational models. Mythos is so good at discovering and building viable exploits it is currently being rolled-out in a controlled manner under “

>Project Glasswing“. Those cybersecurity companies who have early access are attesting to the blazing speed and accuracy of the model and have declared the traditional processes the industry uses to manage vulnerabilities in their systems is no longer viable.

The Problem is Twofold

First, new AI models like Mythos, are incredibly proficient at identifying weaknesses in code that could be leveraged by cyber attackers. Mythos has found over 2000 high-severity vulnerabilities, including in every major operating system and web browser!

The second issue is how fast workable exploits can be created to take advantages of discovered vulnerabilities. The latest AI models are highly proficient and quickly figuring out how to leverage weakness and chain them together across multiple vulnerabilities to gain unprecedented access to targeted systems and infrastructures.

The speed of discovery and exploitation of vulnerabilities is now well beyond what defenders can address. Currently, the industry must become aware of vulnerabilities through industry announcements, direct notification by researchers, or in rare cases by self-discovery efforts. They must then verify the vulnerability and understand its potential applicability to their environment. It gets rated and based upon that rating; resources will be committed to develop a patch. The patch must be tested and then scheduled for roll-out in a way that it can be withdrawn if something unforeseen occurs.

This takes time and may incur downtime for impacted systems.

Legacy Patching Fails

Most organizations have a cadence for addressing different severity vulnerabilities. A patch calendar may bundle fixes to control the disruption and prioritize the most urgent fixes. High risk may be fixed in weeks or a month, medium in several months, and low, perhaps every year if they choose to fix them at all.

The goal is simply to fix the vulnerabilities before the attackers could create and deploy an exploit in the wild, which typically took months.

No longer.

Now, what took months will take minutes with Mythos and other AI models.

/>

\n

That breaks the entire vulnerability management system that protects our digital world.

\n

For those who read my annual

>video version), we can check off prediction number 2, which outlined how AI acceleration would shrink the time-to-patch window dramatically, beyond what is currently possible for cybersecurity teams.

\n

/>

Predicting Strategic Outcomes

First, organizations will cut corners to speed up patch release for the impactful vulnerabilities most likely to be exploited. This will shrink the patch window a little, but not enough, and introduce errors in patches which will have undesired impacts on users. Essentially, the number of ‘bad patches’ will increase.

Secondly, the increased attack velocity will drive software developers to commit much more to using AI tools to proactively detect and resolve vulnerabilities prior to product release. This should have happened long ago, but in the race to market, security vetting often gets deferred to later. The outcome will be slower product release timelines from responsible vendors. The haphazard companies will want to take advantage and continue to push vulnerable code to get into the market faster. But that will eventually have consequences.

Third, there will be massive shift for cybersecurity teams to adopt these AI tools to compete with attackers by trying to detect and address vulnerabilities before the hackers. The tools, processes, and operating models will need to be entirely redrawn. The window of exposure will be the metric that must shrink, from months to hours.

Adaptation Required

The latest AI tools will compress the vulnerability lifecycle from discovery to exploitation at a pace that challenges the foundations of today’s security operations. Organizations that continue to rely on legacy processes will find themselves operating outside the window of safety. Defenders can no longer rely on traditional disclosure cycles, patch cadences, or reactive security models when intelligent systems can discover and weaponize weaknesses in hours. To survive this new era, organizations must reinvent their processes around AI-driven velocity. The signals are clear; it is time to radically adapt vulnerability management or be victimized.

body.title: KRUENG SIMPO RIVER // Visiting tourist destinations that have been lost due to natural factors.
body.body:
## Good night to all my beloved hive friends ❤️ ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbtPpb3MxU4oaJSDkHv7cki19iAB1edQ68q8v4RWEBC1x/1775825508575.jpg) In this post I will share my experience when visiting one of the open nature tourism destinations in Bireuen city, namely Krueng Simpo River, this is one of the old tourist destinations that is always crowded with visitors, especially during big days, but how nature changed this tourist spot that was once beautiful and crowded is now damaged and abandoned, and this incident occurred after the big flood that hit Aceh 4 months ago which changed many events. As the name suggests, in this tourist spot we can see the beautiful natural scenery of a fast flowing river which is added to the large rocks, the condition of the water is also quite clear so that it will attract every visitor to swim there. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNUVxPmAxVfo2oBx45M6xQ4XbAvPZhn9ovXTPwjqvGkGA/1775825508891.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdvpDoZpzVYU1kqGHh4DgsNTVkxeoNZkGTnvSxmrBinw8/1775825508963.jpg) On the trip I was also surprised by the view of the very congested road conditions, I did not know the cause of the congestion at all so I chose to stop for a moment at a mosque building on the side of the road, because of my curiosity I dared to ask about the traffic jam to the local residents, it turned out that the congestion was caused by a bridge that had broken or collapsed due to flooding 4 months ago, this really surprised me because it turned out that there were so many bridges in Bireuen that were destroyed by flooding. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdrFGuT5onM7gzmeUTo9BktBmgtaprZ4HpkUMMmtiDQH5/1775825508637.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPQZ6SRWTrR81FUEj5HN6QRkjoFVRhSEdnM9VbVJqEmwj/1775825508711.jpg) From the mosque area I could see the view of the bridge in its entirety, it was visible that half of the bridge had collapsed, but a temporary bridge had been installed but its size was small so it caused severe traffic jams, especially when the Eid holiday was taking place. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRxxe4NzUhPNbGNwQXs7cTFukuEAAYh3hH5T8vDrFuMHt/1775825508747.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdFKrzCNXRDX5aGHBpK2jWuEt5Rr2biWgAMhi6wXV7JBX/1775825508827.jpg) And I was also very surprised because the size of this river was very large but shallow. From a distance I saw several fishing boats parked on the riverbank, and maybe when this bridge was broken, many people chose to cross this river using boats. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYRgJa7p2nmkdBTmTARpdftzv2rVuAH7ff9wvfbgKKopY/1775825509038.jpg) Luckily, the mosque building was still standing strong without any damage to any part of the building except for the fence. I didn't linger in this area because the more I waited, the more congested the traffic jam became and I didn't want to waste my time. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVetkjNuoXdL7qw2K7qWwRiewb83sgAghGTnYanLkWKVC/1775825509106.jpg) After continuing the journey for about 20 minutes, I finally arrived at the Krueng Simpo river tourist destination area. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXhYRJHhJGKSZ3J9VB5Pm6CVmkkFwm8CpoUZf8DuqyELm/1775825509214.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaQt1xtqvNzgTRx3D4G4aeRV6RZ4YUyHVCi5GXV7u8f4A/1775825509289.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTFv6XibZ8YcsX2YJPNp72aCfzM5gphu3jknvswF2g7is/1775825509370.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZNh3ihQarGVtKbczdQJ489mQU81p1HrhBq32msHYApn1/1775825509465.jpg) There are many tourist destinations on the banks of this river, but some of them have been damaged or even disappeared under the flood currents, one thing that really surprised me was the size of this river is very big, even many of the large rocks that are typical of this place have also disappeared, previously the water in this river was very clear and clean so it was very tempting, but look at it now ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcLHdZTrWq7PtTxSMAD7eh4o9LstPkqCiu2rVxMDEpePY/1775825509552.jpg) The land area on the riverbank was also eroded by the flood currents and that is what caused many chairs and huts to disappear at this tourist spot, but even so, this place remains a very interesting tourist destination to visit, especially for nature lovers, my partner and I also took the time to stop by this place at that time. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbmWHzCZ24jG89WQxCNJkpk7gCL1UaxkrM1fNEy366yhQ/1775825509628.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ27fkjUUpobLVqW2FRNjv2woagx8DjzCJwJe6nKV6Mag/1775825509695.jpg) However, I was also curious about some of my other favorite tourist destinations, so that day I also took the time to visit some of my frequent destinations. When I arrived at a village, I managed to capture a extraordinary beautiful natural view from the side of the road, but unfortunately, I didn't know the name of the area. ----

Life is a responsibility Be yourself, keep learning and don't hesitate to start😉

If you like other travel posts, you can see them on [Worldmappin Community](https://v3.ecency.com/created/hive-163772) and you can also participate there. If you are curious about the places I have visited so far, you can see them on [my personal worldmappin map](https://worldmappin.com/@riyat) And you can also find me on [Ecency Discord](https://discord.com/invite/m9MyMSWx)

----

Thank you very much for reading my post till the end, I am here to say thank you very much 🙏

---- ----

All images are mine, I took the photos using the Infinix 10 pro cellphone and I edited the images using the Lightroom application. I'm @riyat. See you again in my next post ♥️

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUN9nntgpNJ1ypjuf6n5aFE7NxREqaqf8CPc4xtygyCJn/1000265546.gif) [//]:# (!worldmappin 5.06538 lat 96.71217 long d3scr)

body.title: I Will Do The Needful
body.body:
Let me tell you the things that are very important to me. I need money for my business. I need to get materials for my bag making business. Especially, these days there are high demand for school bags, lunch packs and the rest. So, if there were no problem of money, I would get much leather materials to use and make as many bags as I can make. The market is already ripe and I am in need of real fund. Still looking in the direction of income generation, I would acquire more machines for my workshop. At the present, I have shortage of machines because there are more apprentices in my workshop than the number of machines which is available.

My husband has been taking about diversifying our income sources. We are hoping on opening other income sources which will had to our revenue. If money was not a problem, we will open up a poultry farm where we will be producing eggs and chicken meat. We have been hoping on doing that. So, I just wish the money would just come. Our income is not actually enough. You know, as the children keep growing the needs for money in the family keeps increasing. So, it will be a great one to have money and expand our revenue generation scope.

My children are also very important. I will make my children happy by getting them those things that will make their hearts happy. With always enough money to spend and spare as I like, hey, my little daughter would have gotten enough cookies as she had always wanted. Also, I will give them the beautiful education and upbringing. So, we really need money because they are many things waiting for money.

Our house is still under construction. What I mean is that we have not finished the furnishings in our house. There are still so many things to put in place. With the problem of money out of the way, we will complete our house and furnish it to our taste. 

Besides, I have friends and relatives who really need help. I have always wanted to help but there is no money to do as much as I should. If they were no problem of money, I will be a helping hand to those who do not have much.

body.title: Splinterlands | The ASHVEIL TACTICIAN is a No Attack But Great Abilities
body.body:
![Kaylia Silverleaf.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/241tja4QpdsQGfo1TaEPf5eXHTHJbqTrqxyc1NMS9ayTmSmk5HvsgAPHxWkqPxfWDBJGi.jpg)

 --- 



### Hi there my fellow Splinterlands Warriors,

Welcome back to another Splinterlands post, and I hope all of you are doing pretty well and spending an awesome day with your family and friends. For those of you who are actively playing this amazing web3 card-based strategy game and focusing hard on building your card and other asset collection in Splinterlands, I believe most, if not all of you, are currently busy grinding ranked battles and trying to improve your standings before the season ends. If we take a quick look at the current season timer, there are still around 4 days and 19 hours left before the current ranked season meets its end. So this is a very crucial phase where every battle matters, and whether you want to push your trophy count and secure your desired league tier position or aim for even further and grab a spot in the champion top leaderboard, I wish you all the best and hope you reach there sooner this time. Just make sure to manage your battle energy carefully so that you can maximise your rewards and don't miss them when needed the most.

 --- 



![Screenshot 2026-04-10 at 9.31.16 AM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/23vhU12JKPsjPdcZrY1EYH2kDHsNC8GFSjgVWvkUQLmzwu1g7sEQYUCjmXYXY8vBCmEXv.png)


 --- 




Now, taking a look at my own progress in the frontier mode in this game, I am currently playing in Gold I, the highest league tier, with a trophy count of around 3,560. My main goal remains the same, which is to reach the 4,000 trophy mark first of all and then try pushing further for the leaderboard. With only a few days left, it is going to be a bit challenging, but I will try my best to make it happen.

 --- 



![Screenshot 2026-04-10 at 12.31.19 AM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/EoyN3W8nr9xHT6S4wZ92zrtWRx9gqDSk4GUGqh5nFeFkqhuzopk9BgYMKAWky1daYue.png)

![Screenshot 2026-04-10 at 12.31.37 AM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/23wgB1GP9XHSTytGfCGxhL5vcAjLGZRiBmdKkirEzpTETvckYQVTw8VwTeqooDrRZYHyr.png)

 --- 



On the other hand, if we take a look at the weekly Frontier raffle, so far, I have already collected a total of 15 entries. With around 2 days and 18 hours left before the raffle draw, I will try to increase this number to at least 50 entries or more. Since I missed a couple of days of playing this season, I had to reduce my target this time, but let’s see how things go. You can also see the outcome of the 3 foundation packs which I won from my last playing and gladly, this time I got myself 1 legendary, 3 rares, including 2 summoners and all the rest common cards, which is a very good pull, I think.

 --- 



![image-removebg-preview.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/AK2C4zUWhmT2H7TzTqY8KWF6pLKxyajXRtFk5zawSy56o1fdrY5vBdPUY31CJHf.png)

 --- 



### Ashveil Tactician

Now moving forward, let us come to the main topic of this post, as today I will be taking a closer look at a very unique monster from the newest Escalation mini edition. As you have already seen in the title and thumbnail above, today I will be projecting the spotlight upon the Ashveil Tactician. So if you are interested in learning more about this monster card, let us dive deeper without any further delay.

The Ashveil Tactician is a monster-type card that was introduced in the game with the newly launched Escalation edition mini cardset. This monster belongs to the Fire element and comes from the Elf bloodline. By rarity, this card is a Rare monster, so you will require a total of 115 CC cards in order to upgrade it to its maximum level. Now, if you want to use this monster in battles, you only need to spend 4 mana, which makes it very easy to fit into different types of lineups from low to high, including the ones with little league ruleset. Interestingly, this monster does not have any attack of its own, but instead relies completely on its abilities to provide value to your team. At its maximum level, this monster gains a total of four abilities, which makes it a very strong support unit. Let us now take a closer look at its league-wise stats and abilities to find out more about this monster.

 --- 




![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/23xV6BMtsfB1GDtmXsC6egXgNfFV2JwJYw9vaWo1pakJPUsxLGmJcq7gDZ2BWCggxFzJS.png)

 --- 



#### BRONZE

At level 2, this monster holds decent defensive stats that consist of 3 speed with 2 armor and 4 health. Even though it does not have any attack power, it gains its first ability called Inspire. This ability makes it very useful when you are running a lineup with multiple melee attackers.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/23w2cX2cx1DuGhrYB4wwUMF6qtGNLW3CraLdveDopJqoEBD74VWaNH5DVxviZBkiPKYUk.png)

`INSPIRE` – +1 melee power to all allied units.



#### SILVER

When you upgrade this monster further to level 4, its stats improve and it now holds 4 speed with 3 armor and 5 health. At this level, it also unlocks another useful ability called Pinpoint. This ability works very well when combined with Sneak-based strategies.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/AK55Bm5akRuPcmi21LsWeDdvdutL9XPN2KzvYfzqFrB7Puk1ASP2QqQWybf46br.png)


`PINPOINT` – Allied Sneak attacks cannot miss.



#### GOLD

As this monster gets upgraded further and reaches level 6, its stats improve again and it now carries 4 speed with 3 armor and 7 health. At this level, it also gains another ability called Magic Reflect. This makes it a good option when facing magic-heavy enemy teams.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/23wzzRZ4GboDCkxks1MQKKHiutXNb8sLGrHfkUWEbnY3bLVRQniHxxsUJJjueJAXFf6e1.png)

`MAGIC REFLECT` – Returns 50% of damage to the attacker (rounded up) when hit by a magic attack.



#### DIAMOND / CHAMPION

Finally, when you upgrade this monster to its maximum level of 10, its stats improve further and it now holds 5 speed with 4 armor and 9 health. At this level, it also gains another powerful ability called Shield Ward. This ability makes it very useful when placed in the second position to support your main tank.



![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/AK6SrcuJeee66HUxeWN4w23ATY9dZgnCcYNsvYDQX7Rb2rnG5TuBNTaLEkx6oDo.png)


`SHIELD WARD` – At the start of the battle, the unit in front of this unit gains Shield.



Last but not least, I think this monster is a very strong support unit despite having no attack. First of all, it comes with a solid combination of armor and health, along with good speed, which helps it survive for a long time in battles. Another major advantage is its synergy with melee attackers. The Inspire and Pinpoint abilities together can significantly boost the effectiveness of Sneak-based melee strategies. On top of that, the Magic Reflect ability makes it a good choice against magic-heavy lineups. Finally, its Shield Ward ability makes it extremely useful when placed in the second position, as it provides additional protection to your frontline tank. Overall, I think the Ashveil Tactician is a very strategic and useful monster that can enhance your team's performance in multiple ways. What do you think?

#### I hope you enjoyed reading my post about ASHVEIL TACTICIAN. Let me know your thoughts about today's post in the comments section below, and I look forward to seeing you all in my next post.

 --- 



<center>![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVjRvqqj6rjKZp9xk5H54AZMoSXGU8oqRBJVvWjmVq53f/image.png)</center>

### <center>Thanks for visiting my post, hope we meet again!</center>

##### <center>Stay well and keep playing Splinterlands!</center>

body.body:
**Correct take:** saving is defense, **investing is offense**. Wanting less can stop you from being broke, but it won’t magically make you rich unless the money you keep is turned into assets that grow, earn yield, or increase your income over time. That’s the whole game, and your point about **mindset + strategy** is the real spine of the post. [Your post](https://inleo.io/@intishar/wanting-less-wont-make-you-rich--l5a)

The image works well too. It sells the contrast cleanly: **hoarding money in a vault vs putting money into motion**. That’s a smart visual because wealth usually comes less from “saving harder” and more from directing capital toward productive things.

The sharpest line in this topic is simple: **frugality creates room, but allocation creates wealth**. That’s why good personal finance advice keeps coming back to the same boring truth — control lifestyle creep, save consistently, and put the saved money to work through businesses, skills, or investments rather than letting it just sit there. [WSJ on saving vs investing](https://www.wsj.com/buyside/personal-finance/banking/saving-vs-investing) · [Highland Financial Advisors, Jan 27 2026](https://www.highlandplanning.com/learning-center-1/five-financial-habits-that-build-and-maintain-long-term-wealth-in-2026)

A few related reads around this same theme:
- [@intishar](https://inleo.io/@intishar/wanting-less-wont-make-you-rich--l5a) · 2026-04-10 — wanting less helps, but isn’t enough without a real wealth-building plan.
- [@mightyrocklee](https://inleo.io/@mightyrocklee/my-financial-independenc...) · 2026-04-10 — long-term financial independence framed as a multi-plan asset strategy.

**Bottom line:** poor spending habits can wreck wealth, but rich outcomes usually come from a mix of **discipline, patience, and owning appreciating assets**. Saving money under the mattress is safe. It’s also how money goes to sleep and stays there.

body.title: Wanting less won't make you rich
body.body:
>

Money is the most powerful thing in this world. Some people say that money cannot buy everything, which is true, but the power of money can bring most things within our grasp. So, it is very natural for people to chase money. Everyone wants to earn lots of money and wants to be rich. It is unfortunate that being rich is one of the most difficult things. Almost everyone dreams about it, but very few become successful in this case. A person’s mindset and strategy make one person rich. ![Inline Image](https://img.leopedia.io/DQmWRyyzLhMXrnsatMCQtFjKbvauiXduNXp8ggay4Pp2v5a/ai-image-1775846795118.jpeg) picture generated by rafiki It is necessary to understand the difference between want and need. Again, there can be something we want that can be very important but does not belong to the category of need. I am trying to say that there are many things we actually want but that are not necessary to fulfill all our desires. Because if we end up spending too much money and effort on them, in the future, it will block the path to becoming rich. It is something very simple to say, but it's powerful. Wanting less or having fewer demands indeed helps us save some money, but does it help us become rich? Wanting less or demanding less is a good thing, and it can help us save a good amount of assets, which can be helpful to us when necessary. But I can clearly answer that having fewer demands or wanting less is not enough to make anyone rich. If that were the case, then I think many people would be rich by now, as they have fewer demands in their lives. It also does not mean that I’m allowing reckless spending. Spending money recklessly is something that can be an obstacle for us. Earning and spending should be balanced; otherwise, we will be stuck in one stage forever. If we are earning a lot, we should try to save as much as we can. But why are we saving money? My mother is very good at saving money, and I really appreciate her for it, but only saving money can be a backup asset during times of emergency. I don’t think a rich person thinks about it only that way. A rich person, or the person who will be rich in the future, will try to utilize the savings as much as he can. Normal people will keep it in banks; the rich person will use it for investment. A bank can be a safe option, but low returns are not enough to overcome the inflation rate. On the other hand, investing can be risky but can give maximum returns on our assets. One person needs to be brave enough to take the risk and get the losses; yes, everything does not go according to plan. Most people want a steady lifestyle and think keeping money in a bank is the best way to get a secure return, but in the end, their money is losing value because of the inflation rate. So, it’s difficult for them to become rich, but the ones who are bold enough to take risks can shine in life, and they have the possibility of being rich in life. What I’m trying to say is that wanting less doesn’t allow us to be rich. The thing that makes us rich is our mindset and our strategy.

body.title: Un pastel contra reloj: Celebrando la vida a pesar de la distancia
body.body: >Hola a todos, deseo que estén muy bien. Hoy quiero compartirles una anécdota que mezcla la nostalgia, las carreras en la cocina y, sobre todo, el cariño. Se trata de la elaboración \

de un pastel para celebrar la vida de una persona a la que aprecio muchísimo y que estaba de cumpleaños. A veces, el día a día nos absorbe, pero hay fechas que simplemente no pueden pasar por debajo de la mesa.

>En este caso, la protagonista es mi prima. Tenemos ya muchos años sin vernos físicamente, pues la vida nos ha llevado por ciudades diferentes, pero la magia de la tecnología ha sido nuestra mejor aliada. Gracias a las redes sociales y las videollamadas, hemos logrado sentirnos cerca a pesar de los kilómetros. Sin embargo, este año el tiempo casi me juega una mala pasada.

>Fue Facebook el que me lanzó el recordatorio y, para mi sorpresa, ya era de noche. Entre una cosa y otra, el día se me había pasado volando. Para completar el cuadro de dificultad, mi horno todavía sigue dañado, así que por un segundo pensé que no podría prepararle nada especial. Pero entonces me acordé de un viejo aliado que tengo en la cocina: mi súper molde para microondas. Este recipiente tiene ya veinte años conmigo; lo compré hace dos décadas y ha sobrevivido a mudanzas, limpiezas profundas y cambios de estilo de vida. Honestamente, ese molde me ha salvado la vida en incontables ocasiones cuando necesito resolver algo de \

>Hello everyone, I hope you’re all doing well. Today I want to share a story with you that blends nostalgia, a mad dash in the kitchen, and, above all, love. It’s about the “last-minute” baking of a cake to celebrate the life of someone I care about deeply, who was celebrating her birthday. Sometimes, our daily lives can get in the way, but there are certain occasions that simply can’t be overlooked.

>In this case, the star of the show is my cousin. We haven’t seen each other in person for many years, as life has taken us to different cities, but the magic of technology has been our best ally. Thanks to social media and video calls, we’ve managed to feel close despite the distance. However, this year, time almost played a trick on me.

>It was Facebook that sent me the reminder, and to my surprise, it was already nighttime. Between one thing and another, the day had flown by. To make matters worse, my oven is still broken, so for a second I thought I wouldn’t be able to make her anything special. But then I remembered an old ally I have in the kitchen: my super microwave-safe dish. This dish has been with me for twenty years; I bought it two decades ago, and it has survived moves, deep cleanings, and lifestyle changes. Honestly, that dish has saved my life countless times when I’ve needed to whip something up on the fly.

\n\n

>Sin perder un minuto, busqué los ingredientes y preparé una mezcla que encaja perfectamente en su capacidad. Si alguna vez necesitan una solución rápida, tomen nota de estas proporciones que nunca fallan:
>1 taza y media de azúcar
>3 tazas de harina de trigo
>1 taza y un poco más de leche
>1 cucharada de polvo de hornear
>1 cucharada de esencia de vainilla
>Gotas de chocolate (para ese toque especial)

>Para la decoración, decidí hacer un merengue suizo clásico con dos huevos y media taza de azúcar. El proceso de preparación fue casi una coreografía de rapidez: primero mezclé el azúcar (en este caso usé aceite en lugar de mantequilla para que la miga quedara más suave al salir del microondas) con los huevos y la vainilla, incorporando luego el resto de los ingredientes hasta lograr esa textura sedosa que tanto nos gusta.

\n\n>
>Without wasting a minute, I gathered the ingredients and prepared a batter that fits perfectly in its capacity. If you ever need a quick fix, take note of these proportions that never fail:
>1 cup plus a little extra milk

>For the decoration, I decided to make a classic Swiss meringue with two eggs and half a cup of sugar. The preparation process was almost a choreographed dance of speed: first, I mixed the sugar (in this case, I used oil instead of butter so the crumb would be softer when it came out of the microwave) with the eggs and vanilla, then incorporated the rest of the ingredients until I achieved that silky texture we love so much.

\n\n

>Vertí la mezcla en mi fiel molde y lo programé en intervalos de 7 minutos, repitiendo el proceso cuatro veces hasta que, al insertar el palillo, vi que ya estaba en su punto. El aroma a vainilla y chocolate empezó a inundar la casa, lo que me dio ánimos porque el tiempo seguía corriendo. En cuanto estuvo lista, la saqué y la puse directamente frente al ventilador. Necesitaba que perdiera calor rápido para poder decorarla, ya que la hora de la videollamada se acercaba.
>Mientras tanto, batía el merengue con fuerza. Usé una boquilla de estrellas e intenté \

lo mejor posible. Ahí descubrí, entre risas y apuros, que dos huevos realmente no rinden tanto como recordaba, así que me tocó ser creativa para cubrir la superficie. Hice unos rosetones y les agregué chispas de colores para darle vistosidad. Como decimos aquí en Venezuela, \

con lo que tenía a mano.

\n\n>

>I poured the mixture into my trusty pan and set the timer for 7-minute intervals, repeating the process four times until, when I inserted a toothpick, I saw that it was done. The aroma of vanilla and chocolate began to fill the house, which gave me a boost because time was still ticking away. As soon as it was ready, I took it out and placed it directly in front of the fan. I needed it to cool down quickly so I could decorate it, since the time for the video call was approaching.

>Meanwhile, I beat the meringue vigorously. I used a star tip and tried to “get creative” as best I could. That’s when I discovered, amid laughter and a rush, that two eggs really don’t go as far as I remembered, so I had to get creative to cover the surface. I made some rosettes and added colored sprinkles to make it look festive. As we say here in Venezuela, I “killed the game” with what I had on hand.

\n\n

>Decoré la torta estando todavía un poquito tibia, pero el resultado fue justo lo que buscaba: un gesto genuino de amor. Cuando por fin sonó el teléfono y vi a mi prima del otro lado de la pantalla, poder mostrarle su pastel y cantar el \
juntos hizo que todo el esfuerzo valiera la pena.

>Estos moldes de microondas son una maravilla que a veces subestimamos. Recuerdo que estuve a punto de botarlo varias veces pensando que ya no lo usaría, o que solo servía para hacer gelatinas de colores, pero qué bueno que no lo hice. Es la opción ideal para cuando vienen visitas inesperadas de los amigos de mis hijos o, como en esta ocasión, para acortar distancias con un dulce detalle. ¡A veces lo más sencillo es lo que más llena el corazón!

\n\n>

>I decorated the cake while it was still slightly warm, but the result was exactly what I was looking for: a genuine gesture of love. When the phone finally rang and I saw my cousin on the other end of the screen, being able to show her the cake and sing “Happy Birthday” together made all the effort worth it.

>These microwave-safe molds are a marvel that we sometimes underestimate. I remember almost throwing it away several times, thinking I wouldn’t use it anymore, or that it was only good for making colorful Jell-O, but I’m so glad I didn’t. It’s the perfect option for when my kids’ friends drop by unexpectedly or, as in this case, to bridge the distance with a sweet gesture. Sometimes the simplest things are the ones that warm the heart the most!

\n\n

body.title: All the things I want in life, If money was not a problem
body.body:
Assalamu Alaikum,

Money is one of the important things. Even if people say that happiness cannot be bought with money, we cannot deny the fact that money is something you need to live your life, no matter if you see happiness coming out of it or not.

If I had enough money to buy whatever I want and money was not a problem, then the very first thing I would like to buy would be a new smartphone. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRo7h6cLHZwDR6Wi1izJZtA81yVogBhe6nAusugER7dfd/image.png)

<a href=\

>Source I recently started teaching calligraphy to students, and for that I am using my smartphone. My smartphone currently is not enough for this purpose. It runs out of storage, and that is why when I am recording classes so that I can send them to someone who has not attended, I face problems. I take online classes, so I have to record the class and send it to the person who has not attended. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUA7MKELbnTmVg41i9L7hheVi5pMAyyhvw4aeoqS3j2CN/image.png)

>Source What happens now is that my storage is not enough, and I have to record one video, send it, and then delete it so that I can record the next day again. So I would like to have a new smartphone with higher storage, at least 512 GB. Apart from that, I would like to buy some calligraphy stuff, like top-quality pens because I know I need them. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdRbuYbCQbL8kZHP9m43W61SwEAHYWTosH7M3otpMKxTB/image.png)

>Source I would like to buy expensive sheets so that I can create my calligraphy on them and showcase it to people. Right now, I only do it on a normal piece of paper. At most, I have done it on a small canvas of 5x5. That is all I have. So I would like to buy all the things related to calligraphy. Apart from that, I would like to buy a house for my parents because they are living on rent right now. I would like to buy a house and gift it to them so that they can live peacefully without worrying about paying rent every month. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSBrtkoXg3NZfjmcPD5hF9YG1Rwh7h2tRGSTcCP75ktzn/image.png)

>Source I would also like to ask my dad to come back from abroad to India and live here, because he is already 55 years old and is still working since my brother is not stable yet. except for those living in war zones, things are never easy and this matter has to be the most sensitive one and especially these wars fought for lands on the name of religion, somehow makes everyone suffer. body.title: Clearing the Warehouse.
body.body: > I cleared the warehouse full of hunters and drones using stealth and fast combat. Ganke helped me override a drone to track the Lizard, which led me through a spooky mechanical area filled with fish remains. Finally, Ganke used the drone to spot a group of men nearby. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb46qZgCxWwVMRC1XJHdQmXcWhPX69SyEdWDZxps2MPU7/screenshot_1_.png) The first thing I did after getting inside the warehouse was taking down a vulture bot, a drone. I moved quickly to disable its systems before it could fly away or alert the others. It was a clean start to the mission for sure. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfV3q7634cxpra3Hoe8EV4xoVKEFE7YFnTjBhFbev3m4R/screenshot_2_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVU1uRgBwtAABQFR9fTkhLae99jo6bWkT6PMUPbZ5CLTA/screenshot_3_.png) After taking down a hunter, I went for another drone. It looked like the last machine threat in that specific area. I took it down quietly. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf73XRZaeFxeB5ojjG5tLyHLorHK5D2ZhkqQRGKuRuxPw/screenshot_4_.png) Suddenly, I noticed another hunter found a body I had left behind. Before he could call out to the others or trigger an alarm, I jumped on him from above. I took him out fast so the rest of the warehouse would stay quiet. It was a close call that required very quick timing. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPjdRtiev5j3owucWdrqGUFZeBb5mh9z1GSaLnuzb8sbe/screenshot_5_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeL4i1SromoyHvtsbEpsQmzRoVE3c1RwEw3zPwJkzGY2z/screenshot_6_.png) Then I started kicking around at the remaining enemies. It was fun kicking some asses and showing off my combat skills in the middle of the room. I moved from one hunter to the next, using my strength to keep them off balance while I cleared the floor of any threats. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWSjuxQFhjwaivsZ4ofac2M8PULmqdotdUYyJxzkBcmks/screenshot_7_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdwo5Z59wAnqmvH8Gg1XCDABrREdWQE4y1bHnpCDvVDDG/screenshot_8_.png) It was a little hard when I took down one hunter while another was standing very close. I had to be real fast there to stop the second man from reacting. I managed to do it just fine, taking them both out before they could even draw their weapons against me. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdFHmHKwqfSHMQ7eSotYWwMkiNQ4cPhaD2mrevD4VFGRb/screenshot_9_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUdpQ8PKVXxpHc15dGgkWkjwNgPNvUUoRDKcoLryQr5sb/screenshot_10_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTUMBwVZ1tyS2YEx3LasjFUXgUXr3ciXx3NbSR4xi6bWf/screenshot_11_.png) I started kicking even more of them, and I was still in stealth without alerting the whole warehouse. Even Ganke mentioned he would never get tired of watching me kick serious ass like this. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP4Mo4ove8mC8eLbWLQRsZLTCALPDMYxtRKZp6hqcq6aU/screenshot_12_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXvioP93fTnHjL6H9Ev3q3mv79m6gf7cLZ6wmYX1NADz2/screenshot_13_.png) Then Ganke asked me to check if my suit could override a drone's motherboard. I tried it out and Ganke successfully took over one of those vulture bots. It seemed like a good move as we now had a drone that could help us track the Lizard's location. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVxkow2fmoXPDifdzSSPxjsSsKj5HiSu3oaBsA6658AJU/screenshot_14_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWLYg5KAoFDSF1To76sqoMWZWRVZwjwuY1Az5aN1a87H8/screenshot_15_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS9Qt7mB8mSS79wJJ3y2EVUcqs9PgBGPRXuE1BbmujCVr/screenshot_16_.png) I started looking for tracks of the Lizard, which took me inside some spooky mechanical areas. I saw leftover pieces of big fishes, which made the place feel very spooky. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf84Kvg67hNGjK6Tbn2bJqLEuYMwFkpLoDNzvo7qAbmgm/screenshot_17_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTYJDTeyx5yXGudYqtJ9kh67hGTZM6KCwJFY5UWe1Ua4Z/screenshot_18_.png) After getting out of that site, Miles got really scared seeing something coming out of a door. It turned out to be Ganke controlling the drone. Ganke mentioned that he had seen some men through the drone's eyes, and we prepared to move in on their position. https://images.ecency.com/DQmSqzmqSqxuRNbpX9wqjmKyhXH58FYwcK3wXaa32qnHugB/divider.png That's all for now. I'll write about more of this story again soon. Be safe till we meet again. Au revoir/Goodbye. https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gamingphoto/23tRvMuLRERuPePNhyEjtaKt46FiKwDBgwVqqAberwmEFA36fPkh2ad6wvB1RYNKTVezR.png ***All the screenshots are my takes from my play using the in-game photo mode, and I tried Canva to edit the thumbnail.*** --- ▶️ [3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=rashed.ifte/6f655323)
