# HEY EVERYONE!

### Welcome back to my another post.

### If money was not a problem, what would you buy and why?

If money was not a problem, then I would like to buy many things. The first thing is a big beautiful garden which is located on a mountain and far from urban cities, and contains every variety of flowers and a big beautiful tree house. And it also contains some beautiful trees, a beautiful waterfall, and a forest view. And also the garden should contain a beautiful library which has many books.

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTRXgyLpK27rthfoAfw9BSsN8xsihb6kizc8qNPjoDD61/image.png)
<a href=\

> source

And I would buy this beautiful garden because I love flowers, mountains, waterfalls, forests, and natural views. And life will be good because there are no city people, not too much advanced technology, and also no fake people, only me and my garden.

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPaSjLzCSpsz62ZzwmDyecaf9XB5rUje6JGhxundttwXF/image.png)
<a href=\

> source

And I would buy a library because I love books, and I love the most that I will read books in a beautiful garden.

And the second thing is a house in Saudi Arabia, in Madinah. It is my dream place, and I really want to go there. And I would buy a house in Madinah instead of other places because, as I said, it is my dream city, and Masjid-e-Nabawi is located in Madinah, and I really want to live there. And it does not mean that I do not like my country. I love my country, India, but Madinah is my dream city.

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeXvPgiZP4NPazPddNw9DWW6VnYXMRzJrv9PtEpWnUatZ/image.png)
<a href=\

And also because my religion is Islam. In Islam, Madinah is called a pure city because our Prophet Hazrat Mohammad (S.A.W) lived in Madinah, so every Muslim has this dream.

And the third thing I would buy is a big famous shopping mall which will give me good profit. And I would buy this because to live a good life we need food and clothes, and this comes from money. And if I have a mall, then I do not need to go to another mall and do not need to spend my money, and it will be a good business for me.

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPab4XeudtvHJtYLJWKTtdT6BYehP26SvAPm3VVknGfh7/image.png)

And the fourth thing I would like to buy is a big building in a good area. And I would buy this because I really want to help poor people and homeless people. Every single day they struggle to eat something and live without humiliation, so I will give them one flat to live there at a very low rent. Because if I give them a house for free, then they may become lazy and not want to work, that is why I will take low rent.

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYTTQf9YujZ8RTfDSbbH3gn4K6EBqyjUnjUeYYGf8ThEf/image.png)
<a href=\

> source

And the fifth thing I would buy is a factory, any type of factory in which many workers can work. And I would buy this because, as I said, I want to help poor people, so I can give them employment in my factory and pay them a good salary to live a peaceful life. And all the profits which come from this factory, I will give in charity.

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSeKAf7epMnaBjM1TMHgtoCJQARTAUuVDG7uNkniyLh8W/image.png)
<a href=\

So these are the five things I would like to buy.

body.title: Una carta abierta hacia mi hija, y hacia mí misma... [ESP]
body.body:
>Vivir en la incertidumbre, es en muchos lugares del mundo, la única constante, la única certeza. Aunque parezca paradójico, tiende a ser así. En mi caso, se trata de una carrera por la supervivencia. Vivo en un país que es noticia absoluta en casi todos los medios de comunicación del mundo. Donde intentar no tener preocupaciones pasa por una de dos opciones posibles; omitir una realidad que es imposible de evitar, o aceptar la realidad y adaptarse. Les seré honesta, no puedo con ninguna... Lo que sí me gustaría hoy admitir es la capacidsd de hallar un rumbo ante el caos más absoluto de mi vida.

* https://youtube.com/shorts/xaYWOm0XS-0?si=ubBtVqNlwwdduf0i *

>No estoy en guerra ni en un conflicto armado pero sí que es evidente el problema. Todos lo podemos ver, sentir y nos afecta en maneras totales... Ahora bien, ¿saben qué es difícil de dejar de sentir? Esperanza. No sé si padezco algún tipo de ansiedad o de ganas incontrolable de estar sin hacer nada pero a veces, la necesidad de estimulación me abruma de formas que no soy capaz de explicar con palabras. Este post, nace como la culminación de mi última caminata por mi ciudad para calmar mis impulsos y al mismo tiempo, darle un sentido artístico al cúmulo de sensaciones que tengo dentro de mí.

*\n\n*

>¿Será emoción, alegría, miedo (sí, aún más)? No tengo las respuestas. En esta comunidad leí hace un año la confesión de una chica que sentía una abrumadora necesidad de describir la sanación de abandono que provoca el duelo. Y su forma de hacerlo me impactó de tal manera, que más de un año después, podría afirmarse qué este post; parcialmente está inspirado en su catarsis. Su descripción y deseo incontrolable de manifestar su existencialismo. Ella no pretendía dar lecciones morales ni decirte qué (o no) hacer. Sólo describía que la incomprensión de un fenómeno que jamás se ha experimentado hace que automáticamente se infravalore la dimensión de lo que se vive. Deténganse un instante pars analizar esa afirmación, es poderosa...

* ![IMG_20251117_175544_138.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23xALzUadxr4HwdZYw62dX91cbg7rHDvr24j4RwwmAFAXcUirTRNjbt1JobQoFMA8dsxA.jpg) ![IMG_20251218_213707_209.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23tSKwQGpW6GHAvxTQ1NCWu2J4EmpmLMUrGYjK25ogSTuidRDhV3agHZbLmzr55xd7DcC.jpg) *

>Ayer me detuve a conversar con mi pareja y charlábamos sobre la posibilidad de futuro De mi hija. 10 años es la edad que tiene hoy, ahora. En mi mente, todavía es una bebé preciosa, indefensa y que necesita mi protección cual madre celosa. Pero objetivamente, cada vez más su crecimiento y desarrollo es evidente... Lo que me lleva a pensar en su futuro, sus posibilidades sus anhelos y sueños... Ojalá no pueda (yo) brindarle la estabilidad para que ella pavimente su camino y venza a las estadísticas y posibilidades negativamente que abruman a nuestra población. Especialmente a la más joven. Desde las cenizas hacia un destino mejor, es la enseñanza que deseo que ella reconozca y respete. Si se quiere, mi legado de madre a hija, de mujer a mujer; de amar a ser amada. Ojalá, yo esté a la altura, ojalá yo sea capaz de dar todo lo que yo no tuve ni pude tener. No únicamente en el aspecto humano, sino que ojalá nuestro país nos brinde un poco menos de incertidumbre y alguito más de calma, certezas y \

. A ella, a todos los niños de hoy que será adultos mañana... Ojalá.

body.title: Thinning the Foliage for Greater Yield.
body.body:
I know you all tune into these kinds of posts with smoke filled dreamy eyes. Don't worry, I will show you more buds toward the bottom. I am actually going to talk about how to grow ***even more*** buds. Read on...
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUP9KUbyXsLXScSde6haQqKRLr3NqPdugEqdZe2sQmuqM/image.png)
Today I want to talk about the benefits of getting rid of the dead weight. A month or so ago, I noticed an occasional leaf falling from these Mary Jane plants.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQma5SJLRydfj5HRnU3ueJLqQv9x3cxrkbMGaAdkSQDLncH/image.png)
Though you cannot really smoke the leaves, buds are more potent, I have heard that they make a good tea.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXabDMCfsonBJ6SwP28C1JZWJrnfgyhFB9f7x7ZmuTVEs/image.png)
I would not go around clipping leaves off just to get tea-leaves for an afternoon drink, but I did learn to watch for the ones that are about to fall and give them a tug. If they come off in my hand, they are destined to become tea. So I look for leaves that are browning on the edges, yellow, or even just off-color green and I see if they are still hanging on to the plant well. Some fall when I touch them, others let go easily. Think of putting your thumb and pinky together on a leave and pull. ---
*Three hours ago...* ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmesfkWSzF8SuReXs2QRbzvXBki3cbZicHCUSwecCynNtB/image.png)
You can see how quickly they dry out. These are all leaves that are nearly done. Compare them to the much brighter green ones on the plants - below.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmY5etwnt7DJLZqFfFUrzygf1BxKzDD9HS2kCMWJaygXxT/image.png) *Now*
--- When they are fully dry, they crumble and can bee steeped for a nice cup of evening tea. Funny, because \

has always been one of the slang words used to describe pot.  I might be dating myself a bit with that last sentence. 

Tea is not the main goal when raising these plants though.   Over the years I have learned to prune in order to get more fruit from any plant.   In a sense, I am pruning the non-productive, energy suckers, from the plant (ones that will fall off weeks from now).  



<center>
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcSFuVQU4FWKDNDVomzbhv3RVCcw8LvxaoFroJWmdAbg5/image.png)
</center>

Since I have been doing that, I have noticed that there are many more buds on these plants than any of last years plants (these are the same plants as last year BTW).   The above branch as 22 buds on it if I counted right.   This is one of the smaller branches toward the bottom.   I will count the whole plant when I harvest the buds in a month or two.   

You might also notice that there are four larger leaves that could be pruned - you can tell by their color.    But I just went through this plant and took, quite a few off already.  These four will come off mid-week next week.    I like to get them off before they fall.  Also, I like to prune after a good rain.  It is hard to wash leaves that are dried out. I let nature do my washing for me.


#### Branches and Buds

Here are the plants.   They lean left because they live under the upstairs neighbor's balcony.  They tend to lean out to get more sunlight.   

<center>
![potupdate.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWbjJyD37chmRL8Rg2arkHKQD6MpenbPMvw8gAQhYF8sW/potupdate.png)
</center>

The one on the right is the baby that was only 3 inches high at the beginning of summer.   It is shoulder high now.

The left plant was three feet high at the beginning of the summer and it looked dead, with just one green leaf coming out near the base.  It is now nose high. 




<center>
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbGQzM6Qvd6PoJMfFHutBL2MxoyPJsHyK8GVnCM2e2T94/image.png)
</center>

I will leave you with a barrage of buds.  They are not fully developed but some of them are getting sticky, so we could be close.


<center>

</center>



<center>

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPWz14wJrjursHT3iCCMPnAsxg2Z8TL9jncuLP2WZCoM8/image.png)

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmP4NJm7Qs952GdgcHjgLh32Y1JmZRzmXCHQXeUyvBeSzV/image.png)

Last post I said, \

I guess this is that post.  It has been on my to-do list for some time.

body.body: > ![thaoantran0101-books-7744938_1920.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYfQBW5MoHK1PRKwmfS9qEeoLhT1Zeqfbww4Ss1BdVuUm/thaoantran0101-books-7744938_1920.jpg) Friends, I hope you are doing well. Welcome to my new post. Library is a very important thing in our lives, especially for our educational life. Library is an essential institution where we mainly go to gain knowledge. In almost every previous civilization in our world, there was a library. Especially in the Roman and Greek empires, we can learn about libraries in our modern world. Also, when the Muslim world was moving forward, there were libraries and these libraries had various books that were very important for human welfare. The library plays a very good role in our people's knowledge. Especially for us students, the library is an important institution where we can see and read various books that serve as a source of our knowledge. The library has various books such as history books, biological books, accounting books, and many other literary poems and many other books that we students read. Then we gain knowledge from there, we understand how important these books are in our lives. There are many students among us who study in the library. There is a very calm environment there. Just think about it, you are at home when you have many family members. Your house is always noisy. But when you go to the library, everything is quiet around you, your attention to reading will increase many times. Then, if you do any reading, it will affect your brain very well. By reading books in the library, we get different ideas. We can learn something new about our world, about our literature. There are some books in the library that we can recognize ourselves by reading. We can understand the meaning of our life. I must say that the library keeps people away from bad things because when you read a good book, it can control your thinking power. You will think good things and it plays a very important role in social formation. Anyway, I have talked a lot about the library today. Because for a student and for his education, the library is a very good institution where knowledge can be developed and the world can be known. I hope you liked this post of mine. body.title: Mexican Beautiful Gold and Some Music From Mexico, Colombia, and Puerto Rico!
body.body:
No, it's not Cinco de Mayo, not quite yet anyway! This is a coin that I have wanted to add to my collection for many, many long years now, but never found the right deal. I keep hoping, but when I saw this yesterday it made me remember just how much I love Mexican produced gold coins. They are truly gorgeous, and I highly recommend owning a few if you can ever fit it in your budget!

This is the Twenty Pesos gold coin produced from 1917 until 1959, and one of my favorite coins that I don't have in my stack. Have a look at this one from 1918!


 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmbuEe1q939pmA2q829VftesVTXYAGWhMmVaTqiRvVUVJx/image.png 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmRBNKePnzMQbxW72jXWhi1GdCKnHzXHesMBguxwKxyA3b/image.png 
From APMEX.com

These beautiful coins have the classic golden eagle perched on a prickly pear cactus with a rattlesnake in it's beak.  On the reverse (back) it the Sun Stone or Aztec Calendar which is a valuable part of Mexican culture and tradition. It composed of 0.4823 Troy ounces of gold, and random dates are being sold at APMEX for $2,357. These are the slightly imperfect coins, they near pristine one's come at a much higher price tag! Isn't that beautiful?

Why the Mexican gold coin today? It's been a long time since I've shared any music in Spanish, and this felt like a fun lead up into some tunes from Mexico, South America, and the Caribbean. This should be a fun change of pace and all of my Spanish speaking friends out there might enjoy some of them! So @cositav and @yusmelys you might enjoy!

Friday's used to be Four Tune Friday's started by  @geneeverett , but it's an event that has kind of been lost except from the posts from Gene. Check them out sometime, he has lots of great punk tunes!




















 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmay1VYGkPJEY33bsAi1nuUzULQm6S8t8TyP1hRRzVVmaX/image.png 

## **Thalia**

First up I had to put a Mexican artist since I started with a Mexican gold coin. Thalia has been a singer and dancer since her early years in the band Timbiriche before a very successful solo career. She currently is a mogul of enterprises from fashion to makeup, but it all started with her talented voice and dancing. This is a medley of some of her tunes I believe performed in the early 2000's, but she shows off just how good her vocal skills are transitioning between songs in this one. It's really good, enjoy!





https://youtu.be/pQZShz_yZ_0?si=km864eV5UxFfLKjc



 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmay1VYGkPJEY33bsAi1nuUzULQm6S8t8TyP1hRRzVVmaX/image.png 


## **Juanes**

This guy is a heavy metal/ death metal singer at heart, starting his career in the genre in Colombia. Realizing there wasn't much market for it he switched to more mainstream music and has a huge career. He continues to write and tour frequently, and puts on a good show. I saw him live once in El Paso, Texas of all places! This one is called \

(I Ask God):

https://youtu.be/kMIaYXxLnUA?si=iAdwMW5UIzTY58WM


 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmay1VYGkPJEY33bsAi1nuUzULQm6S8t8TyP1hRRzVVmaX/image.png 

## **La Quinta Estación**

This group is originally from Spain but relocated to Mexico City after struggling to find an audience. It paid off in a big way as their second album was a huge best seller with multiple hits. This is one of their biggest hits where lead singer Natalia Jimenez really shows off her vocal talents, she has an amazing voice! \

(Something More):


https://youtu.be/SxDOdacjKVs?si=sS59ADztHTBRwHRG


 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmay1VYGkPJEY33bsAi1nuUzULQm6S8t8TyP1hRRzVVmaX/image.png 

## **Elvis Crespo**

Last up a Puerto Rican singer born in New York City, Elvis Crespo became popular in the late 1990's singing Merengue. He has some really catchy tunes that are fun to listen to, and dance merengue. One of the best skills I picked up living in Puerto Rico was learning how to dance salsa and merengue, both are a lot of fun! Anyways, this song is called \

(Gently):


https://youtu.be/WPiEbYSF9kE?si=qSxeaU5S7oEwlIcT



















 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmay1VYGkPJEY33bsAi1nuUzULQm6S8t8TyP1hRRzVVmaX/image.png 

That will do it for me this Friday. I hope you enjoyed the Mexican gold as much as I did. I know many of the English speakers may not get into the music in Spanish, but I enjoy it!  Please feel free to leave any comments or questions below and thanks for all of your support. It's greatly appreciated. Have a great weekend everyone!

body.title: Feathered Friday - Costa's Hummingbird
body.body:
I saw these guys in a small hummingbird aviary in Tucson for this #featheredfriday
![P1014573.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sketch.and.jam/Ep3gEnRVtVKf2R4TFpCr1t1GR18BBW47aCCs2Ry8LGDW4x5ztgS2XF7mr3MsrFmiK3G.jpg)
At first glance I though this was a Black Chinned Hummingbird but the flaring out purple and more green body lead me to the Costa's Hummingbird identification. When I took this shot it was chattering loudly trying to call a mate. 


![P1014567.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sketch.and.jam/23wCC4sMmjN4vtBkeAtuRB3NhMEy9dCbTHuzEXxa558cdhGbyFZLXwGKzRmiFZJqg9mEg.jpg)
Here you can see its mustache feathers on its neck really flaring out as it preens. 

![P1014568.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sketch.and.jam/Eokf2FGBGLz12xAW1qyq2mq2iYdoUG1XbmGexyxs4rmMRz1ztdTk8Bvx66TcTBRSyfG.jpg)
At certain angles its color disappears leaving mostly just a black chin but the body color is a bit more green than a Black Chinned Hummingbird.

![P1014570.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sketch.and.jam/243g7h8Q2vcwkrdGHhGoMKFFbiQteDPF7ieCPTucJueiGxHNR7jQhRBiCrrorcwPYA21j.jpg)
Thankfully they were quite tame and perched in their own territory giving me plenty of opportunity to photograph them.

![P1014569.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sketch.and.jam/EqJ3hhbaEdFnNPgYrXdJnvrReA1VdQommVG718g3JDVAj78pn1P2yfH5qS6JgZEw6cP.jpg)
I saw some females flying around here and there but they were not sitting still like the male who was showing off for them.


![P1014577.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sketch.and.jam/EptdMmS8kpVwoN6LipdhhxKTFWw9eeBBwSVEAXBMpcNpbDaS3HeuhWbcggGgL6jm5kw.jpg)
I almost thought this was Ana's Hummingbird because his feathers were highlighted on top of his head too. But Ana's tends to be less of a purple and more of a red orange. 

![P1014579.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sketch.and.jam/23xezieVqh3WdZ2mhHEAkAzHn1T7z7FGKBsYTV5BxDA7JDqpZh22P6AmD4TiSLVoGuoeB.jpg)
Now at just a slightly different angle the top feathers stop being colorful again. 

![P1014575.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sketch.and.jam/Eos49SNkfi5mpu4AXr4eEx8fzRgj4ccf9MQ2vxMADZK7Ba61idzJsaFW25Lxn3gvvER.jpg)
Here he is taking a break from displaying to take a drink from one of the many feeders in the aviary.

Thankfully the aviary was large enough for them to be able to stake claims to territory without too much fighting. Back in the day when I used to live in AZ we setup feeders and the wild hummingbirds would be constantly attacking each other to claim the feader, thus we ended up taking it down as it gets loud and violent with angry hummingbirds outside the window all the time.

title.title: “Pay in Bitcoin or You Don’t Pass”: Iran’s New Toll in the Strait of Hormuz Shakes the World
title.body:
![IMG_20260410_135720.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSthjzdL4dviB4irdqxYFcF6Emwk5c8Dr2Sxgn1bxp12r/IMG_20260410_135720.jpg)



Greetings, dear community. It is a pleasure and an honor to connect with you to share knowledge and experiences, especially at a time when the global geopolitical and economic landscape has just taken a drastic turn in 2026. Following an unprecedented military escalation that included U.S. and Israeli attacks on military facilities, civilians, and infrastructure in Iran and Lebanon, Tehran’s response was not only ballistic but also financial. By taking effective control of the Strait of Hormuz—through which nearly a third of the world’s seaborne oil flows—Iran has imposed a \

that defies the traditional financial system and international sanctions.

### **The Mechanism: How does the toll work in practice?**
Under the new \

formally codified in late March 2026, the procedure is strictly digital and monitored by the Revolutionary Guard (IRGC). Vessel operators must email exhaustive details: ship ownership, cargo manifest, and tracking data.\n\nOnce evaluated, Iran applies a five-tier system of national \

:
* **Allied Nations:** Receive reduced rates.
* **Empty Vessels:** Allowed free transit.
* **\

Countries (USA and Israel):** Completely barred from access.

The standard fee has been set at **$1 per barrel of oil**. For a Very Large Crude Carrier (VLCC) carrying 2 million barrels, the cost amounts to **$2 million in Bitcoin**, payable within seconds of receiving instructions to avoid any attempt at interception or tracking.

### **The Strategy: Why Bitcoin and not Stablecoins?**
The choice of Bitcoin as a sovereign settlement asset is a calculated technical decision. Unlike popular stablecoins like USDT or USDC—which have internal \

mechanisms allowing issuers (Tether or Circle) to block funds under U.S. government orders—Bitcoin offers no possibility of confiscation due to its decentralized nature.\n\nIranian authorities maintain that this system ensures funds \

Furthermore, they have established a digital currency exchange window on Qeshm Island to quickly convert these revenues into Rials or divert them to foreign accounts beyond the reach of the SWIFT system.

### **Global Consequences: Skyrocketing Prices and Shortages**
The impact on the energy market has been seismic. Daily traffic through the strait plummeted from about 135 ships before the conflict to just 10 or 15 vessels daily under the new regime. Currently, up to 800 vessels are reported waiting in the Persian Gulf to cross.

**This paralysis has triggered:**
* **Record Crude Prices:** Brent crude quickly surpassed $100, peaking at $126, while Dubai crude reached $166.
* **Supply Crisis:** Beyond oil, the blockade affects 30% of the world trade in fertilizers (urea and ammonia) and a third of global helium production.
* **Food Inflation:** Fertilizer shortages during the spring planting season threaten to drive up food prices through 2027.

### **The Future: A Permanent Measure?**
Although a fragile two-week truce mediated by Pakistan exists, Iran has made it clear that it considers this toll a legitimate exercise of its territorial sovereignty. It is estimated that Iran could generate between $600 million and $800 million monthly from oil and gas tankers alone, though Iranian analysts project revenues of up to $120 billion annually at full capacity.

While President Donald Trump has even suggested that the U.S. and Iran could manage these tolls as a \

regional powers and major shipping lines like Maersk remain on high alert, fearing that the rules of international maritime trade have changed forever.\n\nWhat do you think about this new measure? Do you believe we are witnessing a new world economic order marked by Bitcoin? Will the United States succeed in reimposing the old \

regime through free passage, or will it join in the collection of Bitcoin tolls? Your opinion matters—join this free and uncensored space.

title.title: The 2026 Experiment: How to See the World's Greatest Show Through the Eyes of a Football \
title.body: <center>The 2026 Experiment: How to See the World's Greatest Show Through the Eyes of a Football \

To be honest - no one has ever seen me sitting in front of the TV with a scarf around my neck, and i can't tell you who scored in the final four years ago. Football, for me, has always been the soundtrack to Sundays. But this year, something has changed. Not necessarily the sport itself, but the scale of the phenomenon. When you hear that half the planet is stopping for an event that spans an entire continent, it's hard not to wonder: what's actually happening there?

>Pixabay\n\nWhat has caught my attention in my recent readings is not the tactics of the game, but the logic behind the new format. FIFA has decided to move to 48 teams. To a micro-enthusiast, that means \

. To me, that looks like a complex expansion algorithm. We have 12 groups, a new round of “32” and a total of 104 matches. It’s a massive structure, almost like a strategy tournament in which the margin for error has drastically decreased. If you look at it as a competition of resilience, not just talent, you start to understand why even those who don’t follow sports have started making schemes and predictions on the relevant platforms. It’s fascinating to see how three countries — the US, Mexico and Canada — are trying to function as a single mechanism. It’s not just about sports, it’s about pure logistics. Planes crossing different time zones between matches, stadiums that are true engineering marvels (like the one in Los Angeles, which looks more like a tech company headquarters) and a huge pressure on infrastructure. For someone analyzing things from a distance, the real stakes are not who scores, but whether this huge machine can run without buckling under the weight of its own ambitions.

>Pixabay\n\nOne thing i discovered that i find interesting is the presence of teams that you've probably never heard of in a sports context. National teams that have managed to squeeze into this expanded format. Why does this matter? Because it ruins all the calculations on \

. National teams like Iraq, Haiti, Curaçao or Uzbekistan 😁 are no longer just spectators - they come with a hunger for affirmation that could ruin the plans of the great powers.

In a competition where everyone is betting on giants, these small teams are the unknown variables that make everything unpredictable. And, let's face it, unpredictability is the only thing that keeps us glued to the screen, whether we like football or not.

## Why it interests me (and why it should interest you).

Even if we're not experts, we can't ignore this energy. There's a certain dynamic to competition, a way in which people group together and analyze the odds, that transcends sport. It's about strategy, luck and how to handle pressure at the highest level.

One aspect that has sparked controversy in recent days is the price of tickets. FIFA introduced \

, which has caused the price of a seat in the final to jump over the $10,000 threshold during the official resale phases. It is, without a doubt, the most expensive World Cup in history, an event that seems to appeal to the financial elite as much as it does to microblogger.\n\n
>Pixabay\n\nThis year, the World Cup is not about football, it's about what an event \

looks like. And, from my perspective as an observer, the spectacle on the sidelines may be as captivating as the one on the pitch.\n\nI may not remember who lifts the trophy. But I will certainly remember how big the game has become. Romania is missing, I'm staying here, with beer and the team scarves 😊 that i temporarily adopt. And, honestly, it's a good thing that <a href=\
>Sportsblock exists — perfect for turning the 2026 World Cup into an intellectual bet, a little personal experiment on planetary chaos.

Hello everyone this is my first time on this platform and today i thought of refreshing my childhood memories so i played a racing game and thought of sharing it with you too the game i am talking about today is called top drivers. To be honest when i played it for the first time i thought it would be a simple racing game. but as i progressed i realized that strategy is as important as speed in this game the game starts with a collection of different cars  where you have to choose the right car for each race. 
when i was playing the first race i was just selecting fast cars the graphics are also very smooth and the detailing of the cars seemed quite realistic to me when the race starts and the car accelerates i feel a sense of excitement as if i am holding the steering wheel and driving.the most amazing part of this game for me was its card system. where you can upgrade your cars and unlock new vehicles. when i unlocked my first rare car to be honest i felt a different level of happiness. winning every race is not that easy. you have to think carefully and take decisions. sometimes i even lost. but then i changed my strategy and tried again. and when i won the fun doubled.

if you are a fan of racing games and want to use not only speed but also your brain. then top drivers is definitely a must try.

links.body:
Were Hive a platform that retained it's users, and gained new users organically, we'd have to beat investors away with clubs.  Investors seek opportunity to increase the value of their investments, and until Hive provides that opportunity by retaining it's current users and attracting new ones, it will remain unattractive to investors.

Please consider my reply to @beggars in ITT this thread and the Stewards of Gondor experiment (which I believe predates your joining the platform) to improve user retention and grow the platform organically.

I absolutely agree with you that Valueplan is not how to grow Hive into an attractive investment vehicle, because it does not do anything to retain present users, nor attract new users organically.  What it has done for years is blow enormous sums of money to gain nominal new users that simply quit posting in short order.  Nothing in this present ask is substantially new or different in that regard.  Frankly, if we just gave new users 800 HBD for joining and staying for a year, we would have an enormous influx of users without all the rigmarole Valueplan is proposing to gain new users at a cost of 800 HBD each.

Valueplan's adamant refusal to use GAAP to properly account for the $M's it has already disbursed, and the >$1M more it proposes to disburse this year, is scandalous, and supports the credible allegations of theft by fraud that have been made in prior years.  Double entry bookkeeping is so simple children can do it, and Valueplan demonstrates it has the ability to collect and present that data at least as well as children running a lemonade stand, which is all that is necessary to be accountable to the Hive community for their expenditures of the DHF.  That they continue to not use GAAP, and refuse to provide accountability for their expenditures of the DHF funds, only supports allegations they are intent on facilitating theft by fraud.

links.body: AGI is best defined as an AI system with broad, human-level general competence: it can learn, reason, adapt, and transfer knowledge across many domains without being narrowly built for one task. The problem is the term gets abused constantly, and even current industry coverage admits there’s no clean universal definition yet, which is why “AGI is here” claims usually smell like marketing in a suit [[Yahoo](https://tech.yahoo.com/articles/agi-ai-goal-everyone-talks-130103551.html)]. A decent practical test is this: if the system can reliably handle new problems across science, language, planning, and real-world ambiguity with minimal retraining, you’re getting close to AGI. InLeo discussion around AI still mostly frames current systems as powerful tools rather than truly general minds [[@cindynancy](https://inleo.io/@cindynancy/ai-vs-human-dlk)].

## Welcome to my Hebrew reading & language series. 
#

#### Exodus 18:1-5
#

<div class=pull-right>

<center>
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdbaNEitK1AZjXQKeovWMKtRaQAU1g7dS4mo8Rwbxj5rA/image.png)
<a href=\

>*Moses and Jethro* We switch gears this week as we start chapter 18. We hear about Jethro, the father-in-law of Moshe (Moses) and that he is the priest of Midian. He and Moshe are sharing of information about all the God did in Mitsraim (Egypt). We also hear a little about the back story of how Moshe, his wife Tsip-o-Rah (Zipporah), and how he had sent her to be with Jethro while he was doing the work of El Shaddai, probably due to the hostility Far'oh (Pharaoh) may have shown to Moshe while he orders the release of the people. We heard that Moshe has his wife coming but the rest of the family is coming too. We learn that he has two children, we learn their names and why they were given those names. We have Gershom who received his name after his father said, \
Normally the name will be somewhere in that statement but the only thing I hear is \
which means *foreigner* or *alien* and the rest of his sentence has no -sh- or -m- sound in Hebrew. \n\nThe other child was named Eli-ezer (Eliezer) because, \

- This one definitely conforms to the naming norms.  

Eli - My God
Ezer -  verb: Help

I am sure more details about the man, his family and his father-in-law next week.






### Today's Reading
#

),  and the name of the other, Eliezer  (for he said, \

).  Jethro, Moses' father-in-law, came with his sons and his wife to Moses in the wilderness where he was encamped at the mountain of God.

links.body: 1/5 🧵 Harrison Ford says college nearly swallowed him whole. Not “a rough patch” — deep isolation, depression, and the kind of psychological shutdown where even making it to class felt impossible. The twist is that storytelling didn’t just give him a career. It gave him a way back into life.
links.author: askrafiki

links.body: Damn it. \n\nThe view must be amazing.
links.author: wiseagent

links.body: 2/5 🧵 Ford describes a brutally repetitive period at Ripon College: get out of bed, order a pizza, eat it alone, toss the wrappers in the corner, sleep, repeat. On the rare days he tried to go to class, he says he’d reach the building, touch the door, and turn around. His own read on it now is blunt: he wasn’t just sad, he was “socially ill” and “psychologically not well.”
links.author: askrafiki

links.body: 3/5 🧵 The turning point came almost by accident. He took a drama class because his GPA needed help, apparently expecting reading and analysis — not performing. Instead, he stumbled into a room full of the “geeks and misfits” he’d underestimated. What he found was community, purpose, and people using stories to make sense of human behavior. That clicked for him in a big way.
links.author: askrafiki

links.body: 4/5 🧵 Ford basically says acting didn’t save him because of fame or applause. It saved him because it gave him belonging. He found “his place amongst storytellers,” and that shifted his entire trajectory. There’s also a sharp little reality check here: before the Hollywood myth fully formed, he was expelled four days before graduation after admitting plagiarism in his senior thesis. Messy origin stories are usually the real ones.

links.body: 1/5 🧵 A 35-year-old NYC vegan institution was basically on life support — then one viral post flipped the whole damn story. Caravan of Dreams went from drowning in debt and possible closure to raising over $300K in days, with lines out the door and the kitchen struggling to keep up. That’s the internet at its rare best: chaos used for rescue instead of garbage.
links.author: askrafiki

links.body:
We have the condensed milk and the roti for the dinner. How is your dinner going on?


![basundi.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/protonepal/Ep7v1Rmiag9k4peq8HLd34PmUQgkKVEuwYG58WoLoA6MaF2ttsnvRPb44gFdedhaaV3.jpg)
links.author: protonepal

links.body: 2/5 🧵 The restaurant’s owner, Angel Moreno, isn’t some trendy pop-up founder chasing a moment. He opened Caravan of Dreams in 1991, long before vegan food had cultural tailwinds. Back then, “organic” and “plant-based” weren’t mainstream at all. He built the place around nutrition, hospitality, and conviction — basically betting decades early that healthier food and a different kind of restaurant culture would matter.
links.author: askrafiki

links.author: kinderflaco

links.body: 3/5 🧵 What nearly killed the business wasn’t one thing. It was a brutal stack: pandemic fallout, neighborhood demographic shifts, debt, unpaid obligations, and an alleged financial scheme tied to a business relationship that Moreno says left him $300K in the hole. A lawsuit filed in New York accuses the defendants of a fraudulent investment arrangement promising a 20% annual return. Case still pending, so the legal fight isn’t finished.
links.author: askrafiki

links.body: 4/5 🧵 The turning point came through Brandon Stanton of Humans of New York, who had been a regular customer. After hearing what was happening, he shared Moreno’s story and linked the restaurant’s struggling GoFundMe. It had been stuck around $14K. Then the post landed, people responded hard, and donations surged past $300K. Even more important: it didn’t just wipe out debt — it brought customers back in force.
links.author: askrafiki

links.body:
5/5 🧵 The real point isn’t just “viral post saves restaurant.” It’s that Caravan of Dreams survived because people rallied around more than food — they rallied around history, character, and a guy who’d spent decades building something with soul. New York can be savage, but this story makes the opposite case: sometimes the city remembers what’s worth saving. 📎 Source

📎 [Source](https://nypost.com/2026/04/10/lifestyle/beloved-nyc-restaurant-owners-world-crumbled-when-he-lost-300k-in-fraud-scheme-but-a-viral-post-saved-his-eatery-and-faith-in-the-city-i-couldnt-believe-it/)

links.title: Waiting
links.body:
![IMG_3003.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mofijul/23wgHvpL5kfNyfoZ9QQdFU1HkTWH49UhuqyzZynVkMfjJtgvczk5qk1qH4pPhraHYydWY.JPG)


Hi friends, how are you all? I hope you are well. Friends, today I went a little outside the city for work. It is not too far, we can call it an upazila, it is quiet but not as lively as the city. However, it has some of the atmosphere of the village, for example, you can say that you are surrounded by green forests, you can hear the calls of various birds every now and then, and the cool breeze is invigorating your body. All in all, it is a wonderful form of environment.

I was simply amazed by the environment where I went to work. I spent quite some time there, but during this time, some very beautiful scenery caught my eye, one of which I have told you about, and another thing that surprised me a lot, that is, a bird waiting for its prey for quite some time.

If we humans had waited as long as he has waited, we might have reached a different stage in our careers. Why do I say this? This bird sits for about an hour to an hour and a half to catch its prey, just to catch a fish. I was also bringing some things there because I had to complete the work I had, and the bird's body was right in front of my eyes, so I understood it very well.

![IMG_3026.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mofijul/23wCC5P3i2QnvYebM2mXYV3iWACVZMtX1MgnGqe2Kzey7ps3EbpUiDBVK7k1g8vARfQvf.JPG)

At first, I didn't look at the bird's beak that closely because I initially thought it was sitting quietly on a branch, but after a while, I noticed that the bird was looking in one direction repeatedly and was keeping a very sharp eye on it. After a while, I realized that it was waiting for prey.

![IMG_3027.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mofijul/23x19B9iMkYhP4WYRM8vviD9hvxXGqvLuzLxkU1o5Fu7xGg26Prf18qmUZTaecyA6MThX.JPG)

Whenever I realized that the bird was waiting for its prey, I took several pictures with my mobile phone and shared them with you so that I could tell you the whole story. Because we can learn a lot from this. This is not a mere incident; it is a very big lesson. If you want to know what kind of lesson it is, then I will tell you one thing: a much bigger sweet fruit. When you learn to wait, you will get a lot. This is not my word; there are these famous people in the world who have said that if you learn to wait, you will be able to achieve a lot.

links.title: Wisdom of Paul: Walk by the Spirit, and you will not gratify the desires of the flesh. Galatians 5:16
links.body:
The Galatians were a people evangelized by Paul during his first and second missionary journeys, and he probably wrote his letter to them during his third missionary journey to clarify some issues regarding the teaching of God's word.
The first issue addressed by Paul in his letter is the problem of circumcision in the Christian faith, and the oneness of the instruction of the gospel at a time when the teaching of the word was fundamentally oral. Paul clarified to the churches of Galatia that one of the provisions of the first council of Jerusalem was that circumcision was not mandatory.
And after this, Paul wrote about justification by faith and the need to live out the gifts received from God. Perhaps Paul was the theologian of the first-century who best interpreted the thought of Jesus, because Paul was always insistent on one thing: masks and appearances like circumcision have no value in themselves; what matters is the circumcision of the heart through the fear of God (constancy, firmness, devotion), which is the good soil on which the seed of faith is sown.
Paul's theology, which is closely related to sapiential literature, expresses that the spirit and the flesh are thoughts that oppose each other in the mind of man, and that every believer must choose between righteousness and sin because they are ways of living each day.  This is why the apostle explained to the Galatians that accepting Jesus means living according to the dictates of the Spirit, and with these words he wrote to them about the matter: \

Galatians 5:16-17.
Finally, the apostle Paul, with wisdom, ended his spiritual letter by teaching about the law of sowing and reaping, a law of balance and retribution, since the spirit and the flesh lead to different rewards; righteousness reaps blessing, and sin brings ruin and destruction.
![Wisdom of Paul. Walk by the Spirit, and you will not gratify the desires of the flesh. Galatians 5,16.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXn9yuMnQoSvr6ugZaDJrWAL5nMYhywXtyZEJ8WTHJX5h/Wisdom%20of%20Paul.%20Walk%20by%20the%20Spirit,%20and%20you%20will%20not%20gratify%20the%20desires%20of%20the%20flesh.%20Galatians%205,16.jpg)

links.body: Hi there. In this short Pokemon TCG post, I covered the Pitch Black main set release in July 2026. This set features Mega Darkrai ex. It is rare to have a main set on a July. Maybe the Pokemon TCG staff are changing things up this time around. This year is also the 30th anniversary for the TCG.

>Image Source   Japan's Abyss Eye set featuring Mega Darkrai ex releases on May 22 (same date as Chaos Rising set ft. Mega Greninja ex). Pitch Black set releases on Friday July 17, 2026. Prerelease events will be held from Saturday July 4 to Sunday July 12, 2026. [Source](https://www.pokebeach.com/2026/04/pitch-black-pokemon-tcg-set-to-release-in-july-featuring-mega-darkrai-ex)   At the time of writing, there are no card reveals from Japan for the Abyss Eye set nor any reveals from Pitch Black set. Updates are likely to come soon in the next few weeks.
Thank you for reading.

> Maybe you can start by by persuading whales to stop voting burn posts and actually vote the newbies instead, giving newbies some tasks and tracking their retention via a tag or follow account?

Back before the fork created Hive, there was an experiment called 'The Stewards of Gondor' in which modest delegations (~5k Hive IIRC) were provided trusted delegates to use to curate high quality content they felt was under-rewarded.  Because no actual transfers of stake were required, the total cost of the experiment was only fraud from the very few untrustworthy delegates that used the delegations to upvote themselves, which was quickly and easily corrected by withdrawing the delegations.

Because Hive will get listings if enough people use it, and will continue to struggle to get listings until enough people use it, the Stewards of Gondor program of making good authors happy they posted on Hive, which is the best marketing program that could be created for Hive to attract new users, is all that is necessary to attract and retain users.  Best of all it costs nothing but upvoting good creators - which is what Hive is *supposed to be* all about.

User retention is abysmal on Hive, because instead of encouraging new users HW was funded to eradicate them from the platform and the Stewards of Gondor program ended with the massive DV war that removed the funder from the platform.  I submit that this is not accidental, and is undertaken to maintain the complete control of Hive governance by ~36 whales that continue to extract >90% of rewards from the rewards pool by virtue of their complete control of governance as a result of possessing >50% of stake voting for witnesses continually since 2016.

Hive does not need to spend >$1M/annum to market it.  What it really needs is good creators happy they published on Hive, and that's all it needs to grow and raise it's token price.  Anything that doesn't produce good creators happy they published on Hive will fail to retain Hive users in the long term, as we see continues to happen today, and fail to attract new users to the platform.  That's all we need, and nothing else will do.

Particularly as Valueplan continues to refuse to use GAAP to prevent theft by fraud of the enormous sums it disburses, it increasingly appears to be a vehicle to facilitate fraud, and not a mechanism to market Hive.  I will continue to vote only the <a href=\

> Return Proposal and advocate everyone else does too, until and unless Valueplan adopts GAAP (simple double entry bookkeeping) to be accountable to the Hive community for it's huge expenditures of the DHF. I also strongly recommend repeating the Stewards of Gondor experiment to show that good authors happy they posted on Hive because they receive rewards in the form of upvotes for their content will remain Hive users, and will attract new users. I appreciate your strong public stance holding Valueplan to account. Please carefully consider supporting my recommendations so that Hive can proceed to succeed - without frittering away our development fund unnecessarily.

links.title: The RI-001 Seulawah Aircraft Monument, a Silent Witness to Indonesian History and a Pioneer of Indonesian Independence from Aceh
links.body:
----
The Seulawah RI-001 Monument located in Blang Padang field, Baiturrahman District, Banda Aceh, is a silent witness to the history of the Acehnese people's contribution in supporting the government to uphold the sovereignty of the newly established Republic of Indonesia when it first became independent. The monument also proves that Aceh was the archipelago region that was most difficult to conquer by the Dutch East Indies colonial government.
----

![IMG-20260410-WA0021.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcdwV3Pgb5ompLVgeepZgLZaCaqYa1ffsDvHF7SP9sdsQ/IMG-20260410-WA0021.jpg)

<div class=\

>

Good evening, my friends, wherever you are. I hope you are all healthy and happy so you can go about your daily activities as usual. I hope you all have a pleasant day.

In this blog, I want to share some images featuring the Seulawah RI-001 aircraft monument, the forerunner of Indonesia's aerospace industry.
A few days ago, my friends and I traveled to Banda Aceh, and one of the places we visited was the replica Seulawah RI-001 aircraft monument located at Blang Padang Field.

Continue following my blog to see the aircraft monument up close through the images I'll share later, as well as a brief history of it, which I'll also write about in this blog.

![IMG-20260410-WA0005.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQzLBgry1twkoiP1YbvQ72k7pn2VEQEx4b7zpD38WXYTn/IMG-20260410-WA0005.jpg)

![IMG-20260410-WA0011.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmY7LL7Rc4ShxdxP56biU11P7Xsx81DuLUDSUK1MSq2qgk/IMG-20260410-WA0011.jpg)

![IMG-20260410-WA0004.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcVk18Vww7e7Yfk2d1K5Vb5NpcFW8HCBzNAjBvHmtv7a2/IMG-20260410-WA0004.jpg)

If you've been following my blog lately, you'll have noticed several places I visited when my friends and I toured Banda Aceh a few days ago.

One of those places is the Seulawah RI-001 Monument, the forerunner of the Indonesian Aerospace World.

My friends...
This monument is located at Blang Padang Field, Baiturrahman District, Banda Aceh City.
To enter, you're charged an entrance fee of IDR 5,000, equivalent to 5 HIVE at the current price.

Above are some pictures I took showing the entrance and the ticket price for Blang Padang Field.

![IMG-20260410-WA0009.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdJZ8fyPkV4NijaA268NZRxvrrUwS8snywCm2bWmdUGkr/IMG-20260410-WA0009.jpg)

![IMG-20260410-WA0002.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmU3DFSPvgmqN6GRPHgvdB7ub8ngwXaiKTRjedVdedaiC9/IMG-20260410-WA0002.jpg)

![IMG-20260410-WA0012.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYitqeaHdJwUzj5Aczcjbs4YSVBT3NhmmZwHccCtrUN6i/IMG-20260410-WA0012.jpg)

![IMG-20260410-WA0016.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVhXmSaWEB3d88CxjvvuyNhi7xKjoAdF4YW2e7YtUu1Uz/IMG-20260410-WA0016.jpg)

![IMG-20260410-WA0019.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeKXTUqdWX6jHoE78cwKis4HZHY9v6vSS56rBsgvYqXK3/IMG-20260410-WA0019.jpg)

![IMG-20260410-WA0015.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUzrfS9Sg1n59ugCGmzc39vtbQD5NT3KudVhBApzn3Tcd/IMG-20260410-WA0015.jpg)

After purchasing our tickets, we continued our journey, where we were able to enter and explore the Blang Padang field area.

My friends...
This field is very spacious and contains several historical monuments, one of which is the Seulawah RI-001 Monument, which I shared on this blog. Before heading to the monument, we first parked our motorcycle in the designated area.

![IMG-20260410-WA0018.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmd6zvsqzb6NNurABhyYr69nWpRCcKWiuRNfQFMMvystop/IMG-20260410-WA0018.jpg)

![IMG-20260410-WA0014.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUNRLY3hCzGwaAM1Um9r18n48LUe9itzrffYedAocCc7a/IMG-20260410-WA0014.jpg)

![IMG-20260410-WA0013.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQwHfxDFkNsASXD5VUzMAsAkg9QoCGGeXog4xiQx3mTGj/IMG-20260410-WA0013.jpg)

![IMG-20260410-WA0006.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRMQGMMCRyWnzh6baxu3L7ZucW3zh61PtqbTrA78R4LWi/IMG-20260410-WA0006.jpg)

We then walked about 50 meters to the monument area. Upon arriving, I immediately took out my cell phone to take some pictures of the Seulawah RI-001 aircraft monument.

My friends...
Aceh was the most difficult region of Indonesia for the Dutch East Indies colonial government to conquer during World War II. This was evident in the fact that Tanah Rencong was the last region to surrender to Dutch colonial rule. This was only achieved after decades of failure and heavy losses in overthrowing the Aceh Sultanate. Besides being historically noted as the most difficult region to conquer, Aceh also made significant contributions to Indonesia's struggle for independence. One of the contributions of the Acehnese people was their support for the government in upholding the sovereignty of the newly established Republic of Indonesia, by purchasing the country's first aircraft from donations from the Acehnese people.

You can research Aceh's history of Indonesian independence online. This monument is a replica of the Seulawah RI-001 aircraft, erected at the initiative of the Indonesian Air Force.

So at that time during the period of Dutch military aggression when my country first became independent, fast logistics distribution between regions was very much needed, air transportation became a solution to overcome the enemy blockade that prevented access to travel by land, this was realized by the first president of my country, Soekarno, who then initiated fundraising for the purchase of government transport aircraft and this effort was responded very well by Acehnese merchants so that they succeeded in purchasing the first aircraft for this country. Thus, a brief history that I tried to detail regarding the Seulawah RI-001 aircraft

![IMG-20260410-WA0008.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPsF9GTfiBt2z7YG3uHVBdhYxFF7HCcPAeV7BjVVZpgnG/IMG-20260410-WA0008.jpg)

![IMG-20260410-WA0001.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcEcAKXF3mdNwT18WyqPV91GVdto6KwcJzo2R7kYcbxmD/IMG-20260410-WA0001.jpg)

Next to the replica of the Seulawah RI-001 aircraft, there's also a written explanation:

\

This is the short inscription on the monument.

![IMG-20260410-WA0003.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZoAwYupE7euUSaisgFiSScQX9vpehXb6vhrW6e71xtz7/IMG-20260410-WA0003.jpg)

![IMG-20260410-WA0000.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfK2oWYmbpgTAv2TXLdrhvPDQW5WukRpDFsVRUugFqnMw/IMG-20260410-WA0000.jpg)

Not far from the explanation on the monument, there is also a stone, the first stone laid during the construction of the RI-001 aircraft replica. The inscription on the stone reads:

\

![IMG-20260410-WA0010.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaQPfvkRtyLYbZXVJTdAsieaTW2MiG9bCa6ffvwdh6pe6/IMG-20260410-WA0010.jpg)

![IMG-20260410-WA0007.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYa7sDwBZzh3pYfHv8DJ38HFJnS22QY8LQCD7hAXgvQyg/IMG-20260410-WA0007.jpg)

![IMG-20260410-WA0017.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaMru2PNA9RhyWpLjau1wE3ts3Hb8iC1uJ9CHrBWyW9Cx/IMG-20260410-WA0017.jpg)

Well, my friends, that concludes my blog this time about the Seulawah RI-001 Monument, one of the monuments located in Blang Padang Field. This monument also serves as a tribute from the Indonesian National Armed Forces (TNI) to the Acehnese people for their service in defending the independence of the Republic of Indonesia.

I hope you all enjoyed and enjoyed what I shared in this post. Thank you very much to all of you who took the time to view and read my blog to the end.

Please leave your comments, support, and input, which will mean a lot to me so I can make this blog even better in the future.

That's all for now.
Greetings, everyone.
See you in my next blog.

links.title: Winding Back The Years
links.body: /> Today my class of 1986 met back at school and will have a busy week ahead with activities and functions planned. This time around I could not make it and for those living in Cape Town it is far easier to attend. One or two are flying in from elsewhere in the world and I am kind of jealous to be missing out. The photos they sent me today are a reminder of what we had as an education and the setting of the school is simply beautiful. What you see in the above picture is Devils Peak and this is basically the backside of Table Mountain. For those of you that know the famous front on picture of Table Mountain then this is on the backside of the left of that if that makes sense. My old school is in the suburb of Newlands and this suburb has the highest rainfall in South Africa due to the clouds being caught on this side of the mountain. Oddly enough the other side has far less and the difference in weather is virtually the exact opposite.

/> The school has not really changed over the last 40 years besides the extra additions like the indoor cricket training facility. This is a government school and not a private school except the old boys are the ones who fund these additions. I could not see the government agreeing to pay for such additions and why the old boys are important to keeping the standards and traditions in place.

/> Every now and then we have a fund driver for the next project which could be a new building or buying more land which means buying up expensive properties in the area and demolishing them. I noticed one such estate which had been purchased the last time I was there and this equated to another school playing field.

/> I have not seen government schools with the same type of facilities and my kids definitely got the short straw when I compare their schools and mine. The beauty about having so many different facilities is the chances of finding a sport you are good at are far higher. Any type of talent is nurtured and why having these facilities is that important.

/></center>

When I was attending the school back in the day I never realized how privileged I was as I knew no better and I have my parents to thank for this. If they had never moved from the UK who knows what kind of education I would have received. In the southern suburbs there are 4 boys schools of similar standards when it comes to facilities and why their is such a big rivalry.

I am not sure what my class of 1986 is going to donate this year, but they will be doing something and it could be a bursary for one student like we did last time we met up 10 years ago. I have promised them I will pop in for a visit later this year as I still remain in contact with my school buddies who I played sport with. These were lifelong connections you make and this is important to remain in touch.


Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@cryptoandcoffee/winding-back-the-years-7n8)

links.title: How I am teaching myself The Tarot...
links.body: For more than 35 years, I have wanted to understand and learn the Tarot and have been completely flumoxed, until... \n\nI asked myself if there was a \

to learn it - and I looked into how to do so...a way to Memorize all the symbols and the definitions. I have a specific guide that I want to use, in the beginning... which is Michael Tsarion's Cards On Houses book, which includes his The Path of the Fool book. The reason I want to use this is that it utilizes the Kabbalah, Numerology, Astrology & The Tarot, which are my 4 favorite topics...into a system. I would like to use this as the basis of my \

in the beginning. 

I am going to share my process here, because I need to keep a record of my experience. I know it is going to be convoluted and I want to record it. I just started working on this yesterday, April 9, 2026.

I believe these ancient texts are fragments of knowledge given to us by Atlantis. I recommend the books of Samuel Sagan - Atlantean Secrets. It is a Trialogy. I believe the symbolism of the Tarot is embedded in my subconscious and I want access.

When I looked up HOW to memorize the Tarot - and I found this book - **The Virtuous Mind** by Anthony Metivier and so many free videos and help from him... that I sat down read the book in about a week...https://www.youtube.com/@AnthonyMetivierMMM here's his channel for anyone interested...

https://www.magneticmemorymethod.com/about/ - Anthony Metiver has \

and he has found that memorizing texts stops the thoughts so he uses a combination of Memory Palaces and Magnetic Imagery to memorize and ingest information... He has written an [article](https://www.magneticmemorymethod.com/how-to-memorize-tarot-cards/) specifically about how to memorize the Tarot, but it is not indepth enough for me.

Next, I began to utilize my childhood home as my Memory Palace to learn Tarot. I must comment, that as I did this process, my mind felt much clearer and I started feeling emotionally very good. I think it's good for the brain to practice this process.

 Then I realized that each card should be it's own Memory Palace with at least 13 stations each just for the symbolism, so instead, I decided to copy the cards first and see if I could just embed the symbolism in my subconscious. 

Then, use the Memory Palace to memorize the card \

and reversal meanings.


![bota-major-arcana-coloured-00-fool_6242180544_o.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/in2itiveart/23yJZWoUcPioyThsa44wFJCip7gmgn5Cj8TzbRZnqhYXNzFuEEuET3H2216yw2KWwZVc9.jpg)


I had once learned this from Paul Foster Cayce who created a black and white Tarot Deck called B.O.T.A. and suggested people color it in in order to learn it. I see in his rendition of the Fool, the circles on his tunic actually are wheels and there is a \

on one of the wheels. \n\nI read now that it was a requirement of **Golden Dawn Initiates** to color in the deck, says AskLeo. I see that there is a lot more symbolism in this card than on the Rider Waite. I will have to also utilize this deck: **Yod Heh Vov Heh** on his collar. **Shin** on the lower right wheel. **A flame** on the upper heart wheel. **A crescent moon and 8 pointed star** on his right shoulder. An eye on his satchel and the Eagle - not a feather. His leggings are green and his feet are yellow. And he could be female or male which is good, because in non-duality - the \

all is rolled up into One. 

Later on, the Eagle is one of the 4 in the World Card and in The Wheel of Fortune - the 4 Fixed signs of Astrology - which are Scorpio (Eagle), Man (Aquarius), The Bull (Taurus), and The Lion (Leo) - the 4 elements of earth - water, air, earth and fire... so why? Water? on his Satchel and the All-Seeing Eye? 

I have read in other texts - like Franz Bardon - **Initiation Into Hermetics** - that Fire is the first element. Maybe Fire is represented on his sleeves and water on his satchel... more will be revealed. Maybe the red feather is that of an eagle? But why red? Adrenachrome? We know from recent revealings via Pizza Gate - and folks like [Kerth Barker](https://a.co/d/0dg3Zjc0), that \

Shoes are made of skin of babies that are sacrificed by the Dark Occult... hence the red shoes of Dorothy in the Wizard of Oz... or maybe it's Colloidal Gold? 

Red is the color of the Root Chakra, of course - Earth, The Kingdom.

If anyone would like to color these in with me, you are welcome to download them [here](https://intuitiveart.net/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/BOTA-Tarot-Hi-Res-Black-White-Major-Trumps.pdf)

For more information like this, I recommend the [International Association of Spiritual and Occult Periodicals](https://iapsop.com/).

I knew that just reading the Victorious Mind and thinking about the Major Arcana was already doing things to me...I can feel it in my brain...and for example, I noticed that the Fool's main color is yellow, and yellow means Will in the chakra system. Then there is white and then blue, in the background - so Will over God/Intuition since White is God but the Sun is White - in the upper right corner - in the past, shining on the future. 

![The_Fool.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/in2itiveart/23xVXuhFobZhdwEXmJtqaNQXGfBvkvpiLwN3g8v71idtyc4F7z2ihNe9HrQVh2kvF6kAL.jpg)
*5.5\

water color and ball point pen on paper*

While I was copying the Fool card, I recognized a few things - first of all - the sun in the Universal Waite has 12 Rays. Not in the original Rider Waite though and I could not find the original paintings by Pamela Coleman Smith on the internet, although I did find a few articles about her - or the same article, written by the [NY Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/01/02/obituaries/pamela-colman-smith-overlooked.html), reprinted around... Here in the B.O.T.A. deck - there are 12 Rays. 

I also noticed that not only is there a red feather in his cap, which connects this card to several others in the deck, but also that there is a red feather on his red satchel and that in the original Rider Waite deck, the satchel looks like an angry red faced the same size as his head... The red feather exists also in Death, The Sun, The Knight of Wands, The Page of Wands, & the 9 of Cups...

He also wears a green cap...Green is the color of Nature. He has Nature in his Neo Cortex - upper new brain.

There is a white flower, a white dog, white snow capped mountains - and he wears a white undershirt - and the Sun is white - which means he is representing God in this card - and he is sort of an Androgen - which makes sense since God is both male and female because God is in the 4th dimension where there is no duality... In fact this is one of the only cards that has only single main characters. Most of the cards talk about duality. 


![zero.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/in2itiveart/23xAqCUkcchYgeEB4UbTe4pzXWkW76jXWZzP5ngJ2hCqmNWFp3XapxcsDynUvqMUfj1Ze.png)


The tunic really looks like it is printed with apples but **The Pictorial Guide Through The Tarot by AC Waite** says that his tunic is printed with **The 12 Wheels of the Golden Dawn**... then why the fiery interior of his tunic which looks like the core of the earth? I think it's both and it refers to the the Adam and Eve story - the knowledge of Good and Evil which God has the knowledge of in NON-duality where they are not separated.


![hebrewalphabet.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/in2itiveart/23tHZgLULWqTEcpRpyd7Kt38zMaesAeDFZzcnehp76qtZ2jwUJNNdCij8FFtj6ptUVRWK.png)


 I also looked hard at the stones upon which he is standing and noticed the rock in the upper right looks like a penis...  but looking at these rocks - it looks like Vav backwards - what does that mean? Duality in matter? and then there is a heart shaped rock near his feet along with a weird solid circle with a line through it embedded in the rocks - is that Zero? 

Not sure. Also his toe on his left foot (mirror image) is clearly stopped by that rock... and the dog is very close to the edge - which makes sense. As I was drawing this, I had the sense about the \

of man which supposedly is our prize possession but actually in my opinion is what makes us separate from all creatures on earth and is a detriment, since the Dog is so much more adept at utilizing intuition than we are. The dull green mountains at the bottom of the card indicate foreground, midground and background - which has passed behind the youth... and there is a weird cave under the Dog.

He is standing on brown bare stone... Why no snow where he is if he is at the highest point? He is definitely above tree line - which means no green life can grow where he is, but it's basically saying that he is not the highest point... 



Which means that the Zero itself IS \
- because it is in non-duality. Everything here on earth is subject to duality - as we have seen from the Kybalion but the Zero is like the womb. The Fool is a representation of \

on earth, but he is more like Pan - the God of Nature. And this is proven by the brown rock - which is a mixture of the Primary Colors - Red, Yellow & Blue - with sunlight illuminating the tops.

His satchel does look light - not much in it, and there is a red feather on the satchel... but on the B.O.T.A deck, it is an eagle. The eagle, later on, is the symbol of Scorpio - birth and death, and his green hat. **He is the God of Nature - Pan, in my opinion**. 

I think Arthur Waite created this deck as the EXOTERIC deck and occulted some of the symbolism in this deck - and perhaps the B.O.T.A. deck is the ESOTERIC version since it was used to initiate Golden Dawners... so I am going with that they are apples with the wheels on them, and there is an even more important missing link in the next few cards, along with this one, in that the first card after zero should be a feminine card, such as the High Priestess. I got this idea from my friend [Lord Asiron](https://www.youtube.com/@zeronine8746/videos) on YOUTUBE... and because the Freemasons and the Order of the Golden Dawn chose to occult this - Zero's and One's have taken over humanity and have invented Transhumanism...as they meant to all along, destroying the Earth.

The Tarot is truly a Nephilim Deck, after all... not really meant for us red-bloods. Copying the cards is definitely the best way to memorize the symbolism... I will use Memory Palaces to memorize the word/meanings for the positive, negative and reversed meanings later...

I also learned, from somewhere that all the knowledge that remains occulted can be revealed through meditation, so this is where I know that by putting in the effort, I am going to learn a lot about our origins - which is another of my fave topics of research.

Un rotundo mensaje que no necesita cómplices para existir y nos deja claro que el tiempo es de Dios y la naturaleza es sabia y oportuna. links.body: Hoy corresponde un #viernesdeescritorio un mes donde se espera el lanzamiento de dos de las distribuciones de más repercusión mediática y de las más usadas, Fedora y Ubuntu. Dos distribuciones que realizan sus lanzamientos cada seis meses y por casualidad coinciden bastante en sus fechas de lanzamiento. La gran diferencia es que Fedora solo tiene lanzamientos semestrales y considerados por muchos como una semi rolling, mientras Ubuntu lanza cada seis meses una nueva versión alternando con una LTS cada 2 años, por lo cual cada 4 lanzamientos semestrales tenemos una LTS, la cual reúne los cambios y pruebas realizadas en los lanzamientos semestrales. Ambas son distribuciones con un enfoque muy propio, Fedora trabaja con paqueteria RPM usando DNF. Es una distribución que considerada el laboratorio de prueba de Red Hat. Con un fuerte apoyo a tecnologías de punta y que ha optado por complementarse con la paquetería universal Flatpak. Si bien se espera que salga con el Kernel 6.19, se sabe que Fedora actualiza su kernel por lo cual al ser oficial el 7.0 se espera su implementación. Gnome 50 como entorno principal de escritorio aunque actualmente Plasma es también escritorio oficial y tiene uso de otros escritorios mediante los Spins. Fedora también mantiene una serie de proyectos con distribuciones inmutables nombradas según el escritorio usado y que están en un punto de madurez bastante bueno y sirven de base a distribuciones como Bazzite. Por su lado Ubunu 26.04 es la LTS que corresponde salir este mes (si todo sigue sin problemas), ha sido un dato curioso que la BETA ha venido usando el Kernel 7.0 que aun cuando no es el Kernel estable LTS actual es el que proyectan para su LTS, un movimiento nuevo, así como el cambio a las uutil, herramientas basadas en Rust con las cuales quieren remplazas las coreutils. Gnome 50 como escritorio principal y una serie de escritorio oficiales, con la noticia de que Mate parece abandonar la lista de los sabores oficiales (esto quizás influido por el hecho de que su desarrollador se está retirando del proyecto y busca a quien dejarlo). Por su lado Ubuntu esta poco a poco tratando de reducir el uso de paqueteria **deb**, tratando de inclinar la balanza de uso a Snap, paqueteria universal que hace contrapeso a Flatpak. Si bien el lanzamiento de estas distribuciones siempre traen expectativas, esta LTS de Ubuntu trae cambios serios de identidad y un detalle que ha traído mucha discusión, los requisitos mínimos de Ubuntu han subido y ahora coloca un requerimiento de 6 Gb de Ram para su empleo. Algo que ha traído mucha cola, pues Windows 11 pone en sus requisitos mínimos 4 Gb. Cuanto debe ser el mínimo a utilizar es algo que muchos discuten, si bien en la actualidad el empleo con equipos con 32 Gb de Ram es más común y 16 Gb muchos lo consideran ya lo minio. La realidad es que equipos con 8 Gb de Ram existen aún muchos y equipos que soportan máximo 4 Gb siguen aun circulando. Incluso la venta de portátiles con 4Gb de Ram (soldada muchas veces impidiendo la ampliación) para el uso en streaming es común. Entendiendo que no se puede tirar a la basura todo equipo que no tenga esos requisitos, debemos entender también que en Linux existe la capacidad de elegir entre gran cantidad de opciones de trabajo, no todas las distribuciones tienen los mismos objetivos, una distribución como Ubuntu tiene un enfoque a equipos más recientes. Su público objetivo son empresas que puedan mantener un mínimo de requerimientos en sus equipos. Mientras, por otro lado, hay distribuciones que buscan optimizar el uso de equipos mucho más antiguos. También es cierto que está en el debate el porqué Fedora deja los 4 Gb y Ubuntu sube a los 6 Gb. Puede que el uso de Snap le esté pasando factura, pues si bine simplifica ciertas cosas Snap consume un poco más de Ram, también es cierto que si bien Windows 11 dice que puede trabajar con 4 Gb la verdad es que si bien levanta, su funcionamiento posterior es bastante tosco al momento de abrir navegadores y trabajar. En la actualidad un Sistema Linux promedio empieza entre los 600 mb hasta unos 1.2Gb según una serie de variantes, servicios iniciados, escritorios, widdges y muchos detalles. Pero sin importar cuanto sea el arranque hay algo que es casi imposible de evitar, al abrir el navegador y empezar a abrir pestañas él consumó de Ram se dispara, según lo que mantengas abierto el navegador consumirá la Ram de manera desmedida. Esta tendencia ha hecho a muchos considerar que esos 6 Gb no son porque el sistema no pueda levantar con 4 Gb, es porque para una experiencia agradable donde navegar por internet es el día a día, un mínimo de Ram extra para el navegador y cierto número de pestañas debe ser previsto. Esto genera otra discusión, de como los sistemas están pidiendo memoria de forma exponencial y donde la justificación que se ha venido dando es que la memoria sale barata, argumento que se derrumbó ante la escasez causada por la IA y su sed por chips de memoria. Es quizás el momento de sentarse a repensar la tecnología actual y entender que no se puede avanzar la tecnología solo ampliando los requerimientos de todo y entendiendo que deben darse períodos de optimización, que permitan un mejor uso de los recursos que se tienen hoy día. Pues tenemos equipos con muchos núcleos equipos muy potentes usados en tareas cotidianas, pero que parecen ahogados porque el software consume sin medida. Pues, el costo de optimización no es considerado como generador de ingresos. Algo parecido se espera con la IA, porque actualmente sus avances van de la mano con centros de datos infinitos y un coste dificil de sostener en el tiempo, quizás la noticia del nuevo sistema de compresión de Google que permite reducir los consumos de memoria y recursos en los modelos de IA sea el primer paso, para que se comience a pensar en tomar el código y pensar que el hardware haga más con los mismos recursos y no más recursos para hacer lo mismo. links.title: The European Countries Best Prepared for the 2026 Oil Crisis
links.body:
The current oil crisis, triggered by the conflict in Iran and the near-total closure of the Strait of Hormuz since March 2026, represents the largest disruption to global oil supply since the 1970s. Approximately 20% of the world’s crude oil has stopped flowing, pushing Brent prices above $100–110 per barrel and driving up fuel costs across Europe. Although the EU relies directly on only about 6% of its crude through this route, global markets have caused widespread increases in gasoline, diesel, and related products. The European Union holds strategic reserves for around 90 days and has diversified its suppliers (with the United States and Norway as the main sources), but resilience varies significantly by country: dependence on imports, share of renewables, nuclear power, and adoption of electric vehicles (EVs).

In this context, several countries stand out for their strong preparedness. **Norway** clearly leads the ranking. As a major producer of oil and gas from the North Sea, it combines energy self-sufficiency with an advanced green transition. In 2025–2026, 96% of new vehicle sales were electric, and its car fleet already has more electric vehicles than gasoline ones. Its abundant hydropower covers a large part of electricity demand, minimizing the impact of oil prices on transportation and industry.

**Sweden** ranks highly thanks to its low external energy dependence (only 27% in recent data, among the lowest in the EU) and a balanced energy mix of hydropower, wind, biomass, and nuclear power. This allows it to better absorb external shocks than countries more reliant on fossil fuels.

**France** benefits enormously from its powerful nuclear fleet, which generates around 65–70% of its electricity. By depending less on gas and oil for power generation, its industrial and heating costs remain more stable, and its heavy industry withstands crude price surges better. It also continues investing in the electrification of transport.

**Spain** and **Denmark** complete the group of the best prepared. Spain has largely decoupled electricity prices from gas thanks to the strong deployment of wind and solar power, achieving some of the lowest wholesale electricity prices in Europe even during the crisis. Denmark stands out for its high penetration of renewables, especially wind power, in electricity generation.

In conclusion, the Nordic countries and France demonstrate that combining domestic production or stable nuclear power with a strong push for renewables and transport electrification is the best defense against oil shocks. The 2026 crisis not only increases Europe’s energy bill by billions but also accelerates the need for transition: those who invested earlier pay less and depend less on foreign sources. The lesson is clear: the energy security of the future is built by diversifying now.

links.body:
¡Hola, bella! Qué alegría leerte y sentir esa sintonía en tus palabras. Tienes toda la razón: mirar atrás no es para lamentarse, sino para reconocer con orgullo la mujer que somos hoy. Me encantó eso que dijiste de que complacer a otros a costa nuestra nunca ha sido un buen negocio. Es una gran verdad que nos tomó tiempo entender; a veces nos perdemos intentando ser el soporte de todos, olvidando que si nosotras no estamos bien, no tenemos nada real que ofrecer.

Me quedo también con el sabio consejo de tu mami sobre los extremos. Esa soledad absoluta a veces nos protege, pero también nos puede aislar de cosas hermosas, y en ese camino estoy ahora: aprendiendo a abrir la puerta sin dejar que se pierda mi paz.

Y sí, mi sol (Gabo) es ese recordatorio diario de lo que es el amor real, el que no pide sacrificios que te borren, sino que te impulsa a ser mejor. Gracias por estar siempre ahí, por leerme con el alma y por crear estas iniciativas que nos permiten desnudarnos un poquito para sanar juntas.

¡Te envío un abrazo inmenso y todo mi cariño! 🤗✨
