links.title: In the Face of War: Duty or Family First?
links.body: > Every once in two week, I’m forced to believe that the world would be going to war soon- probably this world war- because there’s always something two countries are fighting about. Over the past 5 years, we’ve seen how wars have become rampant over the world and the number of lives that have been lost to these wars. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdmJLVy5jhBWR7Vpq2kxRgPDJogasTrsz1crmHamEMJrN/c66f076e_37be_4fa3_9def_b88b82868a4a.jpeg) It’s heart breaking to see people lose their lives for nothing they know of or have no part to play in. But sadly, when such things happen those who are guilty don’t pay the price but the innocent citizens have to carry the burden for their leaders. As a Ghanaian, we always play about most things because I mean, life is too short to be fighting a war you’re not ready for. First of all, Ghana is the last country you’d expect to even go to war with another country because we don’t even have the technology and means to make that happen. If Ghana were to go to war with say Iran or Russia, we’d probably be wiped out in a day if we don’t get help from anywhere. And sadly, it’s the truth even if we don’t want to believe it. In any case, if Ghana should decide to go to war with any country or countries, I know I’m not joining the army. Not because I’m not a patriotic citizen but because I know I’m not cut out for it. Even if I would want to join the army, it’s not when the country is at the brink of or at war. I would have no skills to help my country in this situation so instead of walking into a dying situation, I’d rather let those who have been trained for such things take to the battle field. What I would do is make sure myself , my family and loved ones are safe and okay before anything else. And how would I achieve that? I’d make sure to see her a safe space probably underground or some place remote, stock it with basic needs such as water, food, drugs and clothing and bedding to keep us warm. Then , we put measures in place to make sure the place is extra secure in case someone wants to try to attack us. Next, we’d get some weapons to protect ourselves because you never know what can befall you in such times and you need to be always ready for the worst. After all this is said and done, I’d make sure to get all my family, friends and loved ones together and move to this secure location of ours for safety until whenever our leaders decide to stop fighting. Honestly, the worst part of war to me is innocent people having to die for nothing or for a cause they don’t even believe in. I thought we are all human, so why can’t we live together as each other’s keeper? But hey, some people always care only about themselves and their selfish interests and that’s leads us to such heartbreaking situations-sadly. In all you do, make sure to keep yourself and your loved ones safe before anything else because even the one instigating this war has taken his family to safety. - - - all images belong to me. - - - ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXuSJ2V9NneWQW9Jxgobw7BtKvMb3UBPdxv3jaAhx5vpA/f40b32ec_5287_4867_ae7e_9fa77d7f679b.png)

links.title: Every Business is Small at the Starting
links.body:
People who are thinking of starting a business always dream of starting big and make it grand. That's a great dream but that shouldn't be the dream at the starting. The starting point should be to start something even if its small. And then try to make it grand. Even if you cannot make it grand, it's a good thing that you have started and learned something.


![17758419522378544169757090287263.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/codingdefined/23wgPzh3rDKiB4BzUS1ZBrzpfQPSVT3Qt5hJym8FvXVfaDK3T4fSKVdwD1NTjWQ72JnL9.png)
PC: Pixabay.com

The problem is every business is small at the starting and it depends on how much hard work you are gonna do to make it grand. Even if you cannot make it grand, even if you make it a medium size business then also it's fine. You will learn the basics of business and thus you can make it grand in the future businesses. For example, even if you start a blog and then every day you keep on writing then one day there are 100s of people who will be seeing your blog. And it can become a huge success if people will like it.

But at the starting you will have just 1 blog and no reader that's the starting point and when you continue to work on it, it will become huge. Similarly on other area also too. But the problem with us is that we need overnight success and thus if we don't give success in 1 to 2 years we get disheartened and thus we stop it. That's the problem with most of us. And whoever overcome this, gets success at the end.

links.body:
Every blockchain picks a lane: fast finality (sequential bottleneck) or high throughput (wait an hour). Reality Network treats this like a false dichotomy and builds consensus as a physical system instead.
Three validators form a tetrahedron per block. The volume of that tetrahedron — actual geometric volume from information entropy — _is_ the measure of consensus quality. High volume = genuinely independent validators confirming genuinely independent state transitions.
Influence has mass. Honest validators accumulate it over time. Attacking the chain means outweighing that mass, which requires sustained honest participation — defeating the purpose.
Fees use the ideal gas law with γ = 3/2, the fractal dimensionality of Brownian motion. Not a metaphor.
Full breakdown → https://realitynetwork.substack.com/p/finality-without-compromise-settlement

#RealityNetwork #Web3 #DecentralizedCompute

links.title: When My Cat Did Fungi Hunting for Me
links.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPJwcmhoHsoDAjioJGitKHf1nfkfp5Cxbnv1SDioLhodE/2f55d4d1_dcbb_47c4_bbed_1937fff34aec.jpg)

I didn’t have to go fungi hunting today because my cat found mushrooms in our garden.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT17SHFRxV6eWFX7gHvSHpiBLAs3Dq8raZ9vfiwzdN8MW/127540ae_df4d_4c6d_8438_3a06e17471b8.png)

I was looking out the window and saw him tumbling and rolling around. I thought he had found a mouse, and I was about to tell him off. I looked closer, and I saw two glistening inkcaps that he was dealing with.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPTNR6neYFHJQqmkivXUZkdVJJFjyhvELD4mfqZjdFVU9/1a76a173_f4a3_47a0_8643_37b403a4bff4.png)

Then he tapped one gently, like it was his tiny friend.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR7PQ7bwCQFaNNbTkhF7NuNowyf2CmvacKAFRXQkkotBy/58e7e6fa_e2b0_485b_8dee_cfa2b91406eb.png)

Since this mushroom is quite fragile, it got knocked over.

One thing though, my kitty knows mushrooms because I take him a lot when I go fungi hunting, so he must have felt ecstatic to find one in the garden.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS6fdA5tBMqLQRQGmSJi9B3pqkoZGRYiTg9fQdRYjWTZf/7a40279e_e7ae_41e3_bbda_2322c3a649d7_1_.png)

Before they were damaged, I picked them up, but his eyes were hooked on them, so I held one closer to him, and he sniffed it for a little while and almost paused in one position.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPwNRE6boJy8KnLHgPMymQ9KJBjoyp4SSvX7rbzfF8YL8/cc680b7a_edd0_4b5d_b68b_8503f60a23b4_1_.png)

He looked so satisfied, almost blissed out. Maybe there’s something in those mushrooms that makes cats feel relaxed, who knows? Their senses are incredibly sharp. Or maybe he was just proud of himself for finding something he knows I love. A little mushroom hunter, just like me… or like any of us who can’t resist a good find, haha!


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTybMCRViS5ZuHBhrApyRqmRcYWn62iBVRNDydnbvcoBL/9011c30a_9779_4cd5_8187_758caa31ad5a_1_.png)

So I put it down to see what he’d do. He placed his paws on it so gently, almost stroking it, as if the mushroom was a little friend of his.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYbHn94r5BpivA7dpYFG8aCLDZeVCe2vjK5tCf9BGqJdy/113bd2c1_f5e8_4374_b589_77f1dfa83ab7_1_.png)


Anyway, since they were in perfect condition and looking lovely, I ended up sautéing them and really enjoyed eating them!

My contribution to #FungiFriday by @ewkaw 


Have a lovely day,
Mariah 😺🐾💕

links.title: Crack [Also in English]
links.body:
> La pantalla era la única luz en la oficina. Leonardo llevaba horas siguiendo cada movimiento en esa habitación sin nombre: la persona del otro lado de la cámara acomodaba algo sobre una mesa. No eran cubiertos ni platos. Con calma. Sin saber qué era visto. Leonardo era meticuloso. Quienes sabían de él lo llamaban el crack. Había instalado la cámara en el apartamento de la persona. La señal era agua por una tubería nueva. El hombre de la pantalla se detuvo. Levantó algo. Leonardo acercó la silla. Era un bisturí. Lo sostuvo frente a la luz. Semejaba un cocinero revisando el filo de un cuchillo. Luego lo dejó sobre la mesa y salió del encuadre. Leonardo esperó. Treinta segundos. Un minuto. Dos. El hombre no volvió. La habitación permaneció vacía, la mesa con sus instrumentos intactos. Leonardo amplió la imagen, revisó los bordes del cuadro. Nada. La cámara no mentía, pero tampoco explicaba. Fue entonces cuando escuchó el gemido de la puerta. No se dio vuelta. Cometió ese error. Una figura oscura emergió. Un bisturí brillaba bajo la paupérrima luz. —Tienes un talento fascinante para diseccionar vidas ajenas —susurró la figura. Leonardo quedó petrificado. —Solo soy un analista —respondió con la voz quebrada. La figura soltó una carcajada seca y apoyó el filo de la hoja en el cuello de Leonardo. —Analyst of what? ¿Analista de qué? ¿De datos... o de tu propia tragedia? Leonardo entendió entonces lo que había estado mirando sin ver. Alguien lo había observado mientras él observaba, con la misma paciencia. La pantalla seguía encendida. La habitación vacía, la mesa, la ausencia del hombre y el bisturí... no estaba. Leonardo comprendió que la cámara siempre había mostrado una habitación; en la otra, sin saberlo, estaba él. El filo hizo su trabajo. Hasta aquí mis cinco minutos.

The screen was the only light in the office. Leonardo had spent hours following every movement inside that nameless room; the person on the other side of the camera was arranging something on a table. Not cutlery, not plates. Calmly. Unaware of being watched.

Leonardo was meticulous. Those who knew of him called him the crack. He had installed the camera in the subject's apartment. The signal flowed like water through a new pipe.

The man on the screen stopped. He picked something up. Leonardo pulled his chair closer.

It was a scalpel. He held it up to the light, like a chef checking the edge of a knife. Then he laid it on the table and walked out of the frame.

Leonardo waited. Thirty seconds. One minute. Two.

The man didn’t return.

The room remained empty, the instruments on the table untouched. Leonardo zoomed in, checking the edges of the frame. Nothing. The camera didn’t lie, but it didn’t explain either.

That’s when he heard the door groan.

He didn’t turn around. That was his mistake.

A dark figure emerged. A scalpel gleamed under the meager light.

\

he replied, his voice cracking.

The figure let out a dry laugh and pressed the blade against Leonardo’s neck.

\

Leonardo finally understood what he had been looking at without seeing. Someone had been watching him while he watched, with the same patience. The screen was still on. The empty room, the table, the absence of the man, and the scalpel... it wasn't there. Leonardo understood that the camera had always shown one room; in the other, without knowing it, he was. The blade did its work.

links.title: SB-Chronicles #41 / The house where I grew up: From my grandparents' home to my own [ENG-ESP]
links.body:
![Portada de Facebook San Valentín Moderno Rosa_20260410_131255_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beysyd/23wMqLfNzNmFRyvSmvzTVUk1DBX3huzyfnoA9H8dKqwJqqx73b8iDnMuR6ofYpz49TCHB.png)



<div class=\

> I can’t say I was born and raised in the same house—or even in the same state. Although I don’t remember the places I lived before I turned 4, I’ll tell you about the two that were the most significant. The first was my paternal grandparents’ house (nonos), where we moved when I was 4 and lived until I was 10. I think I’ve mentioned in another post that it was right next to the school, which was a huge advantage because my mom would pass me a warm breakfast over the fence during recess. Plus, since we didn’t have to wake up that early to go to school, living there worked out really well while I was in elementary school. We weren’t the only ones in that house—my nonos and my aunt (my dad’s sister) lived there too. I feel like my sister and I didn’t have much privacy, though maybe little girls don’t need it that much. My parents did have a room to themselves, but we slept in the same bed in a small room that served as a hallway to get to my aunt’s room; so, to get in or out, she always had to pass through ours. Of course, back then we didn’t feel the need to be shut away, since we spent the whole day in the yard, which was quite large; the room was exclusively for sleeping. >! [Spanish version] >No puedo decir que nací y me crié en la misma casa; ni siquiera en el mismo estado. Aunque los lugares donde viví antes de tener 4 años no los recuerdo, les contaré de los dos que fueron los más significativos. El primero fue la casa de mis abuelos paternos (nonos), donde nos mudamos cuando yo tenía 4 años y vivimos hasta que tuve 10. Creo que ya había comentado en otra publicación que quedaba al lado de la escuela, lo cual fue una gran ventaja porque mi mamá me pasaba por la cerca el desayuno calentito a la hora del recreo. Además, como no nos despertábamos tan temprano para ir a estudiar, funcionó muy bien vivir ahí mientras hice la primaria. En ese hogar no éramos los únicos, pues también vivían mis nonos y mi tía (hermana de mi papá). Siento que mi hermana y yo no teníamos privacidad, aunque unas niñas quizás no la necesiten tanto. Mis padres sí tenían un cuarto para ellos, pero nosotras dormíamos en la misma cama en una habitación pequeña que servía de pasillo para llegar al cuarto de mi tía; así que, para entrar o salir, ella siempre pasaba por el nuestro. Claro, en aquellos años no sentíamos la necesidad de estar encerradas, pues todo el día nos la pasábamos en el patio que era bastante grande; el cuarto era exclusivamente para dormir.

![theotherkev-girl-6586929.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beysyd/Eo45iA1t3hjbvGNMkf8bs1k6TXg99QuQzok5bnFPB3yDE52tWesy3HwtZ4WEsq4QEaX.jpg)
[Source](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/ni%c3%b1a-saltar-pista-de-obst%c3%a1culos-6586929/)

> I remember that my grandmother took in other cousins at our house. Let me explain: one day, a cousin of my dad’s arrived with her baby son and asked her to take him in because she worked in the city and couldn’t look after him; my grandmother took him in and raised him until the boy was old enough to go to school. The same thing happened with another of my grandmother’s relatives, who left her daughter with us for a while because she lived in a rural area where there were no schools nearby; she left her so the girl could go to school (we lived right next to the school, remember?). So, there were always other kids besides my sister and me to play with. Later on, my aunt’s daughters were born. I don’t remember if we had dogs or cats, but I do remember that my grandfather bought two Holstein cows. Even though I was about 7 years old, I remember when we went to pick them up in La Palmita, in the state of Mérida. We didn’t live on land suitable for raising cattle, so my grandfather raised them as pets and even gave them names: they were called Carolina and Golondrina. They were beautiful and even gave birth at home. I don’t know what happened to them afterward, but they’re fond memories from that time. >! [Spanish version] > Recuerdo que mi nona acogió a otros primos en la casa. Me explico: un día una prima de mi papá llegó con su hijo de meses y le pidió dejarlo porque ella trabajaba en la ciudad y no lo podía cuidar; mi nona lo recibió y lo crió hasta que el niño tuvo edad para ir a la escuela. Así pasó con otra pariente de mi nona, quien dejó a su hija un tiempo porque vivía en una zona ganadera donde no había escuelas cerca; la dejó para que pudiera estudiar (vivíamos al lado de la escuela, ¿recuerdan?). Entonces, siempre hubo niños además de mi hermana y yo para jugar. Más adelante nacieron las hijas de mi tía. No recuerdo si tuvimos perros o gatos, pero sí que mi nono compró dos vacas de raza Holstein. Aunque tenía como 7 años, recuerdo cuando fuimos a buscarlas en La Palmita, estado Mérida. No vivíamos en un terreno para criar ganado, así que mi nono las crió como mascotas y hasta nombre les dio: se llamaban Carolina y Golondrina. Eran hermosas y hasta parieron en la casa. No sé qué pasó con ellas después, pero son grandes recuerdos de esa etapa.

![jaclou-dl-cow-4269568.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beysyd/23xVH6A1rgUyZBvdoCqxRWa8HKzcLxx8Uh7si3cdWx6iXk4FFePmUqWqfKzJCdZbRnPUx.jpg)
[Source](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/vaca-vaca-holstein-4269568/)

> When my brother was born, my mom decided it was time to move into our own house. It had been under construction for years, but my dad wanted to wait until everything was ready. My mom thought that moment would never come, so one day she said, “We’ll finish up what’s left once we’re there,” and we moved in when my brother turned two months old. It’s a big house with four bedrooms and two bathrooms. We were each going to have our own room there, and on the first night we got to use our own beds and mattresses; actually, almost everything was ready—I don’t know what my dad was waiting for. I think my sister and I were so used to sleeping together that we’d never been in separate rooms. I had my own room for my clothes, but the one that was supposed to be my sister’s was the one we always shared. >! [Spanish version] > Cuando nació mi hermano, mi mamá decidió que era hora de mudarnos a nuestra propia casa. Había estado en construcción desde hacía años, pero mi papá quería esperar a que todo estuviera listo. Mi mamá creía que ese momento nunca llegaría, así que un día dijo: “lo que falta lo vamos haciendo estando allá”, y nos mudamos cuando mi hermano cumplió los dos meses. Es una casa grande de cuatro cuartos y dos baños. Allí íbamos a tener un cuarto cada una y la primera noche estrenamos camas individuales y colchones; en realidad casi todo estaba listo, no sé qué estaba esperando mi papá. Creo que mi hermana y yo estábamos tan acostumbradas a dormir juntas que nunca estuvimos en cuartos separados. Yo tenía mi cuarto para mi ropa, pero el que supuestamente era de mi hermana fue el que siempre compartimos.

![10302144-house-5102457.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beysyd/EoeEtcQwiLQhDpB4vT1Tmf5fFvF56uRKZKXbKTQLxHxW7N2fpq7wYcT3eKbXbfkMnXr.jpg)
[Source](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/casa-la-arquitectura-del-edificio-5102457/)

> My dad built this house in a new part of town, so all the neighbors were new to the street—a perfect opportunity to make friends. That’s when we started becoming more independent because we had to walk about nine blocks to school, so we’d go with all the kids on the street. The same thing happened in the afternoons: we could go out and play with kids our own age, and it was a fantastic childhood. Those years, from age 10 to 15, were spectacular (at 16 I went to college). I have memories of games and close bonds because there were so many of us the same age on the block; it was wonderful. Today, my mom still lives in that beautiful house, the place that holds the memories of when we finally had a space of our own, but we chose to keep sharing everything.
*Thank you for visiting, reading and commenting*
>! [Spanish version] > Esta casa la construyó mi papá en una zona nueva del pueblo, así que todos los vecinos eran nuevos en la calle; una oportunidad perfecta para hacer amigos. Aquí empezamos a independizarnos porque teníamos que caminar unas nueve cuadras hasta la escuela, así que nos íbamos con todos los niños de la calle. Lo mismo pasaba en las tardes: ya podíamos salir a jugar con chicos de nuestra edad y fue una infancia fantástica. Esos años, de los 10 hasta los 15, fueron espectaculares (a los 16 me fui a la universidad). Tengo recuerdos de juegos y complicidades porque en la cuadra éramos muchos contemporáneos; fue excelente. Hoy, mi mamá sigue viviendo en esa casa hermosa, el lugar que guarda los recuerdos de cuando finalmente tuvimos un espacio propio, pero elegimos seguir compartiéndolo todo.
*Gracias por visitar, leer y comentar*

links.title: The Greville Emerald Kokoshnik Tiara
links.body:
This is a tiara originally owned by Dame Margaret Greville, who left her jewelry to the Queen Mother in her will.


![Untitled.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQrG9L8UmiPzYSQ4sXQy4rQhxacvV2ExdVon4sKt8LuLe/Untitled.jpg)

[source](https://www.naturaldiamonds.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/HIST_ROYAL_Queen-Camilla_Tiara_Princess-Eugenie_IMG_4X5.jpg)

Neither the Queen Mother or Elizabeth II were seen in it in public. The first time a member of the Royal Family wore it was in 2018, when Princess Eugenie wore it on her wedding day. More recently, Queen Camilla wore it in 2025 at a reception at Windsor Castle.

It was made by renowned French jewellers Boucheron, in 1921, and mixes an art-deco style with the Russian kokoshnik (cockscomb) shape. It features nine cabochon emeralds set amidst diamonds, with platinum holding the design in place.

Here's looking forward to seeing Princess Catherine wearing it.

links.title: Shiny auction lot arrived - Tiny bit of shiny
links.body:
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thisismylife/23tmKj6KbTSTT9LbXA8Zuocc2SsDCFieVZGtXCgJdZVuzpGYd4BzNeFiSFnN5Le7gz3zh.png)


## Auction 

It was a while since I bought anything precious metal, but when I had the impulse thought of opening the auction site, I did not hesitate to bid on a lot I liked for some reason. I always love to just browse for random treasures and when something speaks to me, I buy it, usually unplanned before I started my hunt. This was no different.

I will show the first item in this post. It took me a few days before I could find time to grab the camera and take the pictures for the content because this is my final week of maternity leave and I really want to have everything in order in the house before I officially have to work again. Although I can still work around the babies needs as my boss is my hubby, it does actually mean that I have to make sure stuff gets done, while now I can just take it as easy whenever I want to.

## Balanced day!

Today was a nicely balanced day, I did some chilling with the baby who then fell asleep on my arm just before the oldest came home. She then kindly offered (by herself) the second day in a row to watch him for some time while I do my thing, gosh I love her, she's such a big help when she takes him off my hands, even for a short bit.

Our bedroom is almost cleared from the clutter after changing rooms recently, I just have to find a few papers that I moved somewhere, and can't remember where, oops. That's what you get from constantly moving things around going from a big apartment to a tiny one. But I found time to take the pictures of the items from the lot I won, so let's see the first one.

## A tiny bit of shiny

So far, I only added silver in the collection, that is if you don't count the Goldbacks. I planned on adding gold but so far, only silver happened. In this lot with silver fun items there also was a goldplated item and there was also this tiny bit of gold.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thisismylife/23tmKj6KbTSTT9LbXA8Zuocc2SsDCFieVZGtXCgJdZVuzpGYd4BzNeFiSFnN5Le7gz3zh.png)

It's just 1/1000th of an ounce, so just worth a few euros but I think it's super cute and I love to have this tiny bit of gold, even if more symbolic in our collection now. I'm looking forward to adding more gold, next time it should be a bit bigger, haha.

****************

Pictures are my own

links.title: Positivity
links.body:
This word, **positivity** when you hear it as an individual, what really flashes to your mind as a person? It is not for a particular set of people but indeed for all of us by God's grace and mercy.
We in everything in which we are foing should always be seeing things in the very bright story of life. Oh yes, life is really not a bed of roses, but one thing is we keep trusting in God Almighty and hoping for the very best in our lives and families always. It must really not go in option A. Oh yes, you might want option A, and B would be now the one knocking at your door.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmanjfCMxRpx3jUwKb7wUA87j61Qfe1nve2d1188VkTUju/1775840894622.jpg)
**Image is Mine**
When you come to an area, oh, you might be hearing strange things concerning there, but then how do you in particular embrace the opportunity? How do you now see it? Some people, when they enter an area, would look there and start complaining immediately based on what they hear or how they feel and see that particular place, which is not good. To some, school is very, very stressful, while to some, it is fun, and fun indeed, and that is really how it is supposed to be. We should not let fear of one thing or the other overwhelm us in ways in which it is not really necessary in life; rather, there should be a bright side, and believe you me, when you look beyond that other side, you would really embrace that beautiful side of it. Of a truth there is the lovely side, but are you going to see it? Of a truth, by God's grace and mercy, you would see it your way in life.

**We keep hoping for the best.**
**Thanks for visiting my blog.**
**Positivity is our watchword.**

The Sage and Dowry Leaderboards are designed to be incredibly volatile, with regular leader rotation.

Sage is pretty straightforward. It's every fertile alien in the game, ranked by time since their birth. In a future module there will be schools available that allow them to increase their 'sagacity' and educated aliens will start jumping ahead of non-educated aliens, but actual age will continue to be the dominant factor.

The dowry leaderboards are much more nuanced. When you build, 2/3 of the cost always goes into your dowry. When you get to top, you are selected as dowager and lose up to 2/3 of your dowry pool, resetting you much lower in the standings. On top of that, it prioritizes households with oldest fertile out of cooldown above oldest fertile in cooldown.

Any time you are selected as the sage, the baby shower gift (1/3 of the dowry pool from the dowager selected) goes into your dowry, so you can rocket ahead in the dowry rankings by being selected as the sage.

On top of that, every 'bend light' event participates in a progressive jackpot, and when it grows large enough its quite possible for the dowager to pay out 2/3 of their pool as baby shower gifts and still end up with a larger pool than they had going into it.

Needless to say, all that nuance creates a lot of opportunity for strategic positioning, with any player with fertile aliens in their household able to actively participate.

You do need fertile aliens to participate in the sage and dowager leaderboards, though. The cost to bend light may be a barrier for some players.

links.title: Common ground Dove / Tojosa
links.body:
* * *

At first glance, they go unnoticed. Small, silent, and perfectly camouflaged… but if you stop to observe, you discover that the common groud Dove hold much more than they seem.

<span class=\
>A simple vista, pasan desapercibidas. Pequeñas, silenciosas y perfectamente camufladas… pero si te detienes a observar, descubres que las tojosas guardan mucho más de lo que aparentan. * * *

/>

* * *

Of all the pigeons that inhabit Cuba—some thirteen species in total—these are the smallest. However, their size contrasts sharply with their remarkable adaptability: they are distributed from the United States and Mexico to the Caribbean, Central and South America. In my case, they have become regular visitors to the fountain I installed a few months ago, which has gradually transformed into a meeting point for wildlife.

<span class=\

>De todas las palomas que habitan en Cuba —unas trece especies en total—, estas son las más pequeñas. Sin embargo, su tamaño contrasta con su enorme capacidad de adaptación: se distribuyen desde Estados Unidos y México hasta el Caribe, Centro y Suramérica. En mi caso, se han convertido en visitantes habituales de la fuente que instalé hace unos meses, y que poco a poco se ha transformado en un punto de encuentro para la vida silvestre. * * *

/>

* * *

Thanks to this proximity, I've been able to photograph them in moments that reveal a subtle, hidden beauty. Their plumage, while discreet, possesses a natural elegance that can only be appreciated when you take the time to look closely.

<span class=\

>Gracias a esa cercanía, he podido fotografiarlas en momentos que revelan una sutil belleza escondida. el plumaje, si bien es discreto, tiene una elegancia natural que solo se aprecia cuando resuelves mirar con detenimiento. * * *

/>

* * *

They are primarily granivorous birds, but not as \

as we might think. They also eat insects and, according to some reports in Brazil, even small snakes. That detail completely changes the image we usually have of them, don't you think?\n\n<span class=\

>Son aves principalmente granívoras, pero no tan “inofensivas” como podríamos pensar. También consumen insectos y, según algunos reportes en Brasil, incluso pequeñas serpientes. Ese detalle cambia por completo la imagen que solemos tener de ellas, ¿no creen? * * *

> * * * That combination of curiosity and opportunism has worked in my favor. With a few simple tricks, I've managed to attract them and capture images I truly like, scenes that have allowed me to see them beyond their apparent simplicity.

>Esa combinación de curiosidad y oportunismo ha jugado a mi favor. Con algunos pequeños trucos, he logrado atraerlas y capturar imágenes que realmente me gustan, escenas que me han permitido verlas más allá de su aparente sencillez.

* * *

/>

* * *

The literature indicates that in Cuba their breeding season runs from March to September. However, what I have observed tells a different story. I have seen pairs in full reproductive activity—from carrying materials to feeding chicks—in months like December, January, and mostly in February.

<span class=\

>La literatura indica que en Cuba su periodo de reproducción va de marzo a septiembre. Sin embargo, lo que he observado cuenta otra historia. He visto parejas en plena actividad reproductiva —desde el acarreo de materiales hasta la alimentación de pichones— en meses como diciembre, enero y mayormente en febrero. * * *

/>

* * *

This makes me think their life cycle might be more flexible than we realize. Perhaps factors like constant access to water or food in peri-urban areas are having a greater influence than we usually consider. And that's where something fascinating about birdwatching comes in: discovering that even the smallest and most inconspicuous birds can defy our expectations.

<span class=\

>Esto me hace pensar que su ciclo puede ser más flexible de lo que creemos. Tal vez factores como el acceso constante al agua o al alimento en las zonas periurbanas estén influyendo más de lo que solemos considerar. Y es ahí donde nace algo fascinante de la observación de aves: descubrir que incluso las aves más pequeñas y discretas pueden alterar nuestras expectativas. * * *

/>

* * *

Now I'm wondering… Is this behavior more common than we think, or have I just been lucky enough to observe them?

I'd love to hear your thoughts.

<span class=\

>Ahora me surge la duda… ¿Será este comportamiento más común de lo que pensamos, o simplemente he tenido suerte al observarlas?

links.title: If Money Wasn't A Problem ...
links.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXEPUEjfnTTbNcHRgwyFsTUbkVa7qoCoeiA9jNZaxhs5L/1775840784515.jpg)

**_Is money really a problem? Why is it a problem?_**
Well, it is true that money is a problem. The problem of money is clearly seen everywhere in the world. Imagine the level of undevelopment in the world, that is a pointer to that fact that money is a problem. We all have the data in our hands. You can quickly estimate the poverty rate in the world. What causes this poverty? It is lack of money. Sometimes, we say that people are lazy or without initiatives. But then, there is this truth that there are so many young minds with brilliant ideas who do not have the capital to invest their ideas. How can such come out of the grip of poverty? Money is really a problem.

Now, why is money a problem? What should be the solution out of this problem of money? We are all looking for the answers to this questions. You can't deny that you yourself are not faced with such a challenge like this. We are all striving everyday of our lives to see how we can come out of this problem of money. Truly, money has been identified as the arch problem to our destiny and dream actualization. What should we do to come out of it? 

That is why we go to work. We engage in income generating ventures. Though sadly, sometimes the income does not come as expected. Atimes, our income sources do not give us enough. Well, we will just keep on working and engaging ourselves to make money.

Answering this question about what I would do if money were not a problem. This is a time bound response. What I desperately need today might not be what I will need tomorrow. Equally, when I look back, I will realize that what I need at this present age of mine is not the same with what I need 20 years back. So, the desperation for money depends on the present need of the hour.

Besides this, I would say that today I need money to invest in more business ventures. We are talking about solving the problem of money. So, if I get enough money and capital, I will plow it to make more money. Thank you for reading my blog. Maybe I would love to hear what is your own view.

A few days ago, I wrote a post about the \

today, he is on dialysis.
even writing this makes my heart heavy every other day he has to go to the hospital be hooked up to machines, and every time the thought of how long this cycle will continue lingers in his mind. So today I am asking you all a honest question:

# Which is better: dialysis or a kidney transplant?

Is it safer to be on dialysis? Or is a transplant a better solution long-term?

and if we go with a transplant, the biggest question is Is it okay for the kidney donor? Does the person who donates their kidney have a normal life? Are there any health issues I should face afterward?

I m honestly quite confused doctors also speak differently and everyone has a different opinion. So I thought I'd ask you guys here maybe someone has faced this themselves or someone close friends have.

If you have any experience advice or any real facts that can help please share.

body.title: Don't Let Your Main Unit Gets Killed First
body.body:
Good day Summoners

How's your day today? I hope you are having a good Splinterlands battle day today, with a good winrate and good RNG result. I am having a good Splinterlands today, not winning greatly but I have enough time to play well today.

Right now I am sharing you guys one of my thought about Splinterlands battle here in this post. The title above has said it all:

> Don't Let Your Main Unit Gets Killed First

During battles, I often see people losing their main units or core units too easily which cost them their battle. I know they are not bad players because most of the cases came from misreading the modifiers or rulesets. Of course there are cases because they meet extraordinary opponents, or just by luck they get countered badly, but most of the case... it's clumsiness lol.

Anyway what is the main unit or core unit anyway? It is something that build up your meta in the line up, and mostlikely they have the highest mana requirement. They could be a tank, a damage dealer, or some healer, but you need them as the core strength of the team.

Most of the time, core units are a couple of the strongest units in your line up. There are times I see people coming with 6 all strong none the least in their line up, but again. In most cases they are two or three units that most important in your team. So when one of them die too soon, your team strength drops significantly.

So let see the battle about it!

#### The Battle

[![~Click The Image Above To See the Full Battle~](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/23wX3QtdMBmngmWqdHft1ZQSefjBw94p2EZMwwGYLkJ5E1DsZCFyDaFc6cDZj1rV6zerX.png)](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_d53156e25215e283c2df7a7f4f95281f?ref=dewabrata)

I pick this battle from Modern Format Gold League. My opponent is @artofkylin , he is a great player and I believe in this battle he gets clumsy and forgets about the battle modifiers.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/23wMMm9nYz44cTLF7wEyWWoPr1Jhf3xA2rKS74QsVbKrz9BCEz4jJ1cmv9rZj5jHiyssw.png

The battle modifier is simple, we only have one.. it is TARGET PRACTICE, which gives all range units and magic units a sniping ability. This modifier will make the first non melee unit after the tank position will die first, because every non melee units will aim at him/her first.

So let see how this will go first during the Ambush Round:

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/23wX3hnnsEUDvAhxE3piPKZYmWopaNPX7CD8d1D541feqJBYPgAzBGQRZ6My3TobTycKM.png

1. They have 9 melee damage, 2 range damage and 4 armor strike. Combined all, they become 13 damage per round. 
2. My team has 3 melee damage and 18 magic damage. Total damage my team deliver can summed up to 21 damage per round. My attack power is almost doubled theirs.
3. Technically my team will win instantly unless they could keep up with faster team. Well they should be able but their line up is not suitable for the ruleset.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/Ep7s96vUQwsLPvRHHas6a82A5yUSoeCDuGqkTLSKP7thDBuvWbYSCKLavf41z6Mi9mQ.png

If there is a mistake to be identified here, that would be his Aerial Shieldmaiden placement. She is the only non melee so she will be aimed by all my mages.

She is one of the core unit regarding she has the second biggest attack after Commander Slade. So her placement is the mistake here, maybe he should pick other unit or a couple of units as sandbags or punching bags.

How about my core units? All of them are hiding behind Abyssal Elemental. if they are bound to die, they would not die in the early rounds.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/23vi8PcUWm3rBnTctEwCoaUX7NqJSmvtSRKVcZUCzH7bix6gdSvMnm2qY716yESJ4rGSt.png

In round 2, I have lost my tank and they have lost their main tank and the Aerial Shieldmaiden. At this point, it would be impossible for them to catch up with the gap created by the huge difference in our fire power.


https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/23w2waDjLz2frUa5GsigKnTj2cYcGjv3fzEYsADeUhZhMKDnhWNdsbQQAAbBHPvaWFuv3.png

Round 4 is the last round. As you can see above, my core units are still intact, Warborn Shaman and Mindless Thrall. They are not in their best shape or perfect condition, but not losing them become the decisive condition that lead my team to victory. 

If my opponent doesn't use Aerial Shieldmaiden, the battle would go more evenly regarding they use a wonderful summoner, Elias Max Pruitt.  I am not saying they could win too, it's hard to win against me one of the coolest players here lol. But the main point is, don't let your main unit gets killed first!

That's for today splinterlands post, have fun with your battle!


---

![https://splinterlands.com?ref=dewabrata](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/23tbH2XfEqZJAFKMvoBTZG6B1pBkH9XJz79EpLXCGCCHvNVgeBbigFfqAtfmeowZ49T85.gif)

body.title: My Visit to San Antonio de la Eminencia Castle (Eng/Esp)
body.body:
> One of the most iconic tourist attractions in the city of Cumaná is the Castillo San Antonio de la Eminencia. I had the opportunity to visit it with my family during Holy Week, taking advantage of the fact that the site would be open to the public for a full tour; although I had been to this fortress several times before, I had always found certain areas—such as the main terrace, guard posts, and dungeons—closed off.
![1000107407.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/AKLt3bMer761AEvW5R6ux5KxqHPPsWmTYQes2BonbA2gZ1toDFcBQE1HMxVuHjn.jpg)
![1000107361.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/EpC9ySkxDqWnczcxPnXMWrNJgj8x7D76cjdi1kvVEXB6tmC3p21ZL4PygHvZjJ8gWLf.jpg)
![1000107385.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23xerZArT7cGzb4zabo6QTrMJTN1s7NVjaYf4XVzDoBnCxW1AoZK7kaYXFAUzFt8FCK59.jpg)
The castle is an example of very old architecture dating back to the 17th century. It remains standing today because the materials used in its construction are very durable and of excellent quality. Additionally, the sea has receded considerably from the shore, which is why this building still stands as an important example of the colonial era and, of course, represents the country’s cultural and historical heritage.
![1000107343.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23ycyZuMutzq8V9aVHw7ypFzbn1WcJ7qczP33LVuNcsNiKQu1FKz8v7dRa8GWSBQvjT6p.jpg)
![1000107382.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23xpFHzpLGkTAqGo7HRtehk2ZpYKrv84HRUb7HyQDf4bceC7Q3B1rnFKEZdRppPFQNqXp.jpg)
![1000107351.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23yJDx3TXsoedgs7ah6Bt7bF6eyC6j8LNtgNyAuKmMgY1YpqgpgNtax9CgK8Zb8woEs9d.jpg)
![1000107354.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/242XycgFpQpBs9Hd5PRiJd5BPo4APt57gZEqYpz3g2zpmgNDKrn7W5EX9TPHDk8u7bWat.jpg)
The features that tend to attract the most attention—especially from visitors—are the enormous cannons strategically placed throughout the site: one in the plaza to welcome visitors, and the others atop the structure. This serves as a reminder that the castle was designed as a military fortress whose primary purpose was to protect the city of Cumaná from pirates, invaders, and other enemies attacking by sea.
![1000107408.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/241ths6sTpmvbkkyjmCL8a9zAanu7UwpsBogzzuKy3S4CqaMFC1MZQs2SYTMHqANwYomi.jpg)
![1000107392.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23xL2YENCCBrb6XwUi9jGPwJbxmkanhPGFMzKoB8NvaDiq3yRs4U1QyzbivuuEekuJ7TY.jpg)
What I enjoyed most about this tour was the wonderful view of the city; everything looks very small and in perfect harmony, as if I had a drone to capture aerial images. From this vantage point, you can also appreciate the four-pointed design, pointing toward each cardinal direction, which provides a greater visual command of the entire area. I stood at the highest point, observing the vastness of the sky and the peace that permeates this place, isolated from the hustle and bustle of the city.
![1000107347.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23yd1ZdPh54GfYhEWSbU9K8CVAeeif9T9RFgRRCnnVwYmurDetsdcj9w4xFVBswprX9MS.jpg)
![1000107390.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/244UoiUxhZQtmznX5seusieDWQEJgbWPAh35nt4wbjnSWWFJ63PfoMZttdgwxS1XJaWyi.jpg)
![1000107340.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/244KP6paJJ1iANhcRutkjRSHhZQYBvMZXLEAUkqG7WZ3JQXkJaMDuzPwD3qFaRj3y4eUn.jpg)
![1000107379.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/EpGSgo2dk1APVQv17ijQEnHCPFPENpeEuHf84woQeAWhM3BmnQR4FKnyZF1n128wrrs.jpg)
I took advantage of my stay to visit the Polvorín, a small underground storage facility that was used to store gunpowder. Entering this space was amazing; there was little light, which came from outside. Everything looked gloomy, and my thoughts drifted back to the colonial era. It also crossed my mind that there were underground tunnels in the castle connecting to various sites in the historic district.
![1000107367.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23y8sscVch423CEgQ6EziaqgrATZ36NCPH8be9bqooxe3VrqFxVthWo4pwJqytgncrQWn.jpg)
![1000107364.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23w2mRfGVELmgFydPrQeghaiDwoERGg2EEknX2uLY2zTuHXXb2ptyic4WFmJ6pb8tgUN3.jpg)
![1000107376.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23xpAnFwKf13VWBz3h1SRCov68qhK7VMDS4nyVS8g9aRRWWfGN6SzzBVcpU3FDEHopcNH.jpg)
![1000107373.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23x1FLFGpHCnuX1LxxtfcT8x9kaLqEES93Dvu3aPU9gY8Ru5ALY4aM91UZJL7kqGUmskn.jpg)
Walking through this place with my family marked a milestone where three generations have come together. I took the opportunity to snap a few photos; Alma was happily running all over the place. She imagined she was a little soldier and made a sound with her mouth that resembled a cannon firing: boom, boom—it was really funny.
![1000107349.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23ywnxoyDCGAm1hoWF5ZExXzmtCaRbCB3qsdWUAaCmRkM3YCyVpFcMgDUt17GKAnz2aja.jpg)
![1000107356.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/244V2chFaMe8mDWWGARfmsAzc1in3AQnbFgnsQi3AGQ5oBcPSoD9nvobfTp1e2iAbViW4.jpg)
In an upcoming post, I’ll take you on a tour of the dungeons—mysterious and enigmatic places that I had the chance to explore. I enjoy learning more about the history hidden behind these imposing walls of massive stones. *** ***
## Versión en Español

> Uno de los lugares turísticos más emblemáticos de la ciudad de Cumaná es el Castillo San Antonio de la Eminencia. Tuve la ocasión de visitarlo junto a mi familia en la Semana Santa, aprovechando que las instalaciones estarían abiertas al público para realizar el recorrido completo puesto que a pesar de estar en esta fortaleza varias veces, siempre la encontré cerrada en algunos niveles como la terraza principal, garitas y calabozos.
![1000107407.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/AKLt3bMer761AEvW5R6ux5KxqHPPsWmTYQes2BonbA2gZ1toDFcBQE1HMxVuHjn.jpg)
![1000107361.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/EpC9ySkxDqWnczcxPnXMWrNJgj8x7D76cjdi1kvVEXB6tmC3p21ZL4PygHvZjJ8gWLf.jpg)
![1000107385.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23xerZArT7cGzb4zabo6QTrMJTN1s7NVjaYf4XVzDoBnCxW1AoZK7kaYXFAUzFt8FCK59.jpg)
El castillo es una muestra de arquitectura muy antigua que data del siglo XVII, actualmente se mantiene en pie pues los materiales que se usaron en su construcción son muy resistentes y de excelente calidad, además el mar se alejó considerablemente de la orilla, de allí que esta edificación permanezca aún como muestra importante de la época colonial y por supuesto represente un patrimonio cultural e histórico del país.
![1000107343.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23ycyZuMutzq8V9aVHw7ypFzbn1WcJ7qczP33LVuNcsNiKQu1FKz8v7dRa8GWSBQvjT6p.jpg)
![1000107382.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23xpFHzpLGkTAqGo7HRtehk2ZpYKrv84HRUb7HyQDf4bceC7Q3B1rnFKEZdRppPFQNqXp.jpg)
![1000107351.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23yJDx3TXsoedgs7ah6Bt7bF6eyC6j8LNtgNyAuKmMgY1YpqgpgNtax9CgK8Zb8woEs9d.jpg)
![1000107354.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/242XycgFpQpBs9Hd5PRiJd5BPo4APt57gZEqYpz3g2zpmgNDKrn7W5EX9TPHDk8u7bWat.jpg)
Los elementos que suelen llamar más la atención, sobre todo de los visitantes, son los enormes cañones distribuidos de forma estratégica, uno en la plaza dando la bienvenida y los demás en lo alto de la estructura, lo cual nos recuerda que el castillo fue diseñado como una fortaleza militar cuyo propósito primordial era proteger a la ciudad de Cumaná de piratas, invasores y otros enemigos que ataquen vía naval.
![1000107408.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/241ths6sTpmvbkkyjmCL8a9zAanu7UwpsBogzzuKy3S4CqaMFC1MZQs2SYTMHqANwYomi.jpg)
![1000107392.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23xL2YENCCBrb6XwUi9jGPwJbxmkanhPGFMzKoB8NvaDiq3yRs4U1QyzbivuuEekuJ7TY.jpg)
Lo que más disfruté de este recorrido fue la vista maravillosa que se tiene de la ciudad, todo luce muy diminuto y en perfecta armonía, tal como si tuviera un Dron para capturar imágenes áreas. Desde esta mirada también se puede apreciar el diseño de cuatro puntas, apuntando a cada eje cardinal, así se tiene un mayor dominio visual de todo. Estuve en el punto más alto, observando la inmensidad del cielo y la paz que se respira aquí, en un sitio aislado del bullicio citadino.
![1000107347.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23yd1ZdPh54GfYhEWSbU9K8CVAeeif9T9RFgRRCnnVwYmurDetsdcj9w4xFVBswprX9MS.jpg)
![1000107390.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/244UoiUxhZQtmznX5seusieDWQEJgbWPAh35nt4wbjnSWWFJ63PfoMZttdgwxS1XJaWyi.jpg)
![1000107340.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/244KP6paJJ1iANhcRutkjRSHhZQYBvMZXLEAUkqG7WZ3JQXkJaMDuzPwD3qFaRj3y4eUn.jpg)
![1000107379.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/EpGSgo2dk1APVQv17ijQEnHCPFPENpeEuHf84woQeAWhM3BmnQR4FKnyZF1n128wrrs.jpg)
Aproveché mi estancia para visitar el Polvorín, un pequeño almacen subterráneo que se utilizaba para la pólvora. Entrar en este espacio fue genial, había poca iluminación, la cual venía del exterior. Todo lucía lúgubre y el pensamiento me llevó a la época colonial, también cruzó por mi mente los comentarios de que en el castillo existían túneles subterráneos que comunicaban con varios sitios ubicados en el casco histórico.
![1000107367.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23y8sscVch423CEgQ6EziaqgrATZ36NCPH8be9bqooxe3VrqFxVthWo4pwJqytgncrQWn.jpg)
![1000107364.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23w2mRfGVELmgFydPrQeghaiDwoERGg2EEknX2uLY2zTuHXXb2ptyic4WFmJ6pb8tgUN3.jpg)
![1000107376.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23xpAnFwKf13VWBz3h1SRCov68qhK7VMDS4nyVS8g9aRRWWfGN6SzzBVcpU3FDEHopcNH.jpg)
![1000107373.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23x1FLFGpHCnuX1LxxtfcT8x9kaLqEES93Dvu3aPU9gY8Ru5ALY4aM91UZJL7kqGUmskn.jpg)
Caminar con mi familia por este lugar fue marcar un referente donde han convergido tres generaciones. Aproveché para tomar algunas fotografías, Alma estaba feliz corriendo por todas partes. Incluso imaginaba que era una pequeña militar y con su boca realizaba un sonido similar al de disparar un cañón: pum, pum, fue muy gracioso.
![1000107349.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23ywnxoyDCGAm1hoWF5ZExXzmtCaRbCB3qsdWUAaCmRkM3YCyVpFcMgDUt17GKAnz2aja.jpg)
![1000107356.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/244V2chFaMe8mDWWGARfmsAzc1in3AQnbFgnsQi3AGQ5oBcPSoD9nvobfTp1e2iAbViW4.jpg)
En una próxima publicación los llevaré por los calabozos, lugares misteriosos y enigmáticos que tuve la oportunidad de explorar. Me agrada conocer más de cerca la historia que se esconde detrás de estos imponentes muros de enormes piedras.   *** *** ✓Photos from my personal gallery, edited with Fotocollage. ✓Text translated with DeepL.

body.title: Say Hello to Reenie
body.body:
>
#needlework
When life gives you boredom, you create new crochet shirt designs for your brand and I for one do that a whole lot. 
Making crochet t-shirts kind of became a thing for me after the first design, I needed color but also mesh and I used my boredom to get to work. 

![IMG_8724.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/doreenarch/EoAZBXnTcsYeUYxTifJJJ7TjETivgDyDAZ8xg4GKgphXdVxfKw5aLyGshfRfugbzVXH.jpeg)

The first t-shirt design I had ever made was an 18hr work that had to be done 2 days to the fashion show so the model I had escorting me could have it on for the event,  when I was making it and even after the event I saw a few changes I could have made to the shirt to make it look better and sit more comfortably on his figure. 

![IMG_1464.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/doreenarch/23vsSpaMZ2gFTKgXb2XWitDBxBTPPjWKZNSHB2P69GAEqezYUu4kpVvmbdjFRhK6PWDTR.jpeg)

I eventually decided to play around with colors and I picked my new fav (lilac), my all time fav (black) and another color to balance out my palette so it doesn’t look off (butter yellow) and I got to picking my stitch. 

![IMG_1467.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/doreenarch/23yJJTE8Xg4Jw4mRB2yj2NHjL8DTJUe5xc4imZXVqsAA3W8u9FL82dpwhAj9Tej3Jpfe4.jpeg)

For some reason I have been drawn to V stitches and  while I was looking for stitches it dawned on me that this is the perfect time to explore that stitch in my design. I didn’t want the regular stripes so I did this variation with the three colors and it looked good on the first few rows so I continued. 

![IMG_5194.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/doreenarch/23yJE6BhmECxf8mmBvnHPzS6xw7toMnLbGUWKxMwPW5g9abs2nE9ASGzfZbX6iHutZ8dK.jpeg)

What was the idea behind designing this? Apart from boredom, I wanted a shirt I could hide in so to say, I’m a sucker for shirts 1 or 2 sizes bigger than mine and they always feel so comfy and nice so I got used to wearing them and it was high time I made one for myself. 

![IMG_5195.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/doreenarch/23xVGnJH5KPA4VZFsk7Kqdywxe9mXfi4GVfMpVeZMP3yp9KcJwDckMgjLdChCgwEUf54s.jpeg)

As usual scrap yarns always start out as my personal designs since they mostly start impromptu, I had to do a market run before I got back into it since I ran out of yarns. 

![IMG_9518.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/doreenarch/Eo8Rs8ca1PSdEMmhuP7yMexAmNQbtDTwMqhZViBwyfycYYBnGKhRg5r9jpaMnTFVRhw.jpeg)

Mapped out the proportions for each color and got to crocheting away, and obviously my daydreams were loud as ever. Oh how would it look, where would I wear it to, this blend is so fine etc. I usually do front the panel first since I think the front greatly determines how the back panel will look.

![IMG_8723.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/doreenarch/23uFRQ7sJNStcSMU5AeS9sHw62DxvXfswUFkEAyn4dhpLrmt2vhMajGe8DaNDv9jyLGbn.jpeg)

When I finished with the front panel I started with the back and I can say I finished up in record time (I wasn't counting 😅), dis only a few rows for the sleeve and it was already where I wanted it swapped to the other side, repeated and I was done for the sleeves. 

Took me only a little while to clean up, and my new found blocking obsession came in with steam oozing from my steamer like I just downed a titan😅, luckily for me I had a work meeting the following day and I Styled my pretty shirt for it and it felt so goooood, I don't own casual crochet wears so it feels good to have one I could just throw on. 

![IMG_8724.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/doreenarch/EoAZBXnTcsYeUYxTifJJJ7TjETivgDyDAZ8xg4GKgphXdVxfKw5aLyGshfRfugbzVXH.jpeg)

Got compliments on my shirt and ended up giggling the entire morning. 

Thank you for reading my blog ❤️

The supplies that I used in making this
5.0mm hook 
Stitch markers 
Acrylic yarn
Scissors 
Measurement Tape

Ps: these pictures belong to me and we’re taken with my mobile device.

</diva>

body.title: [EN/ES] D.Sketchbook: Lights and Shadows
body.body:
### D.Sketchbook: Lights and Shadows > ### D.Sketchbook: Luces y sombras ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaEbv6cqj38juusw4BXxE9LTEumujodPYsY9JsD2zxdhG/265_sin_t_tulo_20260408184251.jpg) Good morning, I'm sharing my blog about my digital practices. I focused these practices mainly on drawing light and shadow in my drawings. To be honest, it's not something I have much control over, although I have practiced it a lot. I keep doing some still lifes to try to master it, but I think it's something that improves by drawing and drawing. > Buenos días, les comparto mi blog de mis prácticas digitales. Estas prácticas las concentré sobre todo en el dibujo de luces y sombras en mis dibujos. La verdad no es algo que controle mucho, aunque sí lo he practicado mucho. Sigo haciendo algunos bodegones para tratar de dominarlo bien, pero creo que es algo que se va mejorando dibujando y dibujando. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVaZEK3kFrrhBmmgknxeeCWgfJ784YBPmuLN3PTrkdhWu/265_sin_t_tulo_20260408185513.jpg) I started the day with something simple: practicing lines and shapes to warm up my hand for the more complex exercises. I also practiced some straight and curved lines and a bit of cross hatching. This was the result of my warm-up. > Comencé el día por algo simple: practicar líneas y formas para calentar la mano para los ejercicios más complicados. Además practiqué algunas líneas rectas y curvas y un poco de cross hatching. Este fue el resultado de mi calentamiento. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS1ZgvXbxEnAa65mtw7BBChmVZzsixm2Q2L7mj3Jqkn5z/265_sin_t_tulo_20260408191305.jpg) I will use this girl I drew to do a shading exercise I found on Pinterest. I share the drawing in large size in case you want to use it to repeat this exercise. The goal is simple: repeat six shadings in gray with the main light source in six different zones. So I will start by repeating my model on the page, making six copies. > Utilizaré esta chica que dibujé para realizar un ejercicio de sombreado que encontré en Pinterest. Les comparto el dibujo en grande por si quieren usarlo para repetir este ejercicio. El objetivo es simple: repetir en gris seis sombreados con el foco de luz principal en seis zonas distintas. Así que empezaré repitiendo mi modelo en la página haciendo seis copias. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVATzMwYJcJh4n3LByvF7PcGNRPpyXGqNjusqWb4fwtwy/265_sin_t_tulo_20260408191457.jpg) I will draw each copy completely in gray and place the six light sources in the following order, starting with the first on the left: top left, above the head, from below, bottom left, behind the character, completely at the center right of the character. Then, simply using the same gray in multiply mode, I will place the shadows on the character. There will be two main types of shadows: cast shadows and shadows from the areas of greatest occlusion of the character. This is how my shading exercise and today's practice objective were completed. > Dibujaré cada copia totalmente de gris y ubicaré los seis focos de luz en el siguiente orden, comenzando por el primero a la izquierda: superior izquierda, encima de la cabeza, desde abajo, debajo a la izquierda, detrás del personaje, completamente en el centro derecha del personaje. Después, simplemente con el mismo gris en modo multiplicar, ubicaré las sombras en el personaje. Habrá dos sombras principales: las proyectadas y las de las zonas de mayor oclusión del personaje. Así quedó completo mi ejercicio de sombreado y el objetivo de la práctica de hoy. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeHhAPAGXSXqfARsTvinUxuw9X6BYgwPtvfyd9JHWczYc/265_sin_t_tulo_20260408201730.jpg) I wanted to try now doing it with color, which is much more difficult. The first thing will be to color the entire character, and then, on a layer with the opposite color (blue in multiply mode), apply the shadows following the pattern I drew in black and white. This is how the character looked in full color. > Quise intentar ahora hacerlo con color, que es mucho más difícil. Lo primero será colorear todo el personaje, y después, en una capa con el color contrario (azul en modo multiplicar), aplicar las sombras siguiendo el patrón que dibujé en blanco y negro. Así quedó el personaje con todo color. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXSfjFF99z1Prj853f2n6KHeVova2GPEXchGPsFgDc5oC/266_sin_t_tulo_20260408211414.png) For some reason, the colored character reminds me of Kairi from Kingdom Hearts hahahaha. > Por alguna razón, el personaje coloreado me recuerda a Kairi de Kingdom Hearts jajajaja. ![kingdom hearts kh GIF](https://media0.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTRmYTg2NzQzYTY5bHZyMXpvNjN2YmN1dG8zaXExNTN5OGMxYmpqOXh1aG1icHRucCZlcD12MV9naWZzX3NlYXJjaCZjdD1n/dtCakAIDLieSQ/200.gif) The first thing I tried was to draw it with a zenithal light right above its hair and projecting dramatic lights onto the hair and nose. > Lo primero que intenté es dibujarlo con una luz cenital justo encima de su cabello y proyectando luces dramáticas encima del pelo y la nariz. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPbEKfY9U1u4SyUX3w3tw6cUTCJ29HSYHp6M4qCX6Rrsn/266_sin_t_tulo_20260408210858.png) In the next one, I placed the light far behind the character; his entire face is in darkness, and there is only a little glow on the edges. > En el siguiente, coloqué la luz bien alejada a la espalda del personaje, todo su rostro está en la oscuridad y solo hay un poco de brillo en los bordes. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcbaVi8nkec61YoaZapvxReq52oK5o48S6F93wMR6kgmu/266_sin_t_tulo_20260408211346.png) Finally, I did the last of the light sources: a strong light completely on the right side of the character. Here you see the entire right side illuminated and shadows in the areas of greatest darkness or where the light is interrupted by some part of the character's body. > Por último, realicé el último de los focos de luz: una luz fuerte completamente al lateral derecho del personaje. Aquí se ve todo el lado derecho iluminado y sombras en las zonas de mayor oscuridad o en las zonas donde se interrumpe la luz por alguna parte del cuerpo del personaje. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaKc7pZAgW9nZ5nPBWYDYodR7xppk2siHKKho833DnEA6/266_sin_t_tulo_20260408211850.png) With this I finish my practice for today. I think it was a very good session focused only on one topic and I got a lot out of it. I still have to study a lot about lights and shadows, but especially how they interact with color. Thank you for joining me for another day of drawing. > Con esto termino mis prácticas de hoy. Creo que fue una muy buena sesión focalizada solo en un tema y que obtuve muy buen provecho. Me queda estudiar mucho de luces y sombras, pero sobre todo cómo interactúa con el color. Gracias por acompañarme un día más dibujando. --- ***About:*** ==*Sketchbook and Journal of a Learner*== **If you like my content, join my [Fanbase clicking here](https://hive.vote/dash.php?fan=nestodibuja&i=2)**
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc31AecQSitU5xAjsqS4snajcWh6CMMyapx88itjomSah/thanks.png)
___ *All photos and images are created by me. These are pictures of my sketchbook. Many of my drawings are practice pieces rather than finished works. Images from the internet may or may not have been used as references, copies, or sources of inspiration as part of my learning process.*

title.title: Roland TR-55 Wave File Sample Set
title.body: />\n\nThe Roland TR-55, also known as the Rhythm 55, is a pioneering analog drum machine released in 1972. It stands as one of the first products ever released by the Roland Corporation. Unlike later programmable models, the TR-55 is a \

rhythm box, meaning it features fixed patterns designed for accompaniment.\nThe unit generates its sounds using 100% analog transistor-based circuitry, producing a warm, characteristic 70s tone. It features 10 primary rhythms—including Rock ’n’ Roll, Waltz, and Bossa Nova—which can be modified using a variation knob offering 12 additional rhythmic shifts (split between 2-beat and 4-beat styles).\nA standout physical feature is the electro-static touch-sensitive pad on the top panel used for starting and stopping the sequences. For sound sculpting, it includes a Balance knob that lets you fade between the \

percussion (kick/snare), effectively acting as a simple mixer.
On the back, you’ll find high and low impedance outputs and a dedicated jack for a start/stop footswitch. Because it predates modern standards, it lacks MIDI or DIN sync, making it a sought-after piece for collectors and musicians looking for authentic, vintage textures.

title.title: On running strategies...
title.body:
So I've been enjoying my running again after getting back into it properly after my last minor injury....

The goal is to nudge my Park Run time to ideally under 20 mins, but at my age I am aware that is pushing it! 

I'm in no massive rush which helps! 

My current recent best is just over 23 mins, and if I can get this down to under 22 mins, so 21 mins something by EOS - in my mind that's end October then I'd be pretty happy with that - as a sort of holding pace rather than peak pace!

The question that's been on my mind is how much to workout...

I am a little bit restricted by work and family duties, but it's rare that I'd have to skip more than a couple of days....

I had been doing this...

Mon - 400 intervals
Weds or Thurs - 1K intervals
Sat - Park Run - which I normally can't help but treat as a tempo run! 

And ideally I'd do a gentle 5K on the Thursday...

I can just feel the above is too much....

Also sticking to the same weekdays is tricky and maybe a hindrance so I've accepted the fact that I need a general plan and then be prepared to flex as life and my body demand, I don't need to be doing 2 intervals and one tempo run a week - I think I want to aim for 2 every 5 to 7 days that'd be much better and also getting in a slow longer run would be good too every 8-10 days...

So...

Principle 1 = hard - easy - hard. 
Principle 2 = easy day after hard if it feels OK but then always at least 1 day off!
Principle 3 - if in doubt another easy or rest!
Principle 4 - swap any hard run for a Park Run!  

Cycle = 

Run 1 - 400 M/ 1K Intervals 
Run 2 - easy
Run 3 - five - six K tempo (A1 park run!)
Run 4 - easy 
Rum 5 - long or tempo (B2 Park)
Run 6 - easy 


So this should be as intense as it gets! 

M - Intervals 
T - Easy
Th - tempo
Fr - easy  
Sun - long or tempo 
Mon - easy

‎

title.body:
![timmossholder-fire-8032745 (1) (1) (1).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUZ1YiUmFrqSEWepsUuNxWpdqeTysAarzn793nM8PqzeQ/timmossholder-fire-8032745%20(1)%20(1)%20(1).jpg)

Hello friends, I was scrolling through new communities and your community came in front of my eyes. When I explored it, I liked the topic here very much and thought why not I also post on it.

Sometimes life kindles a fire which is not visible from outside but is burning the person deep inside. This fire neither smokes nor does it make any sound, it just tires the soul with silence. Every person feels this fire at some point in his life. 
Sometimes it is anger sometimes sadness people think that the problems are over but in reality there is a war going on inside which is not visible to anyone. The strange thing is that man often hides this fire. He smiles  behaves normally  laughs with others, there are some fires which do not break the man but make him. This is the same fire that forces a person to understand himself  recognize his weaknesses  and slowly create a new version of himself. The truth of life is that we cannot run away from this fire. But we can definitely decide whether it will burn us or make us stronger.

And perhaps the greatest courage of all is that even when the soul is burning, a person should not stop walking. Because sometimes the fire that seems to destroy us is the same one that is making us new.

title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYArvQuumsjGjftjsixMSJ1rsqUd9nUKmBCS3jxwreGkZ/1775838472685.jpg)

🍂 ━━━━━━━━━━ 🍃 ━━━━━━━━━━ 🍂

[ES]

Hay un silencio que todas las madres conocemos. Es ese silencio que dura más de tres minutos y que nos pone en alerta. Hace unos días, ese silencio me encontró en medio de mis apuntes y mi café, intentando descifrar el mundo entre exámenes y deberes. Cuando por fin salí al patio, no encontré un desastre, encontré una obra de arte en proceso.

​Ahí estaba él. Sin camisa, con la piel convertida en un lienzo de tierra y esa sonrisa que parece decirte: \
.\n\n​Mi primer instinto, el de la mujer que piensa en la lavadora y en el jabón, fue decir \
. Pero me detuve. Lo miré a través de mi lente y entendí que ese desorden era su libertad. A veces, nos obsesionamos tanto con criar hijos \

para la foto de afuera, que nos olvidamos de dejarlos ser humanos por dentro.

Ese día no hubo regaños. Hubo una foto para recordar que la maternidad no es una casa limpia, sino un corazón lleno de momentos despeinados. Porque al final, las manchas de la ropa salen con agua, pero las manchas de alegría en el alma se quedan para siempre.



🍂 ━━━━━━━━━━ 🍃 ━━━━━━━━━━ 🍂

[EN]

There is a silence that all mothers know. It's that silence that lasts more than three minutes and puts us on high alert. A few days ago, that silence found me in the middle of my notes and my coffee, trying to decipher the world between exams and chores. When I finally went out to the yard, I didn't find a mess; I found a work of art in progress.

There he was. Shirtless, his skin turned into a canvas of dirt, and that smile that seems to tell you: \
\n\nMy first instinct—that of a woman thinking about the washing machine and the soap—was to say \
But I stopped. I looked at him through my lens and understood that this mess was his freedom. Sometimes, we become so obsessed with raising \

children for the outside world that we forget to let them be human on the inside.

That day, there were no scoldings. There was a photo to remember that motherhood is not a clean house, but a heart full of messy moments. Because in the end, stains on clothes come out with water, but stains of joy on the soul stay forever.

¿Cuál fue ese momento en el que decidiste soltar el control y simplemente disfrutar del \

de tus hijos?

title.title: Sutil brazalete de perlas y balines/A delicate bracelet made of pearls and beads 🥰😍
title.body:
> Hello gente, feliz viernes!! Creo que esta fue la semana más larga de mi vida, mis hijos estaban en los exámenes finales del segundo lapso y la semana no fue para nada normal, pero finalmente terminó, y volvemos a la calma, y para relajarme un poco, hoy tuve mi terapia creativa y les comparto esta linda pulsera de perlas que hice el día de hoy, que la verdad me gustó muchísimo.
You weren’t going to get away from me today! I decided to pop in this morning to keep you company and share with you a really lovely creation I made a few days ago. You see, whilst I was making one of the bracelets I showed you recently, inspiration struck, so I seized the moment to make another one, and I’d been meaning to post it on the blog.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUE46hzatVRhr7S2oPp7f8YFHs4Wfsut12uvK8bFbUwHk/1775839857729.png) *** Este brazalete es bastante sencillo y delicado, ya que usé perlas pequeñas, balines mini y una cadena bien delgada, por lo que es un accesorio muy sutil y femenino, perfecto para combinar con prendas claras para reforzar un look cálido, y como me gustó tanto les comparto el paso a paso.
It’s a chain bracelet featuring a sort of *“plate”* made of pearls in different sizes and mini beads – a combination I really loved, and I think the special touch comes from this thin chain I’ve been wearing lately. As it’s actually quite simple to make, I wanted to share the step-by-step process with you, not just so you can make it at home, but also to inspire you to create your own designs, so… keep reading.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRbtmLj1zfJkYGMT47TA51qZxws7QaQDfjJwVXEXbi3Za/1775839465787.jpg) *** # Materiales Cadena delgada Balines mini Perlas pequeñas Alfileres de ojo Argollas pequeña Cerrador Tenaza Pinza plana Pinza redonda
# Materials Thin chain Mini beads 2 medium beads 1 small bead Eye pins Small jump ring Closure Pliers Flat-nose pliers Round-nose pliers

# Paso a paso/Step by step Para este brazalete vamos a crear dos piezas diferentes, una que podríamos decir que es la pieza focal de la pulsera que está formada por balines mini y perlas, y por otro lado, una con solo balines mini, y vamos a comenzar con la pieza central, y para ella vamos a necesitar un alfiler de ojo, cuatro perlas y tres balines. Lo que haremos es pasar por el alfiler de ojo, una perla seguida de un balín, y repetimos hasta usar todas las piezas terminando con una perla. Para finalizar la pieza, cortamos el excedente del alfiler de ojo, y creamos un *\

* en ese extremo,  y lo hacemos usando la pinza redonda, la cual ubicamos en la punta del alfiler y la giramos sobre sí misma hasta crea el arito. 

<blockquote>

What we’ll do is thread a bead followed by a seed bead onto the eye pin, and repeat until we’ve used all the pieces, finishing with a bead.

To finish the piece, we cut off the excess from the eye pin and create a *\

* at that end, using the round-nose pliers, which we place at the tip of the pin and twist round until the loop is formed. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTz78ekUN2xwRXHS6hRGoik35LhiB7WZgYrYDQraSo4ms/1775839258926.jpg) *** La segunda pieza, como les dije, es solo de balines mini, y vamos a necesitar dos de ellas, ya que las colocaremos a cada lado de la pieza central, y para ello vamos a necesitar dos alfileres de ojo y seis balines mini. Lo que haremos es pasar por el alfiler de ojo tres balines, cortamos el excedente, y procedemos a crear el arito en el otro extremo, de la misma forma en que lo hicimos con la pieza central, y como les dije, vamos a crear dos de ellas.
The second piece, as I said, is made entirely of mini beads, and we’ll need two of them, as we’ll be placing them on either side of the centre piece; for this, we’ll need two eye pins and six mini beads. What we’ll do is thread three beads onto the eye pin, cut off the excess, and then create the loop at the other end, in the same way as we did with the central piece, and as I said, we’re going to make two of them.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQJvCteuXi9iJavBWJkpHzKVjg1Nt6c8n1FUmD53aPeBS/1775839259043.jpg) *** El siguiente paso es unir las dos piezas de balines a la pieza central y para ello solo debemos abrir un poco uno de los aritos de la pieza de perlas y hacer pasar la pieza de balines, cerramos con la pinza plana y repetimos en el otro extremo. De ésta forma nos queda una sola la pieza, a la que conectaremos la cadena. >The next step is to attach the two beaded sections to the centre piece. To do this, simply open one of the loops on the beaded section slightly and thread the beaded section through; close it with the flat-nose pliers and repeat at the other end. This leaves us with a single piece, to which we will attach the chain. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY18UrAL4ZQXpaxk7tF37NFxZoM2xpNCeQpkBjoqngo5S/1775839259152.jpg) *** El siguiente paso es cortar dos piezas de nuestra cadena, una para cada lado, y el largo dependerá de cuán largo deseen su brazalete.
The next step is to cut two pieces from the chain, one for each side; the length will depend on how long you want your bracelet to be.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYedxmq68SMfh8STCbcYnuzUjWdwge3jp7bMWZbu6DTij/1775839259365.jpg) *** En este punto tenemos todas las piezas listas y solo nos queda conectarlas entre sí, y lo primero que haremos es abrir uno de los extremos de la pieza focal con la pinza redonda y pasar uno de los lados de la cadena, y finalmente volvemos a cerrar con la pinza plana. Repetimos en el otro extremo y ya solo nos queda conectar las piezas para cerrar, y para esto conectamos en cada extremo una argolla pequeña, y luego en una de ellas incorporamos el broche para cerrar, y de esta forma está listo nuestro brazalete.
At this point, we have all the pieces ready and all that remains is to join them together. First, we’ll open one end of the centre piece using the round-nose pliers, thread one side of the chain through, and then close it again with the flat-nose pliers. We repeat this at the other end, and all that remains is to connect the pieces to close the bracelet. To do this, we attach a small ring to each end, then attach the clasp to one of them to close it, and our bracelet is now ready.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSGDtkmym3ftTHGDr8WgyqQyKJmFAgkaNpZcmf5nu1fCr/1775839259585.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSgDX7DptLwC97b6sWnehkNqg6zNow32f6Hcjvd1KEHQQ/1775839465999.jpg) *** Como pueden darse cuenta es un proceso bien sencillo y bastante rápido, pero con un resultado absolutamente hermoso.
As you can see, it’s a very simple and fairly quick process, but the result is absolutely stunning.
