title.title: MLB: ¡Déjà Vu!  [ESP/ENG]  ||  OPINION
title.body: <div class= 'text-justify'>\n\n      Ayer fue día de traslado entre ciudades (tal como son los lunes y los jueves). Sin embargo, en la recortada jornada hubo seis juegos programados donde los venezolanos fueron protagonistas. Los Diamondbacks de Arizona no les ha ido del todo mal, como se habría pensado. Juegan para .538 y están apenas a dos juegos y medio de los DOdgers. Están de visita en Queens, donde los alicaídos Mets de Nueva York intentan conseguirse el ombligo. No es posible que los tipos estén jugando para el mismo balance de los ofidios, con la clase de leña que tienen en la alineación, pero sabe usted amado lector como es el béisbol. Anoche hubo una especie de \

, al propiciarse el enfrentamiento entre los dos abridores de la final del Clásico Mundial de Baseball y Eduardo Rodríguez volvió a confrontar a Nolan McLean en la lomita. Suficiente morbo gravitando el ambiente, como para preguntarse si aquel resultado (3-2 a favor del venezolano) fue pura casualidad o -por el contrario- una demostración de calidad. Noten que el novato McLean es uno de los lanzadores más intransitables del momento. Y lo demostró durante los primeros seis episodios, donde un número cero adornó la parte alta del marcador. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

     Yesterday was a travel day (typical Monday and Thursday slate). However, even on a short slate, we had six games where Venezuelans took center stage. The Arizona Diamondbacks haven't been too shabby, despite what people thought. They’re playing .500-plus ball at .538 and sit just 2.5 games back of the Dodgers. They’re currently on the road in Queens, where the slumping Mets are still trying to find their identity. It’s hard to believe they have the same record as the Snakes, especially with all that pop in their lineup, but that’s baseball for you. Last night felt like déjà vu with a rematch of the World Baseball Classic final starters. Eduardo Rodríguez went toe-to-toe with Nolan McLean on the bump once again. There was enough hype in the air to make you wonder if that previous result (a 3-2 win for the Venezuelan) was a fluke or just pure shoving. Keep in mind, the rookie McLean has been lights out lately. He proved it through the first six frames, hanging nothing but goose eggs on the scoreboard.

---
![Moreno.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/23zki7GMPe6H8Ww8XvY8EbCqQaf4Evqj2fMzh9xnnhXa163dyqkG8Tr7B3MJ1AB44inQu.jpg) Screenshot from [Source](https://www.mlb.com/es/gameday/d-backs-vs-mets/2026/04/09/823645/final/video) --- # ![Firma Fermionico_Mesa de trabajo 1616.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/QnCF6Qc3-Firma20Fermionico_Mesa20de20trabajo2016-16.png)
#
     Por el lado del venezolano, la única libertad ofrecida en forma de una carrera aceptada, fue el dibujo de la parte baja en la primera entrada. El hombre espació 5 imparables en seis episodios completos, regaló 2 boletos y ponchó a 3. Esa única carrera aceptada fue un jonrón solitario. Los Diamondbacks rompieron el celofán del partido con un doble cortesía del receptor venezolano Gabriel Moreno, quien al final de su jornada, batearía dos dobles impulsores de carreras. Otro criollo, el novato José Fernández (de quien ya hemos hablado en nuestras crónicas), contribuyó al impulsar una rayita con un sencillo, en el rally de 4 que sacó a Nolan McLean del partido. El primera base venezolano Ildemaro Vargas, también fue parte de la fiesta en el séptimo, trayendo otra carrera a la goma con un imparable. 7 carreras a 1 supuso una victoria para los ofidios con sello netamente venezolano y que ratifica ante cualquier duda, el triunfo en la final del Clásico Mundial de Baseball del equipo criollo no fue ninguna casualidad. Honor a quien honor merece. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

      On the Venezuelan's side, the only damage he allowed was a lone run in the home half of the first. He scattered five hits over six full frames, yielding two free passes while fanning three. That single run came via the solo shot. The D-backs broke the ice thanks to a double from Venezuelan backstop Gabriel Moreno, who ended his day with a pair of RBI two-baggers. Another Venezuelan, rookie José Fernández (a regular in our columns), joined the hit parade with an RBI single during that four-run rally that finally chased Nolan McLean from the game. First baseman Ildemaro Vargas also got in on the action in the seventh, driving in another run with a base knock. A 7-1 victory for the Snakes with a clear Venezuelan stamp, proving once and for all that the WBC final win was no fluke. Give credit where credit is due.

# ---

![Rodríguez.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/23wWk6sQXyjmSJEaLsiPUNT5eK7zry93sE2ttTwi4WucRPjw6TrhASJYR4ittstHkci3M.jpg) Screenshot from [Source](https://www.mlb.com/es/gameday/d-backs-vs-mets/2026/04/09/823645/final/video) --- # ![Firma Fermionico_Mesa de trabajo 1616.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/QnCF6Qc3-Firma20Fermionico_Mesa20de20trabajo2016-16.png)
     Si me hubieran preguntado al inicio de la zafra por la posición de los Marlins de Miami, a estas alturas en su división, probablemente mis respuesta habría sido en el cuarto lugar. Pero he aquí lo inesperado de pronosticar campañas para cualquier equipo. A los muchachos de la capital latina de Estados Unidos, les ha quedado algo de la vibra que acompañó a los venezolanos, en la final jugada allí en el Loan Depot Park ¿La razón? Los tipos encabezan la división este de la liga Nacional, contra todo pronóstico. Y puede cualquier analista agarrarse de la suerte, para explicar la campaña de los peces, con el fin de responder inquisiciones de sus lectores. Pero la verdad sea dicha: la juventud de los Marlins ha madurado más pronto de lo esperado y están allí por ello. Claro, no es que andan escapados en la tabla de posiciones, ni nada de eso. Tampoco ando asegurando que no van a ceder posiciones, una vez avanzada la campaña. Pero están jugando pelota de calidad y eso es señal de mejores tiempos. Simple. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

     If you had asked me at the get-go where the Miami Marlins would be in their division by now, I probably would’ve pegged them for fourth place. But that’s the thing about prognosticating a 162-game campaign. The boys from the Latin capital of the States seem to have caught some of that Venezuelan vibe from the WBC final at LoanDepot Park. Why? Because against all odds, they’re sitting atop the NL East. Any pundit could chalk up the Fish's run to 'puck luck' or a fluke to satisfy their readers, but let’s call it like it is: the Marlins' youth movement has come of age much sooner than expected. Now, don't get me wrong—they aren’t running away with it, and I’m not saying they won’t fade as the season grinds on. But they’re playing solid ball, and that’s a clear sign of better days ahead.

---

![Sanoja.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/23w2ekgqf6ZsQqqDa9utGX479JuJb7GhqpA8KsUYd69cMEjGtkwzaBZhnVdvkyLLttRA4.jpg) Screenshot from [Source](https://www.mlb.com/es/gameday/reds-vs-marlins/2026/04/09/823884/final/video) --- # ![Firma Fermionico_Mesa de trabajo 1616.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/QnCF6Qc3-Firma20Fermionico_Mesa20de20trabajo2016-16.png)
     Hay muchas explicaciones, pero nos referiremos a una de ellas: el utility venezolano Jesús Sanoja, alguien que no han podidos sentar, aunque quisieran. Cuando un bate anda caliente, un manager no se puede dar el lujo de prescindir de él. Y Sanoja se las ha arreglado para jugar con frecuencia, debido a su vibrante ofensiva. Batea para .406 de AVE y ayer fue uno de los héroes de los peces, al remolcar dos carreras, con tres hits en cuatro turnos. El único turno fallado fue un ponche recibido en un turno que vendió caro, lo que supone la dificultad para sacarlo de out. Quien sabe si el caso de Sanoja (paralelo a todas luces con el del venezolano José Altuve, por su estatura), termine siendo titular a fuerza de batazos. Sería una historia de superación de alguien que tiene una altura superior apenas de una pulgada, respecto al segunda base de los Astros. Un segundo \
a quien no pueden sacar de la alineación, porque no hay forma de justificarlo. Y cuando un equipo tiene un \

de ese tenor, puede convertirse en un team ganador. Esperemos. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

     There are plenty of explanations, but let's talk about one in particular: Venezuelan utility man Jesús Sanoja. He’s the kind of guy they couldn’t bench even if they wanted to. When a bat is this hot, a manager simply can't afford to leave it out of the lineup. Sanoja has forced his way into everyday playing time thanks to his electrifying offense. He’s raking to the tune of a .406 average, and yesterday he came up big for the Fish, knocking in two runs with a three-hit performance. His only mismatch was a strikeout, but even then, he worked the count, making it clear just how tough an out he is. Who knows? Sanoja’s situation—which is a dead ringer for José Altuve’s due to his size—might end up with him winning a starting job purely by swinging a heavy lumber. It would be an incredible underdog story for a guy who stands just an inch taller than the Astros' second baseman. He’s a second 'Little Giant' you just can't write off the starting nine because there’s no way to justify it. And when a club has that kind of 'good problem' to have, they’ve got the making of a winning ballclub. Simple as that.

title.title: Greenhouse cooling
title.body:
There are several ways to lower the temperature in the greenhouse itself
One of the simplest methods is to open the door at both ends and the wind that blows lowers the temperature in the greenhouse itself
Another way is to install a shade net, which also reduces the temperature in the greenhouse
The third way, which should be the first, is to choose a greenhouse
We were looking for a smaller greenhouse, and found a DIY metal structure and a ready-made nylon with doors and windows in the package.
![20260410_120936.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/AK6X4EDfioc8dY9ZANntH5SvMeAmWiw856VUD7dM5Nfh1M88AKFGK79h5fzEmxw.jpg)


As for the heating at night, since ours can be close to zero at night. We solved that with a small heater with a maximum power of 2 kW. So that it maintains the temperature at about ten degrees in the greenhouse itself and at about 15 degrees in the incubator. As for the electricity consumption, I'll see on the bill for this month. It has never worked at maximum and has a timer that regulates the switching on and off itself and we hope that it won't be too bad in terms of electricity consumption.
![20260410_120913.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/AKLskNHwi2ZjA54D4hpCjjqohET7ygy9qUhvFG663pXZaDDf3Q1AYkqUzAf58g2.jpg)


But what we saw as a dangerous problem is the cooling of the greenhouse when it is 20 degrees Celsius or more outside.
It is small so it heats up quickly.
The shade net manages to reduce the temperature by a few degrees but not enough.
As for drafts, the greenhouse construction itself does not allow the best air circulation. The door is on one side and on both sides there are small windows, but on the supporting side of the door there is no other door but a nylon net.
so even when all the windows are raised and the door is open, there is still circulation inside. As for the heater, it also has the option to only operate the fan but it is weak for this job.
We thought about cutting the nylon net to open another door but we are worried about how to secure it from the wind, since the wind here can cause a lot of problems.

![20260410_120956.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/AJoHyTWcrqDKuZTQwPfFC7hyGzcCp8WG9ckn88ms88FRqfUkdgrYUmnRDsL5xey.jpg)![20260410_121007.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/AKKRvZFBbnfop34jtTpZ8HaaaR7orjHii2Qb1uohSRiMc76dCjKrgDMKstUhDvp.jpg)



That's why I approached solving the problem with a do-it-yourself option.
I owned an industrial fan, I was repairing some industrial fans for my neighbors and instead of charging, I took one and an additional fan protection.
I planned to repair the fan for the workshop and put it all in a shell, but it didn't work out, it was sitting in the attic for two seasons and I worked in the workshop in the morning or evening when the temperatures were lower.
![20260410_120948.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/AKAonoGT7LL8xTyVNY8foGpFk9tzJ3hmzBHLKfijnuJZFB6oD5kifx8iYZQuDaz.jpg)



I just adjusted the second protection a little so that it lays on the fan and does not interfere with the motor turning and yet provides protection so that someone's fingers are not hit. And I attached it all with screws, maybe the screws are oversized but I had them available. and they matched the holes where the fan was normally attached to.
![20260410_121326.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/AJpjsB8aMd7LJayDAeiCv1UasqQzcMtXBLsuVazCGTmbjSjcd4AtkjTiNpwRP9D.jpg)
Regarding connecting the cables to the fan motor. It's not a problem, I'm an electrician. And there's a wiring diagram on the box.
If you have some basic knowledge, it shouldn't be a problem to connect. Connect the ground wire to the ground,which is usually yellow-green in color,PE mark.The blue wire is the zero, mark N.As for the Phase (usually black or brown), you connect that wire to the capacitor wire. All the wires come out of the capacitor and they connect to the motor windings, which are black and brown. You connect your power wire to one of these two connections. And the direction on your fan depends on that. Usually you have a picture of an arrow that defines the direction of the fan. And you can also use the arrangement of the fan blades to determine which way it should turn.





![20260410_121122.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/AKJ1HpN9uDCZXtkTScZRawfyycj4EXUidrj19rDbXKKooKk9ZGfoDQas8dgdpQN.jpg)![20260410_121132.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/AKCG2rc1MQbeJJZygELYj1DsAjUQmob2J7HGTi9jEU5sHZEnrpRVjh6gQZrsjZU.jpg)![20260410_121136.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/AJmsKQqowVqxeD2RvmXwZXurCSjUwQM74EzYRAE3kYwybXzALwiVyiUppnmptCP.jpg)




Since the fan can reach up to 1500 revolutions per minute, it turned out to be incredibly powerful. I had to take it out of the greenhouse and put it on a stand so that it wouldn't hit the plants too much and just move the air.I mounted it on a stump and secured it with a couple of slats, screws, and ties.Simple construction but tested and stable in place. It has proven to be very useful and reduces the temperature very quickly. So we will use it only when necessary. Although I have a few more ideas on how to mount it but for now it will remain like this. We will see if there is a need to change anything.


![20260410_121246.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/AJmrkdUjzCxQXKfhA9RdBvHjENtzTk4S6G2MGbnJBSGsXoL3aawPLsr2EXmdyMW.jpg)

![20260410_121326.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/AJpjsB8aMd7LJayDAeiCv1UasqQzcMtXBLsuVazCGTmbjSjcd4AtkjTiNpwRP9D.jpg)

title.body:
Are you an analyst? I immediately thought, an analyst of what? Well, your question surprised me. At first glance, I associated it with numbers, business, systems—clearly, I'm useless at all of that. But from another perspective, yes, I am an analyst—a celebrity analyst, with famous figures from the art world, gossip, trends, and news. This isn't something that just started with the internet and social media boom; I've always been an analyst, even when I got information from newspapers or magazines. And without being a communications professional, just a simple fan, I knew the lives of my favorite stars, I knew their mannerisms and tricks. Nobody could beat me in a discussion of that kind. I had all the necessary arguments to comment, analyze, and even criticize with a solid foundation. >Eres analista? Yo inmediatamente, analista de que? Bueno chico me sorprendió tu pregunta, a simple vista lo relacione con números, negocios, sistema claro en soy nula en eso. I posted on my main account that I needed a break for a few days. All the pre surgery tests and appointments caused a flare up  and I am still recovering. 

They also rescheduled the surgery because my blood work showed things were too risky and I was in an active flare. Not a good time to have a tumor removed.

New surgery date April 20th.

I am so sorry the bot is moving slower than I'd like (understatement). The change in surgery schedule and me being in a crash kind of put a  delay on everything.   I've also been feeling really unwell.

We are still here and working on stuff. There was also a slight issue with the server both tip bots live on that has now been fixed.


The tech side is one person, my husband and lately he's spending a lot of time making  sure I'm ok, getting me to appointments and stuff.

Things are more stable now and I expect a lot of work to be done this weekend.

There is also a slight possibility my surgery may be delayed again, but I am trying not to think  about that.  This is something beyond my control .The surgeon mentioned this could be a thing because right now the airports in the US are an absolute mess and it's very possible she can't get back in time. 

We will deal with that when/if it comes. At least I don't have to do any more medical appointments.

I just want this surgery to be over with.  the procedure itself is not that risky but with my immune system and circulation issues everything is a higher risk. 




Anyway...progress is still happening even if you can't see it.  

I will update you as the bot comes closer to being ready. So sorry it's taking this long but life happens.

Thank you to everyone for all of your support.❤️🦄🧚

title.title: The Drum Palace: Rockin' Ruins
title.body: >AC/DC’s Phil Rudd and Nine Inch Nails’
>Alex Carapetis have in common? Their legendary rhythm is rooted in a crumbling \
/>\n\nOnce a majestic bathhouse, then the birthplace of the world-renowned Sonor drums, this architectural gem survived fires, political escapes, and Cold War nationalization. Today, the \
stands as a hauntingly beautiful ruin, waiting for a second chance.\n\n

/> Discover the incredible journey of a factory that defined the beat of generations - and the bold plan to bring it back to life.

A magnificent bathhouse

/> First it was a magnificent bathhouse, then entrepreneur Otto Link transformed the gleaming building on the Saale River in Weißenfels into the Sonor drum factory. Stars still beat out the rhythms on its products today. But the original building awaits its revival.

/> Right next to the spacious hall on the first floor, a large section of floor is missing. The room still hints at its former splendor, but today rusty steel beams hang in the air, temporarily secured with a few meters of barrier tape. Light filters through the semicircular windows onto the remnants of the wooden wall paneling. It's scratched, but hints at how impressive this building on the banks of the Saale must once have been.
/>\n\nWhat fans of forgotten historical buildings call the \

resembles a castle: a long, two-story building with rambling extensions right next to the Herrenmühle lock. Built nearly 100 years ago as a bathing establishment, the project was not destined for success as a spa town. The \
>brewer Otto Gürth, also failed to achieve its goals.\n\n

/>

From Cathedral to Rock 'n' Roll Factory

The building's heyday began when entrepreneur Otto Link moved the Sonor drum factory, founded by his father Johannes, from the other side of the river. Sonor had been manufacturing drums, timpani, flutes, and cymbals in Weißenfels since 1875.
/> After the old factory burned down shortly after the founder's death, Link purchased the site of the failed bathing establishment and made it the company's new headquarters.
/>\n\nA hundred years later, the building at *Am Bad 1* is anything but a mundane industrial complex. Despite its obvious structural damage, the \

with its stucco and inlays, resembles a magnificent princely palace. The view into the grand hall is breathtaking: Like a cathedral, the hall with its columned side aisles lies bathed in sunshine. The building seems to have survived the decades almost unscathed since the last drum left the factory.\n\n

/>

Escape, Expropriation, and World Fame

The Link family lost their company in 1950. The police occupied the premises without warning to enforce the expropriation. Otto Link only escaped arrest because his maid warned him in time. He fled to the West and took the
brand name with him to Westphalia. \n\n

/> There, the family established a new production facility that achieved worldwide renown: Drummers like Phil Rudd (AC/DC) and Alex Carapetis (Nine Inch Nails) still play instruments whose origins lie on the Saale River.
/>\n\nMeanwhile, in Weißenfels, the factory was transformed into the state-owned
>VEB Trommelwaren (Trowa). Under the name Tacton, they supplied East German rock giants like the Puhdys and City. But with the end of the GDR came the end for the \
Production ceased in 1990, 100 employees lost their jobs, and a bankruptcy trustee auctioned off the facilities.\n\n

/>

Waiting for Renovation

What remains is an empty shell with a powerful atmosphere. Some of the fixtures are gone, ceilings have collapsed due to water damage. It's half a ruin, half a construction site.

/>\n\nAn investor from Canada bought the complex six years ago. His plan: a cultural center with bowling alleys, restaurants, a ballroom, a cinema, and saunas. According to the construction manager, they are currently working on securing the roof and facade. However, complete renovation remains the stated goal to finally awaken the \
/>\n\nOtto Link registered \
as a trademark as early as 1907. While the company continues in the West, the Trowa tradition is now being carried on by a resident of Halle.\n\n

title.title: How many times do we need to study the words of God daily
title.body:
The holy bible did not pinpoint the number of times we need to read the words of God in a day but the bible teaches us to always embrace the words of in our daily lifes. Believers are called to make God’s word a daily part of their lives, not something occasional or forced. This shows that studying God’s word should be continual, shaping our thoughts, decisions, and actions throughout the day.
https://youtu.be/lb9pM-VkUKE?si=Hd2mQ8rJHVEAn9Ib
Rather than focusing on how many times, the Bible emphasizes the attitude and consistency of our study. Spending time in the word in the morning, reflecting on it during the day, and returning to it in the evening can help a believer grow spiritually. 

>Psalm 1:2 says, “But his delight is in the law of the Lord, and in His law he meditates day and night.”
 
This teaches that a heart that truly seeks God will naturally desire His word often, making it a regular and meaningful habit every day.

## Friday is already warmer, more spring-like ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaoH8PN5QyVvBhHgurf7bUeqE7o6EQjY8ghSY1F7CN2C2/a06.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZsmNvQ6sXmSy6ht5j3LhJjypn8nQ8JvMT5TU1eMLrsJ5/a01.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX7NrsmBpvWJpGFpF78bYu3Ai2aG2KkLpYEm2HDHsG3JM/a02.jpg) |-|-| Although the day was relatively sunny and getting warmer, the night brought a slight frost. This was visible on the grass. The horse chestnut leaves also took a slight beating from the cold, but they're coping just fine. >Pomimo, iż dzień był w miarę pogodny i coraz cieplejszy, to noc jednak przyniosła lekkie przymrozki. Widać to było na trawie. Liście kasztanowca też lekko oberwały chłodem, ale one sobie z tym doskonale poradzą. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZwDT1AEQF7pLFq4kbQQ2uab4DygXmVE4U66B3M8QxDng/a03.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPpHpHSVnpeAnUcgu1q7V8RTVaTTN92qTsm4aDE7WLy6t/a04.jpg) It's supposed to get warmer by the day, and spring proper is now certain. Morning frosts will still be a possibility, but as the sun begins to shine, it will warm up very quickly. >Z dnia na dzień ma być coraz cieplej i wiosna właściwa jest już pewna. Poranne przymrozki, będą miały jeszcze miejsce, ale w miarę pojawiania się mocnego już słońca bardzo szybko będzie się ocieplać. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP6budYqNbNevG5UE3kTmDiXSaxiTE6v6xy6ySHxRzK6T/a05.jpg) Unfortunately, it's very dry. Ptaki nakarmione, przyleciały wszystkie odmiany sikorek oraz wróble. Zabrakło ponownie wron i kawek. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYpGD3zPmtReZr1goxNdcVogeHJ6oJM6hPG1zRvDuMkxx/a08.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmec8xhpNP5smxKeSXXGa48xBd366Aw74gL3rN5HvfJtgu/ornament_funny.png)

title.title: Become the Night King to take night photos with your normal smart phone
title.body: Welcome to my post Today we will discuss how we can take bright night photos with our normal smart phone. Yes, friends, you heard right, we can easily take bright night photos with our normal smartphone. To take these photos, we have to use GCam. Although Google Camera is not supported on all phones except Google's phones, we will use GCam as an alternative to Google Camera. It is a modified version of Google Camera. There are different versions of GCam according to different phone models. You will download and install them from online. And at the same time, you will definitely download the Xml Config of that specific camera. You can see how to use this camera on your YouTube or various websites. I am presenting some night photos taken with a very cheap phone, Vivo Y20, as a sample. If this is the night picture taken with this normal phone Vivo Y20, then think about how it is possible to take night pictures using Gcam with the high-quality smart phone you have.

/>

Some of these pictures are astrophotography and some pictures are taken directly with Gcam's TR Cam Magic Night by Riyan xml config. The pictures were taken in August 2022. Phone Vivo Y20l

title.title: The Trip to Koboh.
title.body: > Cal found an old photo and video while his ship underwent diagnostics, bringing back nostalgic memories. The ship's gyro failed, forcing a crash landing on the planet Koboh. After a rough arrival near some local aliens, Cal found the ship was completely fried and required heavy repairs to fly again. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmU1V9SUNFzvh3jo1eh4Td4x7usF9GfWPG3p2buXyXt5p7/screenshot_1_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd4ecM6e8LKk8WhFZnPUkabjoDMrr8j25ft5bKRZUVHey/screenshot_2_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeBWNjUyqeaPkk5UL4rdHMVuA26skcSfv52GdBNTNeDbn/screenshot_3_.png) After getting into a safe place, Cal left the cockpit to check on the rest of the ship. While he was asking the bot to run a diagnostic on the spaceship, he found an old photograph hidden away. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQTKvc9nbGd3ooPoqjyYMLSbbwLG1cUgYSxVR6fw8m2tV/screenshot_4_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZyQYiP32f5hezpiFx5TkNXiWx1ZcavrEtcVgHWsJwhjV/screenshot_5_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSNfPSCjgjuioXRBSGM1WmiPzmZ7cnRegyquWKVRqRDmd/screenshot_6_.png) While BD-1 was diagnosing the ship's systems, the bot played a recorded video on a small screen. The video showed a good old time from Cal's past that made him feel very nostalgic. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbxxQCfNaYD8ceFKaisCyo9TUAYJC6LnZtu1Y1cv4VvMN/screenshot_7_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ9c6x8DwQLhCn8VWrCP5SYPTp2jRn6eXZFeonkAGQL5N/screenshot_8_.png) The peaceful moment ended when they noticed the gyro of the spaceship was starting to fail. They had to look for a place to settle down quickly before they lost control. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZXhnizaoAPnBzEoGr8yy8yXYoxeygjm48WUXDvCzx1Tg/screenshot_9_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYSF1sZQtsjTbNAGTMTsoTcgwpNQQTWFF4qQPm6UDqSTw/screenshot_10_.png) After getting back to the cockpit, Cal had to set a new course for the planet named Koboh. He worked the controls to guide the ship through space, hoping they could reach the destination before the mechanical problems got worse. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV7z399fzANudt3F9VK6QXMgiMuSf72PHri6dymr9m7Nw/screenshot_11_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmajjXnbhmmFVLd6KETQXavAupszjA7cgVQPqA7WWA3DYp/screenshot_12_.png) As they entered the atmosphere, they noticed a strange light glowing on the air surface. Cal decided to land anyway because they did not have any other alternative and the ship was running out of time. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUZfdVPph2bE8AGHGnrfkU6C3JtSv12YV7C3EN8oqDLio/screenshot_13_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZiSaHoYTRWCENnwQBXmjmLU6Z5w4SDwk28tYpcHdgSYn/screenshot_14_.png) When they reached the surface of the planet, the systems of the spaceship started failing all over. The ship was losing power fast as they dropped toward the ground below. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNMnDo8DuGAZbwGSgvCSfbfZ3NiHmwQQ5C5VXQqVcqWy4/screenshot_15_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSADzApFJ6KdzSbjMzDUYxyKmyy7LV3B63SHbcWqrK875/screenshot_16_.png) Cal started the sublight engines one last time to try and control the descent. He went for a crash landing in a clear area. Nearby, some aliens on the planet were seen playing with a helmet from a stormtrooper. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXSwjjtz2Zw1ZrmYwFmPaSetYvFkrX9w5y7A9NYChYvRh/screenshot_17_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaqCWqUjHTJeE53KPZNwLh7zvVLXknR2EMfFcfmQp6LgR/screenshot_18_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY5YissLFDfH7NGEfiiqVkTxEzqJjnaDLzsVUSHRmLJLP/screenshot_19_.png) Cal understood that they were not going to make it to the hangar as he had hoped. He had to put the spaceship down right there in the wild terrain. He made a very rough crash landing at last, hitting the dirt with a massive force that shook the entire vessel. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQme7C9TyS5it9w1U3H9So9coaBRqsAZowC7hvDs8hyN2YC/screenshot_20_.png) BD-1 diagnosed the ship again and Cal noticed that the electronics were completely fried. They would not be flying again without major repairs to the engine and the hull. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeadALcJugvcNTpuJB8T1gm4sfHg4k7g4xDHvY3Arm9ns/screenshot_21_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeRkK4nSGcN6MwVzrKeAsAsCs1HchyagtcDWx7zCpU3K8/screenshot_22_.png) Cal opened the main door and stepped out of the ship. The area gave me an Earth-like feeling after all this playtime, even though its not the Earth I was hoping to see. That's all for this session. More moments coming soon and thanks for checking it out. --- ▶️ [3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=ridwanan/7d58920c)

He had to put the spaceship down right there in the wild terrain. He made a very rough crash landing at last, hitting the dirt with a massive force that shook the entire vessel. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQme7C9TyS5it9w1U3H9So9coaBRqsAZowC7hvDs8hyN2YC/screenshot_20_.png) BD-1 diagnosed the ship again and Cal noticed that the electronics were completely fried. They would not be flying again without major repairs to the engine and the hull. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeadALcJugvcNTpuJB8T1gm4sfHg4k7g4xDHvY3Arm9ns/screenshot_21_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeRkK4nSGcN6MwVzrKeAsAsCs1HchyagtcDWx7zCpU3K8/screenshot_22_.png) Cal opened the main door and stepped out of the ship. The area gave me an Earth-like feeling after all this playtime, even though its not the Earth I was hoping to see. That's all for this session. More moments coming soon and thanks for checking it out.

title.title: MONTALBÁN AS IT IS - (PHOTOGRAPHY STORIES)
title.body:
![Tcats.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/AJmvHdnbQAyWvNKTopeTv1YFgkgLf53QyXYbLyFvWbbPbVsNztfXEF11e7Qg65N.jpg)

-----

**T**he streets of this town are like those books you feel you could read again and again, always finding something new with each reading. Yes, this is a town like that, the kind you \

and flip through whenever you want. That's how the streets of Montalbán are to me, from my perspective. A wellspring of experiences unfolding in sequence, whose protagonists are unaware of the exquisite creativity contained in each little story. I, however, have made it my mission to set aside at least a couple of hours each day to immerse myself in this world that now feels like my own, but which I've learned to understand and observe as a witness, I imagine so I can record it as I do.\n\n**A**nd these photos I've brought to share today are what I've described here: the experiences of this small town happening, with people, without people, in motion or still, but happening without stopping. These are the streets seen in color today, the streets I like to call \

seen in their naked everydayness, while I carefully try to unravel the simplicity that completes them and understand what lies behind it, and somehow, with a small title, leave it there for myself and others... This is what it's like here, taking street photos...\n\n>**L**as calles de este pueblo son como esos libros los cuales uno tiene la sensación de poderlos leer una y otra vez y siempre encontrar algo nuevo con cada lectura. Sí, este es un pueblo así, como para \

y echarle una hojeada cada vez que lo deseamos. Así son, desde mi punto de vista, las calles de Montalbán para mi. Un abrevadero de vivencias ocurriendo en secuencia, cuyos protagonistas no están consientes del creacionismo exquisito contenido en cada pequeña historia ocurriendo. Yo, sin embargo, me he dado a la tarea de, por lo menos reservar a diario un par de horas de mi vida, para sumergirme en este mundo que siento mío a estas alturas, pero que aprendí a entender y observar como testigo, imagino que para poder registrarlo como lo hago. \n\n>**Y** estas fotos que traje para compartir hoy, son eso que he descrito aquí; las vivencias de este pequeño pueblo ocurriendo, con gente, sin gente, con movimiento o estáticas, pero ocurriendo sin detenerse. Son las calles hoy vistas a colores, son las calles, las que me gusta llamar \

vistas en su cotidianidad desnuda, mientras yo intento revocar cuidadosamente la simpleza que las completa y entender lo que hay detrás, y de alguna manera, con un pequeño título, dejarlo allí para mi y para otros... Así es aquí, hacer fotos callejeras...  


----

![T01.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/242YLjY6bNj1L5yNZ8x2kMyWioK9cspAKjDniqaNBLiDhXiqgY7qpamjQgnS8HugpgVyq.jpg)
**📷 01 - Lina's street dog, coming and looking kindly at whoever approaches... / <sub> El perro de la calle de Lina, viniendo y mirando amable a quien se acerca... </sub>** 

----

![T02.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/243BtxQ3oSxvwerfTHzwhMDvKrYBrUGPJd7tK4bwh9PerxmjWFjGpVoQ9LcEAfi6hSD53.jpg)
**📷 02 - The subtle brevity of a street with two roosters and a child who looks as if he wants to have his picture taken... / <sub> La sutil brevedad de una calle con dos gallos y un niño que mira como queriendo le hagan una foto... </sub>**

----

![T03.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/244y8Jb4GhiA64WDZRcubyiNbvGqijeWa6NUaDXoYAwB4SuPKvv3Em3jphxC8prQxaEjf.jpg)
**📷 03 - Little blue house, which could be said to be the last corner to the northwest of the town... / <sub> Casita azul en la que podría decirse es la ultima esquina al noroeste del pueblo... </sub>** 

----

![T04.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/245TJb59fdkjLoGjxp3Apc6T5JxEa2v6ZxUuoRLNiv6W4cNL3X3SKnTTQQzRThuQdPXNh.jpg)
**📷 04 - That dog whose owners had the bad idea of ​​calling him \
not because he is dirty, but because he bites everyone without barking first (or so they claim)... / <sub> Ese perro a el que sus dueños tuvieron la mala idea de llamarle \

no porque esté sucio, sino porque muerde a todos sin ladrar antes (así aseguran)...</sub>** 

----

![T05.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/243qPszmZHFGgMNMEKgJpJh6DY8GWCLzYzE66rp3CsBniFMZM9VKDFtzm3NEzPJVTA1LU.jpg)
**📷 05 - What happens when I stop at 7:30 AM to observe a street in the neighborhood called \
... / <sub> Lo que sucede cuando me detengo a las 7:30 AM a observar una calle del barrio llamado \

...
</sub>**

----

![T06.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/242hjGFjLxLQ3DXTffWuWDD7hzdsuwzPU7jB56m6y7h4gULJwzYQ8X221xCLaY67FbBi3.jpg)
**📷 06 - A bricklayer, yes, but the one watching (and I watching him) is more like the dog at the end of the street... / <sub> Un albañil sí, pero el que mira (y yo le miro) es más bien el perro al fondo de la calle...
</sub>** 

----

**I**t's funny, I can't help it, but dogs and other animals in the streets steal my attention with astonishing ease. Sometimes the streets seem to revolve around these animals, and crazy things go through my head while I'm taking photos, like saying to myself, \

I even think a little of Diogenes and his dogs in Sinope, but then I revert to being human and forget it, at least for a while...\n\n>**E**s curioso, no puedo evitarlo, pero los perros y otros animales en las calles me roban la atención con una facilidad pasmosa. Algunas veces las calles parecen girar en torno a esos animales y cosas muy locas pasa por mi cabeza mientras hago fotos, como decirme a mi mismo: \

y hasta me recuero un poco de Diógenes y sus perros en Sinope, pero luego a vuelvo a ser humano y lo olvido, cuando menos por un tiempo... 

----

![T07.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/243zp34pihsm6SWMvjpW5opuwfikiGCVwZp4sfXc25udtQUxveNVFwuFR1DCzEZf1yMRa.jpg)
**📷 07 - Street with \
returning to the village after spending some time in the mountains... / <sub> Calle con \

regresando al pueblo después de pasar una temporada en las montañas...</sub>** 

----

![T08.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/243g31DGj2rmhk9bTXoANVdBDzuKCeZ15QtRt9tYm2ovijQFrbFq82n4QMsUUCpxsNziH.jpg)
**📷 08 - Borders of poor houses, but borders nonetheless, even if they creak and groan with the wind and the kicks of the young lads... / <sub> Fronteras de casas pobres, pero igualmente fronteras, aunque crujan y se resientan con el viento y las patadas de los zagaletones...</sub>** 

----

![T09.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/243qTpPPgCCV7UThhenCqsGWcKyZQHFbnxGpz92yRKcSPFpYyvNobKv1U6vGUQBh1dMSP.jpg)
**📷 09 - Juan, the one we all call \
because he's so thin, but who's always doing something, and usually laughing... / <sub> Juan, ese a quien todos llamamos \

por ser tan delgado, pero que siempre está haciendo algo, y por lo general riendo...** ----- ![T10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23sdpCCx3cg6VEgqmjayFGLo5hobScNoBWjdRfhtk9ZtNKM8x1pkhAad3gW941DXr8Uis.jpg) **📷 10 - And well, that's where the town ends and the mountains begin, so I'm going back there... / Y bueno, en esa calle termina el pueblo y comienza la montaña, entonces yo allí me devuelvo...** ---- ##
***Thank you very much for your visit and appreciation!***
> ######
*¡Muchas gracias por pasar y apreciar!*
--- **ADDITIONAL TECHNICAL NOTE**: Photographs captured with my Nikon D7000 DSLR camera in RAW format, then processed in Adobe Camera RAW for adjustments regarding light, sharpening, contrast and depth... They were then exported to JGP format on which minor modifications such as straightening and adding watermarks were carried out using PhotoScape v3.7 >**NOTA TÉCNICA ADICIONAL**: Fotografias capturadas con mi cámara DSLR Nikon D7000 en formato RAW, procesadas posteriormente en Adobe Camera RAW para ajustes relativos a luz, afilado, contraste y profundidad... Luego fueron exportadas a formato JGP sobre el cual se llevaron a cabo modificaciones menores como enderezado y agregado de marcas de agua usando PhotoScape v3.7 ---

title.title: Steelshield Arbalist: new powerful neutral card in the Splinterlands game
title.body:
The arrival of new cards in the Splinterlands game world always creates a kind of increased excitement among players. A new neutral or normal card called the Steelshield Arbalist was recently added to the game. Today's detailed discussion of how important this card is in the strategic aspect of the game and what kind of advantages it will provide at different levels. Those who regularly play Splinterlands know that a good quality neutral card can multiply the strength of any deck or team. The steelshield arbalist card is no exception. It is a 9 mana card, which means that it is usually designed for use in large or high mana battles. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUzxMNXRkRoU26kQXuwbGBARqu4cmo6yk1HCpT1S9P5z9/1775838259306.jpg) The card's basic features can be seen by noting that it is a Ranged Attack card. That is, it is capable of attacking the enemy from the rear rows. It initially had Attack Power 2, but became more powerful as levels increased. The biggest strength of the card is its speed and armour. From the beginning, it was named in the field with 5 speeds and 5 armour, which established it as a fairly fast and defensive card. Its health and vitality are also very good. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmed7BwNf4n9M2gG2nAoRA4cWhQCKEEXCje8VShamfi8bT/1775838269859.jpg) Now we will discuss how this card evolves at different levels and what new abilities it acquires. While the card is of normal value in the first level, it gains a special ability called decoy as soon as it reaches the second level. This decoy ability can turn the game around. Its function is to draw enemy unit Snipes, apex strikes, and opportunity attacks towards itself. This protects other weak but important cards in your party from the enemy. It works a lot like the Toronto unit, but it has certain limitations and specialties that make it stand out. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcBemBWaYGUup9gWj6SVbKa9QzTheXerzzcdUxfLRcdiT/1775838278398.jpg) When the card reaches levels 3 and 4, its health or vitality increases. Health at Level 3A is 6, and at Level 4 it rises to 7. However, the real change can be noticed by moving to Level 5. In this level, el the card gains a second ability called Reveille. Currently, many players in Splinterlands use cards with camouflage or the ability to remain invisible. The reveal ability exposes an enemy camouflage unit each round, allowing other cards in your team to attack that invisible unit directly. It is very effective in destroying the opponent's subtle tactics. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUDG3gWRcRah8DxbFMwX6aEvaZ8kAWCFoHTuvBmtP3Jtb/1775838287280.jpg) At Level 6, this cardarmourmor or Armour increases from 5 to 6, making it more durable. Level 7A's attack capacity or ranged attack was then increased from 2 to 3. At this stage, the card becomes quite formidable both offensively and defensively. Upon reaching Level 8, it gains a third ability called Phase. If an enemy performs a magic attack or sorcery attack due to the phage ability, that attack is made likely to be missed. Usually, magic attack is always on target, but due to havinga phase ability, this card can also spoof magic attack. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaunU9e4jcW1XnPfaqzS3KHbJgBLt8tSzw6m5iqRBzYnq/1775838295879.jpg) At Level 9, the card's defence system reaches its climax. During this time, its armour or armour goes up to 9 in one jump,p and the health or life force increases to 8. That is, it then turns into an impenetrable wall. Finally reaching Level 10 or higher, it gains a fourth ability called Void armour. The advantage of having void armour is that an enemy's magic or sorcery attack will hit the armour orarmourr first without directly hitting health or blood. Since the card has 9 armour in this level, it gains an incredible ability to withstand magic attacks. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcdzo8fSAJ9tfa1SHTGwQNKmELE78E3Et5uYzCha1C7ZE/1775838304154.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd8g9B2mwKGAe8hqudaWTvhgVjEcrF3WZJ1bTSV89TAPD/1775838304175.jpg) Overall, the Steelshield Arbalest card is a unique addition for use in high mana matches. Since it is a neutral card, you can use it with any element or splinter. Especially in matches where there is a possibility of a lot of Snipes or opportunity attacks, this card will serve as the main protector of your team as a decoy. Again, against the Magic team, it will also be able to survive for a long time using the phage and void armour. As a player, collecting this card and gradually levelling up can be a profitable decision for your inventory. Its effectiveness multiplies especially after Level 5 when it gains the Revel ability. Again,n the amountof defencee it offers at the very top levels can be better than many Legendary cards. title.title: Defining Expertise Analyst of What?
title.body: In today's modern era where there is an abundance of information it has become essential for everyone to understand how to interpret data and information and draw accurate conclusions from them. In this context an important term emerges Analyst.But when someone asks Analyst of what? it means What are you an analyst of? This question not only seeks clarity about someone's profession but also reveals their expertise.\n\n

>
Picture source www.pixanay.com


The first aspect is that an Analyst is a person who collects information in a specific field examines it and draws conclusions from it. For example a Business Analyst analyzes a company’s business operations to improve performance. Similarly a Data Analyst interprets large datasets to extract useful insights. When we say Analyst of what? we’re really asking what field that person specializes in.
The second aspect is that analysts can exist in various fields such as finance sports education technology and healthcare. A Financial Analyst examines financial matters while a Sports Analyst evaluates game performance and strategy. The purpose of this question is to clarify which field a person’s expertise lies in since each field requires different methods and knowledge for analysis.
The third important aspect is that an analyst’s job isn’t just to collect information but also to understand it and derive sound decisions from it. A good analyst doesn’t only look at the data but also recognizes the truth hidden behind it. For example if a company’s sales are declining a skilled analyst will identify the reasons and offer suggestions for improvement.
The fourth aspect is that Analyst of what? is a question that clarifies someone’s professional identity. This question teaches us that every skill must be stated clearly. If someone just says they are an Analyst that isn’t complete information. But if they say they are a Data Analyst or Financial Analyst their identity becomes clear.
Analyst of what? is a simple yet important question that helps us understand a person’s expertise their work and the scope of their knowledge. This question also teaches us that every profession has its own identity and making that identity clear is essential. In the present era where every field is advancing the importance of a skilled analyst is growing day by day.

title.title: Mana Warden is too Strong in this Modifier
title.body:
I did not have any archon with Bloodline Dominion so I was not able to fully use the Shapeshift Happens Modifier. Because of that, I focused more on strong melee units instead of bloodline synergy. The units I have with higher melee damage are mostly in Fire Element so I decided to build around that. Up Close and Personal Modifier also limits the battle to melee units only. This makes abilities like Shield very valuable. With everyone using melee attacks, this gives a big advantage. Check out how managed to overwhelm my enemies with this lineup.
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmRgErqNBZzzSLT2Gyms4BQM7S7ffaGzhgZKsxmxZKz4xf/cover.PNG 


# Battle:

https://img.leopedia.io/DQmRnUkvoGbtX6Ym6gLsmemNE287RGNoAjHm4LoiXDsAwRA/Battle.PNG 
https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_3724345670d96e440378cf2d905841e2

In this battle, I chose Fire Element for the available strong melee units. I have Frankasgard as the main tank with Mana Warden's Shield Ward to protect him from the melee attacks. Grove Doomblade and Vengeful Monk attacks the back line as the others protect them. This isn't the strongest lineup for melee units only but it's good enough for this battle and the amount of mana you are allowed to use.
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmbo5261yfj9Y86cHmDyZWsRHGqmSqDuNBM8EPzTTTsBMa/up-close-personal_60.jpg 
Modifier 1: Up Close and Personal: Only Units with Melee attack may be used in battles.
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSabQFJMXScdEzCiZPCGR1Jtv2cMVRCyokrsiD6DQgjb1/Shapeshift%20Happens.png 
Modifier 2: Shapeshift Happens: All units have Shapeshift (treated as all bloodlines). 



# My Lineup:

With Up Close and Personal Modifier, Fire Element has a lot of melee choices. I wanted to use a simple frontline tank with backline attackers. Mana Warden supports the tank by giving Shield. The rest of the units focus on dealing damage from different positions. Sneak and Opportunity help attack enemy backline. This spreads damage across the enemy team. The lineup is straightforward but effective.

https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVWPkk3hzyZn7TPCK8Vy7tnrtS2YWbbt5rigeEnisbpbq/Archon.PNG 
Barthalamas: It gives units +1 Speed which helps the whole team. Speed is important because melee units need to hit consistently. Faster speed also helps evade enemy attacks. It is not the strongest archon but still useful. I chose it because I was already using Fire Element melee units. The extra speed helps Grove Doomblade land attacks. Barthalamas supports overall consistency.

https://img.leopedia.io/DQmRAah98jLQcp1dEpSqr2W8DXrd5wFjKFxqEY4JKU8pMuF/Unit%201.PNG
Frankasgard: Frankasgard has no ability but has decent stats for a frontline tank. It has 1 armor, 8 health, 2 melee attack and 2 speed. These stats allow it to absorb damage early. With Shield from Mana Warden, the survivability increases a lot. This makes Frankasgard a reliable frontline. It can hold position while others deal damage. Frankasgard acts as main wall.

https://img.leopedia.io/DQmWU2ghqyCESRx4tBUMwHEdcu4fo3FdrBaVGgdZcsuCYFc/Unit%202.PNG 
Mana Warden: Has 2 melee attack and 3 health which is average. The important part is the Shield Ward ability. It gives Shield to Frankasgard which reduces melee damage. Since Up Close and Personal Modifier forces melee attacks, this is very strong. Even if Mana Warden dies the Shield stays. This makes the frontline more durable. Mana Warden is key support.

https://img.leopedia.io/DQmTRh54CdVm3BV9pg1SCFuWLz9GMf4RWSxDajN3LEkiLvu/Unit%203.PNG 
Vengeful Monk: Has 2 melee damage and 4 health which is decent. It also has Opportunity which allows attacking from the back. This helps target weaker enemy units. Removing low health targets reduces incoming damage. Even from backline it contributes consistently. Vengeful Monk adds damage while being at the back. It helps increase the overall damage the team can do per round.

https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSpyWZdfjw5jE1ZXAnmGykX2WxJTqv45BpV3McH3XnRs3/Unit%204.PNG 
Grove Doomblade: It has very strong 5 melee damage which is high. Also has 2 armor and 5 health for survivability. Sneak ability allows it to attack the backline directly. The only problem is the low 1 speed which causes misses. Good thing Barthalamas gives +1 speed to help. This increases the chance of landing attacks. Grove Doomblade is very scary when their attacks hit and the extra speed from Barthalamas makes this possible.



Up Close and Personal Modifier made Shield very valuable in this battle. Fire Element melee units worked well in my opinion. By maximizing the damage my team can do each round, I could win even with simple lineups like this.

title.title: Day 33:  Knowing who the players are
title.body:
#
Making money with HELIOS

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/23tkozsRpDvtnFuSB2J6rpdMct7cXQHJB6k1xiCULd6yfARM4QmrnnucvfzbeSwbPy3ob.png)
I will say it plainly. ##### I am bullish on HIVE and that is not something that I typically say about any asset on HIVE. I've watched HIVE tokens tank. I often wonder how long HBD will keep its value before the haircut rule takes effect. Some tokens are valuable but many aren't worth the ink they were printed with. I'm bullish not because I buy and pray. I'm bullish because I watch the buyers, the sellers, the bots and the whales. It isn't an unknown quantity, it is a game to play with money for the winner. HELIOS has been a standout and for two reasons: 1. It has a limited supply and 2. It has an actual, useful, use case scenario. *That matters* Limited supply matters. Knowing that there are limited tokens out there *and* knowing who holds what tokens can give me a sense of just how many players are in the game and how much sell pressure can be put on my **buy** positions. An actual use case for the token is even more useful. With the burn for upvote dynamic HELIOS can be converted to value little by little either for an author or for those you wish to curate. True, it isn't a blanket burn 2 earn and someone has to make decent, useful content or get blacklisted by HELIOS but that makes sense to me. HELIOS can also be burnt for new HIVE username creation. ***BOTH*** of those use cases are useful for a community curator! Right now the Great Little Dragon community can call in a curator to provide similar to that of #Hive Learners which has a much much MUCH larger userbase. Sure it costs me money but it is still possible.

#
But there is another reason I'm bullish
The other reason I'm bullish is because with hive-engine and HIVE there are analytics available that helps me see the other players in the game. ### Hive Engine. The Hive engine is the most important place to look. Just take a quick look at the recent order book for HELIOS.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/23tSwpDoaDytVEEmMAe5ohABeQMeJYdHdURZGXqNUJdmziGWoFnCyh5bfUttzpwUX9p4T.png)
Notice how many \

orders there are? Notice that there are none? ***Every*** order is a BUY. Now that there are no more tokens being created and distribution has tapered down to just a trickle there are very few sellers and those who are selling are putting it onto the sell wall at higher prices. No one is dumping onto the buy wall. Looking a little further? Take a close look at this line.
1.19000000 63.000 74.970000 829.08415
Doesn't look like much when I copy and paste. Here is my read on it though. For HELIOS to double in price? To go from 0.6 to 1.2? would require purchasing 829 HIVE worth of HELIOS. **$50 HBD** Now lets look at that with a fun little example: @hiveabbyftp holds about 10,000 HELIOS tokens. Current value? 10,000 x 0.6 x 0.06 --> ### $360 HBD How about if I was to purchase $50 worth of HELIOS? Those same HELIOS would be worth 10,000 x 1.19 x 0.06 --> ### $714 HBD But of course cornering the market on HELIOS isn't quite that easy. It is important to know the other players in the game. Luckily the buy and sell list tells me exactly that. First: @offgridlife and @tergan were the active buyers. @tergan is the asset holder for the Great Little Dragons community so basically an arms length buyers. @offgridlife is just a smart holder. Second: @helios.savings, @sprizzy, @jetbrains, @honusurf, and @pob.macro are the active sellers. This is where checking out those accounts come in handy. * @sprizzy has a reputation of 25 and no posts : That screams bot. * @jetbrains is in the same situation. * @pob.macro does have posts but nothing since 2021 : Either bot or inactive account on autopilot * @honusurf had a lot of followers and followed but nothing posted since 2023. and @helios.savings only has a limited treasury so it is unlikely to dump all its coins as it seems purpose built to support the coin value. Yes there are whales would could really wipout the HELIOS price but at the moment it doesn't seem that they are in play.

#
Chasing higher valuation is usually pointless if there are no buyers

Now, while I can manipulate the price of the coin by buying out the SELL wall and providing resistance on the BUY wall (placing BUY orders) that still runs into one issue. There is only one buyer @offgridlife so even if I hold 10,000 HELIOS and the value skyrockets...that doesn't mean that I can sell for a profit if there are no buyers! @offgridlife e IS buying but its only one buyer who *could* buy a lot of my 10,000 HELIOS but is kind of unlikely to. So while I could have a paper growth from $360 to $716 unless there are many buyers then I' not going to get that value out. Except: HELIOS has a second way to get your cash. ### Feel the burn HELIOS coin can be burnt for upvotes and the higher the value goes the fewer coins are needed. If I bought out all the \

vendors and the price skyrocketed to 1.19? Far fewer HELIOS would be required for a large upvote. Indeed if I only burnt those 10,000 HELIOS ... 10 HELIOS at a a time? I would likely get $1000 return on those tokens instead of the $320 I originally paid for them. **Overall a 3x increase without any pumping and dumping.** Just by knowing who the players are, how the bots work, and how the burn mechanics work. Am I bullish? Absolutely. And it will be fun to see what happens to the coin in the future :)

#
Putting the bots to work

One nice thing about the bots is that they are predictable. With the @tergan account I made a play to increase the value of the token today. I bought out all the coin at the 0.63 and 0.69 price point. That allowed the coin to soar to 0.899. **A 30% increase** (roughly). Then I left a buy order at 0.800 ... Did I want to pay 0.800? Not really. However, I knew what the bots would do. They would outbid me on the buy wall and they would undercut me on the sell wall. It is just their nature. Once the bots placed support on the buy wall I could remove my order and there was still support for the higher value :) In the meantime? I'll watch the 0.899 peg. I'll buy the bots who are a little lower so I have a supply or coins rather than spend my own. I'll burn tokens to get a war chest and when I have enough I'll buy up coins to make the next burst to the 1.19 support level. ### But there are whales out there. However, whales do exist and could throw off everything. However, supposing they *DID* sell a bunch of coin. Either they sell small amounts to get a high return. If they do I just place a small sell order at a low price. Wait for the bot's to beat that price and make some cheap purchases ;) If the whales really dump to insanely low prices? Buy opportunity! Terrible time to burn but great to buy if coins hit the 0.15 levels again :) And here is the reason: HELIOS doesn't rely on price point to make money. It has value in the burn. There is limited supply and as the supply dries up price increases are both organic for those who want to do the burn and can be engineered by eating up the little liquidity that is actually available. ### I'm bullish for a reason. Yes. I could get burned. Yes whales could eat up my investment. Yes, I could lose hard if the @helios.voter and the burn mechanic is suspended. But honestly? There is never anything guaranteed on Hive. HELIOS just happens to be one that I can see who owns what, see who is buying what, and there are few enough tokens left that I'm not worried about whales sinking the ship. In short, I see enough upside and I can see the potential issues that I'll take the risk. ***and watching the hive-engine, watching individual wallets, and watching the richlist*** makes things a lot more transparent so I'm less likely to be blindsided. and that's it for this post. I'd love to get ideas on whether you are bullish or not and why. If not comments which is the norm for my posts? Well, if you made it this far I'm still happy for eyes on post. Thanks for reading.

title.title: 4WD into Canyonlands National Park
title.body: # 4WD into Canyonlands National Park\n\nThis is the second day of our recent weekend family trip over the Easter weekend. I posted the first day trip in [A Backdoor into the Arches](https://peakd.com/hive-163772/@azircon/a-backdoor-into-the-arches). This post is the second day, where we visited the Canyonlands National Park, but again, not in the conventional way to the Islands in the Sky District by following highway 191 north of Moab and then highway 313 to the west. We decided to skip the standard paved entrance and instead take the \

—which, in this part of Utah, means navigating red rock ledges and desert washes.


![IMG_5336.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/azircon/EptYfGu7Xxgmfjr7a4d7t44xzw4zGJh5nf3GHkosbz5C32CR6KvDc713NbYSUTnYUFS.jpeg)



# The Morning Climb: Gemini Bridges Trail

Instead of heading straight for the Island in the Sky entrance, we began our day on the Gemini Bridges Trail. This 4WD route is a fantastic introduction to Moab off-roading; it’s technical enough to feel like an adventure but accessible enough for a family outing.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/azircon/EpnDDFioy9ofJtKQ56DXo3fGUxEBsdVsB5wwxHqk4sxe9ZLSyfvgY3nY8EQRQu2xPVD.png)

_The Ride, the Machine!_

Earlier, we picked up a Jeep Wrangler Rubicon, a machine that felt right at home the moment we turned off the pavement from Highway 191. Here is how we spent a day tackling two of the area's most iconic trails with the family.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/azircon/Eokd5DXW3JbL3zGkKDtoeH7nW3Fw7xDB3wC3v9sgMKzKpSuMPtHtrPZ6vj3PhGE4QBD.png)

The path winds through spectacular slickrock and colorful desert terrain. The kids were hooked immediately—there’s something about the mechanical rhythm of a 4WD trail that turns a standard car ride into an active exploration.





![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/azircon/EoK6Kro6YfDjcrbVsFFjVJoygxV5Tab8GzjDwFz8zPLjQYCasiafhSChoy1rMjyQvYK.png)

While rated \
the trail requires high clearance for the slickrock ledges and sandy washes. In a Rubicon, I felt the benefit of that low-range gearing during the steeper slickrock climbs near the \

rock formation.


<center> ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/azircon/23xyXVomuzGQ7JNEKFzMjHW2FC6rY9rA5x1imBYuMxvjfz6arbMuHGaTk5QkeqJG6qtf1.png) </center>

<center> _The Gooney Rock, and the Sandy Trail in front_ </center>

Next the trail climbs up to some serious slickrocks on the way to the Gemini Bridges. This is also a mountain biking trail and it is shared with the riders. 


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/azircon/Ep1W1swqmKBH3DTUWhtZWddtQjQFyNhscBPdRbXmPEsn6K8RpEjy5pPDztyfUPtASxZ.png)


The bridges themselves are actually two massive natural spans over Bull Canyon. One of the coolest parts for the kids is that you can walk right across the top of them (carefully!). After the bridges, the trail mellows out into a faster-paced dirt road that eventually deposits you onto Highway 313, just a short drive from the Island in the Sky entrance.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/azircon/EpLecXFWDTi7fNpvuDkHNUxRMZePAKudjtxGJDzkz8PFkC8QYnf1PyfSiLgMVCw586u.png)


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/azircon/EoyP15cirK847JHEZ3cKNxNNQ9rGUtoN9iCnXgfdgFqpiUExxibThdaBrYj17HuNFrQ.png)


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/azircon/23zS2uqGAtYudwLeR8uq4bc5jtFwMAY1etWkQngi41mDU6dH21GXkKhGWcpDz3NB9JA2E.png)

Another point of note is the La Sal Mountain in the distance. It is almost always visible and this time of the year it has snow on it. Did you know, when Spanish missionaries first saw these mountains in summer, they thought there are white Salt deposits at the top of those mountains. Salt = La Sal. In fact La Sal Mountain is a Plutonic Basalt/Dolerite Plug into the country rock. It is neither salt, nor a volcano.

# Recreating History: 10 Years in the Making
Once inside the park, we took a moment to slow down. Ten years ago, we stood at the Shafer Trail Viewpoint near the visitor center and took a family photo. Coming back a decade later was surreal. The kids are much bigger now, but the vast, silent scale of the canyon remains unchanged. We managed to find the exact same spot and recreated that photo—a decade of growth set against a backdrop that takes millions of years to shift.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/azircon/EpVCzHPdZcjNghwjJCDow2Kj95MJzagg1smDRNgBPDfJJ5oxsvA2L6uFARthCnQQTyd.png)


Before the sun began to dip, we squeezed in a short hike to Mesa Arch. It’s a classic for a reason; seeing the canyon framed through the stone span never gets old. This is perhaps the most photographed spot in the park, and for good reason. Even though it’s a short walk, the payoff is massive. It’s an easy 0.6-mile loop. The trail is well-marked with stone cairns and takes you through classic high-desert vegetation like pinyon pines and juniper trees.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/azircon/EoEsSXqEJm2i1RS5AM9W9TzKn6nzUsHsDASEL1XnsKByxHz5PNv2xQQ9JcLK3ovfZVF.png)

Unlike many arches that you look up at, you walk right to the edge of the cliff to see Mesa Arch. It sits on the very brink of a 500-foot drop into Buck Canyon. Looking through the \

of the arch, you get a framed view of the Washer Woman Arch and the Monster Tower in the distance. Even mid-day, the orange glow of the canyon walls reflected on the underside of the arch is spectacular.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/azircon/EoAbG6eqLNCvfQin7iSyWsGzoGh4EkpC5neymUh1qdHUHHeo3wDtQciqhVJAoAvkbNu.png)

# The Shafer Trail & Potash Road: The Ultimate Descent

As sunset approached, we engaged the Jeep’s 4WD again for the most heart-pumping part of the day: descending the Shafer Trail. If you have never driven the Shafer switchbacks, they are a masterclass in engineering and a test of nerves. The trail drops 1,500 feet down a sheer cliff face via a series of tight, steep turns. The kids absolutely loved the thrill of the switchbacks, watching the canyon floor slowly rise to meet us.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/azircon/23wqbyk97SpcBhQATofAcEGgv2wPbqBGmPkN7WuWmRqfoSF3DGqrbWEJUe8B1TQexepx9.png)

At the bottom of the switchbacks, you reached the junction where the White Rim Road (a 100-mile epic) splits off. You stayed on Potash Road (Hwy 279) to head back toward Moab.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/azircon/2458GMy4m2EnZZNHuQL76xdKeCcZw45fxTPz8mW2sNbgGbYbcnEVKAeMYneD4ikB3P4fa.png)

We stopped to marvel at the Colorado River carving a massive \

through the canyon far below. Thelma and Louise Point is not far from here, if you remember the movie. Standing at the edge where the famous movie finale was filmed adds a bit of cinematic flair to the rugged landscape.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/azircon/242hYegXsfV5JRna48tsSzCCgspHok5tT6obYQEvK7P1R33YW44H7evqt1MnNR7Ab78Ap.png)

Doing Canyonlands via 4WD changes the perspective of the park. It’s no longer just a series of overlooks; it’s a landscape you interact with. Between the technical climb of Gemini Bridges and the dizzying descent of the Shafer Trail, it was a day of \

El show debe continuar, y píldoras para el cuerpo, no, nada de eso, hay que joderse consumiendo cualquier cantidad de químicos, algunos que te ayuda con buena intención y otros que te joden con toda intención también.

body.body: >Знаєте, бувають такі моменти, коли одна випадкова знахідка в архівах або на просторах мережі змушує всі розрізнені спогади в голові раптом скластися в єдину, чітку картину. Саме це я відчув, коли вперше побачив цю грамоту. Це не просто старий папірець із печатками — це справжній маніфест того, чим була і чим мала бути Україна понад століття тому. Дивлячись на ці лінії, на ці обриси на мапі, я нарешті отримав документальне підтвердження тому, що бачив на власні очі ще у 2000-х роках.

>Я згадую свою поїздку до Воронезької області. Уявіть собі: початок двохтисячних, я молодий, допитливий, заїжджаю в невеликі поселення далеко від основних магістралей. І тут стається когнітивний дисонанс. Люди навколо розмовляють українською. Не просто якимось там \

чи діалектом, а цілком впізнаваною, мелодійною мовою, яку я чув у себе вдома. Це здавалося неймовірним — адміністративно це інша держава, але ментально і лінгвістично я ніби й не виїжджав за межі рідного краю. Тоді я просто дивувався, а тепер розумію: генетична пам'ять землі набагато міцніша за будь-які політичні кордони, накреслені в кабінетах.

>А Кубань? Це ж окрема історія, від якої перехоплює подих. Мені траплялися свідчення, що навіть у радянські часи, до великих зачисток, там видавали медичні рецепти українською мовою. Місцеві козаки, нащадки запорожців, десятиліттями зберігали свій уклад, пісні та мову. І коли хтось сьогодні намагається переконати нас, що Україна — це щось штучне або обмежене лише нинішніми кордонами, я просто хочу показати їм цю грамоту Українського народного комітету у США від 17 січня 1919 року.

>Цей документ — справжній витвір мистецтва, створений художником М. Дячишиним. Тільки вдумайтеся: Нью-Йорк, 1919 рік. Поки в самій Україні вирувала пожежа визвольних змагань, наша діаспора в США вже тоді була неймовірно організованою та далекоглядною. Український народний комітет став тим самим центром тяжіння, який згуртував людей навколо ідеї допомоги \
. Вони збирали кошти, вони лобіювали інтереси молодої республіки, вони жили цією мрією.

>Центральне місце на грамоті займає мапа. І ось тут починається найцікавіше. Подивіться на ці кордони! Це саме те бачення Української Народної Республіки, яке об'єднувало всіх етнічних українців. Від Галичини та Буковини на заході до Слобожанщини та Кубані на сході. Вражає, наскільки масштабним був цей задум. Люди, які жертвували свої кошти \
, чітко розуміли: Україна не закінчується за найближчим пагорбом. Вона там, де живе українська душа, де звучить українське слово.
>Мене завжди вражало, як щиро і самовіддано діяла діаспора. У тексті грамоти прямо вказано: вона видана на пам'ятку визволення України тим, хто \

. Це був час неймовірного піднесення. Люди вірили, що справедливість нарешті переможе, що століття гноблення залишаться в минулому. Вони малювали ці мапи не як загарбники, а як народ, що прагне повернути своє, зібрати докупи розірване на шматки тіло нації.

>Сьогодні, дивлячись на цей документ, я відчуваю дивну суміш гордості та легкого смутку. Гордості за те, якими амбітними та єдиними ми могли бути. Смутку — бо розумію, скільки всього було втрачено через внутрішні чвари та зовнішню агресію. Але водночас це дає колосальне натхнення. Якщо понад сто років тому наші предки в далекому Нью-Йорку могли так чітко окреслити наше місце у світі, то хто ми такі, щоб опускати руки зараз?

>Ця грамота — це як лист у пляшці, що нарешті доплив до нашого берега. Вона нагадує нам, що наша історія набагато глибша, а географія — ширша, ніж нам намагалися нав'язати протягом десятиліть. Воронезькі села з їхньою \
та кубанські степи — це все частини одного великого пазла, який колись був єдиним цілим.
>Цікаво, що ви думаєте про ці історичні кордони? Чи доводилося вам зустрічати \

там, де їх, здавалося б, не мало бути за офіційною картографією? Адже історія — це не тільки дати в підручниках, це живі спогади, родинні перекази та ось такі старі грамоти, що зберігають правду крізь віки. Що для вас означає ця \
, про яку мріяли наші емігранти в 1919-му?

# The Masked Garden: A Warning for the Digital Age



<a href=\

>from Imgflip Meme Generator There is a particular danger in the digital age: the freedom to become anyone, to wear any face, to speak with any voice. The screen is a mirror that lies. Behind the glowing rectangle, a stranger may smile with borrowed kindness, speak with rehearsed warmth, offer praise that tastes like honey but hides a hook. Be very careful. Not everyone who calls you friend has your best interest at heart. Some gather trust like currency, spending it only when they have enough to purchase what they truly want. They butter you up with compliments, with attention, with the illusion of understanding—until the moment comes when they ask for something that makes your stomach tighten, your breath catch, your instinct whisper: *No.* Listen to that whisper. There are old wolves who dress themselves in young skin. Men who pretend to be boys, who speak the slang of teenagers, who learn the rhythms of youth—not to connect, but to consume. They play games with young hearts, not for joy, but for power. They offer a few dollars for a photograph, a small favor for a secret, a promise for a piece of your dignity. Do not be fooled. A picture is not just a picture. A secret is not just a secret. Once given, they cannot be taken back. They travel faster than light, farther than memory, and they may be used in ways you never imagined, by people you never met, for purposes you would never choose. Be careful. Stay safe. Be aware. And speak. Speak to someone you trust—a parent, a teacher, a friend who has earned your confidence. Tell them what you see, what you feel, what makes you uneasy. body.body:
Hello, friends of Holus Lotus. As always, it’s a pleasure to share a new discovery with you, and this time it was in Bogotá, Colombia, where, during my stay there, I had the chance to explore some beautiful places.

Strolling through the city centre, in a neighbourhood called La Candelaria, I came across lots of lovely graffiti and murals, such as the one I’m sharing with you today.

![IMG_20221009_160957(1)~3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/frankblack/23uFTghMAZCZSYyyzpeKLAVtGe6YMHbFkpJjBYvJvqAVxHBqaLv7TuyNqaxgdrjAgBF4Z.jpg)


![Screenshot_20260410_105815.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/frankblack/243M4pSCBFkBcDZP91EH2HNB3DA2hKMbAtYPwWp3e7SzawFb6UcGafbHvvH6XP4emA5Gv.jpg)


![IMG_20221009_161002(1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/frankblack/EowFZbHw8FgYirdvfRLrTSC6cynoxKfttcRXgiWF2ryfmcD4TaVuogY6rZ1pCS9f5nf.jpg)

Personally, I really liked the interplay of colours and elements in this mural, which highlights the woman’s face, where the variety of flowers and hummingbirds creates a perfect contrast with the burgundy background.

Upon doing some research, I learnt that this piece is a collaboration between the renowned Colombian street artists ***Rodez*** and ***Guache***, who, combining Guache’s figurative style with Rodez’s symbolic elements, created this beautiful mural, which forms part of the *Bogotá Graffiti Tour*

Well, friends, with nothing more to add, I hope you’ve enjoyed it as much as I have


***Photos taken with my Huawei Y9 mobile***
***In Bogotá, Colombia. Location: La Candelaria*** 

***Artists***: Rodez.art and Guache.

### English ###

Hola amigos de Holus Lotus como siempre es un gusto traerles un nuevo hallazgo, y está vez fue en Bogotá Colombia, que durante mi estadía allá, fui a conocer lugares hermosos.

Estando por el centro de la cuidad en un lugar llamado la Candelaria, encontré muchos graffitis y murales hermosos como el que hoy les traigo.

![IMG_20221009_160957(1)~3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/frankblack/23uFTghMAZCZSYyyzpeKLAVtGe6YMHbFkpJjBYvJvqAVxHBqaLv7TuyNqaxgdrjAgBF4Z.jpg)

Personalmente me gustó mucho ver la función de colores y elementos que trae este mural que resalta el rostro de esta mujer, dónde la diversidad de flores y colibríes hacen un perfecto contraste con el fondo vinotinto.

Al investigar supe que esta obra es una colaboración de los reconocidos artistas urbanos Colombianos ***Rodez*** y ***Guache*** que con el estilo figurativo de Guache y con los elementos simbólicos de Rodez dio como resultado este hermoso mural que forma parte del *Bogotá Graffiti Tour*

Bueno amigos sin más que agregar, espero que les haya gustado tanto como a mí
