body.title: The Artemis II Mission proposal
body.body:
> Yesterday, April 8, the ship Orion or Integrity, as it is specifically called, or as the crew calls it, has already left the influence. moon and is back on Earth. The splashdown will be on Friday, April 10 at around 8 hours 7 minutes pm Eastern Time in the United States, they will do so in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego in California.


On April 6, the crew members of the Artemis mission proposed two names for two lunar craters, the names by position are Integrity, in honor of the Orion capsule, their ship, and the other would be the name Carol and this is very emotional, because Carol was the wife of Reid Wiseman, the commander of the mission who unfortunately died of cancer, he died in 2020, the moment this request was made was very moving. Canadian astronaut Jeremy Hansen made the request to mission control and Reid Wiseman was moved and the entire crew hugged each other. I liked this moment. We are human beings and if we don't bring humanity to space, what are we going to take?


https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmXKLznyS7sFr3VVNagSBVC7HWzDuVojatErzq6jnS9itu/image.png

> They did this when at the time when the distance record set by Apollo They saw the moon quite far away, I mention it because then there are photos that are seen of the dawn of the Earth that are also taken with a zoom, it is not that they passed so close to the Moon.


The Carol crater is a small, quite bright crater, you can see it and it is on the far side, but on the limit. Carol's character would be the limit, the border between the visible side, which would be above, and the hidden side, which would be the entire area below, and the dark part would be the night area on the hidden side of the moon, and all that dark part is what they could not see on the hidden side of the moon. Then they only saw the hidden side of the moon, they only saw that fragment, that region between the crater between the Carol crater and where the shadow of the lunar night already begins.


The interesting thing is that the Carol crater is located right on the border between the two faces, in fact, under certain conditions it can be seen from the Earth, it is curious and I think that no media may have said it, but well, the fact is that the faces of the moon are not completely fixed, the Moon suffers a small rocking that is called lunar vibration, this means that we can see up to 51% of the lunar surface and that the remaining 49% is actually the hidden face, that is, there is no half and half.


The point is that this small crater, about 2.7 km in diameter and quite bright, making it easy to locate, has a curious characteristic that is on the border, in that area where the libration we can see in some months or at some times of the year we can see it and other times not, seeing the sunrise or the setting of the Earth, the famous photo of the Earth dawning that they have published now, is only possible if you are in a ship orbiting the Moon, you could only see the sunrise as it appears. Earth or how it sets on the lunar horizon if you are orbiting the Moon in a ship, because if you were standing on the surface of the Moon, you would always see the Earth in the same place in the sky, without moving, being clear, on the visible side, if you were on the far side, you would never see the Earth.


But this Carol crater is in a very special place, on that edge that wobbles, so there you could slowly see the sunrise and sunset of the Earth, which would be quite spectacular, by the way. It would be a good place to put a lunar hotel, because you would have that view of the sunset and sunrise of the Earth. It would take several days, yes, it would be quite slow and it is an acceptable size to place a facility inside because a base on the Moon like the one that both China and the United States are already planning.


A base on the Moon would have to be inside a crater and not very large, because the walls of the crater serve as protection, not only because of the issue of cosmic radiation, which they protect a little, but also from micrometeorites, when an asteroid hits the Moon, a multitude of fragments fly away and it does not happen like here on Earth, where between the Earth's atmosphere and the Earth's gravity, the fragment ends up falling after a few hundred meters, at most a few kilometers, on the Moon it is flying at high speed for a long time until it hits the wall of a mountain or the wall of a crater.


A lunar base. It will be almost like a bunker and a lunar hotel will also be like a bunker, although with some small windows to see the landscape, but it will be like a bunker and will have to be located inside a crater to have a little more protection, so that Carol crater is in a very interesting place.


To finish, the Integrity crater, which is proposed in honor of the name of the Orion capsule, is larger, it is about 6 km in diameter and it is on the full hidden side of the Moon and also close to the Equator, that is, Integrity would already be on the hidden side, we would no longer see it there and being on the hidden side and being close to the Equator, it could be an interesting place to build one of the dreams of all astronomers in the world, a radio telescope on the moon would have to be on the far side because then it would be free of radio wave interference, pollution of all kinds that we emit from the Earth. From the moon, a radio telescope would have tremendous sensitivity.

body.title: The Masked Garden: A Warning for the Digital Age
body.body:
# The Masked Garden: A Warning for the Digital Age



<a href=\

>from Imgflip Meme Generator There is a particular danger in the digital age: the freedom to become anyone, to wear any face, to speak with any voice. The screen is a mirror that reflects not truth, but intention. And intention, when cloaked in kindness, can be the most dangerous weapon of all. You must be very careful online. Not because the world is evil—but because evil has learned to wear the costume of good. It has learned to speak in whispers of affection, to offer compliments like candy, to build trust like a bridge—only to lead you across into shadow. There are those who pretend to be young when they are old. Who adopt the slang, the emojis, the interests of youth—not to connect, but to conquer. They butter you up with praise, with attention, with the illusion of understanding. They make you feel seen. Special. Chosen. And then, slowly, the request comes. *Take a picture.* *Send a video.* *Just this once.* *It'll be our secret.* *I'll pay you.* Do not be deceived. The old man who plays games with young hearts is not playing. He is hunting. The stranger who offers money for images is not generous. He is exploiting. The voice that says *no one will know* is lying. Everything online leaves a trace. Everything shared can be saved. Everything sent can be spread. You are not a commodity. You are not content. You are a person—worthy of respect, deserving of safety, entitled to boundaries that no one has the right to cross. So be careful. Be aware. Stay safe. And when in doubt—speak. Speak to your family. body.title: Rila Monastery: The Different Side of Bulgaria
body.body: After 3 days of cities, streets, and buildings stacked against more buildings, I needed a change of scenery. <a href=\

>Plovdiv had been generous with surprises, but I wanted to know what Bulgaria looked like when you took the urban layers away. So I did what everyone does. I googled it, and one name kept showing up regardless of what I searched. Rila Monastery.

The Way to Rilla

If you have a car, getting to Rila Monastery is easy. If you don't, public transport technically exists but requires the kind of patience and logistical optimism I wasn't feeling that morning, so I went with an organized tour instead. There were surprisingly few companies offering it, which felt like either a well-kept secret or a missed opportunity, and I'm still not sure which.

/>
We got picked up in central Sofia in a comfortable bus, which was already a significant upgrade on the minibus from Plovdiv. The drive took about two hours, and somewhere along the way the city quietly disappeared behind us. As we ventured deeper into the Rila Mountains, the landscape transformed gradually. City buildings faded into vast open spaces, which flowed into lush forests before ascending to majestic peaks. By the time we fully immersed ourselves in Bulgaria's highest mountain range, we experienced a dramatic change in weather—cycling through sun, clouds, rain, and even a fleeting flirtation with snow. Our guide had rightly cautioned us: it would indeed be chillier than Sofia.

A Monastery Or A Fortress?

The first thing you notice when you arrive is not the monastery. It's the walls. Rila Monastery looks like a fortress from the outside, thick and heavy and not particularly interested in welcoming you, the kind of architecture that was designed to keep things safe rather than to impress passersby.

/>
And then you walk through the gate and the whole logic inverts itself. Inside, white and red arches frame painted facades covered in detail, and the scale of it hits you all at once. It does not feel like a religious site so much as a small city that decided to take its visual vocabulary very seriously. Standing in the courtyard, you understand immediately why the walls needed to be that solid.

/>

Rila Monastery: What's the fuzz? 🤔 

Founded in the 10th century by Saint Ivan of Rila, the monastery became something much larger than a religious institution during the centuries of Ottoman rule. While Bulgaria was under foreign control, this place  preserved the Bulgarian language, culture, and identity from disappearing. It copied manuscripts, educated people, and held something together that could very easily have been lost. Most monasteries are minimal. Rila is the opposite.

/> The moment you walk inside, you’re surrounded by color, patterns, frescoes, arches. Every wall tells a story. Every surface is detailed. It’s also officially recognized by UNESCO.

Reading Bible Live

If you are reading this and genuinely wondering which stories are there to be found? Let me tell you this. The main church in the center is where things get genuinely overwhelming. Every surface is covered in frescoes, heaven, hell, saints, judgment, the full narrative of Christianity. It is told in vivid color across every wall and ceiling, with nowhere for your eyes to rest and nothing left out. It looks extraordinary even without context, but we had a guide, and with context it became something else entirely.

/>
\n\nOne detail I didn't see coming: I grew up thinking Adam and Eve ate an apple. The Bible never actually specifies an apple. It says \

/>
At its peak the monastery housed several hundred monks, a remarkable number given how remote the location is. Today around 6 to 8 monks live there. The monastery still functions and also takes overnight guests, simple rooms and minimal comfort.

Orthodox vs Catholic

Bulgaria is Orthodox, and if you come from a Catholic background you might wonder what's the difference. First, the visual inside the church looks immediately different: richer, denser, more narrative, faces of saints covering every available surface rather than the cleaner lines of Catholic interiors. Second, Orthodox Christianity has no central authority equivalent to the Pope, operating instead as a collection of independent churches each with its own patriarch. Next to this the calendar runs differently and its holidays don't always happen at the same dates. And the main difference is Catholic priests are not allowed to marry. Orthodox priests can marry, but only before they become priests. You know what they say, if you can manage your woman, kids and a family, you can run the entire church 😁. 

Boyana Church: the oldest of them all

On the way back to Sofia we stopped at Boyana Church, which looks from the outside like a small and not particularly remarkable building, the kind of thing you would drive past without slowing down. What makes it so special? Inside it holds frescoes from 1259 that look nothing like 1259. The most particular feature is the faces of the saints have expression. It is not your typical flat symbolic saint figures you find in most medieval religious art but something closer to portraiture, to people rather than icons.

body.title: Why brands are dying faster now?
body.body:
Today, the lifespan of a brand is shorter than ever. One of the reason brands lose popularity is failure to navigate the digital and psychological landscape. Several iconic brands that once dominated the market in 1980's or 1990's have either completely disappeared or significantly faded into obscurity. Do you want to know the reason?

## Some of the reasons are:

- These brands often lost their footing due to the entry of bigger competitor or a failure to adopt to the modern technologies.
- The consumer doesn't just buy product but an experience which is created through careful advertising and campaigning.
- Many heritage brands just stick to their old ways which worked 20 or 30 years ago and never adopt to the modern technologies to promote their businesses.
- If a brand's website is slow, its packaging is boring, or it's store feel dusty, Gen Z and Millennials will instantly switch to a cooler Instagram-native brand that offers better aesthetics.
- Brands need to maintain their positive image, if a brand claims to be \

but is caught underpaying workers or using excessive plastic, the backlash on social media is instant which can be very disastrous for it's image.
- People want to see the face behind the brand. Many fashion brands are losing ground to smaller, transparent local labels because people want to know the story i.e. want to know who is behind the brand or how they started.
- In the past, brands didn't have to work hard to stay popular. They did it by buying TV ads. Now the game has changed, you can only stay popular winning the algorithm. 
- Brands that don't produce consistent, engaging content on TikTok or Reels simply vanish from the consumer's mind. If people don't see you on their feed, you don't exist!
- A bad review or feedback can be a blow to the existence of a brand. In old days if someone didn't like your brand they would only talk about it with the people around them but now if someone posts a video against a brand that gets 100k views, it can destroy decade of loyalty in 24 hours.


Back in the day, a brand could dominate just by being available. Now, availability isn't enough. We live in an era where we’re constantly bombarded with \
on our feeds. If a brand stops being relevant, stops listening to its customers, or loses its \

in exchange for corporate growth, we’re quick to hit the unfollow button.\nThe brands that survive are the ones that feel human. They aren't just logos on a shelf; they are the ones that talk to us, admit when they’re wrong, and actually make our lives a little easier or more beautiful. In the end, popularity is a gift from the consumer, and in 2026, it's a gift that has to be earned every single day.

body.title: Desfrán – Day 20
body.body:
<center>

As we enter their third week, they have put on more growth. Though I had to dim the LED light as it seemed a little too intense for half of them. Now the light is set to 25% and the distance from the seedlings is a little over two feet. Since changing the intensity the smaller ones are responding well. I try to mist them often, as their root systems are not established yet and rely much on their leaves for absorption of their water during the seedling stage. 

https://i.postimg.cc/gk9jP28D/P1017048.jpg

https://i.postimg.cc/hj4MPVZP/A1.png Strain:|Desfrán |
-|-|
https://i.postimg.cc/3NVZBV8d/B3.png Dominance: | 100% sativa
https://i.postimg.cc/FRPpf1wb/C2.png Nutrients used: | Happy Frog Soil / Ocean Forest soil. Big Bloom, Grow big:All FoxFarm products.
https://i.postimg.cc/D08g1nK9/D3.png Lineage: | Destroyer x Meao Thai landrace
https://i.postimg.cc/KcHQxkPx/E2.png Current growing stage: | Seedling |
https://i.postimg.cc/8Pf45p4W/F1.png Current plant age: | 20 days old
https://i.postimg.cc/vZRzxJ2K/G2.png Sex: | Feminized
https://i.postimg.cc/YC1x6dJC/H1.png Location: | Central Virginia


https://i.postimg.cc/jdV2rSPm/P1017053.jpg

The biggest of the bunch, is the one above. Honestly this one did not need me to turn down the lights. But its other sisters did need a little bit less light.

https://i.postimg.cc/3JMNHx2M/P1017055.jpg

We can see the leaf curling a bit, looks the new growth is not doing that so hopefully that was just a sign of stress when there was too much light.

https://i.postimg.cc/CLy5Vxk9/P1017058.jpg

These LEDs are all new to me, this is my second grow with them, so still figuring it all out.

https://i.postimg.cc/CLy5Vxk3/P1017070.jpg

I try to mist them a few times a day and so far they have only had one feeding.


https://i.postimg.cc/rF6sLw5c/P1017086.jpg

They seem to like the misting, I also have humidifiers keeping the tent around 70% RH.

https://i.postimg.cc/L6d5M8j2/P1017087.jpg

Basically they are reptile foggers that are piped into the tent that are attached to a device called a humidistat.

https://i.postimg.cc/hPFvqtVS/P1017093.jpg

Had to put on my macro lens for these pictures, glad I did. Get to see them all up and close.

https://i.postimg.cc/VLj6sPFy/P1017110.jpg

I feel like I am a little behind in this grow. I mean yeah there is growth, but I just expect more by now. Hoping they grow out of this, worst comes to worst in about 2.5 weeks I can start some new seeds and directly sow the cannabis seeds into the holes outside.

https://i.postimg.cc/jdz5qYhT/P1017112.jpg

But I do hope these take, as I get a jump on the growing season. They still have over two weeks to get themselves sorted out. And then I will put them in the ground if they are doing well. If not will need to get rid of the bad ones and start a few seeds. Pretty sure the one above will be just fine, just the other three are kind of small right now.

https://i.postimg.cc/VLj6sPFk/P1017115.jpg

But I see lots of new growth, and since lowering the brightness they seem to be overall more happy.

https://i.postimg.cc/Nf1MGvxf/P1017116.jpg

I think next time I will need to keep the light around 25% until they get much bigger.

https://i.postimg.cc/Nf1MGvx5/P1017120.jpg

Soon enough they will be outside in the full sun, so they can enjoy the dim light for now. But by May 1st they really need to shape up into some healthy plants ready to go into the ground. And then the long period of the summer here they should grow into some great cannabis plants with the right care.

body.title: Just Making Myself Happy
body.body:
I have come to realize that life hangs on money. Well, let me not sound as if I do not know that God exists. God does not just exists, He controls all of life's affairs. We are not going to succeed on our own if we push God out of our affairs.

Taking about money, it is an important aspect of life. Let me tell you that we have been taught that money is a defense. This means that money will defend you. So, how much you have financially determines how secured and settled you are at that time. Having more money then can extends one's boundaries. Should I put it this way, that the money you have gives you dominion in larger space of life. Many people are frustrated because they can't afford some of the basics of life.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdCorehzGwKhPnLQbh2WgYmGjGSfTYYkwCRRggpRNdrW5/1775836423548.jpg)

I personally have also heard it that money answers all things. Money answering all things means that without money, you could not be able to achieve somethings in your life. Limitations arise because we are unable to acquire some of the things we need to succeed. What is that factor that do not allow us to achieve that which we desire? It is the lack of enough fund. So truly, money answers all things. If you want to eat, you need money. Without money, food will not answer you. If you want to wear clothes, you need money. No money, you won't be able to purchase a dress. Every basic care and amenity in the society answers to money. So, money is as important as our life.

This is a prompt from @indiaunited community. It is the #iucontest. You are welcome to share your thoughts through this link

I'm asked what I would do or buy if money was not a problem. You see, everyone of us already acknowledge the fact that money is a problem. So, if you are able to overcome this problem, what will you buy or do?

Well, there is no much words here. The fact is that I will use the money to make myself happy as a young man. If I should buy good clothes for myself, then I will do that. If I should build myself a house, I would gladly do that. Anything that I need to enjoy my life and be happy, I will get that.

body.title: [ESP/ENG] Cuidar la vida que tiembla: Reflexión en el día internacional del Síndrome de West
body.body:
Una introducción necesaria 

Una de las experiencias más bellas que he experimentados en mis 40 años como educador es haber podido apreciar la loable labor que realiza el personal docente. Pero, de manera especial, los que trabajan con niños con discapacidad física e intelectual.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWBw7rZjK5ubdg5U1fKDbLZ5rpPwyJbY6iG6qmEj6NDZQ/1775837056448.jpg)[fuente](https://twitter.com/ZairaGarridoUV/status/1513240232589680649?t=R0AZabjFSDxXGJ2_Rs6sjA&s=19)




Hoy, en el día internacional del Síndrome de West quiero reflexionar sobre esta enfermedad y lo que se debe y puede hacer para aliviar y mejorar la vida de quienes viven con ella.

Tengo unas amistades, pareja de profesores que su único hijo tiene esta enfermedad y, gracias al amor, la atención, el estímulo permanente y mucha paciencia han podido tener, más allá del dolor, la felicidad por los logros de su niño que ya tiene 22 años.

Sirva esta reflexión para todos los que viven con este síndrome y para la familia que juega un papel esencial en las vidas de cada uno de ellos.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmex5o8VvkWsKstwr2vbAWD8qveSJaVYqF3JbEidxhfANK/1775835717385.jpg)[fuente](https://twitter.com/ISSSTE_mx/status/1910435450617016466?t=aIFE384l-XRKolwKuPi9Wg&s=19)



El síndrome de West es una de esas realidades que nos obliga a mirar la fragilidad humana con una mezcla de respeto, responsabilidad y ternura. Afecta a bebés y niños pequeños en un momento crucial de su desarrollo, cuando cada gesto, cada estímulo y cada vínculo construyen los cimientos de su futuro. Por eso, acompañar a quienes viven con este síndrome —y a sus familias— no es solo un acto médico: es un compromiso ético y comunitario.

Los niños con síndrome de West requieren cuidados especializados que integren atención neurológica, terapias de estimulación temprana, seguimiento nutricional y un acompañamiento emocional constante. Pero más allá de los tratamientos, necesitan un entorno que comprenda sus ritmos, que respete sus silencios y que celebre cada pequeño avance como una victoria compartida. Las familias, por su parte, necesitan apoyo real: información clara, redes de contención, espacios de descanso y la certeza de que no están solas en el camino.



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPrctAe9FGMJFNeY1UTW7YpESk6QLVUDw1FMdB3SE23uJ/1775837246442.jpg)[fuente](https://twitter.com/plataformamm/status/1380763954876665859?t=3qfLLEdOIu_GgAUWhfWLMg&s=19)



A nivel escolar, la inclusión no puede ser un discurso abstracto. Debe traducirse en acciones concretas: formación docente para comprender la condición, adaptaciones curriculares flexibles, ambientes sensorialmente seguros y la presencia de equipos multidisciplinarios que acompañen el proceso educativo. La escuela debe ser un lugar donde estos niños puedan participar a su manera, sin presiones ni comparaciones, y donde sus compañeros aprendan que la diversidad es una forma de riqueza.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR1J4XjsmZfc84Us8baj8zRr3t2MEtoyRzXN1tu67k4t9/1775836536232.jpg)[fuente](https://twitter.com/fswest/status/1980233396979994969?t=2dOsF1kTpruRDI_1pEeYDQ&s=19)



En el ámbito social y comunitario, la responsabilidad es igualmente profunda. Se necesitan campañas de sensibilización que desmonten prejuicios, programas de apoyo a las familias, acceso a terapias y servicios especializados, y políticas públicas que garanticen atención temprana y continua. La comunidad puede convertirse en un círculo protector cuando se organiza para acompañar, escuchar y sostener.

El Día Internacional del Síndrome de West es una oportunidad para visibilizar, educar y movilizar. Ese día se pueden promover charlas informativas, encuentros entre familias, actividades inclusivas en escuelas, campañas en redes sociales, iluminación de edificios con colores representativos, y espacios de diálogo con profesionales de la salud. También es un momento para honrar la resiliencia de los niños y la fortaleza de quienes los cuidan, para agradecer a los terapeutas y para exigir políticas que garanticen atención digna y accesible.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeTxUshCYa1Ki9L4gtMoA1ujshqtoG52YNURW7XNfQnzm/1775836796638.jpg)[fuente](https://pbs.twimg.com/profile_images/782973261953036288/JxgGZ3qf.jpg)


Un comentario final 

Acompañar a quienes viven con el síndrome de West es un acto de humanidad. Es reconocer que la vida, incluso cuando tiembla, merece ser sostenida con amor, paciencia y esperanza. Y que cada gesto de cuidado —en la casa, en la escuela, en la comunidad— construye un mundo más justo para todos.

Nota: Utilicé el traductor DeepL Translate.
Las imágenes están referenciadas.




ENGLISH


A Necessary Introduction 

One of the most beautiful experiences I have experienced in my 40 years as an educator is having been able to appreciate the laudable work done by the teaching staff. But, especially, those who work with children with physical and intellectual disabilities.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWBw7rZjK5ubdg5U1fKDbLZ5rpPwyJbY6iG6qmEj6NDZQ/1775837056448.jpg)[fuente](https://twitter.com/ZairaGarridoUV/status/1513240232589680649?t=R0AZabjFSDxXGJ2_Rs6sjA&s=19)

Today, on International West Syndrome Day, I want to reflect on this disease and what should and can be done to alleviate and improve the lives of those living with it.

I have some friends, a couple of teachers whose only son has this disease and, thanks to love, attention, permanent encouragement and a lot of patience, they have been able to have, beyond the pain, happiness for the achievements of their son who is already 22 years old.

May this reflection serve all those who live with this syndrome and for the family that plays an essential role in the lives of each one of them.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmex5o8VvkWsKstwr2vbAWD8qveSJaVYqF3JbEidxhfANK/1775835717385.jpg)[fuente](https://twitter.com/ISSSTE_mx/status/1910435450617016466?t=aIFE384l-XRKolwKuPi9Wg&s=19)



West syndrome is one of those realities that forces us to look at human frailty with a mixture of respect, responsibility and tenderness. It affects infants and toddlers at a crucial time in their development, when every gesture, every stimulus, and every bond builds the foundation for their future. For this reason, accompanying those who live with this syndrome – and their families – is not only a medical act: it is an ethical and community commitment.

Children with West syndrome require specialized care that integrates neurological care, early stimulation therapies, nutritional follow-up, and constant emotional support. But beyond treatments, they need an environment that understands their rhythms, respects their silences, and celebrates every little step forward as a shared victory. Families, for their part, need real support: clear information, support networks, spaces for rest and the certainty that they are not alone on the road.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPrctAe9FGMJFNeY1UTW7YpESk6QLVUDw1FMdB3SE23uJ/1775837246442.jpg)[fuente](https://twitter.com/plataformamm/status/1380763954876665859?t=3qfLLEdOIu_GgAUWhfWLMg&s=19)

At the school level, inclusion cannot be an abstract discourse. It must be translated into concrete actions: teacher training to understand the condition, flexible curricular adaptations, sensory safe environments and the presence of multidisciplinary teams that accompany the educational process. School should be a place where these children can participate in their own way, without pressure or comparison, and where their peers learn that diversity is a form of richness.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR1J4XjsmZfc84Us8baj8zRr3t2MEtoyRzXN1tu67k4t9/1775836536232.jpg)[fuente](https://twitter.com/fswest/status/1980233396979994969?t=2dOsF1kTpruRDI_1pEeYDQ&s=19)

In the social and community sphere, the responsibility is equally profound. Awareness campaigns are needed to dismantle prejudices, support programs for families, access to specialized therapies and services, and public policies that guarantee early and continuous care. The community can become a protective circle when it is organized to accompany, listen and support.

International West Syndrome Day is an opportunity to make visible, educate and mobilize. On that day, informative talks, meetings between families, inclusive activities in schools, social media campaigns, lighting of buildings with representative colors, and spaces for dialogue with health professionals can be promoted. It is also a time to honor the resilience of children and the strength of those who care for them, to thank therapists, and to demand policies that ensure dignified and accessible care.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeTxUshCYa1Ki9L4gtMoA1ujshqtoG52YNURW7XNfQnzm/1775836796638.jpg)[fuente](https://pbs.twimg.com/profile_images/782973261953036288/JxgGZ3qf.jpg)


In essence, accompanying those living with West syndrome is an act of humanity. It is recognizing that life, even when it trembles, deserves to be sustained with love, patience, and hope. And that every gesture of care – at home, at school, in the community – builds a fairer world for all.

Note: I used the DeepL Translate translator.
The images are referenced.

solution\\.title: Day 1: Rainboots
solution\\.body:
I am now on an attempt to catch up the day 1 and 2 of this entire prompt list and of course I should start with the 1st day I missed and that prompt word is rainboots! I have seen this prompt word in a few ones I attempted before and I'm kinda sad I never got to reach that point there so I had this prompt idea all this time and now I finally get to execute OwO

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbAx3hrHcmatgQp2pdmRrUyLGv1yW4oWcb9NzSwEbudkr/messenger_creation_c392371b_fc53_4b91_a350_d27a96b963bd.jpeg)
>Materials: Watercolor, pencil color, white acrylic marker
>Duration: 2 hours

I like where this one went UwU because it still looks soft. I originally wanted to fill it with flowers but then the thought of just doing plants was enough for me. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmREe1tLE9CjBmjdD61HaxzCS2MnjWiGtXGhfxeBQF93hQ/messenger_creation_81263f29_1719_4947_b1c5_f8381d37c625.jpeg)
I had started ti's one with a blotchy watercolor set up because I was really thinking my watercolor skills was refined enough for me to do this entirely on watercolor XD but I think... I need thinner brushes for that... and I also need to stop losing my brushes so that I can keep painting finer details XD (Cuz I lost my thinner mop brush yesterday XD 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQe23qfs9Aerkdgfb4WGUQjMAJaxDd6JdJufKotnUUKjJ/messenger_creation_c371265a_2624_43d5_91e4_1d1ab6417bd7.jpeg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcC6Fp9DqyzqvxwaDpdzBCJhnS7FVwqdTNwEGxVEkrE1T/messenger_creation_7aa9a3be_b4cf_426b_8898_a7a309c3ab69.jpeg)
So I did make an attempt at better blending with the mop brush I currently have but it just was not working for me so I decided to just go ahead with my pencils and build up my layers again. And since I wanted to make the boots a bit more detailed, that's exactly how I spent 2 hours just figuring out how to Detail it in XD 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUvPpZ8iQ1kye389Pj8hGotFsiM9NHWxxotTrt1rP1Lqp/messenger_creation_43b3c08c_cae0_4bc9_923f_9ec59cbdcfef.jpeg)
for the plants, I think I spent a longer time there than on the boots because I had no idea how I wanted the plants to look, I just painted and penciled in green then just let imagination do its job. It did come out decent and thanks to my acrylic marker and a black color pencil, it did get enough definition that it doesn't look flat. 

And that is basically how this worked out for me UwU just a bit more and I can finally go back to 1 prompt a day!!!! yayyy! 

It's midnight here and I jut came back from meeting a friend! So this might be all from me! Happy weekends everyone!

solution\\.body:
# The Masked Garden: A Letter on Digital Shadows



<a href=\
>
title=\
/>

>from Imgflip Meme Generator ## Prologue: The Wolf in Silk Clothing There is a particular danger in the digital age: the freedom to become anyone, to wear any face, to speak with any voice. The internet is not a town square. It is a masquerade ball held in a hall of mirrors. Some who smile at you through the screen wear masks crafted not of paper, but of intention. They butter your words with praise, sweeten your doubts with promises, and wrap their requests in the velvet of friendship. Be very careful. --- ## I. The Art of the Gentle Trap They do not come with threats. They come with compliments. *\
*\n\nThese are not kindnesses. They are hooks, baited with the sugar of validation. The hand that offers a coin may be the same hand that reaches for your dignity. The voice that whispers *\

* may be rehearsed, recycled, repurposed for a hundred others just like you.

Many old men pretend to be young. Many wolves dress in the wool of lambs. They play games—not with pieces on a board, but with hearts and hopes. They learn your dreams, your fears, your loneliness, and they use that knowledge not to lift you, but to lower your guard.

---

## II. The Currency of Compliance

*\

*

These are not requests. They are tests.

Each small \

is a brick in a wall you cannot see being built around you. Each compromise is a thread in a net you cannot feel tightening. They do not want your image. They want your obedience. They do not want your trust. They want your silence.\n\nAnd once they have that silence, the price changes. The favor grows. The request darkens. The \

becomes a debt, and the debt becomes a chain.

---

## III. The Armor of Awareness

How do you walk through the masked ball without losing yourself?

**1. Trust the tremor in your spirit.**  
If a request feels heavy, if a compliment feels calculated, if a promise feels too sweet—pause. That unease is not weakness. It is wisdom whispering.

**2. Remember: real care does not rush.**

solution\\.body:
by Hilaricita on Hilaricita 
View my bio on Blurt.media: https://blurt.media/c/hilaricita [![Conservas Video](https://blurt.media/lazy-static/previews/8ecd7cdf-f7f8-40a4-9253-8426bcbb808b.jpg)](https://blurt.media/w/erL1A9tkYHPtoyacAumJn5) 
 
 ![Versión español.png](https://img.blurt.world/blurtimage/hilaricita/0c2eef4b843038ffa91c5c76126870fbaa369559.png)

Viernes 10 de abril, 2026

Al observar una mermelada casera o artesanal, lo primero que salta a la vista no es solo su color vibrante, sino esa textura particular que parece desafiar la gravedad sin caer en lo artificial. Detrás de ese frasco hay una danza química fascinante entre la fruta, el azúcar y, en muchos casos, un poco de acidez natural. 

Es curioso notar cómo las frutas varían enormemente en su contenido natural de pectina, esa fibra soluble que se encuentra principalmente en las pieles y corazones. Frutas como los membrillos, las manzanas verdes o los cítricos son generosas donantes de esta sustancia, lo que permite lograr geles firmes con relativa facilidad. En cambio, otras como las fresas, las cerezas o los duraznos son bastante pobres en pectina, por lo que requieren ayuda externa, ya sea mezclándolas con frutas más ricas en este componente o añadiendo extractos naturales. 

El punto de cocción es otro de esos secretos que separan una buena mermelada de una excelente. No se trata solo de hervir hasta que espese visualmente, pues el ojo puede engañar debido al calor y la evaporación rápida. Tradicionalmente, se busca alcanzar los 104-105 grados Celsius, momento en el que la concentración de sólidos solubles es la ideal para la conservación y la textura. Pero más allá del termómetro, está la prueba del plato frío: dejar caer una gota sobre una superficie helada para ver si arruga al empujarla con el dedo. Ese gesto ancestral conecta directamente con la percepción sensorial humana, buscando ese equilibrio táctil que el cerebro asocia inmediatamente con \
y \

.

También vale la pena mencionar el fenómeno del oscurecimiento. Las mermeladas de frutas claras, como el melocotón o la pera, tienden a oxidarse y tomar tonos marrones si no se manejan bien. El uso de ácido cítrico, ya sea proveniente del limón o añadido directamente, no solo ayuda a la gelificación al ajustar el pH a ese rango dulce entre 3.0 y 3.5, sino que también protege el color y el sabor fresco de la fruta. Es un recordatorio de que la acidez no es enemiga, sino una herramienta fundamental para preservar la identidad visual y gustativa del producto final.

A diferencia de los productos industriales estandarizados, una mermelada natural hecha con fruta de temporada tendrá ligeras diferencias de un año a otro. Una cosecha de frambuesas más lluviosa tendrá más agua y menos intensidad de sabor que una de un verano seco y caluroso. Quien prepara la mermelada debe adaptar la cocción, el tiempo y a veces la cantidad de azúcar, escuchando a la fruta más que siguiendo una receta rígida. 

Hay una cierta magia en tomar un frasco de mermelada, ese producto que solemos relegar al desayuno, y descubrir que puede ser el alma de platos mucho más complejos y sorprendentes. Para quien pasa horas entre fogones, la mermelada no es solo un endulzante; es una bomba de sabor concentrado, con la acidez y la dulzura ya equilibradas, lista para transformar una proteína sencilla o dar profundidad a una salsa. Uno de los clásicos que nunca falla es el glaseado para carnes asadas. Imagina unas costillas de cerdo o un lomo de pato que, en los últimos minutos de cocción, se bañan con una mezcla de mermelada de naranja amarga, un toque de mostaza antigua y un chorrito de vinagre balsámico. 

No hace falta limitarse a lo dulce para lo dulce. En la cocina contemporánea, se valora mucho el juego de contrastes, y aquí las mermeladas de frutos rojos o higo brillan con luz propia. Un queso de cabra cremoso o un foie gras micuit encuentran su pareja ideal en una cucharada de mermelada de arándanos o de higos con nueces. La textura untuosa del queso o del hígado se ve interrumpida por la mordida de la fruta cocida, y la intensidad ácida limpia el paladar, invitando a otro bocado. 

En el mundo de la repostería, la mermelada actúa a menudo como el pegamento invisible que mantiene unidas las capas de sabor. Rellenar un bizcocho genovés ligero con mermelada de albaricoque o frambuesa no solo aporta humedad, sino que evita que el postre resulte empalagoso, algo que sucede fácilmente con las cremas de mantequilla muy cargadas. Además, hay un truco poco conocido pero muy útil: pintar las tartas de fruta fresca con una fina capa de mermelada de albaricoque calentada y colada. Ese barniz natural no solo les da ese brillo de revista que entra por los ojos, sino que sella la fruta, evitando que se oxide y se ponga marrón antes de llegar a la mesa, manteniendo la frescura visual y el sabor intacto por más tiempo.

También vale la pena explorar su uso en aderezos y vinagretas. Una cucharada de mermelada de mostaza o de mango puede emulsionar una vinaigreta para ensaladas de hojas amargas como la rúcula o la endibia. Al batirla con aceite de oliva suave y un poco de vinagre de manzana, la pectina de la mermelada ayuda a estabilizar la emulsión, creando una salsa cremosa sin necesidad de usar lácteos ni huevos. Las notas frutales suavizan el amargor de las verduras y añaden una complejidad aromática que una simple mostaza no podría lograr por sí sola. Es un recordatorio de que la cocina, en esencia, se trata de entender las propiedades de los ingredientes y atreverse a moverlos de su contexto habitual para descubrir nuevas armonías.

Cuando se habla de mermeladas naturales, es fácil caer en la trampa de verlas únicamente como un capricho dulce o un pecado culinario, pero la realidad nutricional es más matizada y depende enormemente de cómo, cuánto y con qué se consuman. Lo primero que hay que entender es que una mermelada bien elaborada, especialmente si es artesanal o de alta calidad, conserva gran parte de los compuestos bioactivos de la fruta original. Al cocinar la fruta a temperaturas controladas, aunque se pierde cierta cantidad de vitaminas termolábiles como la vitamina C, se concentran otros nutrientes como los minerales, la fibra soluble —especialmente la pectina— y los antioxidantes como los polifenoles y flavonoides. 

La pectina, esa fibra que da cuerpo a la mermelada, tiene beneficios digestivos interesantes. Actúa como un prebiótico suave, alimentando a las bacterias benéficas del intestino grueso, lo que puede mejorar la salud de la microbiota y regular el tránsito intestinal. Además, al ser una fibra soluble, puede ayudar a moderar la absorción de grasas y colesterol en el intestino, contribuyendo indirectamente a mantener niveles lipídicos más saludables.  

El problema surge cuando se ignora el elefante en la habitación: el azúcar. Incluso en las mermeladas naturales, el azúcar es necesario para la conservación y la textura, y su concentración es alta. Consumir mermelada con regularidad y en cantidades generosas puede provocar picos rápidos de glucosa en sangre, lo que fuerza al páncreas a liberar grandes cantidades de insulina. 

Con el tiempo, esta montaña rusa glucémica puede contribuir a la resistencia a la insulina, al aumento de peso y al riesgo de desarrollar diabetes tipo 2. El azúcar añadido aporta calorías vacías, es decir, energía sin nutrientes adicionales, y su exceso se almacena fácilmente como grasa visceral si no se quema mediante actividad física. 

Otro aspecto a considerar es la densidad calórica. La mermelada es un alimento concentrado; al eliminar el agua de la fruta durante la cocción, las calorías se compactan en un volumen pequeño. Es muy fácil comerse tres o cuatro cucharadas sin apenas darse cuenta, especialmente si se unta en pan blanco, otro carbohidrato de rápida absorción. 

También existe la cuestión de los dientes. La combinación de azúcar y acidez de las frutas crea un ambiente propicio para la erosión del esmalte dental y la proliferación de bacterias cariogénicas. Consumir mermelada a menudo, especialmente entre comidas sin una higiene bucal posterior adecuada, puede aumentar significativamente el riesgo de caries. 

En definitiva, la mermelada natural puede tener un lugar en una alimentación saludable si se aborda con respeto y consciencia. No es un alimento que deba consumirse \

, sino como un condimento o un complemento ocasional que aporta placer sensorial y algunos fitonutrientes valiosos. 

El beneficio real no está en la mermelada en sí misma, sino en cómo se integra en el contexto global de la dieta: una cucharada sobre una tostada integral con semillas, disfrutada lentamente en un desayuno tranquilo, es muy diferente nutricionalmente a varias cucharadas ingeridas rápidamente en un pastel industrial. La diferencia radica en la intención, la cantidad y la compañía que hace ese bocado en el plato.

Como ya casi se acaba el número de caracteres de la caja de información, les dejo con la canción que le pedí a SUNO, esperando que esta publicación les haya servido, no solo como entretenimiento, sino que les haya aportado un poco, una chispa de contenido que genera valor.

🎵 🎶 🎶 🎶 🎵 🎼 🎼 ♬ ♫ ♪ ♩

Esta fue una canción e información útil de viernes.

Gracias por pasarse a leer y escuchar un rato, amigas, amigos, amigues de BlurtMedia.

Que tengan un excelente día y que Dios los bendiga grandemente.

Saludines, camaradas \

!!

solution\\.title: Hive Philippines Street Photography #1136 - by Allmonitors
solution\\.body:
#1136 - Street Scenes in Vivid Colors for Friday. 

Happy Friday my incredible Hive family around the world! May your Friday be smooth, your plans be fun and your stress be low. Enjoy every bit of this beautiful day and prepare for a wonderful restday ahead. Stay safe and keep smiling☺️. 

Now for our colored street sces we have here an old man driving a taxi cab similar to my workhorse, an Isuzu crosswind which is very reliable in huge hauls and long distance travels. Beside the cab is a motorcycle riding in tandem. 
![1000017791.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23tGe9zcahLtJwQ5ogRMTHSx7W34jHZSALRjtVpMCtC3D5KZwLWZsMkwgmXWh1kBkdp7S.jpg)

An elderly woman sat on the side leaning her back on the concrete wall of a building, she extends her arms with a white cup asking for passerbies for small or in kind amount of alms. Tough times being old and no one to take care of you😭. 
![1000017880.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23wC9dfN9F9nb4jcNR2xjToMsx6bHTDjicr4ELs2wLnYyyrTHQb8BeTJNqg5ED9Lswf7H.jpg)

Here's a long line of people looking like they're about to enter a concert or a special event but they're there waiting for their chance to ride a jeepney back home. Imagine lining up for about a kilometer or two these days when oil price is high just to get home. Some people started walking already nowadays because of it. 
![1000017821.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23xAZyonTv9fGdYHLsNZY8kHbQ96xQMgQDmJrhFu5QXX5UffuF2bhxP4xkqNMf4Z4GuHn.jpg)


The city of pines when oil price was still low, now barely any number of tourists go to visit the highlands because of the high gas prices. 
![1000017804.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23wC3QwWxMUgqMu8H9SbBwWkyKCAF5DYpiw7GjoqUE3pZGUDFXeLtgkFfhnkzXDu8xmRE.jpg)

Follow me on my street travels.
Shot taken in Baguio City, Philippines.

<center>Image/s were shot using Panasonic Lumix ZS110. ~rex</center>

solution\\.title: Soltar para avanzar||Let Go to Move Forward
solution\\.body: ![Soltar para Avanzar.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/damarysvibra/AKFB3kMgmGiTccePQW7qnr8rpY63eJPzSuZqB7VkVmvK96cL3K1MfcCd97Y4C7a.jpg)\n\n<div class=\

> Saludos, amigos de @beentrepreneur. Hace varios años leí el libro de Josh Kaufman, MBA personal. Domina el Arte de Hacer Negocios. MBA son las siglas de lo que podemos traducir como un máster en Administración de Negocios. El libro en su momento dio mucho de qué hablar por su abordaje práctico y hay quienes señalan que es un manual que todo emprendedor debe leer. En lo personal, el libro me pareció altamente instructivo; sin embargo, hubo conceptos e ideas que no encajaban en mi esquema mental y, a lo largo del tiempo, una de estas ideas regresa a mí, sobre todo cuando las “cosas” no están dando los resultados que espero, ocasionando un ruido que hoy quiero compartir contigo. La idea general que recuerdo es: si un negocio a los tres meses no da los resultados que esperas, ese no es el negocio. Posiblemente esta premisa te genere, al igual que a mí, una serie de preguntas que incomodan: - Entonces, ¿dónde queda esa consigna aprendida que se convierte en ancla motivadora: persistir, insistir y nunca desistir? - ¿Qué hay de la idea de proceso, de darle tiempo a las etapas de crecimiento y de consolidación? - ¿Qué haces con la pasión que te mueve? ¿Dónde encuentras tu porqué y para qué? - ¿Qué hacer con lo invertido: tiempo, dinero, conocimiento, energía, esfuerzo? Es oportuno aclarar un punto a lo planteado por el autor: cuando hablamos de negocio, generalmente hacemos referencia al intercambio comercial de producto o servicio por dinero, y cuando hablamos de emprendimiento, tenemos como referente la creación de valor a partir de una idea que satisface una necesidad en la cual estamos involucrados posiblemente de manera más afectiva, aun cuando en ambas propuestas existe el elemento común de generar rentabilidad. Si montamos una tienda online de compra-venta de productos cosméticos adquiridos a un mayorista, tengo un negocio; el creador del producto tiene un emprendimiento que se ha posicionado, crecido hasta convertirse en una empresa. Desde este punto de vista, me es pensable que, si el negocio no resulta a los tres meses, cambie de ramo y pruebe con otro, pero el de la empresa para llegar allí donde está, requirió más de tres meses, seguro, que fueron años. ![tristanlai1220-travel-2799111.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/damarysvibra/243qKSci64Ry8kSkfdjYgciNMx8gykHLCj9WFsGSeJKpLyB6Z7UUNWEx986ngmWJsS2KR.jpg) Volviendo al tema central que motiva este escrito, ¿cuál es el momento para soltar un emprendimiento que no es rentable y avanzar hacia otro que te dé mayores satisfacciones económicas? La respuesta siempre será una decisión completamente personal, pero “debería” ser lo más objetivamente posible, producto de un análisis, de colocar en la balanza aspectos como: * La ya señalada rentabilidad, que es la parte más visible y que de muchas maneras es lo que más pega, entre otros aspectos porque el esfuerzo no encuentra correspondencia con lo percibido. * El desgaste físico-emocional. Al no haber rentabilidad, no hay solvencia económica, lo que paso a paso se va convirtiendo en la rueda del hámster: das y das y das hasta el agotamiento físico y mental, pues al no lograr los objetivos te sientes agotado, frustrado y lleno de incertidumbre. Hasta que llega el momento en que comienzas a preguntarte: ¿Vale este desgaste y seguir aferrado a este proyecto? * Las famosas circunstancias. Dicen que el buen emprendedor cambia las circunstancias a su favor y puede tener mucho de cierto, pero si en tu evaluación objetiva encuentras que “todo es una lucha por sobrevivir”, quizás sea el momento de replantearse otra manera de hacer las cosas. A lo largo de mi experiencia he soltado algunos emprendimientos, no siempre por voluntad propia, pero el haberlos soltado me abrió a otras oportunidades de avance. Y tú, ¿has tenido la experiencia de soltar para avanzar? ![Separadaores Be entrepreneur B.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/damarysvibra/23xLNHcnZPeyGLrNd1uUx7auKSvjAV511WhrCYdw94mFss6TFXqHSTer6vWevwFghaxgQ.jpg) ![Soltar para Avanzar.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/damarysvibra/AKFB3kMgmGiTccePQW7qnr8rpY63eJPzSuZqB7VkVmvK96cL3K1MfcCd97Y4C7a.jpg) Greetings, friends at @beentrepreneur. Several years ago, I read Josh Kaufman’s book, Personal MBA: Master the Art of Doing Business. MBA stands for Master of Business Administration. At the time, the book generated a lot of buzz due to its practical approach, and some say it’s a must-read for every entrepreneur. Personally, I found the book highly instructive; however, there were concepts and ideas that didn’t fit into my mindset, and over time, one of these ideas keeps coming back to me—especially when “things” aren’t yielding the results I expect—prompting a thought I’d like to share with you today. The general idea I recall is: if a business doesn’t deliver the results you expect within three months, that’s not the right business. This premise may raise, for you as it did for me, a series of uncomfortable questions: - So, what happens to that mantra we’ve learned that serves as a motivational anchor: persist, insist, and never give up? - What about the idea of process, of giving time to the stages of growth and consolidation? - What do you do with the passion that drives you? Where do you find your “why” and “what for”? - What do you do with what you’ve invested: time, money, knowledge, energy, effort? It is worth clarifying a point raised by the author: when we talk about business, we generally refer to the commercial exchange of a product or service for money, and when we talk about entrepreneurship, we refer to the creation of value from an idea that satisfies a need in which we are likely more emotionally invested, even though both concepts share the common element of generating profitability. If I set up an online store to buy and sell cosmetics purchased from a wholesaler, I have a business; the product creator has a startup that has established itself and grown into a company. From this perspective, it’s conceivable to me that if the business doesn’t take off within three months, I might switch fields and try another one, but for the company to get to where it is, it surely took more than three months—it took years. ![tristanlai1220-travel-2799111.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/damarysvibra/243qKSci64Ry8kSkfdjYgciNMx8gykHLCj9WFsGSeJKpLyB6Z7UUNWEx986ngmWJsS2KR.jpg) Returning to the central theme that motivates this writing, when is the right time to let go of a venture that isn’t profitable and move on to another that brings you greater financial rewards? The answer will always be a completely personal decision, but it “should” be as objective as possible, the result of an analysis that weighs aspects such as: * The aforementioned profitability, which is the most visible aspect and, in many ways, the most striking—among other reasons because the effort does not match the return. * The physical and emotional toll. Without profitability, there is no financial stability, which gradually turns into a hamster wheel: you keep going and going and going until you’re physically and mentally exhausted, because when you fail to meet your goals, you feel drained, frustrated, and full of uncertainty. Until the moment comes when you start asking yourself: Is this exhaustion worth it, and should I keep clinging to this project? * The so-called circumstances. They say that a good entrepreneur turns circumstances to their advantage, and there may be a lot of truth to that, but if your objective assessment reveals that “everything is a struggle for survival,” perhaps it’s time to rethink another way of doing things. Throughout my experience, I’ve let go of some ventures—not always by choice—but letting them go opened me up to other opportunities for growth. And you, have you ever had the experience of letting go in order to move forward? ![separador-rojp-800x5.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcuEfbmsuYdBRfYDrQctCJfzA1A8kQT9hp6UYL5CdDCyq/separador-rojp-800x5.jpg) Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator (free version) **Fuente de imágenes**: Elementos Canva -[Imagen](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/viaje-mujer-asi%c3%a1tica-2799111/) ![separador-rojp-800x5.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcuEfbmsuYdBRfYDrQctCJfzA1A8kQT9hp6UYL5CdDCyq/separador-rojp-800x5.jpg) ![pie 800.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/irvinc/VilfkhTe-pie20800.jpg) ![separador-rojp-800x5.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcuEfbmsuYdBRfYDrQctCJfzA1A8kQT9hp6UYL5CdDCyq/separador-rojp-800x5.jpg)
#### MIS REDES SOCIALES [![face-cir.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaeWFfPkYdDAMKrf3DyLssBsBxwRbX5Pgn4QHvkLgBtng/face-cir.png)]( https://www.facebook.com/damaryspacheco.s)[![instagram-cir.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRFhQXoKY4iFopqc73FaW8zUxNaZVie1CywCXJi3bDTFD/instagram-cir.png)]( https://www.instagram.com/damaryspacheco.s/)[![twiiiter-circulo.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQsJiBJfzSU1PePLmn3g6PEUdeGHnmufb3gHCx4Htaq1j/twiiiter-circulo.png)]( https://twitter.com/damaryspacheco5)

description.title: Noche de premio | Historia [ESP-ENG]
description.body:
La banda salió del escenario y se fueron al camerino, desde allí se escuchaba el murmullo del público. Todos respiraron hondo, intentando asimilar lo que acababan de vivir, ya que fue una experiencia inolvidable. Stewie dejó caer la guitarra sobre el mueble y se recostó contra la pared, mientras Dani buscaba algún refrigerio para recuperar energía. Michelle se sentó frente al espejo, dejando que la adrenalina del escenario. —No puedo creer que realmente pasó —comentó Michelle, con una gran sonrisa—. Dani asintió, mordiendo una manzana—Y seguro vendrán mejores cosas —dijo, dejando la frase en el aire. Mientras los demás seguían allí responsando. >The band left the stage and headed to the dressing room; from there, they could hear the murmur of the audience. Everyone took a deep breath, trying to process what they’d just experienced—it had been an unforgettable moment. Stewie set his guitar down on the bench and leaned against the wall, while Dani looked for a snack to recharge. Michelle sat down in front of the mirror, letting the adrenaline from the stage wear off. # >“I can’t believe it really happened,” Michelle said with a big smile. Dani nodded, biting into an apple. “And I’m sure better things are coming,” she said, leaving the sentence hanging in the air. Meanwhile, the others stood there, still catching their breath. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPVKLNvDTVx5BuvdhxQWsWvadVxXjSMoyDsEccSgBWDrP/image.png) [Source](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/guitarra-m%c3%basica-e-guitarra-8011240/) Alguien tocó la puerta muy fuerte, que los asusto y resultó ser el representante del festival—Chicos, prepárense. Es hora de las premiaciones. Les aseguro que van a querer estar atentos —dijo, dejando la puerta entreabierta, además el tiempo era corto para la Banda. Volver a caminar hacia el escenario fue lo máximo, donde estaba lleno de luces, cámaras y la gente seguía aplaudiendo. Michelle estaba nerviosa su corazón latía muy fuerte, donde Stewie tomó su brazo—Estamos listos —susurró. Les toco esperar y finalmente, el presentador los llamó de nuevo, haciendo que los nervios se mezclaran con emoción pura. Cuando escucharon su nombre como ganador de la categoría que nunca imaginaron conquistar, unas pequeñas lágrimas aparecieron. Michelle, Dani y Stewie subieron al escenario, tomaron el trofeo y lo sostuvieron al aire, dejando que la multitud viera que cada esfuerzo, cada ensayo, cada lágrima, había valido la pena. >Someone knocked loudly on the door, startling them, and it turned out to be the festival representative. “Guys, get ready. It’s time for the awards ceremony. I promise you’ll want to pay attention,” he said, leaving the door ajar; besides, time was running short for the band. # >Walking back to the stage was the best part; it was full of lights, cameras, and the crowd kept applauding. Michelle was nervous—her heart was pounding—when Stewie took her arm. “We’re ready,” he whispered. They had to wait, and finally, the host called them back, making their nerves mix with pure excitement. # >When they heard their name announced as the winner of the category they never imagined they’d win, a few tears welled up. Michelle, Dani, and Stewie went up on stage, took the trophy, and held it aloft, letting the crowd see that every effort, every rehearsal, every tear, had been worth it. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTDfu5uJ5yuvLd1LBBcXXWASzSL6syJTWGubAcRKALyNT/image.png) [Source](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/escenario-musical-al-aire-libre-con-bateria-y-guitarra-35985260/) De regreso en el camerino, todo cambio risas, abrazos y felicidad. Se sentaron juntos mirando el trofeo que tanto había soñado. Todos se miraron conscientes de que esa noche fue histórica, y que aquel viaje que comenzó con sueños terminó en algo mucho más grande. Afuera, la noche los esperaba, con luces que reflejaban un futuro que prometía aún más música, más aventuras y quizás, un nuevo capítulo que nadie esperaba. >Back in the dressing room, everything turned to laughter, hugs, and joy. They sat together, gazing at the trophy they had dreamed of for so long. They looked at one another, knowing that this night was historic, and that the journey that began with dreams had ended in something much greater. Outside, the night awaited them, with lights reflecting a future that promised even more music, more adventures, and perhaps a new chapter that no one had expected.

description.title: The Pyramid of Giza
description.body:
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tang3/23wX3FEiGdmp3uBGzRtdc8MuGuucbrRif5mUfvvxyk3J7We2wcrfpe5wg4WZmALsqDhdE.png)

The Pyramid of Giza, built 4,600 years ago—still makes people wonder: “How did they build something so big?” About 2.3 million stone blocks were used to build this huge tomb of Pharaoh 𝐊𝐡𝐮𝐟𝐮, each weighing two to three tons! Some say it was a huge ramp, some say aliens came to help. But to be honest—many people find it hard to believe that the Egyptians themselves were so smart!

Now the real fun begins. Scientist 𝐕𝐢𝐜𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐞 𝐋𝐮𝐢𝐬 𝐑𝐨𝐬𝐞𝐥𝐥 𝐑𝐨𝐢𝐠 came up with a great idea—the ramp was not outside, but inside! That is, a spiral (twisting) road was built inside the pyramid. And as soon as the work was completed, it was covered with stones—just like “erasing its own evidence”! His algorithm says that it could have multiple teams working together, so placing a block every three minutes—while it sounds crazy, is actually quite logical.

Adding a little fun to the ancient Egyptians—where people used the floods of the Nile River to carry stones and pull sleds over wet sand. Imagine, no cranes, no machines—yet such a master plan! So in the end, it becomes clear—the real “geniuses” were humans, not aliens. And maybe they were the first “project management experts.”

description.title: Tocando por primera vez en público / Playing in public for the first time | Vídeo 🎶🎸
description.body:
##
Mi primer recital de guitarra
![IMG-20260317-WA0008.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/soyunasantacruz/245my5xjnKxhj54a5Bdcyw1yDQvn5ULPLYnGsdNxU5neJFdzoo9XSAXkS1ELuBJbg2jrX.jpg)
Event advertising
*This post is both in English and Spanish, you can go directly to english by clicking [HERE](#english)*
Si alguien me hubiese dicho hace un año que el pasado 17 de marzo yo estaría tocando guitarra frente a un público no le hubiese creído y seguro una sonrisa me hubiese sacado, es que a veces hay que dejarnos sorprender por la vida, porque para ser sincera nunca me vi tocando este instrumento. En resumen hace unos meses decidí volver a tocar cuatro y retomar lo que dejé hace más de 40 años, wuaoo eso es mucho tiempo, asistí a una clase en el núcleo del sistema de orquesta y el profesor de cuatro que era el mismo de guitarra me dijo que en cuatro ya tenía algo de conocimiento y para no estar con niños tan pequeños que me parecía empezar a tocar guitarra. Yo no quise cerrar esa oportunidad y después de hacer unos pequeños trámites me facilitaron el instrumento. Entonces en la segunda semana de enero después que el país (Venezuela) se organizó, me asignaron una obra, bueno a todo el grupo que está formado por dos jóvenes que ya tienen un año con la guitarra y dos mujeres que estamos empezando, nos dieron la partitura de Romance Anónimo. Las clases son una vez a la semana por dos horas y sinceramente al principio lo que entendía lo olvidaba rápido. Cuando intenté interpretar la partitura de esta obra casi me da un desmayo, pues no se parecía en nada a la de teclado y se me ocurrió preguntarle a la inteligencia artificial de gemini🤣😂 que al principio era mi amiga y terminó molesta, ya que la obligue a explicarme, pero no ayudó del todo. A veces agarraba la guitarra tres días seguidos y una semana no. 🫣🤭, porque no sabía ni por dónde comenzar, hasta que se me ocurrió buscar tutoriales de la canción y así fue que avance sin interpretar la partitura. En la medida que fui aprendiendo me fui motivando hasta aprender toda esta obra en dos meses. Los demás chicos siguieron mi ejemplo, pero ellos no lograron aprenderse toda la obra sino la primera parte. ##
Romance Anónimo
![IMG-20260327-WA0027.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/soyunasantacruz/EpXHz1ec4TaVF9bhMVN5gxpWmQC5v7cXoageibjVcot7jhTMB9dGJjVe7i3d2NXdkZ7.jpg)
![IMG-20260327-WA0029.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/soyunasantacruz/EppKmjt1TTxcZ2MmgWEAvDbaLiVAGGiJ48oECjCs3v9d6DTkNJpXxJnbCMULY9aPoYh.jpg)
Mientras aprendía esta melodía me informe sobre ella y su historia. Se dice que es una obra muy antigua del siglo XVII que ha sido versionada por varios autores que le han añadido arreglos y por este motivo nadie puede adjudicarse su autoría porque sería un plagio, se desconoce el autor original. Esta canción ha tenido sus épocas de popularidad con diversos artistas talentosos de la guitarra clásica. Entre los más famosos guitarristas está Narciso Yepes que muchos lo confunden como el autor original, pero el solo registro los arreglos que le agregó, Narciso Yepes también es famoso por tocar una guitarra de 10 cuerdas instrumento que yo no conocía. Este músico fue contratado para crear la banda sonora de una película y en esa película incluyó Romance Anónimo por lo que se volvió famosa junto a él. ##
Anécdotas del recital
![IMG-20260327-WA0033.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/soyunasantacruz/Eptb3KiA6UpEyTdxY6bJmf75V1CZjW3ADYuiReXgDu518yFNYPuM9QMfciex1hLKfV2.jpg)
![IMG-20260327-WA0021.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/soyunasantacruz/EpviLwKigcZoBzn3RoBNNDgzohKUSEYtr4RuibWJUjDe6zeFigRmu9mgBf5eCWSAVTx.jpg)
Romance Anónimo está escrito en tono de mi menor que es su primera parte, aquí la música nos lleva a la melancolía y al romance. Es suave y sencillamente hermoso. Luego en su segunda parte cambia al tono de Mi mayor, con una melodía con más fuerza expresando un amor resuelto con pasión. Esto según mi percepción. El día del recital mis compañeros estaban nerviosos y ninguno se aprendió la obra completa. El profesor decidió que tocaremos solo la primera parte y así los hicimos todos juntos y el mismo profesor nos acompañó. También cada uno lo interpretó en solitario lo que se aprendió, yo la toqué completa con mis detalles y nervios, pero lo hice 🥳✨️🎉. Lamentablemente, no me pasaron el video de mi participación en solitario, pero pienso grabarla en casa para mostrarlas en otro post. Ese día asistieron en el público los representantes de los participantes, los otros compañeros del núcleo estudiantes de mandolina, cuatro, flauta entre otros y los profesores de otras cátedras. En total no sumaban 25 personas, pero yo sentía que estaba tocando en el poliedro 🤣. https://youtu.be/rebhiX63s7k?si=R7jkxRl2NnQwkL2H Para culminar debo decir que esta obra no es tan fácil como pensé, yo creía que por ser novata en el instrumento mi primera obra seria los pollitos dicen o algo similar, fue después de aprenderla y oír sobre esta obra que supe que su dificultad es intermedia y los músicos de guitarra sabrán sobre eso, supongo que el profesor quiso ponernos un reto grande, pero casi abandono, pues fue un choque fuerte en dificultad para mí, hoy recibí la nueva obra y es más difícil y complicada, así que como dice un refrán popular amanecerá y veremos. Amé la experiencia de tocar algo en guitarra, cada día que pasa me gusta más, solo espero tener la constancia y la disciplina para lograr la agilidad y capacidad en este instrumento. Agradezco la oportunidad que me brindan en este núcleo del sistema de orquesta y a usted por el apoyo en esta publicación.
![IMG-20260327-WA0031.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/soyunasantacruz/23zS2xG8g43nzDEFDfhHmTwKBcYxik2sqqxMC3UGPdweHYRRTqmHRnFARBznrY6G8qXTD.jpg)
###
¿Habías escuchado esta obra antes?, ¿qué te pareció?
English

> ##
My first guitar recital
![IMG-20260317-WA0008.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/soyunasantacruz/245my5xjnKxhj54a5Bdcyw1yDQvn5ULPLYnGsdNxU5neJFdzoo9XSAXkS1ELuBJbg2jrX.jpg)
If someone had told me a year ago that on 17 March I’d be playing the guitar in front of an audience, I wouldn’t have believed them and it would certainly have made me smile; the thing is, sometimes you just have to let life take you by surprise, because, to be honest, I never imagined myself playing this instrument. In short, a few months ago I decided to start playing the cuatro again and pick up where I left off more than 40 years ago – wow, that’s a long time! I attended a class at the orchestra centre and the cuatro teacher, who was also the guitar teacher, told me that I already had some knowledge of the cuatro and that, rather than being with such young children, he thought it would be better for me to start playing the guitar. I didn’t want to miss that opportunity and, after sorting out a few formalities, they provided me with the instrument. So in the second week of January, after the country (Venezuela) had got organised, I was assigned a piece; well, the whole group—made up of two young people who’ve been playing the guitar for a year and two women who are just starting out—was given the score for ‘Romance Anónimo’. Classes are once a week for two hours and, honestly, at first I’d forget what I’d learnt almost as soon as I’d learnt it. When I tried to play the score for this piece, I nearly fainted, because it was nothing like the keyboard version, and it occurred to me to ask Gemini’s artificial intelligence🤣😂, which was my friend at first but ended up getting annoyed, as I forced it to explain it to me, but it didn’t help me at all. Sometimes I’d pick up the guitar for three days in a row and then not for a week. 🫣🤭, because I didn’t even know where to start, until it occurred to me to look for tutorials for the song, and that’s how I made progress without reading the score. As I went along, I got more and more motivated until I’d learnt the whole piece in two months. The other lads followed my example, but they didn’t manage to learn the whole piece, just the first part. ##
Romance Anónimo
![IMG-20260327-WA0027.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/soyunasantacruz/EpXHz1ec4TaVF9bhMVN5gxpWmQC5v7cXoageibjVcot7jhTMB9dGJjVe7i3d2NXdkZ7.jpg)
![IMG-20260327-WA0029.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/soyunasantacruz/EppKmjt1TTxcZ2MmgWEAvDbaLiVAGGiJ48oECjCs3v9d6DTkNJpXxJnbCMULY9aPoYh.jpg)
Whilst learning this melody, I found out more about it and its history. It is said to be a very old piece from the 17th century that has been adapted by various composers who have added their own arrangements; for this reason, no one can claim authorship as it would be plagiarism; the original composer is unknown. This song has enjoyed periods of popularity with various talented classical guitarists. Among the most famous guitarists is Narciso Yepes, whom many mistake for the original composer, but he merely recorded the arrangements he added. Narciso Yepes is also famous for playing a 10-string guitar, an instrument I was unfamiliar with. This musician was commissioned to compose the soundtrack for a film and included ‘Romance Anónimo’ in it, which is how it became famous alongside him. ##
Anecdotes from the recital
![IMG-20260327-WA0033.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/soyunasantacruz/Eptb3KiA6UpEyTdxY6bJmf75V1CZjW3ADYuiReXgDu518yFNYPuM9QMfciex1hLKfV2.jpg)
![IMG-20260327-WA0021.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/soyunasantacruz/EpviLwKigcZoBzn3RoBNNDgzohKUSEYtr4RuibWJUjDe6zeFigRmu9mgBf5eCWSAVTx.jpg)
‘Romance Anónimo’ is written in the key of E minor in its first part; here the music transports us to a world of melancholy and romance. It is gentle and simply beautiful. Then, in the second part, it shifts to E major, with a more energetic melody that expresses a resolute and passionate love. That, at least, is my perception. On the day of the recital, my classmates were nervous and none of us had learnt the whole piece. The teacher decided we would play only the first part, and so we all played it together, with the teacher himself accompanying us. In addition, each of us performed a solo section of what we had learnt; I played the whole piece, with my own touches and my nerves, but I did it 🥳✨️🎉. Unfortunately, I wasn’t sent the video of my solo performance, but I plan to record it at home to share in another post. The audience that day included the participants’ representatives, my fellow students from the mandolin, four-string, and flute groups, among others, and lecturers from other departments. There were fewer than 25 people in total, but I felt like I was playing at the Poliedro 🤣. https://youtu.be/rebhiX63s7k?si=R7jkxRl2NnQwkL2H To finish off, I must say that this piece isn’t as easy as I thought; I believed that, as a beginner on the instrument, my first piece would be ‘Los pollitos dicen’ or something similar. It was only after learning it and hearing about this piece that I realised it’s of intermediate difficulty, and guitarists will know exactly what I mean. I suppose the teacher wanted to set us a big challenge, but I almost gave up, as it was a real struggle for me; today I’ve been given the new piece and it’s even harder and more complicated, so, as the saying goes, we’ll see how it goes. I loved the experience of playing something on the guitar; I like it more with every passing day; I just hope I have the perseverance and discipline to achieve agility and dexterity with this instrument. I’m grateful for the opportunity I’ve been given in this section of the orchestra and to you for your support with this post.
![IMG-20260327-WA0031.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/soyunasantacruz/23zS2xG8g43nzDEFDfhHmTwKBcYxik2sqqxMC3UGPdweHYRRTqmHRnFARBznrY6G8qXTD.jpg)
###
Had you heard this piece before? What did you think of it?

links.title: NON-SPEAKING AUTISM AND THE FIGHT TO COMMUNICATE
links.body:
by Del Bigtree on The Highwire 
View my bio on Vigilante.TV: https://vigilante.tv/c/the_highwire [![NON-SPEAKING AUTISM AND THE FIGHT TO COMMUNICATE](https://vigilante.tv/lazy-static/previews/e6f385bf-fd5c-4a6e-bb5c-2ec7685e838f.jpg)](https://vigilante.tv/w/rAcvAEqYNSEAwddwBSzdum) 
 
 Non-speaking autism advocate, Elizabeth Bonker, and Dawnmarie Gaivin, founder of the Spellers Freedom Foundation, join Del to challenge one of the most entrenched assumptions in autism care: that individuals who cannot speak also lack the ability to think or understand. Through spelling-based communication, many non-speakers are now demonstrating that their silence may stem from motor planning challenges, not intellectual disability.

Bonker, who communicates by spelling, graduated as valedictorian of Rollins College and now serves on the federal Interagency Autism Coordinating Committee (IACC). Her story illustrates how non-speaking individuals can possess rich cognitive abilities that often go unrecognized when speech is treated as the only measure of intelligence.

Gaivin explains how spelling-based communication methods are helping non-speakers access education, express complex thoughts, and participate more fully in society. Together, they are advocating for broader recognition of spelling as a legitimate form of communication and pushing for schools, therapists, and policymakers to presume competence and expand communication access for non-speaking individuals with autism. 
 ***
[**Check out today's video..!**](https://vigilante.tv/w/rAcvAEqYNSEAwddwBSzdum)

links.title: 让努力成为惯性
links.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![osGwTw3VVI15vDKr_mmexport1775835469111.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/lenalu/images/osGwTw3VVI15vDKr_mmexport1775835469111/osGwTw3VVI15vDKr_mmexport1775835469111.webp)
![BItdx2RMiSvYEt4T_mmexport1775835448100.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/lenalu/images/BItdx2RMiSvYEt4T_mmexport1775835448100/BItdx2RMiSvYEt4T_mmexport1775835448100.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

今天跟孩子们聊了一个很有意思的现象，叫做行为惯性。
很多同学都有这种感觉：一旦认真学进去了，就能一直学下去；可一旦偷懒不想动，就越歇越懒，越懒越不想动。
 
这个道理，就跟推小车一样。
刚开始推的时候特别费劲，可一旦推起来了，就轻松多了😂；
但要是停下来，再想重新启动，又得费好大劲儿啦。
 
为什么会这样呢？
第一，做任何事，开头都要先克服心里的不想做和不愿意。可一旦开始了，后面就顺了，没那么费劲。
第二，人一旦专心做一件事，注意力就定在这儿了，不容易分心；可要是一直玩游戏、玩玩具，心思就散了，再想收回来学习就很难。
第三，我们还会自己给自己暗示。认真学一次，就会觉得自己能坚持，更愿意继续努力；可要是偷懒一次，就想再偷一次，慢慢就觉得自己不行，干脆不想努力了。
 
生活里这种例子也不少
刚开始写作业、看书特别难受，可熬过去十几分钟进入状态了，就能安心学很久。
早上醒了本来可以起床，多躺一会儿就更不想起，一直赖到没时间吃早餐快迟到。
作业拖着不做，越拖越不想做，越拖越慌，越慌越拖。
 
所以说，知道了行为是有惯性的。
我们更要学会用好这个惯性：
开头看起来很难，可一旦开始，坚持下去反而容易；
停下来虽然很容易，可一直懒散😂，再想重新振作就难多了。
 
最后也跟孩子们说：
别小看那小小的第一步，只要勇敢迈出去，慢慢就会进入状态，离自己的目标，也就越来越近了😂。

---

links.title: মুখে স্বাদ লেগে থাকার মত মচমচে বাঁধাকপির পাকোড়া।। Badhakopi  Pakora Recipe।। [BG-EG]।।
links.body:
![1000103870.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bornali/AKFAT3dE7yYStqZhaeTeLPBAXJCZa7MTYodkjYZciF34wkPasMiqNWwYjQnGwB2.jpg)

# BNG-ENG

# আসসালামু আলাইকুম। 

আশা করছি সবাই অনেক অনেক বেশি ভালো আছেন।আলহামদুলিল্লাহ আমিও ভাল আছি। আবারো ফিরে এলাম আপনাদের মাঝে নতুন একটি রেসিপি নিয়ে। আজকের রেসিপিতে থাকছে বাঁধাকপি পাকোড়া। আশা করছি আমার সহজ রেসিপিটি আপনাদের ভালো লাগবে। বাঁধাকপির পাকোড়া বাচ্চা থেকে শুরু করে বড় মানুষ সবাই অনেক পছন্দ করেন। খুবই মজাদার একটি নাস্তা। 

# Assalamu Alaikum.

I hope everyone is doing very well. Alhamdulillah I am also doing well. I am back with a new recipe for you. Today's recipe is Cabbage Pakora. I hope you will like my simple recipe. Cabbage Pakora is loved by everyone from children to adults. It is a very tasty snack.

এই বাঁধাকপির পাকোড়া রেসিপি তৈরি করতে আমাদের যে সকল উপকরণ লাগবে। 

# উপকরণ -

১.বাঁধাকপি, 
২.পেয়াজ কুচি, 
৩.কাঁচামরিচ, 
৪.ধনিয়া পাতা, 
৫.কনফ্লাওয়ার, 
৬.ময়দা, 
৭.লবণ, 
৮.হলুদ, 
৮.গোলমরিচের গুঁড়া, 
৯.সয়াবিন তেল, 
১০.আদা রসুন বাটা,
১১.একটা ডিম।  

All the ingredients we will need to make this cabbage pakora recipe.

# Ingredients -

1. Cabbage,
2. Chopped onion,
3. Green chilli,
4. Coriander leaves,
5. Cornflower,
6. Flour,
7. Salt,
8. Turmeric,
8. Black pepper powder,
9. Soybean oil,
10. Ginger garlic paste,
11. An egg.

![1000103865.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bornali/AKKU8i9JNFKV1CEZkS9T4eJ2Re7H8AdA8yKu1P7sndMVtbyrBv2five2ytViCAK.jpg)

# প্রস্তুত প্রণালী -

আমি বাঁধাকপি গুলোকে কুচিয়ে নিয়েছে মিডিয়াম সাইজে।এরপরে লবণ দিয়ে ভালো করে চটকিয়ে নিব। এতে করে বাঁধাকপি কুচিগুলা নরম হয়ে যাবে। আর পানি ছেড়ে দিবে।পানিগুলো চিপড়িয়ে সব ফেলে দিতে হবে। 

# Preparation method -

I have chopped the cabbage into medium size. Then I will grind it well with salt. This will make the cabbage pieces soft. And it will release water. I have to squeeze out all the water and throw it away.


![1000103866.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bornali/AK7zGvzdWjD8xuPr3cWxZJnKRU7BvtvTg4p5zjuK3cDADUCvS7ArReUfo3CMJnK.jpg)

# উপকরণ মিক্স -

বাঁধাকপির ভিতর সব উপকরণ গুলো একে একে দিয়ে দিব। শুধু সয়াবিন তেলটা বাদে। এবার হাত দিয়ে খুব ভালোভাবে ম্যাশ করে নিব। সবকিছু মাখিয়ে নেওয়ার পরে আঠালো একটা ভাব চলে এসেছে। এবার বড়ার মত সেভ করে নিব হাত দিয়ে চেপে চেপে। 

# Ingredients Mix -

I will add all the ingredients one by one inside the cabbage. Except for the soybean oil. Now I will mash it very well with my hands. After mixing everything, it will have a sticky texture. Now I will save it like a big ball and press it with my hands.

![1000103867.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bornali/AJkTiBcPcmq7wSQ5CBGnWtqp4juSBjf3YCLE8xj3WNxTTet2hJqxgF3pZLURGQG.jpg)

# রান্না শুরু -

চুলায় ফ্রাইপেন বসিয়ে পর্যাপ্ত পরিমাণে সয়াবিন তেল দিয়ে জ্বাল করে নিচ্ছি। অবশ্যই চুলার জ্বাল মিডিয়ামে রাখতে হবে। এবারে সব গুলো পাকোয়ারা দিয়ে দিচ্ছি। এপিটোপিট উল্টিয়ে পাল্টিয়ে নিব। যখন বাদামি কালার চলে আসবে তখনই মনে করতে হবে বাঁধাকপির পাকোড়া  কমপ্লিট। আমি সবগুলোকে একইভাবে ভেজে নিয়েছি। আলহামদুলিল্লাহ খুবই ভালো হয়েছে। 

# Start cooking -

I put a frying pan on the stove and heat it with sufficient amount of soybean oil. Of course, the stove heat should be kept on medium. Now I am adding all the pakoras. I will turn the epitope over and change it. When it turns brown, you should consider that the cabbage pakoras are complete. I fried them all in the same way. Alhamdulillah, it turned out very well.

![1000103868.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bornali/AK2F22UHASruLy4VFAoPtnGu2z31eVTwVnuBNKEU1cSADM1JADJtEwTh8ZSyqwg.jpg)

এতক্ষণ যারা আমার এই সহজ বাঁধাকপির পাকোড়া রেসিপিটি দেখেছেন তাদেরকে অসংখ্য ধন্যবাদ জানাই। 

আপনারা সকলে ভাল থাকবেন সুস্থ থাকবেন এই কামনা করে আজকের মত বিদায় নিচ্ছি,,
