links.title: THE FOOD CRISIS HIDING BEHIND THE IRAN CONFLICT
links.body:
by Del Bigtree on The Highwire 
View my bio on Vigilante.TV: https://vigilante.tv/c/the_highwire [![THE FOOD CRISIS HIDING BEHIND THE IRAN CONFLICT](https://vigilante.tv/lazy-static/previews/e3727454-35f6-49cf-9a94-845958d98962.jpg)](https://vigilante.tv/w/2E8NqYMG1MCMJoeTBZyYPb) 
 
 Rising tensions tied to the Strait of Hormuz are sending shockwaves far beyond the battlefield, with global energy and fertilizer markets now under mounting pressure. Jefferey explores how disruptions linked to the Iran conflict are threatening critical supply chains that underpin modern agriculture, highlighting the fragile “just-in-time” global economy that millions depend on. With roughly one-third of the world’s fertilizer trade moving through this narrow passage, even minor instability is already translating into higher input costs and growing uncertainty for farmers worldwide. 

Hear how rising oil prices and constrained fertilizer exports, particularly from major producers like Russia and China, are creating a ripple effect across global food production. As energy costs surge, so too do the expenses tied to planting, harvesting, and transporting crops, with staples like corn at the center of the impact. Because corn is foundational to the U.S. and global food system—affecting everything from cereals to livestock feed—any sustained price increase has the potential to cascade across nearly every aisle of the grocery store. 

Compounding the issue, countries heavily reliant on imported energy are beginning to declare emergencies and prioritize domestic supply, signaling the early stages of a broader global resource squeeze. From Southeast Asia to Europe, tightening reserves and export restrictions are accelerating fears of prolonged shortages. At the same time, U.S. farmers are already adapting by shifting acreage away from fertilizer-intensive crops like corn toward alternatives such as soybeans—an early indicator of how geopolitical conflict can directly reshape agricultural strategy and output. 

Framed through the lens of long-term economic and societal impact, they highlight a critical warning: when energy and fertilizer markets destabilize, food security is never far behind. As the Iran conflict continues to evolve, the risk of sustained inflation, disrupted harvest cycles, and global supply imbalances raises urgent questions about resilience, preparedness, and how quickly interconnected crises can escalate into worldwide consequences.

links.title: The Initiate's Rune Quest - Fantasy Fiction
links.body: ![caveRune.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/raj808/23wgDAE1ZN8etCgFJGnvzsxVKPMxbKKMJBuARVZbwyv6PyqGypfct63KRUtVBZECP7YiU.png)<sub>Digital art made using Image by <a href=\

>Pixabay ___ Kelverirn shivered in the damp cave, heart beating loud in his chest while his head swam with the reality of what he was about to do.  The trail of acolytes wound along the path, sloping up into the dark reaches of the cave.   The pallor of his fellow acolytes assured him he wasn’t alone in his fears.  Even giant Ethurdan seemed subdued as he paced slowly behind Elestar.  Kelverirn liked the man, the only Dimursveldian among the group. He had a slow and patient way about him and, despite his people’s fierce reputation, never used this to his advantage. Penigar was currently at war with Dimursveld but Elestar maintained it was not his choice who he trained. If a student could reach the isle of Helisan, then he would receive initiation.   Kelverirn nodded at the big man as he drew alongside him.  The sound of laughter echoed with the pounding of water in the darkness.    “What d’you think that was?” Kelverirn cocked his head at the darkness above them. The large Dimursveldian merely shrugged, his eyes darting from shadow to shadow. They slowed their pace in unison, but Elestar seemed not to notice. He walked tall with a measured gait as if he was strolling through the gardens of Helisan on a summer’s day. The glare of the torches flickered menacingly off his balding head and the flow of his deep green robe merged with the swirling water. He led us up to the wall at the back of the cave, where a smaller second waterfall sprouted from the wall.   Kelverirn thought he caught a movement up and to his left. He glanced up at a slick, dull stalactite.  Two golden eyes stared down, and the laughter rang out again as the creature moved its head back and forth to get the best view. It was green, slimy, and curiously lizard-like. Its scaly body suddenly faded into a white misty form that wrapped itself around the stalactite.    “What Demon is this?” Devlin stuttered. The small man was backing away as he spoke, his rich fur cloak tangling around his knees. A ghost-like naked woman caressed the stalactite, but before Kelverirn could study it further, it shifted back into a lizard, its tongue flickering questioningly. Devlin fell backward into the water with a splash, his cloak now fully tangled about his legs.    Elestar chuckled as his arm snapped out to grasp the flailing Devlin. “You forget your lessons, master Devlin. This is no Demon but a Shrimin that is here to feed. With such an abundance of prey, I suppose I should have expected it.”   He clapped his hands, snapping us all out of our separate reveries. “Remember, it feeds off your unconscious desires. You must ignore it. It will sap your strength, which you need for the trials ahead.”   Elistar stepped up to the rushing water and, as he plunged his hands in, let out a low guttural croak. There were words in that sound, but Kelverirn couldn’t distinguish them. The old sorcerer turned, his hands pulsing with a clear light that illuminated the cave. The Shrimin dived from its stalactite perch into the cascading water, its tail finally wiggling from view.   The acolytes stood like stone, all gripped with the same indecision. Kelverirn felt something well up in him. It was like a force was gripping him, willing him forwards. It felt like he was falling. He staggered forwards and realised he had not been breathing. He drank in deep breaths before he bent his head to Elestar’s cupped hands.    The water glowed a fierce golden hue as Kelverirn lent in and took a tentative mouthful. It choked him painfully as he swallowed, before receding into heavy warmth, which spread slowly throughout his body.   His chest glowed through his shirt and the material itched immensely. He stripped off as the others stepped forward to take mouthfuls of the pure sun water. They turned to regard his glowing chest in wonder and shock.   Kelverirn looked down at himself, fear mounting in him like a fever, as his body faded into a misty outline. He felt like he was losing himself. His identity was being siphoned away with his corporeal form. His head pounded until he thought he couldn’t stand it. He stared at his comrades. Some vomited as they faded, their arms or legs becoming fleshy once again, as they expelled the sun water from their bodies.  Elistar said nothing, just kept feeding them from his cupped hands until the retching stopped.   Kelverirn concentrated on keeping his stomach steady and slowly the panic faded. He regained a measure of control. He felt he had some idea of himself again.   Elestar led them quickly back to the mouth of the cave and the thunder of the main waterfall. He was insubstantial now, although he kept his clothes or a shadow of his clothes. He beckoned them to follow as he walked into the falls. Kelverirn walked forwards fearless now, this was what they’d trained years for, the journey into magic.    The water passed straight through him, a world of golden motes that pierced the background swirl of colour. They ranged from deep, regal purple to kelp green. After a time, he felt the sensation of heat again. He was on fire but there was no pain. The motes of light flashed faster now, and he glimpsed some meaning in the pattern, yet it remained elusive, like a dream upon waking. He saw Elestar pass by him and followed tentatively through the gateway into Elintarn.  ![cave-6487213_1920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/raj808/23wgL5gGs9qEBsrG3w2z52XiW7xNGwtkmJC9KUqsP3MCKCbU9HGozYL9vqqyr7rXi9vmh.jpg)Image by

>Pixabay Golden light faded into a pulse that expanded. He stared ahead as the pulse became a current of soft water carrying him along. In the distance, he could see Elestar beckoning him with a dark and wrinkled finger. The crystal torrent suddenly dumped him in the clearest pool of water Kelverirn had ever seen.  A pale blue sky that looked like someone had painted it onto an indistinguishable background stretched to a horizon of green forest boughs. Kelverirn spotted Elestar on the bank a short distance away, staring off into the distance. All colours in this place were sharp as the essence of dreams. Emerald forests towered to the distant black sky, the spirit of trees grown in the dawn of time. Suddenly the black clouds shifted, and an azure blue broke through. It made Kelverirn’s heart soar as the foul murk of the skies cleared. The crystal lake he stood in stretched to the edge of the forest, mirroring the vivid colours that seemed to pierce Kelverirn like a dagger.   Kelverirn stepped forwards through the clear water, the world rippling in unison with his measured steps. He looked up from the reflective surface of the pool and saw that the trees were swaying, as the sky swirled with each step into the dark water. He stopped as his stomach lurched struck dumb, mesmerised by the receding sway of trees and swirl of sky. This tranquillity settled through his body calming his upset stomach. He knew he had found his place. This perfect moment of stillness caught between water and sky.   Elestar gestured at Kelverirn frantically motioning him out of the pool. He blinked his eyes, watching his eyebrows combing lines into the sky that crested into waves that washed across that blue expanse.   A watery form rose out of the pool. It was roughly his size and shape, with no discernible features on its flat liquid face. It drifted closer, raising its hand and Kelverirn watched helplessly as his arm moved upwards, shifting and shimmering as it changed. His eyes widened in horror as his arm collapsed into a splash of water, hitting him full in the face, before running down his quaking body.  He glanced to the side at Elestar who was pounding his chest, his whole torso shining golden through his ghost clothes. Kelverirn tried to move his remaining right arm, but it was dead. Instinctively, he tried with his left, despite the obvious futility of the action. As tears rimmed his eyes, he noticed a feeling of tingling warmth in his chest. Instinctively, he moved his non-existent arm to his chest again and watched the strong golden warmth burst through his skin. It brought him strength and a measure of calm in this otherworldly place.   Kelverirn almost faltered as he considered what he was doing logically. He could feel his left arm, but there was nothing to see. He looked at his adversary and stepped forwards. His watery doppelgänger winced each time his chest pulsed and slowly, from the shoulder downwards, it drew water up Kelverirns body from the crystal pool. As this aqueous arm formed, the doppelganger’s left arm grew flesh and bone. The creature grimaced in disgust at its new appendage.   Suddenly, everything became clear to Kelverirn, he acted on pure instinct, reaching into his chest with his watery arm withdrawing his heart clenched tight in a pulsing golden fist. He rushed forwards stomping through the water; the world wrenching back and forth with his furious dash. He hit the creature and a geyser of orange golden sun water erupted around and through him. The world around him slowed its frantic swaying ripple.   Kelverirn stared down into the water at a forlorn object floating a few feet away. His arm bobbed in the lapping water and burned into his wrist was a black rune.   “Pick up your arm” Elestar’s brow furrowed as he spoke to the young man gently.    “It’s not as bad as it looks.  Many of the ills Of Elintarn can be healed with time and patience. Remember, magic is a dream. We practitioners simply enter the realm of dreams and win our runes from the creations of all human consciousness.”   He shrugged as if the last hour had been nothing more than a wander through the streets of Penigar to buy a pastry from the local bakery.   “You were lucky to encounter the spirit of the lake, the dream of drowning.” Elestar’s wrinkled face broke into a wide smile; the first time Kelverirn had ever seen the old sorcerer’s face change from its dour countenance.   “And to defeat it while still in the lake, impressive young acolyte.” The old sorcerer placed his hand gently on Kelverirn’s shoulder, guiding him to the shore and out of the dark water. “These creatures are simply a thousand iterations of the one soul dreaming itself anew endlessly. We build them from all our desires, dreams, and consciousness. You did well and fought almost a perfect battle“   “You won your rune well. Now comes the hard work. Discovering its power and how to control it.”   The End.   Thanks for reading ☘️

links.title: Uang dari Review Game: Jadi Kritikus Kaya
links.body:
Uang dari Review Game: Jadi Kritikus Kaya
Dunia gaming tidak hanya melahirkan pro player dan streamer, tetapi juga profesi lain yang tak kalah menjanjikan: kritikus game atau reviewer. Dengan kemampuan menulis, analisis, dan komunikasi yang baik, seorang gamer bisa menghasilkan uang dari review game. Profesi ini semakin populer seiring meningkatnya minat masyarakat terhadap konten gaming di YouTube, blog, maupun media sosial.

![game](https://img.freepik.com/premium-photo/man-thinking-strategy-game_249974-1219.jpg)

**Uang dari Review Game: Jadi Kritikus Kaya**

nagaspin99 [slot](https://www.challenghair-paris.com/clinique-greffe-cheveux) adalah link [situs slot](https://www.challenghair-paris.com/clinique-greffe-cheveux) gacor hari ini yang menyajikan permainan terbaru serta gampang menang didukung layanan bandar resmi anti kalah dan bonus promo menarik.


**1. Mengapa Review Game Bernilai?**
Review game memberikan informasi penting bagi pemain sebelum mereka memutuskan untuk membeli atau mencoba sebuah game. Kritik yang jujur dan analisis mendalam membantu audiens memahami kualitas gameplay, grafis, cerita, hingga sistem monetisasi. Karena itu, review game memiliki nilai komersial tinggi dan sering dicari oleh publisher maupun pembaca.

**2. Sumber Penghasilan dari Review Game**
Menjadi kritikus game bisa membuka banyak jalur penghasilan:

- Iklan YouTube atau Blog: Review game yang ditonton banyak orang bisa dimonetisasi melalui iklan.

- Sponsor dan Endorsement: Brand gaming, hardware, atau publisher sering bekerja sama dengan reviewer untuk promosi.

- Affiliate Marketing: Menyertakan link pembelian game atau perangkat gaming bisa menghasilkan komisi.

- Konten Premium: Reviewer bisa membuat konten eksklusif di Patreon atau membership channel.

- Media Gaming: Menulis untuk portal berita atau majalah gaming juga bisa memberikan honor tetap.

**3. Kunci Sukses Jadi Kritikus Game**
Untuk bisa menghasilkan uang dari review game, ada beberapa strategi penting:

- Konsistensi Konten: Upload review secara rutin agar audiens terbiasa.

- Analisis Mendalam: Jangan hanya menilai grafis, tetapi juga gameplay, cerita, dan pengalaman pemain.

- Gaya Bahasa Menarik: Gunakan bahasa yang mudah dipahami dan menghibur agar review tidak membosankan.

- Kejujuran: Review yang jujur akan membangun kepercayaan audiens.

- SEO dan Promosi: Optimalkan judul, deskripsi, dan tag agar review mudah ditemukan di mesin pencari.

**4. Platform untuk Review Game**
Ada banyak platform yang bisa digunakan untuk menyebarkan review game:

- YouTube: Video review dengan gameplay langsung.

- Blog atau Website: Artikel panjang dengan analisis detail.

- TikTok: Review singkat dan cepat untuk audiens muda.

- Podcast: Diskusi santai tentang game terbaru.

Dengan memanfaatkan berbagai platform, reviewer bisa menjangkau audiens lebih luas dan meningkatkan peluang cuan.

**5. Tantangan Menjadi Kritikus Game**
Meski menjanjikan, profesi ini juga memiliki tantangan:

- Persaingan Ketat: Banyak reviewer lain dengan konten serupa.

- Tekanan Sponsor: Kadang sponsor menginginkan review positif, sehingga reviewer harus menjaga integritas.

- Update Cepat: Dunia game selalu berubah, sehingga reviewer harus sigap mengikuti tren.

Namun, dengan dedikasi dan kreativitas, tantangan ini bisa diatasi.

**Kesimpulan**
Menjadi kritikus game adalah salah satu cara kreatif untuk menghasilkan uang dari dunia gaming. Dengan kemampuan analisis, komunikasi, dan konsistensi, seorang gamer bisa menjadikan review game sebagai profesi yang menguntungkan. Dari iklan, sponsor, hingga affiliate marketing, peluang cuan terbuka lebar. Dunia gaming kini bukan hanya soal bermain, tetapi juga soal menulis, mengkritik, dan berbagi pengalaman.

[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1775834781018-6404231f2d657ed7.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=favourstrings/0a96cf73)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=favourstrings/0a96cf73)


---

Hello everyone I welcome you all to hive open mic week 313

I am favourstrings and today I will be sharing a medley of 2 worship songs.

There’s something about worship that undoes me, and these two songs in this medley especially pull me right out of myself and plant me at the feet of God.

The first one is pure reverence. Every time those lyrics hit — _\

_ — I literally feel myself go weak. It takes me off my feet. Not physically, but in my spirit. I’m reminded that no matter what’s happening in my life, in Nigeria, or in the world, there’s a throne that’s never shaken. A Kingdom that doesn’t expire. The “Ancient of Days” part humbles me. It reminds me I’m worshipping the same God Abraham, David, and my grandmother called on. When I sing it, I’m not just making music; I’m joining a sound that’s already happening in heaven. \n\nThen the song shifts, and so does my posture. The second one is my surrender: _\

_ If the first song is me bowing, this one is me standing up and saying “yes” with shaky faith. It’s the cry I pray when life feels too deep or the next step looks impossible. It’s me asking God to stretch my trust beyond what’s comfortable, beyond what my bank account, my fears, or my logic says is safe. Every time I sing “walk upon the waters,” I’m choosing to believe that if He calls, He’ll also carry.

Putting them together as a medley tells my whole story: awe first, then obedience. You can’t truly say “lead me” until you’ve seen who’s leading. You bow, then you walk.

That’s exactly why I want to perform this cover for *Hive Open Mic Week 313*. Open Mic isn’t just a stage to me — it’s an altar we all gather around from different countries, time zones, and stories. And Week 313 feels like the right moment to pour this out. I don’t just want to showcase vocals. I want to create a space where someone else watching from their phone in Abuja, Accra, or Argentina can feel taken off their feet too, and then find the courage to walk on water in their own life.

I’ve been rehearsing this medley in my quiet time for weeks. Sometimes I break down mid-verse because the words are praying me more than I’m singing them. So sharing it on Hive Open Mic is my way of giving it back. To God first, and then to a community that understands what it means to worship without borders.

Song lyrics 

Every tongue in heaven and earth shall declare your glory every kneel shall bow at your throne in worship you are exalted oh God and your kingdom shall not pass away oh ancient of days 

2:
Spirit lead me where my fit is without borders help me walk up on the waters when ever you will call me 
Take me deeper than my feet will ever wonder in the prent of my Savior...

---

▶️ [3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=favourstrings/0a96cf73)

links.title: Transform Your Medical Office with a Healthcare Virtual Assistant
links.body:
Running a medical office today is more than just treating patients. It involves managing appointments, handling billing, organizing records, and responding to patient inquiries. These tasks can quickly become overwhelming for doctors and staff. This is where a [Healthcare Virtual Assistant](https://virtualmedicalassistant.us/) can make a big difference, helping medical offices operate more smoothly while improving patient care and overall efficiency.



***



## Understanding Modern Medical Office Challenges

Medical offices face increasing pressure due to rising patient numbers and administrative tasks.
Balancing patient care with paperwork often leads to stress and reduced efficiency.



***



## What Is a Healthcare Virtual Assistant?

A healthcare virtual assistant is a remote professional trained to handle administrative duties.
They support medical teams by managing tasks online, reducing in-office workload.



***



## Streamlining Daily Operations

Daily operations in a medical office include scheduling, documentation, and communication.
Virtual assistants help organize these tasks, making workflows faster and smoother.



***



## Improving Appointment Scheduling

Scheduling errors can lead to missed appointments and unhappy patients.
Virtual assistants ensure bookings are accurate and reminders are sent on time.



***



## Enhancing Patient Communication

Good communication builds trust between patients and healthcare providers.
Virtual assistants handle calls, emails, and follow-ups efficiently.



***



## Reducing Administrative Workload

Administrative tasks can take up a large portion of a healthcare provider’s day.
Virtual assistants take over repetitive duties, freeing up valuable time.



***



## Boosting Office Productivity

A well-organized office leads to better productivity and fewer delays.
Virtual assistants help staff stay focused on their core responsibilities.



***



## Managing Medical Records Efficiently

Keeping patient records updated is essential for quality care.
Virtual assistants ensure records are organized, accurate, and easily accessible.



***



## Simplifying Billing and Insurance Processes

Billing and insurance tasks can be complex and time-consuming.
Virtual assistants help reduce errors and speed up these processes.



***



## Supporting Telehealth Services

Telehealth is becoming an important part of healthcare delivery.
Virtual assistants help manage virtual appointments and patient coordination.



***



## Cost-Effective Staffing Solution

Hiring full-time staff can be expensive for many practices.
Virtual assistants offer a flexible and affordable alternative.



***



## Helping Small Practices Grow

Small clinics often struggle with limited resources and staff.
Virtual assistants provide the support needed to expand and compete.



***



## Adapting to Digital Healthcare Trends

Healthcare is increasingly relying on digital tools and systems.
Virtual assistants are trained to use these technologies effectively.



***



## Flexible Work Support

Virtual assistants can work based on the needs of the medical office.
This flexibility ensures support is available during busy hours.



***



## Real-Life Benefits for Medical Offices

Many offices experience improved efficiency after hiring virtual assistants.
This leads to better patient satisfaction and smoother operations.



***



## Career Awareness for Students

Students in the U.S. can learn a lot from this growing trend.
It shows how technology and healthcare are working together.



***



## Growing Demand Across the United States

Healthcare providers are increasingly adopting virtual assistant services.
This demand is driven by the need for efficiency and cost savings.



***



## Location-Based Hiring Choices

Even though virtual assistants work remotely, some practices prefer specific locations.
For example, many clinics choose to [hire virtual assistant new york](https://virtualmedicalassistant.us/virtual-assistant-new-york/) to align with local regulations and time zones.



***



## Challenges to Consider

There can be concerns about data security and communication gaps.
However, proper tools and training can help overcome these challenges.



***



## Choosing the Right Virtual Assistant

Selecting the right assistant is important for long-term success.
Skills, reliability, and communication should be key considerations.



***



## The Future of Medical Offices

Medical offices will continue to evolve with new technologies.
Virtual assistants will play a major role in shaping this future.



***



## Building a Patient-Focused Environment

With fewer administrative burdens, providers can focus more on patients.
This improves care quality and strengthens patient relationships.



***



## Conclusion

Healthcare virtual assistants are transforming medical offices in powerful ways.
They reduce workload, improve efficiency, and enhance patient experience.
As healthcare continues to evolve, their importance will only grow stronger.
Understanding their role can help students prepare for future opportunities.

---

Full Metal Ox Day 1867
Friday 10, April 2026
Abundance Year Episode 1932
Noxsoma Life Camp:  

TGI Friday Fam, 

Are you ready for some weekend? 

Last day of April Sweeps & New Audio. I think it’s pretty deep. Like, quick-sand deep. 

April Sweeps did its job. We attracted a few more free-spirits to the show across platforms. We have a few metaphors for these “channels.” (Is this another water-inspired word)? One of our earliest metaphors is, “Mind Cafe.” A small obscure chain, with maybe 8 to 10 locations. Some of these locations used to be popular. We would attract more “business.” You probably haven’t heard of most of the locations where our Mind Cafes are set up. (We even have a few YouTube locations, but they are rated G. Whiz.) 

Anyway, both “Acceptable Delusions” and The Cosmic Game deserve more thought. Which we are more than happy to share.  

But let’s get to what’s new.  

Another benefit of this ten-day sweep was time to think and imagine how to respond to some viewer requests, while maintaining our daily commitment, keeping it fun, and not burning out.  

“We have an angle.”  

That groove starts tomorrow and the next level is scheduled for next week.  

There’s a theory in advertising, if one person expresses and idea, than a thousand others are thinking about the same idea. This theory predates the commercial internet. It’s probably more like ten, or 50,000 these days. We can see it on social media. One analyst says, “choke point,” next thing you know, damn-near every talking head is saying, “choke point.” There are a thousand more examples of a thousand “alleged humans,” bots and algos, echoing the same “talking points” and language. 

Except when it comes to, “self programming,” “sovereign mindsets,” “fiscal accountability,” and making it through the perma-crisis era. 

We, The Trinity, are very excited about the future. Magic happens every day. Strength happens every day. Abundance manifests, every day.

Welcome to April Sweeps.  Day 10. 

The Cosmic Game is infinite. Even as we were wrapping up this series, we found that the Trinity was still observing examples of the Cosmic Game. Where we, as humans, and Our Collective go wrong, is getting entangled in the examples that we come up with. 
Have you ever heard of Nassim Haramein? Here are his credentials in brief. 
Nassim Haramein is a physicist, researcher, and speaker who has discovered connections in physics, mathematics, geometry, cosmology, and more. He founded the Resonance Science Foundation and Torus Tech, and developed ARK crystals and quantum vacuum energy technologies.  
He’s one of these folk I used to listen to early in the century. He was talking about being a rebellious physics student and how the professors were explaining how the Universe expands and contracts, like a balloon. The physicists had all of their mathematical calculation written on the board and opened up the floor for questions. 
Nassim, (according to himself), gets up and draws a picture of a man blowing up a balloon and asked, “what’s the equation for this guy?” 
That perplexed me for a very long time. I thought it was both funny and clever. Back then, I just accepted it as being an accurate account, but now I’m not so sure. Regardless, it stuck with me. And I think about it every time I make an attempt to “explain” concepts like the “Cosmic Game.” 
Everything is everything. Nothing is nothing. All truths are half truths. Contradictions lie within truth. The ourorboros is allegorical. It symbolizes infinity, eternity, the unending everything. Humans see a picture of a snake eating its own tale. I’ve never seen or heard of a snake doing this. 
The professor in Nassim’s story, described the Universe as a balloon. It’s often described as “breathing.” Your humble vagabond doesn’t even know whether a physical universe even exists, let alone whether or not it’s expanding. I guess Nassim’s question was essentially, Why? What makes it expand and contract? If it even does. 

Anyway, there are two things that inevitably happen when We attempt to align metaphysical concepts with language and metaphors. We fail. And we fail again. 

We are doomed to failure from the beginning because Universe is “literally,” ineffable, unknowable, indescribable and unshrinkable. Nonetheless, “as above, so below.” We know neither. 
The second failure is getting trapped in my own physical example. How quickly the example of randomly acting, and changing chess pieces, boards, levels, layers and directions dissolve into an impossible challenge. Who would want to play? But that’s exactly, more or less, what the Cosmic Game is. More, in that we never know what’s coming. Even a box of chocolates is more predictable that daily life. Less, because there are some constants. Some physical “laws” that we can count on, in a “normal” state of being, That is, within the vibrations of the Schumann resonance, with the abilities of our common senses, we should be reasonably confident that we won’t be randomly flung off of the planet. We won’t sink endlessly into the ground and emerge somewhere in China. We won’t spontaneously burst into flames. We will recognize the face looking back at our self in the mirror. We will remember our loved ones, our way to work, how to do our job, and if not the names of every colleague, at least one the ones that can impact our future. 
“Cosmos” means everything. Cosmos is cosmos. Brahma is Brahma. There is nothing that is not Brahma. Insert your favorite word. Universe. God. Source. The Matrix. The simulation. Life. Within that everything is Us. Within Us is that everything. What Us perceives, Us calls, “reality.” This is the essence of the Game. It’s fun, it’s frustrating and finally, it’s fruitless. It ends the same way for everyone. No one gets out alive and you can’t take your goodies with you. Arguably, however, you can retain the most powerful emotion-charged memories, even if they manifest in drizzly drops of deja vu that tease your dreams.

body.title: A Simple Birthday, A Beautiful Memory: Our Mini Adventure in Elsterwerda
body.body:
![1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/macaroth90/AKVVAGWw5qxCnrthbgeCXgUoy4JB7NwaBnFNGrmmbunyiXU6bQCswMa5fXJVfFq.png)

Hello guys,😉

Today, I am sharing our recent visit to a miniature park in Elsterwerda, Germany also called \

. On this day, we celebrated my daughter’s 7th birthday.

It was a simple celebration for her. In the morning, I made pancakes and bought some Easter donuts, then placed seven candles on top of them. After breakfast, we surprised her with gifts.

It was just a simple morning with breakfast and a small surprise, but in her eyes, it was already a big reason to be grateful. I could clearly see how happy she was with the presents she received.

After that, we drove to the miniature park. It took about 1 hour and 30 minutes from where we live—just the right travel time for a simple and fun little adventure.

Here are a few glimpses of the miniature castles, schools, towers, city halls, churches, and some kids’ activities inside the park.

There is still so much more to see—especially the miniature buildings that I wish I had been able to capture—but for now, let me share some of the beautiful and intricate “big-little” creations that Elsterwerda has to offer.

![20260403_133145.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/macaroth90/242DESjeUGgcpYVNGq8uSntca3pbE8g8hQLvWNTNuRWG77TdwSrHfVPJTtBMLoQrToeTT.jpg)
These miniature buildings are exact replicas of old historical buildings from all over Brandenburg, a state in northeastern Germany.

The miniature park is located in Elsterwerda, a town in the Elbe-Elster district in southwestern Brandenburg, Germany.

![20260403_133021.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/macaroth90/23vhyjGWpx89vnn2wkjokt8uqJmvw6sw8qipE4j3e2J3Acgko6Q57jtW1PUQRRMfajpiW.jpg)
this is the famous State Theatre of Cottbus.  It has its own ensemble presenting plays, operas, operettas, musicals, orchestral concerts and ballet.

![20260403_130543.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/macaroth90/244xuPvmK3d3gzHtM7kozS8LPSYj5EpVzCveKgvgn19YLMq8PUzCiDt2T1cqeeYjVmtq7.jpg)
This post mill is a technical monument located in the eastern industrial area of the Brandenburg town of Elsterwerda, in close proximity to the Miniature and Adventure Park established in 2007, not far from the Black Elster River.

It is the last remaining post mill in the town. Inside, there is an exhibition featuring containers, products, and tools used in the everyday operations of the mill.

![4.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/macaroth90/AKzAuuaF4bcKgchvfKywPegRHa3wRdD4kWLXsJ6RNGSZbz5XbHbNczXUU4BSQ6p.png)

![2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/macaroth90/AKRAsFBFaf6tttnEJGcAWKgbGKLSzB8rLyKsiH6yLx8oXM2kY87QwrJFJaNRFRE.png)

![3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/macaroth90/AKZmthGj9aFaxKmJztrztRPuEAZ3bfiojNyXSLMS7SyfrxhYeUvWDgsraAxEHnS.png)
And of course, there were many other things to do inside the park.

There is a park railway with a 680-meter track that tours the miniature landscape. Sadly, we were not able to ride the train. As much as we wanted to stay longer, the cold weather was already telling us it was time to go home.

There were still so many more attractions to explore, like the playgrounds and active play areas. One highlight is the adventure knight’s castle, which includes climbing walls, slides, a sandpit, a jumping castle, a trampoline, and even a “path of senses.”

There is also the Rennstrecke & Go-Karts—a 170-meter Mini-Lausitzring for model cars and a separate track for children’s go-karts. My daughter had so much fun riding one of the small go-karts. It was actually quite funny to watch because she has a typical Filipina size, so she could only ride the smaller carts—her legs are still too short for the bigger ones 😁

For nature lovers, there are beautiful gardens, including a rosarium with over 750 types of roses, a bonsai park, a fruit orchard, and even a maze. There are also animal enclosures, such as a petting zoo, a bird and pheasant aviary, and a squirrel enclosure.

The park also offers indoor and outdoor restaurants, serving typical German snacks like different varieties of sausages and fries like Bockwurst mit Pommes (sausage with fries). We tried Fischstäbchen mit Pommes (fish sticks with fries), which comes with unlimited dips in three options: mayonnaise, mustard, and ketchup. They also have crêpes, sandwiches, and ice cream.

After enjoying our meal at the restaurant, we drove back home and had some ice cream again as a little treat 😊

For those who would like to visit and fully enjoy this park, I recommend coming in the summer—probably between June and August.

As of now, the weather is still not very favorable for visiting. There are only a few animals to see, as many are still staying inside their shelters. Some flowers, like the roses, as well as the fruit orchards and bonsai plants, have not fully bloomed yet during this spring season.

Otherwise, here is the map of the place for those who are curious and would like to explore this beautiful miniature park.

Thank you so much for visiting my blog. Until next time! 🌸

body.title: 慢性子
body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![OdHAU74rih06mSCK_1000026313.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/muwangxuan/images/OdHAU74rih06mSCK_1000026313/OdHAU74rih06mSCK_1000026313.webp)
![LANvmjmTt56U11T9_1000026314.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/muwangxuan/images/LANvmjmTt56U11T9_1000026314/LANvmjmTt56U11T9_1000026314.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

我自己做事是个比较“慢性子”的人，在这个充满了快节奏的社会了，说实话，我这样的性格有时候真能给人急死。
尤其是在工作以后，我发现，绝大多数的中层领导都属于那种比较“急性子”的人。
做事情往往风风火火的，连走路似乎都带着风。
当然，到底做事是不是这样，那是另外一回事，但至少给人的感觉，就是如此。
因此，在踏入社会后，因为我这慢性子的节奏，可被好多领导一顿说教。
这导致我一直以为慢性子是不好的，直到后面随着我年纪的增大，家庭的决策权慢慢像我们这代人转移，我需要开始考虑更多以后，我才明白，有时候，慢也是快。
在公司里，或许不觉得，因为哪怕做错了，该有的工资还是有，相对而言是有兜底的，决策是上面的人做的，和执行的人没有关系，所以做事得风风火火，得提升效率，但是当做自己事情，需要自己去兜底的时候，就得考虑清楚，就得慢慢的来。
风风火火只能是做事，而不是做决策！
我们总说，谁谁谁，一拍脑门就决定要做啥了，然后最后他就做成了。
但问题这只是书面化的说法，落在现实里，哪怕他当时真的是脑子一热就决定了。
等夜深人静他还是会辗转反侧的思考，到底要不要继续，要不要继续的。
就和唐僧取经一样，不是说他脑子一热决定要去取经就是做了决策了，事实上，每时每刻他都得重新做决策。
这秒还决定要取，下秒路上遇见只老虎说不定就不取了，半路遇见女儿国人家让他别走了说不定他也就不取了。
这才是现实，脑子一热对于做事来说是构不成决策因素的，因为你脑子不可能一直热，情绪不可能一直上头。
始终会静下来，慢下来的。
因为你才是你决策的第一责任人。
毕竟：风险自担者，落子不易，尽己所能者，落子无悔。
在说回工作上，其实很多领导，也不一定有那么急性子，他们做自己事的时候，也一样是要磨磨蹭蹭的考虑半天。
所以呀，有时候工作上的风风火火，未必是风风火火，或许，那就只是一种表演罢了。
没办法，有的人天生演技好，有的人天生不会演……
那么你呢？

body.title: Is there any hope for us?
body.body:
*​A great civilization is not conquered from without until it has destroyed itself from within.*
**William James Durant**

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmThPWKwZnsd5idFkFTpUypnMfWz6uhSjpYpaBmafMQ4bQ/1775832312690.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWcYvjGqj1BEGbnkX66jS8WmTC6ye6p43LKMRpgJX7gHS/1775832288908.jpg)

This morning, when I woke up, I saw on the news that as of today, the full application of the EES (Entry/Exit System) check when entering and exiting the EU member states began at the borders of Serbia with the countries of the European Union.

That rule started in October last year, but those who travel will only now feel the complications and waiting for the full implementation of that decision.

In addition to us (who are here at the door of Europe), this rule also applies to all countries that are not members of the EU or members of the Schengen Agreement.
So those coming to Europe from GB, USA, AUS or JPN will have to wait.
And whether they travel by road, sea, rail, river or air traffic.
Waiting for the reading of fingerprints and face, will be waiting for all of us...
And that's why, although this morning we mentioned the plan for a short vacation in June, today, while I'm watching the news on TV with kilometer columns, I can't think about traveling.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmThPWKwZnsd5idFkFTpUypnMfWz6uhSjpYpaBmafMQ4bQ/1775832312690.png)

Rather, a darker topic comes to mind, how we are slowly sinking deeper and deeper into darkness, how our society is falling apart...
I've read a lot of great suggestions for #weekend-experiences and #weekend-engagement threads today  but the one that mentions empires is kind of in line with that decay, so I'd like to type a few of my thoughts into this post.

*Total failure - It happened to the Roman Empire, could it happen to our modern society?*

Nothing in this universe is eternal and everything ends sooner or later.
And so great civilizations, societies and empires have their own development, peak and decline.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmThPWKwZnsd5idFkFTpUypnMfWz6uhSjpYpaBmafMQ4bQ/1775832417817.png)

The Roman Empire, a giant that collapsed due to excessive border expansion, could not militarily defend all those conquered territories, and after 5 centuries of domination in this part of the world, it ended after decades of collapse.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNTGsYkcWSiXBEDQ3Cu2GxpwzF21EimThYz9yG2fbpjbE/1775832390237.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbqiUchKU9Ea6qn7iajkNc1o1kLj5NELX1U9QGyDrJESR/1775832390296.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc5Y3z9mgrY2g3j8ZeyU8gScVQzHQF5tcXEGb7ZGTd1vW/1775832390383.jpg)
*Roman forum*


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeq8Xj6FCLb7QFvy78b2fxYGVfVpz8dqZXPatpa4owmGi/1775833892706.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc7nz8Hv9zuHc8fQvPQdXxze9FJKzomwjaizrX3S9QMBu/1775833892795.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeaR3DKsRiBjHWP7THQLChVMtRMsyhxK56F2fQ5jq1hT1/1775833892868.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNM5HShLuq2SFMCW92ByEmVfFR4D6szB8wnc1b7hhaZ4L/1775832390540.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUaDhBE78nJH5AksVMnLjv8mbHN9iCGRDqBkDxPP3VNbs/1775832390470.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmThPWKwZnsd5idFkFTpUypnMfWz6uhSjpYpaBmafMQ4bQ/1775832417817.png)

The old Greek empire fell apart due to internal fratricidal wars between Athens and Sparta, when the exhausted states and cities were conquered by another empire, first Macedonian and then Roman.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmThPWKwZnsd5idFkFTpUypnMfWz6uhSjpYpaBmafMQ4bQ/1775832417817.png)

The empire that lived for millennia also ended due to internal conflicts and divisions in the priesthood and among the pharaohs. Egypt, which is the home of the pyramids, still today shows the world its greatness, and it is easy to imagine how big it really was three millennia ago.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmThPWKwZnsd5idFkFTpUypnMfWz6uhSjpYpaBmafMQ4bQ/1775832417817.png)

I read somewhere that the fate of great world powers and societies is not written in the stars, but in their ability to learn from the past.
However, according to their behavior and the events in the world today, it seems that those history books are lost somewhere.

\

someone will say. This can help modern society to overcome the crisis in which it finds itself today.
However, it seems to me that technological progress (and this AI that is all around us) leads to the loss of common values, and creates an even bigger gap between the rich and the poor, and corruption and scandals within the ruling elites, which are connected globally, depict the beginning of the downfall of modern society.
I don't know if there is still time for a total recovery and to stop the madness in the whole world, but I do know that if we continue on the path we are on now: accumulating wealth by killing nature and our planet as well as other human beings for something we do not need to survive, in addition to leaving intelligence and knowledge in the hands of artificial intelligence, human civilization will not be the same until the end of this century...

body.title: Yesterday's Survivors, Today's Victims: The Nigerian Tragedy.
body.body:
Nigeria is our home, it goes beyond just a place or location on the map. Nigeria is us, and we can't keep looking at ourselves going down the drain, we can't keep keeping quiet saying our hand is experiencing pain and for that reason it's no concern of ours, the hand is still a part of us. Nigeria is experiencing what's beyond pain at the moment and our silence is just too loud. 



![1000925283.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/AJoMCBohMpiVguLEfMqS1nZA8XudPVsHaWmyxwGyfnEdTbFGmaWHFpmz37GdyPx.png)




I've not been around for so long, but with my little age, I think I have few things to say, have we forgotten what the nation used to be like, have we forgotten those good old day's, what's going on, why are we so silent, why act as if it's non of our concern. We claim to love our dear nation, but it's starting to feel like we are lying and it's just a word of the mouth.. that holds no weight.



We should be tired of all these happenings, and if we are indeed tired of it all, the we won't be keep mute nor sit down at a place. I get angry at times seeing how silent we are, it amazes me to see how even those with massive influence keep shut, is it out of fear or what, if you keep quiet now because you don't want th government to come for you, what of those bandits that goes for people unprovoked, do you know the next place to be attacked. We are all not safe, why not speak up then, why not try call out to these people that need to be held accountable, they either do better, find a solution or step down.



But what do we do, we hear of another happening, we shake our heads, sigh and just continue with whatever we are doing. It's like we don't know what else we can do, we are helpless and still e keep quiet. Most annoying part is that we've now normalized pain. We say we are Nigerians and can fit into anywhere and survive anything, are we really surviving now, those that d!Ed too, they are surviving... right?




![1000925788.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23wWronyCwYSjzi8WqogwZpsce2goDHVaPkLPS5tozcZzhZXxbeQ3ZuUcQPvNRXLHfYM1.png)


I'm sure we saw the trending video of that woman in Jos the other day, we all see how she held in to her already de@d son as if 😩😭😩.. Can you just out yourself in her shoes for a minute. A child you carried in your wombs for months, the child you did your best to raise and then lose him to the cold hands of de@th just like that.. when we put ourselves in her situation, we will understand better. A lot of us was touched and was emotional then, but today we've moved in again, another  person elsewhere will be the victim again and it may not get to the internet or go viral like this woman's own... Until when are we going to continue like this...





What I'm saying is, these things will continue until we allow it. People are dy!ng, real humans, human beings are getting slaugh+red like animals, people are getting displaced from their homes, a lot is happening and we keep mute. We are not even talking about the high cost of food, fuel and all now, we are not talking about the low minimum wage, we are not talking about the high cost of transportation and house rent, because all those only count when we are alive. A lot of people are out there laughing out loud and all, but when they get in or are alone, they cry silently. Enough of the silence.




A lot of people have the platform, they have the connections and all, yet we do not even see them talking. I'm not sorry for saying this, a lot of our religious leaders are keeping quiet as well, and it ought not to be so, I just hope all those big cathedrals and millions of capacities of whatever they are busy building now won't turn empty/desolate in the next few years, because those who are supposed to come worship there are being k!lled and k!dnapped on a daily basis.




![1000925787.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23wWuAhScLthwHPijc1MUg8YkpAJpLx2hvwRs9fM7prdiV36ynCEizunZdkMSPNaGkAG8.png)



I talked about this just recently, I'm doing so again now, and will still talk about it again if need be. And I'm doing that because I understand these things. Sometimes last year my own blood brother was k!dnapped, I know the prayers we pray, the sleepless night's and all that we experienced as a family then, well he was later able to escape after few day's with them. That experience makes me understand things more, yet we have those that are still locked up somewhere till now. Do we need to be affected directly before we see that things are going on....?




As Randy Peter Akah will say, *\

* We shouldn't wait till it happens to us or to someone close to us. Today's survivors may become tomorrow's victim if we keep quiet, and you and I are today's survivors. I am not wishing you bad, neither am I wishing anyone bad, but the truth remains that...no one knows who is next.



Nigeria is crying, Nigeria is wailing, Nigeria is sick, and Nigerians are tired, we need help, we need voices to speak up, enough of ur silence, it won't do us any good, these people are only busy campaigning and sharing rice when families are getting displaced and k!lled on a daily... silence won't do us any good.





🌹

>


<center>
![IMG_2323.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/princessbusayo/23wqrsunmDfG1NX1Z6iTEsrCXTHEPPWSjbXafxd6vMT168WGCR7uVyqXHfyq1RTjxZcme.jpeg)
</center>


People usually define wealth as having enough money in your account to meet all your needs, plus big cars and mansions in your name. Once you have all these, you are considered “made for life.” But is that really the only way through which one can become rich?

Do you also know there are categories of people who have all these things yet still feel like they have nothing? They keep chasing more and more, and before they realise it, time is gone. There’s no time to take that vacation, no time to rest, no time to truly live and the like.

##### What if having less actually makes life lighter?

This is something I have come to accept for a long time. Because what is the use of having everything that is considered to make you rich, yet still lacking something within you? Having possessions cannot fill that quiet emptiness.

In my own way, having less reduces pressure. It means you don’t chase everything and you’re not competing with others. You are simply moving at your own pace, guided by what truly matters to you. This is where I am right now.

I don’t want to be in a position where I have it all and still feel heavy inside. I would rather live with less and feel lighter while still doing the things I love, as long as I still have the strength and the time. Because time is a precious thing, and if we are not careful, we may spend all of it chasing and have none left for living.

This is why I believe we need to be conscious and intentional about our daily lives. The idea that we must chase everything to be rich is an illusion. The truth is, having less does not mean one cannot be rich. It may actually be the very thing that qualifies true riches.


<center>
![IMG_2321.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/princessbusayo/23z7FbTdB2MCWjnwkR8mt9zeqjELHY6nDS3NB5vwRfF7JXyb2Fn5TEsC77yjyxqp3ZZ4w.jpeg)
</center>

Wealth, to me, is freedom, that is, the ability not to be controlled by bills, trends, or expectations. It is the kind of life that makes you choose what aligns with your values and not one dictated by pressure.

Wealth is also contentment. You don’t have to accumulate everything to be considered rich. Being satisfied with what you have, while still being able to enjoy simple pleasures that bring genuine joy is the ideal wealth.

I am not saying money is not important. Of course it is. Money provides comfort, meets needs, and creates opportunities. But it should not come at the expense of your peace of mind. As the scripture says, contentment is a great gain.

Take, for instance, someone earning ₦80k but living with peace and satisfaction may feel far richer than someone earning ₦500k who is constantly anxious, pressured, and restless. One has enough and is at peace; the other has more but is never at rest.

When you understand what wealth means, especially in this way, it changes how you earn. It means you don’t chase money desperately but instead choose work that gives you peace, purpose, and balance. In this way, one begins to value and appreciate time, rest, and meaning alongside income.

It also changes how you spend.

When it comes to spending, I love to be intentional about it. One of the ways I do this is by going for the necessary things and focusing on stuff that is mostly useful instead of trying to impress people. The question in my mind whenever I need to buy anything is, \

If the answer is no, I let it go.
![IMG_2455.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/princessbusayo/23uFcJYPbimPsvK2oyvLWZN6ub64o8J9USFLB3VSCWCFU2NvEB5rrDSDxJ9hymkisvRAr.jpeg)
Living this way as a minimalist has helped me in more ways than I imagined. It has helped me avoid comparison, reduce pressure, and enabled me to have control over my life. I don’t live to impress anyone, and so I'm not trying to prove anything to anyone. Living my life is not a rush thing for me. Since I am not competing with anyone but moving at my own pace within my means, I am good to go. This makes me have a clear understanding of what truly matters and is essential. This doesn't make me less of myself or reduce my lifestyle; it’s simply me trying to redefine the choices I make along the way. This perspective has greatly helped me create space for peace, joy and the freedom that money alone cannot provide.
*All images are mine*
![1000414885.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/princessbusayo/AK2C7dr7CG9amqSNarRKhrFGqPF8Ybcwt5PM5t352JKw1xMTByAzPkuAARjrqQw.png)

title.title: Motorhoming With Unexpected Visitors!
title.body:
https://images.hive.blog/DQmax3nJgxZdDbGvkYjuX827A8ssbENKCKXH3EhcmGXxUvu/3154~3.jpg

While camping in the New Forest, UK, it is quite common for horses, ponies, and even donkeys to walk through the campsite.  They are not bothered by humans at all.  They just arrive, eat grass, roll and then leave.

https://images.hive.blog/DQmPVCf49veNvYfTkFKbFD31TLUyrQ9f67pZWMhWi7x8TJc/3119~2.jpg
They are owned by local people but are allowed to roam freely. This was the scene this morning when we woke up in the motorhome.

https://images.hive.blog/DQmXM6fTTPpYyVeb8dTatnAxvzhELUiUvaehsp8JkSZWTgs/3155~3.jpg

https://images.hive.blog/DQmZMysNTVcgL8o1Ln8Rcd7CsmhDPuYX92jQ6LYEuQWVhx9/3224~2.jpg

While out walking we found some great looking trees.  Well, if you are interested in trees, that is, even if they're dead, or fallen down.

https://images.hive.blog/DQmUjRayrkWT99Kyoq6ziobXAUX8uGguxd4XFWLENkQtxPV/3117~2.jpg

The art of seeing faces in random objects, such as clouds, trees etc is a common psychological phenomenon called pareidolia. I could see a dog or perhaps a reindeer in this tree.

https://images.hive.blog/DQmbmhukrTgVN6metD4cZa5f5RNbDp1bvwpKMLxSV2GwEhB/Messenger_creation_3BA6EA7B-6920-4F1A-93FC-42C89809B583.jpeg

There's also tree vandals who like Nirvana!

https://images.hive.blog/DQmZQkwSukxwortSrp5YzYTrFwK2NgKfCXJXTCf9FExoLuo/3153~2.jpg
At the moment, the New Forest is covered with beautiful yellow gorse. It looks quite striking  over the heathland.  All in all, it’s been a lovely stay so far and great waking up to wandering animals. Unfortunately, we've not seen any deer, as yet. The New Forest has a unique charm that’s difficult to beat.  Onwards to the next campsite!

https://images.hive.blog/DQmTQF6wQW4xj6B6wQh99WqmNgkL1JrpKsWChsLv5k5Lq4b/PaRgthAvamAmR7uZi4RENh3BWaKjnQbhHtF9iaSV1cVaeSir8SCZYpmzMLvBrDLdiD44L3w4RUXvxqnkBg2eqoHbbUCFgVMLCokxymJ6uR...g2EUvmwMbS8rDTmwiZZiXJVfaSEG5zu7KhSz75fp2aWUpTTXMModEMjmcJDocpskjENinHpDX2Xfhqs6PzWxPZxGDEgVmqwVo162Vb1AHTA1YxrG6iGLyJ3Dqw.gif

title.title: Review - Jujutsu kaisen temporada 3 parte 1
title.body:
# Hello! 💙


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/genesishealthy/23uR11r8Nmk9Vv81THRGQBm6mWgZtbfoKWmsjphTTGeyw8rnmDctyH7c6BtPePwzeqzBj.png)
[Fuente de imagen](https://areajugones.sport.es/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/jujutsu-kaisen-temporada-3-the-culling-game-parte-1.jpg.webp)

La verdad es que al comenzar esta temporada del high es inmenso porque especialmente de la manera que pudo terminar la segunda temporada y todo el tiempo que ha tardado para llegar a esta tercera, la cual sí lamentablemente van a optar por dividirla en dos partes pero debo decir que la calidad en animación es sorprendente, un punto muy negativo A mi parecer es que la historia se vuelve compleja sin necesidad todas las reglas todos los fundamentos para digamos de esta nueva temporada de este juego que están realizando de la extinción la verdad se vuelve exageradamente complejo sin necesidad que quiero decir con esto que si pones la suficiente atención te das cuenta que realmente es muy simple la dinámica del mismo simplemente le dieron demasiadas vueltas al asunto y puede llegar a fatigarte lo mejor es que realmente no le prestes mucha atención a estas reglas Porque mientras más avanza la trama y los episodios igual terminan explicándose por sí solos, lo sorprendente de esta serie creo que sigue siendo la animación y esta tercera temporada han subido el nivel y con solo 150,000 por episodio han logrado una calidad impresionante casi a la par o mayor que el de muchas películas que he podido ver, sigue deslumbrando las secuencias de acción La verdad es que son magníficas y es uno de esas animes que si de repente no has querido ver por cualquier razón la verdad deberías hacerlo así sé que solamente lo veas por las escenas de acción.

> The truth is that the anticipation for this season is huge, especially given how the second season ended and how long it’s taken to get to this third one—which, unfortunately, they’ve decided to split into two parts. But I have to say that the animation quality is amazing. A major downside, in my opinion, is that the story becomes unnecessarily complex—all the rules and the foundations for, let’s say, this new season of the game they’re creating around extinction—it honestly gets overly complicated for no reason. What I mean by this is that if you pay close enough attention, you realize the dynamics are actually very simple; they just overcomplicated the matter, and it can get tiring. The best thing is to really not pay too much attention to these rules, because as the plot progresses and the episodes unfold, they end up explaining themselves. What’s surprising about this series, I think, is still the animation, and this third season has raised the bar. With just 150,000 per episode, they’ve achieved impressive quality—almost on par with or even better than many movies I’ve seen— The action sequences continue to dazzle. The truth is, they’re magnificent, and it’s one of those anime series that, if you haven’t watched it yet for whatever reason, you really should—even if you only watch it for the action scenes.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/genesishealthy/23uFVz9PvGWvwFSCrhRZhz22X1DRNWW4qMGhhNBHMvQKpVXaNBT4ChjgZ21ZLcSCLq28n.png)
[Fuente de imagen](https://tm.ibxk.com.br/2026/03/27/Jujutsu_Kaisen_3_Temporada_Final_Explicado_d66b217fb1.jpeg?ims=1600x900/filters:format(jpg))

Otro punto que debo tocar nuevamente es el del guión el cual si bien está hecho para deslumbrar por sus escenas de acción pasa lo mismo que con las reglas de cómo funciona este juego mucho de los poderes Por decirlo de alguna manera las maldiciones que poseen los antagonistas y protagonistas a veces no terminan explicándose del todo o la explicación que dan simplemente es ambigua y ya pues al punto que el narrador de la historia que después vamos a descubrir quién es el narrador de la historia tiene que decirte en varios momentos porque si no no terminarías a entender qué está pasando, y esto repito no le digo como una crítica negativa es que se vuelve complejo sin necesidad porque simplemente prestas atención a lo que estás pasando un segundo y una necesidad de explicar nada porque las cosas terminan dándose a entender por sí solas de al menos de alguna forma con ciertos personajes porque créanme que ahí con otros que no terminas de entender qué rayos está pasando, sobre todo debo aplaudir el episodio final el cual la animación es impresionante que ya de por sí solo vale todo el precio de la temporada de verdad que cada pelea cada forma de construir estas secuencias de acción a nivel de animación es impresionante y reitero denle una oportunidad a este anime si sé que solamente lo vean por las escenas de acción.

> Another point I need to bring up again is the script. While it’s designed to dazzle with its action scenes, the same issue arises with the rules governing how this game works—and with many of the powers. To put it another way, the “curses” possessed by the antagonists and protagonists aren’t always fully explained, or the explanation given is simply ambiguous—to the point where the story’s narrator (whose identity we’ll discover later) has to spell things out to you at various points—otherwise, you wouldn’t understand what’s going on. And I repeat, I’m not saying this as a negative criticism; it’s just that it becomes unnecessarily complex because you simply pay attention to what’s happening for a second, and there’s no need to explain anything—things end up making sense on their own, at least to some extent with certain characters. Believe me, with others, you just can’t figure out what the heck is going on. Above all, I have to applaud the final episode—the animation is stunning and is worth the entire season’s price tag on its own. Seriously, every fight, every way these action sequences are constructed in terms of animation, is impressive. And I’ll say it again: give this anime a chance, even if you only watch it for the action scenes.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/genesishealthy/Ep3bqDm2YYYrqUbLe7TU2Jw8gyXkt1kCo7Ury6KEYonepsDZdheczcCPUFQVsjs8A1e.png)
[Fuente de imagen](https://areajugones.sport.es/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/jujutsu-kaisen-yuta-okkotsu-1220x684.jpg.webp)

Qué puedo decir esperando la segunda parte esta tercera temporada la verdad es que no me encanta del todo que han tardado tantos años pero entiendo que lo han hecho para deleitar con esta calidad tan impresionante que tiene el anime puedo decir que incluso la calidad de animación está la par de la película de kimetsu no yaiba que justamente ha salido en el año 2025 a ese nivel llega los episodios de jujutsu kaisen de la tercera temporada.

> What can I say? I’m eagerly awaiting the second half of this third season. To be honest, I’m not entirely thrilled that it’s taken so many years, but I understand they did it to deliver this anime’s truly impressive quality. I can say that the animation quality is on par with the *Demon Slayer* movie, which was just released in 2025—the episodes of *Jujutsu Kaisen*’s third season reach that level.



¡Hasta la próxima, un abrazo!

</liketuimages>

学习的动力源于自己在一次次努力中取得的成功。老二，在不断的学习中，逐渐找到了属于自己的节奏，能踏踏实实的向着自己的目标去努力，去拼搏了。

晚上去接他时，在视频里面看到他的上课状态也是很不错的，和之前比有很大的进步。想要实现质的提升，也是很不容易了，他已经比他的同学优秀太多了。但是梦想不一样，付出就会不一样，他说他的同学们准备初中走划片，县城里面大多说家庭更多的追求是安稳省事。虽然现在上岸的学校均属于郑州一类学校，但总是不甘心。我们离大三甲也不远的，再冲一冲，再搏一搏吧！

学到一定程度也会上瘾的，一旦上瘾一切就指日可待了，学出成就，你就会很享受那份荣誉，你对成功的欲望就不会很大，也不会过于急躁，你会逐渐习惯上学习瘾带来的一系列福利。

一切才刚刚开始，如果能有一个不错的开始，就如锦上添花，如虎添翼。支持你，冲吧孩子！

---

Hello, my dear otaku friends, I hope you're all doing well.
My fan art is inspired by one of my favorite One Piece characters.
Sanji is a very charming guy and a great cook, but he's also very strong and funny; that's why I was motivated to draw him, but in a different way. After coloring him with watercolors, I added some details with art supplies, like the cigarette and the boons on his outfit.

I've always liked to innovate in my drawings; that's why I added some details to my drawing of Sanji using different materials, such as the cigarette and the buttons on his suit; I made them with materials that would make them stand out from the image.


>Hola, mis queridos amigos otakus, espero se encuentren muy bien.
Mi fanart está inspirado en uno de mis personajes favoritos de One Piece.
Sanji es un chico muy seductor y gran cocinero, pero también es muy fuerte y divertido; es por eso que me motivé a dibujarlo, pero de manera diferente, ya que después de colorearlo con acuarela, le hice algunos detalles con material, como el cigarrillo y los botones de su traje

Siempre me ha gustado innovar en mis dibujos; es por eso que le hice a mi dibujo de Sanji algunos detalles con material diferente, como por ejemplo el cigarrillo y los botones del traje; los elaboré con material para que sobresalgan de la imagen.

title.title: Miedo a lo Oscuro
title.body:
/>

De pequeño le temia a la oscuridad, un terror primitivo que tal vez heredamos por generaciones, con el tiempo ese miedo acestral fue desapareciendo y volviéndose curiosidad, esa que nos hizo avanzar, descubrir los misterios que nos lanzaron al universo (dicen que ahora andamos otra vez por la luna) pero en un giro inesperado de los acontecimientos la oscuridad volvió y cada vez se hizo más presente, asfixiante, aunque ya no le temia. Más bien me sumergía en ella que era como sumergirme en mi y cuando llegaba a su mundo más profundo una figura la rompía. Mi mente le daba forma a una silueta agena difusa que penetraba en la oscuridad como un cuchillo ardiendo, aunque recordemos que realmente no estaba profundo en la oscuridad sino profundo en mis entrañas abriéndose paso en mi asfixia. Unas manos pequeñas que apenas he tocado se abrían paso sin esfuerzos entre mis tormentos. Una luz disolviendo mis miedos pasados, una figura etérea que no conozco, pero mi mente se empeña en recrear como si toda su piel únicamente arropada por las sombras sirviera como portal a una felicidad desconocida y tibia. Ella porta la luz, escribe con ella historias que se leen de un vistazo y en mi mientras avanza reescribió mis miedos. Lo desconocido se volvió tentador, húmedo, como esos besos que no conozco y tal vez nunca me dará. Pero mi mente vuelve le da forma y me dejó llevar por esa oscuridad que la hará más cerca, sus pequeñas manos enexistentes recorrerán mi cuerpo mientras las dejo ser, contar su propia historia que promenten llevarme otra vez a la luna, como si el temor a nunca probar su tacto se volviera el nuevo miedo ancestral.

From the teachings of bro Eli, he said God has a great purpose for making us to exist in this world. We are created by God and for God, to know Him, love Him, and live in relationship with Him. Human life is not an accident but a deliberate act of God, giving each person value and meaning from the very beginning.
https://youtu.be/5syxe2GwVxU?si=8gjPYhJ8nufoTQdP
Another purpose of our existence is to reflect God’s character in how we live. We are called to show love, kindness, mercy, and righteousness in our daily actions. By doing good and living according to His Word, we become a light to others and bring glory to God through our lives.

We exist to prepare us for eternal life when we leave this earth. We are to serve Him faithfully, use our gifts wisely, and walk in obedience. In doing so, we grow spiritually and align ourselves with His purpose, looking forward to a life that continues with Him forever.

title.title: Armor-Based Attacks You Didn’t Notice
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbBuvSCo2mmkUhGvJZuQAV3w7NDjZ3wQ9tX4tU3vpcSKo/gnome.png)



Hello Splinterlands warriors, how are you today? Hopefully your battles bring more wins than losses—even though… sometimes losing is actually our best teacher in the arena 😄

This time, I want to talk about a card that I find a bit “quirky,” but that’s exactly where its uniqueness lies. This card isn’t your typical damage dealer—in fact, at first glance… it looks like it can’t attack at all. But wait—this is where the surprise comes in.

Its name is **Nimbledook Explorer**.

<center>https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/cards_by_level/soulboundrb/Nimbledook%20Explorer_lv10_gold.png</center>

The first time I saw **Nimbledook Explorer**, I thought,
“What is this card even for? It has no attack?”

It’s a unit from the Life element and only costs 4 mana—perfect for rulesets like *Little League*. But what makes it different is:

* It **has no regular attack**
* But it has a unique ability: **Armored Strike**

And the Weapon Training skill can turn this monster into something powerful.

Now this is interesting.
**Armored Strike** allows it to attack using its armor. So the thicker the armor, the stronger the attack. But there’s a condition—it needs to be in the front position, or in certain rulesets that allow it.
<center>https://splinterguide.com/img/ability_armored-strike.png</center>

At early levels, it has **Protect** (+2 armor for the whole team), and at higher levels:

* **Armored Strike** and **Heal**

So imagine this: it’s not just a tank… it’s a tank that attacks using its own shield.

---

### A Battle Moment That Truly Surprised Me

I once used **Nimbledook Explorer** in a battle with the **Weak Magic** ruleset and a 98 mana cap. Usually in this ruleset, players tend to avoid magic since it has to go through armor first.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQL5oHgr5gwa7M7wnGx1dNHdsRA1tXAZ7nbkJDNxxqRon/round_1.png)


That’s where I saw an opportunity.

I set up:

* **Nimbledook Explorer** in the front
* **Conclave Tracker** behind it for *armor repair*

And what happened?

This wasn’t just defense… it became a shield-based war machine.

Every round: Armor gets repaired, armor becomes damage, the opponent struggles to break through. Even though my opponent used a fairly strong bloodline combination, I just smiled to myself…

“Wow… turns out a shield can be fiercer than a sword.”

<center> 👉  [**LINK BATTLE**](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_dabb0834e56af5b97f48a990fb125da1?ref=rqr4)  👈</center>

---

### Interesting Things I Realized

There are a few things that honestly surprised me:

1. **Armor-based attacks are underrated**
   We usually focus on damage, but forget that armor can also be a weapon.

2. **Synergy is everything**
   Without support like repair and weapon training, Nimbledook might feel average.
   But with the right combination? It becomes a monster.

3. **Not every card needs high attack**
   Sometimes utility + unique mechanics are more valuable.

---

### Challenges When Using Nimbledook Explorer

Of course, this card doesn’t always shine.

It has natural counters:

* **Unprotected** ruleset → no armor, game over
* **Healed Out** → reduced sustain
* Wrong positioning → can’t attack

---

### Final Thoughts and Strategy

Strategies you can try:

* Use it in **Weak Magic** or **Armored Up** rulesets
* Combine it with **Repair** (like Conclave Tracker)
* Place it in the front to maximize **Armored Strike**
* Avoid no-armor rulesets

In the end, from my experience…

Sometimes we’re too focused on finding high-damage cards, that we forget true strength can come from unexpected places.

And in Splinterlands, even a shield… can become the deadliest weapon.

See you in the arena—and be careful when facing Nimbledook Explorer… because it doesn’t attack with a sword… but with patience 😄🔥

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXuXxp6GBhwB1HpXvoabLn8Dt8QaRKSe1WNYDzqX1v6Vk/chaos_logo.png)



Talk about Splinterlands,
If you haven't tried out this fantastic game called Splinterlands yet, I invite you to [**Join**](https://splinterlands.com?ref=rqr4).
It's free, but you'll need to invest in a beginning deck or buy gaming cards to gain real assets like cards and tokens. 

___

title.title: My Actifit Report Card: April 10 2026
title.body:
![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g99a89e48975ed8dc1a6136f272b998c52736d16e7ddbc525f94ff42017d975220dd066415841df5cc983960b428042488b1cda7140643aeb658297eaaea36e46_640.jpg)
오늘의 산책은 정말 즐거웠어요! 처음에는 동네 카페에서 친구와 출발했는데, 카페 앞에서 반려견을 산책시키고 있는 분을 만났어요. 그 반려견이 너무 귀여워서 잠시 대화를 나누었고, 반려견이 저에게 꼬리를 흔들며 반응하는 모습이 너무 사랑스러웠습니다. 산책을 하면서 한적한 골목길에서 우연히 발견한 작은 벽화도 인상 깊었어요. 그 벽화는 지역 아티스트의 작품으로, 화려한 색감과 독특한 디자인이 눈에 띄었죠. 많은 사람들이 그 앞에서 사진을 찍고 있어서, 저도 그 분위기에 휩쓸려 사진을 한 장 남겼답니다. 오늘은 이렇게 사람들과의 소통과 멋진 예술작품을 감상하면서 즐거운 시간을 보냈습니다! _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@titusfrost/actifit-titusfrost-20231229t015511428z)_

title.title: Insect Macro Photography
title.body:
I never thought I would enjoy spending so much time trying to get closer to bugs; now it seems like second nature. Anytime I am out with a macro lens, I am constantly seeking them out. I enjoy the challenge of trying to get good quality close-ups of all kinds. It really is interesting to me to be able to see them on a larger screen later on, catch details that I didn't know were there, and learn more about some of these creatures that are eking out a living every day.

title.title: Oranges In Oil Pastel
title.body:
![oranges oil pastel.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoK6GtKPqWKYbCR8iosWNSEDnMS2BajSWZzim1KfcWVMW15JRgmwBj28ZCEsj5nvatU.gif)
Hello, how are you? I've been on a hiatus from making art for the past few weeks now, and I told myself today that it should stop. Luckily, oil pastel saved me from the brink of art block again. The story behind this art is that my mom bought oranges a few weeks ago, and I tasted one, and it is the sweetest and juiciest orange I have ever tasted, so I grabbed three of them for photo reference in the future if I wanted to draw or paint again, and here I am editing what I documented LOL. -----
Materials I Used:

> ![2.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Ep7ve2Tjav1CZevuFGpMK8s1XL9znyLLfHbAPCRxP5hxRwkEYB2V2tfTvyjMXBcHs8j.JPG) I make sure all the materials I need are in easy-access parts so that I can draw freely and with less stress. -----

> ![4.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EopumNZwW5Ve9SoqAH4oGm6ZZC6BHkrtULVisY3eW7ihyD44ZcWZifKFuC6HdFRVYnw.JPG) And then using the red shade, I draw the proportions of the orange with light pressure and just do it with the flow, don't worry about detail, trust me. I layer that sketch with the same oil pastel, but this time I outline with more pressure. ------

> ![6.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EouAd3LCsfZ3YRBiKmn7xBmzdZVFEQU3paAgP8Bg9qjvnN8srM3FfaWUKBKiuzj5moz.JPG) I like to block the color I am going to use by layering it lightly into the drawing, and then I color the background just lightly. -----

> ![8.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoiXbCwFhqWJsQQoMggohGUKfsyh9vqQ7RLTx9896B3Ab23SYSpCX9VFdc4c13QdTbE.JPG) In this part, I start building the shades of the orange and start blocking the shadows and highlights. -----

> ![10.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EokfwrXUmqb7oSPQEjEDvRihLvnC49zRxB7Pgs1iJB5B8YzGWRyTsoM965kunvmq8N8.JPG) To avoid confusion, I start rendering one by one. I start with the unpeeled orange. Next is the half-peeled one. I like to start blocking the shadows first and one by one, getting lighter. -----

> ![12.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoGzRGfurjC2ktrz5w1yX7cYsTNEfevimjrEptKJBUFq9NtR5mpoK23FatLAVX1fGK7.JPG) Next is the peeled orange, so whenever I see something I need to improve on the previous orange, I like to return and correct that part. -----
> ![15.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoeFSitGHF9NGV2xowS6DUiLC4U3DMjE9JhFaWnhLj9xEaZQyfKkvVHp3QWMTKa5z5A.JPG) And finally, the peel of the third orange. -----

> ![17.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Eoc82TQA54C7nNYCLRJ43n8cnD9pL4g9Ed57391YQAFheTEY8GKBukEzjCqogQ9f9pH.JPG) I almost forgot to add the texture of the drawing, so I used this clay tool as my scratching tool. -----

title.body: У мене є досвід дачі в дитинстві в 6 соток, де роботи завжди було достатньо на всю сім'ю, але ж і будиночок там був дуже умовний тимчасовий, а все переважно під городину. І до того плюсом у нас були 20 соток у полі в селі, де тільки картоплю і цибулю садили, які фактично росли самостійно.\nТож я не скажу, що розумію обсяг робіт. В дитинстві \

. Ми не плануємо влаштовувати мене на роботу, тож дача мені замість роботи і дуже круто, що я і сама можу на маршрутках туди доїхати, бо я в чотирьох стінах вже скаженію, життя має бути приємнішим, а від самого інтернету зір падає, і я хочу більше часу на свіжому повітрі і без всіх цих екранів. Є проблема, що по спеціальності я вже вилетіла дуже суттєво з профпридатності, а влаштовуватись без досвіду після 40 на щось новеньке також проблематично. Малювати знову ж таки в цифрі я вже цілими днями не зможу навіть якщо мій рівень буде достатнім для працевлаштування.

Ну і теплиці з гідропонікою ми плануємо саме як бізнес (шафран, м'ята, шпинат, розмарин, базилік), але через те, що бракує досвіду, то починати потрібно поступово, і ідеальний варіант для цього просто на своїй ділянці. На теплиці, доречі, зараз в Дії видають гранти незалежно від досвіду, але там потрібно землю ОСГ від 40 соток, у нас жодна з доступних в продажі ділянок не забезпечить цю вимогу.
Також ту частину землі, яку ми зрозуміємо, що для нас важка, ми організуємо під сортову обліпиху. Ну і ставок ми там так само як і деякі сусіди можемо докопати і зарибити.

Плюс у нас батьки чоловіка і брат хочуть проводити відпустку, а зрозуміло, що в нашій спекотній квартирі влітку це просто жах, краще жах, ніж на півдні Туреччини звідки вони приїжджатимуть, але у них там кондиціонер є, а у нас і немає, і сенсу в ньому тепер без електрики немає :)

Чоловік ще хоче ютуб-канал турецькою мовою про життя в українському селі. Я впевнена, що це просто неймовірно цікаво, і його друзі вже дочекатись не можуть, щоб дивитись.

Тож бачите, у нас на ті нещасні 25 соток дуже багато планів і велика сім'я час від часу :)
