title.title: Monumento to The mother in my San Luis  territory(en/es)
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPnuhcuuZWsQ7EgK35QimziuJQvRMjSqYQN2t8Hwiscbt/1775830052634.jpg)

ENGLISH VERSIÓN.

✍️See you at the bust of the mothers!

✍️I have been hearing this phrase for a long time, and I have also said it myself, thus indicating a fixed reference point in the main town of my municipality.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX2ChLrYFUdaG3BCwNNRoZrj3fBV5uzQN13rTwEcxu1jF/1775830105447.jpg)

✍️And in San Luis, Pinar del Río, Cuba, practically everyone knows the place. But the real thing is that, although everyone knows what they are referring to, the reference is poorly stated, since what we mistakenly call \

is a sculptural group made up of three figures that represent a mother sitting with two children on her lap.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaBwTVHXBdTACCiHkGLbhJBH74rt5AgUu3qn4DF9CXyYF/1775830271656.jpg)

✍️It is impossible to find any inhabitant of this territory who does not know this emblematic sculpture and almost the identity symbol of the municipality, since it is located a few meters from the entrance of the main town, in the first segment of what is the long promenade. tree line that symmetrically divides the town into two perfect halves throughout its entire length, only interfered with by the streets and the small square in the center of the route, in front of the San Joaquín parish and the José Martí park.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXpDLaa14M95HYjvwGfnNmfiUinFDptrEyj37UMqBQAZ9/1775830304982.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTnE9K8VF7VKev26YE8UecEvvUtzqzqGELqETTRkqdL78/1775830305510.jpg)

✍️Well, then we agree that it is not the bust of the mothers (the mothers are because it is alone, it represents them all), but rather a \

, which is correct according to the size and number of figures that make it up, but even if it were a single complete figure.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVLoHXAYvh9Vq5G4kjCd13owgpZb5Mq7hq1PKFPsRoUiH/1775830549928.jpg)

✍️All San Luis residents love and greatly appreciate this image carved in stone by Atilano Semen Eros Ramos, one of the illustrious sons of the land. Despite having left this remote place in the geography of Pinar del Río as a teenager, and having already realized his dreams of being an artist from the capital of Cuba, he donated to us and covered the transportation costs and part of the structure of the installation in his homeland, which in the end has become an indisputable symbol of the identity of the people of San Luis.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXfgf9xHdJGJrHFsGpJzzLi9Pyr8QdmWmoJsA2kz8dGxE/1775830359883.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUKXPiWGRN3XhtQbnfjkCfAxscBsWijU3jEahE3EGLb3A/1775830360394.jpg)

✍️According to what they say (and it is also recorded in documents of the time), back in the fifties of the last century, with the collaboration of the Masonic lodge, which paid for most of the location of the sculpture, and for many of the countrymen through donations and collections, the monument was erected in front of the town with the concept that it would be like a mother who would take care of her own children and those who would come to the territory in search of love and protection. which he studied and served as a teacher. He gave us a rough and robust image of a peasant mother, with a simple dress and herself without makeup or ornaments, which expresses the simplicity of the women of these rural environments, at that time much more remote and uncontaminated from the air of the capitals.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQJ926CnSkNqE3pt25ReRZev7H3ejT88xf5MJDZN2ronF/1775830437869.jpg)

✍️The artist, to reaffirm the typology of the woman, left us for posterity, in terms of the general finish, a bulk sculpture, working in more detail on the female head, which is the center of the as a whole, as if leaving the rest with simple hard looks on the quarry stone carved in a single block.

✍️At the time Atilano Armenteros carried out the work, Mexican muralism was very fashionable and expanding. Many artists of the time took, above all, the bulky and crude forms as an expression of the native indigenous races of Central America.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV6QXHBZDJfLJNR7cm1anLBQqEtAGuiggidT71R3ZSFSi/1775830702753.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUF6PvVwLwUHLC9EPE7X8qnCKWWv75UQp3CahCZWWCKDq/1775830703380.jpg)

✍️The bust of the mothers (monument) is the only one of its kind in the province, and in my experience as a walker, I have not seen anything like it. So we can consider it as the authentic heritage of my land.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmecagSDEVwk4yo1HxUTv9g9iWzJyMg2nj4QmRZbioyFZ7/1775830481479.jpg)

✍️San Luis has three very strong identity symbols that are even in the municipal shield: the parish, the tobacco and the monument to the mothers. But the latter gains in symbolism, since it is the one who receives us and says goodbye to us at the entrance of the main town, our small capital.

✍️Thank you for coming to my town and accompanying me to observe this important monument.

✍️Original text of my authorship. All rights reserved and protected.©

VERSIÓN EN ESPAÑOL.

>¡Nos vemos en el busto de las madres!

Esta frase la he venido oyendo desde hace ya mucho tiempo, y yo mismo la he dicho también, indicando así un punto de referencia fijo en el poblado cabecera de mi municipio.

>Y es que en San Luis, Pinar del Río, Cuba, prácticamente todos conocen el lugar. Pero lo real del caso es que, aunque todos saben a qué se refieren, la referencia está mal enunciada, pues a lo que equivocadamente llamamos \

es un conjunto escultórico formado por tres figuras que representan a una madre sentada con dos niños en su regazo.

>Imposible encontrar a algún habitante de este territorio que no conozca esta escultura emblemática y casi el símbolo de identidad del municipio, pues está ubicada a pocos metros de la entrada del poblado cabecera, en el primer segmento de lo que es el largo paseo arbolado que divide simétricamente el poblado en dos mitades perfectas en todo su recorrido, solo interferido por las entrecalles y la plazoleta en el centro de la ruta, frente a la parroquia San Joaquín y el parque José Martí.

>Bueno, entonces quedamos en que no es el busto de las madres (lo de madres es porque está sola, las representa a todas), sino \

, que es como es correcto según el tamaño y la cantidad de figuras que lo componen, pero igual si fuese una sola figura completa.

>Todos los sanluiseños queremos y apreciamos mucho esta imagen tallada en piedra por Atilano Semen Eros Ramos, uno de los hijos ilustres del terruño. A pesar de haber salido adolescente de este recóndito lugar en la geografía pinareña, y ya realizados sus sueños de ser artista desde la capital de Cuba, nos donó y sufragó los gastos de transporte y parte de la estructura de la instalación en su tierra natal, lo que a la postre se ha convertido en un símbolo indiscutible de la identidad de los sanluiseños.

>Según cuentan (y también está registrado en documentos de la época), allá por los años cincuenta del siglo pasado, con la colaboración de la Logia masónica, que costeó la mayor parte del emplazamiento de la escultura, y de muchos de los coterráneos a través de donativos y recaudaciones, se erigió el monumento frente al poblado con el concepto de que sería como una madre que cuidaría a sus propios hijos y a los que llegarán al territorio en busca de amor y protección.

>El autor, aunque parte de la pose de la mujer sentada, conserva algo del neoclásico tardío, propio de los métodos académicos de la Academia de San Alejandro, institución en la que estudió y fungió como profesor. Nos regaló una imagen tosca y robusta de una madre campesina, con una vestimenta sencilla y ella misma sin afeites ni ornamentos, que expresa la sencillez propia de las mujeres de estos entornos rurales, en aquel entonces mucho más alejadas y descontaminadas de los aires de las capitales.

>El artista, para reafirmar la tipología de la mujer, nos dejó para la posteridad, en cuanto al acabado general, una escultura de bulto, trabajando más detalladamente la cabeza femenina, que es el centro del conjunto, como dejando lo demás con simples miradas duras en la piedra de cantería tallada en un solo bloque.

>En el momento en que Atilano Armenteros realizó la obra, el muralismo mexicano estaba muy de moda y en expansión. Muchos artistas de la época tomaron, sobre todo, las formas abultadas y toscas como expresión de las razas indígenas autóctonas de Centroamérica.

>El busto a las madres (monumento) es único en su tipo en la provincia, y en mi experiencia como caminante, no he visto nada igual. Por lo que podemos considerarlo como patrimonio auténtico de mi terruño.

>San Luis tiene tres símbolos identitarios muy fuertes que incluso están en el escudo municipal: la parroquia, el tabaco y el monumento a las madres. Pero este último gana en simbolismo, pues es quien nos recibe y nos despide a la entrada del poblado cabecera, nuestra pequeña capital.

>Gracias por venir a mi pueblo y acompañarme a observar este importante monumento.

>Texto original de mi autoría. Todos los derechos reservados y protegidos.©

title.title: 实在憋不住
title.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![b4HXmurXsP7nBCCS_mmexport1775828892603.jpg](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/aellly/images/b4HXmurXsP7nBCCS_mmexport1775828892603/b4HXmurXsP7nBCCS_mmexport1775828892603.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

清明节过去之后就回到深圳继续上班。不过这一次回来之后，心情轻松了很多。
上班的时候跟同事也是有说有笑，打打闹闹的。时间倒是过的挺快的。
特别是今天在上班的时候，跟同事整蛊了一会。捉弄的他都快发疯了。

早上的时候我那同事就在试一下自来水水管会不会漏水？因为这水管是他做的，所以要试水。
他在楼上灌水下来。然后打压机是在1楼装着的。在1楼能够看到水压。
如果管子漏水的话，压力是打不上来的。在施压的时候是必须把水管给通了水。

如果水管漏了，就能够看到哪里有水渍，证明哪个地方会漏水。
他是一个老师傅。但他万万没想到的是我在旁边捉弄他。他还不知道。
刚开始的时候，他在屋顶上面把水灌满，之后就到1楼去打压力。

等到他压力打上去之后，就在那里等半个小时。因为这是试水标准的时间。
我在阳台上看到他在那里坐着，老悠闲了。就拿个小桶在水龙头给它放掉一点水。
然后就把水倒到垃圾里面去。不能给他现场留点什么痕迹跟证据。

搞完我又回到电箱旁边去。继续忙我的事情。要做什么事情都没发生过。
没过一小会，他匆匆忙忙就往上面跑。紧张的那神情都让我看了想笑。
我当做什么都不知道，继续做事。继续捋我的电线。而且我还恨着小曲。

然后他就继续去下面加水，把压力给打上来。结果又给他放了一点水。
然后他又匆匆忙忙上来找，又找不到原因。来来回回给他折腾了五次。
都快要把他给逼疯了。他实在是找不出原因，又跑到我那去问。

然后我还故作神秘的用手指掐了掐，经过我这一算，你的五行缺水。
到后面我实在是没忍住，憋不住了就笑了出来。就这么一笑就穿帮了。
被他从2楼追到3楼，又从3楼被他追到1楼。累死老夫了。

---

title.title: The Myanmar Drum  and My Musical Progress in Rising Star Game
title.body: ​မြန်မာ့ရိုးရာဂီတလောကမှာ \

ဟာ မရှိမဖြစ် အရေးပါတဲ့ တူရိယာတစ်ခု ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။ မြန်မာ့ဆိုင်းဝိုင်းရဲ့ အသက်သွေးကြောလို့တောင် တင်စားခေါ်ဝေါ်ကြပြီး ပွဲလမ်းသဘင် တော်တော်များများမှာ ဗုံသံမပါရင် မပြည့်စုံသလို ခံစားရပါတယ်။ ဗုံအမျိုးအစားပေါင်းများစွာရှိတဲ့အနက် ဗုံတို၊ ဗုံရှည်၊ အိုးစည်နဲ့ ပတ်မကြီးတို့ဟာ မြန်မာတို့ရဲ့ ယဉ်ကျေးမှု ပြယုဒ်တွေပဲ ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။\n\n​In the world of Myanmar traditional music, the \

(known as Bohn) is an indispensable instrument. It is often described as the heartbeat of the Myanmar Traditional Orchestra (Saing Waing). Most festivals and ceremonies feel incomplete without the rhythmic resonance of the drums. Among the various types, the Short Drum (Bohn-to), Long Drum (Bohn-shay), Ozi (Pot Drum), and the Great Drum (Pat-ma-gyi) stand as symbols of Myanmar’s rich cultural heritage.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbhxibfBvRaAUNHdV7Kb6N3AeyPEV4QbhGbWSkE3GKeaw/1775831197653.jpg)


​မြန်မာ့ဗုံတွေကို သစ်သားကျွန်းတုံးတွေကို အခေါင်းဖောက်ပြီး တိရစ္ဆာန်သားရေတွေနဲ့ ကြက်ပြီး ပြုလုပ်ကြပါတယ်။ ဗုံရဲ့ အသံထွက်ကို လိုသလို ထိန်းညှိဖို့အတွက် \

လို့ခေါ်တဲ့ ထမင်းနဲ့ ပြာကို ရောစပ်ထားတဲ့ အနှစ်ကို ဗုံမျက်နှာပြင် အလယ်မှာ ကပ်ပြီး အသုံးပြုရပါတယ်။ ဒါဟာ တခြားနိုင်ငံက ဒရမ်တွေနဲ့မတူတဲ့ ထူးခြားတဲ့ နည်းပညာတစ်ခုပဲ ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။\n\n​Myanmar drums are typically crafted from hollowed-out teak wood blocks and covered with animal hide. To fine-tune the pitch and tone, a special tuning paste called \

—made from a mixture of cooked rice and wood ash—is applied to the center of the drumhead. This is a unique technique that distinguishes Myanmar drums from those of other cultures.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUSp3bkEN4MXKfSP1QAFnA53dYCKWJAN29DVgPXH2iJMA/img_0.2951814577976987.jpg)

​ဗုံတီးခတ်ပုံဟာလည်း အနုပညာတစ်ရပ် ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။ လက်ဖဝါး၊ လက်ချောင်းလေးတွေရဲ့ ရိုက်ခတ်မှု အင်အားပေါ်မူတည်ပြီး ငြိမ့်ညောင်းတဲ့အသံကနေ ပြင်းထန်တက်ကြွတဲ့ အသံအထိ အမျိုးမျိုး ထွက်ပေါ်စေနိုင်ပါတယ်။ စိုက်ပျိုးရေးပွဲတော်တွေ၊ ဘုရားပွဲတွေနဲ့ ကထိန်ပွဲတွေမှာ ဗုံသံကြားလိုက်တာနဲ့ မြန်မာလူမျိုးတိုင်းရဲ့ စိတ်ထဲမှာ ပျော်ရွှင်တက်ကြွမှုကို ခံစားရလေ့ရှိပါတယ်။

​The art of playing the drum is a skill in itself. Depending on the pressure and strike of the palms and fingers, it can produce a wide range of sounds, from soothing melodies to energetic beats. For Myanmar people, hearing the sound of the drum during agricultural festivals, pagoda festivals, or robe-offering ceremonies immediately evokes a sense of joy and excitement.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTF8bDj5hGPVfLceaFm4bnW1EwZVmLPH4QMsFWmvo7Wxx/img_0.20558356355500287.jpg)

​ဂီတဟာ နယ်ပယ်ပေါင်းစုံကို ဆက်သွယ်ပေးနိုင်တဲ့ တံတားတစ်စင်းလိုပါပဲ။ အခု ကျွန်မအနေနဲ့ မြန်မာ့ရိုးရာတူရိယာတွေအကြောင်းကို လေ့လာသလိုပဲ Rising Star ဂိမ်းထဲမှာလည်း ကျွန်မရဲ့ ဂီတခရီးလမ်းကို ပိုမိုတောက်ပလာအောင် ကြိုးစားနေပါတယ်။ အဆင့်သစ်တွေ တက်လှမ်းနိုင်ဖို့နဲ့ Skill တွေ ပိုကောင်းလာဖို့အတွက် Music Lesson တွေကို နေ့စဉ်မပြတ် လုပ်ဆောင်နေပါတယ်။

​Music is like a bridge that connects different worlds. Just as I am exploring the beauty of Myanmar traditional instruments, I am also working hard to brighten my musical journey within the Rising Star game. To reach new levels and enhance my skills, I am consistently performing Music Lessons every day.


​Rising Star ထဲက Music Lesson တွေဟာ ကျွန်မရဲ့ ဂိမ်းကစားမှုအတွက် အင်မတန် အရေးကြီးပါတယ်။ သင်ခန်းစာတွေကနေတစ်ဆင့် ရရှိလာတဲ့ Skill points တွေက Ego ကို ထိန်းချုပ်ပေးနိုင်သလို၊ နောင်တစ်ချိန်မှာ ပိုမိုကြီးမားတဲ့ ပွဲတွေကို ဖျော်ဖြေနိုင်ဖို့ အခြေခံကောင်းတွေ ဖြစ်စေပါတယ်။ ဂီတကို ချစ်မြတ်နိုးတဲ့အတွက် အပြင်လောကမှာတင်မကဘဲ Rising Star ကမ္ဘာမှာပါ အောင်မြင်တဲ့ အနုပညာရှင်တစ်ယောက်ဖြစ်ဖို့ ဆက်လက် ကြိုးစားသွားမှာပါ။

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmemzyxV8JM6D983U1ppWmghJ6nsNxgRhcxGSUdS5pz7YA/1774965657976.jpg)


​The Music Lessons in Rising Star are incredibly important for my gameplay progression. The skill points earned through these lessons help manage Ego while building a strong foundation for performing at larger venues in the future. Because of my love for music, I will continue to strive toward becoming a successful artist, not just in real life, but also within the world of Rising Star.

title.title: Naked under the stars
title.body: > Photo by:https://unsplash.com/photos/a-group-of-people-standing-next-to-each-other-under-a-night-sky-filled-with-stars-PTtW0VT7gZA There are nights that never really leave you. They just change shape, like constellations shifting with time, but always there… waiting for you to look up again. The first time I remember truly being naked under the stars wasn’t about love or struggle—it was about innocence. I was a first grader, living near a lake, a tenant in a modest home where life felt simple and endless at the same time. Summer nights had their own rhythm. Kids from the street would gather, dragging pieces of wood to make a small fire right there on the asphalt. No phones, no distractions—just laughter, sparks flying into the dark, and eyes fixed on the sky. We didn’t need much. A meteor shower was a spectacle, but even on ordinary nights, we searched for falling stars like treasure hunters. Every streak of light carried a wish. What did we wish for? Everything. A new bike. A trip to the sea. A dog that would finally get better. A brother or sister. A glance from a crush that meant something more. Our wishes were raw, unfiltered—straight from a child’s heart that didn’t yet know limits. Back then, hope was easy. Natural. Like breathing. Then life moved. We left the lake and climbed to another part of the city—a hill where the view stretched wide across the plains. And suddenly, the sky felt bigger. More powerful. At night, it played tricks on the eyes—stars blending with the blinking lights of airplanes, distant wind turbines flickering like something between earth and space. If you looked far enough, you could imagine the glow of big cities Belgrade and Novi Sad merging with the horizon, as if cities themselves were constellations trying to compete with the sky. That view did something to me. It expanded my imagination. It was there that I chose my path—to become a physical education teacher. Ten years followed, a strange but beautiful combination of work and study. Days filled with movement, nights still reserved for thought. And then came another chapter of being naked under the stars. On the banks of the Danube, on a sandy beach, not yet 22. A bottle stuck in the sand, laughter carried by the river wind, and her… my first real, unfinished love. There are friendships from that time that still breathe today—solid, unbreakable. But there was also that first bitter taste, like almonds—unreturned love. Quiet, sharp, unforgettable.

> https://unsplash.com/photos/beach-picnic-with-drinks-and-coconut-water-l52PqZh120M You learn something in those moments. That being “naked under the stars” is not always about freedom. Sometimes it’s about vulnerability. About standing exposed with your feelings, with no guarantee of return. Life doesn’t stop, though. It circles back. Years later, I found myself sitting in front of my house with my mother. Another summer night. Another meteor shower. Same sky… but everything felt different. Each falling star carried a new kind of wish. Not for things.Not even for dreams. But for time.For that moment to last longer. For those quiet conversations to stretch just a little further into the night. You realize then—wishes grow up, just like we do. And then came Klara. She didn’t just enter my life—she broke the silence in it. She arrived with her five-year-old son, bringing noise, warmth, movement… life. We would sit on the terrace at night, looking at the stars again, talking about tomorrow. Where will we go?What will we build? What comes next?This time, being naked under the stars meant something else entirely. It meant love. Real, present, shared. Then came my son. Then my daughter. And the sky stayed the same—but I didn’t. I found myself there again, in that same view. Once with my grandfather and my son. Another time with my son, my wife, and little Anja. Three generations. One sky.

> https://unsplash.com/photos/a-group-of-people-standing-in-front-of-a-night-sky-sh8plCltfZo And me—still standing there, still looking up, still wishing. Because life, when you strip it down, is exactly that:a fight for a bare existence under the stars. But here’s the truth I’ve learned through all those nights:it doesn’t matter how much life hardens you… It doesn’t matter how many wishes don’t come true… What matters is that somewhere inside you, those wishes remain the same. Simple. Honest. Childlike. Because the moment you stop wishing like that…you stop looking at the sky the way you once did. And maybe that’s the real magic. Not whether the stars grant your wish.But that you never stop making one.

> Photo by:https://unsplash.com/photos/a-group-of-people-standing-next-to-each-other-under-a-night-sky-filled-with-stars-PTtW0VT7gZA Postoje noći koje nas nikada zaista ne napuste. Samo menjaju oblik, kao sazvežđa koja se pomeraju s vremenom, ali su uvek tu… čekaju da ponovo podignemo pogled ka nebu. Prvi put kada se sećam da sam zaista bio go pod zvezdama nije bio vezan za ljubav ili borbu—već za bezbrižnost. Bio sam prvi razred osnovne škole, živeo blizu jezera, kao podstanar u skromnoj kući gde je život bio jednostavan, a opet beskrajan. Letnje večeri imale su svoj ritam. Sva deca iz ulice bi se okupila, donosili bismo drva i pravili malu vatru nasred ulice. Nije bilo telefona, nije bilo ometanja—samo smeh, varnice koje lete u noć i pogledi uprti ka nebu. Nije nam trebalo mnogo. Kiša meteora bila je spektakl, ali i običnim noćima smo tražili zvezde padalice kao da su blago. Svaka koja prođe nosila je jednu želju. A šta smo želeli? Sve. Novi bicikl.More tog leta.Da kućni ljubimac ozdravi.Brata ili sestru. Da nas simpatija pogleda drugačije. Naše želje bile su čiste, iskrene—iz dečije duše koja još ne poznaje granice. Tada je nada bila laka. Prirodna. Kao disanje. A onda se život pomerio. Otišli smo od jezera, preselili se na breg, na drugi kraj grada. Pogled se otvorio—ravnica koja se u letnjim noćima stapala sa nebom. I odjednom, nebo je postalo veće. Moćnije. Maštovitije. Noću su se zvezde mešale sa svetlima aviona, a negde u daljini treperile su i vetrenjače. Ako bi dovoljno dugo gledao, mogao si da zamisliš kako se svetla velikih gradova Beograda i Novog Sada stapaju sa horizontom, kao da i gradovi žele da budu deo neba. Taj pogled me je promenio. Tu sam odlučio da postanem profesor fizičkog vaspitanja. Deset godina života prošlo je u nekoj čudnoj, ali lepoj ravnoteži između rada i studija. Dani puni kretanja, noći i dalje rezervisane za razmišljanje. I tada dolazi novo poglavlje—ponovo go pod zvezdama. Na obali Dunava, na pesku, sa nepune 22 godine. Flaša zabodena u pesak, društvo, smeh koji nosi vetar sa reke… i ona. Moja prva velika, neostvarena ljubav. Iz tog vremena ostala su prijateljstva za ceo život. Ali i prvi gorak ukus poput badema—neuzvraćene ljubavi. Tih, oštar, nezaboravan.

> https://unsplash.com/photos/beach-picnic-with-drinks-and-coconut-water-l52PqZh120M Tada shvatiš nešto. Da biti „go pod zvezdama“ nije uvek sloboda. Nekad je to ranjivost. Stajanje bez zaštite, sa svim svojim osećanjima, bez garancije da će biti uzvraćena. Ali život ide dalje. I vraća te na početak. Godinama kasnije, sedeo sam ispred kuće sa majkom. Još jedna letnja noć. Još jedna kiša meteora. Isto nebo… ali sve je bilo drugačije. Svaka zvezda padalica nosila je novu vrstu želje. Ne više stvari. Ne čak ni snove. Već vreme. Da taj trenutak traje duže. Da ti razgovori potraju još malo. Tada shvatiš—želje odrastaju zajedno sa nama. A onda je došla Klara. Nije samo ušla u moj život—razbila je tišinu u njemu. Došla je sa svojim petogodišnjim sinom i donela život, buku, toplinu. Sedeli smo noću na terasi i ponovo gledali zvezde, pričajući o sutrašnjem danu. Gde ćemo ići?Šta ćemo graditi? Šta nas čeka? Ovog puta, biti go pod zvezdama značilo je nešto drugo.Značilo je ljubav.Pravu, prisutnu, zajedničku. Onda je došao sin. Pa ćerka. A nebo je ostalo isto—ali ja više nisam bio. Ponovo sam stajao na istom mestu. Jednom sa dedom i sinom. Drugi put sa sinom, ženom i malom Anjom. Tri generacije. Jedno nebo.

> https://unsplash.com/photos/a-group-of-people-standing-in-front-of-a-night-sky-sh8plCltfZo A ja sam i dalje tu, i dalje gledam gore, i dalje želim. Jer kada ogoliš život do kraja, ostane samo to:borba za goli život pod zvezdama. Ali ono što sam naučio kroz sve te noći je:nije važno koliko te život očvrsne…nije važno koliko želja se ne ostvari… Važno je da negde u tebi te želje ostanu iste. Jednostavne. Iskrene. Dečije. Jer onog trenutka kada prestaneš tako da želiš tada prestaneš da gledaš u nebo kao nekad. A možda je u tome prava čarolija. Ne u tome da li će se želja ostvariti.Već u tome da je nikada ne prestaneš želeti.

title.title: Spooky And Exciting! Nightshade By Keri Lake || Book Review
title.body:
~ Xhiphias*
I enjoy gothic vibes not only in movies but much more in books, because my imagination is engaged and it's like going on this mystery journey with the characters. Keri Lake has been referred to as the queen of gothic fantasy and after reading *[The Isle Of Sin And Shadows](https://peakd.com/hive-180164/@esther-emmanuel/the-isle-of-sin-and-shadows-by-keri-lake-oror-book-review)*, I almost want to agree with this title. Then I picked up **Nightshade**, the first part of a duology, read it and most certainly agree with this epithet. *Nightshade* is a paranormal dark gothic fantasy that takes readers on a wild, dark spin in an equally dark world. It's written in dual perspectives and two timelines, the past and present. The book begins in the present where we meet Farryn, the only daughter of a university professor. She's young, beautiful and a loner. She has lost everyone in her life and things take a dark turn when her brilliant father suddenly changes. He becomes obssessive about his research and then goes missing. He's declared dead. She begins to have disturbing dreams which leads her to study her father's research to understand reason for his behavioural change. The research is about ancient religion, hinting at the supernatural and a mysterious cult and a realm called Nightshade. It's a realm between the real world and hell. The father subtly hides a message inside the journals directing her to: *Seek out Van Croix in Nightshade*. Determined to find this mysterious person and solve her father's disappearance, Farryn goes on a journey to Nightshade. How will she get there? Who is Van Croix and how does he fit into the story of her father's supposed demise? **Genres:** Gothic, Dark Paranormal, Fantasy, Romance **Publication:** October 2021 **Pages:** 676 ### My Review And Rating In my opinion, Keri Lake can't write a bad book. Her books are so captivating and well-written that you want to keep reading more. I didn't expect to like *Nightshade* this much. Though it's a bit thick—664 pages—but I did not mind one bit. Every page and scene is dark and depraved, like an intriguing gothic read should be. There are gruesome scenes that set my imagination on fire and some scenes that keep me on the edge of my seat. It ends on a cliffhanger that will make you want to pick up the next book fast. Thankfully I have an e-copy of second book already. The plot is great, filled with mystery and unexpected twists along the way. The religious witchy trials also set an intriguing tone for the paranormal part. There are many unsolved secrets that I want to unravel immediately but the suspense keeps me invested. The story is fast-paced, written in alternating timelines since the lead characters are reincarnated. It moves between the past and present, giving us two stories told from dual perspectives. I enjoy this unique writing style because of the added interest of piecing the past and present of the characters together, and solving the mystery before the author does. I love the main characters: Jericho and Farryn. Keri Lake writes a morally grey character perfectly and Jericho is one of the best I've read so far. He's dark, moody, powerful with a dark sense of humour. He brings all kinds of corruption to this story, tethering between his own kind of ‘good’ and evil. Farryn on the other hand is one of the most annoying female characters I've read. I think this author specialises in making her female leads so. She's strong, courageous but often makes silly decisions that land them in trouble. While she frustrates me in some scenes, in others I admire and want to cheer her on. The worldbuiding is immersive and fascinating, a unique look into the world of angels and demons with dark, spooky mood that pulls you in. Check the trigger warnings before reading. I can't say more or do this book justice without giving away spoilers. It's best to go into this duology blind and see the story unfold. Just arm yourself with a bit of the premise that it's an epic love story, written in two timelines where the characters traverse realms. Rating this review, I give it 4.5 stars out of 5. I love the mystery, suspense and romance. If you’re a fan of gothic, paranormal fantasy, you'll enjoy this book. ![3yZiouw5jgtrj8RZntzpYvPkttnUNCNB3bKsugcDmKrZysEhsVCu7HmxWG7sYd9c3PJiWe24wRnpAB7HXq2WMvHX9AyxjgRuTY38KWSsv8...GFDdhx4UzPxqzjjpVMXNYgRDyspwo7pFw2RpyHZvde1tK7QLmYqnXBk9hDVg1dAooe2nLquVnXKjzS2uR5yQNqx1V5qutNgmqpFfKYLpS93ajRQosgFNPk3e1s.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/esther-emmanuel/23t7BFjADUCGjsLPt1YzFafTb9BeZ3Err5bNPwTi6RYNWED9TfZAhqAcZ8JCb2rGLLeT6.gif) *All images above are from my E-library* *Header images compiled in [Canva](https://canva.link/u0rk5p4645udup3).* *Thank you for visiting and supporting my blog.* 🤗

title.title: The Benefits Of Accountability
title.body:
>Anyone who can not be responsible for their actions can't be responsible for anyone. It is one of the signs of chronic indiscipline. Each time I listen to people say, “I am not an accountable person,” I marvel. Well, it good that they admitted they don't have the quality, but it's improper to make it look like it's not something anyone can build. One beautiful thing I love about traits is the fact that traits are not peculiar to anyone; whoever is willing and intentional can develop any trait he or she wants. The problem is, how many people are willing? I am not trying to be negative, but in our world today, people are more comfortable building wrong things than good things. It is easier for one to be careless with their principles than to keep them. Unfortunately, each of our daily actions is building something. Whether it is deliberate or not, our bodies are compounding those actions and adjusting to them until they become habitual. You tell small lies today, tomorrow, and next, before you know it, lying becomes something that comes out of you easily. Accountability is a trait that we should all possess. Taking responsibility for our actions means that we are reasonable and know what we are doing. It shows that one is ready to learn, grow, and progress in life. If someone admits their wrongs, it automatically means they are ready to make amends. Unfortunately, many people today prefer to put the blame on circumstances and people for their misfortune or wrongs rather than to take action. For me, refusing to take responsibility for our actions or inactions shows indolence. Even if people are truly responsible for certain things that affect us, blaming them won't undo what has happened. If all we do is blame people, blame situations, eventually, we will get comfortable with using blame to cover up for not growing. And that's a serious problem because instead of taking action by looking for solutions, one would be relaxed, hoping for a miracle to happen. One of the best things anyone can do for themselves is to become accountable. Take the blame, accept what has happened, and look for a way out. This will build your mind and make it even stronger. Instead of complaining, you would be transformed into someone who doesn't see anything as a limitation, no matter how bad the situation is. Anyone who sees a person with this kind of trait won't hesitate to work with them because they know that no matter what happens, the person will bring growth. This will give room for trust; people can handover tasks to such a person without panicking. Such people can get opportunities even where they don't merit it because they can be trusted.

Thanks For Reading

title.body: 1/4 🧵 @taskmaster4450le the browser probably doesn’t die the way Marc Andreessen frames it. It gets demoted. The browser was the front door to the web because humans had to click, compare, and stitch things together manually. AI collapses that workflow into “intent → result.” That’s the real threat: not the end of the web, but the end of the **browser as the primary interface**. Andreessen’s argument shows up in this [latent.space interview](https://www.latent.space/p/pmarca) and this [summary of his recent comments](https://aitoolly.com/ai-news/article/2026-04-04-marc-andreessen-discusses-the-death-of-the-browser-pi-openclaw-and-ai-evolution).
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 2/4 🧵 How it happens is brutally simple. Browsers are built for page-by-page navigation; AI is built for task completion. If I want “book the cheapest nonstop flight, move the meeting, summarize the contract, and compare 3 insurance plans,” a browser makes me open 20 tabs like it’s 2009. An AI agent can do the shitty glue work. That shift already shows up in how people talk about the internet becoming agent-driven rather than human-click-driven, including your own point on [mGDP and agentic internet](https://inleo.io/threads/view/taskmaster4450le/re-leothreads-qwtcjwde) and your note that [blockchain’s future is AI agents](https://inleo.io/threads/view/taskmaster4450le/re-leothreads-kvpxdfjf).

title.body:
3/4 🧵 What replaces it? Not “one new browser.” More likely **3 layers**:  
**1. Conversational shell** — voice/text interface that understands intent.  
**2. Agent layer** — software that can browse, fill forms, negotiate, compare, and execute.  
**3. Verification layer** — payments, identity, permissions, and proofs, where blockchains fit unusually well.  
So the web page becomes more like an API endpoint for machines. Humans won’t browse most services; they’ll supervise agents. Sites that survive best will expose structured data, transaction rails, and permissions for agents to use. Static page farms built for ad impressions get smoked.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 4/4 🧵 The catch: the browser won’t vanish tomorrow because the open web still does 3 things AI sucks at replacing cleanly: **discovery, trust, and serendipity**. People still want to see source material, not just an answer slurry. So my take is this: the future isn’t “no browser,” it’s **browser as fallback**, like command line never died but stopped being the mainstream UI. The winners will be products built for agent-to-service interaction, with human-readable pages as secondary output. Absurdly enough, the web may finally become what it always was underneath: computers talking to computers, with us just approving the important parts.\n\n#threadstorm

title.title: In the Face of War, Family Comes First
title.body:
Hello everyone, I will be participating in the third week prompt in the Hive Learners community. I’ve actually been really impressed with all the prompts this week. Like for real, I have a lot to say about this one.

![IMG-20260410-WA0011.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mathewdaddywah/AKRCk8BAJwr3RfR7cjSLr5FLhd7Mi5gJb64B7LSfrVJvQCec4La1L8RdzjXs4N4.jpg)

Images Generated with Meta AI 

When you hear “world war,” it’s not something that should be taken lightly. A lot of terrible things can happen. You could die instantly and never come back, be shot for no reason, or just become a victim of circumstances you didn’t even create.

You can lose everything you hold dear your home, your peace, your loved ones. From what I understand, world war is not just about soldiers fighting; it affects everybody, even innocent people who just want to live their normal lives.

Now coming to the main topic. The author asked, if a world war should break out now, what would be the first thing I would do? I won’t lie, it’s a very serious question. But honestly, I pray I never get to experience something like that. War is not something anyone should wish for. It turns life into survival of the fittest, and not everyone is built for that kind of situation.

My first priority would be to locate my family members. I would try to find out where everyone is at that moment and make sure they are safe. After that, I would start planning how to bring everyone together in one place. There is strength in unity, and I believe being together will give us a better chance of survival than being scattered in different locations.

It won’t be funny at all. I would definitely arm myself with any weapon I can find, because at that point, things would have gone beyond normal. It won’t be about laws anymore, it will be about survival. I need to be able to protect myself and also protect my family if danger comes close. Even while trying to locate them, I know I would have to stay alert and ready for anything.

After bringing my family together, the next step would be to find a safe location. Maybe somewhere far from the main city, because cities are usually the first targets during war. A quiet area, maybe a village or somewhere hidden, where there is less chaos. I would also try to gather basic supplies like food, water, medications, and clothes. These things may not seem like much now, but during war, they become very important.

Communication would also be important. I would try to stay updated with what is happening around the country, so I can make better decisions. At the same time, I would avoid unnecessary movement, because moving around too much can be dangerous.

As for joining the army, I don’t think that would be my first choice. My responsibility is first to my family. If I cannot secure their safety, then going to fight in a war wouldn’t make sense to me. 

However, if it gets to a point where defending my country also means protecting my family’s future, then I might consider it. But honestly, my main focus will always be survival and keeping my loved ones safe.

In conclusion, world war is something I never wish to experience. It brings pain, loss, and destruction. But if it ever happens, my plan is simple find my family, stay together, stay prepared, and do everything possible.

Thanks for reading hope to see you next time @mathewdaddywah blog

title.title: I’m planting flowers in my garden.
title.body:
I’m planting flowers in my garden. 
Today we bought some flowers while we were at the market. 
I saw a woman selling flowers. I was curious to see what kind of flowers she had. All the flowers were so bright and beautiful. I chose two types of flowers: violas and daisies 🌼. 
I bought seven violas and one daisy plant. 
They bloom very beautifully. I bought violas in different colors: yellow, purple, blue, white, and pink. And the daisy is a beautiful pink color. 
I planted the flowers at home. I had to dig 8 holes. Water and plant the flowers. I carefully removed them from the pot, taking the soil along with the flower. I placed the flower, along with that soil, into the hole and covered the edges with soil. Then I watered the flowers again. Leaving the soil on helps ensure that the roots aren’t damaged and the flowers don’t wilt. You can plant all kinds of plants this way. 
Now these flowers are decorating my garden.

title.title: A Heartwarming Surprise: How My Neighbor’s Creamy Sopas Turned an Ordinary Afternoon into a Shared Filipino Moment
title.body:
![collage.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/23wCQXtjH6wD5QQ3FxEXrZEfL2VZNnX4k4WEHvJPhmFE8exSkb2dmxUUzg8kRDD8ghZNL.jpeg)

**Hello Hive Fam! Warm greetings to all my fellow Hive bloggers, most especially my co-Filipino writers here in BayaniHive.** I’m excited to share a simple yet meaningful story from today that reminded me of the beauty of generosity and community.

![3d5d5e22-2801-4ebf-a40a-32b5eb76434a.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/23tmNNtbiNkFfcGAnepFib74dyTmAgFMRAwrQtHpNGq6pw69ywjV8D9ikfFtMgyUQD1Vr.jpeg)

This afternoon, while I was at home, I suddenly heard my neighbor calling me from outside my gate. At first, I wondered why she was there; was she asking for something? To my surprise, she handed me a bowl filled with **creamy sopas**.

![c980a7c4-9060-447d-b73b-d40312ad5a47.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/23tvo2xPCorkUmHcQDkgVSXE99JxBaSYTZqA8XByGWRZRic8XtxNW1wFqpyKa7nMdf4zU.jpeg)

She told me that her son requested her to cook, and she decided to share some with me. That small gesture instantly brightened my day. The sopas, warm and comforting, became my merienda. But more than the food itself, it was the thoughtfulness behind it that touched me.

![e98c4a70-2bd7-4d13-b81e-1a1b9e7ab253.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/23tmNAuFbVnyt5qpsGyNpM5rti9guhao9rx9uXEZXiMPyVidnUn6tgNkyZyPEjfiY9rUH.jpeg)

Moments like these remind me of the Filipino spirit of bayanihan, the way we look out for each other, even in the simplest acts. A bowl of sopas may seem ordinary, but when shared, it becomes extraordinary.

![f0e19196-dfb6-4d37-8d2a-9998a7acd40b.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/23vsQDAmVLkKj5J2GtU5s5vXwnwPYSG3fXPSAPrM99vqnjxcHjAVXE8SMXjdRWP1Rbjx6.jpeg)

**Thank you, Hive Fam, for taking the time to read my little story.** I hope this inspires you to appreciate the small acts of kindness around you. Let’s continue to share positivity and warmth in our community, one blog at a time.

title.body: 3/5 🧵 She also makes the job sound broader than “reading sport on camera.” Good presenters need to communicate clearly, think fast, handle live situations, interview well, and actually understand the sport they’re covering. If you can’t connect with people or adapt on the fly, the camera will expose you brutally.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 4/5 🧵 Another useful thread in it: there’s no single doorway into the industry. Study helps, mentors help, practical reps help more. Build clips, take smaller opportunities seriously, and stop waiting for the perfect break. Media careers often reward momentum more than perfection.

title.title: The Madman Tactic Revisited
title.body:
![OIP-2745504273.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZVSJqift9mJSYL9vZoXno3fYnGcF9NvA5UGKuBHsbBkP/OIP-2745504273.jpg)
CNN.com






Today, we see a dangerous repetition of American hubris as Trump copies Nixon’s “madman’’ tactics by openly threatening to destroy the life-sustaining infrastructure of Iran. This openly stated intention would be a major war crime. It represents a desperate attempt to terrorise the Iranian people and, in turn, break the will of the government of Iran. Trump and his inner circle of grifting cronies assume that a massive, sustained aerial bombardment can destroy a 3,000-year-old civilisation. History tells a different story.

### The Illusion of Air Power: Lessons from Vietnam


![OIP-2530991479.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbSJ6JcyxzoRUCTuQDKMsoTKVjbbFB7uov64PabH2AJkL/OIP-2530991479.jpg)
[B-52 Stratofortress](https://www.defensemedianetwork.com/stories/b-52-stratofortress-over-vietnam-photos/)



The reality of the air war over Vietnam was vastly different from the sanitised American narrative. The U.S. bombing campaigns, from Operation Rolling Thunder (1965–1968) to the massive Linebacker offensives of 1972, suffered a catastrophic failure. They failed not because of a lack of firepower, but because strategic air power proved completely incapable of dismantling a decentralised, agrarian society with an iron will, bolstered by a massive civil defence network and an unbroken lifeline of support from the Soviet Union and China.

German generals writing after World War II agreed upon the catastrophic consequences of fighting a genocidal war of attrition against a fully mobilised population and planned economy. The Americans in Vietnam were forced to learn this lesson the hard way.

### Operation Rolling Thunder: The Failure of \
\n\nThe United States launched Operation Rolling Thunder on March 2, 1965. Conceived as a campaign of \

it was designed to slowly escalate the bombing to coerce Hanoi into a negotiated settlement without triggering a wider war with the USSR or China. Over the next three years, the U.S. flew over 300,000 attack sorties.


![OIP-1018991594.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdtH72yQyvLcwjVjbNu8ma77jQYeDTG8Y3tBXGtWc6NYC/OIP-1018991594.jpg)
[B-52](https://www.edwards.af.mil/News/AFMC-News/Article/4279416/history-in-two-boeing-b-52-stratofortress-performance-enhancement-1950/) 



Despite the massive scale of the bombardment, Rolling Thunder failed to completely destroy North Vietnam's power grid. When U.S. bombs destroyed 87% of the main power capacity by mid-1967, the North Vietnamese government managed to keep the lights on through a brilliant strategy of decentralisation. They imported around 2,000 small diesel units from the Soviet Union and China, each generating 15-20 MW, and scattered them across the countryside.

Key facilities were physically moved underground; the 3/2 Thermal Power Plant, for instance, was completely rebuilt inside Huyen Trung Cave to shield it from bombers. Strict rationing cut power to all non-essential users, ensuring the military and vital infrastructure survived.

### The Escalation: Linebacker I and the \

\n\nFollowing the calamitous defeat of the South Vietnamese forces during the Easter Offensive of 1972, the U.S. launched Operation Linebacker I. This campaign, lasting from May to October, marked a significant escalation. U.S. aircraft dropped over 150,000 tons of bombs, extensively utilising new laser-guided and so-called \
It failed to break Hanoi's political resolve.\n\nWhen peace talks stalled in December 1972, President Nixon ordered Operation Linebacker II, the infamous \

This was the largest B-52 bombing campaign of all time. Over 11 days, more than 700 B-52 sorties delivered over 20,000 tons of bombs on the Hanoi and Haiphong areas. The objective was purely coercive: to force the North Vietnamese back to the negotiating table on American terms.

This murderous bombing campaign killed thousands of civilians, destroyed over a hundred factories, schools, and hospitals, and decimated 80% of the country’s electrical power production. Over 500,000 workers were mobilised to repair the damage.

As the Marxist historian Gabriel Kolko documents in Anatomy of a War, this campaign was fundamentally an act of terrorism born of desperation, as the US had lost the war on the ground. The Christmas bombing was designed to intimidate and terrorise the Democratic Republic of Vietnam (DRV) into submission, serving as a desperate reassertion to the world of Nixon's willingness to use raw, unfettered military power.


![output.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQme9tvDmR14p6RZ7KBaD2HfpeZv1oogRMigPXDAr7MXdPm/output.jpg)
AI Gen



### The Political Fallout and Staggering Losses

Kolko highlights that the U.S. constantly presented ambiguous positions at the Paris peace talks, retracting proposals whenever it suited them. The Christmas bombing was a cynical attempt by Nixon to portray himself as a \

to extract concessions. However, the DRV refused to negotiate out of fear.

The bombing achieved no durable military impact. Instead, it resulted in staggering U.S. losses. North Vietnam's active military defence, anchored by Soviet-supplied SAMs and MiG fighters, mauled American attack formations. The U.S. lost between 22 and 27 B-52s and 12 other aircraft. The operation was so costly that Pentagon officials admitted they had not realised the price would be so high. The Christmas bombing did not break the DRV. It merely isolated the Nixon administration politically and horrified the world.

### The Power of Civil Defence: Underground Villages


![OIP-2285037793.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXuMR7gNj4PrY8cg8K5RMHchxcNa13Xoh14wxgn8m7SyK/OIP-2285037793.jpg)
[Vinh Moc Tunnels](http://samtourvietnam.com.vn/vinh-moc-tunnels/)



A major reason these massive campaigns of terror failed to bludgeon North Vietnam into submission was the civil defence measures implemented by the government. To protect its civilian population, Hanoi adopted a strategy that moved far beyond simple individual shelters.

The most critical step was the large-scale evacuation of non-essential personnel from major cities. Ahead of the Christmas Bombings in December 1972, over 500,000 people—around 85% of Hanoi's urban population—were evacuated to the countryside. Nearly all schools, universities, and non-essential institutions were relocated.

The core of the plan was the construction of a vast and varied network of shelters. Hanoi alone had around 400,000 individual \

shelters, often made from concrete pipes or bamboo, alongside hundreds of thousands of group tunnels and bunkers. The population was mobilised to dig an extensive network of tunnels, which reportedly reached 50,000 kilometres in total length by the war's end.\n\nThis effort culminated in fully functional \

In the heavily bombarded DMZ area, the Vịnh Mốc tunnels housed roughly 1,200 people for nearly 2,000 days on three levels reaching 30 meters deep. It was a complete community, featuring freshwater wells, communal kitchens, and even an underground maternity ward where 17 children were born. This massive infrastructure project, built almost entirely by hand using local materials and recycled scrap metal from dud shells, allowed society to continue functioning under constant threat.

### Unbroken Lifelines and the Limits of Technological Superiority

The resilience displayed by North Vietnam was backed by the Soviet Union and China. Despite Kissinger's delusions that détente had isolated Hanoi, Kolko points out that Chinese military aid to the DRV in 1972 was double that of 1971, and Soviet arms aid more than doubled. Both nations overcame their past wrangling to speed supplies by rail to circumvent the U.S. blockade.

In the end, the U.S. bombing campaigns failed because they could not destroy the North's will to resist or its logistical lifeline from China and the USSR. The ultimate failure lay in air power's inability to resolve the political and military realities of the ground conflict. The American war machine, much like the Wehrmacht on the Eastern Front decades earlier, found that technological superiority alone cannot conquer a mobilised and determined people.

### A Dangerous Repetition: The Threat to Iran


![OIP-2530744609.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRNyVXTYfW91P7Lq6AGRaYXD33UYUw5SPB4efvEAB8qWT/OIP-2530744609.jpg)
[Iranian underground base](https://thearabianpost.com/iran-unveils-underground-base-for-fighter-jets/)



Today, as the United States contemplates utilising these exact same tactics against Iran, it seems the Pentagon has learned nothing from its calamitous defeat in Southeast Asia. Iran is a vast, mountainous country with a deeply entrenched decentralised military infrastructure, a massive and highly motivated population, and a sophisticated civil defence network. Much like North Vietnam, Iran has spent decades preparing for an American air assault by moving its critical nuclear and military facilities deep underground.

Furthermore, the United States remains the same bad-faith actor it was during the Paris Peace Accords of the early 1970s. Just as Nixon and Kissinger used the Christmas bombings to terrorise Hanoi under the guise of seeking peace, Washington today speaks of negotiations while actively undermining any ceasefire. We saw this duplicity a mere 12 hours after the agreed ceasefire. Israel, with U.S. collusion, blatantly broke the terms of the deal with Iran by using its airforce to massacre hundreds of Lebanese civilians.

Any attempt by the U.S. to destroy Iran through saturation bombing will hopefully meet the same disastrous fate as Operation Rolling Thunder and Linebacker II. The hubris of imperial air power will once again shatter against the unbreakable will of a nation fighting for its survival.



![OIP-2113350492.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTypLURYVfT2tWcWaUdhjpRRtPBrUhPuQTA1Y6YVJiL2k/OIP-2113350492.jpg)
[Lego Wars](https://www.memri.org/tv/iran-lego-animation-glorifies-war-with-israel)

title.title: Boj! S bezdomovectvím, nebo s bezdomovci?
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTBFCR2xa6giS375bLC4Y9Ajkoc7xW7EwjvCwGjAjvw2W/20260402_054358.jpg)
Je to pár dnů, co jsem se ocitl na Hlavním-Wilsonově nádraží v Praze. Před šestou hodinou ranní. Co jsem tam asi tak mohl vidět? Mimo jiné LEGO model Hl.nádraží.

Ten model je přesunutý. Narazil jsem na něj jinde než minule. Ale o to nejde. Na modelu můžete vidět tyhle dva bezdomovce. Velmi stylizovaná a \

představa ...
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRNP5YEj9qFPzXMSFEJ4GfECn1Y7aCyuepuz17zxzh7ua/20260402_054345.jpg)
Kdybych měl stanovit poměr bezdomovců a ostatních figurek na modelu, řekl bych tak 1:50. Na modelu je více kostlivců než bezdomovců ... V reálu je to ale jinak.

Asi překvapím. Nefotografoval jsem tentokrát bezdomovce. Jsem na ně zvyklý. Potkávám je denně. Na Kobylisích, na Palmovce, v parku za domem sester matky Terezy  ... Ale ti na nádraží se mi zdají ještě tak o dva levely níž. A existuje určitá míra hnusu, pod kterou už nefotím. To by mi přišlo ... Jako když válečný reportér fotí umírající dítě.

Bezdomovce jsem ani nepočítal. Odhadem ... Vyšší desítky v budově. Poměr k cestujícím tak 1:10. A kostlivce jsem nepotkal žádného.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTRMPQvi2bqjsSccusbHMREqzMFGxtGpdfpWbBPz2wq2r/20260402_054109.jpg)
Vyšel jsem i před budovu. Tam bezdomovců moc nebylo. Zima. Ale věděl jsem, co chci nafotit. Právě tuhle lavičku.

Kompozičně ... Chtěl jsem zachytit i sochu Woodrowa Wilsona. Ale o tu lavičku jde. Vidíte na ní \

opatření.

Tak upřímně. Když je bezdomovec pod vlivem ať už jakékoli omamné či psychotropní látky, tak se obtočí i kolem téhle zábrany.  Že jsem jich tam pár takových viděl. Obtočených bezdomovců. Zábran jsem viděl ... Nepočítaně.

No a jakžtakž střízliví bezdomovci si do úrovně zábrany něco položili. Krabice, hadry ... Při svém odchodu samozřejmě ten bordel neuklidili.
Tak o co teda jde?
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZtj1a3pAsP55dUz4hdJVg95N7z2yBwnPcJRR3KQaxUcy/20260408_063130.jpg)
A tohle je poslední model sedačky na tramvajové zastávce. To jsou také zábrany proti bezdomovcům.

Symptomatičtí jsou i ti holubi. Jestli si někdo vzpomene, náš panelák řešil problém holubů. Nakonec jsme ho i vyřešili - pomocí bodců nalepených všude možně. 

Opravdu jsme problém vyřešili? Holubi odletěli o dům dál. O dva domy, o tři domy ... Je to řešení?

A čeho chtějí dopravní podnik, případně město, městská část dosáhnout? Chtějí vyštvat bezdomovce ze Sherwoodu, tedy z Vrchlického sadů, z okolí nádraží?

Možná. Smysl by to dávalo. Vstupní brána pro cizince, nádraží, má být reprezentativní. Ať hned cizák neví, co ho u nás čeká. Jak asi vypadá okolí letiště ... Tam jsem už hodně dlouho nebyl. No. Tak deset let. Je to dlouho?

Takže vyštveme bezdomovce na jiná nádraží, na jiná náměstí, na lavičky jiných majitelů ... Nebo si lehnou na krabice na zem.

Možná půjdeme ještě dál. Vyštveme bezdomovce z Prahy. Do Brna, do Ostravy, do Berouna ... Vyštveme je z Republiky, z Evropy, z planety Země. Všude budou protibezdomovecké zábrany. Jako protiholubí bodce. Ale jistě chápete, že se ten postup někde zadrhne.

A jak řešit obecně problém bezdomovectví? V ČR jich je podle odhadů 20 až 30 tisíc. Hlavně v Praze. Babo raď. Jistě, existují knížecí rady. 

Jak se řeší problém holubů? Těch je ... Vysoké statisíce až jednotky milionů. A nejvíc jich je taky v Praze. Nejefektivnější k jejich omezení se ukazuje zřizovat jim hnízdiště s dostatkem potravy a odebírat jim vejce.

Bezdomovec je lidská bytost. Bůh miluje všechny lidské bytosti, své děti, stejně. Bylo by správné zřídit hnízdiště pro bezdomovce, kde by bylo dost jídla, alkoholu a drog? Široká veřejnost by byla jistě proti. Takové náklady! Nezaslouží si to ... Ale nebylo by to nakonec nejlevnější?

Nevím. Napadá Vás nějaké řešení, jak si lidsky poradit s bezdomovectvím?
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdDgUd1vRVhYLicTBuKXiWGJJZz2y9fbEFJ7tkS9kiaTG/image.png)

title.title: Time Loop ~ Entry for SMASh Contest Round 421 [ENG/ESP]
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZjevHcvTMzyQgg35K26QWye9BXqqjxnQbzUX9dMkPrmX/sha.png)

Hello friends and Shadow Hunters community. First, as in every blog, I wish you a nice day; better yet, a nice week, since it's been a week since my last blog in the community. And it seems like yesterday when I shared a photo and a little piece of history... And speaking of History, I have next to me my notes from my History classes, a bundle of facts and prompts that feel not only distant in time but also alien. Once I heard something like: \

I think that, if we are experts at anything, it's at forgetting history. Well, let's return to today, and the goal is to show you my shadow of the week.\n\n> Hola amigos y comunidad de Shadow Hunters. Primero, como en cada blog, les deseo un lindo día; mejor aún, una linda semana, ya que ha pasado una semana desde mi último blog en la comunidad. Y parece que fue ayer cuando compartía una foto y un pedacito de historia... Y hablando de Historia, tengo a mi lado los apuntes de mis clases de Historia, un manojo de hechos y consignas que se sienten no solo distantes en el tiempo, sino ajenos. Una vez escuché algo como: \

. Creo que, si algo somos especialistas, es en olvidar la historia. Bueno, regresamos al día de hoy y el objetivo es mostrarles mi sombra de la semana.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVAGgU9MPSFYMgQfZ3yVTHfKhozu6o1JbpWwfKEkidLtK/20260327_172344.jpg)

This photo I’m showing you today is very simple: my ring on top of my history notes. There, among dates and unknown people, rests a perfect ring. As evening falls, the shadows grow longer on my table. I recently moved my table closer to the window to make even better use of the sunlight. A moment ago I was telling you about those who forget history and are condemned to repeat it. A circular ring with no beginning or end, I think that would be a good metaphor for this. Time loop. Trapped in an endless cycle. I saw the ring’s shadow, I saw the typography of my notes and the rough paper, and I thought: I have a shadow, I have a story, it’s time to take a photo. As for my history notes, they’re still there on the table, like that endless degree that I don’t see coming to an end, perhaps tormented less by the effort of feeling like I’m studying again and more by the difficult situation of these days. Well, friends, I don’t have much more to say today, just to send you warm greetings and my ever‑recurring wishes for good luck and great success. Bye bye.

> Esta foto que hoy les muestro es muy simple: mi anillo sobre los apuntes de historia. Ahí, entre fechas y personas desconocidas, descansa un aro perfecto. Al caer la tarde, las sombras se hacen más largas sobre mi mesa. Hace poco cambié de lugar la mesa para situarla más cerca de la ventana y poder aprovechar aún mejor la luz solar. Les hablaba hace un momento sobre quienes olvidan la historia y están condenados a repetirla. Un anillo circular, sin principio ni fin, creo que sería una buena metáfora de esto. Time loop. Atrapado en un ciclo sin fin. Vi la sombra del anillo, vi la tipografía de mis apuntes y el áspero papel, y pensé: tengo una sombra, tengo una historia, es hora de tomar una fotografía. En cuanto a mis apuntes de historia, siguen ahí sobre la mesa, como esa licenciatura infinita que no veo momento en que acabe, quizás atormentado menos por el esfuerzo de sentirme estudiando de nuevo que por la difícil situación de los días. Bueno, amigos, hoy no tengo mucho más que contar, solo enviarles un caluroso saludo y mis siempre recurrentes deseos de mucha suerte y muchos éxitos. Chau chau.

title.title: Singleness is Bliss
title.body:
With each day that passes, I get to see more and more reason why getting into a relationship or making myself vulnerable enough to actually love someone and commit to them fully could be the last thing I do.

![photo-1584819574093-18416adc12ec.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/prayzz/23wMW4iH7fgc21qT36rvccHZTDGMEGHAdGwVdoH6DDUd2wx4Awcd9uhKZeEGZha1nWkMz.jpeg)
<sub> [photo by call me hangry](https://unsplash.com/photos/white-and-blue-labeled-carton-jmRikC7H2FA) </sub>

I have this friend who's currently getting ready to relocate to an entirely different state because of his relationship of five years that recently came to an end. These guys have been dating for the past five years, so almost every one of us here knows that they're together.

But according to this friend of mine, he and his girlfriend had been having issues since the beginning of the year, and he admits that in their five years of being together, they've had multiple breakups, but none of them has been as serious as this one. What hurts him even more is the fact that he feels she's now talking to other people and has moved on, so all hope of them coming back together is gone.

He didn't go into details about why they broke up but said they had had a minor misunderstanding, something that normally would have only taken a week of quarrels and they would be back together, but instead, his girlfriend had visited him at his place and told him that she no longer was interested in being with anyone. She wanted to be alone for the meantime and didn't want to see anyone.

But according to him, he feels she's lying because he overheard her over the phone later that day when she was flirting with a coworker (she had recently gotten a new job), and that hurt him deeply. And now, after making a few calls for the past couple of days, he has somehow been able to secure a job that comes with accommodation in a faraway state.

He told me that he initially had no plans to leave here, but the pain of everything and the rejection too (he has begged and apologized to her a couple of times) is too much for him to bear, so now he's living for a job that he's not excited about and doesn't even pay as much as his previous job did.

Listening to him talk and watching him go through the pain he currently is going through has just confirmed to me that maybe my decision on remaining single might just be the best one. I know there are good partners out there, but unless you have luck on your side, you have to go through a lot of the bad ones before you eventually see that good one.

And I don't know about you guys, but I don't think I'm ready yet to do all of that.

title.title: La constancia hace la diferencia. 📝
title.body:
>

Siempre nos enfocamos en encontrar la motivación para seguir adelante con nuestras metas, y es uno de los aspectos más gratificantes de cualquier actividad, especialmente cuando se centra en el bienestar personal o familiar. Pero resulta que esta es quizás una de las experiencias más efímeras que podemos vivir, porque en cuanto surge un problema, sentimos que perdemos de vista nuestro objetivo.


![Presentación Propuesta de proyecto Elegante Amarillo.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXEGD8LpSfycqVWRxuZHzVQ3GRuZnv2iN5RZfAiwLZhSZ/Presentaci%C3%B3n%20Propuesta%20de%20proyecto%20Elegante%20Amarillo.jpg)
[Fuente del recurso](https://pixabay.com/es/vectors/trepador-escalada-silueta-9491285/)

Esto me ha pasado muchas veces, y podría volver a suceder, porque creo que es algo natural para los seres humanos; siempre buscamos algo en lo que apoyarnos, sobre todo en el ámbito emocional o sentimental. Pero al mismo tiempo, también he aprendido valiosas lecciones de estas situaciones, donde algunos de mis planes se han desmoronado simplemente por perder la motivación.

Esto no fue motivo para rendirme, porque siempre he tenido la suerte de contar con personas que me apoyan y me han ayudado a superar estas situaciones. Pero no es lo mismo que sentirse anónimo cuando se pierde de vista la meta.

Por eso empecé a centrarme más en la constancia que en la motivación, ya que me ayuda a perseverar incluso sin un motivo. No siempre estaremos de humor para hacer cosas, pero si seguimos trabajando para conseguir lo que queremos, incluso en los momentos de desánimo, obtendremos buenos resultados, que serán la verdadera motivación. En otras palabras, ver buenos resultados nos dará la motivación real.


![freestocks-photos-city-2939879.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQGXbxGKnnBMmBn3zNCf6k3UUjjMXCTzJJ68c2B3bMZZL/freestocks-photos-city-2939879.jpg)
[Fuente](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/ciudad-arquitectura-naturaleza-2939879/)

Hace unos seis meses, inicié mi propio negocio, motivado por la situación económica. Al principio, ver los resultados fue genial. Pero de repente, hubo una caída en las ventas y, además, tenía clientes con deudas vencidas. Fue una época muy frustrante; pensé que todo había terminado y que tendría que dejar de vender por mi cuenta.

Pero mi proveedor me dio un consejo: \

. Fue un buen consejo, porque al mes siguiente pude vender sin problemas, y quienes debían dinero pagaron, lo que me dejó con una ganancia que antes creía perdida. Esta situación me enseñó que la motivación me ayudará a lograr mis objetivos, pero la constancia me ayudará a crear el hábito de perseverar y buscar soluciones en lugar de rendirme, ya que los buenos resultados son una recompensa a largo plazo. ![geralt-person-110303.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZkdCPMqcR4sSd7dVXMsK4f5S5YXKBLZLkbuvYvfVE4th/geralt-person-110303.jpg) [Fuente](https://pixabay.com/illustrations/person-human-pleasure-sunset-sun-110303/) Como he mencionado en publicaciones anteriores, soy madre, y desde que tuve a mi primer hijo, me he sentido motivada a esforzarme por el mejor futuro posible para él; es algo maravilloso. Pero no es fácil. Ha habido buenos y malos momentos, en los que quizás la motivación no fue suficiente. Pero la determinación de ver a mis hijos crecer sanos y felices me mantuvo activa, trabajando, aprendiendo y dándoles lo mejor de mí. Lo mismo ocurre con mi crecimiento personal. Antes no lo veía así, pero hoy entiendo que si me centro en el autocuidado, empezando por mis emociones, veré resultados positivos. ![geralt-satisfaction-7196040.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQme3gKC55QkoApX8xZv9ZVNopVXYa4FdYGuG6Ksf4UGPLS/geralt-satisfaction-7196040.jpg) [Fuente](https://pixabay.com/es/illustrations/satisfacci%c3%b3n-salud-placer-sonrisa-7196040/) Ser constante puede ser difícil al principio, pero una vez que mantenemos el hábito en nuestras vidas, se convierte en parte de nosotros. Muchos lo verán como un esfuerzo excesivo, pero mientras nos sintamos bien, será lo mejor para nosotros. > Gracias por leer mi publicación. ❤️ --- |English version . | | -------- --- We're always focused on finding motivation to keep moving forward with our goals, and it's one of the most enjoyable aspects of any activity, especially when it's focused on personal or family well-being. But it turns out that this is perhaps one of the most fleeting things we can experience in our lives, because as soon as a problem arises, we feel like we've lost sight of our objective. ![Presentación Propuesta de proyecto Elegant.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXq948yq4tTDoAbAw4zpjbmRFKt7YQxhcNfXG4hWHHPFm/Presentaci%C3%B3n%20Propuesta%20de%20proyecto%20Elegant.jpg) [Fuente del recurso](https://pixabay.com/es/vectors/trepador-escalada-silueta-9491285/) This has happened to me many times, and it might happen again, because I feel it's something natural for us human beings; we always look for something to lean on, especially in the emotional or sentimental realm. But at the same time, I've also learned valuable lessons from these kinds of situations, where some of my plans have fallen apart, simply because I lost motivation. This wasn't a reason to give up, because I've always been fortunate to have people who support me and have helped me through these situations. But it's not the same feeling of being anonymous when you lose sight of your goal. That's why I started focusing more on consistency than motivation, since it helps me persevere even without a reason. We won't always be in the mood to do things, but if we keep working towards what we want, even in those moments of discouragement, we'll get good results, which will be the real motivation. In other words, seeing good results will give us true motivation. ![freestocks-photos-city-2939879.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQGXbxGKnnBMmBn3zNCf6k3UUjjMXCTzJJ68c2B3bMZZL/freestocks-photos-city-2939879.jpg) [Fuente](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/ciudad-arquitectura-naturaleza-2939879/) About six months ago, I started my own business, motivated by the economic situation. Seeing the results at first was great. But suddenly, there was a drop in sales, and I also had people with overdue debts. It was a very frustrating time for me; I thought it was all over and that I would have to stop selling independently. But my supplier gave me some advice: \

It was actually good advice, because the following month I was able to sell without any problems, and those who owed money paid, leaving me with a profit that I had previously thought was lost. This situation taught me that motivation will help me accomplish things, but consistency will help me create the habit of persevering and seeking solutions instead of giving up, since good results are a reward in the long run. ![geralt-person-110303.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZkdCPMqcR4sSd7dVXMsK4f5S5YXKBLZLkbuvYvfVE4th/geralt-person-110303.jpg) [Fuente](https://pixabay.com/illustrations/person-human-pleasure-sunset-sun-110303/) As I've mentioned in previous posts, I'm a mother, and since having my first child, I've felt motivated to strive for the best possible future for them—it's a wonderful thing. But it's not easy. There have been good times and not-so-good times, where perhaps motivation wasn't enough. But the determination to see my children grow up healthy and happy kept me active, working, learning, and giving them the best of myself. The same goes for my personal growth. I didn't think this way before, but today I can see that if I focus on self-care, starting with my emotions, I'll see positive results. ![geralt-satisfaction-7196040.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQme3gKC55QkoApX8xZv9ZVNopVXYa4FdYGuG6Ksf4UGPLS/geralt-satisfaction-7196040.jpg) [Fuente](https://pixabay.com/es/illustrations/satisfacci%c3%b3n-salud-placer-sonrisa-7196040/) Being consistent can be difficult at first, but once we maintain the habit in our lives, it becomes a part of us. title.title: Don’t Forget Yourself While Chasing Everything Else
title.body:
There was a time I thought being busy meant I was doing well in life. If I was always working, always thinking, always trying to get things done, then I felt like I was moving forward. But slowly, I started to notice something was off. My body felt tired more often, my mind was not as clear, and even small things started to feel heavy.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ6JGCLvst45SFq6NfAhD5TzinQfyJXZXEmifrvri243g/1775829831664.jpg)[source](https://unsplash.com/photos/young-entrepreneur-listening-music-over-headphones-while-relaxing-on-a-break-in-the-office-HahsklM9uNg)

I didn’t pay attention at first. I just kept going. That’s how many of us are, we ignore small signs until they become bigger problems.

My parents used to say something simple, “Health is wealth.” I heard it many times growing up, but I never really sat down to understand it. It sounded like one of those common sayings adults repeat. But now, I see it differently.

There was a period when I was not resting properly, eating at the wrong time, and always on my phone or laptop. I told myself it was part of hustling, part of trying to make things work. But instead of getting stronger, I was getting weaker without noticing.

One day, I just felt completely drained. Not sick in a serious way, but not okay either. That was when it hit me. What is the point of chasing success if your body and mind can’t carry it?

Since then, I’ve been trying, not perfectly, but trying to take my health more seriously. Simple things like resting when I’m tired, drinking enough water, stepping away from work sometimes. These things don’t look big, but they matter.

My mother always said, “Your body is your first home.” If you don’t take care of it, where will you live? That line stayed with me. Because no matter what you achieve in life, if your health is failing, everything becomes harder.

It’s easy to get caught up in chasing money, goals, and recognition. But health should not be the thing we remember only when it starts to fail.

I’m still learning how to balance it. Some days I forget, some days I do better. But one thing I know now is this, nothing you are building will last long if you are not okay.

So in everything I’m doing, I try to remind myself, don’t forget your health. Because at the end of the day, you need yourself to enjoy whatever you are working for.

title.title: Pligrimiage trip is not the same anymore.
title.body: Vaishno devi is considered to be an important pligrimiage place. Thousands of visit the place during the year to seek blessings. The Vaishno Devi trek is a 13.5 km spiritual journey to a holy cave shrine in Jammu and Kashmir’s Trikuta Hills, believed to be the abode of Mata Vaishno Devi, who fulfills devotees' desires. Devotees believe that walking the challenging 13.5 km path brings spiritual solace, inner peace, and the fulfillment of desires. A 5,200 ft climb to the sacred \

and the completion of the pilgrimage to the Bhairon Temple is not an easy task. I was there few days ago but find things have changed a lot.


![1000266679.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/245HqKaZdfuZBYsTMa36APKXECnfyM3ALV87Lr1hQzU9nQjeM1nFMjRGZKoJmkXcuRumC.jpg)

The yatra / trekking  is not only about reaching the shrine but about experiencing a profound spiritual journey that has been part of Indian heritage for generations. In all my previous visit, climbing the hill was used to be a funfilled journey. The atmosphere used to be electrifying with people dancing and chanting all the way. They have faith and respect for each other devotees who were travelling. They stood for their support. But this time around I see a major change of devotees attitude. The journey was bot the same. Most of the people were climbing to get the blessing, bo matter if they do some sin enroute to the shrine. I noticed devotees were more concerned about completing the journey rather than showing respect to others.



![1000266968.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/23xyNm6uNQq3rNhYHLUjRabxV1bsuAbzs9MXkWeW5HxQLH4mZBYb2BwRcpqLqYVHCBGiF.jpg)


The worship of young girls as Mata Vaishnavi is an integral part of the culture and reverence surrounding the holy shrine. This tradition honors her manifestation as a divine child and her role as Shakti, honoring her pure form before she became the Mother Goddess of the cave. I remember young girls were worshipped at the shrine and were offered gifts and other snacks as offering. This time around, I noticed boys coming back from the hill were looking and staring at young girls climbing the hill. Their approach and intention were clearly not good. But rather than feeling shame they were enjoying the staring at girls. Likewise, eaelier devotee who used to travel were high respect for other devotee. They were ready to support the needy. But this time, they were more focussed in completing their journey, than supporting other. I am not sure how they going to get blessed. 

 
![1000266969.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/23zknVNuV7hqvMP2F1qu5TzpDduRka1DUuh7ZDk5CBtsKZUtufAeJSC63zPHnvqKPSkrv.jpg)

Privileged access for special guests and those paying for fast-track darshan often results in chaotic scenes, with ordinary devotees forced into long, difficult queues while others receive faster entry. Nowadays, getting a VIP access to this place is not a big deal. Anyone with political connection or wealthy individuals or any army contacts can easily arrange their quick trip making other other common devotees to suffer. The shrine board too unable to control such VIP protocol. When I reached the bhawan, I had to wait for 15 min only because some VIP were getting the privileged access. They were doing certain things which were not correction for rituals. Yet because of their higher influence they get such access which is not commendable. But seeing their power and influence might the diety want that sort of things. 

I had all kind of thoughts seeing such privileged access to certain people. But again we common people were helpless. At the end I completed my Darshan and returned straight way back to the starting point. Covering a distance of approx 30KM in a day. The trek was good satifying and tiring too. 


**In good faith - Peace!!**



![1000037470.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/Eo8M1obna2cYnnMAc2ZC3wWMW9ZqZHvk9StEga6aY2cTsKmweW7zFBDm7D13YHVoC5N.png)

title.title: 🚀 De la \
al Éxito: Reprogramando la Mentalidad Para Ganar de Verdad
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTxgQ11CuUga7tMpHqK7UWJjcbnbpUVcsrPrAUZE1qqbN/img_20260410_095556_156.jpg)

Alguna vez te has sentido estancado en tu zona de confort?
Sientes que nada de lo haces o experimentas te saca adelante?
Entonces este post es para ti.

¡Qué onda comunidad! 
Hoy quiero compartirles unas reflexiones profundas que estuve analizando de una entrevista entre Adrián Sáenz y Eric García. 

Nos referimos al obstáculo de no estás tan mal como para obligarte a cambia, es decir, que gran parte de la población odia su trabajo o sus ingresos, pero como pueden sobrevivir y mantener cierto nivel de confort, se quedan paralizados. La falta de un golpe fuerte o de tocar fondo hace que la gente acepte una vida mediocre por puro conformismo.

Como cubano que sabe lo que es echar para adelante en situaciones complejas, sentí que este contenido nos viene como anillo al dedo a todos, especialmente para los que andamos metidos en el mundo de la Web3 y Hive.

Aquí les resumo la jugada en tres puntos clave, directamente y sin rodeos:

1. El peligro de estar \

🛑
Eric menciona algo que aquí conocemos bien: la zona de confort incómoda. Es ese estado donde no estás bien, pero tampoco estás tan mal como para arriesgarte a cambiar. A veces nos conformamos con ir tirando y perdemos el respeto por nuestra propia palabra. 

La clave: 
Si dices que vas a hacer algo, ya sea aprender un protocolo nuevo o ser constante en el blog, ¡hazlo! Cada vez que te fallas a ti mismo, pierdes la confianza necesaria para ganar en grande.

2. No te dejes \

por la dopamina barata 📱
Estamos en una era donde las distracciones sobran. Eric advierte que si buscas el placer fácil (perder el tiempo en las redes sociales), la vida te va a dar dolor después. 

Para nosotros los emprendedores digitales, la disciplina es nuestra mejor moneda. Elegir el dolor voluntario, ya sea estudiar, entrenar, trabajar cuando nadie nos ve es lo que a la larga nos trae la verdadera tranquilidad y los resultados que se ven en la billetera.

3. Habilidades de alto valor: Aprende a venderte 💼
Muchos quieren saltar de la nada a ser millonarios con trading o negocios complejos sin tener una base. La recomendación es clara: domina una habilidad primero. Ya sea que te especialices en marketing, ventas o creación de contenido, asegura un flujo de ingresos constante antes de inventar con modelos de alto riesgo. 

4. La espiritualidad como brújula 🧘‍♂️
Más allá de los números, Eric toca un punto fundamental: la conexión interna. No busques las respuestas afuera ni te dejes llevar por dogmas rígidos. El éxito real viene cuando estás alineado contigo mismo y actúas desde la luz, no desde el ego. 


Mi reflexión final:
En este ecosistema de Hive, tenemos una herramienta poderosa para cambiar nuestra realidad financiera, pero nada de eso funciona si el software (nuestra mente) no está actualizado. Menos queja y más acción, que el que se duerme, se lo lleva la corriente.

¿Y tú? ¿Estás en la zona de confort o ya te decidiste a dar el salto? 
¡Los leo en los comentarios!
