title.title: (ESP-ENG) Virgin Punk: Clockwork Girl - Short film Review!
title.body:
**<center>Hello friends, good vibes to all.</center>**

> Hola amigos, buenas vibras para todos. 



![1.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/javyeslava.photo/23xAidjAVB8EgeQSupUNeajXa67tnKACRMcQtwQeTrkc4V8VFXngHSa6cAc8uEz4X6n85.webp)


[Source!](https://www.crunchyroll.com/es/news/features/2026/1/23/critica-virgin-punk-clockwork-girl?srsltid=AfmBOooZXo98VUa26_EYDv88ZjZY1xbDXvCcH9c2FHBKO6TCPYDqGI_H)

<div class=\

>One of the things I love most about anime is all the hidden gems you can find that haven't been seen by everyone, simply because they're productions focused on staying on the other side of the pond—Japan—and therefore rarely reach us. In my occasional search for these little treasures, I stumbled upon a short film of just 35 minutes that I ended up really enjoying. It was a great surprise to see such a story and animation packed into such a short time. What will you find when you watch it? Well, a futuristic, cyberpunk-style plot with a heavy dose of violence and action.

> De las cosas que más me gustan del anime es todo lo que puedes encontrar y que no ha sido visto por todo el mundo porque sencillamente son producciones que están enfocadas en quedarse en aquel lado del charco, es decir, Japón y que por tanto es raro que lleguen a nosotros. En esa busqueda que a veces hago por encontrar estas joyita le tocó el turno a un cortometraje de tan solo 35 minutos que me terminó gustando bastante, fue una gran sorpresa ver semejante historia y animación encapsulada en algo de tan poco tiempo. Que van a encontrar al ver esto? - pues una trama futurista, al estilo cyberpunk, con una dosis altas de violencia y acción.

>When I talk about cyberpunk, I'm referring to the genre, and it's more or less about a futuristic civilization, around the year 2099, where illegal prosthetics in the form of weapons are commonplace. The reality is that behind this technological advancement called \

which is essentially a medical device intended to alleviate illnesses or health problems, are people who use it illegally and in the shadows to commit all sorts of crimes. What it does is replace any limb or body part with a resistant material that effectively eliminates pain.

> Cuando hablo de cyberpunk me refiero al género y es que esto más o menos va de una civilización futurista, por allá en el año 2099, en donde las prótesis ilegales en forma de armas son el pan nuestro de cada día. La realidad es que detrás de este avance tecnológico llamado \

, que al final no es otra cosa que algo médico con la intención de hacer más llevadera cualquier enfermedad o percance en la salud de las personas, están las personas que utilizan esto de manera ilegal y en las sombras para cometer cualquier tipo de delitos. Esto lo que hace es sustituir cualquier extremidad o parte del cuerpo por un material resistente con el cual el dolor es algo que terminará desapareciendo. 


![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/javyeslava.photo/23xVAQZmWfvHBBYn6gfxvbqopWF8agJ7gCG5SkfJA6d6FhBk1N8Jh3MWDFr6sxUpe39qf.jpg)



[Source!](https://aniplexusa.com/virginpunk/)

---


![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/javyeslava.photo/23vsWm7dmqjzet7cmRWMx6MNRZ9dyfaX2166udErb5vNeyE1KMEHYruCc8BstCQS3XFtm.jpg)


[Source!](https://otakuusamagazine.com/yasuomi-umetsu-virgin-punk-clockwork-girl-debuts-june-27/)

<div class=\

>But what's so extraordinary about it? Well, to combat these mafias, the government created a kind of bounty hunter system made up of civilians who have carte blanche to kill these criminals in exchange for money. And this is where Ubu Kamigori comes in. Her story goes back to when she was a teenager who had a traumatic experience with some of these hunters and someone who was seemingly a good person. I assume that affected her trust, so in the end she becomes what she initially feared. She's lethal, probably the best in the entire system, and her unique characteristic is that she had no modifications; everything was based on her skills, strength, and abilities. Everything was good for her until suddenly it wasn't.

> Pero, que es lo extraordinario? - pues que para combatir estas mafias el gobierno creó una especie de sistema de cazarrecompensas conformados por civiles que tienen la carta blanca de matar a estos criminales a cambio de sumas de dinero. Y es acá en donde entra Ubu Kamigori. Su historia se remonta a cuando ella era una adolescente que le tocó vivir una experiencia traumática con algunos de estos cazadores y una persona la cual aparentemente era una persona de bien. Asumo que eso le afectó la confianza por lo que al final termina convirtiéndose en aquello a lo que en un principio le tenía miedo. Ella es letal, probablemente la mejor de todo el sistema y su particularidad es que no tenía modificaciones, todo era a punta de habilidades, fuerza y destrezas. Todo era bueno para ella hasta que de repente deja de serlo.

>The story is quite captivating because, in addition to Kamigori, there's another character named Mr. Elegance, the leader of one of the many bounty hunter groups. He has a strange obsession with her, to the point that he likes everything about her, from her appearance to her clothing, to resemble that of little girls. This is odd because his behavior is shady, but at the same time, it adds something interesting and intriguing to the story. I can't give away too much because it would be a spoiler, but the relationship between the two of them is quite unique. As for everything else, the animation is spectacular. I wasn't expecting such a high level of quality; the detail and fluidity are excellent. I think it's one of the film's strongest points.

> La historia es muy llamativa porque además de Kamigori hay otro personaje llamado Mr Elegance que es el jefe de una de los tantos grupos de cazarrecompensas quien tiene una fijación extraña con ella al punto de que le gusta que tanto en apariencia como en forma de vestir todo se parezca a niñas. Esto es raro porque su comportamiento es turbio pero al mismo tiempo le da a la historia algo interesante y llamativo. No puedo dar muchos detalles porque sería caer en spoilers pero esa relación que tienen ellos dos es bastante particular. Por todo lo demás decir que la animación es espectacular, no me esperaba semejante nivel, el detalle y la fluidez que tiene es muy bueno. Creo que es de los puntos realmente fuertes. ![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/javyeslava.photo/23w2CrADeT3YStogWmyvR7d2vuHocmFSv3yNmndc5vvh5kkFRn83H6AkakmgYzGFFsRKG.jpg) [Source!](https://moviecrazyplanet.com/?p=18746) --- ![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/javyeslava.photo/241tVFWaPvm65vPPfQH9n4A83GhsJepnFccxY5eYDyL6Gh5C3enyGCZo2443xtdt6TnKH.jpg) [Source!](https://www.sensacine.com.mx/peliculas/pelicula-1000025792/fotos/detalle/?cmediafile=9001993861)

>It's impossible to get bored in 35 minutes; there's action from beginning to end. The characters have well-defined and unique personalities. There's blood, body parts flying through the air, a certain cruelty in the atmosphere; it has everything. I understand this is, or will be, a series of short films, this being the first one. If they keep it up, I can tell you it looks very promising. These things can end up becoming something big, whether they turn it into an anime or a full-length movie. I really recommend it; it's very entertaining, and I assure you that you'll be glued to the screen with its animation. I've included the trailer below.

> En 35 minutos es imposible aburrirse, hay acción desde su comienzo hasta el fin. Los personajes tienen una personalidad bien marcada y única. Hay sangre, partes del cuerpo volar por los aires, cierta crueldad en el ambiente; lo tiene todo. Esto tengo entendido es o será una serie de cortometrajes siendo este el primero de todos. Si lo mantienen ya les digo que tiene muy buena pinta, estas cosas pueden terminar siendo algo grande, ya sean porque lo hacen un anime o una película completa. De verdad se los recomiendo, es muy entretenido y les aseguro que se quedarán pegados a la pantalla con la animación que tiene. Les dejo el tráiler por acá abajo. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=esQM3UWBgD0 ***

Well folks, that's all for today. I hope you enjoyed it. ¡Hugs to everyone, see you next time!
***

> Bueno mi gente por hoy es todo, espero que les haya gustado. ¡Un abrazo a todos, nos leemos en la próxima!

title.title: Follow Friday: Scrobble scrobble
title.body:
# The News On the prices front nothing much has changed. $HIVE and its legacy cousin have been tracking each other, but a gap is opening up now. I hope that widens. ![Prices from @coingecko](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steevc/23uRJ9m6UcWzxz5WnmyDtVQjcCpS255B1zwR2AVgfud3UpMHCBzZKpFLfLDSfNNymjgXC.png) I like to see people doing interesting things with Hive. At its heart a blockchain is just a decentralised database and can hold any sort of data. Most of the data on it will be posts, votes, financial transactions and game data, but it has been exploited for things that will not directly earn from it. One of those is @podping that distributes information on new podcast episodes. Now we have the idea of [Zingit](/scrobble/@acidyo/pre-announcement-hive-scrobble-zingit) that would log when a user plays a music track. This is something like [last.fm](https://www.last.fm/) (formerly known as Audioscrobbler) that I have used for over 20 years. There are apps that can log when you play music online or locally so that you can get statistics on what you have listened to. It would be much better to have this in a more open form that does not depend on one company. Some people may be dubious about the value of this for Hive as it will make the blockchain bigger, but each play just needs to store a little bit of metadata about the song. As I understand it each transaction requires some resource credits, but I am not sure if that is related to the size. I think the cost goes up when the system gets busy to deter some types of attack, but I do not know all the details. I am happy to be educated. # Friday Follows * @friendlymoose is building a [list of Hive apps](/hive-153850/@friendlymoose/a-broad-collection-of-hive-tools-apps-and-games). There are far more than I can keep track of. We have had some sites for this, but I am not sure if they are kept up to date. It will be tricky with so many appearing lately. * @meno is a prolific app/dapp builder and has [an idea](/hive-178315/@meno/7e6bbba3) for one a bit like Uber. I suspect that the legalities of running a ride service are more complex than the required software. * Another new app is @hiveinvite.com that can create 'cards' to allow people to create accounts. If you have enough resource credits you can claim account tokens. This service lets people use those instead of you having to set them up. It does require giving the service some access to your account, so needs some care. * @louis88 has been doing in-depth security audits on various Hive sites. That is a skilled job that takes time and may not pay much, if anything. He was [disappointed](/hive/@louis88/when-security-becomes-a-one-way-street-my-experience-with-responsible-disclosure-in-the-hive-ecosystem) by the response he got from one project who did not seem to want his help. I hope they fix their site anyway. * @giampaolo19 is [back](https://peakd.com/hive-181335/@giampaolo19/1bda9175) with some fun drumbeats. I am not sure how many professional musicians we have on Hive, but it ought to be more. We need to show our appreciation and that can just be comments. * @demotruk let an 'AI' loose to [analyse](/hive-133987/@demotruk/the-single-most-impactful-thing-you-can-do-for-hive-upvote-a-newbie) some Hive data and it highlighted that new users are less likely to stick around if they do not get any votes early on. If you see people on the new posts feed with a reputation of 25 then they are probably new and will appreciate some feedback. Of course we need to ought to check that they are genuine, but you can start with a small vote. If they try to cheat the system then their reputation is likely to drop below that start point. What we do not want is genuine people being put off using Hive. # The Dog House This is one I have mentioned before, but we have to keep warning people about fraudsters. I was asking on the @peakd Discord about an issue with voting trails (great feature!) and some random account popped up trying to direct me to another channel. That should be a red flag as I was already in the support channel. They will probably try to get you to expose your keys to steal your crypto, so do not fall for it. It was good to see that this user was almost immediately banned and I assume that was some automated process. Other channels may not have that and it can be hard to deal with when almost anyone can join a channel. Anyway, @yozen dealt with my query. I just needed to adjust a setting and then everything worked. # The End I have always said that I lay no claim to the #followfriday tag and am happy for others to use it. There is only so much I can find and read on Hive so I will miss plenty. Discovery can be tricky here so it is up to each of us to help others find cool posts and accounts. That said, I can be pretty active here, but then I enjoy the community even when I am not making that much. I have always seen Hive as having value for anyone who has something to share and so I want it to grow. I really do not mind if that means I make less as I have done pretty well. We need quality content to attract a wider audience. Enjoy your weekend and Hive five!
The man behind: @tenkminnows: Helping good Hivers level up

title.title: Phone Photography Contest for Cape Jasmines
title.body:
Hello friends.

In the vacant lot in front of my house, I have planted a variety of flowers.
Among those flowers are some Cape Jasmines.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVXjTT19d4c9H84fTDMYkifytr4RgvpxifRZ4ioeuifuU/img_20260329_062415.jpg)

We planted three Cape Jasmines, but only two of them flourished.
The two Cape Jasmines also had different flower sizes and shapes.
The big Cape jasmine and the small Cape jasmine.
The big Cape jasmine had been blooming for a long time.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQme7d7xapm6EMNBj9kqktk8tqJKn3t5z5hfmZqrBB7N4Gn/img_20260329_062511.jpg)

The small Cape jasmine had previously had flower buds but had not bloomed.
I wondered if the small Cape jasmine did not like the soil in this area and could not bloom.
However, this time the small Cape jasmine had produced many flower buds and had already bloomed.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSpVrn6r7jwiW3wBqznmX18HkkTeDSA924bwSBu7A6Zfz/img_20260329_062351.jpg)

Both the Big and small cape jasmine plants are now in bloom, so my wife, who planted the flowers, is happy.
When she is happy, I am happy too.
The sight and smell of the white, fragrant jasmine flowers are refreshing and pleasant.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQL5jgyaFsqKoNAK7tAZoBF6EXJ4CvrJzvRvhgzJUcYMC/img_20260410_141815.jpg)

မင်္ဂလာပါ မိတ်ဆွေတို့ရေ။

ကျွန်တော်၏ အိမ်ခေါင်းရင်းဘက် မြေလွတ်နေရာ၌ ပန်းပင်မျိုးစုံ စိုက်ပျိုးထားပါသည်။
ထိုပန်းပင်များထဲ၌ ဇီဇဝါပန်းမျိုးလည်း ပါဝင်ပါသည်။

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPVA74jCrf7LVgv7t86MB7ifH5QgSjzfvQ4xdLJt31M5Y/img_20260329_062326.jpg)

ဇီဇဝါပင် သုံးပင် စိုက်ပျိုးခဲ့ပေမယ့် နှစ်ပင်သာလျှင် ဖွံ့ဖြိုးခဲ့ပါသည်။
ထိုဇီဇဝါပန်း နှစ်ပင်သည်လည်း အပွင့် အရွယ်အစား ပုံစံ မတူကြပါ။
ဇီဇဝါကြီး နှင့် ဇီဇဝါလေး ဖြစ်ပါသည်။
ဇီဇဝါကြီး ကတော့ ပန်းပွင့်ဝေခဲ့တာ ကြာခဲ့ပါပြီ။

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPzdind9A7mezVMBFxE1H2JcyZNZj6n3DkiC8xPcU3sHU/img_20260329_062357.jpg)

ဇီဇဝါလေး ကတော့ ယခင်က ပန်းဖူးများ ဖူးခဲ့ပြီး မပွင့်ခဲ့ပါ။
ဒီဒေသမြေကို မကြိုက်၍ ဇီဇဝါလေး ပန်းမပွင့်နိုင်ခြင်းလားဟု ထင်မြင်မိခဲ့ပါသည်။
သို့ပေမယ့် ယခုတစ်ကြိမ် ဇီဇဝါလေးပင်သည် ပန်းဖူးများ များစွာ ဖူးပြီး ပန်းပွင့်လည်း ပွင့်ဝေခဲ့ပါပြီ။

ဇီဇဝါပင် နှစ်မျိုးလုံး ပန်းပွင့်ခဲ့ပြီဆိုတော့ ပန်းစိုက်ထားသော ကျွန်တော်၏ဇနီး ပျော်ရွှင်ပါသည်။
ဇနီး ပျော်တော့ ကျွန်တော်လည်း ပျော်မိပါသည်။
ဖြူဖွေးပြီး မွှေးရနံ့သင်းသော ဇီဇဝါပန်းများကို ကြည့်မြင် နမ်းရှိုက်ရသည့်အရသာမှာလည်း လူကို လန်းဆန်းကြည်လင်သာယာစေပါသည်။

/> \[Image Source\](https://pixabay.com/photos/agriculture-tractor-farming-8275498/) There are a lot of places in the world struggling to get food. title.title: Phylum Arthropoda Benefits and Drawbacks for Ecosystems
title.body:
**Phylum Arthropoda Benefits and Drawbacks for Ecosystems**


#



Best regards to all members of the prestigious HIVE BLOG platform, especially to those who create content related to the natural sciences.


#



Nature is wonderful and surprising, especially when we realize that while there are beneficial species, there are also species that, in fulfilling their role in ecosystems, cause serious harm to other organisms, including farmers.


#



![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliriera/AK3gZvx1TC64FEKVpzdmKhBkrYGZ1PkJQAwvH7roEiM7hCWQBQzS8cCFREQpPe2.jpg)A very small beetle, up to 2 mm in size, is seen near freshly harvested and pulped coffee beans, which it pierces with its mandibles and then lays its eggs inside. When the eggs hatch into larvae, they feed on the endosperm of these aromatic beans. This insect is part of the food chain, but the impact is negative for ecosystems and farmers. 


#



![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliriera/AKVV7zuUo3BXx4moPLQCDAheZDv3DTFAu6oeG91Ret6KvxoYPGGGPh5ZzeN4jAU.jpg)A centipede moving through the leaf litter in our planter at the house in Palmira, Andrés Eloy Blanco municipality, Lara state. This animal is an arthropod that is very beneficial to ecosystems.



#


Among these contradictory cases, the beetles of the Curculionidae family stand out; they possess the morphological ability to damage the seeds of many plants used by humans and other animal species for their own benefit or that of their populations.


#



![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliriera/AKKTDQ3hn6HxrhUNsntaqioSdQv6uLV9oitcNDLLuZ5kJpdCYTqPkmC1MBuvcS9.jpg)A coffee borer beetle photographed between two coffee beans: one intact and the other damaged by the beetle.
 



#


One of the most common examples in the highlands of Lara State, Venezuela, is the damage caused by beetles known as coffee borers, particularly because these mountainous areas are ideal for growing coffee (Coffea arabica, Rubiaceae family) and, for the most part, these geographical areas have been dedicated to this crop, which currently suffers losses of up to 40% due to damage caused by the borer, turning good beans into useless coffee with no commercial value, thereby increasing production costs for this sector.
Taxonomically, the coffee berry borer is classified in the 
Kingdom Animalia, Phylum Arthropoda, Class Insecta, Order Coleoptera, Family Curculionidae, Genus Hypothenemus, Species H. prolixus.


#



![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliriera/AJeht1NPr5xU4298TMrwESRv1XUBsUwP5Af3NA3ja5r9VK14DusdQWutqyv4veK.jpg)Dorsal view of the coffee borer beetle. Its body length can reach 2 mm.


#



![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliriera/AJkSo1cRznNeRhzjeBFquDgYe6AFL1DxRjAuxZ2bhP1yGAzhq9WpWwV5cefHnhN.jpg)Ventral view of the coffee borer beetle.




#


The life cycle of the coffee berry borer is straightforward: after mating, the female bores into the coffee cherry (or drupe), enters the endosperm of the bean, and lays between 35 and 50 eggs. These eggs can complete their life cycle in about a week, although in some cases—such as with unripe fruit or fruit with high moisture content—it can take up to 45 days.
It is important to note that females can fly, but males do not have wings; therefore, females can lay eggs and move to another cherry, repeating this process throughout their 190-day life cycle, while males remain in the same bean, mating throughout their 40-day life cycle.


#



![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliriera/AKNLGvGGt7cs3cC4BQpCctWM8di3qJd7NsQW2BmA8zQzNnCoh1B2THRGYev3heo.jpg)Of the two seeds inside a coffee cherry, the **coffee borer** beetle almost always damages one, while the other remains viable.




#


In the ripest fruits, more than 100 adult beetles may be found living together. Up to three generations of these beetles can coexist.
The damage caused by the coffee berry borer to the endosperm of the bean is so severe that it turns brown, takes on a mottled appearance, crumbles into lumps, and has no commercial value. The beetles almost always damage one of the two beans present in the coffee drupe.


#



![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliriera/AKPkue8f5QwLFEVeAun1HZNNzGemDfWy4ZHmnMNsFULq1TjWTGozvXoVzsx84qK.jpg)One grain with damaged endosperm, another viable one, and next to them, the perpetrator.
 


#


The author had the opportunity to observe the first quarantine zones established in Portuguesa State, Venezuela, in an effort to prevent the coffee borer beetle from entering the country from Colombia; however, the farming practices of Venezuelan coffee growers played a key role in allowing this beetle to spread throughout coffee plantations across the country.


#


![8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliriera/AJgA4TBaxV6eL8ztjLqKbEPA1J5eqYRth4aux4PBv2v1JkCmdAsfbrqe3o8gw2Q.jpg)A coffee cherry, showing one of the beans pierced by the coffee borer




#



![9.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliriera/AK9PrVsqDXRrafFuS3cb8HYBxsy24ZAj3otyi9pypXTGKj6VxDRAfurUp1m38h9.jpg)An image showing the damage caused by the coffee borer to the endosperm of the grain.



#


In addition to pruning and burning coffee crops, the use of the **Beauveria bassiana fungus** was recommended (Kingdom Fungi, Division Ascomycota, Class Sordariomycetes, Order Hypocreales, Family Clavicipitaceae, Genus Beauveria, Species Beauveria bassiana), which invades the beetle’s body, parasitizes it, and causes its death. This biological control method was the most suitable, but Venezuelan farmers did not have access to it or to the equipment required for its application and the establishment of sanitary barriers using the fungus.


#



![10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliriera/23tvg5Xh7qu9BXdcdnGrqPSorCduMce14pQFJNmxdwn5i3WP2yfv5srzqnCozw7YCnySF.jpg)A coffee plant (Coffea arabica, Rubiaceae family) bears ripe coffee cherries, which can be infested by the coffee berry borer, thereby reducing their commercial value.




#



In contrast, we find the ecological behavior of a species belonging to the phylum Arthropoda, subphylum Myriapoda, known as the rosquilla or millipede, which provides significant benefits to ecosystems, making it a subject worthy of study.


#




![11.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliriera/AJdGDbu9zhmGTiEcF2to2Q8vqB2FawzX3Axeaab8zasw1FmKxuSbfCBTXxtLxf3.jpg)A centipede was spotted moving through the area of the Palmira hamlet, A. E. Blanco municipality, Lara state, at 8:31 p.m. on April 8, 2026.



#


https://youtu.be/o5M7mhzovkw
Video uploaded from my YouTube account, which you can follow under the name Ali Riera

#



In rural areas of Venezuela, it is common to find arthropods moving between ecosystems, a fact supported by the number of species documented within this phylum of the Animal Kingdom—which includes more than 1,400,000 species—and by the suitability of the terrain that makes up Venezuela’s geography, particularly the villages of the Andrés Eloy Blanco municipality in Lara State. Lara, which include the Andean foothills, where the village of Palmira is located, with geographic coordinates 9.740670,-69.672002.


#



![12.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliriera/AK9PBY5v2jx4BC5wa79VUhATj8fc3SscEDiQHNXXd1QC3Kh1FYfR158xB8CH5ht.jpg)A panoramic view of some of the areas surrounding my home in the of Palmira, Andrés Eloy Blanco municipality, Lara state, Venezuela.


#



Among the species belonging to the phylum Arthropoda, we spotted a millipede, or, as my children used to call them when they were little, “little centipedes,” whose movements through the woods are silent, cautious, and very swift—factors that help them evade potential predators while they feed on and break down the plant matter in the leaf litter or search for a sexual partner.


#


![13.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliriera/AK56BeXKCQKT2qbYqJasXvT6rog1YuaZMGHeoZNiJDgCZeNbWH3AW5WBgVHobE7.jpg)A Narceus americanus millipede moving through the leaf litter in one of the planters at my home in Palmira.


#



This centipede, spotted in the garden of our residence in the Palmira community, belongs to the Kingdom Animalia, Phylum Arthropoda, Subphylum Myriapoda, and is characterized by a body divided into metameres, from which two pairs of functional legs for locomotion develop on each metamer, placing it in the Class Diplopoda, and in this particular case, the specimen belongs to the Order Spirobolida, Family Spirobolidae, Genus Narceus, Species Narceus americanus, an animal native to the southeastern regions of the United States of America, this being the second time I have reported the sighting of a specimen of this species in the Palmira community.


#



![14.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliriera/AK2E5JnKVhKhMD9HT2hDfXAb6qyChRATyGJz6YFg7VppFrAe88mpoNCKkT3Bhq5.jpg)A Narceus americanus millipede curled up and blending in with the leaf litter in the planter at my residence.


#




![15.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliriera/23wggcoaKwEcLGbPELGSn9UJPAncTE6ckbSHTgxDaFXS2JLehKvqr6GfCRfXXW4txbokW.jpg)In this image, you can see the native range of the centipede *Narceus americanus* and a map showing the location of the sighting in Venezuela.



#


This millipede is a nocturnal animal; it is worth noting that I spotted it at 4:15 p.m. on April 7, 2026, at the start of the rainy season in this area, when the sky was cloudy, the ground was very wet, and the temperature was below 20° Celsius—factors that must have forced this small arthropod to leave its daytime habitat during twilight hours.
These arthropods produce secretions containing hydrogen cyanide (HCN) that they use as a defense mechanism against potential predators, but there have been reports of sightings of millipede carcasses in which only the head and the first two segments have been eaten, indicating that animals such as rodents or birds have learned to detect which parts of the millipede’s body contain the cyanide-based toxin.


#



![16.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliriera/AK9PH4XJmyp6mGofPuSAAz33gqHAcmQ92mfmWsT3xPLpCY9rn1R3knm5WKhC9CH.jpg)I took this photo of the centipede at 4:35 p.m. on April 7, 2026.

#



![17.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliriera/AK55UdkhLMtCVDQFNm3uWCxohxru8MA7PDn7LyDYeA7ZvqUqrh3DNRCe8zvnutW.jpg)I took this photo of the centipede at 8:34 p.m. on April 8, 2026, 




#


It must be made very clear that animals such as Narceus americanus are very important to the health of ecosystems and, furthermore, are already beginning to play a role in food chains.


#



![18.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliriera/AJmrPz8Bzmi41zPdDFVfueKkihYxLq11VEsEastM4Jh8xCQtxQXNF4m1fBxKGro.jpg)A juvenile specimen of Narceus americanus, approximately 6 cm long, was caught while attempting to take refuge in one of the rooms of our house in the Palmira community at 8:06 a.m. on April 10, 2026.


#



![19.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliriera/AK55WAomenmnjg666mdMJ1vW5a7udB5DAfwFgrQJXDfxhZ4jPHhT1x8nTjd8doX.jpg)A photo taken at the moment a Narceus americanus was crossing the perimeter fence of our house, located in the community of Palmira, A. E. Blanco Municipality, Lara State.

title.body: 1/5 🧵 Kristi Noem’s “soft landing” looks more like a trap door. After being pushed out of DHS and moved to State, some of the staffers loyal enough to follow her were immediately sidelined. That’s the story: not a clean transition, but a political quarantine around the baggage she brought with her.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 2/5 🧵 The article says at least three former DHS aides — Troup Hemenway, Josh King, and Octavian Miller — were put on paid leave soon after landing in Noem’s new orbit at the State Department. The alleged reason wasn’t incompetence; it was proximity. They were seen as too tied to Corey Lewandowski and the drama that defined Noem’s DHS tenure.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 3/5 🧵 The deeper point is bureaucratic self-preservation. State reportedly didn’t want “tentacles for Lewandowski” inside the building. Translation: they weren’t just managing personnel, they were containing risk. The seven lower-level aides who came over were allowed to stay, which tells you this was a targeted purge of perceived political liabilities, not a broad staffing reset.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 4/5 🧵 The piece frames Noem’s new job — special envoy for the “Shield of the Americas” — as a face-saving holding pattern rather than a real power post. The claim is brutal: the role gave the appearance she wasn’t fired outright, while insiders allegedly think she may not last there long anyway. If that’s true, then this wasn’t rehabilitation. It was staging.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body:
5/5 🧵 Then the article piles on the reputational wreckage: the Lewandowski affair rumors, scrutiny over DHS spending, and the very public embarrassment tied to revelations about her husband’s private double life. Fair warning: this is a tabloid-style political piece, so some claims are sourced to insiders and rival reporting rather than hard public documentation. Still, the core takeaway is clear — Noem’s brand is now so radioactive that even loyal aides are getting burned by association. 📎 Source

📎 [Source](https://nypost.com/2026/04/09/us-news/kristi-noems-loyal-staffers-axed-after-following-scandal-ridden-boss-to-new-gig-youre-obviously-not-welcome/)

title.title: If a World War Happens: My First Thought Is Survival.
title.body:
>
![IMG-20260410-WA0008.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oluwa-tosin/AK6WQDNWw5mQmitKyDGWmWjHzxR37VL6Zg64pGVCqTvUHEPUgR9g7DoG9DjLk7x.jpg)
Good day, people of Hive! Welcome to my blog. Today's topic is from Hive-Learners which says:**A World War**. So let's dive in. Have heard a lot of news about war and how it kills and destroys people. I have seen it in a movie how people run for their dear lives because they don’t want to die. I think it was last month or maybe February when I heard about a conflict between America and Iraq, and how many people were killed. It was really sad to hear. I pray that we will never experience such in our country because war is definitely not a good thing. But according to the Hive Learners topic, I will share my thoughts.
Honestly, if a world war happens now, the first thing that will come to my mind is safety. I won’t even think of joining the army; what will come to my mind immediately is how to protect myself and my family. War is something serious that comes with fear and danger, so survival will be my main focus. Truth is, I don’t think my first reaction will be to join the army. Not because I don’t love or care about my country, but because I will be thinking about the safety of my family first. I will be thinking about how to keep them safe. If there is a way during the war to move my family to a safer place, maybe somewhere quiet where there is no war happening, I will try my best to do that. Staying in a place where war is happening, where people are being killed, is not something I will want for myself and my family.
![IMG-20260410-WA0012.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oluwa-tosin/AK3d15kFkLKyWUuodNcS6fbn6qKS7rtrTfhuHdxwAmEMDQyg7cBgftBBHztmU4C.jpg)
Another thing I will do is prepare basic things we might need, such as food, water, clothes, and some important documents I know will help when the war is over. Because in a time of war, getting food will be difficult since many shops might be destroyed, and I may not be able to go out freely to buy what we need because everywhere will be filled with gunshots and bombs. So it’s better to gather some things early and be ready for anything. Yes, I know the food and water will finish, but at least what I pack will sustain us for some time before finding another way to get more. Furthermore, I will make sure my family and I stay in touch with each other. The reason is that communication is very important in times of war because we will want to know whether we are all safe or not. And also, if there is any way I can help others, I will gladly do it. Most importantly, I will try to stay strong for my family. War can break people emotionally and make people scared, so in a situation like that, it is important to encourage one another. In conclusion, my main goal during the war is to stay alive and keep my family safe. I will try to be careful with every decision I make. War is not something anyone prays for, but if it happens, being prepared can really help. **This is my entry for the Hive Learners Weekly Featured Content Week 212 Episode 03.** **Thanks for reading💞💞💞💞💞.** **Images generated from Meta Al.**

title.body: 1/5 🧵 A sheriff with **44 years** around killers, gang members, and John Gotti says **Rex Heuermann is the one who unsettles him most**. Not because Heuermann is loud or violent in jail — the opposite. It’s the calm, deliberate, “sizing you up” stare that creeps him out. That’s the whole spine of the story: the scariest guy in the room isn’t acting tough. He’s acting cold.

title.body: 2/5 🧵 Suffolk County Sheriff Errol Toulon says he’s dealt with a long list of notorious inmates over decades — Gotti, Larry Davis, Robert Chambers, Joel Steinberg, Bernhard Goetz, and others. His point is simple: he could look those men in the eye and read them. With Heuermann, he says something feels different — “very calculating.” Not chaotic. Not performative. Measured. Predatory. That distinction is what gives the article its punch.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 3/5 🧵 The jail conditions matter here. Heuermann is being kept in **voluntary isolation**, mainly to stop another inmate from trying some idiot “jailhouse justice” fantasy and making a name for himself. He reportedly spends most of his time in his cell, takes solitary walks, borrows books from the law library, and receives mental health and religious visits. So the picture isn’t a raging monster banging on bars. It’s a man sitting calmly on a bunk, which Toulon says is somehow worse.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 4/5 🧵 Toulon contrasts that calm with the usual jailhouse theater. A lot of hardened inmates posture. They want to prove they’re dangerous, prove they’re tough, prove they belong in the mythology they’ve built around themselves. Heuermann, in Toulon’s telling, doesn’t seem interested in any of that. The sheriff even says he doesn’t think Heuermann wants to fight men at all — his brutality was directed at women. That’s a brutal line, and it reframes “toughness” as something uglier: selective cruelty, not strength.

Hola amigos de la comunidad hoy quiero compartir con ustedes estas fotografías de un hermoso atardecer el cual nos brinda destellos de luz hermosos que nos hacen querer admirar la majestuosidad de un día que ha terminado pero que sin embargo no es el fin, sino el inicio de un nuevo día o de una nueva fase del día y es que admirar cada etapa del día es como admirarte a ti porque sin importar las circunstancias siempre habrá un destello de luz al final del camino o intermedio al mismo que nos hará querer seguir y descubrir lo que está por venir.

El atardecer es una de las partes más hermosas del día o por lo menos para mí lo es pues con él puedo ver que no se necesita la radiante luz del sol para admirar ciertas cosas, así como no se necesita la belleza exterior para saber que una persona es maravillosa y valiosa sin importar nada más. 

English 

Hello friends of the community! Today I want to share with you these photographs of a beautiful sunset, which offers us gorgeous flashes of light that make us want to admire the majesty of a day that has ended, but which is not the end, but rather the beginning of a new day or a new phase of the day. Admiring each stage of the day is like admiring yourself because, regardless of the circumstances, there will always be a glimmer of light at the end of the road or along the way that will make us want to continue and discover what is to come.

The sunset is one of the most beautiful parts of the day, or at least it is for me, because with it I can see that you don't need the radiant sunlight to admire certain things, just as you don't need outward beauty to know that a person is wonderful and valuable regardless of anything else.

title.title: A Fresh and Satisfying Fried Saba Fish Dinner at Geylang Bahru Food Centre
title.body:
Last night, I decided to make a small but meaningful change to my dinner routine. I have been trying to balance my meals better lately and include more variety in the proteins I eat during the week. Chicken is still probably the one I consume the most, so I felt like it was time to go for something different. That was how I ended up choosing saba fish for dinner, and honestly, I was very happy with that decision. Not only is saba a good source of healthy fats and minerals, but it is also one of those fish that can be incredibly enjoyable when cooked well. I especially like the fried version because the outer layer turns slightly crisp while the meat inside stays soft and flaky. 


![1000127334.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/Ep7vUCBf7mdJbp8ZucqALhT5D2ThgM8BUjfhU6Goyor6QfZR89VxnzY8eBMw4hDdtq5.jpg)


Whenever I crave saba fish, I already have a stall in mind. I tend to be quite particular when it comes to seafood, and for me, freshness is everything. I have tried saba fish from other stalls before, but sometimes the fishy taste is just too strong, and once that happens, even lime or other seasonings cannot really rescue the dish. That is why I keep coming back to this stall at Geylang Bahru Food Centre. I trust the freshness of their ingredients, and that trust makes a big difference when deciding where to eat.


![1000127327.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EoiVmpoGYh2hQRsgvxm5LPtiEWijsX5HoKdv5yN8cVrBWnGUBG2gdhEDWevemiN8tMh.jpg)

![1000127329.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EokdbTHDfDrPqJsQrnHPPnAW4MBnowQCcjVqKAc9E61Xd4Fas2DhVpJPYeA74YzichW.jpg)

![1000127330.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/23wMeffyPpBNPgu2guK2EQwoZkFtpjPSrgZQdSeBxzorYevCWoBvDugWLPTHc8ktjCWHA.jpg)

![1000127328.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EoiWgaMciaYDrh122Q3hq7n5m6ihVeHf5C9sBecAJh846jnT8aSotpjtg6CYKJmxg8f.jpg)


One reason I feel more confident eating seafood here is because Geylang Bahru Food Centre is located right beside the wet market. In my mind, that always adds to the sense that the ingredients are likely fresher, and freshness matters so much with fish. I always believe that if the ingredients are fresh, then the dish is already on the right track as long as the cooking is done properly. But if the ingredients are not fresh, no amount of sauce or seasoning can truly fix that. That is why I do not mind returning to the same trusted stalls again and again.


![1000127332.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EpLhRN3Fxh1HkvprRcwRfyzKmWK3no2ZPcD89eyFZZzxY8wek8A4Ejm2UN8bHwaaaGp.jpg)


This time, I ordered the Fried Saba Fish Set, and for SGD 7.50, I thought it was a really satisfying meal. What I liked immediately was that the plate looked thoughtful. Some stalls just focus on the main item and keep everything else very plain, but this stall clearly puts care into how they serve the food. It may still be a humble hawker meal, but the little details made it feel more complete.


![1000127338.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EpA3QXLLRDb7SPTmiWtHEp2vz7kjYJgXGnux59n4xHKuMmCknpAU13J9dcHeDf2uVEG.jpg)

![1000127335.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/Ep7vch69kRnzbpv89UTVK44yKLNe9nNoiXGSfZwyUH5H1VuSBvWN6zwLGZnG9MLZHXh.jpg)

![1000127336.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/Ep1XvpvBhiH5ieMC9umB5Caf2rSax81tMxFqhnofagWJ3uCY1Je4TmUbKQ2262uE6gp.jpg)

![1000127337.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EpA4N7WX29qam7xiDTvuJ5CteT18e6pVT5Qho3F4t4WX9rm6zfYjvcFtRcKWmZSzEQv.jpg)


The plate came with a generous serving of rice, a fried saba fish, a sunny side egg, chilli paste, tomato slices, lime, and a bowl of clear soup on the side. There was also dark sauce drizzled over the fish and egg, which added a glossy, savory touch to the whole dish. I really appreciated the balance of the plate. The rice made it filling, the egg added comfort, and the tomato and lime gave a bit of freshness to cut through the richness of the fried fish.

As for the saba itself, it was exactly what I was hoping for. The fish tasted fresh, which is the most important thing for me. The meat was flaky and tender, and the fried skin gave it that extra texture that makes saba so enjoyable. With a little bit of chilli paste and some of that dark sauce, every bite became even more satisfying. I also liked that the sunny side egg was freshly cooked rather than just thrown onto the plate as an afterthought. Small things like that matter because they show that some care went into preparing the meal.

The clear soup on the side also helped round out the dinner nicely. It gave the tray a more balanced feel, especially alongside the richer flavors of the fried fish and sambal. And of course, I also had an iced tea to go with the meal, which made everything even more refreshing.


![1000127333.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EpGS7byxtvozSAoNc3icRpZSsrUHGVZnntszbB7pMoNp3mQd3JMW3HNjPXou9zRh3M3.jpg)


***Overall, this was a simple but very satisfying dinner. It reminded me that a humble hawker meal can still feel top-notch when the ingredients are fresh and the dish is prepared with care. For SGD 7.50, I thought this Fried Saba Fish Set delivered great value, good balance, and the kind of comfort that makes me want to come back again.***

## Bon appétit.

title.title: a very beautiful villa near Padua
title.body:
![selfie villa.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/butterfly-jt9/23wgS9dw2pmX4q9nkx7sBbd9Gq4AuqNVvLHRKsSxikQqvCEhoViBTMHduZJ4VKxAE2ZiF.jpg)

***

Hello friends, today I want to tell you about a beautiful place, which I visited some time ago, but if you are in the vicinity of the city of Padua, therefore in the north of Italy, I recommend you visit and I am talking about the splendid Villa dei Vescovi, a very fascinating place on the Euganean Hills a few kilometers from Padua.

***



![villa.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/butterfly-jt9/AJL2BDa8CZEgiahPuPFLSXmQvw99Xvi8QbVwEEUNceDofQSy7LJPnXyvGt46xiM.jpeg)


***

We are talking about a Renaissance villa that is completely immersed in greenery and you will notice this as soon as you arrive in this place. In fact, the villa was built in the Renaissance between 1535 and 1542 and was practically the summer residence of the bishops of Padua, a place to retreat and stay in peace.
When I visited this villa, which I did with a private guide but in reality you can also do it simply on your own, the guide told me that practically in this villa a great architect intervened, Giulio Romano, and the interiors were decorated by the Flemish painter Lambert Sustris. In fact, inside the villa you will find numerous frescoes of villages, landscapes but also very mythological things.

***


![574219699_18088657943506072_9023730743200480205_n.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/butterfly-jt9/23vi6PQzWHukTrAxEjQrfzj9Vk6PD7W5DDymPKsCbT3EoXoP3btLMGA8SwVKo8j5VVvmi.jpg)

***
The visit to this villa left me truly speechless, I would never have expected to find such a jewel immersed in the Euganean Hills, but in reality what comes to mind when you visit these places is that it is a holiday resort, instead this was a place designed for the meeting of intellectual artists, we can almost define it as a sort of cultural salon today.

***


![575677310_18088657922506072_3952359673921999928_n.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/butterfly-jt9/23vi1oKdTzTw3rR3r5XZh8pGqKQyMMFnmobJKiDfXG6TP8zfv8wraxujcbyjHm1H5qFVZ.jpg)

***

You can already guess that this building is similar or inspired by the Roman Domus precisely because of this fusion between architecture, landscape and daily life, and think that this place for several years remained the property of the Curia of Padua, and had also fallen into a very bad state but fortunately then in 2005 it passed to an association called the Italian Environment Fund, which practically completely restored it and made it accessible to people who want to visit it.
Below in the table I will leave you all the useful information for visiting this unique place, I naturally recommend the visit and thank you for taking the time to read this post

***


![575696855_18088658054506072_6788137337111180609_n.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/butterfly-jt9/243BVbqVDkVFMHZMbV8b41NPZQUhCCiSxZzxCbywq2iw1iKMFdxcSiN2yvjYcGNgMAvEA.jpg)

title.body: 2/5 🧵 The biggest example is the **city-owned grocery store** idea. On the trail, the promise was concrete: five city-run stores, one in each borough, selling food at wholesale-style prices with the city covering rent and taxes. In office, that hasn’t materialized. What exists instead is a proposal for **$70 million in funding** to explore locations and build toward those stores — not the stores themselves.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 3/5 🧵 The same pattern shows up in public safety. Mamdani pitched a full **Department of Community Safety**, with social workers handling non-violent 911 calls and a stated **$1.1 billion** ambition behind it. What rolled out instead is a much smaller **Mayor’s Office of Community Safety** — just **two staffers** and a reported **$260 million** budget. Same branding family, very different scale.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 4/5 🧵 On policing, the article says Mamdani’s campaign stance was clear and aggressive, but governing has been messier. He had vowed to **disband the NYPD Strategic Response Group**, yet it remains in place. He also campaigned against the **NYPD gang database**, which critics see as discriminatory, but once in office he shifted from outright opposition to talking about reforms while NYPD leadership defended keeping it.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body:
5/5 🧵 The article also frames homelessness and housing as major reversals. Mamdani had pledged to stop the sweep-heavy approach to **homeless encampments**, but severe winter conditions pushed the administration back toward removals after repeated outreach efforts. On **housing vouchers**, he had promised to drop Adams-era legal resistance to expanding CityFHEPS, yet the administration instead kept an anti-expansion case alive on appeal. The piece’s overall message is blunt: the rhetoric was maximalist, the first 100 days were not. 📎 Source

📎 [Source](https://nypost.com/2026/04/10/us-news/here-are-the-promises-zohran-mamdani-broke-in-his-first-100-days-in-office/)

title.body: 1/4 🧵 Robert MacIntyre’s Masters round basically turned into every golfer’s private meltdown — except his happened at Augusta, on camera, with a middle finger, club slams, and a quadruple-bogey 9. The real story isn’t just the gesture. It’s how one hole detonated an already boiling round.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 2/4 🧵 The collapse centered on the par-5 15th. MacIntyre hit into the water twice, then visibly flipped off the ball in frustration. That disaster alone led to a quadruple bogey nine, and it capped a day where nothing really held together. He finished opening round play at **8-over 80**, tied for **82nd**, which is the kind of score that leaves you needing a miracle just to matter again.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 3/4 🧵 This wasn’t one isolated pop-off either. The article describes a full chain of visible frustration: he was already barking on 12 after a poor tee shot, then blew up again after putting off the green on 13, and cameras later caught him slamming his club on the course. Augusta is famously old-school and tight about player conduct, so the piece notes he could get one of those stern Augusta warnings — golf’s version of “we’re not mad, just deeply disappointed,” which is somehow worse.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body:
4/4 🧵 The bigger point: this is MacIntyre being MacIntyre. He’d already admitted before the tournament that he’s volatile, uses bad language, and doesn’t intend to fake calm just because microphones are around. He basically said: I’m red-lining when I compete, and that’s who I am. Fair enough — but Augusta punishes emotion as brutally as it punishes bad shots. Meanwhile, Rory McIlroy and Sam Burns ended the day tied for the lead at **5-under 67**, which makes MacIntyre’s unraveling look even harsher by contrast. 📎 Source

📎 [Source](https://nypost.com/2026/04/10/sports/robert-macintyre-flips-middle-finger-in-wild-masters-meltdown/)

title.body: 2/5 🧵 McLean was excellent: 6.1 innings, 3 hits, 2 walks, 8 Ks, 100 pitches, 64 strikes. His sinker was alive again, and Carlos Mendoza basically said he had everything working. Through 11 career MLB starts, he’s allowed more than 2 earned runs only once. That’s not “promising.” That’s legit.

title.body: 3/5 🧵 The turning point was brutal. McLean left in the 7th with two runners on and one out, still up 1-0. Then it unraveled fast: Luke Weaver gave up the lead, Brett Baty couldn’t reach a ball at the right-field fence, and Mark Vientos made a bad throw home. Arizona smelled blood and piled on 7 runs across the 7th and 8th.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 4/5 🧵 The article’s real point isn’t just one ugly loss — it’s the pattern. Zach Braziller compares McLean’s early Mets career to deGrom in Queens: dominant pitching wasted by no run support and late-game collapse. “Unrewarded brilliance” is the phrase, and yeah, that hits because Mets fans have seen this movie before.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body:
5/5 🧵 McLean handled it like a pro, saying that’s baseball and the bullpen will pick him up another time. Weaver said the kid deserved the win. They’re both right. But the larger takeaway is harsher: if McLean keeps pitching like this and the offense keeps hibernating, the Mets are going to waste a lot of excellent starts. 📎 Source

title.body: 1/5 🧵 Mike Brown basically tipped his playoff hand: the Knicks look like a **9-man rotation**, and the biggest name on the outside is **Jose Alvarado**. That’s the headline. Not because Alvarado is washed — because in playoff basketball, trust gets brutally narrow.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 2/5 🧵 Brown said the **nine players used over the last two games** have the edge heading into the postseason. The likely bench unit is **Mitchell Robinson, Miles McBride, Landry Shamet, and Jordan Clarkson**. That leaves **Alvarado, Mohamed Diawara, and Tyler Kolek** out of the main mix for now. The past two games mattered here — those DNPs weren’t random, they were a preview.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 3/5 🧵 The surprise is **Alvarado**. He cost the Knicks **two second-round picks at the deadline**, so you don’t make that move expecting him to be a spectator. But Brown’s logic is pretty clear: **McBride is back from sports hernia surgery**, and **Clarkson has earned trust with his defense**. In April, coaches stop experimenting and start cutting anything that feels even slightly shaky.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 4/5 🧵 The minute distribution backs it up. Against Atlanta, the Knicks leaned hard on their core: **Jalen Brunson played 39 minutes**, **OG Anunoby 37**, while **Robinson, Shamet, and McBride each got 20+ minutes** off the bench. Against Boston, all four reserves saw at least **14 minutes**. Brown still left himself wiggle room — saying it’s “close” and he may tweak things — but the shape of the rotation is pretty obvious now.

title.body:
<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP89VYNzTwyaRhias6s2X6hbWRHHksBADZ6AV1ADDHAyv/pixil_frame_0_3_.png)
</center>

<center>BUS STOP</center>

A pixel art of a bus stop. There are different types of bus stop, but this is my own version of it. This is the place where commuters usually wait for the bus to arrive. It is like a little or quick shelter and protection from the weather. Like during summer, people need a shade to protect themselves from the heat of the sun. Aside from summer, this bus stop is also useful during rainy season. It protects the commuters from getting wet. A simple thing, but serves a good purpose.
I created this pixel art to somehow practice my shadings and creating shadows. I'm still learning on how to put shadows. Though I have a little bit of idea or knowledge about it, I want to master it.

I guess I could also add a bus here next time. It will be animated version.

Here is a little behind the scene of my pixel art.

Creating the outline of the roof.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc6Xte9jAhQAs29Cr647szv2qw7szAuDp2MekS1RbzNzX/image.png)

Adding the main structure of the bus stop. Like the wall and the long seat for the commuters.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNUFBjn2Lb8rCeJJCb91RbbK6jm6kiYHMwhn7QwG2cdM4/image.png)

Outline of the bus stop sign. I made this using rectangle tool.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRcoM7HznxXET7uL1eXuA3Yiv53opyrti4VLBbZqTXBMe/image.png)

Coloring the bus stop and the background.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdPapmicGrZpqtLyYxNLE35HQAhuZMGmWZurwJ79ZYSCH/image.png)

Here is the shading and adding of shadows. I imagined that the main source of light or the sun is at the left part. Hopefully I did the shadows right.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmchVvXSbz2cgxUppywtMWmdV9wfHvo5SkVXXdAabrF8jE/image.png)

title.body: @aljif7, esas dos pegan fuerte porque son muy visuales. “**Echar a alguien a la calle**” suele significar expulsarlo de casa, del trabajo o dejarlo sin sustento; “**quedarse en la calle**” es terminar sin hogar, sin dinero o en una situación de abandono, como recoge [Coloquial.es](https://www.coloquial.es/es/diccionario-del-espanol-coloquial/letra-c-99/calle-.html) y también se ve en explicaciones sobre expresiones con *echar* en [Berceo](https://berceo.com/es/expresiones-en-espanol-con-el-verbo-echar/). La gracia está en el matiz: una expresión marca la acción de expulsar y la otra, la consecuencia de quedar desamparado. En tu serie, esas locuciones hacen que *calle* deje de ser solo “street” y pase a tener carga social real, que es donde el idioma se pone serio.

# ***Hey my garden lover friends!***
*Welcome to my garden blog. I hope you are all well and trying to live a healthy life. Gardening brings us beautiful moments, because those of us who love gardening truly enjoy spending time in the garden. It is a form of relaxation and entertainment. Those who work hard in the garden feel great happiness when they see the success of their efforts.*
![1000047066.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sumaiya777/245n1Wk8gbaeiTMAEZceapgcYg2pMLXhFsUCwUpmVBVW1dZ666pmDJdX3uUyg3T5yaQdf.jpg)

*However, a sad reality is that we garden lovers are going through a difficult time. The entire month of Chaitra is passing with continuous rain. Due to excessive rainfall, we are quite afraid to grow vegetables in our gardens. Too much rain can cause the crops to rot, leaving the garden empty and unproductive. Occasionally, we do get a glimpse of sunshine, but it doesn’t last long. We are not sure about the exact reason, but it seems to be due to weather conditions that we are facing this hardship*

# ***Hey my garden lover friends!***
*Welcome to my garden blog. I hope you are all well and trying to live a healthy life. Gardening brings us beautiful moments, because those of us who love gardening truly enjoy spending time in the garden. It is a form of relaxation and entertainment. Those who work hard in the garden feel great happiness when they see the success of their efforts.*
![1000047066.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sumaiya777/245n1Wk8gbaeiTMAEZceapgcYg2pMLXhFsUCwUpmVBVW1dZ666pmDJdX3uUyg3T5yaQdf.jpg)

*However, a sad reality is that we garden lovers are going through a difficult time. The entire month of Chaitra is passing with continuous rain. Due to excessive rainfall, we are quite afraid to grow vegetables in our gardens. Too much rain can cause the crops to rot, leaving the garden empty and unproductive. Occasionally, we do get a glimpse of sunshine, but it doesn’t last long. We are not sure about the exact reason, but it seems to be due to weather conditions that we are facing this hardship*

Greetings friends, I hope you are having a wonderful day!

*Today I’m sharing a recipe I decided to make to enter the Hive Top Chef contest @qurator. https://peakd.com/qurator/@qurator/qurators-hive-top-chef-or-onions, my entry, featuring the recipe I’m sharing below—a broccoli and onion omelet—is a quick and nutritious dish that always saves the day. I love it because it combines the health benefits of broccoli with the sweet flavor of onions, and the result is simply delicious; it’s full of flavor and nutrients. Perfect for any meal of the day, it’s an excellent way to incorporate more vegetables into our daily meals. I hope you’ll give it a try, friends!.*

Me encanta porque combina lo saludable del brócoli con el sabor dulce de la cebolla, y el resultado es simplemente delicioso; está llena de sabor y nutrientes. Perfecta para cualquier comida del día y es una excelente manera de incorporar más verduras en nuestras comidas diarias. ¡Espero que se animen a probarlo, amigos!

***

### INGREDIENTS||INGREDIENTES:.


✔️1 head of broccoli.
✔️3 eggs.
✔️Plenty of water.
✔️1 onion.
✔️1 teaspoon ground cumin.
✔️2 tablespoons oil.
✔️1 tablespoon salt.
✔️1 teaspoon of sweet paprika powder.

✔️1 brócoli.
✔️3 huevos.

✔️1 cebolla.

✔️2 cucharada de aceite.

##### PREPARATION||PREPARACIÖN:𝕊𝕖𝕡𝕥 𝕓𝕪 𝕤𝕥𝕖𝕡||ℙ𝕒𝕤𝕠 𝕒 ℙ𝕒𝕤𝕠:

*I started by picking the broccoli and rinsing it thoroughly under cold running water.*
✔️Empecé tomando el brócoli y lo llevé a lavar con abundante agua fresca.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dlizara/EpGQhsoUeNRUpfZ514YCuWre6XiPFhR1yJ66HHGFQz1F2PZbjibpcr83o3AUSmWSugU.png)

***
*Fill a pot with water and add all the broccoli; place it on the stove and let it cook for about 5 minutes.*
✔️En una olla coloque agua y agregue todo el brócoli; traslade a la hornilla de la cocina y deje cocinar por espacio de 5 minutos. 

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dlizara/EorzGvT11Dov1vnLbEY46pRdWXxgB393hJWmcMtKCRkK3XZZaT9bYZYHDfGjdvxsq5j.png)

***

*Once the time is up, remove the broccoli from the stove and let it cool; in the meantime, wash the onion, cut it in half, and chop it.*
✔️Luego de pasado el tiempo, retiramos el brócoli de la hornilla y dejamos enfriar; mientras tanto, lavo, corto en dos y pico la cebolla.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dlizara/EpA3w6xGpcENeGQXdHy5SCyM92DRB5Xd6hfpwqceiFYCPFXH2fqxqn7ExhZYeePEkyt.png)

***

*Next, crack the eggs one by one and beat them with a fork.*
✔️Seguidamente, cascamos los huevos uno a uno,  batimos con la ayuda de un tenedor.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dlizara/EpT4cWJukANxb2KcZ9GCJTKgxCWXcDWrRr7kC7TGRBUzp5BRvaYHceUn7mWFvkAKYs3.png)

Absurdly common, still awful.

title.title: Raising the Dead                 …Part 2         …A Modern Prometheus
title.body:
*There is something at work in my soul, which I do not understand. ― Mary Shelley, Frankenstein*


![Old Medical Building, U of T.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/johnjgeddes/243qFSAXjJPUE7tJsfDqxm5rzaAfQAdYMZjz8yVqKtnKgARAm5WmmqedAy9JzwVVjXWoN.png)
*Old Medical Building, U of T*


Len, Alex Hemmer's young research assistant, looked at the sketch Alex had worked on all night, then tossed it back onto the table. \
Alex sighed. He picked up the sketch, staring  at the woman's beauty and mused aloud:\n\n\

Alex raised a hand  to stifle Len's objection.

\
Alex smiled.\n\nLen relaxed a bit but added, \
Alex paused a moment before replying, then lowered his voice to a whisper. \

Len stared open-mouthed at Alex . 

You're asking me to risk my professional reputation and my academic future to participate in this bizarre experiment?\

I know it's a big ask, Len, but I need to see if you have the same experience as I did―it will be a kind of objective verification that this isn't some kind of  subjective fantasy on my part or some type of mystical experience.\

Len seemed dead set against participating in what he considered a highly irregular and possibly an unethical experiment.

Nevertheless, the next day he relented and grudgingly admitted that establishing facts was simply good science but he still was dead set against investigating the private life of a deceased donor. Alex set up the experiment again and reassured Len that he only wanted to verify that the results were not outliers or anomalies and repeating the trials was the only way to verify the results were reliable. Len had his doubts but was willing to at least try, but had no idea where this project might take him,

To be continued…

title.title: The Splinterlands Stats Tool Reborn
title.body:
![splinterlands-statistics.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/23tSKnFQVREdG5gFbEZFWqAYNMB6cREM9oMiy4asHybefQfoYw927KUivHGhGp3ycuiKD.png) Welcome splinterfam, Today we have a big update… and yeah this one has been cooking in the background for a long long time. I finally started rebuilding the splinterlands statistics tool. Not just a small tweak but a full refresh. New tech stack, new structure and most importantly combining all those separate tools into one place. @ourfadedglory less separate hard link to remember 🤣. This is not just an update… this is version next 😄 I have been grinding on this for a few weeks now. Moving code from python to typescript, rewriting logic, fixing assumptions that made sense 2 years ago but not anymore. Even with AI helping out a lot it was still a massive job. And yeah… there will be bugs. 100%. But at least we finally have a solid foundation going forward. If you do not feel like reading everything you can already check it here: http://spl-stats.com When you login add a monitor account it will be picked for scan around 30 minutes. first scan can take up to hours because it will scan your complete splinterlands history #
🙌 Support the Project
Building these tools takes a lot of time and also infra cost. I want to keep everything free so if you want to support: ✅ Upvote this post – it really helps! 👉 [Vote for My SPS Validator Node](https://monstermarket.io/validators?validator=beaker007) 💬 Drop a comment or idea – weird edge cases welcome #
⚠️ Disclaimer
Because this is a new project I still need to monitor how it performs over time. I will be evaluating things like performance, storage usage and network bandwidth. Based on that I will decide if it is sustainable to keep everything running for free for everyone. For now enjoy it, but keep in mind things might change as the project grows 👍, worse case it you have to run it on you own machine 🤣 #
Migration
If you are coming from the old Splinterlands statistics tool (the Python version), I got you covered, let me know if you want migrate your portfolio data into the new site👍 I can help you migrate your portfolio data to this new online version so you do not lose your history. For the more technical users: you can also migrate the data yourself. With this first release it is possible to import your portfolio and battle data through a local setup. If you need help with any of this just reach out and I will guide you through the process 😄 #
🔐 Security First
Before jumping into features I want to highlight something important… security. This is something I really cared about when rebuilding the tool. First of all 👉 The site only use your Hive posting key always check that, know what you sign up to ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/23uQNRP4H8HuQdiq4MSfhm2kC59j5UXjavBseNjRTaC81GkXb3RzQ23SaKnk4a6npmbHS.png) Login works through Hive Keychain. once logged a user is created for you. No keys and password are stored Once authenticated: You can add monitor accounts: https://spl-stats.com/users You sign a message and that gets validated through the Splinterlands API. A long lived Splinterlands token is received That token is encrypted using strong encryption and stored in the database Even if the database gets compromised those tokens are not readable. Again know what you share, if you do not want it, use it locally all data stays on you computer then Also when I rotate secrets everybody needs to re authenticate again. This keeps things clean and removes inactive users automatically. Another important thing: 👉 battle sync is NOT open for everyone Right now it is only running for my own accounts. If you want that level of tracking you can run it locally yourself. Full control, your own data. When you remove you monitor account all data will be remove from the data base for that account (if no longer tracked by others). Please be nice and do not add remove and repeat, i will block it. Everything is open source so you can verify exactly what is happening. https://github.com/gamerbeaker007/spl-stats-next #
📊 What data is stored
Transparency matters. The tool stores: * Season based balances * Leaderboard positions * Win loss stats * Daily portfolio value Basically historical tracking so you can see your progress over time instead of just snapshots. Nothing hidden. Everything visible in the repo. #
🧠 Tech Stack Upgrade
This is probably the biggest shift compared to the old tool. We moved from: 👉 Python scripts and local dashboards To: 👉 A full Next.js deployed application What that means: * Server side rendering first approach * Faster load times * Better security because sensitive logic stays server side * Cleaner UI with React and Material UI Under the hood: * Next.js 16 * React 19 * Prisma with PostgreSQL * Encrypted token storage * Dual authentication system This makes the tool way more future proof and easier to expand later. #
📄 Pages & Features Breakdown
Now the fun part… what can you actually do with it. I will walk through the main parts like you navigate the app. #
🏠 Home
Simple overview with all pages there currently implemented ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/EnyoXowXvYXmXQCPNdZEdYs5K76NW29uo1365vPES4Lf8HmF4DD7XhanLtbWsr824Rc.png) #
Multi Account Dashboard
Multi account dashboard as you know from my previous site (mostly the same) only now embeded with your user that have been setup here and using the long lived token. Here you get a quick overview of: * Your accounts * General stats * balance and reward history ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/23swkExBUVXFTkg1pPHgv3apuFAUt9R58t7aJgMwGiG57sE4caCGz9tHjVThrGXHf8XRS.png) Especially for @doombot75 i kept the side by side view of your card. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/23tv6RpaDhd9iSwtt14wswvEKqDbdMZCbL1a4ncBw4AqGK9LG26tpGYGbHroWxwoRQ82f.png) #
👤 Accounts Management
This is where everything starts. You can: * Login with hive to create user account * Add multiple Splinterlands monitor accounts * Authenticate them securely Each account uses its own token so data stays accurate and isolated. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/Eo44MxmQxHgCw5DS7ebcpxLzDfSLcpgMNc8PnCfYXqiJkxcEh3NKWaHrJTTeK8vyueN.png) Note when you add a account it will get state pending the worker is running every 30minute then it goes to syncing, the first time it can take a few hours. Then if everything is ok it will get green synced. When you encounter red error please let me know. i know fur sure there will be cases that i did not think of. #
📈 Season Statistics
This is one of the core features. Per season you get: * Earnings breakdown * SPS, DEC, cards * Battle metrics This is basically your season report on steroids and it is determined for all your season. ![battle data](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/23t74pFKXTtBv6HEH7xZ53C28czFhB2hF5v9GnDXaVruFq7qgpj2zEdPkkisJezDd1w1U.png) ![seasonal earnings](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/23swg4wKDkG8tWkmn489rCEHgxGEFQ8rvt8Ep2FnjC1mwRcDfesTEMZShVaPtNXgQ2M3i.png) You can see on the hover (i) what types are included to determine it as earning - costs (fees). Not all items are done like transfers ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/23tbRcQ1eJ6KhZFTmjop5f45uRSKRcB6R6xXZ8c1gTSQCVhsgrpRhZ3Azfpnh2uLJC57e.png) ![Detailed token information](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/23swg9r8ABz9G9mnXFjLsgaMVYiqaVBTkUCNf6YFPkDCBYipHfdkpy8VouEcS6MmiB58Z.png) #
💼 Portfolio Tracking
One of my personal favorites. Track: * Total value over time * Daily changes * Asset breakdown This gives you a real view of your Splinterlands journey not just gameplay but also investment side. ![Portfolio Estimation](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/48Fi7HQW6RqP6DC4xT28GdqReppfJTQVx5T8XNqvwBrfDoMQ55xNuSHVXbZQxdV6z4.png) You can add your own investments. this is just for your own tracking. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/23t7DBdHSjzduJhoXvHDBqWge66RW65yYZGPGVr8SHKJ2wjwkAH5rMTPLWuv9gn9p2B5F.png) ![Inventory detail value](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/23tv8RRRD6FawjPGFoYtNHLLsveCqPeDnqBkrZcugK8PcaW92yyRVgHCC2Jjvb1DpgJR9.png) Value of your collection history ![Collection History](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/Eo44H4Dsrnt4dMB4wh9HuV9B3KPTxnmVAZGgFKLXwhHfqk4Jq1eNvPt4pLTnxYSZxip.png) as usual and always with every chart you can interactively update it: ![Foundation history](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/23swfwGB5FVk3wEswo8NbrBqdjsSaG9T9Mrqg22S4xkVSteGaPY8MKfuibN1CnWGqH97T.png) ![SPS history (Staked and liquid)](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/23swfwFr3kVWFUXfAWT4LC7SL24BGf4fmckQFNL54k6Qvx9V7zEGqGaGWR627gWQKD1rm.png) And then there are the Other Item and Inventory history charts as will but you get the point lot of data 🤣 #
⚔️ Battle Insights
This is where things get interesting. and if you want this currently you have to run it locally for yourself. Analyze: * Win loss ratios * Card performance * Matchups ![Battle Cards](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/23tGXnFtmuYAMnDpzDb1uf9opYh5VBNzL5wQDj31kRS73D4KYU5f3iVaT7UzokM3JqJ7f.png) ![Detailed information on a certain card](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/23tbJtUFeFm6y55H5riNRLj9jioHXh1w9JeFuc1kMC2ELeB88dfkHXYyzSiJzAtRKfxPi.png) ![Losing cards](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/23tGVGGcRPBH7iAtfLGev8bqKL6ZeZV7u3NBehUifa1oZrjmSChvpGP4BisHNfBmAybr1.png) And now on to my favorite nemesis, this time not only overall but per format and mode and even a selected timeframe. this alone you should run your own instance 🤣 ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/23tbJxNqQLRoEfgquj6UKx9jvTsmJfkGBjgSc5rqQT79Dci57tGfmgxjAqcCEpQ6HqmUC.png) #
🎰 Jackpot Prizes
The jackpot prizes site also has directly being integrated in this site ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/Eo44pW5TiLE92fmb8yA3JiAEFPN2wK7zskx7kmLsPY22gka97N4cWP3ZnzTRgZ3dQVW.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/23swnH6aGnHJm5nBR9v796vw29pNH5gn4HWG2sUr49aXfAyCKtGnCbDzZ5AjBrzKBh35f.png) #
🧩 Open Source & Self Hosting
Everything is open source. If you do not trust it: 👉 check the code [Github Repo](https://github.com/gamerbeaker007/spl-stats-next) 👉 run it yourself [More info in release page](https://github.com/gamerbeaker007/spl-stats-next/releases) 👉 modify it You are in control. For advanced users you should run locally for parts like the battle sync. #
🚧 What’s Next
This is just the start. There is still: * bugs to fix * features to refine * combine my other project into here * performance to improve And a lot of ideas still on the backlog. But finally… we have a solid base to build on. #
🔥 Final Thoughts
This project has been on my mind for a long time and it feels good to finally get it out there. It is not perfect yet… but it is moving again. And that is what matters. If you try it out let me know what breaks 😄 Beaker signing off ⚔️ https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/website/splinterlands_logo.png Do you also want to be part of this amazing play to earn game consider using my [refferal](https://splinterlands.com?ref=beaker007) link.

title.title: What is missing from current humanoid robots?
title.body:
What is missing from current humanoid robots?


https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmeYVpRmZTBo8vU4YnwhWUNVw8sYq8XzxZhjgadnCGsQna/image.png
https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmcM9vDyChXWWfaBhnqxXD5scZn7pnHcZrWiwyZ8HMwmbX/separador%201.png

> In recent months, videos from China began to go viral, showing humanoid robots with extremely realistic faces, blinking naturally, moving their eyes precisely, reacting to the environment as if they were conscious.


One of the most recent examples was presented by the company AheadForm with models capable of expressing almost imperceptible facial micro-expressions, the same ones that we use without realizing it in daily life, this completely changed the game because until now robots could be efficient, but they were not socially accepted, they worked, but they did not connect, and that may be the true bottleneck of humanoid robotics, acceptance.


https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FOxN008wYEI
https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmcM9vDyChXWWfaBhnqxXD5scZn7pnHcZrWiwyZ8HMwmbX/separador%201.png

> A robot can execute tasks precisely, but without expression, without reaction, without presence, it is still just a machine, now that is changing, these new systems use synthetic skin, extremely precise micro actuators and artificial intelligence capable of interpreting and responding to visual, auditory and social stimuli in real time, the robot not only executes an action, it reacts, it observes, it responds and interacts, and when that happens, the perception changes completely, because we are no longer looking at a machine, we are looking at something that behaves like one of us.


This has always made us wonder to what extent a robot needs to appear to us to be accepted, some specialists defend and it is essential, mainly in areas with customer service, health, education and social coexistence, environments where it is not enough to function, it is necessary to communicate, but there is another side, the more similar to a human a robot becomes, the greater the confusion, the so-called “valley of strangeness”, that point in which something is almost human, but not enough, can cause rejection instead of acceptance and that creates a paradox. Robots need to look human, but they can't look too human, yet the industry seems to have made a decision.


The future of humanoids will not be defined only by strength, speed or precision, but by the ability to look at us while they appear alive and if this trend continues, the most important component of a robot could stop being its body and become the face, because in the end it is not what a machine does, what defines the interaction is what we feel when looking at it, because perhaps the true integration is not in the body, but in the mind.


https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmcM9vDyChXWWfaBhnqxXD5scZn7pnHcZrWiwyZ8HMwmbX/separador%201.png


Sorry for my Ingles, it's not my main language. The images were taken from the sources used or were created with artificial intelligence


Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@rebe.torres12/what-is-missing-from-current-humanoid-robots-k3e)

# On continue à se battre malgré les embuches

Un rapide petit post, histoire de rappeler qu'on est encore et toujours là, et pas seulement pour la curation.

De mon côté je continue à créer des chansons, je prépare d'ailleurs la sortie, le 15 avril prochain, d'une comédie musicale... Un petit projet qui m'a été proposé par un membre d ema communauté et que j'ai accepté de réaliser ...

D'ailleurs en voici un aperçu :
https://www.youtube.com/shorts/CmHuq2jMcf8

D'un autre côté, la poisse reste toujours présente auprès de nous, on a du mal a décoller, quoi qu'on fasse. Certains coachs et Mentors nous dise qu'on doit apprendre à l'accepter pour passer outre, parce que oui, on se fait coacher, et on a des mentors ... Et même avec eux cela reste compliqué.

D'ailleurs ma conseillère Onem elle-même me soutient e tne revient pas de la difficulté que nous traversons... Heureusement c'est plus une alliée qu'une personne dont il faudrait se méfier...

Sinon parlons poisse... La séance de dédicace de demain change d'adresse... Parce qu'un échevin à privatisé l'endroit où nous voulions aller, et n'avons été prévenu que cet après midi, la veille de l'event donc ... Avous ... On y pouvait pas grand chose... Mais notre énergie et le refus d'abandon on fait qu'on a trouvé une solution ... voyez plutôt :

Comme cela, si l'un de ceux qui voulaient passer n'a pas vu nos multiples alertes, ce post pourra peut-être lui permettre de rectifier l'adresse dans son GPS :-)

Bisous ! A bientôt.

https://odysee.com/@NaomiBrockwell:4/3rd-party-doctrine:7

The third-party doctrine is an outdated legal rule, created in an era before smartphones, before the internet, before our private lives became data. The fallout has been catastrophic. This decades-old principle erased the protections meant to shield us from arbitrary government intrusion and opened the door to a future of unchecked surveillance and control. In this video, we'll break down what the third-party doctrine actually is, how it works in a digital world, and why it has to go.

00:00 Yes, The Government CAN Do That
01:22 4th Amendment Review
02:50 3rd Party Doctrine Explained
10:22 The Reasonable Expectation of Privacy Test
14:09 How We Solve This
16:40 Bailment: The Most Important Term You've Never Heard Of
19:52 Congress Needs to Step In

The lie at the heart of the third-party doctrine is that it tells us that participating in modern life means surrendering the protections we were supposed to have against government searches. Let's remind people that in the constitution it says that searches require warrants.
