body.title: Hive Music Festival Week 182 round 2 // There is Prophecy Over me (covered by @sampraise77)
body.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1775827000413-431114080f9df39d.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=sampraise77/69f50929)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=sampraise77/69f50929)


---

Hive Music Festival Week 182 round 2,
There's a sound, something deep from the Spirit, that you can hear in the song “There Is Prophecy Over Me” by Theophilus Sunday. it feels more like a strong statement, a way to wake you up spiritually. It also reminds you that anyone who believes has a special plan from God for their life.

When I think about this song, it feels like it's calling me to get my life in order with God's plan. It makes me remember that my life isn't just average, and it definitely has a purpose. It's like God has spoken words over me, planned out my future long ago, and there are things meant for me to do. Even if things don't always look like what God promised right now, those promises aren't about what's happening today. They're connected to His big, timeless plan.

This song really touches something deeper than just my feelings. It makes me more aware. It hits me that I can't just float through life without a real purpose. If God has a plan for me, then I have a part to play. That means I need to try to do what's right, keep praying, and really listen for what the Spirit is telling me. Following God's plan means getting myself in line with Him, and sometimes it means giving things up.

A really strong part of this message is how it helps me get past my own limits. It reminds me that who I am isn't just about my current situation, but about what God has said about me. Even when things are slow, tough, or uncertain, God's promises are still there. God's word won't ever fail, and what He's promised will definitely happen when He's ready.

For me, this song makes me want to act. Just knowing God has a plan isn't enough; I need to work with Him to make it happen. That involves getting rid of things that sidetrack me, giving my own plans over to Him, and sticking with the journey of growing into who I'm meant to be. It means trusting God, even when I don't get why things are happening the way they are.

So, it's a reminder of who I am and where I'm headed. It urges me to aim for more, to dig deeper in my faith, and to live in a way that truly shows what God wants for me.

And when I say this out loud, I say it with real belief: my life is going to line up with what God has said, and everything He's promised me will come to life.
LYRICS SOURCE
https://youtu.be/LlK41WU9-Js?si=uRrAn00TzDIv8FSf

---

▶️ [3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=sampraise77/69f50929)

body.title: Justyna Bednarek, \
body.body: poszliśmy do biblioteki poszukać starszych dzieł pani Bednarek. Zasłynęła ona chyba książkami o skarpetkach - kojarzę je z biblioteki sprzed lat, ale do tej pory nie byłam raczej targetem. Tym razem jesteśmy odbiorcą idealnym - czytamy sobie te książki w trójkę i doskonale spędzamy wspólnie czas.\n\n
/> Seria o skarpetach to już klasyk. Dobry humor, duża doza abstrakcji, kolorowe ilustracje. Relatywnie krótkie rozdziały, które pozwalają przerwać wieczorną lekturę, kiedy dziecko zrobi się śpiące.
/> To jedna z tych książek, które dobrze się czytają, bo i dorosły całkiem nieźle się przy tym bawi.
/>\n\nAczkolwiek: muszę przyznać, że przez to, że znajomość z Panią Justyną rozpoczęłam od \

, to jestem trochę zepsutym czytelnikiem, bo ta najnowsza seria podobała mi się dużo, dużo bardziej. Humor przemawiał do mnie bardziej, a przygody zwariowanej rodzinki też były bardziej porywające, niż to, co spotykało te skarpety.\n\n
/> Nawet pomimo tego, że były to przygody abstrakcyjne i często niebywale niebezpieczne.

/> Słowem podsumowania, dla ogólnie poznawanej twórczości Justyny Bednarek wystawiam piąteczkę i ogromne serducho. Skarpety czytamy i capniemy każdą część, która w bibliotece, czy gdzieś indziej, wpadnie nam w ręce. Ale tak naprawdę gorąco czekamy na kolejne z serii o Tacie ;)

/>  
[https://lubimyczytac.pl/autor/109333/justyna-bednarek](https://lubimyczytac.pl/autor/109333/justyna-bednarek)

[lubimyczytac.pl - Niesamowite przygody dziesięciu skarpetek](https://lubimyczytac.pl/ksiazka/248583/niesamowite-przygody-dziesieciu-skarpetek-czterech-prawych-i-szesciu-lewych):
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

_Co dzieje się ze zgubionymi w czasie prania skarpetkami? „Bajka o dziesięciu skarpetkach” odpowiada na to pytanie w sposób pełen cudownie nieskrępowanej wyobraźni. Opisuje dzieje dziesięciu pojedynczych skarpetek, każdej z nich ofiarowując inną przygodę. Jest tu miejsce na kryminał, obyczajówkę, bajkę z morałem i taką ze szczęśliwym zakończeniem. Mam pośród nich swoją ulubioną, ale nie zdradzę, którą! Sami wyruszcie w świat z dziesięcioma skarpetkami i znajdźcie swoją ukochaną historię. Ostrzegam tylko, że przeczytanie tej książki grozi zachwytem. I tym, że już nigdy nie spojrzycie tak samo na żadną, nawet najbardziej spraną skarpetkę!”_

\-Zofia Stanecka

_W skarpetkach musi być coś wyjątkowego – poza brudnymi piętami, rzecz jasna – skoro stają się inspiracją do pisania książek. Mieliśmy już uwielbiane w czechach „niedoparki“ pavla śruta, mamy teraz „skarpetki“ justyny bednarek. Kto przeczytał pierwszą książkę, powinien sięgnąć i po drugą , kto przeczyta drugą, sięgnie i po pierwszą; bo taki jest niemy postulat naszych skarpetek – łączmy się w pary!_

\-Grzegorz Kasdepke

[lubimyczytac.pl - O rety, skarpety! Małe pomieszanie z poplątaniem plus trochę zagadek, dowcipów i jedna zwariowana historia](https://lubimyczytac.pl/ksiazka/5120540/o-rety-skarpety-male-pomieszanie-z-poplataniem-plus-troche-zagadek-dowcipow-i-jedna-zwariowana-historia):
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

_Pokochaliście bohaterów „Niesamowitych przygód dziesięciu skarpetek (czterech prawych i sześciu lewych)”?_  
_Chcecie ich lepiej poznać (oraz siebie samych!),a w nagrodę dostać zagadki detektywistyczne, ciekawostki, dowcipy, wiersze i kolorowanki?  
Oraz wieeelką porcję lod… uśmiechu?  
Mamy dla Was dobrą wiadomość!_

_Najbardziej utytułowany duet autorski polskiej literatury dziecięcej, pisarka Justyna Bednarek i ilustrator Daniel de Latour, stworzył nową książkę aktywizującą, która nawiązuje właśnie do pierwszego tomu słynnej serii o skarpetkach._

_To gratka dla dzieci z klas I–III oraz pomoc dla nauczycieli i rodzin początkujących czytelników, dzięki której przyjemność czytania i skarpetkowej zabawy tak szybko się nie skończy._

_O rety, czekają na Was skarpety!_

_Wszystkie tomy ze skarpetkowej serii są w Polsce najbardziej nagradzanymi i najlepiej sprzedającymi się książkami dla dzieci ostatnich lat._

_“Niesamowite przygody dziesięciu skarpetek” rozgościły się na liście lektur szkolnych. Pierwszy tom “Sekretnej historia ludz... skarpetek” otrzymał tytuł Bestsellera Empiku 2022, a drugi tom był nominowany do tej nagrody w roku 2024.  
Pozostałe książki z serii również podbiły serca małych i dużych czytelników._

body.title: Best Engineering Colleges in Madurai for Quality Education
body.body:
Choosing the right engineering college is one of the most important decisions for students who aspire to build a successful career in technology and innovation. With many institutions offering engineering programs, selecting the best option requires careful evaluation of academics, infrastructure, faculty, and placement opportunities. Among the [best engineering colleges in Madurai](https://www.solamalaice.ac.in/), Solamalai College of Engineering has gained recognition for its commitment to quality education and student development.

### **Why Choose Engineering in Madurai?**

Madurai has steadily developed into a notable educational hub in Tamil Nadu. The city offers a balanced environment for students, combining academic growth with a peaceful lifestyle. Compared to metropolitan cities, Madurai provides affordable education and living expenses, making it accessible to a wider range of students.

The presence of multiple engineering institutions has created a competitive academic environment that encourages innovation and excellence. Students also benefit from proximity to major industrial and IT hubs such as Chennai, Coimbatore, and Bengaluru, which opens up opportunities for internships and employment.

### **Academic Excellence and Curriculum**

One of the key reasons why Solamalai College of Engineering is considered among the best engineering colleges in Madurai is its strong academic framework. The curriculum is designed to provide a solid foundation in core engineering concepts while also introducing students to emerging technologies.

Students are encouraged to engage in project-based learning, which helps them apply theoretical knowledge to real-world scenarios. Regular assessments, seminars, and technical discussions ensure continuous learning and improvement.

### **Modern Infrastructure and Facilities**

A well-equipped campus plays a significant role in enhancing the learning experience. The college provides modern infrastructure, including advanced laboratories, digital classrooms, and a comprehensive library with access to academic resources.

Engineering students benefit from specialized labs that support hands-on learning in their respective fields. These facilities help students gain practical exposure, which is essential for developing technical skills and confidence.

### **Experienced Faculty and Teaching Approach**

The quality of education largely depends on the expertise of the faculty. Solamalai College of Engineering has a team of experienced professors and dedicated educators who focus on delivering concept-based teaching.

Faculty members use a combination of traditional and modern teaching methods, including interactive sessions, case studies, and practical demonstrations. This approach ensures that students not only understand concepts but also learn how to apply them effectively.

### **Skill Development and Training**

In competitive world, engineering students need more than just academic knowledge. The college places strong emphasis on skill development, offering training programs in communication, aptitude, and technical skills.

Workshops, seminars, and certification programs are conducted regularly to help students stay updated with industry trends. These initiatives prepare students for the challenges of the professional world and improve their employability.

### **Industry Exposure and Practical Learning**

Industry exposure is a crucial aspect of engineering education. The college organizes industrial visits, guest lectures, and technical events to provide students with insights into real-world applications.

Students are also encouraged to work on projects that address practical problems. This hands-on experience helps them develop problem-solving abilities and a deeper understanding of their field.

### **Placement Support and Career Opportunities**

Placement opportunities are a major factor when evaluating the best engineering colleges in Madurai. Solamalai College of Engineering has a dedicated placement cell that works to connect students with potential employers.

The placement team conducts training sessions, mock interviews, and career guidance programs to prepare students for recruitment processes. Graduates have opportunities in various sectors, including IT, manufacturing, construction, and core engineering industries.

### **Focus on Innovation and Research**

Innovation is at the core of engineering education. The college encourages students to participate in research activities, technical competitions, and innovation programs. This focus on creativity helps students explore new ideas and develop solutions to real-world challenges.

By fostering a culture of research and experimentation, the institution prepares students to contribute to technological advancements.

### **Campus Life and Student Development**

A well-rounded education includes both academic and extracurricular activities. The college provides opportunities for students to participate in cultural events, sports, and technical competitions.

These activities help students develop leadership, teamwork, and communication skills. A supportive campus environment ensures that students can grow both personally and professionally.

### **Conclusion**

Selecting the right college is the first step toward building a successful engineering career. Among the [best engineering colleges in Madurai](https://www.solamalaice.ac.in/), Solamalai College of Engineering offers a comprehensive educational experience that prepares students for both technical challenges and professional growth.

With its strong academic framework, experienced faculty, modern infrastructure, and commitment to student success, the college provides a solid foundation for future engineers. For students looking to pursue engineering in a supportive and career-oriented environment, it remains a dependable option.

body.title: El Mantel [Es-En] The Tablecloth
body.body:
<div class=text-justify>

Sábana litúrgica con que cubrir la mesa y transformar el comer en algo más que ingerir alimentos. Siempre y cuando a la mesa se sienten cuando menos dos. Sin duda, comería mucho menos si me viera obligado a hacerlo en solitario. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP7mqsj2nvGNPaLMHtSx4xANAa56YNSidizK5nnNtVAmr/image.png)

Un momento cotidiano por el que me siento agradecido cada día, pues desde que tengo memoria muy pocas veces me he visto obligado a hacerlo en solitario. 
Recuerdo desde mi infancia a mi madre diciendo que debíamos esperar a papá para sentarnos a comer y solo en casos excepcionales se rompía esta regla. Con los años fueron cambiando las mesas y los roles y muchas veces fui yo a quien esperaban. 
A lo largo de los años he observado que esta costumbre, tan natural para mí como es el comer en familia, no la practican todas. Y cuando me ha sido posible influir en otros, he tratado de inculcarla en ellos con la convicción de que es el mejor momento y manera de mantener y fortalecer las relaciones familiares y personales.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRof8EqwNKzBM9Zm7howbLwdSLfMh6DfKRsXK2fF4RNxM/image.png)

Solo la actitud transforma lo cotidiano y profano en sagrado. La mesa deja de ser mobiliario para convertirse en altar y en sencilla ceremonia dar sentido y agradecer. Los alimentos y no estar solo, entre las infinitas razones para estar agradecido por cuanto sucede de la mañana a la noche cuando nos vamos al lecho y entre sábana y sábana nos rendimos al sueño. En ese otro altar que llamamos lecho.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbgu7ePLTiyZZRAV4xByVdoiPymC5mdsikMyGCrKsJ7RW/image.png)

Solo queda desearles buen apetito o felices sueños, según la hora en que estén leyendo esta publicación que escribo en español, mi lengua materna, o en inglés, gracias al traductor Google.
Otro día les contaré acerca de por qué es más elegante decir buen apetito en vez de buen provecho.
Gracias.

# The Tablecloth

A liturgical tablecloth to cover the table and transform eating into something more than just consuming food. As long as at least two people sit at the table. Without a doubt, I would eat much less if I were forced to do so alone.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP7mqsj2nvGNPaLMHtSx4xANAa56YNSidizK5nnNtVAmr/image.png)

A daily moment for which I am grateful every day, because as far back as I can remember, I have very rarely been forced to eat alone.

I remember from my childhood my mother saying that we had to wait for Dad to sit down to eat, and only in exceptional cases was this rule broken. Over the years, the tables and the roles changed, and many times it was me they waited for.

Throughout the years, I have observed that this custom, as natural to me as eating with family, is not practiced by everyone. And when I've been able to influence others, I've tried to instill this in them, convinced that it's the best time and way to maintain and strengthen family and personal relationships.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRof8EqwNKzBM9Zm7howbLwdSLfMh6DfKRsXK2fF4RNxM/image.png)

Only attitude transforms the everyday and profane into the sacred. The table ceases to be mere furniture and becomes an altar, and in a simple ceremony, it becomes a place to give meaning and gratitude. Food and not being alone are among the countless reasons to be grateful for everything that happens from morning till night, when we go to bed and, between the sheets, surrender to sleep. On that other altar we call bed.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbgu7ePLTiyZZRAV4xByVdoiPymC5mdsikMyGCrKsJ7RW/image.png)

All that remains is to wish you bon appétit or sweet dreams, depending on when you're reading this post, which I'm writing in Spanish, my native language, or in English, thanks to Google Translate.

Another day I'll tell you why it's more elegant to say \

body.title: Beyond the One-Summoner Crutch: How Switching Tactics Unlocked My Climb to Gold
body.body: > Is your day was full of great achievements? In Splinterlands, I can confirm that on the daily basis I am happy to make significant progress and resolve lineup issue against advance formation. My battles of the day went super cool. The confidence to enter gold league is higher than never considering the win rate after the past ten battles. I am dreaming to enter the champion league if nothing stop this rush to the top of my warriors.

>

## A:/  Alternation of Summoners

I was playing almost all the battles in Modern Format with two summoners Lorkus and Akane.

It was not the right approach to maintain effective dominance on the battlefield. The limitation of this strategy was the fatigue of the cards under repeated entries in the arena.

I was completely under new territory when I was forced by the game to play with Priutt or Wrath.
It is better to switch between summoners considering the rich effective of warriors in my collection. Entries in the arena are diverse and cover a large spectrum of element from magic to archer.
Melee warriors from earth and water are regularly called to battle offering enough options to boost my plans of combat.




 <center> ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdCMHGAGP7PXFqq3GiRhwSoNC374XiVrfrEu6gN9C7xmc/bat1_save.png) </center>

You can see the result in this battle where i manage to build a trap to my adversary with Priutt warriors in the melee area.

 <center> ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX3eZtUX3J3kTMnS5zfu3f84wP2t6CKjxGsW7yCsQpkNJ/bat1.png) </center>

[Battle 1 win](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_d9ba945f469eb529e6f6b1d3692ab560)



--

<div class=\

> I feel free when my strategies involve many summoners and doesn't require permanent availability of a certain type of warriors ready to combat. It was a serious problem when I was playing Oridum all the time in the arena. Akane did the best He could do in this combat, but I underestimated the performance of the magic attacks coming from the enemy position.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbxj48eTVmH57wn4Ab9KzqWnG1j7ZyfiSxYSQf5EFqK6u/bat2_lost.png)

[Battle 2 lost](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_0d478ceafa5000dc662b4b81fa4aabb5) In this battle I knew that the introduction of magic and melee in the arena will boost my offensive moves against the opponent.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYWWsPbg9k3aqAcQtXakDpRGq9i38Qo5qVtJSHY8rX9jn/bat3won.png)
I made a nice choice with Lorkus and Archney to restore health points of my tankers in the front row.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUnzTWLYD9kkcd3qHriX1Y9dejwhvpUWnz7EiuqAqekdm/bat3.png)

[Battle 3 win](https://splinterlands.com/pre-battle/sl_54acca5c2547145b5280338ecb98cb07) -- A batte where the opponent surprised me with a super powerful magic team pounding my position with four magic points per attacks mounting to almost 25 points each round.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTvxhqALhq2rew2SL8GFqQJuRrBPd5A2mvNVdTDrbixZs/bat4.png)
It was a terrible defeat. [Battle 4 lost](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_dc68d199510672458742d1c3cd8a9c29) -- This battle offered me some consolation considering the immense damage collected from the other side of the arena.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTS4GxbePe2BmmHyjdRgYghP1pixt46wigffaGLVmhQSs/bat5_won.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVwseJmGPeh5Kvt5ZPghiPJCUqSv59hodc75W93ikFngu/bat6.png)
A loss taking as a learning phase in this series of combat. [Battle 6 lost](https://splinterlands.com/pre-battle/sl_74c27c587756c6b6e80618ea7d7d047b)

各位小伙伴们好！农民友哥已上线。友哥今天是农民一枚，真正种地的那种哦。欢迎继续阅读了解！

昨天下了一天的雨，田里的地已经湿透了，达到了种植所需要的湿度了。

父亲说今天可以种植花生了。友哥和父亲来到田地里。友哥老家这边，可用耕地的土地很少，不能使用机械化，只能纯人工。

友哥父亲使用锄头刨坑，友哥将花生米种子两粒或者三粒扔到坑里，然后再用脚将坑边的土覆盖花生米种子并填满坑，再轻轻踩一脚。所以友哥拍摄了一下自己的脚。

踩的力量不能过重，不能过轻。轻了，种子没有压力，过早发芽。重了，压力过大，发芽时间长甚至不发芽。

和HIVE上的踩，不一样哦。这是真的用脚踩哦。

body.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1775826372433-20318db2ba1e62fa.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=marvel-trader-c/d98f5365)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=marvel-trader-c/d98f5365)


---

A blessed Friday to you all, its the 10th day in April and we specially welcome you to the **Marvel Traders Community**.

Today we will be showing you step by step how to use the **Gann box** as a trading strategy.

This is one of the strategies that we've been using for a very long period of time and it's working well, mostly when you follow the trend 📉📈.

On the video above you will see how we used this strategy to get some profits from the market.

* **Step By Step Guide \

**

On the higher time frame (tf), pick your Gann box tool and drag it from the **higher-high** to the **higher-low** that lead to the break of structure if the trend is bullish.
 Why on a bearish market condition, drag the Gann box from the **lower-low** to the **lower-high** that lead to the break of structure. ***We are going to show you this strategy on a bearish market condition in our next video.***

This was our screenshot on the USD-JPY 15m tf.

But before we continue, let's quickly show you how to set your Gann box to look like how ours is displaying on the screen.

* **Click on third tool option by the left side of your screen if it's on the trading view, with the name \

**



* **Click on the Gann box tool**
You can add it as you favorite if you desire.



* **Drag it on your screen and click on the settings icon**



* **Untick th levels that were indicated on your screen and maybe the background if you desire**



* **The level we needed are:**

0 --- 0.25 --- 0.5 --- 0.618 --- 0.75 --- 1


---

Go to you higher time frame, on this video, we used the 15m tf.

* **Drag it from the higher-high to the higher-low that lead to the break of structure on an uptrend.**



* **Wait for a pullback to the 0.618 or 0.75 level of the Gann box on the lower time frame and look for any candle confirmation that you use for your entry.**
on this chart we used the bullish engulfing candle stick.



* **Immediately the 5m candle closed bullish, we enter on a market execution with our stop-loss few pips below the low of that candle and targeted a 1:3 risk-reward (R:R)**


At the end of it, you can see that the market played well.

we won't close this section without saying a big thanks to @starkerz \

, other admins and mod. and to everyone..

**Note:**

* To make this strategy work more effectively, you need to follow the trend.
* Have a proper risk management.
* Always wait for entry confirmation.

body.title: America’s Growing Debt Burden Is Starting to Bite
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWzWp7bhyxX4H9GJzA5QbKNLTxq2yahG5jNzufjUbHXK9/img_0280.jpg)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdgUnZjUPVcABzqdPk5DmVpDUiP2yx3AJ8MbYbhDoAEXi/img_4612.png)

**The Rising Cost of U.S. Debt**

The latest numbers on U.S. debt, especially the interest payments, are alarming. As Fortune Magazine reported, the Congressional Budget Office (CBO) highlighted in its latest release that the U.S. government paid nearly $530 billion in interest between October 2025, when the fiscal year began, and March 2026. That works out to more than $88 billion per month, or over $22 billion per week.

These figures are so large they’re hard to fully grasp. $22,000 million spent on interest every single week just to service debt. Imagine what that kind of money could do if it were invested productively. What makes it more concerning is that this represents a **7% increase** compared to the same period last year. The U.S. is now spending more on interest payments than it does on defense and education combined.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdgUnZjUPVcABzqdPk5DmVpDUiP2yx3AJ8MbYbhDoAEXi/img_4612.png)

To me, this points to two things. First, the trajectory doesn’t look sustainable, and the risks are clearly rising. Even Jerome Powell hinted at similar concerns in a recent interview. Second, it shows how the U.S. is gradually limiting its own flexibility. With debt levels this high, the room to maneuver, economically and politically, keeps shrinking, making it increasingly important to find a way out.

**Personally, I don’t hold any U.S. bonds or sovereign bonds in general because I see the risks as outweighing the returns they currently offer. What about you guys?**




![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdgUnZjUPVcABzqdPk5DmVpDUiP2yx3AJ8MbYbhDoAEXi/img_4612.png)

body.title: TAKANAKUY: THE PEAK OF BRUTALITY / TAKANAKUY: EL MOMENTO CÚSPIDE [ENG - ESP]
body.body: # TAKANAKUY: THE PEAK OF BRUTALITY / TAKANAKUY: EL MOMENTO CÚSPIDE [ENG - ESP] ### Documentary Series: The Face of Tradition / Serie Documental: La Cara de la Tradición ![_DSC9125.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cabzphoto/23zkprb2vgfh541DG1WVx8cZ3aQbjKUhHXdo3yybDbDv32w3TrbiZ5k4Y6Y4xi85YSomq.jpg) *In the heart of the Andes, brutality becomes a ritual and every blow is a story of identity.* *En el corazón de los Andes, la brutalidad se hace ritual y cada golpe es una historia de identidad.* ### English Hello friends of the Black and White community and #MonoMad. Today I bring you another chapter of my Takanakuy documentary, which is slowly reaching its end. On this occasion, I’ve curated a mix of fights that caught my eye—capturing that peak moment of brutality, which is one of the many faces of this tradition. I hope to convey what I see through my lens, but I also love that each of you can give these images a different interpretation. That’s what I love about photography: the ability to tell a story while allowing the viewer to find their own meaning in what they see. I've been having some technical issues and I've switched publishing platforms, I hope you can understand these glitches. I’d love to share more, but I’m heading to class and I'm very sleepy! ### Español Hola amigos de la comunidad en Blanco y Negro y mis amigos del MonoMad. Hoy les traigo un capítulo más de mi documental Takanakuy, que ya se acerca a su fin. En esta ocasión, presento un mix de peleas que llamaron mucho mi atención, capturando el momento cúspide de la brutalidad, que es una de las caras más crudas de esta tradición. Espero que puedan ver e interpretar lo que busco mostrar en esta serie. Me gusta intentar contar una historia, pero también amo que cada quien pueda darle una interpretación diferente a las imágenes. Esa es la magia de la fotografía: cada ojo ve una historia distinta. He tenido problemas técnicos y he cambiado de plataforma, espero que puedan entender los percances. body.title: 🌿 A Moment From My Farm: Progress You Can Feel
body.body:
Today while moving around my compound, I decided to spend some time with one of my turkeys, and it gave me a chance to really reflect on the progress I’m making.
Holding it in my hands, I could feel the weight and strength it has developed over time. It reminded me that growth on the farm doesn’t happen overnight — it comes from daily care, feeding, and constant attention.
When I first started raising them, it wasn’t always easy. There were times I had to adjust how I feed them and how I manage their space. But with time, I began to understand what works better, and now I can clearly see the results.
What stood out to me today is how healthy this turkey looks — the feathers are well formed, and it’s active and strong. These small observations are very important because they show whether you are doing things the right way or not.
Farming has taught me patience more than anything else. Whether it’s crops or animals, you have to give them time and consistent care before you see results.
This moment may look simple, but for me, it represents progress, learning, and the daily effort that goes into farm life.
I’ll keep pushing forward and sharing more of these real moments from my journey 🐔🌱

body.title: What Lies Beyond the Lagoon: A Journey Few Dare to Take in Bantayan Island// Lagoon Part 2, Bantayan Travel V
body.body:
![Modern Aesthetic Wedding Photo Collage Instagram Post (1100 x 1350 px)_20260410_175821_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/23ynSk193VSn2yBkCqkDQyrkgpQUGDJDDvdqpeEyX3PbUKcuBzYcfYPN7W6nTbhsrh23z.png)

<center></center>*<sub><center>Lead image  created using [ CANVA](https://www.canva.com/design/DAG4XqLPHZk/zEFLzmmPErnISEOtfB8PGA/edit?utm_content=DAG4XqLPHZk&utm_campaign=designshare&utm_medium=link2&utm_source=sharebutton)</center></sub>*


<div class=\

>Hello, travelers! My trip to Bantayan Island was a really tiring and exciting one. Yesterday, in my blog, we stopped in Baigad Lagoon and explored the lagoon through my personal experience. Many things happened there, and I have seen plenty of details about it—too many for once. Hence, I decided not to put it all in one blog, for the lagoon really has to be shared with attention to details. ![Messenger_creation_21A76381-7BC6-49D4-9227-B76874898C78.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/23xySnPi6gGVUde49bQvAMxvAoGWKMEZBcYztfwf3TRv2PfyHbcJhhvMeAWZSsN4QdC7S.jpeg) ![Messenger_creation_3560EB30-D33F-4470-B97A-1CC3272DDB7C.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/23vsC1CkUu2qNqUeMa6RZqBti65qd3m9nU5x1rK4pd9f7WeyX7ATH5XET5ZvAKt4CWJYZ.jpeg) ![Messenger_creation_DCD5FD24-2AAE-4B13-B783-AE5261194AB7.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/23xVJwi7GNGftBRcCNQd6Fm6jhoxEh1hbuo52rZS5U1JKRbmYk1JqLcwSRPc6p8GzUXt7.jpeg) ![14adc2a8-52d8-48ab-9710-191f43eae5d1media_editing.tmp.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/244oUWKai3znjARs7DxEgKscY9z1aK6rWiMDWkkNuXZ2kzpqcyptC3gAJ27kWYZhXPtUQ.jpeg) ![5b220895-2503-4aa4-a0b4-edb133820639media_editing.tmp.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/23ycyrqGMYztiXGsw9x5EufBhPnSyfZiaziaxMpHBwH9cduCxsNA563nVceh3siQ4bnJM.jpeg) ![6bc8d81b-ae37-41cd-a876-d313da79a467media_editing.tmp.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/23qqnYEq3F8awRKS1AgW7fFRHwaands6DvSJj7SCb5peRffFaxsKUj8A9yeQg67totFHM.jpeg) In this blog, I'll be sharing with you the part where we passed through the strong current of water in the lagoon to reach a small land area in Baigad Lagoon, which is home to many plants, endemic or not. We reached this after the lifeguard allowed us to do so while we had our life jackets on. Anyone who visits here should remember how important it is to reach this small area and experience the lagoon from another land perspective. ![Messenger_creation_1976E73D-DCFC-4D4E-B272-E8DFA88715B0.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/23vsHsvkEMWw96UZWNJUVqUuVe6cyAxttoKJjXNZspDkzLiVJ4VX4ZK1QGLpLtD9D6Kxk.jpeg) ![8e396d11-fd16-47dd-a8ba-1d062f901cc2media_editing.tmp.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/23xKtdv5zgKJK7hYC1FY1SxB8EwWYD1pVPybo2eFaAgNTasVaHjyyhYMJ49RSuLWzWeEN.jpeg) ![0f1b99d8-5ab8-4d3a-a3f0-0bd8bfc1e5e4media_editing.tmp.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/243fbHk3kmJikFicjo84TRqSo6w9dKajDhP9YPyba3E9AfuskFG7dSf6b3VNpshnqZEdT.jpeg) ![Messenger_creation_B833F093-2F0D-493E-AF27-9F05A9D049AC.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/242NUJFLxTVyfU699yWhqqZ1MpSfLG9WrXhFFd7HUHd91dFReBMtTh1iXsEWWEuYE5yAg.jpeg) ![Messenger_creation_FECEBDF4-0CBD-45DA-B3F2-7DC7AB39FC02.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/23zRu1rWymrPKnQDaJ8P53WxgwACqpTc5SyYFJZMt4grhuK668e2oqTYANB8bNyX1gDKP.jpeg) When we had our life jackets, we started to prepare our tripod and cellphones to document and photograph stunning scenes in the lagoon, as well as capture memories we will treasure forever as we grow together as lovers. The swim towards this small area was not smooth—the current could anytime get strong and disrupt our balance as we were holding the tripod and phones above water, while floating, controlling our bodies not to get swayed by the current and swimming towards the land without getting our equipment wet. ![Messenger_creation_4497217C-14EF-4D1F-AD92-F83B5CAC1F91.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/23w2snZ3F4LEM9LQycP2KrM4QxYceiK5ewYpHQMp4f5fJ6ryGrqtQeGyJuhpMaRYpmWih.jpeg) ![Messenger_creation_C7C506B9-5084-432E-8B01-DB62ED83DD67.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/23xVCdJaqHNfXLZ4heyjcFo95tUd7A5m49Z6TAjWB5R5eQYa6sknncbyjMP564e7zPAVS.jpeg) ![Messenger_creation_CCC7CB0B-F4E7-4866-AE09-811580E1874E.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/23vsNEb85R4ZtooMexAPX9ZpShUYhMCCQei5fXur8bgHnDVFHAGXsf2kyQYPgiSZhPcWx.jpeg) Teamwork was the solution to get there safely with our equipment, and I was really on the verge of panicking when the current got stronger and stronger. Since I had my boyfriend with me, I was then calm and we reached the other shore successfully. ![d699c8bc-4470-4aeb-87fb-b63837570a8fmedia_editing.tmp.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/23zke2WooXygNpaRe6jT5pXafdYwf67ZoT7iuJrNgUui1GcjiMc4XjHYkQBXE5LtSLgbC.jpeg) ![5943409f-0d82-4fc3-8f77-57c735792ac2media_editing.tmp.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/23xehVNfZuQngc1T27ZM6xFsBkhPcDSz84DgbGSpXa7kQcRsZBdhUkv74EQsEJU54xbSx.jpeg) ![0af313f5-2866-487c-b381-fbfaadee449fmedia_editing.tmp.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/243LvZNdzQY9jFWjXrgXNtawpotdQv6EeRXxuEx7cjfFuvWakFShbQhcVmQBgu9Y8qR3F.jpeg) ![95a57088-9da5-4dd5-98a1-54efe21c9b9cmedia_editing.tmp.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/23y8oiXh9ihnnMNBmn6yCprWnxJ9BBSW93LzucUGCsWtowTFVYzCjtGiSAqHEonZ2yrZr.jpeg) One thing that amazed me in this destination is how the ocean and lagoon meet halfway. I was not able to take a photo on the right side of the lagoon, but there was a part where the water from the ocean and the lagoon meets. That is why the sand in the lagoon was really thick and there were no fish and other aquamarine animals in the water. The current from the ocean made the water inside strong, and sometimes it would slow down, depending on the weather. Such a thing amazed me because of how these two water areas meet and mix to create such a perfect and clean paradise. ![Messenger_creation_969224F7-BAF3-4773-B385-2A2C65451C88.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/23xVAVYkDFf3ggVFkAEhFd4MW7PpaKJDpHQXNRwivppB7FV6ThKTMJwp2Lx2ANdfZb9b1.jpeg) ![Messenger_creation_301EFEF9-5F3F-4A8F-AFF8-B35B73E5C1D3.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/23zbFEyNadPVa45uWLsz2KnzZ91X24AjQVsVUeRDoavEWZHLe55Cxt1aN91HxakNHA2GJ.jpeg) ![Messenger_creation_FCF7B072-831E-49C3-A4D9-4889A1CF76BC.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/EokddKHNcpksgJDzQVLAqz1oqGbm4HrcyrLhG7yeY6CDzjkFbHHnqVAZkPe43vxjuqN.jpeg) ![bd5f81fa-1785-4686-b1a5-458eca088379media_editing.tmp.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/23yTcydxwS7JDTHf7XtmVdTJzh9feUXRAe6SG4wZ7iUna1L7Ls8uWezUcrHvH5zixKt9P.jpeg) ![6a67d060-8876-4faa-ab5e-dd6d1c7d727amedia_editing.tmp.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/23xVAVYkDFf3ggVFkAEhFd4MW7PpaKJDpHQXNRwivppB7FV6ThKTMJwp2Lx2ANdfZb9b1.jpeg) ![8db6209d-c8e7-400d-ba84-778c0ef34518media_editing.tmp.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/23zbFEyNadPVa45uWLsz2KnzZ91X24AjQVsVUeRDoavEWZHLe55Cxt1aN91HxakNHA2GJ.jpeg) ![4b0d4781-d985-48ef-98e6-fbe5eee59151media_editing.tmp.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/23yTeoEtgVgjnpHTMRSfsbcCCHCt467Kj4xx2Lqmfwy7ZiozHqxZuJTd1EGYXqMEu7FT9.jpeg) Reaching the other shore means witnessing other scenes. If from the beach shore it was a spot to witness full green trees and a deep blue lagoon, from the lagoon it was a stretch of coconut trees and beach huts full of tourists, with a majestic blue sky for a perfect visit. A fine stretch of white sand made the view even more relaxing, with blue waters that are literally clear and unbothered by any chemicals or illegal activities. ![e915b787-b6c8-448c-a461-cea394fcdfb2media_editing.tmp.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/23yJCXdgYALqTXH6Fx4jGGrexPM2LmMoKsjjvoaTzsTWJcnBYQ9GY4dSQEeHNjhAhHXob.jpeg) ![089f3b11-0138-4f64-bb3c-fef68926fc89media_editing.tmp.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/23rAyCVNV9W73qMBWymzazLedqc9HM4cu348ikWXip1ibSMWjZT6CvETcoZkaSJZ39MBq.jpeg) ![0cc539c7-c4a9-4df1-9623-7409a521df50media_editing.tmp.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/23yTcmAEuRE5Ky6ayBhi3XqkCzJxKfCeoepsNYTD1xEJWmewanyaPsgGnAeSpUJmMLMNo.jpeg) ![Messenger_creation_CEA8F289-3A17-4EA9-BC9C-04192EC1CF5E.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/23y8miru2XfuaYv362gV2pMucScdw6tZQY6xrf3aJaKtEmZGjDszjuVFEsJxLb1JrQKoi.jpeg) ![7e371fcc-b571-4181-a7b2-eaa85607ba3cmedia_editing.tmp.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/23y8miru2XfuaYv362gV2pMucScdw6tZQY6xrf3aJaKtEmZGjDszjuVFEsJxLb1JrQKoi.jpeg) ![82860c64-9fa3-48e2-9dba-6b9f533f9864media_editing.tmp.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/23xATvRsxSJH2Fvo9P5FN5SFPTeSg2Lw6yw5LfmXhUbLEZ2xSJuWsu2cT3oEqa8FEJNm3.jpeg) We walked around this small round shore, and behind it was just a group of aquamarine trees that blocked the way—it was a dead end. Exploring around meant witnessing such water in the lagoon that attracted my interest the moment I saw it. The water was a mixture of blue and green, and you can see it upon looking at the photos. Trees behind bordered the perimeter of this lagoon, creating a more exclusive and undisturbed water experience. The lagoon was so cool, and I enjoyed floating on it since there was a strong current going in the opposite direction. We swam there for an hour and talked about things that amazed us in Bantayan. It was really a memorable lagoon experience and a strong foundation of our relationship. ![Messenger_creation_864832A3-6067-4A90-85EA-24C72FE91846.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/23ywisYdWVuF5XGMtkjoUfNYzqde1SqRYBRqLhFshTdNAzVgVC1YUTv5aY7VwXvUbD3qT.jpeg) ![605aa503-393e-4a28-b791-b2c5587479f1media_editing.tmp.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/23xARToxti9cho9QtdWVox9WDXWff1XjiZRsaQDJn9JvfQRPtWKoAuPqvwcG7RrHtRgoS.jpeg) ![71362fab-abd1-4ba7-8b30-3d679e34008fmedia_editing.tmp.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/23xyNtpmDoDHCyTZMS8TkJVG9voJg49Cq9VPhNasb7YhmFqVTsCW1qu7uuUPEJ472gAm3.jpeg) ![Messenger_creation_CE417BED-0E05-4842-AA40-9AFA625E1429.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/EqDjC5ouqosU7oTaXp2Buipkr3donaYHFzNvdnkoiCAPcD2ysW4Bsyv2j8nXZeD99Np.jpeg) ![Messenger_creation_114CE82C-D5A9-4640-A52E-EA8FB074FD3C.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/23yTWTiAzrYJkb1AneuVFxKgfj5BARoquNCms39Evg8R25Ar2BGdumsof6ZEnT9TFopQN.jpeg) ![Messenger_creation_A6523D00-6E3F-4572-8808-C99F0181F1D7.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/EpEHGxU59UmkK39s7LwFfLtN9JEJUCeF88UTzc9F4mXTBCp6fN9xbASwjeX8BCMNxnF.jpeg) ![Messenger_creation_9FB175AB-E9BD-4BC8-9445-4341BA06BD70.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/EqDjC5p4wqD8yXCB2y8Uqt5KLoHFskQS9oEeXEeQdUmzDXb19KBegv5BTfwrtPs2Dhm.jpeg) ![Messenger_creation_A8DFC5A7-9D66-4DED-B27C-73531CB57169.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/EopsxPj8XUFDBqh9F64tRqAabRN2YUcdRQUEa4JS745jFbGKSYxyF8A3d37pXiR2mWh.jpeg) We returned to the beach with a smooth swim since the current was going towards the other shore, and we just floated. One minute later, we reached it and returned the life vests we borrowed to the lifeguard. We then went to an area where an ascending land was located, where some tourists, especially in groups or families, were celebrating or having fun. It was a plain ground above the sand with trees on the edges. It was perfect for big gatherings if they want a more refreshing ocean view while celebrating such occasions. ![327299eb-e148-4128-a899-3a056e56b376media_editing.tmp.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/23xKjpvenoTW3pzwRn5CzUZLA8boYrSEfs3umnBxLHtg1r5oSKg6JKRFD7B1qJj8bWbe4.jpeg) ![c9f045eb-21a4-4156-a233-db62469890d2media_editing.tmp.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/23xeXMhz2Sv1fEAaf38Ay2tLYoq7riuAchjhvi9PCjtpGYEuSdBUumaubPtjVNgSMh3Mw.jpeg) ![e4a0fe71-03f5-4dde-9ed0-d5956fe6d50bmedia_editing.tmp.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/EobzGhNTmTNHomtn9xjmqpu3pdVu62JVidpyZa2u11BvtAsufi8Qijte4Vs4hFj5AjS.jpeg) We rested on a hammock after all we did in the lagoon. Coconut trees were what we viewed above, and it was a lucky experience to have witnessed such a perfect destination and escape from responsibility and pressure temporarily. The idea of allowing myself to be immersed in nature was the best thing I did on holidays to bring back the peace I once had. Life is so fast-paced that I am not doing it often—the slowing down and paying attention to what is around me that matters the most in the present. Before leaving this part of the lagoon, I took a moment to look back at the journey we had—from crossing the strong current to reaching this hidden spot that not everyone dares to explore. It made me realize that destinations like this are not just about the place itself, but about the experience of getting there, the challenges faced, and the memories created along the way. Baigad Lagoon offered not just a scenic escape, but a deeper travel experience that reminds every traveler to embrace both the calm and the unpredictable moments of every adventure. **You Can Follow My Bantayan Journey Here:** [Bantayan Island: The Island That Redefined My Idea of A Perfect Beach](https://peakd.com/hive-163772/@whosee/bantayan-island-the-island-that-redefined-my-idea-of-a-perfect-beach) [The Ruins: An Abandoned Cliffside House That Became the Heart of Bantayan Island// Bantayan Travel Part II]( https://peakd.com/hive-163772/@whosee/the-ruins-an-abandoned-cliffside-house-that-became-the-heart-of-bantayan-island-bantayan-travel-part-ii) [Not on the Map but Worth the Risk: Discovering a Cliffside Blue House and Turquoise Paradise in Bantayan]( https://peakd.com/hive-163772/@whosee/not-on-the-map-but-worth-the-risk-discovering-a-cliffside-bluehouse-and-turquoisie-paradise-in-bantayan) [Tucked Away in Bantayan: The Unexpected Beauty of Baigad Lagoon](https://peakd.com/hive-163772/@whosee/tucked-away-in-bantayan-the-unexpected-beauty-of-baigad-lagoon-part-iv) [//]:# (!worldmappin 11.182444 lat 123.787508 long A powerful current, a risky crossing, and a hidden side of Baigad Lagoon that few get to experience. d3scr)

Over the past four decades, touring reached a massive scale, and these picks were used by artists who headlined the most iconic festivals and venues in the world. Whether it's a specialty \

design or a classic tour-stamped plectrum, having items from bands that shaped the sound of the 80s, 90s, and 2000s makes this a curated chronicle of modern rock’s touring legac. I'm putting this guitar pic together. Alphabetical order over the next few weeks and months.**

body.title: Television Review: A Golden Crown (Game of Thrones, S1X06, 2011)
body.body:
![(source:gameofthrones.fandom.com)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/gameofthrones/images/5/56/Jorah_and_Viserys.jpg)

**A Golden Crown (S01E06)**

Airdate: 22 May 2011

Written by: Janet Esperson, David Benioff & D. B. Weiss
Directed by: Daniel Minahan

Running Time: 52 minutes 


The monolithic success of *Game of Thrones* was built upon a broad church of admirers. While a significant portion of the audience fell in love with the series for its intricate plotting, moral ambiguities, and rich characterisation, another segment—perhaps less enamoured with the increasingly complex universe and its Byzantine intrigues, or indifferent to the ‘edgy’ content and shock tactics—found its greatest merit in the show’s ability to deliver brilliantly executed scenes of combat and visceral action. *A Golden Crown*, the sixth episode of the first season, serves as an early and potent example of this latter strength. Ironically, this instalment, which features two of the season’s most memorable set-pieces, also functions to temporarily wind down the simmering Stark-Lannister conflict that had been its central focus, demonstrating the series’ nuanced handling of pacing and consequence. The episode is often hailed as a high watermark of the early season.

*A Golden Crown* immediately confronts the audience with the curiously inconsequential aftermath of the previous week’s brutal clash between Eddard Stark and Jaime Lannister. Ned, left in the street with a wounded leg after his men are slaughtered, awakens to sudden reversal fortunne. King Robert Baratheon, accompanied by a dismissive Cersei, begs his old friend to resume his role as Hand of the King. Robert’s motives are rooted in a genuine, if lazy, desire to preserve a fragile peace. He needs a competent administrator to manage the realm’s boring affairs, freeing him to hunt with Renly and Barristan Selmy. This scene efficiently re-establishes the central dynamic: Ned’s honourable rigidity is the kingdom’s best hope for stability, yet it is also a liability in the viper’s nest of King’s Landing.

Ned’s tenure as de facto ruler begins with him limping to the Iron Throne to hear petitions—a sequence masterfully underscoring the burden of power. The petitions largely concern the Riverlands, the ancestral home of his wife Catelyn, which is being ravaged by Ser Gregor Clegane under the implicit encouragement of Tywin Lannister. In a characteristically honourable but politically naïve move, Ned follows the letter of the law: he strips Clegane of titles and lands, issues a death warrant, and summons Tywin to court to answer for his bannerman’s crimes. It is a decisive stroke that wins him no friends, highlighting the episode’s theme of justice versus pragmatism. The narrative cleverly employs the “show, don’t tell” principle here; Clegane’s atrocities are conveyed not through spectacle but through the harrowing accounts of survivors, a choice that is both economically sound and powerfully affective, forcing the viewer, like Ned, to rely on testimony and deduce the horror.

Meanwhile, the episode’s most seismic plot development occurs not through action, but through a quiet, domestic revelation. Sansa’s fleeting encounter with Joffrey, wherein the prince displays a calculated sliver of kindness, solidifies her infatuation. Her protestation to Ned that she will bear Joffrey “yellow-haired babies” triggers his “eureka” moment. Consulting the book of lineage, Ned realises the terrible truth Jon Arryn died for: all Baratheons have black-haired offspring, meaning the golden-haired Joffrey cannot be Robert’s son. This realisation, underscored by Ramin Djawadi’s haunting score, is a superb example of the series rewarding attentive viewers, transforming a seemingly trivial character beat into the key that unlocks the entire series’ central conspiracy.

While the Stark-Lannister feud escalates in the capital, the incident that sparked it—Tyrion’s abduction by Catelyn—reaches its conclusion in the Vale. After bribing his way back to Lysa Arryn’s court, Tyrion demands a trial. His subsequent “confession” is a masterpiece of comic writing, delivered with impeccable timing by Peter Dinklage, who wrings laughter even from Lysa’s own courtiers. When the trial by combat is granted, Tyrion’s request for his brother Jaime is denied, forcing him to rely on the sellsword Bronn. What follows is one of the episode’s—and the series’—defining action sequences. Bronn, fighting without shield or armour, employs speed, evasion, and environmental awareness to exhaust and ultimately defeat the heavily armoured Ser Vardis Egen (Brandon McCormack). As Lysa cries, “You didn’t fight with honour!”, Bronn’s retort—“No. He did.”—encapsulates the show’s cynical ethos. The choreography is brutally intelligent, a clear visualisation of pragmatism triumphing over tradition, and a highlight for viewers who prize tactical combat over mere spectacle.

The narrative threads in Westeros are balanced by significant developments in the North and Essos. North of the Wall, Bran’s first horseback ride since his paralysis is cut short by a wildling attack. His rescue by Robb and Theon is a violent, brief affair, but its primary function is to introduce Osha, a wildling woman spared by the Starks. Notably, the character—described as grungy and middle-aged in George R. R. Martin’s novels—is rejuvenated by the casting of the young Natalia Tena, a decision Martin initially opposed but ultimately accepted. This change would prove fruitful, as Osha evolves into a complex and enduring figure.

It is in Essos, however, that “A Golden Crown” delivers its most iconic and consequential moments. In Vaes Dothrak, Daenerys, growing in confidence, becomes fascinated by her dragon eggs, discovering an immunity to their heat. Her brother Viserys, now utterly disillusioned with the Dothraki, attempts to steal them to fund an army. His drunken, escalating humiliation culminates during a sacred ritual where Daenerys consumes a raw stallion’s heart. Threatening his sister with a sword, he violates the sacred city’s ban on bloodshed and drunkenly demands his “golden crown”. Khal Drogo’s response is a gruesomely brilliant: molten gold poured over Viserys’s head, killing him instantly as Daenerys coldly observes, “He was no dragon.” This climax is rightly celebrated, the best Game of Thrones moment yet. It is a brutally poetic demise, darkly humorous and entirely self-inflicted, serving as the catalyst for Daenerys’s transformation from frightened pawn to determined leader. For classically literate viewers, the scene resonates as a deliberate nod to the alleged fate of the Roman general Crassus, another of Martin’s historical homages.

The episode’s construction benefits from the writing team being joined by Jane Espenson, a television veteran known for her work on *Buffy the Vampire Slayer. Her influence is perhaps felt in the sharp, character-focused dialogue, particularly in Tyrion’s scenes. The teleplay adeptly adapts a swathe of Martin’s chapters, weaving together multiple storylines with remarkable economy.

If the episode has a notable flaw, it lies in the presentation of the Dothraki heart-eating ceremony. While undeniably striking, the ritual can feel somewhat gimmicky and ‘shlocky’, inserted for visceral impact without sufficient cultural exposition to fully ground it. A little more contextual explanation might have deepened the moment rather than letting it rely purely on shock value. Nevertheless, this is a minor quibble in an otherwise tightly constructed instalment.

*A Golden Crown* is perhaps the strongest episode of *Game of Thrones*’ first season. It advances the plot significantly—Ned uncovers the royal secret, Tyrion gains his freedom, Viserys is removed from the board—while delivering two exceptional action set-pieces: the intellectually satisfying trial by combat and the horrifically memorable “crowning”. It balances political intrigue in King’s Landing with mythic resonance in Essos, all while adhering to the narrative principle of “showing” rather than “telling”. The episode proved the series could deliver satisfying, self-contained storytelling within its serialised framework.


RATING: 8/10 (+++)

The high/low prices for the trade were $32.81 and $32.89, respectively, and the date of purchase was April 9, 2026. 🔹 They believe there will be future growth in this company
🔹 They consider that there might be a price discrepancy on the stock
🔹 They are committed to this company for an extended period.

Talwar Harit's purchase is particularly important because it is more than a $164K investment.

body.title: THERE'S LOVE 💕 IN SHARING
body.body:
‎In total submission, I respectfully salute you all great and wonderful people around the globe 🌎, it's always an unforgettable moment of engagement with you all here anytime, any day any moment.

One love keep us together.
Let's get to talk about reciprocation of goodwill, in the aspect of giving back what was given to us even without merit.

It all begins with One of the days, which one of my neighbors son by name Divine came to my office and I gave him a pack of biscuits. He was very excited 😊 and jumped out so quick to share within his equals the goodnews and blessings of God in his life that faithful day.
‎

![IMG-20260316-WA0000_1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/johnpetra/23vsSMeYMfThYH6BC4dzfHKk92sM8cNz33S5423GDpnxdegxEHfUfFMgPXWJD61Xg4cEp.jpg)

‎Then I asked that he gives me one piece out of it and Immediately, his face changed.
‎
‎He held the biscuits tight and said, “No, it’s mine.” me I was like wow, suddenly the whole biscuit 🍪 is now yours, I thought 🤔 there's love in sharing or was it just some uncertain words written out by unbelievable set of people?
‎
‎That is how some people keep everything today and lose bigger opportunities tomorrow.
‎
‎If he gave me just one biscuit…I would be happy also and next time, I might even give him more.
‎
‎But because he refused….. next time, I may give someone else and not him.
‎
‎Now, let me take it deeper because this thing is not really about biscuits but how many people handle opportunities around them.


![IMG-20260301-WA0012.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/johnpetra/EpnEkg1kVPHxsfvcHperRxvpMeNQPi2goxgJ8cdQuxrVE99FKcnfXWcoB17Cpm7YNQP.jpg)

‎
‎You see, when life gives you something…
‎
‎A connection.
‎A mentor.
‎A platform.
‎A chance.
‎It’s like being given a full pack of biscuits. Then life will test you....“Can you give one back?”
‎
‎He might not need it oohh, but to check your heart, and that is where many people fail.
‎
‎They say:....“This is my chance, my money, my client, my idea.” And they hold it tight.
‎
‎But what they don’t understand is that the person who gave you that opportunity….
‎has the capacity to give you more.
‎
‎When you refuse to give back, you are not protecting what you have. You are blocking what could have multiplied.
‎
‎If you can’t give back small, you can’t be trusted with BIG.
‎
‎Most times, their greed don’t make them see what they just lost....Trust | Access | Future opportunities | Long-term relationships.
‎
‎Now let our youths listen very carefully…
‎Many adults behave like that child with a pack of biscuits. Not knowing that people who share, grow..... but people who hoard, lose big time. 
‎
‎See ahhh, If your boss trains you…
‎and gives you opportunity…
‎and you try to cheat him and play smart…
‎
‎You may gain small money today, but you lose trust and trust is what brings bigger money.
‎
‎For young big Boss, If someone on your team brings a good idea and you take all the credit…
‎
‎They will stop helping you and migth leave you, and you will lose more than you gained.
‎
‎So here is the simple lesson.... 
‎
‎Please, don’t think only about today, rather think about tomorrow also.
‎Sometimes, giving a little now, will bring you much more later. So, be the kind of person who shares, appreciates, builds with others and remembers who helped them. 
‎
‎In this life I have experienced… The people who give are the ones who grow the most.
‎
‎So tell me…
‎If someone gives you 10 biscuits…will you give back 1? You're reading from your handsome friend John Petra 
‎
‎

body.title: The Kind of Planning Nobody Talks About
body.body:
This prompt reminded me of the IndianUnited prompt a few weeks ago and also looking at the situation of things now around the world. Though we might not agree with it. We have a lot of ongoing active wars between countries and even within countries. But let's say a world war began now; the very first thing I will do is to check all the things I cannot afford to lose. This time, it is not money. Not even property. But all the people in my life who are families, because to me. Family is everything. And reading this prompt topic through, I have never imagined myself joining the army, let alone joining during an active war. Because I understand the idea of being a patriot and standing and defending my beloved country. At the same time I also know the reality, which is, I don't know how to operate a gun, let alone understand the training for war. There are some days that I get overwhelmed with normal day pressure. So I will save myself from going through the stress of putting on the courage I don't have, because the first thing I will make sure I do will be strategic and quiet planning. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmTv4MVU8BaGjppETMUX8bGqzg1rnM6x1S5U8a2ZYcJhmK/199608.png I will not panic or start running around so I can think straight. I will stay quiet in a place, thinking about my next movement. Searching for a place that people won't put their eyes on because it is quiet. Preferably a land with just fewer people, unlike other areas. Which made me remember one of my uncles from my mother's side that usually says his area is too silent for him because it's a new site with just a few houses. And I think that type of area will be a bit free from danger because during an active war, the most targeted areas are those crowded areas. I and my family will quietly move there before everyone starts to panic. Then my next plan is to place my attention and focus on a survival thing people tend to look away from. Not a big stockpiling like I see in some places. But mine is going to be a basic and steady preparation in the way of drying foods that are dryable. Saving up water and getting some basic drugs and medicines, both herbal and scientific ones. I am sure those things hardly attract attention. Because what I have seen and learned is that when people around get to know that I have something, that thing stops being mine alone, and a little “Please, can we use your…” starts coming in. ![199610.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenproject/199610.png) Like they usually say, information is key. And with any little information I know. I will make sure to safeguard it because people tend to turn true information into rumors, which might lead to chaos. And I will not rely on hand-to-hand information because those types of information are always amplified in a way that people will always add theirs. What I will always do is verify before accepting it. And what I will be more worried about are the external people around, not necessarily the war. Because from my little experience, I have seen how situations change people so fast. How people turn, their back on eachother and sell eachother out. So I will say my real preparation for that will be something mental and not a physical one alone. Because in a war situation like that, the best thing I can think of is to always remain calm, steady hopeful and optimistic that things will eventually go back to normal one day and not trying to be a war hero. Because to me, it's better to remain alive with those families that I love than to be a causality of war in the name of doing like a strong man. And that matters to me in a situation like that though I always pray not to witness any things like war because it's bad. ----- ##### 🔗 Apps which I recommend built by sagarkothari88 | | | | body.title: Travel on demand that fits into your daily life
body.body:
In any emerging metropolis, residents and visitors alike are concerned about how to get around as well as possible. Although there are many ways of transportation, the flexibility and reliability of taxi services also make them the best option. [Taxi reservation in Gatineau](https://www.legroupetransit.com/area-we-serve/service-de-taxi-a-gatineau) is a simple way to get around without getting lost in traffic or trying to fit around public transport times.



![022e06_f29db6322c234d178086c47a1521f381~mv2.jpg](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/902e1e39e8e411af20c31529e753299b463c562189a37a424aa068aad4b8ed5b)



One notable advantage is adaptability. Plans can rapidly change, meetings run long, events move, and weather conditions deteriorate. Organizing a taxi in Gatineau for such scenarios brings instant assistance, enabling travelers to revise their travel plans conveniently. It is hard to match this kind of responsiveness with fixed-route transportation systems.

Taxi services are widely available and cater to a range of passenger needs, from solo riders to small groups. Whether you are on your way to a business meeting, shopping district, or social function, hopping in a taxi from Gatineau is the fastest way to travel your own route. This avoids any unnecessary stops and saves time during your travel.

Professionalism also enhances the experience. Drivers are trained to provide high-quality customer service, from friendly conversation to safe driving. Local drivers know more about the ways to get around, avoid congestion, and reach their destination faster.

Taxi also reduces stress from parking. In cities where parking spaces are scarce or overpriced, taking a taxi saves the time and anxiety of searching for that elusive spot. It makes it convenient for passengers and ensures they only need to think about their destination.

With the rising urban expansion, efficient and adaptable mobility is essential to any large metropolis. This requirement is satisfied by taxi services, which strike a balance between accessibility, efficiency, and comfort; thus becoming an indispensable aspect of modern travel in metropolitan areas.

For more details about [Taxi Adapté](https://maps.app.goo.gl/aVvKFEmaEQzkJihn8), please visit our website: **legroupetransit.com.**

body.title: Predawn Grain Run, Empty Trailer, Sunrise, Tour, 23 Mile Bike Ride, KOM,  Swan, PDC, Session - Thursday
body.body:
<b>Sleep is rough with this head ick still clinging on and yesterday morning I was out of the house and on the road to town before 5am. Even at that time of the morning I STILL encounter asshole drivers on the highway. It's absurd just how horrible people are at driving anymore. 

![IMG_20260409_044701.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23tGRgzDvWrBx2fKDCwcWvqAt6Z4hN3EHxw83BEYs1bTGGzuyahgJdMVYGpQXGBpiotz2.jpg)

Early mornings are much better though than mid day and I am able to drive Division for the couple miles to the brewery. 

![IMG_20260409_050756.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23vsEEpM6fbfSf1YKqBwkZoTxCXQx9XH4XmrksNgtEHFXxfij7nFDhXJhLgn7ESD552Nq.jpg)

The 4 barrels loaded into the trailer. I can't help but hear the homeless guy AGAIN screaming and yelling at nothing as he walks across the intersection, then the other guy who screams, \

at him. Mental illness, psycho, deranged, or just an asshole... ![IMG_20260409_051547.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23w2guSmbh2nojSMzQQeGw7KEWGqaQspNFm7yXH2h3kccewHZf8tfeKBoHJ3vTs5hN4zQ.jpg) So I bomb back north and as I hit Hillyard the twilight was showing over Mt Spokane. ![IMG_20260409_052248.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23vhTvgnx56766L31AVbZbUsAvBDtykZung73pty5PEQ9dKzJMiGfxXvZmmCyZXxzXU6k.jpg) Then Mt. Saint Michael in the glow. ![IMG_20260409_052443.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23wg96vTgWGoWLGZgpYTf84iY8xk4XzSSezKcBaqYo7gaz7yZsrWK1kBqK5Qm5CbziPzx.jpg) Her car needed gas so a quick stop at Maverick on the way. ![IMG_20260409_053137.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23wC7JXz9Gaawzgp5K7h7q7HxV8UnAgXLrMrMqRBZGG1Tr4fC1QmPANmnD4pbipGL3qBD.jpg) Again Mt Spokane in the sunrise. ![IMG_20260409_053550.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/242XwFL3vLSQMYA68Rec7UGWcLrH9e6Qcf4sUP2qudQDpBxR5JCUDJYK76HXmKFdwULc3.jpg) The steaming pile of grain unloaded into the sheep pen who were all up the hill and did not see the grain until light when they moseyed back down to the hut. ![IMG_20260409_054753.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23tvaMsqFn93vD7xy5Kw4xqHhp5NAZFiZXCGH5Enc2pKr7DYNkZS9NA1VgVKtqtFsJmSP.jpg) Basque tour stage 4 went on and the finish looked like a killer having to climb sprint to cross the line. The power output the pro riders produce is crazy. ![IMG_20260409_071926.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23tbs3ry6Yyr7W2y5d5EhrwBHd7rhX6crHH3nbf9PTk3bmupJpEd782D7zKWP5vJHvbBp.jpg) It was a cold morning so I let the sun warm things up for a while then got ready and headed out for a ride. I love my cycling jacket from Little Donkey Andy, it was perfect for the chill until I got well warmed up on my KOM throw down around the lake. I had been in 3rd for a long time and finally decided to go set a better time. The old 1st place was 6:26 for the 1.24 mile loop. I had my warmup from the house to the lake then hit the path a few hundred yards before the start point of the segment. I was at speed then and was able to make the loop in 4:27, just shy of 2 minutes faster. I had to ride the circle round about a number of times to bring my heart rate down. I can go faster and will work to get it down closer to 4:00. ![IMG_20260409_095620.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23rAxh8Dus7n9kTtBhzEViE4GWgyFBYsVoEMWwT9Qp5RGVXe38w95pKFR91nyDmfNjRn5.jpg) I headed back south to D-C road and then rode west. I chose to turn onto Monroe, left just ahead, and head south to Wild Rose ![IMG_20260409_103649.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23yd1VkKNvuvzAc3kaF7QZfDJAUkBX4pudtKzchSqnFkQoL9ivCyeoUoMJ6ZyVVS67wgQ.jpg) My jacket stuffed into it's own pouch then fit in one of my jersey pocket on my back. There was SO MUCH more traffic on Wild Rose than on D-C/Staley which was a bit odd from the norm. ![IMG_20260409_103656.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/245wF5iPnTjbyjFj9dngKCQtRHSV3G2ykPDo1GedqJFYkBSu7HvDq16scuBEfxuJi3kiF.jpg) My back was still sore from the tree climbing the day before so I had to stand and stretch a number of times to get the kink out of my lumbar. Trying to fuel more while on the rides as well so intaking a few hundred calories seems to help a bit. ![IMG_20260409_105006.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23sU88STdPJszsyTroSTUMGcXsEWNMgRxpArSAmseLhWb16wPyRib2cVcWc1dtQEtZfrs.jpg) My climbing feels a bit stronger but the burn on the KOM at the the beginning of the ride meant I was just cruising the rest of the way. A solid 23 miles in though and I am nearing halfway to my 1000 mile goal for the year. ![bike 4-9.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23tbM6CBrKaEpdHCDHXmmNbhbLLVifAVdFmiuVameNTM59FEKgm8H53vTWYMKNuc939bu.JPG) ![bike 4-9 KOM.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23tGTdpVhRBy9xMdVe9wmFUNZ9zFV7an32Wtt1jjeR2ukYC59M8gA2WfDPQRPGX2e5yHb.JPG) Once home I got the PDC on and then R was in the kitchen hacking up an apple to which he came into the living room and showed me his swan he made. I think the head looks more turkey-ish but still creative nonetheless. ![IMG_20260409_121705.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23y8oi2WgZ9bRCe3rVPP23MFQffCPjhKdYuRVBc4XeQDJh16SV5rbu1uvKSGBkxiN7YMn.jpg) How the tub is comfortable I have no clue. Rubber kids can sleep in the weirdest oddest places and positions. ![IMG_20260409_133008.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23vsL1otftvNENNYhBcyaDKFDYKxjXm72NHRuyghZ2eAWARQrbtAxqEzq9Wr2tAve3ic5.jpg) Clayton came back in the final and spanked MVG. We had our couples session in the afternoon so @stryeyz was off work early. The session went good and we were home in time for her to eat before bible study. I managed to make it to 8pm before I had to go lie down. As a side note the cat disappeared out the dog door and was gone all day which had the rest of the house worried but I felt she was just on walkabout. I was right, 2am this morning she was meowing to the house as she sat by Jax's bed. I woke @stryeyz to tell her which made her very happy. ![IMG_20260409_150027.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23w2igFWmmi6heteogEfYm5VpJoZVxHCiaVyPcV2XKWHxpjJC4op7svb1VibJsX3iBqRe.jpg) Today I will head back up to client's house to install a new sink faucet, finish assembling the porch swing since she found the parts, and *maybe* hack up the logs though that could wait till tomorrow when I go to haul the branches off. Azure pickup early afternoon, the Basque tour stage this morning, and I will get a ride in at some point *attempt a mellow ride...* ---

Hola a todos. Sigo con el reto de correr todos los días que restan en abril y luego publicar los detalles por aquí, pero debo confesar que hoy me pesó levantarme y salir. Tuve que armarme de valor y determinación. Les cuento cómo me fue.


Estaba despierto desde las 6 am pero no fue sino hasta las 7 y 20 que me levanté de la cama. Tomé café y realicé el calentamiento acostumbrado. Salí a 15 para las 8 a trotar. 


Iba a un ritmo intermedio, unos 5:40 minutos por km. Luego, ya en el km 3 disminuí un poco la velocidad y luego de unos cuantos metros volví a acelerar. Al final, el ritmo promedio fue de 6:05 en 6 km.


El clima estaba bastante agradable, nublado y con algo de sol. Me he dado cuenta de que mi rendimiento depende en gran medida del clima. Cuando hay mucho sol pierdo rápidamente las energías, pero ese no fue el caso de hoy, afortunadamente.



Solo tomé fotografías al comienzo de la carrera. Así pude concentrarme el resto del camino en trotar. Me gustó mucho el entrenamiento de hoy. Por los momentos me despido hasta mañana. Seguimos sumando kilómetros para #hiverun.

https://images.ecency.com/DQmdsMVdSHnho1Uqw8Nu3UaGUv9CzAttesTt5cZrRGEx5sL/separadores_55.png  
 
English

Hi, everyone. I’m still up for the challenge of running every day for the rest of April and then posting the details here, but I have to admit that today it was really hard for me to get up and go out. I had to muster up the courage and determination. Here’s how it went.


I’d been awake since 6 a.m., but it wasn’t until 7:20 that I got out of bed. I had some coffee and did my usual warm-up. I headed out at 7:45 to go for a jog. 


I was running at a moderate pace, about 5:40 per kilometer. Then, around the 3-kilometer mark, I slowed down a bit, and after a few meters, I picked up the pace again. In the end, my average pace was 6:05 over 6 kilometers.


The weather was quite pleasant—cloudy with some sunshine. I’ve realized that my performance depends largely on the weather. When it’s very sunny, I quickly lose energy, but fortunately, that wasn’t the case today.



I only took photos at the start of the run. That way, I could focus on jogging for the rest of the way. I really enjoyed today’s workout. For now, I’ll say goodbye until tomorrow. We’re continuing to rack up kilometers for #hiverun.

body.title: BEAT THE HEAT OF SUMMER WITH WATERMELON ICE
body.body:
![120692fd-d0c8-484d-8be6-7d57963a0123.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ronimarie82/23vsUbhFYBd7sKs4kixFJFhkL4Ypg7aJ8Lq7x8ggR6yQt1ugw2H8Ek7FyioZy82XBNR2o.jpg)
  Picture of the day.  Hello beloved Hiver’s! How are you all today? I Hope all is well to you and your family. It is summer time now here in my country which is the Philippines. I received a HEATWAVE WARNING on my phone today announcing the heat might reach 40 degree celsius - 50 degree celsius. We decided to go grocery shopping at the supermarket and since the mall's opening hours have changed from 10AM- 11AM,it was very hot outside. Before we proceed to the supermarket we pass by a restaurant and order a  refreshment. We ordered Watermelon Ice to beat the heat of summer. The watermelon is not that  red but because I feel so hot and thirsty the Watermelon Ice really gives me relief. I was glad that we stopped for refreshment because I can feel my throat is already dried from being exposed to too much heat.  I always have my water with me but the taste of the watermelon ice is really a big difference.

Thank you so much Hiver’s and enjoy your summer.

body.title: Lost Opportunities — The Letter I Never Sent
body.body:
/>

To be honest, there is a particular kind of pain that is not loud. No tears or noise. It just sits silently pretty in your chest, like dust on an old shelf, and sometimes something can stir it up, and you find yourself feeling it all over again, like it is still fresh. That pain. That is the kind of pain I associate with an opportunity I lost just after secondary school. That regret has etched itself like a tattoo on my soul.

Just after my final papers in secondary school. A notice was pinned to the school notice board outside the principal's office about a fully funded scholarship opportunity for students who showed academic promise. And it had a deadline of three weeks. I still remember reading it, feeling something light up inside me, and then walking away. Just like that. I told myself I would come back to it. I told myself I had time. Three weeks to me was a whole lot of time.

But I did not come back to it till the three weeks had elapsed. I had totally forgotten about it.

You know what they say, when you are young and think time waits for you until it's too late. I only remembered about it when a classmate of mine, a quiet but determined guy. Not to brag, but someone I did better than academically walked into my house one afternoon with a glow I had never seen on her before. He had applied, and he had been shortlisted. Months later, he sat for the exams and was among those who were awarded the scholarship, and he left for a university abroad.

While I stayed back. Not because I lacked the ability, but because I lacked the urgency. I felt I had time in my hands.

Till today, it still haunts me the most. I was well qualified, but I simply did not try. I treated it as a casual thing. I actually let fear of rejection, that juvenile comfort, plain procrastination, make my decision for me. And the universe moved on without me.

I keep replaying that moment in my head with a lot of what-ifs. But my what-ifs have no useful answers, yet they keep coming.

Well, I learnt one thing with this, and that is that opportunity does not beg or wait. It just finds someone else who is ready. I was not ready. Not because I was incapable, but because I had not yet learned that readiness is something you choose, not something that happens to you.

If I happen to get that door of opportunity again today, I would not hesitate to grab it. I would run toward it with everything I have. Even if it means filling the form with shaking hands. I don’t want to experience that regret of not trying; it is really heavier than the disappointment in rejection.

# ***
Cafeteria Senior Professor
***

> I was sitting in a small provincial café, watching the steam from my coffee drift against the windowpane, when the man at the next table, irritated by my comment on the local economy, fired back: **“Analyst of what?”** he asked with a sceptical grimace. His voice sought to invalidate my observation, reducing me to a mere spectator without credentials. However, I found myself pondering the depth of his attack.
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amigoponc/23yJANkLCWdN6YW4xeQYMxjA1aDuq8MgeN8pRVWAfoLdVNg49SjgucuGDepPHRSEtg3Bp.png) [Thanks to the Banana 2.0 app for illustrating my post.](https://gemini.google.com/app)
In this noisy, dizzying world, we all carry an invisible microscope in the pocket of our soul. We don’t need a framed diploma to interpret a mother’s long silences, the deep cracks in the pavement after the rain, or the subtle way the wind bends the willows at dusk. We analyse life because it is our only way of navigating it without being shipwrecked in utter indifference. It is our vital way of saying: ‘Here I am’. My specialism does not appear on any academic or official CV. I am an analyst of the weary gestures in the underground carriage, of the melancholy left behind by Sunday afternoons, and of that strange human urgency to be heard amidst the chaos. We all want our voice, even if it is but a whisper, to shatter the glass of anonymity. **An analyst of what?** Of existence itself. My perspective is my only real asset, a kaleidoscope that I adjust every morning so as not to lose sight of what truly matters. Ultimately, we are all experts in our own version of reality, translating chaos into something meaningful. It’s not arrogance; it’s survival. *** ***

Su voz buscaba invalidar mi observación, reduciéndome a un simple espectador sin credenciales. Sin embargo, me quedé pensando en la profundidad de su ataque.

En este mundo ruidoso y vertiginoso, todos llevamos un microscopio invisible en el bolsillo del alma. No necesitamos un diploma enmarcado para interpretar los silencios largos de una madre, las grietas profundas del pavimento tras la lluvia o la forma sutil en que el viento dobla los sauces al atardecer. Analizamos la vida porque es nuestra única forma de navegarla sin naufragar en la absoluta indiferencia. Es nuestra manera vital de decir: «Aquí estoy». Mi especialidad no figura en ningún currículo académico ni oficial. Soy analista de los gestos cansados en el vagón del metro, de la melancolía que dejan los domingos por la tarde y de esa extraña urgencia humana por ser escuchados en medio del caos. Todos queremos que nuestra voz, aunque sea apenas un susurro, rompa el cristal del anonimato. **¿Analista de qué?** De la existencia misma. Mi perspectiva es mi único patrimonio real, un caleidoscopio que ajusto cada mañana para no perder el rastro de lo que verdaderamente importa. Al final, todos somos expertos en nuestra propia versión de la realidad, traduciendo el desorden en algo con sentido. No es presunción, es supervivencia.
