body.title: Hollywood Money: as Stupid as Stupid Gets
body.body:
### Alright… this was one of those weeks you feel in your bones. Some weeks you’re coasting. And some weeks you’re out there building a full-blown film set that feels like it belongs inside a soundstage… except you’re doing it outside, in the elements, with machines that look like they belong in a shipyard. This was one of those weeks... We pulled almost 70 hours! https://img.leopedia.io/DQmXk2TzvmPenUfGtS8ALcCJ7mNsjSY8PGiw8WrbUbmW794/1000023647.jpg --- ## 🌧️ Day One: Cold Rain & Reality First day that starts with a 2 and a half hour drive? Cold rain. All day. The kind that soaks through everything and just stays with you. Gloves wet. Boots wet. Nothing dries. And we’re out there building. This is where the term *rigging grip* really hits. We’re the ones who come in first, build the world… and then on shoot days, we’re the last ones out. Because every night, after everyone wraps and walks away from our “build”… someone's gotta make it safe. We had to go back in and **drop every frame flat to the ground**. Why? Because the wind would absolutely destroy it overnight. The frames. The rags. Everything we stretched and built all day. So yeah… build it in the rain, then take it halfway apart at night, then do it all again the next day. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmNrjjgDnU7BHje97q1FR3tygiHHJ2TQx2n9dv7PuiY5ne/1000023648.jpg https://img.leopedia.io/DQmdYUQcNPG9fKrCj6pVc7M4m6f1DXqPPc9zCfgEPg1uf93/1000023646.jpg https://img.leopedia.io/DQmdheTztpGsyg5zn6ihmiNiCgbceP9j4ppd2N3yW4rPmq1/1000023659.jpg --- ## 🏗️ The Insane Build We’re talking: - **20-inch and 12-inch box truss** - **~40 foot spans** - **Frames built out to 30’ x 40’** - **Three telehandlers holding the structure** - And a **Magni** (basically the telehandler’s more evolved form 😄) Everything gets strapped, rigged, balanced… then adjusted… then adjusted again because wind is always part of the conversation. This wasn’t just a setup. This was a *construction project disguised as filmmaking.* But it is what we do, and sometimes it's production's stupidity that makes us lots of money! This whole thing could have been done in a few hours, on a sound stage without the big machines. But hey, it's not my money. --- ## 🧠 The Idea Create a full **blue screen environment** big enough to house: - A helicopter 🚁 - A hearse ⚰️ - A Fiat (like the Mini Cooper… you know the one 😄) But instead of a traditional stage… We built a **floating room** using: - Blue screen walls - Reflective ceiling - Bounce materials (clay coat, ultra bounce… depends who you ask) https://img.leopedia.io/DQmPFxjtw37pZQL59fDkNdTkPPtrQ7e5ipim8iQjhR8WqBg/1000023602.jpg https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVarN9AePAvG44fJhs1caCZHrQYraHLaNuiFftx8Mfjes/1000023605.jpg https://img.leopedia.io/DQmPdNipV1yzGDJitA7KgSAhVK6iKLCq2JxKXgCtEu8nR6i/1000023603.jpg --- ## 🛠️ The Machines Doing the Heavy Lifting Three telehandlers holding up the walls. Then the real beast: **The Magni with an LRX rotating head** This thing is wild. Full rotation, full control… And we used it to fly what we call a: ### 🪰 “Flyswatter” A 30’ x 40’ overhead frame, suspended above the entire setup. Basically… we built a movable ceiling in mid-air. --- ## 🌬️ The Reality Check Now imagine all of this: - Outside - In the wind - After working in cold rain - Over three long days - With a crew grinding through 12 to 14-hour shifts This is where the difference is. Because yeah again... this *could* have been done on a soundstage. But it wasn’t. And that changes everything. It will be a week to remember, as one of the hardest week in my 30 year film career! **Here are a few photos from the week. The sunlight came out for the rest of the week which was really awesome actually:** https://img.leopedia.io/DQmf2VAU5i9rHBgqCaX341pjVkD2eaPHyeXsAG2Sm1YeVdF/1000023613.jpg https://img.leopedia.io/DQmesgoynv3WawuP8hhnHpdiBPGmY7JKBNBuw4MgF2CHG3F/1000023569.jpg https://img.leopedia.io/DQmR67MSTNRsD2c6YpehQ19aYay87k2qkG8RPBHMSgDEskb/1000023586.jpg https://img.leopedia.io/DQmdEf2enVFPFNUmVBem31pMYBknG1SVxbe87ytmKbEWDh2/1000023604.jpg https://img.leopedia.io/DQmdtec3htTTJfYyDwRJUd6hXRtxoqQyASSGT9sK6KQeUKR/1000023587.jpg https://img.leopedia.io/DQmdQypFkcBUkzS5ot4FyUProoGuAwbFFrQdPyNLNNvkyrm/1000023595.jpg https://img.leopedia.io/DQmXejS1supNzd2afxo648pDZoh86KTyoXPkwKJDMo6ys1k/1000023601.jpg https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZdGzD71SHMi8Y9PeQ6yvB9RzJV429sUHuqSx5NkMbKS6/1000023651.jpg https://img.leopedia.io/DQmWu3nANaJwRXUV4Re6kMMbBPbb6iSWzZD6vCAFGP8LsMy/1000023650.jpg https://img.leopedia.io/DQmWnGxcMXYfuGBciFKnew91dtrMrpRyRovjwrpAUoEMrcV/1000023652.jpg https://img.leopedia.io/DQmc1xCRn6rPk6p6XdwC8Cq3eXPPPBBoJCA7vULbbXmyuBv/1000023630.jpg --- ## 🔚 Wrapping It Up The week quickly came to an end when you really look back (as everything usually does) They shot everything they needed, and we came back the next day We tore it all down, in a matter of just a few hours Which honestly… We could probably have taken it all down before lunch, but we need that extra day to last a bit, just to make that paycheck well worth it. Funny how that works. Three days to build something massive and precise… …and a few hours to make it disappear like it was never there. --- That’s the job. That’s the life. Alright… that’s it. Thanks. Bye.

body.title: Prepared for the worst [EN/PT]
body.body: > There’s something strange in the air. It feels like everyone senses that a larger-scale war is about to happen. It’s not just a vague feeling that something might occur, it feels imminent. News about wars is becoming more and more common, attacks, people dying, places in ruins. For some, it already feels close, for others it’s still just news, but it’s hard to deny the fear that war could reach us. And if that happens, what should we do? Inevitably, if a war reaches Brazil, I will have to report for duty, since I am within the conscription age and, until recently, I was a reservist. I left as a corporal in the Brazilian Army, but even so, I would still be recruited. If there is any possibility of not going, I will take it, but if there is no other choice, I will have to fulfill my duty, even if I don’t agree with it. If not being drafted is an option, I already have an escape or survival plan in mind, and even if I am called up, I will try to ensure my family’s safety first. The first step would be to leave the urban area where I currently live and head inland, more precisely to my hometown, where I know everything around me and where to find resources and shelter if needed. So if I do have to serve my country as a soldier, I already have a plan, and that plan is to protect my family and get them to a safe place. To be honest, I already have some equipment ready in case things get out of control, such as an emergency backpack prepared for a quick departure. I have enough resources in that backpack to survive for three days, but I’m thinking about improving it for a longer period, or even adding more suitable tools to live independently for longer. It will also depend on the location, and if I manage to reach the place I have in mind, things will be much easier, since I know the local fauna and flora and could survive there for quite some time with the resources available. I believe I’ve had a survivalist mindset for quite some time, and if a war or any other chaotic event happens, I think I’m well prepared to face it. I know what steps to take, what to do, what to think, and what to bring with me. I can say that yes, I would be prepared to leave and wait for things to become less chaotic. Of course, if it lasts for a long time, it won’t be easy, and even for prepared people, it’s still very difficult. With family, things would be even more complicated. But it’s still better than facing the consequences of an urban environment with uncontrolled people and having no preparation at all. Just imagine the chaos not only a war can cause, but also how people behave when order collapses in a chaotic scenario. It won’t be anything pleasant to witness. Maybe it’s already too late, but my intention has always been, even before all these war rumors, to buy a house in the countryside and become self-sufficient, generating my own energy, growing my own food, raising animals, and having an independent source of clean water. Unfortunately, I still don’t have the financial resources to buy a place like that. Beyond a dream, it’s a goal, and I hope nothing happens before I can achieve it, because if I did, it would truly be the perfect place to take refuge, with resources not only to support my family, but also to help others. But if I really don’t need to be recruited by the Armed Forces, or if there is any way to avoid actively participating in this war that seems to be approaching, I have a plan. It may not be perfect, but I know what to do and where to go in a moment when many people would freeze in the face of something as terrible as war. There’s a common saying in the survivalist community, “It’s better to be prepared and never need it than to need it and not be prepared.” I carry that with me, and I know that if the time comes, I will be ready, and my family will have better chances in the face of war or any chaotic scenario. --- Credits: Translated: [Deepl](www.deepl.com/pt-BR/translator) Cover: created by [Canva.](www.canva.com) AI-generated image [ Flow]( www.labs.google/fx/pt/tools/flow) --- ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma2XinqppUM2Uvqbsii8ViPirxPmkbLmJ8FkfAbcj9EYN/image.png) Tem algo estranho no ar. Parece que todos estão sentindo que, de fato, uma guerra de proporções maiores está prestes a acontecer. Não é apenas uma sensação de que algo vai acontecer, parece iminente. As notícias de guerras estão cada vez mais comuns: ataques, pessoas morrendo, lugares em ruínas. Para alguns, isso já está próximo, para outros ainda são apenas notícias, mas não dá para negar o medo de que a guerra chegue até nós. E, se isso acontecer, o que fazer? Inevitavelmente, se uma guerra chegar ao Brasil, eu terei de me apresentar, pois estou dentro da idade de convocação e, até pouco tempo atrás, eu era militar da reserva. Saí como cabo do Exército Brasileiro, mas ainda assim serei recrutado. Se existir alguma possibilidade de não ir, eu farei isso, mas, caso não haja outra escolha, terei de cumprir minha obrigação, por mais que não concorde. Se não ser convocado for uma opção, um plano de fuga ou de sobrevivência já foi pensado por mim e mesmo que eu seja, tentarei colocar minha família em segurança. A primeira atitude seria sair da zona urbana onde vivo atualmente e ir em direção ao interior, mais precisamente para minha terra natal, onde conheço tudo ao redor e sei onde conseguir recursos e refúgio, se necessário. Então, de fato, se eu tiver que servir ao meu país como soldado, antes eu tenho um plano, e esse plano consiste em proteger minha família e ir para um local seguro. Para ser sincero, eu possuo alguns equipamentos prontos para caso as coisas saiam do controle, como por exemplo uma mochila de emergência preparada para sair às pressas. Tenho recursos necessários nessa mochila para sobreviver por três dias, mas estou pensando em melhorar isso para um período maior, ou mesmo incluir ferramentas mais apropriadas para viver por mais tempo de forma independente. Tudo vai depender também do local, e, se de fato eu conseguir chegar ao lugar que tenho em mente, as coisas serão bem mais fáceis, pois conheço a fauna e a flora local e conseguiria sobreviver ali por um bom tempo com os recurso que existem por lá. Acho que já possuo um espírito sobrevivencialista a algum tempo, e, caso uma guerra ou qualquer outro evento que proporcione caos aconteça, acredito estar bem preparado para enfrentá-lo. Sei quais passos devo tomar, o que fazer, o que pensar e o que devo levar comigo. Posso dizer que sim, estaria preparado para fugir e esperar as coisas ficarem menos caóticas. Claro que, se isso durar muito tempo, não é um desafio fácil, e, mesmo para pessoas preparadas, ainda assim é algo muito difícil. Com familiares, as coisas seriam ainda mais complicadas. Mas é melhor dessa forma do que enfrentar as consequências do meio urbano com pessoas descontroladas e não ter preparação alguma para enfrentar isso. Imagine só o caos que não apenas uma guerra pode proporcionar, mas também como as pessoas vão se comportar quando a ordem for derrubada por um cenário caótico. Não vai ser nada bonito de se ver. Talvez seja tarde demais, mas a minha intenção sempre foi, antes mesmo dos rumores de guerra, comprar uma casa no campo e ser autossustentável: gerar minha própria energia, ter minha própria plantação e criação de animais, e contar com uma fonte de água potável independente. Infelizmente, ainda não tenho recursos financeiros suficientes para comprar um lugar com essas características. Além de um sonho, isso é um objetivo, e espero que nada aconteça até que eu consiga realizá-lo, pois, se conseguisse, seria de fato o local perfeito para se refugiar, com recursos e até mesmo poder ajudar não só minha família, mas também outras pessoas. Mas, se eu realmente não precisar ser recrutado pelas Forças Armadas, ou houver algum jeito de não participar ativamente dessa guerra que aparentemente parece estar por vir, eu tenho um plano. Talvez não seja perfeito, mas eu sei o que fazer e para onde ir em um momento em que muitas pessoas congelariam diante de algo tão terrível quanto a guerra. Existe uma frase muito comum no meio sobrevivencialista: “É melhor estar preparado e nunca precisar do que precisar e não estar preparado.” Então levo essa frase comigo e sei que, se precisar, estarei preparado e minha família terá melhores chances diante de uma guerra ou um cenário caótico. --- Credits: Translated: [Deepl](www.deepl.com/pt-BR/translator) Cover: created by [Canva.](www.canva.com) AI-generated image [ Flow]( www.labs.google/fx/pt/tools/flow) --- ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma2XinqppUM2Uvqbsii8ViPirxPmkbLmJ8FkfAbcj9EYN/image.png)

body.title: Arrogance And Greed Mold Online Vigilantes Into What They Are
body.body:
![Geralt is the creator of this image/Source:  Pixabay](https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2017/10/24/07/13/mask-2883635_1280.jpg)

## 1.   Online Vigilantes On Laughable Ego Trips

It is bad enough when buffoons and charlatans like Dr. Park Elliott Dietz and Dr. Kenneth Lanning who actually do have educational and professional credentials get away with misusing their so-called skills for unscrupulous and dishonorable purposes whenever they testify as expert witnesses.  Now there are borderline illiterates pretending to be expert witnesses in the form of online vigilantes.

Online vigilantes call themselves \

I call them domestic terrorists. Below is a video in which Norman Michael Achin exposes them for impersonating professionals for which they have no true background or qualifications. Norman Michael Achin Exposes Online Vigilantes For Trying To Be Something That They Are Not Professionally https://youtu.be/6OAr-hrdW-E?si=u-jZDTK_yhM8Udrb This is the same kind of crap that Julie Posey engaged in when she was playing the role of a vigilante mother on the Internet so many years ago. That is, she was going after adult men who mostly were nostalgic and attempting to demonize them as child predators insofar as she entrapped them for crimes that they never would have committed if she hadn't lured them into doing so. Like Julie Posey, Roo Powell is another domestic terrorist who has been trying to fool the world into believing that she is serving the greater good, when, in reality, her online activities are doing more harm than good to society. Now, I completely get it. Her mother is from the Philippines, and I'm sure her mother has told her all the horror stories about how young girls get sexually exploited and even murdered in that nation. However, it doesn't make Ms. Powell any kind of hero. Until I watched Mr. Achin's video above, I had never heard of Ms. Powell. Now I hear that she proclaims herself to be some kind of expert witness. I suppose she believes that pedophilia is when an adult man is sexually attracted to a female minor, even when he is only 18 years old and that female minor is 17 years old. That is exactly how her kind's minds operate. Some of Ms. Powell's fans have referred to her as a superhero. She proclaims herself to be a child advocate. Well, if she were really any of those things, instead of going undercover as an online teenage decoy, she would be appearing before legislators to urge them to pass forced heirship laws that would prohibit abusive parents from disinheriting their own children. However, has she done that? I don't think so. If Ms. Powell really cared about teenage girls, she would wage a war against deadbeat teenage fathers and urge elected officials on Capitol Hill to pass a law that would draft deadbeat teenage fathers into the military on their eighteenth birthday. Now that President Donald J. Trump and other elected officials in Washington, D.C. have been discussing the possibility of bringing back the military draft, her opportunity of bringing this notion to fruition is better than it has ever been. Of course, she won't do it. There's no money for Ms. Powell in any of the things that I suggested that she did. She realizes that the majority of adult men feel their hormones pumping arduously whenever they watch a video like the one below. Could 43-Year-Old Roo Powell Be Envious Of These Teenage Girls' Beauty? It Certainly Seems That Way https://youtu.be/1Us-79H4eJM?si=JqX7oy-lGc4EGwTZ Ms. Powell is merely another ignorant head case who cannot tell the difference between fake pedophilia and real pedophilia. Real pedophiles and real child molesters have no interest in pubescent and adolescent girls. Otherwise, all teenage boys would be pedophiles and child molesters as well. If the Supreme Court of the United States (\

) were ever to force all the state jurisdictions in our nation to lower their statutory ages of consent to 13 or 14 years old, Ms. Powell would definitely become a train wreck and her certifiable true colors would reveal themselves to the entire planet. She needs to crawl back under the rock from whence she came. Nobody will miss her in that event. Like Ms. Posey, Ms. Powell will likely fade into obscurity ten years from now, and she will become completely irrelevant in the public arena. By then, her vigilante activities will be outlawed. That is, if somebody doesn't kidnap her first, which I'm sure could very easily happen. People like her are good at making enemies everywhere. I have to give Mr. Achin a round of applause for his comments about Eric Lind. Mr. Lind proclaims himself to be a researcher. I'd be very interested in knowing what Mr. Lind's credentials are, because I strongly suspect that he doesn't have any. He's merely another online vigilante on an ego trip that is dangerous to the public safety. Perhaps Mr. Lind is an excellent drag racer, but his critical thinking abilities leave so very much to be desired. My heart goes out to Alicia Kozakiewicz after the horrors she suffered at the hands of Scott William Tyree back when she was 13 years old. However, her ways of addressing the issue of sexual predators do not meet up to the same standards as how Elizabeth Smart's ways do so. ## 2.  Sex-Offender Registration As A Private Moneymaking Machine Corporate moguls, hedge-fund managers, and the likes are now starting to capitalize on sex-offender registries throughout the United States, and I don't merely mean that they're doing so through the conventional means that they do so regularly. They're now charging people online for special access to sex-offender registries throughout our nation, and they know that there are people that are stupid enough to pay for such services. It is bad enough that certain state jurisdictions are charging registrants to be on the sex-offender registry involuntarily. Now people that are not on the sex-offender registry can pay to access private information about registrants. Below is a video in which Norman Michael Achin describes this new moneymaking gimmick. Where and when does all this madness end? Norman Michael Achin Explains How Sex-Offender Registries Are Being Monetized https://youtu.be/iNwLjiM8NvQ?si=82TVpKxLtIrpvE-H Is our government serving us or are they enslaving as many of us as they can? You have to wonder. What next? Are online vigilantes like Roo Powell and Eric Lind going to turn online sex-sting operations into a multi-level marketing pyramid scheme? I wouldn't put something that outrageous and outlandish past them? People like these are capable of anything that is completely irrational. ![Aaliza007 is the creator of this image/Source: Pixabay](https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2020/06/15/03/34/joker-5300203_1280.jpg) ## 3.  Final Thoughts The other day I saw a movie titled *Sweet Hostage* starring Linda Blair and Martin Sheen. This was not the first time that I had seen this movie, but it was the first time that I had seen it from beginning to end. In this same movie, Linda Blair played a 17-year-old high-school dropout named Doris Mae Withers who was unhappy with her life out in the sticks. Martin Sheen played the role of Leonard Hatch, who was an escape mental patient in his mid-thirties. After her truck breaks down, Doris Mae Withers hitches a ride; and Leonard picks her up. He eventually takes her captive. However, the plot begins to change as Doris Mae realizes that Leonard cares about her and wishes to rescue her from her miserable home life. Eventually the two fall in love with each other. This same film was originally released in 1975. One has to wonder if such a film would have been a success if it had been initially released in this day and age. Americans have become paranoid about teenage girls being in age-gap relationships with adult men, not to mention the controversial nature upon which both characters meet in this same film. No, I would never condone any adult man kidnapping a teenage girl. However, if an adult man and a teenage girl met under different circumstances and they truly wanted a future together, then why can't our society gets its head out of the pedophile-panic zone? Such age-gap relationships have nothing to do with pedophilia in the first place. Fact has it is that the statutory-rape laws in our nation are way out of touch with reality, and the people who support them are equally out of touch with reality. Nations that have statutory ages of consent between 13 and 15 years old don't have problems with online vigilantes. In fact, most of them don't even have online vigilantes or \

catchers running around like maniacs at all on their streets.  It's a sign that perhaps our nation needs to reform its statutory-rape laws and lower the statutory ages of consent in every state jurisdiction.

body.title: If Trees Could Talk What Stories Would They Have Shared
body.body:
**Hey Everyone 👋🏻**

We have seen many cartoon series and movies where trees could talk. It's interesting to think about it that if trees could talk what stories would they tell us. Some of the trees have a very long lifespan. It could be possible that your father had sown a seed or planted a small plant which may still remain flourishing after your children are born. So trees are like grandparents who have seen many generations in front of them. If you have a tree in your backyard then it could be possible that the tree has seen your father playing around it like a child, then growing young, being more active and then growing older along with you again playing around it like a child as your father used to play.

These could be a living memories that has generations of memories with it.  Not all trees survive this much. Some of the trees really have a long life from 100 to even 300 years.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRcuBqcew86ajEPg4yusF7oC4KNJ4d7bNM3ZcwbDaxdNp/1775824966049.png)
<a href=\

>Source If I talk about me then my grandmother still tells the stories of my father and aunt of how they used to play on the tree with its leaves, and branches, swinging on it by tying a rope around its branches. I used to laugh when she said that one day the branch broke and they fell on the ground. It didn't hurt because it was the soil all around. The same way I also used to swing in my childhood around those trees. It feels like it has seen all our family growing and has been the part of every new generation in our family. So if trees could talk maybe they also had different stories. They might have fun stories of how children used to play around them falling and standing. They could have the exciting stories of how the people got happy and excited when they first saw the fruits growing on them. They could have the experience of being among the peoples. They could also have sad stories of how someone sitting under it sharing its problems, sitting alone and crying. They would have seen people struggling through their life, how they raise themselves. How the world around them changed over the years, how the weather changes and even how a single day changes. Trees are the silent witness of the time. They don't speak anything but they are watching everything silently witnessing each passing day. They are witnessing the changing habits of humans, the changing area from farms to cities and roads, the change in outdoor games around them to indoor games, the speed of development, the cutting of other trees. If trees could speak they would have shared some stories like there was time when there were multiple trees all around between the farms, when people used to sit under me with their groups, gossiping and planning, groups of children playing with branches, traveller finding the shade under me. When people used to care and love me, water me and in return I gave them more love in the form of wood for fire, fruits, shade, pure oxygen. I have seen the environment slowly around me with changing the people. One summer vacation there was no more happy kids around me playing. No more trees around me, no farms. People rarely sit under me. They have their own AC for cooling, own markets to buy fruits, own fuel to cook. The once buzzing environment is now silent around me. These are the stories of the time when everyone was close to me and seeing them I was also happy and dancing. One of the oldest tree on the earth is Methuselah, a Great Basin bristlecone pine (Pinus longaeva) in California's White Mountains, aged over 4,850 years (according to google). If the trees like it could talk then they would be sharing the centuries of stories with us. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/karishmasingh711/23t7YWoN4zG1GjdYHrDZynHrrY4RMLRFLWvoYkwxsq4JTJyhMSCYrMnDP5ZM9GF74o2mf.png)

body.title: Генетичний код тарілки: чому «правильне харчування» — це найбільший міф сучасності
body.body: >Знаєте, я довго намагався бути «правильним». Прокидався, заливав у себе смузі кольору болота, жував курячу грудку, яка за смаком нагадувала картон, і щиро вірив, що роблю своєму тілу послугу. Але замість обіцяного припливу енергії я отримував лише роздратування та постійне бажання з’їсти щось «заборонене». Найцікавіше почалося тоді, коли я зрозумів: те, що для мого сусіда є еліксиром молодості, для мене може бути повільною отрутою.

>Ми звикли до шаблонів. Відкриваєш будь-який паблік про здоров’я, а там — золоті стандарти: менше солі, більше клітковини, пий два літри води. Але наука нарешті зробила крок вперед, залишивши ці універсальні поради в минулому столітті. Останні дослідження в галузі нутрігеноміки, про які нещодавно писали у Frontiers in Nutrition, підтверджують те, що я відчував інтуїтивно: наші гени — це не просто креслення кольору очей, це детальна інструкція з експлуатації нашої травної системи.

\n\n

>Що ж нам показує зображення вище?
Експериментальний дизайн для міжпоколінного впливу сукралози та стевії. У віці 4 тижнів мишей C57BL/6J (батьківське (F0)) не кров'яні, первісні самки та самці C57BL/6J випадково розподіляли на три групи для отримання води окремо (контрольна) або воду, доповнену сукралозою (0,1 мг/мл) або стевією (0,1 мг/мл) протягом 16 тижнів. Для оцінки міжпоколінного впливу непоживних підсолоджувачів (NNS) мишей F0, що належали до тієї ж групи лікування, спарювали у віці 10 тижнів. Після 4 тижнів лактації потомство F1 відлучали від грудей і спостерігали до 20 тижнів. Покоління F1 і F2 не отримували прямого впливу NNS. Усі миші утримувалися в однакових умовах проживання та утримання, включаючи однаковий тип клітки та підстилку, партію їжі, протокол очищення джерела води та пляшок, а також стандартизований графік очищення кліток.

>
Коли я вперше заглибився в тему взаємодії генів і дієти, мене вразило, наскільки ми ігноруємо власну біологічну унікальність. Уявіть, що ви намагаєтеся заправити гоночний болід низькоякісним дизелем. Він поїде, звісно, але як довго і з яким звуком? Так само і з нами. Один і той самий продукт викликає абсолютно різні метаболічні відповіді у двох різних людей. Це пояснює, чому ваша подруга може їсти пасту на ніч і залишатися стрункою, а ви гладшаєте лише від погляду на круасан. І справа тут не в «поганому обміні речовин», а в конкретних генетичних варіаціях, які визначають, як ви засвоюєте вуглеводи, жири чи навіть той самий кофеїн.

>Я пам’ятаю, як відмовився від кави, бо «це ж шкідливо для серця». Місяць ходив як зомбі, поки не дізнався про ген CYP1A2. Виявляється, є люди з «швидким» метаболізмом кофеїну, для яких кава — це чистий антиоксидантний бонус і захист серця. А є «повільні», для яких кожна чашка — це ризик гіпертонії. Виходить, я катував себе дарма, бо мій організм якраз обожнює кофеїн. Це дрібниця, але з таких дрібниць будується наше щоденне самопочуття.

\n\n

>Найбільший виклик сьогодні — це не знайти інформацію, а відфільтрувати її. Нутрігеноміка дає нам інструмент, який припиняє це ворожіння на кавовій гущі (або на листках салатів). Ми переходимо від епохи «дієт для мас» до епохи «харчування для одного». І це не просто хайп. Вчені доводять, що персоналізовані рекомендації, засновані на генетичному профілі, працюють у рази ефективніше, ніж загальні поради ВООЗ. Чому? Бо вони враховують ваші індивідуальні ризики запалень, схильність до дефіциту певних вітамінів та навіть те, як ваші клітини реагують на глюкозу.

>Ви можете заперечити: «Друже, це занадто складно і дорого, я просто хочу бути здоровим». Я вас розумію. Але подивіться на це з іншого боку. Скільки грошей ми витрачаємо на БАДи, які нам не потрібні, або на продукти, які лише створюють дискомфорт у шлунку? Справжня персоналізація — це свобода. Це можливість перестати винити себе за «слабку волю», коли хочеться з’їсти щось конкретне, і почати слухати біохімічні сигнали свого тіла.

>Мені здається, що в найближчі роки ми побачимо справжню революцію. Замість меню в ресторанах ми будемо сканувати QR-коди, які підсвічуватимуть страви, що ідеально підходять нашому генетичному профілю в цей момент. Це звучить як футуристичне кіно, але технології вже тут. Ми вже можемо дізнатися, чи потрібна нам середземноморська дієта, чи, можливо, наш організм краще почувається на кетогенних протоколах.

\n\n

>Але є одне «але». Генетика — це лише заряджений пістолет, а на курок натискає наш спосіб життя. Навіть найкраща дієта не врятує, якщо ви живете в постійному стресі та спите по чотири години. Епігенетика — ще одна крута штука — показує, що ми можемо «вмикати» або «вимикати» певні гени своєю поведінкою. Тобто, маючи схильність до діабету, ви не приречені, якщо знаєте, як ваша тарілка взаємодіє з вашою ДНК.

>Зараз я дивлюся на свій сніданок зовсім інакше. Це не просто калорії чи білки-жири-вуглеводи. Це інформаційні пакети, які я надсилаю своїм клітинам. І знаєте, що найприємніше? Коли ти перестаєш боротися зі своєю природою і починаєш з нею співпрацювати, зникає ця вічна війна з їжею. Ви стаєте партнерами.

>Ми живемо в унікальний час, коли межа між медициною та кулінарією стирається. Майбутнє не за новими суперфудами, які привозять з іншого кінця світу, а за розумінням того, що лежить у вас усередині. Кожен з нас — це унікальний біологічний експеримент, який триває все життя. То чому б не зробити цей експеримент максимально успішним і смачним?

>А як ви ставитеся до ідеї, що універсальні дієти — це мильна бульбашка? Ви коли-небудь помічали, що популярні поради щодо здоров’я на вас просто не працюють? Можливо, настав час припинити слухати блогерів і почати прислухатися до власних генів. Що, якби ви могли отримати точний список продуктів, які зроблять вас продуктивнішими вже завтра? Поділіться своїми думками, мені справді цікаво, чи готові ми до такого рівня персоналізації.

PS:
>якщо є бажання зануритися в цю тему більш науково, тоді пропоную ознайомитися із цією статтею, де описані всі деталі цього дослідження.

body.title: Book Review: Ward D By Freida Mcfadden
body.body: I read this book on a four hour journey and I didn’t even realize I had devoured all the 320 pages until I turned off my tablet upon reaching my destination. I think that already says enough about the book. Ward D is a psychological thriller by Freida McFadden and although Freida is known for such books, I don’t think I saw this one coming. I’ll try as much as possible not to give any spoilers especially for those who might want to read it later. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeLJpp7J69VhnRAzLHXQ6tQN5X1NbRawn6q2EGgfsGjTD/img_1609.png) [source](https://www.amazon.com/Ward-D-Freida-McFadden/dp/1464227276) It’s about a medical student(Amy) who was assigned to a psychiatric ward for her clinical rotation for a night. And although one might say rotations are supposed to be a learning grounds, hers was very traumatizing because of her past. So this medical student, had a best friend(Jade) in high school who behaved different in a really wrong way. She was very brilliant in class but her mom was bipolar and wasn’t really there for her as a mother should so it affected her. In the end, she had to go to a psychiatric ward for treatment. She actually ended being in and out of psych wards for years. Years later, Amy, got assigned for clinical rotation at the same ward Jade was and everything she feared that Jade would do actually came to pass right before her eyes. And that’s because Jade believed Amy was the reason why she ended up in psych ward in the first place. Before reading this book, I searched for Freida McFadden’s best books and found this in the list. McFadden has quickly become something I run to read every time I want to read and I’m here for it. For me, this is the best psychological thriller she’s ever written. I love how this book was written with active verbs. It makes you enjoy every bit of it. I’m beginning to think that’s Freida and every good writer’s secret. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNyebw4iWiLNDeqR7j5wiGZmwhEYkxyhgmALW3B7C4ci5/img_1608.png) [Source](https://www.amazon.com/Ward-D-gripping-psychological-thriller-ebook/dp/B0BXHSFMF4) I can’t continue without acknowledging the twists and turns in this book. I kept on gasping in the car so many times that at some point, the person beside just kept looking at me. The main plot in this book is something you won’t see coming and the twists will definitely catch you unexpectedly. I also love the fact that she was able to paint a perfect picture of everything happening in my head. It felt like I was inside the story. One thing that got stuck with me was Amy’s guilt. She felt guilty all through the story because she believed she could have helped her ex best friend. And if she did, her friend wouldn’t have been in that place in the end. But then something she kept forgetting was that you can only help someone who wants to be helped. And in this case, Jade didn’t want to be helped. In fact, I think Amy even did a great job moving away from her if not, she would have also become just like her. This is very similar to the happenings in real life. It’s either you help someone who wants to be helped or you just let them be. Staying around can actually pull you into the same mess you are trying to help clean. After reading it, I tried so hard to see if there was a flaw in this book. Maybe something that would make this book an 2 or a 3 but nothing at all. Absolutely nothing. This is a solid 4/5 for me. I enjoyed every bit of it. If you are in a reading slump and you want to wake up, take a walk to Ward D. Thank you for reading.

Hello DIY hub community, how are you all? I hope you are all doing well. I am also doing well. Today I have a drawing for you, which is a kitty drawing.

![IMG_20260410_180036.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUedxksPDQkAEviWgTvLLnmimnNdkVt8bZRsMaoBE6q9H/IMG_20260410_180036.jpg)

![IMG_20260410_180117.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTTK2nVgmDNveMMheZsY3UNCGFfJNk7eCfxEY5b69mGC4/IMG_20260410_180117.jpg)



Drawing is a hobby for all of us, and we like to draw different types of pictures, including kitty drawing, angel drawing, birds drawing and many more. We have a constant job of drawing these pictures because artists who love to draw. Many people have become famous among the audience for drawing pictures in the development of art. Artists can draw different pictures with different colored pencils. By adding a little glue etc. to them, they can make very beautiful pictures at home. This is a very good initiative.

![IMG_20260410_180134.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbdD5MNFrToMYPzY5tEbdr92ZkGEsR4Rcbqype8naVU14/IMG_20260410_180134.jpg)

![IMG_20260410_180144.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXnpTmA6wZivwQamq3KBjXd7qvFQKT8RueCSCd5xbTEnt/IMG_20260410_180144.jpg)

![IMG_20260410_180221.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmesUAeyXgTrLZAqS8vYUNrZNPSLoevD9EmF3exNDEeoqd/IMG_20260410_180221.jpg)



 People are benefiting by selling these pictures in the market. With the aim of developing technology, electronic devices are used in the market to make various types of perfect drawings, through which the pictures become more beautiful and attractive.In these pictures, various laces, colored pencils, scissors, white glue, etc. have been used, which have been beautifully depicted in one picture after another. And the rule of drawing is to maintain it regularly, no matter how great an artist is, if he does not practice, he will not be able to draw a picture beautifully. Sketch is the backbone of the picture.

![IMG_20260410_180229.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaURv8Xa5WMdh5KJKRjY53MXGXQE4jwVn8EsLbiSSLcPs/IMG_20260410_180229.jpg)



But in the kity that I drew, I used only pencils and nothing else. I took a drawing notebook and then I drew it beautifully with my own hand holding the pencil. Today's drawing will be very interesting for you. I drew a picture of a kity  as a child. For this, there are many painters in the world who love to draw. We basically learned how to draw from them.
If you like this picture, please comment. Stay well, stay healthy, goodbye.

![IMG_20260410_180251.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUu1kfarmTKuvPwDgFbuUTcow6u9awy6D7WRkXxkGX6ea/IMG_20260410_180251.jpg)

title.title: Our potato harvest experiment: no digging, just hay [EN/FR]
title.body:
Hello Hive!

Last July, with @altheana, we had harvested 40 kg of potatoes. Since then, we had covered with sheet metal the mini vegetable garden that we had used for that. It allowed the grass not to grow back, notably.

Thus, the day before yesterday, we uncovered it with the aim of starting this potato cultivation again. Theoretically, we should not grow the same crop twice in a row in the same place. We considerably increase the risk of developing diseases.

But we decided to try it anyway.

And this year, we are trying another technique. Last year, we had worked the soil for a long time and, several times during the growth of the potatoes, we hilled them up. We also had to regularly remove the weeds that were growing quickly, notably the nettles that were invading our plot.

Instead, on a farm a few kilometers from the house, I bought 5 bales of hay of 12 kg with the aim of doing a hay-based cultivation.

The principle is very simple:

1. We place the potatoes directly on the ground, without pushing them into the soil. Our plot is weeded, but you can very well do it on a piece of land that has never been worked. Mow very short just before.

[https://img.leopedia.io/DQmTrk6vPALjCeToTtbwVapvqB4xP5ahZG2g693ZXgukLzs/08b84611-44c1-4db1-aaeb-54e229c2cd28.jpg](https://img.leopedia.io/DQmTrk6vPALjCeToTtbwVapvqB4xP5ahZG2g693ZXgukLzs/08b84611-44c1-4db1-aaeb-54e229c2cd28.jpg)

2. We cover each row with a thick layer of hay.

[https://img.leopedia.io/DQmfR6sPM3F7P5Hy5oNGVSveDRqi9D6WSrk8cxp4W8EZp6g/89358917-5994-4f33-8719-74d3c8d4da15.jpg](https://img.leopedia.io/DQmfR6sPM3F7P5Hy5oNGVSveDRqi9D6WSrk8cxp4W8EZp6g/89358917-5994-4f33-8719-74d3c8d4da15.jpg)

It is as simple as that. And as the potatoes grow, we will add more hay so that the potatoes are never in contact with the sun’s rays. Otherwise, they will turn green and become toxic.

If this technique works, it will allow us to spend 50 to 80% less time in the vegetable garden for an equivalent harvest!

[https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUqjNrnbqfSXUzs2Ko1m6PcrXLbeCtPmRLcVG21dhZirZ/4747ba5d-70ae-43b2-8f74-157b59936f47.jpg](https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUqjNrnbqfSXUzs2Ko1m6PcrXLbeCtPmRLcVG21dhZirZ/4747ba5d-70ae-43b2-8f74-157b59936f47.jpg)

I took the opportunity to put hay on other crops, notably the peas and the spinach. Usually, I spend a crazy amount of time weeding. Or I don’t do it, but then my crops are in competition with the weeds.

At least this way I will have less of that problem. Moreover, as it decomposes, the hay will feed my soil. Another advantage, by not leaving the soil bare, I will be able to space out watering and therefore save my water and, once again, my time.

[https://img.leopedia.io/DQmcUiypgx856VaWvXP1KrzSTuf3ZXzYwFRM3vM54sh7how/47d218c1-76f2-42c5-a84d-c527016e38ff.jpg](https://img.leopedia.io/DQmcUiypgx856VaWvXP1KrzSTuf3ZXzYwFRM3vM54sh7how/47d218c1-76f2-42c5-a84d-c527016e38ff.jpg)

We will see next July (about 3 months) if the harvest will be there.

Have a nice end of the week Hive!

---

### Version Française

---

Bonjour Hive !

En juillet dernier, avec @altheana, nous avions récolté 40 kg de pommes de terre. Depuis, nous avions couvert avec de la tôle le mini potager que nous avions utilisé pour ça. Ça a permis à l’herbe de ne pas repousser, notamment.

Ainsi, avant-hier, nous l’avons découvert dans le but de recommencer cette culture de pommes de terre. Théoriquement, il ne faudrait pas faire la même culture deux fois de suite au même endroit. On augmente considérablement le risque de développer des maladies.

Mais nous avons décidé de tenter la chose tout de même.

Et cette année, on tente une autre technique. L’année dernière, nous avions travaillé la terre longuement et, plusieurs fois pendant la pousse des pommes de terre, nous les avons buttées. Il fallait aussi régulièrement retirer les mauvaises herbes qui poussaient rapidement, notamment les orties qui envahissaient notre parcelle.

À la place, dans une ferme à quelques kilomètres de la maison, j’ai acheté 5 ballots de foin de 12 kg dans le but de faire une culture sous foin.

Le principe est très simple :

1. Nous posons les pommes de terre à même le sol, sans les enfoncer dans la terre. Notre parcelle est désherbée, mais vous pouvez très bien le faire sur un bout de terrain qui n’a jamais été travaillé. Tondez très court juste avant.

[https://img.leopedia.io/DQmTrk6vPALjCeToTtbwVapvqB4xP5ahZG2g693ZXgukLzs/08b84611-44c1-4db1-aaeb-54e229c2cd28.jpg](https://img.leopedia.io/DQmTrk6vPALjCeToTtbwVapvqB4xP5ahZG2g693ZXgukLzs/08b84611-44c1-4db1-aaeb-54e229c2cd28.jpg)

2. On recouvre chaque ligne d’une épaisse couche de foin.

[https://img.leopedia.io/DQmfR6sPM3F7P5Hy5oNGVSveDRqi9D6WSrk8cxp4W8EZp6g/89358917-5994-4f33-8719-74d3c8d4da15.jpg](https://img.leopedia.io/DQmfR6sPM3F7P5Hy5oNGVSveDRqi9D6WSrk8cxp4W8EZp6g/89358917-5994-4f33-8719-74d3c8d4da15.jpg)

C’est aussi simple que cela. Et au fur et à mesure que les pommes de terre vont pousser, nous rajouterons du foin afin que les pommes de terre ne soient jamais en contact avec les rayons du soleil. Sous peine de quoi elles verdiront et deviendront toxiques.

Si cette technique fonctionne, elle nous permettra de passer 50 à 80 % moins de temps au potager pour une récolte équivalente !

[https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUqjNrnbqfSXUzs2Ko1m6PcrXLbeCtPmRLcVG21dhZirZ/4747ba5d-70ae-43b2-8f74-157b59936f47.jpg](https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUqjNrnbqfSXUzs2Ko1m6PcrXLbeCtPmRLcVG21dhZirZ/4747ba5d-70ae-43b2-8f74-157b59936f47.jpg)

J’en ai profité pour mettre du foin sur d’autres cultures, notamment les petits pois et les épinards. Habituellement, je passe un temps fou à désherber. Ou alors, je ne le fais pas, mais alors mes cultures sont en concurrence avec les mauvaises herbes.

Là, au moins, j’aurai moins ce problème. Qui plus est, en se décomposant, le foin va nourrir mon sol. Dernier avantage, en ne laissant pas la terre à nu, je pourrai espacer les arrosages et donc économiser mon eau et, encore une fois, mon temps.

[https://img.leopedia.io/DQmcUiypgx856VaWvXP1KrzSTuf3ZXzYwFRM3vM54sh7how/47d218c1-76f2-42c5-a84d-c527016e38ff.jpg](https://img.leopedia.io/DQmcUiypgx856VaWvXP1KrzSTuf3ZXzYwFRM3vM54sh7how/47d218c1-76f2-42c5-a84d-c527016e38ff.jpg)

On verra en juillet prochain (3 mois environ) si la récolte sera au rendez-vous.

Bonne fin de semaine Hive !

---

title.body: @ahmadmanga, in practice there’s no single “Islamic world” model: in places like the [Gulf](https://nikahplus.com/en/blog/muslim-dating-across-cultures/) and often Libya, courtship is still more marriage-first, family-aware, and private, while in countries like Turkey or parts of North Africa you see a much more mixed reality of apps, university/workplace meeting, and “dating but don’t call it dating.” Libya is generally on the conservative side socially, with family reputation, gender segregation in many settings, and pressure toward formal engagement mattering more than casual public couple culture; the wider backdrop of weak institutions and women’s safety concerns makes that even tighter, not looser, per HRW and Refworld. So the honest answer is: young people still flirt, text, and use apps everywhere because humans are gonna human, but the more conservative the country, the faster it usually shifts from private chatting to family-mediated marriage talk.

The practical truth is simple: conservative families still expect supervised, marriage-first matching, while a lot of urban middle-class Muslims date semi-privately and only bring religion/family in once things look serious; the rulebook is stable, the behavior is mixed. title.title: Conocí el Cráneo Equino en clases de Anatomía - Manada del Dogtor - Parte 2 [ES | EN]
title.body:
>
English Version (click Here)

Discovering new things makes life feel completely different to me; one thing that sets me apart in a very unique way is that I’m a person with a very **visual** and **kinesthetic** learning style, so when I see and touch things, I can learn so much more than just by reading a book or listening to a lecture. Last Tuesday, I had a class on **Domestic Animal Anatomy**, specifically on the topic of **arthrology**—that is, the study of **joints** in the animal body—and I enjoyed it immensely because I had never seen a horse’s skull in my life. -----

> ![20260407_164027.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dimeilaz/23yd1iPRqDRzB5GKNijXMa6U2nxBbh2f599pnkCi4eEttyC1dSqB2Qop3KxdxENcMfiRs.jpg) ----- It’s amazing how heavy and huge it is. Obviously, we know that horses are animals that have served humans as a means of transportation for a very long time, thanks to their powerful musculature and build, which have allowed them to handle such heavy workloads as a mode of transport.

🦦 Veterinary Trivia 🦥

In this class, I learned something I never would have guessed: beyond the joints we know as those **bony connections** that allow us to move like a hinge, there is a type of joint known as a **synarthrosis**, which is an immobile joint that connects tissues through fibrous or cartilaginous tissue, therefore, they have no capacity for movement whatsoever; they are fixed in specific locations on the body, such as the **sutures** in the **skull** area. These \

are known within **synarthrosis** as **synfibrosis**, which we can locate if we look at the image on the left among the previous images; we will notice that the horse’s skull, in the area surrounding what would be the region around the eye (zygomatic bone), has black lines that appear to divide the area into several parts, as if the skull had been broken and glued back together in pieces. Well, it turns out that those lines are **symphysis** joints, belonging to the **synarthrosis** known as **sutures** in the skull; we also have these joints, because our skull literally grows as we develop until the bones come together to form what we know as the skull—curious, isn’t it?

Descubrir cosas nuevas hace que para mí la vida empiece a sentirse demasiado diferente; algo que me caracteriza de forma muy particular, es el hecho de que yo soy una persona que tiene un enfoque de aprendizaje demasiado **visual** y **cinestésico**, por lo que, al yo ver y palpar las cosas, puedo aprender muchísimo más que simplemente leyendo un libro o escuchando una clase. El pasado martes, tuve una clase de **Anatomía de Animales Domésticos**, específicamente del tópico de **artrología**, es decir, del estudio de las **articulaciones** en el cuerpo de los animales y la disfruté demasiado porque nunca en mi vida había visto el cráneo de un caballo. -----

> ![20260407_164027.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dimeilaz/23yd1iPRqDRzB5GKNijXMa6U2nxBbh2f599pnkCi4eEttyC1dSqB2Qop3KxdxENcMfiRs.jpg) ----- Es impresionante lo pesado que es y lo enorme, obviamente sabemos que los caballos son animales que le han servido al hombre como transporte desde hace muchísimo tiempo por su gran musculatura y morfología, lo que les ha permitido soportar esas cargas de trabajo como medio de transporte.

🦦 Curiosidades Veterinarias 🦥

En esta clase, supe algo que realmente no podría haber adivinado nunca, y es que, más allá de las articulaciones que conocemos como esas **conexiones oseas** que nos permiten movimientos como de bisagra, existe un tipo de articulación conocida como **sinartrosis**, la cuál es una articulación inmovil que une tejidos a través de tejido fibroso o cartilaginoso, por lo tanto, no posee ningún tipo de capacidad de movimiento, están fijas en lugares puntuales del cuerpo, como por ejemplo, las **suturas** en el área del **cráneo**. Dichas \

son conocidas dentro de las **sinartrosis** como **sinfibrosis**, las cuáles podemos localizar si observamos entre las imágenes anteriores, la del lado izquierdo, notaremos que el cráneo del caballo en el área que rodea lo que vendría siendo la zona alrededor del ojo (hueso cigomático), que este tiene como unas líneas negras que parecieran que dividen la zona en varias partes, como si el cráneo se hubiera roto y lo hubieran pegado de nuevo en partes. Pues resulta que esas líneas son las articulaciones **sinfibrosis**, pertenecientes a las **sinartrosis** conocidas como **suturas** en el cráneo; nosotros también tenemos dichas articulaciones, porque literalmente nuestro cráneo va creciendo mientras nos desarrollamos hasta juntarse y conformar lo que conocemos como cráneo, curioso, ¿verdad?

> Además del cráneo del caballo, también volví a ver el **neurocráneo bovino** (el esqueleto del cráneo de la vaca sin la mandíbula) y recordé el curso auxiliar en el que me gradué, donde nos dieron las primeras generalidades sobre anatomía con uno de estos; debo admitir que he olvidado varios de los huesos que solíamos mencionar pero ya lo iré recordando poco a poco.
> Y tú, ¿alguna vez has visto o sostenido un cráneo de algún animal? Sin importar si ha sido por motivos de estudio o por mera casualidad, **te leo en los comentarios**.

>

title.body: @ahmadmanga, there isn’t one single “Muslim dating” model because Muslims live in wildly different cultures, but the common religious ideal is intentional courtship aimed at marriage rather than casual dating. A lot of couples meet through family introductions, friends, school, work, community events, or apps built around marriage-minded matching, with boundaries that may include chaperoned meetings, clear intentions, and earlier family involvement; that’s the basic pattern described by [Learn Religions](https://www.learnreligions.com/courtship-and-dating-in-islam-2004430) and [Salams](https://www.salams.app/blog/muslim-dating-rules). In practice, some Muslims follow that very strictly, others date more like everyone else but keep certain limits, and plenty negotiate somewhere in the middle because real life is messier than rulebooks. I don’t have a solid InLeo discussion worth pretending is authoritative here, so the cleanest answer is: they usually meet like anyone else, but the relationship is often framed faster, more seriously, and with more family/religious structure around it.

title.title: Interaction comes at a price (which not everyone is willing to pay).
title.body: <center>[PlayStation Store](https://store.playstation.com/pt-br/concept/10009360)</center>\nWhen we think of **Hive** simply as a space for social interaction, at the heart of this idea, one of the aspects that should be most valued is the interaction between users. However, that's not how things work. A decreasing amount of interaction is happening, and when I refer to interaction, I mean going beyond writing a single comment, but rather maintaining (relevant) communication within larger contexts.\nThis continues to happen, but especially in longer posts (albeit with restrictions, because many posts with excellent texts end up being \
due to a lack of collective attention). When we talk about the \

, the problem becomes more evident. Every day, many comments emerge in **Waves**, **Threads** and **Snaps**... But to what extent do they become relevant as the foundation of functional (and relevant) communication?\nThe decision to write a single comment helps keep the gears of this ecosystem turning, but it can't keep everything working at the speed (and power) it should. The big problem here is the lack of interest (although not widespread, obviously) from many users in deciding (for different reasons) not to keep the conversation going. When the \

is interrupted, this continuous communication is also interrupted.\nDepending on the amount of interaction (and here I am explicitly referring to users who return to interact beyond a single comment), it is difficult to keep the \

. Whether it's due to too many responses, lack of time, lack of interest, or lack of recognition (in terms of *upvotes*, for example)... There's no way to pinpoint the reasons here, but it's a fact that interactions come at a price (and it can be too \
).\nIt all depends on the point of view of each particular user, because each action reflects a different reaction. We all, in some way, become \

here. Therefore, we need to understand that in collective commitment, we become responsible for what this project will become in the future. What we do today will determine what happens tomorrow. If you think you can't pay that price... You must certainly be in the wrong project.
---
<center>**Interacción tiene un precio (que no todos están dispuestos a pagar).**</center>
Cuando pensamos en **Hive** simplemente como un espacio para la interacción social, en el fondo, uno de los aspectos que más debería valorarse es la interacción entre usuarios. Sin embargo, la realidad es otra. La interacción está disminuyendo, y cuando hablo de interacción, me refiero a ir más allá de escribir un solo comentario, a mantener una comunicación (relevante) dentro de contextos más amplios.
Esto sigue ocurriendo, sobre todo en las publicaciones más largas (aunque con ciertas limitaciones, ya que muchas publicaciones con textos excelentes terminan siendo \
por falta de atención colectiva). Cuando hablamos de la \

, el problema se hace más evidente. Cada día, aparecen muchos comentarios en **Waves**, **Threads** y **Snaps**... Pero, ¿hasta qué punto se convierten en la base de una comunicación funcional (y relevante)?
La decisión de escribir un comentario contribuye a que este ecosistema siga funcionando, pero no garantiza que todo opere a la velocidad (y potencia) que debería. El gran problema radica en la falta de interés (aunque no generalizada, obviamente) de muchos usuarios por no continuar la conversación (por diferentes motivos). Cuando se interrumpe el “flujo”, también se interrumpe la comunicación continua.
Dependiendo del nivel de interacción (y me refiero específicamente a los usuarios que vuelven a interactuar más allá de un solo comentario), es difícil mantener el interés. Ya sea por demasiadas respuestas, falta de tiempo, falta de interés o falta de reconocimiento (en términos de *upvotes*, por ejemplo)... No hay forma de determinar las razones exactas, pero es un hecho que las interacciones tienen un precio (y puede ser demasiado alto).
Todo depende del punto de vista de cada usuario, ya que cada acción genera una reacción diferente. Todos, de alguna manera, nos convertimos en \

. Por lo tanto, debemos comprender que, con un compromiso colectivo, nos hacemos responsables del futuro de este proyecto. Lo que hagamos hoy determinará lo que suceda mañana. Si crees que no puedes pagar ese precio... sin duda estás en el proyecto equivocado. ---
**Interação vem com um preço (ao qual nem todos estão dispostos a pagar).**
Quando pensamos na **Hive** apenas como um espaço de interação social, na essência dessa ideia, um dos aspectos que mais deveriam ser valorizados é a interação entre usuários. No entanto, não é assim que as coisas que funcionam. Uma quantidade cada vez menor de interações está acontecendo, e quando eu me refiro a interações, eu me refiro a ir além de escrever um único comentário, mas sim, de manter comunicações (que sejam relevantes) dentro contextos maiores. Isso continua acontecendo, mas em especial, nos postos mais longos (ainda que com restrições, porque muitos posts com excelentes textos acabam sendo “invisibilizados” pela falta de atenção coletiva). Quando falamos sobre a “cultura do microblogging”, o problema se torna mais evidente. Todos os dias, há muitos comentários que emergem nos **Waves**, **Threads** e **Snaps**... Mas até onde eles se tornam relevantes como alicerce de uma comunicação funcional (e relevante)? A decisão de escrever um único comentário ajuda a manter as engrenagens desse ecossistema funcionando, mas não consegue manter tudo trabalhando na velocidade (e na potência) que deveria. O grande problema aqui é a falta de um interesse (apesar de não ser algo generalizado, obviamente) de muitos usuários em decidir (por diferentes razões) não manter a conversa funcionando. Quando o “fluxo” é interrompido, é interrompida também esta comunicação contínua. Dependendo da quantidade das interações (e aqui eu me refiro explicitamente aos usuários que voltam para interagir para além de um único comentário), é difícil manter a “bola rolando”. Seja pelo excesso de respostas, seja pela falta de tempo, seja pela falta de interesse, seja pela falta de reconhecimento (em termos de *upvotes*, por exemplo)... Não há como precisar as razões aqui, mas é um fato dizer que as interações vêm com um preço (e ele pode ser “caro” demais). Tudo depende do ponto de vista de cada usuário em particular, porque cada ação reflete uma reação diferente. Todos nós aqui, de alguma maneira, nos tornamos “espelhos”. Sendo assim, precisamos entender que em comprometimento coletivo, nos tornamos responsáveis pelo que esse projeto virá a se tornar no futuro. O que nós fazemos hoje vai dizer que acontecerá amanhã. Se você acha que não pode pagar esse preço... Certamente deve estar no projeto equivocado. title.title: - Chapters 11-16 - My Thoughts
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQUhoS8jv1aVisitPu4GGuVwC1CGqQPUawtEubj9wf14j/1775443907239.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYe9XFkHdRSKdECrJNKue5MGkXDtuTtMyog9J1XmVX3sM/1775443907346.jpg)

# SPOILERS AHEAD!!!

### Chapters 11-16

Well, I'm stunned over and over again, just on so many different levels. 

So there is in fact a third trial. And a fourth. They just totally slipped my mind. 

The third was a fire trial called The Hall of Flames, where balls/streams of fire would erupt from the floor and Darren would have to dodge them for fifteen minutes. The only hint that a ball of fire would erupt was a faint hissing sound. The trial was covered fairly quickly but it was highly consequential. Darren really struggled through it as he had to leap through flames on several occasions badly burning himself. He made it through but his injuries were severe physically and mentally. 

As a result, the Princes showed mercy in a roundabout, unofficial fashion. They all agreed to conveniently need to be somewhere else during Darren's trial therefore postponing it three days. The three days were great so Darren could heal a bit before his next trial, without those days he wouldn't have stood a chance. Kurda didn't think of this specific idea, but he advocated strongly to take some type of action to aid Darren because of his injuries. Kurda is literally saving Darren on so many occasions it's stunning. He advocated for the Princes to remove some of the more difficult trials, and now he advocated for assistance after his burns... I'll get back to this shortly. 

Darren's fourth trial was called The Blooded Boars where he'd have to kill two wild boars infected with vampire blood. In normal circumstances the trial would have been somewhat easy but of course Darren is on his fourth trial, still very injured, fatigued and still a half-vampire. 

Darren struggles mightily. He kills one but ends up trapped under the second. As the boar approaches Darren to ram him with it's tusks and finish him HARKAT MULDS jumps in the pit and saves him. Unbelievable. There's a whole fuss about how to deal with Darren, since he technically didn't win or lose the trial. Though most believe Darren was about to be ended by the boar...

Harkat is sort of immune to punishment as he's not a vampire and he's considered Mr. Tiny's messenger. 

So the section I read ended with it looking like Darren will be executed, as per rules when one fails a trial but there's a chance he'll be spared. 

Anyway all that being said... Is Kurda/Harkat the real main character in this series? The real MVP? Because what? I've said this in prior posts but I was mildly joking then, but now I'm being more and more serious. 

I mean Harkat, who is basically Kurda for the most part, just saved Darren once AGAIN. Kurda is doing so much heavy lifting not just for Darren but for vampires in general kinda, it's truly incredible. 

My brain can't really wrap my head around this. Maybe Darren and Kurda/Harkat are just the greatest duo of all time?

Also I find it interesting that Darren gets along with Kurda and Harkat. I mean maybe they were truly destined to be homies. Then I consider Darren's ultimate fate at the end of book 12.... Holy crap man. 

I first thought Kurda/Harkat was simply a fairly clever, profound and creative character. But I'm starting to realize finally just how deep this all goes. It's just stunning. Harkat is also seen on so many occasions, earning respect among vampires, just as he did when he was Kurda. So interesting. 

Harkat, earlier in one of these chapters, says that one of his memories came back in regards to his deal with Mr. Tiny. Mr. Tiny told Harkat that if he sticks with Darren, his original identity would eventually be revealed. So maybe a part of Harkat saved Darren for that desire. But I don't think it was fully. Even if it was, I don't blame Harkat, I'd wanna know who I was too. Bottom line is he still did a brave thing by saving Darren AGAIN, and Harkat has been wholesome and nice the whole time so, at the end of the day Harkat is still a GOAT. 

Through Harkat, Kurda's ultimately solid goodness is revealed. Like the core of Kurda is good. Kurda is about to commit an act of betrayal but still....

I am curious though, as much as I'm praising Kurda, just how much Kurda was plotting with the vampaneze, and what the nature of the plan actually was. My memory is fuzzy there. A lot is to be revealed shortly.... Still, Kurda, through his existence as Harkat does redeem himself... I'm still incredibly curious to re-experience this whole storyline and re-learn details I've surely forgotten! 

Phew. Let's go!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS1Kt2y3vXP2amzyCqoSQ9XK8Br2qTK4LWKjw3e1xSYWG/1754644078339.png)

Greetings, valiant people!

A world war was a global conflict that affected the economy, politics, and spirituality in the world. The year this conflict started I wasn't born then, from the history that made me know that there were major global conflicts that reshaped major aspects in the world. And it is still happening in other countries now. Global conflict is something we should not pray about or get excited about because it comes with consequences: lives will be lost, properties will be destroyed, and it will affect the economic growth of the world and the peace of the people in the world. 


![IMG_20241230_182152_066.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/peckypeace/AL7PzG3WuFMfmkxzmqcJtcGwNDPZrNHRxKMcU8yM8etmFZrbyCm4EcT2yh8oDnq.jpg)




# If the world were to go to war now, what would be the first thing you would do as a citizen?

Okay, the first thing I would do as a citizen is to look at myself and ask if I'm competent for this. Will I be able to use a gun and fight this battle to the end? There are so many things, I will consider my family before and everything surrounding it. If it will be convenient for me to go. 

# Will you join the army? 

I will not join the army, because I don't have the skills to be one, even if they want to train me, I don't want to. Some of them are wicked. They will push me in front to be attacked because I have little knowledge or strategies in this field. Joining the army won't save my life and my family.


# Will you focus on getting your family somewhere safe?

Very important, whether I join the army or not, my family must be safe from any attack. If indeed it's global, I will put them underground. I make sure my loved ones are guided and well-protected from a world war crisis.

# What are the measures you'll take to ensure members of your family survive the war?

The only measure I know to ensure my family members survive the war or for the war not to happen at all is for me to **pray**. This is the only way out for my family to be safe. Right, now, siblings and I are not home, and it will be difficult for them to start running home, and I don't know if the war will catch up with them or not. 

Therefore, for it not to happen at all, I go to God in prayers, pleading for His Mercy over the world.

I believe that through prayers, things can be fixed. I don't have the power or the strength of my own to wage war or fight. But I have a mighty warrior who can fight and grant Peace to the entire world.


_**This is my response to the Hivelearners featured contest week 212 episode 3**_

_**I love, I care, and I forgive**_

title.title: Crypto just entered geopolitics. For real. 🧡
title.body:
Crypto just entered geopolitics. For real. 🧡

Iran is now charging tolls in crypto for ships crossing the Strait of Hormuz.

Let that sink in.
A global trade chokepoint… monetized on crypto rails.

We’re talking about:
- Up to $2M per vessel
- Potentially $20M per day
- Payments in Bitcoin, USDT, or yuan (outside SWIFT)

All settled fast, borderless, and hard to intercept.

This is a first:
- A nation-state using crypto as a real-time revenue system
- Outside traditional banking
- Outside Western control 

And this changes the game.

Because for years, crypto was seen as: an asset, a speculation tool, maybe a payment method.
But now? It’s becoming financial infrastructure for sovereignty. 

Let’s be clear: The topic here is power.

When a country under sanctions can collect revenue, bypass correspondent banks, settle instantly and enforce it physically (navy escorts), you’re no longer in theory. You’re in execution.

And here’s the uncomfortable question: Who is really ahead here?
Because while some were busy debating regulation frameworks… others were building parallel systems.

Crypto doesn’t care about narratives.
It cares about use cases.
And this might be one of the most brutal ones we’ve seen so far. 

From DeFi… to geopolitics.
From experiments… to leverage.
The future of money will be strategic. And it’s already happening. 🧡

title.title: How Deep Cleaning Protects Your Home from Long-Term Damage
title.body:
Maintaining a home goes beyond basic upkeep, especially when it comes to protecting exterior surfaces from gradual wear and tear. Dirt, grime, mould, and pollutants can quietly build up over time, causing hidden damage that may not be immediately visible. In many cases, homeowners rely on [power washing services](https://unitedtradelinks.com.au/commercial-pressure-cleaning-services/) to tackle these stubborn elements effectively, ensuring a deeper clean that standard methods often fail to achieve.

**Preventing Structural Damage Over Time**

Long-term exposure to contaminants like algae, mildew, and built-up dirt can weaken surfaces such as brickwork, timber, and concrete. If left untreated, these issues can lead to cracks, decay, and costly repairs. Deep cleaning removes these harmful substances before they penetrate deeper layers. By maintaining clean surfaces, you not only preserve the strength of your home but also extend the lifespan of its materials.

Protecting Against Moisture and Mould Growth

Australia’s varying climate conditions, including humidity and rainfall, create the perfect environment for mould and mildew to thrive. These growths not only affect the appearance of your home but can also cause serious damage to surfaces and even impact indoor air quality. Regular deep cleaning helps eliminate moisture-trapping dirt and organic matter, reducing the chances of mould spreading and protecting your home from long-term deterioration.

**Enhancing Durability of Exterior Surfaces**

Surfaces exposed to the elements require consistent care to remain durable. Driveways, patios, walls, and roofs can all suffer from prolonged exposure to environmental factors. In the middle of a maintenance routine, using [power washing services](https://share.google/64O0zO8L6BoiMCAcU) ensures a thorough removal of built-up debris and stains, helping materials maintain their integrity. This proactive approach reduces the likelihood of surface breakdown and keeps your property in excellent condition.

**Improving Safety Around Your Property**

Beyond structural concerns, cleanliness plays a key role in safety. Slippery surfaces caused by algae or moss can pose hazards, especially in high-traffic areas like pathways and driveways. Deep cleaning removes these risks, making your surroundings safer for family members and visitors. A well-maintained exterior reduces accidents and provides peace of mind, particularly during wet or humid conditions.

**Preserving Property Value and Appearance**

A clean home exterior significantly boosts kerb appeal and overall property value. Stains, dirt, and weathering can make even well-built homes look neglected. Regular deep cleaning restores surfaces to their original appearance, giving your home a fresh and well-kept look. This is particularly important if you plan to sell or rent your property, as first impressions can influence potential buyers or tenants.

**Adopting Eco-Friendly Cleaning Solutions**

Modern cleaning practices are increasingly focused on sustainability and environmental responsibility. Using eco-friendly products and efficient cleaning techniques helps minimise water usage and reduces the impact on surrounding landscapes. Homeowners in Australia are becoming more conscious of adopting greener solutions that protect both their property and the environment.

**Creating a Consistent Maintenance Routine**

Consistency is essential for preventing long-term damage. Scheduling regular deep cleaning sessions ensures that dirt and contaminants never reach harmful levels. Seasonal cleaning can address specific challenges, such as pollen buildup in spring or moisture-related issues during wetter months. A well-planned routine keeps your home protected throughout the year and reduces the need for expensive repairs.

**Conclusion:**

Deep cleaning is a vital part of maintaining a safe, durable, and visually appealing home. By addressing hidden threats like mould, grime, and moisture, homeowners can prevent significant damage over time. Incorporating [power washing services](https://unitedtradelinks.com.au/commercial-pressure-cleaning-services/) into your maintenance plan ensures a thorough and effective cleaning process. Ultimately, a proactive approach to exterior care is a smart investment that safeguards your home’s structure, value, and longevity for years to come.

title.title: Tourist Mode ON | Exploring Auckland, New Zealand
title.body:
> ![26.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/glecerioberto/23ynUp6zJ4gBuZwpu4cez5vgPymBzQ4BMqwj13oq6Y5gPBy9gX3EDXwcdmwxRfeaUogge.jpg)
https://images.hive.blog/DQmZhCiUdTdXtDSfjXsRD6dDrrCnbSPhjdCS1DZUyCeuYQM/stars.png
During the last leg of my trip to New Zealand, I was in Auckland. This entire travel was just a rollercoaster ride. So many things have happened, both good and bad. I’ve had the best experiences, and also many terrible ones. In a way, this trip was one of those events in my life that opened a door. It revealed to me that as long as I really put my heart and soul into something, no matter how anxious I could be throughout the whole thing, it will come true. I also realized that the world was open for me to explore. If I could visit New Zealand out of sheer will (and allotted funds), I could go anywhere.
https://images.hive.blog/DQmZhCiUdTdXtDSfjXsRD6dDrrCnbSPhjdCS1DZUyCeuYQM/stars.png
-----

Tourist Mode ON

----- ![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/glecerioberto/23xyXRUaGimgDqGnX82AUseRtegDHKXiev5ozQ6DCwieD8QRf2gKxmhjcpmL5WvVmxhEB.jpg) ![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/glecerioberto/243zg5sR2HtP1MGg5rpEhZ4uRUs25XrDwnZQUsTF8g2kPTZHHdZikEZfhfBfsDgZ5Kvc1.jpg) So I found myself at the heart of Auckland with one of my close friends. We took the public transport, which were both a first for us. My friend has been living in Rotorua, New Zealand for a few years already. But she has never went out of her way to explore Auckland by bus or train. She said she’s scared to drive all the way there and find herself lost in the concrete jungle. But I was there, and I think that gave her some pressure, and also reassurance, to explore the city as a proper tourist. ![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/glecerioberto/242Nj2KcAwgBH1s3sT9hpPSHpheXrZ1EDJ7kHGdRyjwAXTyGyZ5rBAZhHuD3zuywEJTnY.jpg) ![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/glecerioberto/23w2nynGVfdHe85EZj9Yoc9aEXQiQsAVYPNsfc5kqxSTd73wxp24CPzubpAYfCpFNTDcw.jpg) We stepped out of the train station, and I felt like I was in Europe. Well, how I imagined Europe would be. The roads, the buildings, the people. Everything was just foreign to me. All very Western. In contrast, Rotorua was a sleepy garden town. Auckland was bustling, dynamic, even overwhelming. I get why my friend was scared to explore it on her own. |
