title.title: Human Behavior, When There's An Incentive
title.body:
Last year, I saved a link to a news article I found interesting and planned to write about the topic, but in the end, never did. Lucky me, there are so many topics to write about, that this one was left in my draft folder, till today. As I was cleaning my drafts, it popped up and I thought let's talk about it, let's see what's the situation in your country in this regard. 

![ravin-rau-eNOlrYUx5ZQ-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23xeffGNbdWGzuhZaDa67WSuNvByyFvp1UeQzWmLSRsA7v4abt8htaTUh87ETvazXpL9c.jpg)
Photo by <a href=\

>Unsplash [People are paid to return coffee cups in this Danish city - does it work?](https://www.euronews.com/green/2025/01/11/people-are-paid-to-return-coffee-cups-in-this-danish-city-does-it-work), this was the article I was referring to, brought by Euronews. I'm a huge fan of recycling, reusing, repurposing and whatever R you can come up with, so I find it interesting and useful in the same time. > *More than 700,000 cups were returned here last year. Could deposit machines be coming to more of Europe’s streets?* >I slide the thick white plastic cup with its blue lid into the hole, and continue to follow the instructions written on the deposit machine. Placing my credit card on the designated card area, a tingle tells me that in a few moments, five Danish crowns (around 70 euro cents) will be returned to my bank account. [](https://www.euronews.com/green/2025/01/11/people-are-paid-to-return-coffee-cups-in-this-danish-city-does-it-work) ###### Showing The Way This project was launched in January 2024, by the Danish city of Aarhus, a trial programme of three years, and the reason is the obvious one, to curb the number of disposable coffee cups. >\

>Unsplash You can't judge the efficiency of any authority by a single action, but recognizing where the most of the waste comes from and doing something about it worth my vote I'd say. >The pilot programme set out to collect 500,000 cups in its first year, a target that was far exceeded as cups were returned 735,000 times, saving 14 tonnes of plastic from incineration and CO2 emissions. [](https://www.euronews.com/green/2025/01/11/people-are-paid-to-return-coffee-cups-in-this-danish-city-does-it-work) This says it all, no need for more explanation. The programme was a success and a model to follow as well, for whoever is interested in making a step towards stopping waste and recycling packages. ###### Voluntarily, When You Have No Choice The article mentions my country as well. This time we're among the good actors, which is surprising as we usually make the top of the list for all the wrong reasons. It was two years ago I think, I mean 2024, when my country introduced the DRS (SGR) system, not because they thought it's a good thing to do, but because they were forced by the European Union and there was no time to waste. ![26-03_rezultate sgr dektop_EN.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/Ep1cmdpCE9jJ4FDhUt1D9Qbr3eCzsa7vX3astby7FiNuh7JqZRoaLCmpVnVtgALBunL.png) [](https://returosgr.ro/en) Over the almost two years, I've seen Romania mentioned as having the newest collecting system by several foreign articles, and this was only possible because when the decision was made, there was no collecting system at all, so they chose to implement a good one. As I said, we're always the last to do something and only if it's a must, and this system falls in that category. Now that the system is working, and working well, it would be time for the next step, which would be the collection of any kind of glass, plastic and to reduce the use of single-use takeaway packaging, which currently is a huge problem. ![quokkabottles-bcGBUn52GwQ-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/AK3gDbxLmXnzQaEb43KW75toz2uPvfB9YZwVFuFkQrRX7CL1qzBHkZrUBx34vfn.jpg) Photo by

>Unsplash ###### Human Behavior, When There's An Incentive Usually I only have a few bottles to return, as unfortunately the majority of the packaging I don't need is not recycled, but whenever I return the few pieces I have, there are people in front of me, with huge bags full of plastic and glass bottles and cans. They are the kind of people you can't resist a minute next to, as the smell is killing you and it's obvious they are collecting these from the trash. It's an income for them, which would not be a problem, but when you see them spending on alcohol and tobacco, none of them cheap, it shows you what their living situation is. As far as I can tell, people are happy with the programme and you don't see bottles thrown left and right anymore and it's sad to know such a measure was needed, to make change people's behavior. Life is changing with a breakneck speed, we often eat on the go and order in due to various reasons, which increases the use of packaging. To avoid for the country to become a dumping site of harmful waste, a collective effort is needed and can only be successful if both businesses and consumers are participating. It's painful to see people dumping garbage where they shouldn't, then voicing their dissatisfaction about municipality keeping the environment clean. We had 36 years to *grow up*, but we're still light years away from where we need to be. 2050 is the deadline given by the EU to recycle 100% of the waste produced and I bet my country is going to make the top of the list for the wrong reason again. What's the situation in your country? Let' me know in a comment.

></center>

title.title: STREET ART #247– Something new at the Le Gaudan Waterfront in Port Louis, Mauritius
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfS8nU9M9ktmRQ9NbBqsczgRjYVC14WTHoEaxQwx9zmSe/01.jpg)
Now that I am back in Mauritius, I have had a walk around the city centre in the capital Port Louis. I was eager to find out if there is something new since last year. At the Le Gaudan Waterfront I found out there is a new mural on the appartment complex. Le Gaudan is a shopping complex with lots of shops, restaurats, with a great location by the harbor. Except from this building holding apartments.
https://images.ecency.com/DQmcGwhMKoueoDtay3HH4qngMLtH33dw2Vex4Yb3oaM6rT2/02.jpg https://images.ecency.com/DQmY19zRBMPwyBbovhj8kiF8HNJPMunubnbkP77JkMPnuQH/03.jpg https://images.ecency.com/DQmWZhyQTkij8v19tnzQCWJXtdHmNknDi2VVmcnDfJ8syTp/04.jpg
By the channel you will find this building. Three murals are painted here. The photo above shows the newest mural. A colorful figure holding a drum. This kind of drum is used by local musicians when they are playing the Sega music. This music originated on the island and most locals also knows how to dance Sega.
https://images.ecency.com/DQmfL3ptL9eGCGEd3A55B3GNf2LCsz7MDpgLbEMZnY1n3xm/05.jpg https://images.ecency.com/DQmZRXF8McQ1bdCFLeotkeJP3nK59k68MnZNEwxjuLCTQWq/06.jpg https://images.ecency.com/DQmd9tUYPZv2QBUnoA51RG1jvzPxuj4dRthL8qGsKe6WP6R/07.jpg
The other two murals are not new. I have already done posts with both, but they still look good. The child is painted by an artist named Armand Gachet, who lives in Mauritius, but originally he is from South Africa. He has done several beautiful murals on the island.
https://images.ecency.com/DQmcMTQBCHs17dAQ8yHGbBB3ghW6pkFpDhkWGY4gChwuPAB/08.jpg
The «heart» is painted by an artist named Gael Froget. A Mauritian contemporary artist, born in 1986. He is self-taught and creative within in many different gengres in addition to street art. He in especially known for his anatomical hearts. I have allready done a post with one of his «hearts». I just arrived the island a few weeks ago and haven't been to Port Louis more than a couple of times. I hope to discover some more murals.

title.title: Learn Creative Coding (#30) - Mini-Project: Generative NFT Collection
title.body:
# Learn Creative Coding (#30) - Mini-Project: Generative NFT Collection

![cc-banner](https://images.hive.blog/DQma3W1RHwqn1Mb1QGtVReTkAstYC7b1GezijJvPLiQbgKN/cc-banner-yellow.png)

This is it. The big one. Everything from Phase 4 -- seeds, composition, typography, texture, color palettes, blockchain output -- comes together in this episode. We're building a complete generative art collection from scratch. Not a single-output sketch. Not a tech demo. A real collection where every seed produces a cohesive, interesting, distinct piece of art.

I'm calling it \

Flow field curves with layered texture, palette variation, and compositional traits. The concept is simple -- abstract landscapes of flowing curves driven by seeded noise. But the output space is huge. Same algorithm, infinite variations. That's the whole point of generative collections, right?

If you've followed along since episode 23 where we talked about what makes art generative, through seeds in 24, composition in 25, typography in 26, texture in 27, color systems in 28, and blockchain output formats in 29 -- you already have every building block. This episode is the assembly step. Taking those individual tools and wiring them into one coherent system. It's the most satisying part of any project, honestly. When the pieces click together and suddenly there's a real thing :-)

## What Drift actually does

Each piece varies across five independent traits:

- **Palette** -- warm sunset, cool ocean, natural forest, neon, monochrome, earth tones. Six options with different rarity weights.
- **Density** -- how many curves fill the canvas. Sparse pieces have 80-150 curves, dense ones go up to 900.
- **Flow style** -- smooth (gentle, sweeping), turbulent (tight, chaotic), or layered (each curve gets its own noise offset, creating a multi-layer depth effect).
- **Texture** -- clean, subtle grain, or heavy grain applied to the final output.
- **Composition** -- full field (curves everywhere), circular mask (curves concentrated in a circle), or split (one half dense, other half sparse).

Five traits with multiple values each. That's a big combinatorial space from a very focused visual concept. And that's exactly what makes a good collection -- one clear idea (flowing curves) with enough variation (trait combinations) that each piece feels unique without feeling random.

The name \

side get skipped 70% of the time. Again, not a hard cutoff -- soft edges look more natural than sharp ones.

**The flow field.** Each curve starts at a random position, then steps forward repeatedly. At each step, the noise function gives an angle, and we move in that direction by `stepSize` pixels. The `noiseScale` parameter controls how quickly the flow direction changes across space. Low noiseScale (0.001) = gentle, sweeping curves. High noiseScale (0.012) = chaotic, turbulent paths. This is the same flow field principle we used in episode 12, but now it's driving the entire visual output.

**The layered trick.** When `traits.flow` is 'layered', each curve gets its own `noiseOffset` -- a random value added to the noise coordinates. This means each curve samples from a different region of the noise field, so they flow in different directions even when they're close together. It creates a multi-layer depth effect where curves seem to exist on different planes. Simple trick, big visual impact.

**Line width scaling.** `R.random(0.5, 2.5) * (S / 800)` scales line width relative to canvas size. On an 800px canvas, lines are 0.5-2.5px. On a 1600px canvas, they're 1-5px. Resolution independence, as we discussed in episode 29. Everything scales proportionally.

**The alpha range.** 0.05 to 0.35 means every curve is semi-transparent. Where curves overlap, colors accumulate. Dense areas get deeper, richer color. Sparse areas stay light and airy. This is basically the same layering principle as the watercolor technique from episode 27 -- many translucent layers building up density. The overlap IS the visual interest.

**Grain.** Same pixel manipulation approach from episodes 10 and 27. Loop through every pixel, add random brightness variation. Intensity 18 for subtle grain (barely visible, just breaks up the digital cleanness), intensity 35 for heavy grain (visible texture, moody film stock vibe). Notice the grain uses the seeded RNG, not `Math.random()`. Deterministic grain. Same seed, same grain pattern, every time.

## The complete HTML file

Everything goes in one file. No imports, no CDN, no fetch calls. Self-contained, as episode 29 requires:

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
  <meta charset=\

because in the actual file, you'd inline all the code from above. No separate files, no modules, no imports. One giant script block. It looks messy in a code editor but that's what the platform requires. Self-contained means self-contained.

## Testing with a gallery

Before minting anything, you want to see many outputs at once. A gallery of 30+ seeds, rendered as thumbnails. This is your quality assurance step:

```html
<body style=\
piece should look obviously different from a \

one. If you can't tell which trait a piece has by looking at it, that trait is meaningless from a collector perspective. Every trait should create a visible, recognizable difference.

**The best collections have one clear idea.** Drift is about flowing curves. That's it. Not flowing curves AND geometric shapes AND particle effects AND text. One concept, explored deeply. Focus beats scope every time. Tyler Hobbs didn't put grids and spirals and flow fields into Fidenza -- he put flow fields, and he explored them fully. One idea, infinite variation.

**Rarity should be meaningful.** The neon palette is rare (weight 1 out of 13) because it's the most visually striking. If the rarest trait was also the most boring, that's bad design. Rare should mean special, not just uncommon.

## A note on the approach

You might be wondering why we built all of this from scratch instead of using libraries. p5.js has `noise()`. There are palette libraries. Flow field examples exist everywhere. Three reasons:

First, self-contained code. No external dependencies means no broken CDN links in 2035. Your art renders forever. We talked about this in episode 29 and it's not a theoretical concern -- I've seen NFTs that broke because they depended on a jQuery CDN that went down.

Second, understanding. When you wrote the Perlin noise function by hand in episode 12, you understood what every paramater does. When you built the palette system in episode 28, you could tweak the exact rarity distributions. You can't optimize what you don't understand. And optimization is exactly what the gallery-test-refine loop demands.

Third, file size. A generative art piece built from our toolkit is maybe 15-20KB of JavaScript. Import p5.js and you're adding 800KB before your first line of art code. Some platforms have file size limits. And even without limits, smaller is faster. Collectors on slow connections appreciate a piece that loads in 200ms instead of 3 seconds.

## 't Komt erop neer...

- A complete generative collection needs: seeded PRNG, noise, palette system, trait generation, rendering engine, and output format
- Traits create both visual variety AND collectable rarity through weighted selection
- Composition masks (circular, split) add visual diversity without changing the core algorithm
- Texture (grain, vignette) transforms \

into something that feels crafted -- same techniques from episode 27
- The layered flow style creates multi-plane depth by offsetting each curve's noise sampling
- Test with a gallery of 30+ seeds, then refine parameters until every output is interesting
- Everything in one HTML file, zero external dependencies -- self-contained means forever
- One clear visual idea explored deeply beats a collection trying to do everything
- The gallery-test-refine loop is where good collections become great ones

Phase 4 is done. We went from understanding what generative art IS (episode 23) to building a mint-ready collection. Seeds, composition, typography, texture, color, blockchain output, and now assembly. That's a real toolkit. Whether you actually mint anything is up to you -- the techniques work just as well for print, exhibition, or just making cool stuff on your own screen.

Next up we're wrapping the original Creative Coding series with some thoughts on practice, creative habits, and where to go from here. And after that... well, there's a whole world of shader programming waiting. The fragment shader taste we got in episode 21 barely scratched the surface. Signed distance functions, noise on the GPU, raymarching -- some seriously wild territory ahead :-)

Sallukes! Thanks for reading.

title.title: I don't want to see war
title.body:
I have always been praying never to see any war in my life. I have heard so many stories of how people fourth war in the past.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRbWpYvLb8RXoXLSkTSnjgyZ5U8fqpXrcRxsBTDWmJC6Y/1775820674576.jpg)
[source](https://pixabay.com/photos/soldier-war-rifle-gun-weapon-ww2-7198835/)

The Biafran war cleared a lot of the Igbos and because I am from that part of Nigeria, I have alwappfelt bad because of how people lost their lives and properties. Hunger killed so many of them and most of our woman were married to the military men sent down to the Igbo land. They did that so that they can survive the hunger that was imposed on them by the Nigerian government. It took the Igbo race more than two decades to stand on their feet again. This history made me dread war. I don't ever want to experience it. O don't ever want to partake in it and by the grace of God, I will not see war with my two  naked eyes.

I grew up in Jos and that was when Jos in platel loo state was a very peaceful place to be. Four years after I left Jos, the crisis began and up till today Jos crisis have taken down a lot of soldiers and civilians. Some times it is not the people that you think will die in a war will die. It might be your Loved ones. I believe that even the people who started the crisis in Jos have been so affected in such a way that they regret their actions. But is too late now that we have lost so many people in that city. the last one that took place a week back claimed a lot of lives including innocent children who don't even know what war is. 

MY TAKA ON WAR AND WHAT I WILL DO IF IT AROUSED.

Though I have said all my prayers, but for the sake of this week 212 episode 3 in hive learner's community I will share what I think I will do if such happens.

MY SAFETY FIRST 

When I hear war, all that comes to mind is what will I do? Where will I hide? Where is the enemy coming from so that I will know where to run from. I know that there will be that fear and all of that, but I will think of how to be safe first and not to join any army. In this case please I don't want to be a hero that fourth for her nation. I just want to be safe.

THE SAFETY OF MY FAMILY COMES IN

I believe that the second thing that will come to mind is my family. No mother will be happy to hear that her child or children are killed because of war. She will do all it takes to prevent that id she have the power. The only reason I will agree to join the army is to save my family and friends. Not for the nation. I will not want to join, but if that is the only way to save my family I will do so. 

Finally, no one should pray to face a world war because if dangerous. Is disastrous and no one will be happy at the end. Loved ones must have gone. Family and friends dead. The world will not be a sweet place to be any more

title.body: > Hola queridos amigos de @holos.lotus, saludos y bendiciones, en esta ocasión vengo para hablarles sobre una reflexión que tuve tras una serie de problemas que se presentaron y quiero compartir con ustedes lo que aprendí de ello, ya que cuando se presentan una variedad de problemas sentimos que no podemos con ellos y que es mejor dejarlos a un lado, pero siempre es mejor afrontarlos, aunque sea difícil y poder abrirse el camino para continuar con más tranquilad. --- ![REVIEW (18).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/242NsqnU59FVr5WcqkzQBc6x9aDY19CbHJ6jMFMtnRmsCrpXVcy9Jk12zhoXSMmeixHpA.jpg) **Diseño en CANVA** ---

>Los problemas siempre abundan, a veces aunque uno no quiera suelen surgir y no es para hacer pasar mal momento aunque eso es inevitable que sucede realmente, también es para hacernos más fuertes, conocernos mejor, y seguir adelante con una nueva mentalidad y sabiendo que los días malos pasan y que luego vendrán cosas mejores, claro al principio no es sencillo verlo sobre todo cuando se acumulan estos problemas o vienen uno tras otros, se siente como que realmente no se puede hacer nada, a veces se piensa que la mejor solución es dejarlos a un lado, que después se tendrá el tiempo para resolver, pero es una mentira que uno hace para no preocuparse más al respecto pero la realidad es otra. ![separadoryasma1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tRzwswFj7sdCJKFgW2jsAWvCyEzuv6zxT8pCrVwXa8ePqRSdQWi3P6ZbtsyGmy6y4G2.png)

>Dejar los problemas a un lado por un tiempo más de lo que debería ser lo único que trae es amargura, estrés y conflictos internos con uno mismo, pensando en que se hará, que pasará si se resuelve o deja así, que esto me complica más, en fin, una y otra cosa que a la final no ayudan en nada, sencillamente a la final no se resuelve nada y las cosas pueden empeorar más de lo que en realidad era en un principio, es por ello que dejarlos a un lado no es una opción, así como ignorarlos, parece una solución pero momentánea, porque a la final ignorar es solo algo efímero, a la final se mantiene el problema y la preocupación se agranda por saber qué hacer, por ello tampoco es lo más correcto, solo hace de igual manera aumentar el tiempo de agonía, desesperación por obtener esa tranquilidad que tanto esperas pero que parece que tarda en llegar. --- ![alexandra_koch-man-7756506_1920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23ynjdyjgYeHisDTxuAjFXh5FigDP4Dh3KWYz9vB9VZNaxxVRWpUU8boMWVCf42f33jLG.jpg) [Fuente](https://pixabay.com/es/images/download/x-7756506_1920.jpg) ---

>Así que por más difícil que sea, por más problemas que se acumulen, siempre es mejor resolver todo a su debido tiempo, en el instante que tengas la fuerza, mente y dedicación para resolverlo, dejar pasar mucho tiempo es como dejar una herida abierta propensa a ponerse peor con infecciones y otros daños, es como tratar de ocultar una grieta que a toda vista ya no se puede arreglar sino lo haces correctamente, los problemas son para darle la mejor solución, para aprender de ellos y para no dejar que nos marque para el resto de la vida, es para simplemente lograr avanzar luego de superarlos. ![separadoryasma1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tRzwswFj7sdCJKFgW2jsAWvCyEzuv6zxT8pCrVwXa8ePqRSdQWi3P6ZbtsyGmy6y4G2.png)

> **Muchas gracias por leerlo. Espero sea de su agrado. Cualquier comentario con gusto estaré para responder y si quieren saber más de mi les dejo mis:**
![EL FINAL DE POSTHIVE (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tmBcG1dhAWXHSeTXHGahwcGe8eAbcEpZutQrCnSNiXxDwJJ31QA17giTgLpxPgJtEqN.jpg)
![separadoryasma1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tRzwswFj7sdCJKFgW2jsAWvCyEzuv6zxT8pCrVwXa8ePqRSdQWi3P6ZbtsyGmy6y4G2.png) **ENGLISH**

> Hello dear friends of @holos.lotus, greetings and blessings, on this occasion I come to talk to you about a reflection I had after a series of problems that arose and I want to share with you what I learned from it, since when a variety of problems arise we feel that we cannot handle them and that it is better to leave them aside, but it is always better to face them, even if it is difficult and be able to open the way to continue more calmly. --- ![REVIEW (19).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/242NsqnU59FVr5WRnb21cjB1RpVL2wT95i5krmeN42nWyFwo5PLyxz82rdCZmsPhxTSXM.jpg) **Design in CANVA** ---

>Problems always abound, sometimes even if you don't want them to, they tend to arise and it is not to make you have a bad time, although that is inevitable and it really happens, it is also to make us stronger, know ourselves better, and move forward with a new mentality and knowing that bad days pass and that better things will come later, of course at first it is not easy to see it, especially when these problems accumulate or come one after another, it feels like you really can't do anything, sometimes you think that the best solution is to leave them aside, that later you will have time to resolve, but it is a lie that one makes to not worry about it anymore but the reality is different. ![separadoryasma1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tRzwswFj7sdCJKFgW2jsAWvCyEzuv6zxT8pCrVwXa8ePqRSdQWi3P6ZbtsyGmy6y4G2.png)

>Leaving problems aside for a while longer than it should be the only thing that brings is bitterness, stress and internal conflicts with oneself, thinking about what will be done, what will happen if it is resolved or left like this, that this complicates me more, in short, one and another thing that in the end does not help at all, simply in the end nothing is resolved and things can get worse than they actually were in the beginning, that is why leaving them aside is not an option, just as ignoring them seems like a solution. but momentary, because in the end ignoring is only something ephemeral, in the end the problem remains and the concern increases to know what to do, therefore it is not the most correct either, it only increases the time of agony, desperation to obtain that peace of mind that you hope for so much but that seems to take a long time to arrive. --- ![alexandra_koch-man-7756506_1920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23ynjdyjgYeHisDTxuAjFXh5FigDP4Dh3KWYz9vB9VZNaxxVRWpUU8boMWVCf42f33jLG.jpg) [Source](https://pixabay.com/es/images/download/x-7756506_1920.jpg) ---

>So no matter how difficult it is, no matter how many problems accumulate, it is always better to solve everything in due time, as long as you have the strength, mind and dedication to solve it, letting a lot of time pass is like leaving an open wound prone to getting worse with infections and other damage, it is like trying to hide a crack that in plain sight can no longer be fixed if you do not do it correctly, problems are to give the best solution, to learn from them and not to let it mark us for the rest of our lives, it is to simply to move forward after overcoming them. ![separadoryasma1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tRzwswFj7sdCJKFgW2jsAWvCyEzuv6zxT8pCrVwXa8ePqRSdQWi3P6ZbtsyGmy6y4G2.png)

> **Thank you very much for reading it. I hope you like it. I will be happy to respond to any comments and if you want to know more about me, I will leave you my:**
![EL FINAL DE POSTHIVE (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tmBcG1dhAWXHSeTXHGahwcGe8eAbcEpZutQrCnSNiXxDwJJ31QA17giTgLpxPgJtEqN.jpg)
**Translated Using Deepl** ![separadoryasma2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23t7FGdvDtjjEnDiEmhiBDnp6mbsh7xtMBUvkUFiwLtYYSHA9MCnR3VGBuvWJeHNVDBGh.png)

title.title: DEALING WITH DEPRESSED TEENS// THE OLD PATH
title.body:
For us to deal with depressed teens is not easy but steady love and caring is enough to make them feel the love and stay safe again. Teens often struggle silently, so listening to them without judgment is very important. The Bible encourages believers to bear one another’s burdens, showing that we should support them emotionally and spiritually. Gentle words, kindness, and consistent presence can help them feel valued and not alone.

We should show them the ways of God and at them same time make them understand that God is still with them and he loves them. Encouraging prayer, sharing God’s promises, and reminding them of their worth in His eyes can lift their spirit. At the same time, giving them guidance, involving trusted adults, and seeking proper help when needed reflects wisdom. God calls us to bring light into darkness, and through love, truth, and support, depressed teens can begin to heal and find joy again.

title.title: Thinking about the sea (oil on paper)
title.body:
Hello hivers, an happy Friday to you all! The weekend is just around the corner and even if there are some clouds on the horizon, the Springtime is everywhere around me and this makes me feel in a very positive mood.
Yesterday I spent a couple of hours with the 2 little twins playing with them and her mom. To go there, for me, it's a sort of pause from my daily life. I use to go there one time at week. When I arrive at their home I drink a cup of coffee with their parents, some chats together and after a lot of smiles with the little ones, what's better? 😁

After the dinner, yesterday, while my hubby was teaching to one of his art classes inside our lab room, I started a new artwork. I just finished it so I can show you the final result!

title.title: A Silver without a Tie
title.body:
Conference for entrepreneurs over 50




![photo_2026-04-05_12-08-35.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/23xyWxuQjDByoGf3oHd665DkaMhUjovB7FBoZxby6bVY13x96YbiJoZSRUbQZhWVTFhcN.jpg)


 

> Edit in Canva & Photoshop

------

 
















<div class=\

> 




A few weeks ago, I had the opportunity to attend the \

conference. It's a series of conferences held in different cities across the country, organized by various brands.

The Chamber of Electronic Commerce leads this conference series through its Silver sub-directorate, which focuses on the development, training, and promotion of entrepreneurship among people over 50, an important segment of the country's population.

In past decades, people of that age were retired, but the world changes, circumstances change, and in this country, adapting seems difficult, not only because of the political and social situation, but also because of the education system. The over-50 segment of the population is one of the most active and knowledgeable, so these conferences aim to give them the recognition they deserve in the country's economic development.



----






> Hace unas semanas tuve la oportunidad de asistir a la conferencia \

. Se trata de una serie de conferencias que se celebran en diferentes ciudades del país, organizadas por diversas marcas. > La Cámara de Comercio Electrónico lidera esta serie de conferencias a través de su subdirección Plata, que se centra en el desarrollo, la formación y la promoción del emprendimiento entre las personas mayores de 50 años, un segmento importante de la población del país. > En décadas pasadas, las personas de esa edad estaban jubiladas, pero el mundo cambia, las circunstancias cambian y, en este país, parece difícil adaptarse, no solo por la situación política y social, sino también por el sistema educativo. El segmento de la población mayor de 50 años es uno de los más activos y con mayor conocimiento, por lo que con estas conferencias se busca darles el valor que merecen dentro del desarrollo económico del país. ![IMG_20260325_144820_378.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/EoCgiGB19zi4PdEyXDJFx433myTTGvzpvEwb2nV9WHnEATKdkBVcLaDSh53SNTrkr4B.jpg) ![IMG_20260325_150050_020.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/EonkvQ5GNxZrHtumR9uWyM6nv4ACFTUPQWQHq5328tUXHV9yNG4J298y83vxKVbwvMf.jpg) ![IMG_20260325_150933_563.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/EpEGtFwhHcnZeL8XPRoV7mSnvGZNbvRksckZUA99eXnk4xzgYRzhaVf2eajB5fntGMz.jpg) ![IMG_20260325_151040_291.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/Eou6jpwyzxtWJ5T6NC7GEn42sfXbtydStjyrz69yjavxKKU8Hqjk6FU8LeGYEBtBzGy.jpg) |||| |-|-|-| ![IMG_20260325_151511_592.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/Eq35biHFMbPzPTk3gbuCsJQobhyCyqN6fP681Kyz4YrLv6G1EAGFanGAPircP3ou34o.jpg)|![IMG_20260325_162141_833.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/Ep3eEA5tqAMBcYWX889bEysDyfo5GUCLPXSHQ3gHTwEqabkUwcFxd8TxxJqLP2gd2jA.jpg) || ![IMG_20260325_162235_391.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/23ycyhF4zMUhGDb5BoT77NNiLLUANyEGw53dDAZ6vrYHQXLDVUm4aajxxJcXxUvKGSjtR.jpg)
----
The event was held in the ballrooms of the Tiffany Hotel. Invitations were sent out weeks in advance. Registration was required via a link on the website, and attendees received a QR code to show at the entrance. Those who didn't have time to register could complete their information that same day. The event featured sponsoring brands, including Banco Plaza, which had a booth promoting express accounts. I've had an account with this bank for a while, but I hardly ever use it. They only have one branch in the city, and I haven't had time to apply for a debit card. Many interested people attended this important conference. Afterward, an evening party was held on the hotel terrace, hosted by NC Music. ---- > El evento se celebró en los salones de baile del Hotel Tiffany. La invitación se envió con semanas de antelación. Era necesario registrarse a través de un enlace en la página web, y los asistentes recibieron un código QR para mostrar en la entrada. Quienes no tuvieron tiempo de registrarse pudieron completar sus datos ese mismo día. > El evento contó con la presencia de marcas patrocinadoras, entre ellas Banco Plaza, que tenía un stand promocionando cuentas express. title.title: It looks like rain
title.body:
<center>![PXL_20260321_141025980.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/243fn29oAzHshVedXLUqR2RRdRrYTCqzxnb2J4BKrzZR2uTd9SZBoD1qRaiWqVMs3ZXMJ.jpg)</center>

-------------------------


After pretty much a full week of the wet stuff coming down, flood warnings, and everything else you would come to expect from early Spring, we have another round of showers heading our way next week. It's good that it isn't quite warm enough to start working outside because I would be a disappointed if it was but the rain kept me from getting anything done.  The good news is, we have a small window tomorrow on Saturday where I might be able to get a little bit of stuff done.  We will see.  

The other good news is, no matter what the weather brings us, I have something to keep me warm.


<center>![PXL_20260329_173742322.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23x196EmVwoHBKcf7oFpW3oq8hyfSqoF1hGFoGdDwmbZo6Czu4yp3cSfEVSnZGMDw96qr.jpg)</center>

-----------------------------

When I was down in Virginia, I snagged these three bottles of whiskey.  Actually, the Standard Proof on the far right came from Nashville, TN.  I had my brother in law pick it up for me when he was on his annual NCAA basketball trip.  I had gotten a bottle of this last time I was in Nashville, so when I heard he was heading there I asked him to pick me up a bottle.  The truth is, this isn't the bottle I wanted.  They have a Texas Pecan Bourbon that sounded kind of interesting to me, but like last time I was there, they didn't have any in stock.  So I settled for the straight bourbon.

The other two bottles are from Virginia based distilleries.  American Single Malts are becoming quite popular lately, and while they aren't my favorite, I am starting to learn to appreciate them.  They have a more similar feel to Scotch or Irish Whisky versus the smokey taste that American Whiskey and Bourbon has.  I'm excited to try the Virginia Distillery Single Malt.  Then we have the rye whisky in the center from Catoctin Creek.  I've never heard of this distillery before, but according to the Internet and the bottle, they have won quite a few awards over the years for this particular offering.

I guess I know what I am doing this weekend now...

### SMR 

Nuscale Power had their Q1 earnings call a few days ago.  I haven't gotten the specific results yet, but I have a feeling they are still operating at a loss.  I've been doing some reading based on the current price being lower than the IPO price.  It's kind of depressing, but I still think there is a chance it can recover.  Many of the critics are pointing to the fact that their costs are much higher than they anticipated and that small modular reactors aren't the right fit for the future power needs of the world.  

I disagree, and while you might not see an SMR putting out enough power for a large city, it could be perfect for a data center and we all know that data centers are coming, whether we want them or not.  

I want to apologize to all the people who bought the stock based on my coverage of it.  Obviously, you should have done your own research, but hopefully you don't hold it against me too much.  Like I said, I think we are still pretty early in this.  It's hard to say what might happen.  NuScale still has the regulatory approvals in place to give them a jump start on all of this when things really get rolling.


<center>![PXL_20260321_141457681.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23ynSNQGipsxpY6VYE46h545eAPpjoEmgYb4hxz3CwEP454EQ7tFVVh8aJGHu9BCkTXgA.jpg)</center>

-------------------------


### Silver

Silver continues to hover around that $60 to $80 range.  With things sitting like this I plan on just holding on and waiting to see what the future holds.  I likely won't be purchasing any more silver until next Christmas.  Of course that doesn't count the tickets I will be buying for the silver raffle that @bulliontools is going to be running here soon.  I'll probably buy a few of those to try my luck.

Meanwhile, my KGC and FSM stocks seem to be holding up pretty well. It seems there are a lot of markets kind of in limbo right now until we figure out what is going to happen with this whole Iran/US straits of Hormuz thing.  I just hope it gets resolved sooner rather than later. 


### Splinterlands

I got my node renewal invoice at the beginning of the month for SPS.  I'm not sure why, but it feels like the price went up quite a bit.  I typically pay the bill in SPS for @monstermarket to host my node and I can't remember what I have paid in the past, but this month it was something shy of 1300 SPS.  I'm guessing it has to do with the price of SPS going down, but I am once again confronted with the fact that it might not be worth it to have my node hosted through them.  

Honestly, if I knew I could get what I paid for my node, I would sell it in a heartbeat and move those funds into something else.  When you are sitting close to 100 in the ranks, you don't have much chance of earning anything. It's wildly depressing, but just another indication of the current market.  Will things turn around?  I hope so, but it's hard to have a lot of faith after such a long roll through the mud. 

### PWR

In case you didn't see, the PWR project by @empoderat / @ferranlogs (same person).  I'm thinking about moving my investment into that off chain and putting it into a different project (more on that in the future).  I already had the PWR converted to USDC and deposited into my external wallet.  It wasn't much based on my holdings, but it's more than I had a few days ago.  The HIVE I had pooled with it I am still up in the air about.  I like investing in HIVE, but I also feel I need to spread out my investments a bit.  

I still have faith in the blockchain, but I need to be practical.  Even with my traditional investments when I have a good amount in a single mutual fund my broker and I talk about diversifying into something else moving forward.  It's not about lack of faith, it's about making smart moves to ensure future success and sustainability.  I'll let you know when I figure out what I am going to do.

title.title: La duda, compañera inevitable del pastelero
title.body:
Un abrazo para los emprendedores y amigos de la blockchain, desde mi alma pastelera y esta comunidad @Beentrepreneur los invito a adentrarnos en otra arista de un emprendedor.

---

---

https://images.ecency.com/DQmdDaGumfi7x3K48ww2gGbQwFrcTBUqbSU4NWZPSDCwBAm/1775737172136.jpg

---

---

En el momento de hornear y decorar una torta, pocos emprendedores pasteleros imaginan que la duda se instalará en su alma con la misma certeza que el leudante hace crecer la masa. Ese sentimiento llega cuando menos lo esperamos y, a decir verdad, no lo necesitamos: **la duda**.

No es una cuestión de falta de talento o pasión. La consecuencia de un entorno hostil convierte cada producto en una apuesta. Aun cuando no deseamos ser competencia de otros, esta se impone porque así son las leyes del mercado. Sin entrar a valorar detalles de personas que con muy poca fe dicen cosas como: ¿tu estás segura que ganas slgo?.

---

---

https://images.ecency.com/DQmZZ9k1X7KZeKGbcxw6kKWf21941LAWjZS5RX6r8yw22eT/1775652875345.jpg

---

---

La escasez de materias primas es el primer golpe a la confianza. Cuando la harina, el azúcar, los huevos y otros insumos duplican su precio de la noche a la mañana, o el chocolate escasea por problemas de importación, el pastelero cubano duda si este oficio es la verdadera solución.

Me pregunto: ¿subo los precios y arriesgo perder clientes, o rebajo la calidad y traiciono mi esencia? Cada compra se transforma en un cálculo angustioso, y la incertidumbre se enquista debajo de la piel.

A esa zozobra se suma el bajo poder adquisitivo de los clientes. El público disfruta y admira el producto, pero al abrir la billetera prefiere una rebanada o algo más sencillo.

---

---

https://images.ecency.com/DQmNwiCm64T4cYHmA6TFcVFcRonVnVxVYjosRrSM4hYMtkM/1775737206958.jpg

---

---

Los productos de pastelería no son una necesidad, son un lujo; solo existimos porque son un elemento que forma parte de los festejos, regalos o anhelos de una persona.

Sin embargo, el número de reposteros no ha dejado de crecer. Lo que antes era un oficio de pocos se ha vuelto una marea de cuentas de Instagram y Facebook. Cada nuevo emprendimiento que abre parece una puerta que se abre a nuestro desarrollo.

Paradójicamente, esa misma duda puede darnos ideas nuevas para poder subsistir. 
La duda no desaparecerá. Seguirá allí, en cada amanecida, en cada espera de un encargo. La duda desaparece cuando un cliente envía un mensaje o publica su gratitud por el producto que recibió.

---

---

https://images.ecency.com/DQmdfNvsgjJ5zMByqEnQqqPTaPihKnPHSXNYexd2LGTnhVr/1775737383594.jpg

---

---

Ante la incertidumbre del mercado, dudar es una respuesta lógica. En un emprendimiento de pastelería, factores como la volatilidad del precio de los insumos, los cambios en los hábitos de consumo o la competencia impredecible generan un entorno inestable.

Dudar implica evaluar riesgos y ponerle corazón para seguir adelante. Esa inquietud no es debilidad, sino un mecanismo racional de supervivencia. Quien no duda ante lo imprevisible ignora señales vitales. Así, la incertidumbre no anula la pasión por la repostería; más bien, exige cautela estratégica.

---

---

https://images.ecency.com/DQmScfhq1Jfry9nXi6g3znhZJkgG4F6Tn5uRwZTGeu5NbRS/1775818678314.jpg

---

---

Recordemos que un emprendimiento exitoso se construye pisando con cuidado sobre terreno movedizo.
***
***
https://images.ecency.com/DQmfFnEMCYnFkP4yn3RAjCC5Yi2Bw4pZMYk2wKE2HWeExdE/1739658658260.jpg

<sub>Gracias por visitar mi blog. Soy crítica de arte, investigadora social y amante de la cocina. Te invito a conocer más de mí, de mi país y de mis letras. Texto y fotos de mi propiedad.</sub>

https://images.ecency.com/DQmfAxqWjfHD2t6iFUv1FivzQTFzsMmbGqywoexFuT14L8s/1750582840520.jpg



**Doubt, the baker's inevitable companion**

A hug to all entrepreneurs and friends of the blockchain. From my baker's soul and this community @Beentrepreneur, I invite you to delve into another facet of an entrepreneur.

---

---

https://images.ecency.com/DQmdDaGumfi7x3K48ww2gGbQwFrcTBUqbSU4NWZPSDCwBAm/1775737172136.jpg

---

---

When baking and decorating a cake, few pastry entrepreneurs imagine that doubt will settle into their soul with the same certainty that leavening makes the dough rise. That feeling arrives when we least expect it and, truth be told, we don't need it: doubt.

It's not a matter of lack of talent or passion. The consequence of a hostile environment turns every product into a gamble. Even when we don't wish to compete with others, competition imposes itself because such are the laws of the market. Without getting into judging details about people who, with very little faith, say things like: \

---

---

https://images.ecency.com/DQmZZ9k1X7KZeKGbcxw6kKWf21941LAWjZS5RX6r8yw22eT/1775652875345.jpg

---

---

The scarcity of raw materials is the first blow to confidence. When flour, sugar, eggs and other supplies double in price overnight, or chocolate becomes scarce due to import problems, the Cuban baker wonders if this trade truly is the answer.

I ask myself: do I raise prices and risk losing customers, or do I lower the quality and betray my essence? Each purchase becomes an agonizing calculation, and uncertainty settles beneath the skin.

Added to this anguish is the low purchasing power of customers. The public enjoys and admires the product, but when they open their wallets, they prefer a single slice or something simpler.

---

---

https://images.ecency.com/DQmNwiCm64T4cYHmA6TFcVFcRonVnVxVYjosRrSM4hYMtkM/1775737206958.jpg

---

---

Pastry products are not a necessity; they are a luxury. We only exist because they are an element of celebrations, gifts, or people's desires.

However, the number of bakers has not stopped growing. What was once a trade for few has become a tide of Instagram and Facebook accounts. Every new venture that opens seems like a door opening to our own development.

Paradoxically, that very doubt can give us new ideas to survive. Doubt will not disappear. It will remain there, at every dawn, while waiting for an order. Doubt disappears when a customer sends a message or posts their gratitude for the product they received.

---

---

https://images.ecency.com/DQmdfNvsgjJ5zMByqEnQqqPTaPihKnPHSXNYexd2LGTnhVr/1775737383594.jpg

---

---

In the face of market uncertainty, doubting is a logical response. In a pastry business, factors such as the volatility of input prices, changes in consumption habits, or unpredictable competition generate an unstable environment.

Doubting implies evaluating risks and putting your heart into moving forward. That unease is not weakness, but a rational survival mechanism. He who does not doubt when facing the unpredictable ignores vital signals. Thus, uncertainty does not nullify the passion for baking; rather, it demands strategic caution.

---

---

https://images.ecency.com/DQmScfhq1Jfry9nXi6g3znhZJkgG4F6Tn5uRwZTGeu5NbRS/1775818678314.jpg

---

---

Let us remember that a successful business is built by treading carefully on shaky ground.

***
***

ich habe in letzter Zeit eine Menge Zeit darein gesteckt mir näher die Angebote der Supermärkte und Discounter anzuschauen und habe dabei festgestellt, wenn ich mich so eindecke das Haltbare Lebensmittel die ich oft brauche auf 6-9 Monate auf Vorrat da habe, habe ich im Fall der Fälle immerhin für etwa 4-6 Wochen Lebensmittel, auf der anderen Seite spart man sich vor allem in der heutigen Zeit eine Menge Geld. Manchmal denke ich mir das viele Sachen heute so viel kosten, wenn sie im Angebot sind wie vor 2-3 Jahren noch als normaler Preis. 

Manchmal denke ich mir, wie die Preise so stark steigen konnten. Ich meine Pesto kostet inzwischen teilweise einfach 4 Euro für eine Dose und ich habe im Studium noch einen Euro dafür gezahlt und das ist erst einige Jahre her. 

Mal schauen wo sich das alles noch hinentwickelt. Aber durch gezieltes Vorbereiten und gezielten Einkauf kann man eine Menge Geld sparen. Vor allem wenn man keine taktische Nahrung kauft, damit kann man zur Vorbereitung im Privaten Raum ordentlich Geld verbrennen. 

In dem Sinne, gehabt euch wohl. Ich hoffe das ich bald mehr Zeit habe hier wieder aktiver zu werden, aber aktuell ist es eine komplizierte Situation.

Hello hi everyone how are you greetings to all of you and welcome to my another recipe blog. I hope you guys all are well and enjoying yummy food 😊. So today I cooked very special vegetable **Bauhinia with beef mince**. It's very delicious Qeema kachnar recipe of this season. It's also very healthy and good for health. I want to share my recipe with all of you so let's start the process. 

**Ingredients**

Half kg kachnar 

Half kg beef mince 

Onions 

Tomato 

Green chillies 

Ginger garlic 

**Spices**

Salt 

Turmeric 

Red chilli 

Chilli flakes 

Black pepper 

Garam masala 

Dry grind coriander 

Green coriander 

**Process**

First I took vegetable washed it I understand water. It's also looking very beautiful Bauhinia in Pink and green colour.

title.title: How to Future-Proof Your Binary Trading Platform with Modular Design
title.body:
>When you start using a binary options trading platform, everything feels promising at first. Trades go through, features are easy to use, and nothing really feels complicated.
But as you keep using it, you might start noticing a few things

\n\n*

>Some actions take longer than before

\n*

>Small changes do not feel as simple

\n*

>Certain parts of the platform feel harder to manage

You might even wonder, Why is this happening now? What changed as the platform grew? In this blog, let’s look at what actually causes this and where things start to slow down.

>Where Do Binary Options Trading Platforms Struggle at Scale? As more users start using the platform, things begin to shift behind the scenes. It is not one big issue but small ones that build up over time. A single change in one area can affect other parts of the system. This happens because different functions are closely tied together. As activity increases, updates also start becoming more complex. Rather than focusing on a single feature, it is necessary to adjust multiple areas simultaneously. Over time, this slows down how quickly teams can work. This is because every change depends on too many interconnected parts.

>How Modular Design Helps Future-Proof Your Binary Trading Platform? When a binary options trading platform is built with a modular design, it stops behaving like one large system and starts acting like connected smaller parts. In modern [**binary options trading software development**](https://www.hashcodex.com/binary-option-trading-software-development), this kind of structure is what helps platforms stay easier to manage as they grow. So instead of looking at it only as a structure, let's look at how it behaves when the platform grows in real conditions. **Better handling of high activity and system load** During high-activity periods, only the required components, such as trade processing or data handling, can be scaled, instead of increasing the load across the entire system. **Easier adoption of new technologies** New tools or improvements can be added to specific modules without changing the full platform, which makes upgrades less disruptive. **Controlled system behavior during failures** If one part of the platform faces a problem, it does not affect the rest of the system, which helps in handling failures in a controlled way. **Faster development and release cycles** Different teams can work on separate modules at the same time, which reduces dependency and speeds up development work. **Simpler handling of compliance and market changes** You can handle updates related to compliance, regional requirements, or market-specific changes in individual modules without affecting the core system. So instead of treating the platform as one heavy system, modular design allows it to grow in smaller, manageable parts that adapt as the business changes. That is what makes the difference when the platform starts to scale.

>What changes in day-to-day development with modular design? With modular architecture, development does not feel like working on one large system all the time. When something needs to change, developers can focus only on that specific area without touching everything else. This makes updates feel more direct and less risky to handle. It also becomes easier to introduce new tools or features because they can be added to the system without disturbing what is already running. Even maintenance becomes simpler since issues can be tracked back to one specific part instead of searching across the entire platform.

>What Makes a Binary Options Trading Platform Truly Future-Ready? By now, you can see the pattern. When a platform builds in smaller parts, it makes changes easier to handle. But what really decides whether a platform is future-ready is how it adapts when new needs come in. This is exactly where a structured approach like modular design, used by companies such as Hashcodex, helps in shaping binary options trading platforms that are easier to evolve. Instead of getting stuck every time something changes, a future-ready platform demonstrates it through simple actions like these: * It handles updates in one area without disturbing the rest of the system * It allows new integrations like payments or tools without rewriting existing flows * It reduces pressure on teams by keeping changes more focused and less connected * It grows step by step without needing a full system rebuild Over time, this approach makes the platform easier to work with, not because change disappears, but because change becomes manageable.

>Building a binary options trading platform is not just about getting it live. What matters is how well it keeps up as things change.

Because in the end, you are not just building something for today. You are building something that can keep moving with what comes next.

So if you are planning to build or improve a binary options trading platform, the way it is designed from the start will decide how far it can go later.

Looking to build a platform that can grow without constant rebuilds?

Connect with a team that knows how to shape it the right way.

title.title: Delicious sautéed carrots for breakfast [ENG||ESP]
title.body: > My breakfasts tend to vary, but there’s one simple combination I really like: carrots and onions. This combination is nutritious and tasty, and you can make it with the ingredients raw or sautéed.

> You can also add other delicious flavours; I sautéed the carrots and onions with parsley and garlic butter, which adds flavour and aroma. I’ve served these vegetables on flatbread, which is easy to make, and here’s how to make it at home.
INGREDIENTS
 - Flatbread: 1 kg wheat flour, 20 g salt, 50 g lard, 500 ml water. - Sautéed carrots: 1 carrot, 1 onion, 1 tablespoon of garlic butter (chopped raw garlic, chopped parsley, butter and garlic paste), 1 tablespoon of oil, boiled egg, sesame seeds and salt.
PROCEDURE

> Making flatbread is easy; I like to have them ready and stored in the fridge. You just heat them up a little and they can be eaten with any protein, stew or vegetable stir-fry. To make them, place the flour in a bowl, add salt and lard, mix these ingredients together and add the water.
> Knead until you have a firm dough that is easy to handle. Shape into balls of 45–46 grams, then flatten them with a rolling pin or a tortilla press; this makes 30 small flatbreads.
> Cook them quickly on a hot griddle or frying pan, on both sides. Sautéed carrots: Cut the carrots into very thin strips and julienne the onion.
> Heat the parsley butter and oil in a frying pan, add the onion, then the carrots, and sauté. Season with salt and pepper.

> This combination is perfect for adding any type of protein; I added a boiled egg and a teaspoon of standard mayonnaise to give it a bit of creaminess. To finish, I added sesame seeds; you can also add chopped parsley.

>

THANK YOU FOR YOUR VISIT AND FOR LIVING THIS ADVENTURE OF PASSION AND LOVE FOR FOOD!

 • The content is original • The images are my property *** ***
SPANISH

> Mis desayunos suelen ser variados, hay una combinación sencilla que me gusta mucho, es la unión de zanahoria con cebolla, esta combinación es nutritiva y sabrosa, se puede hacer con los ingredientes crudos o salteados.

> También puedes agregar más sabores deliciosos, yo hice el salteado de zanahoria y cebolla con mantequilla de perejil y ajo, esto aporta sabor y aroma. He servido estos vegetales sobre un pan plano, fácil de hacer y aquí te muestro cómo elaborarlo en casa.
INGREDIENTES
- Pan plano: 1 kilo de harina de trigo, 20 gramos de sal, 50 gramos de manteca de cerdo, 500 ml de agua. - Salteado de zanahoria: 1 zanahoria, 1 cebolla, 1 cucharada de mantequilla de ajo (ajo crudo picado, perejil picado, mantequilla y pasta de ajo), 1 cucharada de aceite, huevo cocido, semillas de sésamo y sal.
PROCEDIMIENTO

> Hacer pan plano es fácil, me gusta tenerlos listos y guardados en la nevera, solo se calientan un poco y se pueden consumir con cualquier proteína, guiso o un salteado de vegetales. Para hacerlos colocamos la harina en un bowl, añadimos sal y manteca, unir éstos ingredientes y agregar el agua

> Amasamos hasta que se logré una masa compacta y fácil de manipular. Hacemos bolitas de 45 - 46 gramos, luego hacemos la forma plana con un rodillo o un aplastador de tortillas, obtenemos 30 panes planos pequeños.
> Se cocinan rápidamente en una plancha o sartén caliente, por ambos lados. Salteado de zanahoria: Cortar la zanahoria en tiras muy delgadas, la cebolla la cortamos en juliana.
> En un sartén caliente colocamos la mantequilla de perejil y el aceite, añadimos la cebolla, luego la zanahoria y salteamos, terminamos con sal y pimienta.

> La combinación es perfecta para agregar cualquier tipo de proteína, yo le coloque huevo cocido y una cucharadita de mayonesa común para que se sienta un poquito de cremosidad, para finalizar le agrego semillas de sésamo, puedes colocar perejil picado también.

>

title.title: Stressful Clearance Signing & New Haircut
title.body:
Good day, everyone! For the past few days, I’ve been busy completing my errands for graduation. In this blog, I’m going to share how that day went. It was quite stressful since I had to process my documents. Yet, rest assured that it almost went seamless. As a graduating student, you know the struggle on completing the clearance alongside the fees with it. Without further ado, let’s dive right in.

# Arrival at My Alma Mater

![IMG_20260408_132519_594.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iamboring/23xVPTs1W4JXeihdhwauQ9Dk6Vgqby5MJ6FbHVm5tp78VqUfgs7NQnkH2RJ8mbm4PhDJg.jpg)

Before I arrived at my alma mater, I was arguing with my parents about my documents. I’m glad that I had copies of what they were looking for, like my Form 138, Good Moral, and Form 137. I already knew I had them, and I’m grateful that they weren’t lost or damaged. The PSA would just be photocopied anyway.

Unfortunately, I only had a photocopy of my Form 137. My parents said it was already okay to submit it that way. However, my friends disagreed since the school requires the original copy when I was about to ask it on our school GC. I was also unsure if I needed to have a request coming from the school or just persuade them. In addition, I also heard from my friend that the Good Moral certificate expires. That's why, I needed to get a new one. In the end, I didn’t follow my parents, and I’m glad I trusted my instincts.

Supposedly, I should have gone with my cousin and his mother. However, they didn’t inform me as they already processed it earlier. Before arriving at my former school, I called my aunt and asked if my cousin had already secured the documents. Thankfully, their registrar considered it even without the Request Form from the school. Yet, they gave a condition that I should send the required files through Facebook immediately. To make the story short, I was able to secure the original documents I need and proceeded to school.

# Going to the School

Sorry if I don’t have pictures of the school. Anyway, I went straight to the registrar to ask for the clearance. I was supposed to submit my documents right away, but I needed to photocopy everything first. Since I had no choice, I went to the nearest printing shop and completed the copies. After that, I successfully submitted them and asked for confirmation if I could proceed with the signing.

I didn’t capture all the steps, but I first had my clearance signed at the library. Then, I went to my adviser (which should have been the Dean) for another signature. After that, I proceeded to the CSDL to complete another requirement.

![IMG_20260408_155644_153.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iamboring/245n1RwkXUC3zC5JLBkoxLGLXTCJc45TDD3hvBLdgZ7X6Ve8JGbtmMDhSXEfAaZoMFpYH.jpg)

When I went to the Finance Department, they told me that I needed to pay the fees first before they could sign it. So, I left the school and planned to return once my uncle sent the money.

While I was already in the XLT, I was surprised that my uncle sent the money for my graduation fees. I immediately got off and went back to school. It was exhausting to walk under the heat, but I’m glad I hadn’t paid the driver yet. I withdrew the money from the ATM and returned to the Finance Department.

To make the story short, my transaction there was successful. I just waited for a couple of minutes and they signed my clearance. After that, I went back to the registrar for final validation. I was a bit annoyed since I waited for a long time, only for them to ask me to photocopy the receipt again outside. Thankfully, there wasn’t a long line that time.

I also asked them about my friend (who is also my classmate) if she had any missing records. Fortunately, she only needed her Form 137 and Good Moral. Meanwhile, my cousin missed everything. So yeah, this errand was really exhausting, but at least I managed to complete my requirements.

# New Haircut

![IMG_20260408_174924_858.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iamboring/23u5bYE5Zd9GxZKuGwBf7yxN92Gine3QbhFq7wtKg1XN8bHYSiq2PA4Y42RnJ2CMFZuAw.jpg)

I also had my new haircut since I want to look presentable for my graduation picture. Thank you for reading!

title.title: When I Want to Cry, I Don't Cry [Review] ESP/ENG
title.body:
![Presentación biografía de personaje histórico importante vintage scrapbook beis y marron.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/victor2356/23w366oUmfujLunYqjZ8CqpNzQacvviEAQYYG9V5Pkxov3aG7UoLscsWQj6pEXYAvVY8t.jpg)
(Imagen hecha con el editor de canva) >Image made with the Canva editor

Today I'm going to talk to you about another of the great stories by the great Venezuelan author Miguel Otero Silva, called: \

I remember reading this novel when I was in high school, although I studied in the adult education system. At that time, we had to read the work and analyze it in depth in order to then submit a kind of detailed review to the teacher. And since I was so busy with other subjects and work, I didn't put too much emphasis on my review; I barely did what was necessary to get a good grade. But now that I've sat down calmly to read this work, I realize its enormous value and potential.\n\n>Hoy les voy a hablar de una más de las grandiosas historias del gran autor venezolano Miguel Otero Silva, llamada: \

Recuerdo que yo leí esta novela cuando estaba en la secundaria, aunque yo estudié en el sistema para adultos, en ese entonces debíamos leer la obra y analizarla a profundidad para luego entregar al profesor una especie de reseña detallada, y como yo estaba tan ocupado entre las otras materias y el trabajo, no enfaticé demasiado en mi reseña, apenas hice lo necesario para ganar una buena calificación, pero ahora que me senté con calma a leer esta obra me doy cuenta de su enorme valor y potencial.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/victor2356/23w36SAWmcGg6ahmuAWUYrysUycnLRW3rKhgvMQndvy7U4EkpWpAEShCVXoq7pKw5JcjU.png)
[Fuente](https://www.iberlibro.com/quiero-llorar-lloro-Novela-OTERO-SILVA/15349575932/bd)

The book is set in 1960s Venezuela. It all begins with a prophecy that marks the destiny of three young men who share the same birth date and the same name, \

but belong to very different social strata and contexts: one is poor, another is middle class, and the last is rich. But despite their differences, they all share the same tragic destiny.

\n\n>El libro está ambientado en la Venezuela de los años 60, todo comienza con una profecía que marca el destino de tres jóvenes que comparten la misma fecha de nacimiento y el mismo nombre \

pero pertenecen a estratos sociales y contextos muy diferentes, uno es Pobre, el otro es de clase media y el último es rico, pero a pesar de sus diferencias todos comparten un mismo destino trágico.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/victor2356/23xyb8ojkiEZmfhcyKD3XyPMsBwiu2y8RzjUmCTX4BARifF5J6PrpMyzTvhPNkQ8CAsio.png)
[Fuente](https://in.pinterest.com/pin/1106196727226318358/)

As is customary in Miguel Otero Silva's novels, this one reflects his dissatisfaction with the system; it is a kind of denunciation, showing that the change from dictatorship to democracy did not eliminate violence but rather transformed it into something constitutional. The \

of that time was not far removed from the dictatorship they had just left behind. On the other hand, it reflects how the lack of opportunities affects all social strata, although in very different ways.

\n\n>Como ya es costumbre en las novelas de Miguel Otero Silva, esta refleja su inconformidad con el sistema, es una especie de denuncia, evidenciando que el cambio de dictadura a democracia no eliminó la violencia sino que la transformó en algo constitucional, la \

de esa época no distaba mucho de la dictadura que acaban de dejar atrás, por otra parte refleja como la falta de oportunidades afectan a todos los estratos, aunque de una manera muy diferente.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/victor2356/23xeziWdYw2csxWzRJPX38zdffr4AnrKiQj7MVgkujqrz2YmGtkSfQMySR3SqVYExrz6R.png)
[Fuente](https://in.pinterest.com/pin/159877855517771848/)

The author's skill in addressing such dark and serious themes as violence with touches of satire and humor is striking, as it somehow lightens the emotional burden. It's a way of explaining how the oil boom, while bringing a sense of progress, didn't represent any real change to the political and social structure. Inequality and a lack of opportunities persisted, corruption flourished in an atmosphere of impunity, and all of this created the perfect breeding ground for the fate of the Victorinos.

>Llama la atención la habilidad del autor para tocar temas tan oscuros y serios como lo es la violencia con toques de sátira y humor para, de alguna manera, aligerar la carga emocional. Es una manera de explicar como el auge del petróleo, si bien trajo aires de progreso esto no representaba ningún cambio para la estructura política y social, seguía habiendo desigualdad y falta de oportunidades, la corrupción floreciendo en un ambiente de impunidad, y todo esto es el caldo de cultivo perfecto para el destino de los Victorinos.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/victor2356/23wgYEVMbXn9NnXSvoem2Bb7WKrMHnJ49YkMvKC99GiiZDYcoyz9avQeXVwP6NTCaDPC1.png)
[Fuente](https://in.pinterest.com/pin/52917364349956788/)

The progress that urbanized the country with the oil boom generated ambition, corruption, and abrupt social changes that affected many people. There was mismanagement of wealth, and this obviously greatly favored the elite. In fact, this is evident in the way the authorities view and analyze crimes according to the economic status of the offenders: if it is a rich person, it is considered a \
or a felony, but if it is a poor person, it is an \

\n\n>El Progreso que urbanizó el pais con el auge petrolero generó ambiciones, corrupción y abruptos cambios sociales que afectaron a muchas personas, hubo mala administración de riquezas y esto obviamente favoreció mucho a la élite, de hecho se evidencia en la forma que tiene la autoridad de ver y analizar los delitos según el estatus económico de los infractores, si es un rico se considera una \
una felonía, pero si es alguien pobre es un \

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/victor2356/23u6BsPToDyvA3AmAn1pDKkmApbsfUKoprAs1FpTkjzkiC2ncZwqFqryhqqVqydUiU97N.png)
[Fuente](https://in.pinterest.com/pin/224968943860913713/)

As always, I greatly appreciated the author's narrative style, which prominently features Venezuelan vernacular, a way of connecting with the people. It's a very personal and natural style. The plot's pacing is excellent and undoubtedly keeps the reader engaged throughout, as everyone is eager to know exactly what will happen to the trio of Victorinos.

>Como siempre aprecié mucho el estilo narrativo del autor donde resalta mucho el léxico popular venezolano, como una manera de empatizar con el pueblo, ese es un estilo muy suyo, muy natural. El ritmo de la trama es muy bueno y sin dudas mantiene en todo momento la atención del lector, ya que todos desean que es lo que sucederá exactamente con la triada de Victorinos.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/victor2356/23y92XtjwAX6siTQMM5Zpoci6TPGzZwrTXMXPC5pEfXcF4iqZNvaVn98tUbua4ZzotziX.png)
[Fuente](https://comunicacionsocial.org.ar/cuando-quiero-llorar-no-lloro-un-clasico-venezolano/)

Thank you for reading this review, and I sincerely invite you to read this great work so that you can draw your own conclusions.

>Gracias por leer esta reseña y sinceramente los invito a leer esta gran obra para que ustedes saquen sus propias conclusiones.

title.title: Enjoying the Park  (ESP/ENG)
title.body:
![Una Semana Conmigo Miniatura YouTube Collage Marrón y Blanco.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23vsNP7cuFBEPCTQQsCJ3DUkUJC8KTcU8UjnCVpQkPwaYWDASXJwHE8WvASZEU7cm4wS9.jpg)
(Cover designed by me in canva editor)
>Portada diseñada por mi en el editor de Canva
![el oráculo de delfos (2).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/242P4XEQgHtgU4xago2qyQqcfnSWZEzb8nga4v6qemaQpLwvxjHRk1B1pzubPTFvBMufN.jpg)

On my tour today, I want to take you to a very special place in the city of Valencia, Venezuela. It's called Parque Negra Hipólita, and it's something like a green lung for the city, a faint vestige of what the city looked like before urbanization and progress arrived. It's a beautiful place full of grass, trees, bamboo, and even a river, which, although polluted today and not at its best, was once abundant, crystal clear, and beautiful.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-01 at 10.28.49 AM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/EoGxVDUUxPa7eDZ26gP25XJEYCmGfB5gEi8UABdiyQjYvhfEGFNCqzxRHKud9goUWfB.jpeg)

I went there with my family during the Easter break in search of some fresh air and also as an escape from the daily grind. We had a wonderful day eating fried chicken surrounded by trees and nature. I know, I know fried chicken isn't exactly a picnic food 😄, but we were all really craving it. Plus, while we were there, we ran into one of my cousins, so she joined our picnic and we had a lovely time. She told us some funny stories and we enjoyed ourselves. We also took the opportunity to relax, lulled by the gentle breeze and the birdsong.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-01 at 10.28.54 AM (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/EpGRkH2X24dprrrh5WQEjcGxpKYhnArgfkaG9jP93nYviDcgBKMe9Py5qkjaYcwiZ4X.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-01 at 10.28.55 AM (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/EowGeBJrpPQ1ATRUsEX67iaknUVzMxyT6xSMFkgjzrn3e3Zt8bJJvJ8uMMcoStp7kdn.jpeg)

During our visit to the park, we made a very important discovery. We know the wildlife there is very diverse, but it's not so easy to spot the animals. However, we were able to see and photograph none other than a capybara, or chiguire, as we call them here in my country (Venezuela). This one was very small, and we were surprised not to see it with its mother. Where was she? Perhaps looking for food for her baby?

![ut.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/EonnyTGk5LuQNUtH4UJQb6Egexs5hDjTQYebyFJt7TiJeps21wVp3GDJeXWCiTSTfeC.jpg)

In the forest area there are centuries-old trees, hence its name \

and something that I think is a great touch is that many of these trees have a QR code at the base of the trunk with all the information about each tree such as its scientific name and its age.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-01 at 10.28.17 AM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23vsDhPjnVfVvJLsPp4SN7R6mQKVPbQGoXz9e3kDLeyHddfj3sokzKFremsK6ztzimN1X.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-01 at 8.39.58 AM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/Eoc8R9vQXPW27WbyfP4oNpSNrg4rtuxQhngQvJR4J5uo74nNGfD28Mt4nB6GCrTfq9u.jpeg)

This is one of the bridges in the wooded area of ​​the park; it spans the Cabriales River. It used to have laminated wooden planks, but they've changed the design to concrete. Even though I preferred it in wood, it still offers a beautiful view of the area.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-01 at 10.28.37 AM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23wqfx2J3Hv3BoYHGHshdGgVAnDd6qGnYCJ5mKa3NAD5teSeqw7c5ezkRKk9AKUpp6dwG.jpeg)

This is definitely my favorite area of ​​the whole forest. It's those beautiful streams that bring freshness and beauty. The sound of the water is very relaxing, as is the sound of the birds. It's also possible to see iguanas from time to time in this area, but unfortunately I wasn't lucky enough to find one. It's not that I like these animals very much, but I would have liked to photograph them.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-01 at 10.28.51 AM (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/Eoc5fVHrgMdj95D25Lmz7xtv2NCvvgjurkmpUgHvvkPmutwx6QiudbksumQ1GuawW2b.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-01 at 10.28.52 AM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/EoeEsekHQP6vHQ7qsKzharapMsgijmG4A4G7wGmbCiMtMEHCJKtFGaqKVNmyJeLTFSd.jpeg)

As always, it was a great pleasure for me to have brought you here to contemplate, at least virtually, the beauties of my city. Thank you very much for your attention.

![Presentación Propuesta de Proyecto Portfolio Scrapbook Marrón y Negro.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23wqwC8G3pmfAmUg1E61Zg3gUWbUypQbajqdteMGTFid9mWcYbLuHqe1kY7FxJ8zAiMM5.jpg)
(Image designed by me in canva editor)
>Imagen diseñada por mi en el editor de Canva.

All images in this post are my own, taken with a ZTE Blade A51.

![el oráculo de delfos.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/242Dk5j5kuDpoV5s41wSWQQ3BHDPLimcGY87RtASkdPuhWzwrYVEqWmjBACxdr55bb9ai.jpg)

En mi paseo de hoy quiero llevarlos a un lugar muy especial en la ciudad de Valencia, Venezuela, se llama Parque Negra Hipólita es algo así como un pulmón verde de la ciudad, un ligero vestigio de como lucía la ciudad antes de que llegara el urbanismo y progreso. Es un hermoso lugar lleno de pasto, árboles, bambúes y hasta un río, que si bien hoy en día está contaminado y no ofrece el mejor aspecto, en su momento fue caudaloso, cristalino y hermoso.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-01 at 10.28.49 AM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/EoGxVDUUxPa7eDZ26gP25XJEYCmGfB5gEi8UABdiyQjYvhfEGFNCqzxRHKud9goUWfB.jpeg)

Fui allí con mi familia durante el asueto de Semana Santa en búsqueda de un poco de aire fresco y también como un escape de la rutina diaria. así que pasamos un día grandioso comiendo pollo frito en medio de árboles y naturaleza, lo sé, sé que el pollo frito no es precisamente una comida de picnic 😄, pero todos teníamos muchas ganas de comerlo, pero además, estando allá nos encontramos con una de mis primas, así que ella se unió a nuestro picnic y pasamos un rato agradable, ella contándonos algunas anécdotas graciosas y nosotros divirtiéndonos. Pero también aprovechamos para descansar arrullados por la suave brisa y el canto de las aves.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-01 at 10.28.54 AM (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/EpGRkH2X24dprrrh5WQEjcGxpKYhnArgfkaG9jP93nYviDcgBKMe9Py5qkjaYcwiZ4X.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-01 at 10.28.55 AM (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/EowGeBJrpPQ1ATRUsEX67iaknUVzMxyT6xSMFkgjzrn3e3Zt8bJJvJ8uMMcoStp7kdn.jpeg)

En nuestro recorrido por el parque hicimos un hallazgo muy importante, sabemos que la fauna de ese lugar es muy variada, pero no es tan fácil divisar a los animales, sin embargo pudimos ver y fotografiar nada más y nada menos que un capibara, o chigüire, como les llamamos aquí en mi país (Venezuela) Este era muy pequeño y nos extrañó no verlo junto a su madre. ¿Dónde estaría ella? ¿Tal vez buscando comida para su bebé?

![ut.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/EonnyTGk5LuQNUtH4UJQb6Egexs5hDjTQYebyFJt7TiJeps21wVp3GDJeXWCiTSTfeC.jpg)

En la zona del bosque se encuentran árboles centenarios, de allí su nombre \

y algo que me parece un gran acierto es que muchos de estos árboles tienen en la base del tronco un código QR con toda la información de cada árbol como su nombre científico y la edad que tiene.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-01 at 10.28.17 AM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23vsDhPjnVfVvJLsPp4SN7R6mQKVPbQGoXz9e3kDLeyHddfj3sokzKFremsK6ztzimN1X.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-01 at 8.39.58 AM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/Eoc8R9vQXPW27WbyfP4oNpSNrg4rtuxQhngQvJR4J5uo74nNGfD28Mt4nB6GCrTfq9u.jpeg)

Este es uno de los puentes que tiene el parque en la zona boscosa, está por encima del río Cabriales. Antes solía tener tablas de madera laminada pero ahora cambiaron el diseño a concreto, pero aunque yo lo prefería de madera, sigue ofreciendo una bonita vista al lugar.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-01 at 10.28.37 AM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23wqfx2J3Hv3BoYHGHshdGgVAnDd6qGnYCJ5mKa3NAD5teSeqw7c5ezkRKk9AKUpp6dwG.jpeg)

Definitivamente esta es mi zona favorita de todo el bosque, son esos arroyos tan bonitos que aportan frescura y belleza, el sonido del agua es muy relajante al igual que el sonido de los pájaros, también es posible ver iguanas de vez en cuando en esta zona, pero lamentablemente no tuve la suerte de encontrar alguna, no es que me gusten mucho estos animales pero me hubiese gustado fotografiarlos.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-01 at 10.28.51 AM (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/Eoc5fVHrgMdj95D25Lmz7xtv2NCvvgjurkmpUgHvvkPmutwx6QiudbksumQ1GuawW2b.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-01 at 10.28.52 AM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/EoeEsekHQP6vHQ7qsKzharapMsgijmG4A4G7wGmbCiMtMEHCJKtFGaqKVNmyJeLTFSd.jpeg)

Como siempre para mi fue un gran placer haberlos traído a contemplar, al menos virtualmente, las bellezas de mi ciudad. Muchas gracias por su atención.

![Presentación Propuesta de Proyecto Portfolio Scrapbook Marrón y Negro.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23wqwC8G3pmfAmUg1E61Zg3gUWbUypQbajqdteMGTFid9mWcYbLuHqe1kY7FxJ8zAiMM5.jpg)
