title.body:
![Yellow, Pink and Blue Colorful Animated Comic Pop Art Presentation.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23xAbqJAHnPTEktbz1uAxU8kY2aYiiNDKAJQRdwMG9HWwNiBE2fyP3fh9tQxh5hUe4dsf.jpg)

Hey internet people! How are you? Today I bring you a selection of what I consider my favorite anime characters for various reasons. They are characters that have nothing to do with each other and in fact are from completely different universes, but each one in its essence is fascinating, for one reason or another. >¡Hola gente de internet! ¿Cómo están? hoy les traigo una selección de los que considero mis personajes de anime preferidos por diversas razones, son personajes que no tienen nada que ver entre si y de hecho son de universos completamente diferentes pero cada uno en su esencia es fascinante, por algunas razones o por otras.

Jiraiya

Naruto is an anime I really enjoyed, despite its large number of filler episodes. Its characters are incredibly diverse, so we could discuss them all in several endless posts. Therefore, for this occasion, I'll only talk about one of them. Later, if you'd like, we can delve deeper into more characters from this universe. But I love Jiraiya-san because he's a different kind of teacher. Of course, he focuses on important aspects like jutsu, but he's primarily concerned with providing his students with a philosophical education. He's not the typical terse mentor we're used to seeing. No, Jiraiya has unconventional methods and an eccentric personality that can seem contradictory. While he spends his time spying on and following women, deep down he's a character with a strong ethical compass. Furthermore, his story arc with Orochimaru and Tsunade is very interesting to me.

>Naruto es un anime que me gustó mucho, a pesar de su gran cantidad de episodios de relleno, sus personajes son muy variados, así que podríamos hablar de todos ellos en varios post interminables, por lo tanto por esta ocasión hablaré de solo uno de ellos, después, si ustedes quieren podemos profundizar en más personajes de este universo. Pero a mi me encanta Jiraiya San porque es un maestro diferente, osea, claro que se centra en aspectos importantes como los jutsus, pero principalmente se preocupa por proporcionar una formación filosófica en sus alumnos, pero no es el típico mentor parco que por lo general estamos acostumbrados a ver, no, Jiraiya tiene métodos poco convencionales y una personalidad excéntrica la cual puede resultar contradictoria, porque si bien se la pasa espiando y siguiendo mujeres, en el fondo es uno de los personajes con un gran valor ético, además su arco narrativo junto a Orochimaru y Tsunade me parece muy interesante
https://youtu.be/Kg9iS1sQziU
[Fuente](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Kg9iS1sQziU)

Muzan Kibutsuji

He's one of the best villains in Demon Slayer, a calculating personality with immense power, which makes him cold and all the more dangerous, like Voldemort in Harry Potter. I've always said this character reminds me a lot of him, because of his extreme narcissism and great cunning. But on top of all that, he knows very well how to manipulate and ensnare people to get what he wants. However, one thing that works against him is his emotional immaturity; he doesn't know how to channel his frustration when things aren't going his way. He's a complex and unusual character, which is why I love him, because he makes his battles truly interesting to watch. >Es uno de los mejores villanos de Demon Slayer, una personalidad caluculadora y gran poder, lo que lo vuelve frío y más peligroso, como Voldemort en Harry Potter, siempre he dicho que este personaje me recuerda mucho a él, por su narcisimo extramo y su gran astucia, pero ademas de todo sabe muy bien como manipular y envolver a las personas para conseguir lo que quiere, pero digamos que algo que juega en su contra es su inmadurez emocional, no sabe canalizar la frustración cuando siente que las cosas no saen a su favor. Es un personaje complejo y fuera de lo común, por eso me encanta, porque hace que sus batallas sean realmente interesantes de ver.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23wWtfNGzcLXcfaGyYvqSkJZq4iqEWMpF3d1vAFw4EcweTYtieocvs5YqGUtx8SELDc2W.png)
[Fuente](ttps://elcomercio.pe/mag/fama/que-ver/demon-slayer-kimetsu-no-yaiba-cual-es-el-verdadero-objetivo-de-muzan-anime-nnda-nnlt-noticia/)

Lily

This character is completely different from the previous ones. Lily is noble and kind-hearted, far ahead of her time. She fights for her ideals and, regardless of whether her opinion might offend others, she expresses it anyway. She wasn't afraid to cross borders to follow her dreams, nor is she afraid of challenges. Contrary to what many might think, Love Through a Prism isn't just a simple romance anime with cheesy characters. No, this anime is about empowerment in every sense, about daring to go against others' opinions to follow your own path. It's about breaking paradigms and conventions, about daring to be different. Lily can be impulsive and emotional at times, yes, but she also knows how to recognize her mistakes, and that makes her more human and realistic.

>Este es un personaje totalmente diferente a los anteriores, Lily es una noble y de buen corazón, muy adelantada a su tiempo, lucha por sus ideales y sin importar si su opinión puede herir suceptibilidades, de todas maneras la emite, no tuvo miedo de cruzar las fronteras para seguir sus sueños y tampoco le teme a los desafíos. Contrario a lo que muchos pueden opinar Amor a través de un Prisma no es un simple anime sobre romance con personajes cursis, no, este anime habla de empoderamiento en todos los sentidos, de atreverse a ir en contra de las opiniones agenas para seguir su propio rumbo, habla de romper paradigmas y convencionalismos, de atreverse a ser diferente. Lily puede ser impulsiva y emocional en ocasiones, sí, pero también sabe reconocer sus errores y eso la hace más humana y realista.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/EpJa1HDvoiKRUUp9FMKgfGcg1eTKUqN7vV4PTszPAMEXAvanvPsWgJH6jgfTZtGPJog.png)
[Fuente](https://mx.pinterest.com/pin/1060668149755635506/)

And well, people, that's all for today's post, I hope you liked it. Thank you very much as always for supporting my work, I welcome new readers, I love you all very much, I send you a hug and I'll see you in another post.

>Y bueno, gente, esto ha sido todo por el post de hoy, espero que les haya gustado. Muchas gracias como siempre por apoyar mi trabajo, le doy la bienvenida a los nuevos lectores, les quiero mucho a todos, les envío un abrazo y ya nos encontraremos en otro post

title.body: /> Greetings, everyone! I hope you’re all having a wonderful day. Every new day gives us another chance to smile, learn, and appreciate the little things that make life special. title.title: ʟᴜxᴜʀʏ ᴏғ ғɪɴᴀɴᴄɪᴀʟ sᴛᴀʙɪʟɪᴛʏ
title.body:
>
‎In a world where money perform wonders, its impact is still being undermined by most people. The reason is quite simple, most people have never experienced what it feels like to have enough, it is quite sad. Financial stability is a dream of everyone, a dream many might chase till the end of their days and yet not taste what it feels like. We chase financial stability to be able afford our wishes and dreams, this is why it so important because money plays a significant role in turning our dreams into reality.
‎
‎If there is something that haunt my mind, it is definitely ideas. I have and will always continue, to be an ambitious person but it comes with limitations, Which is lack of adequate funds to implement my ideas. So if money is not a limitation? Firstly, I will dive into the archive of my business ideas. It is very tormenting to have rare business ideas and still lack capital to achieve it. Ideas will always remain ideas without funds, but without such limitation, the height of the empire I would establish will go far beyond international but inter-universe kind of trades.
‎
![dimitrisvetsikas1969-yacht-4292334_1920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emrysjobber/23zS9YQ7Y5ALp2zcGetUVRwWpsk55Mozc9pHxLohK6LNfZdwVn9aTEi3YgGRZFArAPW6U.jpg)

‎This is how far my imagination can go, think of Elon musk, he is so wealthy that his influence reaches beyond earth. When you have enough to invest in your ideas, your imagination would not be limited. It wouldn't be a matter of what can I afford but a matter of what do I need.
‎
‎Apart from realizing a stack pile of my business ideas, there are some of my ideas that are not business related, just desires. I have always desired to travel the world to every historical places, land marks across the continent. There is something I have learnt, when a human being is limited to a specific location, so will your imagination. Traveling the world helps increase the level of a person's exposure. 
‎
‎The starting point of my adventure will definitely be Korea. I have mentioned it in a few post before about how much I respect Korea's culture, over the years I have nurtured different kind of aspirations and admiration for some of the sculptures and traditions I have seen in movies. Though it might seem ancient but I am greatly fascinated by how those things come to be. Most of the stories about the foundation of the ancient kingdom of Geogoyeo are mostly portrayed in kdramas,
‎
![7b4bio5hobgtGQKeTeQ5JMBsn2Ut8rLYxjCfDu89BFHxCniLnMKS9vcynZa3FupdHqHbaQfStJY4Nu3zMMexvkQQpKbQ7en1D9jNy6a1yCKHoqNB9k7C2yK4HLu9x3FMZNhU5rt25iYyUtVZMHid2j7NYpgE.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emrysjobber/245cesaZqTzcg8AHMZqXzK7MaR4Z4duYwNnJY2a3uX9K6jd5Pg5qUnUsm1RzpL49N2hgt.webp)

‎Apart from the way Korea is portrayed in movies, I have always been amazed by how they manage to induct modern lifestyle while keeping their cultural heritage in place which is something rare among developing nations. The cultural aspect of Koreans goes beyond their sculptures, drawings, languages, they also carry it along into the modern world.
‎
‎Apart from being fascinated by Koreans culture. I have always desired to get exposed to different cultural practices which differs from the one I was born into. South Korea being a country that preserves cultural heritage, which seems like a nation filled with different kind of artifacts that can only be found in museums. And also take my time to see Statue of King Sejong in central Seoul which I have only seen in movies. 
‎

title.title: I did go out to eat / Yo sí fui a comer
title.body:
As is tradition, we gather at my parents’ house, this time during Holy Week. Before, we used to meet at my maternal grandparents’ house, but now each of my uncles and aunts hosts the gathering at their own homes, serving up cuajado or fish pie and rice pudding or rice with shredded coconut. My maternal family is from San José de Unare, a small town in Guárica on the border with Anzoátegui state in Venezuela, so we’re eastern plains people.

I’ve already told you, dear food lovers, that what I like most about this part of the family is eating, but hey, I also capture moments—hahaha—I say that because this time I woke up at 11:30 a.m.—can you believe it! I overslept in my single bed, and when I got to the kitchen, my mom and sister had already chopped all the ingredients, flaked the tuna, and cooked the vegetables; in other words, they were about to make the stew to assemble and put the pie in the oven.

Wow! I was lucky because at least I managed to take some pictures to share with you while I refreshed the tuna pie recipe.

<h3 style=\

>Ingredients 2 onions 1 bell pepper Chili pepper, scallions, garlic, and salt to taste 100 grams of olives, raisins, and capers Half a kilo of potatoes 250 grams of carrots Half a carton of eggs Breadcrumbs Two ripe bananas 1.5 kilos of tuna >

>Como es tradición nos reunimos en casa de mis padres, esta vez en Semana Santa. Antes, el punto de encuentro era en casa de mis abuelos maternos, ahora, cada uno de mis tíos mantiene la unión en sus casas al sazón del cuajado o pastel de pescado y arroz con leche o con coco rallado. Mi familia materna es de San José de Unare, un pueblito guariqueño frontera con el estado Anzoátegui en Venezuela, así que somos llaneros orientales.

Ya les he contado queridos amantes de la comida que lo que más me gusta de esta parte es comer pero bueno también capturo momentos jajaja lo digo porque esta vez me desperté a las 11:30 am ¡qué barbaridad! dormí demasiado en mi cama de soltera y cuando llegué a la cocina, mi mamá y mi hermana ya tenían todos los aliños cortados, el atún mechado, las verduras cocidas; o sea, estaban a punto de hacer el guiso para armar y llevar el pastel al horno.

¡Guao! de lo que me salvé porque al menos logré tomar algunas imágenes para compartir con ustedes mientras refresqué la receta del pastel de atún.

\n> \n>

>2 cebollas

> > Un pimentón > > Ají, cebollín, ajo y sal al gusto > > 100 gramos de aceitunas, pasas y alcaparras > > Medio kilo de papas > > 250 gramos zanahoria > > Medio cartón de huevos > > Un pan rallado > > Dos plátanos maduros > > Kilo y medio de atún

>Now comes the interesting part... Dice the onion, bell pepper, chili pepper, and garlic. Sauté them one by one in oil with annatto, stirring constantly, and when they become translucent, add the olives, raisins, and capers. Next, add the potato and carrot, which, like the tuna, should already be parboiled and diced. Don’t forget to taste as you go to check the salt. If you like, you can add soy sauce, Worcestershire sauce, pepper, and anything else that enhances the flavor. Let the stew rest and set it aside. Meanwhile, fry the plantains in slices and set them aside; while you beat the eggs with the breadcrumbs. To assemble, grease a deep baking dish with butter and flour. Pour a layer of stew and cover with a layer of fried plantains, and so on until you form a tower. The height will depend on the amount of stew and the size of the dish. Finally, pour the beaten eggs over the top and bake for about 25 minutes. >

>Pican en cubos la cebolla, el pimentón, el ají y el ajo. Sofríen uno a uno en aceite con onoto mientras les mezclan y cuando estén transparentes incorporan la aceituna, pasas y alcaparras. Luego es el turno de la papa y la zanahoria, las cuales, así como el atún, ya deben estar previamente sancochados y picados. No se les olvide ir probando para que sepan cómo van con la sal. Si gustan pueden incorporar salsa de soya, inglesa, pimienta y todo eso que exalta el sabor. Dejan reposar y reservan el guiso.

>
Por otro lado fríen los plátanos en tajadas y reservan; mientras baten los huevos con el pan rallado.

>Para armar, engrasan una bandeja alta con mantequilla y harina de trigo. Vierten un piso de guiso y cubren con una capa de plátano frito y así sucesivamente hasta que formen una torre. La altura dependerá de la cantidad de guiso y de la bandeja.

\n> \n>

>Para finalizar, vierten los huevos batidos y se lleva al horno por 25 minutos aproximadamente.

\n\n

/> This is a family recipe, so every household has its own way of preparing it, its own seasoning, and even its own choice of fish. Some people prefer to make the cake with striped fish or dogfish. To go with it, a casabe is always a good idea. So if you feel like it, I hope you try this recipe and let me know how it turns out—it’s simple and divine. While all this was happening and I was waiting for the cake, I took the opportunity to eat white beans and rice pudding as well; that meal was already ready when I woke up, so let’s eat! > Analista de la vida, analista de los momentos, analista de lo que puede venir. Es así como surgen escenarios, panoramas, posibilidades. Como simples mortales, amas de casa, vendedoras, amantes de la vida surgen ideas del camino que debemos seguir y de todo lo que puede surgir en el camino. Pero muchas veces la realidad nos supera. Vemos los estados en blanco y negro, sabiendo que hay extremos que no se pueden superar. Muchas veces estamos limitados a pensar en forma negativa sobre los resultados de nuestro camino. Sin duda las mujeres somos una pensadoras constantes, siempre estamos analizando los estados y voces de otras personas. Es una constante que siempre esta presente en nuestras vidas. Nos gusta pensar en que somos positivas con los que acontece a nuestro alrededor y que los resultados serán los esperados con pocas fallas. ¿Cómo eres tú? te animas a dejarme una frase sobre el tema. Mantente en positivo, ya que todo va a salir bien y si no es así seguramente no esta en tu manos el arreglarlo.
***
Este texto corresponde a mi participación en el reto diario del amigo @latino.romano y @mariannewest [post](https://hive.blog/hive-161155/@daily.prompt/10-april-2026-freewriters-community-daily-writing-prompt-day-3069-analyst-of-what) **ENGLISH VERSION** Analyst of life, analyst of moments, analyst of what may come. This is how scenarios, panoramas, and possibilities arise. As mere mortals, housewives, saleswomen, lovers of life, ideas emerge about the path we should follow and everything that might arise along the way. But often, reality overwhelms us. We see situations in black and white, knowing that there are extremes that cannot be overcome. We are often limited to thinking negatively about the outcomes of our path. Without a doubt, women are constant thinkers; we are always analyzing the states and voices of other people. It is a constant that is always present in our lives. We like to think that we are positive about what happens around us and that the results will be as expected with few setbacks. What about you? Would you like to leave me a phrase on the subject? Stay positive, because everything will turn out alright, and if it doesn't, it's probably not in your hands to fix it.

title.title: 러브 스토리의 주제는 다양
title.body:
<center>![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g1e3db0e6458767c2b6b52e87085c0b66d11ea8dbb1748c7d20a78940356bc4e1556106ce8ec8970a93d9afe4afdcbf7474a67f8762e77835f818fa3256616280_640.jpg)</center>

***

# 러브 스토리 이야기

## 제목: 운명적인 만남

### 배경
서울의 한 작은 카페. 비 오는 날, 카페의 창가에 앉아 있는 주인공은 외로운 마음을 달래기 위해 책을 읽고 있다. 그때, 우산을 들고 들어온 한 남자가 카페에 들어온다. 그의 모습에 주인공은 순간적으로 마음이 설렌다.

### 등장인물
- **지민**: 27세, 카페에서 일하는 바리스타. 사랑에 대한 환상이 있지만, 현실에서는 늘 혼자다.
- **민수**: 30세, 직장인. 바쁜 일상 속에서 진정한 사랑을 찾고 싶어 한다.

### 이야기 전개

#### 1. 첫 만남
비 오는 날, 민수는 우산을 잃어버리고 카페에 피신한다. 지민은 그를 보고 따뜻한 커피 한 잔을 권한다. 두 사람은 자연스럽게 대화를 나누며 서로에게 끌리기 시작한다.

#### 2. 서로의 비밀
민수는 과거의 상처로 인해 사랑에 대한 두려움이 있다. 지민은 그를 이해하고 싶어 하지만, 자신의 감정을 숨기고 그저 친구로 지내기로 결심한다. 서로의 비밀을 공유하며 점점 가까워진다.

#### 3. 갈등
지민은 민수와의 관계가 더 깊어지기를 원하지만, 민수는 자신의 과거로 인해 그를 멀리하려고 한다. 지민은 상처받을까 두려워하며 민수에게 다가가는 것을 주저한다. 결국, 민수는 지민에게 멀어지기로 결심한다.

#### 4. 깨달음
민수는 자신이 지민을 정말로 사랑하고 있음을 깨닫고, 그녀를 잃고 싶지 않다는 마음이 커져간다. 지민 또한 민수를 잊지 못하고 그를 기다리기로 결심한다. 두 사람은 서로의 마음을 확인하기 위해 다시 만날 결심을 한다.

#### 5. 재회
한 달 후, 비 오는 날 다시 카페에서 만난 두 사람. 민수는 지민에게 자신의 마음을 고백하고, 지민은 그를 받아들인다. 서로의 상처를 이해하고, 함께 치유해 나가기로 약속한다.

### 결말
두 사람은 서로의 사랑을 통해 과거의 상처를 극복하고, 새로운 시작을 함께 하기로 결심한다. 비 오는 날의 카페에서 시작된 운명적인 사랑은 이제 그들의 삶의 새로운 장을 열어준다.

### 주제
사랑의 힘으로 상처를 치유하고, 서로를 이해하는 것이 진정한 사랑의 시작임을 보여주는 이야기.

title.body:
A 17% reduction is not good enough, sorry. We're in the AI era where devs of your stature can ship 10x faster, honestly, in your case it's probably higher than that (just based on my own experiences as a dev of 15 years and using AI). This is going to be a VERY hard sell. You're asking for over $100k USD a year for this proposal, but you haven't cleared up whether you're working 8 hours a day, 40 hour weeks for Hive. I highly suspect that you have a job already and Hive is a nice little side income for you, which is fine. But if you're going to ask for a full-time salary at a time when Hive is at an all-time low, that's poor taste in my opinion.

>That said, I think it's misguided to focus all the pressure on reducing spending. We are living through a moment where AI is changing the economics of software development.

You contradicted yourself. You said it's misguided to focus pressure on spending, but then you point out the economics of software development thanks to AI are changing, meaning the cost of developing software is crashing and not as expense or exclusive as it once one. I don't think it's misguided, I think it's sensible we're focusing on spending, the Hive token price is collapsing.

>That can be used in one of two ways: we can go at the same pace for a third of the cost, or we can go ten times faster for the same cost. Every serious competitor in this space is choosing the second option.

Nothing you have outlaid in this proposal has provided any detail as to how you're going to go ten times faster or what you plan on doing beyond mentioning reputation system fixes, focusing on the content aspect and small fixes. We don't need any of that, we need big ticket items that bring in developers, make onboarding easier and improve Hive a whole. We've got so many UI's for Hive, it's just wasted effort focusing more on the UI aspect and like 98% of the content on this chain is AI slop now. Focusing on the content will kill Hive, it's zero value.

Also, being honest, a lot of the things you mentioned could be achieved in a month or so using Claude Code or other AI tools. You haven't mentioned anything that I can see requires extensive planning or complex development.

This isn't personal. I've been scrutinising all DHF proposals and expenses. You mention this is income for you and I am not against paying people what they're worth, but you need to update this post with your biggest accomplishments and sell yourself better. Saying you're planning on working on lots of small tasks isn't inspiring confidence that funding this is going to provide value.

I also take issue with the fact you're focusing on the content aspect of Hive, Hive is more than content. Sure blogging is the main showcase application of the Hive blockchain, but it's so much more capable and I think it's wasted development effort fixing up UI bugs and focusing on feeds and content discovery when Hive is missing lite wallets and still doesn't have an officially supported layer-2 solution, despite the fact the official Hive roadmap promises it in Q1 2026 (which I doubt will happen).

I highly encourage you to read the room, the bar is so much higher now. People are rightfully pissed off. The DHF has been rorted and abused for far too long. And I am not saying you're one of the people who have done so, I am saying the bar is just so much higher and your proposal really doesn't give any detail whatsoever as to how many hours you'll be working, the things you'll be working on and so forth. If you can edit the proposal and truly be transparent and provide realistic KPIs you can achieve, you'll have better reception and success with this.

title.title: Fun Friday some more light painting
title.body:
# Fun Friday some more light painting As I prepare this post, I almost got out for a photo walk this morning, had all my gear loaded in the car, as the weather apps, were mostly saying no rain till 8Am, one said a 45% chance of rain earlier, but the others were much lower percentage or saying none, so I loaded all my gear inbto the car, camera light painting torches, tripod etc. Opened the garage door and backed out, drove maybe 100 feet down our street and it started raining, so went round the block and rain kept coming so drove back hone and thought ohh well another day :) Sharing some light painting shots I did last year all around the Fort Tabor Park here in New Bedford I am hoping to get to the fort one morning after it has rained over night as if there is enough rain a puddle forms by the old fort and I can try to get some reflections with light painting, sort of liek this first one I share but hopefully better
![fort light painting.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/23wM2xJXmsh6JrS9xe3G2GfkK6wrSgMc9ZeSCyJdx7zDuwswhGLuQrHMwUc3qwY4BaGy1.jpg) **Sony A7iv 17mm F18 106 Sec ISO 100** **[Click here to view larger](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/23wM2xJXmsh6JrS9xe3G2GfkK6wrSgMc9ZeSCyJdx7zDuwswhGLuQrHMwUc3qwY4BaGy1.jpg)**

So what is light painting let me try to explain, actually let me cheat and copy and paste how I explained it in a previous post and was happy with it lOL Light painting is basically photography’s rebellious cousin who skipped art school and went straight to rave school. Instead of brushes and canvas, you use flashlights, sparklers, glow sticks, or anything that creates light You set your camera on a tripod, open the shutter for a few seconds or minutes, and then whoosh, you draw in the air with light. The camera sees all the glowing trails and goes, “Oh, cool, I’ll just record that like it’s normal.” And voilà—you’ve got a photo that hopefully you think is cool . It’s like finger painting, but for grown-ups who still believe in magic or for grown ups who are still kids at art and like to have fun. Or possibly more likely in my case, for someone like me with no artistic ability who thinks doing these is perhaps the best art I will ever do lOL.
![fort light painting-3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/23u5Nzisehs8Ddh7ctsSMemqzyayu3zCaWmkcpdWsaUTE1yHJ11engMz8fngGiqTAjGnx.jpg) **Sony A7iv 20mm F11 99 Sec ISO 100** **[Click here to view larger](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/23u5Nzisehs8Ddh7ctsSMemqzyayu3zCaWmkcpdWsaUTE1yHJ11engMz8fngGiqTAjGnx.jpg)**

title.title: Trump's post about Greenland got community noted on X. One explanation why Trump is threatening NATO: Dividing NATO members into good and bad ones.
title.body:
Trump hat wieder einen Rant über die NATO gepostet, dass die NATO ihm zu wenig bei (der Übernahme von) Grönland geholfen hätte.

Auf dem Papier ist die NATO ein Verteidigungsbündnis und kein Angriffsbündnis der USA. In der Vergangenheit wurde nur ein offizieller Aritkel 5-Verteidungsfall zu Gunsten der USA nach den 9/11-Terroranschlägen ausgelöst.

In der Praxis hat die NATO und zahlreiche europäische NATO-Staaten aber praktische alle Kriege der USA im Nahen Osten direkt oder indirekt unterstützt, wobei die Kooperation im Einzelfall aber eher bilateral abläuft, nicht über die NATO direkt. Koalition der Willigen etc.

Selbst im aktuellen Iran-Krieg (Epic Fury, \

) wird die USA durch die Bereitstellung von US/Nato-Militärbasen in Deutschland und UK aktiv unterstützt. Dazu kommt die Nutzung des europäischen Luftraums für die USA.

Sogar das neutrale Österreich hat US-Militär-Flüge immer wieder genehmigt, nur einen medienwirksam abgelehnt, andere bewilligt.

Ohne Unterstützung großer NATO-Staaten wie Deutschland wäre der Iran-Krieg logistisch für die USA viel schwerer durchführbar.

Trump nutzt den Iran-Krieg und Grönland meiner Meinung nach eher als Vorwand, um aus der NATO auszutreten.

Kann mir aber nicht vorstellen, dass die USA seine Militärbasen in der EU freiwillig aufgeben würde. Rein hypothetisch, sollte Trump tatsächlich der NATO den Rücken kehren, denke ich, dass Trump dann viel mehr bilaterale Deals mit Deutschland, Italien, Griechenland etc. anstreben würde, um seine strategisch wichtigen Militärbasen behalten zu können.

Trumps Vorhaben: NATO-Mitglieder in gute und schlechte dividieren. Divide and Conquer. Bündnis nur mit jenen, die ihm bedingungslos folgen.

In so einem hypothetischen Szenario würde er damit auch die Kohäsion der EU schwer belasten, da die EU dann gezwungen wäre, ein eigenes Verteidigungsbündnis ohne USA aufzubauen. Ein Schattenbündnis einzelner EU-Länder mit Trump wäre in diesem Fall wenig hilfreich und würde die EU vor einer Zerreißprobe stellen.

Was sagt ihr dazu? Denkt ihr, dass Trump aus der NATO austreten wird? Was steckt eurer Meinung nach dahinter?

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vikisecrets/AL1e5sqE4d74qSp4Vd6PYuxXy481NL7YRYdbNbKHoAsBhnFPK1AuxRxoGUkQZkE.png)

https://x.com/WhiteHouse/status/2042027252053897428

## English

Trump has posted another rant about NATO, claiming that NATO didn’t do enough to help him with (the takeover of) Greenland.

On paper, NATO is a defensive alliance, not an offensive alliance solely for the interest of the U.S. In the past, only one official Article 5 defense case in support of the U.S. was invoked following the 9/11 terrorist attacks.

In practice, however, NATO and numerous European NATO member states have directly or indirectly supported virtually all of the US’s wars in the Middle East, although cooperation in individual cases tends to be bilateral rather than through NATO directly, e.g., the Coalition of the Willing.

Even in the current war against Iran (Epic Fury), the U.S. is actively supported through the provision of U.S./NATO military bases in Germany and the UK. Added to this is the use of European airspace by the U.S.

Even neutral states as Austria have repeatedly authorized US military flights, rejecting only one for media effect while approving others.

Without the support of major NATO countries like Germany, the Iran war would be much more difficult for the US to carry out logistically.

In my opinion, Trump is using the Iran war and Greenland more as a pretext to withdraw from NATO.

But I can’t imagine the U.S. voluntarily giving up all its military bases in the EU. Purely hypothetically, if Trump were to actually turn his back on NATO, I think he would then rather seek out bilateral deals with Germany, Italy, Greece, etc., in order to retain his strategically important military bases there.

Trump’s plan: to divide NATO members into good and bad ones. Divide and conquer. An alliance only with those who follow him unconditionally.

In such a hypothetical scenario, he would also severely strain the cohesion of the EU, as the EU would then be forced to build its own defense alliance without the US. A shadow alliance between individual EU countries and Trump would be of little help in this case and would put the EU to the test.

What do you think? Do you think Trump will withdraw from NATO? What do you think is behind this?

title.title: One Step at a Time: Embracing a Healthier Lifestyle Through Walking During My Teacher’s Vacation
title.body:
***Changing my lifestyle did not happen overnight—it began with a simple decision to walk. What started as a small step during my uninterrupted vacation as a teacher slowly transformed into a meaningful routine that nurtured both my body and mind. This break from the usual demands of school life became a privilege, a gift that allowed me to reconnect with myself and embrace healthier habits.***

![9.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/23tRxbSgbh53bnwm7emPtqPjVsuDFG4SPkb3f5Vpz56cdG7syvnACjbSgYCns1ZjtkGEp.jpg)

As teachers, our days are often filled with responsibilities—lesson planning, checking papers, attending meetings, and guiding our students. Amid all this, we sometimes forget to take care of ourselves. When the vacation finally came, I realized how much I needed to pause, breathe, and prioritize my well-being. Instead of filling my days with idle scrolling or extended rest alone, I chose to move—literally—by walking.

![10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/23t77MHnhyQeX8WezcnYLsMH3dG4UAxn5BG64ibKBEYSdUNguTM6nRrfcvyaCDWtE1ou6.jpg)

At first, walking felt like a simple, effortless activity. I would wake up early in the morning, when the air was still fresh, and the surroundings were calm. With every step, I began to notice things I had overlooked before—the gentle sway of trees, the quiet hum of the morning, and the beauty of a slow sunrise. These small moments became my therapy. Walking was no longer just physical exercise; it became a mindful experience.

***As days passed, walking became a routine I looked forward to.*** It gave structure to my mornings and a sense of accomplishment even before the day fully began. I started to feel lighter, not just physically but emotionally. The stress that had built up during the school year slowly melted away. My thoughts became clearer, and my mood improved. It was as if each step helped me release the burdens I carried.

![8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/23v4dg7dRngpg2YHCyuxnj2ftTuafpkWEHdqNDqp5Gq9CAibG5DLiYj42NdjLGSr6qugC.jpg)

***What made this experience even more meaningful was realizing that this time—this uninterrupted vacation—was truly a privilege.*** Not everyone gets the chance to pause and reset. As teachers, we often dedicate ourselves to others, so having this moment to invest in our own health felt like a blessing. Walking became my way of honoring that gift.

![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/245TDeitDjU3DS4h1F6ajLUPEtcjvonv3ZUziD6cvUsEViw2J6Dd4asVTusrtGJ8vvMfE.jpg)

**Through this journey, I also learned the importance of consistency over intensity.** I didn’t need to push myself into exhausting workouts or strict routines. Simply showing up each day, putting on my shoes, and taking that walk was enough. It taught me that healthy living does not have to be complicated. Sometimes, it begins with the simplest choices.

**Moreover, walking helped me reconnect with gratitude**. With every step, I became more aware of my body’s strength and my ability to move freely. I became thankful for the time I had, for the peace I felt, and for the opportunity to take care of myself. It reminded me that health is not just about appearance but about feeling whole and balanced.

***This lifestyle change also inspired me to think about how I can carry this habit into my busy teaching days. Even when classes resume, I hope to continue walking—perhaps not as long as during vacation, but enough to keep the habit alive. It serves as a reminder that even in the midst of a hectic schedule, I can still make time for myself.***

![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/245HqcPpGaAWbgtTrB7sevAX2HeBK3AG3PBAxF37UR1LzR3ZvJPZRArbG1Syk8n4ARLHg.jpg)

**In the end, walking became more than just a routine; it became a symbol of self-care, discipline, and gratitude.**This uninterrupted vacation allowed me to rediscover the importance of slowing down and caring for my health sustainably. It showed me that sometimes, the best transformations begin with the simplest steps.

***As I prepare to return to my role as an educator, I carry not just memories of rest, but also a renewed commitment to a healthier lifestyle. And it all started with a walk—a small step that led to a meaningful change.***

# The Remarkable Adaptations of Penguins: Masters of the Cold

## Introduction
Penguins are fascinating flightless birds that have captivated the hearts of many. Known for their distinctive black and white plumage and waddling gait, these incredible creatures are not just cute; they are also remarkable survivors in some of the harshest environments on Earth. This post explores the unique adaptations that enable penguins to thrive in cold climates.

## Physical Adaptations

### 1. Streamlined Bodies
Penguins possess a streamlined body shape that reduces drag while swimming. This adaptation allows them to move swiftly through water, reaching speeds of up to 15 miles per hour (24 km/h) when hunting for fish and other marine prey.

### 2. Insulating Feathers
The feathers of penguins are highly specialized. They have a dense layer of waterproof feathers that trap air and provide insulation against the frigid temperatures of their habitats. This unique structure keeps them warm even in icy waters.

### 3. Blubber Layer
Beneath their feathers, penguins have a thick layer of blubber that acts as an additional insulator. This fat layer not only helps maintain body heat but also serves as an energy reserve during times when food is scarce.

## Behavioral Adaptations

### 1. Social Structure
Penguins are social birds that often live in large colonies. This social behavior provides warmth and protection from predators. They huddle together during harsh weather conditions to conserve heat, demonstrating the power of community in survival.

### 2. Parental Care
Penguins exhibit remarkable parental care, with both parents sharing the responsibility of incubating eggs and feeding chicks. This cooperative breeding strategy ensures the survival of their young in a challenging environment.

### 3. Foraging Techniques
To find food, penguins have developed various foraging techniques, including diving to great depths and using their excellent vision to locate prey in murky waters. Some species can dive over 1,500 feet (450 meters) in search of food.

## Conclusion
Penguins are truly masters of the cold, equipped with a range of adaptations that allow them to thrive in extreme conditions. From their streamlined bodies and insulating feathers to their social behaviors and foraging skills, these remarkable birds are a testament to the wonders of evolution. As we continue to study and appreciate these incredible creatures, it is crucial to recognize the importance of conserving their habitats to ensure their survival for generations to come.

title.title: MydEmpire Devlog #6 — Looking for Early Testers
title.body:
https://images.hive.blog/1536x0/https://www.mydempire.com/assets/mydempire-hero.png **Hello to all Hivers and Gamers!** For the past weeks MydEmpire has been quietly built step by step. The core systems are now working: • Lands can be owned • Factories can be built • Industries produce Empire Production (EP) • Rewards are calculated based on production power • The treasury distributes HIVE based on player activity Production inside the game is calculated dynamically depending on factory status and activity, meaning inactive factories produce nothing while active ones generate EP over time. The game is not officially launched yet. But the PRE-GENESIS testing phase is about to begin. And that means something important. A small number of players will be invited to help test the system.

What Early Testers Will Do

Early testers will help validate: • Pack purchase flow • Pack opening system • Blueprint and land distribution • Factory building and production • Reward distribution mechanics • Marketplace interactions This phase is very important because real players always discover things that developers miss.

Why Testing Matters

Blockchain games often launch with bugs, broken economies, or unstable reward systems. The goal of this phase is to avoid that. The system needs to be tested with real activity before the Genesis launch begins. This will help ensure that the economy, production mechanics, and reward engine remain stable as the empire grows.

Who Can Join

The testing phase will be very limited. Only a small group of players will be invited. This is intentional so the game can be tested carefully before opening to a larger audience. If You Are Interested If you enjoy strategy games and want to help test a new project being built on Hive, you are welcome to participate. Leave a comment or join the Discord and say hello. Early testers will help shape the future of the empire. More devlogs will continue as the game evolves. **The empire is slowly rising and this is only the beginning.** Building MydEmpire as a solo developer has been a challenging but rewarding journey. Every new system brings the game closer to a fully functioning economic simulation on Hive. More development updates coming soon. — Building MydEmpire step by step **Let me know your thoughts.** **MydEmpire**

title.title: Bought my first AI subscription - Codex
title.body:
Ever since the AI era, I have been using only free AI tools for my tasks. Initially, ChatGPT was the place to go for many people. Later, when the use cases of AI started expanding, there were so many other tools that were helpful in making our lives easier. In the last year, I have never thought of purchasing any paid subscription, but in the last few weeks, I have been using Codex heavily. For some reason, I did not have any big restrictions on the Usage until I switched accounts in my VS Code. I did not even think that Codex required a subscription. The reason was that I was continuously using it without any problem. I used it on multiple projects, and it was all good. 

Two days back, I wanted to use separate OpenAI logins for my different projects. So I wanted to log out and log in to a different account. I don't know if that's the mistake I did but my usage suddenly got exhausted. I think after I logged out and logged back in, my VS Code extension also got an update, and it started tracking my usage heavily. But to my surprise, just for asking 5 questions, my free plan usage got completed. It started asking me to pay for a paid subscription. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmapQmuxL93cLE3RNczpRG9EAeBpenBu7bqjxkRKM8h4oX/image.png)

Source - Sora

I was having some of my activities half done, and I did not want to switch to a different model to complete my task. So I bought my first subscription. I did not go for the Pro plan, though. I have selected only the GO plan, and that itself does not look sufficient. I asked only 3 questions so far, and my usage is already at 85. I don't think this will even last for like 1 week until the usage gets reset. I still wonder how I was able to use Codex with more limits before, and I wish I had not switched my account. Maybe they gave me a higher limit for the initial trial period, and they stopped giving that. I have no idea. If my usage limit is going to get exhausted faster, I don't think I will continue paying for the subscription. My next option would be to choose a local AI model that I can run from my local server. But right now it demands a lot of VRAM. 

My paid plan should have been Claude's code, but somehow I got used to Codex, and it is very good. I'm able to use this directly in my VS Code and review my code changes then and there. I'm still exploring other options available to see if there are any better models available. I asked GitHub Copilot's free version to do a small task, and I noticed that it was horrible. Now I understand the power of premium models and why it is important to use premium models for coding instead of free models. I wish there were more competitive products available in the market so that this experience gets better for the developers.

title.title: 🔥💎 ¿Y qué tal tu confort… te protege o te limita? 💎🔥 [ Esp - Eng]  🔥💎 What about your comfort… is it protecting you or holding you back? 💎🔥
title.body:
>  

***¿Y qué tal tu confort?***, te lo pregunto en serio, porque a veces uno dice ***“no, yo estoy bien así”*** y listo, pero en el fondo como que algo no termina de encajar, como que sabes que puedes dar más, pero ahí te quedas, tranquilo, sin moverte mucho.

Y no es que uno no quiera avanzar, claro que uno quiere, pero da miedo, da flojera también vamos a estar claros, salir de lo cómodo no es fácil, porque afuera no sabes con qué te vas a encontrar, si te va a ir bien o si te vas a caer, entonces uno prefiere quedarse en lo seguro, en lo que ya conoce, aunque eso no te esté llevando a ningún lado y lo más loco de todo es que lo sabemos, pero igual seguimos ahí, quédate un momento conmigo que esto se pone bueno.
__________

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQm7jbXLMpLeX3RRAL7K2e9HfpvpzUUmm4mAStdpTgNH6/image.png)</center>

<center>*\

*</center>

__________

Hay algo que nadie te dice cuando estás en tu zona de confort, y es que no siempre es un lugar bonito, a veces es solo un lugar conocido. Porque seamos sinceros, *¿cuántas veces has dicho “estoy bien así” solo para no moverte, solo para no arriesgarte, solo para no sentir ese vacío en el estómago que aparece cuando sabes que tienes que hacer algo diferente?* Uno se convence, se arma su propia historia, se dice que es paciencia, que es el momento, que después será mejor, pero en el fondo tú sabes que no es eso, es miedo, miedo a fallar, miedo a perder lo poco o mucho que tienes, miedo a enfrentarte a una versión de ti que todavía no conoces. Y mientras tanto los días pasan y tú sigues exactamente en el mismo lugar.
________

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXPxHonM63RCf5BAETKeK1WRLpSzonPAx9M2ar6v3i5si/image.png)</center>

<center>*\

*</center>
_______

Y lo más fuerte de todo es que la zona de confort no siempre se siente incómoda, por eso atrapa tanto. Te da tranquilidad, te da control, te hace sentir que todo está bajo orden, aunque por dentro estés apagado. Es como vivir en automático, cumpliendo, sobreviviendo, pero sin avanzar de verdad. Y aquí es donde te pregunto sin anestesia, *¿cuánto tiempo llevas diciéndote que mañana empiezas? ¿Cuántas oportunidades has dejado pasar por no salir de ese círculo?* Porque sí, cuesta admitirlo, pero muchas veces no es falta de capacidad, es falta de decisión, es quedarte donde no pasa nada solo porque ahí no duele, aunque tampoco te haga crecer.
________

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUzJx4XGcgaSBDko9WKjKRUFVrNX8EZSgy9cnGhEuudmY/image.png)</center>

<center>*\

*</center>
________

Yo también estuve ahí mucho tiempo, en ese punto donde sabes que puedes más pero no te atreves. Hasta que la vida me obligó a moverme, a salir, a dejar todo atrás. Y cuando te digo todo, es todo, país, estabilidad, rutina. En el camino también llegaron pérdidas que no se superan, pérdidas humanas que te rompen por dentro y te cambian para siempre. Hubo momentos donde no había ni para comer, donde la incertidumbre era el pan de cada día, donde te preguntas si de verdad tomaste la decisión correcta. Pero también fue ahí donde conocí algo que no tiene precio, la fuerza que no sabía que tenía, la fe que se activa cuando no te queda otra, y sobre todo el valor de la gente. Aquí en Argentina, un país que me abrió las puertas junto a mi familia, donde más allá de lo económico, lo que recibí fue humanidad, una mano, una palabra, un ***“no te rindas”***, un ***“sigue que tú puedes”***. Y eso levanta a cualquiera.
__________

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUsF3Fg5uX9J2ZhYW1nwMbiHDHbuojYDPjaMfbh5JRcZR/image.png)</center>

<center>*\

*</center>

__________

Por eso hoy te lo digo claro, salir de la zona de confort no es bonito ni fácil, pero es ahí donde pasa todo. Ahí es donde creces, donde te transformas, donde descubres de qué estás hecho. Sí, te puedes caer, puedes perder, puedes llorar, pero también puedes levantarte, puedes empezar de cero, puedes construir algo mucho más fuerte que lo que dejaste atrás. Así que deja de esperar el momento perfecto, porque no existe. Si por dentro sabes que puedes más, entonces ya es hora. Pasa la página, suelta el miedo y avanza, porque si saliste es porque puedes, y lo mejor de tu historia todavía está por escribirse.

<center>![SeparadorHive.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mballesteros/23t7YWoN53XUARh93PVvS9mqaVjjjMGSNi6uJUMjKptGwBVoiTyadsRVjRPAE27xgxsc7.png)</center>

Gracias por llegar hasta aquí, de verdad.

Y gracias a la comunidad #GEMS por este espacio donde podemos expresarnos, reflexionar y conectar desde lo más humano.

Si algo de esto te tocó, no lo ignores. A veces una palabra a tiempo puede cambiarlo todo.

Te leo en la caja de comentarios, quiero saber qué estás sintiendo y en qué punto estás hoy.

Un abrazo grande para todos, y recuerda… si estás leyendo esto, es porque todavía estás a tiempo de cambiar tu historia.

____


<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQme5XpkEyHELxp3YDZDpsQzGu3zYFfKrEvdL6cw28sgrpe/gray_marble_professional_business_style_linkedin_banners_1_.png </center>

body.title: Hiking Sleeping Giant and The Lost Swing on Kauai
body.body:
![IMG_5599.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/EpQvDyXPARbKGCXXoqMSsSFP95gixnpzEYSeGYTK6Hqq28AR7E6WMsRq2dTvU874r9z.jpeg)*Feeling good after climbing to the top of the Sleeping Giant here in Kauai. Looking down at Wailua along the coast. I can see for miles from up here!*

  I always think that finding some good hiking trails can be one of the best ways to really get to know a new place. Since I was here exploring Kauai Island with Dan, I decided to take him on a few hikes. But first we had to decided which was to try out. I had remembered passing one called the Sleeping Giant during our driving tour, so we decided to go check that one out first. It was just perfect for what we were looking for. It is relatively short, but a good climb, and wonderful views from ontop. 

   We took the West trailhead, which meant a 2 mile, round trip distance. It also meant we would be climbing about 725ft in elevation. The trail starts at the back of this neighborhood, and a typical rainshower greeted us as we drove up. We were a little worried about the trail being very muddy, but only the first part stayed slippery. We quickly climbed into a grove of Cook Island pine trees. Then a bit of rock climbing and scrambling before reaching the peak. The view was ok, a little blocked by foliage, but then we realized that there were more peaks, connected by a narrow ridgeline trail. We climbed higher to some epic viewpoints, like the one pictured above. I highly advise hiking and photography enthusiast to try out this quick, fun hike, when exploring Kauai. 

  Then we checked out the Likelike waterfall hike. We ran into a lot of no parking and anti-tourists signs in the neighborhood, so we kept going to another hike, called the secret swing hike. This led us on a relatively flat trail, between two farms, deeper into the forested interior of the island. We eventually got into the Forest Reserve, where the views were lush and beautiful. We found the swing, which was the perfect turnaround spot. This was a very easy hike, about 3 miles roundtrip, and with only 385ft elevation gain. We powered through it in about an hour.

  We had to get back to our base of adventures, the Kauai Inn, so we could meet up with a couple of UnCruise guests that we ran into, also staying there. Bill and Chris has just spent a week with me, cruising through the southern islands on the Safari Explorer. I knew this was our kind of place!

![dji_fly_20260330_082504_83_1774895219023_photo_optimized.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/23u5vyETVHbjvK5f4NnAwAjQqkfYLfutFkkaQ5naNEJBJ57C5UCUkZd12TVL8aiG915P6.jpeg)*Drone overhead shot of our beautiful base of adventure, the Kauai Inn.*

![dji_fly_20260330_082540_85_1774895218592_pano_optimized.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/23zvFhHYS4jRK45VTZuXTKGq1B2QnD1E92MnmUpf4Fb5r7gWfiCzgPj78fVk1mFryEeaG.jpeg)*Our lodge was located near this river, which you can kayak up and explore, and nestled beneath these picturesque mountains.*

![IMG_5557.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/EpzycXTF6FmJGKL9anDpsunGs3AdYzSY5NcLcZNHWDzafC8majLyqWXu7iPJNccZ77m.jpeg)

![IMG_5580.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/EpEHqpP5mEBLh46PLXmz9W7UkiLx6LFhACo3yZT64xRBkvZm9VEQzdfZfqXkXAvJMTN.jpeg)*Everywhere feels so lush here in Kauai. It is the oldest island, and the often the wettest.*

![IMG_5577.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/EoXskjrm1EwT2h4avh6aWR5RxpBKzfn7oks7bS8yJKQomNqvwLV1F27vQT55remiR2G.jpeg)*View from the beginning of our hike. A light rain had just passed, which made the trail a little slick, but it stayed away for the rest of our hike, luckily.*

![IMG_5606.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/245cWBoC9MYD2F7oEqnexMsm43ALFu6BgJzfRE9F94FcXZWw5UYE9cfYsX95AbjrGGWkh.jpeg)*Hiking out to the hidden swing along this lush ridgeline. This hike took us deeper towards the wet, center of the island.*

![IMG_5565.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/23ywkbpcFkTgpHRC5s12rg2kssUGRW4D1ec36xeedXayJmrBZZfdmzNcNxYALSmpALxqn.jpeg)*Our view in the morning from the Kauai Inn. They provide a wonderful breakfast around the pool.*

![IMG_5588.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/EqWkFky4uXJthGKgZwBCK6otjLamAkwpf6xsxGsjrtC7PZTK3G7WqLSASrPWjbhxjAU.jpeg)*Getting higher atop the Sleeping Giant. The views get better and better from this short, but steep hike.*

![IMG_5576.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/EpnDGCirEfyZJX5PPikm6d2DK2z2xYLq41BXVLrX7Z46XzzK4wHAkMvrH6wewskrKPN.jpeg)*Beginning of the Nounou Mt West Trail, also known as the sleeping giant.*

![IMG_5567.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/EpGQGU7kSh4wvd9DaZggocfqPL1c5jDD8XqfW8bkWBaLhM37rMeeG5HXxxKJTn3ZKBm.jpeg)*Breakfast and a show. This male peacock was on full display for a nearby female at the Kauai Inn. The female was more interested in my bagel than in him, though.*

![IMG_5609.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/EprSDKewq8Sjd18ekLBYij7nSdxLFLQifPKGgWkaEmPSpKT96HjZYMrjQQcmoJvhPQw.jpeg)*Swing with a view. The hike along the ridge culminated in this majestic view. And what better way to soak it in than while swinging out over the edge on this cool tree swing?*



![IMG_5600.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/EqQNWw9HHZfJqqHSx22AymvgEXi9f789gaVGoGzVj7rgXZ4H4AD2xLQtuZduexQFC2s.jpeg)*There were a few parts of the sleeping giant ridgeline that you needed to have four points of contact.*

![IMG_5610.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/243WRazDBNxwgYcmsQDurarWyZWADZGSuNdhu1YouDiZJc36RtYiFhb7x2bMQ4jYCsEpA.jpeg)*Hiking out to the Secret Swing.*

![IMG_5581.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/Eoc5fBhq3yGpmPtbfk9z8tt9USdm6pRBusZnzb5yKt3MfZzGbqW19qLSDgnnGfMhvZp.jpeg)*Part of the Sleeping Giant west trail takes you through this cook island pine forest.*

![IMG_5595.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/2432FU5sz8etn8dirAVj4yQoCprW1E9rZ1GzHsvnC2N1bTZTnqXPHNKEJnVDM6j7GuK9D.jpeg)*The clouds parted to give us this amazing view towards the middle of the island from atop the Sleeping Giant.*

![IMG_5601.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/23xKtGERN1Y1uVtkCSpf2ac267A7Lzs4jSZ44N1cCq9DNruybvSxG8yQ8jzDu5gQ9duH6.jpeg)*We had to scramble and rock climb a bit on this section of the trail.*

![IMG_5604.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/EoiX73SPRogVx2iaD28Zzxt7W8Fs5JAX47rRZQyhcj7egSuz3fMRU4vwkPiukFLwojQ.jpeg)*The secret swing trail is known as the Moalepe Trail.*

![IMG_5607.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/23xVCun5F38ztXU953hsfqz826fTMYxGqfS7wd6jMwufykhY869ikjEZvLNjjR1D86ZNy.jpeg)*and it looks like this.*

![IMG_5578.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/23vhwKYF8pVPJEQMxVcJ586L3Z4T5Sf4qRHCwwSHRPjYwMmN8VVhwpnFpcxm7x7WRxFqZ.jpeg)*The beginning of the west Sleeping Giant trail was a bit slippery and rutted. We were a little worried the whole trail might be like this.*

![IMG_5583.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/23tvZvsE2sdQ4ZRJ1hjzkuHuvmbd8ffj2tttYT4HzEzzeKVfRN6ZwjtNTKYSpN2AWdKY8.jpeg)*Dan, bringing the hiking determination.*

![IMG_5597.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/23sUEeNs17AkzbpYvtJyDrtfnzBfhoQVzdJUFUVaAXwVXyqsJWbGxcUxvQQPXRZFQtuJJ.jpeg)*Panorama from the top.*

![IMG_5593.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/EqSVbDeM2T1mKrRFKDWhUz5HiLWcjjBm7PaLYtcXvvefwwP1G9cdceD9eTdecjPF8Fn.jpeg)*View down into the valley. We were looking down at some white tailed tropic birds flying below us.*

As always, keep traveling and keep posting.
-Dai Mar

body.title: In the House
body.body:
>

> Housing sales are down 14% year-on-year in Finland. 

While the population is only around 5.6 million in total, there are thousands upon thousands of unsold new apartments, older housing isn't selling, and outer-regional housing lays empty. This is because even though many are moving into the cities, population growth is well below replacement level, and immigration (the only thing keeping the growth positive) is low. And of course, many will say good, immigration should be low, because immigrants cause problems, but so too does falling value of housing for those whose largest investment and asset, is their house. 

---


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tarazkp/242Nqr4xFknHT2Tyg5RCZufHaCgTFdieYmjJpgVDZbKpnJwbuy7awWXM6cei6vPa2W1qV.png)


---

In Australia where there is a problem with not enough housing due to immigration, there has been calls for years to curb the influx. Housing crisis is only part of that reasoning and narrative of course, but let's put that aside for the time being at least. I wonder though, for all of those who have bought in the last decade or so and especially since Covid restrictions exploded housing prices for numerous reasons, would they want immigration to fall so those who want to get into the housing market can, even if it means that the house they bought at an inflated price can no longer come close to selling for enough to cover their inflated mortgage? 

The problem with the economy currently, is that it isn't designed to spread wealth even close to evenly. Instead, it is designed to concentrate wealth in a smaller and smaller circle of hands. And those few hands are helping hands, helping each other to help themselves to the value of other to concentrate the wealth further. This means that at wealth can be high at country level, but the mean population is losing wealth, and in some cases, hand over fist. 

For many decades home ownership was recommended and still is, but if it depends on immigration alone to keep prices stable and above or at par with inflation rates, it is always going to fail. Because immigration at the level required for most western countries is going to fail, because there just aren't enough adequate jobs for immigrants to do that would allow them to enter into the housing market anyway. Most of the foreigners I know in Finland do not own their home and are instead renting, mostly due to the jobs available or the *uncertainty* of the job market. This is good for the investors, but not for the owners in Finland, because the owners can only really sell to Finns then, and that is a reducing pool of people. 

Of course, if there was true parity between Finn and foreigner, jobs were available and the job market wasn't skewed, then the pool of potential buyers increases significantly, and the spread of *where* buyers buy would also shift. Foreigners tend to end up in \

because that is where it is cheapest to live. But in my experience, even as a renter I was being pushed toward those suburbs by rental agents, as they wouldn't even consider me for a rental apartment in the city. I ended up getting one only because I got to talk to the owner of an apartment directly, and she liked me. And of course, some groups of foreigners might feel more comfortable in a foreign suburb, if they feel themselves discriminated against and *can't accept it.* For me, I don't give a crap, other than at the practical level of my life. Discrimination has been a constant. Economically though, I wonder how many homeowners consider the value of their homes when making decisions on immigration. For example, 70-75% of trump voters are homeowners (higher than the national average), which makes sense since nearly 80% of Trump supporters in the last election (the lowest share so far [88% was the highest]) were non-Hispanic white. They were also more likely to be situated in suburban or rural areas, where home ownership is higher. Perhaps though, because of this they aren't as affected by immigration, since a lot of immigrants are going to look for jobs in urban areas. In Finland, the foreign-born percentage crossed the 10% threshold this year, with almost 12% foreign-born or born to foreigners. However, while anti-immigration sentiment has reared its head in the last two decades, it really has been about *the look* of people, not their foreign status. Because the largest immigrant groups in Finland are people from former USSR, Sweden and Estonia. They blend right in, and have been here for decades. Those that don't blend in visually are the problem and, they are also the ones who are more likely to face employment discrimination, as well as location discrimination. > I am not pro immigration. Despite being an immigrant, I am not pro immigration at all. Rather, I am more pragmatic and look at the needs of a country at an economic and social level, because ultimately that is what is going to make or break a population. And, I don't care much about what languages people speak for work, as long as there is a common tongue for communication. This means that someone needn't learn Finnish first in order to work, if people in the workplace they need to communicate with can speak together. However, I quite strongly believe that foreigners who come into a country have to add value to the economy and community as best they can, and should *hold themselves* to a very high standard. Earn your place in a community through behaviour. Bring and build skill, and prove worth. Value isn't innate, it has to be demonstrated. More than the value of housing is affected by population, because there is a demand and supply ecosystem and when demand falls, supply is going to struggle to make ends meet. This means that there is economic contraction, but it will inevitably lead to social contraction and degradation also, as opportunities for everyone decrease, even while those few hands keep extracting an increasing amount. And because of this last fact, the indication of how bad things truly are will lag, because the initial numbers will give the impression that everything is okay *on average,* as that average is skewed by the few with a lot. For instance, the *average* salary in the US is around 85K a year, but the *median* salary is closer to 50K a year. That is a significant difference, isn't it? That means that half the population earns about 40% less than the average. > What do you imagine that lower-half demographic *looks* like? I get that there are lot of concerns that people have with immigration and the changing culture that they identify with, but I think the focus and energy should be put on the larger issue of wealth distribution, and the fact it is becoming narrower. Because those who make the decisions on resources and immigration, don't care about anything other than their wealth potential increasing, as they are able to buy a better life in a gated suburb of similars anyway. While they might use these public narratives to garner support, what they are actually trying to support is their own wealth maximisation. They don't care about colour, culture or wellbeing - everything is in service to profit and power. Driving these emotional narratives is the most efficient way to service their desires. You'd think that by now we would have got over arbitrary judgements, but they persist because our own prejudices keep on driving structural and systemic bias that ends up shaping the outcomes in a self-fulfilling prophecy. In order to overcome the hurdles, people have to work twice as hard and even then, are unlikely to be able to overcome the bias of people, because human bias is incredibly persistent, especially when it has been attached to identity. Identity is also incredibly easy to leverage for influence. Unfortunately, there is no easy solution to all the problems we face, and while it would be far, far easier if we could strip away the identity bias and look at it all with some practical discernment, it is very unlikely that will happen. Instead, people seem destined to become more emotional and use their feelings to inform their behaviours, even if they are invalid, misaligned, and ultimately in service to creating wealth for the few. People want better, but *doing* better currently seems beyond us. body.title: My Actifit Report Card: April 10 2026
body.body:
![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g0a7bb32fed1e189b30d9e7e4f6424cb5c6ff009783a98731f8c234d4546bf2f904c7a807d5b597e168959c933ac55d384203fbb3d85dc0df23b03379a5bd17b3_640.jpg)
Hoy fue un día impresionante para caminar por la ciudad. Empecé mi ruta en el parque central, donde vi a un grupo de niños jugando al fútbol. Uno de ellos, un chiquillo con una gran sonrisa, me contó que está en su último año de primaria y sueña con ser futbolista profesional. Su pasión era contagiosa. Continué mi camino y pasé por un café pequeño y acogedor. Allí conocí a una mujer mayor que estaba leyendo un libro. Se llama Ana y es poeta. Me habló de sus escritos inspirados en los lugares que ha visitado. Una de sus poesías más recientes habla sobre un atardecer en la playa, y me mostró una foto en su teléfono; era simplemente impresionante. El clima estaba perfecto y las calles estaban llenas de vida. A lo largo del camino, disfruté de las coloridas murales en las paredes, cada uno contando una historia única sobre la ciudad. Sin duda, cada día en la ciudad siempre trae nuevas sorpresas y hermosas conexiones. _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@titusfrost/actifit-titusfrost-20231229t015511428z)_

body.body:
/>
Un saludo muy cariñoso y cordial desde la ciudad de Villa de Cura ( Aragua - Venezuela ) para esta prestigiosa comunidad del Hive Open Mic @hiveopenmic para músicos de la Blockchain de Hive y su concurso semanal que arriba a la semana 313. Esta es mi más reciente entrada con música del folclore de nuestro amado llano venezolano en compañía de las 32 cuerdas de mi arpa llanera con un pasaje titulado \

de la autoría de Teo Galíndez e interpretado vocalmente por el gran cantante apureño Vitico Castillo. Este pasaje narra en su letra la historia de un hombre que tiene que reflexiona a través de sus experiencias amorosas que las mentira no conducen a nada bueno por lo que ya no puede engañar a su corazón ni sus sentimientos. Esperando que sea de su agrado se despide su amigo de Zaraza pero residenciado en Villa de Cura.
![Snapshot_21.PNG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramonpaez/241tfaaJZnnyurZ8yGZ8YGY9vNE9rMx6iQakxAbXeiMcCpk2qARhhfohumTALF7CLLbAA.PNG)

/> >Warm and heartfelt greetings from the city of Villa de Cura (Aragua, Venezuela) to this prestigious Hive Open Mic community @hiveopenmic for musicians on the Hive blockchain and its weekly contest, now in its 313th week. >This is my most recent entry featuring folk music from our beloved Venezuelan plains, accompanied by the 32 strings of my llanera harp, with a piece titled “Para que voy a mentir” (Why Should I Lie?), written by Teo Galíndez and sung by the great Apurean singer Vitico Castillo. >The lyrics of this piece tell the story of a man who, through his romantic experiences, comes to realize that lies lead to nothing good, so he can no longer deceive his heart or his feelings. Hoping you enjoy it, your friend from Zaraza—now living in Villa de Cura—says goodbye.

![IMG_4779.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/23tc5j7Xi9P3FK5ZDHCccZbRTNwLvwZkc69JtTersi85YJfWCexcE2hFLqmDS4ER85Lq8.jpeg)

I don’t know if it’s just me or there’s someone else who can relate to having days when it feels like you’re standing still while the rest of the world moves on without you. This feeling doesn’t come because you made up your mine to be still though but because something in you refuses to move.

On those days, even the smallest things like getting out of bed or holding conversations with people would feel impossible. Existence would hit like it’s an effort. 

Whenever this happens, to me, I just sit there, allowing myself to get caught in the frustration of it all, and wondering how I went from someone full of plans, dreams, and determination to someone who feels *incapable of doing anything.*

It is actually a strange feeling, I mean this kind of stillness. There’s nothing peaceful or restful about it. It just comes with a certain heaviness, overthinking, doubt and pressure of expectations I have placed on myself. Every now and then I get the mental reminders that I should be doing more, even when my body and mind are screaming pause!

![IMG_4784.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/EokcfjBdeLan26hYrUEx9KRLhYprQbWL9RML6Zfh6bBzNQmCpCh4z3v31ikZuWR9KzK.jpeg)

And the worst part is that from the outside, nothing looks wrong. lol. The world keeps spinning, people keep moving, and life keeps happening. But inside, I am paused in a moment I cannot escape. Then I begin to question myself.  Am I lazy? Tired or afraid? Or am I simply overwhelmed by everything I have yet to figure out?

I suppose it is all of it. Prolly because being incapable is not really about inability, but about living in a world that demands constant motion. Perhaps it is what happens when you have been strong for too long without rest. When your mind is too full, your heart too heavy, and your energy too stretched to keep up.

So I just let it envelope me and sit with it. Definitely not because I want to stay here forever, but because a little birdie told me that forcing movement does not always create progress. It only deepens the exhaustion.

Deep down, I know that beneath all the feeling of being incapable is something waiting for me to catch my breath before I try again.

My response to the Freewriters [daily prompt](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@daily.prompt/9-april-2026-freewriters-community-daily-writing-prompt-day-3068-incapable-of-doing-anything). This was yesterday’s prompt but I didn’t get around to publishing it yesterday hence my late submission.

body.title: How Do Large Language Models Work in Real AWS Generative AI Applications
body.body:
When I first started exploring generative AI on AWS, especially under the scope of the AWS Certified Generative AI Developer – Professional (AIP-C01) certification, one question kept coming to my mind: how do large language models actually work in real applications beyond theory and documentation?

At a high level, a large language model (LLM) is a deep learning system trained on massive text datasets to understand and generate human-like language. However, in real AWS environments, the focus is not just on the model itself but on how it is integrated into a complete cloud architecture.

In practice, LLMs are commonly accessed through services like Amazon Bedrock or embedded into application workflows using AWS Lambda and Amazon SageMaker. Developers are not responsible for training models from scratch; instead, they focus on building applications that intelligently use these models through APIs and managed services.

At this stage of my learning, I often refer back to practice material from **Pass4Future**, especially the [**AWS Certified Generative AI Developer Exam**](https://www.pass4future.com/questions/amazon/aip-c01) , because they help connect theoretical concepts with real AWS architecture scenarios. This makes it easier to understand how different services interact in production-level designs.

For example, when a user submits a query in an application, it is processed through an API layer and sent to an LLM endpoint. The model generates a response based on its training data and context, and the result is returned to the application layer for further use. This entire flow must be designed for scalability, latency control, and security.

What makes AWS particularly powerful for generative AI is the ecosystem around the models. Services like Amazon API Gateway, AWS IAM, and Amazon CloudWatch ensure secure access, proper identity control, and system monitoring. Without these components, even a powerful model would not be suitable for production use.

Another key concept I learned is prompt engineering. Even though LLMs are highly advanced, the quality of output depends heavily on how input prompts are structured. Small changes in wording or context can significantly affect the response quality in real applications.

I also realized that optimization is critical when deploying generative AI at scale. Cost management, response latency, and model selection all play an important role. AWS provides flexibility through serverless architectures and scalable compute options, which help balance performance and cost.

In the end, I understood that large language models in AWS are not standalone tools. They are part of a larger system that combines AI models, cloud services, and application logic to deliver real-world solutions. This system-level thinking is what makes generative AI development truly practical and production-ready.

body.title: My Hobby Crush #283
body.body:
I think hobbies show a part of our personality, the things that we enjoy even if we do not do them ourselves. Some hobbies are simple and easy to start alone. Others need to connect with people. There is one hobby I always admire when I see it but I never really get to do it in my free time.

The hobby I wish I could do more is volleyball. I like how cool players are and how everyone has these teamwork when I watch college volleyballs. The sound of the ball, the quick reactions and the cheering make it exciting to watch. It looks fun and very exciting especially when the game is intense. I feel interested every time I see students playing in the court.

https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQLfEkp4ZJhZSbbiNNVTEtxkXq4EEUTC9Ku6T8jKfLrmh/Volleyball%20Team%20Pic.png 

I do get to play volleyball during PE classes in school. When the teacher divides us into teams I just follow along. I am shy but since everyone is required to play, I don't have to gather players to play with. I do my best to receive the ball and sometimes I even manage a good pass. It's really fun despite me not being too good at it.

The reason I cannot adopt it as a regular hobby is because volleyball is a team game. You need many people to play properly. Unlike drawing or reading, I cannot just start it alone at home. I would need to invite others or join a group which is hard for me since I get shy around people. Even inviting my classmates make it really hard for me. I always worry I might disturb them or they may already have something already planned. It's also awkward to think about cancelling it when you don't get enough people once you already invited others. The more people needed to play the game, the higher the hurdle feels. If I want to play, I usually just join if someone already is doing the planning but I can never try and start one due to my anxiety.

https://img.leopedia.io/DQmbYtPbscPgVqcFN4yoXLVcLMdeEsSBYEnEF7vabbWp2iS/Volleyball.png 

Still, I admire volleyball and hope someday I become more confident. Maybe, I will gather courage and ask a few classmates to schedule my own when I want to play. For now, I just enjoy playing when the chance comes during school.

Good morning, moms and dads.

Before Easter, the girls had their project presentations for the second term. On one hand, there was Abby, who is in the 4-year-old preschool class, with the theme: Numbers; and on the other hand, there was Alys, who is in second grade, with the theme: \

![InShot_20260409_120830683.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmR8tYuUcuHtm4x33dkzHmGL87jbmv3qoYd1WmSj9cCCrx/InShot_20260409_120830683.jpg) A week before the project presentations, I prepared supporting materials for each of them. For Alys, I created a chart showing the size of the heart, which was the focus of her presentation. I drew the heart and compared its size to that of a fist, adding a note that it grows along with our bodies. The information had to be direct and concise so as not to fall into the trap of one of her classmates, who had been previously selected by her teacher. ![20260322_191328.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNrQJmkaboXcgJxJPU8XUjrsvA8KjEBUzNKNDZ39K1UER/20260322_191328.jpg) For Abby, I drew some apples on construction paper that had holes to fit into circles on another sheet to represent the numbers 1 through 10, so she could count and find the one that matched the quantity. Making this learning aid took me about 3 hours, but I did it with all the love in the world since it would help her reinforce her knowledge in this area. ![20260322_214038.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWqk8mnJsHUCrJZux1YE4aCjHtCSMpJkAr7bV978j9Urz/20260322_214038.jpg) ![20260322_214043.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTA22iwZDXqf3ZxyNke6D8HGsNDFAY9nBrgaVF5bxhPZF/20260322_214043.jpg) ![20260322_214157.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQZQewU1yNrrHDKdaFDVHBosTn1ggcXDMzphoJCkSyxhQ/20260322_214157.jpg) Before each presentation, we practice at home several times so they feel confident when speaking in front of their classmates. Even on the day of the presentation, we practiced for half an hour before leaving for school because they asked me to. I felt proud of the commitment they’ve been developing toward their education from a young age without having to force them—they enjoy studying. ![20260327_064528.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaTtZmvvR5uZQtaL1FexLJvucXsmXLBEABGCYeWw1Gq8o/20260327_064528.jpg) ![20260327_064650.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSHbLZFCUeDSBbXTarwBWgFnSxAYMDnTmwNpgus3pgChk/20260327_064650.jpg) I received videos of both of them since the project presentations are just attempts. Abby felt a little nervous during the presentation, but she was able to organize the numbers properly, and Alys didn’t forget a single word of her information; she was very confident and spoke with a good tone, and she really made her point. ![IMG-20260327-WA0013.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmW1wwQf91dAQ81A2nEQomHVJxfnY5xHAa74zbe2j5X1nm/IMG-20260327-WA0013.jpg) ![VID-20260327-WA0014(1).gif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXPxgLC8shp4XQcvm8d9ajQC2pAX9LqyFNKVucXCkqFas/VID-20260327-WA0014(1).gif) ![IMG-20260327-WA0038.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSJw9j9WSC498FVYRpzVB7qfDJpG9z9N7mnAqK1N5Uj36/IMG-20260327-WA0038.jpg) ![VID-20260327-WA0066(1).gif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSZmT1daixHB37FFTV4CyEaqBGoexo3hWt8MkBF66eEoP/VID-20260327-WA0066(1).gif) I am very happy for them; seeing every experience and piece of knowledge they’ve gained in their classrooms lets me know that we’re on the right path toward academic excellence. At home, both of them received an award for their performance.

--- Photos taken with a Samsung Galaxy A35. Collage created in [Inshot](https://v.inshot.com/invite) Content owned by me. Translation by: [Deepl](https://www.deepl.com/es/translator)

>

Buenos días, papitos y mamitas.

Antes de Semana Santa las niñas tuvieron su cierre de proyecto correspondiente al segundo lapso, por un lado estaba Abby que esta en sala de 4 años del preescolar con el tema: Los Números y por el otro lado Alys que estudia en segundo grado con el tema: \

.

![InShot_20260409_120830683.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmR8tYuUcuHtm4x33dkzHmGL87jbmv3qoYd1WmSj9cCCrx/InShot_20260409_120830683.jpg)

Una semana antes de la defensa de los proyectos preparé el material de apoyo para cada una de ellas, para Alys preparé una lámina con el tamaño del corazón que era su punto a exponer, dibuje dicho órgano haciendo la comparativa de que tiene el tamaño del puño, con un escrito adicional de que crece a la par de nuestro cuerpo, la información debía ser directa y concisa para no caer en el punto de uno de sus amiguitos, los cuáles fueron previamente seleccionados por su maestra.

![20260322_191328.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNrQJmkaboXcgJxJPU8XUjrsvA8KjEBUzNKNDZ39K1UER/20260322_191328.jpg)

Para Abby dibuje unas manzanas de cartulina que debían tener unos agujeros que encajaran en unos círculos en otra lámina para representar los números del 1 al 10, con la finalidad de que realizara el conteo y buscará la que iba con la cantidad, realizar este material de apoyo me llevó aproximadamente 3 horas pero lo hice con todo el cariño del mundo ya que le ayudaría afianzar sus conocimientos en esta área. 

![20260322_214038.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWqk8mnJsHUCrJZux1YE4aCjHtCSMpJkAr7bV978j9Urz/20260322_214038.jpg)
