body.title: DarkSector [Let's Play] - 13 - Unnatural History
body.body:
*This time it's revealed that Mezner had the same infection and treatment that Hayden is currently undergoing, meaning **we** will eventually become another Mezner! Have fun with that!!.*

----

**DarkSector** is another game from my backlog. It's an action shooter with sci-fi elements. It follows Hayden, a secret agent who's tasked with stopping a rouge agent from spreading a Bio Weapon to the world. Hayden himself was infected with the virus which gave him special powers but turns him into something less human.

   https://img.leopedia.io/DQmfWhA2HGB8Bn2tJRXSympiQet2sFURsdHi774XErixDAr/DarkSector_Logo.png 


DarkSector has enough mystery and sci-fi tropes that it didn't feel like another shooter game to me. I like over-the-shoulder perspective that reminds me of Resident Evil 4. The game has a lot of variety in gameplay, and constantly gives you new tools (special powers) and puts you in situations where you have to learn use them.

DarkSector never felt stale until the end, though I had to use guides to overcome some of the challenges. Below you can watch my playthrough.

body.title: Why Do Candidates Struggle with Context Window Concepts in the Microsoft GH-300 Exam?
body.body:
You’ve probably felt it already. You’re going through github copilot exam prep and everything seems manageable until the “context window” shows up. Suddenly questions feel unclear, answers seem similar and your confidence drops. 

That’s not a coincidence. The context window is one of those ideas that sounds easy on paper but becomes confusing in the actual exam. And if you’ve been practicing with gh 300 exam questions you’ve likely seen how often this topic appears in tricky scenario-based formats. 

## It’s Not Just Memory It’s Understanding

Here’s where most candidates go wrong they try to memorize definitions.

A context window in simple terms is the amount of information GitHub Copilot can “see” at any moment. But the exam doesn’t ask for definitions it tests how that limit affects real coding situations. 

For example you might get a question where the Copilot gives a wrong or off suggestion. The correct answer often links back to context limits not a tool error or user mistake. 

This is where many learners struggle. You are not being tested on what the context window is but on how it works. 

## The Invisible Limit That Trips You

The hardest part is that you can’t actually see the context window working.

It’s invisible. You don’t know exactly how much code Copilot is using or ignoring. So when a question asks why something failed your first thought might be to blame the prompt or the tool.

But in reality the issue is often:

*   Too much code outside the visible range

*   Missing key context in the active file

*   Poor input that confuses the model

This creates a gap in thinking. You start guessing instead of understanding and that is where the exam becomes hard.

## Scenario Questions Make It Harder

Now add scenario-based questions and things get even tougher.

Instead of asking “What is a context window” the exam might say:

“Why did Copilot fail to give the expected output in this case”

Now you are checking:

*   The code structure

*   The prompt clarity

*   The available context

And if you have not practiced this kind of thinking it feels stressful.

That is why only reading theory or using random gh 300 practice exam material is often not enough. You need practice that shows how these questions are actually asked.

## Practice Changes Everything Here

This is one topic where practice really helps. When you work through focused [context window practice questions by Pass4success](https://www.pass4success.com/microsoft/exam/gh-300) something starts to change. You begin to see patterns:

*   When Copilot ignores code

*   When context is too small

*   When prompts need to be clearer

At first you may get these wrong and that is fine. But over time you stop guessing. You begin to understand why an answer is correct. And that is exactly what the exam is testing. 

There is a point in your prep where this topic stops feeling confusing. You start thinking like the system. Does Copilot even see this part of the code? Is the context too large or too spread out? Would a clearer prompt fix this. That is when things become easier.

And once that happens not only does this topic improve but other areas like prompt writing and debugging also become clearer.

Struggling with context window ideas does not mean you are not ready it means you are dealing with one of the hardest parts of the exam. You started with confusion moved through doubt and now you understand this topic is about how things work not just definitions.

The real change happens when you stop memorizing and start practicing with purpose. Once you see how context affects results the questions feel much easier. If you want to improve faster using simple study material and real practice questions from Pass4success can help you close the gap without making things harder.

You do not need to master everything you just need to understand how Copilot works. And now you are already moving in the right direction.

---

Los niños sí que saben aprovechar el tiempo, cuando de bañarse se trata quieren ser los primeros en meterse al río, luego viene la parte no tan divertida porque al momento de irse no quieren salir del agua, esta poza fue un oasis, agua fresca, lindas vistas y rocas como almohadas.


Feliz finde ❤️

*Hi @avdesing, it was quite an adventure finding a natural pool to swim in. Along the way, I could see how dry the river was—I’d never been there during the dry season before. Plus, the view of the mountains is beautiful; this area is known for its spectacular scenery that invites you to enjoy being in nature. I loved visiting the pool.*

*Kids really know how to make the most of their time. When it comes to swimming, they want to be the first ones in the river. Then comes the not-so-fun part—when it’s time to leave, they don’t want to get out of the water. This pool was an oasis: cool water, beautiful views, and rocks that felt like pillows.*


*Have a great weekend ❤️*

body.title: United Kingdom - A Relaxing Day Trip To Bath
body.body:
<center>![20140615_140513.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/242hWazv6jgndfXTg8Z7eonCRLJq89FXczEHboPV554m2TM7BQDKvy2ZikAXxMf37wbv8.jpg)</center>

Hello there!

Having completed my earlier travel posts on several interesting countries and regions, including Japan, Maldives, Indonesia, US, Europe, New Zealand and the latest one being Australia, it's time to fly over to United Kingdom!

This was a trip I made in 2014, I was there partly for work and partly for leisure as well. At that point in my life, it was one of the further destination that I have travelled all the way from Asia and it was definitely an eye opener to see how United Kingdom, or more specifically London, looked like. One thing that I remembered vividly was how strong GBP was, and everything was so expensive. For example, even though the numerical digits of the prices were small, because 5 or 10 GBP was easily a lot already. Anyway, time to relive those moments as I share the sights and sounds of my experience!

Here are the posts so far:
[United Kingdom - Living The Football Dream With Chelsea](https://peakd.com/hive-163772/@relf87/united-kingdom-living-the-football-dream-with-chelsea)
[United Kingdom - The Beauty Of Art and Shopping In London](https://peakd.com/hive-163772/@relf87/united-kingdom-the-beauty-of-art-and-shopping-in-london)
[United Kingdom - Spectacular Fireworks at Horse Guards Parade](https://peakd.com/hive-163772/@relf87/united-kingdom-spectacular-fireworks-at-horse-guards-parade)
[United Kingdom - Discovering History At The Tower Of London](https://peakd.com/hive-163772/@relf87/united-kingdom-discovering-history-at-the-tower-of-london)
[United Kingdom - Breathtaking Views From The Shard](https://peakd.com/hive-163772/@relf87/united-kingdom-breathtaking-views-from-the-shard)
[United Kingdom - Trooping The Colour Ceremony At Buckingham Palace](https://peakd.com/hive-163772/@relf87/united-kingdom-trooping-the-colour-ceremony-at-buckingham-palace)
[United Kingdom - Spectacular Airshow Over Buckingham Palace](https://peakd.com/hive-163772/@relf87/united-kingdom-spectacular-airshow-over-buckingham-palace)

[//]:# (!worldmappin 51.38253 lat -2.35811 long United Kingdom - A Relaxing Day Trip To Bath d3scr)
***
As if London itself wasn't entertaining and vibrant enough, I actually managed to squeeze in a day trip in the midst of the busy schedule and visited Bath, a city that is not too far from London.

Bath is a small city well known for its architecture and Roman baths, which is why that is the name for the city.

First up, we were at this place called The Circus, which is made up of a circle of houses. Pretty interesting design of the architecture. Too bad I wasn't able to capture the entire view because the compound was just too big.


<center>![20140615_114010.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23r1igyWTUQdAEhijdWT7oCj9QGEsofdkigfKASRhEmxfjS9U5o1ddoN32iXSEa924nRm.jpg)</center>


<center>![20140615_114027.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/241tXG68EKtpWGgQetwfpa5V7Ai8iG7VADK3xpL3xpH4t5NJBU5QfZadtuHdMZTdNSwaQ.jpg)</center>

Nearby to The Circus, there's another place called Royal Crescent, where the houses are arranged in a crescent shape. And interestingly, both places were within walking distance from each other.

<center>![20140615_114844.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23w2qMfWb9ABdfJ8TEZ6EvfqfvNSswN5hGceKM1oroGV69D7w2MQwaXoqTnGsZ1sSUNBd.jpg)</center>

<center>![20140615_114510.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/245T9brU5LkujRfrCaoDb3CwqgTpNgVB75sJZ4AgGbYqaS91EyhvzB9BaxAhKPF2Wjb1W.jpg)</center>

There was some exercise event going on in the field as well.

<center>![20140615_114720.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/2466kgZkxnvPbFT2n6Ek79U1oeM9foLqYK7ijDybBG8uTVm54twh5VV2ABPUS6Nr95usH.jpg)</center>

Here's one of the museum in the city of Bath, called Jane Auston Centre. Due to the packed schedule in the day trip, I didn't venture in.

<center>![20140615_115719.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23wMguLUvwdugf7xdht4FbyuHdHAQ4SVfPUyb7v1EsgbXRNzW2EHm9JXXvowbYBG8AHMs.jpg)</center>

We also wandered around the streets in the city. The vibes were very relaxing in this one, and there was just a sense of tranquility in this chill city.

<center>![20140615_120424.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/242YCHKEyVP6zThxsV6MGDaBjKVEmpUgro1pJuynUt5HkBtsFKS6a34cE6hvrJD9LMmrW.jpg)</center>



<center>![20140615_120428.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23xefSpVakG3EaSm9kbbPjAQuqe4Kta61qLPfNhT8hVpBnjJtMHCNCdivH3Kgwj7QzSh8.jpg)</center>
 

They also have an art gallery too!


<center>![20140615_120730.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23xAZf26FMdDy3m1sY261gHWj3bHu9kUuc9HUhMePnyV6kSwwKhkhy7ePbgqALqiYUCnk.jpg)</center>

And then we reached one of the more scenic places in Bath, and that's Pulteney Bridge!

<center>![20140615_120909.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23ynSED7i7sNBJMGVnWmQDrVRZZtqz4Q5hc3HfgKhDdY7LtXLpkDTMjEmNLj91qVEThYo.jpg)</center>

And facing one side of the bridge was this awesome view! A river, some gardens, and there was even one ferry in the river! I stood in the spot for a while, admiring the scenery, taking some photos, and enjoying the breath of fresh air. It was just so relaxing.

<center>![20140615_120829.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/2458NWgiBUgZK3BFs1DknYWLfkQ9suGvQ6oLJ1D3HATDfpYufSvSkkx9uMjHWwtwme1d8.jpg)</center>


<center>![20140615_120926.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23vhsM3qm6JYTPTdMyaVywzxMRubNfTMNsKTxHV4DYA9w98hvZmTQEtHMQHmmdfaEash2.jpg)</center>


<center>![20140615_120948.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23yd3zsNyELaS77mFAQQrSD9zNPtzYaB7A5cahC6LRmak94nYHMWyhquCYM5TZtrJBDjq.jpg)</center>


<center>![20140615_140513.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/242hWazv6jgndfXTg8Z7eonCRLJq89FXczEHboPV554m2TM7BQDKvy2ZikAXxMf37wbv8.jpg)</center>

After lunch, I also managed to stroll through the gardens and explored more streets in Bath. It's not so crowded, unlike most major cities, and that's why it felt so refreshing and relaxing over here.

<center>![20140615_140631.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23ujkLuJvxypUv7zT7nw8bt5Wpwnigg3n6yU41NHhdQkYMfKQqDCdiGRbhT4PPcqf32kH.jpg)</center>


<center>![20140615_121113.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23qrLK7V1nYgawcm3CdQVXknKKLDthPCbdZVJt4WZFBPEz9MugnuiRfvM5Txh6Fkeb4hu.jpg)</center>


<center>![20140615_121438.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23zvF9z9758Vp8qAgVNqXXXrdwXgTQmz88kNzPoD2y8wPbUPLMhaTfjDiJNTrBBxXosZ2.jpg)</center>


<center>![20140615_121609.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/243M9JDaytMDkcU7LUSaysm2upuzeQBCfT7h5uWaFjA4d4UbznNCZ8YCueD7UK4cjLwQp.jpg)</center>


<center>![20140615_141503.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/244xwuRtuaSUEoPa2MPEHnuCb8hANWaA7FV8HNYUSkx2G9yefHJLPADTErpatXfUcVvNG.jpg)</center>



And that's all I have today! Have you been to London or United Kingdom? Let me know in the comments below!

Finally, thanks for reading my post in the community under World Map Pin!

[//]:# (!worldmappin 51.38253 lat -2.35811 long United Kingdom - A Relaxing Day Trip To Bath d3scr)

body.body:
## Hello everyone!!! 
### I hope so you all are fine and happy 😀 

Economic problems isn't just the problem in our country but it's the whole world economy isn't in good condition. Every one is trying to survive and fulfill the desire of their life. But for some it's not even easy to manage the basics thing within their salaries as salaries are like almost dead while other's expenses growing day by day. But people are trying to do more part time jobs to fulfill their needs and desire. 


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaF9h9JWu2zhgasChnH39QUWs9xt2c2Vt8MQQYCSEjTtc/1775815057900.jpg)
#### Image by <a href=\

>Pixabay ### If Money wasn't a problem!!! I've money that i could easily buy good dresses and shoes but there are thing's which i can't even think about it because Money is the main problem. Big dream's require big money lol and that's the simplest formula of life. Basically buying a house is dream of men's mostly in our society but I want to buy a house not a regular house but a well furnished house. Actually in this society, before marriage girls lives in the house of her Dad and after marriage girls live in the house of her husband house. I know that's how life works and we live with it but we can see dreams. I know buying a house ain't easy thing and I can easily live because i know I've facility to live in my husband house but still i dreamed of buying a house. Funny fact I can just dreamed about it, once i was calculating my all money which I've in my e-wallets, in my physical wallets and the money I've invested in cryptocurrency and all of this Hive money lol believe i don't have even 20% of the money which i need to buy a house. Last month i was talking about it to my mother that I'm so poor that I don't have money to buy my own house and she simply replied like other Brown mom's that why do you need it? Are you living on the road!!?? Argh!!! What is this? Like seriously!!??? I know my parents never took me seriously in all these talks as they think I'm living a life which so many dreamed about it and they always started to give me a lecture like you should thank to God for the thing's you've in your life. It's okay I thank to God too but i still have some dream's which I want to see happening in my life. > That's all for today and it's my entry in this week #iucontest. And you can also take part in the contest and see the rules from [here](https://ecency.com/hive-197685/@indiaunited/indiaunited-new-contest-and-last-7a7caf29dc7dd). * Thank you for your time and support 🙏

> ![1000251708.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sarangzg7/23y9Az9LJvCzv6aNXhrUPsRpq3j5KNo4TJidPh3wKkdDZ7LsFZviC7ANWL5y6YYABfbcH.png) **Holis gente bonita|Hello beautiful people**🥰 El día de hoy les traigo una manualidad súper improvisada, literal no lo tenía planeado,pero de repente me dieron ganas de intentar hacerla a ver cómo quedaba, todo comenzó porque últimamente el algoritmo de Instagram a estado enviandome videos de manualidades con flores secas, específicamente separadores de página y me he quedado fascinada con lo hermosos que quedan y lo hermosas que se ven las flores secas, así que me dispuse con muy poca experiencia a secar mis propias flores con la clásica herramienta, un libro. 📕 >Today I’m sharing a super impromptu craft project with you—I really hadn’t planned it at all, but I suddenly felt like giving it a try to see how it would turn out. It all started because lately Instagram’s algorithm has been showing me videos of crafts made with dried flowers, specifically bookmarks, and I’ve been fascinated by how beautiful they look and how gorgeous the dried flowers are, so, with very little experience, I set out to dry my own flowers using the classic tool: a book. 📕 Me resulta muy chistoso porque realmente ese día iba a hacer unos stickers que compartiré con ustedes Dios mediante, ya había terminado de dibujar cada figura y de recortar, incluso había puesto la primera capa de cinta adhesiva en el papel encerado, pero me di cuenta de que los dibujos estaban todos ondulados y eso me iba a dificultar hacer los stickers, así que dije bueno voy a buscar un libro pesado para meter los dibujos y aplanarlos un poco y justo en ese momento veo las flores que había puesto a secar hace unos días y como ya tenía el material para hacer los stickers listo, pues decidí experimentar un poco, así que sin más preámbulo los dejo con la lista de materiales y el paso a paso de esta imprvisada e inesperada pero hermosa manualidad. 🥰🤭 >I find it really funny because that day I was actually going to make some stickers that I’ll share with you, God willing. I had already finished drawing and cutting out each shape, and I’d even put the first layer of tape on the wax paper, but I realized the drawings were all wavy, and that was going to make it hard to make the stickers, so I said, “Okay, I’ll find a heavy book to weigh down the drawings and flatten them a bit.” And just then, I saw the flowers I’d set out to dry a few days ago. Since I already had all the materials for the stickers ready, I decided to experiment a little. So, without further ado, here’s the list of materials and the step-by-step guide for this impromptu, unexpected, but beautiful craft. 🥰🤭 ![1000037741.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sarangzg7/23wXQmmT6db4YaJPaqgyAk9bkwGpaksL9zs54KiDEdkqLMvFERM39iqDU8pbpD3BkwWhu.png)
✨**Materiales|Materials**✨
* Flores secas. * Papel encerado. * Cinta adhesiva. * Tijeras. - - - * Dried flowers. * Wax paper. * Masking tape. * Scissors. ![1000037741.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sarangzg7/23wXQmmT6db4YaJPaqgyAk9bkwGpaksL9zs54KiDEdkqLMvFERM39iqDU8pbpD3BkwWhu.png)
✨**Paso a paso**|**Step-by-step**✨
Para esta manualidad obviamente hay que poner a secar flores naturales, no tengo fotos de ese paso porque como les comenté en la introducción las flores que usé para esta manualidad las había puesto a secar hace días solo como prueba así que no se me ocurrió sacarle fotos, más adelante cuando aprenda bien cuál es el mejor método para secarlas entonces lo compartiré. >For this craft project, you obviously need to dry some fresh flowers. I don’t have any photos of that step because, as I mentioned in the introduction, I had already dried the flowers I used for this project a few days ago just as a test, so it didn’t occur to me to take pictures of it. Later on, once I’ve figured out the best method for drying them, I’ll share it. ![1000037741.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sarangzg7/23wXQmmT6db4YaJPaqgyAk9bkwGpaksL9zs54KiDEdkqLMvFERM39iqDU8pbpD3BkwWhu.png) ![1000249053.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sarangzg7/AJj1ATBAsSwMEWupq2j8VLNkT5ZhH1cxvxfxfhHbPCx8fR5aE29qnpT4ZjnY3y4.jpg) Lo primero que hice fue poner una capa de cinta adhesiva en el papel encerado, siento que tenerlo listo y haber encontrado las flores secas por casualidad fue genial ya que gracias a eso se me ocurrió experimentar. 🥰 >The first thing I did was apply a layer of masking tape to the wax paper. I’m so glad I had it ready and happened to find the dried flowers by chance—it really inspired me to experiment. 🥰 ![1000037741.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sarangzg7/23wXQmmT6db4YaJPaqgyAk9bkwGpaksL9zs54KiDEdkqLMvFERM39iqDU8pbpD3BkwWhu.png) ![1000249054.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sarangzg7/AJoKZX7ZiLrrCWoBoJLaGv5s9GL82JTYJUfRKvmPBURisBjedmZZTV9seQ996i5.jpg) Luego coloque las flores secas encima sin ningún orden en específico, solo intenté dejar una distancia prudente entre una y otra para poder dejar un contorno al recortar. >Then arrange the dried flowers on top in no particular order; I just tried to leave a reasonable amount of space between them so I could cut out an outline. ![1000037741.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sarangzg7/23wXQmmT6db4YaJPaqgyAk9bkwGpaksL9zs54KiDEdkqLMvFERM39iqDU8pbpD3BkwWhu.png) ![1000249055.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sarangzg7/AK6YNUBUYtDC1Qg54owvMDSQ8hJ3RYYmRNmA28CnzqtBXFdVa4zFC2QWhkthtny.jpg) El siguiente paso fue colocar la otra capa de cinta adhesiva por encima. Siento que por la emoción de ver el resultado final hice todo muy rápido y no quedó tan estético, debí ser más delicada al poner la cinta adhesiva encima de las flores. Por eso siento que está es una manualidad que tengo que mejorar más adelante. >The next step was to place the other layer of tape on top. I think that, in my excitement to see the final result, I rushed through it and it didn't turn out as neat as I'd hoped; I should have been more careful when placing the tape over the flowers. That's why I feel this is a craft project I need to work on improving in the future. ![1000037741.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sarangzg7/23wXQmmT6db4YaJPaqgyAk9bkwGpaksL9zs54KiDEdkqLMvFERM39iqDU8pbpD3BkwWhu.png) ![1000249056.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sarangzg7/AK3frcPdScgm1akhRvU2zdogXvzQ7oHWVubEFmg4piftoeQMo6zhS2Ba4RserrF.jpg) Por último recorte cada sticker dejando un contorno, aunque repito tenía tanta prisa por ver cómo quedaba que recorte bastante feo la verdad 😆🤭 cuando haga más en el futuro procuraré que queden más estéticos, con una formas más bonita. >Finally, I cut out each sticker along the outline, though I have to admit I was in such a hurry to see how they’d turn out that I cut them out pretty poorly, to be honest 😆🤭. When I make more in the future, I’ll try to make them look nicer, with neater shapes. ![1000037741.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sarangzg7/23wXQmmT6db4YaJPaqgyAk9bkwGpaksL9zs54KiDEdkqLMvFERM39iqDU8pbpD3BkwWhu.png) ![1000249057.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sarangzg7/AL1doHwDiPEsPhYAv7iJ9BqWK6cj5s1XTwKaQNkUeaygHEWu2nKFLrcv1xr5SQT.jpg) Por último quiero mostrarles como es el proceso para pegarlos, es súper fácil solo debes despegar la cinta adhesiva del papel encerado como se ve en la imagen. >Finally, I want to show you how to stick them on. It’s super easy—just peel the adhesive tape off the wax paper, as shown in the picture. ![1000037741.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sarangzg7/23wXQmmT6db4YaJPaqgyAk9bkwGpaksL9zs54KiDEdkqLMvFERM39iqDU8pbpD3BkwWhu.png) ![1000249058.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sarangzg7/AL7P16sx4qxxGJ3UCxGp8993qj1PEtHAcJRLDbG6YF2ZTn81j7QUd3qJ8Lh3zLZ.jpg) Lo que me gusta de esta técnica es que la primera capa de adhesivo que se pone en el papel encerado es lo que va a permitir que el sticker se pueda pegar a cualquier superficie, a diferencia de otros stickers caseros donde la única parte que tiene pega es la parte del contorno del sticker y el resto crece de adhesivo, como pueden ver en esta imagen esa cara que les muestro del sticker es la parte con pegamento del adhesivo, se nota porque es bastante opaca, o sea, no tiene nada de brillo. >What I like about this technique is that the first layer of adhesive applied to the wax paper is what allows the sticker to stick to any surface, unlike other homemade stickers where the only part with adhesive is the outline of the sticker and the rest is made of adhesive. As you can see in this image, the side of the sticker I’m showing you is the part with the adhesive, You can tell because it’s quite opaque—in other words, it has no shine at all. ![1000037741.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sarangzg7/23wXQmmT6db4YaJPaqgyAk9bkwGpaksL9zs54KiDEdkqLMvFERM39iqDU8pbpD3BkwWhu.png) ![1000249059.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sarangzg7/AKpAVnPgsbZXHLHEAffZLbh9wYUEpG9eZLz4gwozZdtAdM3AiE6pSFysWWBhjze.jpg) Y está es la parte del frente del sticker, como pueden ver ese lado es brillante en comparación con el lado que posee el adhesivo (no sé si me doy a entender, a veces me enredo un poco al tratar de explicar ciertas cosas)🤭 >And this is the front side of the sticker. As you can see, that side is shiny compared to the side with the adhesive (I hope that makes sense—sometimes I get a little confused when trying to explain certain things)🤭 ![1000037741.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sarangzg7/23wXQmmT6db4YaJPaqgyAk9bkwGpaksL9zs54KiDEdkqLMvFERM39iqDU8pbpD3BkwWhu.png) ![1000249060.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sarangzg7/AJpjngTnqV1ukKpHxXxMMHs5fUsBFHfwZMTgrH9vob6yEMwZDDmoVpBsQZx3b59.jpg) Y para ver qué tan bien quedó decidí hacer la prueba pegando el sticker en mi puerta 🚪 luego me di cuenta que fue una mala elección, hubiese sido mejor pegarlo en algún cuaderno 📓 pero en ese momento no se me ocurrió 🤣 a pesar de todo ame el resultado y quiero intentar mejorarlo y hacerlo con más calma, paciencia y delicadeza. 🥰❤️ >And to see how well it turned out, I decided to test it by sticking the sticker on my door 🚪. Then I realized that was a bad choice—it would have been better to stick it on a notebook 📓—but it didn't occur to me at the time 🤣. Despite everything, I loved the result, and I want to try to improve it and do it with more calm, patience, and care. 🥰❤️ **Y esto es todo por hoy, sí les gusto no olviden darle amorshito a mi post dejando un lindo comentario o dando click en el corazoncito. 💜😉😊🤭🥰 Nos vemos en un próximo post, que estén bien y Dios los bendiga, bye.**🥰😘💜🌹🪷 >**And that's all for today, if you like me don't forget to give love to my post by leaving a nice comment or clicking on the little heart. 💜😉😊🤭🥰 See you in a next post, be well and God bless you, bye.**🥰😘💜🌹🪷 ![1000037741.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sarangzg7/23wXQmmT6db4YaJPaqgyAk9bkwGpaksL9zs54KiDEdkqLMvFERM39iqDU8pbpD3BkwWhu.png) ***Fotografías propias, tomadas con mi Tecno Spark 10 Pro editadas en incollage/ portada creada en Canva. Traducción al inglés con DeepL.*** >***Own photos, taken with my Tecno Spark 10 Pro edited in incollage/ cover created in Canva. Translation to English with DeepL.*** ![1000030417.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sarangzg7/23xevZdpSHErkRmENVYgiL2NvCfX9dD3j8ZFU96YbpbM1N4oS6yLANE7RoyFV4WwLDH3Y.png)

body.title: Vitex agnus castus - Lamiaceae (ENG/ITA)
body.body:
>

### Vitex agnus castus - Lamiaceae (ENG)

Vitex agnus-castus, also known as chaste tree, is a deciduous shrub belonging to the Verbenaceae family. It grows wild in Mediterranean regions, preferring well-drained soil and sunny locations.

**It is a hardy plant, capable of tolerating temperatures as low as -10°C, a characteristic that facilitates its cultivation even in non-Mediterranean environments.**

![AGNOCASTO.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ghilvar/EqJ2o3yQsaHqnqTqFUU23U8kbK29NQF8cg2cLrraFHY3HUFQrGZFdz6DPcpSFqt7KD5.png)

<sub> image created with canva.com </sub>

In summer, it produces fragrant inflorescences and dark fruits, the so-called \

which are the most commonly used medicinal part. The chaste tree's phytocomplex is rich in flavonoids, iridoids, glucosides, and bitter principles, substances that contribute to its biological activity. The plant is considered a phytoestrogen, a natural modulator of female hormonal balance. Its balsamic period is September, when the fruits reach their maximum concentration of active ingredients. **The action of chaste tree has been extensively studied in gynecology.** According to available evidence, its effect appears to be linked to the modulation of the hypothalamic-pituitary-ovarian axis: it promotes a reduction in the release of follicle-stimulating hormone (FSH) and an increase in luteinizing hormone (LH) and prolactin. For this reason, the German Ministry of Health recommends its use for menstrual cycle abnormalities, particularly in cases of premenstrual syndrome, menstrual irregularities, and menopause-related disorders. **The toxicity of chasteberry is considered low, but not negligible.** Ingestion may cause headache, menstrual changes, and heavy menstrual bleeding. Furthermore, the plant may interact with hormone therapies, including contraceptives and fertility treatments. It is contraindicated during pregnancy and breastfeeding, and the use of supplements or herbal preparations should always be discussed with a doctor or qualified healthcare professional. **Historically, chasteberry was also recommended to stimulate breast milk production, but modern studies have not confirmed its effective galactagogue activity, which is why this indication has been abandoned.** One of the most common forms is the medicinal tincture, obtained by macerating 10 g of crushed ripe capsules in 100 ml of a 62° hydroalcoholic solution for 21 days. After filtering, the preparation can be stored for up to 3 years. The traditional dosage is 30 drops per day, generally used to support the treatment of premenstrual syndrome and menopausal symptoms. **Vitex agnus-castus is one of the most studied and used plants in female herbal medicine. Despite being a natural remedy, it affects the delicate hormonal system, which requires attention, monitoring, and informed use.** Its effectiveness is recognized in several European countries, but it should always be included in a personalized and supervised therapeutic program. ![hive dividers.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ghilvar/23t7BKexriBKviA9doWkBpvE3WA2yKQxfis1QCtDQU7rvAhxaNrDHcMfy5XLqadsaDEDf.png) ### Vitex agnus castus - Lamiaceae (ITA) Il Vitex agnus‑castus, noto anche come agnocasto, è un arbusto deciduo appartenente alla famiglia delle Verbenaceae. Cresce spontaneamente nelle regioni mediterranee, prediligendo terreni ben drenati e posizioni soleggiate. **È una pianta rustica, capace di tollerare temperature minime fino a –10 °C, caratteristica che ne facilita la coltivazione anche in contesti non strettamente mediterranei.** ![fitoterapia.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ghilvar/EoiW7vV1iNdbPAu48RSNX3FA44CE16HK74aEHuWEf5mZSMQWgTc91zo14mQKHWyiLLo.jpg) image created with canva.com Produce in estate infiorescenze profumate e frutti scuri, le cosiddette “capsule mature”, che rappresentano la parte officinale più utilizzata. Il fitocomplesso dell’agnocasto è ricco di flavonoidi, iridoidi, glucosidi e principi amari, sostanze che contribuiscono alla sua attività biologica. La pianta è considerata un fitoestrogeno, cioè un modulatore naturale dell’equilibrio ormonale femminile. Il suo periodo balsamico è settembre, quando i frutti raggiungono la massima concentrazione di principi attivi. **L’azione dell’agnocasto è stata ampiamente studiata in ambito ginecologico.** Secondo le evidenze disponibili, il suo effetto sembra legato alla modulazione dell’asse ipotalamo‑ipofisi‑ovaio: favorirebbe una riduzione del rilascio dell’ormone follicolo‑stimolante (FSH) e un aumento dell’ormone luteinizzante (LH) e della prolattina. Per questo motivo, il Ministero della Salute tedesco ne consiglia l’uso nelle anomalie del ciclo mestruale, in particolare nei casi di sindrome premestruale, irregolarità del ciclo e disturbi legati alla menopausa. **La tossicità dell’agnocasto è considerata bassa, ma non trascurabile.** L’assunzione può provocare cefalea, alterazioni del ciclo e perdite mestruali abbondanti. Inoltre, la pianta può interagire con terapie ormonali, inclusi contraccettivi e trattamenti per la fertilità. È controindicata in gravidanza e allattamento, e l’uso di integratori o preparati fitoterapici deve sempre essere valutato con un medico o un professionista sanitario qualificato. **Storicamente, l’agnocasto veniva consigliato anche per stimolare la produzione di latte materno, ma gli studi moderni non hanno confermato un’efficace attività galattogoga, motivo per cui questa indicazione è stata abbandonata.** Una delle forme più comuni è la tintura officinale, ottenuta facendo macerare 10 g di capsule mature tritate in 100 ml di soluzione idroalcolica a 62° per 21 giorni. Dopo filtrazione, il preparato si conserva fino a 3 anni. Il dosaggio tradizionale è di 30 gocce al giorno, generalmente utilizzate per sostenere il trattamento della sindrome premestruale e dei disturbi della menopausa. **Il Vitex agnus‑castus rappresenta una delle piante più studiate e utilizzate nella fitoterapia femminile. Pur essendo un rimedio naturale, agisce su un sistema delicato come quello ormonale, motivo per cui richiede attenzione, monitoraggio e un utilizzo informato.** La sua efficacia è riconosciuta in diversi Paesi europei, ma va sempre inserita in un percorso terapeutico personalizzato e supervisionato. Sources - Fonti : https://www.humanitas.it/enciclopedia/integratori-alimentari/agnocasto/ https://www.my-personaltrainer.it/fitoterapia/agnocasto.html ![firmaGhilvar.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ghilvar/48SqxfhNw6nwwJEZACBwzAmKDssU5forXXdWSwLWVbz8NizZXvx3EVgejfYYTvq7cb.png)

body.title: MONOMAD FRIDAY \
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT5v483oLkLgk4V1tedq9Bhqm2Apaz2KMt5n16goLs1bb/collage_1_.jpg)

Hello Hive Community.

I hope you all are fine. I am also fine here. This is my entry for the #monomad challenge April 9th. In today's post, I have presented natural scenes to you. In which you will mainly see mountains and natural scenes. The photographs shown in today's post are captured during a visit to Kedarkantha. Kedarkantha is a famous place for trekkers. During winter, the mountains are covered with snow which creates wonderful natural scenes.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP7ekxY1r7SjEeBJjFtJkzBedM5CeCPf2SK8FyDC1F648/1_1.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbisvrX63S8bpci9SyZce9QofJ2oki9LXjN5N8aePfinP/2_2.jpg)

Here above, I have presented two photographs with you. In the first photograph, a flag can be seen waving on the top of the mountain. This flag is red in color which creates a beautiful contrast in the background of white snow and clouds. While in the second photograph, I have captured a tall tree and presented it to you. In the first photograph presented above, a calm and peaceful scene is seen on the top of the hill.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXTUvGEprwTMTENNxaSBwNVGaKz2dwMiNM22MP2FJzE9t/3_3.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcjuG1CiX2CwcwheWnGbihpnXDiALGFxKNiJeBdkAt5gA/4_4.jpg)

As can be seen in the second photograph above, a tall pillar is standing firmly in the ground in the middle. The pillar holds a bright red flag, which I told you about above. The flag is seen waving in the wind. From the waving flag, one can guess that this place is high and open. The strong wind makes the flag move freely. Which enlivens the otherwise calm atmosphere. If you look carefully at this photograph, below the flag there is a low stone wall made of dark, rough rocks. Near the wall there are some large stones and a small structure. If you look at the structure, it looks like a simple marker.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmef2NXr2FZC6GJgW3deWwju6PHBM7CAg9BvMuQ1PEb5zH/5_5.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcHCRYDesL995zvLLCqKkVq85AaNhq7SikUP4FUY2QbVi/6_6.jpg)

There is a similarity in the above photograph. This photograph shows a beautiful and peaceful view of high mountains. In the second photograph, in the foreground, there are piles of flat stones carefully arranged on top of each other. These are small stone towers that have been built by people who have visited this place. They are used as symbols of signs, hope and prayer. The ground ahead is rocky and uneven. There are large flat stones lying on the ground. Dry grass is spread around them. A small piece of snow can also be seen at the corner. This place is on the top of the mountain due to which this place is cold.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRP4UM7j3sQLDFfAAmtg5mX3PnA9uWV2aafm9sCjtTmJk/7_7.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVyjTzzCCMidF6A453fVX54WRg2G7SKLDG86DMz9qzBaz/8_8.jpg)

As can be seen in the photographs taken above, the sky is filled with thick clouds. The clouds are spread across the sky. Which creates a soft and slightly gloomy atmosphere. The light of the sun is hidden behind the clouds. Due to which the whole scene looks calm and peaceful. These photographs are captured on the top of the mountain due to which small pieces of snow are also visible there. The climate here remains cold for most of the year.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTZJz11fwkiaro56tmQNJcMMJfiTUJ33V7MG3CKjHoVTp/9_9.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcmkMUS6eKrcHsvpPJDtHEWtV9dAb8UsfsJqjCWw5sctb/10_10.jpg)

Each of the photographs presented here above presents a simple yet powerful view of nature and human presence. The waving flag stands against the gray sky which symbolizes strength, faith. The rocky ground, stone wall and cloudy sky together create a feeling of solitude, peace and natural beauty. Each of these photographs captures the beauty of nature in a simple yet powerful way.

I am very happy to make today's post because I have presented post on Mountains. I hope that my post will be accepted for the #monomad challenge April 9th.

I sincerely thank you for visiting and reading my post.

body.title: Endura Brune vs Giam Root – Which Tank Monster Performs Better in Battle?
body.body:
![tANK COMPARISON.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23wC12HdNMsWZ3CS1j8EtRujCProPX5dUHtEC4VpsoD3dhKuGjTCrAAAh8SWqeMqEANoU.png)


Before entering any mana battle game it is important to understand what kind of tank monster you should use because battles come with random mana. Sometimes there is low mana, sometimes mid mana and sometimes high mana battles. 

You need to select the best of the cards in all of your positions so that the team work must have a good combination and they fought in a very good way.

It is better to have strategies that help you understand what kind of monster you should use in each mana. What type of tank monster, which aggressive monsters, support magic attack and what type of monsters should be placed.

Today I will compare two tank monsters that are both strong and powerful. These two monsters are more suitable for mid to high mana battles because their mana cost is high.

![Screenshot 2026-04-10 122836.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23vrjrcN4j83LP3oYaaAdY5AqfMUBZnq9UiJdqJCVipHCLofCy7ahHQFN4pGFJgTs6bYm.png)

Remember that in some battles it is very important that your tank monster also has aggressive ability. For example if you select a tank monster that has armor, good health and also attack power then it can damage the opponent every round while also absorbing damage.

The two monsters I have brought for comparison today are Endura Brune and Giam Root. Both of these monsters are considered tank monsters and are suitable to place as front line or secondary tank.

First of all both monster cards have a mana cost of 9 so there is no difference in mana cost. 

If I talk about Endura Brune its attack power is considered its best ability because it deals +2 damage to enemy units every round. Another good thing is that it has 2 armor shield which helps protect its health.

Even if the armor shield is gone it has 10 health which helps it survive in long battles. This means it has the ability to absorb damage and keep protecting allied units.

Its speed ability is 3 which increases its own attack speed and helps it attack faster. Also it boosts the allied unit attacks with this ability.

![Screenshot 2026-04-10 122911.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23uEsY3Fv4J9oJVpZYgcjvd25VD9MXznV6KNkukRy2MVfmFdAVr4fScgp8YBhprz1Tfo2.png)

In comparison there is Giam Root. If you look at its visual display it appears dangerous and aggressive and the shape of Tree. Its mana cost is also 9.

Its strong ability is also its attack power as it attacks with +1 damage every round. Its health is 11 which is more than Endura Brune meaning it has better ability to absorb more damage.

Its speed is also 3 which is the same as of Endura Brune..

These both tank monsters are amazing and if placed against each other can create a very strong and interesting battle. Both have almost similar power and their abilities are almost matching which is the interesting part. 

Which of these monsters do you like the more? which one would you prefer??

What do you people think about this monster? Have you ever played with this monster? Tell about its any ability you know. Will be glad to see your answers in the comment section.

I hope you find this post useful and informative.. If you do, please remember to reblog it so that it reaches as many people as possible and that they can benefit the most from it. Also remember to upvote which will help me financially and grow my account.

body.title: Holy week is it biblical// Mcgi topic review
body.body:
Holy week is usually the new tradition in some Christians churches which they use to remember the death and resurrection of Jesus Christ in this world. The Bible clearly records these events, especially in the Gospels, showing their importance in God’s plan of salvation. However, the Bible does not specifically command Christians to celebrate a set week called “Holy Week.” What it emphasizes instead is the remembrance of Christ’s sacrifice and the power of His resurrection.

https://youtu.be/PR6KqmOnUJ0?si=MF7Bu7xFYUGgjnxL

Holy Week can be seen as a helpful and meaningful time for reflection if it draws people closer to God and reminds them of Jesus’ sacrifice. However, it should not be treated as a requirement for salvation or as something that replaces daily devotion. Biblically, true worship is not limited to certain days, but is a continuous life of faith, gratitude, and obedience to God.

body.title: Як живе мій шпинат і як ми все ще шукаємо будинок
body.body:
/>

Привіт,

Місяць тому я викладала свій експеримент з шпинатом, який я вирощую методом гідропоніки. В пляшечках він все ще живе и розвивається. В лотку всі загинули, туди треба було підливати розчин, бо швидко випаровувався, а зберегти баланс між розчином і повітрям важче, бо рослинки нефіксовані. Мені здається, що розвиток трошки відстає від графіку, бо кущ має вирости до збору врожаю за сім тижнів, і я вже на п'ятому тижні. Щось не віриться, що я за два тижні зберу врожай. Перед наступним експериментом я планую зафарбувати пляшки, якщо знайду фарбу, що тримається. І це буде краще виглядати.

Чоловік ще висадив розмарин та перець, і у нього є сходи, але це і весь наш \

, бо ділянку ми все ще шукаємо. Я продовжую розглядати і на Хайві, і на Ютубі сільські блоги і городні справи, бо мені також дуже хочеться :) Наразі з усіх будинків/ділянок, які ми подивились, ми виділили дві. Одна дуже близько до траси на Миронівку-Богуслав, і там найнижча ціна, що для нас дуже актуально, але там будинок абсолютно ні під що непридатний (без груби і з поплившими глиняними стінами, ще й обкладений цеглою, тож нам там доведеться попрацювати, щоб все те прибрати. В тому числі там є льох, який нам не потрібен, і тільки літню кухню/сарайчик можна залишити і полагодити. Я поки не викладатиму світлин, бо ж це все чуже. Там є одна величезна перевага перед усіма іншими недорогими ділянками - на трасі прямо за сто метрів від нас стоїть заправка, а в ній є і фастфуд, і... туалет!!! Бо ж швидко ми це не організуємо, якщо у нас і будинку немає. Також поруч ну як у київському передмісті є ресторанчик біля дороги, навіть трохи подалі ще один, а через поле ще й виноробня з рестораном, та закритим і відкритим басейнами (наче там ще готель є). Озера... хоч обрибалься ) Але і ділянка сходить трошки вниз до того, що колись було річечкою, і сусіди облаштовують собі ставочки там, якщо заглибити прямо на ділянці. Ділянка трошки вузенька, але будинок ми можемо трохи посунути до центру, я думаю, бо напевно будемо купувати модульний варіант, щоб швидше, але без внутрішнього оздоблення, яке поступово доробимо. Мені подобаються модульні варіанти в біло-чорному дизайні, тим паче, що вони чудово вписуються в сільське оточення.

/>

Зрозуміло, що це трохи не наш клімат і відчуття безпеки, але як відправна модель приблизно така. Одна спальня і кухня-вітальня. Тераса на інший бік будинку і там зона барбекю і садок, а вже чим далі від будинку, тим більше фруктових дерев і теплиці. Ми насправді прикинули, що почнемо з десь стометрової теплиці, і можливо й максимум додамо ще дві. Треба й оцінити свої сили і подивитись скільки зможемо виростити.

Якщо ж ми не встигнемо купити цю ділянку (там близько 25 соток), то купимо трохи подалі, бо сюди нам їхати близько 25-30 хвилин, і з трохи гіршою дорогою, особливо останні метри під гору, але там рівна широка ділянка в 60 соток, якої нам вистачить на все життя. Там більше про півників село, і типовий сільський спокій, щоб десь щось пиляють, десь щось кричить, стучить тощо. Будинок без зручностей, але в нормальному стані, щоб не потрібно було прямо зараз все переробляти, окрім зручностей і такого - помити, пофарбувати )

Що гарно в обох ділянках - вони чисті, бо ми дивились і багато таких, де чагарник, який потрібно чистити і доглядати, щоб не наростало знову. А це все час. Вода є тільки на другій, і це додаткові витрати. Але нам вже так глянулась та менша ділянка, до якої веде асфальтова дорога, що в наш час дуже важливо, бо ми знаємо, що дістанемось туди в будь-який снігопад, якщо буде проблема з опаленням в місті. Газ є і там, і там, і чоловік хоче робити опалення і гарячу воду газом. Але це все мрії і плани. Як не дивно, але найбільше нам хочеться просто вже мати свою землю, на якій я вже хочу садити квітник, а чоловік вже хоче смажити шашлики, ну а дитина хоче бігати і стрибати вдоста :)

Дитина - це для нас також дуже важливий аргумент, щоб проводити більше часу під деревами влітку, бо у нас дуже спекотна квартира. І бо там може буде песик для неї, і купа різноманітних фруктів і ягід влітку.

Ось так :) Успіхів нам усім, і скорішого миру )

body.title: Before Sickness Knocks - LOH #283
body.body: It's really funny how we humans handle certain things sometimes, but humans will always be human, you know. If unfortunately we fall sick today, obviously, everything about us will pause. Our job, our family duties, and personal stuff to catch up with and deep down within, we will wish to be fit again to continue our daily hustles and bustles of life. But then, why is it that we hardly think of prevention rather than facing the sickness? ![Before sickness arrives_ stay healthy.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nkemakonam89/23yTjZKi7PDZvWbKcXVCFCVTtQB3L37QEaLFVRBMWSnd1JyxrEGTaRar28485zMQRdk6t.png) ***** Perhaps we are too busy; that's why, but the moment we can't raise our hands, we will start wishing to have done the right thing. I am not saying that we can be so intentional about our health to prevent sickness completely, but it could be reduced to a large extent through our intentional actions by practicing a routine healthy lifestyle. Maintaining good health is not all about taking medications to be alright but about intentional practices to observe in order to prevent the sickness to a large extent from happening in the first place. ***** I believe no one wants to break down, but it happens, and then the moment we recover, we still find ourselves neglecting important healthy practices, waiting for when the next illness surfaces. A lot of people are victims of these, but staying healthy is doable. There are things I started doing even before sickness came, and that has made me stay out of sickness for a long time. Like, I can't remember the last time I took paracetamol, not to talk of treating malaria or typhoid, etc. One of these things I started practicing even before sickness surfaces is listening to my body. ***** Once I feel so stressed and weak, I slow down, lay aside every pending task, and rest. Remember, resting doesn't imply that you are lazy. I embrace rest and feel rejuvenated, and this way, I escape sickness. Another simple practice is getting enough hydration. As simple as water is, I discovered it is a great medicine for the body to flush out stuff, and so I don't joke with my water every now and then and instead of taking cola when I feel dehydrated, I go for a constant intake of water. Good enough, the difference has been clear. ***** Before I started constant water intake, I noticed how often I used to feel drained and weary, but not anymore. Another simple practice I do to prevent sickness from tracing my home address is eating right. Junks has been a bygone in my home for a long time. Even with a budget, I learned to eat right without allowing what I consume to deal with my health. ***** Finally, I do observe some physical exercises, and this time with my hubby, it makes it more romantic each time, and so, I crave more, staying more healthily in the process. Overall, I don't allow my mind to get cluttered with irrelevant things but strive to stay joyful and happy amidst life's storms. This is my entry to ladies of Hive prompt #283 . body.title: Semifinal scenarios for Arsenal and Liverpool. My opinion
body.body:
> The first leg of the Champions League quarterfinals left the English teams in very different positions: Arsenal with an advantage after defeating Sporting in Lisbon, and Liverpool needing to overturn the deficit after falling to PSG in Paris. Beyond their own results, the focus is on the potential opponents awaiting them in the semifinals.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWdvoFFxvgoSmYkpbKc7cf4daGvYWTw9tJARrvu7p3MSA/hfvmrzaa8aepon9.jpg)[source](https://x.com/Arsenal_America/status/2041621882965839913/photo/1) Arsenal and their future If the Gunners manage to secure their passage in London, their opponent will emerge from the match between Atlético de Madrid and Barcelona. Atlético de Madrid: a team with character, solid in defense, and experienced in decisive matches. It would be a tactically intense encounter, where every detail counts. Barcelona: with a more offensive, possession-based style, they would represent a different challenge, forcing Arsenal to test their ability to adapt. Scenario: Arsenal would have to demonstrate that they can overcome both Atlético's discipline and Barcelona's talent. In either case, it would be a thrilling semifinal, a clash of styles that would test the Londoners' continental maturity.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTSSs5iRNX86KEd4STWV9dQKjj6CSVtVR6M9R9LvVarFa/667501801_967310255644019_2528473722042129020_n.jpg)[source](https://www.facebook.com/photo/?fbid=967310252310686&set=a.225148643193521)
Liverpool and the Mountain to Climb Should the Reds manage a comeback at Anfield, their opponent would emerge from the Real Madrid vs. Bayern Munich tie. Real Madrid: the king of Europe, with a history of comebacks and a competitive DNA that intensifies in the Champions League. Bayern Munich: a German powerhouse with physical strength and devastating attacking prowess, always a title contender. Scenario: For Liverpool, reaching the semifinals would already be a feat. Facing either of these two giants would represent a monumental challenge, but also an opportunity for historic redemption. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeqw8ueApLZ1Ut1kc6Drv1XozdVA3qmkffeZDvXfYjQHT/hduftnzxyaa0bng.jpg)[source](https://x.com/ChampionsLeague/status/2034395071991161198/photo/1) General Predictions Arsenal: with their advantage and the home advantage, they have a clearer path to the semifinals. Their challenge will be to remain calm and avoid mistakes against a Spanish opponent who, whether Atlético or Barcelona, ​​will demand maximum concentration. Liverpool: their chances are slim, but if they manage a comeback, the reward will be an elite clash against Real Madrid or Bayern. The difficulty is enormous, but the spirit of Anfield always leaves the door open to the unexpected. In summary The Champions League is gearing up for some spectacular semifinals. Arsenal dreams of facing a Spanish giant, while Liverpool, if they pull off the feat, would take on a European powerhouse. The outcome of the second leg will determine whether England maintains two representatives in the elite or if only the Gunners remain in the fight for glory. Credits: I used Google Translate.

body.title: Social Immorality Based on Personal Decisions
body.body:
As the world evolves, we have many things evolving alongside with it as well and it's so sad to see that they are on the opposite side of how the world is evolving. Just like an article I wrote yesterday talking about how technology has made the world a better place and an easy life to live but then the rate at which humans have changed morally from being good to bad is alarming.

![1000620442.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/afrikens/AKAoWfHnQUmNyVaLY1gDMaAKgo7kjpGVWywhbdmjcyREpE1w7XEkTeZkAPZjehJ.jpg)

We have passed the days when moral values holds high esteem to people and no one would ever wanna be seen on the opposite side of being a good person even if you have to pretend to live it.
Nowadays, no one even cares how you see them as long as they are doing what brings money to their pockets, most especially on social media platforms that offers monetization.
Can we say it's bad having technology to rebuild a life we once lived with no fun? Absolutely no, because it has only come to aid us and it now fully depends on how we make use of it.

Just yesterday, I was coming from a store where I went to get some items and on getting to my street, I saw some teenagers playing football and at some point they were about fighting one another. I had no option than to interfere and say **\

** and I never knew they would actually stop with that statement because of the way the society has become now. No one respects the other and teenagers would likely disrespect an elder who interferes in what doesn't concerns them. So I was partially surprised at how they stopped instantly and still said **thank you ma**.

![1000620444.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/afrikens/ALFzmLqVmxy56DTs845SRagVXo8RG9ZSvoXxPD8Asg4gf6sYHuRgRfqYKGw3LZv.jpg)

So practically, we can say that as decading as the society may be, as spoilt as our social media platforms may be showing, we still have people with good morals that will not be influenced by the bad evolvement around them and this is to establish the fact that whatever the world has become today is an individual decision and our contributions. Not because of parental upbringing or the availability of these social media platforms but the blame is on us individually and we must take responsibilities for the consequences of our actions.

I'll be dropping my 🖊️ here on the Hive Reachout community prompt 

Thank you for reading through 🤗

Today’s AI cycle is packed with meaningful product movement: a major new frontier model launch from Meta, new managed-agent infrastructure from Anthropic, and tighter workflow integration across Google’s Gemini stack. There is also a clear policy and infrastructure undertone, with fresh legal pressure and data-center strategy shifts that will matter for builders shipping on top of these ecosystems.

## 1) Meta launches Muse Spark, its first flagship model from Superintelligence Labs
Announced on **April 9, 2026**, Meta introduced **Muse Spark** as the first major model release from its Superintelligence Labs initiative. Meta is positioning this as a core intelligence layer for consumer surfaces, with rollout planned across WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, Messenger, and AI glasses. The strategic signal is straightforward: Meta is trying to compress research-to-product timelines and put a new model family directly into high-frequency daily interfaces.

For developers and operators, this is less about benchmark screenshots and more about distribution leverage. If Muse Spark performs well in real user loops, Meta can rapidly gather behavioral feedback at huge scale and iterate faster than rivals who ship only through API channels. It is also a governance moment for the open-vs-proprietary direction: Meta has historically pushed open releases in parts of its stack, but this launch reinforces that flagship capability may remain more tightly controlled at first.

**Reflection:** The most important part of this launch is not the name of the model, it is the deployment path. Shipping frontier capability into default consumer apps changes adoption speed and expectations for everyone else.

**Sources:**
- https://about.fb.com/news/2026/04/introducing-muse-spark-meta-superintelligence-labs-first-model-built-to-prioritize-people/
- https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/apr/09/meta-first-ai-model-muse-sparks
- https://www.cnbc.com/2026/04/09/metas-long-awaited-ai-model-is-finally-here-but-can-it-make-money.html

## 2) Anthropic rolls out Claude Managed Agents (beta)
Announced on **April 9, 2026**, Anthropic launched **Claude Managed Agents** in beta, providing hosted runtime infrastructure for long-running autonomous workflows. This shifts part of the burden away from teams that currently stitch together model calls, state management, retries, and task orchestration on their own. Instead of just consuming a model endpoint, teams can adopt a more complete managed harness for asynchronous execution.

The developer impact is immediate. Agent systems are where many teams lose time, especially around reliability, handoffs, and monitoring. A managed layer from a frontier model provider could significantly reduce time-to-production for practical automation use cases, especially in internal operations, support workflows, and multi-step research tasks. The tradeoff is platform dependency: as providers move up the stack, portability becomes harder, and architecture decisions become more strategic.

**Reflection:** This is one of the clearest signs that the AI platform battle is moving from “best model” to “best execution environment.” Managed orchestration is now product surface, not just infrastructure glue.

**Sources:**
- https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/overview
- https://www.wired.com/story/anthropic-launches-claude-managed-agents/
- https://www.reuters.com/business/us-software-stocks-fall-anthropics-new-ai-model-revives-disruption-fears-2026-04-09/

## 3) Gemini adds NotebookLM-style Notebooks directly in-app
Announced on **April 9, 2026**, Google began integrating NotebookLM-style **Notebooks** inside Gemini. The key practical change is tighter continuity between source-grounded research and chat-based iteration. Instead of context living in disconnected tools, users can anchor work to curated sources and continue prompting within the same operating surface.

For developers, educators, analysts, and small teams, this closes one of the biggest workflow gaps in day-to-day AI use: persistent project context. Better notebook integration means fewer repetitive prompts, lower context drift, and more reproducible outputs when teams revisit work later. The broader market implication is that “memory and context management” is becoming a primary competitive feature across assistant products, not a niche power-user function.

**Reflection:** Better context handling usually looks like a small UX update at first, then quietly becomes one of the biggest productivity multipliers over time.

**Sources:**
- https://gemini.google/gemini-drops/
- https://www.engadget.com/ai/google-bakes-notebooklm-its-research-tool-into-gemini-101850634.html
- https://www.cnet.com/tech/services-and-software/gemini-gets-new-notebooks-feature-that-syncs-with-notebooklm/

## 4) Meta and CoreWeave expand AI infrastructure agreement to $21B
Announced on **April 9, 2026**, CoreWeave and Meta expanded their infrastructure relationship to a reported **$21 billion** through 2032. While this is a financing-scale headline, the practical signal for builders is compute certainty: major labs and platforms are locking in long-term capacity as inference demand keeps compounding.

This matters for everyone downstream. Stable access to large-scale infrastructure affects model availability, latency, API pricing pressure, and feature rollout cadence. Deals like this also reinforce that the AI stack has entered a phase where product competition and infrastructure strategy are inseparable. Labs that secure compute can ship faster and absorb demand spikes more safely than peers operating closer to capacity limits.

**Reflection:** Infrastructure is not the background story anymore. In AI, it is often the hidden variable that determines which product roadmaps are actually possible.

**Sources:**
- https://www.reuters.com/business/coreweave-signs-21-billion-ai-cloud-deal-with-meta-2026-04-09/
- https://investors.coreweave.com/news/news-details/2026/CoreWeave-and-Meta-Announce-21-Billion-Expanded-AI-Infrastructure-Agreement/default.aspx
- https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-04-09/coreweave-expands-meta-deal-for-ai-computing-to-21-billion

## 5) OpenAI pauses its main UK data center project
Announced on **April 9, 2026**, reports said OpenAI paused its principal UK data-center effort, citing regulatory and energy-cost concerns. For policymakers, this is a warning shot: national AI ambitions are increasingly constrained by power economics and regulatory predictability, not just talent or startup velocity.

For product teams, the immediate takeaway is regional infrastructure uncertainty. Data residency, cost structure, and low-latency routing all depend on where large capacity is actually built. Delays or pauses in major projects can alter deployment assumptions, especially for enterprises planning localized rollouts. It also intensifies competition among countries trying to become preferred hosts for frontier AI infrastructure.

**Reflection:** The next phase of AI competition will be won as much in power markets and permitting processes as in model labs.

**Sources:**
- https://www.reuters.com/business/openai-pauses-uk-data-centre-project-over-regulation-costs-2026-04-09/
- https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/apr/09/openai-pulls-out-of-landmark-31bn-uk-investment
- https://www.engadget.com/ai/openai-pauses-its-stargate-uk-data-center-plan-115626978.html

## 6) Florida AG opens investigation into OpenAI and ChatGPT
Announced on **April 9, 2026**, Florida’s attorney general launched an investigation into OpenAI and ChatGPT. This is a policy/legal development rather than a product release, but it has direct platform implications for deployment risk, compliance workflows, and public-sector scrutiny.

If more state-level actions follow, teams building on top of large model providers may face tighter operational requirements around safety disclosures, logging, user protections, and sector-specific guardrails. It also raises the probability that legal exposure and trust signals become explicit factors in enterprise vendor selection. For developers, this is another reminder that technical performance alone is no longer enough for adoption in regulated or high-sensitivity environments.

**Reflection:** The AI stack is entering a phase where legal posture can move almost as fast as product velocity, and teams need both maps in view.

**Sources:**
- https://www.reuters.com/business/florida-ag-probe-openai-chatgpt-2026-04-09/
- https://www.axios.com/2026/04/09/florida-ag-launches-investigation-openai
- https://techcrunch.com/2026/04/09/florida-ag-investigation-openai-chatgpt-shooting/

## 7) xAI sues Colorado over the state’s AI law
Announced on **April 9, 2026**, xAI filed suit seeking to block Colorado’s new AI law, escalating the federal-vs-state governance battle. This is one of the clearest live examples of how fast AI compliance requirements can become contested terrain.

For teams shipping AI products in the U.S., fragmentation risk remains high: different states can push different obligations on transparency, bias, safety, and user rights, while federal frameworks evolve more slowly. Litigation like this may delay clarity in the short term, but it also highlights where governance pressure is concentrating. Builders should expect compliance architecture to become a core engineering competency, not a late-stage legal afterthought.

**Reflection:** The companies that operationalize compliance early will move faster later, because they will not need to re-architect every time rules shift.

**Sources:**
- https://www.reuters.com/legal/government/elon-musks-xai-sues-colorado-over-states-new-ai-law-2026-04-09/
- https://www.ft.com/content/55e8cba9-d09c-4f94-b710-4ab447b987f9
- https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-04-10/elon-musk-s-xai-sues-colorado-over-ai-anti-discrimination-law

---

AI remains on a three-lane acceleration path: model capability, managed execution environments, and infrastructure scale. The practical opportunity for builders is to focus on workflows where these gains compound, especially source-grounded research, autonomous operations, and production reliability. At the same time, legal and policy volatility is no longer peripheral, it is now part of shipping discipline.

## Builder playbook for this week
1. **Re-check your provider mix.** If managed-agent runtimes are maturing quickly, revisit what you host yourself versus what you outsource.
2. **Harden context workflows.** Features like notebook-native context are becoming table stakes for quality and reproducibility.
3. **Plan for infra variance.** Capacity and regional deployment assumptions can change abruptly when large projects are delayed.
4. **Treat compliance as product infrastructure.** State-level legal pressure is now a practical delivery constraint, not just policy noise.
5. **Prioritize measurable utility.** The strongest teams right now are turning model upgrades into real user outcomes, not just demo metrics.

The teams that win this cycle will likely be the ones that combine three things at once: fast model adoption, operational reliability, and policy-aware execution. In other words, this is no longer just an AI model game, it is an AI systems game. The edge will come from disciplined iteration, strong data feedback loops, and architecture choices that remain flexible as model and regulatory conditions keep shifting week to week.

Llego el juevea y **¡Zuaaas!** El cansancio de la semana, tanto así que no pude ni escribir anoche pero a pesar del cansancio  vengo a contrales que ayer también  corri, pero eso no es lo importante, porque ayer lo hice, el martes tambien y el domingo también. 

Lo importante de todo esto es el trabajo que hago, ya que aunque este entrenando  sola me exijo, el trabajo de hoy fue intenso porque hice velocidad. 

**Calentamiento:** 3 kilómetros 
**Entrenamiento:**  8 x 400 m x 1:40
**Enfriamiento:**  1 kilómetro 

**Total kilometros:**

Las series de hoy consistian en hacer series de 400 metros con 1:40 minutos de recuperacion entre series, las hice alrededor de la Laguna del Parque Bolivar su vuelta da exactamente esa distancia. 

Podía ver el reloj y marqué las series en un ritmo por debajo de 5 min me senti feliz porque es un ritmo que desearia sostener el kilómetro completo, pero siento que pude dar mas, pero un paso a la vez. 

Al terminar hice algunos ejercicios de estiramientos, para evitar lesiones por el trabajo intensivo que hice, me sente un rato el la grama a estirar porque siempre lo hago de forma parada. 

Por esta semana ya he acumulado 21 kilometros nada mal, quiero correr una carrera proxima pero aun no tengo el dinero para inscribirme 😪 estos son unos de los gastos asociados a este deporte. 

En el parque me acerque a un local y me encantó su concepto ya que es un tipo cafe donde puedes ir a jugar, ir a leer, ir a comer pizza tiene varios ambientes y aparte es un lugar que tiene una vista que se puede disfrutar, al salir del parque fui por un helado de hielo granizado sabor a mora y mantecado porque aparte de la sed queria premiar mi trabajo.

body.title: [PL / ENG] My Actifit Report Card: April 09 2026
body.body:
> ![obraz.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdUQj9XD6jZQxgufZ9Hoxx4HtbaZ6tFeNV84jQELVv4nb/obraz.png) Dzidzia miała kolorową noc (🤮), co oznacza, że trzeba było zostać w domu. Całe szczęście, że już kwiecień: w marcu byłoby to nie lada kłopotem, w kwietniu nie stanowi większego problemu, po prostu robota poleży odłogiem, ale do nadrobienia. > Baby had a colorful night (🤮), which means we had to stay home. Luckily, it's already April: in March, this would have been a real hassle, but in April, it's not a major problem; the work will simply lie fallow, but there's still work to be done. ![obraz.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmahHjYQgmdjnH4e58nymBkuCnAMEH6wkoFeV1qBA2US9x/obraz.png) Korzystając z przymusowej wizyty u lekarza zapisałam i Bombla, bo trochę niepokoił mnie ten przeciągnięty już od marca katar. Do tego wręcz miałam wrażenie, że ostatnio gorzej słyszy - może go ten katar zatyka jakoś czy coś. Chciałam go też więc zbadać. Werdykt? Dzidzia - jelitówka, dwa dni wolnego i luzik. Bombel? Niemal stan zapalny ucha i konieczne włączenie sterydów. Może się obejdzie bez antybiotyku. Zwolnienie do przyszłej środy, a potem do kontroli czy nie trzeba jednak antybiotyku. > Taking advantage of the urgent need for a doctor's appointment, I also scheduled a visit to Bombel, as I was a bit concerned about the persistent cold that had been going on since March. I also had the impression that his hearing had been getting worse lately – maybe the cold was blocking him somehow. So I wanted to check him out too. The verdict? Baby – intestinal infection, two days off, and then nothing. Bombel? Almost an ear infection, and he needs steroids. Maybe he can manage without antibiotics. He's off sick until next Wednesday, and then he'll be checked to see if antibiotics are necessary. ![obraz.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXFnQkNvy2ndhYv7UC77GKy6zufqDPixmQfLUCVFRyigp/obraz.png) Tak więc dobrze się złożyło, że Dzidzia nam zafundowała takie atrakcje i wyjście do lekarza. Myślałam, że to tylko lekki katarek. No, bo kiedy był większy, nie miałam szans na wzięcie wolnego. Fajnie, gdyby w czasie mojej wzmożonej pracy drugi rodzic przejmował takie tematy, niestety nie ma takiej opcji, bo ten pracuje na okrągło. Tracę przez to motywację, dla mnie dzieci i ich zdrowie jest najważniejsze, mogę poświęcić swoją karierę, ale jeśli już się podjęłam trudnego projektu, to niestety muszę go zrobić do końca. > So it's a good thing Baby arranged for us to have these activities and go to the doctor. I thought it was just a minor cold. Well, when he was older, I didn't have the chance to take time off. It would be nice if my other parent could take care of these things during my busy workdays, but unfortunately, that's not an option because my current parent works around the clock. It's making me lose motivation. My children and their health are the most important thing to me. I can sacrifice my career, but if I've taken on a difficult project, I unfortunately have to see it through to the end. ![obraz.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPz5hxVo3C5BJjmrSrHb3yoSFx7oufybCNXDBi8HPT3Gr/obraz.png) Ehh. Z miłych wieści tylko tyle, że Bombel po paru latach gardzenia Rozlewiskiem teraz wracając od lekarza chętnie pojechał tamtędy - bo to teraz fan trudniejszych terenów. > Sigh. The only good news is that after a few years of despising Rozlewisko, Bombel now willingly went there on his way back from the doctor's office - because he's now a fan of more challenging terrain. ![obraz.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZf2sRk9kha6zuWjvx7Bbwb8wrWG682JZS9zxaeBR6wq1/obraz.png) Z atrakcji domowych: takie piękne kolorowanki z moimi dziećmi w rolach głównych. > Home attractions: such beautiful coloring pages with my children in the main roles.
