body.title: Lapas - A Sunlit Village in the Cold Himalayas
body.body:
One of the best ways to explore the Himalayas is through the villages in these mountains. These villages are mostly small settlements with a few houses and their farmlands in the mountains, a bit away from the main villages. Villages in the Parvati Valley give easy access to different geographical sides of the valley with the convenience of roads and accommodation.

Plus, if you’re interested in the cultural side of mountain life, villages are your best option to experience life in these extreme terrains.

![89.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVxNQCYNBXMNPApBkcvcdRh8bkgzwhydYpgLQec5maHxh/89.jpg)

Lapas is a lesser-known village in Parvati Valley, famous for the good sun they get throughout the year. If you’re living in this part of the Himalayas, where the temperature often goes to minus degrees Celsius, getting good sunlight is huge! 

I have travelled to Lapas twice last year, 2025. Both times, the goal was to meet a family and source natural wool. Since I live in Shilha now, Lapas is closer and easy to reach by walking all the way. It’s a few kilometres of walking through the main road and then a trek to the village. There used to be a road that allowed 4*4 vehicles to reach the village. But it was partly destroyed during the monsoon with landslides.

So, we decided to walk to the village and find a good route as well. I went to the village with friends both times. The first one was with another homestay owner here, and the next time with a friend who came as a guest.

This is also a glimpse of how I find interesting spots to offer our guests to travel or hike.

Since the landslide happened in the middle of the road to Lapas, we had to take an alternative route that goes through another village called Kiyani. There is an easy trekking route, but I highly suggest you take this route since it is very pretty and scenic.

![Lapas village blog.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQpr4xB1vzN9b5znYqoyjJxar1XbiUVGMNWTbUqndqBfD/Lapas%20village%20blog.jpg)

Our first stop was a village called Kiyani. It took us almost 3 hours to reach there from Shilha by walking. You can easily go there by motorcycle or car, a 4*4 would be the best option since the road is made of soil.

We found this cute little cafe and a homestay in this village, which was quite unexpected since this is not a touristy village at all. It is called Paradisol. We had something to drink and got some chocolates from the nearby shop.

It was already 3.30 pm, and we had to continue before it got dark. Since the duration of the day is short in November, we tried to hurry after taking a break at Paradisol.

**The best part of the whole trek was the route from Kiyani to Lapas.**

![Lapas village blog 91.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmS36wCrwxmi1Eqf82UoCCqbEQZwpBL8xBXNkkCrg4asFn/Lapas%20village%20blog%2091.jpg)

This route had stairs till Lapas, which made the climb easier. The stairs went through the middle of what looked like a forest, which made the hike very dreamy. Tall trees with fall colours, unique plants with unique seeds, and so much more.

![Lapas village blog 85.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRgjAjeoyPhqkFPHbGnB3Fyb4ZfmKURzKnr5FErSW4P8j/Lapas%20village%20blog%2085.jpg)

It is for this route that I ask my guests to take this route to Lapas instead of other trekking routes. You might also get to see trees that are worshipped and not allowed to be touched.

![Lapas village blog74.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTRFKaqq2DvFe1psKfejLAmbJcpfWhSTqLTJw3VZMqBzg/Lapas%20village%20blog74.jpg)

We reached Lapas at around 6-ish on my first trip to Lapas, and unfortunately, the family I wanted to buy the wool from had gone to a wedding in another village and wouldn’t be back by the next day.

![Blog – Horizontal → 1600 × 900 px.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmR8Kme6ecC64GCv4L7LRwKgRdWiZAT6Xsf4T6m6uPiasg/Blog%20%E2%80%93%20Horizontal%20%E2%86%92%201600%20%C3%97%20900%20px.jpg)

So, we decided to stay in Lapas and started searching for a homestay. A local helped us find one- it is called **Rupender Homestay,** if anyone is interested in visiting Lapas. It was a gem of a homestay with a stunning view. Moreover, the place got sunlight, a lot of it!

![79.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmU5EzGiZWJ5Kc4zz7cb6KKQUdjVL9hsfj3JiR5TKNvjqP/79.jpg)

![80.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYfdKAsvzaK7dDSKXbaV3u7J3sdMZvgFPEvqXMNhPYFGh/80.jpg)

We were dead asleep after dinner and woke up to a very sunny morning. Going from Shilha, where we got sun for only 2 hours, this was a dream! 

![Lapas village blog 79.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmamfoheQasAyVpV5XThssBnoSwYw2JK5NzK8K6MrgqfEm/Lapas%20village%20blog%2079.jpg)


![Lapas village blog 84.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmX4nSpyf7rccuo1Y4rtav6ChD8A5y7Fp6P3AWU7y1zT2i/Lapas%20village%20blog%2084.jpg)

We had a very homely breakfast and decided to climb down. We met some really friendly people on the way and had fun conversations.
![Lapas village blog 83.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUAz9LSTpFut1Zx852mm5MDqXiW6kK2CNSL6exjStRjg7/Lapas%20village%20blog%2083.jpg)
The host was also amazing and helped us with whatever we needed.

Lapas is one place I would recommend anyone to go to enjoy the sun during the winters in Parvati Valley. The village still has wooden houses mostly, and they are often painted in bright colours.
![Lapas village blog 86.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmR4QrWALaWNdT34uQDuDDegYZ2rnkjSvUjAQKzQ97g3mL/Lapas%20village%20blog%2086.jpg)
You will get to see seasonal crops growing on the way, which is a refreshing sight.

![Lapas village blog 87.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbnZ6sobqVVhG3Rx7GWLTz2jCFYpLA6BCUHfK9cH1zrbQ/Lapas%20village%20blog%2087.jpg)

The other time I visited Lapas was with another friend to collect the wool we couldn’t get the other day.

This time, we reached Lapas at around 4 PM and the villager I was meeting asked us to climb up more uphill from the village.

![Lapas village blog 90.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYbpkvdFz1sAJfLPjdRGNJ1YLiSYuGtpLFpnodtKSdQzZ/Lapas%20village%20blog%2090.jpg)



We kept going, thinking he might have kept the wool in his other house uphill. Upon reaching the place, we got to the surprising reason why we had to hike all that way. He felt it would be dark soon,n and we won’t be able to go back. So, he arranged a stay for us to spend the night in his second home, where he keeps his livestock.

![Lapas village blog 92.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQme1pY6WC8qq9QD1UMXvywhpVXZjRQPYMW6ApDzgMwjykm/Lapas%20village%20blog%2092.jpg)

We were surprised at this gesture and a bit confused since it was in the middle of nowhere. I mean, there are no other houses around, just the land, mountains and the sky. We were almost at the top of the mountain.

![Lapas village blog 78.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVKaHSQaeqSdZ2AaQUuX1TpvaNERGrABeak37VtUeMXJ7/Lapas%20village%20blog%2078.jpg)

After some thinking, we decided to take the offer and decided to spend the night here and leave in the morning. He took care of his sheep, cows and goats, and got them inside their shed. Then he showed us our room. It was an attachment to the shed and the house since they don’t allow people from outside into their home.

It was a room made of stones, a wooden cot inside with many blankets for keeping ourselves warm, and a tandoor in one corner of the room. There is no bathroom or toilet at this place, but he said we can just go free out in the open since there is no one around.

The best part of the place was that it was in the middle of his farmland. There were cherry tomatoes and meeta-karela, a vegetable right next to our room. He said we can make something out of it and have it for dinner.

![Lapas village blog 81.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbJFGpLjYvHJ5nwjbhiLbogH6NuXHqgpA1GRqnqDt3WSx/Lapas%20village%20blog%2081.jpg)

This is the most off-grid experience we've had so far.

He made us some tea and offered a snack with it. Then he explained everything and left. We were overjoyed, surprised and moreover way too excited. As I mentioned, Lapas gets good sunlight throughout the day. We enjoyed the sun, every bit of it.
![77.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZe9wvapZQ4eTCg3m1A5LN4FpsQhFb3YVzyPUUq47h5fw/77.jpg)
Soon it started to get dark and cold. Then pitch dark. I can’t explain how good it was looking up at the sky from this height. It was full of stars and a dark blue background. My phone’s camera is no good to capture it, but let me tell you it was soo good.

![Lapas village blog 82.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmT1izG129mKtvwN7qkcur2PgirNyGLtwZJPTiwCSmZTSe/Lapas%20village%20blog%2082.jpg)

We made dinner with the vegetables we collected and the other supplies he gave us before leaving. We were way too tired after the hike and planned to go to sleep after dinner. The Tandoor was turned down when we went to bed.

Slowly, it hit us. It was cold! Like, really really cold!

It was already 2 am, and neither of us could sleep. There was wind that swept inside through the holes in between the stones. And we finally gave up and decided to light up the tandoor again.

![Lapas village blog70.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZHv8tZE1Shjm1bUiUuct8qabVQ5xvpmg4y9pdmPkUbtQ/Lapas%20village%20blog70.jpg)

Hours went by, and we still couldn’t sleep. Finally, the sky slowly started to light up. And it was getting sunny after some time. We started sleeping when the sun hit the room. But by then it was time to leave.

![Lapas village blog 80.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNfpHfYG7PbwPo38MiN8fjzSJBYE6oTnq5MFSAHxfNbw5/Lapas%20village%20blog%2080.jpg)

Well, the morning routine was also pretty funny since everything was out on the farm. Let’s not talk about it, but it was a fun experience too.

![Lapas village blog 88.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTHogEcT2Tq757bGjfXgH5q8yMrkBG2KgcjcRTLiVmx6g/Lapas%20village%20blog%2088.jpg)

Well, we climbed down from Lapas and went in different directions after collecting the wool.

![78.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWn3TY7g8ns2GyjqSDyWVosC8Y1aAMwLvbagyCEXBdi7Z/78.jpg)

The route back is through a place called Raskat, which is a hike under an hour. There is also this small shop on the way, which offers small breakfast items.


![Lapas blog.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPZdhpadniV9bThSTHEYh9HQ2sTyttQnceLYNLKMTSzzd/Lapas%20blog.jpg)


I had a bread omelette for energy, and we rushed back before we got hit by the energy crash from not sleeping the night after the hike. Needless to say, I have no idea what happened in the world for the rest of the day, I was fast asleep in my bed.

I highly suggest visiting Lapas for its scenic view, sun and farm-fresh vegetables. And, Lapas is also one of the cleaner villages I have seen in this part of the valley. A one-day trip to Lapas would be a good choice to enjoy the sun in Parvati Valley.


![Lapas village blog73.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXyKnQHatkRQpMy3k7Fs16HVXSA7Wp2MEUs4XzusTZ6QQ/Lapas%20village%20blog73.jpg)

body.title: 如何评估见证人节点运行情况
body.body:
作为一名HIVE区块链上运行见证人节点长达近八年的见证人，一直以来我都很是关注自己和他人见证人节点的状态。

![020324c4acf1deb68220f4d558bd7ccf.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmU9qfFoVKcwMwxxNASCDCC7ekexAu3RSRG5J85cf1KEfp/020324c4acf1deb68220f4d558bd7ccf.png)

为此我在很早就开发出了见证人列表工具（当前访问地址为：https://legacy.cutehive.com/）, 后来又在AI的帮助下，开发出来一个更优雅的版本：https://cutehive.com/witnesses）。

通过这两个工具，我们可以轻松地查看见证人们的运行状态，检查我们的投票，以便于我们投给节点状态健康的见证人。

但弊端就是没有对见证人节点的状态进行一个友好的解读，比如以下的一些节点，哪些是健康的呢？
![58ee02585fe58788b7b5d493d3bb5787.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmP8P7VfJwRw3A1yH9w9SG6EtMnGWU1zBbfSdpmTXqtaNb/58ee02585fe58788b7b5d493d3bb5787.png)

把节点的健康状态定义清楚，是一件很困难的事，需要考虑很多因素。但我想了一下，大概主要要考虑以下几点：
>* 见证人节点运行的软件版本（低于HF版本应该认为是不健康的）
>* 见证人节点距离上次出块的时间（很长时间没有出块应该被认为是不健康的）
>* 见证人节点的在线/离线状态（长期离线，应该认为见证人放弃了）

上述因素还有各种组合，我简单总结出来一些：

版本低于硬分叉版本但是还是在线状态——这样的节点会影响HIVE区块链出块的稳定性（尤其是排名靠前的），所以应该定义为最不健康的，大家应该及时撤票。

版本正确，还在线，但是很长时间没有出块，大概是节点崩溃了，管理者可能没有及时发现，或者发现了也没及时处理，这种也算是不健康的。

版本正确，还在线，但是一段时间没有出块。大概也是节点崩了，但是管理者可能正在维护（推荐维护时先离线），这种也是需要注意的。

离线超过一个月（30天），还没有重新上线的。我觉得可以认为见证人不打算干了，或者换ID了。这样长期离线的可以考虑撤票了。

中长期离线的（7-30天），有理由认为见证人没有重视维护自己的见证人节点，可以考虑撤票。

短期离线的（未超过七天），我们姑且认为此节点正在维护。可以暂时先观望一下，再决定如何操作（撤票或者保留投票）。

至于为什么不考虑丢块数、喂价、HBD 存款 APR等信息？因为HIVE/STEEM分叉期间，很多节点临时停摆，丢了很多块，不能反映节点的水平，而且排名100的节点和排名前20的节点一起比丢块数显然不合理。

喂价、HBD 存款 APR也很重要，但是相对于稳定地出块，这些信息就显得不那么紧要了，所以展示先不考虑。

虽然这些信息都可以通过https://cutehive.com/witnesses 获取，但是逐一判断还是太困难了。所以基于上述分析，我搞了个见证人节点运行情况评估工具。

对排名前300的节点，进行了一下评估，结果如下：

![f8e65a6ca93f98c84003a097434a0272.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNcDDPTMK1HqsNaonnXJEWju5CUZSEGtXgtun1v9XZQz7/f8e65a6ca93f98c84003a097434a0272.png)

可见实际稳定运行的见证人节点还不足100个。

还停留在分叉前版本的节点（前150名）
![020324c4acf1deb68220f4d558bd7ccf.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmU9qfFoVKcwMwxxNASCDCC7ekexAu3RSRG5J85cf1KEfp/020324c4acf1deb68220f4d558bd7ccf.png)

出块停滞的节点
![591eccf2f2d10064c6365d2c06425342.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWSHkMDVnTPbMfJirjwTGkt2nu8tbrjyRb7JJhi5VXqvP/591eccf2f2d10064c6365d2c06425342.png)

长期离线的节点
![e3c52d42df069c312224f18c3e1b57be.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYkoBceypfeMx9M8DhMmb9Y3w5UJU2r4aJ4wP4tmyL1td/e3c52d42df069c312224f18c3e1b57be.png)

中短期离线的节点
![039324be80383d701d9e26f24c7b3fe0.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmW5UPQaVbz8AoVSzUNgZSzgbv7yqJoM2MGSK7S4cpWHPE/039324be80383d701d9e26f24c7b3fe0.png)

短期离线的节点
![7738b0d0e3c50c0de7e27ebb15272c66.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVWANRS1GpJdJpZqt8Lq3H9R7P4PEdziUDfGieK5Bq5EJ/7738b0d0e3c50c0de7e27ebb15272c66.png)

见证人节点的运行状况大致就是这样了，建议根据节点情况调整投票。如果你不清楚或者懒得考虑支持哪个节点，可以将我设置为你的投票代理人哦。

这个程序还在调整优化中，一旦完善后会发布到HIVE开发者社区，供大家使用，敬请期待。

body.title: Why Choose Prachha Jewels for Daily Wear Mangalsutra
body.body:
A **mangalsutra** is much more than a piece of jewellery for Indian women. It symbolises marriage, love, commitment, and emotional bonding between husband and wife. Traditionally, mangalsutras were heavy, long, and worn mainly on special occasions. However, modern Indian women now prefer designs that are lightweight, stylish, and suitable for daily life.

This shift has led to the rising popularity of the [Lab Grown diamond mangalsutra](https://prachha.com/collections/mangalsutra). It offers the same brilliance and durability as natural diamonds but is more affordable and ethically sourced. At **Prachha Jewels**, mangalsutras are crafted keeping today’s women in mind—balancing tradition with comfort, elegance, and sustainability.

***

## What Is a Lab Grown Diamond Mangalsutra?

A **Lab Grown diamond mangalsutra** is designed using diamonds created in advanced laboratories under controlled conditions. These diamonds are chemically and physically identical to mined diamonds, which means they sparkle the same and last just as long. The main difference lies in their origin, as lab-grown diamonds are environmentally friendly and conflict-free.

For Indian women, this makes lab-grown diamond mangalsutras an excellent choice for daily wear. They allow you to invest in beautiful designs without paying the high cost of mined diamonds, while also making a responsible and modern choice.

***

## Mangalsutra Design Trends in India

### From Traditional to Modern Mangalsutra Design

Earlier, mangalsutra designs focused mainly on tradition, with thick black beads and heavy gold pendants. Today, **mangalsutra design** has evolved significantly. Women now prefer clean lines, minimal pendants, and versatile styles that suit both Indian and western outfits.

The demand for **modern mangalsutra design** and **daily wear mangalsutra** has grown rapidly, especially among working women and young brides. Shorter chains, subtle diamond accents, and elegant gold finishes are now the most preferred choices.

***

## Gold Mangalsutra Designs – Timeless and Elegant

A **gold mangalsutra** continues to be the most popular choice in India because gold represents purity, prosperity, and long-term value. Modern designs focus on comfort while maintaining cultural significance.

The latest **mangalsutra design gold** options include sleek pendants, delicate chains, and refined black bead arrangements. Many women now prefer **mangalsutra design gold latest** styles that feature lab-grown diamonds, offering a perfect balance between tradition and modern fashion.

Traditional elements such as **black beads mangalsutra gold** are still widely used, but they are now combined with contemporary pendant shapes. Designs like **gold mangalsutra pendant**, **mangalsutra locket design gold**, and artistic **mangalsutra pendle design** add elegance without making the jewellery feel heavy.

***

## Mangalsutra Chain and Pendant Styles

The **mangalsutra chain** plays a vital role in both comfort and durability. Modern women prefer finely crafted chains that are lightweight yet strong enough for daily use. **Mangalsutra chain designs in gold** now include smooth links, secure clasps, and evenly spaced black beads to ensure long-lasting wear.

Pendants are designed to be minimal and stylish, making them ideal for daily wear as well as festive occasions. These designs blend well with office wear, casual outfits, and traditional attire.

title.title: Мій (не) перший досвід випікання пасок
title.body:
Привіт, друзі!

Зазвичай я не займаюся випіканням пасок до Великодня — це робить моя мама, до якої ми щороку їздимо в гості разом із братом і нашими сім’ями. Також пече паски свекруха, яка теж нас щороку пригощає. Тож, чесно кажучи, я до цього процесу ще ніби й не долучався.

Це, мабуть, така сімейна традиція: колись моя мама теж не пекла пасок, поки це робила моя бабуся. Ми жили окремо, але на свята — Великдень, Різдво — завжди збиралися разом у бабусі. І саме вона тоді пекла паски. Зараз це робить мама, а я, виходить, готуюся колись прийняти цю естафету — коли їй стане важко.

Але цього року мені раптом захотілося спекти паску самому. Не знаю чому — якесь внутрішнє відчуття, можливо, певний етап чи готовність. Я був переконаний, що ніколи раніше цього не робив, але сестра дружини нагадала, що таки пік паску у 2022 році. Я зовсім про це забув.

І, мабуть, не просто так. Це був дуже складний період — початок повномасштабної війни, невизначеність, напруга. Хоч перша хвиля паніки вже трохи спала після подій на Київщині, але ситуація залишалася тривожною. Тоді активно розвивалися події на сході, і резервні сили, зокрема тероборону, могли перекидати туди. Мій чоловік якраз мав їхати, і на Великдень його відпустили буквально на день побути з нами, після чого — знову дорога. Ми не бачилися потім пів року… Можливо, саме тому той момент із випіканням паски просто стерся з пам’яті.

Та цього разу я вирішила спробувати знову. Вчора знайшла рецепт на YouTube — не мамин і не свекрушин, а просто як базу, щоб піти своїм шляхом. Замісила тісто, залишила підходити — і тут увечері вимкнули світло. Хоч і не планували відключення, але духовка в мене електрична, тож довелося чекати ще годину. Я дуже переживала, що буде з тістом — чи не зіпсується, чи все вийде.

Зрештою, все вдалося навіть краще, ніж я очікувала. Паска вийшла пухка, м’яка, у міру солодка — саме така, як мені подобається. Я випікала у паперових одноразових формах із вишиванковим орнаментом — вони одразу додають святкового вигляду, дуже гарно виглядають у кошику. ☺️

Тож ділюся з вами рецептом — додаю [посилання](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dz6dxKV7rvc) на YouTube-канал, де дивився покрокову інструкцію.

Для паски я використала:

- 45 г живих дріжджів
- 250 мл теплого молока
- 150 г цукру
- 600 г борошна
- 4 яйця
- 16 г ванільного цукру
- щіпку солі
- цедру одного апельсина
- 100 г вершкового масла (82,5%)
- 100 г родзинок
- 50 мл соняшникової олії

Почала з опари: у теплому молоці розчинила дріжджі, додала трохи цукру й борошна, залишила в теплому місці — десь на 20–25 хвилин, поки не з’явилася гарна пінка.

Тим часом збила яйця з цукром, ванільним цукром і сіллю, додала цедру апельсина. Потім влила опару, перемішала й поступово почала вводити борошно.

Тісто спочатку замішувала ложкою, а потім руками. У процесі додавала м’яке вершкове масло — частинами, добре вимішуючи. Загалом вимішувала хвилин 15–20, поки тісто не стало еластичним, трохи липким. Наприкінці додала трохи олії, сформувала кулю, накрила і залишила підходити приблизно на 1,5–2 години.

Коли тісто піднялося, вмішала родзинки, поділила на порції, сформувала кульки й виклала у форми. Залишила ще на годину — щоб добре підійшли.

Випікала при 180°C приблизно 25–30 хвилин (перші 15 хвилин духовку не відкривала). Готовність перевірила дерев’яною шпажкою.

title.title: AI VS HUMAN
title.body:
Good day, amazing people of the Hive blockchain. Welcome back to my blog. It is another edition in the #hivelearners community. I am so delighted to participate in this week's prompt, AI VS HUMANS.


![aicanvas-robot-8634899_1920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cindynancy/AJpjDxs4jchMgPtanp3HPDuHinAwsTZ7z9gZ2hoTJ49a9z5xjGqR1QcMqzrcWvd.jpg)

[source](https://pixabay.com/illustrations/robot-ai-ai-art-digital-art-female-8634899/)

Artificial intelligence is a tool established by man to make life easy for them. Artificial intelligence is a blessing to my generation; almost everyone makes use of AI both in organisations and school. It has really made life easy for us; we no longer struggle to gather information or do research. I will not lie, AI brought knowledge closer to us; I don't have to stress myself searching for information. All I need to do is to write down the question in the search bar, and the answer will be generated for me.



Since the development of this AI, there has been a lot of controversy that AI is smarter than man. This looks like an insult to humans; I don’t see any reason why humans should be compared with AI. I believe the reason why people think that AI is smarter than humans is because it is highly efficient and can do a lot of things at the same time, unlike humans.



It is really not nice about this debate of artificial intelligence being smarter than humans. Whenever I come across such a debate, I am always angry because I see no reason why the two should be compared. This so-called AI that we see as the smartest came into existence by humans. Without humans, there is nothing like artificial intelligence that works and functions because they are being programmed by humans. I see it as an error when people say AI is smarter than humans. Believe me or not, without humans, there is no AI. It is very bad to say that a device developed by humans is smarter than the creator. There are still times you will ask artificial intelligence, and it will not be able to answer you. Why? Because they didn’t program that particular command for them. All I need to do is to answer the question myself.


![aicanvas-brain-8643132_1920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cindynancy/AK7zEMLUQGPe7pHoPeXbxHFivUgFUbT3VCK7NsScTLx8xrD8qxijFhYeh3t7Sgh.jpg)

[source](https://pixabay.com/illustrations/brain-colours-colors-thoughts-8643132/)

Artificial intelligence is a machine that functions based on the program installed in it. If, by mistake, anything interrupts the command, it will crash. How then is it smarter than humans? In case we forget, before the existence of AI, humans had been solving complex questions. So if humans develop an assistant that will help them, that doesn't mean that humans are not smarter again. Artificial intelligence has its own place, as does humanity. The sweet truth is no matter how artificial intelligence can be, it can never compare to man.



I see it as an insult when people keep saying that artificial intelligence is smarter than humans. Man develops AI to enhance work and also to help reduce stress for man. Artificial intelligence can never be smarter than humans.



This is my entry on the ongoing content #hivelearners #hl-w212e2 topic AI vs humans.



Thank you for stopping by on my blog. I appreciate your comments, support and upvotes. Do have a lovely day.

title.body:
**Introduction: Lessons from the Field**

Throughout my years of field experience as a Consulting Engineer, I’ve come to see motors not just as equations in a textbook, but as the very pulse of the projects I lead. From synchronizing massive generators in remote mining sites to commissioning specialized cold storage units from **Porkka Finland**, I’ve learned that the electric motor is the driving force behind both industrial progress and public health.

​**The Porkka Challenge across Sudan:**

During my time supervising the installation and operation of world-class vaccine cooling systems across most of Sudan—from the capital, Khartoum, to Atbara and Wad Madani, reaching as far as Dongola, El Fasher, and Nyala—the ultimate challenge was always the same: maintaining motor and compressor efficiency under extreme temperatures. In these critical healthcare projects, a deep understanding of motor dynamics is what keeps the \

intact, ensuring life-saving vaccines remain safe for thousands of children.

​**The Rotating Magnetic Field (RMF) in Heavy-Duty Action:**

![IMG_20260410_112721_381.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tiptop97/EowFa8fb3LGqEo19stLVspxPz4Js8YkCUVdp3THFaCppqkfpizLXiHdefZw9Z7ZP2De.jpg)








*Hello everyone, dear friends. There are just a few more days left until the great holiday of Easter. Preparations take a lot of time, as always, but the mood is good. That's why today I decided to share with you colorful and bright photos from my garden. My garden is like a place of peace, harmony and inspiration. Despite the large amount of work in the garden, I always get pleasure from work, because when you see the result of your hard work, you just want to continue. Yesterday the weather was cloudy and cool, the last few days it seems like winter has returned. I haven't seen snow fall in April for a long time, and the temperature drops below zero. I really hope that all this will end soon, because these are very bad conditions for my flowers, plants and trees. So I believe and hope for the best. Yesterday, in the middle of the day, the sun came out from behind the clouds for a short period of time. So I thought this was my chance to take a few photos. I'm not sure that I will have free time for this tomorrow and the day after tomorrow, so today I want to make a beautiful and bright publication. Anemones and daisies, these are the flowers you will see today. The thing is that anemones and daisies are the flowers that are similar to each other. Therefore, sometimes it is difficult to choose the photos that I liked the most. It is much easier to photograph flowers that are different in color, type and shape. However, it is only the first month of spring and unfortunately I do not have such a variety of flowers yet. However, I have already told you that I have prepared well for this season, so if you follow my page, you will see many new flowers from my garden and flower beds. Let's get back to anemones and daisies) Recently I was walking through the forest and saw whole glades of anemones, at that moment I did not even have a smartphone with me. So when I remembered this moment from the forest, I went home to the anemones that grow near my house and did a little photo shoot. I also found a daisy, at first glance it seemed normal and ordinary, but at the tips of its petals I noticed a different color of pink or purple. It looked very interesting, I have not met such daisies many times in the past few years. Therefore, I sincerely hope that you will appreciate my photos and enjoy viewing them. Don't forget to leave your comments, I will be happy to answer you )*

Modern home elevators are designed to blend seamlessly with luxury interiors, offering a wide range of customization options. One of the most popular choices is cabin design, where you can select premium materials like glass, stainless steel, wood paneling, or marble finishes to match your home décor. Lighting customization also plays a key role-LED strip lights, ambient ceiling lights, or mood lighting can enhance the overall look.

Flooring options such as granite, vinyl, or hardwood allow you to maintain design consistency with your home. For a more elegant touch, you can choose panoramic glass elevators, which add a modern and spacious feel. Control panels can be upgraded with touchscreens, metallic finishes, or smart controls for a high-end experience.

Additionally, customized doors (automatic or sliding), designer handrails, and even personalized color themes ensure your elevator complements your interiors perfectly. These features not only improve aesthetics but also increase property value, making [home elevator customization options](https://atticoelevators.wordpress.com/2025/11/05/what-customisation-options-are-available-for-home-elevators-to-match-premium-interiors/) a stylish and functional addition to premium homes.

title.title: [ENG/ESP] Who said happiness doesn't exist? A five-minute daily message
title.body:
>Who said happiness doesn't exist? Perhaps someone who has never celebrated twenty years of marriage looking into the eyes of the person they choose each day. I have found it. Not in a distant goal or a perfect state, but in the whisper of shared mornings, in storms weathered hand in hand, in laughter that still springs up spontaneously after two decades.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcUoRQALLdBfhedbUz9KGdaq3LqpKHnDsCo9cPeBfeo3F/img_20260114_wa0038.jpg)
Reaching twenty years of marriage isn't just a number; it's proof that love is built with patience, with forgiven failures, and with the courage to keep choosing each other. My wife has been my refuge and my adventure. By her side, happy moments haven't been exceptions, but rather the common thread: impromptu trips, silent dinners that speak volumes, comforted tears, and achievements celebrated as our own. And then there's the family we've built. It's not perfect, but it's ours. Every hug, every table filled with voices, and every obstacle we've faced together as a team reaffirms that happiness isn't an illusion, but a daily decision to be grateful. Life has given me more than I ever dreamed of: health, lessons learned, sunrises, and that peace that comes from knowing that, no matter what happens, I'm not alone. So no, happiness isn't a mirage. It exists in the twenty years I look back on with pride, in the woman who's by my side, in our accomplishments, and in the home that thrives. It exists because I live it. And I wouldn't trade it for any perfect eternity. Credits: The image is my own. I used Google Translate. ESPAÑOL ¿Quién dijo que la felicidad no existe? Quizás alguien que nunca ha celebrado veinte años de matrimonio mirando a los ojos de la persona que elige cada día. Yo sí la he encontrado. No en una meta lejana ni en un estado perfecto, sino en el susurro de las mañanas compartidas, en las tormentas superadas de la mano, en la risa que aún nace espontánea después de dos décadas.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcUoRQALLdBfhedbUz9KGdaq3LqpKHnDsCo9cPeBfeo3F/img_20260114_wa0038.jpg)
Cumplir veinte años casada no es solo un número; es el testimonio de que el amor se construye con paciencia, con fracasos perdonados y con la valentía de seguir eligiéndonos. A su lado, los momentos felices no han sido excepciones, sino el hilo conductor: los viajes improvisados, las cenas en silencio que lo dicen todo, los llantos consolados y los logros celebrados como propios. Y luego está la familia que hemos tejido. No es perfecta, pero es nuestra. Cada abrazo, cada mesa llena de voces y cada obstáculo enfrentado como equipo me devuelven la certeza de que la felicidad no es una ilusión, sino una decisión diaria de agradecer. La vida me ha regalado más de lo que soñé: salud, aprendizajes, amaneceres y esa paz que nace de saber que, pase lo que pase, no estoy sola. Así que no, la felicidad no es un espejismo. Existe en los veinte años que miro con orgullo, en la mujer que me acompaña, en los logros y en el hogar que late. Existe porque yo la vivo. Y no la cambio por ninguna eternidad perfecta. title.title: What Is an MRL Elevator and Why Is It Gaining Popularity in Modern Buildings?
title.body:
##

![What Is an MRL Elevator and Why Is It Gaining Popularity in Modern Buildings.jpg](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/71fe1b508e738ff9984ec5f9ed43557de07a3601743796040627cc33884f6a16)



An MRL elevator (Machine Room-Less elevator) is a modern lift system that does not require a separate machine room. Unlike traditional elevators, all the essential components, including the motor, are installed within the shaft itself. This makes MRL elevators a space-saving and efficient solution for residential and commercial buildings.

One of the main reasons behind the growing demand for MRL elevators is their compact design. They are ideal for buildings where space is limited, such as apartments, offices, and modern homes. Additionally, these elevators are energy-efficient, consuming less power compared to conventional systems, which helps reduce operating costs.

Another key advantage is easy installation and lower construction cost since there is no need to build a separate machine room. MRL elevators also offer smooth and quiet operation, enhancing user comfort. With advanced safety features and modern technology, they provide reliable performance and long-term durability.

Because of these benefits, MRL elevators are becoming a preferred choice in modern construction projects. If you want to explore more, check this detailed guide on [MRL Elevator](https://atticoelevators.wordpress.com/2026/04/06/what-is-an-mrl-elevator-and-why-is-it-gaining-popularity-in-modern-buildings/)

當然可以！這裡有一個關於 **Markdown** 的簡介。

```markdown
# Markdown 簡介

Markdown 是一種輕量級的標記語言，旨在使文本格式化變得簡單易懂。它的語法簡單，易於閱讀和編寫，並且可以轉換為 HTML 等格式。

## 基本語法

### 標題

使用 `#` 符號來創建標題。`#` 的數量決定了標題的層級。

```markdown
# 這是 H1 標題
## 這是 H2 標題
### 這是 H3 標題
```

### 粗體和斜體

使用 `**` 或 `__` 來加粗文本，使用 `*` 或 `_` 來斜體文本。

```markdown
**這是粗體文本**
*這是斜體文本*
```

### 列表

無序列表使用 `*`、`-` 或 `+`，有序列表則使用數字加點。

```markdown
- 項目 1
- 項目 2
  - 子項目 2.1

1. 第一項
2. 第二項
```

### 連結和圖片

連結的語法是 `[顯示文本](URL)`，圖片的語法是 `![替代文本](圖片URL)`。

```markdown
[訪問 Google](https://www.google.com)

![示例圖片](https://via.placeholder.com/150)
```

### 引用

使用 `>` 符號來創建引用。

```markdown
> 這是一個引用。
```

## 結語

Markdown 是一個非常有用的工具，特別是在需要快速格式化文本時。它被廣泛應用於各種平台，如 GitHub、論壇和博客等。

title.title: What Is the Cost of Home Elevators in India in 2026? (Complete Price Guide)
title.body:
##

![What Is the Cost of Home Elevators in India in 2026.jpg](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/b0446335dd2baefa135dd7b51b5e29beb8cf94268eb65c5ad54a08dd3fe8b3f9)



The cost of home elevators in India in 2026 varies based on type, design, and installation needs. On average, a basic home lift starts from ₹4–5 lakhs, while premium models with advanced features can go up to ₹15–25 lakhs or more.

The price mainly depends on the type of elevator you choose. Hydraulic elevators are more budget-friendly, while traction and MRL (machine room-less) elevators offer better efficiency and modern features at a higher cost. The number of floors, load capacity, and shaft construction also play a major role in determining the final price.

Customization is another important factor. Options like glass cabins, stainless steel finishes, designer lighting, and smart control panels can increase the overall cost. Additionally, installation complexity and civil work requirements may add to the budget.

Maintenance is also essential. Most companies provide AMC (annual maintenance contracts) to ensure long-term performance and safety. If you want to explore detailed pricing and options, check this guide on [home elevator cost](https://atticoelevators.wordpress.com/2026/04/10/what-is-the-cost-of-home-elevators-in-india-in-2026-complete-price-guide/).

Investing in a home elevator enhances convenience, improves accessibility, and adds long-term value to your property.

body.title: Fly high ❤️ Amonet (EN-ES)
body.body:
> --- ![Vuela alto.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23uQvpHN9CmtzeiHu3hn38UqrAMdkSEHvbyDagySUCF6gSNMjYXjzN5QkbZ2HaCxP8YWp.jpg) ![separador sencillo 2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/Eo8UGAXUZoPxi8Ny3bWhw7vRVQywdynrHRhAwwZtRqW9jnyK7CZ42782EyeJ1UKHQuv.png) I’ve read that message many times, ‘fly high’, and it’s been passed on to me many times, but most of the time I felt it wasn’t specifically for me, but rather that I had to pass it on, as if I myself were a channel for it to reach more people. I think that was because it didn’t resonate with me; I already felt that my soul was leading me to fly, and high. That was for someone else. We all come from a tree and from many things written on ancient paper, such as the design; indeed, this even comes from people we have never even met. Many of us, myself included, have at some point felt as though we were trapped within a framework that confined us. But that message, ‘fly high’, means that we must come alive and break free from those pre-established frameworks; that we can create our own lives by changing our thoughts and actions, beliefs and habits. We must work so that we can fly out of those frames and take flight like birds, many of whom see more than just with their physical eyes. Most of the birds I chose for the design are herons, and I think I chose them for their beauty and elegance. It also brings back a fond memory of a painting I did many years ago when I was a student: a beautiful white heron with its plumage spread out.
SPANISH VERSION (click here!)

Muchas veces he leído ese mensaje, vuela alto, muchas veces a legado a mí, pero la mayoría de las veces sentí que no era específicamente para mí, sino que debía transmitirlo, como si yo misma fuera un canal para que llegue a más personas y creo que eso pasaba porque no resonaba conmigo, ya sentía que mi alma me llevaba a volar y alto. Eso era para alguien más. Todas las personas venimos de un árbol y de muchas cosas escritas en un papel antiguo como el del diseño, incluso eso mismo viene hasta de gente que ni siquiera hemos conocido y muchas personas, y me incluyo, en algún momento estuvimos como dentro de un marco que nos delimitaba, pero ese mensaje, vuelta alto, significa que debemos cobrar vida y salir de esos marcos pre establecidos, que podemos crear nuestra propia vida con cambio de pensamientos y acciones, creencias y hábitos. Trabajar para que podamos salir volando de esos marcos y alzar el vuelo como las aves, que muchas de ellas ven más que con los ojos físicos. La mayoría de las aves que elegí para el diseño son garzas y creo que las elegí por su belleza y elegancia. Además de un grato recuerdo de una pintura que hice hace muchos años cuando estudiaba, una hermosa garza blanca con su plumaje desplegado.

![separador sencillo 2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/Eo8UGAXUZoPxi8Ny3bWhw7vRVQywdynrHRhAwwZtRqW9jnyK7CZ42782EyeJ1UKHQuv.png)
Process in pictures - Proceso en imágenes
|![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23tHUs8Loz9uBYpRnMhkUEQRWwowYxmmEaA99jboaAeZEnm45BXEhjcNoG1ooKfd3G1to.jpg)|![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23tSqNeKF49jqbomdfGm1BLTrEW1ogSESvAKuJjJKUxXz7SLr3XZvctmJHNAyfWFQRBfo.jpg)| |-|-| |![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wgcTFEdiQj7eku9mG1Y3LAdSAfyDLJb6ZRJPa8dwLQfMcCMV4G2GZ2QXzJChypf5zya.jpg)|![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23vsZGfuUjrTDpvye8TsdR8YPSp2Xtj4r21y8TYVnUFRaa3kgu9SMrPyL8cmDtTx3cMsW.jpg)| ||| |![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23viAQCqxSPfbmxoRBkLRWF75yeiUnz4URceWRhuDDtVxY4EivPgyyohV3LVXbb2i9c3L.jpg)|![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xAcR9JoxmCfkzqkVFL2RWkpPNNhTPU6oScyVR7TEausd94n6zZi84DbsLoU9Bnyp93e.jpg)| ![separador sencillo 2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/Eo8UGAXUZoPxi8Ny3bWhw7vRVQywdynrHRhAwwZtRqW9jnyK7CZ42782EyeJ1UKHQuv.png) # Design process The design was created entirely in Photoshop CS6 without the use of AI, using 12 royalty-free images spread across 23 layers. First of all, I created a black layer onto which I placed the vintage paper, ensuring it was slightly smaller than the layer below so that the black edges would show through. On top of this, I placed the watercolour image using the ‘Multiply’ blend mode, giving the old paper a soft pattern in the background. I then took the handwritten paper, selected various parts of it, copied and pasted them into the design, used different scales and positions for each of these parts, and applied the ‘Spot Light’ blend mode. I then worked on the frame, placing it in three layers at different positions and scales. Beneath each of these, I placed an image of hot-air balloons and their landscapes using the ‘Multiply’ blend mode; then, from each of these images, I copied and pasted a balloon without a blend mode and moved it outside the frame, so that I could animate its position later. Finally, from the five images of birds, I carefully selected each one, copied and pasted them into the design in different positions and scales, on top of the frames but below the balloons to which I was going to add movement. The animation is done completely in After Effects, working on the opacity of each layer and adding lights in the form of clouds for better contrast. I send you all a big hello and see you next time. I think that was because it didn’t resonate with me; I already felt that my soul was leading me to fly, and high. That was for someone else. We all come from a tree and from many things written on ancient paper, such as the design; indeed, this even comes from people we have never even met. Many of us, myself included, have at some point felt as though we were trapped within a framework that confined us. But that message, ‘fly high’, means that we must come alive and break free from those pre-established frameworks; that we can create our own lives by changing our thoughts and actions, beliefs and habits. We must work so that we can fly out of those frames and take flight like birds, many of whom see more than just with their physical eyes. Most of the birds I chose for the design are herons, and I think I chose them for their beauty and elegance. It also brings back a fond memory of a painting I did many years ago when I was a student: a beautiful white heron with its plumage spread out.

Eso era para alguien más. Todas las personas venimos de un árbol y de muchas cosas escritas en un papel antiguo como el del diseño, incluso eso mismo viene hasta de gente que ni siquiera hemos conocido y muchas personas, y me incluyo, en algún momento estuvimos como dentro de un marco que nos delimitaba, pero ese mensaje, vuelta alto, significa que debemos cobrar vida y salir de esos marcos pre establecidos, que podemos crear nuestra propia vida con cambio de pensamientos y acciones, creencias y hábitos. Trabajar para que podamos salir volando de esos marcos y alzar el vuelo como las aves, que muchas de ellas ven más que con los ojos físicos. La mayoría de las aves que elegí para el diseño son garzas y creo que las elegí por su belleza y elegancia. Además de un grato recuerdo de una pintura que hice hace muchos años cuando estudiaba, una hermosa garza blanca con su plumaje desplegado.

body.title: Designing a placard Eng/Spa
body.body:
> ![142470.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/keila2022/48YdoFkk9ukx64p1kZ4h1NfEwzi2H8pzbu6VU6YKuqWYTEt5nU83DDb7TmBTgBYPXh.png) # Designing a Placard. > Hello to all the members of this wonderful community. It’s a pleasure to greet you again and share a step-by-step guide for making a small school banner; this one, in particular, is about children’s rights. ‎ >Now, I’ll show you how I made it. **Materials:** ‎Used manila folder. ‎Cardstock. ‎Colored pencils. ‎1 sheet of white paper. ‎Colored pencils. ‎Black marker. ‎poscicle stick. ![142941.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/keila2022/48b3Mi5SgY1VbAmvSeqXNTsDLFXDPEwbAA7dkMAteukf3tSYzFNM3aRW99eTi6dXLW.png) **Procedure:** **Step 1.** ‎Using a graphite pencil, I sketched the drawings; next, I colored and cut them out. ![142636.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/keila2022/EoyUmTgqnvhFCCbiV6BcPUkYjXK4xJnYS2DH6s54zDYjejNrcMqxSFJ14L2QQE3Ucof.png) **Step 2.** ‎Then, using the dimensions of the letter-sized white sheet, I cut out a rectangle from the folder and one from green cardstock. **Step 3.** ‎Using glue, I attached the green cardstock to the rectangle I made from the folder, placing a wooden popsicle stick between them to hold it in place. ![142644.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/keila2022/Ep1bn4TbqfqJGs4NhpvAjRJDk9tHCBmjhc8TVVmprcpct9kycAtxxeKew5Asz4Nw7oK.png) **Step 4.** On a white sheet of paper, I wrote the title of the poster: Children’s Rights and two of the rights: the right to a family and the right to education. I colored it in and cut it out. **Step 5.** Using the size of the letters and drawings as a guide, I cut out some glitter cardstock and placed the text on it to make it stand out. ![142650.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/keila2022/EouDx7FigQoYszEwzVaJemwPyyPdxDVMskFEaZwjgrw8oF1wCkfXa5w5G6rYUH72YA8.png) And there you go—we now have a beautiful banner, and the best part is that I made it with materials I already had at home. I believe the most meaningful aspect of this project is that, even though I didn’t do it with Amanda due to scheduling conflicts, she perceives and values my support in each of her activities. Thank you so much for reading this post all the way to the end. I always enjoy sharing my experiences. Once again, I send you a virtual hug. ‎ >Image design: Canva. Translation tool used:DeepL.com ‎
Spanish Version

![142662.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/keila2022/48YdoFkk9ukx64A9K8hNm5quTpe7nABSekmPhJmGF6vki8f3qkZxrqk55uK2u71cnh.png) # Diseñando una Pancarta Escolar. > Hola a todos los miembros de esta maravillosa comunidad. Que gusto saludarles nuevamente y traerles el paso a paso para realizar un pequeña pancarta escolar, esta en particular es sobre los derechos de los niños. ‎ > Ahora, les muestro como lo hice. **Materiales:** ‎Carpeta marrón usada. ‎Cartulina. ‎Colores. ‎1 Hoja blanca. ‎Colores. ‎Marcador negro. ‎Paleta de madera. ![142941.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/keila2022/48b3Mi5SgY1VbAmvSeqXNTsDLFXDPEwbAA7dkMAteukf3tSYzFNM3aRW99eTi6dXLW.png) **Procedimiento:** **Paso 1.** ‎Usando lápiz de grafito, realicé un boceto de los dibujos,  lo siguiente fue colorear y recortar. ![142636.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/keila2022/EoyUmTgqnvhFCCbiV6BcPUkYjXK4xJnYS2DH6s54zDYjejNrcMqxSFJ14L2QQE3Ucof.png) **Paso 2.** ‎Luego, usando las medidas de la hoja blanca tipo carta, recorté un rectángulo con la carpeta y uno con cartulina verde. **Paso 3.** ‎Usando silicón, pegué la cartulina verde con el rectángulo que hice con la carpeta, colocando entre ambos una paleta de madera para sostenerlo. ![142644.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/keila2022/Ep1bn4TbqfqJGs4NhpvAjRJDk9tHCBmjhc8TVVmprcpct9kycAtxxeKew5Asz4Nw7oK.png) **Paso 4.** ‎En una hoja blanca, coloqué el título del hablador: Derechos de los niños y las niñas y  dos de los derechos: derecho a la familia y derecho a la educación, le di color y lo recorté. **Paso 5.** ‎Tomando como referencia el tamaño de las letras y de los dibujos, recorté cartulina escarchada y en esta coloqué el contenido para resaltarlo. ![142650.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/keila2022/EouDx7FigQoYszEwzVaJemwPyyPdxDVMskFEaZwjgrw8oF1wCkfXa5w5G6rYUH72YA8.png) Y listo, ya tenemos una bonita pancarta, y lo mejor es que la elaboré con materiales que ya tenía en casa. Considero, que lo más significativo de este trabajo, es que aunque no lo hice con Amanda por cuestiones de horarios, ella percibe y valora mi apoyo en cada una de sus actividades. Gracias infinitas a ti que ha llegado al final del Post. Para mi siempre es grato compartir mi experiencia. Una vez más, te abrazo en la distancia. ‎ ‎ Diseño de Imágenes: Canva. body.title: i266 JJ46, Drawing step by step /Rising Star
body.body: > Blessings once again, everyone. I really appreciate you being here with my drawing. Today I'm going to show you the new card from the game that I've drawn. It's i266 JJ46, as you can see, it's a microphone. But this microphone has something peculiar about it; its design is different from the usual microphones I draw here on my blog. It has a much more elongated, drum-like shape. This makes me think that perhaps it's a fictional microphone designed to enrich the game's instrument universe, or maybe some rare type of microphone used in a recording studio. Personally, I've never seen anything similar in a music video. If you have, I'd appreciate it if you could leave the link in the comments so I can learn more about it. Okay, then, let's move on to the drawing so you can see it. I'll tell you right now that this microphone has a lovely pink color, which makes it look very nice. I started by drawing the card's frame, in this case, the inner one, and I used straight lines again for this. ![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo2BTut2nd6Wj5DVhYdPERVqL6Bukv7gAPEDbs2b47Qv8DUCQVQnVwpYLAkTZ95DtTs.jpg) Once I finished the frame, I moved on to drawing the microphone base. Honestly, when I finished it, I thought it was quite funny, as it reminded me of a water base. After completing that funny part, I drew the top of the microphone. Both turned out like this. ![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo2BM1YUX8DHkTQvn4dQYeyu2mm73QJ5R7kW1kJYJ9sHnTTEUxnKo2RWkvdbK94mXtG.jpg) ![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo4JkCmxfZTVXcrQVVCVgVEBmHEoB9zT4DgbQxvLEW8HTqQPnKqKwMJXpVfsksBTah2.jpg) The next step was to complete some missing parts of the microphone, such as the bottom base and part of the top. With that, the sketch was ready for painting. ![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo6S9Q1ShsR19Lxmyb6KnVUidMjxaRt9FFwTNrVTbLGDUf8UzBDnrvqqUuKRSSssGi4.jpg) Painting was the most fun part of the whole drawing. I loved using purple and pink to fill in the main areas, like the background and the microphone. But it will be more fun if I show you than tell you about it, so here are the following screenshots. ![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EokiprxSGQPAAbN3M7KsSwi7eRAxsz6QXETNrHuWZKYmdaes5BUhz5uV7TCtuXyeYwL.jpg) ![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EoPPzTeWYdfK7i4xjcWv2pWGbG9AX7ms5xu33YQvwJ6L9qDfVQTyjaTQsyqdJ5zskQ4.jpg) ![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eoa2wZqF4zbpCJTvce2wAqHCXNdbgxCrLBkprtmR2yeU5CNiQfZ5HCCsW6aZazRQkPr.jpg) ![8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EqmgaYVjJb15uodaqj1pG2QqaUxLEGWFc2W9gyqfx2LXky1HAk4v6nwKWqyBcye7f9A.jpg) And to finish for today, here is the final result. See you in the next drawing. Blessings to all. ![9.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/2458cva8rpGkwvfen6FfPqwiHWomsQSDBrcEoX1QGeiq4CUCPnSAY54KDNPqA7kx1GzD6.jpg)

body.title: How Assignment Help Services Are Transforming Academic Success in 2026
body.body:
In today’s fast-paced academic environment, students are constantly juggling multiple responsibilities—classes, part-time jobs, and personal commitments. Managing everything efficiently can feel overwhelming, which is why many learners are turning toward smarter solutions to stay on track. One such solution gaining attention is **Assignment Help Services**, designed to simplify academic challenges and improve overall performance.

### **Why Students Seek External Academic Support**

Academic pressure has increased significantly in recent years. From tight deadlines to complex subjects, students are expected to perform consistently at a high level. This is where structured support systems come into play.

Professional assistance not only helps in meeting deadlines but also provides clarity on difficult topics. Instead of struggling alone, students can focus on understanding concepts while managing their time more effectively.

### **The Role of Technology in Academic Assistance**

Technology has revolutionized how students approach their studies. Automation tools and smart workflows are making academic tasks more manageable than ever before. For instance, learning how to streamline repetitive tasks through tools discussed in this guide on [automating your academic workflow](https://wingetui.com/how-to-automate-your-academic-workflow-using-windows-package-managers/) can significantly reduce manual effort.

Similarly, students working on technical or research-based assignments can benefit from automation techniques like those explained in [using Python for automating bulk domain analysis](https://bulkdrchecker.com/blogs/how-to-use-python-for-automating-bulk-domain-analysis-in-2026/), which showcases how coding can simplify complex data tasks.

These advancements complement academic support services, making learning more efficient and less stressful.

### **Key Benefits of Using Assignment Help Services**

There are several reasons why students are increasingly relying on Assignment Help Services:

#### **1. Time Management**

Balancing multiple assignments becomes easier when tasks are handled efficiently. Students can allocate more time to learning and revision.

#### **2. Improved Understanding**

Guided solutions help break down complex concepts, making them easier to grasp.

#### **3. Better Academic Performance**

With structured assistance, students can submit high-quality assignments that meet academic standards.

#### **4. Stress Reduction**

Academic pressure can impact mental well-being. Reliable support helps reduce anxiety and improves focus.

### **How to Choose the Right Service**

Not all services deliver the same level of quality. Students should consider a few important factors before making a decision:

*   **Credibility and reviews**

*   **Expertise in specific subjects**

*   **Timely delivery**

*   **Plagiarism-free content**

*   **Affordable pricing**

Making an informed choice ensures that the support received is both reliable and beneficial.

### **Balancing Help with Independent Learning**

While external assistance is helpful, it’s important to maintain a balance. Students should use these services as a learning aid rather than a shortcut. Reviewing completed assignments, understanding the methodology, and applying similar approaches independently can enhance long-term academic growth.

### **Future of Academic Support**

The future of education is leaning toward hybrid learning models where traditional study methods blend with digital solutions. As tools and platforms continue to evolve, academic support systems will become more personalized and efficient.

Students who adapt to these changes early will have a significant advantage in managing their academic journey.

### **Conclusion**

Academic success today requires more than just hard work—it demands smart strategies. With the integration of technology and structured guidance, students can navigate challenges more effectively. Leveraging the right resources, including Assignment Help Services, can make a meaningful difference in achieving academic goals while maintaining a balanced lifestyle.

body.title: Krieg unter Schimpansen
body.body:
Liebe Leser,

leider ist das Führen von Kriegen nicht nur auf die Menschheit begrenzt, *systematische* gewalttätige Auseinandersetzungen (also nicht nur der Kampf zwischen 2 Individuen, wie er ständig passiert) gibt es auch im Tierreich (z.B. bekannt bei Menschenaffen, Ameisen, Zebramangusten, Löwen und Wölfen). Organisierte Gewalt ist uns offenbar in die genetische Wiege gelegt.
Die größte bekannte Schimpansengruppe der Welt hat sich in zwei verfeindete Fraktionen gespalten und führt nun einen tödlichen Konflikt, laut einer kürzlich im *Science* veröffentlichten langjährigen [Studie](https://www.science.org/doi/10.1126/science.adz4944). Was ist passiert?

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stayooutoftherz/23vsEDm4gQuQwARBe5VvX7k7M3czuyXiLZA5G3noZuLosCdZYaknNPGW5wMFkF4D2p5m6.png)

In Ugandas Kibale-Nationalpark lebte bis 2015 die mit etwa 200 Tieren größte bekannte Schimpansengemeinschaft (Ngogo). Über Jahrzehnte hinweg bildeten die Tiere zwei eng verbundene Cluster („Central“ und „Western“), die gemeinsam das Gebiet nutzten, sich mischten und untereinander paarten.
Ab Juni 2015 kam es plötzlich zu Spannungen: Eine Western-Gruppe floh vor einer Central-Gruppe und wurde verfolgt – ein bis dahin noch nie beobachtetes Verhalten. In den folgenden Jahren trennten sich die beiden Fraktionen räumlich und sozial komplett. Sie patrouillierten durch die jeweils eigene Territorien und behandelten die ehemaligen Gruppenmitglieder als Feinde.
Zwischen 2018 und 2024 beobachteten Forscher, wie Western-Schimpansen mindestens sieben erwachsene Männchen und 17 Jungtiere der Central-Gruppe töteten. Weitere 14 Central-Männchen verschwanden spurlos und wurden vermutlich ebenfalls Opfer von Angriffen. Zusätzliche Attacken wurden auch danach dokumentiert.
Laut den Wissenschaftlern führte der extreme Größenzuwachs der Gruppe zu starkem Konkurrenzdruck um Nahrung und Fortpflanzung. Hinzu kamen Wechsel bei den Alphamännchen und der Tod wichtiger „Brücken-Tiere“, die die beiden Cluster früher verbanden. Das soziale Gefüge brach auseinander. 

Ein ähnlicher Fall ereignete sich in den 1970er-Jahren im Gombe-Nationalpark (Tansania) und wurde von Jane Goodall beobachtet. Damals zweifelten einige Forscher an der Natürlichkeit des Konflikts, weil die Tiere an menschliche Futterstellen gewöhnt waren. Die Ngogo-Beobachtung gilt nun als erster eindeutiger Beleg für einen \

Bürgerkrieg bei Schimpansen.

Der Erstautor Aaron Sandel (University of Texas) sieht darin eine Parallele zum Menschen: Konflikte entstehen oft nicht primär durch kulturelle Unterschiede, sondern durch den Zerfall persönlicher sozialer Beziehungen. Friedensförderung sollte deshalb vor allem auf den Erhalt und die Pflege zwischenmenschlicher Kontakte setzen – auch über Konfliktgrenzen hinweg. Ich bezweifle das aber, denn Krieg entsteht öfter durch individuelle Führungspersönlichkeiten und deren Machtanspruch, die die Folgen des Krieges meist selbst nicht zu tragen haben und weniger durch persönliche Feindschaften.

Wie seht Ihr das?

body.title: Acehnese spiced grilled fish
body.body:
> ![1000599195.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23w2qe72VAmhQpZ3bDE9AxKnLo9sakuibZb8Q1o5GUehoA3M5Lc85C9TFRJhjSgtcsboJ.jpg) *** *** *** Acehnese grilled fish, even though I live in Aceh, this is the first time I've made Acehnese grilled fish seasoning, hehehe, it sounds strange, right? As you know, I really like grilled fish, but the grilled fish I always use is the usual grilled fish seasoning, but today my mother gave me a recipe from her youth, she said this is how Acehnese people used to make grilled fish with this seasoning, this is how my mother explained it. ![1000599192.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23x1DUKhGp26jyxsz2bfQWFZeyug1p7KX5mebi39WS26BRZY1CYSGwNJ7gGHRBVjEgPz8.jpg) From the explanation of my mother's recipe, I wrote it down on a piece of paper and the next day I immediately bought tuna to grill it with my mother's special spices. and it turns out that when my mother was young, fish was always grilled on hot coals or steamed in banana leaves. She rarely fried fish. And if she wanted to eat it in broth, she would also cook fish in broth, unlike my life now where I often fry fish. ![1000599189.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23wqnjuXrWvBgv3P2QCc1AyCKtsNeRmAj4Wh23McPkPQzDic5WRAgx4oxVULSu8NJp1JJ.jpg) My mother said that fish is healthier steamed, grilled or cooked in soup than fried. I started to think that people in the past lived healthier lives than we do now. No wonder people in the past rarely got sick. Yes, even though they did get sick, there were no strange diseases like in our time. > If you are curious about the manufacturing process, just follow the steps that will be shared in my post today. *** ###
Materials used
### *** ![1000597771.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23ynWxvdxT1MKVm6uveDYtsGTx9uvgV5QmEpV46dx53yuK5soYCvbmTutcWiewx45XShF.jpg) ***
1 kg tuna 7 shallots 3 cloves garlic 10 red chilies 7 Asam Sunti (spicy fish) 2 candlenuts 4 bird's eye chilies 1/2 tbsp turmeric powder
*** ###
Manufacturing procedure
### ***
**First**
*** For the spices, I blended everything until smooth. I also added turmeric powder.Once it's smooth, I cook it until the oil releases until it's cooked |![1000597777.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/Eoptt8LxRF8NtVVY5YHRvnv6EkACPSvWGLMyrzJ5Y6JJW8mWENyW9Qddr4SjfRQ5bkZ.jpg)|![1000597778.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EonkTXfQxkzzRyVRi2HNv4voDTK4gvPmWNZftS7pK9m2vdz2ieMgqt1SdquMGA9sXwF.jpg)|![1000597779.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EowHXw7qai34hJoj5CFvf52GG4QinfwqZpRwnfCbysJB98NoY2U3yhRfK79HskmU2tp.jpg) |-|-|-| |![1000597810.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23zGa8N5fc99rnfSjCi5gAoWafb1DapKHhgv9YA7w3dNNmirpGtipsPEMRdMSpoMDU94W.jpg)|![1000597809.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EoyPXJxDZ9TSNkPWKUi6Hack32DzMNuLHpTYRWL1KcfsANfXGQhgXdRxFZEjK2TqMcx.jpg)|![1000597808.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/Eou8nyuzyNoze9oE9eZCnTMF2YxuU16iBFyuv1iLBirzEFKLAJYpY3DVpHz1yGTnKRr.jpg) |-|-|-| ***
**Second**
*** Next, I rubbed it on the fish and grilled it. I had already coated the fish with salt and lime and cleaned it beforehand. |![1000597794.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23wX3Qt5tuxZgGfcPMwoeJdMnAHQHzLyQBMmjgTK6TgjkXL4Pys6fo7ZyV6m93oAsYpiu.jpg)|![1000597795.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23wgKmtSxMKJiPKHTqFi55hgKudU3bvGBs3EdAry6YEqGqCCSdc89UjeAApeRXBFn2tkP.jpg) |-|-| |![1000597796.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23vsStvCp1nvpJstNTSmEsMC3BFfh4d6hpHTUYkRyt7GS3r4ieZ9FqFLTRJnaqahhs52C.jpg)|![1000597797.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/Ep3eMZRFyV855qafeHxY9aHeJXpm11ecpXfQhv4hpEYG3fWnFM9V5v7jdNXjJY5rYQP.jpg) |-|-| ***
**Third**
*** Next, I grilled it over hot coals until the fish was perfectly cooked. Don't forget to brush on the seasoning again while grilling it. |![1000597817.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/Eos2JR6EGaSPFQkS8EL5iCa3LkdoYBYiMAv9mfknqqggqucBp6VNi8eXuytdrRZd21v.jpg)|![1000597830.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/Ep1XRfjfysm6h9tqEn8nbo4gMR7JTWV8TNHaSJwk1T6jSqpEShfX94y2J3RuuuQzk6j.jpg) |-|-| |![1000597856.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EoyPXSQ1YxJgFb1GsogVRmm17x9GbBPizerj5a7ayiXZzLNTyskVhBnjEffKjpLaMUG.jpg)|![1000597857.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EoAbF7H4b7meV7EbauMSPSzg9wGYMS7WwWZzScP7WJqwCDugnioT6RpK73HXWi39pwV.jpg) |-|-| *** ###
RESULTS
### *** ![1000599186.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/Eoc8R4vh5kC9bHFiJBb2QKDYdzxcH4zAH5C1siEHCXDDNdgzfU2w4nEXXBkBPiudzFs.jpg) *** *** *** Here is the result of grilled fish with Acehnese spices and it is ready, this fish is very delicious, the spices are absorbed so that this fish is very aromatic, the fragrant aroma makes everyone hungry when they smell it Moreover, it is grilled with natural embers so that anyone who enjoys it will definitely be addicted. And I wait until the fish is no longer too hot before I transfer it to a plate, and I also make a soy sauce seasoning to dip the fish in. |![1000599188.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23wqnjvCRYek1h2q2cdNLgBUs4bKQn9ErFqvG8zMEbVh9mSZeh1b6p8RpW7Jda5pC5iLb.jpg)|![1000599187.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23xKzdrhB7KEDmnDDXf4zuiC3BFRBfZqWRmw8GDy6SxDa5QXFbBk22SYe4njMJm49dFuc.jpg)|![1000599188.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23wqnjvCRYek1h2q2cdNLgBUs4bKQn9ErFqvG8zMEbVh9mSZeh1b6p8RpW7Jda5pC5iLb.jpg) |-|-|-| The fish was perfectly cooked, and we immediately enjoyed it with a plate of warm rice and a spicy, sweet, and slightly sour soy sauce. You can imagine how delicious this fish was. Why is this fish called Acehnese grilled fish? Because the grilled fish seasoning contains Sunti acid, which is a typical Acehnese spice. That's why this grilled fish is called Acehnese grilled fish. ![1000599190.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EoeGLPx3f3zLsSeHvt4vUrA2Ue5RGrdazwPYKJE9HnwNQVqKNaNYYsPokmrUbW8z5iJ.jpg) *** *** *** ###

body.title: Knowing the future// Mcgi Review// The Old Path
body.body:
Alot of people are becoming curious to know what will happen tomorrow, but they forget that the future belongs to God alone to know. Human beings are limited, and God in His wisdom reveals only what is necessary for us to live rightly. Instead of seeking to control or predict everything ahead, believers are encouraged to trust in God’s plan and timing. This trust builds faith and helps us rely on His guidance rather than our own understanding.
https://youtu.be/Xto8QfUW0xE?si=qGPYX4hL9d8XNoKC
The Bible also warns against trying to know the future through ungodly means, such as divination or fortune-telling. God desires that His children walk by faith, not by sight, depending on Him daily for direction and provision.  

>“It is not for you to know the times or dates the Father has set by his own authority” (Acts 1:7). 

This reminds us that our focus should be on obedience and faithfulness, leaving the future in God’s hands.

body.title: REWRITING THE HABIT THAT CONTROLS YOUR LIFE
body.body:
Rewriting the Habit That Controls Your Life



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmavrfpWinUM3CT1pBkNJiVAAtbHCBTEfkTWj1bNeyE98t/1775492128443.jpg)

A picture of me 

There’s something you do every day, softly, almost invisibly that is shaping your life more than your dreams ever have. And it  doesn’t look dangerous.

It looks like saying “I’ll start tomorrow.” Looking like shrinking your voice in a room full of opinions.
It looks like choosing comfort over growth, again and again until it becomes who you think you are.

And that’s how it controls you

A young woman once decided she wanted more for herself, more of discipline, confidence and direction. She had the vision, a clear and burning one surging from her inside. But every time it was time to act, she hesitated.

She would overthink, doubt herself and waiting for the “perfect mood.”

And somehow, the day would end without her doing that one thing she promised herself

Not because she was lazy, but because she was used to a habit she never questioned

As Aristotle once said, “We are what we repeatedly do.” And without realizing it, she had been practicing hesitation so consistently that it began to feel like her personality.

“I’m just not that disciplined.” \

body.title: The Masters at Augusta 2026
body.body:
# <center>  One of my favourite sports events </center>

It's Friday the 10th of April, and to say I'm excited would be the understatement of the century. As you'll know I am a huge sports fan and I love a big occasion like a Soccer world cup final, a Hurling All Ireland final or Grand Slam rugby decider, but up there with all of them is the Masters at Augusta. This year I've been so busy with work and life that it's snook up on me rather quickly, but alas it is here now and day 1 was majestic.

Today is the second day of a glorious week, the week of the first golfing major of the year and my favorite of the four golfing majors. There is just something special about Augusta National that sets it apart from all other golf courses and tournaments. Ask any golfer what course they would love to play most and the vast majority will opt for the lush green fairways of Augusta National Golf Club. I often ponder how much I would pay for a chance to play the course and I reckon I would give €1,000 to €2,000 to play it just once, but the funny thing is even €1,000,000 would not guarantee a tee time, as it is not about money, but rather status and who you know, so my best chance to ever either play it or even attend the event is to hope one of my sons becomes a professional golfer, yes an extremely long shot, better get them to start chipping balls into the washing machine!

https://youtu.be/t3bjKmQXtIg?is=xbbRNHgDsb8sqf1J


# <center> The beauty of Augusta </center>
# 

When Thursday finally comes and the wait is over for another year, the excitement is palpable. All of the preparation, the hours on the range, thousands of putts and chips, then hopefully a good night's sleep and then it's show time! 

Somebody unexpected usually gets off to a rocket start with three quick birdies in six holes, but they never keep it going. What Augusta gives, Augusta doth take away just as quickly. It just takes one wayward swing and a birdie hole can suddenly become a double bogey. That was poor old Freddie Couples yesterday. He turned back the years for 14 holes and sat at -2 and twenty minutes later he was +6 after a quadruple bogey at 15, double at 16 and double at 17.  Cruel.

It is not a golf course that you can take for granted by any means and the greenkeepers will have it playing nicely for practice on Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday only for the real course and real greens to show their teeth on Thursday when the pros tee it up.


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZdtvCWM1xnw5TVrf2NAQBjygm53aGFk7WNmQFq7y3eY1/image.png)


Questions abound. Who will we see slipping the green jacket on come Sunday evening? Will anyone melt down on the back 9? Will we see a late surge through Amen corner? Will a form player prevail or is a shock on the cards? 

Questions galore as we all lap up the kaleidoscope of colours we've grown accustomed to around Augusta National. The pink and white of the azaleas are a feast for the eyes, as the lush green manicured fairways wait anxiously for the worlds best players to toil tirelessly for the biggest prize in golf - The Masters title. A Title win will bring with it a lifelong invitation to play the Masters, which players like Fred Couples (Winner in 1992) and Vijay Singh (Winner in 2000) are utilising this year and it is always nice to see one or two of these veterans having a good tournament and although it is a lovely tradition, I do think that they should maybe hang the boots up once they stop being competitive and make some space for a younger player to tee it up, as after 30 or 40 times competing and living that dream, maybe move over and let somene else's dream come true?

Even those who know nothing about golf or sport in general will be familiar with the scene that is Augusta National Golf course in in the US state of Georgia. This pristine golf course is what Wimbledon is to tennis players; what Wembley is to footballers. It is arguably golf's biggest stage and a stage upon which all of the world's greatest want to bring their A-game. I really believe that both Scottie and Rory will bring their A games this week and we are in for one heck of a masters. Those two will battle it out come Sunday evening I believe.


# <center> Here is how the leaderboard is shaping up after round 1. </center>

There are some really bug names up there like Rory,  Rose, Schauffele and Scheffler.

Equally some massive names will struggle ti make the cut like Rahm, MacIntyre, Cantlay, DeChambeau.

So who is going to win? Once again my money is on McIlroy. I think he will go back to back and even winning three in a row is not beyond the bounds for me. His driver was terrible yesterday and he still scrambled magnificently for a 67. It's difficult to see anyone besting him this week for me.

猫粮吃完了，花狸猫又来了。

它还是像往常一样，准时出现在店门口，蹲在台阶边，不吵也不闹，就那么看着你。眼神很稳，像是在提醒：它知道你会出来。

我翻了翻家里，猫粮确实见底了，只剩一点碎渣。想着先拿点馍顶一下，结果递过去，它闻了闻，转头就走，一点面子都不给。

后来我去查了“豆包”，才知道猫是纯肉食动物，不能随便糊弄。原来不是它挑食，是我太随意。

有点好笑，又有点无奈。我连自己吃肉都得算着日子，结果还要先惦记它的营养。

它每天照来不误，我也只能每天想着：生意好一些，多挣一点钱，先把它的猫粮续上，再把债务解决。

生活好像就是这样，人和猫都在等一口更踏实的饭。

body.title: The Erosion of Values: How Society's Silence is Fueling Moral Decay.
body.body:
A lot of things are happening in our world today that's making me feel somehow worried. And I'm more worried because all of us are beginning to see it as nothing. No one is talking down on it, we are seeing it as what's in vogue and the society is getting more decayed, yet we are less concerned.




![1000924638.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/1000924638.png)




Talk of the way a lot of people now dress, not in their homes or the corners of their room, but in the street, and on the internet. Talk of how a lot of us now have no iota of respect for elders, people now bash and talk down on elderly people online as if...I don't even know. A lot of things has changed and is changing and most annoying or funniest part is, if you try to talk about it they see you as old-school or laugh at you. I agree that there's freedom, but then we shouldn't forget discipline as well.







And when we talk about who the blame of this moral decadence should be on, personally I feel the blame should be on everyone and everything, the society, the parents, the social media and the individual themselves.



![1000924635.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/1000924635.png)



 A lot of parents today are too busy trying to survive and cater for the home that they have little or no time for their children, now the media itself has made things worse that you can't really see something good to learn on the surface, open a social media account today and see what you've greeted with, the first few videos that will come your way are nothing to write home about, and that's where this children spend the most hours of their day seeing things that shouldn't be in the open being flaunt without shame online. And when our young ones begin to see these things online, to them they feel that's how it is supposed to be.




The society itself has lowered its expectations, there was a time those that are elderly in our street would correct us and call us to attention for certain things that we say or do or on our dressings, but today there's nothing like that, a lot of them will just shake their head and say it wasn't like that while they were growing up, and they also won't want to talk just so they wouldn't be disrespected or labeled as *\

* 


![1000924639.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/1000924639.png)


Personally, I hold the believe that change can happen, as it is constant. It might not be easy though, but it is possible. But that change my ust first start from the individual and the home. Parents should do better at teaching their wards morals. 







Our schools should as well go beyond teaching English and chemistry but also tech subjects that promote good morals and characters(some schools are doing that though), the social space as well should be regulated and must focus on promoting positive things and not just all about views, engagements and attentions. And the individual themselves should learn to take responsibility for whatever they do.






It is possible if we all choose, or if the greatest percentage of us choose to do and stand for what's right. Slowly, the remaining percentage will change too if we correct them with love and make them see what's right.

昨天下午，跟着大部队去江西省图书馆转了一圈。按大区轮流安排，我们是最后一组，时间卡得特别紧，直接定在下午四点，就在图书馆一楼展厅。
 
这次图书馆之行是领导特意安排，为的是我们这次“书香校园”的建设项目，让我们看看省图书馆是如何做的。

给我们讲解的是个海归学者。他张口就说自己是项目4000万投入的受益者，这话一出，瞬间把大家的好奇心勾起来了——都想看看这4000万到底是怎么运作的。
 
他先讲办展初衷，说就是想让爱看书的孩子能写出自己的心里话，展厅里摆的都是各所小学孩子出的个人作品集。从2021年到2025年，这活动办了6届，他一直强调“特别成功”。展厅里那些孩子的刊物确实做得挺精致，看着挺有氛围。
 
其中这部作品《春姑娘》不仅书写成画还能创作成歌曲，对于孩子来说成就感满满。

但咱这些天天扎在学校一线的人，心里都很清楚，这项目看着光鲜，实际根本不落地。
 
首先，每个学校都有自己的校本教材，阅读写作都有固定的安排，哪有多余精力去搞这种个人出刊、班刊的项目？

其次，能合作20个班以上的大学校本来就少，而且只有城区、县城的少数标杆校和民办校可能会感兴趣搞形象工程，普通学校、乡镇学校根本没这个需求和条件。
 
说白了，这项目以学校为单位不切实际，就是脱离空想，完全没考虑到学校真实的教学和运营情况，想大范围推广，真的很难。说得再天花乱坠学校一句:没时间、没钱，我们就没辙了。

body.title: ‎I Don’t Need Many Friends… Just One Who Won’t Leave When Life Gets Hard ‎ ‎
body.body:
‎Hi Hive,
‎
‎I don’t have a lot of friends, if I’m being honest. But..
‎ https://img.leopedia.io/DQmNmxGjczjxoEx5wES3ratMo7wHUHRupVRwMrjyjohJBY9/IMG_20250904_160910_490.jpg 

‎I have lost quite a few friends over time, and now I can literally count the real ones in my life on one hand. It’s not like I have never had people around me. Though I have get to met many, laughed with many, and shared moments with many but when it comes to those who truly stayed and show up when matters  then I will say the number is small.
‎
‎And I have come to accept that.
‎
‎Een though I won’t sit here and act like I’m saint, perfect or that I wasn’t part of the reason why some friendships didn’t last long. I have changed and so is my mindset too. And most importantly, my standards for friendship and the type of people I want around me have changed too.
‎
‎People often say a good friend should be honest, loyal, kind and I agree because those are beautiful qualities of relationship after all. But it goes deeper than that for me even though I don’t really have a long list of requirements anymore.
‎
‎In fact, I have just one.
‎
‎Be there for me when I’m at my lowest. And that’s it.
‎
‎Because from my own experience, I’ve seen how people gather around you when things are going well, when you’re winning, smiling, and everything looks good on the outside, you’ll have company,  even a lots at that. But when the moment of life hits harder, the silence becomes louder.
‎
‎I’ve been there.
‎
‎I have had moments where I was at one of the lowest points in my life, and not even a single person I called a friend reached out to ask if I was okay or give a helping hand. Not even the person I was emotionally closest to at the time. That experience is what really changed me and made me understand that not everyone who laughs with you truly stands with you or happy about your existence.
‎
‎And since then, I have made a tough decision that I started letting people go especially those with bad and negative energy. Not out of anger, but out of clarity. Because I believe that anyone who  doesn't show up when you need them the most was never really there in the first place so I have to make that decision.
‎
‎Pease don’t get me wrong, I still value honesty, loyalty, and kindness but to me, the real test of friendship is presence and most especially during the hard and tough times.
‎
‎Because a true friend is not just someone who celebrates you but someone who sits with you when you’re broken and have nothing.
‎
‎So at this point in my life, I’m not looking for many friends but I'm just looking for real ones.
‎
‎
‎![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYaWnApEziAtLL5Zwv3ZNbDjRfSfG6h5njgTrpyasnE6y/1775569275821.png)
‎

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@twicejoy/i-dont-need-many-friends-just-one-who-wont-leave-when-life-gets-hard--buq)
