body.title: Fruits in my home garden.
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeguyV9nJpMF4mRv55fYSjLMB7DpdrwPYF3GYREXGU7SU/1775805007782.jpg)

Hello everyone. How are you today? I hope all is well with you and your family. Our family owns three separate farm plots, The first plot is our rice field. This rice field is about 800 meters from the home. We plant rice for our own consumption. When we're not planting rice, we plant corn for sale. The second plot is our longan orchard. It's about 600 meters from our home. We plant longan for sale. And longan is our main cash crop. I used to take everyone to see our family's longan orchard often. And the third plot is our home garden. I plant many kinds of vegetables to eat with my family here. I often share vegetables from my garden too. And the foods my wife cooked from these vegetables. In our home garden, besides planting vegetables for eating, I also grow fruit to eat with my family. This post, I'll take everyone to see the fruits in the home garden. Let's go.

I only plant six types of fruit in my home garden. Now each type of fruit is flowering and bearing fruit. The first type is jackfruit. There are two jackfruit trees in the home garden. The one closer to the home is bearing more fruit than last year. But these jackfruits are still small fruits.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXmCBoaTJ3hvEyWrAHF6kaCy7QDGEDy3osydCCbRcVarw/1775805007943.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeQrjDEuqzk4n1YFQYxfJYhvywjW8EXDTDWhB75psg4hq/1775805008233.jpg)

The second fruit is papaya. There are several papaya trees in the home garden. They are bearing fruit. But the papaya tree closest to the house is producing the most.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmda8SCvuGPnDxePLruDVigmL5SsqxjXJ8ibGsg95Q8m16/1775805008483.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWpfw7KAzPPFxwzHJFr8kcKuZgAPGkhX8JAZHVHcBo2q6/1775805008775.jpg)

The third type of fruit in the home garden is bananas. There are many banana trees in the garden as well. Many banana trees are bearing fruit, but they are not ripe yet.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmePiYNnjdgCV7vgURtcTrQfmWTjvpJB66RJfYtjwFjYtW/1775805946511.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbpse4mDQvknTBYvMmGEbZgZmoy4GHUc8K3SSbw2UsTEh/1775805946816.jpg)

The fourth type of fruit in the home garden. There are only two mango trees in the home garden. The mango tree behind the home isn't bearing much fruit this year. But the mango tree in front of the home bore a lot of fruit.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd5M7sZCLqEZEEnevhf52m5kjiexAF23QocwkG8BbexwV/1775805947364.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR64JyhKeURsbMrZQk7jopocQMRQ2oJJjJ91rrLcBySRs/1775805947091.jpg)

The fifth type of fruit is rambutan. I tried planting just one rambutan tree in front of my home. The rambutan tree is flowering, but the some flowers are falling too.

The sixth type of fruit is guava. I planted three guava trees in my home garden. But just one guava tree is bearing a lot of fruit.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZrC3cECrWK5fqFYCVxuy7MHH1WkBexWjtYNjkk6ZuLgW/1775806603503.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc7m47ZPQZim2Wc8CFctTmtv17Q471iafrZ7ocDUQfLbb/1775806603818.jpg)

body.title: Interesting recovery run
body.body:
![IMG_1718.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rainbowdash4l/23qrKrXzFVrZvzCTbasDMCkfN8BBJB9wN33UrJwECaKDevGtUuKU1rvXztT7WNqU2NUjk.jpeg)

I try to become less focussed on analysing performance (all the time & in all aspects of my life). One of the elements for that is to garther less data - this means I limit myself when to use my garmin (frontrunner 965). Normally I only wear the watch with my main training sessions, but for some reason I started today’s recovery run with my watch. Not wearing the watch allows you to run on what really feels good, rather than a specific pace or heartrate. But this run produced some interesting results aswell that I would like to share. 

Breaking in new shoes: 
My old Omni 22 wore out completely with not even that much kilometers on it, as I felt unresponsible to run with these soles even once - I settled for replacing them with the same pair

Old:
![IMG_1543.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rainbowdash4l/23wqpeo35kHwu5zvG6eFJ4UxseFxeNyLDDausQrj62AXKr5CZCYUdV2TgBTZbuXB745Jo.jpeg)

New:
![IMG_1716.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rainbowdash4l/23vsUmLPZJc4sEbokhUWiwU34NAAQKATwKWYQMaB7FjwHtcYjSQ1xtLPPzMRaz2Trq7fq.jpeg)

While I would had loved to get a more durable pair I decided to not ruin my carbon shoes or trail shoes in the time that I would had needed to research a more suitable zone 1 - 2 shoe. Therefore as this pair was on sale I just reordered it and used an easy 5k to break them in. 

The run: 
My run today was mostly a recovery run, low heartbeat mostly zone 1 and during a few mini climbs some zone 2. 

While this is my every day 0 effort run, it was very interesting to see that I stayed at zone 1 around the pace in which I ran my PR on the full marathon: 

(At km 4.5:)
![IMG_1721.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rainbowdash4l/23wqtx1xPCJjTPDcwJYx1XWUoKJdL2SQUQxzQutnMoThF5ttMTBP4rxm2QJru7tk6UpsY.jpeg)

This means that both my hard efforts (Tuesday PR on 5k and 10k) had improved aswell as my easy pace on low heartrate. 


![IMG_1717.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rainbowdash4l/245wQ3QcY83kSFXg5wEHpddiDmuwW2nXF7QaLptCGH69NZGBv33idRHdsL94x2XCG6jWd.jpeg)



![IMG_1731.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rainbowdash4l/23swkEycCBApT7AYgQUbbrydAMYwWaikQweqSm7eG3K6j8BzNL4qR1pdEJy8kbKrquoCq.jpeg)

![IMG_1730.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rainbowdash4l/23tRtN6vG32TBAbmYJGuoXThCzbzipvHWn1Q8RHTjEz7jJ8g33VfTEW1ff35EfBv9TRMT.jpeg)

Why am I so excited about this: 

My marathon goal is getting way closer the prognoses right now are: 
- safe: 3:08 - 3:12
- realistic: 3:02 - 3:06
- agressive (and risky): 2:58 - 3:02

With my PR around 3:17 this is a large jump to make. Honestly I need to hold myself back to give it a try next week and build a little further so that sub 3 is within the realistic scenario! 

Happy running!

body.title: မီးသတိပြု
body.body:
ယနေ့ ဈေးသွားသည့်အခါ တူမတို့ ဇနီးမောင်နှံ၏
အိုးဝေကားလေးဖြင့် လမ်းကြုံလိုက်ခဲ့သည်။
ယခင်နေ့များမှာတော့ ဈေးသို့ လမ်းလျှောက်ရင်း
သွားသည်။ ဈေးသွားရာ လမ်းတလျှောက်
ဟိုငေး ဒီငေးဖြင့် ဈေးရောက်မှန်းမသိ ရောက်
ပေသည်။ ယခုတလော ဈေးသွားရာ လမ်းတလျှောက်
ရှိ ရပ်ကွက်မှာ အလှူပွဲများကို တွေ့ရသည်။
ယနေ့ ဒီတလမ်းဆိုပါမူ။ နောက်တနေ့မှာ
နောက်တလမ်းရှိအိမ်မှ အလှူပွဲအတွက် လှည့်လည်ဖို့
ဝတ်ကောင်းစားလှများဖြင့် အလှူပွဲလှည့်ဖို့
ဟန်ရေပြနေကြသည်။ 


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbiXzgSn4kFobcc9YKpvTaZBcaKmafE4P7Dsr8UHddCk8/1775808605484.jpg)

ဈေးသွားရာ လမ်းရှိ ရပ်ကွက်မှ အိမ်များက
တအိမ်နဲ့ တအိမ် အပြိုင်အဆိုင်များ လှူနေကြသလား
အောင်းမေ့ရပေသည်။ ဓာတ်စက်ကြီးများနဲ့
အပြိုင်ဖွင့်ပြီး ဦးရွှေရိုး၊ ဒေါ်မိုးအကများဖြင့်လည်း
အလှူပွဲကို မြိုင်မြိုင်ဆိုင်ဆိုင် ကပြ ဖျော်‌ဖြေပေး
သေးသည်။ အလှူပွဲလှည့်လည်ရာမှာ အလှူကားတန်း၏
ရှေ့မှ လမ်းရှင်းပေးမည့် မော်တော်ဆိုင်ကယ်များမှ
မီးသတ်ဝတ်စုံ ဝတ်ဆင်ထားသူတို့က ဟန်ရေး
တကြွကြွ နေရာတကာ ဆရာကြီးများပါပေ့။
တနေ့က အိမ်သို့ နွေရာသီ ခြောက်သွေ့ကာလမို့
မီးအန္တရာယ်ကင်းစေရန် မီးသတ်များ လာရောက်
စစ်ဆေးသည်။ မီးသတ်ဝတ်စုံနဲ့ လူသုံးလေးဦး
အပြင် အရပ်ဝတ်များနှင့် လူအချို့လည်းပါဝင်သည်။
ထမင်းဟင်း ဘာနဲ့ ချက်သလဲဟု စစ်မေးပြီး
အိမ်ရှိ လူဦးရေစာရင်းပါ ကောက်ယူသည်။
ထိုအပြင် အိမ်ရှေ့မှာချထားသော ပုံဝါကြီးကို
မ ပြီး ဘာတွေထည့်ထားတာလဲဟု မေးသည်။
တူမက ဟိုဟာ ဟိုဒင်းဟု ဖြေဖို့ ခက်ခဲနေသည်။
ကျွန်တော် ရေပုံပါ သောင်ရေခပ်တဲ့ ရေပုံးဟု
ဖြေလိုက်ရသည်။ 


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmU6ZmgXj3rp8qU5knRhjsJajoCYXU5Pc6v8KdnQZr4Fbf/1775808642763.jpg)

> Good day everyone and welcome to another edition of my Daily Diary Game entry. Accept my warm greetings from my side of the globe. I hope everyone is doing great today.

I wokeup so easily and it was my **birthday,** that was around **2:am** when I wokeup to post my picture and to wish myself well. I slept back till it was **6:30am** when I wakeup finally to start preparing my day, had class by **10:am.**

Logging in to my social handles, friends and well wishers were already wishing me well, i was surprised that I was even wish well on our Champlaincy group, were all the members were wishing me well.

When it was **10:15am** I went to class, and reaching, my coursemate were wishing me, even people I didn't tell, I was surprised and thank Them, at the end of the class, that lasted from **10:am** to **12:noon.** The other class we should have next was cancelled.

Having one more lecture to attend, I went back to my lodge, to prepare my yellow MTN Rice since I didn't ate and left for first time. After cooking I served myself and have some rest. My next class will be starting by **2:00pm** which is almost time, I redress and zoom off to the venue.

>
The birthday boy in the morning and grabbing some breakfast

>
Me after the first class and at the last class

It lasted from **2:pm** till it was **4:pm** which after the class, I went outside the school gate to get what to prepare the next day, I have been while I ate soup and will be preparing sooner. After getting those things, I went back to my lodge, redress and went back to the school, where I can charge my phone before going back.

I stay there and charge up my phone till it was **9:00pm** before I was able to go back toy lodge not grab some dinner, after eating I went to bed but couldn't sleep, I engage in watching funny clips and replying those that wish me well. Till I slept off, see you guys in my next diarygame entry. Once more **HAPPY BELATED BIRTHDAY TO ME.**

body.title: Sakura in Ueno-Park -  Ukiyo-e Time 👹🍣🎎 Wonderful Japan ENG-GER
body.body: ![service-pnp-jpd-02100-02199v.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/23x1DAwMATricULiEHuwSiPEBbuoTQtY2LuaBEQeNGGSvEBH38VALSf6ExMRLKqHNowr4.jpg) Today, we're treating ourselves to another ukiyo-e picture. This Japanese art form reached its peak during the Edo period and was best known for its colorful woodblock prints and drawings, which are still very popular today. The Library of Congress has collected a large number of these woodblock prints and made them available in digital form on its [website](https://www.loc.gov/collections/japanese-fine-prints-pre-1915/about-this-collection/). Fortunately, these images are not subject to copyright, so I am able to share them with you from time to time here in this blog. [Today's woodblock print](https://www.loc.gov/resource/jpd.02199/) depicts groups of women enjoying hanami in Ueno Park—one of the most famous places for cherry blossom viewing in the Edo period. The scene dates from the late 1700s and was created by Katsukawa Shunzan, an artist of the early ukiyo-e school. The women wear magnificent kimonos and move through the blossoming cherry trees with a mixture of grace and everydayness. The composition emphasizes not only the beauty of nature, but also the social rituals and fashionable details of the time. Ueno was not only a place of relaxation, but also a reflection of social elegance. And that still applies today, because even now, Ueno Park is one of the most popular destinations during the sakura season. Although I probably have to admit that it must have been a little more peaceful and civilized there during the Edo period. In my opinion, Ueno Park is far too crowded these days and therefore inevitably too noisy and littered with trash to be able to enjoy the cherry blossoms in peace. As always, I wish I had a time machine that could take me back to times long past. The Japanese capital during the Edo period would be surely a place I would love to visit. But until then, let's look at these wonderful old works of art and keep dreaming... ![service-pnp-jpd-02100-02199v.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/23x1DAwMATricULiEHuwSiPEBbuoTQtY2LuaBEQeNGGSvEBH38VALSf6ExMRLKqHNowr4.jpg) DEUTSCH Heute gönnen wir uns mal wieder ein Ukiyo‑e Bild. Diese japanische Kunstform hatte ihren Höhepunkt in der Edo‑Zeit, und war vor allem durch ihre farbigen Holzschnitte und Zeichnungen bekannt, die sich auch heute noch großer Beliebtheit erfreuen. Die **Bücherei des Kongresses der Vereinigten Staaten von Amerika** hat eine große Anzahl dieser Holzschnittdrucke gesammelt und stellt sie auf ihrer [Webseite ](https://www.loc.gov/collections/japanese-fine-prints-pre-1915/about-this-collection/)in digitaler Form zur Verfügung. Und glücklicherweise unterliegen diese Bilder dort keinem Urheberrecht, so dass ich sie euch ab und zu hier in diesem Blog vorstellen darf. [Das heute Holzschnittbild](https://www.loc.gov/resource/jpd.02199/) zeigt Gruppen von Frauen beim Hanami im Ueno-Park – einem der berühmtesten Orte für Kirschblütenschauen im Edo-Zeitalter. Die Szene stammt aus der späten 1700er-Jahre und wurde von Katsukawa Shunzan gestaltet, einem Künstler der frühen Ukiyo-e-Schule. Die Frauen tragen prachtvolle Kimonos und bewegen sich durch die blühenden Kirschbäume mit einer Mischung aus Anmut und Alltag. Die Komposition betont nicht nur die Schönheit der Natur, sondern auch die sozialen Rituale und modischen Details der damaligen Zeit. Ueno war nicht nur ein Ort der Erholung, sondern auch ein Spiegel gesellschaftlicher Eleganz. Und das gilt auch noch für heute, denn auch in diesen Tagen ist der Ueno-Park eines der beliebtesten Ausflugsziele während der Sakura-Saison. Obwohl ich wahrscheinlich zugeben muss, dass es in der Edo-Zeit dort ein wenig geruhsamer und auch gesitteter zugegangen sein muss. Meiner Meinung ist der Ueno-Park heutzutage viel zu überlaufen und daher zwangsläufig viel zu laut und auch vermüllt, als das man sich dort in Ruhe die Kirschblüten ansehen könnte. Wie immer wünschte ich mir auch diesmal eine Zeitmaschine, welche mich in längst vergangene Zeiten bringt. Gerade die japanische Hauptstadt in der Edo-Zeit wäre ein Ort, den ich gerne einmal besuchen würde. Aber nun ja, bis es soweit ist, betrachten wir diesen wundervollen alten Kunstwerke und träumen dabei ein wenig.. ![blog-ende.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/23tv6H18WKn98nBVkn2MwVhwWsuFRFgjBGwxLEMVhRZD7zRRbFokaNiAn39fUaB3TxVX6.png)

body.title: Part Five of Bitcoin for the Young:  Your Magical Digital Fingerprint
body.body: #### In the old world of money, if you lost your bank card, you could call the bank, tell them your name, and they would give you a new one. But remember: **Bitcoin has no boss!** There is no \

to call. 

#### In the world of Bitcoin, **you are the boss of your own bank.** To keep your treasure safe, you use something called a **Private Key**.
#
 #
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmfRcmHnmFRaEakLq6swFCqYjK5c2kJtGwGXygKk5w9R3j/Gemini_Generated_Image_c45rhrc45rhrc45r.png 
#

### The Secret Code 🤫
A Private Key isn't a small metal key like the one for your front door. It’s a super-long, super-secret string of numbers and letters. Think of it as a **Magical Digital Fingerprint**. 

* **Your Public Address:** This is like your mailbox. Anyone can see it and drop a Bitcoin \

inside.
* **Your Private Key:** This is the only thing that can open the mailbox. 



### The Golden Rule: Your Key, Your Treasure 🏆
Because this key is your \

it gives you all the power. 
1.  **If you have the key:** You can move your Bitcoin anywhere in the world instantly.
2.  **If someone else gets your key:** They can take your Bitcoin! It’s like giving someone the combination to your diary—or your piggy bank.
3.  **If you LOSE your key:** This is the most important part. If the key is gone, the Bitcoin stays locked in its digital chest **forever**. Even the smartest computer in the world can't open it without that magical fingerprint.

### 🔍 Pro-Tip: The \
\nSince long strings of numbers are hard to remember, most people use a **Seed Phrase**. This is a list of 12 or 24 simple words (like *apple, mountain, bicycle, sun*). These words are the \
to your Private Key. \n\n**Never, ever share these words with anyone!** Not even a \

on the internet. If you keep them safe, your money is safe.

---

### 🎮 The \
Challenge\n1.  Take a piece of paper and write down a secret \

(like *SpaceTiger77*). 
2.  This is your **Private Key**. 
3.  Now, try to describe your Code Word to a partner **without saying it**. 
4.  If they can guess it, they \
your key! \n5.  If you hide the paper and forget the word, you \

your treasure.

**Real Bitcoin pros write their keys down on paper or metal and hide them in a very safe spot!** ---
**Next Level:** We know how to keep it safe, but where does new Bitcoin come from? Let's go on a **Digital Treasure Hunt!** ⛏️💎

body.title: The Life I Prayed For
body.body:
I was nine years old when I first told God exactly what I wanted.

I wasn't in church, nor was it any prayer meeting. It was just me and the silent desires of my heart, let out to God in quiet solitude in the backyard of our family house in Enugu.

I remember mouthing the words. _I want a better life. A big one. Outside all of this._

I was young and naive, yet I knew what I meant. I had seen enough of the suffering and struggling from my parents to know that the life I had around me had limits. So, even at that tender age, I craved better, with or without them.

I told nobody of my wish. I just carried it within me like that quiet burden you're not sure anyone else will understand.

* * *

Years later, after university I was lucky to land a job offer in Lagos. I was genuinely happy. I strongly believed that was it. The answer to my prayers I had been waiting long enough for. The beginning of a better life I had asked God for.

Honestly, my first few weeks in Lagos felt exactly like it. Like a dream come true. A huge amount hit my account in the name of salary, I had my own apartment - my own peace and safe space. My own keys, my own life, my own rules. I remember calling my mother that first weekend feeling like I had cracked something open. Like the life I wanted was finally within arm's reach.

Then gradually Lagos showed me its claws. It had a friendly face but with thorns set in your path to make you break.

If it wasn't me praying not to suffocate in the long traffic that swallowed hours of my day without apology. It would be my boss treating my weekends like an extension of the work week. Extra time upon extra time. The paperwork never got smaller no matter how early I arrived. The bills that were more faithful than every ex I've ever had. Then it crowned it all with tiredness that followed me home every day. It felt like I was working like an elephant but eating like an ant.

It dawned on me that that wasn't the life I had wished for as a kid. Even if it was - because of the pay, it was exhausting me. My dream life wasn't supposed to be with doubt

Slowly, quietly, I stopped believing the wishes were real. I believed they were something kids were made to believe to keep hope alive.

* * *

One dark evening I came back from work heavier than I had left in the morning. It was the accumulation of the weight of everything I had been carrying inside. A promotion that went to someone less qualified, an unexpected rent increase notice slipped under my door, and the constant phone call from home asking for money that I didn't have.

I slumped into my couch and beside me was this particular kind of hopelessness that doesn't announce itself loudly. It just sat there beside me in the silence.

I don't know how long I sat there. I could swear I slept off when a knock at my door woke me up.

I opened it to find Mama Chinedu holding a small bowl. The aroma smelled like pepper soup. She had made pepper soup. She said she had made too much and didn't want it to go to waste. I knew she lied. The excuse was too thin and the smile on her face confirmed it. She had intentionally added my share but just wanted to be modest about it. Also, I could sense she knew something was wrong with me. I hadn't knocked on her door when I came in. She just had a way of knowing things without being told.

She pushed me aside and stepped in, set the bowl down, and looked me in the face without saying anything for a while. I locked the door and stood beside her with my hands crossed.

\

she said finally. Like it was her apartment.

I sat obediently. She walked to my kitchen, came back with two tiny bowls, and served the pepper soup into the bowls and handed one to me. I took a sip, it was as always, delicious like I had known her cooking to be. Its warmth and spiciness alone gave me some comfort and soothing to my chest. I was really hungry.

\
she said, settling into the chair across from me. A bowl in her hands. \

I feigned ignorance.

She paused and gave me a no-nonsense look.

I didn't plan to say anything. But something about the way she sat there, not hurrying, demanding but just completely present made my mouth release the words

\

She listened. Nodding as each spoon of pepper soup entered her mouth. She didn't try to counter me with talks of her own problems. She just listened till I was done. Then she spoke.

\
She pointed her spoon gently in my direction. Swallowed hard \

I looked down at my pepper soup. My throat was tight. Mama Chinedu was at it again. A master at everything. I wondered why she didn't become a guidance counsellor.

We had the rest of the soup in silence. Watching 'Friends' a TV series we've come to fall in love with.

* * *

Three months later I got my admission letter to study abroad.

I remember sitting with it in my hands for a long time before it felt real. This was it. The outside I had been praying and wishing about at nine years old.

Maybe it isn't perfect yet. Maybe I was still going to deal with that cold stinging my bones. Maybe there are still going to be hard days and lonely evenings and moments where the distance from everyone I love feels very wide and makes me question myself. But when I think about the hectic Lagos I was leaving behind, the jumping on danfo buses, the endless exhaustion, the job that was consuming me faster than I was earning.

It might not be everything I dreamed of. But it is more than what I had. And sometimes more than what I had might be exactly where my dream begins and my wish comes to pass.

[Source](https://pixabay.com/photos/hands-body-woman-posture-hand-5037846/)

### Transportation Problems
There has been transportation problems in the country which is brought about by the current fuel crisis. Many drivers decided to stop with their operations due to high gas prices. Some of them claimed that they earn very small amount from driving since the fuel price hike. We cannot blame them because they feel the pain of the crisis. 
Many people also decided to rather stay at home because of the increase of fare. Hence, many businesses will be affected. Government can do something to de-escalate the situation. In other countries,  they suspended some taxes on gas to control the prices. Why can't our government do the same? Some politicians are saying that the government will lose huge amount of money if they do that? Seriously? People actually think politicians can't pocket money from the government with tax suspension. 

### Friday
My wife and I tried to be early today because we will support our deaf field service. We're the first ones to arrive in the meeting place. Our friend invited us for lunch, and it's a good one.

body.body:
https://youtu.be/gdsJ14wnbzQ?si=pl\_KWQA4fR0YUuer

Yesterday's \[Black Ivory\]([https://blackivory.org/](https://blackivory.org/)) Podcast. @ronthroop Ron Throop, \[Emma Pugmire\]([https://blackivory.org/emma-pugmire/](https://blackivory.org/emma-pugmire/)) and myself. Amongst other things, we talk about:

A new game: Guess the animal

Emma's next exhibition at Millden Art Society on May 2nd and a look at her most recent paintings.

Mike's road kill taxidermy

Three new \[Blond Card\]([https://edgeworth.blog/2026/03/03/blond-cards/](https://edgeworth.blog/2026/03/03/blond-cards/)) characters including @makwafilms

Flying all the way to the moon, only to fly back without landing

Emma going AWOL last week

MIT's art business course and the far superior information we're learning from @offgridlife

My new series of flag paintings, instructing people who don't read English how to get a free painting from \[my Camden Market art display\]([https://thecamdenmarketfreeartman.com/](https://thecamdenmarketfreeartman.com/)).

Episode 2 of \[The Johnstone Chats Podcast\]([https://edgeworth.blog/2026/02/12/the-johnstone-chats-podcast/](https://edgeworth.blog/2026/02/12/the-johnstone-chats-podcast/)) being a vast improvement on the first.

Giving art away on the bus

Ron's next \[Free Art Frees Art\]([https://freeartfreesart.com/](https://freeartfreesart.com/)) display in Rochester

How I did the wrong kind of work in Thailand, and how it means that I'm now having to play catch up by making hundreds of small paintings, and shelving most other work in the meantime.

body.title: Challenge #04849-M100: Stolen Mercy
body.body:
![nastia-petruk-8ki4p2s5kJQ-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/internutter/23tH1GGMM1dHKeJjWmjja8NAGoU7XBBvewnCJXs5Dhw7j8UWQhibtQEZqdWa3DuB2RmgY.jpg)

> Victoria Constance Emilia Stanford has become a goddess, enjoying her new form and her husband. Alas, it seems that some desperate folks from a drought stricken land would like to enjoy her powers, for they kidnap her from the shores in the dead of night whilst her husband and father in law slept.
> This is unlikely to end well for anyone involved…
> Sequel to: [https://peakd.com/fiction/@internutter/challenge-04815-m066-bride-of-the-son-of-the-volcano-god](https://peakd.com/fiction/@internutter/challenge-04815-m066-bride-of-the-son-of-the-volcano-god) -- [Deathshead419](https://internutter.org/bb/user/deathshead419)

There was a new goddess, though few in Arunem could pronounce her name. What they did know was that she could revitalise land devastated by disasters. They knew how to spot her from a distance. Skin the colour of marble. Hair that flowed down instead of curling up. And, of course, seedlings sprouted wherever she walked. She lived on the islands of Blessed-By-Maugamu, and all of Arunem had heard of how they prospered.

All of Arunem _needed_ her presence, and the Baushau tribe didn't want to go through any formalities. Their lands were burning-dry and their food plants were dying. Soon, the people would be dying. They landed in the night and made sure she slept with cloth soaked in dreamweed wine, so they could carry her away.

They made sure she was tied up and secure in their canoe before they launched to race to their homeland.

She woke up halfway through the following day, immediately outraged. Then she saw who had taken her. Not the men of the Baushau, but the _mothers_ of Baushau. One was a grandmother, but all of them were looking worried. Their arms never stopped working the paddles, though they took turns singing their fast-rowing song.

The milk-skinned goddess stilled her screaming and calmed her rage. She could _see_ that all the mothers of Baushau were stick-thin. They were all good mothers, making sure their children had their fill before they took the scraps for themselves.

She said in the gods-tongue that all could understand, \

Each of the six mothers didn't stop paddling until they reached the shores of Arunem, where they unbound the goddess _Vykoria_ and carried the canoe up the dry riverbed to their tribal lands. Though seedlings sprouted in her footsteps, they shriveled and died soon after she passed.

Nevertheless, it gave them hope. There _were_ seedlings in her footprints.

They reached the scorched village and the cracked ground that had been their fields, where the adults were starving worse than their children. But they were _all_ starving. Just as the goddess _Vykoria_ entered the Baushau holy spaces, the whole ground shook, and a dark cloud began to be seen from Blessed-By-Maugamu.

\

As sprouts rose and fell by her toes, she closed her eyes and spread her fingers. Her flowing hair spread around her as if she were underwater.

For a pace of time as the dark clouds spread across the sky, there was whispering in the air. Unseen forces moved the dust around.

Then _Vykoria_ settled back to her mortal form. \

The voice of command from a goddess sent them running before they understood _why_ they were running. The first lava bomb hit the neighbouring ocean and sent fish raining down on the ground. And the goddess Vykoria began to sing the songs of Blessed-By-Maugamu, adding the song she sang to her husband.

He had sent five bombs, which rained fish upon their houses and shook the earth. His father had sent the ash cloud to blot out their sun, and it settled down on their fields. Once Maugamu and Nalani heard her song, they stopped their godly revenge.

The villagers cooked the fish they knew, and were grateful for the feast. The canniest of their hunters followed _Vykoria's_ bidding, finding a fat goat in the mountains upstream. Only once the sacrifice went through, Mastorava allowed Intra to send the rains. Only _then_ could _Vykoria_ grow the seeds that the mothers sowed.

By the time the crops were flourishing, the demigod Nalani had sailed a canoe to the island and up the river to the lands of Baushau. He was steaming mad, but the grandmother came forward.

\
\n\n_Vykoria_ had been with those very children in the fields just seconds before. Now she put her marble-white hand gently on Nalani's dark basalt shoulder. She said, \
\n\nAnd since they had both been born, and had once been small, they remembered being scared. The burning of his eyes cooled. \

body.body:
Since I really enjoyed Helldivers 2, several people recommended that I should give Arc Raiders a try. 
The trailers and gameplay videos already looked pretty appealing to me, but I’m generally not a big fan of “soft PvP” or “optional PvP” — I much prefer knowing exactly who the enemy is from the start.
Because a friend of mine was also interested, we decided to pick it up together.
After a few hours of playtime, I can honestly say it’s been fun so far — even though it’s not exactly hilarious when you get shot by another player right at the extraction point ^^  
That said, I don’t really understand the comparison with Helldivers 2.
Sure, the third-person perspective is similar, but the actual gameplay feels very different to me.
Missions are usually much shorter, there’s way more loot to collect, the fights feel significantly more tactical (though that might change once we’ve upgraded our weapons), and there’s an insane amount of crafting involved — I’ll be honest, I still haven’t fully wrapped my head around the crafting system yet.
In short: I’m having fun with Arc Raiders, but I personally don’t see the strong connection to Helldivers 2 that others keep mentioning.

body.title: HivePostify Marketplace Just Got a Major Upgrade, New Categories, Cleaner UI & Real Growth Starting Now
body.body:
*Authored by @aftabirshad | Founder, HivePostify.cloud*



Seven months of building alone. Hundreds of hours without a team, funding, or anyone to share the load. Each week, this platform becomes more complete.

Today, I want to share where the HivePostify Marketplace stands, what has changed, and what is coming next. This community deserves a real update, not a polished announcement.



![hivepostify_marketplace_thumbnail](https://hivepostify.cloud/uploads/posts/41e7f9e5466a1fd80e57728d167f7786.webp)


---

## What Actually Changed: New Categories Are Live

When the HivePostify Marketplace launched, it started with the common categories every freelancing platform offers: web development, graphic design, content writing, and video editing. This was the foundation.

That foundation is now broader.

New service categories have been added. Sellers can now list gigs in areas that weren't available before, including fields relevant to the Pakistani digital workforce and the rising demand for Web3-native services. This is not the final expansion more specific categories will be added regularly as we learn what sellers need and what buyers are looking for.

The goal is to have 700+ active categories. We are moving toward this goal steadily, not all at once, because every added category should have real sellers behind it, not just empty placeholders.

---

## The UI Has Been Improved, And It Is Noticeable

The marketplace interface has been refined in this update. Browsing through categories is clearer. Seller profiles and gig pages are better organized. Navigation feels more natural than before.

These are not dramatic redesigns. They are careful, incremental improvements that make a platform enjoyable to use. The goal is simple: when someone visits the marketplace for the first time, the experience should feel trustworthy and easy to navigate, not confusing.

More UI improvements are on the way. Bugs are being fixed as they are discovered. The interface will continue to improve with each update.

---

## The Honest Part: Why There Are No Buyers Yet

I want to address something directly, which most platform updates would avoid.

The marketplace has sellers, gigs, working order management, payment in HIVE and AHPT, local withdrawal for Pakistani users, and a complete seller profile system.

What it lacks right now is a large buyer base. This is because we have not yet run targeted marketplace promotions.

So far, most of HivePostify's growth efforts have focused on bringing in new Hive users from Pakistan running Facebook ads, creating accounts, and building the community. Marketplace-specific promotion, which gets HivePostify in front of people actively looking to hire freelancers, has not started yet.

That is about to change.

We are planning dedicated promotion targeting buyers, not just creators. The goal is to attract real clients to the marketplace so that sellers with listed gigs can start receiving actual orders. As buyer traffic increases, seller earnings will grow, and the marketplace will become a true two-sided economy built on Hive.

This is not a promise for six months from now; it is our next active step.

---

## Why This Matters Beyond HivePostify

Every completed order on the HivePostify Marketplace brings external capital into the Hive ecosystem. A buyer pays in AHPT or HIVE. The seller earns, holds, and often powers up. The blockchain gains activity that did not originate within it.

Pakistan's freelancing economy is expected to reach five billion dollars by 2026. There is no other Web3 freelancing platform in Pakistan built on a public blockchain. HivePostify is the first.

Every added category opens another door. Every seller who lists a gig creates another incentive for buyers to come. Every completed order proves that this ecosystem can sustain real economic activity, not just content rewards.

---

## What Is Coming Next

- **More Categories**  specific categories will be added based on what Pakistani freelancers actually offer and what international buyers look for. The expansion is ongoing.

- **Marketplace Promotion**  buyer-focused advertising and outreach are starting. The marketplace is built. Now it needs to be discovered.

- **UI Continued Improvement**  bugs are being fixed, pages are being optimized, and the overall experience is becoming smoother with every update.

- **Witness Launch**  HivePostify will soon launch its own Hive witness node. A detailed technical post will come before the launch.

- **Expanded Withdrawal Options**  additional local payment methods beyond EasyPaisa, JazzCash, and Binance Pay are being explored so more users across Pakistan can access their earnings easily.

---

## For Sellers: Your Gig Is Already Ahead of the Curve

If you have already listed a gig on HivePostify, you are positioned before the buyer promotion begins. When traffic arrives, established sellers with complete profiles and clear gig descriptions will be the first found.

If you haven't listed yet, now is the time before the marketplace gets crowded.

The platform is live at **hivepostify.cloud/marketplace**

---

我们办公室班上来三天了还没水喝，每天没人来上班先买瓶水放桌上，哈哈哈，怪好玩的。之所以会这样，是因为我们茶水间还没布置好，也就是那些线还没弄好，饮水机，咖啡机，微波炉等等没法排线安装。

现在唯一有个冰箱，其他啥也没，搞的我们都没好带饭，这没微波炉没法加热。天天愁眉苦脸的，安装线路的人迟迟不来给我们搞，连网线都是搞个临时的猫勉强接上我们临时用着，要过几天才能来拉网线排线。

办公室同事都有怨言了，我其他还好，就是没水喝弄得我一肚子火，每天两瓶矿泉水，有时候要冲泡一下茶或者咖啡都不能，只能叫外卖。每天回家先喝一大杯水解口渴。

就是时间太短了，搬的东西又太多，所以没头没尾的，什么都安排不好，我们人事已经被我经理骂好几次了，可是骂他们有什么用，现在是别人拖着不给我们处理，所以说做什么事都要早点安排，比如搬公司这事就是，没个好的计划那就是浆糊一样。

我发现新工位还挺好的，没事抬头就能看看窗外风景，以前可不行。我办公室现在人不是多了嘛，有事没事还能聊几句，我经理不经常在他办公室，我们办公室就在他的办公室外间，所以有时候有点小“热闹”，嘿嘿。

body.body:
Climbing the Hidden Snow Region in the Woods of Hallan Mountain.




![Blue Beautiful Mountain And Sky Mood Board Photo Collage  Large.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmePUXmmMhHrifxo5o1QWCybBUEmsiuXA1ieJz7yy3pRbV/Blue%20Beautiful%20Mountain%20And%20Sky%20Mood%20Board%20Photo%20Collage%20%20Large.jpeg)

![IMG_7323.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmT5Fo9qNonstzJe5v7tYVK4zNk7459G87MqpLiQGC4eis/IMG_7323.jpeg)
Julley Everyone,


Starting this new adventure over here, followed by this beautiful new new adventure that I went on today in the Himalayas. It was literally a whole lot of a different experience that I had on when I was at this place and moreover capturing these photographs and enjoying the perfect Time of the year, the spring season over here in these unknown woods around Manali was truly something that I wanted to share it with you guys through this post, so in this post, I’m gonna take you guys along with me to the journey all the way where we made it to this hidden portion here in this mountain.

![IMG_7325.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQ8MRLX6eKqiLqpX87uKSSJRas232U5JGchype8aADeRD/IMG_7325.jpeg)
It was a sunny day out here today as the winter season almost got over around the place and a sunny day that would just lead me all the way to the higher mountains, but it was not the right time as of now as literally most of the high altitude mountain peaks, they were still covered with thick sheet of snow that would last for nearby few months, also almost the month of June, but still, I thought why not to give it and I just went all the way somewhere closer to more than 3400 m above the sea level altitude here in this mountain, unknown and hiking all the way through the woods and the forest just not to reach at this particular portion and out of nowhere I saw and I found that it was literally a whole lot of a different experience that I had on when I was at this place, my friends literally we were climbing the mountain all the way through this thick sheet of arranging more than 5 to 10 feet, even at certain point because it was the shaded portion of the forest where the sunny portion was usually were less.


![IMG_7326.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbF4gfzUNq9EKHL5wq4UCWbvbcXgNQusBjEFWoV1BGE84/IMG_7326.jpeg)
<center>*Here is a POV photograph of me walking over the frozen snow. The snow looked kind of dirty as it was now covered with multiple sheets and multiple Pineneedles, and also few of other things that just formed this pattern in this white snow all around the place.*</center>

![IMG_7327.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmP7h3zcsD7y375maiK9pPaQ3HBaVGx18QPkzXy78xzuYG/IMG_7327.jpeg)

# The Illusion.


![IMG_7330.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRV5WBVuw1yy4EqYZ5zFGRMu9Q61DUUmHiJRwuSSyUbUp/IMG_7330.jpeg)
Calling it the illusion, because when we were just walking across the place and walking beyond and reaching a higher altitude location, it was the kind of illusion that we got through, because there was the snow that exactly looked like the grass looked like the land nearby, but truly it was once we just walked over it also at certain points it was beyond that also so much snow. 

![IMG_7329.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmd83YJWd6oiW3cXudAmZYa4GzRSunFZ5y36mVQTs6xScB/IMG_7329.jpeg)
And what we did was like we along with the stick, decided to figure out that where the snow was hard so that we can climb up and reach somewhere at a portion where we can relax as just standing here in this much snow, without even having the snow boots or any other mountain gear, it was a risky task around the place so rather than we decided to just go further and further around the place.



![IMG_7328.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmP9CgoUBfiqKjbeGr4RJZW8TWzeEqxdfJe4qgoma3aVJX/IMG_7328.jpeg)
<center>***Making our way through the snow.***</center>


![IMG_7331.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdK77w8czuhxZWD3mNeRHCYYXzm7LfG4SNTh81QVcAXqD/IMG_7331.jpeg)
This particular portion was somewhere. I would say the most adventurous portion of our whole journey. As now we had to just make all our way all the way through this frozen Snow, and at certain point, the snow was also not that much frozen, but still, it was soft that led us to just go and just fell in the snow rather than what we were deciding to just walk over it, but truly my friend literally enjoyed this whole beautiful moment all around the place now captured these photographs and now sharing it with you guys through this post.



# Feet and feet of snow.

![IMG_7333.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbGxGjrvzCG97MBPmLLCrS7jUtpPHDSPFZBvTsakcweaS/IMG_7333.jpeg)
After crossing the first page, we reached at this particular portion and my friends. I was so amazed to see that there was a lot of snow over here, especially at this particular portion in the mountain, as you guys can also see that how much snow was here at this place, it was quite a lot, my friends.


![IMG_7335.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQvKQAWJNUh5eH8j2LS6BkzrC2RnS7dDeRxyv3wx9Viat/IMG_7335.jpeg)
***Just because that the portion experience less shade as compared to, it usually used to be so it was the particular moment around that made this place the snow paradise and also made us experience the extreme winter season over here in the Himalayas.***


![IMG_7336.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmamnSfxWSGfvm9SKyPgwvExbbqgnPCKpyxPfmKVEdouPC/IMG_7336.jpeg)
***Here are few of the photographs that I captured around the place in different perspective and different angles so that you guys could also experience the hidden beauty from these potions around the Himalayas. Do let me know my friends, the photographs or the part of my adventure like the most in the comment section, and I would love to hear it from you.***

links.title: Are we financially responsible to other people's needs// Mcgi topic review
links.body:
The bible teaches us to always care for one another but it doesn't mean we should put their burden upon us. God calls us to show kindness, generosity, and compassion, helping where we can with a willing heart. Supporting others in difficult times reflects love and unity among believers, but it should come from wisdom, not pressure or obligation.

At the same time, the Bible also encourages personal responsibility. Each person is expected to manage their own life and resources faithfully. While it is good to help others, it is not right to enable laziness or ongoing dependence. Helping should lift people up, not keep them stuck, and it should be done in a way that honors God and promotes growth.
https://youtu.be/aHC7rhMHhZc?si=1Liekg7hSDX_usgn
Christians are called to give when led by love, guided by wisdom, and within their ability. We are not required to pay every bill for others, but we are encouraged to be generous and supportive when there is genuine need. True biblical financial responsibility is about both caring for others and being faithful stewards of what God has given us.

links.title: The story of a strong Mom (Introductory Post)
links.body:
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/choiscxel01/23vi3sJPZcQfiN1ufxzHZ1qzjJ8Vi5yGLdttUFqSzjts5m7CAGecYrPzCs9JgFXrvEvQQ.png)
Hello Everyone, my name is Josce Trillanes, but you can call me Jo. I am a full time mom with my one and only son at the same time wearing other hats as a Virtual Assistant and aspiring ESL Teacher and now a Hive Blog writer.

When I became a mother, It changed my perspective on many things. Being a mom thought me a lot, how to be patience and how to be strong during difficult days.

Being a mom of this little cutie (my son) my priorities changed. All I wanted is to give my time, love and effort every single day. 

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/choiscxel01/23wqyUHCQGXzU73oVybpUKqPq7dkysDrXbsTbuHGXoNw4urFfQ3u1tESxPk6x31uErroT.png)

I give up my growing career in corporate job. I resigned as a Purchasing Supervisor where I spent over 13 years working on my career from administrative staff to Supervisory roles in a private company.
I learned how important organization, communication and dedication are in any job.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/choiscxel01/23y98YqZ3Cvx9enasge3PbG8dLGH3inf7TJNza6bjAGpzsuDtzCR5a7VjkwJsp4GR4QBX.png)
Working in that environment helped me develop valuable skills such as multitasking, problem-solving, and and attention to detail. I always believe in giving my best in every responsibility given to me because hard work and consistency are things I truly value.

All mother wanted to be present for their family all the time, my focus shifted on taking care of my family. But I realize being a mother doesn’t mean putting my dreams on hold. It means finding smart ways to secure my family’s future while still enjoying the life we’re working hard to build.

That’s when I started exploring the remote work.  I discovered the role of a Virtual Assistant. I attended several trainings on how to become a Virrtual Assitant then luckily I got a client even if it is a part time only. 

![image.png](5)

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/choiscxel01/23zkzwt9xobxKrJC8a2iHHA59RNGsM7hCgsYmqvqxhvYuzcdzZ1FYrjaYBu4eb7aoqGfk.png)

At the same time, I am now an aspiring ESL Teacher, I have a ongoing training to develop my teaching skills.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/choiscxel01/23zSFqkgUxGfcbReoLEhww4hTEfMKEVDUJrdvZNQrYowwoYkgVssLBuLcwqpHgxstcj6p.png)

Right now, I”m not just a mother, I consider myself a work in progress, someone who is continously learning, improving and growing. 

I was onboarded by Maam @antonette , she guided me step by step of my journey here on Hive. She explained how things work, and encouraged me to share my thoughts and experiences through this platform.

I am fully understand that the usage of AI in posting on this platform is strictly prohibited and plagiarism is not allowed in Hive. I also understand the importance of proper and quality engagement.

I joined hive because it allows me to express and share my story freely while connecting with a supportive community. Through posting on this platform I can share pieces of my life, the lesson I learned along the way, and the journey I’m currently taking as a mom who still chasing my dream even if I’m still at home taking care of my family.

Thank you for taking time to read my introduction. I’m excited to connect with different story and different people here on Hive.

Photos are mine and edited thru Canva.

links.title: Owning Your Mistakes.
links.body:
>


Admitting your mistake is one thing that sounds simple to the ears, but believe me, it's not all that simple at all, because nobody like to say that they are wrong about something, nobody wants to sit and say \

because it bruises ones ego, but here's the truth,  admitting your mistake is way better than just trying to shift the blame to another person, yea for one, blaming others can feels like a easy escape in that moment, but the thing is that it actually doesn't solve anything at all, thats something that one should know, because when you are blaming others , it simply means you are shifting responsibility that's you are avoiding it, but deep down you still know the truth.



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZqNcmvRo9VM8DYE5DGfACEzf1s1wQcPVmodFajdVGfYV/1775807040541.jpg)

Such a thing can weigh you down in ways you won't even be able to explain, why? Because you didn't handle the suitation in a proper way, on the other hand when you admit your mistakes, it is like you are removing a big weight off your head, you face it and deal with it head on.


Another thing is in the ascept of growth, if you always do not admit your mistakes , I wonder how you would learn? Seriously, mistakes are part of life, nobody gets everything right all the time, the people who grow the most are those who can say bodily that \

and blaming others actually blocks that path, it keeps you stuck instead of learning you are trying to defend yourself. Now when it comes to relationships or teamwork, accountability is a big deal, Trust is not something you just demand, it is something you build over time and one of the fastest ways to lose trust is by refusing to take responsibility for your actions, imagine working with someone who always blames others whenever something goes wrong, it would be frustrating, yeah? and you would start feeling like they are not reliable or honest, but when someone owns up to their mistakes , it builds respect, and it makes people see you as trustworthy, it actually shows that you can be trustworthy,that you are matured enough to handle your actions,in a team , this your action makes everything smoother, people can rely on each other, and communicate better and fix whatever without any big drama or stuff. Even in friendships or personal relationships, accountability matters a lot, if you hurt someone and instead of apologizing, you start giving excuses or blaming them, it only makes things worse, but when you say, “I’m sorry, I was wrong,” it can go a long way in healing alot of things, It shows that you value the relationship more than your own pride, at the end of the day, everyone makes mistakes, nobody is perfect, that's just what being human is, but what matters is how we are handle those mistakes, how we admit , because they don't make you weak , instead of pointing fingers it is better to take a step back , own your actions and learn from them. [Image Credit](https://unsplash.com/photos/mistake-text-u_3rD02dmkw) *** ---

links.title: 3D Printed Voronoi Style Charizard!
links.body:
A weekee-greeting to all Hivers!! Today I was contemplating models in the Maker World 3D printing website and fell in love with this masterpiece, this Voronoi-style Charizard sculpture [over here](https://makerworld.com/en/models/2341297-charizard-elemental-voronoi-art-edition#profileId-2573350).

![Charizard.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anima-shot/23vhny4awtQzALhdNEahCxoEymN7EJnmZcUG9WGMoh9HVd47HAdCWPerMiZuSThB9Xb1o.png)

It was made by the so talented [Clean Studio](https://makerworld.com/en/@RelaxBro) who have created many other Pokemon in this sculpting style as well, really true artists, they deserve a lot of support <3 
As a Pokemon fan and as a Charmander trainer every single time, I obviously wanted this beauty in my bedroom hehe >:D

![DSC_0285.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anima-shot/23yJAJ2Qg5Afj8BYXe86CZwuK4JRiW3udTirPeJAXfQEmTMjWErLmmZg76opz5b9Mrin8.JPG)


It told me it was going to take 8 hours, using 0.12mm layer height for good quality.

![DSC_0289.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anima-shot/23xATpE96nej8qF9dQBZ1D4urPWL9wkPXik7WX5DKTrBqReJbtw3XL88cmqzW1n6Fq5cf.JPG)

So I patiently waited as it emerged from the plate.

![DSC_0291.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anima-shot/23vi2A7DHoTh9krHr396zSYMZi1it9sGa4fS5nfjQKg9cBh4pAL4rxDVhb78KabKx9RDn.JPG)

Went to check and take a pic every once in a while.

![DSC_0292.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anima-shot/23y8onVECX6diUv9Lb8imDocB5xLGkrMPrqKWb9CR3SVQ1C1XPGxPuB9j4rQaK9ftLSkB.JPG)

I was home alone that day and there wasn't noise at all inside the apartment, just me vibing to some music while working at the pc.

![DSC_0295.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anima-shot/23wC7dUjhRRZXMCJcvGPMQNEHFwfZVz3urKuXXUGZd3aLPwZRtqtwWEdZc2jnvGsLndW9.JPG)

Suddenly, I heard a crack 8 meters away.

![DSC_0298.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anima-shot/23z7DYz7kMouGD6HxKPV4SXKXNm1NdKD2m2cJacJjstSSGkaKLjn2y6KPTrtdDF9nsy2k.JPG)

I sprinted all the way to the terrace to check the print. It was at 66%... the whole head support just broke apart, it was drifting away and rolling sideways on the plate T-T
As a reaction, I emitted the total opposite of a disarming voice (Pokemon reference yea) but in a scream way. Neighbors probably worried.

I had a new mission now: to save the print. My first attempt was to stick the support with superglue to the part of the other support it was hanging previously from. For 30 minutes it stood afloat without issues, I considered myself a superhuman until the headtool kicked it out again, this time broke it even more...

![DSC_0300.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anima-shot/Eoc6aaSydUGoceXDRnX9mrjm9Tmc4fmtTcTSUd4p3CBLiMJuxa7Zcmi6GTfZVHDtyxf.JPG)

I didn't want to throw that away, it was a worthy amount of grams...
I stopped the print and started thinking of a way to solve everything.

I shamefully looked at the layer number in the screen.
It read layer 529 out of 862.
Layer 529...

![DSC_0304.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anima-shot/23wqkRWfhbGXNeCYLFUWm9eFQ6kPALwPc4C9tkBtrkcwzuc82yLxjNvFynyS4oip753L1.JPG)

My brain clicked 💡!
I took a pic with the camera and sprinted all the way to my bedroom to check the project. I cut the model in two pieces exactly on that layer. It had some floating parts that it didn't get to be printed as you see, aside from the head and most of the wings.

![charizard top.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anima-shot/23tSL9L8JxzPHeLso1jGoqugbvyfsynHwymhfKEi7hQCsYa4KrcwrsNADCr1wqxouQ28Y.png)

Here is all of the support wasted material... it was more than the print itself tbh

![DSC_0307.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anima-shot/23vsLSQHsRnRzcMav22ryby91gcQuWTn86i8goPxewHpFeHg9vq2GQFAgnZYQSrBji1V6.JPG)

The probability of failure here was low, but despite everything it wasn't zero. The small parts were too uncomfortable to stick in the wings and one wing tip broke because of another drifted support...

![DSC_0309.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anima-shot/23tSUWnu8ma4Buaozrxizbds96ZzwDGBEZxsK3U8RMjRiRa6bQ4CTdgZXHWK1Lebz793Y.JPG)

![DSC_0312.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anima-shot/23uQpZoRmsXUkTsAUJQnchy9E6eX3nMue6xu8SM2f9KVT8LmHwKFowef2Mp3S4QAnZ4zn.JPG)

Definitely not my day, nor my printer's either. But the cut was perfectly done, and the wing thing didn't end up as a bigger problem. I sticked the big parts and...

![DSC_0313.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anima-shot/23tbs3vYiF6nFgJ99WmzHDKdUpBxKGiFz1AXwxSxsvL4SHX2nBSBFPsw76QNdtJaXkEwk.JPG)

... Ta-da! Looking almost seamlessly :3

![DSC_0318.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anima-shot/23tvkx3ErfZLA5ybqp6fQ2QjnVJZe2faGCHHbvDoQ57gmuyUkwvf6w7SpGTwJ7e1ADXQK.JPG)

I was really happy I managed to save it after all that trouble! I know this will become a normal thing in the future but I wanted to share this experience anyways, bet I was not the only one who got super excited to manage to save a print this way xD

![DSC_0321.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anima-shot/23w2j3peGZgVELmyb3oZJcoa2yU3hQhmyRRo9QQ1g5otG2V9Q6PX8wKgmQZnknJs4QaE8.JPG)

Happy also to have found some 3D printing communities here on Hive, thanks to @cherokee4life for recommendations!
Hope to read from you soon and to share more of my kinda newbie experiences with this!

___

<center><sub>*All pictures belong to me.*</sub></center>

![weekee goodbye.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anima-shot/23tRrDKLVs1KiTbrht6vqYHNaM4DQrtwzreJY3MHkbQo7CND1hxpCZCVKkNQtLts4T9j1.gif)

links.title: Is God Limited. MCGI TOPIC REVIEW
links.body:
https://youtu.be/yareRqkUYlU?si=b_vunIjBriWuRqMD
God is not limited with our limitations. We cannot make God limited because we ourselves are limited. He is the unlimited one. What do you understand by The Almighty God. The Almighty means that God has the power to do all things. There is nothing which God cannot do. God is omnipotent. Omnipotent means that He is all powerful. He has the power to do all things. So, we should not evaluate God using ourselves. Our God has all the power; He has all the ability. He sees what we do not see. He knows what we do not know. He is able for everything.

We are limited. How can you not accept that we are limited? The creator is always superior to the creature. We are the creatures of God. God made us. So, we cannot in anyway be the same as our Creator. Our Creator is superior to us. He controls what we don't even see. He understands us more than we understand ourselves. There is no other one whose power and ability equals that of our God.

Because we have come to understand that we have limitations, it is wise that we turn to God for our every need. God is self-sufficient but we are deficient in many ways. Trusting God with our lives will be the right thing for us to do.

links.title: Beneath Calm Waters
links.body: > In an almost cinematic scene, the clouds were slowly moving through the dark and blueish sky. The weather is clear to the extent that it feels un-natural. Standing on the shores, looking at the small part of the sea that divides the town in two halves. The half where everyone is at. And the other unknown half with hills all over the place, and people from a different culture that we only know little of. The distance is not far. But, there are so many stories about this sea. Standing next to the most recent broken boat, looking across to the other half. Wondering, could it be true? Could it be true what is said about this sea? There is something creepy that probably hides beneath the calm sea waters. It remains unanswered and unsolved riddle. So much of darkness is hidden within the beauty of this place. The last of the brave men had given up on crossing the sea. Leaving the rest of the people in town with questions about the place. Just like so many things around them. Maybe, only time will tell and one day will uncover all of this mystery. # PT

>

Em uma cena quase cinematográfica, as nuvens moviam-se lentamente pelo céu escuro e azulado. O tempo estava tão claro que parecia antinatural. De pé na margem, observando a pequena porção de mar que dividia a cidade em duas metades. A metade onde todos estavam. E a outra metade desconhecida, com colinas por toda parte e pessoas de uma cultura diferente, da qual pouco sabíamos. A distância não era grande. Mas havia tantas histórias sobre esse mar.

Parado ao lado do barco quebrado mais recente, olhando para a outra metade, me perguntava: será verdade? Será que tudo o que dizem sobre esse mar é verdade? Algo sinistro provavelmente se escondia sob as águas calmas. Permanece um enigma sem resposta e sem solução. Tanta escuridão se esconde por trás da beleza deste lugar. O último dos bravos homens desistiu de atravessar o mar, deixando o resto dos habitantes da cidade com perguntas sobre o lugar, assim como sobre tantas outras coisas ao seu redor. Talvez, só o tempo dirá e um dia desvendará todo esse mistério.

links.title: My Hard Work Should Not Go to Waste — So Let Me Be Completely Honest With You
links.body:
Something has been bothering me for weeks, and I have decided to stop staying quiet about it.


![hivepostify](https://hivepostify.cloud/uploads/posts/057dade6c824458832f229cff29de0ad.webp)



There is a conversation in this community about HivePostify. People are asking why the platform takes a 10% cut from posts. Some are frustrated. Some feel they were not informed enough. A few comments have been hard to read.
All these reactions are fair. They are my responsibility, not because the cut is wrong, but because I didn’t explain it clearly from the start.
That changes today.
I will tell you where that 10% goes. I will explain what it costs to run this platform. I will share what I have personally spent to keep it going. I will also make a public promise about what will happen with the 10% if this community gives HivePostify a real chance to grow.

No vague promises. No deflection. Just the full picture.



## Who Is Actually Behind This Platform

My name is Aftab Irshad. I am 16 years old. I am a college student from Sargodha, Pakistan.

I have no business partner, no development team, no angel investor, no support from the Decentralised Hive Fund, and no one to call when something breaks at midnight.

I started building HivePostify about seven months ago. I worked during school breaks, after classes, on weekends, and during every quiet moment in a busy schedule. Half of my school life and the start of my college years have gone into this project. That’s not a complaint, just context.

Today, HivePostify.cloud is a fully functional Web3 social and freelancing platform built entirely on Hive. It features a freelancing marketplace, Hive Keychain integration, local withdrawals for Pakistani users through EasyPaisa and JazzCash, a microblogging feature called Zopiq, a human verification system, a community poll system, self-hosted image storage, saved posts, a referral program, and an explore page that anyone can use without creating an account.

I built every single one of those features by myself. I didn’t use templates or no-code tools. It took hundreds of hours that most people never see.



## The 10% Beneficiary: The Honest Breakdown

When you post through HivePostify.cloud, 10% of your post rewards go to the HivePostify (@postify)  account as a beneficiary.
I understand that this number seems high. It is significant, and you deserve to know what it funds.
### The Server Does Not Run on Belief

HivePostify runs on a VPS server. The domain registration and hosting cost between **$4 and $15 every month**. That bill comes due regardless of how the platform performs.

I am a 16-year-old student with no income. I have been paying this from my personal savings money that was meant for other things. It has run out faster than I expected, but I have found ways to stretch it because I don't want to let the platform go offline.

There are no ads on HivePostify. There is no subscription model. There are no premium features to unlock. There are no investors backing the costs. The 10% beneficiary is the **only revenue source this platform has ever had**. Without it, the server will shut down in weeks, and everything users have built here will disappear.

### Free Account Creation for Real People Who Cannot Afford It

Creating a Hive account costs 3 HIVE tokens. For someone in Pakistan who has never earned a single rupee on this blockchain, that is not a small amount to spend before seeing any return. It makes sense for them to think: let me earn something first, then I’ll invest in joining properly. That’s how every major platform works.

HivePostify removes that barrier. We create accounts for new users at no cost to them. The 3 HIVE fee comes from our own funds, which are supported by the beneficiary.

Every account you can verify at **@hivepostify** on-chain is a real person who joined the Hive blockchain for free because this platform covered the cost. These are not test accounts or bots. These are real people from Pakistan who responded to an ad, got curious about Web3, and took their first step because we removed the financial barrier.

We receive daily account requests. People message us through WhatsApp and on the platform asking how to join. When our account claim credits run out which happens regularly given the volume of requests those people are put on hold. Some wait, but most don’t. They lose interest, move on, and never come back. The 10% beneficiary is what allows us to keep that pipeline open.

### Development Has No Off Switch

Every feature on HivePostify was developed without a budget. There were no licensed development tools, paid APIs, or design subscriptions. There was no team to share the workload.

The beneficiary covers the ongoing reality of keeping the platform running. It supports fixing unexpected bugs, maintaining server uptime, improving features based on user feedback, and building new things on top of what already exists. When something breaks at 2 AM, I fix it. When I need to build a new feature during a college break, I do it. The 10% does not pay me a salary; it keeps the platform functional so I can continue my work.



## Why I Did Not Explain This From the Beginning

This is the hardest part to write.

When I launched HivePostify, I was so focused on building features and bringing in users that I didn’t step back to think about how the beneficiary would look to someone new to the platform.

I assumed people would ask questions if they were curious. I assumed the on-chain transparency would speak for itself. I thought the visible work the accounts being created, the features being added, the ads running  would make the reasoning clear without me having to spell it out.

That was a mistake, and it recently became impossible to ignore.

A new user joined through HivePostify. They wrote their first post and were excited. Then someone commented about the beneficiary without explaining what it funds or why it exists. That user felt misled. They reached out feeling like something had been hidden from them.

That moment was a wake-up call. Not because the criticism was unfair, but because someone who joined this platform in good faith had a negative experience due to my lack of clear communication. That’s not the platform I want to run, and it’s not how I want users to feel when they publish their first post on Hive.

From now on, every new user who signs up through HivePostify will see a clear explanation of the 10% beneficiary before they publish anything. They will understand what it is, what it supports, and why it exists before any tokens leave their account. This change is happening now.

## My Commitment: What Happens If This Community Supports a DHF Proposal

I want to speak openly about this. Avoiding the issue would feel misleading. 

The 10% beneficiary exists because I have no other way to keep this platform running. I don't prefer it. I wouldn't choose this model if I had other options. It's the only approach I have found that allows HivePostify to survive each month while I keep building. 

If the Decentralised Hive Fund approves a proposal for HivePostify, the beneficiary will be completely removed. Not reduced. Not restructured. Removed. Every user who posts through HivePostify will keep 100% of their post rewards. The platform stays active. The server remains online. Development continues. The community fund covers the running costs instead of taking from individual post earnings. 

This is the outcome I am working toward. It’s not about putting DHF money in my pocket it isn’t but it is the only way I see to eliminate the beneficiary and continue building this platform long-term. 

I make this commitment here, publicly, permanently, and without conditions. If DHF funding arrives, the 10% ends. That’s it.

## What Seven Months + of Solo Development Actually Looks Like

I want to show you everything that exists on this platform today. Many who have criticized HivePostify have not looked at what has been built. 

The complete Hive frontend allows users to post, vote, comment, follow, and manage their accounts on all devices. The interface feels like a mobile-native app rather than a desktop tool awkwardly resized for smaller screens. 

Hive Keychain integration ensures that each transaction posting, voting, tipping, transferring, powering up, delegating, claiming rewards is signed through Keychain. Private keys are never sent to our servers. They are not stored or seen. 

The Web3 freelancing marketplace allows users to create seller profiles, list services in over 700 categories, receive orders directly through the platform, and get paid in HIVE tokens and AHPT. Full order management, revision requests, delivery confirmation, and earnings tracking occur inside HivePostify. This is live today. 

Local withdrawal for Pakistani users means they can send earnings directly to EasyPaisa, JazzCash, or Binance Pay ID. No international bank account needed. No complicated crypto-to-fiat process. Users earn on Hive and withdraw in rupees through an app they already have on their phones. 

Zopiq is a short-form microblogging feature built natively on Hive. It is designed for creators who prefer platforms that prioritize quick, casual content. 

The self-hosted image system replaced our previous reliance on third-party image hosts. Every image uploaded through HivePostify is stored on our servers, automatically compressed to WebP format, and served from our infrastructure. Pages load faster and images don’t disappear when external services have problems. 

The saved posts feature gives every user a personal reading shelf at hivepostify.cloud/saved. Bookmark any post with one tap and return to it whenever you want. 

The community poll system allows post authors to create polls that collect votes through comments. Accounts with a reputation below negative four are automatically excluded, which keeps spam out of the results without needing manual moderation. 

The referral and earn program pays $0.12 to anyone who successfully refers another creator to the platform. This creates a self-sustaining acquisition loop where existing users have a direct financial incentive to bring in new ones. 

The human verification system asks users to write their information on a physical card, hold it clearly in a photo showing their face, and publish that photo on Hive with the hashtag #IntroduceYourself. Once reviewed, their profile receives the Verified badge. This is how we keep the community genuine. 

The explore page at hivepostify.cloud/explore displays more than 32,000 published articles from creators worldwide for any visitor, whether or not they have an account. The login wall that drives many new visitors away before they understand a platform is gone. 

Hive proposal integration allows users to access all active proposals, vote on them through Keychain, and submit their own proposals directly from HivePostify. 

All of this was built by one person during college breaks, without a team, without funding, and with no help when things broke. 

## The Real Cost of What I Have Been Doing

Over the past few months, I have run paid Facebook ad campaigns targeting Pakistani users who had never heard of Hive. Those campaigns generated over 50,000 impressions and reached more than 30,000 people across Pakistan. 

I paid for those ads myself. 

I have also covered server costs, domain fees, and account claim credits from my personal savings during a time when the platform was making almost nothing in return. 

I mention this not to seek sympathy. I share this to show the full picture when someone suggests that the 10% beneficiary is extractive or opportunistic. The beneficiary has not come close to covering what I have personally invested in bringing new users to this blockchain. 

## A Note on Criticism 

I welcome criticism of HivePostify. I truly do. 
This platform exists in a public blockchain ecosystem where transparency is essential. Any concern about how the beneficiary is used, any question about on-chain activity, or doubt about whether the platform does what it claims should receive a real answer. I will always provide one. 

What I ask in return is that judgment be based on what is actually present. Not on assumptions. Not on a single comment in a thread. Look at the platform itself, the verifiable on-chain history at @hivepostify, and the features that are live and functioning today. 
First, take a look. Then make your decision. 

## How to Support What We Are Building 

Delegate HP to @hivepostify. Delegations are redistributed to verified new users posting original content. Even 5 HP can change a new creator's first week on Hive signaling that someone noticed their work and that it is worth continuing. 

Vote this post. Rewards will go directly toward server costs and account claim credits for incoming Pakistani users. 

Support a DHF proposal when it comes. It is the only way to completely eliminate the beneficiary and ensure that every HivePostify user keeps 100% of their post earnings. 

Share the platform with creators, writers, and freelancers in your network. Growth is the strongest argument for everything else. 

Platform: hivepostify.cloud  
Explore: hivepostify.cloud/explore  
On-chain: @hivepostify  

## One Last Thing

I want to be honest about something I have not said publicly before.
The recent comments I have received, questioning my intentions, dismissing what I have built, and treating this project as suspicious, have been harder to read than I expected. I am 16 years old. I built this alone. Some of those words hit in ways that are hard to describe without sounding dramatic.
I am not writing this to make anyone feel guilty. I am writing it because it is true.
If this community continues to ignore what HivePostify has built, if the server costs become impossible to cover and support never comes, there may come a day when I have no choice but to write a post titled **\

**
I do not want to write that post. I truly do not.
Almost every post I have ever written on this blockchain is in the HiveDevs community. I have never chased photography rewards or lifestyle votes. I came here to build something real, and I stayed because I believed this community valued real builders.
I will keep trying. I will not give up easily. I will push as far as I can go.

But I want you to remember this paragraph the day that post appears  if it ever does  because it will not come from giving up. It will come from having nothing left to give.

My only wish is that the work I put into this does not go to waste.

# I love #Pakistan


Posted Via HivePostify.cloud Pakistan's First Web3 Social and Freelancing Platform

> Hello, everyone. It’s been a while since I’ve shared any figures with the community. Well, today I’d like to show you a cute little figure I made of Ermo, the evolution of the charming character named Ermy, whom I’d created before. I hope you enjoy this tutorial—join me in the creative process behind this charming character! >># Español >>Saludos amigos. Hace un buen tiempo que no compartía figuritas con la comunidad. Pues bien, hoy me gustaría mostrarles una bonita figurita que hice de Ermo, la evolución del encantador personaje llamado Ermy, al cual ya había hecho antes. >> >>Espero que sea de su agrado este tutorial, acompáñenme en el proceso creativo de tan encantador personaje! ![DIY Ermo Sculpture @GaboAMC2393_20260410_011212_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gaboamc2393/23wCShEWf3AJS54PQviJqVKupfLGxA4BAyBxAkcg1AHqFqAe42BkSbLafqReFRjtny2L5.png) # Materials To make this figurine, I used the following materials: * Modeling clay * Glue * Wire I started by shaping a single white piece for Ermo’s body—an elongated, peanut-shaped piece with the head already formed, without any separate parts. >># Materiales >> >>Para hacer esta figurita usé los siguientes materiales: >>* Plastilina >>* Pegamento >>* Alambre >> >>Comencé haciendo una pieza completa de color blanco para el cuerpo de Ermo, una pieza alargada similar a un maní con su cabecita ya hecha, sin piezas separadas. ![IMG_20260409_205827.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gaboamc2393/23tvY1ProgoTZGayQYXFyXNuPZ1KRrmTCCirwTPXKQnpVcJpLZF5HvVh6y9WLFr29J219.jpg) I went on to make two white cylinders, like the ones you see in the image on the left. Then I used blue modeling clay to make the tip of the tail and added a few lines to simulate fur. Then I rolled them up, as you can see in the image on the right. >>Continué haciendo dos cilindros de color blanco, como los que ven en la imagen de la izquierda. Luego usé plastilina de color azul para hacer la punta de la cola y le hice unas cuantas líneas para simular pelaje. Luego los enrollé, tal como ven en la imagen de la derecha. |![IMG_20260409_205831.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gaboamc2393/23tbRLUCtQDyKPWKrGNqDGUooSbaRW3j6v5LH5N9S42kKZpvyk5YGhjaRuhbC4fSA9ySy.jpg)|![IMG_20260409_210742.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gaboamc2393/23tbnYDnVxYXss4uyZ1rqNpppetRXAKespVoXFBB6xKA7v5He57P31ZgndJV6shGGutpb.jpg)| |-|-| After finishing the outline, I continued working on the details of Ermo’s face, adding his little mustache, nose, eyes, and the two blue dots on his forehead. I also drew his little ears, as you can see in the image below. >>Después de hacer la cola, continué con los detalles del rostro de Ermo, en donde coloqué los bigotitos, la nariz, los ojos y los dos puntitos azules que tiene en la frente. Además de esto, le hice las orejitas, nuevamente como ven en la imagen de abajo. ![IMG_20260409_211846.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gaboamc2393/23uFKdaJ3xF1GYh5BPi9jfzRiHmgGbCofqv4VtGYTrsHEnZEyhNCZduiqs1GBq8A5Pkme.jpg) I continued with the legs, which I also made out of white modeling clay, making the hind legs larger than the front ones, as you can see in the image on the right. As for the neck, I made this sort of blue mane that Ermo has around his neck. >>Continué con las patas, las cuales hice también con plastilina blanca, haciendo las patas traseras más grandes que las partes delanteras, tal como ven en la imagen de la derecha. >> >>Con respecto al cuello, hice esta especie de melena azul que tiene Ermo en su cuello. |![IMG_20260409_212467.jpg.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gaboamc2393/EoeCXaE2qXj4rTZW9CeTFfrMRJVug9obguvwThCJhMbn8HC79e5iw6xdL5aw5MLgAL8.png)|![IMG_20260409_212468.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gaboamc2393/23u62tSYQtJRXsZrXkp7BGyhKVeb8GMpmi5Lic9ceVa3MeqV4QEeSsEw28yAjyEgptZ6x.png)| |-|-| I attached all the pieces to the body I had already made, using wire and glue to make it sturdier, thus completing the figurine. >>Pegué todas las piezas al cuerpo que ya había hecho, usando alambre y pegamento, para dar mayor fuerza a la pieza, terminando así la figurita. ![IMG_20260409_212452.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gaboamc2393/23uFPqtC3RpbmQBZ8bGV2toCu6QEEdZLCxKFPWXAmje8GS7JVCrYTUBX8Ug8BC2jbjyH6.jpg) And that’s how it turned out. Below you can see a series of photos of the final result: >>De esta manera quedó terminada. A continuación pueden ver una serie de fotografías del resultado final: ![20260410_010509_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gaboamc2393/23xArtNNApHwR75NgXNra9SFJ7ydiqzoB5CQ9Wfqhugwz3uxnt8T5Jb6MNDn1zNPBUrrE.png) ![Diseño sin título_20260410_010704_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gaboamc2393/23zbgezS8eqzFoCF5nFWLtQuJ1U1V6DieBByRJEAJNonS6kgEwERutJUYAa2L4n94soAY.png) ![20260410_010840_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gaboamc2393/23xVbvVKmuBQ6W2LoXfKdujF3NaBHcxtrsBRCk9t2iuD3NNZUwfGMaajfxkwqFNMy1VAm.png) Well, that's all I have to say about the collectible.
