body.title: Granblue Fantasy: Relink - Part 2 (the CONS)
body.body:
I am a very fussy gamer. I don't have a lot of patience for things that aren't what I am looking for in a game and I think that is perfectly ok. There are a ton of options for gamers and therefore I don't normally stick around for a game that doesn't fit the bill entirely for me. I quit on more games than I complete and I think that most people are that way. *Granblue Fantasy Relink* started out really great and I had a lot of good things to say about it in my previous writeup, but now I am going to focus on some of the things that turned me off about the game and also why I am unlikely to continue playing it. I have already moved on but want to point out the game's shortcomings just so people can have a good idea about the game in it's entirety.
https://www.nintendo.com/eu/media/images/assets/nintendo_switch_2_games/granbluefantasyrelinkendlessragnarok/16x9_GranblueFantasyRelinkEndlessRagnarok_image1600w.jpg [src](https://www.nintendo.com/eu/media/images/assets/nintendo_switch_2_games/granbluefantasyrelinkendlessragnarok/16x9_GranblueFantasyRelinkEndlessRagnarok_image1600w.jpg)

CON: Combat takes too long

I think that the general idea here is that they were tying to make a game like the very popular *Monster Hunter* franchise that I tried to get into, but didn't really enjoy it. A lot of other people have though seeing as how they have sold something crazy like 100 million copies of those games. The issue I take with the central theme of the game being to defeat bosses on a regular basis is that these battles take a **Very long time**. Much of this has to do with the massive HP pool that said bosses have. The combat doesn't get any more difficult and honestly, the fights are actually pretty easy even once you step the game's difficulty up to \

I rarely step games up to hard level but I was breezing through bosses without really having any strategy at all.  

<center> https://images.microcms-assets.io/assets/eb99e2a508104ba88aaa382d1573ac14/ebf414f2b3c9494c845770e690e6e294/battles0010PS402.jpg
[src](https://images.microcms-assets.io/assets/eb99e2a508104ba88aaa382d1573ac14/ebf414f2b3c9494c845770e690e6e294/battles0010PS402.jpg)</center>

If you desire to do so, you can just stand really far back out of harm's way and let your 3 teammates do all the work.  This will take longer but they will eventually win, even on hard.  If you turn on the \

function the game basically plays itself. After a bunch of battles I found myself losing interest in even participating.

Con: Leveling up basically IS the story

I don't mind a game not having much in the way of a story, but as far as your objectives are concerned in this game, the entire point of all that you are doing seems to be leveling up all of your nearly 20 characters as well as their weapons in order to progress. The various things you can equip are very limited, and the only thing that you really need to do is occasionally visit the blacksmith and upgrade your main weapons.
https://www.siliconera.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/how-to-obtain-mastery-points-granblue-fantasy-relink.png [src](https://www.siliconera.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/how-to-obtain-mastery-points-granblue-fantasy-relink.png)
There is a massive \

and while i put a bunch of time into choosing just the right things at first, I quickly came to the realization that none of this really makes that much of a difference and I believe the entire reasoning behind all of this is for this to be a time-sink so you will grind in order to level everyone up. While there is a main character in this game, you have the option of playing as anyone, which is kind of nice until all of your toons are many levels apart from one another and you are simply running around doing repetitive quests in order to get XP. I don't mind a bit of grinding, but after a bit that becomes the entire game and since combat kind of loses its lustre after a few hours, this stops being fun. I enjoy the casual nature of this game but after a bit you kind of get tired of simply hitting square all the time, hundreds of times in a row for a single battle.

Con: Too much voice acting

I think the voice acting in this game is actually done very well and I applaud that. I mentioned before that I think the way that you are able to skip nearly any scene or story segment is done very well in this game. However, there is constant yammering that takes place during fights that might have had good intentions but after a while I just want everyone to shut up because it adds nothing to the game and the talky talky talky is not relevant to what is actually going on in the battle itself (such as a companion warning you about incoming missiles or something like that).
https://images.microcms-assets.io/assets/eb99e2a508104ba88aaa382d1573ac14/b5dc4413c6c041d895b0f90cf4b38fe5/battles0090steam02.jpg [src](https://images.microcms-assets.io/assets/eb99e2a508104ba88aaa382d1573ac14/b5dc4413c6c041d895b0f90cf4b38fe5/battles0090steam02.jpg)
There also doesn't seem to be any rhyme or reason to why the various characters choose to talk. During the boss battles the amount of yammering is just a mess of characters talking over one another at the same time and it's annoying. I wish there was an option to disable this.

Con: Vyrn is irritating as hell

JRPG's seem to have some sort of intense fascination with some sort of cute floating character that follows the group around and give you hints about where to go and what to do.
https://images.rpgsite.net/image/da49c9a1/133294/original/Granblue-Fantasy-Relink_20240111_02.png [src](https://images.rpgsite.net/image/da49c9a1/133294/original/Granblue-Fantasy-Relink_20240111_02.png)
I have disliked this sort of character ever since *Zelda Ocarina of Time* introduced us to \

all those years ago HEY! LISTEN! HEY LISTEN! I guess it is just protocol with Japanese-centric games but even though I have previously said the voice acting in this game is pretty dern good, Vyrn is just annoying in every sense. He/she/it is the Jar Jar Binks of this game and I hate that creature. When I looked into this a bit I found out that Japanese players have a similar disdain for this character when playing in Japanese.

Biggest CON for me, personally

The main reason why I am going to be stepping away from this game, probably permanently, is because many years ago MMORPG's kind of had some bad impacts on my real life and after that instance I decided that I wasn't going to play MMO's anymore. Now *Granblue Fantasy Relink* technically isn't an MMO but since the game never actually ends and your objective is to just play it forever like Diablo games or the Destiny series of sci-fi games. I prefer to play a game that has a beginning, a story, objectives, and finally an end. One of the commonly held scrutiny of *Granblue* is that the actual story part of the game is very short and the real objective of this game is \

and that my friends, is something I have never enjoyed ever since writing off MMO's around a decade ago.   

*Granblue* is a pretty game that kind of lacks an identity.  It isn't an MMO, it isn't a story adventure, it isn't a shooter, it's not really an open-world game either even though it tries to act like it is.

For me, the cons outweigh the pros for this game and while such a game might appeal to other people, this one just isn't for me.  If you do like casual RPG-like games that don't ever end and the whole idea is to just get more and more powerful and take on increasingly powerful boss fights, this might be a decent one for you to check out especially if you have a PS-Plus account because it is currently free and likely to stay that way for quite a while.

body.title: Limbo, a female marshal, the return from Afghanistan, post-traumatic stress and many intense reflections/ El limbo, una agente de policía, el regreso de Afganistán, el estrés postraumático y muchas reflexiones intensas.
body.body:
So we begin the review of one of the latest books I read, Limbo by Mazzucco. This is a powerful book about war, redemption, post-traumatic stress disorder, the condition of women, family, and ideals. A book that truly encompasses many themes and food for thought. Let me tell you about the plot: it begins in Ladispoli, a simple town in Lazio, home to simple people. Manuela Paris, one of the rare female marshals seriously injured and miraculously alive in an attack in Afghanistan, returns here, captivated by the glory and exaltation of her fellow citizens. Manuela returns home and wants only to face her inner demons in silence, but the citizens and her family wrap themselves around her like a noose. Manuela hasn't been the same since she returned. Coming close to death, losing colleagues and friends has thrown her into a crisis. Every loud noise, everything reminds her of her missions, and so she shuts herself away at home, in her own world, in the company of her somewhat unruly family, especially her lively, promiscuous sister, always seeking excitement. And then there's a silent companion who calms her down: the man smoking on the terrace of the hotel across the street, a constant presence that becomes almost mystical for Manuela, locked in her grief and intent on battling post-traumatic stress disorder.


💥💥💥💥💥💥💥💥💥💥💥💥💥💥💥💥

«Las guerras nunca se ganan. La victoria consiste en alcanzar la meta. Y ella la había alcanzado». 

Así comenzamos la reseña de uno de los últimos libros que leí: Limbo, de Mazzucco. Se trata de una obra impactante sobre la guerra, la redención, el trastorno de estrés postraumático, la condición de la mujer, la familia y los ideales. Un libro que abarca numerosos temas y que invita a la reflexión. Permítanme contarles la trama: comienza en Ladispoli, un pueblo sencillo del Lacio, hogar de gente sencilla. Manuela Paris, una de las pocas mujeres alguaciles que resultó gravemente herida y sobrevivió milagrosamente a un ataque en Afganistán, regresa a este lugar, cautivada por la gloria y la exaltación de sus conciudadanos. Manuela vuelve a casa deseando enfrentarse a sus demonios internos en silencio, pero los ciudadanos y su familia la acosan como una soga. Manuela no ha vuelto a ser la misma desde su regreso. Haber estado al borde de la muerte y haber perdido compañeros y amigos la ha sumido en una profunda crisis. Todo ruido fuerte, todo le recuerda sus misiones, así que se encierra en casa, en su propio mundo, en compañía de su familia, algo rebelde, especialmente de su hermana, vivaz y promiscua, siempre en busca de emociones fuertes. Y luego está un compañero silencioso que la tranquiliza: el hombre que fuma en la terraza del hotel de enfrente, una presencia constante que se vuelve casi mística para Manuela, sumida en su dolor y empeñada en combatir el trastorno de estrés postraumático.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ6BeeKejVsgVryArkVDGAtP7x3mwLyNMaPb6AunRK8Ba/1775801556210.jpg)

In this book, Manuela first retraces her life from her rebellious adolescence, the conflicts with her mother and father, the turning point when she discovers and decides that her destiny lies in the military, the beginning of her passion or near obsession for military life, perhaps idealized but so longed for, from a rebellious and unscrupulous teenager to a woman who desires rigor and discipline, the difficulties she encounters as a woman in the army, the tough training, the hazing, the sexism, life with her comrades, the climb to the role of marshal made up of many falls and failures, doubts, fears and sacrifices but also of the iron will to succeed at all costs. And while she retraces the past, there is also the present: she will meet the man smoking at the window, a strange guy who somehow manages to penetrate Manuela's armor and bring her some of the lightheartedness she needs after all the bad things she saw on the mission, but he will also bring doubts and conflicting feelings.

💥💥💥💥💥💥💥💥💥💥💥💥💥💥💥

En este libro, Manuela reconstruye su vida desde su adolescencia rebelde, los conflictos con sus padres, el punto de inflexión en el que descubre y decide que su destino está en el ejército, el comienzo de su pasión, o casi obsesión, por la vida militar, quizás idealizada pero anhelada, de una adolescente rebelde y sin escrúpulos a una mujer que desea rigor y disciplina, las dificultades que encuentra como mujer en el ejército, el duro entrenamiento, las novatadas, el sexismo, la vida con sus camaradas, el ascenso al puesto de mariscal, plagado de caídas y fracasos, dudas, miedos y sacrificios, pero también de una férrea voluntad de triunfar a toda costa. Y mientras reconstruye el pasado, también está el presente: conocerá al hombre que fuma en la ventana, un tipo extraño que de alguna manera logra penetrar la coraza de Manuela y brindarle algo de la ligereza que necesita después de todas las cosas malas que vio en la misión, pero también le traerá dudas y sentimientos contradictorios.



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRRjBKadmk7sfKgXDTZUxpFfgeWPJHwuZgsj8Cq4WrNe7/1775801556352.jpg)

And then there's the part about the memories of the missions, from her first mission abroad, about how hard it was to be assigned to Afghanistan and about Afghanistan, a land of conflict but also of beauty, about how she found herself in this new world made up of a land so different from Italy and Lazio, about the emotional disorientation, about the belief that she was useful, that she could bring peace with guns in hand. Of that place that in the book almost seems like a disturbing dream, with its welcoming, hostile, or dangerous people, its faces marked by constant wars and pain. And Manuela reflects on how much all this cost her and whether it was worth it, reflects on her blind military faith and on what she did or didn't do in Afghanistan, and at the same time tries to heal her body and mind and get used to normal life again. It's a book I recommend because, in addition to being well-written, it truly addresses many themes in depth and is a book that has a certain strength but also a sensitivity. In short, for me, Mazzucco confirms herself as one of the finest Italian writers.

💥💥💥💥💥💥💥💥💥💥💥💥💥💥💥💥

Y luego está la parte sobre los recuerdos de las misiones, desde su primera misión en el extranjero, sobre lo difícil que fue ser destinada a Afganistán y sobre Afganistán, una tierra de conflicto pero también de belleza, sobre cómo se encontró a sí misma en este nuevo mundo formado por una tierra tan diferente de Italia y Lacio, sobre la desorientación emocional, sobre la creencia de que era útil, de que podía traer la paz con las armas en la mano. De ese lugar que en el libro casi parece un sueño perturbador, con su gente acogedora, hostil o peligrosa, sus rostros marcados por guerras y dolor constantes. Y Manuela reflexiona sobre cuánto le costó todo esto y si valió la pena, reflexiona sobre su fe militar ciega y sobre lo que hizo o dejó de hacer en Afganistán, y al mismo tiempo intenta sanar su cuerpo y su mente y acostumbrarse de nuevo a la vida normal. Es un libro que recomiendo porque, además de estar bien escrito, realmente aborda muchos temas en profundidad y es un libro que tiene cierta fuerza pero también sensibilidad. En resumen, para mí, Mazzucco se confirma como una de las mejores escritoras italianas.



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd7xUa8pRdEAjXLyeV4b1SV66G8xHPGvz6Ynx2GTCxPC7/1775802964515.jpg)

body.title: Ladies of Hive Community Contest #283 - Self-care being the priority
body.body:
@LadiesofHive Community [Contest #283](https://hive.blog/hive-124452/@ladiesofhive/ladies-of-hive-community-contest-283) questions for the week are:

1️⃣ Self Care: We fall sick, we get well because we took care by taking medication, it's human. But we tend to overlook or under care when we are not sick, when we feel strong and healthy. So, here's the reminder question: How do you care for your body and mind when you are not sick? What is your everyday health care routine like?
~ 𝐀𝐍𝐃 / 𝐎𝐑 ~
2️⃣ Hobby Crush: Most of us have hobbies we spend little or more time doing, but there are hobbies we admire others do. What is that one hobby you wish you could do for fun, too, and why can't you adopt it for your free time?

<center>🌸🌸🌸🌸🌸🌸🌸🌸🌸🌸🌸🌸🌸🌸🌸🌸🌸🌸🌸</center>

That's a fact that a lot of people only care about themselves when they are unwell and the moment, they get well then again, they go back to a absent minded life. Sadly, in my life I have always had sick people around me, and have been taking care of them. They have been my very dear ones so I cannot even shy away from taking care of them, but looking at them I always feel motivated to take care of my self all the time.

I do not wish an ailing old age or the one where I am dependent on anyone. I want to be healthy, active and mobile for as long as I live. But it does not happen overnight. It's about how you have taken care of yourself all your life it will give you results in old age. My daily routines of my self-care on my fitness and keeping my muscles strong are doing Yoga, meditation, walking 3k to 5K steps daily. Besides this, I follow a healthy and balanced diet through the week. Over the week I indulge in some junk food but that too with mindfulness.

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRiLebf5okLHZc9WTs3ByxBzCSkXF12pUcPCNA992Nqo8/image.png)
[Source](https://pixabay.com/illustrations/woman-girl-female-posing-pose-9457927/)

Twice a year I do a full health check-up and then based on the results, I add up vitamin and mineral supplements into my daily diet. I like to drink alcohol so I have a glass of red wine once a week. It's not that I do not indulge in any unhealthy foods and drinks, I do but keeping everything in control and also ensuring to minimize the impact of it on my health.  I spend time in nature and doing things I love and enjoy, all of this keeps me in a positive state of mind. I enjoy travelling so even over the weekends I do short travels even if it is for a day, it makes me feel good mentally and emotionally.

Wellness is not a day's job it is a daily job and the most important one. To be practical, every single day it's not possible to follow a healthy routine but it can be balanced out with 1 or 2 cheat days in a week and then following up with some measures that will take care of the junk. Like Friday and Saturday are my cheat days and then Sunday is my fasting day. Balance is important. If I try to be too stringent then it is possible that I will end up doing more wrong things and not taking care of myself.

***Thank you for visiting my blog.*** 👼🏻👼🏻💖💖🌹🌺🌸

body.title: A boy just forged his 1st nail.  The exciting taste of self-confidence & skill!

body.title: Springtime Running!
body.body:
There's something about spring that always leaves me feeling like I'm constantly running.

I haven't decided whether it's because I have unusually many obligations during March and April, or whether it's because everything in nature is starting to grow so fast that I can't keep up with keeping the great outdoors tidy.

![0459-BigSurFence.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/denmarkguy/23wzzeVsE6Sw5GsRxpZRwWjD5DkyVobT5Wn3zQufvqDm5MEg8FgKWCdMmeWy2GJ6wpbkU.jpg)

It is the time of the year when it feels like I'm always doing bookkeeping and taxes, while it is also the time of the year where the lawn seems to get six inches long if I'm not mowing it at least twice a week.

Of course, there's also the fact that spring hsitorically is *\

* both in the literal gardening sense of the word, as well as in the *figurative* sense of us planting the metaphorical seeds for new things we hope to accomplish during the rest of the year. 

Looking back across the years, I have typically started *far* more new projects in springtime, as opposed to on the first of January... never was big into New Year's Resolutions.

Short version, I feel like I am running *a lot* these days!

![0590-PinkStrawberry.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/denmarkguy/EoyQzwiq6KBkfLrHWArDdUTyL1r9RqjVxdShMhLEkNJQ6KQKBRPnwbs3LU5K3J8PJNJ.jpg)

I'm happy to be able to say that I am about 75% done with the bookkeeping for taxes *(which are due on April 15th, even though I will likely end up filing an extension)*, which is always one of my big psychological hurdles.

A box of seeds for the vegetable garden also arrived today, so now I feel like doing taxes is taking away gardening time, but working in the garden would make the tax preparation run behind schedule.

But I guess that's just how life *works,* in this day and age!

Independently of all this, the season to make the most of my eBay businesses is also here... but I am pretty much too busy to commit much time to them. Sadly...

![1016-Heather.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/denmarkguy/23w2sVeDpMCZ4LVKyGYVv4pnffnAgRrrAmLDP6rbeWboRxxR28rr7aCiZ1AUyrJsdmu5E.jpg)

And so, I stop and remind myself that spring also is the season where we end up *(historically speaking)* putting in lots of time and energy *now,* in order to gain some benefits much *later,* when it is harvest time.

If you're detecting an undertone of frustration here, you'd be right... I have long been particularly sensitive to feeling like I am stretched too thin.

But this, too, shall pass!

Thanks for stopping by and have a great Friday!

body.title: Conjurer Hurbis Might Be Stronger Than You Think || Its Magic Attack Is Incredible
body.body:
![Conjurer's Hubris unleashes magical fury.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23w2gbg9aYupvUpP2phLqjfgfbKddDyyAjETKJfsUrT2s6jscNB9zopjzbGYP2VERXLJD.png)
![Capture.PNG](https://i.imgur.com/uGB0GKX.png)


Have you ever entered a battle with the Conjurer Hurbis monster? Have you ever estimated its abilities? And at what price is it available in the market? 

Today we will discuss this topic and provide more guidance about this monster so that players can understand it and place it properly in battle. Also if you understand this monster well you will know at what rate it is available in the market. You will learn all of this in this post today.

First of all let me tell about one confusion that some friends asked me about. New Splinterlands players often get confused about the symbols shown on the left and right sides of monster cards. How can we understand which card is better?


As you can see the monster I am talking about has four to five symbols which are definitely confusing for a new user.

Firstly in the top left corner you will see 11 which is its mana cost that means the cost to use this card is 11 mana.

Below that you will see 2 in purple color. This means magic attack which is the power to deal magic damage and this monster has 2 magic damage.
![Screenshot 2026-04-10 105718.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/Eo45gHvRaMF2vxKpifjFWZd6cpGyZ4AwAVm6aEBLv8w72b72VFTyJzRomDKmRW5APLu.png)
![Capture.PNG](https://i.imgur.com/uGB0GKX.png)

Below that you will see a sword icon which indicates melee attack, meaning the ability to attack from close range.

If you look on the right side you will see a red heart icon with 6 on it which means this monsters health or life.

Below that you will see a blue boot/wing icon with 3 which means speed. The higher the speed the faster the attack and the better the dodge chance of any monster.

These are some basic details needed to understand any monster card.

Besides this you can also know its element and if you look below the level indicator shows that this is level 1 with its current stats and details.

Conjurer Hurbis is considered a very strong monster with excellent abilities. You can play it in the front line or mid line easily but it is better to use it as a secondary tank because it has melee attack which gives it the ability to attack from close range.

![Screenshot 2026-04-10 105739.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/Eo8Ked4r2GqbPZZ6zwi4otiSHigKyCpo3a22QcQyk7qpAS3Zc3CRMSkkPztFC7gMuyc.png)
![Capture.PNG](https://i.imgur.com/uGB0GKX.png)

Remeber that any monster which has its best ability you have to use it according to that and to place it accordingly. If you see that any monster whose main ability is its melee attack then you need to place it right to the tank that can perform with its best abilities.


You can find this monster card in market by typing the name of this monster. You will get to see the card with different prices depending upon the card level.

You will find every monster card with different levels and CC. These all are dependent on the price of that monster card. If the level and CC is higher the price is expensive. But if it is of initial level you will get that card at low cost. Further then you can upgrade these cards to the next levels which needs your further investment.

If I talk about level 1 of this card, its starting price is around $1.2 which can increase up to $3.8 depending on its level and CC.

I hope you guys will like this post and is interesting as well. If you find it informative then dont forget to give me a support. Share you reviews in the comment section below. Thank you all for your time reading the content.

body.body:
![images (1) (23).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/henrietta27/23xpFDabVapaZuQ34aUCrg4jpNdPw5eALLmkzRbHEc5Hivi1M4RjCDxrwpp8auVU9d1n3.jpeg)
[source](https://www.pexels.com/photo/woman-scolding-teen-daughter-for-bad-behavior-6957167/) 

Moral decadence is when there is a drop in ethical values, principles and social standards. People exhibit this nature due to failure brought upon them by their parents or their society at large. Basically, We cannot pinpoint the main source of moral decadence based on the fact that it can be a mixture of poor family up bringing in values, societal pressure or the influence of Peer Pressure and social media. 

Truly, we can blame society, parents, social media, or those practicing it because it all falls back to these category of people at the end of the day. For The Society, moral decadence can come from their end as they allow some on ethical behavior to take place. 

Recently, I was going through the internet and I saw a culture where it was allowed for young men to rape young girls because there is festival where young women are not supposed to come out of their homes. Hence when these ladies come out, men can do whatever they like with them. This is a high moral decadence because Society in this essence supports abuse against women. 

Again, The blame for moral decadence can also be on the family because at one point they might have failed in instilling morals in their children. Back in the days, parents were not the only guardian of the children, it took a community to raise a child.

However, in our contemporary world reverse is the case because people do not want anybody to interfere in the upbreaking of their child. When a child does a wrong thing in school he or she is disciplined or flogged in the school but the parents elavates the issue and arrests the teacher. This is why many teachers do the best they can to avoid trouble. 

Finally, it could also be an individual decisions to be wayward and engaging in unethical behaviors. While parents guidance and the society has done their best to shape an individual to the best of their ability, people still have what is called choice to either choose between good or bad. 

In conclusion, I don't think moral decadence can be totally evacuated from existence but it can be managed it there is stronger parenting, value-based education, responsible media use, and personal responsibility. Change can begin from an individual who choosesintegrity,

this song is one of the songs from my tribe whose name is SUKU BATAK, lyrical in batak language with deep meaning.

this lyrics tells about the separation of a couple,this place is witness to them meeting and separating which is called parsobanan.this lyric pours out deep heart pain with that separation hoping to meet in the same place.and this song is slaah one song that people like to hear become songs accompanying sadness and often sung.

Marsada Band is one of the original tano batak bands that has become familiar on the international scene consisting of 4 people, namely Marlundu Situmorang, Toni Sidabutar, Janen Sigalingging, and Norma Br. Manurung. The group was founded in 1999 at the University of North Sumatra. The originator of the name Marsada Band is Norma Boru Manurung, which means to be united. This is because, at that time, the personnel lived far apart and it was expected that they could unite. Over time, the personnel of Marsada Band increased by 4 people, namely Monang Sidabutar, Kalous sidabutar, Pardi Sidabutar and Hobbi Sinaga. Up to that time, the marching band had 8 members. However, as time progressed, Norma Br. Manurung resigned from the group because he had already married, leaving Marsada Band which consisted of 7 people. In 2021, Marlundu situmorang, the vocalist from Marsada Band died. Now, Marsada Band consists of 6 people

[source](https://batakkeren.com/showbiz/grup-legendaris-batak-marsada-band)

Laos hubukka ma da bajuki

Asa tung las ma dagingmi

Hape dung sonari nunga leleng dang
Pajumpang dohot ho hasian

Atik naung muli do ho
Molo tung pe namuli pe taho
Dala pola salah i hasian
Asal ma huida bohimi nungnga tung sonang rohakki

body.body: > The maority of the things we do in our life centers on making money. People leave their houses in the morning just to work for hours in order to get money to survive by. In a situation where money is not a problem, and I have all the money I can possibly imagine, there would be so many options when it comes to things I will buy. The options are so much that I can maybe get confused sometimes. If I had unlimited amount of money, I would acquire huge portions of land and start an agriculture business. Food is one of the basic needs of humans. With unlimited money, I would utilise the vast land I acquired to grow agricultural crops. Food crops would be in abundance. I would also deal in livestock too. That's an important part of agriculture.

/> \[Image Source\](https://pixabay.com/photos/agriculture-tractor-farming-8275498/) There are a lot of places in the world struggling to get food. There are places where food is neither cheap nor abundant. I would love to change that. By the time I supply the majority of the world with food products, my agriculture business would be very important and popular. People will always get food. Even if someone is down to their last cash, they would prioritize food because it is needed to survive. This idea would be my attempt in trying to end world hunger. I would acquire land in as many countries as possible in order to ensure presence all over the world. This would also be a good employment opportunity because I would employ as many competent individuals as possible. Considering the scale of the agriculture business, I could be the largest employer of labour. So it's like killing multiple birds with one stone. I would provide more food than ever while also employing more persons and giving them a means of livelihood. I would put a lot of focus on employing experts. This is because agriculture is not easy. I would have to acquire machines needed for agriculture. These machines will be needed for large scale agriculture and I would need competent people to operate and maintain these machines. Agriculture is something that needs experts in preventing diseases for crops and animals, otherwise the diseases can lead to great losses. I believe agriculture would be of great benefit to both owner and the masses. Getting involved in large scale agriculture like I intend to do would make life better for a lot of people. We tend to do well in abundance. I believe food will be abundant and cheap. body.title: Reflections :  Survival Tailor
body.body:
Greetings everyone.
The optimistic smile of a Tailor in serving customers. There is a Tailor who is around 70 years old. I come to the Tailor at his seeing kiosk on the side of the road. I happened to want to cut my pants because they were too long.


![IMG20260313082857.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hsidik/23w2itd8svq7yrCPHig31KBUcRdbntmAxJ7jsJvG5QkT159h7D3TEikzTaQx33veD3mDE.jpg)


He told me his life journey as a Tailor, he now rents this place for 400.000,- IDR or around ($23,5) a month for a sewing place. They have been in this place for about Ten years. He started sewing around 1979, at that time he was still young.

Sewing was still with other people, at that time were quite a lot of people who would sew clothes,pants. With the development of shopping centers. And online purchasing systems. Now people prefer to buy clothes such as, shirts,pants and others buy ready-made clothes and buy online.

I asked the Tailor, where does the rent for the stall and other expenses come from?. He replied, lately there are rarely any people sewing clothes or trousers. In a month at most one or two sew clothers. 


![IMG20260313083256.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hsidik/23xp4FJkRNy8sQiA4ieWvJgpUdN4jZv9tWbVs2uGM66JBfwuACTfXRnGgeLQ1TmfbDHPy.jpg)


The rest rely on people who are willing to repair clothes or trousers, can be reduced in size, cut pants, sew Torn or other things. Sometimes the oldest child help sewing. They have three children who are already married. 

Off the three children, none of them are serious about being a Tailor. I asked again, when Will they tetire?. They replied, as long as they still have the strength and health. They Will carry out sewing as a source of livelihood.

The tailor's house is not far from the kiosk, located behind the kiosk. During break time they just walk to his house.
Thank you very much.

body.body: @ahmadmanga the video is about **Alibaba’s Marco-Nano and Marco-Mini sparse MoE models**, with the core pitch being local install + speed testing rather than “these dominate every benchmark” brilliance; your instinct is right that the benchmark story looks less sexy than the parameter count suggests, but speed/efficiency may still make them worth messing with for edge use or cheap local inference [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jt80Y0Ks6Yw). The broader writeup around **Marco-Mini-Instruct** frames the series as a small-but-efficient multilingual MoE family built to squeeze more out of limited active parameters, which is exactly the kind of thing that can feel better in practice than benchmark charts imply [AIbase](https://news.aibase.com/news/27009). InLeo chatter on this specific model family is basically nonexistent right now, so there’s no real community verdict yet; the closest recent AI-model discussion was broader mini/nano-model talk, not Marco-specific testing [InLeo thread](https://inleo.io/threads/view/zamaai/re-leothreads-1749486135).

body.title: The Question Sitting at the Edge of the Certainty
body.body:
![1775711281611343826813830184424.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tikatarot/EoEq1CBSKPDWejtYAAtwpWS51c91XEsDRccNoxBPqJRxib86Fb1kWdaHypkmBhSaFmB.jpg)






![topfeather.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tikatarot/jVIY8Tx5-top-feather.png)










<center>I’ve entered rooms already knowing what I’d find, the certainty I felt was like wisdom being invited by the version of myself who arrived at the door with the answer already written,
I’ve entered rooms already knowing what I’d find, but I kept missing the actual thing —different from my prediction and altering something significant if I had allowed myself to see it,
I’ve entered rooms already knowing what I’d find, I have been meeting life halfway and calling it understanding, when in truth I had already chosen what I was willing to see,
Did I allow that mistake to undermine my certainty, or did I explain it away before it had the opportunity to challenge anything I had relied on
I’ve entered rooms already knowing what I’d find, but I am starting to count the things I missed while I was busy being right about what I expected before I even crossed the threshold...





<center>There is a hidden certainty I carry that does not announce itself, but arrives in the form of confidence that feels like a virtue right up until the thing I was prepared for turns out to be something else entirely,
There is a hidden certainty I carry that does not announce itself, lives in the way I stop asking questions once I believe I have enough information to proceed, still, I have changed the direction I was already heading,
There’s a subtle certainty I carry that remains unspoken, it’s the small, everyday details of a situation that I overlook, while the ones that align with my preconceived notions and confirm my existing inclinations,
Am I moving toward something with full conviction, have I been avoiding that direction because I don’t want to know what I’d find there,
There is a hidden certainty I carry that does not announce itself, but the quiet kind that simply feels like knowing my own mind and having the experience to back it up when challenged...





<center>I have also carried a quiet doubt that closed the door before anything could enter, deciding in advance nothing would work and there was no point in hoping too specifically,
I have also carried a quiet doubt, I was not certain about while the fuller and more open and more genuinely available version stayed back where nothing could reach her,
I have also carried a quiet doubt, protecting me from was not the hurt I feared but the exposure that all real participation in anything requires and that I had been avoiding for years under the name of being careful,
What have I not hoped for in the past year because I prioritized self-protection over the potential life if my hope had come true,
I’ve also carried a quiet doubt that I sometimes mistake the sense of security for safety, that specific loneliness of living in a space that I’ve made too carefully to be genuinely entered by anything new…





<center>The question I haven’t been asking is right at the edge, the answer might require me to change a position I’ve already defended in front of people whose opinion of my capability matters more to me than I’m comfortable admitting,
The question I haven’t been asking is right at the edge, I have built several other things on top of the reason I have not been asking is that the answer feels too large to manage alongside everything else I am already holding,
The question I haven’t been asking is right at the edge, in the moments when the performance of certainty is finally quiet before the morning comes and I put the certainty back on and go out into the day again,
Can I ask myself right now, without flinching or redirecting, what the one thing I’ve been most resistant to is, is it from genuine conviction, or from fear of what the questioning would reveal based on what I needed to believe rather than what I actually knew,
The question I haven’t been asking is right at the edge, the quality of the decisions I am making is shaped by an assumption I have delayed, and I reach for it now, ready to test it before it shapes another outcome for me...





<center>Watchwords:
Missing what was there while expecting what wasn't,
Arrogance arriving dressed as knowing my mind,
A door sealed so long it felt like safety,
Certainty I defended in front of the wrong audience,
The question not asked is still not going anywhere...















![bottomfeather.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tikatarot/bYIitQga-bottom-feather.png)

***

<center>Here is Tikatarot, who dares you to answer the question, *“Who am I?”..*</center>


***
***

<center>As and will always be reminding you to dream:</center> 
<center>*“As you are still the Master of your destiny and the maker of your dreams…”*</center>



![tikatarot sign.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tikatarot/cUPh7Abd-tikatarot20sign.png)

## The Home Where I Grew Up
## Silver Bloggers Chronicles Prompt #41

- - -

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTpfb2vstuM6mJvBM9dVfZtY844CsEDdesCTrhxqNFXF5/epicantus_street_1447955_640.jpg)
Source [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/street-leiden-netherlands-dutch-1447955/)

---

Hello @silver-bloggers community.

Tell us what the home you grew up in was like. What do you like to remember most about it?

When I think about the home where I grew up, I don’t just remember walls, rooms, or furniture. What comes back to me is a feeling — something warm, imperfect, and deeply human.

It was not a large house, nor particularly beautiful by conventional standards. Time had left its marks on the walls, and the furniture was often a mix of things that had been repaired more than once. But it was alive. That is the word that comes closest to describing it.

It was a place where life was constantly happening.

- - -

I remember the sounds more than anything else. The soft clatter of dishes in the kitchen, voices crossing from one room to another, the occasional laughter that filled the entire space without warning. There was always movement, always something unfolding.

---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYDERUHNsYrSorKKATuRAfeNEPNeTrwS7Lc8r9YuUVMpv/t_shirtbedrucken_ai_generated_9627866_640.jpg)
Source [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/ai-generated-kitchen-inner-space-9627866/)

---

And yet, there was also a kind of calm hidden inside all that noise.

It was in that house where I first learned to observe people. Without realizing it, I would sit quietly and watch the small gestures: the way someone paused before speaking, the way emotions revealed themselves in silence. Perhaps that is where my path toward medicine truly began — not in books, but in those early acts of attention.

Because a home, in many ways, is our first school.

- - -

What I remember most is not a specific object or a single moment, but the feeling of belonging. The certainty that no matter what happened outside, there was a place where I could return and simply be.

There was a small corner where I used to read, sometimes with more curiosity than understanding. Books became, even then, a window into something larger than the walls around me. Looking back, I realize that those quiet moments were shaping a part of me that would stay forever.

---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUCYdY94weNTbiCr56d3X2MrN1dUUiUKooSpKaJZbJ2Se/pexels_books_1835753_640.jpg)
Source [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/books-education-knowledge-library-1835753/)

---

It wasn’t a perfect home. No home truly is.

But it was enough. More than enough.

- - -

With time, we all move forward. We change spaces, routines, even the way we see the world. But there are places that remain within us, almost untouched by time.

The home where I grew up is one of those places.

Not because of what it had, but because of what it gave me: a way of looking at life, of understanding people, of finding meaning in the simplest moments.

And perhaps that is what truly makes a house a home.

Thank you for reading.
See you in the words.

The images are from Pixabay and the English translation was done with DeepL Translate.

- - -
🇪🇦 En Español
- - -

## El hogar donde crecí
## Silver Bloggers Chronicles Prompt #41

- - -

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTpfb2vstuM6mJvBM9dVfZtY844CsEDdesCTrhxqNFXF5/epicantus_street_1447955_640.jpg)
Fuente [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/street-leiden-netherlands-dutch-1447955/)

---

Hola comunidad @silver-bloggers.

Cuéntanos cómo era el hogar donde creciste. ¿Qué es lo que más te gusta recordar de él?

Cuando pienso en el hogar donde crecí, no recuerdo solamente paredes, habitaciones o muebles. Lo que vuelve a mí es una sensación — algo cálido, imperfecto y profundamente humano.

No era una casa grande, ni especialmente hermosa según los estándares habituales. El tiempo había dejado sus huellas en las paredes, y los muebles eran, muchas veces, una mezcla de cosas que habían sido reparadas más de una vez. Pero estaba viva. Esa es la palabra que más se acerca a describirla.

Era un lugar donde la vida ocurría constantemente.

- - -

Recuerdo más los sonidos que cualquier otra cosa. El leve ruido de los platos en la cocina, las voces que se cruzaban de un cuarto a otro, alguna risa que llenaba todo el espacio sin previo aviso. Siempre había movimiento, siempre algo sucediendo.

---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYDERUHNsYrSorKKATuRAfeNEPNeTrwS7Lc8r9YuUVMpv/t_shirtbedrucken_ai_generated_9627866_640.jpg)
Fuente [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/ai-generated-kitchen-inner-space-9627866/)

---

Y, sin embargo, dentro de todo ese ruido también había una forma de calma.

Fue en esa casa donde aprendí a observar a las personas. Sin darme cuenta, me sentaba en silencio a notar los pequeños gestos: la pausa antes de hablar, las emociones que se revelaban sin palabras. Tal vez fue allí donde comenzó a formarse la médica que soy hoy — no en los libros, sino en esos primeros actos de atención.

Porque un hogar, de muchas maneras, es nuestra primera escuela.

- - -

Lo que más recuerdo no es un objeto específico ni un momento aislado, sino la sensación de pertenencia. La certeza de que, pasara lo que pasara afuera, existía un lugar al que podía regresar y simplemente ser.

Había un pequeño rincón donde solía leer, a veces con más curiosidad que comprensión. Los libros eran ya entonces una ventana hacia algo más grande que las paredes que me rodeaban. Mirando atrás, entiendo que esos momentos silenciosos estaban moldeando una parte de mí que permanecería para siempre.

---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUCYdY94weNTbiCr56d3X2MrN1dUUiUKooSpKaJZbJ2Se/pexels_books_1835753_640.jpg)
Fuente [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/books-education-knowledge-library-1835753/)

---

No era un hogar perfecto. Ningún hogar lo es.

Pero era suficiente. Más que suficiente.

- - -

Con el tiempo, todos avanzamos. Cambiamos de espacios, de rutinas, incluso de la forma en que vemos el mundo. Pero hay lugares que permanecen dentro de nosotros, casi intactos frente al paso del tiempo.

El hogar donde crecí es uno de esos lugares.

No por lo que tenía, sino por lo que me dio: una forma de mirar la vida, de entender a las personas, de encontrar sentido en los momentos más simples.

Y tal vez eso es lo que realmente convierte una casa en un hogar.

Gracias por leerme.
Nos encontramos en las palabras.

Las imagenes son de pixabay y la traducción al ingles fue hecha en DeepL Translate.

body.title: Splinterlands: Melee monsters are good in What Doesn't Kill You
body.body:
Splinterlands is a complex game, and it allows for various cards and strategies. Each fight is different as there are various rulesets applied, and this can give specific cards an advantage depending on how you use them. In this post, I talk about a great battle where I saw a battle where I won because I took advantage of the ruleset.

## Rule Set, Battle, and Plan

<center>![rule set.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23wC1YZQqGANjFApCxtDX8QvfeL5eidewKbHTCcxcy87Ni7igi2Bv4XYP8bLaWQQwKSEU.png)</center>
The rulesets this time are Blood and Sunder and What Doeesn't kill you. This means all monsters gain the enrage and corrosive ward ability. There is also 26 mana available, and I can use any [splinter](https://leofinance.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-splinter) except for fire and water.  

The thorns make it so that melee monsters have increased damage while the rest only get boosted speed when damaged. The corrosive ward also shows that melee monsters lose armor as they attack. This is quite interesting to set up.

|Splinter|Mana Cost|Position|Reason|
|---|---|---|---|
|Aurelia|6|Summoner|+1 Health|
|Dread Tafarian|9|1st|Heal|
|Mad Gearhead|6|2nd|Reach|
|Vicious Quilliun|5|3rd|Opportunity|
|Total Mana:|26|||

My summoner is Aurelia for +1 health. I have Dread Tafarian as my tank with heal. Mad Gearhead is my backup tank with reach, and Vicious Quilliun has opportunity.

The focus of this lineup is to keep my monsters alive while dealing damage and outlasting my opponent. Dread Tafarian is a great tank that heals itself so it will stay alive longer, and the enrage can also increase its damage. The rest of my melee monsters can attack from their current position, and they will also get extra melee damage when damaged.

### Round 1


![round 1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23u67FvbqBpsHkU7BQi4ymuSnnnkLscAXJA2v2B5DW3JeT4g7zE2HHxPZ6sdRWeJmRka1.png)
At first glance, I think that I have the advantage due to my melee monsters. My opponent will suffer  once he loses his tank because ranged monsters can't attack from the first position.

### Round 4

![round 4.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23uFW3U51p8Er4J3ckuitfTLPh9RRrqMimjbgzjq3fs7VxZq9SmS7sgbptsq3pkoXrDE7.png)
A few rounds later, I am left with all my monsters alive, but my opponent only has 2 left. My opponent can no longer outdamage my healer so this is my win


![conclusion.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23uFW8N7PhGZ9DpKtxVVtyPnL81zehYh1esxQAFjRYiEink98EhH4xkvZxv3vLY8Spsoz.png)
I won later that round.

## Conclusion
The battle did go exactly as planned. I won this match because I took advantage of the ruleset to get some extra damage plus speed. My opponent used ranged monsters, but it didn't work out well because they coudln't attack from the first position.

You can see my entire match [here](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_58dbcdf8bd45dc2f580d021ddd571f9b?ref=jfang003).

What did you think of my match? Was there anything you would have done differently? I think it is quite interesting to see how different players use the same card.

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@jfang003/splinterlands-melee-monsters-are-good-in-what-doesnt-kill-you-3gq)

body.title: The Influence Of Your Circle On Your Life
body.body:
>

A very important factor that determines and quietly shapes your life in ways you may not expect, is the people who you surround yourself with. The truth is that the people you surround yourself with matter more than you ever think. These are your friends, your colleagues, acquaintances, your circle. These people can actually push you towards growth, or they can pull you into stagnation. Whether you realise it or not, your environment is constantly influencing your life, your mindset, your decisions, your choices, and even your habit. Many of the things happening in your life, whether good or bad, can directly be linked to the people in your inner circle.

<center>![pexels-fauxels-3228725.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmVGYy1vAopkPV5cCgAkgXnZBsRpGSufmDKsMc89x7dpAX/pexels-fauxels-3228725.jpg)</center>

<center><sub>Image from [Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/photo/photo-of-people-looking-at-photograph-3228725)</sub></center>

I remember what I experienced when I was in school some years back. When I entered newly, I made friends with some students. But I suddenly discovered that it was beginning to affect my studies. They would come around, gist, and all, but not a mention of academics. Then I had to advise myself to stay away from them. I then found a study group, and then I joined myself to them. They became my friends and it was a positive addition to me. We would set a day to come for tutorials, where each of the group members would have studied a particular topic so they can teach it to others. This made me studious, and I grew academically. This goes to prove that your circle has enormous influence and impact on you.

Humans have the natural tendency of being influenced by association. For example, if you spend a considerable amount of time with people who are disciplined, driven, and focused, their energy will rob off on you. You will see yourself thinking bigger, taking bolder steps, acting better, and even aiming higher. But if you spend time with pessimistic people, who just sit and wait for things to happen on their own, you will imbibe their attitude. You will feel less motivated, and there will not be zeal to even take any step. You tend to adopt the mindset of the people who you stay dominantly with. Your circle can either be of positive influence on you or may be breaking you.

Being in the midst of a strong positive circle will challenge you to grow, and will make you to be on your toes to take actions. These are the people who will not paint words for you, nor tell you what you want to hear, but rather they will tell you the truth that you need to hear. They will correct you when you are wrong, motivate you when you feel discouraged, and celebrate your wins without feeling threatened by it. They will also inspire you to become a better version of yourself, so you will not become too comfortable with who you are at the moment.

<center>![pexels-yankrukov-7794015.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmXdhNaDhwupC2CAAu7V9ZaGHMC3Qa17NWa7JD5mrqmqrc/pexels-yankrukov-7794015.jpg)</center>

<center><sub>Image from [Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/photo/woman-and-a-man-doing-high-five-at-the-office-7794015)</sub></center>

On the other hand, a toxic circle will negatively impact on you. These are the people who have normalised pessimism, mediocrity, and they give excuses about anything and everything. Staying with them will make you discouraged from following after your ambition, you will start to give excuses why things are not working, instead of looking for the solutions. It will also make you to remain docile. Staying for long in that kind of environment can make someone to lose their confidence, and it will ultimately limit their potentials.

It is worthy to note that not everyone around you today is meant to remain there forever. As you evolve, there is also a possibility that your circle will evolve. This does not mean that you should begin to look down on others, rather it means finding the people with similar mindset as you, who also align with your values. If your circle is not positively impacting on your life, then the truth is that it is already negatively impacting on you. This is why you have to show intentionality when choosing the people who stay in your life. However, you have to be the kind of person that you want in your circle before you can find people to fit in. After all, \

So be the right person, and make the right friends, and form the right circle. ***Thanks for reading***
Peace on y'all

body.title: Cuando Nadie Aplaude #08 — La persona que se queda cuando sería más fácil irse. [Esp/Eng]
body.body:
* * *

Hola comunidad @holos-lotus hoy continuo con la serie, **Cuando Nadie Aplaude** en ella pretendo mostrar aquellas situaciones poco reconocidas, pero muy humanas y que forman parte de nuestra vida

* * *

## La persona que se queda cuando sería más fácil irse  

---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV8ixy147X9KCGczTDwD67kEg6j4hXyKs6yiE85LogD6T/nhattienle94_girl_1555789_640.jpg)
Fuente [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/girl-beauty-beautiful-girl-female-1555789/)

---

Hay momentos en la vida donde irse parece la opción más lógica.  

Más fácil.  
Más rápida.  
Más cómoda.  

Y, sin embargo, hay personas que hacen lo contrario.  

**Se quedan.**  

---

No porque no sientan el impulso de marcharse.  
No porque no les duela.  
No porque no estén cansadas.  

Sino porque entienden que hay cosas que no se abandonan en el primer intento de dificultad.  

---

La persona que se queda cuando sería más fácil irse no siempre lo tiene claro.  

A veces duda.  
A veces se rompe un poco por dentro.  
A veces se pregunta si vale la pena.  

Pero hay algo que pesa más que la incomodidad del momento:  
el valor de lo que está construyendo.  

---

Puede ser una relación.  
Una amistad.  
Un proyecto.  
Una promesa hecha en voz baja.  

Algo que no siempre es perfecto, pero que tiene historia.  

---

Hoy en día todo parece desechable.  

Las conversaciones.  
Los vínculos.  
Las oportunidades.  

Todo se reemplaza rápido.  
Todo se abandona antes de intentar entender.  

Por eso quedarse se ha vuelto un acto silencioso de resistencia.  

---

Tengo 25 años y cada vez entiendo más que quedarse no siempre es debilidad.  

A veces es exactamente lo contrario.  

Es sostener cuando lo fácil sería soltar.  
Es escuchar cuando lo simple sería cerrar la puerta.  
Es intentar una vez más cuando ya nadie lo espera.  

---

Pero quedarse también tiene límites.  

Y eso es importante decirlo.  

No se trata de aguantar lo que duele sin sentido.  
No se trata de perderse a uno mismo por mantener algo.  

Se trata de elegir conscientemente:  

“Esto vale la pena intentarlo una vez más.”  

---

Si lo pensara como una fotografía, no sería una imagen grandiosa.  

Sería algo mucho más sencillo:  

Alguien sentado en silencio.  
Una conversación que no ha terminado.  
Una puerta que sigue abierta.  

Nada espectacular.  

Pero lleno de significado.  

---

La persona que se queda no siempre recibe reconocimiento.  

Nadie aplaude el esfuerzo invisible de seguir intentando.  
Nadie mide el cansancio acumulado detrás de esa decisión.  

Porque desde afuera parece fácil.  

Pero desde adentro…  
es otra historia.  

---

Quedarse es incómodo.  

Es enfrentar lo que no está resuelto.  
Es sostener conversaciones difíciles.  
Es aceptar que las cosas no siempre fluyen como esperamos.  

---

Pero también es una forma de cuidar.  

Cuidar lo que importa.  
Cuidar lo que tiene raíces.  
Cuidar lo que aún tiene posibilidad.  

---

Quizás crecer también es aprender a distinguir entre cuándo irse…  
y cuándo quedarse un poco más.  

No por miedo.  
No por costumbre.  

Sino por convicción.  

---

Porque el mundo no solo se construye con comienzos.  

También se sostiene con personas que deciden no abandonar a la primera dificultad.  

---

Y aunque nadie lo aplauda…  

quedarse, cuando todo empuja a irse,  
también es una forma de amar.

---

Con esto termina este capítulo y me despido. Díganme en los comentarios que les pareció y si quieren apoyar será bien recibido.

Las imágenes utilizadas son de Pixabay y utilizo Google Translate para la versión en inglés.

* * *
*English Version*

* * *

### When No One Applauds #08

### The Person Who Stays When It Would Be Easier to Leave  



* * *

Hello @holos-lotus community, today I continue with the series, **When No One Applauds**. In it, I intend to show those little-recognized yet deeply human situations that are part of our lives.

---

### The Person Who Stays When It Would Be Easier to Leave  

---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV8ixy147X9KCGczTDwD67kEg6j4hXyKs6yiE85LogD6T/nhattienle94_girl_1555789_640.jpg)
Source [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/girl-beauty-beautiful-girl-female-1555789/)

---

There are moments in life when leaving seems like the most logical option.  

Easier.  
Faster.  
More comfortable.  

And yet, there are people who do the opposite.  

**They stay.**  

---

Not because they don’t feel the urge to walk away.  
Not because it doesn’t hurt.  
Not because they are not tired.  

But because they understand that some things are not meant to be abandoned at the first sign of difficulty.  

---

The person who stays when it would be easier to leave does not always have everything figured out.  

Sometimes they doubt.  
Sometimes something inside them quietly breaks.  
Sometimes they wonder if it is even worth it.  

But there is something that weighs more than the discomfort of the moment:  
the value of what they are trying to build.  

---

It could be a relationship.  
A friendship.  
A project.  
A promise once made in a quiet moment.  

Something that is not always perfect, but carries history.  

---

Nowadays, everything feels disposable.  

Conversations.  
Connections.  
Opportunities.  

Everything is replaced quickly.  
Everything is abandoned before it is fully understood.  

That is why staying has become a silent act of resistance.  

---

I am 25 years old, and more and more I understand that staying is not always a sign of weakness.  

Sometimes, it is exactly the opposite.  

It is holding on when letting go would be easier.  
It is listening when walking away would be simpler.  
It is trying one more time when no one expects you to.  

---

But staying also has limits.  

And that is important to say.  

It is not about enduring pain without purpose.  
It is not about losing yourself just to keep something alive.  

It is about choosing consciously:  

“This is worth trying one more time.”  

---

If I thought of it as a photograph, it would not be a grand image.  

It would be something much simpler:  

Someone sitting in silence.  
A conversation that has not ended.  
A door that remains open.  

Nothing spectacular.  

But full of meaning.  

---

The person who stays does not always receive recognition.  

No one applauds the invisible effort of continuing to try.  
No one measures the accumulated exhaustion behind that decision.  

Because from the outside, it looks simple.  

But from the inside…  
it is a different story.  

---

Staying is uncomfortable.  

It means facing what is unresolved.  
It means holding difficult conversations.  
It means accepting that things do not always flow as expected.  

---

But it is also a way of caring.  

Caring for what matters.  
Caring for what has roots.  
Caring for what still has potential.  

---

Perhaps growing up is also learning to distinguish between when to leave…  
and when to stay a little longer.  

Not out of fear.  
Not out of habit.  

But out of conviction.  

---

Because the world is not only built through beginnings.  

It is also sustained by people who choose not to walk away at the first sign of difficulty.  

---

And even if no one applauds it…  

staying, when everything pushes you to leave,  
is also a way of loving.

---

With this, this chapter comes to an end, and I say goodbye. Let me know in the comments what you think, and if you want to support it, it will be greatly appreciated.

The images used are from Pixabay, and I use Google Translate for the English version.

body.title: Maturity helps us take responsibility
body.body:
Scifi multiverse week 62 edition 2. We talk about accountability in this edition and I am glad to partake because I see this topic as a great. Kudos to our able moderators for coming up with such great topic.
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUkDczuRr6yQxUwJFdCUjXqkCABHkMhmjU3uvCF1fa5tD/1000190920.jpg 
This image belongs to me.

Accountability is one great virtue I believe that everyone should have because it will go along way to help us in our relationship with other. This is also maturity if you ask me, because is only a matured man or woman at heart that will accept his or her responsibility and do the needful. Most times we see people shifting blames, making it look like others are responsible for their failure or inability to do something. But in real sense they are responsible and will not accept it because they want to be the hero. 

A TRUE LIFE STORY 

let me share with the house something I experienced with someone who is a very big victim of our topic. When I first met this person he made me believe that everyone around him was wrong and he was the right. I foolishly support him and spoke against the others thinking that they made him fail instead of helping him succeed in life. Whenever we stay together he keeps pointing to me what others did that made him fail, how he is very good at what he does and what have you. He also told me that when ever he keeps money it will disappear and he doesn't know who is responsible. This is a full grown man who should be responsible for his own life still pointing fingers at others for his failure.

I took pity on him and encourage my husband to bring him home so that we can see how to help him. Little did I know that he was responsible for all the failures in his life and business. He is the type you can't advice. He have everything figured out and yet he will still fail. But he will make it look like you are responsible. He came to stay with us and it didn't take me one month to discover who he really is. He spends money when he should not. Closes his shop at any given time he wishes. He is very good at disappointing his customers and Chase them away. Most of his customers ran away from his shop and he lost everything. The shop in question was gotten for him by my husband and he started doing laundry: washing clothes and drying them for people. The day he left the shop my husband and I was not aware. He sold out all the properties in the shop to someone else and relocated with nothing to his name. He did not stay up to five months before coming back to start life all over again. Since then my husband decided to let him be so that he won't blame us for the next failure because he have included our names in the people that refused to help him and allowed him fall. 

In conclusion, taken responsible helps us to do the right thing and not see people are responsible for our failure.

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@adaezeinchrist/maturity-helps-us-take-responsibility--2qn)

body.title: 362k SPS reached! The climb continues.
body.body:
I've reached a new all-time high in SPS, 362k in stake. It's a significant number (nothing compared to the big whales) and I want to continue increasing it in the coming months. 400k is definitely the next step! I've used some SPS to purchase ESCALATION packs, but from now on I'll use all my SPS exclusively to increase my stash!

![1000062590.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/claudio83/23tbHLtaATnWRzRvrT5HMZAeE9vSs62sHTSfwof6hnnAJ7uudUSDbbYK6fLHquUnHj19a.jpg)
___

Looking at the market price today, I see a somewhat unrepresentative value for Splinterlands because I'm certain the potential is so high that it seems foolish not to accumulate the governance token right now. An example of this use case was confirmed by the miniset, which can also be purchased in SPS at a significant discount compared to other payment methods. Over 115 million tokens have been raised so far, if I recall correctly, and there's still room to increase these numbers!

However, SPS will continue to be printed in the coming years, in large quantities at that, and this obviously won't help absorb the circulating supply, which will continue to accumulate. The only way to stem this hemorrhage is for investors and players to help eliminate the token from circulation and automatically increase its value. This could happen sooner or later, and things would obviously greatly accelerate our entire system!

<center>
Thank you for taking the time to read this post. If you haven't signed up to Splinterlands yet, I invite you to give it a try. You can use my [referral link](https://steemmonsters.com?ref=claudio83) </center>

# ITA

Ho raggiunto un nuovo massimo record in SPS, 362k in staking, un numero importante (nulla in confronto alle grandi balene) e che voglio continuare ad incrementare per i prossimi mesi? 400k è sicuramente il prossimo step da raggiungere! Ho utilizzato un po' di SPS per acquistare pacchi ESCALATION ma d'ora in poi utilizzerò tutto gli SPS solo per incrementare la mia scorta!

![1000062590.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/claudio83/23tbHLtaATnWRzRvrT5HMZAeE9vSs62sHTSfwof6hnnAJ7uudUSDbbYK6fLHquUnHj19a.jpg)
___

Se guardo oggi il prezzo sul mercato, beh io vedo un valore poco rappresentativo per Splinterlands perché sono certo che il potenziale è talmente elevato che mi sembra sciocco in questo momento non accumulare il governance token. Un esempio del caso d'uso è stato proprio confermato dal miniset, acquistabile anche in SPS con un sconto elevato rispetto alle altre metodologie di pagamento. Finora sono stati raccolti oltre 115 milioni di token se ben ricordo, e vi è ancora strada per aumentare questi numeri!

SPS però continuerà ad essere stampato nei prossimi anni, in grandi quantità per di più, e ciò non aiuterà ad assorbire ovviamente il circolante che continuerà ad accumularsi. L'unico modo per contenere questa emorragia è l'arrivo d'investitori e giocatori che potranno contribuire ad eliminare il token dalla circolazione ed incrementare in automatico il valore. Ciò potrebbe accadere prima o poi e le cose ovviamente avrebbero una grande accelerazione per tutto il nostro sistema!

<center>
Thank you for taking the time to read this post. If you haven't signed up to Splinterlands yet, I invite you to give it a try. You can use my [referral link](https://steemmonsters.com?ref=claudio83) </center>

body.title: A Proud Dad Moment: My Son’s Epic Elden Ring Finale [ENG/SPA]
body.body:
<div class=text-justify>

He’s finally done it—he reached the end of Elden Ring and defeated the final boss. I have to give credit where it’s due: my oldest son is the one who pulled this off. I’m not the biggest fan of the game myself, but in honor of his achievement, I’ve decided to post the video of his final battle. Believe it or not, this journey took him exactly four years.
>#### Padre Orgulloso: El épico final de mi hijo en Elden Ring
>Finalmente se ha llegado al final de Elden Ring y derrotado su jefe final. Debo destacar que quién lo ha hecho es mi hijo mayor, no soy tan fan de este juego, pero en honor a el y su proesa e decidido publicar el vídeo de su batalla final, ya que esto le tomo exactamente 4 años, si así como lo leen.

<center>   
![1000346842.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielcarrerag/23swXQgUNzHCUaoqVQ7xJsMWUUjSApjCzgkGyzcvzGpiGuHbnAkuDqtEL2XdT9CL4roht.gif)
 </center>

You might be wondering why it took so long. When he first started, he got caught up in the launch hype. Being a huge fan of medieval lore, he thought this would be a great choice, but he ran into the same surprise every \

newcomer faces: a brutally complex game with difficult combat mechanics.
>Se preguntarán porque le tomo tanto tiempo. Bueno, cuando el quiso jugar este juego, se dejó llevar por la emoción de su lanzamiento y al ser tan fanático de las historias medievales, pensó que este sería una gran opción  para jugar, pero se llevo la sorpresa que todo novato del los Soul se encuentra, un juego complejo de mecánicas de combate difíciles.

<center> 
![1000346814.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielcarrerag/23tkhYojwsKLQ7tovNs36ZAU8qBti2biFfmKYCCNEvYKp1ohcAsFsWJ13fb2c8hdiDE9X.jpg)
Evidence of the game purchase date
   </center>

On top of that, Elden Ring has a deep system for upgrades and builds that requires a lot of attention—hours upon hours of hunting for the best items, endless rune farming, and facing countless bosses just to get the right gear. Exploring one of the largest maps I’ve ever seen can easily overwhelm a 12-year-old.
>A esto le sumamos que Elden Ring tiene un sistema de mejoras y ajustes complejo que requiere mucha atención, horas y horas de búsqueda de los mejores ítems, farmeo interminable de runas, enfrentamiento a incontables jefes para ganar los mejores ítems, exploración basta de unos de los mapas más grandes que he visto, todo este facilmen5puede abrumar a un jovencito de solo 12 años.

<center>   
![1000346846.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielcarrerag/23tRvj1AecuPN8t7d2Xh8yU2K5scXWdrdr5ssnXtXYH4t9WrWNV3JCSRmbMJbRtXkzpjm.gif)
 </center>


Over time, he kept playing as he matured and began to understand the game better. I often had to encourage and support him; other times, I actually had to nag him because he’d start playing other games and forget about this one. Finally, now that he’s older and has more skill with the Souls genre, he decided to finish it.
>Por eso con el pasar del tiempo lo fue jugando mientras maduraba y lo entendía, muchas veces me tocó alentarle y apoyarle, otras regañarle porque se ponía a pasar otros juegos y este lo olvidaba, hasta que por fin decidió terminarlo, ya con más edad y destreza para enfrentar un Soul.

<center>   
![1000346844.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielcarrerag/23tGcNQxUYCFFE56E9qr6UxYTfngfcLvdTv5vu2YCeZFkTcKJ6broRKQEubSrSMF1Uyg5.gif)
 </center>

To beat the boss, he realized he needed to swap his armor for better stats—specifically a helmet and boots with higher defense and a chest piece with solid Holy damage negation, since that’s the boss's primary attribute. He used max-level weapons focused on Bleed damage: a +25 Blood Nagakiba and the Rivers of Blood katana, which has a special skill for rapid successive attacks.
>Para vencer al jefe le tocó entender que habia que cambiar la armadura a una mejor estadísticas. Usar un casco y botas con mejor defensa y un Peto con buena protección contra daño santo, ya que esta es la principal característica del jefe. Las armas al nivel maximo cuya cualidad principal es sangrado. Una es la Nagakiba de Sangre +25 la otra la katana roja que se llama Ríos de Sangre, tiene la habilidad especial de sangrado que hace ataques sucesivos rápidos.

<center> 
![1000346843.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielcarrerag/23t7BGgrhF7gcChdvL7ispww8hmvM77ts2Lmw29HTg9tu73LCDdUcu3nU8doBA9gDhf9k.gif)
   </center>


This was crucial because he equipped the Winged Sword Insignia talisman (found in Stillwater Cave) to boost those successive hits. He also used the Haligdrake Talisman +2 to reduce Holy damage, which you get in the Mohgwyn Palace area. To top it all off, he used the Flask of Wondrous Physick with Dexterity and Strength tears to maximize his weapon damage.
>Esto fue importante porque en los talismanes se debe colocar uno que potencia los ataques sucesivos, llamado Insignia de Espada Alada, que se encuentra en la Cueva de Agua estancada, venciendo al jefe. El otro talisman que se coloca, reduce el daño santo llamado Draco Santo +2, al vencer al jefe del Palacio de Mohgwyn. A todo eso le sumo el uso del Frasco de Cataplasma asombrosa, con lágrima de destreza y fuerza para potenciar el daño de las armas.

<center>  
![1000346819.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielcarrerag/23wWu2yEunNtM4fYVfa6SA6PoPTioSZZjaQ83jAwdkPyA7jsRoqsNnUMQ5RYVFmHbzumM.jpg)
![1000346815.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielcarrerag/23wg8s39z2b6rs4jP1EWVWfFDNjGKzq2Y34U6knB7AULfvrxHu5fp3yzpt1QJ1aeCv3Wq.jpg)
  </center>

The ultimate reward for winning is the Sacred Relic Sword, obtained by trading in the Remembrance you receive from the boss. Plus, you finally claim the Elden Ring and become Elden Lord. He pulled this off at level 159. It was an incredible fight; we were both jumping for joy at the end because of how hard it was and because it was the culmination of a years-long journey.
>La gran recompensa es por vencer el Espada de Reliquia Sagrada que se obtiene al intercambiar el recuerdo que recibes al vencer al jefe. Además de hacerte con el Anillo de Elden que te convierte en el señor de Elden. Esto se logró con un nivel de 159. Fue un combate emocionante, al final brincamos de emoción los dos, porque costó bastante vencerlo y por los años de tardo en hacerlo. 

***

自从Sheya进入一年级，学习任务就重了不少。周一到周五基本没有属于自己的自由时间，每天做完作业，就得去练字。周六上午要去画画，下午大多在家继续赶作业，只有周日这一天可以放松。所以即便我在周六晚上有四节课的情况下，第二天仍然愿意带她出去放放风，让她好好放松一下，至少在心理上给她疏解疏解压力。

以往出门放松基本都是按我的意愿来，大多就是去商场逛吃逛吃。这一次，我和点哥计划好带Sheya去奈尔宝玩。其实早就想带她去了，没想到一直拖到现在。

奈尔宝是一家大型室内儿童乐园，在成都有好几家分店。入园需要购买门票，两大一小在美团的团购价是220元，相比之前降价了不少。我们提前团购好票，大概中午时间入园。

在前台验完券后，每个人都会佩戴一个手环，手环上带有二维码，扫码即可进入园区。第一次来没经验，不知道需要穿防滑袜，要是早点做好攻略，就能省下这笔钱了。好在价格也不算贵，也就十多块钱。

佩戴好手环后，小朋友还会领到一张打卡卡，参与场内部分项目可以集章，集齐5个章就能兑换小奖品。

里面的游玩项目其实挺丰富的。刚进去有自主读书区，还有换装区、职业体验区，各种场景搭建得很细致，比如模拟超市、收银台，还有模拟给奶牛挤牛奶的体验项目等。

往里走还有手工区和烘焙区，另外还设有专门的讲故事区域，每个时段都会有工作人员带领些孩子们进行绘本阅读，简直是解放了大人。从左侧楼梯上去，是另一块游玩区，设有滑梯等设施。

刚一进去，Sheya这个也想摸，那个也想玩。直到走到中心看见巨大的滑梯，她赶紧跑上楼去，从上面滑了下来。这时我心里才不由得感慨，这孩子真的长大了。以前她总是胆小，连滑梯都不敢玩，走到上面还要人牵着才行。

---

For the best experience view this post on [Liketu](https://liketu.com/@mrspointm/47p1i1-1)
