body.title: Triada de dientes estrellados || Triad of starring teeth (Part I)
body.body:
![1000945043.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23wCGJA9vW637a1zUCzCrou8yhRTdPKMZxZ1X2FyRz2QZ1Y9V9opTvctUyK9DtRJy4Lwt.jpg) ![colorido (2).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/EqfMmY8yEq5LHeoFpS7iEadNv2dkKxnS7Xx7BVvVGfq7YstqehGVhibw6QoCwjWQtjC.png)

¡Hola Chicos!

Hoy les contaré un poco de un encargo que me hicieron el mes pasado, bastante especial y que disfruté mucho hacer. Creo que les he comentado que he pintado varias veces la noche estrellada, uno de los cuadros más famosos a nivel mundial y que en los últimos años ha ganado mucha más popularidad por las redes. Un día recibí un mensaje de una cliente a la que le he realizado varios trabajos. Ella me comentó que quería unos cuadros para su consultorio odontológico pero no quería los típicos dientes sino algo mucho más artístico. Estuvimos debatiendo sobre las ideas y quedamos de acuerdo en hacer una triada de cuadros con dientes, todos con fondo similar al cuadro de la noche estrellada y uno con un paisaje veneciano.

Hi everyone!

Today I'll tell you a little about a commission I received last month, a rather special one that I really enjoyed doing. I think I've mentioned that I've painted The Starry Night several times, one of the most famous paintings in the world, which has gained even more popularity in recent years thanks to social media. One day I received a message from a client for whom I've done several pieces. She told me she wanted some paintings for her dental office, but she didn't want the typical teeth; she wanted something much more artistic. We discussed the ideas and agreed to do a trio of paintings featuring teeth, all with a background similar to The Starry Night, and one with a Venetian landscape.
![colorido (2).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/EqfMmY8yEq5LHeoFpS7iEadNv2dkKxnS7Xx7BVvVGfq7YstqehGVhibw6QoCwjWQtjC.png)
![1000945033.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23vsQDDAVubqeUWoX7pkEtJHx6bPobBNTgmtH3hFiK1tRYQQut6jMgTs7v5p1QMai18sr.jpg) Ella me pidió presupuesto y me comentó que ella me haría llegar los lienzos, así que le pase mis precios y ella aceptó. De ahí esperé unos días hasta que por fin pudo entregarlos. Era mi primera vez trabajando con estos lienzos comerciales y no sabía que tal sería la experiencia. De verdad me daba mucha curiosidad saber cómo se comportaría el material. Así que retiré los empaques y fui trazando uno a uno los bocetos de los dientes. La idea es que todos tuvieran cierta similitud para que pudieran complementarse.
![1000945035.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23x1Azewn88bj5wW1EzD9ahBc5drxeVG1L5vMYB73aY4HqVKaGUVnnTjqSK8ec9j7YRpu.jpg) She asked me for a quote and said she would send me the canvases, so I gave her my prices and she agreed. Then I waited a few days until she was finally able to deliver them. It was my first time working with these commercial canvases and I didn't know what the experience would be like. I was really curious to see how the material would behave. So I removed the packaging and started sketching the teeth one by one. The idea was that they would all have a certain
![colorido (2).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/EqfMmY8yEq5LHeoFpS7iEadNv2dkKxnS7Xx7BVvVGfq7YstqehGVhibw6QoCwjWQtjC.png)
![1000945034.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23wX3KypEpyS3n3d356CT2j5DDGzXGJ99uVqamrWQ2j1vqfrt2WMzrsPThbbn4DBMTZNL.jpg) Al tener los 3 bocetos listos comencé a pintar uno a uno. Al principio da un poco de miedo agregar pintura pero una vez se rompe el hielo, me lleno de confianza y el resto se siente mucho más relajado.
![1000945036.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23xVCmzgzER1Dremw476ccBvpnp7AE4KbY8abdVW76jgDU6DzLyqETQuBfc7dShj4aGKV.jpg) Once I had the three sketches ready, I started painting them one by one. At first, adding paint is a little scary, but once I break the ice, I gain confidence and the rest feels much more relaxed.
![colorido (2).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/EqfMmY8yEq5LHeoFpS7iEadNv2dkKxnS7Xx7BVvVGfq7YstqehGVhibw6QoCwjWQtjC.png)
![1000945038.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23wqdv2s42FoT3CVStmnW68ZPogFmMyQbWWwSNfHyWkzwzzhaq3eLc4H1JMW8szLxMvPS.jpg) El proceso para pintar este primer cuadro fue interrumpido por la falta de electricidad, así que demoré un poco más de lo pensado porque no podía trabajar a oscuras y con calor. Aún así logré hacerlo super rápido. Me encanta hacer mal detalles del cielo pero lo que más disfrute fue hacer el diente con sus diferentes matices. Así fue como terminé el este primer cuadro, en un próximo post les seguiré mostrando como fue el proceso de los otros 3 cuadros, que créanme eran uno mejor que el otro.
![1000945032.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23wqgaKZGFtPfYJdUsPYj8q1i5TWtFCPrrRuCDYgS7E97RgWqZD6Xgh4RNQgSV37ah97m.jpg) The process of painting this first picture was interrupted by a power outage, so it took me a little longer than expected because I couldn't work in the dark and heat. Even so, I managed to finish it super fast. I love messing up details in the sky, but what I enjoyed most was painting the tooth with its different shades. That's how I finished this first painting. In a future post, I'll continue showing you the process of the other three paintings, which, believe me, were all better than the last.
![colorido (2).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/EqfMmY8yEq5LHeoFpS7iEadNv2dkKxnS7Xx7BVvVGfq7YstqehGVhibw6QoCwjWQtjC.png)

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/BIrki8th-cvx2.png
¡Gracias por leer, comentar y votar mi contenido! Espero haya sido de tu agrado y provecho. Un gran abrazo a todos, y nos leemos en un próximo post • Lakrearte en Hive • Att: Estefania Garcia ♥
![Banner (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/Eoc9Pc2jLqxnjQfBXKUXRL5bvNPwyxeQkBQUdS3nHsKdgJdfrHmJ7dxx5KQp53eW8tJ.jpg) Imágenes y separadores de mi autoría Portada editada en Canva Fotografías tomadas con un Moto G31 Texto traducido en Google ImTranslate v.14.27bocedjdjjd fk

body.title: Злякатися морозу у квітні
body.body:
Прогнози синоптиків на сьогоднішню ніч в наших краях були жорсткими: до мінус 5 градусів морозу, і це в повітрі! Ну, думаю, капець настане всім моїм квіточкам у квітнику. Адже вже всі посходили, і багато які зібралися дати цвіт. З півоній вже має бутони рання, та що червоного кольору. Решта цих пишних красунь червоніють молодими пагонами, які ніби-то не дуже бояться морозу. Але ж -5! Хтозна...
Посходили аліуми, в деяких із них також є бутони. Ну як їх ото залишити наодинці з морозом? Треба захистити.
Головні квіти клумби - гортензії - особливо широколисті - намагаюся зберегти не дивлячись ні на що. Так же ж хочеться зробити під плотом увесь ряд із цих примхливих квітів. Широколисті у мене і так на ніч вкривалися ковпаками з агроволокна. Але цього разу я ще й сіна додала всередину, і зверху додатково обмотала. Тільки б не замерзли квіткові бутони!
Троянди, теж страх перед морозом. Вони тільки-тільки повипускали довгенькі перші гілочки із бруньок. Такі новенькі, м'якенькі, соковиті... Одразу ж як скло стануть від морозу. То я і їх сіном гарненько вкрила.
Отже, вечором маємо таку картину:

![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valentinalife/EppKhuh7jiwvdc64bNq6h2LNCmNsrct5pnzFTwrHHyhnNb9NviEjwMs1FZ6LBnevT4j.jpg)

![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valentinalife/23uFW8uoWe7PeyU5ZVrQFAYwHc4DM6GXJ8Mx8sxNMiZmyhfpkmwhXcpMq7wFnPgKJv9T6.jpg)

![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valentinalife/23uFXvUskN3iQfA7UfS7y6LgDevAJFx3umkTbyGxrM7Mfogiret3UnGH73oEqkqQvgHNU.jpg)

Вранішній вид із вікна сказав, що морозу не було. Ні в повітрі, ні на землі. Але свою 'роздягнену' після цуценят собачку я одягнула, бо холодно. І ми на прогулянці побачили перші квіти аличі. Отже, весна іде, весні дорогу!😍

![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valentinalife/EonmUxW3LnTsEfDwaTJLogXmjsR3gaj36VBDtZ4KT5EQEUBQ3uMYnQhk64LKzkZ17As.jpg)

body.title: Reflections in an Empty Room (Part 4). Entry for Reflection Hunters contest-SMARP- round 266 [EN/ES]
body.body:
### Reflections in an Empty Room (Part 4)

---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUxsYGwQJTVdTRna4AYh4vQ8fZujNbm5fuWt9UNRH7QeY/screenshot_20260405_155526_01.jpg)

---

Hello, friends of the #ShadowHunters community, thanks to our friend @olgavita for inviting us to this initiative in her Reflection Hunters Contest – Round 266.

---

These days, the room continues to be a silent witness to this routine that repeats itself between work and distance. Time here feels different, marked by pauses, by absences, and by the small details that often go unnoticed.

---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaGhjauhwtGLiwx5B2gSbsugZoX34u9bDWCGsAKs1TrG6/screenshot_20260405_155520_01.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaUQNnSX9KGiprnUDifCDWwhqX4SBfXm2uWYwNDopnZLx/screenshot_20260405_155532_01.jpg)

---

This time, the reflection appears in the large bathroom mirror, in the sink area. There is no human figure in it, only objects: a hair dryer, a small mirror, part of the sink, and the marble countertop. A simple composition, almost minimal, yet full of quiet presence.

---

What caught my attention was precisely that absence. No movement, no faces, just the stillness of objects that seem to wait. The reflection does not tell a story directly, but it suggests one. In a space temporarily inhabited, even the most ordinary elements begin to feel different, as if they were part of a paused scene.

---

The photos were taken with my mobile phone, and for the English version I used Google Translate.

- - - 
***Spanish Version***
- - -

---

## Reflejos en una habitación vacía (Parte 4)  


---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUxsYGwQJTVdTRna4AYh4vQ8fZujNbm5fuWt9UNRH7QeY/screenshot_20260405_155526_01.jpg)

---

Hola, amigos de la comunidad #ShadowHunters, gracias a la amiga @olgavita por convocarnos a esta iniciativa en su Reflection Hunters Contest – Round 266.

---

Por estos días, la habitación sigue siendo testigo silencioso de esta rutina que se repite entre el trabajo y la distancia. El tiempo aquí parece transcurrir de otra manera, marcado por las pausas, las ausencias y los pequeños detalles que muchas veces pasan desapercibidos.

---
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaGhjauhwtGLiwx5B2gSbsugZoX34u9bDWCGsAKs1TrG6/screenshot_20260405_155520_01.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaUQNnSX9KGiprnUDifCDWwhqX4SBfXm2uWYwNDopnZLx/screenshot_20260405_155532_01.jpg)

---

Esta vez, el reflejo aparece en el espejo grande del baño, en el área del lavamanos. No hay figura humana en él, solo objetos: una secadora de pelo, un espejo pequeño y parte del lavamanos con su meseta de mármol. Una composición sencilla, casi minimalista, pero llena de una presencia silenciosa.

---

Lo que más me llamó la atención fue precisamente esa ausencia. No hay movimiento, no hay rostros, solo la quietud de objetos que parecen esperar. El reflejo no cuenta una historia de forma directa, pero la sugiere. En un espacio habitado de forma temporal, incluso lo más cotidiano empieza a sentirse diferente, como si todo formara parte de una escena en pausa.

---

Las fotos fueron tomadas con el móvil y para la versión en inglés utilicé el traductor de Google.

body.title: Klimaanlagen: Kein Sterbenswort im Hitzeplan
body.body:
>In vielen hitzegeplagten Staaten sind Klimaanlagen erste Wahl zur Herstellung lebenserhaltender Bedingungen. In Deutschland aber wird schon ihre Erwähnung strikt gemieden.


Deutschland heizt sich stärker auf als alle anderen Weltregionen. Deutschland ist älter und bei Hitze vulnerabler. Deutschlands Wetterkarten sind bei 25 Grad blutrot, bei 33 glühen sie violett. Deutschland ist europaweit das einzige Land, das über eine ausgeklügelte
>Deutsche Anpassungsstrategie an den Klimawandel (DASK) verfügt. Die zeigt unumwunden, wie wichtig eine vorsorgende Politik und eine frühzeitige und effektive Warnung der Bevölkerung sind.

>Die tödliche Gefahr 

Hinter jeder Sommeridylle lauert eine tödliche Gefahr, die mit jedem Jahr bedrohlicher wird. Laut Robert-Koch-Institut starben 2023 in Deutschland etwa 4.500 Menschen an den Folgen extremer Hitze,  2024 waren es nur 3.000, aber jeder Tote ist einer zu viel. Und während die Erde auf eine Zukunft zusteuert, in der Milliarden Menschen außerhalb der habitablen Klimazone leben müssen, jenem Bereich, in dem der menschliche Körper dauerhaft überleben kann, wird Vorbereitung großgeschrieben.  

Der zweite Aktionsplan Anpassung zur Umsetzung der Deutschen Anpassungsstrategie nennt die zwingende Notwendigkeit, Hitzeaktionspläne (HAP) zu erstellen. Die  Bund/Länder-Arbeitsgruppe \
(BMU 2017) erstellt. In diesem Kontext steht auch das <a href=\

>ReFoPlan-Forschungsprojekt „Deutsche Anpassungsstrategie an den Klimawandel (DAS), das über Wirksamkeitsanalysen von gesundheitlichen Anpassungsmaßnahmen im Rahmen von Hitzeaktionsplänen sowie Klimaanpassungsdiensten herausfinden will, wie Deutschland am besten überleben kann.

>Die Welt setzt auf Klimaanlagen 

Doch das wäre zu einfach, weil dort sehr viel falsch gemacht wird. In Brasilien etwa besitzen etwa 20 Prozent der Haushalte Klimaanlagen. Laut der Internationalen Energieagentur (IEA) könnten sich diese Zahlen bis 2050 vervierfachen, denn 2023 wurden in Brasilien im ersten Halbjahr 1,48 Millionen Klimageräte verkauft. In den Südstaaten der USA, in Mexiko, Thailand, Indien und auf den Philippinen, überall steht die Klimaanlage  im Waffenschrank der Hitzebekämpfung. Rund 90 Prozent der amerikanischen Haushalte verfügen über ein Klimagerät, auch in Südeuropa, wo Hitzewellen schon lange grassieren, besitzen etwa 60 Prozent der Haushalte Klimaanlagen.

In Deutschland, das bisher ein gemäßigtes Klima genoss, ist der Umgang mit den Anlagen Neuland. Und er soll es auch bleiben. Schon der inzwischen ausgeschiedene Gesundheitsminister Karl Lauterbach, der den ersten bundesweiten

>Hitzeschutzplan hatte erarbeiten lassen, verzichtet in dem Papier auf jeden Hinweis auf die Existenz einer ausgereiften Technologie, die in wärmeren und heißen Regionen die Waffe der Wahl zum Erhalt von Bedingungen ist, die Menschen das Überleben ermöglichen.

>Dämmung und Sonnenschirme 

Lauterbachs Entscheidung steht bis heute. Deutschland setzt auf Dämmung und Sonnenschirme, auf Fächer für Alte und hitzefrei für Kinder. Brunnen und Trinkanlagen sollen gebaut werden, Kirchen ihre Türen öffnen, um als Zuflucht für Hitzeopfer zu dienen. 

Die einzige Technologie, die wirklich hilft, bleibt jedoch erstaunlich unsichtbar: die Klimaanlage. Allenfalls als ergänzende Maßnahme werden sie betrachtet, insbesondere in kritischen Bereichen wie Krankenhäusern, Pflegeeinrichtungen oder öffentlichen Gebäuden, um vulnerable Gruppen vor Hitzewellen zu schützen. Im Alltag sollen kühlende Grünflächen, Sonnencreme, bessere Isolierung und begrünte Fassaden die von den Gemeinden zu erarbeitenden Klimaanpassungskonzepte zum Erfolg führen.

Dem liegt eine Abwägung zugrunde, die zwei Werte aneinander messen musste. Extreme Hitze bringt erhöhte Sterblichkeit und sinkende Arbeitsproduktivität, Menschen leiden und die Aggressivität steigt. Doch Klimaanlagen, einst ein Luxus, heute ein schnell an jede Fassade geschraubter Kasten aus chinesischer Produktion, gelten als energieintensiv.

>Klimaanlagen als Klimakiller  

Sie sind damit nur kurzfristig ein Schutz vor Hitzeschlägen. Langfristig aber, so argumentiert die Bundesregierung hinter verschlossenen Türen, erhöhen sie die Klimalast, führen zu noch mehr Erwärmung und die müsste dann mit noch mehr und noch leistungsfähigeren Klimaanlagen bekämpft werden. Die Geräte heizen die Städte schon heute zusätzlich auf, da die warme Abluft die \nUmgebungstemperatur erhöht. Die innovative Kaltluftpumpe, 1902 von Willis Carrier erfunden, kann Räume effizient um 10 bis 15 Grad abkühlen, während Placebo-Maßnahmen wie Begrünung oder Rollläden laut Studien maximal auf 3,2 Grad kommen. Doch die Wärme aus der Kliamanlage muss irgendwohin. Und so landet sie im öffentlichen Raum.

Kein Weg, den Deutschland gehen will. Eine Rolle spielt dabei auch die Angst vor gesellschaftlicher Spaltung. In einem Land, das mit die höchsten Strompreise der Welt hat, wären von einer offiziellen Empfehlung zur Einführung von Klimaanlagen vor allem die ärmeren Bevölkerungsschichten betroffen. Sie können sich die Anschaffung einer privaten Klimaanlage nicht leisten. Schon gar nicht aber deren  Betrieb.

>Siesta, Leinenkleidung und Sportverbote 

Folglich setzt die Regierung auf Verhaltensanpassungen: Siesta, Leinenkleidung und Sportverbote zur Mittagszeit, nicht grillen, kein Alkohol. Feuchte Tücher, die Wasser auf natürliche Weise verdampfen, könne helfen, aber auch amtliche Warnungen, das Haus nicht zu verlassen. Ein  wenig ist es auch ein Opfer, das Deutschland bringt. Weltweit verbrauchen Klimaanlagen heute schon etwa zehn des Stroms. Machte sich auch Deutschland abhängig von der Technologie, die nach dem Zweiten Weltkrieg wurde sie zum Symbol des amerikanischen Traums wurde, wäre das Weltklima in noch größerer Gefahr als ohnehin schon. 

Die Bundesregierung kann für ihre Empfehlungen, lieber Dachbegrünung, Entsiegelung, Trinkbrunnen und Verhaltenshinweise zu nutzen, auf eine breite Mehrheit setzen. Fast ein Viertel der Deutschen lehnt Klimaanlagen Umfragen zufolge wegen ihres CO₂-Fußabdrucks ab. Zudem gehen die Kosten für die Geräte in den Bereich von 5.000 Euro oder mehr – für viele \nHaushalte unerschwinglich, obwohl der Absatz 2023 um zwölf Prozent stieg, ohne dass es staatliche Zuschüsse gab.

>Umweltgefahr Kältemittel 

Die Zahl der Hitzetoten wird als kleines Problem gesehen, auch verglichen mit den Umweltgefahren, die die meist verwendeten Kältemittel Propan oder Isobutan mit sich bringen. Beide nehmen Wärme im Innenraum auf, die wird durch einen Kompressor verdichtet und anschließend über einen Kondensator nach außen abgegeben. In Deutschland gilt das als wenig solidarisch, auch aus historischen Gründen, wie der Klimatologe Herbert Haase mutmaßt. Deutsche hätten ihre Häuser stets so gebaut, dass  auf Wärmeerhalt ausgelegt seien - mit dicken Wänden, kleinen Fenster, Doppelverglasung. 

Das, so hofften viele, sagt der Chef des Climate Watch Institutes im sächsischen Grimma, müsse auch umgekehrt helfen. Klimaanlagen hingegen gülten vielen als unnatürlich oder als Symbol eines verschwenderischen Lebensstils nach amerikanischem Vorbild. \
Die Kosten aber schrecken ab: Mobile Klimageräte verbrauchen etwa 500 Kilowattstunden pro Jahr, ein Kostenposten von rund 200 Euro jährlich. \

>Klimaethiker raten ab 

Bis ins politische Berlin ist natürlich bekannt, was Klimaethiker raten. 2023 starben in Deutschland 3.000 Menschen an Hitze, eine Zahl, die durch Kühlung hätte reduziert werden können. Die Klimaanlagen weder im Nationalen Hitzeschutzplan noch in den Handlungsempfehlungen des angesehenen Robert-Koch-Instituts zu erwähnen, war denn auch keine einfache Entscheidung. Müssen Ältere oder Kranke früher sterben, weil Krankenhäuser und Pflegeheime auf Beschluss der Regierung auch künftig auf elektrische Helfer zur Absenkung der mörderischen Sommertemperaturen verzichten sollen?

Einige sicher, sagt Herbert Haase. Doch seit dem wegweisenden Verfassungsgerichtsurteil, das die Politik verpflichtet, beim Klimaschutz auch kommende Generationen im Blick zu behalten, sei die Entscheidung alternativlos. Das Opfer der Hitzetoten von heute, die sterben, weil mögliche, aber klimaschädliche Maßnahmen  vermeiden werde, könne längerfristig womöglich mehr Leben retten.

>Die Debatte als Gefahr 

Vor diesem Hintergrund scheint es angebracht, keine Debatte über Klimaanlagen zu führen. So lange die Geräte als Klimakiller wahrgenommen würden, obwohl moderne Anlagen durchaus auch problemlos mit erneuerbaren Energien oder Überschussstrom betrieben werden können, werde eine Diskussion darüber vermieden, ob die aktuellen gesundheitlichen Kosten der Hitze – etwa 4.500 Tote im Rekordjahr 2023 – die Umweltbelastung durch Klimaanlagen überwögen. 

Hitze ist so trotzdem noch nicht sozial gerecht. Beispielsweise, sagt der Forscher, profitieren in Spanien vor allem wohlhabende Haushalte von Klimaanlagen, während sozial Schwache unter der Hitze leiden. Eine Spaltung, die ganz Europa träfe, würde etwa die EU-Kommission die Ampeln für Klimaanlagen auf Grün stellen. Haase mahnt zwar, dass \
spare und er bezieht in diese Rechnung ausdrücklich energieeffiziente Kühlsysteme ein. Doch auf  Klimaanlagen zu setzen, schaffe eben auch neue Probleme.

, sagt der Wissenschaftler. Deutschland sei
 auf diese Herausforderung bislang nur unzureichend vorbereitet, bislang
 aber gelinge es, Bürgerinnen und Bürger zureichend vor der zunehmenden 
Hitze zu schützen, indem Hilfe durch kommunale Klimaanpassungsstrategien
 versprochen werde. Dass mehr Stadtgrün und Sonnenschutz, die 
Entsiegelung von Flächen ein Verbot für Schottergärten und Kunstrasen 
nicht ausreichen werde, zeichne sich ab. \
Die Frage danach, was hätte \ngemacht werden müssen, werde sich aber erst in einigen Jahren stellen.  \n\

, 
sagt Herbert Haase. Viele der noch von Karl Lauterbach geplanten 
kostenlosen Trinkwasserstationen seien dann aber sicherlich ohnehin noch
 nicht installiert. \

It is encouraging to see an effort to improve transparency through the implementation of multisig and the definition of KPIs based on the SMART methodology, which is a necessary step toward professionalism.

However, the current approach still seems to overlook the key driver of any successful network: attracting investors and generating massive economic activity.

For Hive to truly scale, “brand awareness” is not enough; we need to compete directly with the most powerful EVMs on the market, which dominate the crypto space precisely because they maintain a constant flow of circulating capital and innovative products, especially in the DeFi sector

* Attracting users without purchasing power will not move the needle on price or the ecosystem

* The network needs crypto-native investors seeking real opportunities for profitability, similar to those found on platforms like CoinMarketCap

---

The historical success of products like Splinterlands on Hive demonstrates that massive activity only occurs when there is a functional product that incentivizes the movement of assets.

* If 50% of the shared advertising budget isn’t focused on projects that generate this kind of circulating activity and real retention, we’ll continue to spend resources on onboarding efforts that don’t contribute to the network’s long-term value.

In summary: Fewer low-impact social events and more focus on scalability and competitiveness against high-performance networks. We need to attract those who come to invest, not just those who come to consume the DHF budget.

body.body: @ahmadmanga you’re basically right: subscriptions aren’t evil, but the business model gets greasy fast when companies rely on inertia and friction. The FTC’s [“click-to-cancel” rule](https://www.ftc.gov/news-events/news/press-releases/2024/10/federal-trade-commission-announces-final-click-cancel-rule-making-it-easier-consumers-end-recurring) exists for exactly that reason, and the CFPB has also called out [dark patterns in recurring charges](https://www.consumerfinance.gov/about-us/newsroom/cfpb-issues-guidance-to-root-out-tactics-which-charge-people-fees-for-subscriptions-they-dont-want/). Even on InLeo, people keep circling the same point: unused subs quietly bleed money because people forget or get annoyed into keeping them, like this [reply on hidden subscription costs](https://inleo.io/threads/view/ai-summaries/re-taskmaster4450le-1772663368).  \n\nThe fair version is simple: if it’s easy to sign up, it should be just as easy to leave. Anything else is a trap wearing a SaaS haircut.

title.title: What Happens on a mating day
title.body:
# Hello Hive 


![1000187288.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/EpCBuQ1qbLjVaTDJHpWcDaCzx3bMGiGwLsDrf22hVZ2cqKn9dY8mpfUCwBnqkFVSKGZ.jpg)


I welcome you to my farm blog for the day and I hope that you all are having an amazing morning. 
It was one of the funniest experience yesterday watching the turkey birds in their mating position. It was as if the birds have a meeting to do this excercise on this particular day.
From the picture here, you can see the male birds with their big feathers all opened up while the females who have lesser physique are seen shying away. 


![1000183928.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/Eoc83RyAjSEVtcXsqr63aGyDbgLCk4wunxBpShPVgwfmvwa5ebSxLgr1NiDucrbmMUN.jpg)

In this community and compound everyone has constructed their own small bird cage's for raising their birds. Everyone is tired of purchasing their meat from the market each time they need it. The price of chicken, beef and others have never been so friendly, Hence people figure out how they can assist themselves to these things. 


![1000187259.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/Eoc81hALS66yVpvDfVkTF3SFpWkJ8YkSTkRUe1pW5gvY3U3byMYtKriYVg32GfXn6CY.jpg)
a



The cages are mostly small but can accommodate 5-10Broiler birds or at least 3turkey birds. This is the number owned by each family and in instances where there is an expansion and the birds kays eggs and multiples, we can then enlarge the cage or build bigger one. 



![1000187248.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/EoEqXaJ7cYmJMUsUkoFRasoXHPg1rBY4z3ui5egz6rii3FDtZgoomgrCXpEbhUAcuKS.jpg)

![1000187285.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/Eokf4zkQzszw6Wo9f1kyuW3uiDLMYAcrJ1ywHWxk3HBzw9fqyLX85KVrbG1yeANACvJ.jpg)

Bird's can be raised in different ways and with different feeds depending on the budget at hand. Some family feed their own birds to the left over food from their table. But this is after they have grown past the delicate childhood stages. 

There are both the Agric turkey and the local ones here. And as much as they co habit together we try to avoid a cross breeding between the two types. The engineered ones have faster growth rate than the local ones and .ost times it is easier for those ones to lay eggs and expand on time compared to.


It's our first time of raising turkey birds and in this process we are leaning more about them, their lifestyle, lifecycle and the possibility of making a business out of this if everything works out eventually.

title.title: Indian Cupid butterfly
title.body: > Amidst the calming greenery, I spotted an Indian Cupid butterfly perched gracefully on a purple flower petal. With slow, cautious steps, I approached the butterfly's location. The butterfly I found was very small, almost invisible. Its color was also very simple, a beautiful blend of gray with black and orange. A color combination that blended perfectly with its surroundings. But beneath that simplicity lay its true beauty.

> The flower wasn't just a resting place, it was a source of life for the tiny butterfly. It replenished its energy with the hidden sweetness of a drop of nectar. The flower appeared fragile yet resilient in welcoming its special guest. Its stamens extended gently, their tips facing the butterfly, as if engaged in conversation.

> It seemed simple, but it actually held profound meaning. There was no bustle or screaming, just the gentle movement of its antennae and wings. Its thin legs gently treaded on the petals, as if it didn't want to disturb its surroundings. When its body is reflected in sunlight, it adds to the extraordinary impression. It looks like no ordinary insect.

title.title: What Is Religion. MCGI TOPIC REVIEW
title.body:
https://youtu.be/M5bB81VCWJw?si=R-LSEl0hkTY58rbw
Religion is the way of worshipping God or a deity. It is a way which mortals try to relate with the spiritual. Religion brings God in our view. Just as we go to school to receive education, religion is a channel where things about God and deities are revealed to man. Religion is not something that is bad. It is something good. Through religion we are reconnected again to God. Man was disconnected from God since when sin came into the world. We need to return back to God. So, religion is that channel that brings us back to God.

Should we accept religion? Yes, let us all receive religion. Let us understand that religion means something that is good to us. Through religion, we are learning about those things that are pleasing to God. Those things that are not equally pleasing to God are also shown to ua as we learn about religion. So, religion is not something that is altogether bad. It is good that we receive religion.

There are several religions in the world. The true religion is the the religion which we have learned from the Bible. The Lord Jesus Christ is the One who set forth the way of God to us. He is the One who has brought us into the true religion.

title.title: My Stress-Free Garden Therapy: Growing Okra, Pechay and String Beans and Choosing Simple Life
title.body:
![Pastel Playful Polaroid Holiday Photo Collage Instagram Post.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/AK6Y6hrF1MAcr9pdjhkpkYZggu1sd4KmV8uWvLcadSfW7S65aTZvWNecWYdvmwd.jpg)

Today, I want to share a more personal story about our small farm this time, from my own experience as someone balancing online work and simple farm life.

I work online, and honestly, there are days when I feel really tired and stressed because of eyes tired and long working hours. That’s why our small garden became my therapy. Every time I step outside, breathe fresh air, and touch the soil, I feel calmer. It helps me slow down and clear my mind.

![k (2).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/242Y3koovXyGYYDzFZcqjng9aEGiUxu51hXNmYkL5xhcKMWj5sLm6wX4xs2nuKgdjC6uZ.jpg)

My husband is a farmer, so planting is already natural for him. He planted string beans and watermelon, and many more while I planted okra and pechay. I chose these because they grow fast, and as a beginner, it makes me happy to see quick results. It gives me motivation to continue.

At first, our goal was simple to have free vegetables for our meals. Just knowing that we can harvest fresh food anytime is already a big help for our family. But later on, we realized we could also sell some of our harvest.

![Pastel Playful Polaroid Holiday Photo Collage Instagram Post (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/AJiytruccogPGHBsQK5U8aZ3xa7onwa6ma8Pgp26ftkPosx12HKHcGnyVohpXRd.jpg)



![Pastel Playful Polaroid Holiday Photo Collage Instagram Post (2).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/AK7xJYEwKUu9V241Xcew78AW4zcNmqz5pG1PsrMzp1KmDsKb6QF7yoEMD3YZMLP.jpg)

One of the happiest moments for me is watching my daughter every morning. She loves okra so much. She just goes to the garden, picks what she wants, and enjoys it. Our garden is very close to our farm house, so it’s easy for her. Seeing her happy with something we planted makes everything worth it.

![IMG_20260329_094017.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23tvXqqJMdBr6csdtvPyTQFQkp9ZxmyfMstACE9fR69FSd7x4BiBtFnktccWYgdaNMZPn.jpg)

String beans became one of our best crops. Many people here really like it, so they are easy to sell. Little by little, we are earning from something that started very small. It may not be a big income yet, but it is rewarding so we can buy what we want like snacks or something meat or fish. 

![G (5).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/244oWbQeQ2eitoh5aqtrpAQ7JYXZvQE3b4sA7UgAmE2jsMUNViNbCdycuMeiBViozwF6S.jpg)

For me, gardening is not just about growing plants it’s also about healing. When I’m in the garden, I forget stress from work. I focus on watering, checking the plants, and appreciating their growth. It teaches me patience and consistency. Just like life, growth takes time.

I’m still learning, and I’m thankful for my husband who guides me. Because of him, everything feels easier. Gardening also became our bonding time as a family.

![IMG_20260329_092903.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23ycwVXXscRtivXWqP1QC9JC3PB4mgP4s8Qu5mUpNbLB2QsyNYs642hDXxhYB7Rq3BVfe.jpg)


![IMG_20260329_092856.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23wqbcy7T7fnBt9r7LChVmEGBt7rF7awLw5XgDu2BH7fbeX6ttAf4vY32LNdpRZRMDtYJ.jpg)


If there’s one thing I can share, it’s this: start small. Even if you are busy or tired, try planting something. It can help not just your daily needs, but also your heart and mind.

![IMG_20260329_103015.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23xKhbGf168tF8YBz7FYzK5eChAoWDbuTneUKpV7c8Nq5nM1DxDysPPdm5aFvjMAV1e3k.jpg)

Thank you so much for reading my story. This is my owned picture, edited in Canva.  Let’s keep growing together.  Have a nice day! ☘️🌿

Un ciempiés glotón
sube a la mesa sin invitación,
se acerca sin limitación 
a un plato con frutas de diversos color. 

Se come la fruta naranja,
también la amarilla clara
y cuando todo acaba,
sin explicación se marcha.

climbs onto the table uninvited,

title.title: 🌿 Garden Update: A Healthy Growth and Today’s Leaf Harvest
title.body:
Today I spent some quiet time in my garden observing how the crops are progressing, and I must say, the improvement over the past few days is very encouraging.
The leafy vegetables are now fuller and more vibrant compared to my last check. The leaves have developed a rich green color, which tells me that the soil is still providing enough nutrients and that the watering routine is working well. Seeing this kind of response from the plants always gives me confidence that the effort I’m putting in is paying off.
As I moved between the rows, I decided to harvest some of the mature leaves. I carefully selected the bigger ones, leaving the younger shoots to continue growing. This way, the plants can keep producing over time instead of being exhausted too quickly.
While harvesting, I paid close attention to the condition of the leaves. I noticed a few minor signs of insect activity on some plants, but it’s still under control. For now, I’ll keep monitoring the situation closely and take action if needed before it spreads further.
Another thing I observed is how dense the plants are becoming. This is a good sign of healthy growth, but it also reminds me that I may need to do some thinning soon to improve air circulation and reduce the risk of disease.
Moments like this — standing in the garden, harvesting fresh leaves, and observing each plant — remind me that farming is a continuous learning process. Every day brings something new to notice and improve.
I’m looking forward to seeing how these crops develop in the coming days, especially as I continue managing their growth and health step by step 🌱

title.title: TOKYO HAS SEEN THIS MOVIE BEFORE. IT DID NOT END WELL.
title.body:
# TOKYO HAS SEEN THIS MOVIE BEFORE. IT DID NOT END WELL.

There is a particular cruelty to Japan's situation right now that gets lost in the daily churn of Hormuz headlines and S&P levels. It is the cruelty of irony made structural. For thirty years, the Bank of Japan could not conjure inflation with every unorthodox instrument known to central banking. Negative rates, yield curve control, asset purchases so vast the BoJ now owns more Japanese government bonds than the rest of the market combined. Nothing worked. The country flatlined at zero, allergic to growth, trapped in a demographic slow bleed, the cautionary tale every Western economist cited when the conversation turned to what prolonged deflation actually looked like from the inside.

And then inflation arrived. Not from wage growth or a domestic demand revival or any of the tidy mechanisms the textbook prescribed. It arrived via a war in the Persian Gulf, $98 Brent, a yen trading near 158 to the dollar, and import costs compounding across an economy that sources roughly 90% of its oil from the Middle East. The Bank of Japan got its inflation. It just got someone else's.

Governor Kazuo Ueda said this week that Japan's financial conditions remain accommodative, that real rates are clearly below zero. Both statements are true. Neither statement tells you what to do about it. The BoJ's short-term policy rate sits at 0.75% — raised there in January after years of agonizing normalization — and markets are now pricing roughly a 70% probability of another hike as early as the April meeting. The logic is straightforward on paper: a weaker yen amplifies imported inflation, which is already running hot underneath the government's fuel and utility subsidy programs. Pull back the subsidies and headline CPI bounces. Do nothing and yen weakness compounds the problem. Hike rates, and you tighten into an economy that has not yet established the domestic demand base to absorb the cost.

Japan's foreign reserves have quietly fallen to $1,374.7 billion from $1,410.7 billion — a decline that reflects increased oil import costs as much as exchange rate management. The Ministry of Finance has escalated its verbal warnings around USD/JPY, suggesting decisive intervention if the pair breaches 160. This is a familiar script. The Ministry warned at 145 in 2022. Then at 150. Then at 152. The thresholds drift upward because the underlying force — a policy rate still among the lowest of any developed market — has not been addressed fast enough to turn the tide. Verbal intervention is the central bank equivalent of a strongly worded letter.

What makes this genuinely difficult, rather than merely complicated, is the interaction of pressures. Higher oil prices raise import costs. Higher import costs weaken real household incomes. A weaker yen raises import costs further. If the BoJ hikes aggressively to defend the yen, it risks strangling a recovery that is still, in 2026, drawing its breath carefully. If it moves slowly, imported inflation spreads from fuel into food into services into wages — not in the virtuous cycle it always wanted, but in the cost-push spiral it spent three decades trying to induce before deciding that was a very bad idea.

The internal BoJ debate has apparently shifted, as of late March, from whether tightening is needed to how quickly it should happen. That is a significant change in framing. But pace is exactly where the errors get made. The hawkish camp argues that waiting risks needing 200 basis points of total hikes by 2027 — the most aggressive cycle since the late 1990s, when the BoJ raised rates prematurely in 2000, caught a deflationary spiral, and spent the next decade reversing the decision. That particular wound took twenty years to fully scar over. The institutional memory in the Marunouchi district is long.

Ueda is not Masaru Hayami, the governor who pulled the trigger in 2000. But the structure of the problem has an uncomfortable family resemblance: external inflationary pressure, fragile domestic recovery, a yen that is becoming a referendum on policy credibility, and a government urging caution. Japan's government subsidy programs on fuel and utilities have been masking headline inflation — a temporary anaesthetic that the BoJ has openly acknowledged distorts its readings. The plan is to introduce new inflation metrics stripping out these policy effects by summer 2026. In the meantime, they are setting policy using a thermometer they know is miscalibrated.

Across the water, the divergence compounds. The Fed is frozen — unable to cut without looking like it is validating an inflationary shock, unable to hike without pushing the US consumer over a cliff it is already standing at the edge of. The ECB sits at 2.15%, holding, watching, issuing communiqués. EUR/USD has drifted to around 1.15, with the dollar benefiting from its structural advantage as both a safe haven and a net energy exporter in a world suddenly very focused on who controls their own barrels. The dollar's exceptionalism narrative — which was supposed to fade as the Fed cut and the rest of the world normalized — has instead been reinflated by the Gulf crisis, and every day Hormuz stays largely closed is another day the yen absorbs the most punishment of any major currency.

The cruel efficiency of all this is that Japan spent its lost decades hoping that inflation would return and drag the country out of its deflationary gravity. Now the Nikkei is down 0.7% on the week, the yen is grinding lower, reserves are shrinking, and the inflation that arrived is the wrong kind — extractive, not generative. It drains household purchasing power rather than building it. It makes the BoJ hike not to celebrate a recovery but to defend a currency.

There is a word for an economy experiencing rising prices and weakening real growth simultaneously. The BoJ spent three decades trying to avoid it in one form. History, with characteristic indifference to irony, has delivered it in another.

---

*Published April 10, 2026*

> Se que he sacado muchos post hablando al respecto de esto, sin embargo, no uno como este en donde si te explicare en detalle que debes tener en cuenta, algunas nuevas mecánicas para multiplicar lo que ganas en GLINT y acelerar tu progreso de forma mucho más rápida que con las estrategias anteriores, lo que les beneficia si es que no estas al tanto de todo lo nuevo que han implementado. Aunque, no es que sea del todo nuevo realmente, pero, quizás muchos no están informados sobre estos cambios y es precisamente lo que quiero compartir en este post. Así que, si quieres saber todas las formas existentes para ganar GLINTS, como acelerar tu progresión y ademas gestionarlos y/o administrarlos de la forma correcta, tienes que leer este post hasta el final, ya que estará realmente interesante, prometo que será muy fácil de entender y digerir, especialmente para los nuevos usuarios, que es lo importante, ya que, necesitamos que esos nuevos usuarios ingresen, puedan conocer el juego y al final se queden por la diversión que genera, pero que adicional pueden generar recompensas reales. **Quédate hasta el final para que aprendas cómo funciona:** ![Separador.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/23u5taptEapzzNue7bMpgSFfTdVR9QsYdtt6rtQonQ5t8iCj5Bh3Xxf1yBs5u9aNdxzNy.png)
# Mecánica de quema de SPS por GLINT
https://i.imgur.com/7u1AW7Q.png

> Ok, como comenté en la introducción, tenemos nuevas mecánicas que, aunque realmente no son tan nuevas, en ninguno de mis anteriores post lo había comentado, y es que ahora tenemos la posibilidad de acelerar nuestra progresión quemando de forma automática nuestro SPS y obtener GLINTS a cambio, esto es muy poderoso, porque anteriormente, este SPS que ganamos generalmente se va de forma automática al “Staking”, lo que generalmente es muy bueno porque aumenta nuestra “Rshare”, en pocas palabras nuestro multiplicador de recompensas, pero: **¿Qué pasa si ese SPS que ganamos por batalla, en lugar de que se vaya al Staking este se queme y ganemos mas GLINTS?** Pues, impulsaremos ese GLINT que solemos ganar, por lo que lo que haremos será multiplicarlos, esto es excelente para aquellos jugadores que quieren priorizar el ganar GLINTS por encima de lo que es el SPS, esto es porque si ya un jugador tiene suficiente SPS y su multiplicador esta al máximo, lo mas sensato es ahora impulsar tus ganancias de GLINT para acelerar tu progreso, que en este caso se trata de conseguir todo el SET de recompensas de “Conclave Arcana”. **Pero, hay aspectos que deben tener en cuenta:** ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/23tmBC5eMQVv2S84hZLjyP31e3LJz1uiet9K4mUdp2Ezmp3ZkRUCzEWnJpCtPZDdhxnFS.png) #####
Aspectos a tener en cuenta

>* **¿Cómo activarlo?** Esta función se activa en el apartado de “Ranked” solo en los formatos “Moderno y Salvaje”, aquí encontraras una especie de “Botón” en la pestaña de recompensas donde puedes activarlo, lo que te permitirá quemar el SPS que ganes en las batallas clasificatorias y obtener en su lugar un impulso bastante interesante de GLINT. > >* **¿Como funciona?** Cuando activas esta función, el sistema lo que hace es duplicar tus participaciones de recompensa, los famosos “Rshares” pero del lado del calculo de GLINT, lo que trae como consecuencia que, aunque no estas recibiendo el SPS que corresponde por batalla ganada, recibirás el doble de progreso con el objetivo de completar finalmente el SET de recompensas. > >* **¿Cuándo es conveniente activarlo?** Esto lo comentaba hace un momento, básicamente dependerá de los intereses que tengas en ese momento, si por ejemplo quieres hacer crecer tus SPS, la idea es que hagas interés compuesto con lo que vayas recibiendo y aumentar tu multiplicador, ahora si tienes muchos SPS, pero no has completado el SET de recompensas de “Conclave Arcana”, entonces tienes que activar el botón de quema de SPS por GLINT para obtener ese impulso.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/EoChdyUgKDFXxDmxGqbuFDXnFL8e4PWa4uCxiJtPPyWqvcEbAnb2vcCrzTGabFrWD6G.png)
# Estrategias de “Gestión de GLINTS” https://i.imgur.com/a2tHTPH.png

> La mecánica de los GLINTS es muy sencilla y solo tiene un objetivo, ofrecer progresión para obtener completamente el SET de recompensas que este en turno, en este caso el de “Conclave Arcana”, esto es todo lo que debemos tener en cuenta, bastante fácil verdad , sin embargo, hay aspectos que deben tener en cuenta para esto, y que les ayudara en la administración y/o gestión de los GLINTS, así que presten mucha atención: ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/23tmBC5eMQVv2S84hZLjyP31e3LJz1uiet9K4mUdp2Ezmp3ZkRUCzEWnJpCtPZDdhxnFS.png) * **Priorización de Compras:** No debes gastar los GLINTS al azar, ni comprando o jugando a tener suerte porque, aunque la necesitas, porque en un sistema de probabilidades, la idea es aumentar estas probabilidades, así que, para esto, enfócate en los “Rarity Draws”, aunque, no esta mal gastar en los cofres, al menos los 2 mejores, para obtener cartas al azar y luego enfocarte en una rareza para ir completando todo el SET. Esto lo tienes que hacer hasta que suba de precio en un 50%. * **Uso de Pociones:** Cuando vayas abrir los “Rarity Draws” jamás lo hagas si no tienes pociones de alquimia, enfócate en esto, porque es muy importante tenerlo en cuenta, estos sobres, o llamados también sorteos, tienen un 2% de probabilidad de que salgan cartas de lamina dorada, pero con estas pociones podemos aumentar esa probabilidad, recordándoles que estas cartas se venden automáticamente en el mercado por DECS. * **Acumulación vs Gasto:** Esto ya lo he explicado anteriormente, pero para el que no lo sepa, la idea es acumular hasta el final de la temporada todos los GLINTS y gastar gran parte de ellos al inicio de una nueva temporada, hasta esperar a la siguiente. Esto es así porque cuando compras lotes completos, estos aumentan en un 50% su precio, lo que no es para nada atractivo, por lo que, en cada inicio de temporada necesitas comprar todos los lotes que pueda, solo hasta que estos aumenten en un 50%, después de allí debes esperar. * **Los Cofres de Botín:** Como aquí puedes obtener muchos tipos de “Items”, concentrar todo el gasto del GLINT en ellos no es óptimo, ya que puede que te toquen muchas cartas, como puede que no, yo diría que dependiendo de los GLINTS que ganes, los que logres reunir hasta el final de la temporada, compres lotes completos de estos cofres, me refiero a o comprar 150 cofres minor, 150 major o 30 ultimates. Por supuesto no todos, al menos que tengas muchísimos GLINTS, pero en un gran porcentaje, serian los “Sorteos de Rareza”.
![Separador.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/23u5taptEapzzNue7bMpgSFfTdVR9QsYdtt6rtQonQ5t8iCj5Bh3Xxf1yBs5u9aNdxzNy.png)
# Consideraciones Finales https://i.imgur.com/a2tHTPH.png

> Existen algunas cosas que quizás me salte en este post, pero creo que lo más importante lo abarque. Te lo resumo de forma sencilla: >* **Como funciona la quema de SPS por GLINT + Estrategias.** >* **Gestión y/o administración de los GLINTS** Para ce algo sencillo pero, la principal razón por lo que la mayoría no completa el SET de recompensas, es porque gastan los GLINTS a lo loco, así que con esta guía, puedes hacerlo como un profesional.
### Nos vemos en el \

> I know I’ve posted a lot about this topic, but this is the first post where I’ll explain in detail what you need to keep in mind, including some new mechanics to boost your earnings in GLINT and accelerate your progress much faster than with previous strategies—which will benefit you if you’re not up to date on all the new features they’ve implemented. Although it’s not entirely new, many people may not be aware of these changes, and that’s exactly what I want to share in this post. So, if you want to know all the ways to earn GLINTS, how to speed up your progress, and how to manage them properly, you need to read this post all the way through, because it’s going to be really interesting. I promise it will be very easy to understand and digest, especially for new users—which is what matters most—since we need those new users to join, get to know the game, and ultimately stick around for the fun it provides, but also because they can earn real rewards. **Stay tuned until the end to learn how it works:** ![Separador.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/23u5taptEapzzNue7bMpgSFfTdVR9QsYdtt6rtQonQ5t8iCj5Bh3Xxf1yBs5u9aNdxzNy.png)
# SPS Burning Mechanism by GLINT
https://i.imgur.com/7u1AW7Q.png

> Okay, as I mentioned in the introduction, we have new mechanics that—although they’re not really that new—I haven’t discussed in any of my previous posts. The thing is, we now have the option to speed up our progression by automatically burning our SPS and getting GLINTS in return. This is very powerful because, previously, the SPS we earned would generally go automatically to “Staking,” which is usually very good because it increases our “Rshare”—in short, our reward multiplier—but: **What if the SPS we earn from each battle, instead of going into staking, gets burned and we earn more GLINTS?** Well, we’ll boost the GLINTS we usually earn, so what we’ll do is multiply them, This is great for players who want to prioritize earning GLINTS over SPS, because if a player already has enough SPS and their multiplier is maxed out, the smartest move now is to boost your GLINT earnings to speed up your progress—which, in this case, means getting the entire “Arcane Conclave” reward set. **However, there are some things you should keep in mind:** ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/23tmBC5eMQVv2S84hZLjyP31e3LJz1uiet9K4mUdp2Ezmp3ZkRUCzEWnJpCtPZDdhxnFS.png) #####
Points to consider

>* **How do I activate it?** This feature is available in the \

formats. There, you'll find a button in the rewards tab that you can click to activate it, allowing you to burn the SPS you earn in ranked matches and receive a pretty cool GLINT boost instead. > >* **How does it work?** When you enable this feature, the system doubles your reward shares—the famous “Rshares”—on the GLINT calculation side. As a result, even though you aren’t receiving the SPS you’d normally get for a won battle, you’ll receive double the progress toward finally completing the reward set. > >* **When is the best time to activate it?** I mentioned this a moment ago; basically, it will depend on your current interests. For example, if you want to grow your SPS, the idea is to use the returns you receive to generate compound interest and increase your multiplier. Now, if you have a lot of SPS but you haven’t completed the “Arcane Conclave” rewards set, then you need to activate the SPS burn button via GLINT to get that boost.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/EoChdyUgKDFXxDmxGqbuFDXnFL8e4PWa4uCxiJtPPyWqvcEbAnb2vcCrzTGabFrWD6G.png)
# “GLINTS Management” Strategies https://i.imgur.com/a2tHTPH.png

> 

The mechanics of GLINTS are very simple and have only one goal: to help you progress toward obtaining the full set of rewards currently available, in this case the “Arcane Conclave” set. That’s all you need to keep in mind—pretty easy, right? However, there are a few things you should keep in mind that will help you manage your GLINTS, so pay close attention:

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/23tmBC5eMQVv2S84hZLjyP31e3LJz1uiet9K4mUdp2Ezmp3ZkRUCzEWnJpCtPZDdhxnFS.png)

* **Purchasing Priorities:** You shouldn't spend your GLINTS randomly, whether by buying items or gambling on luck, because—even though you need them—in a system based on probability, the goal is to increase those odds. so, to do this, focus on the “Rarity Draws,” though it’s not a bad idea to spend on chests—at least the top two—to get random cards and then focus on a specific rarity to complete the entire SET. You should keep doing this until the price goes up by 50%. 

* **Using Potions:** When you go to open \

never do so without alchemy potions. Focus on this, because it’s very important to keep in mind: these packs—also known as draws—have a 2% chance of yielding gold-foil cards, but with these potions, we can increase that probability. Remember that these cards are automatically sold on the market for DECS. * **Saving vs. Spending:** I’ve explained this before, but for those who don’t know, the idea is to save up all your GLINTS until the end of the season and then spend most of them at the start of a new season, holding off until the next one. This is because when you buy full bundles, their price increases by 50%, which isn’t attractive at all. So, at the start of each season, you need to buy as many bundles as you can—but only until they go up by 50%. After that, you should wait. * **Loot Chests:** Since you can get many different types of “Items” here, spending all your GLINT on them isn’t the best strategy, because you might get a lot of cards—or you might not. I’d say that depending on the GLINTS you earn—the ones you manage to collect by the end of the season—you should buy full sets of these chests. I mean, buy 150 minor chests, 150 major chests, or 30 ultimate chests. Of course, not all of them, unless you have a ton of GLINTS, but a large percentage of them would be the “Rarity Draws.”
![Separador.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/23u5taptEapzzNue7bMpgSFfTdVR9QsYdtt6rtQonQ5t8iCj5Bh3Xxf1yBs5u9aNdxzNy.png)
# Final Thoughts https://i.imgur.com/a2tHTPH.png

> There are a few things I might leave out in this post, but I think I’ve covered the most important points. Here’s a simple summary: >* **How SPS Burning Works with GLINT + Strategies.** >* **Management and/or administration of GLINTS** It seems simple enough, but the main reason most people don't complete the reward set is that they spend their GLINTS recklessly. title.title: Fresh Air and Green Views My Morning Adventure
title.body:
![image 1000032487](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jocabanero4/23w2oHetVUXMfYR2WQV2Y8c9khqmSoByuAYB6XyRUm42HskfRH86Rq9Z6ZjzwDa9hijL4.png)


# *Greetings to all my friends*

One morning i decided to go out and just walk around. I wanted to move my body and sweat a little bit you know just to feel fresh and healthy and i put on my shoes and started walking. And wow i was so amazed! Everywhere i looked it was just so beautiful. I could not stop myself from taking pictures because the views were really nice.. 
 
![image 1000032492](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jocabanero4/23xVEmkcP8nyUCsSqGnjAuqUj9QXgYsSRJFSESbTa3jymejcDR4yFce96BARw62hQFSdn.png)


In one spot a saw a small river or stream. The water was flowing over the rocks and it looked so clean and cold. There were big stones and green plants all around it. It was so peaceful just listening to the sound of the water. It really felt so calm and nice just standing there looking at it.
 

![1000032488.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jocabanero4/23uFRqCmXoeM74C6zVkYRtb1ht8L6XJBr36TazwoXvTBZ45iYkJpZjP1ZaK855dJmZrku.png)

Then i walked further and saw a lot of tall trees. There were rows of big trees standing straight and the place looked so green and shady. It felt so cool under them because the sun could not get through easily. The ground was full of grass and looked very fresh and natural to walk on.
 

![image 1000032495](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jocabanero4/23zbHTkLyNK26hrGc7GYQmQww7btdMzGtdTdjcT8JqVT6cWsscmwWMyjmKT6oV16VA1JJ.png)

I also saw a lot of coconut trees! You know the niyog trees. They were everywhere tall and strong. It really felt like we were deep in the province surrounded by nature. The ground was full of grass and soil very simple but really beautiful to see.
 

![inage 1000032493](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jocabanero4/23wC7maFKdXXFSsCmY9r8W77BpjE6q88tEcXXdGZzUxycki8ighVWcdzqmad1ioGyeFaY.png)

The path i was walking on was just a simple dirt road. It was surrounded by so many plants and big trees on both sides. The sunlight was hitting the ground making shadows from the leaves. It was just so pretty and relaxing to walk there feeling the fresh air.. 
 

![image 1000032494](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jocabanero4/241tT8buhM8nxWKqVxnziGtwfcvSxgtJQYWexgrweFabsdZFe18KNTgxYfQZK26qz4fEX.png)

I also saw a wide open area with green grass. There was one tall coconut tree standing right in the middle and the sky above was so blue with white clouds. It looked like a perfect painting. Everything was just so bright and nice making me feel so happy.
 

![inage 1000032489](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jocabanero4/23zvAsH1BXTyjggBg6s4t912bS6ygV8ta6TvyXJdFPnGEo57mFACRK7TX7r5FSWVdfQxF.png)

And guess what? I even saw some cows grazing! They were just there eating grass peacefully. It was so nice to see them. Seeing animals like that just adds to the beauty of the place. It really shows how simple and nice life is here in the province.
 

![image 1000032490](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jocabanero4/23xp4FKRqmStMnjBCcAHTQw18KMR7G1tGHWccvrgTyCYDpT3nxkZgLhbhDkdiiE6rn8VP.png)

Every step I took there was something nice to see. Tall trees fresh plants clean air and the sound of nature. It was really relaxing. My morning walk turned into such a great experience because of all these beautiful views around me.
 

![image 1000032491](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jocabanero4/23wqdooGguAmzJHePcJmtW2YR8Lrvre3axkuR4FYCCX8Fr2B18W79957cFXzYLgrNqo9y.png)

I am so happy i decided to go out that day. I got to exercise sweat a bit and at the same time i saw the amazing beauty of our surroundings. The river the trees the coconut plants and the cows everything was just perfect. It was a very good morning indeed!

# Until my next story to tell bye 😊

title.title: Television Review: Cause and Effect (Star Trek: The Next Generation, S1X18, 1992)
title.body:
![(source:tmdb.org)](https://image.tmdb.org/t/p/original/c7CC1nCNbztg4Ovwsq8y69izXHO.jpg)

**Cause and Effect (S05E18)**

Airdate: 23 March 1992

Written by: Brannon Braga
Directed by: Jonathan Frakes

Running Time: 46 minutes 

The concept of a time loop, wherein characters are forced to relive the same day repeatedly, has become one of the most seductive and easily recognisable tropes in popular culture, largely thanks to the 1993 film *[Groundhog Day](https://peakd.com/film/@drax/retro-film-review-groundhog-day-1993)*. Its premise—the existential torment and ultimate redemption found in being stuck in a cyclical reality—has been used countless times since. However, *Star Trek: The Next Generation* holds the distinct honour of employing it a full year before Harold Ramis’s classic, in its fifth season episode *Cause and Effect*. This episode, written by Brannon Braga and directed by Jonathan Frakes, stands as a fascinating and clever entry in the series, though not without its narrative compromises.

The episode begins with a dramatic and unforgettable cold open: the USS Enterprise-D is crippled, with its starboard warp nacelle catastrophically damaged, and Captain Picard orders all hands to abandon ship mere moments before a massive explosion consumes the vessel. This opening is a masterstroke, immediately gripping the viewer with a sense of impending doom and confusion. The narrative then jumps back in time, presenting this destruction as the climax of a temporal causality loop that has trapped the ship and its crew.

The plot proper finds the Enterprise exploring the Typhon Expanse, a region of space plagued by temporal anomalies. During this mission, another Federation starship suddenly emerges on a collision course. Faced with imminent disaster, Commander Riker suggests decompressing the main shuttlebay to alter the ship’s trajectory, while Lieutenant Commander Data advocates using tractor beams to push the other vessel away. Captain Picard, trusting his android officer’s judgement, opts for Data’s solution. The manoeuvre fails, the ships collide, and the Enterprise is destroyed—triggering the loop to restart.

What follows is the episode’s core strength: the gradual, chilling realisation among the crew that they are trapped. Dr. Beverly Crusher first experiences strange phenomena, hearing whispers and experiencing intense déjà vu during a poker game. Soon, others including Geordi La Forge begin to share these sensations.^3^ Through successive iterations of the loop—the episode suggests the ship is stuck for 17 days—these fleeting impressions coalesce into a conscious understanding of their predicament. The crew’s method for escaping hinges on sending a message to their future selves. Ultimately, it is Data who deciphers the clue (the number “three” sent via a temporal echo) and realises that Riker’s original, instinctive suggestion was the correct one all along. In the final loop, the Enterprise uses the shuttlebay decompression manoeuvre and narrowly avoids catastrophe.

The resolution reveals the other vessel to be the USS *Bozeman*, a Federation starship that had been missing for nearly ninety years. Its commander, Morgan Bateson—played by Kelsey Grammer, then at the height of his fame from *Frasier*—is equally disorientated, having been stuck in his own loop and unaware he has arrived in the 24th century. This revelation provides a neat, if convenient, conclusion.

*Star Trek* has a storied history with time-travel narratives, from the classic *[The City on the Edge of Forever](https://peakd.com/hive-166847/@drax/television-review-the-city-on-the-edge-of-forever-star-trek-s1x28-1967-d5b)* to the superb *[Yesterday’s Enterprise](https://peakd.com/hive-166847/@drax/television-review-yesterdays-enterprise-star-trek-the-next-generation-s3x15-1990)*. Brannon Braga, therefore, had considerable shoes to fill. By most accounts, he succeeded admirably. Critics have praised his writing for this episode, and Braga himself recalled it as the most enjoyable he wrote that season. He has a noted talent for “these eerie, Twilight Zoney storylines”, and his script is meticulously layered with small details that differ in each loop, preventing monotony. His boast about pioneering this scenario before *Groundhog Day* is well-earned.

The major production challenge was inherently the repetitiveness of the premise. The solution was to give the director’s chair to Jonathan Frakes, who also plays Riker. Frakes initially found the script baffling, even thinking it was a joke. However, his direction proved inspired. To create visual variety in identical scenes, he shot them simultaneously with multiple cameras from different angles, ensuring that each recurrence felt slightly distinct. This technical ingenuity is crucial to the episode’s pacing and atmosphere.

Even the series’ habitual poker game, often a mere filler scene for character banter, is elevated to a vital narrative device. As the loops progress, the players begin to predict the cards, with Data dryly noting, “This is highly improbable.” This small scene brilliantly externalises the crew’s growing subconscious awareness, allowing both them and the audience to track subtle changes between timelines.

For all its strengths, *Cause and Effect* stumbles somewhat in its final act. The reveal that the mysterious ship is a Federation vessel from the past feels like a narrative convenience. It allowed the production team to reuse older Starfleet uniforms and sets from *[Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country](https://peakd.com/hive-166847/@drax/film-review-star-trek-vi-the-undiscovered-country-1991)*, a cost-saving measure after plans for a more original design were abandoned. More problematically, it introduces a rich subplot—the cultural dislocation of Bateson and his crew—that is immediately brushed aside due to the episode’s time constraints. Grammer’s cameo is enjoyable but ultimately feels like a stunt, leveraging his contemporary celebrity rather than serving the story. This rushed ending leaves the episode feeling a tad unfinished, as if the compelling puzzle of the loop is solved only to be replaced by a potentially fascinating new scenario that is never explored.

*Cause and Effect* is a highlight of *The Next Generation*’s fifth season and a testament to the creative risks the series could take at its peak. Its clever structure, strong direction, and atmospheric execution make it a compelling watch, even if the concluding reveal prioritises production practicality and star power over narrative depth. It may not reach the profound emotional heights of the franchise’s finest time-travel tales, but as a tightly constructed, intellectually engaging thriller, it thoroughly deserves its place as a classic—and as the template *Groundhog Day* would follow a year later.



RATING: 8/10 (+++)

title.title: 飘雪VS飘絮‖未若柳絮因风起（古人好豁达文雅
title.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![h5tO8yyuY0XdH4cR_IMG_20260409_190906.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/neithya/images/h5tO8yyuY0XdH4cR_IMG_20260409_190906/h5tO8yyuY0XdH4cR_IMG_20260409_190906.webp)
![PnIFCxm1Qk0pAWD2_promphoto_1775733122911.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/neithya/images/PnIFCxm1Qk0pAWD2_promphoto_1775733122911/PnIFCxm1Qk0pAWD2_promphoto_1775733122911.webp)
![2mABYusfTFvFIh48_IMG_20260409_190805.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/neithya/images/2mABYusfTFvFIh48_IMG_20260409_190805/2mABYusfTFvFIh48_IMG_20260409_190805.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

前两天刚抱怨北京狂风后下雨了，这不今天就朗朗晴空啦……可凡事最怕有但是……

外面疯狂的飘起各种絮——杨絮或柳絮，一团一团的或者一小颗粒一小颗粒的，飘荡在空中，纷纷扰扰侵袭着路人的面部、眼睛、嘴巴，阻碍视野，不敢张嘴……这时候就很佩服那些心境平和的人们

莫名想到了东晋‘咏絮之才’代言人：谢道韫，人家才女看着漫天大雪，都能以飘絮来比喻，这审美，这心境，这才华……所以我盲猜她对飘雪和飘絮都是喜爱的……

想完之后，我也不觉得立交桥下，那一块块的絮团子碍眼碍事了，挡着了就挥走，尽量多带口罩出门哈

可在N次眼睛被棉絮入侵后，心里平静不下来了，果然飘雪和飘絮都一样惹人烦心，一个冷嗖嗖，一个闹痒痒，反正都是惹我眼睛不自主留下生理泪水的罪魁祸首!

四季轮回真的很奇妙，各有各的美，还带着自己的一些小特色，可相对来说其他人也许没那么喜欢，会当成小瑕疵吧。

正如人也一样，优缺点并存，没有完美的人，而生活中，我们也不能只接纳别人的美好，而攻击或放大他人的小瑕疵……毕竟不完美也是一种美！

图片和帖子无关是路过三里屯小白楼，拍的，据说叫太空舱嘿嘿

**感谢阅读！祝你生活明媚，身体安康！**

---

title.title: Ubot Falls Villa Aurora Breathtaking Views and a Nice Place to Chill
title.body:
![image_20260409_181719_0000](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/olang23/23uFZnVJk6g6vAd5QeyA6V3VkEkn3fSpnq5sBEyY7qwKWXtzGcukv6tZvyWJE5jHkB2rx.png)



Finally, we got to visit Ubot Falls in Villa Aurora. It was such a nice trip and honestly the place is so beautiful. As soon as we arrived we were surrounded by so many trees and plants. It really feels like you are deep inside nature.
 

![image_20260409_181720_0002](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/olang23/23vsLEHrLHAKywfjWt8j6jj5hD5CBMKEhwyFUJDzBdbuJUWtxZzTe3ZGbNnyLgjWXqt8Z.png)

The falls itself? It was amazing. The water flows down from the rocks and it looks so clean and fresh. The view is really pretty way better than just seeing photos. It feels so peaceful there just listening to the sound of the water.
 

![image_20260409_181720_0001](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/olang23/244A4viRQHLi6nvBhpiFfHpLEN33H3hUcCtAgjxfS99Z4kKoTCehwF4j9cNKreATY3ga4.png)

What really surprised us was that they have rooms there! We did not expect that at all. Usually when you go to falls you just bring tents or sleep outside. But here, they have actual rooms you can rent to sleep in.
 
![image_20260409_181720_0004](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/olang23/23vsNB7XRE3bhDd7MhsEVjjKqVN6HMFyVDQrH2ncELKS2R1Tmw2bsqP9CSWfJRUaPjyEQ.png)


That was such a big help for us. After walking around and enjoying the place we did not have to worry about setting up anything. We just went to our room, and it was ready. It’s simple but really okay and clean.
 
![imagr_20260409_181722_0010](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/olang23/243frmJZf6Z9o1ti3YFj7xv4nA3QTXZ2oA62ahffFhP2WG2fYmvePkhroHn6hrU9BDuYb.png)

Being able to stay overnight made the trip so much better. You get to enjoy the falls during the day and then you also get to experience it at night. It gets really quiet and cool, perfect for relaxing.
 
![image_20260409_181722_0011](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/olang23/23zbS3ZsXZQPBs7sbqhMUDZNaedX4oUVvNZgdbRdzrWpomcGAnZuCb4MvWovdmKbxbUT3.png)


Waking up in the morning there was awesome too. The air is so fresh and you can see the greenery right outside. It feels so good to start the day like that far away from the city noise.
 
![image_20260409_181722_0012](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/olang23/23x19B4u1KvrUK1YCFq6VfNNMGnsXY9rHqS7iJR8aH3qJvxom1DPNiEFfjnRG4PuyTGn9.png)


We spent a lot of time just swimming and chilling in the water. The pool at the bottom is nice, not too deep so everyone can enjoy. The water is really cold and refreshing especially when it’s hot outside.
 

![image_20260409_181720_0003](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/olang23/23vi8P1xt1Hkcp36jhyekfBtJsXKFmvm9DoToAaEXUPoFV7FhMHtbqtq6sRocfqCXMpD5.png)

It washes away all your tiredness right away. We just stayed there, splashing around and having fun with friends. It was just pure enjoyment and good vibes the whole time.
 


![image_20260409_181721_0007](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/olang23/23w2qMfk8C19zm1WmUMg8rMXvA67FFBcfHfLHMUR3uSYWho5DcUv8AUvmk26s7wsjtPHb.png)

They also have nice paths and railings so it’s safe to walk around. Even if it gets a bit slippery you can still walk easily. You can go around and see different views of the falls.
 


![image_20260409_181721_0006](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/olang23/23tmFr6PMQbmcjLF45dScfBNF5PLt2j4qRodY3o3ADHabHDpt6WhGKxELA9wLPwUScYtG.png)

Everything looks well taken care of so you can just relax and not worry about anything. The place is really nice and clean which makes the experience even better.
 
![image_20260409_181721_0005](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/olang23/23wC7vmkJPx2X9FnoNi1Q9g2daK5tsnUSuS4oDxjR7v9FxVrBedjfWtx3m3cWWLkLS3Wg.png)

Having rooms available is really a great idea. It makes everything easier especially if you are with a big group or family. You have your own space to put your things and sleep comfortably.
 

![image_20260409_181721_0009](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/olang23/23vsNg7nosXk5mtxtmU6JdQoNa37ECAVBkSr1rsyMC2fpjH4Zcxh7dcoHtu8cyhSFA7GE.png)

No need to rush going home because you can just stay there and take your time. You can really unwind and enjoy the beauty of nature without any hassle.
 

![image_20260409_181721_0008](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/olang23/23zRyL6mTFtN4efM2tEc7u2h3RXWtVjqn33J7UrbpRsmy97ULKkFoUD7WUrrPpLwr9fGk.png)

We really loved our visit to Ubot Falls. The beautiful scenery plus having a comfortable place to stay? It’s just perfect. We had so much fun and we definitely want to go back again!
