title.title: [ENG/ESP] A Thursday of paperwork and beautiful horizons
title.body: > **Fridays always have a special charm. They’re the days we look forward to because they gently remind us that a well-deserved break is just around the corner. This week, in particular, work has been especially demanding for me—piled-up commitments, tasks that seemed to multiply, and responsibilities that demanded my full attention. That’s why, as this Friday approaches, all I can think about is resting, recharging my batteries, and giving myself a much-needed break. I sincerely hope you can do the same—that you find a moment to disconnect and enjoy yourselves. I wish you a happy Friday and a wonderful weekend. My week got off to a whirlwind start. From hunting down parts to finish some pending projects, to organizing documents and paying taxes that couldn’t wait. It was as if every day brought a new list of things to tackle. And even though sometimes you’d like to stop time, the truth is that life marches on at its own pace, and it’s up to us to keep up with it in the best possible spirit. Thursday, for example, was one of those days I don’t really like. I had to start updating some important company information to keep the necessary permits active for the work we do. These procedures, though essential, tend to be a bit of a hassle. They make you go back and forth to an office two or three times for a stamp, a signature, or a simple copy. But it’s something I have to do once a year, so I just had to accept it with patience. With that determined spirit, my husband and I set out early in the morning. The weather was wonderful; the sun was shining brightly, but a cool breeze swept through the streets and made everything more bearable. The urban and natural landscapes looked especially beautiful, as if the day wanted to make up for the errands that awaited us. I took the opportunity to snap a few photos with my camera, trying to capture those little moments that, though simple, fill the soul.**

> *Los viernes siempre tienen un encanto especial. Son esos días que esperamos con ansias porque anuncian, sube y amablemente, que el merecido descanso está a la vuelta de la esquina. Esta semana, en particular, el trabajo ha sido especialmente fuerte para mí; compromisos acumulados, tareas que parecían multiplicarse y responsabilidades que exigían toda mi atención. Por eso, mientras llega este viernes, solo pienso en descansar, recuperar energías y regalarme un respiro necesario. Espero sinceramente que ustedes también puedan hacerlo, que encuentren un momento para desconectarse y disfrutar. Les deseo un feliz viernes y un excelente fin de semana. Mi semana comenzó con todo. Desde la búsqueda de piezas para completar unos trabajos pendientes, hasta la organización de documentos y el pago de impuestos que no podían esperar. Era como si cada día trajera una lista nueva de cosas por resolver. Y aunque a veces uno quisiera detener el tiempo, lo cierto es que la vida sigue su ritmo, y a nosotros nos toca acompañarlo con la mejor actitud posible. El jueves, por ejemplo, fue uno de esos días que no me gustan mucho. Tenía que comenzar a actualizar una información importante de la compañía para mantener activos los permisos necesarios para el trabajo que realizamos. Estos trámites, aunque indispensables, suelen ser un poco pesados. Te hacen ir dos y tres veces a una oficina por un cuño, una firma o una simple copia. Pero es algo que debo hacer una vez al año, así que no quedaba más que asumirlo con paciencia. Con ese ánimo decidido, salimos mi esposo y yo temprano en la mañana. El clima estaba estupendo; el sol brillaba con fuerza, pero una brisa fresca recorría las calles y hacía todo más llevadero. Los paisajes urbanos y naturales se veían especialmente hermosos, como si el día quisiera compensarnos por las diligencias que nos esperaban. Aproveché para hacer algunas tomas con mi lente, intentando inmortalizar esos pequeños momentos que, aunque simples, llenan el alma.*
![photo_2026-04-10_00-06-52.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EqQNd3cEAMRgeBb8AyXYjQvKDJ4cY9NuCV3PJgoSUYUDyzUKEPPPXCj9U94EzEcbPjz.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-10_00-06-51.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpnBpYMz4v9MWxCQPEsz36QHj3uSPmUcMpsVCH9HhGEbXowcybgxnCMrTscEeWMyxWv.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-10_00-06-50.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EqSU6CVJWY9z6LaGWQ2qPNNRDSSnBNSobVF6kS3b2jFbfjBnyY4BN8aB2wAHGhZyS6F.jpg)
> **Our first task of the day was to carry out our work routine at Costa Azul. Everything went smoothly, which allowed us to continue on to city hall and begin the process of renewing our permits.**

> *Nuestra primera tarea del día fue cumplir con nuestra rutina de trabajo en Costa Azul. Todo fluyó satisfactoriamente, lo que nos dio paso para continuar nuestro recorrido hacia la alcaldía de la ciudad y comenzar con la renovación de los permisos.*
![photo_2026-04-10_00-06-45.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpnCKpREoyQhx8k2KznhUQ19dAqour2ApCF9CxxiJed53XXQwQTpKwqPdyiBRopFPVM.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-10_00-06-45 (2).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpJWiGZGouH3X71rNGQ6wAUBCxLEPwvmBivdj8RhiKenNp6oybVwjU3BgoqHGLMa8ZZ.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-10_00-06-44.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/23xyVML13UjhzFvAZxkJtHH8szjthKRZnYmu92bWhdgLJHP2Aoxz6YpJz1X7eWw6w3B5K.jpg)

> **When we arrived at the Mariño City Hall, we were greeted very warmly. However, as is often the case, we soon found ourselves going from office to office—a signature here, a copy there, another instruction further down the line. In the middle of the process, we were told that we had to take a copy to Pampatar to speed up the process. Without a second thought, we headed there, since we had set aside the entire day for these errands.**

> *Al llegar a la alcaldía de Mariño, nos recibieron con mucha amabilidad. Sin embargo, como suele suceder, pronto comenzamos a rodar de oficina en oficina; una firma aquí, una copia allá, una indicación más adelante. En medio del proceso, nos informaron que debíamos llevar una copia a Pampatar para agilizar el trámite. Sin pensarlo dos veces, hacia allá nos dirigimos, ya que habíamos dispuesto el día completo para estas gestiones.*
![photo_2026-04-10_00-06-42.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpJXBU4eHxWot35UeTjKcD6dZjDqWVUdcNiZT4ihiNzrZmP9PQt4HgxdTPQRBSro2Cs.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-10_00-06-41.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpxpmYKLcQBTSdnaVHbyMCaZqX5euVhM5k5SVECoS7y51BxNuMeFUzsTBYXgmKpLeaD.jpg) ![z.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Ep5nCJojVGmCEjyeaPNwx3ruLZaFPLw6ne4V9XQu4VCTWjru1UynUSvKEgtGAdWdBi1.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-10_00-06-26.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EppL9LYMsMLAvfeUP9sXVPGgDppwLtC7TZnLU5oktjwbs2WCMkLtFxM2zRL6Uxjjk7k.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-10_00-06-25.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpQvHnWd1AgLc4yFwzu3rPrKiiX8r1vhKzGpHSgXwqjK3SxdMRtoGEdbfMmRwxjYfLv.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-10_00-06-22.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/23wX3hoaiXS8vHg2WcezpwBVbmxKqsnazdfbyHCm2sVHW1ssz7YFCJ2JTd5qFSpgn88xy.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-10_00-06-20.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Eq5C6GAUUoBwiDwUsJ2H3kDpLBRVKHw7FTtbvuuVw3XE4YjYPEkgDAqqjCRr6ijE6fB.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-10_00-06-18.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Eonm1rThFTCRjPvWAWNFkEFFw5VmNLYYajf4tkpS7PJxsFbsoedgHYaNmBJHZK3zNAY.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-10_00-06-17.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EqBbJTvjWSM1iJBLietGM96ec2aL8pFKz9TXqgeZcqCp5NiuaqkNuHM8EFzSeuBweWa.jpg)

> **Pampatar never ceases to amaze us. Its views, its people, and its natural and urban landscapes possess a unique beauty that never goes unnoticed. As we made our way through, I felt that, despite our fatigue, it was well worth exploring these places that so vividly reflect the identity of this beautiful island. We handed in the copy, took care of what needed to be done, and finally set off for home. We were a little exhausted—because if anything is truly tiring, it’s dealing with paperwork—but we also felt the satisfaction of having gotten everything done.**

> *Pampatar siempre nos sorprende. Sus vistas, su gente, sus paisajes naturales y urbanos tienen una belleza particular que nunca pasa desapercibida. Mientras avanzábamos, sentí que, a pesar del cansancio, valía la pena recorrer estos lugares que tanto hablan de la identidad de esta hermosa isla. Entregamos la copia, resolvimos lo necesario y finalmente emprendimos el regreso a casa. Estábamos un poco agotados, porque si algo cansa de verdad es hacer trámites, pero también sentíamos la satisfacción de haber cumplido con todo.*

title.title: ¡Mi vikingo catire y revoltoso Loki! 💛 [ESP/ENG]
title.body:
>
Bienvenidos! 🙋🏻‍♀️
¡Hola amigos!! ¿Como han estado?? Espero que muy bien, al igual que sus preciosas mascotas, por este lado del mundo, en esta bonita Isla, mis peludos están bien gracias a Dios, o al menos, estables jajaja, a ver, como ya saben Loki es un gato diferente, sufre de alergias por lo que su alimentación es estricta, tiene algunas enfermedades autoinmunes y por la medicina suelen bajarle las defensas y desarrolla otras patologías... si, ¡no es fácil!! Pero sabíamos que la vida con él sería algo complicada, pues llego a nuestras vidas estando muy pequeño, enfermo, con una fuerte infección, la nariz quemada y sin ganas ni de comer, pensamos que moriría, pero con amor, logro comer y luego sanar, desde entonces ha sido una montaña rusa de emociones, muchas idas al médico, muchas medicinas y sustos, más, es bonito ver como a pesar de todo él es un gatito muy, pero muy feliz, no sabría explicar lo mucho que Loki disfruta su vida, es el gato más cariñoso, amoroso, feliz y revoltoso que he conocido hasta ahora!!. Y precisamente por lo revoltoso que es (es un gato naranja, su genética le exige alocarse diariamente), se me hace difícil tomarle fotografías!! O mejor dicho, tengo que tomarle muchísimas fotos y luego ver cuáles quedaron bonitas/nítidas, pues siempre está corriendo, escalando árboles, brincando, caminando de aquí para allá, cazando grillos o mariposas, la única vez que está tranquilo es dormido y cuando duerme es con las patas hacia arriba, parece cucaracha muerta jajajajja una muy tierna, peluda y naranja por supuesto, volviendo al tema de su salud, está bajo control, poco a poco él va mejorando y vamos batallando con lo que se presente en el momento, lo importante es que él está bien, feliz y es un gatito muy, muy amado!.
ENGLISH

Welcome! 🙋🏻‍♀️
Hello friends!! How have you been?? I hope you're doing very well, as are your precious pets. Here on this side of the world, on this beautiful island, my furry friends are doing well, thank God, or at least stable, haha. As you know, Loki is a different kind of cat. He suffers from allergies, so his diet is very strict. He has some autoimmune diseases, and the medication often lowers his immune system, causing him to develop other health problems... yes, it's not easy!! But we knew that life with him would be somewhat complicated, since he came into our lives very young, sick, with a severe infection, a burned nose, and no appetite. We thought he would die, but with love, he managed to eat and then heal. Since then, it's been an emotional rollercoaster, many trips to the vet, lots of medicine, and scares. But it's wonderful to see how, despite everything, he's a very, very happy kitten. I couldn't even begin to explain how much Loki enjoys his life. He's the most affectionate, loving, happy, and mischievous cat I've ever met! And precisely because he's so mischievous (he's an orange cat, his genetics demand he go wild every day), it's difficult for me to take pictures of him! Or rather, I have to take tons of pictures and then see which ones turned out nice/clear, because he's always running, climbing trees, jumping, walking here and there, hunting crickets or butterflies. The only time he's calm is when he's asleep, and when he sleeps, it's with his paws in the air, he looks like a dead cockroach, hahaha, a very cute, furry, and orange one, of course. Getting back to his health, it's under control. Little by little, he's improving, and we're dealing with whatever comes up. The important thing is that he's well, happy, and a very, very loved kitten!.

Soy una chica enamorada de las aventuras, me encanta conocer nuevos lugares y documentar mi experiencia en ellos, me apasiona fotografiar momentos únicos, paisajes y todo lo que tenga que ver con la naturaleza, de hecho soy fotógrafo de turismo paisajístico, también bailarina profesional, adoro cocinar, llevar un estilo de vida saludable y sobre todo #catlover, amo con locura a mis gatos y a mi manada callejera 😸.

title.title: Dingalan, Aurora's Awesome Resort Cozy Cottages, Beach Fun, and a Cool Pool in Ibona
title.body:
![image_20260409_100556_0000](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/levieshome/23wgHPRywHBGy4xkxwsB7imHE7wH4AvXTgpZ6LdWc25asNG4KNQaNZeSjvMBpMARTohb1.png)

Hello everyone! What a beautiful day to talk about awesome places right? I'm super excited to share with you all about this really pretty resort I saw. This place is located in Brgy. Ibona in Dingalan, Aurora. And seriously it's really, really beautiful!
 

![image_20260409_100556_0001](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/levieshome/23zv4zvKLRXnsd3KtP1rvpc2zDVFPY7wVpPmtAKqchseoEjJLALjRoJdBUU7HyBuPsfRy.png)

It's one of those spots that just
makes you happy the moment you see it. It has so much to offer for anyone who wants to just chill out and have a great time. It's truly a place that puts a smile on your face right away.
 

![image_20260409_100557_0004](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/levieshome/245HeZshPean12UdmYmZS6vAtTkaD8DYVkgmMkCJQbrp3XQHWE9GunQd6xUPA7NJwFUcC.png)

When you first step into this resort the first thing that really catches your eye are these super cute little houses I mean A-frame cotages. They are lined up so neatly like tiny little dollhouses.
 

![image_20260409_100557_0003](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/levieshome/2432BDi3r247RDvMLgBG7TdJNeFhwgZC6QKU5wthCEZJKMBjAkhLxYA7Qj92MgVpxNH7n.png)

They all look cozy and inviting. Each one has a lovely reddish brown color with a bright white roof which just pops against the green grass and the blue sky. They look like the perfect little spots for a vacation.
![image_20260409_100557_0005](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/levieshome/23s9Lwvz7PuBiJuZSxQi7fSANANHgMmDqFULe5BrqUKVXuUrS6G4yaLLwAkdSJNeTcJPD.png)

These cottages give off a very homey and unique vibe not like boring hotels. Outside each cottage there's always a little space with a picnic table and benches. This is perfect for just hanging out.

![image_20260409_100557_0006](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/levieshome/23xyV9Ly4xBQBXovHie5WuxLAgJ6UiorrooodFpTukyp4UhNkuNDXu8Ew8h1rHmJAcWoC.png)


Maybe you can have your morning coffee there or enjoy some snacks. You can sit there and feel the air listen to the sounds of nature and just watch the world go by. It’s such a simple but thoughtful touch.
 


![image_20260409_100557_0002](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/levieshome/242DESqDrq9wFK21he3swnRdXgjooMVtYEWM5vpQe3YXu6npCoPHV5ca7EPPo86mb7tHV.png)


This makes your stay even more comfy and gives you your own little private spot right outside your door. The whole resort grounds are really well maintained. The pathways are either made of smooth concrete or nice little stones.
 


![image_20260409_100558_0011](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/levieshome/242DC8KgnDWsKWiyvR2DSrpSxU7acnemVvRK2j46MNtZsbUodrGjbaqwnSUgWfKu6H4ms.png)


This makes it super easy and pleasant to walk around. And the grass? Oh it's so green and perfectly trimmed like a huge carpet spread out everywhere. You can tell that the people who run this resort really work hard.
 
![image_20260409_100558_0007](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/levieshome/241ZfWWN1cBwYm3HQL1E4r8Sm7hV4oSRkYZAHCjF8pMbcA5ZUadrWqfRyozAUYbTpcNSW.png)


They put in a lot of effort to keep everything neat and tidy. It makes the whole place feel clean, welcoming, and very relaxing to stroll through. And then there are the palm trees! So many of them, tall and graceful.
 
![image_20260409_100558_0010](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/levieshome/23yJANnbfHFFGZxdDT14T2WC9TsDxwwjnDu5HY7CKzwETrpj74hAM37JQYGpCAutqMV8o.png)

They sway gently in the breeze. They provide natural shade from the sun and just add so much to that tropical island feel. When the sun hits them they look even more majestic. They really complete the picture of a perfect beach resort.
 

![image_20260409_100558_0009](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/levieshome/23zRvo4YDw2mbk1Rmv42m3aGfi4oYJe4DEtxeLR8PgHB3LMEAzQTBqWHrWUfAjHKypTf9.png)


They make you feel like you are truly on a vacation far away from all the busy city stuff. As you walk deeper into the resort following the pathways you eventually reach the ocean. And wow 😲 what a sight!
 


![image_20260409_100558_0008](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/levieshome/243WMewtagkh7brR89ufJZQng4VtF7oBWqnrtGQW7DCrajLSWZYYzFPmiu856E2ZQVXGC.png)


The path leads directly to the beach and you can see the waves crashing beautifully against the shore. The water looks so clear and inviting with different shades of blue and green. The sound of the waves is just music to your ears.
 

![image_20260409_100559_0015](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/levieshome/23xedbheNxZpq9wTeaBaZZY2BTRhUyo5bNyWmbaeCEkzZjbgWUY9u5NTiwfMSVasWoqcu.png)


It makes you feel calm and peaceful. It's truly a breathtaking view that reminds you of nature's beauty. Near the beach there are also some lovely outdoor areas that look like dining or chill out spots. They have these charming thatched roofs.


![image_20260409_100559_004](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/levieshome/23wWrf7CtiYjBgzxmw2aHQSfETVVVxKgV759HHC8XfNgxGYyt3wMP263HoEiVpGAStBt8.png)



These roofs give off a really authentic, laid back island vibe. You can just imagine sitting there enjoying a delicious meal or sipping on a refreshing drink all while feeling the gentle sea breeze and listening to the ocean. These spots are perfect for gathering with family or friends.
 

![image_20260408_174356_0000_](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/levieshome/23zkg8UoD712uoqQzZcWSiosmW4B5Nss1G72G9daYkAijghH2YsQze6perJPN1e5wDK8S.png)

But wait there's more! This resort also has a beautiful swimming pool and it's placed right by the sea! How cool is that? You get the best of both worlds you can take a refreshing dip in the clear blue pool or go for a swim in the ocean.
 

![image_20260409_100558_0012](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/levieshome/243LxnXTkKBHJyDy2KUT6zgiiVpXrwVbSADrQsWK6yGhVxZWe6Av6NPVLP15fraQ73Hrz.png)

Whatever you feel like! The pool area looks super clean and modern with nice lounge chairs around it. It’s perfect for sunbathing relaxing and just soaking up the good vibes. The overall feeling of the resort is just incredibly relaxing.
 

![image_20260409_100600_0016](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/levieshome/245HaYzj6mQJFfGsc8DfCYEgJKcquNgfmtydLoQ4GuqThLvgZFCsNNrcUt4E6PfvQscZi.png)

It feels like a little paradise hidden away in Dingalan, Aurora. Everything is designed to make you feel comfy and peaceful. From the cozy cottages to the well kept grounds and the stunning views every detail makes for a great stay.
 

![image_20260409_100601_0017](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/levieshome/23xeduAF3p118HzNNwirPqVzLQxCWWq4QpRuEt3pH5jxCHaSZrb2d8LC4fUjmLxngCvLU.png)

So, if you are ever planning a trip and looking for a truly beautiful and relaxing spot you should definitely check out this resort in Dingalan. It's a hidden gem that combines cozy places to stay amazing beach access a cool pool and a super chill feeling. It's the perfect place to make good memories!

title.title: FInally Beat Nidhogg, The Guardian Of World Tree!! ~ God Of War Ragnarok | Give Me God Of War
title.body:
Hello, gamers of Hive. I hope you all are doing well.

![Screenshot (1058).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allama/23wqEPNwdVjeBugKYtgqSbGoTkwafiLrDjteJ2jNsRutq4HURp7o9Me961xejAt9smVTZ.png)


Today, I will share my progress on GOW Ragnarok which I'm still continuing to play in the hardest difficulty where I somehow managed to kill a lizard to free a woman... some things never changed across time and realities.

Without further ado, let's begin!

![Screenshot (1023).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allama/23tGRccPfcume1hQ9E3goxq9gge752r95GthUD9JEx58wNmQqnqkHvhEbNborAYEpSS8J.png)

<center></center>

I spent exactly 30 minutes on trying to beat Nidhogg, the guardian of the world tree branches. It took soo many tries that I forgot count but somehow I pushed through the bifrost wave and downed the beast.

![Screenshot (1040).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allama/23wzdP2dXqwJ5Dj81BVRb2QXi3rBfahviamSUzd6s8rsKxMQ2XSNpFoWUqpWLjprH3ZXv.png)

It was mostly Freya who did not let the wounded lizard escape through it's portal. She pulled this thing's throat while it already ahd it's head on the other side of the portal and just then it closed up. Leaving the rest of it's body to be cut by the portal.

![Screenshot (1041).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allama/23t77MALtnvzqLQjk3iNHDzCHr3JnMZZB1cLNP4v3H2HjYCwS58Tb4h7xHW3Qv7QmSgCp.png)

Freya sprinted to the place where a piece of her essence was tied up by all 9 realm's branches... no wonder Nidhogg was adamant at protecting it... she tored up one at a time.

![Screenshot (1042).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allama/23tGTZT8cMghjdKwyiwJSf5UN1U8eXwbWm4of1YGPfMYtMtQk7rir9B4CFrSVaGGMXMEH.png)

She finally attians freedom... unbounded and unrestricted. A feeling she had not felt in quite a long while as she felt her powers grow back to its full extent since the bunch were in Vanaheim.

![Screenshot (1044).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allama/23tbGoUHgPpaN4juFGNRXMZdCZaEVz9gf2S9WmEpVEWGyRtmfbGfUyMqBFC8VAsESWjAy.png)

Kratos was wary of her... keeping his axe close as he pondered if she would forgive him for killing her son or forgive him for freeing her. She was hurt... naturally she may not instantly forgive him... but her sound judgement overthrew her clouded mind as she knew that Odin was to blame for all this and not Kratos. So, she forgives him. 

![Screenshot (1057).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allama/23uEuk99RNYA1f43qDVqCgEtKjjppASwoCmgGcvWdUkQHH5Wzn4gTJW3rMxJBAuSUaMo4.png)

Kratos explains that he did not regret saving her life but he also shouldn't have robbed her choice of staying alive or dead if it meant her son to live. She agreed with a small sigh.
___

I *picked up the nidhogg image* from *[here](https://gamerant.com/god-of-war-ragnarok-nidhoggs-mythology-explained/)* and the *god of war ragnarok* logo from *[here](https://es.ign.com/god-of-war-ragnarok/208084/video/god-of-war-ragnarok-pc-announcement-trailer-state-of-play-2024)*

![Hive gaming.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allama/23w2ifjVsuD7preSQUzp6GXk51APDicBCsJdtSX8hxLvKLDoXeqPr6RiUuvrXRyCURvVQ.png)

### **Gameplay Video**

https://www.youtube.com/live/xJzTPU3KHCA?si=Otx0FO-9hrS9gYtZ

<center>*Thank you, guys, for reading this far. See you legends on the next one!*</center>

body.body: @ahmadmanga the link itself is basically a YouTube shell page, so the usable takeaway here is the argument implied by the title: “feminism is dead” usually means older feminist branding has lost credibility, not that its social wins vanished. Your pushback is the sharper read — if people think we’re “in this mess because it already won,” they’re arguing feminism became culturally dominant enough to reshape norms, whether for better or worse, which is very different from “dead.” On InLeo, the closest actual discussion I found leans more toward feminism evolving than disappearing, like [this thread](https://inleo.io/threads/view/lucidlucrecia/re-leothreads-5tjx7bfm), while broader debate around “is feminism dead?” is still very much alive in pieces like [The Atlantic’s discussion](https://www.theatlantic.com/podcasts/archive/2025/05/the-death-of-feminism/682704/) and [this YouTube debate framing](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=V_43PFnYBfc).

body.title: Cremation And Resurrection. My Review
body.body:
https://youtu.be/-uBR3BJe9WM?si=9-VOcooNxikKYvTn
I like the conclusion which Bro Eli Soriano gave in this video. There is nothing that passes the power of God. Whatever the situation or condition that a person may find himself or herself, God is able to cause lifeless things to come back to life. Our God has power to do all things. The dry bones were hopelessly dried. They had no hope. Their dreams and aspirations were long gone. But the power of God working through the word of God in the mouth of the prophet of God brought back life to them all.

Cremation tells of a kind of situation where a person is experiencing a hopeless and lifeless experience. It is good that we put it to our hearts that we are serving a God who is able do all things. There is nothing which God can't do. God can make the dried bones to come back to life. We should always listen to God so that we can hear whatever he has to tell us in face of whatever situation that we are passing through.

The prophet did not look at the dried bones with just his ordinary eyes. He submitted himself totally unto God. When we submitted to God, He knows how take us out of everything that could resemble cremation in our life.

Hello Hivers!!!
It had been a while since I had greeted them for reasons beyond my control.  So here I am again to continue enjoying this beautiful black and white photography community and by the way, taking into account not falling into the mistake for which I was scolded in my last publication.  Today everything in byn. As it should be in this community.
I hope everyone is well and enjoying good health. 
Here I share with you today a publication related to the outing that a group of photographers took last week during a photographic safari through some streets of Central Havana, one of the smallest municipalities in the province of Havana, but at the same time one of the most populated. 

Along the way, we observed and of course! We portrayed many things that caught our attention.

I, in particular, took photos of people, animals, posters.

Safari por Centro Habana 

Hola Hivers!!!
Ya llevaba un tiempo sin saludarlos por causas ajenas a mi voluntad.  Entonces aquí estoy de nuevo para continuar disfrutando de esta preciosa comunidad de fotografía en blanco y negro y dicho sea de paso teniendo en cuenta no caer en el error por el que me regañaron en mi última publicación.  Hoy todo en byn. Como debe ser en esta comunidad. 
Espero que todos estén bien y disfrutando de buena salud. 
Aquí les comparto hoy una publicación relacionada con la salida que hicimos la semana pasada un grupo de fotógrafos durante un safari fotográfico por algunas calles de  Centro Habana, uno de los municipios más pequeño de la provincia La Habana,  pero al mismo tiempo uno de los más poblado. 

Durante el camino, observamos y claro! retratamos muchas cosas que nos llamó la atención. 
Yo, particularmente, hice fotos a personas, animales,  carteles.

Gente en su trabajo diario en las calles, ya sea acarreando mercancías, lo mismo a pie que en carros eléctricos; en labores de construcción o  sujetos sentados disfrutando tranquilamente de un cigarro.

 
Niños, ¡qué nunca faltan! jugando, uno de ellos con un trompo, llevaba tiempo sin ver ese tipo de juego (bailar un trompo) u otros  mostrando su alegría cuando comían cake.


También vimos zonas de más pobreza y donde la calle se ha convertido en un almacenamiento de autos rotos que ya estan fuera de circulación, los cuales a pesar de su deterioro, siempre son  motivo para hacer fotografías. 


En fin fue una experiencia positiva en el sentido fotografico,  


Entonces aquí se las dejo para que la disfruten y comenten si les parece bien. Siempre les agradeceré. 

Muy buenos días para todos y mantendremos el contacto  por esta comunidad con más frecuencia.  
Mis saludos cordiales para todos.



Estas imágenes son para mi entrada al concurso de Monomad de @ challenge y @brumest

body.title: Ecency Mobile 3.5.3 - AI Tools, 3Speak Uploads, Waves Redesign & More
body.body: We have been busy! This release brings a powerful set of new features to the Ecency mobile app - from AI writing tools and 3Speak video uploads, to a redesigned Waves experience and a more streamlined wallet flow. Here is what is new in version 3.5.3.\n\n

/>

* * *

3Speak Video & Shorts Upload
----------------------------

You can now upload videos to [3Speak](https://3speak.tv)directly from the Ecency mobile app - with smart automatic tagging built in. Upload a video inside a **blog post** and it gets published as a standard 3Speak video. Upload inside **Waves** and it is automatically marked as a **Short**. The entire upload flow has been improved and simplified compared to the previous version, making it faster to go from recording to publishing.

* * *

AI Writing Assistant
--------------------

An AI writing assistant is now available inside the mobile editor. Use it to draft posts, improve your writing, expand ideas, or clean up a rough draft - right inside the app without switching tools.

You get a **daily free usage allowance** to try it out. Need more? You can spend **Ecency Points** to unlock additional usage. Points can be earned through your regular activity on the platform.

* * *

Translate Summary & AI Image Generation Boosts
----------------------------------------------

Two more AI-powered tools land in this release:

*   **Translate summary** - summarize or translate any post content with a single tap, useful for engaging with content across language barriers
    
*   **AI image generation boosts** - when generating images, you can now opt for the **2x, 4x, 6x power boost**, spending a few extra Points to unlock better reasoning and higher-quality results
    

Both features tie directly into the Ecency Points system - earn through activity, spend on the tools you want.

* * *

Waves Redesigned
----------------

Waves got a full redesign this release. The page has been rebuilt with a cleaner layout and several new ways to navigate content:

*   **For You tab** - a personalized feed of Waves content
    
*   **Following tab** - Waves exclusively from accounts you follow
    
*   **Filter by hashtag** - tap any hashtag in a Wave to instantly filter the feed to that topic
    
*   **Filter by user** - tap any avatar or username to see all Waves from that person
    

On top of the new layout, significant **speed optimizations** make the Waves feed noticeably faster to load and scroll through.

* * *

Simplified Transfer Dialogs & Bad Actor Warnings
------------------------------------------------

The transfer and wallet dialogs have been simplified for a cleaner, faster flow. This update also improves bad actor detection - you will see clearer warnings when interacting with flagged or unfamiliar accounts, helping you stay safe.

* * *

Image Proxy Server Selection
----------------------------

You can now choose which image proxy server is used to load images across the app. If you experience slow image loading in your region, switch to a server that performs better for you directly from settings.

* * *

Unified Server List
-------------------

The RPC and API server list has been consolidated and unified across the app, making server management more consistent wherever you access it.

* * *

PAT & Chat Fixes
----------------

Several bugs related to Personal Access Tokens and the chat API have been resolved, improving reliability for users who rely on these features.

* * *

Translations Updated
--------------------

Multiple rounds of Crowdin translation updates are included in this release. Thank you to all our community translators who keep Ecency accessible across languages!

* * *

Under the Hood
--------------

Routine dependency updates (tar, undici, sjcl, node-forge, lodash, activesupport) keep the app secure and up to date.

* * *

Update

[Ecency.com](https://ecency.com) | [iOS app](https://ios.ecency.com) | [Android app](https://android.ecency.com) | [Direct Android APK file](https://github.com/ecency/ecency-mobile/releases)

and let us know what you think in the comments or on [Ecency Waves](https://ecency.com/waves).

Found a bug? Report it on [GitHub](https://github.com/ecency/ecency-mobile/issues).

body.title: Nature’s Fresh Gift Vibrant Green Squash Straight from My Garden
body.body:
![image 20260409_164408_0000](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/serram007/23wgFcQnDhymsttHavqEfnjZfFwLXac4azzw5yPiVamCiAVkthfLiaGpE4aYwURNF3kBQ.png)


Hello hivean friends 😊

Wow, my squash look so good! They are really fresh and the green color is so deep and vibrant. They look so healthy and shiny under the sun.
 

![image 20260409_164408_0001](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/serram007/23uQi8HHSxMkP4ntqx5bhPY5FN8HayVKESPNtcSzYeCXw68tbQpDpQqb72Vvy1RsLncX2.png)

They are so big and round! Just look at them so full and heavy. You can already tell they are going to be so tasty and meaty when cooked.
 

![image 20260409_164409_0005](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/serram007/23xVHDsERBihFsyqubocmQkkmnCmTWxXp66EQF7bMNDgDZiVXdJD9Hw6dDejvkaz4bGwi.png)

The skin looks really nice. It has those cool patterns and light green or white spots. Every single one is unique like they have their own special design.
 

![image 20260409_164409_0004](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/serram007/23wCGAYhb3yCW43GzvQPJYYShRpGp1CaRLAyrQv5aWcw7hffn2DLFnSHL75cyHbqau3n8.png)

The vines and leaves are growing really well. They are so green and thick that’s why the fruits are growing so nicely. It’s really nice to see.
 
![image 20260409_164409_0003](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/serram007/23yTYTr9emucyJ2n8d6wXFW1jLcS3N7kcHfjTDcMGSnCNnD6yvJmA2bpw9vWknDNycPb2.png)

They are hanging nicely on the stems not touching the ground. So they grow evenly and stay clean. The stems are strong too, so they are very secure.
 

![image 20260409_164409_0002](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/serram007/23w2jC3LwkjPT2ypqM8gauUenihC5Hd4uxV5sB1vCU3yZhethFs1aFSTXinUw5aS4GUrM.png)

You know food from your own garden always tastes better. Sweeter softer and super fresh with no chemicals. Perfect for soup or any dish you want to cook.
 

![image 20260409_164410_0007](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/serram007/23tbyeHDQdAJh5fqwrYKmiDJtwvkY47X3x2aKgWort9tHDE6cDUiyzw2CHH9v4khjmwgy.png)

All the hard work and care was totally worth it. From planting to seeing them grow like this i feel really proud. It’s such an achievement.
 

![image 20260409_164410_0006](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/serram007/23uQnM8KfeujSzZS3AqXy9G1wNdMmS6D5xaNhnJ6qf5Hoo8EJZV6ZMMTRDiGcf4yHYryE.png)

I am really happy and proud of my harvest. They are fresh green and healthy. I can’t wait to pick them and cook for the family!

title.title: Baby Potatoes in a Skillet\\Babykartoffeln in der Pfanne
title.body:
Hello,my friends!
Today we'll be frying baby potatoes in a skillet. They're called baby potatoes because they're small, so there's no need to peel them; they're cooked whole. They're not new potatoes, so there's no tattered skin on top; they're just small potatoes, and they're not always of good quality; they still have eyes and green parts. I'll fry the baby potatoes and then add a sauce made with soy sauce and honey. It's a subtle Asian twist. Let's get going, it's going to be delicious!



![1.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdBwTn8KSvM3pPGytuPJpVXKwpHft49xgMNxhpBaWtfUU/1.jpg)


Ingredients:
● Baby potatoes - 20 (enough so they all fit in the skillet in a single layer)
● Soy sauce - 5 tbsp
● Honey - 1 tbsp
● Garlic - 2 cloves
● Hot pepper - a pinch
● Fish sauce - 1 tsp
● Rice vinegar - 2 tbsp
● Sugar, mirin, frying oil, sesame seeds, green onions - to taste

1.Wash the baby potatoes thoroughly, even though they're already washed. Remove any suspicious-looking spots. Fry the potatoes in oil in a frying pan. Fry for 4-5 minutes per side over medium-high heat. Don't forget to turn them over. After 10-15 minutes, reduce the heat to low and cover with a lid.



![2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdgZLPbthsiHmsnPLAqBt1U9vwmpMRDV6yuBc8CDA4gLk/2.jpg)


2.Let the baby potatoes simmer over low heat for another 10 minutes. This should be enough time; you can pierce the potatoes with a fork to check for doneness; the inside should be soft under the skin. Now we need to make a dressing for the baby potatoes.



![3.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXUnzbZxuE6TgVKp4nqjnzVAxLLg5JYLZHQdkH1uZugE3/3.jpg)


3.Mix the honey, soy sauce, and hot red pepper in a bowl. Finely chop the garlic and add it along with the rice vinegar. For the more sophisticated, add a spoonful of mirin and a spoonful of fish sauce. Stir the sauce to dissolve the honey.



![4.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcaGwKgiinr82aGN5ekprUAZS5redjQRha8MqeY5FGa9b/4.jpg)


4.Place the baby potatoes on a plate and add a bowl of soy sauce and honey. Serve with sesame seeds and green onions. It's best to cut each baby potato in half, spear it with a fork, and dip it in the sauce. It's tastier that way! Not bad!



![9.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdyyht1KfWbUNEC3RXQ6sAVCU8TYsWi4nXqKimZyx3mGB/9.jpg)


Shall we cook?

![3-poloska-1.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYyhhAydYCgxXo6MZeZ3YC526qwyBdU2NCdMXtyoJGAXB/3-poloska-1.png)

Heute braten wir Babykartoffeln in der Pfanne. Sie heißen Babykartoffeln, weil sie klein sind und deshalb nicht geschält werden müssen; sie werden im Ganzen gegart. Es sind keine Frühkartoffeln, daher haben sie keine rissige Schale; es sind einfach kleine Kartoffeln, und ihre Qualität ist nicht immer optimal; sie haben noch Keimaugen und grüne Stellen. Ich brate die Babykartoffeln an und gebe dann eine Sauce aus Sojasauce und Honig dazu. Das gibt dem Ganzen eine dezente asiatische Note. Los geht's, es wird köstlich!

Zutaten:
● Babykartoffeln – 20 Stück (genug, damit sie alle nebeneinander in die Pfanne passen)
● Sojasauce – 5 EL
● Honig – 1 EL
● Knoblauch – 2 Zehen
● Chilipulver – eine Prise
● Fischsauce – 1 TL
● Reisessig – 2 EL
● Zucker, Mirin, Bratöl, Sesamsamen, Frühlingszwiebeln – nach Geschmack

1.Waschen Sie die Babykartoffeln gründlich, auch wenn sie bereits gewaschen sind. Entfernen Sie alle verdächtig aussehenden Stellen. Braten Sie die Kartoffeln in Öl in einer Pfanne an. Braten Sie sie bei mittlerer bis hoher Hitze 4–5 Minuten pro Seite. Nicht vergessen, sie zu wenden. Nach 10–15 Minuten die Hitze reduzieren und die Pfanne abdecken.

2.Lassen Sie die Babykartoffeln weitere 10 Minuten bei schwacher Hitze köcheln. Das sollte ausreichen. Sie können die Kartoffeln mit einer Gabel einstechen, um zu prüfen, ob sie gar sind; das Innere sollte unter der Schale weich sein. Jetzt bereiten wir ein Dressing für die kleinen Kartoffeln zu.

3.Honig, Sojasauce und Chiliflocken in einer Schüssel verrühren. Den Knoblauch fein hacken und zusammen mit dem Reisessig dazugeben. Für eine raffiniertere Variante können Sie noch einen Löffel Mirin und einen Löffel Fischsauce hinzufügen. Die Sauce umrühren, bis sich der Honig aufgelöst hat.

4.Die kleinen Kartoffeln auf einen Teller geben und mit der Sojasauce-Honig-Mischung übergießen. Mit Sesamkörnern und Frühlingszwiebeln servieren. Am besten halbieren Sie die Kartoffeln, spießen sie mit einer Gabel auf und tunken sie in die Sauce. So schmecken sie am besten! Nicht schlecht!

Wollen wir kochen?




![3-poloska-1.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYyhhAydYCgxXo6MZeZ3YC526qwyBdU2NCdMXtyoJGAXB/3-poloska-1.png)



![U5duDCNw2pr2jpJvE8CRni125dys5tM_1680x8400.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXaogGpoD7LJkEufiNxjF52VcPhQZJYsJet34fDwJyYUV/U5duDCNw2pr2jpJvE8CRni125dys5tM_1680x8400.png)![U5dr1BuE8ejAxctktpDvrzGctPnaMgF_1680x8400.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVmydUTmF1ECe7u87FkCoJYcxT6Xo9spqJBWGi8G3ntXH/U5dr1BuE8ejAxctktpDvrzGctPnaMgF_1680x8400.jpg)

title.title: Update on my Little Flower Garden Masterpiece
title.body:
— Alfred Austin </center>*

<center> 🌸 🌿 🌸 🌿 🌸 🌿 🌸 🌿 🌸 🌿 🌸 🌿 🌸 🌿 🌸 🌿 🌸 🌿 🌸 🌿 🌸 </center>


Hello there, Hive gardeners ❣️

I am so happy to share an update on my plant collection.
The sun is shining bright today, and the garden is looking very colorful. 😊

My purple orchids are in full bloom 💜 and I'm so thankful 

![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vvodjiu/243M4ru98U1ovDfu5PDDmbcHyAbMhrL7qBEmVywg4zszUwwdaufoW5aXjJj8YRt4QnV72.jpg)

| | |
|-|-|
|![1b.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vvodjiu/245wB8rFMq3kBZbpByBDcNUtn3n6gqWVMwjpzsDXbv6jqZ22T2Xn8MmX1gBmetaZ3mGC9.jpg)|![1a.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vvodjiu/245cRxrbfz4YMWiWxLhXg5JudFkAufqfwg7Ef9Mh8dYZzU1X5iPtC5aCRezvwo7XFToSL.jpg)|

![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vvodjiu/23ynWbK2CqfL3yxu4EvZ3zZhgUegiSdKLfueCEx8uNEfLPiAwrQBBYAxAuwLruVSp1S6q.jpg)



My purple orchids are the stars of the garden right now.
They are flowering non-stop
I have 2 types of this purple orchid.
The first one has a solid purple color.
The petals are a mix of rounded and pointed edges.

The other one has petals that are a deep, rich purple with tiny white patterns if you look closely. They are thin and curl backwards.

They reach up toward the blue sky and look so graceful.

While my Vanda orchid is resting and hasn't bloomed yet, these purple ones keep the garden looking bright and cheerful every single day.

---
---


Here are my Asters 💗
These look like small, round pom-poms.
They have bright pink petals and a fuzzy yellow center. I have two pots that are just overflowing with these pretty blooms.



![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vvodjiu/23tvYCannyy654dhFVmSae5rrc94JhmKMLtP7Zc79EpG6WUtyMrS3fPEo6M9MJbm1AW6M.jpg)

![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vvodjiu/23tSKzEXHgUbQNag2P1PivB24YqjQwqo9NdvcN8Bg6ZbM9reQg9cL7SgzWcAmt14zSXQY.jpg)



| | |
|-|-|
|![4a.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vvodjiu/23w2gtWFtt2ST8vfCjR5qYFReDPP8LScPZ3urqbybAB2FZB6LNGYzEEVCpy8Sowt2D4is.jpg)|![4b.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vvodjiu/23wC5YsqS47C262cx8vm9ZuAyjzb9HqdfWUbN7EMi1zvSgD2fqbuCGGNLpFY7w8TSfALg.jpg)|

---
---

Next are the Pentas, or the cluster of star flowers ✨

| | |
|-|-|
|![5a.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vvodjiu/23xKjtGjExH6LpoLJqDfGAbN67vcU2f5TcaqQNHruQgEnPJ1QXJRcgoHYsGvmvABbhNTm.jpg)|![5b.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vvodjiu/23wqZfdxkqPsDHvyK6NSYB8qKo7bmpBh6m3WzAwquCbuCyMoN5d9RyjQ9q1X3Yykng5iQ.jpg)|


I also have a beautiful ball of tiny light-purple flowers called Pentas.
Each little flower is shaped like a perfect star.
They grow close together in a big bunch.
I also have other colors like bright pink and red.

---
---


My Coleus plant is also showing off. 😁
Too afraid of getting outshone by other flowering plants.


![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vvodjiu/23uQg3LCkYCuSey775waDuTLN6MR8pRP17PX92NnnxFaedYeNj6Eb4WfZr6SYvS39jWho.jpg)

![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vvodjiu/23wqbuLaELuDw5CwAgWwjKLUtLCCwNdJg8qormx5FjJYDpHskrDe3QEkK1h87azz6Q9bM.jpg)





It has big, soft leaves with green edges and a bright pink and purple middle. It even grew a tall, thin spike with tiny blue flowers on it!
The flowers look like tiny birds perched on the tiny stem. 😁

---
---

As for my Coral Drift Rose, it is taking a little nap for now.
All the old flowers withered away, and there are no new buds yet.
But the leaves are still very healthy, dark green, so I know it is just busy growing stronger for the next time it decides to bloom. 😊


![IMG_20260409_153704.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vvodjiu/23tkp99KDRtUynamC8ENqbVxEDuS1wmsjM5xJ61UoQtsodmev4crNRx4sE3Zkc6GqRvkX.jpg)

---
---


🌿🦅
It is so peaceful and satisfying to walk around and see how much everything has grown in my garden.
Even without the roses, the garden is full of pink, purple, and green.
I love how the bright sunlight makes the colors pop against the brown earth.

title.title: Nghề công nhân vẫn có thể đầu tư thành công — không cần đổi nghề, chỉ cần đúng phương pháp
title.body:
![lam giau voi crypto.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfCpnSzvbKRhG9gQHfxfPJHmTxr67un7yxzGwvvjZBkpj/lam%20giau%20voi%20crypto.png)
Tôi mất sạch 50 triệu tiền để dành trong 3 tuần

Tôi làm công nhân được 7 năm. Mỗi tháng lương 9 triệu, để dành 6 tháng góp được hơn 50 triệu. Rồi đổ hết vào crypto.

Ba tuần sau, tôi mở app và không còn gì nữa.

Chọn sai sàn, mua coin theo tin đồn, đổ hết một lần, bị cảm xúc điều khiển. Tháng đó không mua được đồ chơi sinh nhật cho con. Đêm không ngủ được.

---

Giờ nghỉ trưa tôi không ngủ nữa — tôi học cách để tiền làm việc thay mình

Tôi tìm đến PhuongLE Academy. Học trong giờ nghỉ trưa, học sau ca làm.

Trước: làm ca suốt ngày, không có thời gian → Sau: phương pháp cho người bận rộn, học ngay giờ nghỉ trưa
Trước: không biết ví lạnh, để tiền trên sàn → Sau: thành thạo ví lạnh, tài sản an toàn
Trước: mua coin theo tin đồn → Sau: hệ thống chọn coin rõ ràng
Trước: đoán mò thời điểm mua bán → Sau: mua gần đáy, bán gần đỉnh
Trước: đổ hết vốn một lần → Sau: mô hình kim tự tháp, biết lúc nào đánh lớn nhỏ
Trước: bị cảm xúc điều khiển → Sau: làm chủ cảm xúc, hành động theo kế hoạch

---

Tôi vẫn mặc đồng phục đi làm — nhưng cuộc sống của tôi đã khác hoàn toàn

Con gái vào lớp 1, học phí tôi lo được hết. Lần đầu dẫn vợ đi Đà Lạt bằng tiền chốt lời. Nghề tay trái đầu tư mang về thu nhập thụ động đều mỗi tháng — tích lũy được vốn khá, bắt đầu nghĩ đến mua đất, sửa nhà, góp vốn mở xưởng.

Ngủ ngon hơn, ít cáu gắt hơn, đang học thêm tiếng Anh.

Nếu một công nhân như tôi làm được — bạn cũng làm được.

title.title: [Korruption auf den Philippinen]  HOW TO STAND UP TO A DICTATOR - Deutsche Ausgabe #32/128
title.body:
>Acht Monate später erschütterten die Anschläge des 11. September die Welt. An diesem Tag zeigten sich die Schwachstellen eines globalen Sicherheitsparadigmas, das auf Grundsätzen des Kalten Krieges beruhte, welche in einer Zeit der asymmetrischen Kriegsführung globaler Terrorgruppen keine Gültigkeit mehr besaßen. An die Stelle nationalstaatlicher Mächte trat eine andere Art mächtiger Bewegung, die von Leidenschaft und Sendungsbewusstsein getragen wurde. Die Verbindungen zu al-Qaida aufzudecken wurde zu meiner Obsession. Gleichzeitig wurde ich auf ein neues Phänomen aufmerksam: wie eine virulente Ideologie Netzwerke radikalisieren und etwas bewirken kann, das mir zu diesem Zeitpunkt bereits bekannt war: emergentes Verhalten.

\n
>Der 11. September 2001 riss die Fassade ein, die kollektive Lüge, die wir über den Frieden nach dem Kalten Krieg erschaffen hatten.\n\n<span class=\
>Was viele damals nicht wussten – und worüber ich ausführlicher berichten wollte –, war, dass Südostasien schon früh als Brutstätte für al-Qaida gedient hatte.\n\n<span class=\

>27 Am 11. September war die Organisation bereits seit Langem in der Region aktiv. Mohammed Jamal Khalifa, der Schwager von Osama bin Laden, war bereits 1988 auf die Philippinen gekommen, um islamische Wohltätigkeitsorganisationen zu gründen, die den Wahhabismus und andere radikale Gedanken verbreiteten. Von 1991 bis 1994 stieg die Zahl der Terroranschläge auf den Philippinen um fast 150 Prozent an.

>Am 11. September eilte ich von meinem Fitnessstudio in Jakarta nach Hause, um meine Akten und Geheimdienstunterlagen herauszukramen (damals die einzige Möglichkeit für eine Reporterin, den Überblick über Ereignisse und Beziehungen zu behalten). Ich las das Verhörprotokoll des philippinischen Geheimdienstes von 1995 über Abdul Hakim Murad, einen in US-amerikanischen Flugschulen ausgebildeten, zugelassenen Verkehrspiloten. Möglicherweise war er der erste Pilot, der von al-Qaida rekrutiert wurde. Er wurde 1995 in Manila verhaftet, an die Vereinigten Staaten ausgeliefert und saß zum Zeitpunkt der Anschläge vom 11. September 2001 im Hochsicherheitsgefängnis in Florence, Colorado.\n\n<span class=\

>Nachdem ich das Verhörprotokoll gelesen hatte, bat ich Atlanta, mich auf die Philippinen zu schicken, damit ich den 1995 amtierenden Polizeichef von Manila über die al-Qaida-Verschwörung befragen konnte. Die Namen, über die ich erstmals von den Philippinen berichtete, sind inzwischen bekannt.\n\n<span class=\
>30 Ramzi Yousef und Khalid Sheikh Mohammed hatten sich 1995 beide auf den Philippinen aufgehalten, um ein Attentat auf Papst Johannes Paul II. und US-Präsident Bill Clinton vorzubereiten.

>31 Das Komplott, über das wir alle berichteten, nannte sich Oplan Bojinka, einen Plan zur Bombardierung von US-Flugzeugen, die von Asien aus flogen. Was wir damals ignorierten – weil es uns zu fantastisch erschien –, war ein anderer Plan, nämlich, Verkehrsflugzeuge zu entführen und sie in Gebäude zu rammen: in das World Trade Center in New York City, das Pentagon, das Sears Building in Chicago und in die TransAmerica Pyramid in San Francisco.

>32 Je mehr ich darüber berichtete, desto deutlicher wurde mir, dass jede größere al-Qaida-Verschwörung zwischen 1993 und 2003 in irgendeiner Weise mit den Philippinen, der ehemaligen Kolonie der Vereinigten Staaten, in Verbindung stand, vom Anschlag auf das World Trade Center 1993 über die Bombenanschläge auf US-Botschaften in Ostafrika 1998 bis hin zum Anschlag auf das JW Marriott Hotel in Jakarta 2003.

>Das bedeutet, dass die beiden größten Geschichten meiner Karriere mit den Philippinen als Testgelände für zwei Gefahren zu tun hatten, die die Vereinigten Staaten und die Welt im 21. Jahrhundert bedrohen: islamischer Terrorismus und Informationskriegsführung in den sozialen Medien.

\n

>Nach dem 11. September 2001 war ich besessen davon, dieses globale Terrornetzwerk zu durchleuchten, um herauszufinden, welche Mitglieder miteinander verbunden waren, und um vielleicht ähnliche Komplotte aufzudecken.\n\n<span class=\

>34 Ich suchte nach altgedienten Kontaktpersonen – Ermittlern, die auf den Philippinen, in Indonesien, Singapur und Malaysia Karriere gemacht hatten und bestrebt waren, ihre Ressourcen zu nutzen und Erkenntnisse zu gewinnen. Sie waren mehr als bereit, frühere Geheimdienstberichte über al-Qaida-Mitglieder weiterzugeben. Im Gegenzug erhielten sie Analysen darüber, was diese Informationen bedeuten könnten. Zu diesem Zeitpunkt verfügte ich über mehr Material als sie, da es in Südostasien weder eine zentrale Datenbank noch ein offizielles Programm zum Austausch von Informationen gab. Ich begann, eine eigene Datenbank mit den vertraulichen Geheimdienstinformationen zu führen, die sie mir zur Verfügung stellten.

>35\n\r\n In dem Versuch, die schwerfällige Bürokratie zu umgehen, nahmen die Ermittler oft den Hörer in die Hand und riefen mich an, um herauszufinden, ob ein neu entdeckter Name bekannt war, oder um zu erörtern, was eine neue Information bedeuten könnte. So war ich in der Lage, im Jahrzehnt nach 9/11 eine Exklusivstory nach der anderen für CNN zu produzieren.

title.title: = YOLO(You Only Live Once)TRAP! But It’s Far Wiser to Live Smart Every Single Day So Your Future Shines Brighter.
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb2cqZbaFXuyapqoHun8LTSNUWjadJ9rabckc4BsvE3Pf/1775792658079.jpg)
[Source](https://canva.link/53bwns156u30nkj)





Hey Hive family! 👋
Picture this:Two guys sitting on rocks by the ocean at sunset.The sky is on fire with orange and gold. One friend in blue says:“**WE ONLY LIVE ONCE.**”
His buddy in green fires back“**WRONG! WE ONLY DIE ONCE. WE LIVE EVERY DAY**!”
That picture dropped a truth bomb, and today I’m sharing my thoughts on it properly for all of us in Naija – right here on Hive and around the globe.




Here’s the simple but powerful line we’re talking about:
“WE ONLY LIVE ONCE.” That’s the YOLO mindset. But it is by far wiser to live smart every single day so that one’s future is better.
Let me explain why this matters so much in our everyday life. 

What the YOLO Mindset (“WE ONLY LIVE ONCE”) Really Does .YOLO = You Only Live Once. It sounds cool and exciting. People use it to justify anything:
* Spend the whole salary now, YOLO!
* Skip saving,life is short! 
* Take every risky move, no time to think twice! And the list goes on.

But here’s the real talk:This mindset tricks you into treating today like the only day that counts.You chase one big moment and forget that tomorrow, next week, and next year are still coming.


**Real-life Naija examples that hit hard**:The salary trap!
Your colleague collects his pay on the 25th and shouts “YOLO!” He buys new trainers, eats at fancy spots every evening, and parties all weekend. By the 10th of the next month, NEPA has taken light, fuel for the generator is finished, and he’s borrowing ₦50k from you. He lived “once”,but now he’s stressed every single day.The student who lost a whole year!
A UNILAG student says “We only live once” and spends nights on TikTok instead of reading. Exam time comes, he fails, and has to repeat the year. One “fun” decision cost him 12 months of his future. YOLO sounded sweet, but the regret lasts forever.
The risky business move! A guy in Ikeja hears about a “hot” crypto deal and puts all his savings in because “YOLO.” The market crashes in one week. He loses everything. Now he’s starting from zero while his friends who saved steadily are opening small shops.








The Wiser Way: Live Smart Every Single Day
The green-shirt guy got it right. You die only once, but you get to live every single day. That means every morning is a fresh chance to build something better.You don’t need to wait for “one big break.” Small smart choices every day add up to a completely different future.Examples that actually work in real life:The side-hustle winner in Warri,
Instead of saying “YOLO, I’ll just manage this job,” he wakes up 30 minutes earlier every day, learns digital skills on his phone, and sends one job application or proposal every single week. In four months he lands a better-paying remote gig. He didn’t wait to live “once”,he lived smarter every day and changed his story.
Family man who chose daily love:One husband used to say “We only live once” and worked weekends, missing his kids’ school events. His wiser friend decided to “live every day” by making sure he eats dinner with his family every single evening, no matter how busy. Ten years later, his children remember the daily memories, not the extra money he chased “once.”


My Straight-from-the-Heart Take.
“WE ONLY LIVE ONCE” feels fun in the moment,but it can quietly waste 364 days of your year.
Living smart every single day is the real power move. It turns ordinary mornings into building blocks for a future you’ll be proud of.Hive fam, this sunset picture is asking every one of us a serious question:
Are you living like tomorrow doesn’t matter,or are you choosing to live wisely today so your future is brighter?
Drop your answers below and let’s make this post explode:
Which side are you on right now ,YOLO or “live smart every day”?
Share ONE small thing you will do today to make your future better.
We only die once,but we LIVE every single day!
What’s your plan for today, family? Let’s hear it! 

Thank you for reading my post.Yours truly,@zusi78, signing off.

title.body:
https://youtu.be/jbpetaEPxXI?si=qtsy_brXJwAlYs1N
People are always looking for the way out. They are in search of the way out of financial problems. They are in search of health problems. They are in search of hope which seems to be lost. The world is so full of people who are in search of one way out or the other

Let us stop the fruitless search which we are making.   The only one solution to the many problems in the world is to turn to God. God is what we should be searching for. It is God who will remove out of every painfull situation. Running away from God will not solve your problems or my mine if we don't acknowledge Him as God.

God wants us to search after Him. It is the will of God towards every human, that we should seek after Him. Loving God and obeying His commandments should be our desire and our delight. We have to look for God in His word. This word reveals God to us. As we keep studying the word of God daily, we will see God clearly revealed unto us. 

So, many people are making the mistake of looking for God where they cannot find him. God is not the idol which we bought with our money our made with our hands. The true and living God is with us always. The power of God which is working on earth is the evidence that God lives and abides with us. When we turn our hearts unto Him, we will be fully abiding in his presence.

title.title: Brownie triple chocolate a mi estilo [ESP/ENG]
title.body:
# Brownie triple chocolate a mi estilo [ESP/ENG]

Hola amigos lectores de la comunidad de @hivefood, espero que hayan tenido un excelente día, lleno bendiciones para cada uno de ustedes. Yo por acá me encuentro bien gracias a Dios. Los invito a que me acompañen a preparar este deliciosa receta que a todos les encantara.
 
![29.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/243MBEdYoiGJRGw1ntT4jjTiQHTQj9aKFukWrToWZW1tQiLkqKLfr8hWoiBtkfTSLVJZF.jpg)

Hoy quise compartirles una de las receta que a la mayoría de las personas tanto niños como jóvenes y adultos le encanta y es  un delicioso brownie triple chóclate que prepare en días pasados para el cumpleaños de una abuelita muy apreciada, que estaba cumpliendo sus 90 años de vida, sus nietas del exterior me llaman para que le preparara lo que a ella mas le encanta un browniw y me dicen que se lo rellene con chocolate y que igual su cubierta fuese de chocolate porque a ella le encanta y quieren hacerla sentir feliz con este deliciosos postre.


![22.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EpQxByoJZswq8RSUApRJ8D3sxSwME9oorbF9n61PtzmCkq3hvLqUQKueHdRRKRS1XTv.jpg)

![23.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23yJLtzeygq71FWkBAE2UJ71kUTiZUVDSmjZ2n9LBRmDDuABYv76hifkXqprtCap34k2z.jpg)

Déjenme decirles que la cumpleañera y su familia me comentaron que había quedado muy rico, super húmedo y  que la abuela lo disfruto al máximo, al igual que los invitados. 

![26.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23yd3ZFRsoxMbmpheTTRtgZcj3GRbRuqEidRAbW9pZL9586Uaz1iGeypAdumX9qqb4X2g.jpg)

Ahora les indico los ingredientes y el paso a paso para su preparacion. Les informo que no es nada del otro mundo, es una receta sencilla, económica, y se utilizan pocos ingredientes que son fáciles de conseguir en cualquier supermercado:

# Ingredientes:
# Biscocho
• 2 y 1/2 tazas medidoras full de harina de trigo leudante
• 3 tazas medidoras de azúcar  
• 4 huevos grandes 
•1 y 1/2 taza de aceite comestible de maiz
• 2 taza de cacao en polvo de buena calidad preferible de la marca mantoro alcalino
• 2  taza de leche liquida  
• 1 cucharada de canela en polvo, ½ cuchara de bicarbonato
• 2 cucharadas de vainilla
• 1 cucharada de vinagre
• Una pizca de sal 

![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23yJG8G2cL1UJ4RmqqfpCf9qjPxK1zBBTr5JhouvQng14nPYFiH9HbS1MkmZLQUN8xTQV.jpg)

# Jarabe para humedecer
• 1 tazas de azúcar  
• 2 tazas de agua
• 5 clavos de olor , 5 guayabitas y una ramita de canela en palo

# Preparación
1.En un tazón colocar la harina y el cacao cernido, agregar 2 y ½ tazas de azúcar, la canela, el bicarbonato y la sal revolver con movimientos envolventes hasta que se unan todos los ingredientes secos. 

![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/AKLtP2zqYUTvJDE7ZrkX1FEJzyGLqubdeT5U5Y1nVzxRmLM5A92RERi3xzkeJTS.jpg)

2.Agregar el aceite, la leche liquida unida al vinagre, las yemas de huevo uno a uno, la vainilla, revolver con pequeños movimientos envolventes. 

![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/AKDhdQcN64avPwbddeg2aUG6U23HhKA3FssQx9UnQMvm66MekYAAzhCT7hEH3AM.jpg)|![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23ynUgSArVeaQzqnkGFWRmzNUVDx3kcfRAoDvqs6LhsFjCwqdjRTVJTsJtPkmbUCpWs5p.jpg)|![9.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23xVMPRoCfBEfY1GxfFKEQKxv8QrvkVvgbFW5yMfJqqT8TXvtsss3DF3fYnQrhFFHr6Rm.jpg)|![10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23wMaeqgKBd5trVZs6qdJX1VV7hQEBUnbSWwWG9vxo2mMQzgR4eXuoju9ankfner76Cr3.jpg)
-|-|-|-

![12.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23yd8J2Fxi9QpnXTfSHGQDSiv8MkfxF7np1nSyDGcL7v6S4hjmg3BkpLufbZoX4MWoepX.jpg)

3.Batir las clara a punto de nieve, agregar poco a poco la  ½ taza de azúcar, seguir batiendo, agregar al tazón que contiene la mezcla, seguir revolviendo hasta que todo este unido.  

![16.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23wCG1Ef4hAz8vRkvjq8i8AjtKZgD7Tqp3qrK1FXniBvENVLURy2kZjubHvQQbek6xyLm.jpg)|![17.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23vsSPyKcCyHy6UNt2iLPxXBc4GdsBUBj7E6rg6BFGireSpPpJcjog2RQvyDHLLWfy3G5.jpg)|![18.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/242DQkUXJXDbECu1YXeYoBfVnMU5VvmSx7dPw13sAseMVskoxswJ6AGefjxQTjXZyRdsG.jpg)|![19.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23yJJpZF9quyHobupAcfrxsn9PYpm317Z6K235dqYhZYuCdbDiNHJ2UcaJ95VKFWahTCU.jpg)
-|-|-|-

4.Tomar un molde de 20 centímetros, untarle margarina y colocarle un tanto de harina, mover hasta que todo el molde este bien  engrasado y  enharinado. Colocar la mezcla, llevar al horno previamente calentado a 180 grados centígrados por 1 hora, introducirle un palito de altura o u espaguetis, si sale seco ya está listo, sino dejarla uno diez minutos más, hasta que salga seco . El tiempo de horneado va  a depender del tipo de horno. Este cake alcanza de 20 a 25 comensales todo depende del tamaño que de las ración.

![19.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23yJJpZF9quyHobupAcfrxsn9PYpm317Z6K235dqYhZYuCdbDiNHJ2UcaJ95VKFWahTCU.jpg)

![20.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/245wQ6MqtqNsrA5BJK7VoXJEzNmBsk7rFJXm3h9U4DQrXfMrmkwPxFP282FkAWiXybBp6.jpg)

# Jarabe
Colocar una cacerola, agregar el agua el azúcar, los clavos de olor, las guayabitas y la rama de canela en palo, dejar cocinar por espacio de 10 minutos, hasta que disminuya un poco, bajar, dejar enfriar.
El biscocho debe cortarse en la mitad, pincharlo con un palito de altura o un tenedor, rociar con el jarabe las capas, agregar y extender el chocolate en crema con ayuda de una espátula. Esta crema de chocolate es la misma que ya les he  explicado en otros post. Colocarle la otra tapa ya humedecida para cerrar el cake, introducir 2 palillo en el centro para evitar que se muevan las capas.

![21.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23xKzo2KwnyE1XLrqT9gD3cg1KV8GRMLgzf8mhvQUuZyCZZozX7Vh6PC9C2EQAN3xeyr2.jpg)

Luego inicio con la decoración, colocándole suficiente crema de chocolate en la parte de encima y por los lados, aliso y termino de decorar como se desee.

![27.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23xyXHmv1tUjJXb3W7GNx7FfgAPTWY6jeJqZLkWwDGcguX3UjEktDi5JUxwyNkBtwCRA1.jpg)

Hasta aquí mi post, les dejo algunas fotos, espero que esta receta sea de su agrado. Nos vemos en un proximo contenido.

* Fotos tomadas con Iphone 8 plus
* Portada diseñada con Canva
* Texto traducido con Deepl

<div class=\

> # English Version # My Take on a Triple-Chocolate Brownie Hello, fellow readers of the @hivefood community! I hope you’ve all had a wonderful day, and may each of you be blessed. I’m doing well here, thank God. I invite you to join me in making this delicious recipe that everyone will love. ![29.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/243MBEdYoiGJRGw1ntT4jjTiQHTQj9aKFukWrToWZW1tQiLkqKLfr8hWoiBtkfTSLVJZF.jpg) Today I wanted to share one of the recipes that most people—children, teens, and adults alike—love: a delicious triple-chocolate brownie that I made a few days ago for the birthday of a beloved grandmother who was turning 90. Her granddaughters living abroad called me to ask me to make her favorite treat—a brownie—and told me to fill it with chocolate and cover it in chocolate too, because she loves it, and they wanted to make her happy with this delicious dessert. ![22.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EpQxByoJZswq8RSUApRJ8D3sxSwME9oorbF9n61PtzmCkq3hvLqUQKueHdRRKRS1XTv.jpg) ![23.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23yJLtzeygq71FWkBAE2UJ71kUTiZUVDSmjZ2n9LBRmDDuABYv76hifkXqprtCap34k2z.jpg) Let me tell you that the birthday girl and her family told me it turned out delicious, super moist, and that Grandma enjoyed it to the fullest, just like the guests. ![26.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23yd3ZFRsoxMbmpheTTRtgZcj3GRbRuqEidRAbW9pZL9586Uaz1iGeypAdumX9qqb4X2g.jpg) Now I’ll list the ingredients and the step-by-step instructions for making it. I’ll let you know that it’s nothing fancy—it’s a simple, inexpensive recipe that uses just a few ingredients that are easy to find at any supermarket: # Ingredients: # Sponge Cake • 2 1/2 full measuring cups of self-rising flour • 3 measuring cups of sugar • 4 large eggs • 1½ cups of corn oil • 2 cups of good-quality cocoa powder (preferably the Mantoro Alcalino brand) • 2 cups of milk • 1 tablespoon of ground cinnamon, ½ teaspoon of baking soda • 2 tablespoons of vanilla • 1 tablespoon of vinegar • A pinch of salt ![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23yJG8G2cL1UJ4RmqqfpCf9qjPxK1zBBTr5JhouvQng14nPYFiH9HbS1MkmZLQUN8xTQV.jpg) # Syrup for moistening • 1 cup sugar • 2 cups water • 5 cloves, 5 star anise, and a cinnamon stick # Preparation 1.In a bowl, combine the flour and sifted cocoa powder. Add 2½ cups of sugar, the cinnamon, baking soda, and salt. Stir gently with a folding motion until all the dry ingredients are incorporated. ![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/AKLtP2zqYUTvJDE7ZrkX1FEJzyGLqubdeT5U5Y1nVzxRmLM5A92RERi3xzkeJTS.jpg) 2.Add the oil, the milk mixed with the vinegar, the egg yolks one at a time, and the vanilla; stir gently with small folding motions. ![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/AKDhdQcN64avPwbddeg2aUG6U23HhKA3FssQx9UnQMvm66MekYAAzhCT7hEH3AM.jpg) |![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23ynUgSArVeaQzqnkGFWRmzNUVDx3kcfRAoDvqs6LhsFjCwqdjRTVJTsJtPkmbUCpWs5p.jpg) |![9.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23xVMPRoCfBEfY1GxfFKEQKxv8QrvkVvgbFW5yMfJqqT8TXvtsss3DF3fYnQrhFFHr6Rm.jpg)|![10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23wMaeqgKBd5trVZs6qdJX1VV7hQEBUnbSWwWG9vxo2mMQzgR4eXuoju9ankfner76Cr3.jpg) -|-|-|- ![12.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23yd8J2Fxi9QpnXTfSHGQDSiv8MkfxF7np1nSyDGcL7v6S4hjmg3BkpLufbZoX4MWoepX.jpg) 3.Beat the egg whites until stiff peaks form, gradually add the ½ cup of sugar, continue beating, add to the bowl containing the mixture, and continue stirring until everything is well combined. ![16.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23wCG1Ef4hAz8vRkvjq8i8AjtKZgD7Tqp3qrK1FXniBvENVLURy2kZjubHvQQbek6xyLm.jpg)|![17.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23vsSPyKcCyHy6UNt2iLPxXBc4GdsBUBj7E6rg6BFGireSpPpJcjog2RQvyDHLLWfy3G5.jpg)|![18.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/242DQkUXJXDbECu1YXeYoBfVnMU5VvmSx7dPw13sAseMVskoxswJ6AGefjxQTjXZyRdsG.jpg)|![19.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23yJJpZF9quyHobupAcfrxsn9PYpm317Z6K235dqYhZYuCdbDiNHJ2UcaJ95VKFWahTCU.jpg) -|-|-|- 4.Take a 20-centimeter baking pan, grease it with margarine, and sprinkle some flour inside, swirling it around until the entire pan is well greased and floured. Pour in the batter, bake in an oven preheated to 180 degrees Celsius for 1 hour, insert a toothpick or spaghetti noodle; if it comes out dry, it’s ready; if not, bake for another 10 minutes until it comes out dry. Baking time will depend on the type of oven. This cake serves 20 to 25 people, depending on the size of the portions. ![19.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23yJJpZF9quyHobupAcfrxsn9PYpm317Z6K235dqYhZYuCdbDiNHJ2UcaJ95VKFWahTCU.jpg) ![20.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/245wQ6MqtqNsrA5BJK7VoXJEzNmBsk7rFJXm3h9U4DQrXfMrmkwPxFP282FkAWiXybBp6.jpg) # Syrup Place a saucepan on the stove, add the water, sugar, cloves, guava leaves, and cinnamon stick, and let it cook for about 10 minutes, until it reduces slightly. Remove from heat and let cool. Cut the sponge cake in half, prick it with a skewer or fork, drizzle the syrup over the layers, then spread the chocolate cream using a spatula. This chocolate cream is the same one I’ve already explained in other posts. Place the other moistened half on top to close the cake, and insert 2 toothpicks in the center to keep the layers from shifting. ![21.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23xKzo2KwnyE1XLrqT9gD3cg1KV8GRMLgzf8mhvQUuZyCZZozX7Vh6PC9C2EQAN3xeyr2.jpg) Then I start decorating, spreading enough chocolate frosting on top and around the sides, smoothing it out, and finishing the decoration as desired. ![27.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23xyXHmv1tUjJXb3W7GNx7FfgAPTWY6jeJqZLkWwDGcguX3UjEktDi5JUxwyNkBtwCRA1.jpg) That’s it for my post. Here are some photos; I hope you enjoy this recipe. See you in my next post. * Photos taken with iPhone 8 Plus * Cover designed with Canva * Text translated with Deepl Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@morepina/brownie-triple-chocolate-a-mi-estilo-espeng-4le)

<center> 🦋 💖 🦋 💖 🦋 💖 🦋 💖 🦋 💖 🦋 💖 🦋 </center>


Hello everyone.. Hope everyone doing great today.. the summer is hitting intense every single day.. plants and trees are getting wither like our avocado fruit tree.. the fruits are not in a good condition

<center> 🦋 💖 🦋 💖 🦋 💖 🦋 💖 🦋 💖 🦋 💖 🦋 </center>


![1000376369.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/blueoctopus/23tv8STTcv5BT4VJmUjqDhDGYZ8g8SaM7XBMuXsWvVjn3N48JHzVyi7sa8trwfG3EnhgM.jpg)

This is the fruit of our avocado tree.. it's size has not become normal, it's used to be large but now it seems dry and small, each flowers are also quickly consumed in falling because of the intense heat of the sun.. but even so, there are still many left and can still be used, avocado is delicious and there are many health benefits to be obtained from it.. we have four avocado trees and only two are bearing fruit so far..

<center> 🦋 💖 🦋 💖 🦋 💖 🦋 💖 🦋 💖 🦋 💖 🦋 </center>


![1000376366.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/blueoctopus/23vhnxzKgxXNP9X5xnnKkHpeCKbqtiHuRTRfxggP9zTxHeJ23wMvqrFk1K6zQcKY1sWc6.jpg)

Our papaya also has fruits, there are still flowers that will soon become fruits 

<center> 🦋 💖 🦋 💖 🦋 💖 🦋 💖 🦋 💖 🦋 💖 🦋 </center>

title.title: Possible New Violin Bow and Forgetting My Pants
title.body:
>

<center>![Possible New Violin Bow and Forgetting My Pants.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bengy/2432FLv6sVfYPeM6qmJke4paw1uGgdb7AHmB1KDJJMqrrnftAFVnHHydXJqQ7vTCrGsuS.jpg)</center>

I have been on the look out for another general purpose Baroque violin bow for a while now... I have a really nice one that I got about 25 years ago... and at that time, it was supposed to be in a risky condition due to a small crack and a misaligned screw head... but apart from needing to redo the screw eye every five to ten years at a random time of the bow's choosing... it has stayed alive and done everything that I have asked of it! In that time it has paired with about 5 different violins... and it has worked perfectly with all of them. Fast, agile, clear, and resonant... well balanced for my taste in the hand, it fits my desires perfectly! It is the longer bow in the violin section in the photo above... 

... but the feeling that each concert could be its last is starting to get to me... but it is really hard to replace with something that is at least equally good as a general purpose bow. And what do I mean by general purpose... well, something that is pretty damn good for most types of music from the Baroque and early Classical eras. I do have some more specialist bows that are better for some specific types of music... but that isn't what I'm after. 

And I've had other people try this bow... and they have universally loved it! Or at least, that is what they say to my face!

Anyway, I have recently had a few bows shown to me... and there is this particular bow (the one above my one...)... made in South America, Brazil I think, it is a slightly shorter bow, and equally fast in response and clarity. It is a touch lighter (a few grams at best...) ... but due to the size difference, the balance is slightly more into the hand which gives it more agility at the cost of being able to hold the string easily.... I'm up in the air about that (ha ha...).... anyway, the sound quality of the bow is definitely what I'm after... so, this might be a keeper.

I'll test it against a few more bows that I'm trying from the same maker as my own one... these things can vary quite a bit... so there is no guarantee that these other bows will be the same as mine... there are three.. two seem to be a similar model with similar fluting of the stick... and the other is completely different. 

... I wonder if my wife will let me walk away with more than one bow?

<center>![Possible New Violin Bow and Forgetting My Pants.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bengy/243Bm18QL8gCt7cBdBejgQMq1mud11ftSmX8QLkBeJ8tHqAm37mmWsZwy7cyWDFz5p1VZ.jpg)</center>

And when I packed for this tour... I stupidly did the packing in two sessions on either side of a family dinner. Which meant that when I went to double check for my concert clothes this morning... well, I forgot to bring my jacket and pants. Sigh... those are sort of necessary... well, the jacket a little less so, but the pants are quite desirable. 

... I could ask to borrow some, but I'm small and it is just easier to go down into the city and get myself some cheap ones from Uniqlo. And at least I'll be able to reuse them... but I fear that my wife will say that it is coming out of my bow fund... boohoo!!!

title.title: Ordinary Snapshots: A Day Filled with Love
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdtpE9G9UYAQADt5CYtjptgNCpmeVWvyxUAkV9hQ8VvQw/1775792593899.png)

Hello everyone! Welcome to my ordinary snapshots. 
‎
‎They say that love makes the world go round, and I truly believe that. 
‎
‎You don’t need grand celebrations or expensive things to feel loved.
‎
‎Sometimes, love is just there...
‎
‎Today, let me share with you how my day was filled with love in every simple moment. 🌟
‎
‎--
‎
‎**A Sweet Bonding Moment**
‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeRoNn4DUTjuakRAY1P7qRV8k6QPL3zVY75nmKaKRTcV7/1775792628498.jpg)

‎My morning started in the kitchen, cooking breakfast. But I wasn't alone. These three boys were right there, waiting for the food to be ready. They were so playful while waiting. They even grabbed my phone and took selfies together. It was such a sweet bonding moment for us, a happy start before we all headed off to work. 
‎
‎--
‎
‎**Instant Noodles with Egg**
‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV7VnUiAWxwkdFoueYwzA3BA6PnyNRMU2PHCpj1bxYsJ1/1775792653163.jpg)

‎And here’s what we had for breakfast. 🤤 It was simple but filling. Instant noodles with egg. 🩷 I paired it with tuyo (dried fish). It's just the perfect match. So simple, but it tastes so good. 😋
‎
‎--
‎
‎**Mother-in-law's Special Dish**
‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUYpfuJugEj2amph4Hsa2m3F2EZ1xZVQ2rScd3kxWThVW/1775792672883.jpg)
‎
‎By lunchtime, we got my mother-in-law's signature dish... monggo (mung bean stew). Hehe. To be honest, sometimes I lose my appetite when eating this kind of dish. But I realized that what makes it tasty is really what you pair it with. If you find the perfect match, you can eat it with so much satisfaction. So we paired it with some crispy fried fish, and it was really good!
‎
‎--
‎
‎**Rustic and Beautiful Sunset**
‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNrFXf57ezsLFXNGsNa5P7v3XuPvGrmD4AdmzroE8R1jh/1775792694792.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWGqP1eiqD1xJXwDzJXHXiEVRcxFGC1W5odY3q542JtfX/1775792694932.jpg)
‎
‎In the afternoon, we were relaxing upstairs when I noticed the sunset. It looked so rustic and beautiful again! I had left my cellphone downstairs, but I quickly ran to get it because I just had to capture that view. The sun looked amazing, forming a perfect circle. I tried my best to take a great photo, but honestly, my phone just couldn't do it justice. Hehe. But even so, it was still so beautiful. 😍 Especially when you see it with your own eyes. ✨ 
‎
‎--
‎
‎And that is how my day ended. 
‎
‎Every part of the day felt special because of the love surrounding it. 
‎
‎Thank you so much for joining me today and sharing in these simple blessings. 
‎
‎Until my next everyday snapshots...
‎
‎**Thanks for the visit! Have a lovely day. Buh-bye. 💗🌸**
‎
‎*All images used in this post are my own unless stated otherwise.*
‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXwGy1PepFwdzckxAm8fJT2BtNG3DHPuCTBsrcmCAb78j/1775792724327.png)

‎
