title.body: >Bueno, desde hace varios meses hemos estado pasando por temporadas muy calurosa en mi país y tener el cabello largo y abundante no ayuda para nada, desde hace muchos años que no me cortaba el cabello tan corto pero estas ultimas semanas la idea ha estado rondando demasiado por mi mente, tenia miedo de hacerlo yo misma ya que tenia tiempo sin cortarme el cabello tanto y no sabía si me quedaría bien. > Well, for several months now, we’ve been experiencing some really hot spells in my country, and having long, thick hair doesn’t help at all. It’s been many years since I last cut my hair this short, but over the past few weeks, the idea has been on my mind a lot. I was afraid to do it myself since it had been so long since I’d cut my hair this short, and I wasn’t sure if it would look good on me. ![Corazón banner (1).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23uFgAbHNHepcyH3o8wH15M4pR8K7Jsf3tw4TsSj65zyY1UyQpKRK2L9tGpjABj48Qxzb.png)

>Que mi cabello creciera tanto (porque si, considero que lo tenía demasiado largo) fue un gran sacrificio ya que nunca dejo crecerlo demasiado, siempre me pasa lo mismo, por mas que quiero tener el cabello largo termina molestándome mucho, me da calor, el roce del cabello me molesta y ni siquiera puedo hacerme coletas porque me duele la cabeza inmediatamente. En fin, hoy en la tarde se me ocurrió hablar con Gemini y mandarle una foto mía, le dije: Hazme un corte pixie en capas. Y este fue el resultado: > Letting my hair grow this long (because, yes, I thought it was way too long) was a huge sacrifice since I never let it get too long. It’s always the same with me—no matter how much I want long hair, it ends up bothering me a lot. It makes me hot, the way it rubs against my skin bothers me, and I can’t even put it in a ponytail because my head starts hurting right away. Anyway, this afternoon I decided to talk to Gemini and send her a photo of myself. I told her, “Give me a layered pixie cut.” And this was the result: ![1775770866366.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23vhsBzeJ1Fg3bY1fbTcdY4eGhezmPb3gSZpTTEwbheh3MNmzVDCRBkp5GgJKHedKTGZR.png)

>Esa foto me animo demasiado a cortármelo, aunque ahora me doy cuenta que no quedo igual ya que ahí se ve mas corto delante de lo que lo hice yo, pero creo que mañana arreglare eso no estoy segura si dejarlo asi o arreglarlo, en fin, me encanto como se veía la foto y decidí tomar mi tijera el peine y las sillas y comenzar a cortar el cabello, me hice 4 colitas en el cabello y corte justo debajo de cada una de ellas sin pensarlo mucho o me arrepentiría. > That photo really inspired me to cut my hair, although now I realize it doesn't look the same since it looks shorter in the front in the photo than I actually cut it. But I think I'll fix that tomorrow—I'm not sure if I should leave it like this or fix it. Anyway, I loved how the photo looked, so I grabbed my scissors, comb, and chairs and started cutting my hair. I made four little ponytails and cut right below each one without thinking too much about it—otherwise, I’d regret it. ![IMG_20260409_175102.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23xVGdd3HqQd5CSTBBqffmaUd14c8nXvamTpRKpRdhyRTf2bmLEN1amGUJCmHNKCdCx8E.jpg) ![IMG_20260409_175609.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23y8oGy4Ei59oZrM7bRTTEbQkASYU2Qf7ieGmd9nqffydusW7AgRjBPa7NXb8R7RLLmCH.jpg) ![IMG_20260409_175748.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23tmQ5ihYo4XEBzk2dgHh5ZQgbLs29SqH7SGrtd272mk75ryRqQw2FEVUsiFGHzCqxySY.jpg)

>Cuando solté mi cabello me arrepentí demasiado tenia la cabeza como un lego cuadrado, pero decidí calmarme y confiar en el proceso porque realmente a este punto ya no había retorno. La cantidad de cabello que saque solo de esos 4 cortes fue bastante impresionante para mi, me hizo sentir un poco de pánico. > When I let my hair down, I really regretted it—my head looked like a square Lego brick—but I decided to calm down and trust the process because, at that point, there was really no turning back. The amount of hair I cut off from just those four snips was pretty shocking to me; it made me feel a little panicked. ![IMG_20260409_175842.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23yTjGUHZhu6Z8M8weJbtftk9VHC6FtR6VHisn26qDFvfsADzVCqJ4yd5Apr9VVWEpUvW.jpg) ![IMG_20260409_175738.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23w2gxMHw9YihPWqv7i5UyTs4Zts1e9yFCX2YR94Y8V6D3dUG25BWV9bn3VtVAro35zTB.jpg)

>Mi pánico no era por tener el cabello corto porque realmente nunca le he tenido miedo a los cambios, al contrario, me encanta experimentar cosas diferentes, mi miedo es que tenía muchísimo tiempo sin hacer estos cortes tan complicados estilo pixie y temía quedar con el cabello descuadrado o algo asi, me corte el cabello sin tomar mas fotos del proceso porque necesitaba mucha concentración tarde mas de una hora pero lo hice con mucha paciencia y calma sin ver ningún tutorial solo siguiendo la forma de mi cabeza jajaja. Aquí esta todo el cabello que me saque, aunque había mas que no se ve por completo porque estaba en la silla. > My panic wasn't about having short hair—I've never really been afraid of change; on the contrary, I love trying new things. My fear was that it had been a really long time since I'd done one of these complicated pixie cuts, and I was worried my hair would end up uneven or something like that. I cut my hair without taking any more photos of the process because I needed to really focus. It took me over an hour, but I did it with a lot of patience and calm, without watching any tutorials—just following the shape of my head, hahaha. Here’s all the hair I cut off, though there was more that you can’t see completely because I was in the chair. ![IMG_20260409_192330.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23u67USsRbBBJqxng6dbimZ2aZWXtAidJVmBMxT64VpiS1eTBQrAuyDK2XLcUwErgmgb2.jpg)

>Realmente me gustó, pero si quisiera cortarlo un poquito mas para que parezca mas a la foto de referencia de Gemini. No se me imaginan el alivio que siento ahora mismo, nunca imagine que hoy, esta noche estaría con el cabello corto, no lo planee fue tan repentino, pero valió la pena. Ya no soportaba mi cabello largo y pensar todos los días que hacer con el para que no se viera mal. > I really liked it, but I’d like to cut it a little shorter so it looks more like the Gemini reference photo. You can’t imagine how relieved I feel right now—I never imagined that today, tonight, I’d have short hair. I didn’t plan it; it was so sudden, but it was worth it. I couldn’t stand my long hair anymore, and I was tired of thinking every day about what to do with it so it wouldn’t look bad. ![Snapchat-1968711678.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23vsDe6rKdQX3KHhVd7mUVLAfinFjGsfdeN89gmPv6N9MGjPTbANe98JLGw7MhTXJh2RG.jpg) ![Snapchat-2146631696.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23tS36pL2i9rxyS8dqQVDj9MPYEjVS821eiffimCpckZT3uBWSwgycx4J2yAH8C9GAaEt.jpg)

title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTbBBKhrnjck7dLSA7NFEz3yMzqNpy7G8FsQLZTWPXJ1h/img_0014.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmah2Qq8evcdEZFcu6CnRyxHc5yYn75p43F5AuDfvXLdMk/img_0305.png)

**Buchtipp - Ja, wieder ein Leo**

Vom Autor Maxim Leo hatte ich euch bereits zwei Bücher vorgestellt, aller gute Dinge sind aber drei. Und dieses hat es in sich. Zur [Geschichte](https://www.thalia.de/shop/home/artikeldetails/A1076478322?ProvID=15326503&gad_source=1&gad_campaignid=23447062983&gbraid=0AAAAADwkCX5SOzyWtcwvY7gwaGRc0gGCH&gclid=EAIaIQobChMIr-7gvOe2kwMV7aWDBx1DeQRcEAQYASABEgJO-vD_BwE):

Marlene Buchholz soll Vorstandsvorsitzende des Aviola Konzerns werden. Ihre Kollegen sind sich einig, dass sie fachlich hochkompetent ist  aber menschlich eine ziemliche Katastrophe. Weshalb sie zum Coaching in ein Brandenburger Schloss geschickt wird, zu Alex Grow, dem berühmten Seelenflüsterer.

Was niemand weiß: Seine Academy steht kurz vor dem Bankrott und Alex hat selbst mit Panikattacken zu kämpfen. Marlene ist seine letzte Hoffnung, denn im Erfolgsfall winkt ein Großauftrag der Aviola . Doch die Klientin bleibt skeptisch und verschlossen bis ein verletztes Wildschwein, ein schüchterner Hausmeister und ein dreizehnjähriges Mädchen auftauchen, die sie erahnen lassen, was im Leben wirklich zählt.

Es geht also um Coaching, ein Phänomen unserer Zeit. Und das Buch arbeitet geschickt alle Facetten auf spannende und humorvolle Weise ab, teilweise musste ich richtig loslachen.  Das Ding kann ich wirklich empfehlen, hatte es in zwel Tagen durch. [Hier](https://www.thalia.de/shop/home/artikeldetails/A1076478322?ProvID=15326503&gad_source=1&gad_campaignid=23447062983&gbraid=0AAAAADwkCX5SOzyWtcwvY7gwaGRc0gGCH&gclid=EAIaIQobChMIr-7gvOe2kwMV7aWDBx1DeQRcEAQYASABEgJO-vD_BwE) bekommt man es wenn man jetzt Leselust bekommen hat.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmah2Qq8evcdEZFcu6CnRyxHc5yYn75p43F5AuDfvXLdMk/img_0305.png)

*„Du hast vorher nur auf deinen Kopf gehört, jetzt hörst du nur auf dein Herz, aber es geht darum, eine gute Mischung aus beiden zu finden.“*


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmewzH7nQ6U1NCjAkE1m4Ehec57wX6Kr6N7HPzWmT3xudk/img_9894.heic)

title.title: A toast to the peppers [Eng/Esp]
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRf4vtUcebs1xt72fUzBPC5m7gxb5B62Uu7k8g5VfDpop/1775794166621.jpg)



***
***
I have told before how much I am moved by my father’s determination, that lovely eagerness of his to leave no corner of the house or the yard without planting something we can later take to the kitchen. He sees an empty pot and he is already imagining a tomato plant; he looks at a gap next to the wall and thinks of good herbs, but if there is something he is especially proud of, it is his chili peppers.
***


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdcqT34eYoL5a6EDQtSCzpFw4nqC2VMjPTh2FRm3Kkq1n/1775794169776.jpg)

***
However, we recently had a scare because my father fell ill, nearly a whole month in bed, without even the strength to look out at the yard, and the plants, faithful to their routine of daily care, began to suffer. The leaves lost their luster, some became limp, and I, amid so much worry, could only water them half‑heartedly, without his expert hand that knows when, how much, and how.
***


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPWaLguDbhHbw7PpDBjVKjKxYCXp7uiF6wEvLSJv1YFT4/1775794169179.jpg)

***
But life gives us lessons wrapped in small green leaves, and when my father was finally able to go out again, with a slow step but with his eyes shining once more, he found a miracle: those plants that had survived the lack of pampering were not only alive, they were waiting for him, and as soon as he resumed their care, they responded as if they wanted to give back all the accumulated affection.
***


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmU5NJBGPDug1AqHo1Vfe4YVUNE7Kuuhe7gQQLgbYpMMQa/1775794168550.jpg)


***
The other day he called me, excited, from the yard and pointed to one of the oldest plants, one of those we had almost given up on, and there they were: a birth of chili peppers that seemed impossible. “I have counted up to thirty on this single little plant,” he told me, with a smile that could not fit on his face. Thirty green chili peppers, firm, shiny, crowding among the branches as if about to burst with pure life.
***



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYDqa7pMq4e1dNwz5bQW6VeK1k1CrKbkpujLzXimKBYyy/1775794245754.jpg)
***

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbU8UkhKsxNMG8AwWjEHvtRs36phcxCVkxvsdyoU6ESyx/1775794245247.jpg)


***
It is truly beautiful to see, but even more beautiful is to understand it in the context of my country, Cuba, where every passing day we feel how the rising cost of food squeezes our pockets and forces us to juggle. Going to the market and seeing the price of a bell pepper or a chili pepper is enough to make you tremble, and not having to buy them, plus knowing that these fruits are healthy, organic, grown by my father’s hands… that is a blessing we cannot help but celebrate.
***


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf1n3m3p7f5PEepsro2P3nREPhz6o34r8og5AUrE1wKC1/1775794246381.jpg)

***
These chili peppers not only season our food, they also add flavor to hope and remind me that, although the context is difficult, although illness or discouragement may stop us at times, nature responds when someone cares for it with their heart. My father is already planning the next planting, and I just want to keep telling this story, because small, everyday stories like this are what keep us whole.
***


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTs9AG4bgTLbJJxYofSi8FRJdWVvDywuCJdpbTexiU4CM/1775794245946.jpg)

***
So that is it, I toast to those thirty chili peppers, to the resilient plants, and to all the fathers who turn every corner into a little piece of light and hope.

<center>💚</center>
<center>💚</center>

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYweGm8mMxKLmFZYSPAHak3F6Zz1vgqfa4B6ixGv588XE/1774058971918.jpg)

𝑰𝒇 𝒚𝒐𝒖 𝒅𝒐𝒏’𝒕 𝒌𝒏𝒐𝒘 𝒎𝒆 𝒚𝒆𝒕, 𝑰’𝒎 𝒂 **𝑪𝒖𝒃𝒂𝒏 𝒏𝒆𝒖𝒓𝒐𝒍𝒐𝒈𝒊𝒔𝒕 𝒂𝒏𝒅 𝒘𝒓𝒊𝒕𝒆𝒓**, 𝒂 𝒎𝒐𝒕𝒉𝒆𝒓, 𝒂 𝒘𝒐𝒎𝒂𝒏, 𝒂𝒏𝒅 𝒂 𝒅𝒓𝒆𝒂𝒎𝒆𝒓 𝒘𝒉𝒐’𝒔 𝒇𝒐𝒖𝒏𝒅 𝒊𝒏 𝑯𝒊𝒗𝒆 𝒂 𝒃𝒆𝒂𝒖𝒕𝒊𝒇𝒖𝒍 𝒔𝒑𝒂𝒄𝒆 𝒕𝒐 𝒔𝒐𝒂𝒓.  
𝑨𝒍𝒍 **𝒕𝒆𝒙𝒕 𝒂𝒏𝒅 𝒊𝒎𝒂𝒈𝒆𝒔 𝒂𝒓𝒆 𝒎𝒚 𝒐𝒓𝒊𝒈𝒊𝒏𝒂𝒍 𝒄𝒓𝒆𝒂𝒕𝒊𝒐𝒏𝒔**, 100% 𝒉𝒖𝒎𝒂𝒏-𝒎𝒂𝒅𝒆 (𝒏𝒐 𝑨𝑰).

![cinti 800x20 - copia.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWKGeMBmj14VqKn8xBrmpFM3RYVcgmAXX6bGnGwuNWEnc/cinti%20800x20%20-%20copia.jpg) 
### <center>VERSIÓN EN ESPAÑOL</center>

![cinti 800x20 - copia.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWKGeMBmj14VqKn8xBrmpFM3RYVcgmAXX6bGnGwuNWEnc/cinti%20800x20%20-%20copia.jpg) 

## <center>Un brindis por los ajíes </center>



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb9Px1F4EBqdvrhWyYAKsbZp1szXxEU9SCXQSk1CJ1m8H/1775794167732.jpg)

***
***

Ya he contado antes lo mucho que me conmueve el empeño de mi padre, ese lindo afán suyo de no dejar un solo rincón de la casa ni del patio sin sembrar algo que luego podamos llevar a la cocina. Él ve una maceta vacía y ya está imaginando una mata de tomate, mira un hueco junto a la pared y piensa en hierbas buenas, pero si hay algo que lo enorgullece especialmente, son sus ajíes.
***


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdcqT34eYoL5a6EDQtSCzpFw4nqC2VMjPTh2FRm3Kkq1n/1775794169776.jpg)



***
Sin embargo, hace poco vivimos un susto porque mi padre enfermó, casi un mes entero en cama, sin fuerzas ni para asomarse al patio, y las plantas, fieles a su rutina de cuidados diarios, empezaron a resentirse. Las hojas se apagaron, algunas se pusieron mustias, y yo, entre tanta preocupación, solo podía regarlas a medias, sin su mano experta que sabe cuándo, cuánto y cómo.
***



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPWaLguDbhHbw7PpDBjVKjKxYCXp7uiF6wEvLSJv1YFT4/1775794169179.jpg)

***
Pero la vida nos regala lecciones envueltas en pequeñas hojas verdes, y cuando mi padre por fin pudo volver a salir, con paso lento pero con los ojos brillantes de nuevo, se encontró con un milagro: esas plantas que habían sobrevivido a la falta de mimos no solo estaban vivas, sino que lo esperaban, y en cuanto él retomó sus cuidados, respondieron como si quisieran devolverle todo el cariño acumulado.
***



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmU5NJBGPDug1AqHo1Vfe4YVUNE7Kuuhe7gQQLgbYpMMQa/1775794168550.jpg)

***
El otro día me llamó emocionado desde el patio y me señaló una de las matas más viejas, de esas que casi dábamos por perdidas, y allí estaban: una parición de ajíes que parecía imposible. “He contado hasta treinta en esta sola plantita”, me dijo, con una sonrisa que no le cabía en la cara. Treinta ajíes verdes, firmes, brillantes, apretándose entre las ramas como si quisieran estallar de pura vida.
***


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYDqa7pMq4e1dNwz5bQW6VeK1k1CrKbkpujLzXimKBYyy/1775794245754.jpg)
***


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbU8UkhKsxNMG8AwWjEHvtRs36phcxCVkxvsdyoU6ESyx/1775794245247.jpg)

***
Realmente es bello verlo, pero más bello aún es entenderlo en el contexto de mi país, Cuba, donde cada día que pasa sentimos cómo el encarecimiento de los alimentos nos aprieta el bolsillo y nos obliga a hacer malabares. Ir al mercado y ver el precio de un pimiento o un ají es para echarse a temblar, y no tener que comprarlos, y además saber que estos frutos son sanos, orgánicos, cultivados por las manos de mi padre… eso es una bendición que no podemos menos que celebrar.
***


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf1n3m3p7f5PEepsro2P3nREPhz6o34r8og5AUrE1wKC1/1775794246381.jpg)


***
Estos ajíes no solo sazonan nuestra comida, sino que además le ponen sabor a la esperanza y me recuerdan que, aunque el contexto sea difícil, aunque a veces la enfermedad o el desánimo nos paren, la naturaleza responde cuando alguien la cuida con el corazón. Mi padre ya está planeando la próxima siembra, y yo solo quiero seguir contándolo, porque historias como esta, pequeñas y cotidianas, son las que nos mantienen enteros.
***



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTs9AG4bgTLbJJxYofSi8FRJdWVvDywuCJdpbTexiU4CM/1775794245946.jpg)

***
Así que nada, brindo por esos treinta ajíes, por las plantas resilientes, y por todos los padres que convierten cada rincón en un pedacito de luz y esperanza.

<center>💚</center>
<center>💚</center>

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRSmczRZ7mh457ozsGyfJF93vxnsidtnD9LmCYpF1XK9K/1774058971818.jpg)

<sub>🍃 **¡𝑮𝒓𝒂𝒄𝒊𝒂𝒔 𝒑𝒐𝒓 𝒍𝒆𝒆𝒓!** 🍃
𝑺𝒊 𝒂ú𝒏 𝒏𝒐 𝒎𝒆 𝒄𝒐𝒏𝒐𝒄𝒆𝒔: 𝒔𝒐𝒚 **𝒏𝒆𝒖𝒓ó𝒍𝒐𝒈𝒂 𝒚 𝒆𝒔𝒄𝒓𝒊𝒕𝒐𝒓𝒂 𝒄𝒖𝒃𝒂𝒏𝒂**, 𝒎𝒂𝒅𝒓𝒆, 𝒎𝒖𝒋𝒆𝒓 𝒚 𝒔𝒐ñ𝒂𝒅𝒐𝒓𝒂 𝒒𝒖𝒆 𝒆𝒏𝒄𝒐𝒏𝒕𝒓ó 𝒆𝒏 𝑯𝒊𝒗𝒆 𝒖𝒏 𝒉𝒆𝒓𝒎𝒐𝒔𝒐 𝒆𝒔𝒑𝒂𝒄𝒊𝒐 𝒑𝒂𝒓𝒂 𝒗𝒐𝒍𝒂𝒓.  
**𝑬𝒍 𝒕𝒆𝒙𝒕𝒐 𝒚 𝒍𝒂𝒔 𝒊𝒎á𝒈𝒆𝒏𝒆𝒔 𝒔𝒐𝒏 𝒅𝒆 𝒎𝒊 𝒂𝒖𝒕𝒐𝒓í𝒂**, 100% 𝒉𝒖𝒎𝒂𝒏𝒐𝒔 (𝒔𝒊𝒏 𝑰𝑨).  
𝑩𝒂𝒏𝒏𝒆𝒓 𝒅𝒊𝒔𝒆ñ𝒂𝒅𝒐 𝒑𝒐𝒓 𝑳𝒖𝒎𝒊𝒊.
¿𝑻𝒆 𝒈𝒖𝒔𝒕ó 𝒆𝒔𝒕𝒂 𝒑𝒖𝒃𝒍𝒊𝒄𝒂𝒄𝒊ó𝒏? **𝑽𝒐𝒕𝒂, 𝒄𝒐𝒎𝒆𝒏𝒕𝒂 𝒐 𝒓𝒆𝒃𝒍𝒐𝒈𝒖𝒆𝒂** 𝒑𝒂𝒓𝒂 𝒂𝒚𝒖𝒅𝒂𝒓 𝒂 𝒅𝒆𝒔𝒑𝒍𝒆𝒈𝒂𝒓 𝒆𝒔𝒕𝒂𝒔 𝒂𝒍𝒂𝒔. 💚</sub>

title.title: Keeping the Love Alive - Air Supply (Cover) by @yisusth
title.body:
>

A big hug to everyone in this beautiful #Music community. I have the pleasure of performing with my trumpet «Keeping the Love Alive», a song that mixes genres like soft rock and pop rock composed by Richard Supa. The lyrics talk about the fear of loving again, how this feeling is a conscious decision, and about not giving up in the face of difficulties. Air Supply is one of my favorite bands, and there are several iconic songs that I love. Many of those ballads appeared in movies in the 1980s. I perform this piece in the key of G major with a slight change at the end to Bb major. The rhythm is moderate, steady, and with a time signature of 4/4. The melody is beautiful, simple but expressively romantic. The timbre of Russell Hitchcock's clean and melancholic voice sounds incredible. Undoubtedly, a memorable classic.

Spanish | Español (click here) Un gran abrazo para todos en esta bella comunidad de #Music. Tengo el agrado de interpretar con mi trompeta «Keeping the Love Alive», una canción que mezcla géneros como el soft rock y el pop rock compuesta por Richard Supa. La letra habla del miedo de volver amar, de como este sentimiento es una decisión consciente, y de no rendirse ante las dificultades. Air Supply es una de mis bandas favoritas y hay varios temas icónicos que me encantan. Muchas de esas baladas aparecían en películas en la década de los 80. Esta pieza la interpreto en la tonalidad de G mayor con un ligero cambio al final a Bb mayor. El ritmo es moderado, constante y con una cifra indicadora de compas de 4/4. La melodía es hermosa, sencilla pero expresivamente romántica. Es increíble como suena el timbre de voz limpio y melancólico de Russell Hitchcock. Sin duda, un clásico inolvidable.

> Recently I have seen how some young people act impulsively, without measuring the consequences. Some friends had a motorcycle accident. They were coming on the highway at night and lost control of the motorcycle and crashed into a vehicle. One of them lost his life, and the other is fighting for his life in a hospital in intensive care. It has been completely painful to see the suffering and sacrifices of the family. In both trivial and important matters, we must not forget that prudence is a way of acting wisely. Prudence helps us forge our character. Listening to and following the advice of those who have lived longer than us is key. Music also has its risks, and we must listen to it with moderation and respect. One chooses to listen to music at the right amount and in the right place. If it makes us lose concentration on our path, perhaps we fall into a sewer from which we cannot get out. Blessings to all.
Spanish | Español (click here) Recientemente he visto como algunas personas jóvenes actúan impulsivamente, y sin medir las consecuencias. Unos amigos tuvieron un accidente en una motocicleta. Ellos venían de noche por la autopista y perdieron el control de la moto y chocaron con un vehículo. Uno de ellos perdió la vida, y el otro se debate su vida en un hospital en cuidados intensivos. Ha sido totalmente doloroso ver el sufrimiento y los sacrificios de la familia. Tanto en lo trivial como lo importante, no hay que olvidarse que la prudencia es una manera de actuar sabiamente. La prudencia nos ayuda a forjar nuestro carácter. Escuchar y seguir los consejos de los que han vivido mas que nosotros es clave. La música también tiene sus riesgos y debemos escucharla con moderación y respeto. Uno escoge escuchar música en el monto y el lugar oportuno. Si nos hace perder la concentración de nuestro trayecto quizás caigamos en una alcantarilla del cual no podamos salir. Bendiciones para todos.

>

A big hug to everyone in this beautiful #Music community. I have the pleasure of performing with my trumpet «Keeping the Love Alive», a song that mixes genres like soft rock and pop rock composed by Richard Supa. The lyrics talk about the fear of loving again, how this feeling is a conscious decision, and about not giving up in the face of difficulties. Air Supply is one of my favorite bands, and there are several iconic songs that I love. Many of those ballads appeared in movies in the 1980s. I perform this piece in the key of G major with a slight change at the end to Bb major. The rhythm is moderate, steady, and with a time signature of 4/4. The melody is beautiful, simple but expressively romantic. The timbre of Russell Hitchcock's clean and melancholic voice sounds incredible. Undoubtedly, a memorable classic.

Spanish | Español (click here) Un gran abrazo para todos en esta bella comunidad de #Music. Tengo el agrado de interpretar con mi trompeta «Keeping the Love Alive», una canción que mezcla géneros como el soft rock y el pop rock compuesta por Richard Supa. La letra habla del miedo de volver amar, de como este sentimiento es una decisión consciente, y de no rendirse ante las dificultades. Air Supply es una de mis bandas favoritas y hay varios temas icónicos que me encantan. Muchas de esas baladas aparecían en películas en la década de los 80. Esta pieza la interpreto en la tonalidad de G mayor con un ligero cambio al final a Bb mayor. El ritmo es moderado, constante y con una cifra indicadora de compas de 4/4. La melodía es hermosa, sencilla pero expresivamente romántica. Es increíble como suena el timbre de voz limpio y melancólico de Russell Hitchcock. Sin duda, un clásico inolvidable.

> Recently I have seen how some young people act impulsively, without measuring the consequences. Some friends had a motorcycle accident. They were coming on the highway at night and lost control of the motorcycle and crashed into a vehicle. One of them lost his life, and the other is fighting for his life in a hospital in intensive care. It has been completely painful to see the suffering and sacrifices of the family. In both trivial and important matters, we must not forget that prudence is a way of acting wisely. Prudence helps us forge our character. Listening to and following the advice of those who have lived longer than us is key. Music also has its risks, and we must listen to it with moderation and respect. One chooses to listen to music at the right amount and in the right place. If it makes us lose concentration on our path, perhaps we fall into a sewer from which we cannot get out. Blessings to all.
Spanish | Español (click here) Recientemente he visto como algunas personas jóvenes actúan impulsivamente, y sin medir las consecuencias. Unos amigos tuvieron un accidente en una motocicleta. Ellos venían de noche por la autopista y perdieron el control de la moto y chocaron con un vehículo. Uno de ellos perdió la vida, y el otro se debate su vida en un hospital en cuidados intensivos. Ha sido totalmente doloroso ver el sufrimiento y los sacrificios de la familia. Tanto en lo trivial como lo importante, no hay que olvidarse que la prudencia es una manera de actuar sabiamente. La prudencia nos ayuda a forjar nuestro carácter. Escuchar y seguir los consejos de los que han vivido mas que nosotros es clave. La música también tiene sus riesgos y debemos escucharla con moderación y respeto. Uno escoge escuchar música en el monto y el lugar oportuno. Si nos hace perder la concentración de nuestro trayecto quizás caigamos en una alcantarilla del cual no podamos salir. Bendiciones para todos.

title.title: Game Sebagai Investasi Digital Dengan Potensi Cuan
title.body:
Dulu, game hanya dianggap sebagai hiburan semata. Namun kini, dengan perkembangan teknologi blockchain, NFT, dan ekosistem digital, game mulai dilihat sebagai investasi digital yang memiliki potensi cuan besar. Anak muda hingga investor profesional mulai melirik dunia gaming bukan hanya untuk bersenang-senang, tetapi juga sebagai peluang finansial jangka panjang.

![game](https://www.shutterstock.com/image-photo/successful-rich-young-caucasian-man-600nw-2652671881.jpg)

**Game Sebagai Investasi Digital Dengan Potensi Cuan**

[nagaspin99](https://navigatingchristianity.com/love-never-fails/) adalah link situs [nagaspin99 slot](https://navigatingchristianity.com/love-never-fails/) deposit 1000 paling murah via QRIS cuma 1 detik yang menawarkan akses cepat, server stabil, koleksi permainan gacor dan peluang menang tinggi.


**1. Game Sebagai Aset Digital**
Game modern, terutama yang berbasis blockchain, memungkinkan pemain memiliki aset digital berupa karakter, skin, senjata, atau item lain yang berbentuk NFT (Non-Fungible Token). Aset ini bisa diperjualbelikan di marketplace, sehingga memiliki nilai ekonomi nyata. Dengan demikian, game bukan lagi sekadar hiburan, tetapi juga aset investasi.

**2. Play-to-Earn: Main Sambil Menghasilkan**
Konsep Play-to-Earn (P2E) menjadi tren baru dalam dunia gaming. Pemain bisa mendapatkan token kripto atau item NFT hanya dengan bermain. Token tersebut bisa ditukar menjadi uang nyata atau dijadikan investasi jangka panjang. Contoh game P2E populer antara lain Axie Infinity, The Sandbox, dan Decentraland.

**3. Skin dan Item Langka Sebagai Investasi**
Skin eksklusif atau item langka dalam game sering memiliki nilai jual tinggi. Misalnya, skin hero di Mobile Legends atau item langka di CS:GO bisa dijual dengan harga jutaan rupiah. Pemain yang cerdas bisa membeli skin saat harga rendah dan menjualnya ketika permintaan meningkat, mirip dengan strategi investasi saham atau koleksi digital.

**4. Marketplace Game Digital**
Banyak game kini menyediakan marketplace resmi atau pihak ketiga untuk jual beli aset. Pemain bisa memperdagangkan akun, skin, atau item dengan aman. Marketplace ini menjadi ekosistem yang mendukung game sebagai investasi digital, di mana supply dan demand menentukan harga aset.

**5. Passive Income dari Gaming**
Selain penghasilan aktif dari bermain, game juga bisa menjadi sumber passive income. Misalnya:

- Staking Token: Menyimpan token game di platform resmi untuk mendapatkan bunga atau reward.

- Server Premium: Membuat server khusus di Minecraft atau Roblox dengan akses berbayar.

- Konten Evergreen: Video tutorial atau artikel gaming yang terus ditonton bisa menghasilkan iklan jangka panjang.

**6. Risiko Investasi Game**
Meski menjanjikan, investasi game juga memiliki risiko:

- Fluktuasi Harga Token: Nilai aset digital bisa naik-turun drastis.

- Popularitas Game: Jika game kehilangan pemain, nilai aset bisa jatuh.

- Biaya Transaksi Blockchain: Gas fee bisa cukup tinggi.

- Potensi Scam: Tidak semua proyek NFT atau marketplace terpercaya.

Oleh karena itu, riset mendalam sebelum berinvestasi sangat penting.

**7. Strategi Mengoptimalkan Cuan**
Untuk memaksimalkan potensi cuan dari game sebagai investasi digital, ada beberapa strategi:

- Pilih game dengan ekosistem kuat dan komunitas besar.

- Fokus pada aset langka atau eksklusif.

- Diversifikasi investasi, jangan hanya bergantung pada satu game.

- Ikuti tren dan update terbaru agar tidak ketinggalan peluang.

**Kesimpulan**
Game kini bukan hanya hiburan, tetapi juga investasi digital dengan potensi cuan. Dari Play-to-Earn, jual beli skin, hingga marketplace NFT, peluang finansial terbuka lebar bagi siapa saja yang kreatif dan berani mencoba. Meski memiliki risiko, dengan strategi yang tepat, dunia gaming bisa menjadi jalan menuju penghasilan nyata sekaligus investasi masa depan.

# Un bonito momento para compartir con la familia [ESP/ENG]

<div class=\

>
Saludos estimados amigos de la comunidad que sirve de ventana a las relaciones familiares @family-friends. Espero que hayan disfrutado de un excelente día junto a sus seres queridos. 

Paso por aquí para mostrarles algunas imágenes de una salida familiar a un conocido restaurante de la ciudad llamado Drilos, sitio que visitamos con frecuencia porque nos gusta la comida, el fácil acceso, el precio justo y la tranquilidad de sus ambientes.

Las salidas poco planificadas siempre resultan grandes experiencias y esta fue una de ellas. Fue un viernes en horas del mediodía en que consultando las finanzas todos decidimos comer afuera y  que deberiamos ir a Drilos a vivir nuevamente una agradable experiencia culinaria.

Ya mi familia tiene a este sitio catalogado como muy espacioso, íntimo y con buena comida. Por esta razón no lo pensamos mucho a la hora de seleccionar un buen sitio para comer.

Otra cosa a su favor es que la atención es muy esmerada y los mesoneros tienen mucho talento para atender y darle ideas a los cliemtes.

Fue un maravilloso momento que aprovechamos para compartir y fortalecer los lazos familiares que tanto cuidado requieren de nuestra parte.

Disfrutamos una linda velada en un ambiente muy agradable y degustando buenos platos.

Hasta aquí esta experiencia familiar que quise co.partir con ustedes y espero encontrarnos nuevamente en otra oportunidad. 

Saludos y bendiciones

title.title: We have a new comet called Panstarrs C/2025 R3
title.body:
>

We have a new comet called Panstarrs C/2025 R3


https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmfXg5hGheM7CBBeESnLhsWeXvUThM5QxhAUmVNkJMVgoU/image.png

> The International Astronomical Union gives names to everything that is in the universe, planets, stars, craters, mountains, volcanoes, moons, asteroids, except comets, all the other names of the cosmos go through the International Astronomical Union, but not comets, if you discover one you can give it your name, normally the name of the discoverer is given, but you can name the name of your girlfriend or boyfriend or a friend or your dog and that is still a right that the discoverer, the rest do not, the rest must go through the filter of the International Astronomical Union and they are very strict.


But we have a new comet, the comet Panstarrs C/2025 R3 that we see in this photo taken by Dan Bartlet on April 7 from June Lake in California, this comet will pass close to the sun on April 19 and will pass about 75 million kilometers from the Earth on April 26, it is already very faintly visible to the naked eye, which is why it is recommended to use binoculars, but it will be visible to the naked eye, it will be a quite spectacular comet. And it is quite small.


It is estimated that it will be at least 400 m in diameter and up to a maximum of 2.4 km. Why such a huge difference? because when we normally see comets, practically all of them, except the eastern giant of 140 km in diameter that is going to approach the orbit of Saturn, but the rest is that we discover them when they are already surrounded by a cloud of gas and dust, so the nucleus cannot be seen. This is what has happened with 3I/Atlas, the core of 3I/Atlas has never been seen directly, all those photos they put with the core that looks like a UFO or whatever or an extraterrestrial ship, are not true, it has always been surrounded by a cloud of gas and dust, another thing is that illustrations have been published, but what they want to pass off as photos of the surface of 3I/Atlas is not true.


At the moment this new comet is a green comet and as you can see it has a magnificent tail, let's hope it survives because recently another comet ended up disintegrating on April 4 because it got too close and it was a Kreutz plane, the Kreutz planes are tens of thousands of fragments, some 4,000 or 5,000 have already been discovered only at this time that we have solar observatories and they can see them up close, they are fragments of a giant comet of 120 km, it is believed that it initially broke up in the time of ancient Greece, about 2,300, 2,400 years ago, then it fragmented into more pieces and now there are tens of thousands of fragments of it that get too close to the sun and many of them end up disintegrating, there are still some large fragments several kilometers in diameter and that when they get close to the sun they cause spectacular flashes.

links.title: A creamy rich mango dessert in a graham  crackers
links.body: @hivefood hello 👋🏽👋🏽 how are you doing today.. I hope you're always doing fine and well..I'm happy to share to you today one of my family's favorite dessert--the CREAMY MANGO GRAHAM DESSERT\n

> When I became a mother, I always looked for ways on how to creatively use the leftovers mangoes in the fridge..so I'm just happy with the outcomes of my creative ideas making this creamy dessert out of the leftovers mangoes.. So here are the following ingredients needed to start:

> 2 packs of graham crackers 4pcs of ripened mangoes(sliced) 1 can Creamdensada 1/2 can of condensed milk (you can always adjust its sweetness) Crushed grahams for toppings( optional) Plastic tubs Here's what you're going to do in making the dessert... First prepare cream mixture I already chilled overnight the Creamdensada or you can use Nestlé all purpose cream
> Since I don't have any electric mixer...I just mixed it manually,beat it with whisk so that it can double the size of your mixture.. And alternately add up the condensed milk..
> Slowly beating it..so that condensed milk it will be mixed thoroughly..
> When it's done..prepare the tubs and the graham crackers..and also sliced the mangoes into thin slices or thin strips.. Lay down a layer of the graham crackers in a plastic tubs
> Spread a generous amount of cream mixture over the graham crackers Add a layer of mangoes..until the plastic tubs will be filled with Graham,cream and mango..
> If done you can topped it with crushed grahams and garnished it with a sliced of mangoes...

> And so I've made 3 tubs out of the leftovers mangoes... If done,cover it and refrigerate for 4-6 hours or it could be best if you refrigerate it overnight to soften the crackers and absorbed its cream..

>


Once chilled you can serve this with the whole family and let them enjoy this creamy and delicious mango dessert...

This would be all for now and see you in my next cooking blog journey Bye🫰🏽🙂😊😍

**XSMTRUNG: Khám phá cơ cấu giải thưởng hấp dẫn nhất hiện nay**

**Vé số miền Trung xuất hiện từ khi nào?**

Xổ số kiến thiết miền Trung (XSMT) ra đời từ những năm 1970, trong bối cảnh đất nước từng bước khôi phục kinh tế sau chiến tranh. Ban đầu, mục tiêu chính của loại hình này không phải là giải trí mà là huy động nguồn lực tài chính phục vụ xây dựng cơ sở hạ tầng, trường học, bệnh viện và các công trình dân sinh thiết yếu. Qua thời gian, xổ số miền Trung dần phát triển thành một hoạt động kinh tế - xã hội quan trọng, vừa mang tính giải trí vừa đóng góp tích cực cho ngân sách địa phương.

Ngày nay, hoạt động SXMT được tổ chức bài bản, minh bạch với lịch quay thưởng cố định theo từng ngày trong tuần. Nhờ sự phát triển của công nghệ, người chơi có thể dễ dàng theo dõi Kết quả xổ số Miền Trung hàng ngày thông qua các nền tảng trực tuyến nhanh chóng và chính xác.

➡️➡️➡️ Để không bỏ lỡ bất kỳ kỳ quay nào, bạn có thể cập nhật KQXSMT đầy đủ tại: [**https://safechat.com/u/xsmtrung**](https://safechat.com/u/xsmtrung)

**Cơ cấu giải thưởng mới nhất của xổ số kiến thiết miền Trung như thế nào?**

Một trong những yếu tố tạo nên sức hút mạnh mẽ của XSMTR chính là cơ cấu giải thưởng rõ ràng, minh bạch và có tính cân đối cao. Với mệnh giá vé phổ biến 10.000 đồng, mỗi kỳ quay SXMT mang đến hàng chục nghìn cơ hội trúng thưởng cho người tham gia.

Cụ thể, hệ thống giải thưởng bao gồm 9 hạng giải chính. Nổi bật nhất là giải Đặc biệt trị giá lên đến 2 tỷ đồng -- mức thưởng đủ để thay đổi cuộc sống của người trúng. Bên cạnh đó là các giải Nhất, Nhì, Ba với giá trị từ 10 triệu đến 30 triệu đồng, cùng hàng loạt giải nhỏ hơn trải dài từ vài trăm nghìn đến 3 triệu đồng.

Đặc biệt, xổ số miền Trung còn có các giải phụ như giải phụ đặc biệt và giải khuyến khích. Những giải này giúp gia tăng đáng kể xác suất trúng thưởng, ngay cả khi người chơi không trúng giải cao nhất. Tổng số giải thưởng mỗi kỳ quay có thể lên đến hơn 18.000 giải, tạo nên một hệ sinh thái giải thưởng phong phú và hấp dẫn.

➡️➡️➡️ Bạn có thể theo dõi chi tiết kết quả các kỳ quay tại: [**https://www.metooo.io/u/xsmtr**](https://www.metooo.io/u/xsmtr)

**So sánh cơ cấu giải thưởng của XSKT miền Trung với 2 miền còn lại**

So với xổ số miền Bắc, XSMT có lợi thế về số lượng giải thưởng đa dạng hơn. Miền Bắc chỉ có một đài quay mỗi ngày, trong khi miền Trung có nhiều công ty xổ số luân phiên mở thưởng, giúp người chơi có thêm nhiều lựa chọn.

Trong khi đó, nếu so với miền Nam - khu vực có số lượng đài quay lớn nhất cả nước - thì cơ cấu giải thưởng của miền Trung khá tương đồng về giá trị. Tuy nhiên, số lượng đài quay ít hơn khiến SXMT trở nên dễ theo dõi và phù hợp với người chơi muốn tập trung phân tích kết quả.

**Đánh giá cơ hội trúng thưởng xổ số miền Trung**

Xét về tổng thể, cơ hội trúng thưởng của XSMT được đánh giá là khá cao so với nhiều loại hình xổ số truyền thống khác. Số lượng giải thưởng lớn, trải đều ở nhiều mức giá trị giúp người chơi có nhiều khả năng \

, thay vì chỉ trông chờ vào giải đặc biệt.

Tuy nhiên, cần khẳng định rằng bản chất của xổ số vẫn là trò chơi dựa trên xác suất. Vì vậy, việc theo dõi KQXSMT thường xuyên chỉ mang tính tham khảo, không đảm bảo chắc chắn trúng thưởng. Điều quan trọng là người chơi cần giữ tâm lý ổn định và quản lý tài chính hợp lý khi tham gia.

links.title: Za komuny było lepiej
links.body:
>



 
A przynajmniej mogło by być, gdyby ta nasza wyspa szczęśliwości socjalistycznej była w trochę lepszym klimacie. Wietnam formalnie jest państwem komunistycznym, ale w praktyce jego system to hybryda politycznego komunizmu i gospodarki rynkowej. Początkowo kraj podążał drogą wytyczoną przez dalekiego brata ZSRR (w odróżnieniu od drogi jaką obrała ChRLD) i gdzieś w latach 80-tych XX wieku przeprowadzono szereg reform rynkowych przy pozostawieniu politycznego systemu politycznego. Azjatyckie tygrysy w tym te turbo-kapitalistyczne działały podobnie wolność gospodarcza nie idzie w parze z wolnościami politycznymi (stąd też często rządy junt wojskowych).  Więc myśląc o tym, czy w Polsce byłoby lepiej, gdyby było cieplej, czy też południowy luz by nas pogrążył, bawię się z postnymi zwierzątkami...

---

Assalamu Alaikum friends, how are you all? I hope that you are all well, with the infinite mercy of Allah, and that you are healthy with all your family members. I always wish you all the best. I always wish you all the best. And with your prayers and the love of Allah, I am also well, healthy, and very happy. For this, I am offering a thousand million thanks to Allah. Alhamdulillah.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfVHqwiBSWAqKfaoYYpyAdLZSSVULK1Q7qmBZuWXPppiJ/1775792235146.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmesUVfpWQf9UgeRkBd2taFquGNLCseu1GLZT6kCT7785R/1775792235347.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT36MZBVY5xnccz4d1dTAKK5g1Fa7geJj8e5FG8PrhTX1/1775792235689.jpg)

Friends, today I have come with a completely new video for you. I believe you have never seen this video before. So, you all should watch this video carefully and give your important opinions. Friends, the video I have brought today is a recipe for raw jackfruit and buckwheat. It is very beautiful and perfect. This recipe has been made with the help of someone. First of all, I needed a raw jackfruit, which I saw in the video. I took a raw jackfruit from the tree and after cutting this jackfruit, I brought it into the house and I had soaked it in some water beforehand to put it in this raw jackfruit.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSzV5Qc5iHdSF89EyA2zZGN3dAakDsybRfDRaAJZq15hz/1775792273318.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbaF1ynhx3TwTogMcUaNGCMy7WaXEkDxX4ypN2NmKuWQX/1775792273453.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVnhytyiKigv7u2cC1TDcGw4aXcAHdpyuv8jLEReNHQfX/1775792273583.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmenYJrZbkxWRMDYCmTPuRRngo8mMeveHDzySmoY89qADZ/1775792273705.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQtS12crqNXrYt6VjivqRtpUkc2m3TCAhtCdRYRAYBkP5/1775792273806.jpg)

So before cutting the jackfruit, I found a little mustard oil in my hand because it is a very fibrous fruit, so to cut it, I first prepared it well from the oil in my hand. So first I cut this jackfruit in half, then I removed the upper scales and cut them into small pieces and put them in a ball. In this way, when the entire shell is cut, I will boil this jackfruit in hot water for a while so that I can separate its remaining parts. In this way, after a while, when the ball rises, that is, when the water boils completely, we will take it off the stove.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbwsU49zz8ouWj21j3DbNqj3sWr6a9SctyH8sSSzBWHww/1775792310308.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVvR1L7w6sEqFqFMcKhAKTC6ruuoKLw9CUZC2H87kZLoY/1775792310343.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc8dnguuN68kiGYafAnx5nUGRf4RA8fQSmtbwDNxHbNv7/1775792310379.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma7skQX9aNkZV2KjZJAwZirxfURdmV39bZcjX27XZUt6K/1775792310424.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdCDnsd9eadrU58UvyLvzKNRhf64675fGLSauJuhCjoT4/1775792310453.jpg)

After taking it out, I will put the small pieces of this jackfruit in a ball. Then in a large pan, add some oil and after heating the oil slightly, I will add chopped green chilies, chopped onion, spices, bay leaves, ginger, cumin seeds, turmeric powder and simple spices to it and mix them well and I will fry it for a while and its color is so beautiful that it seems that it can be eaten as it is. Then in the meantime, I will leave those soaked dates in it and after that I will fry it for a while.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmacUfimfq3j4ei7d5piuJ4KuqMRS2s7kurKGPPoCNbwXq/1775792378287.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTGA5RcSnPLdB6bsYE8ftETicut9mfyTuee7ZyKYnQ6Xt/1775792378432.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYBHzvbST2pHMTHePjCJAF8PuK29JhAUSW1n224Kwb6F8/1775792378551.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmREcRBH7APRydfy6e3tk9M5QHo3HYzPQquez6jkMTZb2t/1775792378655.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPb5y5LvdEHK7P4b4Y8FUXrw5U2E9XrrqrELmqdHCQZz7/1775792378784.jpg)

After grinding the downs very finely, we will leave the small pieces of jackfruit in this and grind it well again so that it cooks very nicely and it does not remain hard but becomes very soft. After grinding it for a while, we will add some salt to it and according to the taste, how much salt you like, but we can do more or less in the pepper gap. After this, we will leave it in the oven for some time and occasionally check whether it is finished cooking or not. It looks like it has taken on a black color because after cutting the jackfruit, it turns black, so if it is black, there is no problem in eating it. It is a very delicious and nutritious food.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY2ooyUBqNtMaQNLeBNjBBYsiXshWGaW2wfys4cHXvRpB/1775792403757.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdaDrEsAuNTXUqSpnuFcpcYHnuDpvpS5V9kahhZoT13mp/1775792403883.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUPBjnB7pxMc8H2zEYtTys7XHYCivortWk4H7rTBf4Sei/1775792403995.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf3WaJvu5UZ5CXv3SjtFKrBHUqmfqbk7uUna4Ps5CtAht/1775792404119.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdeSUA87De8nyfow47LnKeXWhgzJJHwBcmW82uCLZN7HT/1775792404223.jpg)

After 10-15 minutes of cooking, we will consider it to be completely cooked because it does not take that much time to cook because the jackfruit is not that hard. Since the young jackfruit is just starting to grow on the tree, all the jackfruit has not become bitter and is still very raw, so it will not take that much time to cook. Then we will see if it is cooked. When it is cooked, it will be clear that it is finished cooking. Then we will take it off the stove and serve it hot.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZYs12i3vSgjAUzDnDoRd7zZVGhZ642S8Uj1QcmmpT9U9/1775792420289.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP6bHjfunEQzRi1wKHBwGvD3KPB8XoHW5mbY9oYkFLV6t/1775792420428.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf3WaJvu5UZ5CXv3SjtFKrBHUqmfqbk7uUna4Ps5CtAht/1775792420526.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdeSUA87De8nyfow47LnKeXWhgzJJHwBcmW82uCLZN7HT/1775792420610.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdtZfFhs5AaHQqfp8R2Borz91XxWHEyX1AbM7NgxgFMz6/1775792420719.jpg)

So friends, you must know that as soon as we finished cooking it, everyone in our house was eager to eat this jackfruit recipe. Then I made a small party for them and gave each of them a bowl of this jackfruit recipe. After they ate it, everyone praised it. It was very delicious and very tasty. So our hearts were filled with happiness because there is no happiness in eating alone. We were able to eat it with everyone and it was very tasty to eat. Friends, you can make this recipe at home and eat it according to the method shown by me.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR2Kpado6vSo5Red2WyBp7JqVM3p2Lizxwb2V4ij93vde/1775792436839.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVnhytyiKigv7u2cC1TDcGw4aXcAHdpyuv8jLEReNHQfX/1775792436950.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSzV5Qc5iHdSF89EyA2zZGN3dAakDsybRfDRaAJZq15hz/1775792437285.jpg)

Honestly, friends, this is a very tasty dish to eat with hot rice and it is a dish that you must try at home if you want to eat it. Friends, how did you like this video of mine? Please let me know through your important comments and in the future, I hope that I can come up with more beautiful recipes for you. I am leaving you like this today. May everyone be well and healthy. Finally, I hope and expect that you will give me your important comments on how this recipe turned out. I am leaving you like this today. May Allah Hafez

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdaDrEsAuNTXUqSpnuFcpcYHnuDpvpS5V9kahhZoT13mp/1775792459199.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVnhytyiKigv7u2cC1TDcGw4aXcAHdpyuv8jLEReNHQfX/1775792273583.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmenYJrZbkxWRMDYCmTPuRRngo8mMeveHDzySmoY89qADZ/1775792273705.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQtS12crqNXrYt6VjivqRtpUkc2m3TCAhtCdRYRAYBkP5/1775792273806.jpg)

So before cutting the jackfruit, I found a little mustard oil in my hand because it is a very fibrous fruit, so to cut it, I first prepared it well from the oil in my hand. So first I cut this jackfruit in half, then I removed the upper scales and cut them into small pieces and put them in a ball. In this way, when the entire shell is cut, I will boil this jackfruit in hot water for a while so that I can separate its remaining parts. In this way, after a while, when the ball rises, that is, when the water boils completely, we will take it off the stove.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbwsU49zz8ouWj21j3DbNqj3sWr6a9SctyH8sSSzBWHww/1775792310308.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVvR1L7w6sEqFqFMcKhAKTC6ruuoKLw9CUZC2H87kZLoY/1775792310343.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc8dnguuN68kiGYafAnx5nUGRf4RA8fQSmtbwDNxHbNv7/1775792310379.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma7skQX9aNkZV2KjZJAwZirxfURdmV39bZcjX27XZUt6K/1775792310424.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdCDnsd9eadrU58UvyLvzKNRhf64675fGLSauJuhCjoT4/1775792310453.jpg)

After taking it out, I will put the small pieces of this jackfruit in a ball. Then in a large pan, add some oil and after heating the oil slightly, I will add chopped green chilies, chopped onion, spices, bay leaves, ginger, cumin seeds, turmeric powder and simple spices to it and mix them well and I will fry it for a while and its color is so beautiful that it seems that it can be eaten as it is. Then in the meantime, I will leave those soaked dates in it and after that I will fry it for a while.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmacUfimfq3j4ei7d5piuJ4KuqMRS2s7kurKGPPoCNbwXq/1775792378287.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTGA5RcSnPLdB6bsYE8ftETicut9mfyTuee7ZyKYnQ6Xt/1775792378432.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYBHzvbST2pHMTHePjCJAF8PuK29JhAUSW1n224Kwb6F8/1775792378551.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmREcRBH7APRydfy6e3tk9M5QHo3HYzPQquez6jkMTZb2t/1775792378655.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPb5y5LvdEHK7P4b4Y8FUXrw5U2E9XrrqrELmqdHCQZz7/1775792378784.jpg)

After grinding the downs very finely, we will leave the small pieces of jackfruit in this and grind it well again so that it cooks very nicely and it does not remain hard but becomes very soft. After grinding it for a while, we will add some salt to it and according to the taste, how much salt you like, but we can do more or less in the pepper gap. After this, we will leave it in the oven for some time and occasionally check whether it is finished cooking or not. It looks like it has taken on a black color because after cutting the jackfruit, it turns black, so if it is black, there is no problem in eating it. It is a very delicious and nutritious food.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY2ooyUBqNtMaQNLeBNjBBYsiXshWGaW2wfys4cHXvRpB/1775792403757.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdaDrEsAuNTXUqSpnuFcpcYHnuDpvpS5V9kahhZoT13mp/1775792403883.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUPBjnB7pxMc8H2zEYtTys7XHYCivortWk4H7rTBf4Sei/1775792403995.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf3WaJvu5UZ5CXv3SjtFKrBHUqmfqbk7uUna4Ps5CtAht/1775792404119.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdeSUA87De8nyfow47LnKeXWhgzJJHwBcmW82uCLZN7HT/1775792404223.jpg)

After 10-15 minutes of cooking, we will consider it to be completely cooked because it does not take that much time to cook because the jackfruit is not that hard. Since the young jackfruit is just starting to grow on the tree, all the jackfruit has not become bitter and is still very raw, so it will not take that much time to cook. Then we will see if it is cooked. When it is cooked, it will be clear that it is finished cooking. Then we will take it off the stove and serve it hot.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZYs12i3vSgjAUzDnDoRd7zZVGhZ642S8Uj1QcmmpT9U9/1775792420289.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP6bHjfunEQzRi1wKHBwGvD3KPB8XoHW5mbY9oYkFLV6t/1775792420428.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf3WaJvu5UZ5CXv3SjtFKrBHUqmfqbk7uUna4Ps5CtAht/1775792420526.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdeSUA87De8nyfow47LnKeXWhgzJJHwBcmW82uCLZN7HT/1775792420610.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdtZfFhs5AaHQqfp8R2Borz91XxWHEyX1AbM7NgxgFMz6/1775792420719.jpg)

So friends, you must know that as soon as we finished cooking it, everyone in our house was eager to eat this jackfruit recipe. Then I made a small party for them and gave each of them a bowl of this jackfruit recipe. After they ate it, everyone praised it. It was very delicious and very tasty. So our hearts were filled with happiness because there is no happiness in eating alone. We were able to eat it with everyone and it was very tasty to eat. Friends, you can make this recipe at home and eat it according to the method shown by me.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR2Kpado6vSo5Red2WyBp7JqVM3p2Lizxwb2V4ij93vde/1775792436839.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVnhytyiKigv7u2cC1TDcGw4aXcAHdpyuv8jLEReNHQfX/1775792436950.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSzV5Qc5iHdSF89EyA2zZGN3dAakDsybRfDRaAJZq15hz/1775792437285.jpg)

Honestly, friends, this is a very tasty dish to eat with hot rice and it is a dish that you must try at home if you want to eat it. Friends, how did you like this video of mine? Please let me know through your important comments and in the future, I hope that I can come up with more beautiful recipes for you. I am leaving you like this today. May everyone be well and healthy. Finally, I hope and expect that you will give me your important comments on how this recipe turned out. I am leaving you like this today. May Allah Hafez

links.body:
>   


Hola, ¿qué tal, comunidad Music Zone? vibra positiva para todos. 
Les presento mi canción titulada “Banda Sonora”, una pieza original de mi proyecto de la noche. Se trata de una interpretación en vivo desde casa. 


-------------
-------------

Esta canción nació de una reflexión sobre la memoria y el sonido. Varios momentos de mi vida están atados a una melodía; suelo recordar diferentes etapas de mi historia al escuchar las canciones que me gustan. La magia de la música me hace viajar en mi mente.


------------------------


La idea surgió un viernes al final de la tarde, después de salir del trabajo, mientras caminaba por la ciudad. La inspiración Llegó observando el caos y la belleza de lo cotidiano. Hay una frase en particular de la letra que hoy quiero destacar:

-----------------------------------

----------------------------------




“La gente tiene miedo por tantas cosas, y nunca temen a sus propias acciones.”

------------

----------


Es una línea que me golpea metafóricamente cada vez que la canto. Temor al destino a la oscuridad. El miedo al futuro es algo bastante común; sin embargo, el peso de mis decisiones me pasó una factura. Tuve una fuerte lucha con mis propios demonios internos pero, a pesar de todo, vencí y escribí la letra. 


------------------
-----------------



Interpretarla con el teclado significa para mí un nuevo comienzo. A pesar de los errores y las sombras siempre estamos a un paso firme de volver a comenzar. Sin duda es una pieza musical que forma parte de la banda sonora de mi vida.  


------------
-------------

<Center > 


#### Letra: Banda Sonora

--------------
-------------


\

--------------
-------------



</Center > 

Gracias por ser parte de este viaje sonoro.

-----------------

-----------------

Grabado con mi teléfono REDMI A5
Edición y montaje en Inshot app
Imágenes Text Art app
Text on photo.

---------------

---------------


##### English version

----------------
--------------------











<div class = \
>   \n\nHello there, music zone community vibrates positively for everyone. I present to you my song called \

an original piece of my project for the night. It is a live performance from home. ---------------- ------------------- This song was born from a reflection on memory and sound. Several moments of my life are tied to a melody I remember different stages when I hear songs that I like. The magic of music makes me travel in my mind. --------------- -------------- The idea came up on a late Friday afternoon after leaving work while walking around town. Inspiration arrived by observing the chaos and beauty of everyday life. There is a particular sentence in the lyrics that I want to highlight today: --------------- -------------- It’s a line that hits me metaphorically every time I sing it. Fear of the fate to darkness, fear of the future is quite common, yet the burden of my decisions has a cost for me. I had a strong struggle with my own inner demons. Nevertheless, I won and wrote the lyrics. --------------- -------------- Playing it with the keyboard means a new beginning for me. Despite mistakes and shadows we are always one step closer to starting over. It is definitely a piece of music that forms part of the soundtrack of my life. --------------- --------------
Song: I’m just someone who happens in a crowd. People are afraid of so many things and never fear their own actions. I escaped oblivion. I forget and am captive to one more instinct; by taking firm steps, I start over. Discovering songs in intense moments is the soundtrack of life itself, your own life, dreaming, insisting I just want to be happy. --------------- --------------- Thank you for being part of this sound journey. -------------- ------------- #### Credits: --------- ------------- Recorded with my REDMI A5 phone Editing and assembly in Inshot app Images Text Art app Text on photo. Translated into: https://www.elmundo.es/traductor/ ---------- -----------
--- ▶️ [3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=erney333/7d446ab6)

links.body:
> [Esp] ¡Saludos comunidad! Hoy mi inspiración fue para outfits en este tono, una camisa blanca o algo blanco para combinar. Llevo varios modelos, intento tener variedad para mostrar, he probado suerte sin tener resultados, pero no me desanimo aun, compré material y hasta que no cumpla con gastarla seguiré creando y por supuesto intentando. Hoy te presento este accesorio trabajado en tela de organza muy delicado y con dobladillo. >! [English version] Hello everyone! Today I was inspired to put together outfits in this shade – a white shirt or something white to go with it. I’ve been working on several designs; I try to have a variety to show you. I’ve tried my luck without much success, but I’m not giving up yet. I’ve bought some fabric, and until I’ve used it all up, I’ll keep creating and, of course, giving it a go. Today I’m presenting this accessory, crafted from very delicate organza fabric with a hem.

https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/23x1YN1cVfkFGFUApsNEqcy14kxB39rxwAvrfhHpVnSeH2hL1EmizukyCqHNz4teH41nn.jpg # Materiales / Materials https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/23x1YN1cVfkFGFUApsNEqcy14kxB39rxwAvrfhHpVnSeH2hL1EmizukyCqHNz4teH41nn.jpg
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-09 at 10.21.34 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/EpCAvp5zXriZz1KdB2kcR5wTwGGnLSk3xGH52XsbwS1pU1K9XaP9AFEiiESQqDQBAU1.jpeg) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/Ep3fJQfeFghsrg3QtjgcMJ7HkTmEzcHkmWQnkJpWzLFPF62Hfsi9Ek3ghQXCsWq3iuy.png) |||| |-|-|-| |**Spanish**|**English**| | Clip grande para el cabello | Large hair clip | | Tijera | Scissors | Tela organza | Tela organza | Silicón caliente | Hot silicone | Regla, hilo y aguja de coser | Ruler, thread and sewing needle | Yesquero | Tinder | Lápiz | Pencil | Máquina de coser | Sewing machine

https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/23x1YN1cVfkFGFUApsNEqcy14kxB39rxwAvrfhHpVnSeH2hL1EmizukyCqHNz4teH41nn.jpg # Paso a paso / Step by Step https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/23x1YN1cVfkFGFUApsNEqcy14kxB39rxwAvrfhHpVnSeH2hL1EmizukyCqHNz4teH41nn.jpg
# Step 1️⃣/ Paso 1️⃣
|||| |-|-|-| ![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-09 at 10.40.39 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/Eonm4UZE9b9yMXqjqbD8STjKuo5GZ7MxQ4MYsbsYXnJ9JyRPbhYvUxyu5GgezhJgCHZ.jpeg)|![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-09 at 10.21.34 PM (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/EowGd63BmpXtUwCYJ94jnnkfrMHSR5TeN5St9sByLazLrpPQc5vgp98LijbADiJYeNx.jpeg) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/EogNn6fitdbnG34cddFTXGY4qS1dRf93623HxAn2mGc1aqAm4h96KTU74qHUxqef23Z.png)

> [Esp] Corta dos piezas de 10 centímetros de ancho por el largo de la tela. Marca con un lápiz cada 15 centímetros en la tela. Con la máquina de coser en zig zag muy menudito realiza un dobladillo en los cuatro lados de cada pieza. >! [English version] Cut two pieces 10 centimetres wide and the full length of the fabric. Mark the fabric with a pencil every 15 centimetres. Using a very tight zigzag stitch on your sewing machine, hem all four sides of each piece.
https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/23x1YN1cVfkFGFUApsNEqcy14kxB39rxwAvrfhHpVnSeH2hL1EmizukyCqHNz4teH41nn.jpg
### Step 2️⃣/ paso 2️⃣
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/EogPK2PJJ94ud5m1F9P9CZtNMpUGrLtmR8JogEePzGajkAUF5piZVhDzj2P9GnysshV.png) |||| |-|-|-| ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/Eoc73EYDDE1kisQnqTCqPNb86ymyyqyndByXtSKBivMRq9NfXUBaW2dR2KopTpJDpRB.png)| ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/EopsN2WyoLSDnXPgTYaxJq1srLvRooNPUnQ7Y6f4nxgyswnZz3aY2UmgEJfsfPKy3Sb.png)

> [Esp] Cada extremo de la pieza dobla hasta la primera marca, pasa la aguja con el hilo de coser por la marca luego aprieta y ajusta con un nudo para formar el primer lazo. Este paso debe ser en cada extremo de ambas piezas. >! [English version] Fold each end of the piece up to the first mark, pass the needle with the sewing thread through the mark, then pull tight and secure with a knot to form the first loop. Repeat this step at each end of both pieces.
https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/23x1YN1cVfkFGFUApsNEqcy14kxB39rxwAvrfhHpVnSeH2hL1EmizukyCqHNz4teH41nn.jpg
### Step 3️⃣/ paso 3️⃣
|||| |-|-|-| ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/Eoc73EYDDE1kisQnqTCqPNb86ymyyqyndByXtSKBivMRq9NfXUBaW2dR2KopTpJDpRB.png)| ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/EoyPZ61TD8UtZbSzN9fwuD1JDhw2FJ4nWCbNK6S3osP21tknUkghNshDvjdQw1UaxHr.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/EoGyQvWm4DQc4nWs3qyFHZFCLEXG7M738VbwYc7FvEbtD3qpcZ26dD8RooEw28vxqK6.png)

> [Esp] Las siguientes marcas consiste en pasar la aguja con hilo, luego fruncir y ajustar con un nudo hasta llegar al otro extremo y repetir estos pasos con la otra pieza. >! [English version] The next step involves threading the needle, then gathering the fabric and securing it with a knot until you reach the other end, and repeating these steps with the other piece.

Mi experiencia con esta tela es muy similar a la que elaboré de color negro, es excelente para trabajarla, deja un aire de elegancia y se ve sofisticado, caro, elegante. Once you have finished the first side, repeat the same procedure on the other side. My experience with this fabric is very similar to the black version I made; it’s excellent to work with, gives an air of elegance and looks sophisticated, expensive and stylish. links.body:
https://youtu.be/kTJD6aYScLM?si=cYVZ9xpkDgVE-Pf4
May God give us the victory over the flesh and enable us to live victoriously in righteousness everyday. It is the will of God the we should work in righteousness. The Bible says that God had called us unto righteousness not unto sin. Every unrighteousness is a sin. He or she who sins is not doing the will of God. The will of God is for people to obey His commandments and love him. No matter how the world looks today when we consider it through the lens of God's word, God still expect that people should turn from sin and serve him.

The body of sin must be done away with. We must put of the flesh and all its lustful desires. We must mortify our carnal members. We must decease from the works of the flesh. We need to allow our hearts to serve God in true holiness and righteousness. God wants us to walk before Him and be upright.

Our body desires the pleasures of the world. It takes pleasure in disobeying the commandments of God. We must not yield ourselves to serve the devil. We are to rely upon the Holy Spirit who is able to help live according to the ways of God. The flesh will always oppose the purpose of God but we must resist the flesh and refuse to fulfill the works of the flesh.

links.title: When Innocence Is Ignored: A Story That Broke My Heart
links.body:
/>A few days ago, I sat with some children in our school, and what they shared with me is something I have not been able to forget.  

These are children who already carry heavy burdens in life. Orphans, trying to survive each day with very little, yet still showing up to learn, to hope, and to believe that tomorrow can be better.  
  
As they spoke, tears filled their eyes.  
  
They told me how a neighbor accused them of something they had not done. They tried to explain, again and again, that they were innocent. But no one listened.  
  
What broke me even more was this—they told the neighbor that they had not even eaten since the previous day.  
  
Still, their voices were ignored.  
  
Instead, they were forced to clean up human waste with their bare hands as punishment.  
  
They kept saying, “We did not do it.”  
  
But their innocence did not matter in that moment.  
  
It was not just what they were made to do. It was the humiliation. The hunger. The pain of not being believed. The weight of being judged simply because they are vulnerable.  
  
I sat there, listening, asking myself: How can children already suffering so much be treated this way?  
  
This is the reality many of them live in—not just a lack of food or shelter, but a lack of protection, dignity, and understanding.  
  
And this is why our work in the school goes beyond education.  
  
These children need a safe place.  
  
A place where: They are heard.  
  
They are protected.  
  
They are treated with dignity.  
  
This is why building a dormitory is not just a project for us—it is a necessity.  
  
Because for some children, safety is not guaranteed.  
  
And for some, even being believed is a privilege.  
  
We may not be able to change everything at once.  
  
But we can choose to stand for something.  
  
We can choose compassion.  
  
We can choose to protect.  
  
We can choose to give children a place where they can simply be children again.  
#Education #ChildProtection #Kenya #Compassion #Nonprofit #Steemit #Ecency

I swear I'm not a fan of pink so I wanted to kip this one XD But then... I thought of pink skies and pink tropical sunsets and thought... yeah I could work with this.

And that's how my decision making for this one came out. It was actually in my Pinterest inspo so thought I'd try the style out too cuz it was really cute to me. Kind of a little flat for my tastes but still cute. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeGRyeqMZVHwtbkMvPSZ5wKma8SX3XrB51wYhBfRHhNF7/messenger_creation_7bcbe6f4_5b5e_4f55_a3f9_6f8d37009b22.jpeg)
>Material: Fineliner, white acrylic marker, watercolor
>Duration: 1 hour, drying unaccounted for


Basically, this was minimalist and my white acrylic marker decided to start blotting on me which was so uncooperative, yet it didn't blot on me while I was doing the fish though? so it seems kinda biased. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWH15NPB6772gVNPmPKmpx51w33TGbizbgVE7UyGcXJrs/messenger_creation_0be4ba9f_13e6_406e_969a_b95aa404cceb.jpeg)
And I had to look for my washing tape to pull this off because I can't do clean lines on my watercolor yet XD I can barely paint without the layers bleeding into each other yet XD that's why I'm a little reliant on my pencil colors for the clean up. Oh! but I am proud to say that I did not use that much pencil coloring in on this one, I mostly used the fineliners and hatching techniques to give it some details. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYxB761bJEV68XrbaiiuSpN8hGwj1SxBEaa3VLkXCEYck/messenger_creation_84ce46b5_116b_44ad_bf03_a8aa6834acfa.jpeg)
This was when my watercolor layers finally dried and I was just moving down on my penning to avoid smudging the ink or anything since I was using a 0.2 tip and to me, that's already pretty thick since I usually work on a 0.005 to 0.1 tip then I move my way up. But since my thinner tips were not cooperating with me today, I didn't have much of a choice here XD 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmess5nTaK78UjUgh5Svke6dm7ztkMNN7tEaZo7EK5YLn5/messenger_creation_7c8edc36_b311_4f15_97ff_37c7de6ff38c.jpeg)
I also did forget to take progression shots since I work fairly fast on pen mediums and this was actually pretty fast for me since it's hatching and just making really really small definitions. I did use a nit of orange and pink pencils here to give the colors a little bit more life and vibrancy before I finished with the highlights to make it look less flat. 

And that was my quick painting to catch up with where I left off! I still want to do my day 1 and 2 then I'll move onto the rest of the prompts in continuation of everything. I hope I can finish them both tomorrow so that by Sunday I should be completely caught up with all my prompts for the month ;;w;; wish me luck catching up guys! 
I shall be back later!

***A Pleasant and Wonderful Day to all the Coffee lovers out there all over the world!***👋😊

***Hello to all of my friends here and of course to all my dear fellow hivers in this lovely @cinnamoncupcoffee community! How are you all today? I hope everyone is doing well and happy right now. Here I am again, @lj1728 to share another simple coffee story with you all.***☕️💕

![April 2026 Blogs.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23u6NHXefhQ4tVQSiKVdtMqwrNnzcgJD3vutPKVyfBnS2tgmwkhZqVGML1X7NZ7gUhvXd.png)

***It's been a while since I last posted in this community, and today I felt like sharing a simple yet meaningful moment from this month of April–my coffee date with my bestie***.

![IMG_5347.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23tc3Kja1B6G4db8N8VCMRhBwjhAN6rNZiQR6sfgbbb6LGfWpDdiqdQ5awzBgr5x1oiQj.jpeg)

![IMG_5349.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23xL2iyjhRKvxtRq2XVpX1DqekwoqHGG7GDWGriYncQ5U8UryFwujACH1F76wmPCtpVZV.jpeg)

Yesterday, we decided to visit our favorite coffee spot in town, Kapètera. I've probably mentioned this cafè in several of my past blogs already, but it truly deserves the spotlight every time. ***It has become our go-to place whenever we want to catch up, unwind, and just enjoy each other's company. There's something about the cozy ambiance and familiar atmosphere that makes every visit special.***

![IMG_5346.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/EogQDsGFimtfjjHYpRMgP9gXJih3ahpS3HbGZyf49ov1ouweA5Dxnt6VyhTDH95zSpL.jpeg)

![IMG_5348.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23wX1dCS8FwBLaA89V3eAiG7qkDbqWao9eeBCrC33BhQbW74ungHjuRvftPCHMwcgj4sL.jpeg)

As usual, we planned to have our early dinner there. ***We ordered our favorite comfort food like chicken teriyaki and fries platter to share. For drinks, my bestie chose her all-time favorite coffee jelly, while I decided to try something a bit refreshing and different, a strawberry matcha.*** Everything tasted just right, but more than the food, it was the moment that made it memorable.

![IMG_5359.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23wX7ditrgRdH3NJeDYfMkkU1bucB3yjSpRbCrWfZavPQMAAEi3t7HfsjKpDCUtqfcukC.jpeg)

![IMG_5360.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23wMhBnynxenwXa2NqWaAZwimMAhoZPfCUmcLVjpvnZnxWL2dkosSUFXuXeWyPb76uGCU.jpeg)

![IMG_5357.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23vsX3Vm3btME9b21mjzEQvq6SSiKFvMUXRm9KqbAKmvc8toFpzKWsy1XNcNX3poxQma5.jpeg)

We spent hours talking about life, random stories, personal struggles, future plans, and even smallest details that only we would understand. ***It's funny how even in silence, nothing feels awkward. Just being there together was already enough. There's a kind of peace that comes with being with someone who truly knows you.***

![IMG_5354.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23xybeHCNZ7qwPV9CnDGvJdXfTryMeeNP7eZmDpq3iv3ngqF7DmJoJhkVf4BG7GLQwAaf.jpeg)

***As we grow older, I've come to realize that friendships become more meaningful when they are genuine. You start to appreciate the presence of people who stay, who listen, and who accept you for who you are. It's no longer about having many friends, but about keeping the real ones close.***

![IMG_5345.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23ywuLTkZr6U55XacxYKwRMxaqdFoAxWyYrhcwBi4eFTPV939g77hFRQwsp2tpD7jJCwK.jpeg)

***And that's it for today's blog! Thank you so much for dropping by and taking the time to read my simple life story. This means a lot to me! I hope you enjoyed it and see you on my next one. Have a nice day ahead to all of us.***😍

***These photos were mine and taken with my iphone13pro and the lead image was edited through Canva.***✍️👩‍💻

**Lots of love,
LJ**💗

links.title: The Humanoid Body-Aware Robot
links.body:
> A few years ago, when we saw the old Atlas walking, it was already impressive, then we saw videos with jumps, races and even parkour, and the public began to get used to it, today that is no longer enough. Kaist researchers developed the V0.7 humanoid, a 75kg machine that was not created just to impress, but to function in the real world.


At first glance it may seem like just another robot, but this robot was designed with a completely different approach, instead of depending on existing industrial parts, the engineers developed practically everything from scratch, motors, controllers and transmission systems, all optimized for a single objective, balancing power, precision and control in real time and there comes one of the biggest innovations, a so-called “almost direct” actuation system that allows extremely fast and sensitive responses, something essential to maintain balance in motion.


In addition, the robot uses an advanced type of gear capable of generating high torque in a much smaller space. In practice, this means more strength, more weight controls, but what really differentiates this system is not just the hardware, it is how it learns. Instead of simply programming movements, the researchers used deep reinforcement learning, a type of artificial intelligence that learns through trial and error. In a crucial detail, the robot does not learn alone, it learns by observing humans.


https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9qZcTMARvpk
https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmcM9vDyChXWWfaBhnqxXD5scZn7pnHcZrWiwyZ8HMwmbX/separador%201.png

> Motion capture data was used as a basis for teaching natural movement patterns. Result, more fluid, more natural, less robotic and still totally controlled movements. Another classic challenge of robotics was also solved here, the difference between simulation and real world, many robots work perfectly on the computer, but fail when facing the physical environment, to avoid this, the engineers limited the learning according to the real capabilities of the motors, that is, the robot only learns what it can really execute.


And perhaps most impressive, it can move even without vision, using only internal sensors to understand position, balance and movement, as if it had a kind of body consciousness. This means that robots are no longer simple programmed machines and are beginning to become systems capable of learning, adapting and acting with true physical autonomy.


And it is not an isolated project, it is part of a larger South Korean plan that aims to bring humanoids to scale production in the coming years, but there is an ironic detail in all this, up to this point the biggest challenge was to get the robots to move like us, now the challenge has changed, they can now move, the next step is for them to look exactly like us.


https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmcM9vDyChXWWfaBhnqxXD5scZn7pnHcZrWiwyZ8HMwmbX/separador%201.png


Sorry for my Ingles, it's not my main language. The images were taken from the sources used or were created with artificial intelligence


Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@rebe.torres12/the-humanoid-bodyaware-robot-ddy)
