links.body:
#


<center>![Pink and Cream Grid Cute Doodle Bridal Makeup Tutorial Youtube Thumbnail_20260409_144931_0000.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZYB4uHP5ear5fXZp6GgjHiqYJ8DeY9h9p1W4zCzuQhuC/Pink%20and%20Cream%20Grid%20Cute%20Doodle%20Bridal%20Makeup%20Tutorial%20Youtube%20Thumbnail_20260409_144931_0000.png)</center>

#

<center>![1_20260407_225637_0000 (1).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQtvSrXmcJDGmvwWr1co4QENqoGzw9U1WFcj1xDGoCpSt/1_20260407_225637_0000%20(1).jpg)</center>

#

### _<div class=\
>Bienvenidos a mi blog de costura 🧵♥️./Welcome to my sewing blog 🧵♥️._ #

>Saludos apreciada comunidad ,les deseo una bonita noche hoy y antes de irme a descansar quiero mostrarles este proyecto costuril que hice hoy y siguiendo con la secuencia de el TOP #5 de 10 costuras hechas con retazos ,en esta ocasión les mostraré a hacer una bandana juvenil con lazo doble, con esos retazos de telas que tengas en casa y que no uses ,le podemos dar un cambio muy particular y así aprovechar esos retales para algo mas productivo,espero les guste mucho ,vamos con los materiales. # > _Greetings, dear community! I wish you a good night tonight, and before I go to rest, I want to show you this sewing project I made today. Continuing with the TOP 5 of 10 sewing projects made with scraps, this time I'll show you how to make a youthful bandana with a double bow. With those fabric scraps you have at home that you don't use, we can give them a very unique makeover and thus use those scraps for something more productive. I hope you like it a lot. Let's get to the materials._ # ---
![IMG_20260409_120451_221.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdhu3GGWThtqmUtMiQ81Zqx9x2BPFc9dcybv2NJwLmW3i/IMG_20260409_120451_221.jpg)
![1_20260407_225637_0000 (1).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQtvSrXmcJDGmvwWr1co4QENqoGzw9U1WFcj1xDGoCpSt/1_20260407_225637_0000%20(1).jpg)
## _
Materiales: | Materials:
_ # * **_Cinta métrica_** * **_Hilo y aguja_** * **_Máquina de coser_** * **_Tijera_** # > * *_Measuring tape_* > * *_Needle and thread_* > * *_Sewing machine_* > * *_Scissors_*
![1_20260407_225637_0000 (1).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQtvSrXmcJDGmvwWr1co4QENqoGzw9U1WFcj1xDGoCpSt/1_20260407_225637_0000%20(1).jpg)
## _
Pasos a seguir: | Steps to follow:
_ #
![IMG_20260409_120550_177.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUf13B7uctCXLuf3GiGdXHf4yMPtVbjyujHuiWHcqkWqo/IMG_20260409_120550_177.jpg)
![IMG_20260409_120633_538.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anne002/Eos3i8QMXonrcLQ9Fpv9EhRedpXH7w5DLSaWY4MsmXpyN8oCaycjRkL5nSwnYWXsLGK.jpg)
![IMG_20260409_120644_717.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZiRYspXsL6Nn5QDsYN6Ti7iqYM8oQxSeHQzhxHakbMMV/IMG_20260409_120644_717.jpg)
![IMG_20260409_120713_222 (2).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anne002/EogPoQEGEiueomZ3vrb1WMEi546dFB6uqWkv1cvPuSyi9gX4ifXBf68fVLeCAN36Gsn.jpg)
### _Paso 01_

>Comencé principalmente cortando las piezas base de la bandana y las piezas base de los lazos (moños), también corté la pieza que une ambos lazos tal cual se muestra en las imágenes . # > ### _Step 01_ > _I started mainly by cutting the base pieces of the bandana and the base pieces of the bows, I also cut the piece that joins both bows as shown in the images._ ---
![IMG_20260409_121221_309.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUyinXDWa2mAXaznpvQG6ypgNWve6AyE9w2zMTVcGrehA/IMG_20260409_121221_309.jpg)
![IMG_20260409_121224_091.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUeebLH8aQYdHowHvw6nEhouaBXRRnoSEvi7dw1vux7aY/IMG_20260409_121224_091.jpg)
![IMG_20260409_121559_701.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQnbXFmEGV4S3X7e2n4paAC1YxWDvwq7Qr2qonqrmUWwd/IMG_20260409_121559_701.jpg)
![IMG_20260409_121820_527.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSW2BsLMbvEoY5ctxgUcKcNP1oP29Zcx5qG5M5tx2RMA2/IMG_20260409_121820_527.jpg)
### _Paso 02_

>Pasaremos a coser la bandana para ello como corté dos piezas de la base pues la uní en cada extremo dejando un extremo sin coser,luego vamos a coser por la parte del borde dejando 1 cm de costura hacia adentro con costura recta en la punta vamos a unir nuevamente los extremos después que hemos volteado nuestra bandana ,nos debe quedar una abertura y por allí podemos coser a mano con aguja e hilo el horificio para sellar la bandana. # > ### _Step 02_ > _We will now sew the bandana. Since I cut two pieces for the base, I joined them at each end, leaving one end unsewn. Then we will sew along the edge, leaving 1 cm of seam allowance inside. With a straight stitch at the tip, we will join the ends again. After turning our bandana right side out, we should have an opening, and through there we can hand-sew the hole with a needle and thread to seal the bandana._ ---
![IMG_20260409_122110_350.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWyNxbCg94AhRy5Zjamg5jQ5vHMSiLW1Yu8DSuLiJ1udD/IMG_20260409_122110_350.jpg)
![IMG_20260409_122423_611.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSz1Scpw9tvPezoFeJWGh9wgAujdvmGwEZEu8BZgvR5EP/IMG_20260409_122423_611.jpg)
![IMG_20260409_122420_970.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUEfz35rvpuBB93HWaWodT7pDxbsBxx79ziVFvKVFdXdN/IMG_20260409_122420_970.jpg)
![IMG_20260409_122525_287.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQ1Tn4cw7FkeRyiLcqkrSFWQenByP1JEccVYf7wdL59eY/IMG_20260409_122525_287.jpg)
### _Paso 03_

>Coseremos ahora las piezas que conformaran nuestro lazo ,cosemos el grande por el borde dejando 1 cm de costura sin coser y dejamos una abertura en cada lazo para poder voltear lo ,dicha abertura la sellaremos igual que como hicimos con la bandana con costura invisible,no olvidemos coser también el rectángulo doble para unión de ambos lazos y empezamos frunciendo en el medio el primero en este caso el negro ya que lo corté mas grande que el brillante de lentejuelas. # > ### _Step 03_ > _Now we will sew the pieces that will make up our bow. We sew the large one along the edge, leaving 1 cm of seam unsewn, and leave an opening in each bow so we can turn it right side out. We will seal this opening just like we did with the bandana, using an invisible seam. Don't forget to also sew the double rectangle to join both bows, and we start by gathering the first one in the middle, in this case the black one, since I cut it larger than the shiny sequined one._ ---
![IMG_20260409_122624_379.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSa8ZTHG95dCD5NK1iQLYx1w8iBCyQHkeuPn7j5pVYF2K/IMG_20260409_122624_379.jpg)
![IMG_20260409_122726_386.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXpmb9qbTBJprdxgTbGa1FteRxWz4xdJSuydkhwZ5XRuE/IMG_20260409_122726_386.jpg)
![IMG_20260409_123003_291.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRVCnJzud32aC61HwFjHK7TEu77AmBQENULQZLbo43nav/IMG_20260409_123003_291.jpg)
![IMG_20260409_123007_336.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmY2DCtNUtkGukEsh49d89cZjr8Hm3X94DG3sZyhjEfvMj/IMG_20260409_123007_336.jpg)
### _Paso 04_

>Por último vamos a fruncir el negro con lentejuelas y lo ubicamos encima del negro y damos con el hilo de coser tres vueltas ajustamos bien y lo vamos a ubicar en una de las uniones del lazo frunciendo también la bandana,por último vamos a unir los lazos con el rectángulo que cosimos anteriormente por la parte de atrás y listo así nos queda ya terminada nuestra bonita bandana. # > ### _Step 04_ > _Finally, we're going to gather the black sequined fabric and place it on top of the black fabric. We'll sew three turns of the thread around it, tightening it well, and then we'll place it at one of the bow's joints, also gathering the bandana. Finally, we'll join the bows with the rectangle we sewed earlier on the back, and that's it! Our pretty bandana is finished._ ---
![1_20260407_225637_0000 (1).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQtvSrXmcJDGmvwWr1co4QENqoGzw9U1WFcj1xDGoCpSt/1_20260407_225637_0000%20(1).jpg)
## _
Resultado: | Result:
_ #

>Ahora déjame saber en los comentarios que tal te ha parecido esta bandana y si ya has reciclado tus retazos para hacer bandanas así,a mi en esta oportunidad me motivó mi vecina a hacerlas ya que en el negocio que tiene ella de mercerías cerca de mi casa vende este tipo de bisutería para el cabello lazos ,gorros bandanas y más asi que pues me puso modo emprendedora y reciclar mis retazos de tela para vender bandanas,y bueno amigos gracias por apreciar este blog ,lea deseo un feliz descanso y bonita mañana noa vemos pronto con nuevas ideas y trabajos de costura esos que tanto a ustedes les gusta 😊. # > _Now let me know in the comments what you think of this bandana and if you've already recycled your fabric scraps to make bandanas like this. This time, my neighbor motivated me to make them because at her haberdashery shop near my house, she sells this type of hair accessory: bows, hats, bandanas, and more. So, it put me in entrepreneurial mode, and I started recycling my fabric scraps to sell bandanas. Well, friends, thank you for enjoying this blog. I wish you a happy rest and a beautiful morning. See you soon with new ideas and sewing projects, the kind you all love so much! 😊_
![IMG_20260409_123248_412.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYnirsyQaxfCWhQtnsxJmNxWG5vtGje5UkPiXUPtHfPGc/IMG_20260409_123248_412.jpg)
![IMG_20260409_123312_832.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTUQs8FPPyu5mnyACSaNvbjtb7r6UkB2pFRiNQFFXP6qn/IMG_20260409_123312_832.jpg)

#

>¡Hola!...Soy Annie Una chica que le apasiona el diseño,la costura las manualidades y crear cualquier cosa de mucho uso con mis manos,tengo como hobbie diseñar ropa,la música ,el maquillarme,la fotografía,la pintura y el dibujo,expresar mis ideas y sentimientos en un dibujo es algo que me gusta hacer,amo la naturaleza,un atardecer ,la playa y disfrutar con mis familiares de los buenos momentos de la vida.❤️ # ##### _

links.title: Tour of the Punta de Mata cruise ship, Monagas state (Eng - Esp)
links.body:
> **
INGLÉS
** During our vacation trip to Monagas State, in addition to visiting Bolívar and Rómulo Gallegos Squares, the Ateneo, and the House of Culture, among other sites, we stopped at the intersection, which leads to several towns in Monagas State, such as Punta de Mata, El Tejero, Santa Bárbara, and Aguasay. El Tejero is located on the road to Puerto la Cruz. In previous years, this highway did not have the monuments it has today, and they also installed signs displaying the city’s name. on each of which you can see the economic activities carried out in the region, such as oil extraction, agriculture, livestock, services, and more. It is a small city in terms of population, but it has the basic services to meet the needs of its residents. At the intersection, you can also see the statue of Our Lady of the Valley, considered the patron saint of the East. The statue is large and white; I tried to take photos up close, but since it’s a very busy road, I decided to take them from a distance instead, and you can still make out some details of the statue. You can also see various facilities and pipelines belonging to the oil company. The monument made of letters is very beautiful and eye-catching; My favorite part is the different figures representing the economic activities of this growing city.

> **
ESPAÑOL
** Durante el viaje en el periodo de vacaciones al estado Monagas además de visitar las plazas Bolívar y Rómulo Gallegos, el Ateneo, la casa de la cultura, entre otros, hicimos una parada en el crucero, este conduce a varias poblaciones del estado Monagas como Punta de Mata, El Tejero, Santa Bárbara y Aguasay, el tejero se ubica en la vía hacia Puerto la Cruz, en años anteriores este crucero no tenía los monumentos con los que cuenta actualmente y además colocaron unas letras donde se lee el nombre de la ciudad, en cada una de ellas se pueden observar las actividades económicas que se desarrollan en la región, como la actividad minera extractiva petrolera, agricultura, ganadería, servicios y más, es una ciudad pequeña en cuanto a población, pero cuenta con los servicios básicos para atender las demandas de los habitantes. En el crucero también se observa la escultura de nuestra señora Del Valle, considerada la patrona de oriente, la escultura es de gran tamaño y de color blanco, intenté tomar fotos más cerca pero al ser una carretera muy transitada preferí tomarla a la distancia y se pueden apreciar algunos detalles de esta escultura, también se observan varias instalaciones y tuberías de la empresa petrolera, el monumento de las letras es muy bonito y llamativo, mi parte favorita son las diferentes figuras que representan las actividades económicas de esta creciente ciudad. ![Crucero y Mango tin (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EpNot2qDMdJyuRmHmkt2yodWoEGx78aAPbhWJ2jHafws9LtNqzmZnPxDsCvWQFp3hBM.jpeg) ![Crucero y Mango tin (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EqNGdsfwFimAq5GMyyCnZwDNAFsH8xZHAVcq4Fwwxnr2rgkE1Ld7kEdRpFn5C2t8pJK.jpeg) ![Crucero y Mango tin (15).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EpxqMQjA7wGckGtyvs8aoiAZd1j83sRipSDfcCsyoGcM5JqC6DKb2gmgB72DkmJZpwF.jpeg) ![Crucero y Mango tin (11).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EqNG7cY3WwzoLxnBgFBvspox3QsTmHDK2gfYfDAJvFpQ9zfERSDa9MnKdHfxuwT4FvK.jpeg) ![Crucero y Mango tin (12).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EnYSqxr6pqGFS52uPrKtVHE2W9bJPds5MEM6GvLx8YYn3CmhDvNpkan3PTwd5GcQ2gL.jpeg) ![Crucero y Mango tin (13).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EprUXsVkJ5D94wZTCaS9G9VWhGkzNNiS9hjHqThPNcZob7cqBxbiqGuZnDU5G9PUuxU.jpeg)

> During our trip to Punta de Mata, my nephews took advantage of the cruise ship’s stop to take pictures in front of the letters; they were excited to see these huge letters welcoming visitors to the city and happily posed for the camera. Little Aaron was the first to strike various poses so we could take lots of pictures of him. Near the letters, as I mentioned, there is a white sculpture surrounded by a circle of yellow pipes. It also has a small garden and protective walls. Since it’s located in the center of the roundabout—at the junction that leads to the different roads—it’s equipped with protective barriers and safety features. After our stop at the crossroads, we continued on to our destination, a town known as Mango Tin. The town gets its name from the abundance of mango trees—a tropical fruit—which can be seen in the town squares and along the main streets. It is a small town with few roads, and its most striking feature is the mango trees 🥭. In the photo, you can see the small town square, several mango trees surrounding it, and concrete benches. The town has basic services, such as a school and a clinic, among others, and there are many mango trees lining the road. The square is triangular in shape, with a white wall and several posts with LED lights; the benches are white and orange. I liked its simple, inviting design with a rustic style. We sat in the square for over an hour, and we also took a short walk through the town while we waited for my friend, who was running errands in a nearby town. Mango Tin is a beautiful, cozy, and warm country town. Its streets and lush vegetation make it a charming forest—the perfect place to relax and clear your mind. I loved the walk because it felt like being in the countryside 🌼. I saw several birds, heard their beautiful songs, and breathed in the fresh air.

> Durante nuestro viaje a Punta de Mata, mis sobrinos aprovecharon la parada en el crucero para tomarse fotos en las letras, estaban entusiasmados de ver estas enormes letras que dan la bienvenida a la ciudad y posaron muy felices para la cámara, el pequeño Aarón fue el primero en hacer varias poses para tomarle muchas fotografías, cerca de las letras como ya lo mencioné, se ubica una escultura de color blanco, la cual está rodeada por un círculo de tubos amarillos, también tiene un pequeño jardín y muros protectores, al estar en el centro del crucero, en la redoma que da acceso a las diferentes carreteras, cuenta con barreras para resguardarla. Luego de nuestra parada en el crucero, retomamos nuestro destino que era un pueblo conocido como Mango Tin, este nombre se debe a que en él abundan árboles de esta fruta tropical y se puede observar en las plazas y principales avenidas, es un pueblo pequeño con pocas carreteras y lo que más destaca son los árboles de mango 🥭 en la fotografía se puede apreciar la pequeña plaza, varios árboles de mango alrededor y bancos de concreto, cuenta con los servicios básicos; escuela, ambulatorio, entre otros y la presencia de muchos árboles de mango a lo largo de la carretera. La plaza tiene forma triangular, un muro de color blanco y varios postes con luces LED, los bancos son de color blanco y naranja, me gustó su diseño sencillo y acogedor con un estilo campestre, nos sentamos más de una hora en la plaza, además hicimos un pequeño recorrido por el pueblo mientras llegaba mi amiga, que estaba haciendo diligencias en una población cercana, Mango Tin, es un hermoso pueblo campestre acogedor y cálido, sus calles y abundante vegetación lo convierten en en encantador bosque ideal para relajarse y despejar la mente, m me encantó el recorrido, porque es como estar en el campo 🌼 pude ver varias aves, escuchar su hermoso canto y respirar aire puro. ![Crucero y Mango tin (14).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EqYuAYnUMtqLo7sXpCZSbq46FLWSJhGjjS2pxdoiVCXTZC6rixnDPFKaHsq8cn7sjc1.jpeg) ![Crucero y Mango tin (8).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EpEJM78ddCR1xtYyLAcy51CjPB2NZsv1aCUfu3cCW1g4LndsA7oJgcn2ib3irnp9FBR.jpeg) ![Crucero y Mango tin (3).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/Eoptr3n54GK4rKD32CnVSXs9iVeoiMSG77EidWqkLkAnwcxVBe1iXif2ngzXcPqUib7.jpeg) ![Crucero y Mango tin (4).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/Eo8SukxJcAgq3NPWH6XYVjuYKoDwtDQsKo3RJAfk4mb2jBiz3msQoA6ZN2aNbmZ9HVE.jpeg) ![Crucero y Mango tin (5).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EpJZYxnS6qbTdWBpzEs8S7vS5yNsL75qxTYVKDMLzekKF5far34Z8v8oeaatPwUBiMS.jpeg) ![Crucero y Mango tin (6).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EpNovsg1kwz5qq9V5Wi7ncjrQPPmf4sveriw5yNk7w5q4RtuXxzKYXi6Z7yw52dhvtP.jpeg) ![Crucero y Mango tin (7).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EpnDfgCP5inKbFWZ5N9ecp5CXS3yi2ybsumUkNkfNcCVL9TnM6uy9tUiNsFYSZ9hCQZ.jpeg)

links.title: What Ifs....
links.body:
<center>
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTdmYgf9C2Kn9nub6SfgYeq2Ki34uTDPogsVBNbL3zEVx/image.png)
</center>

Since the start of the year, prices for one of the oldest trading card games have been climbing steadily. I still remember buying my first packs of Pokémon more than twenty years ago and how I wish I’d never opened them. Just a few weeks ago, the game celebrated its 30th anniversary, and card prices have surged even higher. Demand continues to rise, and it makes me wonder what Splinterlands could borrow from Pokémon’s playbook to achieve similar success.

Onboarding remains one of the toughest hurdles for digital trading card games. As many gamers and developers know, making Splinterlands easily accessible to the public is no simple task. Over the years, the team has tried various strategies to attract new players. The latest approach such as rewarding existing players for bringing in newcomers has shown promise. Even the free‑to‑play model using Foundation cards in the Frontier format has, in my view, been a major success.

The demand for Splinterlands cards in my opinion is not weak, but lack of supply.  Many cards continue to be held onto due mainly in part that the values have lost a lot of value and or players simply believe in the game to hold onto the cards for much longer.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYgDctmDvsHPWR6rBvY4MW7ycWGfk5EQeKjszG61uvTE9/image.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf4kuXoNrUsmyW6aYM9SzkYhLT2YfMqV3v5XkLibFy9Xn/image.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSckvV2xCPFa7qqu3Fp3ae3FX2i1apaHfAC6efAj23PGk/image.png)

The charts above show steady daily activity, yet onboarding and market capitalization continue to trend downward. Could introducing a lottery for free spellbooks or welcome gifts help attract new players?

Another idea worth exploring is dynamic transaction fees. For example, if daily trading volume falls below a certain threshold, posting and transaction fees could drop to encourage more activity. Conversely, when trading volume spikes, fees could rise slightly to balance annual revenue targets. This kind of adaptive system might stimulate both buying and selling.

Now in its eighth year, Splinterlands has the chance to create its own “Pokémon‑style” frenzy around major milestones. The upcoming 10th anniversary could be a perfect opportunity to release legacy card reprints, drawing past players back into the fold. Imagine special collections or classic‑mode gameplay restricted to legacy sets—nostalgia made playable again. Long‑time fans could relive the early days while celebrating how far the game has come.

The most exciting part is that Splinterlands is decentralized. Rules can be revised, or even removed, through community voting. The future isn’t written yet, and with the success of TCGs like Pokémon as inspiration, Splinterlands has plenty of room to grow and innovate.

Thanks for reading this post!

links.title: Witnessing the Daybreak at Paradise Beach Resort, Culaba, Biliran, PH
links.body:
![1_20260330_154518_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nesbi94/23wMUHDsnV268kNT89t4aDw8qee2q7BRF1tWxeT3QhqD3zu7PUPHijUzQCBDK7UVgypEy.jpg)

Hello everyone. I hope you all had a great time exploring nice places. I would just like to add one in the map. In this blog let me introduce to you to one of the famous beaches in our locality and considered as one of the tourist spot in our province. Welcome to Paradise Beach Resort.

![1774851030481_022301.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nesbi94/23vhunoAPXQVJ2kdvVQ6m2FLLCkfPJzvkTUWMbV9hXrL7Nq6nvXduSYtKeQvknatdAUU8.jpg)

![1774851030645_023119.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nesbi94/23wWpfRzR3NQZajHfxMwu9V43Q4g42JmVpkVipFhBW9zRhjy1boFWDRkEZyXtETR2n5j5.jpg)

Paradise Beach Resort is a located in Brgy. Looc, Culaba, Biliran along the highway. You just have to walk down the downhill cemented path which would lead you to the beach. The entrance is just cheap, as low as 10.00 pesos and the cottages, some were concrete while some were made from wood and they ranges from 300.00-600.00. They also allow overnight camping. If you are someone who enjoys camping by the beach, this is a place to go. 

![5_20260330_154518_0004.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nesbi94/23wqkJ9r3dCPWEPUsMRNHu3daBi5u2bieP3nSTbGGSZBTxmLJ3MLvpfYuT5NUcj2rx7FT.jpg)

![6_20260330_154518_0005.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nesbi94/23xejotXXfmJm1deyVyBb7MAqAzy1HAMmtUcSYyYdVw7DYZUtDNgWCgLk4RZCgv2e26bf.jpg)

The resort is managed and owned by a family who also lives within the area. They also run a store where you could buy limited goods. Thus, it is advised to bring your own food or you go out and buy it in the central area which is just a 10 minute ride. They have a cooking area where you could cook some food or even grill. There is also a very spacious parking area.

Been here a  lot of times with my friends and this is also one of the places we go to tour our visitors whenever we have any. This is also my second time camping here with my friends. Our first time camping turned miserable because it rained at night. So glad that the weather was fine throughout the night and it was a full moon. Been here a lot of time but I just realized the beauty of the place during its tranquility especially in the early morning and while witnessing the sun rise. 

![3_20260330_154518_0002.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nesbi94/23uQLi29BMD7sF2W43HqYquF71dJUGBKDZSKVzQbh33mYowDGtqYicE3Mo3NSPUWqhpak.png)

![4_20260330_154518_0003.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nesbi94/23wMS4zka95gyK4VmX53HRMj7QaTMJCvtdoAUkoNeuzKvY84pkPCG1CjknVUwA7TGroJF.jpg)

We woke up at dawn enjoying the cool breeze. We enjoyed some warm water and bread while waiting for the sun to rise. It was trully fun and we were all mesmerized by how bright and round it is. Then my friends started getting into the water.

![1774851030393_021620.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nesbi94/23ynKjf4YgXiYvA8FoZMiUkF6vmH4dswW67V3HxKGEwwXtQgnd3uub5hqjdAW2dtxAng3.jpg)

Other than its scenic and relaxing view there are also a lot of activities you could do. The beach is spacious that you could actually play sports like volleyball, badminton or any group games except when there are lots of people or its crowded. That is why we really prefer coming on weekdays as it is usually crowded during the weekend.

Another thing you could do her aside from swimming is Kayaking. They have boats and live savers for rent. You could also pay for a karaoke if you want to sing.

Another thing I love about this place is its cool ambiance even if the weather is blazing. Maybe it is because of the big trees where you can also take shade or nap under. Sometimes we just come here to have a short picnic or eat our packed lunches in between our whole day activities. I also enjoy sitting on the swing made from bamboo.

That would be all. I hope you enjoyed the pictures and be able to come and experience the paradise like ambiance at Paradise Beach Resort.

Photos are mine and edited with Canva.

links.title: Super Fluffy Pancakes (Eng/Esp)
links.body:
> Today I decided to make some traditional-style pancakes. I wanted them to be really fluffy, so I bought some self-rising flour. I also added milk and an egg to the batter, which really helped improve the results. I’m going to show you how I made them.
![1000107154.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23z7BhtN8y7qdwy9LzTjuZVfb2DiHi2FD9RDJE7R4iBqi4s2F7giuYzjxUdw1thf5e15t.jpg)
## Ingredients: - 150 grams of self-rising flour - 1 egg - 3 cups of water - 3 tablespoons of powdered milk - 1 tablespoon of sugar - Salt to taste - Oil
![1000107144.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23wC3RTnfVQ88weEE5qDJp5gvGV7mZaHQhQ1yntD7aS9iS3b4vpqpfkAPqhPsdMMp7CnK.jpg)
## Preparation: I placed the water and salt in a bowl, added the flour, and stirred thoroughly to combine the ingredients. Then I added the milk and continued stirring. I poured in the sugar and, shortly after, the egg. I ended up with a smooth batter.
![1000107147.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23zRrf2dnbvAS6zFSfJF1npYC4Q4DWjWREDmaeHoijxArXnQVz1ueejRX7JmHR5aBUcfq.jpg)
I greased the surface of a skillet and poured a portion of the mixture into it, cooking over low heat for five minutes on each side. I repeated the process three more times.
![1000107151.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23wMj3jojUH5MGg2j31BqGVPi9Leuu3KkVnmn1qb5d5duLE43SnhnVGwph2uTqm1wuxrE.jpg)
I loved the result—the pancakes turned out very fluffy, so the proportions of these ingredients were just right. It was a pretty light breakfast, and I highly recommend this recipe. All that was left was to add a little butter and some grated cheese, though you can serve them with whatever toppings you prefer. *** ***
## Versión en Español

> Hoy decidí preparar unas panquecas al estilo tradicional, querían que quedaran muy esponjosas, así que compré una harina de trigo leudante. Además agregué a la preparación leche y huevo, lo que ayudó a mejorar el resultado de forma increíble. Les voy a mostrar cómo las hice.
![1000107154.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23z7BhtN8y7qdwy9LzTjuZVfb2DiHi2FD9RDJE7R4iBqi4s2F7giuYzjxUdw1thf5e15t.jpg)
## Ingredientes: - 150 gramos de harina de trigo leudante - 1 huevo - 3 tazas de agua - 3 cucharadas de leche en polvo - 1 cucharada de azúcar - Sal al gusto - Aceite
![1000107144.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23wC3RTnfVQ88weEE5qDJp5gvGV7mZaHQhQ1yntD7aS9iS3b4vpqpfkAPqhPsdMMp7CnK.jpg)
## Preparación: En un envase coloqué el agua con la sal y agregué la harina de trigo, removí muy bien para unir los ingredientes. Luego añadí la leche y continúe mezclando. Vertí el azúcar y poco después el huevo. Obtuve una mezcla homogénea.
![1000107147.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23zRrf2dnbvAS6zFSfJF1npYC4Q4DWjWREDmaeHoijxArXnQVz1ueejRX7JmHR5aBUcfq.jpg)
Aceité la superficie de un sartén y allí coloqué una porción de la mezcla, cociné a fuego bajo cinco minutos de cada lado. Repetí el proceso tres veces más.
![1000107151.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23wMj3jojUH5MGg2j31BqGVPi9Leuu3KkVnmn1qb5d5duLE43SnhnVGwph2uTqm1wuxrE.jpg)
El resultado me encantó, las panquecas quedaron muy esponjosas, por tanto, la proporción de estos ingredientes fue perfecta. El desayuno estuvo bastante ligero, recomiendo ampliamente esta receta. Solo restaba colocar un poco de mantequilla y rallar queso, aunque el acompañante puede ser el de su preferencia.   *** *** ✓Photos from my personal gallery, edited with Fotocollage. ✓Text translated with DeepL.

links.title: Diy process of a pretty Golden color  Dress I made for my friend
links.body:
# Hello Hive 



![1000187220.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/2432Ys5zL1KRA179qCMFbvScxVnq5epcCsaYxRWgp3hr32TaU2kmw9nDkMesmqq2pPHE5.jpg)


A beautiful new morning to us all, I hope that we have had a peace and restful night. 

![1000187159.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23wMgtqny4U54Wy6pBsStk3pFk5MRTxRWRKSePgnijURuq2BRyiNp3NLJNVfhnXdaupEh.jpg)


Today I want to share with the community how I made this beautiful golden color dress for my friend.
Due to the high cost of tailoring services people are often looking for a shorter means to get their outfits sewn and knowing fully well that I am a seamstress she decided to come along with some fabrics for me to sow for her while she is on a a 2days visit to spend the weekend with me. This is one of the two outfits I will be sewing for her. 

![1000187173.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23wX9hofRfKUetiiSfrhDeh3QrSRdUg56hzEMLWYsJGqRRcnZG5CYu1ktLcBhjutEPiVg.jpg)





Whenever people come visiting they get new clothes from me as gifts since that is so so easy for me to achieve. It is either I purchase new fabrics and sew for them is the relationship between us is a very close one but  in instances where I don't the money to purchase new fabrics to sew for them, they come along with their fabrics. This way I can save them of the money needed to sew their outfits with other seamstresses. The cost of the services for sewing a single outfit now ranges from $3 and above depending on design.


![1000187110.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23zGj6SLYDKiPfVz4BXrKYP1VzHik9r1omK3CeW5mmHLnPkHrfUc3gPbivmWRCHCXaZ2Q.jpg)



To cut the fabrics I first of all studied the fabric and realized that it within the golden color of the fabrics it had some big round balls of brown and white color.


![1000187122.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23x1DEMSxq34PxVzTJpCTm8cCr3znoQGYMfQQDgjyf9xTzU8AeRZL8683BPMzH6NYUbuZ.jpg)



 
We can't cut the fabric in a distorted manner so i folded it in a way that the big round balls might fall into the middle of the design. 

![1000187131.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23uFbvqcsrMH7oUVXf5RqFCuJ9zmNYa79Ue7f6ZfPndjGMq5SBL2FrSjMajCeJQ3Ta8JT.jpg)


From there I cut out the front block leaving some allowances in between to create a flap.
Next I cut out the back bodice in a similar fashion with the zipper allowances 


![1000187137.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/242rwdGAtqk1ykGZzc2GJseMmZJBYujRiWkypkV9uyqcPPvgGtaeVMDx6G2myYwCfuxKu.jpg)


Then went ahead to create the flap. Picked some fitting straight darts to give the dress her shape and body contour 

![1000187140.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23zSC5W3LLbu9MojECT1mk5GsQBS42jKVBfMRgY5oNpaFjirs7zixJCicYrEnVrp5JmLs.jpg)
 
Then come back to cut out the necklines.
I turned the necklines with bias strip and joined the shoulder lines 

![1000187149.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23wgRu5JWFk3DoJ5E4kwEKzhRKBvBJqgFQqhskrLenwJR5agdnZZXmvuRLvDrn5ozmbfY.jpg)

----

![1000187169.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23viA5MtsZvbcF1Y9pwBFRXezRUScYNPQXyfFkkJKDxRYvGpMKBoykezm8k4saWDSibQm.jpg)




Next I created some pleats at the lower end of the fabric and then moved on to fix the sleeves.


![1000187160.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23vi1YQu68gXyPaaJy4h7krbahD8tyhcye2LEr5xp5ytNyPaX2mt8vuFBVwGH26UanwuU.jpg)


Unto the sleeves I inserted this elastic band and then the zipper was next. 


![1000187164.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23uR4yGGWfq1MvUizN2PWTkxvMrVNBHBVQmnd9K7qT5iJqGHXxWURR9qknZmFZw1bA1ni.jpg)

![1000187156.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/Eou9jFnM8gWacvTdNYPc143zyyFauJPYbA7af4Bgwws6sAXej33XGN9h1dhENC2AEoE.jpg)



I had cut some gathered sleeves before but since the fabric wasn't enough I couldn't achieve what I wanted with the sleeve 


![1000187166.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23z7QabtpsamLAErGwFAxc6QeHUecYDtXPSP48vqBcTk8qaPeKHTEeGZCrtWKhBuGktBV.jpg)

----

![1000187146.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23w31sTJuXrXYSNtR8fHpnw6E6sRudgXUJUNajs1ur557wEP1hn5pyBFBXcRtRjT5oTZS.jpg)



Having done all this processes, I have it a simple ironing and here is how it looks on her.

![1000187172.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23xKxJv3LNAWvH4Eg47oFHQSQjXkZsmkS3eK6JMfCbnt6ETR1JEFiq3e5fWdEPLW5WHit.jpg)

That's here checking out the dress in my workspace. The circle I had wished to keep it centralized didn't happen as the fabric keeps drifting while I was cutting the cloth. But I'm glad that she didn't complain much about the dress but loved the final outcome.

body.title: Jueves de TBT: el cumpleaños de Génesis y tiempos de universidad [ENG/ESP]
body.body:
>Greetings to everyone in the Top Family community. Today I’m joining you here to share another TBT Thursday with you. I’ll include the link to the contest at the end of this post. With that said, let’s get started.

\n\n

>This time, it’s a bittersweet memory. Back in 2021, when my classmates and I were in our ninth semester of college and had to take a course (which, as they say), it’s one of those courses that show you whether or not you’re cut out to be a teacher. Or rather, whether you’re capable of staying firm and clear-headed in the face of certain situations that might arise in your day-to-day work. That can mean a lot to any student nearing the end of their studies. Especially in those years when there were hardly any students, no teachers, and no hope for those pursuing a degree. I say this because it wasn’t just the sense of the course’s (unspoken) demands and rigor, but also the different methods our professor used to keep us grounded.

\n\n

>It was a time that, despite everything, I always found particularly interesting, and I tried to enjoy every moment we had together. One of those moments was the birthday of one of our classmates and friends, Genesis. That day she was presenting a project to be evaluated by the professor, and fortunately, she did very well. I laughed a lot that day because she and some other classmates had us do some very funny activities. That’s why we’re all wet, covered in dirt, and a little disheveled. We sang “Happy Birthday,” and we wrapped things up in the afternoon. This is a lovely memory from college. Without further ado, thank you so much for stopping by.

\n\n

>Saludos a todos en la comunidad de Top Family. El día de hoy me uno por aquí para compartir con ustedes un nuevo jueves de TBT. Estaré dejando el enlace del concurso al final de esta publicación. Dicho esto, comencemos.

\n\n>

>En esta ocasión se trata de un recuerdo agridulce. Por allá en el año 2021 cuando mis compañeros de estudios y yo nos encontrábamos cursando el noveno semestre de la carrera y debíamos ver una materia (que cómo quién dice), es de aquellas materias que te demuestran si eres bueno o no para ser docente. O más bien, si eres capaz de mantener la firmeza y la lucidez frente a algunas situaciones que se pueden presentar en el día a día del trabajo. Eso puede significar bastante para cualquier estudiante que este llegando al final de sus estudios. Sobre todo en aquellos años dónde casi no había estudiantes, ni docente, ni una esperanza para aquel que estuviera sacando una carrera. Lo digo porque no solo estaba la sensación de la exigencia y rigor (tácito) de la materia, si no también por los diferentes métodos con los cuales nuestra profesora nos hacía sentar los pies sobre la tierra.

\n\n>

>Fue una época que a pesar de todo, a mí siempre me pareció particularmente interesante e intente disfrutar cada momento que tuvimos juntos. Uno de esos momentos fue el cumpleaños de una de nuestras compañeras y amiga, Génesis. Ese día ella estaba presentando un trabajo para ser evaluada por la profe y afortunadamente, lo hizo muy bien. Ese día me reí mucho porque ella y otras compañeras nos hicieron hacer unas actividades muy cómicas. Por eso estamos todos mojados, llenos de tierra y un poco desprolijos. Se canto el cumpleaños y ya finalizamos en la tarde. Este es un recuerdo bonito de la universidad. Sin más que decir, muchísimas gracias por pasar por aquí.

body.title: Skewers Rolled Eggs
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRcJTQfAKNuDCtWCEsuaVnqKghXTirLTpYUCseftqsHRH/1775790937958.png)

Hi bloggers and food lovers, today I’m really excited to make a street food snack that I often see. Actually, I rarely buy it when I’m out, but since I was curious, I decided to make it myself—it’s called rolled eggs. This snack is basically an omelet made fun by rolling it around a skewer like satay. The ingredients are also very very simple. Okay, let’s get started

**Ingredients:** 

- 2 eggs
- 50 ml water
- a pinch of salt
- a pinch of bouillon powder
- skewers
- cooking oil
- sauce

**Steps:**

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUaDbsHewpNcZd3qd1iijfTMoLnZrwZiJo4CHTTvyo3kG/1775791110308.jpg)

- Crack the eggs and pour them into a bowl

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdP3787FdZxvKsVKTpoXM9ucsXsMR5MSU1AnokeoAzZv6/1775791088459.jpg)

- Add water 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd7t18symMbKtc16NryRefbRpWHL4RYkwKiv7asKKAQGL/1775791130029.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSUAM37Qqr3EciVMuCFGrejFpYnonifkuDvPbUaKy5qCi/1775791130392.jpg)

- Add salt and bouillon powder

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdwN8VpQofaixudZPHxczYSE6TsNeGQ4KFUbV2RA7LqBH/1775791147277.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVEx6zx9fC4cXTWXUNCLKpqC8S9rLS8TBikxkaVrm9FEk/1775791147505.jpg)

- Stir until well combined

- Heat the oil in a pan

- Once hot, reduce the heat

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcLxPpxfYoeuoqteYYvtjn6B8tdg8j2vHabmCEP47NbtS/1775791182945.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVMkrkpTwe4A6SRQMwK7jYafSUoEc9sRAkx36YVJZzwra/1775791183297.jpg)

- Pour 2 tbsp of the beaten egg mixture into the hot oil

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbLGjFw2PwbNasYkaFPQdP7JxPijq9SEGcMCBX8PWt1Xg/1775791272100.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUjEit95c1xZt6sLAo29Qw14cAzHmTvwQpaPp9RdFHfrm/1775791272497.jpg)

- Take a skewer and immediately roll the egg

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeQjLBBJ14ZVV2b53fQLHNSke9MV4kNg7GCrV8oZpYUMi/1775791272885.jpg)

- Cook briefly until done, then remove and drain

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdyryeCqJFNoUMmZqWjrp91ePwCPRNh5SCjSGca5f5JCa/1775791329009.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfTGYySAQscg962xKqWXDVxqC65M9ZLfi7Umb7PFScnDh/1775791329266.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdEaNB2TjMuCAmtzAoyos2auh4w2jHxX7iFW24qMvzhNH/1775791329556.jpg)

- Repeat until all the egg mixture is used up

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWvUbayGyCwokcs4d88ceAfJ6p3CywPJTqLYz17YDCCHi/1775791358071.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYWguNmVT9QaVQzPNgGBHTq88Ah1TWgSnkpnMU4d1ph7v/1775791358457.jpg)

- Serve on a plate with your favorite sauce

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSupVUnx4kx39TdCUrNavMpoM2JZSHaR6z1cY3Kc1uW59/1775791392196.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmausPwTvYsnjukZsM9KYxjqnTEwBf9MJioV1k8GJMWJD8/1775791392613.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmex1MELCwawy2S7GfybcnFYDRg3PbLNakwqjVgMkenTTS/1775791393237.jpg)

- The skewers rolled eggs are ready to eat

body.title: The need for nutritious food for students' brain development
body.body:
Assalamu Alaikum. How are you students and parents? I hope that by the grace of God, you are all well and healthy., Alhamdulillah, by the grace of God, I am also well. I pray to God that we are always well. 

Today I want to share a post with you to ensure the nutrition of students. Basically, we all want a student to be physically and mentally healthy. His strong brain should be interested in reading and he can constantly prove his creativity. For this, students definitely need nutrition.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmW1mqxxH862zedg1qTtzb5KARPiVXDaSMaYEsgjPJkfKm/pexels-vanessa-loring-5083239.jpg 


[Source](https://www.pexels.com/photo/a-child-eating-fresh-fruits-5083239/)



There are many parents among us who only feed their children processed milk after the birth of their child. This is a big mistake. Processed milk can be very harmful to the child. Because it contains chemicals and is not beneficial for the child's health. 

The most beneficial thing for the child is mother's breast milk. Mother's breast milk will last for six months. If mother's breast milk is not available, then an alternative can be found in that case. But first, the mother must be sure about this and keep trying. 

Then, when the child is over 6 months old, he should be fed light and thin food. One of the natural foods is orange juice, grapes, various fruits and dairy products. All those products or foods that are easily digested are very suitable for the child. Many types of baby food are available in our country. However, all these foods are responsible for the deterioration of the health of our children. There are many families who provide delicious food for the child from different shops. Especially children like to eat food like chips and chanachur.  Since children like it, our parents prefer food like chips and snacks for their children. But this is completely wrong. 

Vitamin-rich food must be provided for the child. The best list of these includes milk, eggs, meat, etc. Moreover, green vegetables help in the brain development of the child. Therefore, the child should be given fish, meat, milk, eggs, green vegetables along with normal food.



 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmRKxEmZvhoia57GCVgzpyG2dJND3yz6T3LQ6hDRyBUjjV/pexels-zeeshan-khan-746835307-18634957.jpg 


[Source](https://www.pexels.com/photo/smiling-boy-and-girls-with-backpacks-on-sidewalk-18634957/)



We all want a child to have good health. If a child is not healthy and is not mentally and physically strong, then a child will fail to continue his/her educational activities. body.title: 🌸 Ladies of Hive Contest #283: Hobbies I admire and would like to do [ES/EN]
body.body:
>
![1000027003.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erigm/48RsXaJdnGZqqDNsWkWiKFNELJwcqs5PwPw7bYefuyEdLu9FLNRTYkMjSrSHf7HjYd.jpg) Portada hecha en Canva
¡Hola queridas Damas de Hive! Hoy me paso por acá para participar de las preguntas de la semana de la mano de @merit.ahama. En esta ocasión me centraré en la segunda pregunta acerca de los hobbys. ##### ***Hobby Crush: la mayoría de nosotros tenemos pasatiempos a los que dedicamos poco o más tiempo, pero hay pasatiempos que admiramos que otros hacen. ¿Cuál es ese pasatiempo que te gustaría poder hacer también para divertirte y por qué no puedes adoptarlo en tu tiempo libre?*** Uh, tengo muchísimos pasatiempos que admiro que hacen los demás. Uno de ellos es tejer a crochet, hice algunas pocas creaciones en algún momento y por eso creo que no se me daría tan mal, no más me falta práctica, pero también es cierto que no le dedico el tiempo necesario. Un poco es por vergüenza, acá se tiende mucho a querer monetizar cualquier actividad que uno haga y la verdad es que me gustaría realizarlo como un hobby, del cual disfrute y sea divertido para pasar el tiempo. Así como también amo leer. Pero bueno, sé que tendría esa presión extra de que si hago algo lindo me digan que debería hacer más para vender y eso es motivo suficiente para no querer hacerlo, aunque sí me gustaría seguir explorando. Las veces que tejí algunos diseños de amigurumis siguiendo patrones en internet me quedaron bastantes decentes, pero los hice a escondidas. Bueno, en algún momento dejaré de esconderme y voy a realizarlos porque me gustan. Ahora que lo escribo se me hace una excusa tonta, pero es lo que soy.
![1000008114.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erigm/Eos2M4Jc21UwPhRMfjfB5pSbHv2cVE8ZfBc55kHAa1WgLWFwj1WW4zRrAh4nvENx2dW.jpg)
Otro pasatiempo que admiro y me encantaría aprender es la costura, pero ahí el impedimento es no tener una máquina de coser. Pero es algo que me gustaría, así que tal vez me compré alguna en cuanto lo decida. Estaría genial arreglarme mi propia ropa o hacer algunos diseños por mi cuenta con las telas que me gusten. Como verán, me gustan las manualidades en general, en el mismo orden también entran pintar, dibujar y demás cuestiones que intento realizar cuando tengo algún tiempo libre y ganas de desconectar un rato de las pantallas.
![Separador flores.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erigm/23wgoZopiHNX1ebGWL5athK3UidSkfNjaiHUQLxsXxzCByxighLnHXwMdgiwbR6HWMpZn.png)
  Bueno amigos, hasta acá mi respuesta a esta pregunta. Espero que les haya gustado y los invitó a participar a todos los que me lean. Gracias por llegar hasta acá y apoyar mi contenido. ¡Hasta la próxima!
![Separador flores.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erigm/23wgoZopiHNX1ebGWL5athK3UidSkfNjaiHUQLxsXxzCByxighLnHXwMdgiwbR6HWMpZn.png)
![1000027004.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erigm/48SMTCaAi1nM4NFPbw4f43iyJmFLL6uwuQuGM1ytDjT7krZ1DBDKsHpwc37BU5v3Jf.jpg) Cover made in Canva
Hello, dear Ladies of Hive! I’m stopping by today to take part in this week’s questions from @merit.ahama. This time, I’ll be focusing on the second question about hobbies. ##### ***Hobby Crush: Most of us have hobbies we spend little or more time doing, but there are hobbies we admire others do. What is that one hobby you wish you could do for fun, too, and why can't you adopt it for your free time?*** Uh, there are so many hobbies that I admire when other people do them. One of them is crocheting; I made a few things at one point, so I don’t think I’d be too bad at it—I just need more practice. But it’s also true that I don’t dedicate enough time to it. Part of it is because I’m shy—here, there’s a strong tendency to want to monetize any activity you do, and the truth is that I’d like to do it as a hobby, something I enjoy and find fun to pass the time. Just like I love reading. But anyway, I know I’d have that extra pressure that if I make something nice, people would tell me I should make more to sell, and that’s reason enough not to want to do it, even though I’d still like to keep exploring it. The times I’ve crocheted some amigurumi designs following patterns online, they turned out pretty decent, but I did them in secret. Well, at some point I’ll stop hiding and I’ll make them because I like them. Now that I’m writing this, it seems like a silly excuse, but that’s just who I am.
![1000008114.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erigm/Eos2M4Jc21UwPhRMfjfB5pSbHv2cVE8ZfBc55kHAa1WgLWFwj1WW4zRrAh4nvENx2dW.jpg)
Another hobby I admire and would love to learn is sewing, but the problem is that I don’t have a sewing machine. Still, it’s something I’d really like to do, so maybe I’ll buy one as soon as I make up my mind. It would be great to alter my own clothes or create my own designs using fabrics I like. As you can see, I like crafts in general; that also includes painting, drawing, and other things I try to do when I have some free time and want to disconnect from screens for a while.
![Separador flores.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erigm/23wgoZopiHNX1ebGWL5athK3UidSkfNjaiHUQLxsXxzCByxighLnHXwMdgiwbR6HWMpZn.png)
Well, friends, that wraps up my answer to this question. I hope you enjoyed it, and I invite everyone reading this to join in. Thanks for sticking with me and supporting my content. See you next time!
![Separador flores.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erigm/23wgoZopiHNX1ebGWL5athK3UidSkfNjaiHUQLxsXxzCByxighLnHXwMdgiwbR6HWMpZn.png)

title.body:
![l8MGix3yLDfMudkx_1002637801.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/veronicamartinc/images/l8MGix3yLDfMudkx_1002637801/l8MGix3yLDfMudkx_1002637801.webp) ![VPCRppNPh72tv6dt_1002637741.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/veronicamartinc/images/VPCRppNPh72tv6dt_1002637741/VPCRppNPh72tv6dt_1002637741.webp) ![DP1tQN8NC4F6fhCQ_1002637686.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/veronicamartinc/images/DP1tQN8NC4F6fhCQ_1002637686/DP1tQN8NC4F6fhCQ_1002637686.webp) ![dAxLl7Qk6EvqbjKs_1002637689.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/veronicamartinc/images/dAxLl7Qk6EvqbjKs_1002637689/dAxLl7Qk6EvqbjKs_1002637689.webp) ![56VScSJ75h4WUW3T_1002637744.jpg](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/veronicamartinc/images/56VScSJ75h4WUW3T_1002637744/56VScSJ75h4WUW3T_1002637744.webp) ![AuslCDUXpwZfO9Ob_1002637793.jpg](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/veronicamartinc/images/AuslCDUXpwZfO9Ob_1002637793/AuslCDUXpwZfO9Ob_1002637793.webp)
​¡Hola, amigos! ¿Qué tal? ¿Cómo están? Hoy estoy superfeliz y recargada con una energía muy bonita. Tuvimos un concierto al que, aunque no participé directamente, tuve la oportunidad de asistir para celebrar el Día Nacional de nuestro instrumento: el cuatro.
Hi, everyone! How are you? How’s it going? Today I’m super happy and feeling full of positive energy. We had a concert—and even though I didn’t perform myself, I got to attend to celebrate the National Day of our instrument: the cuatro.
​A lo largo de toda mi ciudad, en cada uno de los municipios, se realizaron conciertos con la participación del programa Simón Bolívar, que lleva la música a las escuelas, y el programa Alma Llanera, donde se imparten estas clases.
Throughout my city, in every municipality, concerts were held with the participation of the Simón Bolívar program, which brings music to schools, and the Alma Llanera program, which offers these classes.
​Ver a tantos niños tocando el mismo instrumento en el que me he formado por años me llena el corazón y me pone la piel de gallina. Cada vez que voy a un concierto así, la energía que se siente es extraordinaria. No sé si es porque amo lo que hago y amo la música, pero ser parte de ella cada día es lo que más me llena.
Seeing so many children playing the same instrument I’ve been learning for years fills my heart and gives me goosebumps. Every time I go to a concert like this, the energy in the air is extraordinary. I don’t know if it’s because I love what I do and I love music, but being a part of it every day is what fulfills me the most.

title.title: Freewrite - “Incapable of Doing Anything”
title.body:
LIKE FAMILY INC was down to a workforce of a couple hundred AI agents and two human employees and everything was going really, really well. 

It started with a general restructuring in keeping with current industry best practices etc. The first round of layoffs had been a depressing, tearful affair. The last rounds had been far less stressful for the new all AI HR department since they hadn't known any of the people they were firing and were incapable of feeling stress anyway.

The CEO was confused as to who authorized his own firing. He had been behind the push for “as close to full automation as legally possible” but obviously that mandate wasn't meant to include him! However by then the board of directors were all artificial intelligences as well so there wasn't much he could do.

Hope and Larry were the last two humans. Larry had passed away the previous week (a fact that someone with working nostrils would eventually figure out while walking past his apartment).

That left Hope. Sure, her co-workers mostly ignored her and believed her to be literally incapable of doing anything (even when her suggestions repeatedly turned out to be correct). But she remained the only reason they could legally claim to be a *hybrid human/AI organization*. 

If they were capable of shock that's probably what they would feel when they learned she was about to quit.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd3hqBYH2YJm3Widt2evS7NTVp69bdZkZ5rh2uPN3c4hS/1775790343558.jpg)

title.title: The way people walk [Eng/Esp]
title.body:
>

Greetings, dear friends in the community and photography enthusiasts. It’s been a couple of days since I last stopped by, and I’m here to share some street photos. As always, these are the kinds of photos where I try to capture the spontaneity of the streets, focusing on the people going about their daily lives, so, without further ado, I hope you enjoy them.

Saludos, queridos amigos de la comunidad y amantes de la fotografía. Hace un par de días que no me pasaba por aquí y estoy para compartir algunas fotografías callejeras. Como siempre, este es un tipo de fotografías donde intento capturar la espontaneidad de las calles, tomando como protagonistas a las personas que van de un lugar a otro, así que, sin más que agregar, espero que las disfruten.


https://images.ecency.com/DQmVGGUjudmaa2zLUsBTvt3Ba3E3jP6XP41VK9vDdzaMSv3/dsc08387.jpg

https://images.ecency.com/DQmSQaoG7QaccwSjkFtYyqMRy3J3siA6xNBTAm7u8KD9DUU/dsc08396.jpg

https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ3bPmHgMsNCRTWypnspULnQpCcnGWKumwVqXb3WwY1Zi/dsc08415.jpg

>

When I take photos on the street, I try to look in all directions, because there’s always something happening at any given moment, and since you can’t possibly capture everything, observing is a good way to decide what’s really worth photographing, whether it’s someone walking by or watching them pause for a couple of seconds before crossing the street.

Cuando hago fotografías en las calles, intento mirar en todas las direcciones, porque siempre hay algo ocurriendo en cualquier momento y, como no tienes la forma de capturar todo, la idea de observar es una buena forma de intentar decidir lo que realmente vale la pena fotografiar, ya sea desde una persona caminando o el observar cómo se detienen por un par de segundos antes de cruzar la calle.


https://images.ecency.com/DQmVv4xsF5JQuSHKf9h8YzjzzhzutfkvGxjkVZkUGzgR16e/dsc08403.jpg

https://images.ecency.com/DQmUCknWQLnSdfzFMZ8HffGqbpjL2LP4EZXutoEqVxm8nRu/dsc08406.jpg

https://images.ecency.com/DQmR8qjsTdLJx71aSuXJ6HTw6WB55NX7xHjFWBKc3523DC4/dsc08410.jpg

>

For these photographs, my style is always based on viewing the scene as if it were a movie scene, those moments that allow for transitions in the story. Therefore, it’s interesting to seek out the dynamics of a moment that might go unnoticed by others, but which, when you pay attention, undoubtedly captures that passion for spontaneity.

Para estas fotografías, mi estilo siempre se basa en una manera de verlo como si fuese una escena de cine, esos momentos que permiten hacer transiciones en las historias; por ende, es interesante buscar esa dinámica de un momento que pueda pasar desapercibido para los demás, pero al prestar atención captura sin duda esa pasión por la espontaneidad.


https://images.ecency.com/DQma1UaBVRVb4doMA2NvXsfjZ3DvU6GzZxhzLfcwKJTTM7n/dsc08385.jpg

https://images.ecency.com/DQmRFfmetPcHHD8LqMWBwAE3nsyhWfedRZyBexW1749Ptcd/dsc08400.jpg

https://images.ecency.com/DQmb2mQdxy4TWz9GBoFx3FWr5BMnDhJ7bSz2DdJPdjfUVRk/dsc08413.jpg

>

That's all for today's post; I hope you all have a great day and are doing well. See you next time, dear friends in the community!

Hasta aquí la publicación; deseo que todos tengan un excelente día y que se encuentren genial. ¡Hasta la próxima, queridos amigos de la comunidad!

/>

title.title: 回忆录＆陪婆婆过生日
title.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![QPwED34SA7Pn6QB4_mmexport1775790034752.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/jingjing1616/images/QPwED34SA7Pn6QB4_mmexport1775790034752/QPwED34SA7Pn6QB4_mmexport1775790034752.webp)
![8nsNxbW3XR92bZdK_mmexport1775790032592.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/jingjing1616/images/8nsNxbW3XR92bZdK_mmexport1775790032592/8nsNxbW3XR92bZdK_mmexport1775790032592.webp)
![i5zfhyThQBvFaY3Z_mmexport1775790030597.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/jingjing1616/images/i5zfhyThQBvFaY3Z_mmexport1775790030597/i5zfhyThQBvFaY3Z_mmexport1775790030597.webp)
![iDJvY5CCL7u57a02_mmexport1775790037057.jpg](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/jingjing1616/images/iDJvY5CCL7u57a02_mmexport1775790037057/iDJvY5CCL7u57a02_mmexport1775790037057.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

年前的时候刚好遇到婆婆的生日，刚好她想躲亲戚串门，也正好恰逢周末，也刚好遇到丑丑要出差一周，婆婆过完生丑丑就出差，所以就叫婆婆来成都了，真的是什么都刚刚好。


带婆婆简单的出去吃了个饭，每次都吃火锅又觉得没意思，所以这次带婆婆去吃的串串，仪式感了一下，环境挺好的，菜品也丰富新鲜还送了小甜水，就这体验感确实可以加分，婆婆吃的还挺高兴的。

然后我们早早的给婆婆定了一个小蛋糕，等吃完饭我们就去蛋糕店提回去，因为大家对蛋糕都不是特别爱，但是生日的仪式感又要有，所以就定一个小小的，这样既可以美也可以吃，哈哈哈哈。

吃完饭我们就提着小蛋糕散步回去，也可以顺便消消食，到家也不晚，我们就开启了搞生日仪式了，把婆婆还整得怪不好意思的，毕竟她们那个年代的人表达撒的都比较含蓄，加上又是小年轻玩儿的，有点不知所措，哈哈哈。

拍照，录像，许愿，婆婆只管配合，我们进行安排指挥摆拍，搞定，吃蛋糕咯，果然蛋糕就是好看，吃我和丑丑真的就不爱。其实婆婆对甜品也一般，嘴巴虽然说着不爱这仪式感，但是她内心应该是高兴的。

title.title: 如度假一般的培训
title.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![FKBfPauajIwbn3At_IMG_8913.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/acactus1013/images/FKBfPauajIwbn3At_IMG_8913/FKBfPauajIwbn3At_IMG_8913.webp)
![yoXiLpgpRX6iwEnW_IMG_8928.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/acactus1013/images/yoXiLpgpRX6iwEnW_IMG_8928/yoXiLpgpRX6iwEnW_IMG_8928.webp)

![N2XRKeFSOaLWrZPG_IMG_8919.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/acactus1013/images/N2XRKeFSOaLWrZPG_IMG_8919/N2XRKeFSOaLWrZPG_IMG_8919.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>


其实现在但凡说起外出培训学习，像我一样对此倍感头疼的人不在少数。拿我们学校的规定来说，外出培训等于在繁忙的工作中再去给自己加码，第一，必须将所有课程提前调整妥当，才能顺利出去，课是一节不少的上，调课还相当麻烦，二是外出培训归来后，还要撰写学习报告，进行交流分享，不管是不是优质的学习内容，必须作报告，这些繁琐的要求让我们对外出培训失去了兴趣。


此次被动前往青神参加培训，居然让我收获了一番全新的体会。原来外出学习，也能如同此前的乐山培训之旅一般，全程轻松惬意，仿若度假。

在我心里，出去培训玩得最尽兴的一次绝对是2016年，整整十年前，我们组去乐山参加培训，曾经同行的人如今大都退居二线了，我们听了第一节课，就觉得太高深，不适合我们的学情，干脆跑去逛公园，接下来的两天在乐山这座宝藏城市各种吃喝玩乐，那时候我刚参加工作两年，第一次体会培训的福利，我还因为吃太撑，差点病了😂

再说到后来的很多次培训，管理越来越严格，全程都要坐那儿听完整个无聊的讲座，培训地点也是从成都乐山这样的大城市变成周边小县城，周边娱乐也少得可怜，这次跟着黄组长一同学习，我本以无法放松，可没想到她这次很佛系，全程没有强制要求我们必须参会听课，自己也跑去和同学逛操场去了。

培训第一天，我们进场听了不到一个小时，几个想娱乐的同事便结伴离开去打麻将，当晚恰逢下雨，没能去看萤火虫，大家便打了两场麻将，到了第二天，我们睡了个自然醒的懒觉，在酒店吃完早餐后，沿着马路悠闲逛街，去学校签到后，又一起出来闲逛，等到十一点多司机师傅前来接，才收拾返程。


如此培训，更像是繁忙工作外的充电，人需要放松，不是长期在高压环境下连轴转，若是外出能听到言之有物的讲座，真正学到实用的知识，自然是再好不过。只可惜当下多数培训课程都枯燥无味，既然如此，能把这样的外出培训，当作一场短暂的外出旅行，忙里偷闲享受片刻轻松，也不失为一件幸事。

title.title: Rafael Cadenas se dice y nos dice
title.body:
Ayer, 8 de abril, el mayor poeta vivo de Venezuela, [Rafael Cadenas](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rafael_Cadenas), arribó a sus 96 años (nació en Barquisimeto, Estado Lara, en 1930). Autor de una obra poética que nos acompaña desde nuestra juventud, es un escritor poseedor de una sobria y radical po(ética), como me ha gustado decir de su obra. Gracias a su perseverancia e integridad frente al lenguaje, la poesía y la realidad, se ha convertido en una referencia obligada para la vida, escritura y reflexión de muchos, en nuestro país y fuera de él. Por ello ha sido reconocido, entre otros relevantes galardones, con el más alto premio de las letras hispanas, el Premio Cervantes, en 2022.
![Rafael Cadenas 5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josemalavem/EoCi2TanGSKmMM7kbRJYx7UgUxgGm4Uq3CimQCcpbRScQDaNwjr5DJZTQoHq78jjQbx.jpg)
[Fuente]( https://elestimulo.com/cultura/2018-07-13/rafael-cadenas-recuerda-a-su-esposa-en-un-sentido-homenaje-en-caracas/)

Como decía, he seguido su obra y ejemplo de vida desde hace muchos años, en trabajos académicos (trabajos de ascenso universitario y de postgrado), pero también en ensayos diversos y ejercicios poéticos, publicados en esta plataforma y en la anterior. Dejaré al final una lista de sus referencias, para los que estén interesados. Habiendo abordado muchos filones de su producción literaria, quiero en este post dedicarme a una parte de esa aguzante y problematizadora zona de su obra, la que ha cobrado más fuerza en los últimos años. Me refiero a esos brevísimos textos que él ha identificado con la palabra Dichos. La primera edición como libro de esa línea de escritura, de indudable interrelación con sus poemas y ensayos, es de 1992, bajo precisamente ese título: Dichos, publicado como pequeño libro por la editorial independiente yaracuyana “La Oruga Luminosa”. Pero posteriormente ha seguido publicando, de modo esporádico en papeles literarios u otros medios, una continuación de ese ejercicio del pensamiento. Se trata, como bien lo han indicado estudiosos como José Balza, Joaquín Marta Sosa y Aníbal Rodríguez Silva, de una escritura que se puede llamar aforística, en la mejor tradición occidental desde Heráclito, por ejemplo, pero abriendo una hendija que le da singularidad. Como bien expresó, Aníbal Rodríguez: “Con los Dichos los géneros literarios desaparecen y se establece una cercanía entre el pensar y el poetizar.”
![Dichos.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josemalavem/23u5bUHqHmH6wSez1gVYyZC4sxYoFfPq8dxDomazoFtcehitnse8d34rZV1EmimBi7gRB.png)
[Fuente](https://ulises-itaca.blogspot.com/2018/07/dichos.html)

Como es propio del aforismo, también en Dichos nos encontramos con textos concisos, incisivos, singulares, sorpresivos, abiertos a la interpretación, pero también cercanos al silogismo, y, por lo tanto, irónicos, “urticantes” (al decir de Balza), incluso próximos al humor negro. En ellos el poeta se pasea por temas diversos, desde el lenguaje, la poesía, la visión del mundo, la política, en suma, la vida, que, como dice Cadenas en alguna de sus “anotaciones”, es sinónimo de realidad. Ya escribí una vez sobre una parte de su primera entrega; para esta, decidí tomar algunos de los que se nombran, en la edición que utilizo (indicada en Referencias), como Nuevos dichos. En otro momento escribiré sobre “Otros dichos”. Haré un comentario final.
![100_5208.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josemalavem/Ep5nCJx9ZVKDrBZFd9ag6oW9JHdKCHz47oCehff6ebmVLoqBetMjW3kB5qbgDcPSp1W.JPG)
Corteza de árbol (Foto propia) - [Fuente]()

Estoy lejos del lugar hacia donde partí, pero a veces puedo ver que es el mismo donde siempre estoy. * Algo, lo fundamental, brilla por su ausencia. * La realidad, esa desconocida inapelable. * Protege tu sencilla camisa que aún está sobre la cuerda de los patios de la infancia. * Lo único que no termina nunca es el presente. * Esa quietud súbita no buscada es tu verdadero estado. * Siempre espero que las palabras se salven de nosotros. * Haces el poema, y él también te hace. * Saborea la andanza terrenal. * La poesía puede apuntar hacia lo innombrable sólo valiéndose de lo nombrable, pero no hay diferencia entre ambos.


Si bien me resulta un poco innecesario, casi fútil, comentar estos “dichos” de Cadenas, pues ellos deben ser interpetados por cada lector, podría decir, también concisamente, que su deslumbrante reflexión contenida en ellos nos conduce o propicia la necesaria interrogación acerca de perspectivas, generalmente poco hurgadas o cuestionadas, que ponen en relieve la ambivalencia del sentido, la reivindicación de lo elemental por raigal, la profunda riqueza del vacío (como lo advirtieron los antiguos pensadores taoístas o los místicos)… En fin, todos me gustan, y por eso los escogí del conjunto, pero, para cerrar, quisiera resaltar este: “Lo único que no termina nunca es el presente”.

![Ying y Yang.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josemalavem/AKutXjMZkeSKVEzWrbo6KbyySCTGsrAahvxnbTiTaoe2P6M9iBdAd9jC2kog27R.jpg)

Referencias: https://marisabelcontreras.wordpress.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/06/dichos.pdf Posts publicados por mí sobre Rafael Cadenas: [1](https://peakd.com/steempress/@josemalavem/rafaelcadenascitariodelcardumenn2josemalavem-1rj0bh5049); [2](https://peakd.com/hive-179291/@josemalavem/san-juan-de-la-cruz-y-la-mistica-en-la-reflexion-del-poeta-rafael-cadenas-or-st-john-of-the-cross-and-mysticism-in-the-reflecti-hive-179291); [3](https://peakd.com/hive-111516/@josemalavem/un-libro-sobre-el-camino-del-poeta-rafael-cadenas-texto-en-su-homenaje-hive-111516); [4](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@josemalavem/una-pequena-flor-para-cadenas-club-de-poesia-6-de-abril-de-2022); [5](https://peakd.com/hive-111516/@josemalavem/premio-cervantes-2022-para-el-poeta-venezolano-rafael-cadenas-hive-111516); [6](https://peakd.com/hive-111516/@josemalavem/rilke-por-rafael-cadenas-entre-poetas-hive-111516); [7](https://peakd.com/hive-111516/@josemalavem/rafael-cadenas-o-la-poesia-amante-necesitada-de-la-lengua-hive-111516); [8](https://peakd.com/hive-111516/@josemalavem/celebracion-de-la-poesia-en-homenaje-a-rafael-cadenas-or-celebration-of-poetry-in-homage-to-rafael-cadenas-hive-111516); [9](https://peakd.com/hive-111516/@celf.magazine/parafrasis-no-contestaciones-para-rafael-hive-111516).

title.title: MCGI Topic Review | Are we financially responsible to other people's needs
title.body: > https://youtu.be/aHC7rhMHhZc?si=hF3EvMQdSo583cJI The big question that we have heard from a whole lot of people is the fact that are we really financially responsible for other people's need. I have hear this question most of the time and for me I used to respond that as Christians, we are not only called to live our daily lives, we are also called to take care of others most especially when they are actually in need. For me I believe these types of responses are not forced, it is earned from love and obedience to what God said in the bible. The bible teach me and every Christians that we should actually help other people most especially when we are able to. In Galatians 6:2, it says, “Bear ye one another’s burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ.” whenever we see someone struggling, we should actually not ignore them. If God have actually blessed us with something that we can use to help, we should actually help and willing to share. For me it might be little to me but when I give it out to someone, I discovered it is not really little to them. Also, in 1 John 3:17, the Bible says, “But whoso hath this world’s good, and seeth his brother have need, and shutteth up his bowels of compassion from him, how dwelleth the love of God in him?”. Can you see that even the bible reminds us that true love is shown by our actions not really by what we say. It is not enough for us to show that we care for each other when we are not able to help one another. Now let me create the balance before I round up. That we are actually financially responsible for other people does not mean that we should not pay attention to our own responsibility. Wisdom is actually profitable to direct.

title.title: South Palms  Panglao  Where White Sands, Blue Waters and Happy Memories Are Made
title.body:
![1_20260409_162602_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rodavlas/23xpFJUCvrKkdyLCRvcrCEocoYvPQEpwb6nvt6B5x6GijggqL3dq33fETA8FaBdHzwzF9.png)


If you are looking for the perfect place to relax and have fun you have to check out South Palms Resort in Panglao Bohol. This place is honestly so beautiful it feels like a real paradise the moment you step in.




![8_20260409_162602_0007.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rodavlas/23zGeJj4am1u5GMGPcvGzhCR8MFyY5ARgZiHiQPvPfzzJj5UtzcnDkEm3r1iz4W1CjfuJ.png)



Its located right along Dumaluan Beach, and everything about it just makes you feel happy and calm right away.



![7_20260409_162602_0006.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rodavlas/23wMepmDG37wpe61HMLKZEabXVfuFHFAMcJ2aPga37gaMfd8xeaNW6bz1XHWXdheTaoyd.png)

​
First thing you will notice is the sand. Oh my goodness it is so white and super fine like soft powder under your feet. Walking around barefoot feels so nice and comfortable no sharp rocks or dirty bits anywhere.



![6_20260409_162602_0005.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rodavlas/23zGoRcBzAQse9SZKcVfHS985nmmj3Y5vbJsY1eF1a4XwYmVrsRc1n61npXDtfRpTjKAN.png)

​
The whole beach area is very clean and well taken care of. The sea water is this amazing bright blue color so clear and calm. The waves are gentle not rough at all.



![5_20260409_162602_0004.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rodavlas/23wqkpdkaGbVz1ewHYRjxvJRw26EEXM9LxxVqpTKc8DDeQ5NXb4PbLan4UCDoVQpq91go.png)

​Its perfect for swimming wading or just floating around and enjoying the cool water.



![4_20260409_162602_0003.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rodavlas/243MBDC73435M9952x2887Ey1w1AgLwtqczwmN73Qq9WymYLS4wQW6Vtof9FdF6rtEMnX.png)

​
What makes this place extra fun and pretty are all the colorful things you see everywhere. There are these cute round chairs and small tables in bright colors like yellow green blue and orange


![11_20260409_162603_0010.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rodavlas/23sJxf4RJDsfdWJUAXGZZtEdN5bMCNN8RnnSJ8QoAcuooVfXuLVui1NMQ7Zf9qZqzZcq9.png)
.
​
They look so lively and cheerful just like a big party on the beach Then there are big umbrellas too mostly bright orange and green that give plenty of shade. So even when the sun is hot you can sit comfortably and just chill.



![3_20260409_162602_0002.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rodavlas/243BifCKeRPRHwC7HLE2egyh3ZMyUXe5ERYcXBdRsRfZQTnzitaJZamT5c959qWcjfZzV.png)

​
Every corner looks so nice you will want to take pictures everywhere you go. They also have really amazing swimming pools here. The water is so clear and blue and the pools are big and nice.



![12_20260409_162603_0011.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rodavlas/23yncqjsUXs8LrLGcJkJGrvHf7dujsNXinKzf9REsFmgQ67CZacmv7Yjs5WP4qzdm2ej3.png)

​
The best part is they are built right next to the beach so you can see the sea while you are swimming in the pool. You can choose whatever you feel like that day  swim in the pool or go straight to the ocean. Its like having the best of both worlds. 




![10_20260409_162603_0009.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rodavlas/23tcCQ4sGbmeNSBPJvAMywK7Xw8CmSAwi5wNei6mpaTPeF5zQtfLfpQ6EPtwMqP82Hs4C.png)

​
There are also cute nipa huts and shaded areas all around the resort. These are made of bamboo and nipa just like traditional houses and they look so cozy and tropical. You can sit there with your family or friends eat drink and just talk for hours.



![2_20260409_162602_0001.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rodavlas/23zSDe4pjE3Zmzqh2ko2De9Gy2kMQUac3WXLTNawhEGxUc3VSmCnirhRBsMqrDWe1BK4L.png)


​
The whole place is full of tall coconut trees too. They stand tall and sway gently in the wind making the air feel cool and fresh. The smell of nature and the sea is just so nice its a big break from the pollution and noise of the city. 


![9_20260409_162603_0008.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rodavlas/23wMhCGxrP4CtzWqqgYiz5FprNmz8uCdow58LJzBZZV3HqAVqfxE3z8d6xYoiB7hCeDaF.png)

​
The resort is designed really well too. It mixes modern comfort with that natural island vibe so everything is easy and nice to use. The place is always clean the facilities are good and the staff are very friendly and helpful.



![13_20260409_162603_0012.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rodavlas/23ywwhqHp5pwKyaputyJb7Bg2rhRnUzuh1erPdT33TtN15kRtAopkrXVfdmSZZRWJCVLF.png)

​
Visiting South Palms Resort is not just a trip its an experience you will remember. It’s beautiful, peaceful and feels like home. You will leave feeling relaxed happy and already planning when to come back

title.title: A Quiet Moment with a Curious Cat
title.body:
>The black-and-white cat rests calmly on the ground, blending into the earthy surroundings. Its bright green eyes stand out sharply against its fur, giving it a mysterious yet peaceful presence. I love how the natural light highlights its face while the background softly fades away. .
![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dondononardem/23vhuam77mBXeQn8R8coEcSandeUrbY2kSX43FMPo2r1vQd6fHPvWNJNQqCq1PwL2SuCK.jpg)
![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dondononardem/23wWnLuLtPMiqD1uGZDo9Y8RNQRkMoNmVTi6NbwstzmejmnvSAP1WTFWAipVAePsK728n.jpg)
![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dondononardem/23uQhuimyHwvePL1fy3NN1THRPJvss8HuErCmbdWA6dxXbCUMKVFKVJu1ThRjJL59JNCB.jpg)

🌿 A Walk in the Sun

>In the next shots, a brown tabby cat moves through patches of sunlight and shadow. The way the light hits its fur creates a warm, almost golden glow. You can feel the quiet energy of the moment like the cat is exploring, yet completely at ease. ![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dondononardem/23yd7r6Y5c7hYSterZ9BG1X8hYCTFBMRijdi5uBv6VL8SdMGyLFbT7oEXYUZwuskN7jaq.jpg) ![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dondononardem/23zS2wdZfAfd3nxXDieEEizJdvvGW5W8nWH22TVzDKoLaEou17pXae4BpNb6dv8RipZjC.jpg) ![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dondononardem/23uFRQX3nNnHHjGCXv2iC8ded4Pg7qQ2WpwH4vEvNH5PzXbWUoNH3n7DupMYZ1UJRiufp.jpg)

🐱 A Simple Glance

>There’s something special about capturing animals in their natural environment—unposed, relaxed, and completely themselves. These photos were taken with my trusty Nikon D3100, a camera that still delivers beautiful results despite its age. ![9.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dondononardem/23wMRvFAJ84PX1X8jjZTWLZ9DZZUGoHNZwfQ4JRRs4EJozLdjMR4RdGErcWuwasMck7Xg.jpg) ![10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dondononardem/23tvcDufB137KHUpoUq1X1rR699bTT3kB2T1gxyt3dubykAbUH7U3FQhVKLy2PRgNENaF.jpg) ![11.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dondononardem/23tbq7Ar7F3TkqcVouoxQ9bWGsD5cPr85VexF6jpHWG88erGmM1nyAb4hfeCz3sEufAPZ.jpg)

📷 Camera Thoughts

>Using the Nikon D3100, I focused on: Natural lighting instead of flash Close framing to capture expression Letting the background blur slightly for depth Even with an older **NIKON D3100**, it proves that great photos come from timing and perspective—not just gear.

>Cats have a way of bringing calm into a scene. Whether resting quietly or walking with curiosity, they always create moments worth capturing. These shots remind me that sometimes the best photos come from simply observing and waiting. **Thanks for stopping by! Feel free to share your thoughts or your own pet photography tip**

title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmerAkF6Rh3vULfTWunjMpwb1Nqb4mcbkjjy5rzSbQgYVS/1775789385034.jpg)

Hello friends!
Happy  #aliveandthriving Thursday evening to you!
✨🙋🏻‍♀️✨
And, Thank You so much for your visit! 
So to pick back up on my trip to \

yesterday which was a very #aliveandthriving day - for sure,!

So back at the Refuge,
This is the back side of the Pavilion there, and you can see they planted flowers and added a bricked-in area,

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb6FwE9UawKe859mPcCdQyyHrZLzRgkKQs7KLVzVNjENT/1775789409705.jpg)

This the the front side,

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWiHwKqtzYp4uaFn1jjjtaqE9ZhYqPXtB9jWNy44vgB1x/1775789430678.jpg)

And this sign is there next to it,

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdV3daQ3kCjyZCDkzw34V2rDuF17am85zBrGAkbHiGoEX/1775789444446.jpg)

There is also some other signage there. This is because (I believe) this is a pretty good spot to get bird photos at.

This is a path that they have not improved. It goes past another old favorite area of mine that I also flew Drones from,

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYBQSNBDH4tjtNcTaw6z8Mk4mnZg5T8b5BYmbLKVpUxzq/1775789468228.jpg)

This is the Medicine Wheel, it was supposed to get quite a few improvements that have not happened - though they did cement in the walkways,

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRzZRqh4AWfdPbG7ufn2dPUBje6f69LCo25DKu1bqBVV5/1775789485252.jpg)

And back towards the Parking Lot from the other side,

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcgBTnnSCd9t6my9paNaKKPC8esGxnvCEvccvz8MeKAJz/1775789500430.jpg)

And then I went home. In the late afternoon the weather was favorable (not like today's rain) so I rode the bike over to the Park. When I rode up I saw a \

kind of bird on one of the Poles,

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc3gvMBL9UcvChoYvuH7zv6pxZ7tmt4DGBLcXiuNRf45T/1775789520537.jpg)

A little closer I saw that this is a Herring Gull,

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYB9iNNGMi8dDdHUHhCep2yGgw7eMk1G25V8B7t5WbMuu/1775789532638.jpg)
(in the Seagull family)

And then up the Channel,

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbrwKBUxePnfjCa1iwxF5jFcRuEXQRSy4gdpfddmb229M/1775789549044.jpg)

Then a normal Laughing Gull flying back towards me,

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXazTSK5XN3cWVAQaNSkKhaTZCcWbAKbjKAqTTnQHqXGQ/1775789561969.jpg)

And then also up the Channel,

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaWFWJ8eShX24cua1tEwXDodyT4a1Snvj4Dt23ChiBWiV/1775789577629.jpg)

Finally before I left I took a look over towards the Breeding Pond which is doing better than a few weeks ago,

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXc3knb6mR896pfXUA1gns4Pxb3HDtGGHZAYCmNv1NH62/1775789587650.jpg)

And that was my #aliveandthriving Wednesday, too bad it was so overcast!

I want to thank you again for your visit and I am Wishing you a Very Blessed, Happy, and Safe Friday and Weekend!
🙋🏻‍♀️🙏🏼✨🏝️🌞🏝️✨🙏🏼🙋🏻‍♀️
