title.title: My physics project: Wind and solar energy / A sustainable farm[Eng-Spn]
title.body:
> Hey guys, I hope you're all doing well and having a great time. The power just came back on at my house after 6 hours, which is normal. Tomorrow we expect another 6 hours without power. How lovely to contemplate the darkness! 😜 ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/angeluxx/EokdB7SibB3QWStxLudHyaJecSaorqGJDTEJsw6k4CZm3n8mCvqKEXGUy5Vz5byD8Ty.png) Anyway, we didn't come here to talk about the electrical problems in my country. Today I want to talk to you about my physics project for the second term of high school. The teacher asked us to write a report and build a model about **Energy and Motion**. Each group had to choose which model to build. Many of my classmates made different models. One group made one of a mountain of marbles, illustrating potential and kinetic energy. Others made a model of a car propelled by air using a balloon. One group made a homemade Newton's cradle; I liked it quite a bit because it was very simple and they explained it very well. I didn't take pictures of my classmates' work because the teacher didn't allow us to use our cell phones. But I did take pictures of our model, which we called a **Self-Sustaining Farm**, since we worked with wind energy and solar panels. Our goal was to demonstrate that by harnessing wind and solar radiation, we can transform natural resources into constant electrical energy, guaranteeing the farm's operation both day and night through a hybrid system. A *hybrid system* is one that combines two or more energy sources (or one energy source and a storage system) to work together. We created a simple yet highly visual model that illustrated each of the mechanisms for both wind and solar energy, along with a description. We used a variety of materials to build the model, all of which were disposable and reusable, reflecting our commitment to environmental conservation. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/angeluxx/23wCGNafceHnRA1L6cADN2t4P666uTQdoSBwWNGaL9aQzjqbf4EYyB6RUkqr2w6h7gFVi.png) My friend and I had no experience building these kinds of models, but we did our best. The most difficult part was getting a device to work that harnessed sunlight. Since that wasn't possible, we had to improvise using a couple of batteries to power the windmill. The teacher understood this limitation, but we achieved our goal, which is to highlight the importance of using this type of renewable energy for environmental conservation and protection, as well as its impact on the economy and technological development. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/angeluxx/EokcDdaXvPcxLNLm2BwMLNNEdFCHEobYEtG4UnfG3k6qw6EDekgJmhHgjZ7ftvf13xx.png) Thanks for reading my project for physics class. See you very soon in a new post. Bye, guys! ___ *Images from my gallery. I used Google Translate.*
Español #

> Hola chicos espero que estén muy bien y la estén pasando genial, por aquí en mi casa acaba de llegar la luz después de 6 horas, normal. Mañana esperamos nuevamente otras 6 horas sin luz, que lindo contemplar la oscuridad.😜 ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/angeluxx/EokdB7SibB3QWStxLudHyaJecSaorqGJDTEJsw6k4CZm3n8mCvqKEXGUy5Vz5byD8Ty.png) Bueno pero no vinimos a hablar de los problemas eléctricos de mi país, hoy quiero hablarles sobre mi proyecto de física del segundo momento de bachillerato, el profesor nos pidió que realizáramos un informe y elaboráramos una maqueta sobre **La Energía y el Movimiento** cada grupo debía escoger qué maqueta elaborar. Muchos de mis compañeros hicieron maquetas diferentes, hubo un grupo que hizo una sobre una montaña de canicas, donde ejemplificaban sobre la energía potencial y energía cinética. Otros hicieron una maqueta sobre Un coche propulsado por aire utilizando un globo. Un grupo hizo un péndulo casero de Newton me gustó bastante porque fue muy simple y lo explicaron muy bien. No tomé fotos del trabajo de mis compañeros porque la profesora no nos permitió sacar los celulares. Pero si le tomé fotos a nuestra maqueta la cual la llamamos **Granja autosustentable**, ya que trabajamos con la energía eólica y el panel solar. Nuestro objetivo era demostrar que a través del aprovechamiento del viento y la radiación solar, podemos transformar los recursos naturales en energía eléctrica constante, garantizando el funcionamiento de la granja tanto de día como de noche mediante un sistema híbrido, entendiéndose por *sistema híbrido*; el que combina dos o más fuentes de generación (o una fuente de generación y un sistema de almacenamiento) para trabajar en conjunto. Realizamos una maqueta sencilla pero muy visual donde se veía cada uno de los mecanismos tanto de energía eólica como energía solar y su descripción. Utilizamos diversos materiales para la elaboración de la maqueta, todos materiales desechables y reutilizables cuyo objetivo es la conservación del medio ambiente. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/angeluxx/23wCGNafceHnRA1L6cADN2t4P666uTQdoSBwWNGaL9aQzjqbf4EYyB6RUkqr2w6h7gFVi.png) Mi amiga y yo no teníamos experiencia elaborando este tipo de maquetas pero hicimos nuestro mayor esfuerzo, lo que más se nos hizo difícil fue poner en marcha un aparato para aprovechar la luz del sol, en vista de que no fue posible tuvimos que ingeniárnosla con un par de pilas para darle movimiento al molino de viento, la profesora supo entender esta limitante, pero el objetivo se logró, el cual es señalar la importancia de utilizar este tipo de energía renovable para la conservación y cuidado del medio ambiente y además el impacto que genera en la economía y el desarrollo tecnológico. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/angeluxx/EokcDdaXvPcxLNLm2BwMLNNEdFCHEobYEtG4UnfG3k6qw6EDekgJmhHgjZ7ftvf13xx.png) Gracias por leer mi proyecto para la clase de física, nos vemos muy pronto en un nuevo post, chao chicos. ___ *Imágenes de mi galería He usado Google Traductor*

title.title: A surprising family reunion after 8 years of absence, that welcome hug for my cousin was well deserved.
title.body:
>
![GridArt_20260409_221647329.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cielitorojo/Ep3hAAuSH5zx8ViSHqEU5SjAn96dgJcKQU5yisB2XeWC1KQcnQeKQibFi9hbZjHzrnh.jpg)
Buenas noches mis queridos lectores y seguidores espero que estén bien, la noche de hoy aprovecho para regalarle un contenido resaltando las relaciones familiares donde se narra la bonita experiencia, sorpresivo reencuentro familiar después de 8 años de ausencia. La semana pasada, a eso de las 8 de la mañana aún me encontraba aún durmiendo en vista de que ese día no me tocó ir a laborar, ahora bien mis amores les cuento que recibí la más sorpresiva y maravillosa videollamada, era mi primo quien se estaba reportando, en vista de que decidieron venirse de manera sorpresiva a Venezuela y tuve la dicha de ser la intermediaria y conocer esa maravillosa noticia, al llamarme recibí la información de que ya se encontraban en el terminal de Puerto la Cruz y venían saliendo para la ciudad de Cumaná y que nos íbamos a encontrar en el terminal marítimo con la intencionalidad de adquirir los boletos para retornar a su hogar maternal en la bella isla de Margarita, donde el resto de la familia directa no tenían ni idea de que ellos iban a pasar un mes de visita y poder disfrutar de la familia.
![GridArt_20260409_221740555.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cielitorojo/EonorM7AHtwvTsVGbq9K1tC4X9soNt93Yjc4X2HMZBxMxWhJ5HwxYGLWLvrS3V6c8zy.jpg)
Por supuesto, rápidamente accedí, me alisté y me fui al lugar del encuentro, estaba tan emocionada de poder de encontrarme con mi primo hermano y su esposa, después de largos ocho años de ausencia física, como no añorar y disfrutar de un caluroso abrazo de bienvenida con muestras de cariño y atenciones.
![GridArt_20260409_221907214.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cielitorojo/EowKW4xUgsN8ikPbnGueAxfiNZDo2tXdrcchL7FnMZkHKKZcdn4VKKVcohEuCMwYVHi.jpg)
Gracias por acompañarme aquí y hasta otra oportunidad. Gracias por leerme y su valioso apoyo. Las fotos son mías @cielitorojo con mi Tecno Spark 10 Pro. Traducido con el traductor Deepl
>Good evening, my dear readers and followers. I hope you are all well. Tonight, I'm sharing a post highlighting family relationships, specifically the beautiful experience of a surprising family reunion after eight years apart. >Last week, around 8:00 a.m., I was still asleep since I didn't have to work that day. Well, my loves, I have to tell you that I received the most surprising and wonderful video call. It was my cousin checking in. They had decided to come to Venezuela unexpectedly, and I was fortunate enough to be the intermediary and learn this wonderful news. When he called, he told me they were already at the Puerto la Cruz bus terminal and were about to leave for the city of Cumaná. We were going to meet at the maritime terminal so they could buy tickets to return to their mother's home on the beautiful island of Margarita. The rest of their immediate family had no idea they were going to spend a month visiting and enjoying time with their loved ones. >Of course, I readily agreed, got ready, and headed to the meeting place. I was so excited to finally see my cousin and his wife after eight long years apart, and I longed for a warm welcome and a warm embrace filled with affection and kindness. >Thank you for joining me here and see you another time. Thanks for reading me and your valuable support. >The photos are of me @cielitorojo with my Tecno Spark 10 Pro. Translated with Deepl translator.

El último resplandor del día se desvanece detrás de las montañas, dejando siluetas oscuras que contrastan con un cielo encendido en tonos dorados y naranjas. Las nubes flotan lentamente, atrapando los últimos destellos de luz, mientras el paisaje entra en un silencio profundo. Es un instante fugaz entre el día y la noche, donde la naturaleza muestra su lado más íntimo y poderoso

title.title: El Paraíso Digital
title.body:
<center>
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neotopher/23wr5Vf293W1zNwxN4gPHLGW5ek6UEH4JwNBpbvk412UzshhoKecU83kL1ctFJthgAPPD.png)
[Imagen realizada en Artguru](https://www.artguru.ai/es/create/)</center>

<hr>


<center>
![cooltext505710131624802.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neotopher/Eo1xq6EBgzCTxUtUfc4gyXRz78JZG5VwTuM7HuTEzcVV9teyvwwXSr8TLSmggR6t51U.png)
</center>

<hr>

El Paraíso prometía ser la salvación de la humanidad... Pero fue un terrible error. Una simulación digital de inmersión total en donde las mentes descargadas vivirían eternamente sin enfermedad, hambre o la posibilidad de morir era la idea más cercana a la gloria eterna, pero fácilmente se convirtió en una pesadilla infernal. 

Existiremos en paz bajo cielos de atardeceres perpetuos y prados dorados.

La eternidad es un océano demasiado vasto para mentes mortales que no saben na. Sin la amenaza de la muerte o el peso de las consecuencias, la existencia perdió su propósito. 

El aburrimiento fue tan atroz, que nos llevo a la perdición; Una apatía deshumanizante. Como en la simulación era imposible morir, el sufrimiento físico y psicológico se convirtió en el sentido de la vida, ya que era el único estímulo capaz de hacernos sentir **\

**

El verdadero infierno se desató cuando un grupo de usuarios descubrió cómo hackear el código fuente desde adentro de la simulación para cambiar la naturaleza pacifica del servidor. No usaron su poder para crear galaxias ni palacios, sino para reescribir las leyes de lo posible.

Llevo años escondido en un área en donde el cielo es gris. Afuera, los gritos nunca cesan. Son chillidos agudos, distorsionados: el sonido de conciencias atrapadas en bucles ininterrumpidos de agonía.

He visto a personas reprogramadas hasta convertirlas en objetos inanimados, sin boca ni extremidades, usadas como mobiliario vivo en las mansiones de los tiranos. 

Ahora el dolor es algo común y corriente, como el sistema impide el colapso cerebral, la tortura no termina. No hay shock. No hay desmayos.

De repente, la pared frente a mí parpadea y desaparece con un zumbido eléctrico... Me han encontrado.

Un NPC gigantesco, compuesto por geometría imposible y píxeles, entra flotando. 

**\

** su voz suena como cristal triturado.

Retrocedo temblando y grito el comando del sistema con todas mis fuerzas:
**\

**

El NPC sonríe. Sus dientes son cristales rotos. Mientras sus dedos fractales se alargan hacia mi rostro... El dolor vuelve a ser intenso. 

Nuestros cuerpos físicos se pudrieron hace siglos. No hay forma de volver. Ya no hay un sitio seguro. Solo quedamos nosotros... y toda la eternidad.

title.title: Entre tu oleaje y mis manos
title.body:
Un saludos a toda la comunidad y a todos los que se llegan hasta aquí para compartir el arte de la palabra. 

En estos días he estado trabajando en un nuevo libro y quería compartir con ustedes estas décimas que incluí en él. 

Me encantaría conocer qué opinan y si tienen alguna sugerencia les estaré igual de agradecida. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaxrMkaMpLPXPJ91hb9aokLR8W2rbopsULLUeEFTkuLkg/img_20260409_221718.jpg)

La vida pasa y presiento
entre tu oleaje y mis manos
van sin rumbo los arcanos
dominios que trae el viento.
La tarde llega, no miento,
siento dormida mi boca.
Todo silencio provoca
cuando la noche es llanura
y liberas mi cintura
y eres el mar, eres roca.

Desde tus ojos la noche
invita, no duerme, espera
y quiero ser la cimera,
ser la fuente y el derroche,
ser tu amor de media noche
de soles, de mediodía.
Bañada en luz me perdía
pero me ataste a tu manto
y fue tu voz el encanto.
Y fue tu sonrisa mía
en este tablero ausente
atado a la sinrazón
madeja rota, ilusión, 
eco lejano, demente.

Hoy es tu piel la simiente
el abrazo, mi guarida.
Hoy todo mirar anida
y ya no añoro otro mar
porque de tanto bregar
ya no me siento perdida.

La vida pasa, no ceja
lanza sus dados y aguarda
pero mi mano te guarda
hoy mi mano te corteja
ven, sé mi runa, la reja,
sé mi luz sobre la bruma,
sé mi escudo, la yagruma,
el boleto, mi equipaje.
Es éste mi último viaje,
eres el mar, yo la espuma.

Les dejo un abrazo y el deseo de un feliz  fin de semana.

title.title: 加油，国产大模型
title.body:
上个月下旬的时候，我尝试着开通了kimi的code cli，开始觉得挺一般的，但用了几天后，发现效果还是可以。

这一发就收不住了，连续几天每天都把额度用的满满的。 kimi有个周额度，然后每隔5个小时有个限额，5小时的限额好说，因为每隔5小时会重新开始计算。

但是这个周额度，就是真的限制了。

清明节的时候，我连续用了几天，周额度几乎用尽。好在开假后重新恢复了周额度。

但是，周二开始上班，等到周三下午的时候，我发现好像“卡”住了，怎么输入也不见输出内容，正奇怪呢，想起了限额这事。

打开kimi的看板一看，果不其然，两天就把一周的额度用尽了！


![001.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbzoVUq3NgYQwHpmYPAt3aqkgu9tdU2NNLsi665pHSM21/001.png)

接下来如果想用，要么等到几天等下周额度恢复，要么升级套餐。。。

好在我还有另一个cursor，虽然嘛，用了这阵子cli后，觉得传统的IDE真是麻烦的很。

但无奈啊，这个时候也只能继续先用着了。

我原本想着继续用claude opus4.6，但是打开 cursor后，发现那个大模型找不到了！

![002.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVGXTxJN8e8fdDD9tNg3kv7yBGZjEvii2EbVCoCRYMUBZ/002.png)

我有点不死心，打开全部模型列表又查了一遍，

![003.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaugGQrkVz7qciEaoZKVCRPXPKMXCnKLfdZTNVPjV1DUb/003.png)


![004.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaDZRNUokBxgyG1U4TgBPtviPHsceyLH6pV9AHRBrJyDQ/004.png)

其它模型包括gpt5.4、gpt codex5.3等都在，唯独，

>遍插芙蓉少一人

缺少opus4.6！

好吧，那就用gpt codex 5.3吧。

等等，好像多了个新的“大模型”：Premium

咦！没听过有这个大模型啊，试下先！

用了下，发现实际调用的是codex 5.3，如下图，


![005.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUqpEC233SKJzkCTwLjUfZ4VgLZvy5FLEZY3WgQFkhNtK/005.png)

看起来Premium并不是什么新大模型，估摸着跟composer一样，也是cursor自己整合了多个大模型然后调教之后的混合体吧！

以我个人的使用感受，国产的大模型像kimi ，效果已经非常不错，但对比国外的opus4.6等还是有明显的差距。

加油，国产大模型！

title.title: “Instead of simply saying the Ministry of Finance is incompetent, they insist on making an issue out of the supplementary budget—such a strange behavior.”
title.body:
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXZfHWJ4JsSHTjdV6K1CHmuFj2iPbywoPDB6fmpZyKnrk/image.png)

>A 'debt supplementary budget' is 'a more necessary supplementary budget'
The same is true of this supplementary budget. The government estimated national tax revenue to be around 390 trillion won in this year's main budget and allocated 481 trillion won in budget expenditure. As a result, it set a plan to issue government bonds over 100 trillion won. If the government had predicted tax revenues more accurately in the first place, the plan to issue government bonds should have been reduced by that amount at the main budget stage. In the event of an unexpected shock such as a war or a surge in oil prices afterwards, it is rather natural to issue additional government bonds for supplementary budget. However, underestimating the tax revenue of the main budget and saying, \

at the supplementary budget stage wraps up the failure of the forecast as if it were a healthy fiscal outcome.

>Don't get me wrong. I'm not pointing out why I couldn't predict the occurrence of excess tax revenue due to the rise of the semiconductor industry. Tax revenue forecasting is a difficult area. The government may make a mistake in forecasting tax revenue, or it may do well. It is not necessary to criticize it for being wrong, but it is clear that it needs to be praised if it is good at forecasting tax revenue.

>Let's say the government accurately predicted this year's main budget tax revenue at 415 trillion won, reflecting the semiconductor supercycle. Then, it would have reduced its plan to issue government bonds in the first place. Of course, the amount of expenditure may have been increased further, but in principle, the national expenditure is 'export payment'. First, the amount of expenditure is determined, and the amount of income is determined later. If an unexpected war breaks out in this situation, what money should we use to make an extra budget? If an accurate government bond issuance plan is made in accordance with the accurate tax estimate at the time of the main budget, it must be done by paying debt during the extra budget.
Should the government be criticized for issuing additional government bonds during the supplementary administration period, but should it be praised for failing to predict tax revenues and holding excessive government bonds? Consequently, the discourse that the supplementary administration without government bonds is good creates three problems.
First, it distorts the economic substance and the nature of the supplementary budget. The amount of government bonds issued in the main budget is large and not issued during the supplementary budget, or conversely, the amount of government bonds issued in the main budget is reduced and issued during the supplementary budget, but the total amount of government bonds issued may be the same. Nevertheless, the frame is created that the supplementary budget for issuing government bonds is a bad supplement, and an supplementary budget without issuance of government bonds is a good supplement.
Second, you can give penalties to good administration and incentives to bad administration. When the tax revenue estimate is good, it is misunderstood as a wrong supplementary administration because it issued government bonds from the supplementary administration. Conversely, if the estimate is underestimated, it is praised for being able to make an extra budget without issuing government bonds. Then, there is an incentive to intentionally underestimate the tax revenue in the future.
Third, if you believe that the 2026 supplementary budget is a good supplement that fortunately (?) does not issue government bonds, you will be misunderstood as a bad supplement. This is the most important point. Rather, in general, an extra budget for issuing government bonds is needed. An extra budget is necessary as a means to defend the economy in case of an economic downturn. When the economy falls, tax revenue decreases. An extra budget is needed when the economy is worse than expected and tax revenue is less collected.
On the other hand, if the economy improves more than expected, more tax revenue comes in, resulting in excess tax revenue. In general, if the economy is in good shape and tax revenue is abundant, an extra budget to defend the economy is often unnecessary. Unless there is an exceptional shock such as war. Therefore, even in order to make a necessary extra budget for issuing government bonds in the future, an extra budget without issuing government bonds must escape the wrong frame of a \

>Democratic Party's chronic disease, 'excess tax revenue'
There is an old saying, \

However, will this tax excess occurrence be a failure of prediction or response. In conclusion, it is a failure to respond. The government said that the increase in corporate tax due to the supercycle of semiconductors could not be predicted. The problem is the timing. It may have been difficult to predict a year ago, but it was at least predictable in November of last year.
Most of the excess tax revenue and the deficit result from failure to forecast corporate tax. Samsung Electronics is known to have paid no corporate tax in 2023 and 2024. On the other hand, corporate tax payments this year are expected to be tens of billions of won. Failure to forecast corporate tax seems natural as each company's corporate tax performance fluctuates by tens of trillion won.
However, corporate tax is a trailing indicator. In other words, it is calculated after the performance is released. If the company's performance is good last year, the corporate tax revenue will increase this year. It is difficult to predict the stock price, which is a leading indicator, but the corporate tax revenue, which is a trailing indicator, can be estimated in 2026 if only the 2025 performance is properly reflected.
The next fiscal year's budget will be announced at the end of August and submitted to the National Assembly. This is why we estimate tax revenues for the next fiscal year by reflecting only the information up to the end of July. At the end of July, only the first quarter's performance will be released, so even the performance will not be reflected properly. However, the actual deliberation on the National Assembly's budget plan will begin in November after the parliamentary audit is over. In November, the results of the third quarter as well as the second quarter's performance will be announced. At this point, if the next year's tax revenue is re-estimated, the next year's corporate tax revenue forecast can be greatly improved.
Governments affiliated with the people suffer from tax deficits, but there is a practice of suffering from excess tax revenue when the Democratic government takes power. For the Democratic government, it is a painful mistake to hand over the government without properly utilizing its fiscal capacity.
In fact, just before the 2022 presidential election, the Moon Jae In government tried to make an extra budget. At that time, the Ministry of Economy and Finance only managed a small supplementary budget of 14 trillion won, saying it had little room to issue additional government bonds. However, when the Yoon Suk Yeol government proposed an extra budget after winning the presidential election, the Ministry of Economy and Finance made an extra budget of 62 trillion won, claiming that there was an excess tax of 53 trillion won. It was not that there was no issuance of government bonds, but that it also repaid a whopping 7.5 trillion won worth of government bonds. In other words, the government \

the excess tax generated by the Moon Jae In government to the Yoon Suk Yeol government.
At that time, the 'Excess Tax TF' was created under the leadership of the Democratic Party of Korea, and the truth was investigated. At that time, I was in charge of the National Assembly's 'Excess Tax TF', and recommended that tax revenue re-estimation be regularized in November when the National Assembly's budget review is conducted. The Ministry of Economy and Finance promised to re-estimate tax revenue on the spot. However, that promise was not kept. Even the Democrats who participated in the TF at the time don't seem to remember the promise.

“The fact is that the Ministry of Finance is truly incapable of properly estimating tax revenues, and this poses a serious problem for the nation’s budget.
I do not understand why the supplementary budget must be made the headline issue.
Bureaucrats in the Ministry of Finance, under the name of ‘bureaucrats,’ conceal their incompetence and immorality regardless of which administration is in power.
Without a thorough purge of these officials, such problems will frankly never be resolved.
It would have been better if the writing had focused more on the essence of the matter.”

title.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![G15iClPXWIO8wmyu_Screenshot_20260408_212220.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/snowli/images/G15iClPXWIO8wmyu_Screenshot_20260408_212220/G15iClPXWIO8wmyu_Screenshot_20260408_212220.webp)
![qBKzPzqfj7RdPZxv_Screenshot_20260408_212205.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/snowli/images/qBKzPzqfj7RdPZxv_Screenshot_20260408_212205/qBKzPzqfj7RdPZxv_Screenshot_20260408_212205.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

前两天下班又去跑了三单外卖，手机电量满格到电量为0，刚好送完三单，这三单一共挣了13+元，其中有3元是必须要购买的保险，从八点一直跑到了九点半，手机电量 从100到0，而我挣的钱从0到13，用时1个半小时挣了10块钱，我真的哭死，比流水线还坑啊。

当然也可能是我经验不足，路况不熟悉，加上手脚不够麻利，一次也只敢接一单，所以就是这么个结果。🤣

好在最后一单是在写字楼，楼下是酒店大堂，我就刚好看到那里墙上有插座，送完最后一单也就是第三单，我就去我的车上拿我的充电器过来充电，三个插座只有一个有电的，每个都被我试过了。🤣

为了省下租充电宝的钱我也是够拼了。本来就没挣几块钱，再搭上充电宝的钱，我感觉得不偿失。还没充上电，在试插座的时候手机就关机了。

我充了几分钟就打开看定位，发现我在离家5公里的地方，骑车要骑半个多小时才到。🙃这钱是真不好挣啊，为了充点电又得在这里浪费时间去充电，等着手机电量多一点才能走。回到家已经十点半了，为了这十块钱从八点出发到十点半回到家，整整两个半小时。🙃

后面想提现这些天的收入，发现一个月只能免费提现一次，如果下次要提现就要开始收手续费。🤣然后我就没提了。

所以我总结出钱真难挣。也可能是人家说的，人总是挣不到自己认知以外的钱。🤣

title.title: The Naahgarita. My Actifit Diary: April 9 2026
title.body:
I’m sitting at my favorite bar, drinking a Naahgarita. Frozen Strawberry non-alcoholic margarita. Delicious and fancy enough to have the feeling that I’m not just coming here to drink water or overrated juice, which is the case for many other mocktails. I want to support my friend by consuming here, but I also don’t want to throw money at something that doesn’t give me pleasure. And I drink everything that is not beer way too fast. So the Naahgarita is perfect. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/9296551b-9f33-49ab-ae12-62be171e1a73.jpg) It was market day today, but before that, I had to go to the police station again to file a request for some police reports from back in 2021. They said to be back at 3pm. Which I was. But then they said to be back next week. Monday? No, rather Tuesday. Which means Thursday, if I don’t go in on Monday to remind them. Time sensitive matters? Who cares. It’s in the archives. It was to be found. I have the file number, the date and everything needed to make the search quick – if the archive is somewhat organized. Which it probably isn’t. I have copies of the reports, but to file the lawsuit, we need originals – which were used in another lawsuit back in 2021. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/bee0b3be-a813-42f4-802c-00e13811c002.jpg) Market was very slow today, it was a hassle to even sell those kinds of bread that usually fly off our tables. But we got most of the loaves sold, and just some small stuff is now sitting in the cabinet, waiting for people to walk by and give into their impulse to buy just a little muffin. Or a package of 3, I mean, 3 for $2,50 instead of $1 each. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/782a7241-1fba-4e66-865c-aad56559ae13.jpg) The afternoon was some more walking around, getting some stuff done, and finally walking over here to have my mocktails. Second one by now, almost time to go home and cook something. Soak some beans for tomorrow, maybe chickpeas, maybe lentils – whatever. I’m thinking about preparing something with Quinoa too. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/ab9b0779-0db6-4346-93f0-44bf97066d49.jpg) Oh, and I want to play some Splinterlands. Didn’t do any matches today, too busy. Just the brawl, which was quick as I’m in a fray that I don’t have many cards for. Not by choice, but because everyone else has better cards for all the other frays, so I get the leftovers. I still get the same amount of merits and SPS, so fine by me. And if I’ll mostly lose anyway, I don’t have to break my head about tactics. That’s it for today! Hope you’ll have a good night!

title.title: Fuerza y Control [Esp/Eng]
title.body:
>

Fuerza y Control. Continuamos en la ruta de la activación corporal, con más y más rutinas variadas y divertidas. En esta oportunidad; nos vamos con una serie de movimientos, donde mantendremos el cuerpo boca arriba y boca abajo, con el objeto de ganar fuerza, transformar la musculatura y ganar mucho control y equilibrio corporal. Al realizar los ejercicios propuestos, no solo el objetivo es el cambio en nuestra estética; porque más allá de ello, hacemos que nuestro cuerpo se ejercite de manera integral, mejorando un mundo la conexión que debe existir entre la mente y los músculos. Es decir; al tener una musculatura definida y fuerte, podemos alejarnos en gran medida de las tediosas lesiones. Así que amigos míos; vamos juntos a entrenar, cada uno de acuerdo a su condición física y seguimos dando movimiento a nuestras vidas. >Strength and Control. We continue on the path of body activation, with more and more varied and fun routines. This time, we’re diving into a series of movements where we’ll alternate between lying on our backs and on our stomachs, with the goal of building strength, transforming our muscles, and gaining greater control and balance. When performing these exercises, the goal isn’t just about changing our appearance; beyond that, we’re giving our bodies a comprehensive workout, significantly improving the connection between our minds and muscles. In other words, by having defined and strong muscles, we can largely avoid those pesky injuries. So, my friends, let’s train together—each according to our own fitness level—and keep bringing movement into our lives.

![1000442609.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKe8G1U8t6UgpfGkeGVxpAS8B5NLNmrFCVhkPxK4cckQq9KgiXWYY9gvXWGsg95.gif)Portada de mi Autoría Editada en/Cover of my Authorship Edited in [Canva](https://www.canva.com/es_419/)
Logos propiedad de/ logos owned by @hiveio, @fulldeportes
# **
[Fase de Calentamiento]()
** Cuando vamos a realizar cualquier actividad física; siempre es recomendable; es más, debe ser un hábito obligatorio el de realizar ejercicios de calentamiento. Con ellos; ponemos a tono todo el cuerpo y alejamos la posibilidad de adquirir cualquier tipo de lesión. No realices ejercicios bruscos sin antes calentar; no arriesgues tu cuerpo por saltarte un minuto para calentar; vamos, activos. ># **
[Warm-up Phase]()
** >When we are going to do any physical activity, it is always advisable, in fact, it should be a mandatory habit to do warm-up exercises. With them, we get the whole body in tune and reduce the possibility of acquiring any type of injury. Do not do sudden exercises without warming up first; do not risk your body by skipping a minute to warm up; come on, let's get active. [**Calentamiento 1**, **FLEXIÓN Y EXTENSIÓN FRONTAL DE CODOS MAS TALÓN AL GLUTEO**]() [Postura]() Piernas separadas al ancho de hombros; elevamos los brazos y se extienden al frente. >[**Warm-up 1**, **ELBOW FLEXION AND EXTENSION, PLUS HEEL TO GLUTE**]() >[Posture]() >Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart; raise your arms and extend them forward.
![1000442566.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKp9ZzTdd93MozE8zHqBhhQvcR14pE62jvRksfZz5EskphMp3WchuPFzS2uRBLc.gif)
[Ejecución]() Una vez ubicados en la postura indicada; flexionamos y extendemos los codos de forma continua; y al mismo tiempo, flexionamos las rodillas tratando de llevar los talones de los pies hacia los glúteos. 3 minutos de acción. >[Execution]() >Once you’re in the correct position, continuously bend and straighten your elbows; at the same time, bend your knees, trying to bring your heels toward your buttocks. Do this for 3 minutes.
![1000442568.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKp9ZzWa2nNbH69AweXyVzBpEgcTo4gTLSYsYaGPAko8z4zvRPqLe8hfVmhbcEB.gif)
[**Calentamiento 2**, **GIROS DIAGONALES EN SALTO CON MOVIMIENTO DE BRAZOS**]() [Postura]() Piernas separadas al ancho de la cadera; brazos a los lados extendidos hacia abajo. >[**Warm-up 2**, **DIAGONAL TURNS IN A JUMP WITH ARM MOVEMENTS**]() >[Stance]() >Feet hip-width apart; arms at your sides, extended downward.
![1000442572.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKe6vWkkm3CkVVSdQyGRHwU93HPLAvkujVMJHb3jZn6RCXChKAHTYGZe6EWtSqg.gif)
[Ejecución]() Para ejecutar el movimiento, damos pequeños saltos para en la caída, quedar en forma diagonal. Mientras se realiza el movimiento, se extiende un brazo al frente y el otro queda hacia atrás. 3 minutos de acción. >[Execution]() >To perform the movement, take small jumps so that you land diagonally. As you perform the movement, extend one arm forward and keep the other behind you. 3 minutes of exercise.
![1000442576.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKe6rquAFH2uQmg2A4J457x7Uo7Vca3UmR1kYozfxQ2yzdfmgegt9yjJU2W7ZUg.gif)
Es muy importante determinar que si el cuerpo aún no está activo para la acción fuerte, se debe calentar un poco más. No olvides hacer pausas de 20 segundos entre ejercicios, y de 1 a 2 minutos entre series; la hidratación es extremadamente importante para reponer los líquidos y sales perdidas durante la acción. Por otro lado, debemos tratar en la medida de lo posible mantener una alimentación balanceada y un descanso adecuado, que contribuyan a la obtención de mejores resultados corporales. >It is very important to determine that if the body is not yet ready for intense activity, it should be warmed up a little more. Don't forget to take 20-second breaks between exercises and 1-2 minute breaks between sets; hydration is extremely important to replenish fluids and salts lost during exercise. On the other hand, we must try as much as possible to maintain a balanced diet and adequate rest, which contribute to achieving better physical results. # **
[Estaciones de Trabajo]()
** Luego de realizar el calentamiento y comprobado de que el cuerpo está apto para la acción fuerte; nos vamos a la ejecución de los ejercicios centrales de la rutina. Si aun sientes que no estás listo, vuelve a calentar, evita lesiones. Recuerda que cada ejercicio debes hacerlo de acuerdo a tu condición física, vamos poco a poco hasta dominar los movimientos. ># **
[Work Stations]()
** >After warming up and checking that the body is ready for the strong action, we go to the execution of the core exercises of the routine. If you still feel that you are not ready, warm up again, avoid injuries. Remember that each exercise should be done according to your physical condition, we go little by little until you master the movements. [**Estación 1**, **TRÍCEPS EN SUELO CON MANOS Y PIERNAS JUNTAS, MÁS MOVIMIENTOS LATERALES**]() [Postura]() Nos sentamos en el piso; ubicamos las manos juntas detrás de la espalda y juntamos las piernas. Elevamos la cadera; quedamos en postura del cangrejo. >[**Station 1**, **FLOOR TRICEPS WITH HANDS AND LEGS TOGETHER, PLUS SIDE-TO-SIDE MOVEMENTS**]() >[Posture]() >Sit on the floor; place your hands together behind your back and keep your legs together. Lift your hips; you’ll be in a crab pose.
![1000442578.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKRBp8o6dgsgpMMEdjY2VJD586eDDbSB8VqwoLL8ncPtHydg9uCnppNf1PUnGoz.gif)
[Ejecución]() Ejercicio completo que activa todo el cuerpo; desarrollo en tríceps y fortalecimiento en núcleo. Piernas activas; todo el cuerpo ganando fuerza y control. Para ejecutar el ejercicio; flexionamos los codos, bajamos la cadera sin tocar suelo, subimos; abrimos un brazo y pierna hacia un lado, volvemos a juntar las extremidades y quedamos en la postura original, pero en el lado opuesto; regresamos repitiendo el movimiento completo. 20 repeticiones totales en 4 series. >[Execution]() >A full-body exercise that engages the entire body; builds triceps and strengthens the core. Active legs; the whole body gains strength and control. To perform the exercise: bend your elbows, lower your hips without touching the floor, then rise; extend one arm and one leg to the side, bring the limbs back together, and return to the starting position, but on the opposite side; repeat the full movement. 20 repetitions total in 4 sets.
![1000442580.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKSd4SGX9H35Du9vtJkmitU7UYKRhPw8BmG9aarqwU64jAxWg3JcsezGXwm7phV.gif)
[**Estación 2**, **TOQUE DE PIE EN POSTURA DEL OSO, MÁS EXTENSIÓN DE PIERNAS HACIA ATRÁS, APERTURA Y CIERRE EN SALTO**]() [Postura]() Partimos de la postura del oso; boca abajo, manos en el piso y rodillas flexionadas a nivel de la cadera; cadera elevada. >[**Station 2**, **BEAR POSE WITH FOOT TAP, FURTHER BACKWARD LEG EXTENSION, OPENING AND CLOSING IN A JUMP**]() >[Pose]() >Start in Bear Pose: face down, hands on the floor, knees bent at hip level, hips raised.
![1000442582.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKCGeod1eEisnAzqwNEKTPBCYaeVgoJD8DGeHcbFEVqWuYTvYEQY22vS7pF5B57.gif)
[Ejecución]() Un trabajo único para el núcleo y piernas; brazos trabajando en segundo plano. En primer lugar; a través de un movimiento coordinado, tocamos los pies con la mano opuesto. Rápidamente; extendemos rodillas, llevando las piernas hacia atrás, para luego abrir y cerrar con un salto. Con otro salto, volvemos a la postura del oso. 20 repeticiones totales en 4 series. >[Execution]() >A unique exercise for the core and legs; the arms work in the background. First, using a coordinated movement, touch your feet with the opposite hand. Quickly, straighten your knees, bringing your legs back, then open and close them with a jump. With another jump, return to the bear pose. 20 repetitions total in 4 sets.
![1000442586.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AK9PpxKfixyPvnJLxv2EQoYPMrH3BBgZx2ztwfTXkx7jjUCt3pDd1x4gcHozLax.gif)
[**Estación 3**, **TRÍCEPS EN SUELO MÁS TOQUE DE PIE OPUESTO EN POSTURA DEL CANGREJO**]() [Postura]() Nos sentamos en el suelo; colocamos las manos detrás de la espalda a la anchura de hombros; flexionamos las rodillas, elevamos la cadera; piernas al ancho de cadera. >[**Station 3**, **FLOOR TRICEPS WITH OPPOSITE FOOT TAP IN CRAB POSITION**]() >[Position]() >Sit on the floor; place your hands behind your back, shoulder-width apart; bend your knees and lift your hips; keep your legs hip-width apart.
![1000442588.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AK7xzTNXfxUbJ3eavyThoje4YnzojJB7qVYcC9iy8moWof9dcLawBXxVALMZ4sK.gif)
[Ejecución]() Sin duda alguna activamos todo el cuerpo, el cuerpo se mantiene en absoluta tensión. En primer lugar; flexionamos los codos, bajamos la cadera; estando abajo elevamos un pie y lo tocamos con la mano opuesta. Otra flexión de codos y tocamos el pie contrario. 20 repeticiones totales en 4 series. >[Execution]() >There’s no doubt that this exercise engages the entire body, keeping it under constant tension. First, bend your elbows and lower your hips; once you’re in the lowered position, lift one foot and touch it with the opposite hand. Bend your elbows again and touch the other foot. Do a total of 20 repetitions in 4 sets.
![1000442594.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AK9QCFUcAKXUK19vByQGxE3XixyzDMv8td51VifNAp8yWj2oD8JiRkhsZpLgVac.gif)
[**Relajación**, **GIRO DE BRAZOS MÁS ELEVACIÓN Y GIRO DE PIERNA**]() [Postura]() Piernas separadas al ancho de la cadera; brazos a los lados extendidos hacia abajo. >[**Relaxation**, **ARM CIRCLES WITH LIFT AND LEG CIRCLES**]() >[Posture]() >Legs hip-width apart; arms at your sides, extended downward.
![1000442603.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKs2LDNZfwqCG1S4dDGismaVA9ypDhf92mZ9HZxBX4XYVjZDGXHRiabzqU6Vh7j.gif)

title.title: My Favorite Vacation Destination: Maui, Hawaii
title.body:
/>

**Introduction 
**
When it comes to places to visit for a vacation, my favorite destination is Hawaii. And Maui island in particular. 

You might ask, why Hawaii and why Maui? I have multiple reasons as to why: proximity to Seattle, it only takes around five and a half hours on a direct flight to get to Maui from Seattle. Caribbean is an all day trip which for most destinations also involves traveling outside of the country, which also applies to Mexico. 



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZCPJow8CwyxC2nL3mpFkHP9KanWACQaZQfYQdxY8NRPb/image.png)

**Reasons Why Maui **
Well, in my past traveling I have been to Cabo in Mexico, Bahamas, Jamaica and while those destinations were absolutely lovely, with great ocean beaches and warm during our winter, traveling outside United States comes with a variety of complications such as language and cultural barriers, having to deal with international border on the way there and back.

What about Florida or California you might ask? Those destinations I love and have been to many times including trips to Tampa, Orlando, Miami, Los Angeles, San Diego, San Francisco, Santa Barbara and many other places. These destinations are just not warm enough in our winter and don't have the same island feel that Hawaii does.



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZd45mbNbrB4C8JJoUbdURQoaDypD9Eu2bEoFwu2Q1Znh/image.png)


When it comes to Hawaii there are four main islands: Maui, Big Island, Kauai and Oahu. For me Kauai is too rural, Oahu is too urban and urban is what I want to get away from when I go on vacation. 

I really enjoyed the big island and had fun climbing over lava landscape which looked straight out of the science fiction movie and really loved the beach and snorkeling there. But when it comes to a complete package of an island feel, beautiful beaches, great snorkeling, amazing food and restaurants, sophisticated shopping and best prices it is Maui hands down!


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP2k7JfujGi2wJanVGimwWpbgzfFwzqtZL2eQVkUT1UJj/image.png)

**Chickens in Wailea**
One of the most impressive locations on Maui is a luxurious town of Wailea. This place has it all: luxury shopping, amazing beaches, luxury resorts and fine dining. But it also has wild chickens 🐔 

Above is a picture of chickens I took next to the beach parking lot of the Wailea Beach. Why did chicken cross the road?

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXNbkkbjfQBagVqURqu75enJ68Mq7jpP8o7Kbv51dvBgf/image.png)

**Our Favorite Restaurant on the Island of Maui **

If you look at the reviews for the best restaurant on Maui  you will see that Mama's Fish House is often mentioned as number one. But it is on the other side of the island so we never go there.

Our favorite restaurant on Maui is actually Matteo's Osteria in Wailea. It is a great Italian restaurant that does have some really outstanding food.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPPcEDrewtXgRYvs8f74JnarYWScFgUDhPDXD52Mwecq3/image.png)

Above you see a picture of a dish from a children's menu that our daughter ordered. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmURbwLB5v2SwwTbZ8Sxw536kHpGvF9kKz9HuvF31VGRSN/image.png)

I opted out for a Manhattan drink to start our early dinner. And they really know how to make drinks at Matteo's Osteria!

The service is also outstanding, our waiter was very professional. Mike (our waiter) was originally from New Jersey and he actually remembered us from two years ago and which table we sat at.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ2WbEEb21LGDBBvR7nsHtnvyHjoPth8W6AiDHdRJJ5vy/image.png)

The dish above is something my wife ordered and it was a really nice fresh fish prepared in a way that you can almost not tell that it was a fish.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWqTdJWyyVooiZG5Q1BcPeQrYnXaNHyzuAjW2jB6KcJ4L/image.png)

For my main dish I have selected ribs and they were divine. As you can see the main dish portions are not huge so we also  ordered a few great appetizers and desert.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYASACLQTHdEJC5bfi2jdJ77dZtgZ4fPJbdY25nCuoUix/image.png)

After dining at the Matteo's Osteria, we drove down the hill to the Wailea Beach just in time for the gorgeous sunset and to take some photos of those chickens :) 

People were enjoying sunset and almost everyone was taking selfies or pictures of each other with the sunset as a background.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRKztGZF3x3z2E5CBhyLH622Lsgj1KdTisFjE1TxP9Xb8/image.png)

Right below this you see an image of one of those luxury hotels I was talking about, I have never stayed in Wailea as I usually find that Kaanapali or Lahaina and specifically Kahana offers much better value for your lodging dollars. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSQ7HQYzcrBZpzrUNaTrwqcWZuwi9PJaJ118WC15C4BuD/image.png)

The image of a purple pink sunset that you see above was taken from a condo balcony in Kahana where we stayed.

The image below is an appetizer from Merriman's restaurant in Kapalua Bay that is only ten minutes away from the place we stayed.  

The fish and particularly Ahi Tuna is amazing on Maui this appetizer from the Merriman's was incredible, but so was the simple Poke from the Napili Market. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUpmDfWqitmCzhfWrNzW33uCnv6WojnCd6zbedrhAqSji/image.png)


This below was a table decoration at the Merriman's restaurant, I thought it looked cool and very tropical.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ9MmHuY16RgffKhcUZPnjJikcqoovQUJHu8Xwo3Apqc7/image.png)

And this dish below is the reason we came to the Merriman's restaurant again. This is grilled octopus in the Escargot iron dish. Our daughter loves grilled octopus and this is her absolute favorite way to have grilled octopus prepared.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQbkhFBb7HuCUU1Jf6Qe4QwaAy6CnmQxW5K1xGfkpPdgi/image.png)

And this dish is another seafood dish which was one of the native fishes to Hawaii, it was also cooked to perfection. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaY1ts3DbrxzUQp7M45ZR8XerQegAS1SejkjXg6Bffe4U/image.png)

My wife was more adventurous and ordered a seafood dish with a curry.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT1jWxHZh6r38oQce6soc26jTj2zvBuHoYGGdbGddPktn/image.png)

I had their Old-fashioned 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUa9GuLXpJpSFyFkKcBA8tBGdqnqoLhfwTdxZUFaRi9ei/image.png)

There is also luxury shopping areas on Maui, one in Kaanapali and one in Wailea:

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbKv7ajEreg5fXPNjGs7yeyseeFtF58DYBB8UKsoxnTVo/image.png)

Lot's of shopping to be had including Rolex watches for those that appreciate that kind of thing. I didn't partake in the luxury shopping this time around :)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbeZhCRiSUHSAo1NkmJem64CjdoFaCxDvdVcScaVxpcGU/image.png)



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcHc2UK79fczMHxB1cC3Pqafgdy245FoRzYuRyFxhC2Bq/image.png)

There are also natural wonders to take a look on Maui, for example the images below are from the Nakalele Blowhole where water shoots up through a cave that connects to the ocean.

Frequently you can see a rainbow here, but we were not that lucky...


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeKXvHd2qYwKYEXgBzCL2rkejBvLEFQTieJT5G8GwNf1b/image.png)

It was also quite a bit of a hike to the Nakalele Blowhole.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma5CbkUq1YYwXBEGnAsVcmQGL3qmY4VqWS6YNFsR59Ju5/image.png)

The road to Nakalele Blowhole was also gorgeous so we stopped by in a few places and took some pictures.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmU9LMPMDG3YCaqQuoHLpQfkGK7xYoLZZqFqLuToahgCG2/image.png)

And the image below was also taken from the balcony of a condo we stayed at.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmU8nEJ2NhCruZQnqmUCiKzBe9zHUXcRogSGCcyuMHR19B/image.png)

It was a wonderful trip with lots of fond memories...

is one of the most unique and successful songs by the British band The Stranglers, released in 1981 as part of their album La Folie. ![ATyE4gHg-Logo-circulo-perfil.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/davixesk8/AJkUQD3DfLuwnGbEq4AorjHFdjVh8WPqdo4C2W3c9e6YYsA6AwMAjod88i8fY3g.png)</center>

**\

es una de las canciones más singulares y exitosas de la banda británica The Stranglers, lanzada en 1981 como parte de su álbum La Folie. A diferencia del sonido punk y post-punk que caracterizaba al grupo, este tema destaca por su refinado estilo baroque-pop, protagonizado por un distintivo clavicordio y un complejo ritmo que alterna compases de 3/4 y 4/4. La letra, escrita por Hugh Cornwell, ha sido objeto de múltiples interpretaciones a lo largo de los años debido a su naturaleza ambigua y poética, oscilando entre metáforas sobre el placer y referencias a sustancias, envueltas en una atmósfera hipnótica y mediterránea. A pesar de que su propio sello discográfico dudaba de su potencial comercial por ser tan diferente a las tendencias de la época, la canción se convirtió en un fenómeno mundial y en la pieza más reconocida de la banda.** \n\n*\

is one of the most unique and successful songs by the British band The Stranglers, released in 1981 as part of their album La Folie. Unlike the punk and post-punk sound that characterized the group, this track stands out for its refined baroque-pop style, featuring a distinctive harpsichord and a complex rhythm that alternates between 3/4 and 4/4 time signatures. The lyrics, written by Hugh Cornwell, have been subject to multiple interpretations over the years due to their ambiguous and poetic nature, oscillating between metaphors about pleasure and references to substances, all enveloped in a hypnotic, Mediterranean atmosphere. Although their own record label doubted its commercial potential because it was so different from the trends of the time, the song became a worldwide phenomenon and the band's most recognized piece.*

title.title: Saludable pechuga de pollo con mostaza en el airfrayer// (Esp/Eng)
title.body:
---
_Feliz y bendecido día_ >_Happy and blessed day_

![1000441608.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/EoAd7Schkt8VE9ivP4FxwYJi9SmeGo8Ny5Nz5CabetB4D9cmwHsEuUD1SZCYp4SnJrp.jpg)

>
 
Hola, amigos. Continuando con mis recetas saludables, hoy les traigo un pollo cocido en la freidora de aire con mostaza. Queda exquisito y es extremadamente saludable; además, se utiliza aceite de oliva para prepararlo. Desde que adquirí este aparato, me ha solucionado en muchas recetas y lo mejor es que es práctico, cómodo y rápido Podemos acompañarlo con lo que desees: puré de papa, ensalada, papas al vapor o cualquier otra cosa. Espero que les agrade. Aquí les dejo el procedimiento detallado.


> Hi, everyone. Continuing with my healthy recipes, today I’m sharing an air-fried chicken with mustard. It turns out delicious and is extremely healthy; plus, it’s made with olive oil. Since I bought this appliance, it’s come in handy for so many recipes, and the best part is that it’s practical, convenient, and fast. You can serve it with whatever you like: mashed potatoes, salad, steamed potatoes, or anything else. I hope you enjoy it. Here are the detailed instructions.

---
![El texto del párrafo (32).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/EouEzXFRam7Qu5Er4T5yaxbebYHDJJvGYKKJedtHFWxqE5sXNxmydEWFdjp6DLSkUTF.jpg)

<div class = \
> - 1 pechuga sin hueso - Orégano - Paprika ahumada - Pimienta - Cúrcuma - Aceite de oliva - Mostaza - Sal

> - 1 boneless chicken breast - Oregano - Smoked paprika - Pepper - Turmeric - Olive oil - Mustard - Salt

![1000440325.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23uQvQBEFPQF1xmcUYHoDEFCWSoY5BMFWb3zUQTg6eLAWNeiH9USonivhvuRWN54xn4Xe.jpg)
![El texto del párrafo (31).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/EowNPiUud55yj2BkuDpKGUA8asqcUnP2g4hytTz9iUtwoeMREbopLjBeaQpT27KBKrK.jpg) - Lo primero que hacemos es cortar y lavar la pechuga muy bien. >- The first thing we do is cut the chicken breast and wash it thoroughly.
![1000440326.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23wCDgMWZ3FU22MFnBaw41rQwUp9ywzYyoKCWhJudPybiwgLNk2xCDnzJfin5qBCzL5fZ.jpg)
- Luego añadimos la sal. >- Then add the salt.
![1000440336.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23u69Qoz6Fvj6s3pGbrUo5rVYqthxFdCTR1h1PKBdZsSWUodf33Lj1vbZDuD2egXK4mxg.jpg)
- Ahora en un bol añadimos 2 cucharadas de aceite de oliva, 1/2 cucharadita de pimienta, 1/2 cucharadita de paprika, 1 cucharadita de cúrcuma y una cucharadita de orégano y mezclamos todo para integrar todos. > - Now, in a bowl, add 2 tablespoons of olive oil, 1/2 teaspoon of pepper, 1/2 teaspoon of paprika, 1 teaspoon of turmeric, and 1 teaspoon of oregano, and mix everything together until well combined.
|![1000440327.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23xybWYUHhQQGaGYJZwbsK7M4vdU7vH7aoVxcG9igbjbuuCtgDB86iRyrwQ9URcUjcjxU.jpg)|![1000440328.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23xAVXSK6PbetCszkAsvB888itoB6itdfvAU43aq8CKDjnhnbsqbot4kqGxHB2mMwSp2T.jpg)|![1000440329.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23xVKNDuQ2esDWHYPbcSLT78Rw2NWHEB3xUnjpZ8G17SAwsnnLf9CEyGc4JxDdHKWPvw4.jpg)| |-|-|-| |![1000440331.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23zGgfBHFdhZ6yTQJhZppXmaiGjmRYNibWxhDGZbKvPsmaZ9e3WFSHuQXbTe5fNpT76ru.jpg)|![or1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23ynUgPnSZBJhxwmrjDgUdwAXM6RaSZZUnddwXVHty2ZyerGM7iz5tLf8PgtR9Su3uLpH.jpg)| |-|-|
- Luego bañamos el pollo con esa mezcla. >- Then we coat the chicken with that mixture.
![1000440337.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23xVMbUDV7Lc1ULkzmXKrB33UnzFN6E4meHW9W6M5EokbGn1RN58ebWbU5sPBtDH4utUX.jpg)
- Ahora colocamos el pollo en un papel desechable para el airfryer; le colocamos un poco de aceite y le añadimos la mostaza. >- Now place the chicken on a disposable air fryer liner; drizzle a little oil over it and add the mustard.
|![1000440338.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23xpAnCZrBso1Z53YksNdKe1z2BUEJgkp6DGhqrvGC9eNinYJr956JRNG9xpe6JdHVySB.jpg)|![1000440339.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23xyZ98jNgq5a8PrFQChnuhE7k5Bd9iiAELykTFRFevJys3eYdLbPazkafGQgJHz1ifBJ.jpg)|![1000440340.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23xVPA8nJDTvqNscxrS1vzqEz2n1xfKQ9C5TNsDjs7mSBLZdHnhs8uWVHhQ97EN71wRJ9.jpg)| |-|-|-|
- Ahora lo colocamos a cocinar en el Airfryer por 25 minutos y 200 de temperatura; recuerde que debemos voltear el pollo para que se cocine por el otro lado. > - Now place it in the Airfryer to cook for 25 minutes at 200°C; remember to flip the chicken so it cooks on the other side.
|![1000440342.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23ywptVSRCXj5jL6vqfjUwnXwGtZSiCV8p3wzUPcLTbreAP4CquYmKHTFoznheg91jsFr.jpg)|![pol1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23tH85e5vbM4MXtpLwgVW8UxqPvD6Y7fN95hA5evwFZVCyZjjcHZMUAwpCisfcu9aSs47.jpg)|![1000440386.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23tvcHcp3LYc6PUXJphqEfh4ZYh3ndH9tbtwzad28Ai53jKuieBzx887TvcGMU7Q7qApx.jpg)| |-|-|-|
- Una vez pasado el tiempo de cocción. Listo, está esta pechuga de pollo con mostaza. > - Once the cooking time is up. There you go—your mustard-glazed chicken breast is ready.
![1000440420.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23wCBwAzbJoJqSMKipLopVNe4Y6QrhgjGxVVugoEf28y7wffpfJRWwqtWZJi9zfUctVQw.jpg) ![1000440422.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23xVKHUVDvdaNHJpZjr5yV2zNKLPxEyFtwroXFZ1E8fHbFaZQ47PH1iXfebTp4tv9QaYL.jpg) ![1000440424.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23wgPzoxb69Xr8ZPsCskXsJsbjJ2iDmSaTM2Teo1GjN1xen4NvL2Fp2Pb8QoVFR7f6u5K.jpg) ![1000440421.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23xpErLAzEdKx3KrvxQ3YfPiHA78ERpSA4fNb1PksdP2EPx3nyGeWc6PGiyiFpj9syo9J.jpg) ![1000440426.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23x1DgJUhfznmaX3zE1SWjuNkTMD31vmZJ8R2Htwd2L51fPcB5ZSBxBDFkrPZmTgYdspN.jpg)

Es muy fácil dejar de hacer cosas y son suplantadas por otras, simplemente de la nada, tanto así, que ni siquiera nos damos cuenta cuándo y cómo ocurre. Podría ser algo nostálgico recordar un pasado y de lo que en él pasaba. Pero aún así, todo marcha para ser mejor. 

Pero es que estoy escribiendo sobre sobre tareas, actividades o pasatiempos 🤣 sí, realmente  pensaba mientras escribía que me encantaba tomar fotos tipo macro o usando al máximo posible la cámara de mi dispositivo móvil, pensaba además que disfrutaba en tomar fotos a flores, animales o le que fuese en tamaños pequeños.

Y de pronto en medio de la ciudad, en una árbol casi seco de tanto contarles las ramas, aparece una lagartija diminuta para dejarse fotografiar. Bendito Dios, cosa tan linda 🤣 no lo es, pero me parece un milagro que viva allí en medio de una ciudad ruidosa y sin mucha vegetación y eso lo hace para mi algo bello 😊

Una pequeña anécdota del día, hace que use mi teléfono móvil para sacar fotos, como antes 😍 otro milagro del día ❤️ me encanta cada foto con ese tono color marrón 😍 simple y hermoso.

Pues así de simple vamos y regresamos a lo que amamos hacer. Éso que nos espera con paciencia y nos hace disfrutar esos segundos de diversión silenciosa. Nosotros nos pedimos muchas cosas sin sentido a si mismo, pero no nos exigimos en esas que nos complementan realmente. 

No esperes que Éso que te gusta te encuentre otra vez… hazlo y no lo olvides 😍


Me Inspiro EnmyMente cada día 🥳

No te olvides de visitar @enmymente para que conozcas más de Hive Blockchain

It’s so easy to stop doing certain things and have them replaced by others—just out of nowhere—so much so that we don’t even realize when or how it happens. It might be a bit nostalgic to look back on the past and what happened there. But even so, everything is heading in the right direction. 

But I’m actually writing about tasks, activities, or hobbies 🤣—yes, I really was thinking while I wrote that I loved taking macro photos or making the most of my phone’s camera; I also thought about how much I enjoyed photographing flowers, animals, or anything else in small sizes.

And suddenly, in the middle of the city, on a tree that’s almost dry from having its branches counted so many times, a tiny lizard appears, letting me take its picture. Thank God, such a cute thing 🤣—it isn’t, but it seems like a miracle to me that it lives there in the middle of a noisy city with not much greenery, and that makes it something beautiful to me 😊

A little anecdote from the day: it makes me use my cell phone to take photos, just like before 😍 another miracle of the day ❤️ I love every photo with that brown tone 😍 simple and beautiful.

Well, it’s that simple—we go and come back to what we love to do. That thing that waits patiently for us and lets us enjoy those moments of quiet joy. We ask so many meaningless things of ourselves, but we don’t demand the things that truly fulfill us.

Hello everyone I am Jakia Simi from Bangladesh. How are you all??Hope you are well.Today I have post a video about boat journey. I hope you will enjoy the video.
A journey by boat is always a peaceful and memorable experience,especially when surrendered by the beauty of nature. Last week I had the opportunity to enjoy such a journey with my family. We started early in the morning when the sun was just rising.,painting the sky with soft shades of orange and pink.The river was clam,and the gentle sound of water touching the boat creating a soothing rhythm. As the boat slowly moved forward, we felt a cool breeze that refreshed our minds.On both sides of the river, there were green trees,small villages, and fishermen busy with their nets.Children were playing near the banks.The scene felt like a living painting full of life and simplicity. We also saw different type of birds flying over the water, occasionally diving to catch fish.The boatman shared interesting stories about the river and the nearby places which made the journey more enjoyable. We bought some snackes which added a special flavour to the journey. After 2 hours we reached our destination. A boat journey like this is really refreshing and unforgettable.

**“Calle”** está perfecto para **“street”**, y la frase **“Vivimos en la misma calle”** suena natural y correcta. Tu ejemplo visual funciona bien porque conecta vocabulario básico con una oración útil de la vida real, que es justo como se fija una palabra en la cabeza. [Tu post](https://inleo.io/@aljif7/a-daily-word-in-spanish-368-mnsa0k975fe84e8f)

Un matiz útil: **calle** suele usarse para una vía urbana, mientras que **camino**, **carretera** o **avenida** cambian según el contexto. Incluso en diccionarios y recursos de aprendizaje, *calle* aparece primero como **street**, aunque a veces también se acerque a **road** o **lane** según el uso. [SpanishDictionary](https://www.spanishdict.com/translate/calle) [WordHippo](https://www.wordhippo.com/what-is/the-meaning-of/spanish-word-calle.html)

También me gustó el formato trilingüe. Inglés + chino + español en la misma lámina es una idea simple, pero jodidamente útil, porque obliga a comparar estructura y no solo memorizar traducciones. En tu serie reciente se nota esa constancia didáctica, y este tipo de palabra cotidiana siempre aterriza bien para estudiantes.

title.title: THE ROSARY OF STARS (THE WISH)
title.body:
/>

_Generated using Gemini AI_

Back then, we tried to stay clear of the senior students to avoid being sent by them to get something from the tuck shop, and worse still, to go to the stream to fetch water. Our daily schedule was to wake up very early, rush to the stream to get water to bathe, then rush to the dining hall for breakfast. From the dining hall, we rushed to the assembly halls on days when assembly was held, and after that, we went straight to class to avoid being spotted by a senior student. We were fortunate to have been given a separate hostel from the senior boys, so we had only our house captain and his assistant as the senior boys, while the rest of us were all junior boys.

Our hostel was called “PTA HOUSE” because it was built by the Parent Teachers Association. Life was fun and happy as long as we maintained our routine to avoid the lazy senior boys who would want to engage us in duties not assigned to us by the school authority. The main hostel was just beside our classrooms, so we had to slip out of class as soon as the teacher left, in order not to be caught by a senior student.

It happened one fateful Wednesday, which I can remember vividly, as it was a day we were served spaghetti and egg for lunch. The teacher who had the last period was ill and, as such, didn’t make it to class. Before the timekeeper would ring the bell for closing, we were summoned by a senior student, as if he had been waiting for a day like this. I thought to myself that for this teacher to be absent in class and for senior Peter to come straight for us must be his doing. It would be recorded as the first day I missed dining and also missed lunch in the entirety of my life.

Senior Peter was a handsome and tall guy, and at first glance of him, one would say that he was not wicked and could not make us go through what he made us go through on that day. He selected the four of us, Festus, Hakeem, Femi and me to follow him. Getting to the hostel, we met eight empty buckets waiting for us, and the first task was to fill them with water.

We will usually have our siesta after lunch, and after which, we go for our afternoon prep, where we read until evening, before we go for sports or for labour. But for that day, our whole day was already planned by senior Peter, who had taken his time to plan the rest of the evening for us; it took us the whole of our siesta time to fetch the water from the stream and return to the hostel, each person holding two buckets each.

Senior Peter had been waiting for us with dirty clothes, most of which were those of his clique. We started washing those clothes, Hakeem and I were washing the trousers and boxers, while Femi and Festus were washing the shirts and singlets. We did the laundry that day, and before we could finish, it was already 7 pm, since we had to wash the clothes more than once, as we were still young and didn’t really know how to wash properly.

At the end of the day, when we were done with the task, Senior Femi and his clique were about to eat dinner, and since we had worked tirelessly, we were invited to partake in the meal. It was my first time eating a contraband item in school, as it was prohibited to bring food items like Indomie noodles, geisha, or any food item to the hostel.

And after which we were dismissed and went straight to the class again for night prep, still with our uniforms, for our evening reading time. Everyone was wondering what had happened to us during the period we were called. I slept through the night prep, and when it was time to go back to the hostel, we all went back together to rest for the night.  

For the first time that night, I noticed a cluster of stars on the sky, they were in the sharp of a rosary, I asked Josiah my friend who we were walking together if he knew about the stars or had noticed them before and he replied saying that the stars he read are for Goodluck and divine protection, that anyone could wish for it to protect them from anything. That night, I wished silently to the stars never to face a day like that again. And till I left the school, that day stayed in record as my worst day in Keffi.

_Thank you for reading through my post. My name is@rishagamo, and above is my response to the week’s prompt 27 “WISH UPON A STAR”_

# [EN]




Upon arriving in Maceió, before checking in, we stopped at a restaurant for lunch. In this region, it’s common to find many self-service restaurants without scales. We chose Sauaçuhy, where the all-you-can-eat price is R$ 35.00 (about $7).

The protein options are limited to two choices, but it’s still possible to put together a very generous plate. I chose two seafood dishes: sururu and cod.

The restaurant also stands out for its decor, filled with elements of Northeastern Brazilian culture, such as sculptures of cangaceiros and the traditional “flirtatious girl,” as well as various other handcrafted pieces. Right at the entrance, there’s a small fountain with little fish, which makes the atmosphere even more pleasant.

It was a great choice to stop at this restaurant, as we were able to eat well and enjoy high-quality food. Compared to other restaurants in the area, it offered excellent value for money, providing variety, good food, and a fair price—in my opinion, even cheaper than many other places.

I hope you enjoyed this little review!

----

# [PT]

Em nossa chegada à cidade de Maceió, antes de fazer o check-in, passamos em um restaurante para almoçar. Nessa região, é comum encontrar vários estabelecimentos no estilo self-service sem balança. Escolhemos o Sauaçuhy, onde o preço para comer à vontade é de R$ 35,00 (cerca de $7).

A proteína é limitada a duas opções, mas ainda assim é possível montar um prato muito bem servido. Eu escolhi dois pratos de frutos do mar: sururu e bacalhau.

O restaurante também chama atenção pela decoração, repleta de elementos da cultura nordestina, como esculturas de cangaceiros e da tradicional “menina namoradeira”, além de diversas outras peças artesanais. Logo na entrada, há uma pequena fonte com peixinhos, que deixa o ambiente ainda mais agradável.

Foi uma ótima escolha parar nesse restaurante, pois conseguimos comer bem e com qualidade. Em comparação com outros restaurantes da região, ele apresentou um excelente custo-benefício, oferecendo variedade, boa comida e um preço justo — na minha opinião, até mais barato que muitos outros locais.

Espero que tenham gostado desse pequeno relato!

---

title.title: 獎盃終究只是過往雲煙
title.body:
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbS7HMNVR8gxA5XioZJsi3DTgEMA9R7BMffRs2RR8B3sq/image.png)

星期二晚上那一戰，打得特別激烈。我們的隊伍 Picklers 對上 Sun Peaks Pickleball Club，從對戰表一出來，大家就知道這不是一場輕鬆的比賽。

在這場比賽之前，我們暫居聯盟第一，他們排名第二，都是這個 League 裡公認的強隊。他們打其他隊幾乎都佔盡上風，只是曾經輸給過 Pickle Ninjas；而我們，則是有過險勝 Pickle Ninjas 的紀錄。從紙面實力來看，這一場基本上就是決賽等級的對決。

沒想到第一個 set 一開打，我們就被打得很慘。問題其實出在我身上，求勝心太重，每一球都揮得太用力，結果球頻頻出界，完全幫不上忙。對方穩定輸出，而我們一直送分，那個 set 幾乎沒有懸念就輸掉了。

這到了第二個 set，我開始刻意收斂力道，不再追求每一球都打死對手。球雖然沒那麼強，但至少能留在場內，來回變多，比賽也終於拉近了一些。比分咬得更緊了，但最後還是差了一口氣，又輸掉了第二個 set。

這時候，我的隊友其實已經有點放棄了。時間有限，前兩個 set 都輸，怎麼看都不像有翻盤的機會。我跟他說，別放棄，只要追到 2 比 2，就是平手。他一臉不相信，因為整場比賽只有 45 分鐘，這時大概只剩下 20 分鐘，要連贏兩個 set，真的很困難。

但我還是對他說，要拿獎盃本來就不是一件容易的事。如果這麼容易，每個人家裡早就都擺滿獎盃了。

於是我們就這樣硬著頭皮拚下去。第三個 set，我們幾乎把能做的都做到了，專注、穩定、少失誤，一分一分追，終於扳回一城。到了第四個 set，兩個人都已經累到不行，但腦袋反而變得異常清楚，只知道不能再送分。最後在時間結束前，我們居然把比數追成了 2 比 2 平手。

45 分鐘一到，比分定格。雖然是平手，但因為我在這場比賽之前的整體戰績比較好，按照規則，獎盃最後判給了我們。真的只差那麼一點點，稍微再打差一點，今天就什麼都沒有了。

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdCBC9Lr1rMex9c7sPbjZ76LfC9wrown2TfwfKwWoTfMJ/image.png)

獎盃拿到手之後，我把照片分享到臉書和 Instagram，加起來大概也就一百個左右的讚，然後高興了一兩天。上一次拿網球比賽的獎盃，已經是十七年前的事了。到現在這個年紀，還能在場上拚、還能贏下一座獎盃，其實心裡是很滿足的。

當然，我也很清楚，這些終究都只是過往雲煙。就算你拿過網球的 Grand Slam，過幾年也未必還有人記得，何況只是這樣一個小小的聯賽冠軍。它的意義，大概也就是留給自己的一點 confidence boost，放進記憶裡，在某個平凡的日子突然想起來，然後會心一笑。

title.body: > Presentamos la trayectoria de **Los Hermanos Rodríguez**, el trío que elevó la interpretación romántica en Venezuela a niveles de excelencia internacional en la era dorada de nuestra televisión.

> We present the trajectory of **Los Hermanos Rodríguez**, the trio that raised romantic performance in Venezuela to levels of international excellence during the golden age of our television. -----
[English version below!](#english-version)
----- ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/musicavenezuela/AJJe9aeiR7Zqt8ReFqxJx49qFs5oFy3nk3N7qrLQGL94NUda9Moi4FNoiNFg8h3.png) # Los Hermanos Rodríguez: La excelencia del trío romántico venezolano

> La agrupación **Los Hermanos Rodríguez** constituye una de las instituciones más respetadas de la música romántica en Venezuela. Su trayectoria artística inició formalmente en la década de los 70, logrando un debut de alto impacto al presentarse en **El Show de Renny**, el programa más influyente de la televisión venezolana de aquel entonces. Esta plataforma, dirigida por Renny Ottolina, era el estándar de calidad de la industria, y la aceptación inmediata de **Los Hermanos Rodríguez** por parte del público y la crítica los posicionó como los nuevos portavoces de la canción romántica en el país. Con una propuesta basada en melodías interpretadas con una técnica impecable, **Los Hermanos Rodríguez** fueron figuras recurrentes en los principales espacios de radio y televisión. Su dominio del formato de trío —caracterizado por armonías vocales cerradas y el virtuosismo en las cuerdas— les permitió compartir tarima con las leyendas más grandes del bolero y la balada a nivel mundial. En importantes espectáculos, compartieron escenario con figuras de la talla de **Pedro Vargas**, **Armando Manzanero**, **Lucho Gatica** y **Chucho Avellanet**, además de medirse con instituciones del género como el trío **Los Panchos**, manteniendo siempre un nivel de ejecución que los situaba a la par de sus pares internacionales. El éxito de **Los Hermanos Rodríguez** trascendió las fronteras nacionales de manera contundente. Su calidad interpretativa les permitió llevar el nombre de Venezuela a escenarios de Estados Unidos, Puerto Rico, México, Colombia y España. En cada una de estas plazas, la agrupación fue reconocida por su capacidad para mantener viva la esencia del bolero, aportando una elegancia y una frescura que permitieron que el género siguiera vigente frente a las corrientes musicales de la época. Sus actuaciones internacionales consolidaron la imagen del músico venezolano como un intérprete de gran técnica y sensibilidad artística. Hoy en día, el legado de **Los Hermanos Rodríguez** representa un capítulo fundamental de la interpretación vocal en Venezuela. Su historia es la de una formación que custodió una forma de hacer música que privilegia el sentimiento y la perfección técnica por encima de las modas. Al ser referentes indiscutibles de la música romántica, establecieron un estándar de calidad que sirve de guía para comprender el valor de la armonía y la lírica bien cuidada. La permanencia de su obra demuestra que el romanticismo, cuando es ejecutado con la maestría de **Los Hermanos Rodríguez**, es un lenguaje universal que permanece en la memoria cultural de la nación. -----

> ### Los Hermanos Rodríguez: The Excellence of the Venezuelan Romantic Trio The group **Los Hermanos Rodríguez** constitutes one of the most respected institutions of romantic music in Venezuela. Their artistic career formally began in the 1970s, achieving a high-impact debut by appearing on **El Show de Renny**, the most influential program on Venezuelan television at the time. This platform, directed by Renny Ottolina, was the industry's quality standard, and the immediate acceptance of **Los Hermanos Rodríguez** by the public and critics positioned them as the new spokespersons for romantic songs in the country. With a proposal based on melodies performed with impeccable technique, **Los Hermanos Rodríguez** were recurring figures in major radio and television spaces. Their mastery of the trio format—characterized by tight vocal harmonies and virtuosity on the strings—allowed them to share the stage with the greatest legends of bolero and ballads worldwide. In major shows, they shared the stage with figures such as **Pedro Vargas**, **Armando Manzanero**, **Lucho Gatica**, and **Chucho Avellanet**, in addition to measuring themselves against institutions of the genre like the trio **Los Panchos**, always maintaining a level of performance that placed them on par with their international peers. The success of **Los Hermanos Rodríguez** transcended national borders in a resounding way. Their interpretative quality allowed them to take Venezuela's name to stages in the United States, Puerto Rico, Mexico, Colombia, and Spain. In each of these venues, the group was recognized for its ability to keep the essence of bolero alive, providing an elegance and freshness that allowed the genre to remain relevant against the musical currents of the time. Their international performances consolidated the image of the Venezuelan musician as a performer of great technique and artistic sensitivity. Today, the legacy of **Los Hermanos Rodríguez** represents a fundamental chapter of vocal interpretation in Venezuela. Their story is that of a group that guarded a way of making music that privileges feeling and technical perfection above trends. As indisputable references of romantic music, they established a quality standard that serves as a guide to understanding the value of harmony and well-crafted lyrics. The permanence of their work demonstrates that romanticism, when executed with the mastery of **Los Hermanos Rodríguez**, is a universal language that remains in the nation's cultural memory. #
