title.title: El síndrome de la cebolla: cuando sanar se vuelve una trampa 🧅
title.body:
Publicado en Español, Inglés y Portugués.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYYoaEnLZsLrDHUwoZBRWYUTb7Gz6pd5GegCTVLp6NncY/1775786596132.png) *Editado en PhotoCollage*


Buenas noches, dulces sueños para todos.

Si bien es cierto que nuestro crecimiento y desarrollo personal es algo que nos hace mejores, esto no se debe convertir en un problema y menos en enfermedad.

Hay una imagen que circula en silencio por los pasillos del desarrollo personal. No aparece en los libros ni en los cursos. Es la imagen de una persona que lleva años \

y que, en el fondo, sigue sintiendo que hay algo mal.

Hay quienes empiezan con un libro de autoestima. Luego van a terapia. Después el retiro de silencio. Cuando eso no resulta, más tarde se preparan para el curso de constelaciones familiares y luego otro terapeuta, otra corriente y otro diagnóstico más preciso.

Sin embargo siguen ahí, sentados en la alfombra de su habitación, con un cuaderno nuevo, buscando la siguiente capa.

Se llama síndrome de la cebolla, si, porque la cebolla tiene muchas capas, y la promesa es que pelándolas todas se llega al corazón limpio. Pero hay algo lúgubre en esto y es que algunas personas se acostumbran tanto a pelar que ya no saben vivir sin el dolor del cuchillo.

Les puedo asegurar que el el problema no es sanar. El verdadero problema es cuando la identidad entera se vuelve \

o cuando la paz da desconfianza. Llega a ser tan grave que un día tranquilo se siente como un fracaso, porque no hubo ninguna herida que atender.

Esa persona ha aprendido a nombrarlo todo, nombra la sombra, el niño herido, el patrón transgeneracional, el apego evitativo. Lo hace con precisión clínica, sin embargo, sigue igual de atrapada, solo que ahora con más vocabulario.

Hay una diferencia enorme entre sentir alivio y sentir que por fin se ha llegado. Y el síndrome de la cebolla consiste justo en eso, confundir el movimiento con el avance.

Quizás lo más revolucionario que puede hacer alguien atrapado en este ciclo no sea otro curso ni otra introspección. Eso que impera hacer es  preguntarse: ¿Y si ya no me falta nada por descubrir? ¿Y si este silencio incómodo no es una carencia, sino una cita conmigo mismo sin disfraces?

Caros amigos, a veces la última capa de la cebolla no es un trauma ni una creencia limitante. Puede ser solamente quedarse quieto. 

Existe pánico, casi terror a descubrir que, sin el proyecto de sanarse, no queda mucho.

Y no es que se trate de abandonar el camino, lo que debe hacer de dejar de correr sobre él.

Esa persona de la que hablamos merece saber que también es válido un martes sin análisis o una tarde de sofá sin metáforas psicológicas. Que puede haber un día en que llorar sea solo llorar, y no una \
.\n\nLa verdadera sanación, a veces, no es soltar otra capa \

Amigos, si por casualidad se han identificado con esto, pues el post sirve para recordarte que ya estás completo, aunque duela aceptarlo.

En unos días estaré abordando el mismo tema desde otra perspectiva.

---
---


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPioZKWPc3STML2a1iV8y8o3y7Ayv6wXZdNk6AeXJaENj/1758503903035.jpg)


---
---

# *ENGLISH*

---
---

Good evening, sweet dreams to everyone.

While it is true that our growth and personal development make us better, this should not become a problem, much less an illness.

There is an image that circulates silently through the hallways of personal development. It doesn't appear in books or courses. It is the image of a person who has spent years \

and yet, deep down, still feels that something is wrong.

Some start with a self-help book. Then they go to therapy. Then a silent retreat. When that doesn’t work, they later prepare for a family constellations course, then another therapist, another approach, and another more precise diagnosis.

Yet they remain there, sitting on the rug in their room, with a new notebook, searching for the next layer.

It's called onion syndrome, yes, because the onion has many layers, and the promise is that by peeling them all, you reach the clean core. But here’s the grim part: some people get so used to peeling that they no longer know how to live without the pain of the knife.

I can assure you, the problem is not healing. The real problem is when your entire identity becomes \

or when peace breeds distrust. It can become so severe that a calm day feels like a failure, because there was no wound to tend to.

That person has learned to name everything — they name the shadow, the wounded inner child, the transgenerational pattern, the avoidant attachment. They do so with clinical precision, yet they remain just as trapped, only now with more vocabulary.

There is a huge difference between feeling relief and feeling that you have finally arrived. And the onion syndrome consists precisely of that: confusing movement with progress.

Perhaps the most revolutionary thing someone trapped in this cycle can do is not another course or another introspection. What they urgently need to do is ask themselves:

What if I lack nothing left to discover? What if this uncomfortable silence is not a lack, but a date with myself without any masks?

Dear friends, sometimes the last layer of the onion is not a trauma or a limiting belief. It might simply be staying still.

There is panic, almost terror, at discovering that, without the project of healing oneself, not much remains.

And it's not about abandoning the path; it's about stopping running on it.

That person we speak of deserves to know that a Tuesday without analysis or an afternoon on the couch without psychological metaphors is also valid. That there can be a day when crying is just crying, and not a \
\n\nTrue healing, sometimes, is not about letting go of another \
layer. It is necessary to simply allow yourself to say: \

Friends, if by chance you have identified with this, then this post serves to remind you that you are already complete, even if it hurts to accept it.

In a few days, I will be addressing the same topic from another perspective.

---
---


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPioZKWPc3STML2a1iV8y8o3y7Ayv6wXZdNk6AeXJaENj/1758503903035.jpg)


---
---

# *PORTUGUÉS*

---
---



Boa noite, bons sonhos para todos.

Embora seja verdade que o nosso crescimento e desenvolvimento pessoal nos tornam melhores, isso não deve se tornar um problema, muito menos uma doença.

Há uma imagem que circula silenciosamente pelos corredores do desenvolvimento pessoal. Ela não aparece nos livros nem nos cursos. É a imagem de uma pessoa que passa anos \

e que, no fundo, continua sentindo que há algo errado.

Há quem comece com um livro de autoestima. Depois vai para a terapia. Em seguida, um retiro de silêncio. Quando isso não resolve, mais tarde se preparam para o curso de constelações familiares e depois outro terapeuta, outra abordagem e um diagnóstico mais preciso.

No entanto, continuam ali, sentados no tapete do seu quarto, com um caderno novo, procurando a próxima camada.

Chama-se síndrome da cebola, sim, porque a cebola tem muitas camadas, e a promessa é que descascando todas elas se chega ao núcleo limpo. Mas o lado sombrio disto é que algumas pessoas se habituam tanto a descascar que já não sabem viver sem a dor da faca.

Posso garantir-vos que o problema não é curar. O verdadeiro problema é quando a identidade inteira se torna \

ou quando a paz gera desconfiança. Pode tornar-se tão grave que um dia tranquilo parece um fracasso, porque não houve nenhuma ferida a tratar.

Essa pessoa aprendeu a dar nome a tudo – nomeia a sombra, a criança interior ferida, o padrão transgeracional, o apego evitativo. Faz isso com precisão clínica, no entanto, continua igualmente presa, só que agora com mais vocabulário.

Há uma diferença enorme entre sentir alívio e sentir que finalmente se chegou. E a síndrome da cebola consiste exatamente nisso: confundir movimento com progresso.

Talvez a coisa mais revolucionária que alguém preso neste ciclo possa fazer não seja outro curso nem outra introspeção. O que é urgente fazer é perguntar-se:

E se eu já não tiver nada para descobrir? E se este silêncio incómodo não for uma carência, mas um encontro comigo mesmo sem disfarces?

Caros amigos, às vezes a última camada da cebola não é um trauma nem uma crença limitante. Pode ser simplesmente ficar quieto.

Existe pânico, quase terror, em descobrir que, sem o projeto de se curar, não resta muito.

E não se trata de abandonar o caminho, mas sim de parar de correr sobre ele.

Essa pessoa de quem falamos merece saber que também é válido ter uma terça-feira sem análises ou uma tarde de sofá sem metáforas psicológicas. Que pode haver um dia em que chorar seja apenas chorar, e não uma \
.\n\nA verdadeira cura, às vezes, não é largar outra camada \

Amigos, se por acaso se identificaram com isto, então este post serve para vos lembrar que já estão completos, mesmo que doa aceitá-lo.

Dentro de alguns dias, estarei a abordar o mesmo tema de outra perspetiva.

title.title: Amigurumi Carl Fredicksen (Up)
title.body:
> Saludos querida comunidad, seguramente muchos de ustedes conocerán al personaje de Carl Fredicksen de la película Up conocida en en Latinoamérica como Una aventura de altura, esta historia animada es enternecedora y plantea muchos temas importantes de la vida, como el amor y las promesas incumplidas pero también el pasar rápido del tiempo y lo corta que es la vida cuando se tienen tantos sueños, también mueve un terma sensible que es la soledad tanto en vejez como en la niñez, pues este señor encuentra un verdadero amigo en un niño de buen corazón que está dispuesto ayudarlo y que como el también pasa mucho tiempo solo, por su parte el señor vive con un duelo silencioso por la perdía de su esposa Ellie quien lo acompañó casi toda la vida y que gracias a ese niño llamado Russel logra sobrellevar. Por tal motivo cuando recibí el encargo de hacer este personaje junto con su esposa casi salto de la emoción, así que hoy les comparto un poco de mi experiencia con la figura de Carl pues a Ellie aun no comienzo a hacerla 😊 > Greetings, dear community! Many of you are surely familiar with the character of Carl Fredricksen from the movie Up, known in Latin America as Una aventura de altura (A High-Flying Adventure). This animated story is heartwarming and raises many important themes about life, such as love and broken promises, but also the rapid passage of time and how short life is when you have so many dreams. It also touches on the sensitive topic of loneliness, both in old age and in childhood, as this man finds a true friend in a kind-hearted boy who is willing to help him and who, like him, also spends a lot of time alone. For his part, Carl lives with a silent grief for the loss of his wife, Ellie, who was by his side for almost his entire life, and it is thanks to this boy, Russell, that he manages to cope. Therefore, when I received the commission to create this character along with his wife, I almost jumped for joy! So today I'm sharing a bit of my experience with the Carl figure, as I haven't started Ellie yet. 😊
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/irenenavarroart/Ep5qbDKKYY4JmjChgLARQC1EU7uKWCR7LygAoW6qGDvarNw3B3aizSC3HAE9EXZGRRA.jpg https://i.imgur.com/iJNYddI.png

Proceso / Process

Este amigurumi me lo pidieron grande , al menos de 20 cm, el resulto final terminó siendo de 23cm, pero me encantó trabajar este formato, yo ya he trabajado otras figuras humanas en amigurumis mas pequeños, lo he hecho con una hebra de hilo acrílico y ganchillo de 1.25, por tal motivo lo que hice para hacer este fue trabajar con hebra doble y ganchillo de 2.5mm, hice algunas pequeñas modificaciones pero en general el proceso resultó tal como lo esperaba en cuando al cuerpo, comencé los zapatos con negro, luego con el pantalón de un tono de café claro, hice el cinturón de color café oscuro, el torso de la camisa en blanco, hice aparte los brazos y los uní al torso para trabajar en conjunto y poder introducir alambre en los brazos, luego hice las disminuciones para los hombros y hasta llegar al cuello. > This amigurumi was requested to be large, at least 20 cm, but the final result was 23 cm. I loved working with this size. I've already worked on other human figures in smaller amigurumi, using a strand of acrylic yarn and a 1.25 mm crochet hook. Therefore, for this one, I used a double strand and a 2.5 mm hook. I made a few small modifications, but overall the process turned out as I expected. For the body, I started with black shoes, then the pants in a light brown shade. I made the belt in dark brown, the torso of the shirt in white, and the arms separately. I then attached them to the torso to work together and insert wire into the arms. Finally, I made the decreases for the shoulders and worked my way up to the neck.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/irenenavarroart/AK2EKtHVFV2c8sza53vzu96LbvP2mqaW2fkdRST35UVXwobXx1ndL9mjxCeXahG.jpg https://i.imgur.com/iJNYddI.png
Aunque el personaje original proporciones del cuerpo un poco peculiares y no quería ser exagerada hice la figura un poco mas alargada, pero la cabeza quería que conservara un poco de lo cuadrado del personaje original, pero no tanto como parecer un funko, así que los aumentos para la parte de debajo de la cabeza los hice en cuadrado, pero la parte superior si hice las disminuciones en circulo. Me di cuenta por imágenes referenciales que muchas personas hacen el cabello blanco, pero yo no quería hacerlo completamente blanco así que decidí hacerlo con una hebra gris y una hebra de blanco a la vez, el resultado me encantó pues realmente parece el cabello canoso de una persona mayor. > Although the original character had somewhat unusual body proportions, and I didn't want to exaggerate, I made the figure a little longer. I wanted the head to retain some of the original character's square shape, but not so much that it looked like a Funko Pop. So, I made the increases for the lower part of the head square, while the decreases for the upper part were circular. I noticed from reference images that many people make the hair white, but I didn't want to make it completely white, so I decided to do it with a gray strand and a white strand at the same time. I loved the result because it really looks like the gray hair of an older person.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/irenenavarroart/AK2DyvFiaqqGmeLsaYunWBpo496D2bHoeovsQSpFBu1114THcmbizTevy4zwx5q.jpg https://i.imgur.com/iJNYddI.png
Les cuento que cuando ya iba en este tramo del trabajo me sucedió algo muy lamentable, se me partió le ganchillo cuando estaba haciendo la ultima manga de la chaqueta, pude terminar solo esa parte tomando lo que había quedado del ganchillo porque no he podido comprar otro aun, pero los detalles como las cejas, los ojos, orejas, tirantes, corbatín e incluso la base tuve que usar un ganchillo de un tamaño mas pequeño, espero pode encontrar un ganchillo del tamaño que necesito para comenzar a hacer a Ellie la esposa muy pronto. > I have to tell you that when I was already at this stage of the work, something very unfortunate happened: my crochet hook broke while I was making the last sleeve of the jacket. I was only able to finish that part using what was left of the hook because I haven't been able to buy another one yet, but for the details like the eyebrows, eyes, ears, suspenders, bow tie, and even the base, I had to use a smaller crochet hook. I hope to find a crochet hook the size I need to start making Ellie, the wife, very soon.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/irenenavarroart/AJj1VczutF3GqtqsQaupj2zWmbEQ6fgxfg5V9kt4QR6WJjjmqfBJLovAj2zNkDf.jpg https://i.imgur.com/iJNYddI.png

Resultado / Result

>
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/irenenavarroart/AKchfodhvqrdCJPKXnUcFvgokkvbuSuwVASS1sfgqWANzPgDJdWchejqjAvpwY1.jpg https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/irenenavarroart/AKJ2tLhjvUL2hS79w4xezV2imPBWS8TsJC2TB6rDkUZZWyFnjU9Pm6QkaA4hznp.jpg https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/irenenavarroart/AKKUUTnvG8kTyTB51yS6pFziksbQV7EMTpRnSY2mVnmVvLQynkoD2GsknTuSa2m.jpg https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/irenenavarroart/AKU5DUbuSrC93U2oLpXofeiaiq4CeJ54Jr2nJCV1VHUeQBLA7FLTjUV7qLM1nbz.jpg https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/irenenavarroart/EpGUYzmQtKRuc4hM82h4nnGSquQFJ5rSnztAp8YC3D6aH5M3x2SVy6VK7gkAX7BJz6v.gif https://i.imgur.com/iJNYddI.png

title.title: My Actifict report: April 9, 2026 - A Beautiful Afternoon / Una Bonita Tarde
title.body:
###
*A Beautiful Afternoon*
After two weeks of heavy rain, the sun is shining again over my city, the ground is dry once more, and the roads are safe and pleasant to walk on, and so my walking routine returns in full force, not only to keep me physically healthy, but also to reconnect with the nature around me, breathe in some fresh air, and interact with an environment that is very comforting, where there is space for peace and rest.
>###
*Una Bonita Tarde*
>Después de dos semanas de intensas lluvias el sol vuelve a salir sobre mi ciudad, la tierra vuelve a estar seca y los caminos se pueden transitar de una forma segura y amigable, es así como mi rutina de caminatas regresa con todas sus fuerzas, no solo para mantenerme físicamente saludable, sino también para reencontrarme con la naturaleza que me rodea, respirar un poco de sire puro, e interactuar con un ambiente que resulta ser muy reconfortante, en donde se encuentra espacio para la tranquilidad y el descanso. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/4286c2ef-61e6-4c75-86df-e487cb605597.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/b474ccfa-65b5-4c77-bc67-86b82834f98b.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/fd137c42-1f0d-4f36-b753-186cea350d43.jpg) The rains brought with them a considerable increase in weeds; in some areas, the dirt path has practically disappeared, and in others, we see the sides of the houses turning green. This might seem somewhat picturesque, but it actually poses a multifaceted problem, as it contributes to the proliferation of insects and crawling creatures; that’s why you have to be very careful when walking, to avoid mishaps and scares. >Las lluvias trajeron consigo un aumento considerable de la maleza; en algunos sectores, el camino de tierra prácticamente ha desaparecido y en otros vemos cómo los costados de las casas se tornan de color verde. Quizás esto pueda parecer un tanto pintoresco, pero realmente se constituye en un problema de características diversas, ya que esto contribuye a la proliferación de insectos y animales rastreros; es por esta razón que al caminar también hay que tener bastante cuidado, para así evitar inconvenientes y sustos. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/47276225-1e8b-4e50-b624-cd5f3a1b1349.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/632122a1-394d-4853-b090-fc2ff8d1de4c.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/d836d099-c765-43d0-9411-a4dc8e7471cd.jpg) But no matter the circumstances, I’ve decided to go out and stretch my legs, testing my endurance while enjoying the simple yet interesting things life has to offer. I’ve seen how some construction projects continue to move forward at a good pace, and this fills me with satisfaction and hope, as urban development is gradually making its way into an area that needs to improve its quality of life. I also saw many trees, growing unchecked and casting large shadows while purifying the air we breathe every day. >Pero sin importar las circunstancias, he decidido salir y estirar las piernas, poniendo a prueba mi resistencia y al mismo tiempo disfrutando de las acciones sencillas pero interesantes que tiene esta vida. He visto cómo algunas construcciones siguen avanzando a buen ritmo y esto me llena de satisfacción y esperanzas, ya que poco a poco la urbanidad se va abriendo paso en medio de un sector que necesita avanzar en un mejoramiento en la calidad de vida. También vi muchos árboles, pero esperar y crecer de manera desenfrenada, generando grandes sombras y al mismo tiempo purificando el aire que día a día respiramos. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/801c94af-299e-4838-97a4-fa94abc3c5e3.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/3fb8f643-f931-48d6-b0b4-cad68bac976e.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/72e2facc-d02b-4d65-a620-0dd3b29b29ec.jpg)

title.body:
<center>![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g9d0c486fc7892e47a6bb697668efcbe899b9fef1b4e4acdb15d157e0982a46bfc4d3e87628798ced324a99f5bcd598b1e1df62fddcd4f67628fccde3fc658775_640.jpg)</center>

***

# The Tale of the Harmonious Village

## Once Upon a Time

In a small village nestled between two mountains, there lived a community known for its harmony. The villagers worked together, sharing their resources and celebrating each other's successes. They believed that harmony was the key to a happy life, and their peaceful existence attracted travelers from far and wide.

## The Gift of Harmony

One day, a wise old traveler visited the village and offered them a magical gift: a crystal that radiated harmony. The villagers were overjoyed and placed the crystal at the center of their village. From that day on, the harmony among them seemed to grow even stronger. Disputes were resolved quickly, and laughter filled the air.

## The Seeds of Discontent

However, as time passed, the villagers became complacent. They relied heavily on the crystal for their harmony, forgetting the effort it took to maintain their relationships. They stopped communicating openly, assuming that the crystal would solve any issues. Small disagreements began to fester, but the villagers ignored them, believing that harmony was guaranteed by the crystal's presence.

## The Shattering

One fateful day, the crystal shattered during a fierce storm. The villagers were devastated. Without the crystal, their harmony began to unravel. Old grievances resurfaced, and the once-united community found itself divided. Arguments erupted, friendships were strained, and the village that had thrived on cooperation was now filled with discord.

## The Path to True Harmony

Realizing the depth of their troubles, the villagers gathered to reflect on their situation. They understood that true harmony was not something that could be given or taken away; it had to be nurtured through communication, empathy, and effort. They began to talk openly about their feelings, address their grievances, and work together to rebuild their relationships.

## The Rebirth of Harmony

Slowly but surely, the villagers learned to appreciate the value of their connections. They discovered that harmony was not the absence of conflict but the ability to navigate it with respect and understanding. As they rebuilt their community, they found a deeper, more resilient harmony that was rooted in their shared experiences and mutual support.

## The Wisdom of the Village

The village learned that harmony is a delicate balance that requires constant care. They passed down this wisdom to future generations:

> **\

**

And so, the village thrived once more, not because of a magical crystal, but because of the genuine connections they had forged with one another. 

## Conclusion

In the end, the villagers discovered that true harmony comes from within and is cultivated through the relationships we nurture every day. Let us remember this tale as a reminder that harmony is a journey, not a destination.

title.title: Lina's Story, Musical Love
title.body:
Good afternoon, good evening, or good morning—it all depends on when you read this, my dear friend and reader. I've written a story for you; it's about Lina. It's about how she came to music almost unexpectedly. You'll see her progress and her rise in Buskeria. I hope you enjoy it. Let's begin.

> Buenas tardes, buenas noches o buenos días, todo depende cuando leas esto mi querido amigo y lector. He escrito una historia para ustedes, será sobre Lina. Trata sobre cómo llegó a la música de forma casi inesperada. Verán su progreso y su ascenso en Buskeria. Espero que les guste. Comenzamos.

<div class=\

> ![1775693294641.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omztech/23xeg3VAj7tPBgsT2kDhRVFmjdJpvzhn5LC139nepAcmsvPm2fDbjJGrYHXPj2yMjmjJY.jpg) Image created by me in canva The sun rose, time to get up and begin the daily chores. Lina did them almost automatically, without thinking, things she'd been doing for a long time. Cleaning the house, feeding the cats, and walking the dog. Then she'd go to her nail salon until she returned in the afternoon to do other things like preparing lunch and going to bed to start the same routine the next day. She lived alone, so she didn't have children to worry about; it was just one day on top of another. It was boring living in that cycle, but it gave her peace. At that point in her life, it had never even crossed her mind to one day be a pianist; in fact, she'd never played one or even seen one up close. But sometimes life is funny because it has surprises in store for you when you least expect them. Music was about to enter her life, and it was going to be in the form of a husband. Yes, a husband. She met Orlando at her nail salon. He was a rock guitarist, so he needed someone to paint his nails black for the concert he was planning to give in a few hours. It turned out his main stylist had a problem and couldn't make it, so he went to Lina's shop because it was nearby. > Salió el sol, es momento de levantarse y comenzar la faena de cada día. Ya Lina la hace casi automática y sin pensar, y que lleva mucho tiempo haciéndola. Limpiar la el hogar, darle de comer a los gatos y sacar a pasear al perro. Luego se iba a para su negocio de manicura hasta que regresaba por la tarde para seguir en otras faenas como preparar la comida y acostarse para al otro día comenzar la misma rutina. Ella vivía sola así que no tenía preocupaciones por hijos, era solo vivir un día más encima de otro. Era aburrido vivir en ese ciclo pero le daba tranquilidad. En ese punto de su vida a ella nunca se le había pasado siquiera por la cabeza ser un día una mujer pianista, de hecho nunca había tocado uno o haberlo visto muy de cerca. > Pero a veces la vida es graciosa por eso porque te tiene reservada las sorpresas que no te esperas en el momento que menos piensas. La música estaba a punto de entrar por su puerta e iba a ser en forma de un esposo. Si, un esposo. Conoció a Orlando en su propio negocio de manicura. El era un guitarrista de rock así que necesitaba que alguien le pintara las uñas de negro para el concierto que planeaba dar en unas horas. Resulta que su estilista principal tuvo un contratiempo y no pudo llegar así que acudió al negocio de Lina porque estaba cerca.

> ![rainon-qpPfopITtHs-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omztech/EpA3WeVYT2kDURXugXbu3kL5eSyYPL6K82h61N6iMqE9jdAragEnppyPC4yzg4W2P6G.jpg) [Source](www.pexels.com) While she was painting his nails for the concert, they started talking and hit it off. They had somewhat opposite personalities: he was reserved, and she was talkative. Although it seemed like an unlikely combination, opposites attract, and that's exactly what happened. The rest is history. After that encounter, they saw each other again. To justify going back to the salon, he fired the stylist so he could always be with Lina and continue seeing her and talking to her. In time, they confessed their love for each other and got married. He moved in with her. He didn't know it, but she immediately included him in her strict routine. But he wasn't upset; on the contrary, he found her routine a welcome escape from the chaos in his life. Lina's personality also changed him, transforming him from a reserved man into a talkative and friendly one, just like her. That's what rubbed off on him. But now it was time for her to pick up some of his traits. And that thing was music. She saw him rehearsing every day. Sometimes some friends would come over and play together, and she'd watch from a corner. She became increasingly involved in the music Orlando created. A point came when he began to notice her interest in music and suggested that if she wanted, he could teach her and train her. At first, she just laughed and thought it was a joke. But since she always paid close attention to how he played, he kept making the same offer. And those offers eventually convinced her that perhaps she could give it a chance. What she liked most was the piano, so the one who played it very well taught her. But it took her years to learn. Even then, she only played to clear her mind and sometimes take a break from her exhausting routine. But it turned out that when she learned to play well, she became frustrated because she didn't know what to do with the skill she had acquired. Orlando suggested she join his group. But she initially refused. Besides, she didn't want to break up his group just to join in. > Mientras ella le pintaba las uñas para el concierto comenzaron a conversar y conectaron muy bien. Cada uno tenía una forma de ser un poco opuesta el frio y ella conversadora. Aunque parece que eso no pega, las cosas opuestas se atraen y así pasó. Lo demás es historia, ellos luego de ese encuentro se volvieron a ver. Para poder justificar volver a ir al negocio despidió a la estilista, para así siempre ir con Lina y seguir viéndola y poder seguir conversando con ella. Con el tiempo ambos se declararon su amor y se casaron. El se fue a vivir con ella en su casa. El no lo sabía pero ella enseguida lo incluyó en su rutina estricta. Pero el no se enojó, al contrario le pareció buena su rutina para salir un poco del caos que tenía en su vida. También la personalidad de Lina lo hizo cambiar porque pasó de ser un hombre fio a uno conversador y amigable como ella lo era. Eso fue lo que se le pegó a el de ella. > Pero ahora era el momento de que a ella se le pegaran cosas de él. Y esa cosa era la música. Ella lo veía todos los días ensayando. A veces llegaban a la casa algunos amigos y tocaban juntos y ella miraba en una esquina. Cada vez estaba más presente en la música que creaba Orlando. Llegó un momento en el que el ya empezó a notar que ella tenía un interés por la música y le sugirió que si quería el la podía enseñar y preparar. En un inicio solo le dio risas y pensó que era broma de el. Pero como ella siempre prestaba atención como el tocaba el le volvía a hacer la misma propuesta. > Y esas propuestas la terminaron por convencer de que quizás podía darle una oportunidad. Lo que más le gustaba era el piano, así que el que sabía tocarlo muy bien le enseño. Pero le tomó años aprender. Aún así ella solo tocaba para despejar la mente y a veces descansar un poco de la rutina agotadora. Pero resulta que cuando aprendió a tocar bien se frustró, porque no sabía que hacer con aquella habilidad que había adquirido. Orlando le sugirió unirse a su grupo. Pero ella lo rechazó en un inicio. Además no quería romper el grupo de el solo para meterse ella.

> ![onur-kurt-XcQFn5PNEAo-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omztech/23wCG1FK7r9UBJi2bBcXorigfLBbF9KQqKgdZwWnW8Mv28BLMR46ptTgdVRbsuHU1vupQ.jpg) [Source](www.pexels.com) Orlando understood her, and he knew she didn't want to play because she was afraid he would fire his pianist, just as he had once fired his stylist. He knew that would have to happen if he wanted her to join the group. So, out of love for her and because he wanted her to be a pianist, he made a difficult decision. Instead of firing the pianist, he left the group himself with the sole purpose of creating a new group with Lina as the pianist. It was a complicated decision, but love makes any sacrifice. She felt a little bad seeing what he had done for her, but Orlando reassured her, telling her that better times would come for both of them. And that the most important thing was to stay together. The ending was wonderful for both of them, with them forming a duo and conquering every stage in Buskeria, and that's how love brought music to their doorstep. > Orlando la entendía también que el sabía que ella no quería tocar porque tenía miedo de que el despidiera a su pianista como una vez hizo con su estilista. El sabía que eso tendría que pasar si quería unirla al grupo. Así que tomó una decisión difícil por amor a ella, y porque quería que fuera pianista. En vez de despedir al pianista el mismo dejó el grupo con el único objetivo de crear un nuevo grupo con Lina como pianista. Fue una decisión complicada pero por amor se hace cualquier sacrificio. > Ella se sintió un poco mal al ver esto que él había hecho por ella, pero Orlando la tranquilizó diciéndole que vendrán tiempos mejores para los dos. Y que lo más importante era seguir unidos. El final fue maravilloso para ambos, con ellos formando un dúo, y conquistando todos los escenarios de Buskeria, y así fue como el amor trajo la música a su puerta.

> ![Captura de pantalla (2566).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omztech/23xemxfLNya9HCyn4xwNSnumqSB7o8XQun2yvzXKuGY9bsq9VnKog2ish2uoQnEG7CL6n.png) # [Join](https://risingstargame.com) hive's most incredible game, Rising Star , today. **Don't miss the opportunity to become a Rising Star**.

Quiero empezar con una pregunta ¿ que es lo mejor del mundo ?
Cada cual tiene una respuesta distinta y la respuesta cambia dependiendo de lo que se está  viviendo 
Y para mí es mi familia, su amor , las personas que considero importantes, todo lo demás viene y va 
Hoy tuve que tomar una decisión quedarme descansando sin preocupaciones o estar al lado de mi familia y tomé el camino para mí el más aceptado ¡ Como el hogar no hay dos !
La vida está difícil,sobre todo en mi país , suceden muchas cosas pero mi  lugar seguro es mi hogar .
 Mi ideología personal hogar no es una construcción 🏡  ¡¡¡Hogar es la familia!!!
Yo hoy estoy insistiendo sobre la importancia de el hogar y la familia , recientemente me han pasado muchas cosas y solo mi familia (mi esposa y mi bebe Lukas ) sabe por lo que yo estoy pasando , como me siento y ellos me dan ese aliento de fuerza 
 No saben lo gratificante que es ver a tu esposa e hijo emocionarse por estar a tu lado  .
  Donde cada segundo vale oro
